I had Hill for chem1c in the summer, and as long as you go to class and put in some effort you'll be good. He's very clear with the material and enlightening on life in general, funny too. Questions are exactly like what he does in class, in fact, that's all he does. I loved him, glad I got to finish off the general chem series with him

Dr. Hill was an okay general chemistry professor. His teaching style comes directly from the book, but that isn't necessarily a bad thing. Many people complained that he didn't teach the concepts well at all, but that's why at the beginning of the quarter he said to study at least an hour per day. CHEM 1B isn't an easy A, so be glad if you do! :)

Professor Hill didn't always explain the concepts very well. He mainly did examples and worked out calculations on the board every class. His tests were difficult and the curve at the end was not very generous as many students had expected. It seems that the curve helped the students who did well on the final and not the other students.

He really does look like Paul Giamatti http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Giamatti.  Anyways, the guy is an Organic Chem God. He was so enthusiastic about Ochem compared to General Chemistry. Do the homework and understand the lecture examples and there is no reason you shouldn't pass his midterms.  Good luck people!
Quizzes were pretty much exactly what he said they would be on. Pretty short multiple choice midterms. Fair curves. Only problem is, it's a little hard to read his writing sometimes.

This guy is a pretty cool teacher. The curve for the class is usually nice :D Not organized AT ALL leave spaces between topics to add in more info. He makes his exams based off questions from the homework and practice exams. The class isn't too hard, just study and you'll do fine.

Prof Hill is a very easy prof. But he doesn't teach very efficiently at all, he wastes a lot of time talking about random stuff, or answering stupid questions from stupid people. We ended up not going over chapter 8 in 1A b/c of lost time! we had to squeeze that in in 1B making it harder! I got an A+ and I mostly just took notes from the book

He's not as easy as everyone says he is..u have to work hard but on the bright side he does know how to teach..I learned more chem from him than my 2 years of chem in high school... the curve is really nice...he bases it on how much a student improved

The BEST chemistry teacher hands down in the entire university. if you study hard and attend office hours to ask questions then there should be absolutely no reason why you cannot get a C, B, or even an A. dont listen to anyone that says he's too hard. those people are either really stupid or didnt try at all.

Professor Hill is a great teacher!! He knows his Organic Chemistry and is passionate about the subject. He tells you what will be on his midterms and finals. No tricks! Homework is a must in order to pass this class! He also offers plenty of help through office hours and review sessions! Take him!!

Had him for 1a and 112b. Gchem he was not that great it sounded like he hated his life, but he was clear and fair. For ochem he loved his job, he is straight forward and clear, if you like sarcasm you will like him. his tests were perfectly fair, I didnt get the best grade but i can't complain. do the homework on the syllabus and you will be fine.

Professor Hill is a very fair teacher. Attend SI, lecture, do homework and it's an easy A. He's very helpful in office hours and most of his exam questions will cover homework verbatim or lecture notes/examples especially if he says it's a "great homework question/example!" I learned more from this prof than any other professor.
Went to class 1/5 of the time and still ended up with an A+. Easy class.

Great professor. Students who complain aren't ready for college chemistry, and should reconsider majors. HIs exams were based directly off his homework problems. Helpful during office hours. Textbook use is a bit heavy.
Dr. Hill is a good professor, but if you're not following him closely in lecture it's easy to get lost.

Dr. Hill is awesome. One of my favorite professors from the chemistry department. He is really fair in testing, he basically tells you whats going to be on it. Just read the book and do problems and you should be fine. Also make use of office hours, theyre great!

Dr. Hill was a really easy professor. He is really helpful and if you pay attention and go to his lectures, you'll do really well on the midterms and final. Also go to his office hours, he's a really nice guy.

I am having a terrible experience in this class. Test questions are nothing like what is presented to you for practice and he tells you things will not be on midterms that in fact ARE! He is unclear with his information, though he is occasionally funny. My advice: read the book and learn on your own.
He teaches all over the place, not clear at all. Did not like this teacher

Professor Hill is one of the best professors I have had for chemistry at UCR. He definitely knows his stuff and is very good at explaining tough concepts, and is clear and easy to understand. I would definitely recommend people to take his class.

Very straight-forward and fair. Exam draws on problems similar to homework problems, so complete them all. If you can easily finish those, you'll do fine on his test. Stay ahead of lecture and you'll understand the content well and utilize his OH and review sessions.

professor Hill is a fair professor. Most test questions come directly from assigned homework so make sure you do the homework. His office hours are also extremely helpful. Dont put studying off till the night before the exam. Grades are ranked based on the best score in the class.

Very good at explaining concepts and covering only the things that are on the exams. Lectures are pretty entertaining, he can be funny sometimes. He just seems a bit disorganized. Tests are fair and the curve is also nice.
good professor. curve is pretty good.second midterm is extremely hard. Fair class. must take.
He can teach but his notes aren't organized. His lectures were pretty boring. His tests and quizzes are kinda hard. Reading and doing problems from the book helps a lot.

Really unorganized professor. His notes are so random and all over the place. There were some stuff that were on the test that he didn't even cover. Quizzes were hard. So basically, you have to study by yourself because Hill can't teach.

Horrible. Didn't cover half the material we were tested on. Words his test questions very diffcultly. Is usually rude when you ask a question in class and has an "im always right attitude" when he makes mistakes all too often. Avergage grade on the final was 50%
this man will do one type of problem for 3 weeks then have the nerve to not have one problem on the midterm. he will give you the ol' reach around avoid

His notes were unorganized. He got off topic very often. His midterms were way too long for the amount of time given. No practice midterms were given. Watch out for the phrase "you like that?" He tends to mock the class when you dont do well on a test. overall: TERRIBLE.

He's a good speaker. He's funny and makes sure that the class knows the material. His lectures are always interesting and full of practice problems. My high school chemistry class was harder than this. Plus, he really does look like Paul Giamatti.
Hate him he makes the tests way too long then he makes fun of the whole class for failing. The average grade in his class was a F

Dr Hill is not a hard teacher. He hints a lot of his exam questions and he does his best to try to help everyone. If you are sincerely trying your best he will help your grade out. Go to class everyday because it is truly helpful. Also, he is not boring at all. Funny but not boring.

I wouldn't say that the class was a joke but it definitely was more on the easier side. Now my High school chem class was a joke which was why I did not know anything about the subject. This was an excellent introductory course. His tests are fair and he explains everything in layman's terms. He was also funny and looks like Paul Giamatti.

This class was a joke. I never studied anything outside of the lecture notes, and got an A in the class. Very funny and brilliant teacher. Just go to lecture every day, pay attention, and you should do well.

Very funny teacher. I loved his choice of wording and his hilarious attitude. Mole Day Rocked(Big Whoot)!!!!! Need to go to his office hours to actually know what is going to be on the test and to know what a great guy he is. Tough but Fair (wink,wink). Quizzes get hard, then easy, THEN HARD again. He loves to teach Chem so he's a great guy. -M&M
Easiest class ever! Don't even have to memorize anything unlike the other professors at this school!

Professor Hill is probably the best ochem teacher I had. By far he was the hardest. However, I recommend people take him. I never read the book but going to class and office hours, and doing as many homework problems as you can, will guarantee a good grade.
Dont expect to pass if you dont beat the averages on the midterms and final. But if you do the homework youll be alright.
He's a tough teacher, but fair. He's easy to understand so you don't really need the book. If you go to ALL his lectures, do the hw and do well on the quizzes you'll do fine in the class.

he's a great teacher! lectures were clear and straightforward. his lectures taught me more than the book ever could. tests were fair, some questions were straight from the hw so if you do the hw, you'll be fine. he doesn't allow cheat sheets but you actually don't need it for his tests. just go to lecture and do the hw, and you'll be fine =]
He's not a hard teacher, nor is he a easy teacher. He's in the middle, overall tough but fair.

Professor Hill is a very competent and fair instructor.  His exams are not easy, but there's a curve...  Despite a previous review, his lectures are as entertaining as they can be for O chem.  Many people were scared to take the "hard" teacher because he doesn't allow a notecard on test.  I also considered changing but now, I'm glad I didn't.

he's a fair teacher overall because he curves. But his test get progressively HARD and he puts weird reactions that you've never seen before. He'll admit it was a hard quesiton that nobody would get rigth but then puts it on the test anyways. He doesn't let you use any notecard or anything on his tests. Have to work hard! always willing to help
I think this is his first time teaching.  Overall, he's a pretty fair prof. He's funny sometimes... took this over the summer so lectures were long.
Read the chapter and do homework at night -- there will be plenty of time for sleep during lecture.  Bring a pillow, and he'll have you snoring before he finishes his first pointless ramble.
Keeping up with the readings and using the study guide provided by the professor will help you succeed. Some lectures were held on Zoom, which helped manage a busy schedule during the winter quarter.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Dylan Shaul is a wonderful professor. He knows a great deal about everything and can answer every question a student has to ask.
He is respects students' opinion and value contributions to discussion.
Dylan Shaul should be distinguished asap.

knowledgeable, an honor to be in his course,Phil154.quick to respond via email. Always willing to help. lectures can seem long at times but do the readings and stay engaged, itll b a good conversation. For essays, really just understand the readings and use the slides. great professor, need more like him. It is so cool how he is an author as well.

Professor Shaul was decent. This course does have some writing that can be complicated at first, but once you get the hang of it, it goes by ok. The in-class test was pretty straightforward, pretty much just copy and paste from the study guide. Sometimes the lectures tended to drag, however, so keep that in mind. Other than that, he was good.

He was chill, provided the text you needed to read, he would answer questions if you had them, but he wouldnt purposely give moments to discuss a concept until the end, again, only if you had questions. He explained the concepts well and provided the slides he created. Attendance was a small portion of the grade and was only taken in discussion.
He's nice, lectures are non-mandatory and his slides highlight everything you need to know about the class, so you really don't have to go to lecture anyways. he's really passionate about the course.

If you can, try to avoid taking his lectures in the night. He only has a short paper, in-class test, and final paper, but everything is dependent on the lecture slides and what he talks about. Topics aren't that hard to understand, but readings are super dense, so pray you get a good TA. Discussions are mandatory for your grade, so don't skip.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: BE AWARE THAT THESE REVIEWS ARE INACCURATE. Puig is an awesome dude, but barely sentient. Entire class was getting 50s on exams and that was considered the norm. Explains things in an extremely convoluted way. He does curve at the end though, it's just a stressful wild card semester. I'd avoid if possible.

I think Puig is a really nice guy. However, his class was the most difficult class I have ever taken. I didn't understand when he would explain things at all. I think it's because he's so smart and on a higher level of thinking than the average student, so he would overly-complicate the material. His tests are 3 hard questions. Wouldn't recommend.
Interesting Professor.
Very positive experience.
Don't miss any single class, since the most relevant problems for exams are those solved during class. Textbook is not that useful.
Excellent teacher overall.

His dynamic teaching style demystified complex topics, making learning enjoyable. Though I initially grappled with the material, his patience and extra assistance made a huge difference. Their focus on real-world applications truly broadened my perspective. I'm grateful for the enlightening journey through this course.
I would take his class again and again! I really learned a lot. I regret not having been sufficiently prepared to fully appreciate his classes.

Professor Puig's Calculus 2 teaching was exceptional. Engaging style made complex concepts understandable. Personalized guidance and focus on real-world applications enhanced my grasp of the subject. Highly recommended for a supportive and enriching learning experience.
Great Professor!

Professor Puig's Calculus 2 teaching was exceptional. Engaging style made complex concepts clear. Supportive guidance and real-world applications boosted understanding. Highly recommended for an enriching learning experience.

Professor Puig excels in teaching Calculus 2. Their clear explanations and supportive guidance made complex concepts easier to grasp. Emphasis on practical applications boosted my understanding. Their availability for extra help outside class was invaluable. Highly recommended!

Professor Puig's brilliance shines through in every lecture. His exceptional organizational skills create a seamless learning experience. Always receptive to feedback, he consistently implements suggestions, fostering an environment that evolves with students' needs and enriches our learning journey

Professor Puig's teaching style is transformative. His respect for students as independent thinkers creates a vibrant learning atmosphere. Emphasizing critical thinking, he instills a passion for analytical exploration. An exceptional educator for those craving intellectual stimulation and growth.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Puig embodies excellence in teaching. He fosters an environment where students are respected and encouraged to think critically. His focus on analysis over memorization is invaluable for those seeking a deeper understanding. A fantastic choice for students aiming to grow intellectually.

Puig genuinely care about students, and prioritize analyzing over memorization in class structure. I understand that some students who prefer an easier approach may not appreciate this. However, for those seeking a deeper understanding and a professor who challenges them to think critically, Prof Puig is an excellent choice.

Professor Puig de Dios' teaching in Calculus I is exceptional. Clear explanations, though exams were very tough, specially the third midterm. However, very generous grading reduced stress, allowing focus on learning. Group work was very helpful. Very highly recommended!!!

Professor Puig's dedication and expertise in teaching Calculus I were exemplary. His clear explanations and engaging teaching style made complex concepts understandable. Their commitment to student success was evident throughout the course. Outstanding instructor!

Genuinely the worst professor I have ever had. Puig is absolutely incompetent as an instructor and will make you suffer for it. Nearly half of my class dropped the course because of Puig's seeming goal of making all of his students fail (last time I checked calc 1 is not a weed-out course). If you ever get Puig as a professor switch out immediately

Puig is a nice guy but not a great teacher. He often doesn't explain concepts clearly and just expects you to accept what he's saying. He is not generous about giving partial credit on exams, but he seems to mostly grade homework by completion. He assigned very little homework.

This professor is not the best lecturer. He often diverges to odd tangents, and he fails to explain the material clearly. His discrete class was not particularly difficult, but I did not find myself learning all that much. He clearly cares a lot about his students, but his teaching is not particularly effective.

Puig is a very interesting professor to say the least. In his lectures, he starts taking attendance mid-sentence. He also really likes to know the background and culture of your name which shows that he cares about his students. Overall, really nice professor and generous grader, just hard af tests.

RUN!He's a cool person but usually just teaches to students who already took Calc. He refuses to give good practice problems cause it will just "give us the answers". Midterms are two questions. If you miss any part of a question, it affects you greatly. He is set in his teaching style and will blame you for not knowing (even if he didn't teach it)

Absolutely terrible. Professor isn't accessible outside of class at all(doesn't even have in person office hours) and throws weird curveballs on exams just because. Class was generally an ordeal and not fulfilling whatsoever.

This discrete math course was fascinating! The focus on isomorphisms and proofs really challenged my critical thinking skills. The prof's emphasis on interdisciplinary approaches made the course even more valuable. I appreciated the unique final project where I was able to do research and present my findings. Excellent course. Highly recommended!

This calculus 1 professor has a teaching style that emphasizes understanding over memorization. His unique approach motivated me to delve into the concepts in depth, which has never happened before. Overall, an exceptional educator who has helped me overcome my struggles in math.

He really cares about his students, takes the time to explain difficult concepts and makes sure that everyone understands before moving on. Overall, he encourages analytical thinking among his students, that's why some students might give him critical reviews if they are taking calc as a core course but I personally appreciated his teaching style.

Puig is honestly a nice dude. However, he's kind of a bozo and often devolves into tangents that are unnecessary. For example, stories about his failed marriages are weird and not relevant to class. If you haven't taken calculus before, don't take this class. He is incompetent as a teacher and should seriously stop getting hired by universities.

Big on proofs and concepts over examples and application. Few homeworks and tests. His Calculus 1 class was frustrating, but he shines in Discrete Math. Notices when students are lost and takes time to explain. If you want to be excited to go to class and get an easy A/B, take Puig. Very well rounded man, funny, cares about his students as people.

Do. Not. Do. It. You will learn absolutely nothing and be confused the whole time. The only way to get by is watching Youtube videos and teaching yourself everything. Refused to explain problems, give practice problems for the exam or go over concepts again. I took this as a GE and thought it would be an easy A as I've done calc before, its not!

Honestly this class was so rough as a student who hadn't taken Calc before. We only had 3 homeworks, 2 midterms, and 1 final which was nice but he teaches in a way that didn't make sense to me and I found myself frustrated and confused most classes. He is a really nice professor but probably not the best option for non-math people.

If you did not take Calculus in high school, do not take Professor Puig de Dios. He is a very nice, genuine guy, but a very hard professor. I did not take Calc in high school and was completely lost. The class is not run very structured, and I was confused almost every class. Person wise he is great, but Professor wise I would not recommend.

Yunied is very different from many professors. For starters, he only assigned 1 hw the whole course. He told us what to expect for the exams. So we had to put in some effort to pass the class, but it made many students easily pass without learning much at the same time. So you really have to be on top of the material at his pace to keep up.

Worst professor ever. He doesn't answer questions and makes students feel bad about asking them, is mean to students. He can't teach and doesn't show any of his steps. Tests are hard. Goes on tangents about nothing. Overall f****ing sucks avoid him

This professor actually cared for his students. He provides many opportunities in which you could get extra credit (doing problems on the board, going to events, small presentation etc). He would not give excessive hw. Midterm and final were good if you attend lectures and office hours
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Overall his class was pretty easy, if you go he tells you the what to expect on the midterm and final. He is kind of hard to understand due to his accent. He is willing to work with you if you want extra credit (ex: he let a student present a powerpoint on r&b for extra credit). Homework is very simple.

He taught this class for the first time. He did it very poorly. The class was made of 2 quizzes, 1 group project, and a midterm. He gave us the quiz and midterm questions ahead of time, so those were very easy to do well or at least pass. The group project was very much NOT clear and it was irritating that he kept talking during presentations.

Good professor with very fair grading. I had him for MATH009A and its pretty easy to get an A. Had an 100% in the class before the final. He had 5 scheduled discussion quizzes in which he drops the lowest one. Homework he gave out very sparingly which was nice. Curved the midterm and basically told us what was on the final if you went to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Every interaction with this dude was unpleasant. I'd say 75% of the class stopped attending which he took note of by making his tests consist of OVERLY difficult problems that he worked through during an entire lecture instead of structuring them off the homeworks. Hope for a good TA because his lectures are super unorganized.

Yunied was a great teacher and really cares about his students doing well. Just stop by in his office hours and ask for help, youll be sure to do great in the class. He tries his best and the way he structures his classes make it simple and easy for students to follow along. Overall hes a really cool guy and really smart.

Yunied is an interesting guy. He cares about you understanding the concepts in the class, but he doesn't do that many example problems. For our class, he allowed us to write our own final problems. He also set the due date for homework at the end of the quarter, which I didn't like since it encouraged procrastination on my part.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He was terrible. He was very sporadic and not organized whatsoever, and many things were unclear even after students asking many many questions. He's hard to understand and hard to follow. He would talk during the midterm and final, which was super irritating! The only thing I enjoyed was how the homework was sort of "do it at your own pace".

It was his first year teaching so it was a rough quarter. I took calculus in high school so my previous knowledge got me by. He was hard to understand and everything was very unorganized. I wouldn't take his class again. I failed the first midterm but whatever score you got on the final replaced the midterm score and vice versa with the midterm.
The professor for this class was amazing. All you have to do is the work and you will be prepared for the midterm and finals. She is very clear and willing to be there for you as a student.
Dr Dubcovsky is a fantastic lecturer who makes you feel enveloped. The course was fine and I loved how she would care and advise me.

Dubcovsky clearly shows her love of the material through her lectures. Super enthusiastic and caring for her students and always ready to help. As long as you show up and do the work, you will have a fun time in her class.
Best professor ever. Super enthusiastic, and the material was engaging. Honestly just put in the work to genuinely learn, and you will be fine.

The class was overall good BUT be prepared to read and write A LOT. This was the class I studied the hardest among all the classes I took at UCR. Online recorded lectures+ added value in-person sessions. You have to go to as many as you can. The professor was kind and engaging. My TA Andrew was amazing, a life savior. Please be prepared to STUDY.
For a class at 8 am, Professor Dubcovsky was very enthusiastic. She likes the material and is there to help undergrads. Her HIST 099W will help any aspiring history student get to the next level.

I lagged out of the first zoom session and missed everything that was talked about. She set up our own zoom call and walked me through everything I missed after I emailed her. She is such a kind professor that cares about her students' learning of the material. There is a lot of assignments, but they each have a purpose. Give effort for an A.

Prof Dubcovsky is a very fair grader and very accommodating to online learning. She is very flexible with assignments and gives good feedback. You can tell that she genuinely cares about the material and it helps you stay interested and care as well.

I have mixed feeling about Dr. Dubcovsky. I took her 99W which is a core requirement for history majors. Her class wasnt hard but it wasnt easy either. The course felt random because it had no theme. One week we would talk about Slavery, the next week Star Wars. I ended up with an A in her class but I dont feel like I really learned anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Her class was about developing a research project concerning the pirates of the caribbean. Very cool class and would definitely recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: She's very kind and understanding. She gives you two days after the deadline to submit an assignment. She has a a lot of readings every week but you can get away with just reading one or getting a summary of it. Very easy and lenient. There's about 3 quizzes and maybe 4 or 5 assignments throughout the quarter.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Simmons is very kind! I enjoyed taking her class, there were three quizzes throughout the course. She would also have weekly discussion boards. The assignments were straightforward and easy. Take advantage of the extra credit, it helps a lot! Overall, reach out to her if you need any help. I definitely recommend.

If you do not like to read, SEHE 002 is not your course. This professor is really sweet and accessible for office hours. She really wants you to succeed and I think going to her office hours is helpful

Not bad, but I was rather disappointed by the course. Dr. Simmons takes an unorthodox approach to teaching about the 20th century, and the course is structured around themes rather than events. There are only so many times that a class discussion can say "Eugenics is bad" and stay interesting. However, the final essay was very interesting.

Professor Simmons is a very caring person. She really wants you to do well in her class. The class is really easy. The only difficult assignment was the essay you have to do towards the end of the quarter. The weekly assignments aren't hard either. Just participate in the discussion and lecture and you will do great.
It was an easy class. You could easily pass if you at least try. But it might be hard to get A on her class.

Overall kind and caring professor. Graded things in a collective format rather than individual. Instead of grading each discussion board separately, we had to put all our work for the weeks into midterm and final portfolios. Also, 3 quizzes + 1 essay. Grade depended on how much you participate in class by contributing to discussion of the topics.

Participation and reading is are big things, if you don't you'll fail. She assigns the same amount of reading as all my classes combined, and expects you to know the reading word for word. The class was fully online and was quite confusing. The structure was odd and there's a lot you have to worry about. The TA's are lost too and not helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I love her course for Medical racism, eugenics, and the Tuskegee study. It is very informational and interesting and honestly, it is something everybody should know about. She is a very kind and understanding professor, and she really does care for her students. If you have the opportunity to take a course taught by Professor Simmons, take it!

By far, Professor Simmons is one of the best professors that I have had during my time here at UCR. She is understanding, kind, respectful, and very knowledgeable. Her teaching methods are engaging and eye-opening because she makes you reflect on the material rather than simply write about it. I highly recommend this professor.

She was absolutely understanding during the COVID-19 & BLM Protests situations. We had quizlets every week on the readings & she dropped the lowest one. We had discussion sections instead of lecture. She did have podcasts but not very many & they were only 10 minutes long. She definitely cares very much for her students. Would recommend. Love her!

Prof Simmons' lectures are so engaging and thorough. You can really tell she cares about the subject and her students. There are maybe 4 papers that are graded pretty fairly. There is a midterm and final, but as long as you know your material you should be fine. There is no textbook, just a lot of primary and secondary sources to read.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: There was a LOT of course readings so make sure to stay on top of it. She also posts all her lecture outlines, but I'd really recommend going to class since she adds a lot of detail. There are also three essays and the prompts were kind of weird, but the writing workshops helped a bunch. I would def take this class again! :))
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Very nice woman, I thought the first two essay prompts were straightforward while the third was confusing. Didn't read much outside of assigned sources, and midterm/final were annoying to study for but not difficult.

Professor Simmons is clearly passionate for history! The overall course was interesting expect for the final paper we had to write. Grading is very fair and Professor ensures that students have resources for help! -wrote 3 essays prompts were extremely confusing! -final exam were straight forward - USE LECTURE OUTLINES Good luck!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Honestly considering that history 20W is both a writing AND history class I was expecting to hate it but all of my group and I really loved professor simmons. Her lectures are not too boring and does not make history a drag. The essays are not too bad considering their length. She does a really good job at explaining and the TA's were amazing too

Very nice woman, although lecture is a little scattered bc she talks rly fast & her slides don't have words on them, just pics. Went to lecture 7 times out of the quarter, didn't read her lecture outlines, just studied terms for midterm & final. She let us know the essay prompts for both tests early, so that was rly nice. Be careful of harsh TAs

I love Prof Simmons. She is a great lecturer and she really cares about her students. She takes into account what we want to change in the class. For the midterm, many ppl were mad that they didn't have time for the essay, so she gave us the prompts for the final a week before. If you go to class and pay attention, you don't even need to study

She's a really sweet professor, who is obviously really passionate about history. The class itself can be pretty boring, but I still recommend going to every lecture. Study her lecture outlines for the midterm and final, and remember to refer to readings/other sources for her tests.

pay attention in lecture!! she talks fast and doesn't have actual slides so you really have to pay attention! after the midterm i stopped going to class and i really regret it because she covers a lot in her lectures. the delegate assignments aren't that bad and the chances of getting chosen are small. her lecture outlines are also super helpful
reviews.rating_tags: LECTURE HEAVY--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Simmons is a great professor and caring. She is accessible outside of class and goes out of her way to help her students. The way she teaches is a little confusing at first, but you will get used to it by the third week. The midterm and final are easy if you are good at history or study. Outlines for lectures are posted but come to class.

Professor Simmons is caring and very sweet to her students. Beware of her delegate system, you could get called on in class to speak about a topic. Lectures can be boring, but really aren't necessary to go to because she posts notes. Midterm and Final include short answer questions and essays
She really cares about her students.
Horrible teacher. Don't take her class

Enjoyed this class. Professor truly cares about her students and wants everyone to pass. I like how she focuses on the overall context than memorizing dates and people. All notes are online but going to lecture helped a lot with additional info for exams and delegate essays.

Easiest class ever! Her notes are online, just make sure you bring it to class to write additional notes. The class structure is really confusing at first but you will get the hang of it after a week or two. There are essays but it isnt that hard depending who your TA is. I would take this class again if i have the choice to.

This professor is extremely smart and helpful. This is not an easy class but if you put in the effort you are fairly graded. The TA's are extremely helpful and so is the professor. Don't think this is an easy A but if you try your best, you'll get an A.
This is the easiest class hands down. Didn't go to class because she posts the notes. Never got chosen as delegate, but I still managed to pull through this class. Easy. 99% recommended.

Coming into this class I thought it was going to be an easy A, but it wasn't. TA's are hard graders and the class itself is pretty boring. Never got chosen as a delegate though. Attend discussion its worth the same amount of your grade as the midterm and final.

She is very interesting and has a passion for the material she covers.  She is extremely helpful and very approachable.  People that complain about her obviously don't appreciate good teaching. She's also extremely cute.

I thought this class was fairly easy. It was about the basic events that occurred in history. She posts lecture outlines, which are very helpful since she talks so fast because she gets so excited about the material. Grading is done by the TAs, so get to know them. Overall I say easy A, if you do what you have to.

Horrible. Does not curve. Texts are Wikipedia. Knowing about historical events are never enough and stating their significance in my opinion is not what she wanted to see. For a class I only took as a GE, this turned out to be a lot more trouble than I thought. Thanks for ruining my GPA.

She is extremely boring and talks super fast so you don't get a chance to copy down her notes. Her tests and papers are graded unfairly and extremely hard. You do not use a book but the midterm and final is all definitions and essay. She gives you like 45 definitions but only tests you on 4 which is pretty annoying. I would take another professor

Her lectures can be boring but she GIVES you the information that you need to know for the midterm and final.  One short paper and two delegate essays.  Overall, this class was not bad at all if you actually go to class and pay attention.  Very passionate about subject and really cares about students concerns with the course and their success.

Her exams and papers are unfair. She is very vague. Confuse people. Subject are very vague. Has a very strict essay guideline. Two essays in the final along with 6 short answers. She wants to connect all of the world events in her lecture. Delegates have to answer questions during lecture. Lectures are Discussion and Discussion sect.are lecture.

Prof. Simmons class was clear and easy to understand. She didn't care too much for detail, rather for overall concepts. There wasn't a book for the class, just a few essays. The midterm and final were simple, just key terms and an essay.
I had her for history 20. we used no text book and readings were posted on ilearn and easy. Couple papers in discussion and a midterm and final. Overall I ended up with a B+ just study the key terms.

Her classes especially her upper division classes are not easy. She rushes through every lecture without making sense. She is not very helpful during office hours; she asks you many questions instead of answering your questions. Don't expect to get higher than a C on her final. She is such a strict grader.
Stay far away from this professor. She does not teach very well. Lectures are pointless. Don't bother with her lengthy essays and exams.
She is the worst history professor should can ever get. Her instructions on essays are not clear. She assigns lots of heavy readings and essays.

I have taken her world history 20th century honors class and history 191 and this class. She will give you a hard time. She assigns lots of readings and essays. She grades harshly on essays and exams. You would be better off with a different professor to save your GPA.
Avoid this professor at all costs. Her lectures are boring. Her exams and papers are unfair.
There is no point in taking this professor. She assigns lots of essays, but she does not return work. She has an annoying voice which distracts you from learning. I would find some other professor.

she's not a hard professor. her lectures are sometimes cool and exciting and other times are dull and it seems like it'll never end. she wants participation and really throws herself out there for her students to pass. she posts lecture outlines and ppts online, but her exams seem like an english exam since she wants PARAGRAPHSSS in 80 minutes!!
Avoid this professor. She Has anger management problems. She gets angry during office hours when you ask her questions.
Her lectures are very dull. Do not take her if your do not perform well on papers and exams.
Discussion is mandatory. You will lose lots of points if you don't attend discussion. Her lectures are so boring.
This professor is not easy. It is quite the opposite. Her class is very challenging. Her term papers and exams are very hard. This class is not worth your time.
You definitely do not want to take this class with this professor. Her exams are not easy. Studying for this class will not help you at all. You would be better off with a different professor.
This professor is hard core. She assigns lots of readings that are not useful for the papers and essays. Her exams are so hard. You might not get higher than a C in the class.

I thought this was the easiest class ever. The teacher was so sweet. Everything was easy to understand and she gave extra credit for attending office hours. I went to class 75% of the time and got 97% and higher on my quizzes, midterm and final. Shes super easy and all her notes are online. Id recommend it to anyone looking for an easy A.

this class was a joke.  lectures were interesting, but she posted all the lecture notes online. material was interesting, but most of the help came in discussion sections. overall, a pretty cool class.

Simmons is very sweet and welcoming. She is thoughtful and respectful toward her students.  Still, for a grad course she lacked defined guidelines & expectations for assignments and class meetings. Also, I was very annoyed to never receive work back with comments, and thus never improved upon my studies--how frustrating! Grade and return please!
She keeps her class interesting, but she is not helpful on the papers. Instead, discussion class is really helpful, it helps when the exam is coming. She is not that hard overall.

Great Professor!  She really enjoys her subject and wants her students to express their thoughts and opinions on them.  Likes group discussions based on the readings so make sure to keep up.  She was also totally willing to help out in any way she could with the assignments.  I really enjoyed her class.
Too much readings and book without clarity. Plus wasn't helpul with papers.
No Comments
Very interesting course.  Was taught very well.  Lectures were always interesting.  Small class, you are expected to participate.  Readings are long, but interesting.
No Comments

PHYS 040A is a difficult course as it requires a lot of studying. I recommend attending lectures, discussions, office hours, and SI tutoring. As I failed PHYS 040A last quarter, I asked Dr. Joe for help. He was helpful during office hours to prepare for exams. Overall, a great professor who cares about students learning and students success.

Professor Joe is very easygoing and his curves makes the class very forgiving. Theres lots of homework to do but it is helpful in terms of conceptual knowledge. Self studying is key to get a good grade in the class.

I think he was alright, he tries his best but his teaching is confusing in my opinion. I knew most of the topics already because of AP Physics C, but I felt like he made it more confusing than it had to be. There was also a lack of practice problems and too many conceptual problems. Still, not bad. Very generous curve.

Professor Joe's lectures are informative, however, there is a lot of self-studying involved when taking this class with him. There is a lot of homework, which is quite difficult, but they help build skills that will be necessary for exams. He gives extra credit for participation for each correct answer, which helps boost your grade.
Quite an easy grader in terms of passing but if you want an A then there is a lot of homework

Chill professor that tried his best.
Tips:
- study homework problems
- Use lecture questions for conceptual practice
- Professor answers questions clearly, so ask questions

reviews.comment: Professor Joe is really chill. His midterm and final exam are pretty hard but he will give extra credit and curves toward the end of the quarter. His lectures are OK, I recommend to self study frequently. I would also recommend to do the homework legit as the midterm was pretty based off those.

really chill and is always open to explaining questions more deeply. 1 midterm, 1 final, curve is on your final overall grade, there's always "prelecture" assignments and a lot of hw but it is beneficial, youtube videos will also help. he does polleverywhere quizzes for every lecture and it's for a participation grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Joe has been the first stem professor that doesn't make me want to take a nap during lectures. His grading curves have been generous so far.

Class was a rough experience. The midterms and finals cover way too much material and if you make a slight mistake you get almost zero points on the problem. It's either his road or the high road so good luck if you have this professor.

God aweful, this man acts like his class is the most important class there is. I dropped sooner rather than later and I SUGGEST YOU DO THE SAME. Not worth the exhaustion tbh. ACTS LIKE STUDENTS FAILING HIS CLASS IS SOME COAT OF HONOR.

ARC tutoring didnt even help me. After million breakdowns I finally passed on my 2nd try with a b-. DO NOT take math22 here, save yourseld and take it at CC.

Mr. Curtis is not a good professor. His exams are harder than necessary, and he assigns an overwhelming amount of homework that's difficult to keep up with. You have to do well on all three midterms just to have a decent grade. The only positive is that he's funny. I wouldn't take this class unless you already have a strong algebra background
Curtis treats his class like hes the head coach of the 2008 Detroit Lions. Never again.

Wow where do I begin. I had to take his class twice and failed. Almost didn't meet requirements to be a finance major because of Curtis. Do yourself a favor and just take this course at a CC because he is not worth it. He rushes all his lectures. He will not let you use a calculator. I went to ARC tutoring 3x a week and still couldn't pass.
genuinely the first class i've struggled so much on, I wouldn't wish this experience to my worst enemy. Never take this class please, do yourself a favor

My first time ever taking Calculus and he really does explain it well. There is quite alot of HW i will say but if you do it the day of the lecture, youll be good. He doesnt post slides and if you do skip one day, the material will look a little confusing so dont be behind. But honestly if you have a good foundation of math, youll be good.

This professor is extremely serious about his exams and work. He is straight-forward. If you do not attend lecture and discussion you will fail. If you do not study, you will fail. If you study, go to office hours, go to lecture, discussion, you should pass.
Amazing professor so sad he is retiring.

The professor talks a lot but doesn't teach clearly, using confusing sports analogies and invading personal space. TAs were no help, and we had to pay $51 for online homework that barely matched the lectures. Be prepared to teach yourself. Overall, disorganized, unhelpful, and not worth it. I dislike with a passion and he isn't a REAL PROFESSOR.

He's very down-to-earth & clear with the class rules. His lectures are somewhat engaging enough to keep you paying attention. I HIGHLY recommend attending his office hours to do the  study guides with him, as well as on your own time (He & his TA's makeup the quizzes/midterms/final with the study guide ?'s). Do the hw on time! Overall, solid guy.

Decent professor, very straight forward in lectures. Although it is a lot of math to fit in 10 weeks. His lectures are heavy and a lot goes into discussions also. Common issue I saw was his tests felt like they made no sense. Will do each problem on the study guides and still received low grades. Hard enough already if bad at math.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Michael Curtis is a horrible grader with a grading rubric that makes sure a student doesn't pass a single exam. The first thing he said during my winter quarter was that 40% of students fail each winter quarter which is already a red flag for why you shouldn't take this class. Please do yourself a favor and take Math022 at a community college.

This professor grades heavily based on tests. The exams are extremely difficult. He doesn't properly prepare students for the exams. None of his material prepares students for real life scenarios. First time ever I received anything below a B (let alone a "D"?!!) in ANY course throughout my years of schooling.

Professor himself is great at teaching, but keep up with the daily workload. This class requires a lot of discipline and time management - you NEED to study and review consistently. If you stay on top of assignments and attend supplemental (if you need it), it's a pretty fun class. DON'T SKIP LECTURE!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a tough grader. Expect so much weekly homework, two midterms, a final, four discussion quizzes, and online quizzes. Exams are graded hard with no extra credit. You must practice a lot to understand the material, or you'll struggle.

(Fall 24) Professor Curtis's class is difficult if you didn't take calc in high school (I didn't). The TA you get can either be super helpful or not helpful at all. Most of the quizzes were somewhat like the study guide. I recommend doing the homework right after class or on the same day because it helps understand the lectures better.

This professor goes way too fast during lectures and does not post lecture reviews. I know he has to teach a lot of material but he just breezes through it and calls it a day. He's aware more than half his class fails his class and does not care. Did not like his courses take at community college.
He was one of the few professor that helped me understand calculus.

the class is very fast paced and he covers a lot of material in a short time. he explains things pretty well given the short time frame, you just have to make sure to either attend each lecture or get the notes from a friend. if you keep up with the homeworks then the quizzes and tests aren't too bad, he also posts study guides so you can practice
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
I never took calc before yet I finished with an A. Here's how you can too:


-attend EVERY discussion and lecture. Lectures are super important so take good notes
-do your hw on time, and do it everyday in order to gain good practice
-study hard for EVERY quiz/exam (I can't stress this enough: start at least a week before)
-attend SI/office hours

if math isn't your strong suit, i DON'T recommend him. thinks that most the class getting Cs overall is normal, 60-50 percent averages on midterms. if your TA isnt good youre screwed. wish i listened to reviews before sticking with him. not bad at teaching, but uncaring of the class' skill level, despite being aware most arent great at math.
The midterms and final basically determine your grade so if your a bad test taker goodluck

Okay, so I failed this class and retook it. Easiest if Math 004 is taken first. STUDY WITH A GROUP. Professor is really nice so go to office hours, he will appreciate your effort. Do all homework early and study continuously. This class requires maximum effort, but everything gets so easy if you try and have friends to help you. Talk in discussion!

Curtis is a great teacher, but man his class is difficult. You either love him or you hate him. I was doing really well in the class until I bombed the final and dropped my grade from an A+ to a B+. GO TO LECTURES. You can probably afford to only miss 1-2 lectures all quarter as the class moves super fast.

reviews.comment: prof is a good lecturer (insensitive af tho) he expects a lot n its assessment heavy (quizzes/tests) this class stressed me out so bad like definitely took years off my lifespan lol i think i studied every day.. but tbh if u acc fr study it's not that deep if ur lazy u will fail it's rlly that simple, js allocate hella time n u will be fine

Professor Curtis is a challenging but engaging instructor. His lectures are helpful, but the coursework requires significant effort. Utilizing resources like unstuckstudy AI alongside the textbook can really boost your understanding.

Coursework is obviously going to be difficult in a fast pace environment. If you fall behind early, make sure to catch up before it is too late. Class is very exam heavy, so make sure to study. Don't always rely on the curve.

It's always been about love and hate, now let me say I'm the biggest hater
I hate the way that you walk, the way that you talk, I hate the way that you dress
I hate the way that you sneak diss, if I catch flight, it's gon' be direct
Prof has no sympathy and your grade depends on how good your TA is. Never taking this class again, so many students fail and the prof doesn't care.

Honestly, the effort you put in is the grade you get. Curtis is engaging and explains well, he allows flexibility on what can be given on the test through a majority vote. Homework can be a pain but it's a given it's math, just put in the effort and use the reattempts. Also, follow the study guide well and you'll be fine for the midterm/final.

Average professor, bad teacher and terrible person. My low rating is based on the fact that he does not give anyone the time of day and basically said "if you find yourself in a tough spot, that's cause you put yourself there". Other than that, the class is a pretty typical calc class.

The content is honestly pretty difficult, you can pass the class as long as you do well in discussion (do the weekly study guides!! ). Lecture helps, especially since my discussion teacher was no help. Don't worry too much if you fail the midterms, I failed both, but passed the final with a 75% or higher and ended the class with a B-

By passing this class, i relied on 2 resources. 1. Lecture notes. 2. Youtube videos (The Organic chemistry tutor!! His videos are almost similairly to what curtis reviews). Pay attention to the first topics reviewed in first couple weeks, as they will be used in future material.

Sit in the front, write everything!  Midterms 1 and 2 are 32% of your grade. The Final is also 32%. The final was only 15 questions and I finished it in about 1 hour. ( got 84%) However, I am relatively math savvy. Never went to an office hour(nor took calc in hs) but studied the weekly study guides for the exams and quizzes. GO TO DISCUSSION!

Really solid lectures and pretty helpful in office hours. The class is made up of three midterms, quizzes in discussion and a final. I'm pretty bad at math and was still somehow able to get a decent grade, just do practice problems and follow the study guides. Also go to office hours! Curtis seems scary but he's really nice when you talk to him
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
if you get curtis for business calc, good luck. 

- from a 3rd year retaking his class for the 2nd time soon to be 3rd solely because of how he grades. 

he does NOT believe in extra credit ir curves, better hope you were born a genius cause your gonna need it.

Quite the guy who doesn't have much care.
Avoid him, and please take Math 4 with someone else.
Homework load and tests and quizzes do not have the same questions as from the study guide
Doesn't let us use our "methods" in math
Super strict

Extremely clear and concise lecturer; cares about his students' success. Content can be difficult to get through if you're entirely unfamiliar with calculus, but attending lectures regularly, taking clear notes and examples, and re-practicing the homework study guide problems help a great deal!

This class made me fall in love with math again, the concepts you learn are very interesting and very rewarding once you mastered them. To get a good grade in this class I literally put in about 30 hours a week practicing, but it was well worth it. How much you put in the class is what you get out of it (if you use the correct study habits)

He provides a study guide but if you attend lecture and do the HW it's not necessary. Prof is a nice dude, kinda straightforward. Instructions are very precise; you know ahead of time exactly what to learn, get whichever grade you want. Caveat is if you don't know alg 1 from hs you are probably screwed.

Loved this class with Curtis! I recommend watching a few vids and getting comfortable with derivatives and anti-derivatives before taking his class, also sharpen up your basic algebra skills. Curtis is a great professor, and does his best with such a short amount of time. If you put in a lot of effort you could definitely get an A in the class.

reviews.comment: He was a really understanding and nice teacher. His lectures were very clear, however there is lots of homework to do online. If you do the homework and go to lecture then you are good for the midterms. Discussions were mostly useless, however attendance is required for them. Overall, this class was really good and he was a a great professor!!

Highly recommend taking this class online at a CC!There is a huge workload between the homework and studying for weekly quizzes. The teacher says the only people who write his bad reviews are those who don't try in the class. However, in me and my peer's experiences, we literally gave our whole lives to this class and still struggled to pass.

Professor Curtis made me LOVE calculus! I took this class during my first quarter of freshman year, and he is the best. His lectures are great, and he makes everything easy to understand. The homework and study guides are enough to help you pass the quizzes and exams, but you have to put in the effort if you want to pass this class.

Worst professor ever in my first year, literally gives no care to anyone. Tried talking to him and seeing if there's ways I can pass after not doing well on both midterms. He kept walking up the stairs saying I'll fail with that very very very annoying sarcasm, "SORRY." I felt struck by this and still am, how is he not reported?

I went to ONE lecture the entire quarter. The HW is extremely easy, and I basically self-taught myself. However, if you aren't gonna go to lectures, TAKE ADVANTAGE OF YOUR DISCUSSIONS. I may have seemed like a dumbass during discussions because I never went to the lectures, but my TA was extremely helpful(Analiz Gonzales) Def recommend her!!

Good teacher, class is difficult due to workload rather than the actual material. Go to lecture! Self-study helps but can't replace lecture attendance. 62% is a failing grade but still take the class seriously. Gives sample finals and midterms, and quizzes can be extremely easy depending on TA. I'm bad at math but if I could do it so can you!

A polarizing figure in the UCR community, I would say Prof Curtis has more friends than enemies in the UCR community. I loved his class and how he taught, and would have gotten an A+ if I hadn't sh*t the bed and gotten a 76 on the final. (Attendance not mandatory but show up)

Not good at math so to me the class was hard, but honestly Curtis explains really well and does the best he can to make it understandable for students. If you pay attention in lecture and do the practice problems every week, you will pass for sure. Spend a lot of time studying for this class if you want to do well

reviews.comment: be prepared to study and use the outlines and study guides he provides. i think what people dont understand is calc is like cooking. at first it might not taste good, but if you keep cooking and follow the recipes, it'll keep getting better and better. if there's a discord i suggest using it, the people in there helped alot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: the whole class is decided by the university standards, he doesnt have much control over how difficult or how fast paced everything is. in general if you attend every lecture or get notes from someone, study often, do the homework, you should be prepared for quizzes/exams. i didnt think i was good at math b4 this class and i passed
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is so nice to his students and he actually cares. His study guides reflect exactly what is on the tests, and the homework isn't that hard. He makes himself available to his students and gives positive feedback while encouraging us to do better. I've had him for two different classes and each one he's shown to really acre about his students.

Curtis is honestly one of the best professors at UCR. He is very determined in teaching the materials during lecture. Which means if you got to lecture YOU WILL PASS. skipping class you will easily get lost and will not know what will be on the quizzes/midterms. He is extremely kind and is willing to help you understand math better.

The class is tough, there is not doubt in that, especially if you have never seen calc before. But, if you do the homework way before its due, and study a lil extra (like everyday study calc for 2 hours including hw) you will be ok. GO TO OFFICE HOURS!!!! This is so essential and trust me on that one. PUT IN THE WORK! or you will fail for sure.

He gets distracted easily... Whenever there was a test or quiz, he would state "maybe" or "I'm not sure..." and "It's either or..." in describing outlines. The homework was tedious in which of the online textbook and Mathlab, but wasn't that much help. In all, I think I learned calulus best during the discussions. He's just a weird teacher.

I think Curtis has low ratings/bad rep because the contents of the class itself. Calculus is often hard for people to learn in general so they get mad at the instructor for not understanding it when it's really not the instructor's fault. If you show up to class and put effort in, you will be alright. His teaching is perfectly fine.
hard af he sucks

This class can get really overwhelming at times with the amount of materials hes throwing at you but if you do the mml hw asap, itll help you a lot! If you put in the work and study and understand materials, its an average math class. Curtis makes the material a lot more easier to understand!

First thing I want to point out for this class, BE READY TO STUDY, especially if you're not good at math. Prof. Curtis is a pretty solid professor. He's good at explaining concepts, but the only downside is that the notes/materials show on screen are handwritten and his exam protocols are strict. You can't ask questions during an exam....

I took math004 online and math22 in person with Curtis. It's not as bad as people make it to be. He wasn't very accommodating for the online environment but as things have adjusted back to in person it has changed for the better. The material is pretty heavy for both classes so take advantage of the provided resources (SI sessions and office hours)

Professor Curtis has been one of the best math teachers I have ever had. You have to go to lectures if you want to do well. I took it Spring of 2022 in person and we had Mon/Wed Discussions (50 min, assignments due in class) and lectures on Tues/Thurs (1hr 20 min). Exams are easy but you NEED to study. You'll fail if you don't try.

Don't take his class if u want to keep a good GPA. The way he teaches is weird and unclear, and I almost learned everything from YT. He's very strict on exams, he doesn't care much about his students and shows no respect. IDK why someone gives positive feedback on his class cuz you won't get a good grade even if you almost fought your life for it.

reviews.comment: Curtis is horrible. Take a community college class for the credit if you need it. Lectures are pointless, he does example problems that do not relate to the hw, quizzes, or exams. reviews.comment: Not much to talk about, just very hard generally.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

I took math 004 and 022 with Curtis and I normally am not a math person and he truly helps If you reach out to him.

Professor certainly tries to teach but doesn't really accommodate all students and slow down when needed or check up on everyone. Class is definitely hard overall, but with a lot of practice can potentially pass with a decent grade. Not a "fun" class

Very straightforward professor, tries to crack jokes sometimes but overall good teaching. People complain a lot about the class but you just gotta put in the effort and you'll get a good grade. reviews.comment: Despite what everyone said about Curtis, I think he was a fine professor who did what he had to do. As long as you attend lecture and actually put in the effort for this class, it’s hard to not get an A or at least a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Curtis was a funny guy who made math tolerable. His grading was very fair and was generous when giving points. Anyone who gives him a bad review just isn’t capable and wants someone to blame for their own shortcomings.

Curtis gets bad reviews bc Calculus itself is difficult--a professor doesn't change that. He's extremely detailed with what's on the quizzes by giving study guides and sample Midterms/Finals. You never go into a test/quiz blindsided. If you fall behind, advocate for yourself and get help; go to tutoring or OH. Your grade is based on your effort.

He is ok at teaching the material but the examples he gives at lecture are very basic & never similar or helpful to the hw/exam difficulty. Study guides for quizzes/exams are very vague & studying becomes overwhelming because theres so much not narrowed down. I suggest attending SI sessions, office hrs & watching YT videos for the extra help.
I mean just do the study guide he gave, and they are almost just changing number in your quiz and test. Don't miss lecture!! They are very useful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you dont care about learning math and just want to pass then Id recommend this class over the regular calc classes. Hes terrible at explaining calculus (get ready to self teach) but his exams and quizzes are extremely easy. The exam questions looked nearly identical to the practice problems he posts weekly. And he curves too so a 85 is an A-

Curtis really isn't that bad. If you took PreCalc in HS, you'll be fine. If you didn't this class may be a struggle.
