AMAZING and FUnny! I had her for Drugs and behavior, intro to psychology, and also learning and conditioning got A+ in all of them. Shes is thorough and fun. I loved all her classes. Take her. Read the chapters and lectures lightly...youll get an A.

Wonderful professor. Covers all of the material thoroughly. Lectures slides are extremely helpful. She's very fair. Super hilarious! Keeps you interested in the lecture, clarifies and covers all of the material, makes sure you understand the material, rewards for attending (midterm and extra credit questions are from lecture examples.) Recommend!

Dr. Huffman is a great professor! The topics covered in 130 can be very tedious and easy to confuse, but Dr. Huffman walks you through them step by step. To get an A go to lecture and write down any and all verbal examples she gives. These are the examples she uses on the tests.

For an intro to psych class this was hard. She did say the first day it was going to be like a neuroscience class. To do well on the tests, just learn the vocab and diagrams. I didnt attend class regularly but when I did she always made an effort to make the class fun, cracking jokes and telling stories.
Really boring in lecture. Spends the whole lecture explaining one example, which only takes most professors 5 mins to do.
She is very clear in lectures and tries to make them interesting.
she treats the class like neuroscience. midterm questions were difficult and some were irrelevant. no recommended.

I loved her class! This was my first Psych class i've taken and I loved it! She is very helpful and speaks very clear. Her lectures are both interesting & funny. I would definately take another class taught by her!

This class was really easy. I barely used my textbook. The difference between an A and a B is attending class, so attend lecture. Just read power points for notes and you will do fine! What helped me was that I had a great TA so hope that you have a good TA.

GOOD PROF! Take her if you want to learn. Her class is alittle challenging, but psyc 1 is mainly focused on the brain so what can you expect? Her final was very easy and I liked her secret decoder for EC points! I didnt read the book but attended lecture and studied the AMAZING study guides that she provided and got a B!
She is very helpful you will def. love her!

She is a great professor. She is thorough in her explanations and give funny stories/anecdotes to help you remember information. Attending lecture is important to do well on exams, but that's not unreasonable considering it is college.
She is by far one of the best professors at UCR. I earned an A+ in the class.
Exam questions are vague and confusing. She is harsh and unreasonable in grading discussion participation. Not a good professor.

The worst professor at UCR. It's intro to psych not neuroscience. I don't think she knows the difference. You have to work so hard to get an A in this class. Everyone says psych is easy but not with her. Horrible teacher, avoid at all costs.

Power points are useful for quizzes, but not for exams. On exams, she asks questions that aren't even on the slides, or in the book (just random facts she brings up in lecture). You have to go to class every lecture to get a decent grade. Not recommended if you want an easy A/B. Avoid this teacher!

She is a great professor! Though it was her first time teaching Psych 1, everything about her lectures were interesting and captivating. I learned a lot without having to purchase the book; her slides were well-informed and her midterm and final was fair; no surprises. You can tell she wants everyone to succeed. Good thing she teaches upper div!
She's a great professor...really cares about her students and is extremely fair on grading. Her review powerpoints correspond with her midterm and final. Not a difficult class if you study

Lectures are boring. She's a new teacher to psych so she takes it too seriously. Midterm average was quite low and quizes every week in discussion. Do not take class if you are looking for an elective, not easy. If you really want to take psych, try it with ANY other professor. She makes you buy a book even though none of the other profs make you.

I had him for the lab section for Physics 040B. When the internet went out during the LSA exam, he gave us a very good point compensation. He is a very understanding person and I would happily have him again in the future.

Although the work given may be intimidating at first, the experience in the classroom makes up for it. The lectures are amazing, and the professor made the seemingly difficult topics extremely easy to understand. The exams may feel hard because that is what the professor wants us to experience but the huge curve is such a boost to the GPA!

Professor Barsukov is one of the best, if not the best, physics professors in the entire world. His teaching style is very conceptual and fundamental from an experimental viewpoint. Lectures are very intriguing and focuses a lot on understanding the mathematical prescription of electromagnetism. LOTS of hw. Straightforward exams. Fav class so far.

Dr. Barsukov will guide you to find what is beautiful in physics. A challenging course (a friend and I stared at grass for 30 min after the midterm) but finding that beauty was like the walls of the classroom peeling away to reveal the infinite. Please don’t be intimidated; you’re in caring hands. Make an effort and you’ll be rewarded.

I was a little hesitant about taking this class because of it being honors but Professor Barsukov made it fun and interactive. I am not going to lie, the exams were quite difficult but not impossible. The midterm is designed to not be fully completed because he wants people to be able to do stuff they know. Great curve as well!! Take this professor

Professor Barsukov is one of the realest physics professors I've had. He was very helpful and understanding to any types of situations, especially during COVID19. Go to lectures and take notes. If you don't go to lecture it will be very hard to understand his notes. Do the homework and always ask for help. Very doable to get an A. Take the class.

Dr. B is a professor who knows the material and is not afraid tot get deep in its explanation. As a student you will use the textbook and do homework regarding the textbook but really learn the material in lecture. His exams go off of his lectures and are more concept heavy than calculation heavy. Learn and practice the basics and you will be fine!

If I could tag all the good tags, I would do so. Professor Barsukov is THE BEST physics professor I have ever had. Apart from being an amazing lecturer and very well-versed with the content, he is down-to-earth and very caring. He allows students to formulate exam dates and expands on everything in the course profoundly. Tests are fair as well.

Phy 135B is a difficult course. It focuses on hard physics concept which is tied to even harder math. Dr. Barsukov did his best to provide us with the best education online. He was very supportive and very helpful. Yes, you will have to work hard. There is a lot to learn and a lot to work on. It's a journey that can be hard, but it's worth it.
Prof. Barsukov, an excellent teacher. Tough grader, HW is not easy. However, midterm and final were fair game. Curves are awesome!!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Difficult course, but fair. Lecture attendance is a must. To cover content from a lecture by yourself you would have to read from various books for 3 hours. HWs are difficult and time consuming. Exams are conceptually driven and fair. The class is curved appropriately. Best and most challenging UCR physics course. Barsukov is well respected.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: First thing, there is no textbook for the course. Second the lectures are fast and mandatory and really great. Super interactive with the students. Fair Grader. The best written and fair exams I've ever taken in a physics course. Tons of homework. Spent on average 8 to 10 hours a week on assignments. I loved it, best physics class at UCR so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor, really cares about students and making sure the concepts are understood as opposed to just being able to pass the tests. The course is tough but he provides plenty of office hours and is very accessible. Sick curves too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He reminds me more of a Bond-Villain than he does a professor. I got a 50/110 on the midterm and was questioning life, college, the purpose of the universe. But s/o to the man Igor because he gave us a fat curve. Keep being you man <3

Great professor! Expects you to understand the material. Midterm and final are hard,  but he understands how difficult it is, so there is a good curve. You have clicker questions, & a good amount of homework (due every week.) Read beforehand! Demos are helpful and he explains them thoroughly. His accent may be a little hard to understand at first.

Friendly, approachable, and accommodating. He allows students to take the course in the way that suits them best, whether it be asynchronously or IRL. Follow his grading criteria and you will do well. He likes to see critical thinking in essays, and participation in class discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I have nothing but good things to say about Professor Brookwell- honestly everyone should just take a class with him at least once. He's very wholesome, very knowledgeable, and very respectful to student needs. I wish every professor was like him.

I took his class for Intro to Video Game Studies and he is what all professors should strive to be as his class is engaging and he makes it fun by allowing discussion about content amongst peers. His syllabus is straight to the point and if you have a question or need help he is quick in answering his emails. Truly one of the best in UCR.

I loved this class. It was very engaging and very interesting. We spent a lot of class watching live streams and youtube and talking about it from a political viewpoint. The readings are short and interesting and he goes over them in class. He is super cool and laid back. We only had 2 discussion posts, 2 replies and a final 2,500 word final.

Intro to Research Methods taught by Prof. Brookwell was a blast! The course does not require previous experience in research, and helps if you're interested in future research. Readings are simple if you give them the time, and they are relevant. Graded by three assignments (last one being your report), but they build off each other. Great course!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good professor. Very kind and nice. Super accessible and always answers questions. Very nice with grading. Allows cheat sheets on the exams. Drops lowest homework and exam grades. Exams are easy if you study and use the cheat sheet correctly. Class is easy if you do the assignments and material is easy to understand with time.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had Dr. Bennett for PSYC11 & PSYC 134. Her grading criteria are always the same: lowest midterm, discussion, and assignment dropped, no cumulative final or midterms. Tests are easy if you can understand the concepts in the slideshows well, and 8.5x11 cheatsheet is allowed for all tests. Lecture is not mandatory, but she explains concepts very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I truly don't understand why Dr. Bennett has such harsh reviews. She is a great teacher who explains the material step by step and shows us how to conceptually understand the material which I believe is crucial for future psych classes. Her grading criteria is clear and reasonable "Show all work and you get credit"!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly, I thought this class was unnecessarily difficult. Although there are 3 midterms and one is dropped, it is extremely tedious. Final also takes up a lot of time, and grading is too strict in my opinion. If at all possible, take another professor for this class.

Not sure why Dr.Bennet has such a low score but she is a great professor. 3 midterms lowest grade dropped, weekly problem sets lowest grade also dropped. Though the work is tedious and quite annoying, it is doable and easy at the end of the day

Prof. Bennett is blunt and straightforward. Her class is organized, and as long as you keep up with weekly work, it's a guaranteed A. Lectures are nice, but can be skipped. However, the worst aspect of this class is how particular her grading is; the midterms focus on very basic but tedious math, and small details/missteps can cost you quite a lot.

Class is not structured that well. Depending on when your discussion is, you're probably going to barely have time to do your assignments, or just be expected to do them without half of the lecture notes. Also no policy for excused absences, even if you have legitimate reasons like being sick. She's also meticulous with the grading on exams.

The course assignments were portions of the final paper you have to write, which didn't really seem to help me with my final writing since I was only worried about getting something in on time. There are also 3 tests, so you have to study for those. Discussion mandatory. Prof. Bennett seems like a very nice and knowledgeable person, though!
Prof Bennett was so sweet. This class was not easy but show up, study, and you'll pass.
This was the worst class I have ever taken. Exams were extremely difficult, the average for each midterm was a D- and she still didn't even curve! DON'T TAKE HER
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class I ever took. The whole class was failing her exams and she didn't seem to care. She treated us like we should be experts in this subject. She even made fun of our bad memory. Her exams were crazy difficult. Very stressful class. I would not recommend taking her. She doesn't seem to remember how hard it was to be a student
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She was the worst professor I have ever taken at UCR. The subject material was not difficult, but the exams were ridiculous. I read the textbook, showed up to class, and still did not pass. She asked for feedback, but refused to help. The class average was extremely low and she still did nothing to help. She did not curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is the one where you should believe the bad reviews and not risk taking this class. Terrible professor.

Shes oblivious to the fact that our poor grades are a reflection of her performance as a prof. She acts like were demanding the world from her when asking for resources to better prepare for her exams and ofc she said no to it all. The material itself isnt that hard, but her exams are so overly complicated which makes it hard. Avoid her if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I feel like deep down inside, Professor Bennett has good intentions, but GOD this class was the absolute worst. The content isn't difficult to understand, but her test questions are weirdly ambiguous. Class average is around a D-, asks us how she can help and when we tell her how she says no. Good luck if you have her for a class!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This her first year teaching this course. After the first exam she got mad at us for doing poorly but it reflects bad on her. The class average was a low D in all three exams. I believe not one exam was a passing grade as a whole. We asked for a study guide, extra credit, and to curve the grades she said all nos. exams are hard and tricky.

The material is easy, and you will understand what she is trying to teach you, but don't think that will be enough. Her midterms are far from perfect, and are more difficult than any other psych class. My hypothesis is that she is writing these questions on the bases that she can answer them rather quickly, thus not preparing you enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I really didn't like Professor Bennett. I'm currently in this class and I must say that she has some of the hardest tests that I have ever taken. The material itself is so easy that you could explain it to a five-year-old, but the exams are where everyone is falling short. She gives trick questions and questions with no clear answers.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The material of this class is simple and relatively easy. However, she makes her exams pretty hard on purpose for no reason. She seems to have her own ceiling of how well she wants you to do, and she makes sure to impose this by making her exams hard.

This professor is horrible. The material is not difficult, it is the professor who makes it hard. She gives extremely difficult exams where time and again the class average was low D and very low C's. The entire class was struggling and she did nothing to help our studying.
The professor blames students for poor grades. Says she does not believe in trick questions but definitely gives them to you. She expects you to be an expert without much help getting there.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Bennett is seriously SO amazing. You can tell she really puts effort into her lectures and explains things very well. 3 midterms & a final. I wouldn't say the concepts are hard because she breaks them down very well but do study for all your exams and you'll be fine. She is so sweet and I hope her future students are just as sweet to her.

One of the best professors I have ever had. Her lectures are very straightforward. It was a 180 from the AP stats teacher I had. The downsides that there isn't much time to complete the tests and that homework can be a bit time-consuming. Poll everywhere for participation. Textbook/lectures are helpful. Haven't heard any complaints from students

Professor Bennett is SUPER sweet with a hear of gold. Her lectures are very easy to follow along and she also posts them online with audio which is seriously so helpful. Love her and wish I have her for another class again.
I enjoyed her class! Great professor

Intermediate analysis is no joke. The class it self is rigorous and you must already have a good understanding behind calculus. He did his best to help during office hours and class. Make sure to ask help from him and the TA. Be prepared to self study as he doesn't provide much.

Math 10A. Solid professor. Lectures are pretty good and easy to follow. Makes it as enjoyable as possible and cracks a few jokes here and there. No curves and no extra credit but fair grading and practice exams are VERY good indicators of what to expect. ZERO tolerance for cheating. Even if you are a tiny bit suspicious, its over. Dont try it.
He grades easily on exams often giving most of the credit for small mistakes for the question and he is usually a nice guy but during exam days, he usually gets into an irritable mood.

Math 10A. He's a really good professor and truly cares. He'll throw in a few dad jokes that are pretty funny. He's really good at answering questions and the discussions are very helpful. Lectures aren't mandatory and notes are posted. He does make a good amount of mistakes though. He posts really good midterm/final reviews.
He falsely accuses students of cheating and gives bad grades for no reason. Do NOT take his class

Super chill class, theres about 1 HW assignment every week that shouldnt take more than 45 mins. If you took AP calc in highschool this class will be a breeze. Theres a quiz during discussion almost every week but as long as you're up to date on the lectures the quizes should be a breeze as well. Gives oppertunities to save your grade as well.

This class was not hard at all, but I also took AP Calc in high school. The quizzes and tests are exactly like the homework, and he has very clear expectations. You cannot use a calculator, but he does not mark off if the number is wrong if the work is correct. He also makes pretty funny math puns, so that's cool too.

Best professor I had last quarter. The lectures are fast-paced, but manageable if you pay enough attention. The midterms are exactly like the practice ones (except one "extra" problem for those who go the extra step to study, ad he said), similar to the final. Homework is straight up and the quizzes/worksheets assigned are easy.

Absolute goat. Did great on midterms, his practice midterms are a great indicator of how the midterms are exactly. His final is a little difficult the practice exam isn't the best tho. Great teacher and did well in this course.

Got 100 on both midterms and cooked by the final. Make sure to REALLY prepare for the final as the midterms are not a good indicator of how difficult the final will be. Otherwise, he is a good professor with slightly messy handwriting. Reasonable amount of homework too.

Hes honestly fine, he is fully capable of teaching this course to you with only in person lectures. The class is very well paced and you can learn the course entirely off the professors posted notes if you hate showing up. Side note: his handwriting is pretty messy but if you have any sense of academic accountability and time management, youll pass
This professor sucks and is genuinely so rude. I would not recommend that anyone takes his class.
Awesome sauce.

I love this guy! He tells dad jokes in class and they are so funny. His teaching is actually good, fast but he post lecture notes. Homework is light, exams are ok. He provides lots of help, with sample exams. I would def take him again, very sweet guy. fits are fire.

His lectures can be a bit fast and overcomplicated, and his writing is hard to read. Not to worry though, he cares a lot about his students and always stops to answer all questions. And he gives study guides before each midterm that are exactly like the exam. The homework especially helped me understand the material. But don't rely on just lectures

Not the best professor by any means, but overall a nice and relaxed guy. Also might be temporary/still learning. Has relatively bad handwriting and teaches at a very quick pace. Quiz every other week in disc, 2 midterms and 1 cumulative final. Course itself is doable, but be ready to self teach a lot of the material if you think you can't keep up.

I enjoyed Dr. Hill's class, she is very passionate and intense but in a good way. Our midterm and final exam were essays which I preferred over exams. The thing is her rubrics are confusing and vague. Attendance is required for discussion/lecture but she does give extra points on random lecture days. We also had group projects which were simple.

Dr.Hill can bevery unprofessional at times, especially when contacting her about clarification.She has a lot of reading(3 textbooks), many films, and long lectures that do not relate to the midterms or group projects(2 that you have to persent +assignments).She did not communicate with the TA almost at all. She will yell and get emotional in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class is reading focused and material-centric. Professor Hill is a jovial lecturer as well as former Berkeley grad who deeply regards subject matter covered in this class. There's never a dull twist when attending her course! There was an assigned group presentation and my group's topic was particularly sensitive, but altogether essential.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Honestly she is a great lecturer, she makes u feel engaged and talks about serious topics. But her midterms, finals, and coursework asks tooo much from students. Thats saying a lot since i love reading. Be ready to read 1 chapters every week from different books ( we had 3). Just know this isn't an easy A class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hill is a passionate speaker and professor but that's the extent of her role as an educator. There were two required readings and a 3 hour long lecture. Just do all the readings. Lectures are long and tangential, filled with virtually no information that could be connected to the readings. Midterm and final exams are long and poorly structured.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She wasn't responsive during finals week, and I had a better time contacting the TA for clarification.

Dr. Hill is very sweet and caring, but get ready to read, read and read.  Take this class with another professor if you have a busy life. You must read endlessly to pass quizzes and exams. Her lectures are super long too. Stay away!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hill was amazing to listen to and taught straight-forwardly from the text, utilizing personal experience and conducting live interviews. I admire her because family violence is something that needs firm solutions, while appealing to the energy levels of today. She definitely sparked change and motivation - is a welcoming professor.
DO NOT take this class is all I have to say!

I would not recommend. Her passion was too much. It often felt like she was ranting. I like getting extra help. There was no TA and she does not grade the papers herself. She was also often hard to reach out to.

Prof. Hill is a passionate teacher no doubt, but sometimes the content of her lectures are drowned out by her passionate tangents. 3 papers total, can get by with reading the textbook alone. Made the exams too complex by asking for too much content with a short page limit. She is very sweet and kind, always understanding of student struggles.

One of the most enjoyable classes I have ever had. She has a true passion for the course as she spoke from the bottom of her heart about the importance of understanding family violence and the devastating effects it can have on people's lives. There are only a few assignments that rely heavily on reading but they're manageable.

I enjoyed Dr. Hill's lectures, she's one of the more inspirational Professors on Campus and found her class enjoyable to be in. She made me more interested in my class as you could see her passion for Sociology. A Professor that I will always think back to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: 1 of the best professors UCR has to offer. If UCR had a medal for most inspirational Professor I would nominate her. Dr. Hill pulls from the textbook to build her slides and supplements her course work with personal experiences of stories she has collected through life. Her class is very personal, and emotional but you gain perspective. Allhumdilla

Love Dr. Hill. Was surprised 2 see overwhelmingly (-) responses here... Perhaps she and students had a rough qtr, and students had lots of complaints? All I can say is that she has been generous and forgiving throughout this qtr when students have communicated a need, & Im grateful to her. Cool prof with lot of insights and passion/energy!

I've taken Dr. Hill twice in both upper-div Sociology courses (online). Throughout her courses I have expanded my knowledge in important subjects that should be taught at all levels. The reading is expected for an upper-div course with 3 papers throughout the quarter NO TEST I think a weigh of the grading depends of the TA more so.

I dropped this class after a week or two because Hill used the word r*pe repeatedly in her lectures. I emailed her asking if she could stop or use another word, and she said she would and the next lecture she used the word 4-5 more times. After I left, all I heard about her and this class was absolutely horrible. Try to avoid her at all costs.

The exams were written, and they were long! She's an absolutely incredible woman and so understanding, given the pandemic circumstances. She made accommodations whenever she could, however, there was so much assigned reading. The lectures were interesting and inspirational, but the course load was too much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--So many papers

reviews.comment: Final & midterm were written & split into two sections: short & long answers with 3-6 questions. 1st section every question must be 1-2 pgs & 2nd 3-4 pgs each. I emailed Hill about the heavy course load & she shortened the final, but I still ended up writing 12 pages. This class was easier for me since I am a Soc major.
She is kind and intelligent professor.

Took Social Inequalities. She's awesome! Went into this class with no expectation, hoping for a B. Got the first test back with an A. Was tougher on the exams than other assignments but I still did well. The book is kind of boring. Got a 91% overall! I recommend her :)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She turned off her Evals because she's afraid of students speaking up to her. Asking a question during lecture about an already vague midterm and being yelled at, as well as refusing to allow accommodations during a pandemic to students who need them, further confirms this. I learned more from the textbook than I ever did from lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's very rude to those who try to voice their concerns during class. Her "lectures", if you can call them that, are just her reading off slides and the textbook. Take a different professor if you can, it's not worth taking her section.

Janet teaches the importance of voicing concerns, yet manages her class with the authoritarian style. Refer to below reviews. Furthermore, we pay tuition to learn, however, this quarter I feel as if my money went to paying Janet to read off slides and books providing no further substance or depth. Literal word for word monotone reading.
She was okay, but refused some major issues students had during the pandemic! Wish she was more understanding..

I had Dr. Hill during the pandemic and I was disappointed. She was rude to a student that tried to ask a question during lecture. She yells at you during lectures and doesn't explore multiple views. She had us write a paper and provided almost no instruction. She was inconsiderate sometimes too. If you can find a different prof take their course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She was very rude towards her students. During this pandemic I understand that its hard we all are going through it but does not mean you should yell at students. Turned off her evals because she knew what she did was wrong. Wouldnt take her again.

I took this class during the pandemic and lots of students on zoom were disrespectful in the chat considering that we are all trying to learn and it was the professors first time teaching online. She did amazing. she posted lectures if you were unable to make it. If you like to expand your knowledge take this professor. 3 tests & lots of homework

Doctor hill was great i really learned so much from her than i did in my two years at UCR. She is not an easy A but every single assignment widened my knowledge on sociology cant say that about much professors. The readings and films that she provided werent just material to waste your time they actually connected to what she was teaching.

Lots of the people in my class were very disrespectful and rude to the professorial the zoom chat, so that tells you a lot about the hateful reviews. But overall she was very educated on sociology and all the material given to us tied altogether in what she was teaching. A lot of work to do but its all easy just gotta use your brain.

By far the most informative and passionate professor ive had at Ucr. She gives lots of readings but they all tie in to what she is talking about theyre not pointless. The people rating her badly just want easy As. She encourages you too expand your knowledge. If you are lazy i dont recommend this prof. but for those who want to learn take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: she is non caring about her studnets. i had time work conflict for the final which is on a Saturday and she essentially said, too bad. she took off her evals for the end of the quarter which is already an indicator that she knows she is bad. would not take again, a lot of the assignments were easy but very repetitive.

Professor Hill seems very passionate about the subject of Sociology, but does not seem very skilled in practicing what she preaches. She remained deaf to the concerns and struggles of her students through one of the most unprecedented times in our academics. Going off on students for asking, and silencing chats during moments of concern, etc. 1/10
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She did not take her students circumstances into consideration. Our voices were not heard when we expressed our concerns. All throughout lecture Professor Hill yelled at us and barely taught the material that was needed for midterms and the final.

Attending lectures was torture. Doesn't teach the material, she shouts it at us, and always going off on tangents. I understand that the material she is covering is serious and I'm interested in it myself. But as someone w anxiety, there is no reason why she needs to YELL. Never seen a professor be so rude & dismissive to students

Reading and videos in lectures. Have to study slides/book on own before tests. Disorganized. Proctored midterm 2 after we were not for the 1st. Rude to students /TA over concerns. Not accomodating or caring. Chat off, no discussion allowed, no discussion section, really left on own. Study guides did not help. Unacceptable as a SOC prof!!!!

She is great at teaching, I enjoyed the lectures at first. But as the class went on, she has shown that she will not listen to/work with students when they need her the most. especially rn, we needed her to be a little more accommodating and she refused. We also weren't allowed to review her for school evals (she turned it off), so im here.

Goes off tangent a lot. Did not accommodate accordingly to the ongoing pandemic and instead placed stricter regulations during online proctoring even after students voiced their complaints. Teaches about giving a voice to minorities and speaking up but when students spoke up about our concerns, we were immediately shut down by her.

She was really sweet at the beginning of the quarter, but towards the end of the quarter, she was yelling at students about asking about her vague midterm instructions, not allowing students to talk about the George Floyd protests, and refusing to give a compromise for her final. For a sociology professor, she loved to silence her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I'm sure she's nice but she doesn't care about her students. One time, a student asked about the midterm and prof rudely interrupted her and said she'd only answer questions about midterm in office hours. Really disorganized, goes off topic, super vague, no rubric for "paper", suddenly decides to proctor test (COVID times), bad experience :(

It's sad that the content is interesting, but is taught by a professor who does not care about her students. She only goes by her own agenda and ignores feedback and meaningful discussion from her students. For a professor who preaches all quarter to shut down meaningful conversations about current issues during class does not sit right with me.

Although she seems to know what she is talking about, she frequently goes off topic which can lead to material not being covered in class. I took the class during the Coronavirus pandemic so there is some rough patches to be expected, but it seems that she put little to no effort in making the switch to online classes.

She's passionate about what she teaches but not a great professor. Rude at times, very unclear and unorganized. Minimal info given about the logistics of midterms which was upsetting. Some parts of the tests are very specific to lecture, but overall if you have common sense and general understanding about the world around you don't stress.

Dr Hill definitely knows what she's talking about and is knowledgeable, but the tangents are a little too much to follow. A lot of material is supposed to be covered (especially in an intro class) but we often run out of time during lecture because of rants or tangents. Students are often left to their own devices to study and fill in the gaps.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: This whole thing was during the coronavirus bull yet despite the fact that were in the middle of a pandemic Hill decided that for our second midterm we should straight up be recorded. Were required to sign this contract that says we have to consent to being recorded, have perfect wifi, etc. otherwise well lose points.

Dr. Hill was not the best teacher by any measure and I am upset that my expectations for the class did not live up to the actual class. Do yourself a favor and avoid this class. Rants too much in class so little to no attention to actual material. You've been warned.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: 3 2-3page papers. Directions are vague. Ask your ta for clarification. 2 exams and a final. 50 mc and short answer questions. Provides a study guide but exams may or may not reflect the s.g. and short answer questions are not given. TA was Julisa, TOUGH GRADER but can look over your paper. As for Dr. Hill goes OFF TOPIC. Not sure if I recommend her

I had this professor in Fall 2018. 5 papers (2-3 pages per each), directions are VERY vague. Ask your T.A. for clarification on the directions of the paper. 2 exams and a final (non-commulative and multiple choice) but does provide a study guide for each exam. Note, exams may or may not be based off the study guide. Section is attendance
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--So many papers

reviews.comment: I wish I would have taken Dr. Hill sooner, she's very passionate about Sociology and teaching. If you do all of the assigned readings and attend lecture then you'll be good! She does pop quizzes, but they are not difficult. She's very understanding so if you have a problem email her. She's definitely one of the best professors I have taken at UCR!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She needs to realize that people have class after her lecture and she needs to stop interrupting and let groups finish their presentation. Also shes pretty bad at checking emails so asking her in person is always best.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hill is truly a nice lady, but this class felt more like a Race and Inequality class at times than a Modern Soc Theory class. Get ready to read! There are critical thinking papers assigned, two midterms, and a final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr Hill was great! She really cares for her students and is willing to help them. Lectures were relatable and funny. Sometimes she gives extra credit for showing up. Tests were basically just the homework and she lets you use a formula sheet for the midterm and exams.

Great Professor! Is very real and has funny lectures. It's obvious she cares about her students, she always is ready to slow down or go back a slide. Even though she posts all her lecture slides, I think going to lecture is much more important since she has way more to say than is on the slide and you can ask her questions. PLUS she goes over hw!!

Dr. Hills is a great and passionate professor. At first I was not sure about her because it was my first time taking her in one of my upper division courses but she made lectures very interesting. We had powerpoint presentations, pop quizzes, a take home midterm and a take home final. Both the exams were papers, but were very long but easy write.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I took Dr Hill for Soc 1 in the winter at Norco College. Shes a very sweet and lovely person. Her class was interesting, learned some things that a lot of professors dont teach you. No hw just 2 shorts papers and offered extra credit.. midterm and final exam werent too bad. She provides a study guide.. overall, a great experience.

Very knowledgeable about marriage, families, and singleness. Was very caring and gave students extra credit for showing consistency and effort. At times, however, the course was unorganized which was frustrating for those who do best with structure and organization. Overall, a very fun and interesting course with a caring professor.

Professor Hill is one of the most inspirational teachers I've had. I loved going to her lectures because she was an engaging teacher. I was interested in taking this class to know more about relationships, families, and being single. I actually learned more than that and learned more about myself from taking this course. My TA Jessica was amazing!

Dr. Hill is a very motivational lecturer. She keeps you interested and the material is very relevant. She shows lots of movies in class, and assigned lots of reading (about 5 books in the class). 1 Take home midterm and 1 take home final paper. Will randomly take attendance. Essay prompts are confusing and broad. Doesn't reply to emails very fast.

I loved this professor and class. I found this class very interesting and fun, and Dr. Hill did a great job teaching us the material. She tells a lot of personal stories, but they are relevant to the course, so she's not just rambling.  Discussion Attendance,Case Study & Presentation, Marriage and Family Project Paper, Midterm, and Final (20% each)

Hill is a good person but really not a good prof. We only had one take home essay midterm and one take home final that were massive % of our grade and she postponed their due dates multiple times; it was annoying as hell. Her class is also more of a preaching environment then an actual teaching one. It's just her passionately talking for 1 hr
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Hill makes the lectures so lively, and she is so sweet. It's easy to tell she genuinely cares about her students. The class goes at the pace of the students so don't worry about the difficulty. Although she was hilarious, she talks extremely fast and it can be hard to follow. But don't worry, as long as you have the book you don't have to go.

I honestly don't know why Dr. Hill has such low ratings, maybe she has gotten better now as a professor? She is so sweet, caring, friendly, and inspirational. Her motive is to not trick students. She clearly states what is on the exams, and wants students to understand the material. I LOVED having her for stats and I hope I can take her again.

Dr. Hill has by far been the best professor I have taken at UCR! She cares about the students success. I valued how she spoke in terms of everyday real life.  Sometimes words of wisdom and experience is better than what's written in textbooks.

very great teacher! she really knows how to teach and i wish professors had to sit in and take lessons on her style! she changed my life forever and i mean it! i was a second year Electrical Engineering major and her philosophy made me change to Ethnic Studies. Thanks Dr. Hill!!!

One of the greatest professors! She changed my perspective about sociology. In her class I learned how to keep an open mind when it comes to social problems. Her Passion is seen greatly in her lectures. As long as you keep an open mind in her class you will do well.

Amazing teacher, not your typical traditional teacher who bores you to death. She is passionate, and highly educated. This is one of those class where it can truly change your life; you will remember forever. This is not like your typical ordinary class where next quarter you forget everything. You WILL REMEMBER the class & her

Dr. Hill's lectures were very informative she provided you with half of the information we needed that would be in the midterm.  Basically if you pay attention in lecture and have an idea of what the assigned readings are about then you are good to go. But I would say Lecture is VERY important!!!

Dr. hill is awesome. Her lectures will blow your mind awY and get you thinking. She cares about the world we are living in. She is passionate and real and has evidence to make her points. Easy class just go to lectures and pay attention.

Great professor. I learned so much in her class. You will think in a different way after you take this class. Don't be afraid to take her, she's great. Most of her test questions come from examples she gives in lecture, so you MUST attend  lecture. Make sure you read and know the terminology in the book.
Dr. Hill is an amazing person. She is extremely passionate about the material. Very easy course.

Dr. Hill is a great interesting proffesor! I never regreted going to class. Soc 35 (Racial and Ethnic Issues in the US) was especially moving. I feel lucky to have had a class this early in my college career that has impacted me so much! (and Im a Bio major) over all very recommended easy yet amazing class.

If u can't pass professor Hill's SOC001 class ur stupid. If u find her lectures pointless ur naive. 3 simple multiple choice exams. Questions come from readings/notes and examples she gives in lecture. A few short essays. Weekly homework. I took the class Winter 2011 and earned a B+ only becasue I didn't do some of my homeworks.

Terrible professor. EXTREMELY unorganized. Rants in class about her personal life. I'm sorry, the death of your sister is terrible and all, but it has nothing to do with your class. Very unscientific approach. The questions on the midterm and finals are like multiple choice on her autobiography.Too much about her, too little about the field.
Really great professor and she motivates you about how the society worksa and just study from the notes and lecture and you will be fine for midterms and finals
She was great. I learned a LOT about myself and the world I live in. I strongly recommend her. Do the readings and you will be fine.
How can you have 89.57 percent and not get an A-. That's all I have to say.

worst professor at UCR by far. all she does is preach and preach about the same topic every single lecture. Her midterm and final was ridiculous. 18 pg midterm, and for the final she gave us 1 long essay question to do at home and she was going to pick 4 out of 9 short (2pg) prompts we were to write about in class. DONT TAKE HER BY ANY MEANS!!!!

She constantly preaches the same messages over and over and over again. She's unprofessional, the study guides are horrendous in how 1/3 of them aren't even covered in the course material. She gets behind in her lessons cause she's so busy preaching stuff she's been saying since Day 1. I really don't know why she's still employed here.

really interesting class. shes very passionate about what she's teaching, which makes you want to learn more. her midterms and finals are all essay questions. THEY ARE EXTREMELY LONG but i thought they were easy. you just have to read to get an A. take it if you suck at scantron tests!

Dr.Hill is very smart, she's also very funny. She truly cares about ALL her students. She's the best teacher i have ever had. If you believe that everyone should have equal rights then this is the class for you! She's AMAZING!

So basically you're going to love this class if: you believe white people are the root of all evil, you hate conservative people, you think the American government is out to get you, or you don't like people who make large amounts of money.

very passionate about what she is teaching.  at times seems like more of a preacher than a professor but she is very engaged and wants students to do well in the course.  lectures can be a little on the dull side but she shows lots of videos and often interacts with students to show examples.  very opinionated.

DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. She preaches instead of teaching.  She becomes violently angry when you express an opposing view. She included very specific questions on the test to see if you remember statistical facts, which I don't really mind, but her questions were ridiculously specific. AVOID TAKING HER CLASS.

Prof. Hill should be a Minister not a teacher, she spends all her time preaching the same thing over and over. She never stops talking and like to interrupt you. She goes off topic and spends Lecture reading to the class from like 3 different books. She does everything in essay format, her midterm is like 18 pgs. worth of essays.

I took her for a class called Corrections & she is the worst professor to hit UCR. Don't take the class if she's teaching it. She's not organized & she hardly talks about what we should have been learning. She's not available in her office hours or through email
i love her style, you get used to it but she does stray away from her actual lesson

Anybody taking this class, should prepare to be disrespected. Students are required to construct a power point presentation and spend hours on it only to never present. THis is because Dr. Hill clearly respects her students so much as that she thinks that it's necessary to interrupt constantly throughout the presentation's duration.

Dr. Hill is completely undeserving of a PHD. Her self-absorbed singular lectures simply involve her aggregiously misinformed blabbering about what she thinks are social problems. She does not follow a syllabus, is allergic to grading, and loves to disrespect her students. I encourage anyone taking her class to attempt a power point presentation...
Her lecture are VERY useless. The class is basically essay based until the final. I failed the final and still ended up with an A in the class. The discussion counts for almost your entire grade.

If I wanted to learn about her family and relationships, I would've registered for "Professor Hill's Family & History". I actually registered and paid tuition to learn about "Couples and Families" & all I learned from her was stuff about her family. As for her powerpoints, they were straight from the book and she didn't follow her syllabus. At all.

Professor Hill is very wise and you can learn a lot from her. But you won't necessarily learn much about what the class is supposed to be about because Dr. Hill  rarely touches on the actual course topic, textbook, or numerous readings in lecture. She is very disorganized and never ordered the text for the bookstore or put the books on reserve.

Really easy class as long as you read and keep up with assignments and do well on the midterm and final of course. She tends to rant on about race and ethnicity though and talks a lot about the struggle of Blacks. I thought it was interesting and she's really funny so you wont be bored. Easy class

I thought the class was pretty easy. If your the type of person that needs organized tructure and you need to keep to the schedule don't take this class. She's usually off the dates given in the sylabus and goes off topic but i though it was really interesting because she talks about life more than the book. Personally I like her she's really funny
Got a B- in the class. Have to listen to her lectures and read the book a bit.  I studied the book before every midterm and did fairly well. She's really interesting. I'd take her for 001.

worst teacher ever. avoid avoid avoid. never lectures on the 5-6 textbook/books she assigns and is completely unorganized. changes up grade rankings last minute and exams drastically are dropped or appear so be prepared..oh wait, you cannot. there is no way to prepare for this class. lectures are not boring but are IRRELEVANT!

Mrs. Hill is unable to respect anyone else but herself in the classroom, some examples include: requiring students to give extensive presentations in front of the class, then constantly interrupting them and go off on tangents for 3-10minutes and then let the student start again, and then interrupt them again,

or not even let them finish their presentation because she does not agree with their interpretations, when in fact the given material obviously has multiple interpretations.  This was extremely difficult to deal with because she would constantly waste class time with her speeches about how unbiased and open minded she was.

Towards the end of the quarter Mrs. Hill told the class explicitly that she does not care about her teacher evaluations, which just provides further evidence about her inability and unwillingness to respect anyone but herself or to perhaps even think for a moment that she could be wrong.

This class SOC 174 was supposed to be a class about Socialization and Personality and Mrs. Hill treated the course as a race and ethnicities lecture.  I did the best I could to take the good with the bad, and utilized my TA in order to get by.  She needs to be talked to, or reprimanded, or fired, I leave the rest in the hands of the administration

She is the worst! Try to avoid her. No matter what soc class you take she ALWAYS shows the same old videos. She has some serious issues. She is also VERY VERY unorganized, she always leaves her class and is really bias. She tries to be funny but she's not. She's a preacher but never lectures about the book. She lost my friends test!

unfortunately had her for 2 classes in the same quarter! same as one below...unorganized, late, and the workload is heavy..you have to do ALL the readings, not even attend class, basically teach yourself! if you don't have to take her class..don't!

fun to listen to... but EXTREMELY unorganized, late to class, off schedule w/syllabus, ALOT of work that you have to do yourself because what she teaches in class is NOT what she asks for on exams! Be careful when taking her classes, seems easy but not.

I love professor Hill she is super funny! Her tests were kind of hard because she wouldn't discuss the readings but if you understand the overall picture you should be fine.You don't have to agree with her.But a lot of what she says is true in our society.  She is hilarious and my T.A, Sheila I'm not sure if that's how you spell it, she was AMAZING
i liked it... i mmean she told the truth people are just too narrow minded to learn it.. i know because before i even went into this class i already knew most of the facts she tried to prove

She is quite a character. I must say I did not find her lectures/teaching methods boring... very interesting. However, she is EXTREMELY unorganized. She was always late to class, and we were always behind schedule. Overall, it's a fairly easy class so long you keep up with the reading. My only advice would be to NOT fall behind on reading.

The class was really easy, all you have to do is read the book, if you dont read your screwed because she tends to go off topic. A lot of people do not like her teaching method but its keeps you awake and makes you laugh. As long as you do all the assigned readings and attend lecture the class is easy.

no no no bad bad bad!!! stay away!! i've had to take her class twice and soc is my major :/ read the book yourself and don't sit in the 1st 3 rows unless you wan to be used as a example, which those examples make up a big part of the test so go to lecture but be prepared to hear her preach about her opinions and not the actually sociology.

Janet Hill seems at first to be an inspirational teacher but each class she spends the full hour talking in a circle about nothing. She favors stories about black people. You don't learn anything in lecture so you have a lot of reading to do on your own but she uses weird stories from lectures on the midterm. I don't recommend her.

Ridiculous. She has this tedious tendency to revert to "ghetto slang" at which time I stop paying attention due to her nonsensical rambling. Her lectures usually consist of her criticizing the rich, whites, the government, etc. She's not a sociologist; she's a socialist. I honestly don't understand how on earth she was allowed to teach here.

This professor spends the entire lecture trying to passher ideas off as facts. Whenit comes time to take the testonly 25%of the test has anythingto do with the chapters,and a large majority is simplywhat she said or did in lecture.She does not test us on ourknowledge of sociologybut rather our knowledgeof her opinions and our attendance inclass.

I took Intro to Sociology and Sociology of Gender with her and...she doesn't change one bit. Intro to Soc was just all about how blacks are mistreated - Soc of Gender was exactly the same, maybe focusing on black women a bit more. Hill is funny at times ("mmm hmmm") but I think you don't learn jack squat from her. Depend on your TA to learn!

I sat in on her lecture today and this woman is insane. I didn't know that a sociology class was the same as a church sermon. I've never heard "Jesus" so much in one day. For an educated woman you would think she would be more professional and keep her biases to herself. She puts her beliefs into the course which isn't how it should be.
She LOST my test. She might loose yours to. VERY unorganized and unprofessional

Favouring minorities doesn't make you a sociologist.  She took the concepts she taught us were "wrong" and used them to teach us how bad everybody who isn't a minority is. She'd make a wonderful preacher, but is a pretty lousy professor.  She wasn't very open minded, imo, and I wouldn't recommend her.
She is awesome when it comes to lecture delivery but she is VERY DISORGANIZED. She never discusses the assigned readings...most will not enjoy her.
She is very enthusiastic. Interesting class and not hard to pass.
Enthusiastic but INCREDIBLY unorganized. Additionally runs off on a tangent and exams generally do not follow the study guide. Unless you read the book cover to cover, you're safe.
she is an ok teacher but it is somewhat hard to understand
she is an ok teacher

She rambles off topic. Doesn't really teach according to text. Read a lot from other books. Very opinionated and ideal. Somewhat impactful and funny, but not helpful to prepare students a better understanding of the course.
Extremely conscious and not afraid to say the truth. Historically, relates topics which makes it more believeable. If you don't like it then Soc is not for you. Reading is a must.

An entertaining character but a terrible teacher.  Lectures were worthless because she basically preached the entire time about why our country sucks.  TONS of reading from which assignements and tests were based.  Avoid this "teacher" unless you have to take this class.
Professor Hill is on top of her game! It is an easy class to pass if you attend lecture/discussions reguraly,do your work, and study for the midterms and final. She is a great Professor!

She was unorganized, habitually late, and her syllabus was incomprehensible. Her TAs didn?t even know what was going on most of the time. Her lectures lacked cohesion and relevance to the subject she had chose for that day. I attended every class and never took notes. I gained absolutely nothing from her course. I don?t recommend her by any means.
Dr. Hill is a good teacher. Her tests are hard because it's not only multiple choice, you actually have to answer short answers and think critically but that is how you learn. Sociology is great.

I was offended by her lecture at times.  She tends to be very hypocritical in her lectures, but always in favour of the underdog (black, poor, etc).  Sociology isn't about preaching in favour of the underprivileged, it's about viewing ALL sides of the issue at hand and making YOUR OWN judgment.
Read every assigned reading! Her tests cover details from a wide range of the readings. There are essays or quizzes every two weeks, so don't put the readings off.
unfair grader, unorganized, biased and dont expect her to email you if you need help or be around for office hours.

Basically tells you to read the 3 books which she does not go over in class.  Lectures are her entertaining you with stories that aren't really useful, but you need to know.  Quizzes were ridiculously hard, averages of 12-15 out of 25 and assigns an obscene amount of writing for a 4-unit course.  Very disorganized, and rarely in her office for OH.

Well, this professor wouldn't be too bad if she didn't preach the whole time. She brings up really good points but the problem is, she assigns TOO MANY READINGS as if her class is the only one we're taking. Don't take Jennifer as a T.A, she's just as disorganized as the professor!
very easy class. show up and listen. read the chapter once, and review notes for midterm and final. very fair class. most complaints come from people not wanting to do any work. easy way to boost GPA
NOT A GOOD TEACHER. TESTS HAVE OFF THE WALL QUESTIONS. SOME OF THE TESTS HAD CLASS AVERAGE SCORE OF UNDER 60%. IF NOT FOR THE TA THIS WOULD HAVE REALLY A POOR EXPERIENCE

Preaches to the class the whole time... the whole f-ing class is biased and based on nothing concrete.  The textbook and supplementary readings are all subjective.  Never went to class, I always came out pissed off for having learned nothing. Hill is just a bitter person who needs to take a few more English classes.
Very interested and dedicated to her work.  She can borderline on being prechy, but has good reasons for what she is praching about.  If you can get by that, and work hard she's great.

She's completely incompetent.  Sociology can be an interesting subject, but she makes it abysmal.  Her socialist overtones get tiresome quickly and she really likes to invent her own words. How this woman ever received a PhD is something I will never understand.
Very entertaining. Always cracking jokes and making the class revelant to the student. A little indecisive when it came to deadlins.

She doesn't post up lectures in iLearn or slow down on lectures, so you can either study at home or just listen to her at the lectures. Yet, she does say what will be in the exams. As days pass by more, fewer people come.

I really enjoyed taking this class. I learned soo much. Dr. Hill knows how to keep her audience interested and her class is an easy A. Just make sure you get a good/easy TA cuz a lot of points come from ciritcal responses and also they correct the short answer section to the exams. Overall.. very easy material even though there is a lot of stuff bu

She's a very good lecturer. I didn't mind being in there at all. It is important to attend class, the videos and stories she tells in class shows up on the tests. Grading is done by TAs, so be nice to yours! Just make sure you over the review sheets before each test and you'll have no problem getting a good grade.
Very passionate about her topics. Funny and entertaining to listen to. Class is passable if you read the study guide.
hard to understand and doesnt really teach. Easy grader

Dr. Hill may be funny and entertaining in class, but she is very unorganized. There is too much reading for anyone to even remember the titles of the articles. She is one of the worst professors I have ever had!
awesome prof., very funny in her lectures!!! take her for all sociology class...i recommend her.
She is a very interesting professor and is quite entertaining. However, she is extremely unorganized. I felt like I didn't really learn anything new in this class but she grades fairly easy.
She was interesting and class attendance is important.

Assignments= 5 (1-2 pg) critical responses in which you have to analyze the readings and the many videos that she shows. Attend class on regular basis & pay attention to videos, they r usually part of short answer questions on her test, which are pretty simple if you pay attention throughout the course.
She was funny, passionate and made the subject interesting.  She was very easy and anyone who says otherwise is an idiot.

She is a very unorganized teacher and I was very disappointed. She gave me a C for some weird reason  on growl when I actually got a B+ for my overall grade.  I think the topic of Sociology is great but I think she made it seem boring than it really is. Otherwise her test were somewhat easy, but I understood most of the material through the textboo

She's really funny and passionate about sociology. She's really nice and truly cares about her students. Also, she's much more concerned about you learning then making you struggle for your grade. She shows alot of films and video clips though, so don't ditch class
SHe was a great teacher and made the topic very interesting. She knows her stuff and teaches in her creative ways and funny examples

Notes similar to book. Some are not, requires reading before lecture. Tests have some simple questions: terms and names, but the short essays are related to a lot of movies, Lowen article's, and other article's she has in her vast collection. You have to remember all concepts and dissect them from the articles using specific examples. READ A LOT :(

Her exams are not easy because she did not put any "important" ideas on the tests... we watch lots of videos and most the the exams are base on the videos. In addition, the class was very unorganized...she did not finish lectures and we have exams based on those lectures. She did not even provide notes. ( you need to study by yourself!)
No Comments
hard subject.   hill is great very interesting ideas and hilarious.

I don't believe that a teacher should give so many opinions if she is teaching alongside of the book. It's no wonder she is a part-time teacher.  She makes too many references about people cheating. On the tests, she puts in questions that are not related to anything. Society sucks because of her.

I don't agree with most of the reviews here.  Even though her lectures were taken straight out of the book, everything was laid out in an easy-to-understand manner.  And hell, she was funny!  Even though the material sucked (she couldn't help that) she put some of her funny spin to it.  Tests were easy if you read the stupid book.
She is awful!  Her classes are a complete waste of time, because all she does is go on rants about how it sucks to live in our society.....how this woman got her PhD, I will never understand.
she was ok....all questions were answered, a lot of material  to study though.
shes called a professor?
she can be a little confusing, but i've always enjoyed how animated she was. I had her for 110A before too. I got an A in both classes, but most people don't really like her. Oh well.

THE WORST PROFESSOR I"VE EVER HAD!!!!! Horrible in teaching the material....horrible in test material....she gives you about 50 minutes to complete a test that should take two hours!! Take this class with another professor otherwise you will be frusterated the entire quarter!!!!!!!!!!!! Stay away!
shes a pro.  so she thinks her students are like her. thats why her tests are impossible.  STAY AWAY FROM THIS PROFESSOR. OF ALL COST.
She is a bad teacher. I dont even think she knows what she is talking about most of the time.
No Comments

She's not a very good professor.  She says one thing and does another with her grading. She tries to cram way too much information at you at the last minute and expects you to know it all for the test that was usually only a couple of days later. Stay away from this professor if you can, she will only bring you misery, especially for a stats class.

To be honest, shes funny, shes a nice lady, but she gives bad lecture...shes always in a rush, and says her tests are EASy, but everyone ends up getting like a C average. Only because her wording on the test is horrible.  She puts up terms that werent even on the study guide.

She's a nice person, but a horrible professor. I had her for two classes the same quarter and we covered the same material even though the classes were completely unrelated. Everything wrong in soceity is because white people exist. She makes anyone who is white feel guilty for it. That sucks!

she's a cool teacher, she'll make you laugh. however, she's so focused on getting you all the information that you don't have time to even understand what she is saying. the test are okay not too hard.

She's got attitude...so this class isn't as boring as it could potentially be.  Unfortunately, she speeds through her lectures like Speedy Gonzalez on pep pills and gives students a totally inadequate time to write down notes.

POSC 110
