I loved Jasso.  I think he's brilliant, and taught us better than any other professor at UCR.  But don't expect to show up to class whenever you please, his lectures are crucial and extremely beneficial.  There's a lot of work, but it's worth it. You'll learn a lot!

Class requires small assignments. There aren't that many readings, just 1 case study. Overall the class is not diffucult I would say its a relaxing class. Easy filler if you dont have anything else to take. I recomend if you want an easy class.
Prof. Jasso is a conceited prick. AGSM should think twice about who they hire as a lecturer. Talked down to us students. Felt like he thought he was better than everyone.

first of all, jasso is far from being the best, but rather is limited at best. He is a teacher who still wants to focus on being young and appeal to a simple minded crowd, and at the same time wants to act as if he is one of the best intellectually    which is completely absurd, his teaching method is stale and out dated, he is the complacent one.

A real teacher. Expects a lot and gives a lot. Makes you learn through critical thinking; best way to lean. Lots of writing, but the experience is rewarding. Very articulate. Cares about students. Inspiring. Intellectually engaging. I'll take more classes with him. If you want to lean do the same. We need more teachers like Jasso.

There is a ton of writing, 3 in class essays, 10 page paper at the end and 4 case studies that are 5 pages each. If you are good at writing you'll get an A. Go to office hours, TA and professor! Get feedback on your writing. I thought it was an easy, interesting class. Review the book and notes often.
The worse professor at UCR period.

this class is a waste of time and you will find yourself wondering what the professor is talking about half the time because he constantly goes of tangent. Insane writings that are just busy work and have no value towards your actual education. TA's grade like crap and are a little weird so avoid this class if your looking for just grading.

Attend lecture so that you can get the essay questions for tests, read the book, lecture will not cover everything needed for essays, start the 15 pg paper right away, easy pick is the Sarbanes Oxley Act of 2002, there is a quota on A's given so complimenting him makes a difference between a 89% or a 91%

I have to say this course is all about writing. Simply it is a writing class but with no feedback. If you are a self-regulated people and very good at bluffing, you need to take this class. The professor is teaching in three schools(ashamed for a Ph.D.). It is no wonder that he never grades and gives out the same essay quesions over and over.

An excellent professor. For the people who are dumb enough to think that your professor grades all your work... YOU ARE IN COLLEGE...TA's grade the work. He's a nice guy and if a great professor.   Yes this class is rediculously hard... but he is a good prof

I don't understand why people are bashing this prof. He is a cool guy who actually cares about the students. Yes his class is annoying hard, but welcome to college. We aren't in high school anymore. Enjoy it.

(Continued)If your TA is kind and you are good at writing, talking about ethics with big words, than you probably get a B+ or A-. Otherwise, you cannot make it. 15-page law research paper, 4-page case study and a quizz each week. Mid-term takes two days to write tedious essays. He never looks at them at all. He is pointless and ignorant in lecuture

Dr. Jasso was the antithesis of a good professor.  Self-absorbed, self-important, and making reference to his own work as the authority, he has no concept of how to properly communicate concepts.  He also assigns weighting of grades to bizarre places.  I got B- to B on all midterms/final paper and got a C-. For TAS, Vinesh is horrible, switch now!

People, this is COLLEGE! Yes, there is a 15 page paper, yes, this is a difficult class, yes, you will be required to do work. But what else do you expect from a college course? You will not go far in life, or this course if you dont try. So put in some effort, and you'll be fine.

I have gastrointestinal problems and Dr. Jasso kindly looked out for me. Honestly, his class isn't easy. You must study and pay attention, and do your homework. His expectations are clear, readings are thorough, research requirements are manageable. He calls out bad students. He's improved his teaching and how he listens to students.

I thought that he is arrogant and unhelpful to students. his lectures are repetitive and class is mandatory because during my class the day I missed he sent an attendance sheet around. he also assigns work that has no grade value and expects it to be done (ethics handbook).

This guy is part of the reason why I want to get out of UCR in general. He is a terrible professor who assigns to much for you to do given a 40+hr workweek and on top of this he is full of himself. Do yourself a favor and dont take this course. You will do ALOT Of work that will give you little to no payout.
Great teacher, loves what he does!

His level of conceit is so high, you can sense it in every word he utters. He looks down on his students as petty, ignorant, stupid liberal blobs of flesh and acts as though he has lived life twice already. His coursework is tedious and repetative. Lectures are random and subjective; he likes to throw out partisan arguments and not allow debate.

This is not too hard of a class if you want a B. Getting an A in this class is hard, so if you need an A do NOT take this class. To do well you need to be a good writer and be willing to put in a lot of work. Professor is pretty arrogant. =(

I had him for Bus 102 and 103.  Pretty hard professor and also give you a lot of reading, writting and research.  However, he'll push you to the limit and beyound.  Excellent professor and highly recommended if you don't mind the work.

Arrogant sure.  Demanding very.  Clear expectations yes.  If you want to learn and really stretch your brain, he'll do that.  If you just want to show up and pass the class find another professor.  He will help and guide you.  I had him over a year ago and he still helps me with other classes.  A great professor!

He's hard and talks at random. His tests are very subjective - essays only and a ridiculously long policy paper (minimum 15 pages.) He is arrogant and thinks his subject is the most important one and you can't live  a "fulfilling" life without it. If you take him, get ready for a lot of work.
Avoid him if you can!!!!!!

I had him for Bus 109 and 103. He is a lot of work and there is group work. He assigns random assignments at random times on top of the loads of work. Overall, he's a good professor. He's funny and a little cocky. He's a little ignorant too but you just have to get his sense of humor behind things.

I had him for Marketing and I took him again because it was the only BUS109 class that fit into my schedule.  Unfortunately, he not that great of a professor.  He's really funny and a great story teller, but at the end of the day you leave class with only a basic understanding of business strategy.  He's quite ignorant and prejudiced at times too.
very useful teaching, while being funny. the things he teaches requires you to think, and it may be a bit complicated.he does require you to do lots of research work though
really boring. he gets mad when your late to his class and he's very random.

HE IS A VERY GOOD PROFESSOR, GREATE IN MARKETING. YOU DO NOT NEED TO BUY THE BOOK, JUST GO TO HIS LECTURE AND DISCUSSION, TAKE NOTES, YOU WILL BE FINE. THERE WILL A 15-20 PAGE ESSAY DUE AT THE END OF THE QUARTER, SO BE AWARE OF IT.

Rambles about useless stuff and always goes off tangent.  Sure he's funny, but I didn't learn anything useful.  On top of that you have this ridiculous 15 page paper which he is very unclear about.  Class is unstructured and he barely writes anything he talks about or use power point.  You are better off taking Bowman for marketing.

I don't see how anoyone could have possibly liked Mr. Jasso.  He talks down to his students and treats us as if we're ignorant, incompetent children.  He's always bragging about stuff and telling us completely useless stories.  He is ALWAYS going off topic.  Oh, and on the first day he told us that he doesnt give out many A's.  And I got an A-

The most pointless professor I have ever had in my life!!!! The professor does no care if you learn something or not, he doesnt teach he is constantly off topic and as if this isnt enough he is haughty and treats his students like ignorant tools. Somebody needs to take out the garbage at UCR.

Jasso is arrogant, he brags about all the insitutions he has attended and yet he is extremely ignorant. I got an A in his class but not because i went to class or took notes. He is the worst professor i have ever had at UCR :( And he demeans his students every chance he gets.

class was chill.  he is very sarcastic, which keeps things interesting. the 15 page paper was a little excessive for your first business class in college, but it was just busy work. overall, pretty good teacher who can keep your attention.

Do not take this class if you are not willing to put a lot of work and effort. He is a good teacher but gives a TON of work. 2 10-pg papers, hw every week, 20pg group paper and group presentation. You learn a lot and if you do all of the work it is a guaranteed B. He's funny and don't fall asleep in class or he'll pick on you.
very cool and easy teacher, lots of work but nothing too much, fun class, and you actually learn alot

I dont know what's wrong with him. He talks and talks and talks and acts like he knows everything when he's just filling in class time with his b.s. that stupid 15 page paper that he makes students do is also full of crap. we're in bus10 not bus40 and hes throwing this crap on us.

Jasso is a good teacher. Go to class, pay attention and do all the work. You will pass with an A or B. There is nothing really difficult about this teacher. You will receive a multiple choice exam and an essay exam. The essay exam will help a lot, so make sure you know what to write.

Class was on marketing institutions, so the material was very dry, but not the professors fault.  Nice guy who gives students multiple opportunities to turn in hw, but sometimes you are not quite sure what he wants.  2 take home essay exams and a group project are required.

Professor is hilarious and does really seem to care about material that he teaches.  He approaches marketing in an interesting manner.  The only thing that was annoying were the weekly quizzes offered in discussion sections and the long marketing project, but class was interesting and you learn a lot

He's funny and easy talking. I really liked his class and you will. I got an A, you need to prepare some term-paper but it will def. help you. He doesn't much go over the text books but if your attendance is perfect, you will get an A. All your exams are from the lecture not the book, of course tons of terminologies from the book.

I don't know why people talk **** on him, he's hilarious in his classes, you learn a lot of important aspects on marketing, not just textbook stuff, his classes aren't boring and yea there was a 15-page paper, but he was fair when it came to his tests.  I've taken him 3 times and gotten an A everytime.
No Comments

this is one of my favorite professors. He'll prank call companies during and he jokes around. This is the second time i've had a class with him and i think ppl just take him too seriously. hes not arrogant, hes just confident. he never talks bad about UCR, i find it annoying that he defends it so much. just to lecture and remember the stupid words

He talks about lots of things randomly during lecture and thus, it's kinda hard to take organized notes from him. However, parts of his words will be on the test, really need to listen. DO go to the review lecture. Need to read for key terms n idea for test n short essay. Don't know what he really wants from research papaer, depends on TA i guess.

Kind of assholish.  Absolutely no organization to his lecture whatsoever.  Jumps from topic to topic, but you have to listen because random bits from his lectures appear on the exams.  You also have to do the reading because he picks on people in lecture and asks them to explain it... and heaven help you if you don't know.

Arrogant. He likes to go on and on about all the fine institutions he has attended and how UCR isnt that great, so basically we all suck and he is almighty. His class isnt too hard. Its easy to get a B but I don’t know about an A. I dont think he likes to give out A's b/c somehow I was at a B+ the whole quarter, even after I got an a on A the final

Does not get to the point! Makes me crazy.. also he's unclear on what he expects on his assignments, such as the research paper or whats on the midterm. But overall seems like a nice guy. You don't really have to go to his lectures, since he just rambles on.. which is good. BUt make sure you read the book.

He is probably the most useless professor I've had so far.  He rambles on about all these stupid topics which would be very meaningful but I've had two philosophy classes and he was trying to sound like he knew what he was saying but just said lame things in an arrogant way.  I learned more about business researching for my paper than from him.

if you do the reading from the text and go to lecture, the midterms are pretty straight forward.  VERY easy B, work for an A. the last questions on the midterms are graded rather harsh, even though it's only out of 3 points or so,it really hurts your grade.It's stupid,because my TA wouldn't giv the full credits.he said the professor told him not to
He just liked to talk a lot, didnt do a good job of presenting the material. Also, he messed up on my final grade, along with several other students'.

Even the conservative professors would be appalled by him. His ****, classist, and misogynistic remarks were obvious to the point that they became comical. He is a rude, unintelligent, arrogant pedagog who completely disregards human worth.
he was great and had lots to say

his class is okay. his lectures are pretty tedious but interesting. Exams are very easy if you know all the terms in the text and attend the lectures. he tend to give out the questions from the lectures (even if they are silly) So definitely attend all the lectures and you will do fine.
he is an evil teacher, he changed our final one week earlier from the actual final, but only gave us one day to study for the WHOLE finals, and that just sucks~!

He gave wayyy too much work for a 2-unit class - 2 5-10pg papers! Had a conservative bias in class - made conservative political statements without backing them up, and graded down one of my papers for having an opposing point of view. I give him that the material was interesting, but the bad outweighed the good in his class.
No Comments

The worst prof I've ever had. Rambles about nothing in class, no notes prepared, and basically acts like he knows what he's talking about. Picks on students in lecture, which is so pathetic. I didn't learn a single thing. Tests are tedious with irrelevent info. Avoid him if possible. Horrible!

Horrible professor who is never prepared.  The tests have random questions about things that he thinks he talked about in lecture.  "What is marketing?" Answer: "Everything"  This is how the class is run and it is disgraceful. I doubt this guy even knows one thing about business in reality.No ethics

Easy teacher that just talked about anything that popped into his head, tried to be mean but it didn't work, he even forced kids to fill up all the spaces in the UV! Nobody learned anything and everyone got an A on the paper. pointless class, and an easy a if you have good common sense

Class was such a joke. The test questions are pretty much common sense. EVERYONE got an A on the research paper (not an exageration). SOOO little material is covered during lecture. Waste of time. If you don't get at least a B in the class, you're hopeless. Oh yea, makes a lot of unfunny jokes. =(

OMG!! this wasnt even a class. he was so unprepared to teach. he gave random homework assignments from the top of his head. he talked off topic like an idiot. he threatened everyone to attend lecture by sayin it was mandatory. haha but no one went. easy to cheat in thas class!! very easy!!

WORST TEACHER EVER!!!  that is, if you want to call him a teacher.  the class should be called Life 101.  if you've payed attention at all during your life to ANYTHING, then this class is cake.  but please, CHANGE YOUR MAJOR before taking this class.  he is such a moron and should not be teaching!!!

Ok basically you attend lecture and he just talks about random things that come up in his mind and tries to connect it to Business.The class is not hard at all, he assigns little assignments that dont even count towards your grade,and miterms/final are so easy! Proff. is unorganized but easy. Peace!

He's horrible, he picks on students during lecture, makes you go to class. tries to be funny but now. think he's better than us, makes fun of students during lecture. harder than other professors for bsad 10, 10 page essay project for the class. HORRIBLE!
He so boring and he calls on random students for answers (thats why i dont like going to lectures) and his tests are soooo much harder than the other bsad 10 professors! so avoid him if possible

The worst professor i have ever had. by taking attedence and throwing out random questions during lectures to force people to go to his lecture that is very useless is stupid and pointless. even tho his midterm was easy.
his class is so... dumb! he makes lectures mandatory, when he doesnt even teach. its completely useless!!!

He makes 2 units class as 4-unit-working. It is very REDICULOUS! His way of teaching is repetitious and very biased. Because of his prejudiced conclusion, he limits any sides of topic about UN. I guess he has no talent to teach Poli Sci. I do NOT recommend his class. You are gonna regret.

You read 5 plays, which isn't bad at all! You just have to actually try and act and put yourself out there. Fostered a great community and was kind to us. Our TA was chill! Intro to acting class so it's not supposed to be some advanced studio class. Breadth friendly. The writing assignments and exams are easy if you just put in some effort.

Free class as long as you show up and try. He's a really nice guy too and will accomodate. Just pay attention to the readings in the syllabus and if you at least glance through them the written part of the midterm and final will be free.
There were some extremely frustrating moments over the time in this course from both the professor and the students. Not overall a fun and informative class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: A sweet professor. His class is more "Let's try acting," so it's great for beginners. Though we only acted out two times, which I was bummed out about. The midterm was difficult since you HAD to remember every little thing from the plays and his lectures. TA's grading is somewhat ok. Read 5 plays only. Its more sitting and writing than acting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I thought this would be easy but there are 5 plays that you have to read and the exams are free response. The TA grades hard. Attendance is mandatory and is taken for both lecture and discussion. If you are more than 5 minutes late for both, you will a 1/2 on attendance which is 50%, and it's a huge part of your grade. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!

way too much work for a breath course. Read 5 plays, write a 3-5pg essay, 1 written midterm and final both about his 6 virtual lectures that are 20-40 minutes long. We only got 2 real acting performances this whole quarter. Go take this class with the other professor if you are looking to learn how to actually act instead of reading and writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: dont do it
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Make sure you take the time to memorize the plays and get very familiar with your partner and he will pass you. Professor sees the class as lets TRY to act so he's very understanding. honestly I thought Id be embarrassed but it fr doesn't matter get on stage say the lines and get that A.

class is pretty easy. He's cool, I don't have a problem w him. 3 hour long lecture which was not good since I got bored. I got 100% on midterm surprisingly, I thought I didn't do good cuz I didn't really read or remember the plays. easy A just take the class
Awesome teacher. Definitely recommend taking his class.

The class is a more reading/writing than I expected, but it wasn't hard at all. We have 2 performances in the quarter (before midterm and final), and the top performances each time were given an automatic A on the respective exam which I loved. 
My TA, Andrew, has cerebral palsy and was hard to understand sometimes but he is very nice and funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: The class was very difficult when this is an intro to acting class. He expected a lot out of us despite him cancelling class on a few occasions. You have to read plays which he doesn't really incorporate into how to act well. You will be saying to yourself "why did I do this?"
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He acknowledge that this was an introductory acting class, which was understandable, until we began to get into the material. He expects you to remember every detail from 5 plays. He was late to many classes and cancelled classes without notice many times. In the end, he gave hope in cancelling the final, but expected academy award acting.

Honestly, professor Carazo was a good professor. There were more writing assignments than I originally expected but they were easy and the TA didn't give me a hard time with the grading at all. I really like how the class lecture was literally only 15 min video a week. Professor Carazo does a good job of getting straight to the point.

He gives way too much homework. About 1000 words per week. TA's a really harsh grader, I really understand, sympathize, and respect for his hard work while living with mental illness. But it makes students a lot harder to understand him. Especially when TA does pretty much everything. Dont take him as breath.

He's not a good online teacher. Expect lots of homework. I would say he is giving twice as much homework as my upperdivision classes, which is insane. There is a paper due every week. Single spaced I might add. The TA grades so grading is different every class. I had to spend $70 on books of plays for the class. He just expects a lot. Not an easy A

Professor Carazo is great! This class was Intro to Acting, and it was so much fun. The material is easy and there aren't many assignments aside from discussion boards and very short reports on plays. TA does all grading and is a very easy grader. No tests aside from Midterm and Final, as well as 2 performances. Definitely would take again!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: A decent teacher and class :) pretty easy assignments and exams as well, do what is expected and you will get an A!! Another person mentioned that our final was posted an hour late and that is true but we were awarded with extra credit and a three hour extension, the TA and professor were really considerate.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: At the beginning of the course, it felt like home, it had reminded me of my High School drama experience- but then, it all changed. The professor's lectures became shorter and shorter, until it was nothing but outside sources. Not mention the cherry on top; the final, 1 hour late, no apologies, nothing. Just a long winded and recycled questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved him for acting: the process! fun class, interesting way of teaching, and would hope to have him again for another acting class :)

Do not take him!! Its an intro class and he makes it seem like its not and he ask for so much to do! And his TA grades everything and shes a horrible grader. Take the other intro to acting class. I believe his name starts  with a B I heard hes really easy and chill.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Awesome professor! Really fun class! Some work in the beginning but not hard. If you are outgoing or want to become more so then take this class! (If you are taking it with a friend make sure to have same discussion time! You only work with people in your same discussion)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class requires you to go outside your comfort zone and explore a different role other than your own. You can't afford to be shy. There is memorization of scripts and a lot of teamwork. Also there are readings and small papers you need to write.

The hardest thing about this class was working on a group acting presentation. If you're lucky, you'll pick a good group, but if not, good luck. Otherwise, this class was pretty interesting and fun, you get to perform and watch others perform. Luis is super fun as well!! Make sure to talk to him outside of class, he is so supportive and helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Overall Luis is a great professor. Some of his policies frustrated me and that's the only reason I wouldn't take another class with him, but at the end of the day he's a great professor, fair grader, and his class was really fun. Just make sure you go to class because attendance was worth more than 20% of my grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Made the class a ton of fun. Hope to take several more with him.

He is one of the most involved teachers i have ever met on campus. He will take the time to help you if you need it but the class is pretty straight forward. You MUST READ THE PLAYS. There are a few reports but they will be pretty easy to complete as long as you read the plays.
Best class I've ever taken. Easy A. However, he has a passion for this class so be ready to work a little. But just take him. He's really easy.

Easy A as long as you participate. Class is pretty much mandatory cause he take attendance. Really fun class. By the end of the quarter, you'll definitely love it. Pick good group partners cause you're basically stuck with them for the rest of the semester lol. Definitely take it!

Awesome Professor. Class was always a good time. The only time you take notes is during the first two weeks then the rest of the quarter is all activities in class. I would love to have him as a professor again.
He is the reason why I love UCR. Seriously, he made my first year at UCR awesome. The best teacher EVER. Easy and fun! Take him!
Luis is definately one of the best professors I have ever had in all my years of schooling. He actaully cares about the progress of each student. This is an easy A course IF you actually do the work.

Luis is an amazing professor who actually cares about his students' progress.  He is a working actor and is easily relatable. Each class was fun and enjoyable and he does not rely on a textbook.  We did have to read a play a week for the first half of the quarter, but they were easy reads.  Take this class!
Very laidback and fun. But you must also put in work so that your acting isn't just mediocre. Lots of play redings books but they are interesting reads. Overall fun class!
He is awesome. Helps that he is an active actor. Also he cares more about the development of the student than using textbooks. Really fun and easy to talk to as well.
Luis is actually an actor. This is very fun/chill class. The class has a bit of writing though. It's college come on.

This professor grades strictly on very few assignments and provides no feedback, even when students ask for it. He rushes through lecture material which is based off of his own textbook and a bunch of cluttered slides generated by NotebookLM. His teaching style is very sloppy and I sadly didn't learn much from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Did not give clear guidelines for any assignment, would refer you to youtube or ai for help, so I wouldn't recommend for people who second guess themselves.
Awesome, go for it.

Prof. is a pro in his field and and amazing communicator, makes things simple for us and one of the best I've come across till now. He not only just shares topic knowledge he goes a step beyond and teaches us real life implications 

He cares a lot about students and shares amazing materials that helps you beyond the course.

Great guy, solid professor. Lectures there is so much content, can sometimes get boring, and he goes a bit fast. But the content can be interesting. It will take some effort from the students side to do well but as long as you can understand and go at his pace, it's a fun course!

Weekly reading and reflection assignments, take home midterm, and a group project broken down into several assignments. Project isn't too bad as long as you stay on schedule and don't procrastinate. Issues were that assignment instructions sometimes weren't clear and would prof would often post assignments the day they were due without announcing

Cares a lot about students, very proactive and clear in lectures. Attendance and participation required but its very easy. Also very understanding and accommodating to students, even delayed the take home midterm due date for us.
Look Moulik seems like a really nice guy who I would definitely have a beer or watch a soccer game with. He's like the ideal father-in-law. But jeez his class was boring.
This guy is a certified yapper, but he is very kind.

The most unorganized professor I ever met, gave the midterm on week 8 that cover more than 500 slides. This dude has a extremely ambiguous guideline on how he grade your participation grade. Super lazy, grade all of your assignments after week 10 and post it immediately so he can ignore all the emails students sent him

Great professor who gives really interesting lectures that are driven by his passion for information systems. The assignments were straightforward but the midterm was surprisingly difficult. The class was overall enjoyable, but the TAs were atrocious. Considering he is such a good professor, I hope he can find better TAs in the future.
Very nice prof who cares about his students. Lectures can be a bit messy. Beware the exams don't match his lectures!

Very caring. Class is graded on a midterm, group project, indiv. and group assignments. Gives extra credit opportunities. Lectures can get boring but definitely not the worst. Very caring of student and wants to give them all an easier time.

Easiest class ever, made stuff so easy by not teaching python & the grading was easy too as long as you got work done. Easiest A i got. People wanted to learn python but i prefer getting better grades than learning something hard and this class was definitely that. He gave us a lot of chance to improve our score through assignments. Easiest class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super easy professor. Literally do not even need to go to class to get an A+. Basically, 70% of your grade is based off of super easy group and individuals assignments that are already posted all over Google. Midterm was alright, just use common computer knowledge and you should get a good score. I'd take again for an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took BUS-101 class. Attending lecture is a waste of time. Assignments (all writing) are super easy, just Google everything. Midterm was not related to the class (midterm review didn't help either). No final, just a group project. Team up with good people, and you're set.

Had him for Bus101; he is a very unorganized professor, incredibly unorganized. Multiple group and individual assignments and lectures were unrelated; he'd just start talking about completely unrelated things. The Midterm was online in person and unrelated to the content in class. One final group project and no final. Pointless class.

I took him for both BUS 171/173 and man this dude never fails to surprise me. He comes to lectures with a bag full of opinions and boy you're gonna hear all of them. He often rushes through the slides and goes off on tangents. Lax interpretation of the syllabus and some assignments get scrubbed off the agenda. Every week is filled with surprises.

Had her for HIST30 last quarter, she's amazing! Lectures are very casual; she does encourage you to talk. Easy grader for in-class writes and tests. Tests are not multiple choice, mostly a loose prompt, and you write.

She's very pro creative writing/free form and likes it when students share their thoughts in class (tho participation isn't mandatory). Lectures are slightly scatter brained but interesting none the less. Managed to pass with a be with doing little to no readings at all. TAs are very helpful. Tells you exactly what will be on the exams

Professor McGarry is a bloody genius. Wish I could take it again.

great class! pretty interesting and not like other history classes with just facts and dates. tests not too hard. just go to class. you have to pay attention to take good notes.

hated this class!  She talks about history like everyone in the room has a Ph.D and she will not slow down in her lectures. She gives keywords and an essay for midrem/final which basically come from lect

There was kind of a lot of reading, but discussions were always really good.  Everyone's opinion respected. My favorite prof/class ever.
Great class, cool media!  Made history come alive.

She is wayyy liberal and hates anything that challenges her political views. I had to rewrite my term paper, it was way lame.  I busted balls in this class, but it paid off. Peace loving conservatives avoid this class.

Professor Womack was so kind. Not sure where the bad reviews are stemming from cause the class was very easy to manage and it was easy to stay on top of the content. She was quick to respond to questions and was very understanding and accepting of all students. She even encouraged everyone to reach out if they had personal questions.
She's so sweet and very understanding. The lectures are easy to digest. You do have to write essays, but they're pretty straightforward. For her the class I took was GSST001S.

Professor Womack was wonderful and so caring. This was meant to be an in-person class but it was online. Cuz the professor had some family issues, but it was alright. reviews.comment: Her teaching style and the amount of group work are not conducive to my learning.

Professor Womack is a kind and caring professor that wants to see her students succeed. She gives all essential materials needed and does not require and other textbooks. As a transfer student, Prof. Womack is a gem I discovered at UCR. I have taken 3 classes with her because the material she brings to class is captivating and relatively important to current events. One of my favorite professors at UCR! Many discussions are involved in the class, but it helps you understand the concepts and readings in the class. I have learned so many important things in this class and other classes with Professor Womack, which have helped me personally!

Professor Womack has been hands down one of my favorite professors at UCR. I was thrilled to have the opportunity to take another one of her classes since she truly cares about her students success. Prof Womacks class is incredibly inspirational to be in. She is incredibly passionate about what she's teaching and values others opinions. Amazing professor! Dr. Womack is super caring and accessible to students and works hard to create a classroom environment that helps understand the content on a deep level and reflect on it as a group. Prof. Womack was one of the highlights for me during my time at UCR. She's caring, passionate about the subject matter, and did a great job organizing her class. She is a fantastic lecturer and educator and I looked forward to going to her class!

Participation matters. Class expectations are straightforward and grading is fair. Highly Recommend!

professor tanya does not give feedback on papers unless you bug her in office hours. she can make lecture fun for students. the test are book based so you really need to understand concepts and know examples.

Tanya is so sweet and willing to help anyone that needs it! i would recommend her to anyone! her lectures are based off power points and her grading scale is well put out. if she teaches other classes no doubt i'll sign up!

reviews.comment: She’s not that bad you just have to pay attention to lectures and take notes during class. You don’t even have to read the textbook as long as you listen to her and go to office hours. She gives clicker questions during office hours and it helps during exams

Her slides are TERRIBLE and old. Her lectures aren't clear. Constantly has problems with zoom. Grade cutoffs were unknown. Sucks at communicating. Graded on only the exams and discussion. Discussion attendance is 4% of the grade only! Seriously avoid her if you want to save your GPA. I had to do god knows what to barely get an A-. AVOID HER!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Questions are worded in extremely convoluted ways that leave multiple possible answers. In all respect she knows exactly what she is talking about; but explains it in a way that goes over most peoples heads. She is a prof who disagrees with the book.

If you get this professor, leave the class. Not help with explaination and very rush. My fried who had her ask if she could get slides ahead cause she want to learn ahead of time and get it over, did not post it until the day she was really busy. She takes a while to understand the situation, and very stubborn like when someone ask for zoom code.

I had this professor for the second half of the quarter for this course. To succeed in her class you need to be able to teach yourself a lot of things as this professor is far from approachable. Make sure to read the notes, attend lecture, do the HW, and read read read the notes. If you want to have a chance at the exams, attend her study sessions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Final is so unfair. Actually all of the tests are super unfair. They are wayyyyy too difficult for the learning criteria necessary for the course. I would rate as a zero if possible do not take this prof if you have the choice. Not worth ruining your gpa. Even with studying as much as possible you will not pass or get close to the grade you want.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Exams were unnecessarily hard for an intro bio class. Confusing wording and majority of kids score a C in this class. Rude to students and she will yell at them over small things
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: AVOID HER LIKE THE PLAGUE! You better know how to study in this class w the complex material & weird wording on exams. This prof is so rude & indifferent; she wonders why people don't come to OH because she snaps at you when you ask questions & gives unnecessary responses then assumes you don't come to class. She'll make you feel less than a person
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: For being an intro bio class this class gave me so much stress, her slides are mostly pictures and she goes so fast. Lectures are already difficult to understand but exams are so painfully hard. If you have the option to take any other prof take them, avoid this professor. Even my smart bio friends struggled heavily in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This professor seems to think you should already know everything about biology before even taking the class. The tests do not reflect what is discussed in class and she doesn't curve the class grades. She has mentioned her average is about 52% yet she sets a C- to 57%... this is completely unfair. If you have to option, do not take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She taught the material nicely; however, her exams were tough :( During the exams, she would leave her mic on, which was very annoying. You also can't go back and change your answers :/ Also, some of her questions were on quizlets, so just look around and you will be better prepared for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you are not a good test taker (like myself) DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF! The grade is made up of only 2 midterms, the final, and discussion quizzes/worksheets(WKSTS ONLY WORTH 0.5 points!!!) This prof is a good lecturer but not too approachable. Lectures are recorded and posted. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you're a premed student, this is one of the weeder courses. Class was so hard and exams were on a completely different level. I struggled SO much in this class but then took Bio 5B and got an A+. Just push through the class and try your best. Make sure you watch lectures and READ THE BOOK!

MG has an attitude that makes you not want to go to class at all, and refers to examples that are difficult to understand. She also gets very distracted with technological issues, and often would hold the class back after lecture ends just because someone started packing up at the 5 or 10 minute mark. Her tests are badly worded and confusing. AVOID
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: MG is not an understanding professor, I took her class in the midst of the COVID19 outbreak and she truly tried her hardest to make it harder on us. She did not end up rounding my grade up either. This class was split between Dehesh and MG and Dehesh was BY FAR a better lecturer. MG's lectures are mostly pictures good luck to non-visual learners
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: awful professor & confusing lectures. she seems nice at first but if you personally ask her a question, there's a good chance she'll be rude to you. Her test questions are confusing, unnecessarily long & badly worded. Don't rely on her redemption system because it doesn't really work. If you're stuck with her, prioritize bio over all other classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: amazing prof. shes so sweet and caring about the students, but bio5A is generally a hard course so as long as you thoroughly understand the material, youll be okay

Bio005a itself is a difficult class especially because the only points that factor in your grade are your midterms, final, and discussion quizzes. Dr. Martins-Green's questions on her tests are really long and confusing; her lectures are practically all pictures so you really need to focus and pay attention.

If you are a visual learner you will do great but if not good luck. Basically all her slides are pictures which she verbally explains but in a 500 person lecture hall its a little hard to understand. Its like she knows exactly what she is talking about but doesn't actually teach it to us she just shows us then expects us to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: MG is an okay professor. She rambles a lot and is often distracted by technology. Copy down whatever she writes on the board and annotate the notes she posts online. Some of the exam content are not talked about in lecture so read the book and PRACTICE USING THE BOOK QUESTIONS. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. MG was a fantastic professor and she really wanted all of her students to succeed. I realized this the first day of lecture and studied practically daily for the class, even if it was for a mere 30 minutes. The class is not hard at all, even though there might be some difficult questions on her tests. READ THE TEXTBOOK RELIGIOUSLY!

She goes really fast during lectures and can come off a bit mean, but if you ask her questions personally she's nice. She does A LOT of clickers certain days so make sure to go to class. Make sure you read/watch videos and know how to apply the content. Her exam questions are HARD. Make sure you are on top of everything you learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Her lectures are very heavy and fast paced. She posts the notes online so be sure to print them out and takes notes on the print outs. Make sure you understand the material before class. If you plan on learning the material during class you won't survive. Use her lecture as a review of what you read. You have to work for the A to get the A.

Great Teacher but expects a lot from you. Nothnagael's side was a lot easier. Final was nothing like the Midterms. It was 100 questions and felt like hell. Do not study last min. unless you plan on failing. CPR's are pretty easy if you go to TA office hours and ask for help. I got a B bc I did not really prepare that well for the Final.

Dr. Martins-Green is a great professor who takes time to help students. Whenever I had an issue that I would bring up to her, she would talk me through it and make sure I understood it.  I enjoyed having her as a professor, but I have some friends who were on the fence about her and other friends who just didn't like her, so it depends.
She is very arrogant and all over the place, not very clear. I felt intimidated to ask a question because the way she answers is very discouraging and unhelpful and condescending. AVOID AT ALL COSTS

As soon as she starts teaching, read and outline the chapters she teaches. Every tiny detail has the possibility of showing up on her midterm and final. Her questions are tricky and must be read at least three times over. For the final, study from the textbook, lecture notes, and homework. A challenging professor, but she means well.

She's brilliant, knows her stuff, and cares about her students! Given that, the exams test conceptual understanding and piecing information together - just like real life in the science arena.  Currently in med school and wouldn't be here if it weren't for her class.  Go to office hours, ask questions and be eager to learn.  She'll warm up to you.

She is a professor that definitely wants to see you succeed -- and willing to do more for it if you are willing to also. Very enjoyable professor person to person. Her lectures are generally pretty clear, especially with the slides provided, but at times, she moves too fast on hard subjects and too slowly on easy. Her tests are hard, so prepare.

Dr. Green was an ok lecturer. She often times yells into the mic and talks loudly, but it keeps the students awake. This class was difficult if you made it. I read all the assigned readings and studied almost daily for this class. Go to discussion and lecture as those are free points. The curve was good A- (80%) i received a 91% overall studying!!

She definitely wants all of her students to succeed. She isn't one of those lazy teachers. She is readily available for your help. The main negative is that her tests are beyond difficult. The avg on the first midterm which was Maslovs portion was a 76%. When she taught the avg on the second midterm was a 56% and the final was a 59%.  80% A-

half noth and half martins...I personally disliked noth, but found her to be more clear and flat out. She clear, but make sure you understand the concepts and do the self quizzes in your text. I can't stress the textbook enough, use the book! And the final is pretty hard so make sure you understand the central dogma really well. (translation, etc.)

Pretty easy class overall, as a recommendation just make sure you study the book, attend lecture because there are clicker questions and DO THE SELF-QUIZ questions in the textbook. Also use internet flashcards, they really do help you see if you mastered the material. But beware of the final, it does slip up a lot of people...
HARD! She talks and goes through slides too fast. She does not write a lot of notes in class and mostly uses her slides (which is available online).

Great professor but scary. Just had final today and she dismissed this girl's test for working 4 minutes after Dr. Martins-Green called time. She's serious with her testing policies, so don't try anything cute. However, she is extremely smart, though, and she does teach the course material well. Her test questions are easier than Dr. Nothnagel's.

She doesn't take the time to fully make sure that a student's question is thoroughly answered.She answers quickly and then jumps to move on. She is a verbal teacher so watch out. you might want to record the lecture because she hardly uses the power point and when she writes things on the board it is very vague She'd write one word & verbally speak

She's beyond hard. She is incredibly knowledgeable of biology--hands down, she knows what she's talking about, but her tests are far from easy. Before the midterm and final, she sets up many review sessions and Q&A's, which helped me in the long-run.

I thought MG was an interesting teacher. I didn't think she was as bad as many people put on here. Although I would personally prefer Dr. Nothnagel I really enjoyed her. If you take her be prepared for fast writing and pay attention to her examples.

Very hard and requires that you pay really close attention to every little detail. She made this class too hard for an introductory bio course. She is hard to understand and expects you to come to class with prior knowledge. Very negative and puts students down. This was a terrible experience but so are all the bio courses offered here

I read every little detail in the book. I went to every class. But I have one things to say bout her midterm and final. Its honestly difficult. I understood everything and passed with a c+. Her tests are worded in such a confusing way. As a person she seems unapproachable person but she is nice, however, if u wanna pass with an A take someone else

The professor looks like she knows what she's doing, but all she does is read the power points word by word. She encourages you to pass, but when she took over the class the home work averages just dropped. She is the 2nd professor for the class so take her if you want.

She truly cares about her students. However, that is simply not enough. She is not a great teacher and all she does is put slide after slide which will make you fall asleep. She has an accent which is understandable but still. Her test are much more difficult that Nothnagel but they come as a joint package. Curve is decent so take her for Nothnagel

I had nothdog for the first part of the quarter and I thought he was sort of funny and annoying at first but then I loved him towards the end and now I realllllyy wish that martin's-green did not take over the class because she just cannot teach. Hard to understand and I just stopped going to lecture overall. if you can take another prof/nothnagel
She truly wants her students to do well and is extremely helpful during her office hours. I really enjoyed her class but make sure to study alot in this class. It's worth it!

she's hilarious because she YELLS, i mean YELLS, at the top of her lungs to the class and especially to students who leave class early. but she's a good teacher. take her, it's entertaining and a learning experience.
omg i wished nothangel stayed, this teacher looks like a woman version of dr. nothangel.

she is an easy test taker. but she doesnt teach. have to learn on your own. her lectures are boring. and she wastes time teaching students how to take notes which was really dumb of her. she didnt go over the material at all. and just assign us to read on our won.

I took this class in 2003 when there was no HW. However, she seemed pretty straight forward at the time. I believe people just complain about her b/c Nothnagel makes her look bad by going above and beyond the call. In reality, she and Nothnagel are among the best Bio Prof's at UCR.

Nothnagel is a better lecturer. Her exams are somewhat tricky..and that sucks because she makes up a large portion of the final. Be prepared to do some self learning. She does go over important points more thoroughly, so that is a plus.
No Comments

She gives out a handout of the slides she presents in class but not all of them are on the h/o so you have to write them down.  And she expects you to be fast.  I suggest you take double notes or re-write your notes b/c if you want the slides + the notes, you have to re-write your notes.
very hard to understand what she is saying. tests are very hard
she sucks at teaching. she talks really fast and she's a **** in person. nothnagel is like 100000 times better at teaching and so much nicer.

She's a good professor.  Several problems though: talks really fast, expects you to be able to write what's not in the handout slides in a matter of seconds, and hard to understand her.  She wasn't a bad professor, but Nothnagel was much better.
She's a pretty good teacher, but not as good as Dr. NOthnagel.

Very approachable and helpful. Compare with Nothanagel, she is much better. Very interesting lectures.  Actually have a chance to listen to her lectures rather than write like crazy in Nothnagel's. Tests are very straightforward. Take Nothnagel's tests and u'll DIE!!!!

This teacher sucks.  Prof. Nothnagel is wayyyyyy better. She talks really fast, doesn't wait for you to catch up during lecture, she's unorganized and doesn't even know what she's talking about.  If you take her class, make sure you go to all of HER lectures cuz she's crazy
Rapid talker with heavy accent who talks to you as if you were still in high school.  Beyond that, she knows her material, works with students if they need help, and her tests are tough but fair.
Not that hard, but her teaching is horrible. honestly.

She may hav won some kinda award but doesn't mean she can teach. I was doing great when Nothnagel was teaching then she came and my grades dropped like crazy. Nothagel should have just taught the whole course. She's evil and the final was krazy hard
Her grammar is terrible.  She's difficult to understand and she talks to her students as though they are 15.  It's evident that she really cares about the class, but she's just not a good teacher.
Sure, she cares about her students, but that's not going to help come test time.  She lectures on powerpoint, but its straight from the book.  Her tests are very hard, so prepare to study!

her english needs some help, her lectures are filled with pictures from the book. it's a very hard class that involves lots of reading. and you definitely definitely need to be prepared to work hard cuz there's no curve.
Extremely hard to understand. She talks to fast and the test questions are hard. She probably is a good teacher, but I can't get past the language barrier between the two of us.

What r u guys talking about, i mean sure she is organized but with pictures, how do you learn by looking at pictures all day. Her test are off the wall, anybody who has ever had the CSI question knows what i am saying. She does care about students though.
She is very organized with her lectures and her tests are pretty straight forward. However, a lot of material....concepts and terms need to memerize in order to pass.
Lots of material to gather and retain in a short time.  Rather difficult to understand her--what w/ her accent and all.

Prepare to study for Bio 5A, its prolly the hardest course I took at UCR.  Professor Martins-Green is very organized and her tests are pretty straight forward.  However, you need to know the concepts and terms to pass!  Beware, its a lot of material...
She's very organized. Her lectures are not that boring. And yea..her tests are not that hard. Good teacher. Interesting.
She is very organized in her lectures, and her tests are not that hard.

He was a good lecturer. But if you don't understand, start going to office hours right away. Homework/discussion questions are worth 20%, the midterm is worth 30%, and the final is 50% of the grade. It is a tough class. He does curve the entire course but be careful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hard material but easy class to pass overall, midterm and final were identical to his practice videos

Somehow a “difficult” class where the midterm is basically the practice exam and the final looks almost the same too. If reviewing the exact material you're tested on is too much, then yeah, maybe it's hard.

He doesn't give a study guide,isn't specific about what material to study,alot of formulas to remember and he doesn't practice them with class enough not even the TA in discussions do, Class is test heavy,& does practice problems only a few days before the exam leaving no preptime.overall this was a really bad experience since he grades so harshly.

Very easy class. 20% problem sets, 30% midterm, 50% final. The midterm was basically word-for-word the practice exam (even the FRQs), and the final MCQs were also the exact same, just with slightly different FRQs. If you actually study the practice material, you'll be fine. I honestly don't know how anyone is getting below a B.

Solid professor. The class heavily relies on 2 exams (80% of the grade). The exams were almost completely word-for-word, even number-for-number, to the practice exams he gave, so go to the review session and study those, and you should get an A. I enjoyed his teaching style during the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Literally the best professor I've taken so far, super chill and very straightforward exams. He doesn't over complicate the exams or Econ in general. If you need to take ECON103 absolutely do it with prof Marti.

Ok professor and has a boring voice that puts students asleep during lectures. Lectures can be dry sometimes but if you do understand homework and formulas associated with them you should be good for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was not super difficult however- all other ratings are correct while assessing how he gives out the practice tests a day or two before. Also, the practice final had maybe 1/2 questions similar to the ones on the real final. That final was curved so hard it brought what would've been a C for me to a B+. Go to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Never take his class
This professor doesn't give info on the midterms until 2 days prior. Doesn't respond to emails either. Tough Grader as well.
This professor doesn't announce the information for the exam until a couple days prior. He never responds to emails.

Mixed bag, a lot of class had us going over deriving equations and inputing random variables to get a final equation which was the only thing that really mattered. Homeworks were very similar to tests, like same thing but a changed number or concept.

Prof. Victor's class was semi-difficult; the majority of the grade for this class comes from exams, so if you fail an exam, the chances of getting an A are slim to none. However, exams aren't too difficult as long as you pay attention to the exam/lecture review he does before every exam. The textbook he 'highly suggests' isn't needed at all.

I would not recommend this upper division elective course for any Econ students. He does not care about our grades and rely everything on his grader. We were not given study info until the last min for our midterms and finals. The grading system is way too harsh. Most importantly, he does not respond to urgent emails at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The course was asynchronous at the time I took it. Homework is graded on effort. From what I recall, the grading criteria is 50% 2 midterms; 40% final exam; 10% homework. He dropped the lowest of the two midterms. Can't remember if he curved the grades. I don't have any opinions on the professor. TA did a decent job. Course overall is satisfactory.

For this class there is one quiz per week which is not graded by accuracy but completion. There are two midterms and a final. He post a midterm review before the test which are just like midterm questions. Overall easy class if you watch all lectures and take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Ortego-Marti was great as a professor for online. His lectures were all asynchronous and he made it clear that he understood online school was stressful for us as students. He posted practice questions before every exam. There was 4 quizzes (2 highest scores counted), 2 midterms, and a final. I'd definitely take class with him again.

Prof. Marti is a good teacher. He covers a lot in the lectures and the material is hard, but you have to read the book and slides to truly understand it. His midterm exam is the EXACT copy of the practice midterm and the final is also very doable. Many reviews here say his final is very hard. You have to study for it tho and if u do, u'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Ortego-Marti always goes in depth with equation derivations, which is useless for exams, so just memorize the equations. Midterm is EXACTLY like the sample questions he gave us in the lecture before the midterm, but final is extremely difficult. But, there is a huge curve at the end so just do better than the average and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Hes an alright professor, not rude or anything and is actually very nice when you ask questions during his office hours. The midterm is super easy if you go to the review the day before. The final, not so much, but! Its doable and the huge curve at the end helps big time. Good luck!

He's honestly a pretty decent professor, handsome too but a tad bit monotone. Always willing to take questions. Midterm was easy just like previous comments however final is notoriously difficult. Bottom line: go to lecture and study and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor doesn't give study guides so students get a sense of what the final will be on. The midterm was exactly like the midterm guide, but the final is not. Lectures are clear and specific but it's hard to study for when you don't know how it's going to be applied or what he's going to be testing. The homeworks don't help much.

He's not a bad professor, it's just that the material is pretty hard. Maybe explains a little too much detail but he's always willing to answer questions. The midterm is easy, show up for the review/study it and you're good. Study for the final or you're gonna have a really bad time. There is a curve but if you get none right you're still toast.

Midterm was easy if you study the practice exam he shows you in class before you take the actual midterm next class meeting. But, the final was extremely difficult because there were many free-response questions (you have to really understand certain concepts) and some MC questions that were hard to solve. However, there's a big curve at the end.

Show up to discussion to turn in homework, but what the TA goes over isn't relevant. Make sure to go to class because he reviews problems from previous midterms which definitely help when taking the actual midterm. Only about 1/4th of the midterm was similar to the final exam. HUGE curve but it was still difficult, study on your own time!!!

He's not as bad as many people here say he is. He does go over the ppt slides in great detail. It does get confusing at times but he always stops to see if there are any questions and tries to make it simpler. He doesn't talk fast. Take good notes, make sure you know the concepts and you'll do just fine.

His lectures are somewhat helpful. Don't get too hung over on the derivations - just focus on the end product and its application. You can easily condense his slides to a quarter of useful information after skipping through the derivations. Attend every lecture because he randomly gives exam questions. Review the slides a bunch, and you'll get an A

He's pretty boring and the gives real life examples from Newspapers. He explains/proves how the formulas came to be. Go to class before the midterm because he shows you the exact questions. The final is hard, but it isn't unreasonable. Really understand the formulas and know them all. Weighted: Final: 55% Midterm: 35% HW/Disc Attendence: 10%

Get ready to teach yourself cause Marti talks so fast you can't understand him. His handwriting is really bad so you can't read what he's scribbling and he's goes so fast when he lectures, you can't catch anything. He treats the class like we're high schoolers and colds us when we rustle or make noise. The final is extremely difficult.

Generous curve for this class. He is great at lecturing and always stops for questions. The midterm is easy as long as you look over the homework. The final is difficult since you have to integrate the concepts in order to solve the free response. Overall, study the powerpoint, the book is helpful sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Class has a curve. Not an easy A; however, he is a great professor and really cares about his students. Midterm is very easy, you get points for participating in discussion and for turning your homework in; however, the final is very difficult and actually overlaps may topics (some where not discussed much). Study!! Study!! Study!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Not an easy A. Class is not curved. the final pretty much destroyed everyone. Midterm however is an easy A if you study hard for it.
Class is not curved so ignore what was mentioned below. Midterm was passable, but the final just destroyed everyone.

His lectures were incredibly boring & monotonous. Keep up in class & make sure to go to the class before the midterm!! He shows examples that are basically the same as the actual test. You should get an A on the midterm. Final is a different story... it's hard! But an A on midterm and  a little above average on the final you can probably get an A.

Knows what he's teaching, and makes sure the class understands what is going on in the lecture. The topics are pretty hard to grasp, but try to pay attention in lecture. Textbook isn't needed because he condenses it all into his powerpoints (they're posted on ilearn but go to class for the examples). Midterm was okay, final was hard.

Smart professor. Very intelligent individual who knows how to teach. The textbook is not necessary because he knows exactly what to put in his slides for students to learn. Midterm is a Free A for the taking. Final is cumulative and hard. but do not fear, Huge Curve.. It's like a bio class curve.
The class is easy. Just do the minimal amount of work and you will do fine. The only problem is that the professor is snobbish and takes little interest in teaching.
Very easy and class is fun and usually ends early! Take him!! It's super worth it!

Victor is very smart! He prepares you for the next level, and that's a good thing. When I got to 105B I knew my stuff better than most other students. He really goes into detail and isn't afraid to take time and review a point again. His midterm is easy but definitely study. His final is pretty hard and has a lot of free response questions.

As long as you study the homework questions and the questions he does during lecture then you should do good on the tests. The midterm is really easy and the final is not that hard as long as you study. If you study for the first midterm then you should do great at least on half of the final.

Great teacher. He is passionate and cares if u learn. Exams r straight forward. Fairly easy midterm and a much much harder cumulative final. No text book is required. If u study the slides and discussion u will do ok.

Ortego-Marti is one of the best professors at UCR for being so clear and concise with his teaching abilities. I can say I have learned more from him than any professor at UCR. If there's any professor you should take at UCR, Ortego-Marti should be one of them. Follow the slides, review the work, you'll get at least a B. No book needed.
Goes through too much material in a short amount of time, which makes it hard to grasp the material.
Class was dry and boring. Lots of notes and slides. Covers a lot of material so make sure to keep up. Midterm is easy, but final was extremely difficult. Not an easy A
Professor is very passionate. Lectures are quite dry but he is helpful. Book is not necessary but it is useful.

Professor's lectures are SUPER BORING. but he's so good looking, you can't help but go. Go to his office hours! No one goes ... so you should. Class is pretty straightforward and easy. Just do the hw sets and you're good.

I survived this class! It's over! Advice: DO NOT buy the book for this class. His lecture slides are sufficient enough to get through this course. His midterm and final are based off his lecture slides and problem sets. If you do these and understand them. Then you are guaranteed to pass this course. Good luck!

As this was an Intermediate Macroeconomics course, Victor was okay. He has sort of a montone voice and it's quite easy to fall asleep in class. The midterm/final are exactly like the problem sets so I guess that's okay. Overall, he was decent.

Pretty boring lectures. Sometimes it's hard to understand where he is going with lectures or how some subjects connect. The final is worth 40% of the grade, I believe. The practice tests he gave us were not nearly enough like the final. Don't trust practice tests. Do your own studying because it's about 6 actual questions with about 4-5 parts each.

Final is in person and slightly dif from study guides, midterm retake offered, curves a lot at the end like I went from a 76 to a solid B for my class grade, material is digestible but it is lengthy, tons of math and word problems. Took with bus 103 and 104 and managed coursework ok.
Fine class, fine professor but by far the most forgettable business class I've taken here. Work was logic based and I feel like it had potential but just not memorable for me at all.

Put in the work and you will do well. Go to lecture! Take good notes and do the optional homework. Quizzes are easy. Final was around 25 questions. Professor is really nice. Office hours are helpful. The material is only hard if you don't try. Curves offered when needed.
wasn't that great since the final was in person

Do not believe the most recent rating with 1 below. Professor Orsdemir is a very good professor. In order to do well in this course you will have to put effort into your studies, take advantage of his office hours, and also be at the TA's discussion section.

Ok so clearly the review under this one was cheating on their midterms and lazy. If you do the work, you can definitely pass the class and final. This includes studying and practicing the problems. Overall professor is disciplined in his practice. Has a light accent. Happily answered questions. Don't talk in his class he'll stare at you. Nice hair.

Professor Orsdemir was a good professor overall. Optional homework is not for a grade. Weekly quizzes were straightforward. The lecture was boring. 2 midterms and one final. All resemble the quizzes and sample exams, just with different numbers. Extra credit for completing sample exams. Take notes on videos watched in class, they might be on exams.

reviews.comment: The class itself is pretty boring, especially when it's online. The material isn't too difficult and is generally straightforward. Lectures can be dry and make you fall asleep. The 2 midterms and final exam look almost identical to the weekly quizzes, just with different numbers. The professor is approachable and helpful if you go to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not the best professor. El Hafsi was way better in 104 and i ended that class with an A

Attendance not required but you should attend to understand the material. The class is easy, there are weekly quizzes, 2 midterms, & a final. Lectures are extremely boring & he can be a grump if you answer wrong, but it is worth it to take him.

Look he gets bad ratings because the subject is boring and thus hard to follow. Not really his fault. However, he is actually a decent teacher and does want you to succeed. Most students who struggle are just not putting in the effort. Also avg UCR student isn't the brightest anyways but in no way is this class super hard. Sure it takes effort

The content itself can be hard to understand but the professor is very understanding and does his best to make it easy for students. Midterms are online, based off of weekly quizzes and easier than the HW. Final is in person, definitely study in advance. Textbook not required. Pay attention in lecture, take notes and you should be fine.

Both midterms are fully online with two tries each all based on practice problems. For some reason, he decided to make the final super tricky with confusing wording and weird add-ons compared to practice problems. It was in-person and lasted only 2 hr 15 instead of 3 hours. Took attendance like 3 times randomly, but nice enough to give lots of EC.

Class is pretty boring to be honest. Subject isn't the most interesting which isn't really his fault. Lectures are really long but the content isn't too complex. Just be a student and take notes and attend lectures. Go to office hours if you are lost and you will be good. Skip lectures and risk it. Not a bad teacher just a boring subject.

His lectures are pretty slow and all the important content would be ~10 minute long nuggets in a 1.5 hour long recording, so I recommend if you take him online to watch everything at x2 speed. Everything is weighed heavily in favor of the exams, and the Final was a blow out
Everything you're tested on is in the lecture, he records lectures so students have access. Good amount of extra credit to boost your grade.

Weekly quizzes and three exams. No hw but gives it optionally to study. Textbook and attendance not required but you have to watch the lectures to learn. The lectures are easy to understand and thorough. Gives a practice exam with the exact same questions for each exam. Gives a lot of extra credit. Doesn't go out of his way to make it easy though.

Teaches material well and lectures are recorded/posted. Allowed us to have 2 attempts for both midterms and took highest score. HW isn't graded but worth doing to learn the material and the 4 lowest quizzes are dropped. Opportunities for extra credit. He doesn't go too fast and gives lots of time to do the quizzes with unlimited attempts.
I would definitely recommend this professor for BUS 105. Lectures are recorded and posted. Lecture content is useful and teaching style is excellent. Exams are fair, no graded homework.

At first, seems like he doesn't care. But if you try to pay attention during lecture you learn that he's very knowledgeable and makes the concepts and difficult equations easy to understand with LOTS of examples. Uses practical, real-world examples so if you stay awake, you can apply this info to future jobs.

Gives the option for multiple attempts for the quizzes. He does extra credit exam reviews for the midterm & final. The exams are similar to the quizzes and homework is not mandatory. The only thing I did not like is that the syllabus emphasizes the required book, but I never needed it. He takes attendance at random times during lecture.
Huge Thumbs down!

Class isn't particularly difficult but professor makes it difficult to understand and clearly lacks passion for teaching. Required and randomly graded attendance, exams make up 70% of overall grade. Some extra credit here and there. "Required" textbook is never used a single time.
