reviews.comment: Terrible. He should retire. Please
He wants you to fail. Doesn't know how to teach. For sure do not like his way of teaching.

This was a strange class. For context, I took this course online asynchronously and it consisted of two quizzes each week, two midterms, and a final. The lectures are extremely dry and I ultimately avoided them, studying on my own instead. Practice his problem sets and you'll do well. Overall, I don't feel like I gained much value from this course.

didnt watch lecture videos, 100% on every quiz, didn't studied, A on midterm 1 and 2, high B on final, final grade A, runs canvas kinda ass never had a prof have useless clutter in the grade category before guy gives you the mean of your own test literally just your score for the same thing again

(WINT 2022). Dr. Orsdemir uploaded video lectures every Monday and Wednesday. Quizzes (sometimes easy, sometimes hard) for each lecture were due the next day by 11:59 pm. He had strict guidelines for our homework. No late work was accepted. We had 2 midterms & 1 final, which were open note open book, but Google and other websites were prohibited.

His course was the "easiest" business class I've taken so far. He lets you retake quizzes an unlimited # of times, drops the lowest quiz/hw grades, provides practice tests, and only grades a portion of the hw. I liked his teaching style and his lectures were easy to understand. Only con was how he threw a minor curveball at us w/ that final.

It’s ridiculous that the final is worth 35% of your grade when it’s literally just another midterm. In essence 33% of the class is worth 35% of your grade will 66% of the class (other two exams) are only worth 40% together. Seems like backwards logic. Also an awful communicator. Avoid him if you can. Not tough content but he makes it hard.

Professor has a heavy accent that can be slightly difficult to understand at times, but turning on captions for his videos on YouTube is surprisingly helpful. He assigns two quizzes a week (one for every lecture), and there is normally one homework assignment every week (comprised of 3-4 problems). Quizzes can be retaken as many times as you want.

Most of important details are not clear and specific at all but heavy tested on the test. Learning from other person on the YouTube was only way I can reach help to learn those details. discussion class was the same situation and little helpful, only made class more confusions.
Exams are very hard but he curves a lot and care about his students

Professor Orsdemir is very knowledgeable and seems like a good person, but I really have a hard time understanding some of the things he says in lecture because he tends to mumble a bit. Also I found the first midterm and the final extremely challenging because they are harder than the examples went over in lecture and from discussion.

Adem makes the class challenging. His tip on excelling the class is to understand, not to memorize. He is not helpful during OH. The midterm and final together cover 70% of final grade. The HW takes a little time to finish, but is manageable. To do good on his exams, do the homework (understand it) and understand his lecture slides.
Probably shouldn't take him for 105, very tough grader and hard to keep up with his class. Final and Midterm are 70% of your grade, only curves at the end if he thinks its necessary
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very difficult to understand. He clearly lacks passion in teaching, which makes lectures long and boring. you begin to zone out and miss everything in class. The tests are very hard and are very confusing. Would not recommend, find a different professor to take this class with.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Does not go over specifics on what needs to know and makes the student figure out everything on their own. Terrible at teaching the subject matter. He is a good instructor, very clear with the material. If you do the homework you'll be fine. Also there are only about 4 homework problems per chapter which isn't much. Some people just expect to not put any effort in at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor can be a bit confusing when teaching, but if you get a good TA, they will really help simplify the lectures. Understand the concepts in the homework and you'll get an A! Emphasis on understand, not memorize, although he does reuse some similar problems in exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Not a easy professor...... The average grade for exams are Cs.
I like this professor! He is helpful and goes over examples during class that will be on exams. He took his time to explain whenever a student was confused. Very smart professor.

He knows what hes talking about but sometimes the TAs explain materials better in class. Do the homework because its similar on the exams. Attend class because you need to fill in the empty powerpoints and he takes surprise attendance. Go to the TAs office hour they help alot when it comes to homework.
hes a great professor

He is awesome. He answers all questions and is very responsive to suggestions of what he can improve on. He's doing a really great job. It is an easy A if you pay attention to lectures and do homeworks..

The class in itself is difficult, so I feel like grading him based on that, is a bit unfair.  BUT I will say this, he can't seem to explain the material well in lecture. I feel like I learned the most when I did the homework. Exams are pretty straightforward I think. Straight from lecture slides and hw. Study the homework and youll be fine.

Doesn't make the material easy to understand. Homework is very time consuming and difficult. Tests covers material from lecture slides (definitionsconcepts and math problems). Attendance matters in discussion and he randomly takes attendance in lecture. Class material isn't easy to begin with, so make sure you stay on top of it. Class was curved.

Taught the first half of the class, was better than professor Blaha but not great. He's nice and cares but boring and lectures arent super informative. Midterm average was in the 50s, your best bet is to learn/memorize the homework and lecture problems (test problems are similar or often identical) and ride the curve. Recommend taking BCH100 first

Dr. O Leary is an amazing lecturer and makes his classes engaging and informative. He only taught the class for the first 5 weeks, but he made the midterm straightforward. If you understand the homework and LOs you will get an A. Excellent professor and his office hours are fun and collaborative.

I wish he was the professor for the entire course. Every lecture he is full of energy, making it easier to follow along with his lectures. His learning objectives have a crazy amount of material only for a little bit of it to be on the midterm. The lecture slides are very dense with so much material to memorize.

Dr. O'Leary is a compassionate and skilled professor. He cares about his students and his tests are fair. If you memorize all the slides and understand the homework you will get an A in the class. If you show you understand and can apply the material during the exam you will get the points. The class is curved pretty heavily.

Very enthusiastic about biochemistry, as every lecture he teaches is full of energy, making it easy to follow along with his lectures. He also tosses around some jokes every so often, which adds to his charm. The only thing I would say is that his learning objectives have a crazy amount of material only for a little bit of it to be on the midterm.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Dr. O'Leary is a great professor! I wish he was the professor for the entirety of this course. He is very knowledgeable about the material and breaks things down so that they are easier to understand. 
Homework is tough but ask questions! He is easy to talk to & great at explaining. Midterm was mix of homework, quizzes but was mainly lecture based.

Direct and to the point, very comical lectures, Midterm was all based on the HW and core principles. HW ever week quiz every week lowest score dropped. TA is amazing, clear and cares about your success. Know the HW, know the key concepts. Lectures include everything youll need on slides, so book isn't needed. BCH is hard, but he makes it doable.
Great professor, really fair with what he tests on and keeps lectures funny with dry humor :)

Usually stem professors are so mundane and boring, that’s not the case with O’Leary tho! You can tell he’s passionate about the material & cares about his students. Exams are very similar to the homework, and knowing the key objectives are important!

Professor taught the first half of the quarter and the lectures were pretty dense, not a lot of difficult material if you study and ask questions during office hours, but there is so much material it was difficult for me to master and remember everything. Everything on the test are usually on the power point but given in a different example.
I really enjoyed Dr. O'Leary. He is funny and understanding of circumstances. Plus he puts everything you need to know on the slides but keep in mind there is a lot of memorization for BCH110A.
Good professor. Really hammers down key points. Dry humor. Would take again.

reviews.comment: Great professor, really nice and explain the material well. Easy to talk to during office hours and he is willing to help! Even though he taught half the quarter, I would take a class with him again! His exam was not that hard, as long as u took notes and paid attention. He also throws a few jokes here & there to keep the class awake and focused.
I love him!! Great guy, great lectures, great everything!!!!
Professor will not communicate, he will not even try. He teachers but not does care for student's wellbeing
Homework it is about 10 section in each chapter 10 question in each section and 2 chapter in each week. all the class material online. I found it difficult with classes beside.
I have struggled with math my entire life, but I succeeded in this class. I received an A+ in the class If you study you will do great. This class is very doable even to those who struggle in math.
he was not very helpful when i went in for office hour help. he seems like he's always in a bad mood. he's pretty funny though and cracks jokes during class sometimes.

Not the worst teacher i suppose. Pretty clear in his explanations, and he'll clarify anything that is not clear.But he is an extremely picky grader. EXTREMELY. He's pretty lazy, said so himself. did all HW, went to every lecture/disc, still didnt pass his class...and i passed math22...then again math isnt my strong point. first class i didnt pass..
This class is ridiculous. No matter how hard you try you will fail. He does not know how to teach. He loves to be mean and give ridiculously hard questions on the midterm and finals. Avoid him!
Useless, stupid, grades hard, cant explain, failure at life in general.  Does not care about success of students.

if math isnt your thing i suggest going to his office hours or the ta's office hours. he explains things and it becomes much clearer. hes nice in class because he goes over things that he knows students dont understand and he warns us sometimes about quizzes in discussion.go to class if you need help because he will explain the material pretty well

Understanding him in class isn't really a problem, until you get the midterms/final and see there are nothing like what is taught. HARD. Go to class and don't fall behind, seriously. If you're struggling, forget understanding all the material just focus on the types of problems on the sample midterms/finals.
Go to class. tests are hard. he likes to use tricky questions. i'd suggest doing the hardest problems from each section because these will most likely be on the test.
He gaves pretty clear lecture, but his midterms and final are super hard!!

He is a really good teacher. He's really helpful and if you go to his class everyday, you'll understand the material. Simple as that, if you don't go to class then you'll get lost. His TA's are very helpful too. It's best if you go to their office hours if you don't understand and have any trouble. Things will work out if you talk to him or at leas

Pretty cool Professor. He's young so he is not as experienced as other Professors, but he is still a very good professor. He gives very good lectures and reviews on the material and for the midterms. Some of the ways he teaches how to do certain problems are somewhat difficult to understand though, be sure to always ask your TA's for help.
Best professor at UWP hands down. She respects other students work. The homework she gives is not too much bc it's helpful.

One of the best teachers I've ever had! Most English professors make you feel like you need to write as good as Shakespeare! Dr O Brien made me see that it's almost impossible to correct everything imperfect in writing. Writing essays was actually fun in her class cause she made us understand that writing in college is “creating new knowledge”

Good overall, she takes the effort to know everyones names which is nice. Read the syllabus and the assignments clearly. Grading isn't that bad and shes very understanding if you do turn in an assignment late.

reviews.comment: ENGL1C! I took English 1c with Clare, and she was a good professor. We didn't have a lot of homework, just a lot of work to do outside of class. I took it in the summer, so everything felt very fast. She is very easy to talk to and understands people's own struggles. She is a good prof definitely recommend her.

I took Clare for ENGL001C not B. She was a great instructor! The coursework was very manageable but challenging enough to encourage growth. Explanations of the courseworks were clear while providing context of its importance both inside and outside of class.

THIS IS FOR ENGLISH 1C!! 
Clare is an amazing teacher. I really enjoyed taking her class. I was comfortable with asking questions and making comments and she was always super understanding. Course assignments were easy to manage and not intense. I would definitely take this class again! Super fun :)

Creates an open environment that allows for discussions of the text and different perspectives to be presented. ENGL 1C, 

Clare is a very fun teacher and her class is really enjoyable. Her course just made sense. Everything we did, we did for a reason. She never gives busy work. All the work flows with each other. Overall she is a great and effective instructor.

THIS IS FOR ENGLISH 1C! It wasn't an option. Clare is a very fun and helpful teacher. She gets the knowledge across without giving busy work or any nonsense to fill time. My experience was pleasurable, though there had been several moments of strange silence during class due to our shyness. But overall the experience was enjoyable. The class is fairly easy; Just do the work that's assigned and you should get an A in the class. That being said, the professor was just okay.
professor is very rough around the edges. class is an easy A otherwise

I genuinely love this prof, he's nice and cares about students' concerns and questions, tho he isn't techsavvy. Giving him a one just out of principle. You have to pay $35 to do quizzes for his class. Avoid

This class was hard for a breadth. You could secure a decent grade if your TA was nice though. Lectures were hard to understand and didn't offer a lot in terms of content. A decent person who seems to be passionate about anthropology, but that's about it. The syllabus is monumental in size and confusing, lectures are hard to understand and lackluster, and his grading policies are harsher than need be. He is not an effective teacher, I wouldn't take his class again.

Grade depends on your TA, nice Ta= easy A. The majority of your grade is based off 2 essays. Class was easy you don't need to go to lectures just discussions but the prof is rude. Professor Nida seems like a really nice guy. Unfortunately, his lectures are all over the place, and his prompts/rubrics for assignments are very confusing and intimidating. The TA's assign a lot of work, but it's manageable and it doesn't require much effort.

Professor Nida is nice, but his lectures are horrible. His whole canvas is overcomplicated and your success in the class depends on the TA that you get since they grade everything. Very bad lecturer but very easy class. I simply stopped going after the first lecture they're so useless. The two papers (3 pg and 5pg) are fairly easy. The weekly quizzes help you learn the content. reviews.comment:
By far the worst syllabus l've ever seen.
Extremely long, inconsistent and confusing, filled with completely useless information.
Weird rules and explanations that are completely unnecessary, assignments are like that too. He states that turning in a final draft that is 70% similar to the rough draft is self plagiarism. Simply false info.

I never attended his class after the first lecture. Lecture is absolutely useless to be honest. Going to discussion is more than enough. he was  disrespectful. his syllabus was 20 pages which was ridiculous and he made everything about this class boring and confusing. he's terrible at explaining and i can barely understand what he's saying half the time lol. i h@ted this class, stopped going to lectures bc they were so useless. take for the easy A but do not go to him for help
so easy honestly. you dont need to go to lecture, but if you do its hard to understand what he's saying cause the captions dont align with his accent. just do the work, and youll be fine!

Class was really easy. Two papers about your culture and identity. weekly homework and a couple assignments in the discussion section.

He acted like he was the king and just to talk to him you had to go to the TA to ask him a question. Dr. Nida's lectures were not difficult to understand but I did fine without attending them. My TA made this class very easy and fun!

take her!!!

test testtesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttest

Dr.Ostevik= was great at explaining concepts. She tied them to real world examples which helped a lot with understanding. There were multiple extra credit opportunities and exams were quite fair but not easy. If you put in the work you can get an A.

good at lecturing and easy class. Wants you to do good. Final optional to replace a low exam score. Has extra credit which is nice since the class is already easy. Participation is from polls, frq, and exit ticket. There was some questions on the exam that were worded kind of weird but overall good professor. 10/10

Dr. Ostevik teaches well and very nice at explaining clearly during office hours. Her exams are fair except a few questions. There's discussion quizzes based on lectures and the papers.

Good professor. Exams every other Friday. Final optional, replaces lowest exam score if better. Can exempt one exam. Lectures and slides uploaded. Attendance mandatory, does poll everywhere (you may miss points if it glitches, just do exit tickets). Participation is 10 points but you can get a max of 15/10 each unit if you do the exit ticket.

Ostevik is very clear about her expectations for the class. She gives out announcements frequently and does her best to make sure everyone knows what's going on. You must participate, but she gives out many opportunities other than in-lecture options to be able to gain them. She also has good office hours and tea for students who drop in.

Best bio professor to end my entire 5c series on. Amazing teacher, very kind and sweet. Plenty of extra credit, and exams are just memorization from slides. If you do well, you can not take the optional final and even excuse yourself from an exam if you do really well in the lab (that depends on your TA). Overall really good.

Great prof overall, really easy to get an A. Gives a good amount of EC through in-class questions and iEval, tests are pretty easy if you read the slides, mostly vocab-like questions. 5 exams but you don't have to take 1 and optional final. Lab is easy just 1 final presentation no tests. Structure of class is slightly confusing but she explains it

Recorded lectures. 5 exams covering 5 units, an exam every 2 weeks. Optional final to makeup 1 exam score. Optional online open-note quiz post-exam to make grading 80 raw exam/20 quiz. Content-heavy slides. Extra credit opportunities. Grading: 5% Participation, 70% Exams (5 x 14%), 25% Lab grade. Standard grading scale; 90% A-, 93% A, 97% A+.

Kate was great! Slides were easy to follow and well organized. She adds to the slides so pay attention. Her exams weren't bad. She gave us two chances to take the exam. The first 60 mins: on your own. The last 20 mins: group exam. She also let you can an optional final to boost your grade! She's sweet and kind and super easy to talk too!
reeeeeeaaaaaally doesn't like you talking in her class. every lecture she's calling chatterboxes out XD
Great professor! Her exams reflect her lectures. Go to office hours!

Kate is super nice and makes her exams 100% fair. The lecture slides are wordy and lectures are a bit tiring to sit through but other than that this class is a breeze to get through. IClickers are done throughout the class & it doesn't have to be correct, you just have to participate in it. Overall highly recommend her, she's amazing

Very caring prof. Her lectures are not very engaging, but as long as you attend class, participate in polls, and review the slides for tests, youll do fine. Test questions come straight from polls and slides. Take this prof. if you can, you will not regret it.

Lectures aren't that helpful and he does do clicker questions but not for every lecture. Midterm was essentially a copy and paste of the practice midterm with the exact same numbers used in the problem. Final did feature exact problems from final exam practice but not a majority of them like the midterm did. Lastly, top percent of class gets an A.

His lectures are hard to follow and are boring but he's a nice guy and is fair with tests. His practice tests have few questions that are verbatim on the tests not a lot though. Just watch YT videos and know how to do your HW and you should be fine. The curve goes crazy as well so make sure you're doing well at least on the midterm and lab.

Great professor, but the class itself is a lot of work. He's very helpful in office hours, so don't be afraid to attend those. His lectures are very visual, so you won't get the whole idea if you skip lectures and take notes on the slides. He's a caring professor overall and won't test you on things he didn't explicitly teach.
Dr.Weng cares about his students I had a couple of emergencies during the quarter and he was never not open to extending a assignment or even dismissing it. We need more staff like Dr.Weng.

Fantastic Professor. Extremely dedicated and always explained concepts crystal clear. Very approachable and always gives stellar advice/problem solutions. Despite his stellar RMP rating, lectures are rushed, hard to follow, and homework topics go unexplained—leaving you to self-study for exams. On the plus side, he's genuinely kind and always approachable.

Peng Wei is Great! He explains things clearly and gives great curves. Homework sometimes is hard but overall is fine. Do all the work and attend the class, you will be fine. Will take him again.

I didn't like his style of teaching and I found it difficult to understand him. Wish he did more practice problems during lecture. I passed only because the curve was extremely generous. As a person he is kind & helpful. He was always willing to extend deadlines. Also no clear grading scale, which was stressful at the end of the quarter.

Very generous curve on the midterm/final. His grading criteria is a bit vague however so your final grade may be different from what you were expecting.

If you want a class that prioritizes understanding over formulaic mathematical operations of classical physics, then this is the one for you.

Don't slack and do all of the homework, and also reference supplementary material. Good luck.

Content is very interesting.

He tries his best to teach well and his lecture notes are really informative. He yaps all of lecture which is useless and he is very straightforward. Gives vague comments and suggestions on essays. Do not recommend if you want to do well in the course.
Super straightforward. More on the simpler writing side of English 4. It's strict but helpful. Recommended if you want to take English seriously. Make sure to read his website for grading guides.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great lecturer, grades quite harsh. You should definitely be prepared for low grades with pretty vague explanations. Make sure to check out his website too, as he bases everything off of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Currently taking 1A with Prof. Potter for Fall 2023 and he is a good professor. Makes lectures barable and as someone who dislikes English, I still dislike it even after taking this class (mainly because I hate writing essays). You write 4 essays + 1 final. Unlimited revisions (there's a slight process to go through though). Follow the prompt!
An extremely tough grader but allows you the entire quarter to revise papers to get a better grade though you may struggle to find time.

His classes are interesting but they aren't helpful. His lectures are fantastic for making you think, but he doesn't actually really teach you how to write in order to get the grade you want. I've spent so much of my time trying to contact him and revise to improve my essay grades but its not worth the effort. Had to salvage my grade with final.
your gpa will never see sunshine
be prepared to suffer emotional damage when you see your essay grades
good person, you learn a lot, but this will only hurt your grade. extremely tough grader and rarely you can get a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bro this is my second week and this professor is amazing. Class is so fun. Insane sense of humor. I'll update at the end of the quarter

He's funny and gives good lectures. He let us leave early a lot. Just know that all of the good reviews are for the teacher he is, not the way he grades. Super hard grader. The average on the first essay was a C-. Average on the second was a C and the third a C/C+. If you take him, put it as pass or fail so it doesn't hurt ur gpa.

He's a very tough grader. I went to office hours several times for feedback and to learn from my mistakes and even then my rewrites were not good enough to qualify for a grade change. I put a ton of work into this class and still got a B! He is tough and will not make this class easy. If possible take another prof. On the upside he's entertaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Went into this knowing he'd be a tough grader, but I thought he was slightly rude. He's a tough grader and you may bomb the first essay, but just keep pushing. Go to office hours & see how to get that better grade for revisions. Cameras should be turned on to show you're engaged, but some people didn't. post & reply to people in discussion boards!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Honestly, when I first saw the reviews I was nervous for his class and tried to switch out but then I just worked through it. His prompts are very simple and straight forward. As long as you stick to exactly what he's looking for, you'll get a good grade. Allows revisions. Def go to office hours and ask him what he's looking for in an essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He is my favorite English professor so far. I mean he may act like a teacher wants to make your life miserable, but he wants to help you with pretty everything that you encountered in his class. College level essay is going to make you felt like you do not know how to write but it would definitely help you go further in the future.

Professor Potter is a funny, enthusiastic, and energetic teacher. He is a harsh grader, however, and rarely proofreads papers himself, as he expects the students to learn from their mistakes. Stay optimistic! In the beginning, it may seem like you're going to fail, but toward the end, it gets better.

Very tough grader. Don't enter his class expecting it to be anything like your traditional high school English class. You learn a whole new style of writing in his class that drifts away from too much structure. I highly recommend letting go of your bad writing habits as soon as possible, or the grading will negatively impact you.

I've heard that Eng004 is the hardest English class at UCR and all professors are tough graders, including this one. We had 5 essays, 1 in class, 1 final and 3 at home. Just revise, revise, and revise your essay until its solid, but it'll still be hard to get a B

He thinks this is an upper division english class because he grades soooo hard, it's ridiculous. Don't fall for the "there are revisions in this class" because it doesn't help. He says participation isn't mandatory, but he'll give u a C in it even if you only miss one class if you don't participate in class. He is a cool guy though!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is a very very tough grader. Dont take his class if you want an A. Even a B may be hard to get in this class. He lets you revise papers but theres not much of a change in your score and it is hard to find time to do amazing revisions when you always have another paper to work on. Entertaining lectures but no filter and can be rude at times.

I had him for engl004 last quarter and he was one of the best professors ive had so far. He's really nice and caring for students, and is not strict, so its easier to be at ease in the class and happily engage without the worry of him attacking you. He is also very helpful when it comes to grading essays, and he lets you revise an essay worth a lot

He is the laziest professor I have ever met. He is very vague about what he wants on his essays. Don't go to his office hours because he barely helps you and sometimes leaves 30 minutes early. He is a very hard grader and does not care how much effort you put into the course. He is fine with giving everyone a C. Don't take this class expecting an A

Overall he is a cool professor, but he grades too hard. His grading is ridiculous. Do not come into this class thinking youll get an A. You can revise essays but half the time it doesnt help. Stay clear
Good class! He's funny guy and will keep you entertained while actually teaching you stuff. Highly recommend
He is very straight forward and honest!
He cool! But his class it hard

Well, starting off, he is probably the best professor you will get in English since he offers unlimited revisions. He is a very tough at grading papers and you will have to work for your grade. I did find him very enjoyable though, he really improved my writing as a whole. Also, he will read this so thanks for the passing grade Potter.
Let's you revise essays asany times as you want. Sometimes you can't tell if he's mad or trying to make a point.

One of the best professors I have had. His class improved my writing greatly. It should be obvious he is a tough grader. He checks for logical fallacies and makes sure that  you address all counter-arguments sufficiently. He cares deeply for his students but can be too harsh when criticizing personal views. Also, there is your chili pepper Potter!!

Pretty tough grader for Eng 4. He values grammar a lot.  I took him once and failed his class, but i retook his class again in the another quarter and passed. He has helped me improved throughout the two quarters. Go to his office hours and ask for help on whatever you need. He will help you.

He is very funny. He is very straight forward in this lectures. At times you are really confused on what he wants in the essay. He isn't really clear on what he specifically he wants in the essays. He is a tough grader

I took his class for English 4 last year after not passing it the first time. He has the highest passing rate for students in English 4. His lectures were entertaining. He is a hard grader. He is willing to help. He will tell you how college essays are graded. I learned what the reader is expecting from me and helped  my after I passed his class.

He is crazy funny. Hands down funniest teacher I've had in a long time, but his grading is also insane. Its really hard to try and get a good grade without doing revisions, but sometimes those don't even help.
Very hard grader.  Rewrites are basically useless. Talks random stuff. Also very rude.
Not a very good teacher. Very rude sometimes and doesn't explain the material very well.  His revision policy is okay. He grades pretty harshly. Pretty cool, but explains material weirdly.

Good grader, funny as hell, and dead useful. If you were in a squeeze and needed to reach him outside of email, he'll give you his number so you can communicate and be in touch with him regardless. If you need to finish your English 1 series, make sure Professor Potter's teaching it.

Professor Potter is very helpful. I did not pass English 4 the first time, and I had Dr. Potter for the second time. Potter makes class interesting and has a high pass rate for English 4. Recommend taking Potter if you are struggling with English 4.

his class is kind of easy, only if you're interested in writing. He is DEFINITELY a hard grader but it helps you in the end because it makes you a better writer. His lectures are very interesting and engaging. He makes coming to class fun. However we didn't use the textbook very much, you could probably get away with borrowing someone's for reading
Hard Grader!!! lets you revise your essay but you still get a low grade. Dont take him if you want a high grade.

HARDEST CLASS IVE EVER TAKEN!!! You learn so much in this class and like the other reviews say he is a tough grader. Yes he does let you rewrite your essays BUT sometimes rewriting them doesn't help your grade at all! I rewrote one essay because that is all that was given back in time for a rewrite and my points only increased by 6 points -_-

Professer Potter is an AMAZING professer. He can be intimidating at first but you learn to love his teaching. Harsh grader but lets you revise ALL your essays as many times as you want. So you can still get a good grade. He is very helpful with essays and makes your writing skills better.Take this class with this professer you wont regret it!
He's a tough grader. From experience, though he doesn't care about attendance, you miss a lot of useful info when you don't go.
Brilliant professor. If you're serious about improving your writing skills take his class. He is a hard grader but it's to help you improve. His lectures are interesting and essential.

His classes are fun to attend, and he is a very smart person. But he is the hardest grader I've ever had in my life. I didn't even improve my writing skills... so he did not help me learn to write better, plus he gave me a low grade.

I enjoyed this class. He is very smart and witty. I learned a lot in this class and although he was a harsh grader I did learn to write  bit better. I would recommend this class to anyone that wants to learn and challenge the way they write.
Potter is a very interesting professor. Workload isn't so bad as long as you stay on top of it. However, he is a very harsh grader.
He is one of my favorites and I loved his class because he makes you really think about your topic. I do not think he grades that hard I just didnt put much effort.
His lectures are fun. However, he is a very hard grader.

By far one of most favorite teachers. His classes are chill because he puts people on the spot. You will never win an argument against this guy! Unlimited rewrites but is a hard grader(his grading policy is not the conventional ie: 75%=B) Come to class on Revision days, he brings food for his students! >:D

his essays seem easy to write but beware! he is a hard grader. i got a C but hey not bad for writing my essays the night before or the day of ... he allows revisions. he is a very helpful teacher nonetheless.. he doesnt require attendance for his lecture so you dont have to show up
he is a tough grader on essays but offers a lot of help and his classes are informative
Potter is a great teacher. He is willing to help you before and after class. But, he is a hard grader. Overall, he will get you thinking for writing your essays.
Awesome professor! He lets you revise your essays endlessly. However, he is a hard grader but it makes you work for that perfect A (:
He let us rewrite our essays so that was helpful. But he talks as if he knows everything... Somewhat annoying.

Very generous, understanding, and humorous personality thats not the usual that you would expect. Talks a little too fast, but you get used to it as you go on through the quarter. His grading is a little strict. Is willing to help students all the time. He allows revisions on your papers as many times you want so a lot of room for improvement.
A really great professor. His teaching skills are excellent and most of all, he makes you think, which is good =) If you think you're going to be bored in his class, the you're wrong.

Proffesor was a hard grader but he lets you rewrite any essay. The class was very interesting. We talked about topics that most people refuse to argue about like religion, class etc. You will learn how to make strong arguments that can convince anyone.

Professor Potter was an excellent teacher to me and I am glad to have had him this quarter. He is a breath of fresh air compared to all the usual teachers I have had before. He makes us think without us even knowing it and teaches us a lesson in the process. It doesn;t hurt that he is good looking either.
Odd man, but a good teacher because he makes you think about the world in a different way. Worth working your ass off for.

I had him Winter and Spring qtr. for English 1B and 1C. I really enjoyed this class because he is an interesting and funny professor. He lets you out early about 85% of the time. If your good at English you'll do fine. He usually has 4 essays and required readings almost everyday and students get to make the final which is taken at home.

Great teacher, had him my first quarter at UCR, he does grade kinda hard but it makes you work harder and you feel better when you get a good grade on a paper.. really funny guy too, and he brought us donuts on the last day :-)

he is so awesome! grades kind of tough, but my class only had about four essays, daily reading, and a final. he has really interesting classes that are interesting and that youre not just going to forget about the second you leave class. the essay topics were very unique and fun. great teacher.
Great teacher! You actually learn something valueble in his class. Hes very straight to the point in lecture. Class ends early most of the time :) . Grades kindof hard. You must try hard for the A.

the best prof i could have hoped for for my first quarter of college.  his lectures and assignments are interesting and in the end you actually feel like you learned something (unlike 95% of other college courses). slackers stay away.  one of the best profs i've ever had.

This was my third timeat engl4 and I really needed to pass.  I did not think I could but prof potter really helped me and I got through the class.  Other profs were no help.  He asks a lot but it is worth it if you want to learn.  I hope he is teaching 1A in fall.
he is the best english teacher I ever had. Although he is a difficult grade, you will learn far more in his class than expected.
the best teacher ive ever had

Professor Potter is not as bad as he seems. For our final he told us to write an in class essay about what class we think we deserved in the class. I argued a B and ended up getting it even though my essay grades were C's. He also brings donuts during peer editing time. If you put in the effort he'll give you a fair grade.
He is not as hard as people rate him.  If you do the work you can get a pretty good grade, far beyonding a passing grade.  If you don't work, he will definitely fail you.  You have to try.
take another teacher!!! he is a very tough grader. you probably will fail.

Was doing really well... got an A and a B+ on first essays... then i got C- on last essay... over got C in class, was a real curve ball... he is interesting, but a really hard grader, and really reluctant to discuss your grade with you...
No Comments
I really did'nt want to take this class but I actually learned alot.  I wish I did'nt have to take all of the other english classes tho.
I hate morning classes but he made it pretty easy to go.  very fun and interesting.

Happened to be one of the student that he debated all the time. Just make sure you read his readings and show up to class. Obtaining a B is not hard in that class. He also prepares you very vell for the FINAL that is taken with the rest of the other English04/05 students. He will get in your face.
He is fun and funny and i learned alot
Very hard professor. Grades hard and hard to understand.
Good teacher but talks too fast.
Potter helped me pass the test.  I couldnt have passed it without him.
Very hard unclear on his comments when he grades your paper should define terms when he comments on your paper
Discussed a lot and always debated something.  He made it like a class for arguing and discussing things instead of really helping us understand college writing. He was funny though.
He does not let make arguments without backing them up.  Most ppl complaining about this prof. are just whining because they couldn't slide in this class.
This guy thinks he's hardcore. He belittles your writing if its not Ph.D quality work. He thinks that his views are always right. If you think otherwise, prepare to get a bad grade.
I really look forward to class!  Every day I learn something.

Professor P is awesome! He gets the class really goin.  He's a little picky on the papers, but it doesn't hurt your grade if you really try. He does not let you get away with sayin stuff without proof or backing it up.
he is so funny the class went very quick
he was hard to please. one of those teachers that seems to expect you to read their minds and write what they want to read....some may like him but i don't.
Potter is not close minded but will force you to defend your position.  Assignments teach debate skills. Humor a plus.
This prof is hard because he makes you challenge your assumptions. I would definitely take him again.

if you disagree with him, just keep your mouth shut and write what he wants to hear, or you will get reamed in the grade. he is so pompous and pedantic, i practically puked after each class. avoid at all costs.
Professor potter is not hard like the other ratings said, if you do the work you will pass the class easy you just have to do the assinments!
No Comments

He is an awesome prof. He helps out a lot and he does scare people in the begining because he is a hard grader. He is worth taking, and you learn so much. He challenges you and makes you rethink what you really think.

Class was very enjoyable. He taught us (me) how to avoid things in writing. Very hard grader; I got nothing but check-minuses and minuses on my papers because of content, not mechanics. He made me enjoy writing and editing papers.
hard grader. he tries to challenge your ideas so that you can think about issues. he can get annoying when he does this. Topics on essays are not that interesting. The readings are easy.
Hard class, a lot of reading, but useful.  Funny Prof, who did an excellent job teaching really complex writings and ideas.
a class i actually want to go to every morning. keeps things interesting with his unusual perspective, and quirky activities. i learned a lot.  i'm glad i took the course.
He's great! Really rapid-fire, keeps you awake. He made the class really enjoyable! He's been one of my favorite professors!
He is a hard grader.  In class he has a closed mind.  He is always right and you are always wrong.
Sincere about his subject, makes learning a learning  a pleasure.

Lectures are pretty hard to understand as he skips over slides and problems too fast, but I'd reccomend staying for the in-class quizzes for points. Overall, understandable courseload but you'll mostly self-study.

Grade scale is pre-curved (82.5% is an A-). Lectures go by fast but are heavy in terms of content covered. 2 midterms(50min for 15Q) and final exam(3hr for 40Q). Exams are challenging, but some questions are directly from HW or lecture slides. Lots of points to earn, so don't fall behind. He has an accent, so it may be a little hard to understand.

Professor Cheng is a good Professor. His class is very fast-paced, and most of the grade weight comes from the midterm and final. He does give extra credit from Poll EV attendance which is nice. His lectures were not super in depth and knowing how to solve many different scenarios for the questions are neccesary for the final and midterms.

He was a super nice professor. His tests were light work if you studied and his test questions weren't that hard. His lectures were mostly concept based with little time spent actually working out problems, so you will probably have to solve problems on your own.

He's a great guy, a bit difficult to follow along with sometimes, but his lectures are honestly great. He offers a lot of extra credit, and an 82.5 is an A- in the class. The final is exactly like the practice test, and make sure to understand how to do the homework and the practice tests to do well in the course.

Prof. Chen is a pretty good professor. Go to class for participation points or have someone text you that pollev's are happening. STUDY EVERY WEEK. there are weekly quizzes that are 1/10 of your grade. Do the practice midterms over and over and you'll do well on the real stuff.  Its a hard class but if you study a lot you can get an A

Lectures are fast-paced. He kinda just skims through the topics without really going over problems and fully explaining them, but his practice tests are very helpful to prep. Didn't go to many lectures but still ended up doing well. Also, uploads slides for you to review what was covered. He provides good amount of ec as well.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good reviews seem to be from summer section. Avoid at all costs during the actual school year. Worst professor I've ever experienced at this school.

Attending lecture is only for the million points he sets up to make sure you go, you do not learn anything from him in lecture that is not on the slides. Unable to understand him during lecture and discussion doesn't help either. Be ready to legit teach yourself everything outside of class.

Professor Quan is a great professor, and his slides are enough to understand the content of the class. The 2 midterms and the final are quite tough, especially because Chem 001B is widely considered to be the hardest of the series. There are also weekly quizzes in discussion, and it's very easy to lose points on them.

The good reviews are deceiving. Very thick accent I genuinely don't understand a word he says, also reads off lecture slides. Test itself is not hard, but definitely not enough time for the amount of (trick) questions. Discussion is not really a discussion it's just taking a quiz in silence with no guidance. Nice guy, but not a good teacher.
his voice is so annoying an really hard to understand. bad at teaching things, goes over things once and never again, basically have to self learn

Had it over Summer, great prof. Gave 2 midterms and a non-cumulative final w/ practice exams, lowest exam dropped. homework quizzes online and open note, hw is not turned in. PollEv counts towards participation points and he offers extra credit for correctness. And the grading scale is curved. Basically impossible to fail this course. 10/10

The discussions for this course give a quiz every week. The smartworks highly reflect on lecture material. Office hours are very flexible. Theres polls everywhere every now and then that give good extra credit. Didn't really utilize the book, lectures had good amount of content. .
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: class was actually reasonable. the tests and quizzes were challenging but all problems he gave in class as examples or in the homework. The redemption points were super helpful and he provided lots of extra cred. Hes a nice guy and the final was exactly the same as the practice test he provided. I ended with a 96% and got a 66% on the first midterm

He is a decent professor. I found that I struggled with this class more but that was on me. He has a semi-thick accent. There is a discussion quiz every week and that is what hurt my grade the most. Attendance isn't mandatory but make sure you keep up with PollEv. Definitely isn't easy because you need to dedicate a lot of time to practicing.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Cheng is really good at lecturing. Usually Chem B is the hardest in the chem series, but he makes topics very accessible. He cares a lot for the students and offers a lot of redemption and ways to gain back points.
He is a fair professor. Honestly you just need to put in the work to get an A. Definitely take him but be ready to grind chemistry, you definitely cannot slack in his class.
Really chill guy his practice problems are super helpful.

He is a good professor. Good professor as in he gives ec, clear hw, redemption on final.BUT go to lectures since they are fast paced. Class is vague so u have to self teach. PRACTICE PRACTICE. its only gets difficult.
Ask questions after class and introduce yourself to him. He is a grumpy person, but soft at heart.
DONT EXPECT a A if u cant do work

Main good thing was tests were extremely reflective of in-class lecture problems and examples. Just go through the slides and understand them. He does not post solutions for all of them though so you need to go to lecture. Discussion quizzes were alright and did actually help to be fair. Offered redemption from the final which saved my grade.

The lectures were very fast-paced and boring. Make sure to answer PollEV since they can get you extra credit. Midterms and final reflected his PollEV, homework, and practice midterms and finals. Quiz every discussion; this depends on your TA. Still had to self-teach out of class.

Professor Cheng is a solid Chemistry professor. His accent was sometimes difficult to understand, and the lectures are very fast paced. However, the exams quite closely reflect the homework / in class problems, and he is the first professor I've ever had who sticks to his extra credit and redemption points. Do and understand the homework problems.

This professor has an accent that makes it hard to understand what he is saying sometimes. He also reads off his lecture slides, so it less like teaching us the subject and more so telling you. When he shows you how to calculate questions, he sometimes skips steps because he assumes that you already know. He gives passive answers to questions.

I took AP chem in high school and I saw this class as a snooze fest. The problems are easy to breakdown if you are used to dealing with AP style questions. Everything you need for the workout problems is in the formula sheet, you just have to understand which values go where. Attending lectures didn't really help beyond understanding formulas.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Cheng kinda just reads off lecture slides and doesnt really teach but the material isnt overall that difficult. study using the practice midterms, quizzes, & optional homework. hes not terrible but its sometimes hard to sit thru lecture. an A isnt hard to obtain but the weekly quizzes were a bit tough. but overall not too bad of class
Professor Cheng is an overall great professor. His midterms are almost similar to the practice midterms! Do very well in the clicker quizzes in order to get extra credit. Points add up!

Literally Best Chem teacher. He can be pretty boring sometimes, but he does the absolute most to help you pass his class. His midterms are based on HW and clicker quizzes. He gives a lot of extra credit and is very understanding.
Lots of information is in the notes, but he goes through it really fast. Be prepared to study a lot outside of class to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Prof. Cheng's class was a difficult, yet easy class. HE GIVES A LOT OF EXTRA CREDIT!! Just try to do well on the clicker questions in class and you'll get an extra 20 points. His midterms are pretty easy if you study. Study the clicker questions, extra hw, and Smartwork! The questions are just taken directly from these.

He has a generally difficult subject and is not good at teaching it. students would leave after the clicker quizzes because he isnt good at explaining the material at all. However, his grading system is chill. he has a redemption opportunity on the final (if you do better on the final than a midterm, hell match your score), but avoid if possible

Prof. Cheng is a good professor and goes through every problem you may encounter on the midterm/ final. Has a heavy accent though but still able to understand. his clicker questions are generally not too difficult but not easy to catch upon first glance. The class is gracious has he gives out lots of extra credit. Do the extra HW to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He's honestly not the greatest professor and I struggled in his class at times but there's alot of extra credit and a curve so it's one of the easier classes to get a good grade in As long as you show up
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Try on the clickers because they give a decent amount of extra credit if you get enough right. He posts both the clicker questions and slides (that he reads off of) after the lecture. First midterm based more off of clickers and second midterm based more on homework. He's pretty helpful during office hours, but lecture isn't as great.

Quizzes every week but they're simple and to the point. This helps you in the long run for the midterms and final. Midterms are easy and straight-forward. A little hard to understand his accent and says "more-s" instead of "moles" but overall i love this teacher! Best chemistry teacher.

Worst professor I've had, he literally just reads off the slides during lecture. By the end quarter, people just stayed for his pop clicker (20 mins in) quizzes and left right after.  Also, there's a quiz for his class EVERY WEEK EVEN DURING MIDTERMS! ALSO he doesn't respond to emails about your grade and didn't honor point system on the syllabus!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He made this class soooo difficult due to his teaching. He reads directly off his powerpoint slides and when he does try to show a chemistry problem he does not even use units or explain how he does the problem. His final is worth 400 points! And his midterm questions are each worth 8 points, thats a lot of points that can be missed! GOODLUCK :/

He's the most useless professor I have yet so far at UCR. The man can't teach to save his life the only thing he knows is how to read of power points which is something an a kid in elementary school can do
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He reads directly off of a power point which is exactly what I read in the book; Pictures are even taken from the book. Read the book and make sure you understand because lectures are not very good. Study his clickers and his homework questions. Midterm one, questions taken from clickers and midterm 2 questions taken his online homework questions.
Hard class. Be ready to study. He's very helpful in office hours. Exams are closely related to clickers and examples in class. The final is harder.

He was a great professor! Honestly, all you needed to study was his clicker and homework questions. He is pretty easy to understand as well and his slides were helpful. I didn't really read the book and I passed with an A-.

Prof. Cheng was overall a great professor! The material can sometimes be difficult beware of that, but his midterms and final were heavily based on clicker and homework questions. He also gives away a lot of extra credit which is rare in a science class! Recommend!

He's really nice and not a bad professor at all. The tests come straight from clicker questions in class and the online homework (smartwork) and he uses the same questions every quarter. The points for clicker questions are graded on participation. Some of the other professors are hard so take this class with professor Cheng if you can!
Best chemistry professor I've had thus far!!

Not sure why everyone likes this professor. He was pretty confusing and sneers at the class when you don't get the right answer to his "fun quiz". His accent is also really distracting. I had to read the book and go to SI sessions to understand what was going on. Overall, not a good experience.

great professor, really cares about his students. The course was much harder than expected. Without the generous curve, the majority of the class would not have done well. Really wants the best for his class. Labs are incredibly painful, and the precision and accuracy can really hurt you!
just go to lectures and do the practice midterms. You'll do fine in the class. He's not that hard, but if you read the book and know what your doing it will be fine. Chem labs are evil!

easy, quizes are sort of confusing. his accent is nice and most like it. he did nto give a good lecture on the pi and sigma bond. that was really bad and****ty

He's nice and passionate about the subject, but he does not know how to teach. I taught myself everything I knew in this class. If you get him, just hope for a good TA. I found the math lecture to be incredibly informative and helpful! The instructor was very engaging and made the material interesting and very relatable. He gave examples of applications we could use for every single lecture.
Great professor and basically AP Calc review. Good lectures and responds to emails and is generous with hw grade and points for finals and midterms.

(Math009B) I personally had some trouble following along with some of his lectures since not only was the content covered too quickly, but he also didn't explain the topics in an intuitive manner. Hi! Okay so: I took his math 046 class spring quarter 2022. There was no option for that but I feel like its important to leave a review in case someone is looking for guidance. He IS SUCH A NICE TEACHER he ALWAYS helps me on EVERYTHING hes nice and gentle and he is ALWAYS UNDERSTANDABLE I dont mod his accent because I can ALWAYS UNDERSTAND HIM NO MATTER WHAT he is such a great teacher I WANT HIM TO BE MY TEACHER FOREVER SERIOUSLY doctor Zhang if ur reading UR AN AMAZING TEACHER from ur student

Dr. Zhang is a very happy and dedicated professor. He is extremely nice and doesn't try to fail you. He wants you to learn. Take him! He's a great guy.
