Amazing professor. Wants all of his students to succeed and is extremely passionate about the material he teaches.
Best professor at UCR period. Extremely engaging lectures and genuinely cares about his student's success. Wish he taught more classes here.

Rich is a very down-to-earth professor and enjoys teaching about information systems. If you have zero programming experience you'll be fine as he tailors this course towards those with little-to-no experience. It's very difficult to fail this class. His lectures are enjoyable and he gives a lot of valuable career advice.
I thought he was a great professor and challenged the students to learn and develop strategies to be successful.

Professor Rich is super chill. I had previous Python knowledge so his 101 class was pretty straightforward. Even if you have zero coding knowledge, you shouldn't be worried b/c it's a beginner's course in coding. Lectures are super helpful so show up to those and pay attention.

One of the best professors I have ever taken. He is enthusiastic and patient with his students. His assignments do take time outside of class to understand, but it comes with coding in general. I will never forget his last lecture since it was that iconic and memorable. Overall, I can't say anything negative about him.

Best teacher at UCR. He accommodated for all students; he did in person lectures, live zoom sessions, AND recorded the lectures. No tests, just three projects. My first time learning code and he was very beginner friendly. Not once did I ever feel like he was moving too fast during lectures, he always stopped to double check everyone understood.
Great guy but this class is hard especially if you're a beginner with coding. Youtube videos are more helpful than the professor and TA to be honest lol

Rich is a really cool guy and I think his lectures are entertaining. One of my favorite professors at UCR so far! I don't understand why people are complaining and saying his class is hard. well yeah any class is going to be hard if you don't pay attention. If you think this class is hard, just wait till you take Jasso.

Professor Rich is a good lecturer with a lot of passion, but I feel like his expectations for students to code are a little high. If coding or computers in general is not your thing, then this class will feel horrible. As someone that likes computers, but not experienced in coding, I felt the assignments were moderately hard, but doable.

Professor Rich has a very good character but this class is not organized. Total of three projects first one was easy the second and third were very hard. He expects you to know a programming language just in two lectures and these gave me a very hard time to complete. If you know programming then this class will be easy if not, a nightmare.

To be honest, I do not understand how his ratings is even above a 2. Maybe before covid hit and there were classes in person, it was much better. Some of the homework were doable as an entry level, yet some of it was incredibly difficult unless you already have decent amount of knowledge in coding. Try to avoid if you can.
This man swears we are computer science majors.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: RIch expects all students to know how to code, so unless you already know how to code in python at a high level, good luck completing any of the hw or projects. It starts off easy with simple projects, but once it gets to python, you will be screwed. Projects are worth a lot of points and very hard. Lectures do not help at all. Avoid at all costs
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Rich is so bad. Don't listen to other people's opinion. Coding involved and he says he will teach you but he doesn't. When it comes time for the projects, you don't know how to do it because he takes lecture time to talk about useless stuff. Unless you know coding, this class is the worst class you will ever take. Rich a b**** too. Sorry it rhymed.
One of the best professors I have ever had!

Really great guy. He makes learning the subject clear and interesting. Homework is very easy as long as you're keeping up with content, and the content is very relevant to real life. Only curveball was the end of the quarter project. It was a bit too advanced based on what we've been covering in class in my opinion, but still wasn't that bad.

Rich is the best professor ever and I would not take this course unless he taught it. We have three quizzes that are fairly simple if you were in class and 4 homework assignments that are done for credit. Attendance is not mandatory; however, if you want to understand the class and pass the quizzes you should go. No book needed or midterm/final.

Worse business teacher I ever had. He would not curve I only need 0.5% to pass, he did not curve. Also, at his last class, he sounds like he is going to give us extra credit. But! he didn't! NEVER TAKE HIS BUS101
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I highly recommend taking a class taught by Professor Rich. He makes the class content easy to understand and has a gift of keeping his students engaged in lectures. I learned so much and I always looked forward to attending this class.

Rich is easily the best prof. I've had at UCR. He clearly lays out what is expected of his students. He genuinely wants each student to succeed. He used Discord which allowed students to ask questions, which were quickly responded to by him, one of the TAs, or a fellow student. Going to class is key because he redacts info from the posted slides.

I've taken Professor Rich's Bus 101 course and currently taking his Bus 175 course as well. He is by far my favorite teacher I've had at UCR to this day. Rich not only does an excellent job teaching his material, but he also genuinely cares about the well being of his students.

#1 UCR BUSINESS PROFESSOR HANDS DOWN Rich wants to see his students succeed. He is one of the few professors at UCR who truly understands how students learn best (as seen by his flipped lecture teaching style). Pre-Class materials are easy to follow and always < 15 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This professor is a really good lecturer and I definitely feel like I learned from the class because he teaches with up to date industry knowledge. His exams were pretty hard with averages of C in a few of them. Extremely strict no late policy on homework but easy work. There's no curve. It was his first time teaching 101 so we were an experiment.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The quizzes were more like exams. It felt like he worded questions in a confusing matter on purpose. He does not give good feedback on quizzes. His lectures are interesting and he gives good examples Yet must attend every lecture due to there being no book and watch out for quizzes they are meant to confuse and worth a lot. Not an easy A at all!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Definitely one of the top Business professors UCR has to offer. His focus is on learning for his students & he does this by implementing real world applications in his teachings. Professor definitely knows his material due to extensive experience in the IS industry. His class structure is simple, fair, & engaging. Overall, awesome professor!

Even though he's new, he's one of the best business professors at UCR. He's super nice and has a great sense of humor, and goes the extra mile for students. Lectures were fun and homework was easy to boot. Quizzes given every other week in lecture and no book needed for this class. Overall, a very easy class with an awesome professor.

He is a great professor that is truly invested in his students. Lectures are engaging and he sets students up for success not only in the class but for their professional careers. His integration of business applications used in IS is interesting and relevant. Lectures are organized and he is always willing to help his students.

He's a good professor and he makes you think about IT in different ways. He really cares and you should definitely take him if you get the chance. No midterm or final, just quizzes and homework. Really interesting class and quizzes are not cumulative. Basically 3 lectures, and then a quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Awesome professor who genuinely cares about the success of his students. His flipped class teaching style is refreshing and places an emphasis on learning and engagement. His expectations are clear and he made the course enjoyable. Nice person who has a passion for teaching, would definitely take any class he teaches again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easy! Great Professor!

Professor Singh is pretty chill. His lectures are pretty boring but business can only be so entertaining. Class grade heavily influenced by group end of quarter project presentation (make a product/extension). I literally did not try in the class but he offers so much extra credit I nearly got an A so you should be fine.

He has 2 exams and 1 final. The 2 exams are open book/notes no electronics, the final was closed everything but only use 3 cheat sheets. The few quizzes that were in class you could use your laptop. Depending on the year of the book, the PowerPoint numbers are not going to match and for exams he's going to go off of what is on his PowerPoints.
Professor Singh is caring and wants to see his students succeed. As long as you do the assignments, you will pass the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Caring professor. Make sure you do the required readings and pay attention during lecture because the exams will be challenging otherwise.

Professor offers a lot of extra credit. Homework is online and so are quizzes but they are in person. The exams are very reading heavy and conceptual, taking notes only on the lectures is not enough. Make sure to get in a good group for the group project. Great lecturer, but does go off topic frequently. He is very caring for his students.

Quizzes are open notes so it was easy. Final and midterm both extremely heavy on textbook and conceptual, but offers lots of extra credit. Lecture is slow and sometimes likes to ramble (likes to bring up his McDonald job), funny otherwise but skippable. Group project was also easy but attend and pay attention during lectures on balance sheets.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: Probably the easiest class I've taken , he claims there are pop quizzes but never had any ,test and super easy and a presentation is required for the discussion .Really easy class

Pop-quiz in class sometimes, open notes though, super easy. Group project, so get ready to socialize, but they were super easy too. Overall easy class. The lectures were a bit slow and boring, and you can basically skip unless there's a quiz. Just study the textbook and slides. Allows a cheat sheet for tests, too, light midterm, and final.

Lots of extra credit. Midterms are open note and open book. I kind of struggled on the midterms, it's just very conceptual. The lectures are alright, I found the slides and the textbook helpful. For the group project, please choose good people. For some reason in my section, we couldn't choose and I ended up doing most of the work by myself.

Sometimes it's easy to get lost in his lectures so I suggest actively taking notes. You don't really have to read, you could go based on taking notes from lectures but reading is always better for context. He's a great speaker just sometimes a little off topic. Quizzes on each chapter he covers, its open book.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: This class requires the bare minimum to pass, but your grade is entirely based on the group project. I would recommend joining a group you are familiar with because you will be working with them all quarter. The lectures are boring and not mandatory, the quizzes are all open note, just prioritize your presentations and final project to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very nice guy gave us tons of extra credit to ensure we had good grades, and I still ended up with a B+ XD

He was aware that his lectures drone, and checked in often to make sure students were still following. During the lectures, he would slip in a small bit of analysis or some data from outside the slides and it is important to note those for exams. Syllabus was very clear on graded parts, and stands true. Lecture optional, discussions mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very respectable and loved him as a professor for BUS010! He allowed cheat sheets on exams and quizzes and always explained topics well!

I had him for my honors leadership development class, and loved it! The lectures were so insightful and aligned with the textbook. You do have to read the textbook for the quizzes, but he allows open book for the first two and the last you have a 2 page cheet sheet which is really helpful. Participation and attendance matter. Overall a great class!

Tests and final exams have a lot of situational/real-life scenarios, which can be a bit challenging. Reading the textbook and going to the lecture helps with the exams and the final. The professor also offered a lot of easy extra credits to boost grades, and the group projects are very important and do impact your grade.

Overall it was an easy class, he allows unlimited paper cheat sheets for the quizzes and midterms, and two pages front and back for the final. A lot of questions are situational, or come from the textbook or sometimes from the lecture. As long as you go to a few lectures and read the textbook, you should be good.
Greatest professor Ive ever had.
Great, easy but attend lectures

Raj Singh is so easy he saids that he will curve the who class if the final is low. The only you will fail is if you don't show up to 1 or 2 class and don't even open the canvas the only way to fail is to not even acknowledge the class. Very easy must take.
Great guy, overall easy class, lectures are heavy, the work is easy, easy grade

Honestly one of the best professors at UCR. He gives lots of opportunities to get extra credit. He takes attendance a couple times randomly throughout the course. Allows noted for exams. You should have no reason to fail his class.

He is solid professor. Good at explaining & sometimes over-explains himself to ensure we'd understand. Will allow students to create cheatsheets for exams/final & all quizzes are open-notes. Hw assignments are basically quizzes 2.0. Group project is easy if given enough time. The final was a bit harder than expected; DONT solely rely on cheatsheet.

He is a good professor in terms of expanding on the materials during lecture. He is very patient, allows cheat sheet and gives extra credit. However, his exams are very tricky and quite difficult. Lots of questions are scenario based and very obscure. Discussions are for a big group project presentation.

Reasonable in terms of grading. He's really lenient in class such as allowing cheat sheets/book on midterm and two sheets for the exam. Also very forgiving on extra credit opportunities. The exams were doable as long as you followed lecture/readings. Group project isn't graded hard and is fairly simple.

The exams are really difficult, including random details from the textbook. Unless you're prepared to read and thoroughly understand the entire book, this class may not be the best choice (don't take it). The professor seemed passionate though
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: Very nice and caring professor. Lectures aren't mandatory, but he gives extra credit if he sees not a lot showed up. Exams are pretty tough,more application-based, barely includes anything from the lectures/homework. Provides lots of extra credit opportunities. There's a quarter-long project,which can get annoying if you don't pick good teammates.

Genuinely one of the best professors I've had, the exams did include a lot of the material from lectures so I recommend attending. The exams are also really hard but he offers a lot of extra credit, so trust me its fine to fail an exam and the get an A if you do ALL the extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: He's a very caring professor and makes sure that you're able to get the most out of the class. Be sure to read the textbook, but overall he provides a lot of opportunities for you to grow as a student.

the best way to get a good grade is to do all the homework and extra credit if you can, because the test questions are full of random things that are only mentioned once so they're kind of hard, but your grade is based on lots of other things too. also you get to use your notes on the midterms which is really nice. the group project is annoying :/

You can tell he's really passionate about what he teaches, but his tests and lectures feel like two different classes. Quizzes are really free points but finals are heavily application based and nothing like what is covered on quizzes/lectures.

Professor Singh was my first business professor at UCR and I must say that his lectures and assignments really helped make the class interesting and useful. Each chapter of our class' textbook was easy enough to understand and filled with examples of modern business application as well. I recommend this class for students even wanting a taste!

Dr Singh genuinely seems to care about his students, however, he doesn't disclose the value of the textbook on the exams, his lectures tend to go either too fast or slow, and exams are presented odd with what feels like foreign information, if you are active about success in the class, you will achieve it, he is kind and generous in grading.

Professor Singh at face value is good; and by good I mean that he is not not of value in the role of professing. I rate him a 2/5 because he makes no clear effort in trying to reinforce the value of an introductory business course that he should. The content of the course is graspable but all exams/quizzes become semantical because of this.
Dr. Singh is a very good business professor although his lectures can be boring at times he explains everything professorially and all the quizzes and exams are open notes.
Amazing, cant recommend him more. He was always their when you needed help. Do choose a good group for your project because most of your grade depends on your group. Other then that he was amazing.

Professor Singhs class is very relaxed. I will say it is based primarily on lectures but his slides are always posted online. He is also very kind and understanding and provides a lot of extra credit.
extremely confusing and unclear lectures with difficult tests
One of the top professors at UCR, the man is an inspiration he has so many degrees and hes so chill. But the class is really dependent on the text book, so read up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really nice professor and cares a lot about his students. He gives lots of extra credit. The only thing that made this class a little difficult were the exams.
Super easy. he is adorable and cares so much about his students. his lectures can get boring but not too bad. quizzes are online. barely any homework. highly recommend
Okay in general, tests are tough and some qs are kind of weird. Lectures were helpful in my field but tests, not as much.

His tests are sincerely the worst: most of the class bombs them because they're filled with irrelevant, randomly specific questions that were probably mentioned one time in the past. 70% of the questions are from the absurdly expensive textbook and sections he did not teach in the lecture. After he nukes your grades, he offers office hours.

Great professor but beware of the tests - some of the questions he puts on there are the most random information. Not applicable to real work environment. Buy or rent the textbook because he lets you use it on the exams but not the final.

I had an absolute blast taking his class! Very clear syllabus and grading structure. The class content was honestly not very difficult and he is always available for help. I do however suggest picking a reliable set of people for the group project, as that could tank your grade pretty badly. Attend lecture for extra credit opportunities.

The professor is very passionate about the subject but his lectures can get really boring. I did a lot of reading for the class quizzes were not too bad but I didn't on the tests or the final. I might be unprepared for the final but some questions do be questionable. He offers some extra credits. Experience of group project depends on your members.

A lot of reading required. Lectures were very boring. Gorup Project is not fun either. Exams are extremely tough despite how the rest of class feels. Don't treat exams lightly and it should be an easy A with the curve. Just get a B and the curve will boost you. DON'T BE THE CURVE.

Went out of his way to schedule a makeup exam for me. Super friendly and flexible. Only heavy work for the class is the group project, but the exams are easy(open book/note). The final allows for two cheat sheet papers.
He was amazing I loved him and I am going to miss him. He is very caring and class is pretty easy. I definitely recommend for people to take this class.

The Professor was good at teaching the class and taught instructions very well; I would take it again. However, the TA Nabh Agrawal wasn't great; he picked at the littlest things and was very tedious with grading. Professor gets a W in my book

Make sure you read the book and know where the information is cause he lets you use it on the 2 midterms. The more familiar you are with the book, the easier it will be for you on the midterms. Don't procrastinate on the group project. Ask your TA for feedback on it in advance so you can make adjustments. Only a cheat sheet for Final, no textbook.

Although his quizzes and exams can be challenging, he does provide extra credit once in a while which can benefit you a lot. Exams and quizzes consist majority from his lecture slides but also from the required textbook. He doesn't mention when he gives out that extra credit which is why it is important for you to attend the lecture.

Surprisingly I passed, even though I failed every test and quiz he gave out. Honestly, this class is just common sense and you'll pass. He also gives out extra credit once in a while when you go to his lectures (he won't tell you when). There's a lot of reading and if you do the reading you'll pass the tests and quizzes. Overall, easy to pass class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Class wasn't too difficult in total but quizzes and tests are pulled directly from textbook so read in depth and take notes, as lecture content is not as heavy on the test. Lectures were a bit bland and hard to follow and make sure to focus on final business plan project as it's quite important and focus heavily on studying for midterm and final.

Prof. Singh does a good job of conveying his passion for teaching & I appreciated how he genuinely cares for students. I found the class content interesting as it focused on intro to business concepts. There's a group project that is worked on throughout the quarter. There's EC and unannounced quizzes so be sure to do the readings from the textbook
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Lectures were quite boring and bland, but he does care a lot about student progress and provides extra credit. Exams were open notes, but it was quite hard as the wording of the questions made it quite difficult to understand. You are expected to do a big group project during the quarter which is worth the majority of your grade.
The lectures can be dry at times. There's a decent amount of group work as well. That said, he's very caring for his students and you can tell he wants us to succeed. His passion is contagious.

literally the goat i love raj singh. fr though the class is relatively easy if you don't think it is ykwim. basically don't think its all just "common sense" and "i can just go to the lecture and be fine on tests". read the textbook and study your notes and the exams are easy. the group project is also easy just get it out of the way early.

The Midterm and final were a bit hard but the lecture has good and clear. Take notes in the lecture and the reading, it is important to have the note for tests. There will be a big group project, but the grading really depends on who is your TA so don't freak out during the first few weeks, it will be fine if you do your work!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: He was great but often the wording on tests and quizzes made it difficult to understand

- Good amount of quizzes and tests
-Don't freak out they are either take home or easy
-He is VERY laid back and actually provides great insight
-Final was difficult. he prepares you but still difficult

All in all, You will love it and for a first year class. welcome to UCR and you will do well.
DO NOT FREAK OUT ABOUT THIS CLASS OR PROFESSOR

Professor Singh was nice but his tests and class were terrible. The lecture was boring and everything he covered in class is in the book. The tests are worded terribly and the class average was in the forties for the final. He tries to make it easy by letting the exams be open book and cheat sheets, but the average was a C and below for all exams.

professor Singh is really passionate about what he teaches and you can tell by the way he teaches. No attendance for his lectures, but slides are posted on canvas. Offers a lot of extra credit (8 points for fall 22). Final exam and big group project make up most of your grade. Homework and quizzes are easy T/F questions. A lot of reading.
Taking notes of his lectures and doing the required reading is key!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: professor singh is an amazing individual, but his class was one that requires tremendous amounts of reading. at times his questions on tests would not be related to the chapter. The midterms were open book - average was a B. The final covered 6 chapters without using the textbook - avg was a C. Don't be worried but just be prepared for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: His lectures can get heavy, but he is an amazing professor.

Professor Singh was very nice, but his lectures can get a bit boring. There is a large group project for this class so make sure to stay organized when working on it. Overall this class wasn't too difficult as long as you put in a reasonable amount of effort.
You'll meet lots of people in this class. He is very kind and very respected. He's very interactive with the students which is nice. Test are super easy, which are basically True and False questions.

Professor Singh does not round grades he uses a strict point system. With an 89.7, my grade wasn't rounded up :( HIs lectures are alright and his classwork is easy. The group project and tests are a majority of your grade so make sure you don't miss too many points there.

Professor Singh is definitely a great person. Very caring, interesting, and is fair with assignments. He definitely likes participation and will remember your name if you are up front. Tests and quizzes were not hard but studying will do justice. Would definitely recommend :)

Professor Singh's class was alright. His lectures are recorded but sometimes boring since they aren't very engaging. However, he is very nice and cares about his students. Tests and one group project make up a majority of the grade and it's based on points, which can sometimes be difficult. Overall, I would retake but it wasn't the best experience.

The homework assignments are very flexible, the quizzes are mostly true or false, as well as the tests and midterms. The group assignments are easy, but the final project consists of more work but very straight forward. Differently recommend taking this class with this professor.

Raj is the best professor I have ever taken! His class outline is very straightforward: - (T/F + Multiple Choice) quizzes - (T/F + Multiple Choice) tests - 1 group project - homework assignments (gives you entire quarter to complete) Attendance is mandatory but overall the class is very easy! Raj truly cares about his students.
Nicest professor at UCR! Raj is really caring and lenient in terms of grading and assignments! Attendance is mandatory, but as long as you do all of the assignments it should be an Easy A.

Honestly, professor Singh can be a little nitpicky and he picks very specific material from the books which forces you to read. But that aside I have never seen a teacher care so much for his students. The material can be kind of dry sometimes but he does his best to spice it up. Honestly a solid professor and an incredible individual.

accommodating to students dur COVID. Willing to communicate w/students & help them learn. 2 quizzes that will be notified to you during class. Sometimes takes attendance &other times he doesn't through iLearn. You can choose who to be in group projects with (if have friends you can do it together). Teach &correlate materials to his real-life skills

actually accommodates students (esp during COIVD). Always willing to talk to you during office hours and help you with anything he can. You do have 2 Quizzes and he will inform you when it will be coming. Everything is in the syllabus & if confused ask him bc he will explain everything. Incorporate his teaching to real-life. will have group project

Professor Raj is hands down the best professor at UCR. I've taken him for 3 quarters now and I will be also taking him for my last quarter here. He is the most caring and nice professor ever. He always makes sure you are doing good and if there is something going on he will give you extensions. His lectures are very good. Make sure to participate.

Just a great guy that really cares for his students and WANTS to give them easy As and teach them something while doing it. Most of the books he assigns are found free online with a bit of searching. Only problem is he's not the most tech savvy but gets the job done.
None

The compassion and enthusiasm seriously radiate off of this man. He is a very positive professor and you can clearly see how much he wants his students to succeed and be successful. His exams can be quite a challenge unless you REALLY REALLY carefully read the book. He uploads lecture slides and the group project assignment isn't bad at all. 10/10.

Professor Raj is one of the best business professors at UCR. I've had him for BUS010 and BUS107, in both classes his lectures are heavily influenced on definitions. Making note cards is a great idea for his classes as there are many things to memories. Aside from that he is really nice and truly cares about his students!
Best Professor at UCR. He is so nice and approachable with students and always ready to help. Pay attention during lectures and finished all assignments.
Best Professor at UCR. He is so nice and approachable with students and always ready to his help. Pay attention during lectures and finished all assignments.
Textbook is not needed. His lectures are super boring and hard to pay attention to. The class isn't hard just do the assignments and you are good to go!

Professor Singh is an approachable individual. You should read the book to achieve high grades for exams. Do not stress over the in-class quizzes and homework assignments. You must interview a manager for the individual paper. Also, the group will submit a written report. There is a case competition for groups. You should attend discussion classes.

His grading is so unclear. He doesn't explain the assignments as he has his better TA's do the heavy work for him. I looked around class one time and there is at least 3 people sleeping. He really plays nice when he needs a good evaluation. He doesn't care about us and he's a show-off.

Raj is a good professor when it comes to teaching and trying to get his students to learn business concepts. However, on exams he gives tricky questions and ultimately screws peoples grades over on the final exam and final project. I had a 96% before taking the final and ended up with a B+ in the class.
Tough grader and focuses so much on grammar errors
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Raj Singh doesn't care about your grade, he cares about your learning. He'll go out of his way to make sure you understand, and will try to give you credit once he knows you do-- sometimes even after you got it wrong the first time. Took him for MBA stats at Chapman Univ, and appreciated his helpful approach. He's a good man and a good instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's an amazing and inspiring professor. He really wants everyone to understand the broadness of business, whether it be the financial aspect, or the marketing aspect. He's very nice and respectful. You can talk to him after class if you have more questions. There is a group project, but its self explanatory. Amazing professor and businessman.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Raj Singh is a great Professor! The class a group project you have to with other students in ur section and it due at the end of the quarter. He has a lot of hw assignments but they are easy and gives extra credit. There is 2 midterms which are open book & the final is closed book with cheat sheets you can use.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: His class was very easy. You just have to read the book, take notes and study for the exams. There are 2 midterms which are open book, 1 final which is open notes, and 1 group project.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Raj was a funny and caring professor, never failed to make us laugh. Go to lectures so you won't miss the pop quizzes (very easy). Do ALL of the extra credit assignments and don't procrastinate on the business plan! The quizzes and tests are concept based and go to office hours for extra help on all quizzes/tests. Buy the book from years after 2016
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The most boring class ever, you'll fall asleep. He is not a good lecturer too. The only reason I even go to class because of the pop quizzes. Midterms are open book, the questions are situational, not straightforward. Have fun working on the business plan, it is hell.

Raj Singh was a nice and understanding professor, but his lectures were pretty boring. There are a few pop quizzes to make sure that students are attending lectures. The midterms are open book but you should still read the content beforehand. The group project is crucial so make sure to prepare for it early on. Also, do the extra credit! It helps!

Tests are open book, so long as you read your textbook or listen in on lecture you're good. I probably could've done better if I didn't screw up the tests. But he also offers a lot of extra credit. Group projects are a thing but they're not too difficult if you know how to manage your time. Otherwise easy class

Dr. Singh is nice. He makes lectures too boring and sleepy. He gives some extra credit and his exams are open book. SHould be an easy class and honestly going to lecture was kinda a waste of time because I felt so sleepy in his class. I wish he could be more interesting and I wish the class wasn't held at the UV.

A pretty nice and passionate lecturer. The class material itself is kinda boring, but easy to learn and not hard to study. He lets you bring in a cheat sheet for the final exam. Has 2 midterms and 1 final, and 3 pop quizzes (but they were always held the lecture before each midterm and final). Not hard to receive an A as long as you put in effort.

Such a nice man! The class itself is super boring and I fell asleep in every lecture. But the work is easy, lots of extra credit opportunities. There is a chance for a pop quiz in every lecture so you have to attend so you wont miss out. Went to his office hours because I was confused and he gave me extra points on my midterm for going.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I could not have asked for a better business professor. His lectures are often entertaining and engaging. He has a genuine passion for teaching his students and will put in the effort to make sure everyone succeeds. Although Raj does not curve, he offers multiple extra credit opportunities. The final, without the proper preparation, is difficult.

So the class is pretty laidback. There are 2 midterms, both open book, as well as smaller assignments. Main things are the business plan and the final. Study hard for the final as it tends to drop everyone's grade by a letter or two. Raj is super caring though if you go to his office hours he will take time to help you with your grades etc.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Rajs grading system is very fair, as he allows you to use your book on both the midterms and any pop quizzes. Study hard for the final (cheat sheet allowed but no book) and do extremely well on the business plan as these two are usually the determining factors when it comes to your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Raj Singh is a very respectful and nice professor. His tests are open book, but the final is four-page open notes and not open book. There are three pop quizzes, so attendance is mandatory. There is a group paper, a few group assignments, and an individual paper. Tip: study as much as you can for the final because it is a little hard.

He always asked everyone "are you guys good with that? Make sense? okay". Very caring professor and gives extra credit. His lectures are boring. The midterm and many quizzes were open book but still, people got like a B or C on them. He is the GOAT and I loved his class. I would see him again in my upper divisions.

Professor Singh is very attentative to students. He really encourages good study habits in students and will extend extra credit due date. Midterms and quizzes are open book as well, so overall pretty easy class.

Amazing. Very kind and understanding and definitely knows what he's talking about. Class itself is not actually hard, just basic common sense about business over the world. Midterms are open book and he even gives us a cheat sheet for the final. Overall, very good professor, made me less worried about my first year of college as a business major!
A little boring, but learn many things. Many credits.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Very passionate about business. The textbook was an easy read, and the exams were definitely fair in evaluating our knowledge. Homework was helpful to study for the exams. Group project to turn in at the end of the quarter, but fairly easy.

Professor Singh is extremely kind.  His class is very simple.  His exams are open book, quizzes are open book/note or take home & for the final, you get a 4 page cheat sheet.  There is 1 group project that you work on the entire quarter.  If you do what you should, class is extremely managable.  He offers a lot of extra credit as well.

Clear that Singh has a passion for his job. Boring lectures. I know the final screwed everyone over. I know it dropped two letter grades (ie. A- to a B) for a handful of ppl. Definitely need to read the textbook to pass. Txtbk sold at the bookstore for this class is "edited" by him so there is only material he teaches in there.

Lectures a bit boring. Homework on iLearn & not due til week 10. Do the extra credit; helps w/ grades. 2 open book exams & cheatsheet final. Really read the book for final. 2 e-portfolios. Bus plan group project kicked my ass. Good professor & tries to engage students w/ questions during lecture but it turns awkward when nobody answers for a while.

Really nice & caring. Open-book for exams #1 & 2. Open notes for exam #3 ( 2 sheets on both sides, or 4 sheets on 1 side). 5 online hw (20 Qs per). 2 short essays (e-portfolio). 2 papers (group & individual). 3 group presentations (2 essays & paper). Bring your book for 3 pop quizzes. Book info is a bit different from lecture. Raghav is a great TA.

I didn't even show up to class.  Only went twice, which were when our midterms were.  Easy class.  The exams are in chronological order (open book exams).  Just remember that when you choose your business group, choose dependable people, because you will work with them a lot.  TAKE ADVANTAGE OF ALL EXTRA CREDIT ASSIGNMENTS. THEY UR GRADE A LOT!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, i had fun taking this class.

Introductory course should be simple. But not only he makes his class complicated but his syllabus and TA's slides were outdated. Many times, the actual due date were different from the date listed on syllabus which made our group confusing and made us rush. Besides, our TA graded the report unnecessarily hard and many ended up horrible grade.
Raj is a great professor. He has a good sense of humour and is very compassionate with students. I love Raj because of his personality.

Everything is based off of the book. The answers to the homework, quizzes and tests were found in small hidden details you *might* know if you did the reading carefully. The first 2 midterms were open book and the final was open notes ). He's really cool and cares about the students. Huge group project, you'll spend a lot of time with your group.

Great professor, very humble, and approachable. There are 3 quizzes, 2 midterms (open book), and a final (closed book, open notes). Gives extra credit opportunities! One big group project that involves writing up a business plan and includes a presentation at the end of the quarter. Don't miss points! I was 6 points away from an A-.

He's a good professor. His class isn't hard, but you need to read the chapters assigned to pass. There is 3 quizzes, 2 midterms, final, a group project, and some small presentations. On the tests he would let us use the textbook and on the final he let us use a cheat sheet. He has an accent but it isn't hard to understand. Overall good.

The lecture section is long but helpful. Professor Singh makes sure everyone understands the section before moving on. Class is mandatory due to 3 pop quizzes. Open book/notes.  The discussion section is somewhat helpful for the group project. Be prepared for a business prompt and 10 mins presentation. Attendance is mandatory due to points taken.
He's okay... I'd take other professor if I could though

It was a pleasure to take Intro to Bus 10 with Proffesor Singh. He is very knowledgable in the business field and it open to helping students succeed in his class and in the outside world. If you read the book that is assigned and listen to his lectures you will get good grades in the tests. I would definitely take another class with Prof. Singh !
I am taking this class this summer with this professor and it is confusing and complicated.  Never want to take this professor again.
I don't  recommend  this  professor. No idea why rating is so high

Seriously, is he the only prof. in UCR for bus 10?  His class is just too complicated for introduction class. Tests are hard but worth relatively few points and focus on annoying group project which wasn't really helpful and time consuming. the subject mightve been more interesting if I had another prof.

Singh is really clear and easy. He has a lot of experience in the business field and always gives advice to students. The midterms are open book and are really easy but the final is closed book with a cheat sheet and it's super hard. You can recover from it as long as you do all the homework assignments and do good on the group project.

I took Business 10 (Intro to Bus) with him and he was amazing and very passionate about teaching. One of the best professors i've had here at UCR and he is always there to help his students. People will say that his lectures are boring but students complain about EVERYONE's lectures because they're more than an hour long. Overall great professor.

DON'T MISS CLASS. Missing just a few points will be the difference between an A and a B. You can only miss about 45 points before you drop to a B from an A. Discussion attendance is easy points so DON'T MISS. This class is an easy A but you have to put in the effort and do the assignments, even when it seems dumb. DON'T MISS ANY POINTS

Gives out a lot of extra credit assignments. Homework assignments are all due by the end of the quarter. Be sure to get 1010 on all of those because this class is passed on how many points you have. One group project presentation in discussion by the end of the quarter.
He can be hard to understand due to his accent but not too bad. You should study for clarity because it may not be clear during lectrue

He is an easy professor. Three tests - 2 are open book and four pages of notes. One is not open book but you are allowed four pages of notes. The last test was brutal though. It is honestly a hit or miss if you know the information. It will be one random line in the chapter. Do the extra credit because it will truly help your grade.
There's enough EC assignments to boost your grade. One group project that lasts the whole quarter but isn't hard at all.

He's a really nice guy, but his lectures are super boring. 2 open book midterms and 1 closed book cumulative final. He takes very specific, irrelevant lines from each chapter on the exams, which makes the final very hard. He gives a lot of extra credit, so make sure to do all of them; they will seriously help you boost your grade.
he was cool

He is one of the best Business professors at UCR. He is extremely helpful and makes you feel like you belong. Singh s very inspirational and an overall very good professor. You should be lucky if you get him!
2 exams open book, final one cheat sheet straight from the book.

It was an easy class until the final. The two midterms are open book but have to read the book carefully to answer the questions. The final is closed book but one page cheat sheet; it's word for word from the book so it's terrible. There is an individual paper and a group paper that includes a presentation. Tough A, but glad I took it over summer.

I was already interested in a career in business, and Singh only got me more excited and enthusiastic about the business field. His class is really easy and straightforward if you read and prepare with a "cheat sheet". There is a mandatory group project where you have to present to your discussion class. He is really nice and wants the best for us.

Lectures were a little boring but helped in understanding the material. However, he's not as boring as other professors out there. There are two midterm in which he allows you to use the textbook. The final is not open book but he does allow a cheat sheet. He also offers extra credit so its easy to get a good grade.

Class is pretty simple, but all of the tests are basically word for word from the book, which makes them damn near impossible to Ace. However, Singh gives you chances to boost up your grade with some extra credit and group projects.

Prof Singh is awesome. For the students who are actually passionate about business, you will enjoy him. He is extremely approachable and wants you to succeed in this course. Also, you must purchase the textbook in order  to get an A.

Rambles a lot. Goes off into tangents a lot too. Talks a lot about business people. He gives extra credit, but not too much. Big projects worth a little of your grade. But open note open book midterms, and the last one (aka final) is a two/four page cheat sheet.
Rambles too much, is the reason why i am no longer a business major. Boring, a little arrogant too. DO NOT RECOMMEND

pretty easy class. didnt attend most lectures but he gives pop quizzes towards the end of the quarter. 2 midterms both open book. final is pretty hard so that is something you need to study for even with the one page cheat sheet. discussion is super important
very easy if you read the textbook. both midterms are open book and final allows 2 page cheat sheet. one tip: do the extra credit assignments, he gives alot and they are fairly easy
Rambles too much
Best professor ever.
easy midterms and final! the midterms are open-book, and you can use a page of notes during the final. i barely went to class, and never really studied for the midterms, but still passed.

Singh is an awesome teacher! 2 midterms open book, final 2 page cheat sheet. Gives out a lot of extra credit! Group project is a hassle but also easy. Quizzes are random so attend lecture! EASY CLASS.
Professor Singh was amazing! One of the best, most inspirational professors I've ever had in all honesty. He really cares for his students and he's a very nice person.

Professor Singh was a very helpful professor. I have had 2 classes with him so far and he is always very concerned with the students progress. His teachings are straight from the real world and he gives strong examples to support his teachings. I highly recommend taking a class with this professor.

easy easy easy. take this class and your quarter will be a breeze. all midterms are open book open note. final has one page notes front and back. all test questions come from the book. group project is simple

He's very easy. If you read the book thoroughly you will get an A, since all the texts are from the book. And even better, he wants you to get an A. Also, don't stress about the project too much, as long as you follow your TA's instructions you'll be fine. Also he shows you some cool videos about business as a career, those were my favorite!

He is a good teacher and is always trying to get everyone to pass the class. Midterms and quizzes are open note/book, so make sure you read the book so you know where things are. There is also a quarter long project that wasn't that bad and actually helps you understand business a little bit better.
2 midterms. 1 final(Worth 200 points). 3 pop quizzes. 1 group paper. 2 extra credit opportunities.  Takes random attendance so make sure you go to class.  Study hard for the final.

Dr. Singh is a really great professor. He gives everyone a lot of wiggle room so you can get your A. The extra credit really helps in the end. For me, it was the difference between a B+ and an A-. He's approachable and always concerned with his students. Don't skip class, because there are a bunch of quizzes (easy). Final is hard. Be prepared.

Prof Singh really cares about the students, he knows that bus10 is a breadth course for other majors and doesn't make it very difficult. Do all the extra credit assignments they're very helpful if you miss any points on tests. Open book mid terms w/a cheat sheet final. SHOW UP EVERYDAY in case there's a quiz; if you miss if you're screwed.

pretty easy. the group project freaking sucked because you have to pick groups before you know anybody, and you don't get to know how badly your group members' work ethics suck until it's too late to switch groups, but i still got an A, and he tries to be as helpful as possible. easiest midterms and final ever. good teacher overall.

Really nice, generous guy but don't take it for granted. He gives out a lot of extra credit. ALWAYS SHOW UP ON QUIZ DAYS. You're guaranteed to get an A in the class as long as you do all the extra credit and actually read the book.
During his lectures, he always goes on tangents. Lectures are pointless EXCEPT on quiz day. Always attend discussions because that's part of your main grade along with the final.

The professor is really nice. Two midterms are open book and open notes, but final is closed book and closed notes with a cheat sheet allowed. Reading the chapters before the midterms are very helpful and recommended. Do not take this class for granted. It is easy as long as you pay attention.

Professor Singh is really chill guy. He gives out a lot of extra cred so be sure do it. His midterms are open book, but I suggest reading the chapters beforehand. The group project is cake, but the final is fairly difficult since it isn't open book. He allows a cheat sheet which I recommend you make very detailed. Overall, its pretty easy class.
Boring, but easy class. He has pop quizzes but they are open book. His midterms are also open book. But the final is closed and a little hard. Overall easy class

Pretty good teacher.  Helps you a lot.  Everything is open book and easy until the final which is closed book. It's a ridiculous final and the class average is a D on it so be sure to study hard! DOn't expect help on your grade, i got an 89.5 or somethin n didn't get an A- haha :(

Prof. Singh overall I would say he is a mediocre teacher. His lectures are boring as hell but you have to go if you want to get a good grade. Pop quizzes are frequent and you can't make them up. If you do go to all of his boring lecture I supposed that an A is certainly attainable. Group project for this class was quite useless.

As a senior-By far the best professor on campus.A)Actually really cares about student.  B)3 Quiz-T/F, 2 Mid-Mult., 1 Final-Mult.(Don't be fooled by the test type.  Still need to do the work. C)You will learn more real world info. than any other course. GREAT PROFESSOR who makes it REASONALBLE to get a GOOD GRADE. Should be a Required Course & Prof.

Singh is a really smart guy, knows his stuff and will teach you actual real world situations! His lectures are actually fun to attend, and you will actually learn! Open book, open notes for tests, and you get a cheat sheet for final. Have to attend his lectures, gives 5 pop quizzes that equals a test grade!
Really easy class. open book and open note for all midterms and we got a cheat sheet for the final...really easy professor.

Dr.Singh is a very nice professor however his lectures dont help you at all for the test. The only reason you must go to the class is for the pop quizes and if you miss one, you're screwed. it's 20 pts which is almost half of your midterms. just study the details for the finals and you will be fine. other tests are easy bc it's open book open notes

This guy is brilliant. Anyone who begs to argue should take a second look at his credentials. He received his phD from USC. His class is pretty ez it does not require much work. This is college if you want to learn you have to challenge your self and read the book, come to class and ask questions otherwise sit back and enjoy your ez A.

Easy. Class should of been condensed to a 5 week course, it's a waste of time to have 10 weeks of this. Professor is unorganized and takes so long to explain an easy topic, I lost interest fast.  Has good ratings because he is easy, not because he challenges you.  But then again, most students at this school only care about the grade(it's UCR).

Granted it's easy to get a decent grade (open book/notes), he is the most disorganized prof I've had. Definitely not my idea of UC-standards, but then again only a few are at this school. Bases the classes ability to comprehend the material on a couple individuals so you probably will get lost in the curriculum. But if you want to learn, stay away.

Good guy, good professor, learned a lot of stuff. this stuff is definitely useful if your a business major, so even tho he lets u not show up to class, open book open note, you still should pay attention for your sake... but he's a genuinely good guy.

Singh is still one of the best professors. He listens to his students and goes at their pace. If you don't understand something, he'll help clarify it. Class was a little boring but wasn't bad. Open book, open notes, group midterm and quizzes. Final is directly material from the book. Occasionally gives out extra credit. What more could you ask for

Cares a lot about students and tries to do his best to be helpful inside and outside of class. Takes attendance randomly for extra credit. Gives pop quizzes. Open book and notes for midterms and finals

A good professor. You only need to do homework and follow his lecture. Test is opened book/note, so be careful with calculation during test then an A is easy. For this class, text book isn't really needed, so I don't recommend to buy it (it's thick and expensive >_<)

Either you attended all the classes and passed or you missed a couple of classes and your grade went down. Professor does take attendance at random and adds this as extra credit at end of quarter. You do need to keep track of your scores.

each pt. on the quiz/exams is 1% of your grade. everything is heavily weighted so get as many points/partial credit as you can. Solved problems in class with no connection to applications or real life. basically you solve problems but don't know why. this is one of those instructors you take and forget.

He is a great professor! Go to all his lectures because there are pop quizzes. Know how to do the problems during lecture because the problems are similar on the exams. Open book and open note for exams. Must take this professor!

Even though he may be considered easy by most students, he is always late which leaves you wondering if he is even going to show up, he leaves during tests so you can't ask questions, he has no control over the class so you can't hear him lecture, he makes you watch boring movies regularly. Not professional at all. I LEARNED NOTHING FROM HIM.

He is great professor. He is not to difficult. But one must attend Discussion and lecture in order to do well. His class is open note and hes always willing to help. Can not ask for a better professor.

I've had singh for BSAD10/121/126 now and trust me, he is one of the best and easiest professors. If you get the chance, definitely take him. He has open note/book tests so it makes it even easier. He moves along at the students pace so the class isn't hard at all. He is really the****. Go to class though, or u'll slack and mess up and hate him.
open book and notes on both the midterms and the final! AWESOME i got an A in this class. take him if you get the chance!
his class is open notes but the final was super hard! he is also very disorganized and unclear
he is the ****, great teacher
disorganized

Don't bother taking this.  Yes, the tests are open note but the final exam is too long to finish.  The group project, too, is utter rubbish.  You might as well take this class with a professor who cares about you learning the material

Open notes open book. Really easy. Also gave out an additional 20 points of extra credit for coming to class and presenting the group project. Don't be fooled by the open notes open book thing though. It might take you the whole test to figure out where the stuff is in the book. Overall, still a great teacher. I plan on taking him as much as I can.

I aced everything, quizzes , midterms and when i got into a group project with a randomly selected group, my group bombed the project. i dind't get an A in the class. can you believe that and this ****teacher won't curve me. whata load of crap! it isn't my fault the groups retarded.

Although his exams questions can be confusing, it is open book and notes. The first two exams are even done as a group. However, the final is done individually and time-consuming. This course is pretty interesting and will help you in the future. He is my favorite professor. He actually cares for his students and their education.

OPEN BOOK/NOTES on all tests! But his notes are really REALLY messy! Sometimes unreadable. Nice guy, really cares about you doing well. Take GOOD notes and you should be fine. Don't buy a book. SOOO NOT NECESSARY!
a GUARANTEED A. what more can i say. just make sure that you do well on quizzes and exams. btw, he believes in all the exams should be open book/open notes.
Do not buy the book!!!!!! Biggest waste of money! Just go to lecture and take notes and check your calculations and mininum you'll get a B!!!! No curve :(
Open book open note exams and quizes for a math class....what's not easy about that?? Just double check your calculations!!
I had for a class.  Mid-terms are always easy but it's the final that you will get screwed.  Easy going professor, but very lazy which is not good.  Trust me.
A for sure!!!
He is a very cool and nice professor. He is  very understanding and his tests are open book and open notes.  I suggest you take him  because he is very good professor and explains very thoroughly.

So far, he's the most generous professor i have ever had!! tests and quizzes are open book and open notes and he gives extra credits too!! his classes are easy, and it's a shame not to get As in his classes!!
His classes are the best by FAR.

Hilarious professor!  His accent can be funny at times and his jokes are stupid funny.  If you get a chance, make sure you take him.  Open book/open notes, even though he might say its not the first day of class(just to get students to drop).  Easy-going professor!

he tries to be helpful, but is horrible at explaining things...but at least its open book and notes, so you just rewrite the problems with the new numbers even though you dont know why you're doin it...make sure u go to the TA sections, thats where u actually learn whats goin on in the class

Worst professor. Ignores you when you try to talk to him. Does NOT give you partial credit so that if you mess up in the beginning, you are basically screwed for the rest of the midterm or final. Doesnt even know the equations, he has to ask the students if hes doing the problem correctly on
Awesome teacher! wants everyone to get a good grade. makes class fun and informative. materials are presented in a good manner./ this prof. i highly recommend
hes very cool and laid back. everyone does well in his classes
He is a cool professor and has open note/book exams for BSAD 155. Advice: READ before taking exams and you will ace the class!
His tests and quizzes are very straightforward and he really wants everyone to do well in the class.
coll, laid back, open book quizzes and tests!
really laid back

Take this class with him if you want an A+!  He's not the best professor in the business department, but he definitely is the most generous grader!  Prepare to listen to stories irrevelant to his lecture topics...he "forces" his students by giving out pop quizzes and random attendence for points.
if ur gonna take this class, def take it with this teacher...open notes for quizzes, midterms, and for the final.
Open notes and open book group Midterms. Just need to do well on the individual final and you will get an "A". A very nice professor.

a very nice professor.. he tries very hard to make you understand what he's trying to teach..make sure you go to class though.. becuase some of the midterm questions is exactly the problem he does in class.. midterm was open notes and open book
VERY EASY CLASS! open book!!! he seems like a nice teacher and gave out a lot of extra credit. i ended up with an A+!
Very knowledgable and caring for his students. Lectures are kinda boring, but he has important words of wisdom to say in his classes. Funny at times. Highly recommended.

i cant emphasize how EASY his class was. his exams and quizzes are straightforward, no tricks.  he makes little math mistakes every now and then, but who doesnt? and unlike some professors that pretend they're right, he corrects himself the next day if he doesnt know how to do a problem

Amusing professor at times, should go to lecture, doesn't curve, no homework, 8 quizzes but it's all open book/open notes same for midterm/final. Tells you what chapters are covered on quiz/mid/final. Super easy class group project is a cinch, discussion is mandatory. Posts lecture slides online.

One of the most intelligent professors i have ever met. You dont have to worry about cramming and memorizing subjects in this class its all about common sense. He's like a grandpa telling you war stories except his is about what he did to get to where he is at. Smart guy chill class the best!!!
his class is EXTREMELY boring. there is seriously no point going to his class, just read the text book and you'll be fine.
this guy is the bomb, open notes and book, quizes are the same as the excersises done in class, he is the bomb, no homework either, it is all about the singhmister.

Okay, these guys rated his upper division bsad class poorly. But believe me, his BSAD 10 class is sooooooo chill. He is a really practical guy with nothing up his sleeves. Its all about this SINGH!!! Highly recommend his BSAD 10 class, trust me.

He is not only a great person, but also a great teacher (VERY INTELLITGENT). He highly respects his students and their learning abilities. His lecture are clear and helpful. Exams/pop quizzes are OPEN BOOK and OPEN BOOK. Just read and you'll have no problem finding the answers. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
The good: Very nice, flexible, good grades, frianldy The Bad: Lazy. Repeats anecdotes. Sometimes misses class.

Teaches OUTDATED (1970's) information.  Unacceptable at the graduate level.  Biggest waste of a course so far at UCR, my advice is take this core course when someone else is teaching it.  Raj needs to retire.
One of the most caring and intelligent teachers I have ever had. Take his classes and you will see why.
Best Professor I have ever had.
I hated this guy! He changed the syllabus, made up everything as he went along, accidentally failed an entire discussion section-MINE! The punk didn't curve.
Doens't know how to teach
Class is easy, most important thing is to have a fair and understandable TA.
worst professor i've ever had at ucr

4 pop quizzes, each of which are worth 10% of your final grade. No asking questions during quizzes. Doesn't really have a good teaching style. Relatively unreasonable. Avoid this professor. And if you have him, hope your TA is good.

Study guides are not closely aligned with exam content, and despite a midterm average around 50%, no curve was applied. The teaching style may feel less interactive. Some policies may also be strict, such as deducting points from the entire exam if it is not completed in time, rather than only grading unanswered questions as incorrect.

No care for us and was extremely blunt. Likely to be rude instead of mannerful/civil. He claimed that our midterm scores were the worst he'd seen, and claims to apply a curve based on how the class did. However, my raw score was a 67.9% and that didn't get rounded to a C. Even those who got a good grade disagree with his attitude and teaching style

This class was very confusing in terms of cohesive content. The way he sets up his lectures and hw don't help since almost every lecture required some sort of inaccessible website not to mention if you have a macbook you literally can not do certain things on excel for the labs. Pollev attendance every class, and doesn't respond to emails.

I wouldn't say he's the greatest Stats professor, but he's not the worst either. You definitely have to get outside help in order to understand the material and READ the book! Both the reading that's assigned and the textbook. He's an amazing Sociology professor, but Stats is just not his thing. Don't knock him down because of this one class.

Highly suggest going to office hours for additional help. 4 quizzes, 2 assignments, 2 midterms and a final

reviews.comment: this is the second class i have taken with professor Rotondi. he is a great! he is clear in what he expects from the class. he does move a bit fast with this subject, but he is willing to help if you go to him for help.

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors! I've had him for a few classes. Must print out the notes and take them to class to fill out blanks - no laptops, but he's really engaging and loves teaching. Paper was doable, tests were relatively easy. Just study the slides, really. Looking forward to taking him again.
Worst professor ever, do not take him for any of the courses that he teaches.
