reviews.comment: Get ready to memorize everything. Test are based on memorization skills. Last minute slides. If you have good memorization skills and do not want to learn much I would recommend this professor.

Rotondi is one of the best professors i've had at UCR. He is really passionate about what he teaches so that makes the class all the more interesting. You HAVE to do the readings because he WILL give pop quizzes, but they're not bad at all. All in all, I loved this class. It was my favorite of the quarter.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The class is very easy if you do the readings. Pop quizzes based on readings. The readings are not hard to get through just don't be lazy. Very passionate about the subject. Great lecturer. Review lecture slides before the tests.

Professor Rotondi is great. He does require a lot of reading and pop quizzes but honestly, all you need is to do his readings and go to class to pass. He doesn't make it boring, he tries to crack jokes here and there, and he's super sweet. I just regret not trying harder. But overall a good experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took him last quarter and I can honestly say that you can't go wrong with taking him. Make sure to get the books and READ. He does pop quizzes (10pts) on the readings and they make a difference in the end. There's 3 exams, a paper, and the final (cumulative) and it's all doable as long as you show up, read before class, and ask for help. Simple.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: A lot of reading, one paper, one midterm and one final. He is one of the best professors at UCR, if you want to learn he is the one.

Love him as a professor. He's one of the best professors I've had at UCR. He's super organized with the schedule and cares about his students. He really wants us to learn and pass. The class does take actual effort so it's not for the lazy. He's also pretty funny and his lectures are not boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: His lectures will definitely have you laughing, he's such a great professor. Focused a lot on the theorists so know how to differentiate them all. Definitely attend lectures & READ ALL OF THE READINGS. There are pop quizzes, stay ready and aim to pass them all! He is a great professor, you have to do the work. 3 Exams, 1 Paper, & Final (this qtr).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor, received a B. Pop quines are tough, failed a few after doing the reading. Read ahead of time and study your reading notes before every class! Most quizzes are T/F, and if it is false you have to write in the correct answer. Attend class, that is how you know material. Text books compliment class but do not cover everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Rotondi uses class time efficiently and sticks to schedule. All readings are posted online. Gives pop quizzes on the readings (usually true/false, make corrections to the false). Cares about students doing well. One 8-12 page term paper. Made time for me to review my midterm & answer all questions. Fun to talk to if you visit his office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: he makes lectures confusing by posting the slides but having pieces missing so you have to attend lecture to get the missing information. missing one lecture can really mess you up. other than that it's a lot of reading and understanding research methods, pretty straightforward
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Professor Rotondi is one of my favorite sociology teachers at UCR. I had him two quarters winter soc169 and spring soc159. He does a great job explaining and TEACHING his lectures which is huge. I never read and managed to pass every pop quiz but his midterms are kind of hard so definitely study hard for those!

Professor Rotondi's a really friendly guy who's good at what he does. Your assignments include 3 worksheets which provide a basis for your research proposal (due week 8). Midterm + final exams. POP QUIZZES. Do the reading. Also, no laptops! Print out the notes beforehand. This wasn't an easy A but it's doable.I'd gladly take another class with him.

good professor overall. Lectures are interesting for the most part. You have 1 midterm during week 6 , a paper due week 8 and final. Weekly pop quizzes so you must be in class for them. His tests are easy as long as you review your notes. (he posts notes before every lecture, you still need to attend lecture to fill in the blanks)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class was hard in general since it was about research and methods. The tests were hard bc there was so much material to cover. There are daily readings and weekly pop quizzes. Two midterms (if i remember correctly), one final, and a research proposal paper. Professor knows his stuff tho, and he's a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Rontondi is a great professor.  His lectures are easy to follow, even when the material is dense.  He makes himself available.  He is organized and sticks by his syllabus.  His exams are based directly off the powerpoints, so study those and the exams are not too bad.  Pop quizzes are based off readings, but only worth 10%. He is very fair.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lecture slides have blanks, so go to lecture. Pop quizzes based on readings (there's a reading for every lecture). (Supposed to have a quiz weekly, but we only got 4 throughout the entire quarter.) Two midterms (15% each), 1 final (25%). Also 1 paper (25%) but should be a piece of cake. Also section participation - just show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I don't normally write good reviews but this professor is pretty awesome. Awesome in a sense that he keeps the class interesting and he won't throw you under the bus with impossible material. He gives you everything u need to know, just read and do your assignments and you'll be okay. Plus he is also very open to helping his students..
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: No textbook but there are articles he posts on iLearn that you are required to read before each lecture because he gives out pop quizzes. Attendance is required because the exams are based off of his lecture power points. Even though he posts them online you have to go to class to fill in the blanks. Pop quizzes, 2 midterms, 1 paper, 1 final.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Really good lectures. He's an amazing lecturer for sure, but he does give out pop quizzes (usually on Wednesdays) based on the reading, but if you read the lecture slides, which he posts the day before lecture, you'll pretty much get a 10 on the quiz. Paper prompt is pretty straightforward, and midterms are alright.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: His pop quizzes are super detailed and difficult. He grades really tough without giving us a rubric and gives the prompt out after you read the book so you're forced go back and waste time finding specific examples. This class is easily one of the most difficult ones I've taken at UCR.

He is a great professor, you can tell he actually wants to be there. He does show movies in class but they are actually helpful and related to what we are learning in class. The books he has us read are really good reads and easy to read but some of the weekly readings are super boring but you have to read them to pass the pop quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: If you read and attend class regularly you will pass with a B or higher. Guaranteed. There will be lots of reading but some or all of the articles are provided online. Love this guy!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The pop quizzes were super detailed.  We read two books as well as a LOT of journals/studies and posted chapters from other texts. You need to read a lot in this class.  The midterm was tough and based on a combination of all the readings and lectures, but the final was much easier and based primarily on lecture notes. Exams are multi choice.

Very helpful and nice. If you go to office hours and ask for help he will help you. Weekly pop quizzes that are easy if you read but must pay attention to detail at times. Lecture notes will be very helpful for studying and the essay assigned. Must attend class to fill in missing lecture note information. Overall, a good class. It's not difficult.
She is organized and efficient with her lecture time. She is exactly what you want out of a professor. Provides plenty of examples online if the lectures were confusing, and is available offline.
Great teacher who helps with complicated stuff. Homework and exams weren't easy, but she explained everything well.

Amazing teacher. Very clear teaching and repetitive to ensure everyone understands. She's enthusiastic and gives students many chances to get good grades. she gave 10 extra points for our midterm meaning you can score over 100%. show up to class, do the homework and make use of TA's. It's not a hard class as long as you pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Really nice, understanding, and caring. This is the second time I've had her, but I can tell she cares about her work and wants you to pass. Game theory was pretty easy, and close to the homework.

Attendance is not mandatory, but there are two midterms and a final. Each lecture is uploaded to iLearn along with previous midterms and extra practice homework problems in addition to MyLab. If you do the practice homework, study previous midterms because they resemble the exams, and attend discussion you will get an easy A! Final is cumulative

Super easy class, do the homework for the grade doesn't really help overall. Class with her just to watch and listen, and go to discussions its very basic concepts to learn or memorize and tests are exactly the same as sample midterms and finals
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Have had her for Econ003 and now taking Econ163 with her. She is absolutely awesome and is great at explaining things so everyone can understand. If given the option, I will take her for a 4th time.
The lecture only talks about concepts and if you could handle well the HW and practice exam, it's a easy A.

Easiest professor ever. I never thought an upper div course can be the easiest class among my schedule. Listen, learn and ace, that's it. Basically if you can get an A on both Econ3 and Math 9A you are most likely to get an A in this class. She gives about 10 extra credits for every test and her midterms are extremely easy. Take her, save grade.

Gives a lot of extra help, practice midterms, practice problems, online homework. If you do the online homework diligently and study it, you'll be fine.  Lectures are kind of cloudy and no one really goes but she does a lot of examples so I'd suggest you go.

I didn't go to a single class. I looked through the textbook the day before the test and got an A. From what I've seen when I take the tests and the way she talks and interacts with the students, she is very nice!!
She's cool. Class was pretty easy... just memorize the stuff you learn in class and you'll be fine.
Although she can be unclear in her lecture, she will be clearer in her office hours.  Also, her tests and grading were fair.  I would recommend her.
Understand a bit of calculus and this class will be a lot easier on you. She was fair in grading considering the circumstances.

Great professor, she is really unappreciated by her students. Everyone just sits and complains about her class but it is micro with calc, dont expect a walk in the park. She makes things as clear as a good professor can. I recommend her all day long, she helped me establish my thirst for economics.

Had the worst TA in the history of my education here at Riverside (horrible handwriting and clarity), on top of that the professor yelled at students in her office hours instead of helping with material. Avoid if possible.

People think she's difficult, but she literally tells you exactly what to study for each exam, which she clearly goes over in lecture. Go through each type of question in all three conditions you learn and GO TO LECTURE. Two midterms, one final, dropped lowest midterm score and lowest few homework assignments. Discussion is only 5% of your grade.
keep all your math skills up to date. do the examples twice and all the homework assigned. micro  is hard.

Urme is a great professor, and she tries to get her students to understand the theory, not just how to do a problem. Both midterms were pretty hard, class average was not that good, Hw are hard to understand...Overall not an easy class but manageable

This is her first time teaching, and honestly, she needs a lot more practice. I tried my best to do good in her class, in homework and in tests, but both discussion and lectures are not too much of avail. Hopefully she will curve and the people who struggled really hard, even despite her being incomprehensible, will pass. Avoid if possible!
She Is a really good professor, Explains everything in a Clear manner, and is really helpful. Homework and Tests are hard, but if you read and go to your discussion it should be no problem.

In class he goes kinda fast and writes only on paper with his barely legible handwriting. Does demos in class and records and post lectures. Most of your grade is based on the final (55%) and midterm (25%) which are both mcq. They are not that difficult and you will be well prepared if you do the HW legit. Curves class. My grade went from C+ to A-.

I hate physics but this guy made the experience so much worse. He spoke SO FAST, rushes everything, he writes on sheets of paper with a single black pen, super unorganized, and his writing is ILLEGIBLE. Exams are ok and homework is fair, but he is so unhelpful in office hours. Made me cry once because he refused to help and just yelled at me.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he is a good professor but goes fast during lectures. he wants you to understand and do well which is good. his exams are on the harder end but he does have a good curve. final is hard keep that in mind. utilize his study guide/practice problems and go to lecture!

lectures were very fast paced & hed gloss over some complicated topics but go into extreme detail into topics that dont need it. didnt go to office hours much b/c its always full & his office was small. can tell he rly cares abt us & our futures. got below the avg on the midterm but well enough on the final so just put in some work & youll be fine

This professor has great lectures and efficiently moves through the material. This professor also has great office hours. If you can take advantage of his office hours, you are 100% going to do well in this class. The workload is not a lot whatsoever, meaning you only have three 5 problem assignments each week.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Only two exams, midterm and final, so a lot of your grades rides on them. Homework three days a week eventually got annoying, especially when the assignments got longer and more complex during the last few chapters. His lectures are really helpful and he lays out exactly what you need to know.

Amazing professor, you can tell how passionate professor Mohideen is about physics just based off of his lectures. His lectures are very heavy but you can get a good understanding just from his notes,recordings, and demos. His curve is also very generous. I got 2/8 on the first midterm and 11/18 on the final and managed to pull a B in the class.

This professor simplified the material greatly and made it very understanding. He's good on lecturing and doesn't waste anytime with information he will not ask about. His tests were incredibly easy. If you attend lecture and do the homework, combined with his lenient grading criteria, you will get an A. You would have to try to fail to get a D.

1 midterm (8 questions) 1 final (18 questions). MCQ only. Avg was 50% for MT1 and supposedly 60% for the final. Curve is generous: 25/40 on MT1 and 50/90 on final means a guaranteed A. Polls, Handwritten notes, and recaps each lecture which is good. His practice exams weren't very helpful. Relies on vectors ALOT so make sure you know them.

Had a REALLY generous curve. Notes explains concepts really well. He also does a good review lecture before exams (1 midterm and 1 final) but forces you to memorize formulas. Tbh I only attended the review lectures, and did half of the poll quizzes and homework, and it's still enough to end with an A so def still take this prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved how he lectured. Hand wrote notes and examples during lecture to copy. Showed demos that kept you engaged in class. Class had a fat curve, I 30/40 on midterm, 41/100 on final an A in the class. No formula sheet but if you attend class and do HW you will learn the formulas quite easily. He goes over last lecture every class which helped a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not the best lecturer and the tests were extremely hard and poorly structured for online learning. However, there was a FAT curve. Make sure you get at least one question right on the exams and youll pass the class. You can totally bomb the midterms, just do decent on the final and youll be ok!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Nice professor. It was the usual with any physics class. Really fair professor and fat curve.

Do not.... do not take him if you can avoid it at all costs. His final was 60% and the midterm was 20% and he gave no formulas for the exams. Extremely hard to understand and hand writing is awful. I dont have any positive things to say about this class. Worst physics teacher ever.

Super cool and chill professor. Very fair and curve so fat youd have to try and fail the class. The only gripe is that he makes you memorize the formulas but the test questions are easy enough to the point where just knowing them will get you the right answer or at least most of the credit. MT 1 was a little challenging, but the final was very easy

Prof. Mohideen is one of the most caring professors you can have in UCR which is a nice change because our physics department doesn't have the best rep. Althought he does expect us to memorize formulas for our exams, it isnt as overwhelming as other people make it out to be! PARTIAL CREDIT HELPS A LOT DURING EXAMS! He's more than willing to help.

He's a very passionate professor and wants you to succeed. Yes, you don't get a formula (but if you ask, you do have a chance to get one: it depends on class vote). His exams are pretty straightforward, as long as you know the formula. Some of his questions do pull from the homework, so if you do take him, really try on the homework!
I still have no idea what happened in that class. He grades really easily, but his tests don't make any sense. He doesn't even answer questions right on the review. Good luck if you're in this class.

You better be prepared for the final cuz he don't provide no formula sheet fam. You gottta memorize like a bunch of formulas for like 30+ equations. If u ain't down for memorizing stuff take another class
The man cares and he wants you to succeed. Put in the work, do what you're suppose to do and you'll be fine. He is enthusiastic about the subject and he will answer your questions.

Great prof. Very straight forward and clear as to what he expects. Midterm was very fair. Study the HW and formulae and you're set for it. The final was much harder, with heavy emphasis on magnetism/electrical currents (~65% of exam). Very helpful in office hours.
Helpful prof with a great attitude. Hard subject though, so you will need to put in a lot of effort on your own.

Good teacher. Class seemed a little intimidating at first because tests are solely free response. Just study the hw and examples done in class..    only thing that bugged,is he would wait TOO long for students to answer his questions.

In my opinion, Dr. Mohideen is probably the best physics professor. I have sat in other professors' lectures before and he's the best so far. Physics is a tough subject but he tries to make it easier for his students to understand. Definitely take him if you can.

The most difficult class I've ever taken.  More difficult than quantum mechanics.  Has a good attitude.  Doesn't just lecture--he makes the class interactive by asking students questions, encouraging them to think for themselves.  At times, however, he got confused by his own notes, wasting much class time trying to decipher them.

Great professors.. talks to students before class.. really makes you understand material in class.. homework is the typical webassign.. great during office hours.. and during discussions TA gives answers to homework
If you understand and review all your physics hw. You will get an A+ for sure. Final will emphasize on several circuit problems. Know your stuff.
No Comments

knows his stuff.  before class,  he walks up and down physics2000 asking individual students how they are doing in the course.  his tests are incredibly hard, but his grading is incredibly lenient.  he will give you partial credit if you draw a diagram!
great professor.  Hard exams but easy grader.  Write anything on exam for partial credit.

Grading is lenient by science majors' standard. Partial credit is awarded for chicken scratch and some physics. If you know most of it, you get almost all the points. But the questions are somewhat difficult.

knows his ish, asks how everyone is doin all the darn time. derivations are tooooooooooooo long though. he also does the discussions, so there is NO help on homework whatsoever.......there is a TA somewhere, but not to be found

Definitely would never take a class with him again even if I needed it. Hard to understand, if you don't respond to his questions with the exact answer he is looking for he dismisses your attempt, harsh grader, attitude was unpleasant, and no amount of review of lectures, and outside help will be able to prepare you for the questions on the exams.

I ignored the reviews and went in with an open mind, thinking my work ethic would get me through, but it didn't matter. The professor is rude, dismissive, and unprofessional. He knows the material but doesn't care about students. No support, no respect, harsh grading with no empathy. The content isn't hard, but your grade won't show your effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The class itself is fairly easy—just a lot of reading. The issue stems from the professor. He doesn't seem to care about the students, and he carries a bad attitude most of the time. During the final exam, he stopped everyone to complain about a recent rating he received on this site. Very unprofessional and rude.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While the professor has good tests, it's very hard to study in the class with no review guides and over 700 collective slides. The daunting amount of partially work is relieved with the best score in out of 2 midterms. He wouldn't answer turn-in questions for the final and showed bad mood about a low rate-my-professor rating that he showed in final

The lectures were clear and with a small class asking questions was easy. It was graded on a curve. The content flowed nicely, making studying enjoyable. Only your best midterm grade counts, and attendance is 25% of the grade. Gave us the test dates & homework due dates on the first day of class. Only needed the textbook for ONE homework problem.

Best professor I've ever had. He makes sure you're able to explain concepts to the simplest degree. The exams are extremely easy as long as you pay attention to what he says in lecture. I'd say the power point isn't so helpful, but the way he explains topics makes it so that I don't even need the power point to study.

Assignments are pretty inconvenient. The homework needed to be printed out, and the tests were all taken using the blue books. To be honest, it would have made everything much easier if he just used Canvas like every other professor. It would definitely help with keeping track of assignments and grades.

I was hesitant to take this course. But, after spending a full quarter with Troiano, I can confidently say he was an attentive professor who wanted, above all, for his students to succeed and his classes to be valuable. Throughout econ119, he was diligent and worked hard to help all his students. He was accommodating and accessible on each occasion

This is probably the worst professor i have taken. Professor never shows up on time to lecture, his teachings are so confusing and not make any sense. I actually learned most of the material by reading the book, then his lectures make some sense. We had 0 grades going into the final. The whole class was frustrating and stressful. AVOID...

By far the worst experience I have ever had at this school. Was consistently late to class, showed up an hour late to the midterm. He made the final at 5am despite the school having an assigned time. Was really unprofessional and held class from his phone outside. Stubborn, never gives direct answers, horrible lectures. NEVER TAKE HIS CLASS. NEVER
Best Professor at UCR hands down.

Professor Ugo was terrible. He has a quick temper and seemed irritated with us all the time. He didn't even set the midterm date until Week 7. He posted the midterm grades AFTER the add/drop period had passed and didn't upload any grades until after the final. He made us take the final at 6:00am because of HIS poor planning.
He is the worst econ professor at UCR, like he doesn't care about his students and he thinks that he's always correct. ALSO, he changed the final time to 6 AM like seriously. DO NOT take his class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The worst economics professor at UCR. His midterms are super confusing and when asking for feedback on his test will criticize you for asking questions. His response to everything is come to lecture and will constantly blame the students for everything. According to him he is a great lecture and he does nothing wrong. Do NOT sign up for his class.

Ugo is the worst professor I have ever had. He is so unclear in all areas. He assigns homework with topics he never taught. He didn't want to give us a midterm review, study guide, or even the date for the exam. Even when he gave us a review, only two questions were "applicable to Fall 2020 exam" according to him. Ugo goes on tangents.

Dint take his class. Terrible at explaining and doesnt take feedback at all. Doesnt draw out any graphs or handwrites any problems. Goes off on many tangents in class so it is hard to keep up. The midterm was nothing like the hw or the sample. Refused to provide any information in the midterm including material, format, platform for the test, etc
Easy class easy A. Took this course at CSUF, but it was a good experience. Highly recommend.

A great and interactive lecturer for both beginners and those who have grown up with the Spanish language. Very active and entertaining in the way he teaches which keeps your attention throughout the class. Homework is very little and simple to finish. He makes sure that the students are actually understanding the subject whether in Span or Engl.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Oscar is a really chill professor and the class was pretty enjoyable because of his laidback stye of teaching. The class was not too hard to get through. Oscar is great at helping students with anything and working outside of class when needed. And he's not too bad to look at. Just saying.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Oscar was 100% the best Spanish teacher I had, especially when factoring in the B+ given to me by Jorge Sanchez Cruz in Spanish 3. But all joking aside, Oscar is a great teacher who actually cares about his students and will do everything to made sure you make it through the UCR Spanish program. If you have a chance you should take his class.

Spanish at UCR is hard enough, but Oscar makes the class much more enjoyable. He shows that he genuinely cares about his students and wants to give everyone the best opportunity to do well in the class. Amazing person. Amazing instructor.
Oscar is one of the best Spanish TA's that there is!

I had him for both Spanish 1 and 3 and he did a great job teaching it. I would highly recommend this instructor for Spanish. He teaches way early in the morning but it's worth it since he is probably one of the nicest people you'll meet as an instructor.

This class was very easy and was graded by attendance, term paper, and a final exam. Prof Underhill also does sessions where students get to ask questions regarding jobs and careers which I found to be very helpful.
Great professor! Best in the school, extremly underrated. Gives assignments that help in the real world and doesn't waste your time. NEARLY IMPOSSIBLE TO NOT GET AN A.

I enjoyed this Business class and learned a lot about privacy and different laws. Underhill is a passionate professor! He helped a lot this summer and gave great advice beyond the class. Truly a great guy and recommend him for future classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Underhill presented topics that interest students. The student chooses five labs to complete. Also, the labs are super fun! The group project was intense. However, Professor Underhill was willing to provide clarification on the expectations. Start on the written report as soon as possible, but do not stress over the midterm and the final.

Professor Underhill is truly a gem. He assigned two massive collaborative projects that mimic the real biz world. He exposed his students to various software and systems that are used in post-graduate. Overall a very accommodating professor who genuinely wants his students to succeed in life. His background cements his credibility for this course.

BUS171 is definitely on the harder side of IS, but through Underhill's effective teaching structures, he makes it an easy class. I was able to land so many internships through the skill sets and applications offered to me in this class.

Actually cares about your understanding and wants to help navigate you through your careers after undergrad by offering lectures based on questions from his personal experiences in the start-up community. Professor Underhill is my inspiration.
LOVE Professor Underhill, I wish he taught classes in all concentrations in the School of Business. Cracks these hilarious jokes in class, going to miss him once I graduate :(

By far the best professor here at UCR. Class is very well structured and effective when it comes to applying the material to midterm, group projects and final. I would take his classes every quarter if I could.

Professor Underhill was an amazing instructor! He was very straightforward with assignments, accessible for help, and fostered a comfortable learning environment for students to learn in. He also offered additional help for students to improve their resumes and tips to succeed in the workforce. I would definitely take this professor again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: So apparently this is the first time that Professor Underhill assigned this project and it was not a good experience. It would have been fine if we were given better instructions to follow but everything was so vague. The professor himself was very nice and caring but was not organized at all. There were many days that class got cancelled.

reviews.comment: I took this class based on ratings, and apparently this is the only year he has assigned a BIG group project in bus 101, and man does it suck being a guinea pig. Terrible at providing guidelines, examples, and what he expects from you or your group and he misses class too. Extremely frustrating quarter in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof Underhill is an amazing teacher. His lectures were informative and require full attention. There is a midterm, a final, but the big group project outweighs it all. Stay on top of the labs (homework), they are easy points. The class material may come off scary, but you come to enjoy it as you learn about new technology within business.

I loved this class! My friend told me about it last quarter and she was right - it is the best one on campus. Professor is cool and showed us lots of cool gadgets and how they work. I've never held electronic components like chips and resistors before and it helped me understand. VR and the 3D printing were my favorites. Wish he taught more.

He is honestly a very good teacher, if you can take EE003 you should! He does his best to make the class easily digestible for non engineering students there are also a lot of hands on activities. There's a decent amount of homework but not too much, just a few quizzes and short articles but you do learn a lot.
Although the lectures can be very boring and hard to follow at times you are only graded by three papers. FYI you do not have to buy/rent all the books that are on the syllabus.

Prof. Ulin covers interesting subjects, but it's hard to follow him with no lecture outline as he lectures for a long time and over zoom. The prompts for the essay are very confusing, so ask for help. Your grade is determined by your TA, have a bad one like me- good luck. I would say do not take this class unless you are a local and have A+ writing
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I had Prof Ulin at USC and he was phenomenal. He's very knowledgeable and clearly passionate about his course. You can definitely get away with not reading everything in this class but I highly recommend it! Only 3 papers and the TA's aren't very tough graders as long as you communicate your ideas with them.

He's a good professor and was kind enough to help me by writing a recommendation for a scholarship. He's a gruff, pretty honest person and he knows what he's doing when it comes to writing. Gives good feedback on your work and is pretty accessible outside class. He was the LA Times Book critic!

Prof. Ulin is my favorite professor at USC. He is so caring and was understanding of of needs, and he gave us a lot of resources and patience during COVID. He gave really incredible feedback on my essays (I'd never had a prof so invested in reading my work). It helped me grow as a writer. He's also ridiculously smart and good at what he does.

This class is supposed to be reading-intensive, but the amount of reading isn't thattt bad. He is a nice professor and very open to all kinds of ideas and answers. He isn't a tough grader and only weighs the one (out of three) paper that you did the best the most.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: He made Chem 1A soooo easy! In lecture, he hand writes all his notes, and gives plenty of time to copy them. He thoroughly goes over his notes and  gives plenty of examples! His lectures perfectly encapsulate the content in the exams, which made it very easy to pass with an A ! Just go to lecture and pay attention and youll pass!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He made chem easy to understand, he would always make sure the class understood the material before moving on. Homework was online and you had an infinite amount of tries. Exams were pretty much homework and quizzes. He would write hand write his notes in class which made gave students time to write them as well... and he was a cutie.

Took this class during summer, not for credit. Lectures are not mandatory, but he does not provide online notes, so basically if you're not hanging around, you need to attend. Lectures only give out basic knowledges, homework is essential for getting good grades on tests. His hand writing is sometimes hard to read, pay extra attention on listening.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof. Ung is very good at teaching, but he does not curve. Regardless of what the avg. is he doesn't curve much. Usually practice tests resemble actual midterm, but still study because he tricked us and it was completely different. His practice examples are way easier than the actual test questions.

He is the best professor I have had at this school to this day. He is an amazing lecturer and there's no way you can fail if you just sit in his lectures and digest some information. He is super straightforward and the exams were exactly like the practice exams. He never tries to trick you, and he's very friendly. He takes the time out for question
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The person below me is lying. Yes, he is a great teacher but the class was so ezpz. But let's not ignore the fact that he is smexy and buff af. This is the only reason why I get out of bed every morning at 9:30aM to attend his 12 PM lecture. He was gifted with such genetics( great V-taper) and smartness. 10/10 would take him again.

reviews.comment: Hou was a great professor. i recommend anyone to take a chemistry class with him. He really breaks down the synthesis and reactions in a easy way to understand. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Umanskaya is very clear and always helpful. Her lectures are as interesting as they can be for a 101 level class.

I absolutely loved Umanskaya. She is the most organized and methodical professor I've ever had. She is incredibly helpful and a wonderful teacher, I highly recommend her. Her class made me want to major in economics.

Professor Umanskaya is incredibly organized. Her lectures are understandable and interesting most of the time. She is very Russian, but has a sense of humor and a cool accent. Her assignments are hard, and she's a hard grader, but you will learn a lot. She is flawlessly knowledgeable about her subject, and I highly recommend her!

Love this professor. She sticks to the textbook (slides and hw all correlate with the textbook) so it's fairly easy to self teach. Her exams are fairly basic and as long as you do the homework you should be fine (more than fine). I recommend all freshmen to take her class because it definitely helps the transition from high school to university :)

Great professor! Lectures are mandatory and listening to her explanations are a must! She explains everything very thoroughly and her powerpoint slides are extremely helpful. Most of the quizzes are based off of the slides. Going to office hours will definitely help. I definitely enjoyed taking this class.

Easy class, Hw is worth 30% of the class, and is super easy using the lecture notes. Her tests were straightforward. She is a very clear lecturer and very much cares that you understand her. She has a Russian accent but is perfectly understandable and clear in my opinion. I recommend her

Umanskaya was a pretty good lecturer. she has an accent she explains the information very well. Her tests are fair, but it's not all memorizing, you will need to understand the concepts to apply it. The homework is worth 30% of your grade and sometimes harder than the midterms but they help you understand the concepts so do them!

The class overall is easy. You don't have to go to lecture if you read her slides & the book. I went to all the lectures & even though she has an accent she's very clear & good at explaining the material. The midterms were kinda hard. U actually have to understand the material & not just memorize, have 2 b able 2 apply it to examples.

Had her fall 2012 & she's new to teaching econ 2. Her midterms were easy and the final had repeated questions from midterms. Liked that she let us keep the midterms. But my friend took it Winter 12 and she didn't get to keep the midterms and said they were harder than my old ones. 1st part of midterm you should know from high school. GOOD LUCK.
Do the homework and study her lecture slides and read the book! Midterms and Final are based on how you APPLY on the things she talks about, not memorizing vocabulary or anything.

This is an easy class as long as you read the textbook and do the homework. The midterms are not that difficult you just have to know how to apply what you learn in class. Classes can be boring and she does have an accent but its not that bad and you can still understand what she is saying

Classes are extremely boring. She spends all her classtime going over her powerpoints which are all posted online. Not an easy A, but not impossible if you read powerpoints and study homework assignments.

Class isn't very interesting. She mainly just reads off slides. Takes some time to get used to her accent; most of the time I find myself just trying to comprehend the words she's saying instead of actually focusing on understanding the material. You can pass if put the effort into studying.

She has an accent and her class is very boring. but her powerpoints are all based on the textbooks so if you read book and study her pwrpoint, it should be fine. homework is online and pretty easy, as it follows book. Midterms and final are not that bad if you studied. but she curves if the  average is not above a 75.

Her accent is killing me! I can't understand her at all! If you really like ECON, this is your class but for some of you guys are trying to meet the requirement, dont really suggest taking this class. Her midterms are hard as F.... So try to find a better professor for ECON002....

this class was not a walk in the park. the midterm was similar to the  quizzes but the final was tough mainly because it was cumulative. Quizzes gave me the most headache because they were just so hard to prepare for. i studied everything last minute and received a B+. To do well in the class, you must understand all the trade models thoroughly

She is not that bad, but at the same time goodluck in this class. It's not the way she lectures, it is the way her quizzes and exams are structured that make you feel like you studied the wrong thing. Beware, she grades very hard, so I would recommend not to take her. You can do okay if you get into it, but if you didn't like macro, then dont risk.

Great professor.  Very tough on grades.  I was a little under 1/2 point from an A and she gave me an A-.  Can you believe that???  Not lenient at all!!  And there is no point arguing with her.  But overall she is a very dedicated, great professor.
Gives incentive for students to study where whichever student has the highest cumulative score receives an automatic A+ and does not have to take the final. O_O!

This class was so easy...seems like a lot of people in the class had a hard time but she basically gives you a whole sheet with problems that will be on midterms and finals...homework could be tricky but it was graded on effort so it wasn't a problem at all...she has a pretty heavy accent, but it's easily understandable...easy class IMO
Extremely difficult professor, hard to work with.  Very strict on grading.  Take someone else if you can!!!

The course is extremely interesting and she presents the information in a logical way. As others have mentioned, her midterms are similar to HW problems. In ECON 178, the final is based on your understanding of the trade models covered in the course rather than on calculations so be sure to understand the models. Doing the HW will be very useful.
It's hard class. International trade is actually a econ class. I'm those people bad at economics so goodluck. Take the class if you want to stress out.

She is a great professor. The test is really just like hw and study guide she gave. So if u understand ur hw and study guide (Which you can ask her during her office hour) you will do fine on the test. How hard the class is depends on how well you understand the materials, you earn the grade you get. She doesnt grade anything, the grader does..

Horrible teacher for Econ 187. She was useless during lectures and her voice was monotone so you never know when she is gonna say something important. The test are ridiculous and are nothing like the homework. She also really grades the homework hard. But if you know someone who took her she let us keep our midterms and homework answers.
she is really easy if you go to class and understand the homework - -....i don't know why people say she is hard...if you do your work, there is nothing hard
you could really learn something from her, she's explains the concepts clearly, just attend her class regularly and you can do well

Prof. Umanskaya is a very good teacher. The information she provided in the class was very straight-forward and clear and as long as you attend the lectures regularly and do the HW and practice problems, you are sure to do well. TA does grade exams, but I did not find the Winter 08 TA Ozan to be overly critical.
Her class is not hard.  You could get a good grade as long as you have the notes and read the book.  Unfortunately, the TA Ozen is not helpful at all.

She's not too bad of a teacher, I suppose if you go to lecture you'll get a decent grade. However T/As grade your exam so be wary of your T/A, if you get Ozan just get outta there.   Exams are pretty tricky, NO MULTIPLE CHOICE. You're seriously better off with Bandy or Das. They are both easier, and Das' exams are completely mult. choice.
She's nice & kind easy
keep it real!

Her English accent is way better than other ESL professors. She is not that difficult. What you need to do is: do all the homework assignments and make sure you understand them thoroughly. Midterms/Final are pretty much from homework assignments. As long as you do what you need to do, there is no way you are going to fail this class. Recommend her!

She's a good professor... tends to get a little boring, so I stopped attending lecture, because she doesnt take attendance or give any quizzes. The 2 midterms and final were a little bit of a challenge, but I ended up with a B+ in the class. You can find that most of her tests are based off of lecture slides.

If you want a teacher who is totally anal about grades then take her. She would not correct a grade for a missed discussion even though it was made up. That one point was the difference between a C+ and a B-. She would not budge. Completely unfair. Avoid her.

light russian accent. Has 5 HW assignments, 2 midterms, 1 cumulative final. study guides are given before each exam. With the help of TA's, this makes it a very easy exam because the questions are almost identical. If you somewhat read the relevant chapter, do your HW, know the study guides by heart, you'll get an A+.

My favorite professor I have taken so far, I find him hilarious. He keeps the class engaged through his humor and shares personal stories that connect to the topic. Very engaged with his students and interacts with them throughout the class. Class is pretty straightforward, tests reflect notes, treated this like a gen ed which is why I got a B.

I took him Fall of 2025. He was a funny professor and his lectures were entertaining so it kept me engaged. Exams are easy as long as you study his slides and read the textbook. I'd recommend Sy's course to anyone who wants a chill breadth class.

Great professor! Lectures were super fun and he genuinely loves the topic which makes the class enjoyable. To get an A in this class make sure to study a lot before the tests, there are 3 tests and a study guide which is vague but if you review the slides, understand the terms and differences between them and read the textbook you'll be good.

reviews.comment: easy class but make sure to prepare for tests. since he doesnt have a ton of assignments, it's harder to do well in the class if you don't do well on tests. for the tests, make sure to skim the textbook sections since he puts info from the textbook (that we never covered in class) on the test

I went to two lectures. One at the start of the quarter and one right before the final. He gives us study guides of what is on the test, but there are some questions about stuff he only covered in lecture or discussion.
THE GOAT !!!!! HE CURVES SO GOOD THANK U KING🙏🏻
Lots of terms to memorize
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is genuinely one of my favorite professors of all time. He goes in detail about every topic he teaches, and gives sufficient examples during lectures that help you understand it better. He also incorporates lots of humor and engages with his students. The exams and papers were easy. He also brings his doggo to class, super cute!!
His class was simple to understand, and the tests were pretty easy! Review the slides well; that should get you the A you need.

The tests will often have questions he didn't cover in class from the (free) textbook . Tests are easy tho, so its fine. His lectures are majority crowd work which is good for some but I found annoying. His tangents can be insensitive, sometimes racist. Part of grade is participating in his research w/ his app "mind tap" which is a breeze.

GREAT professor!! He gets off topic a lot but he always ties it back to psychology. The lectures aren't mandatory but if you attend lectures he will give you examples that are word or word on the exams, they also have videos that aren't available on slides.The class is overall really easy as long as you actually study

Funny dude overall. He is really clear with what is needed to be done. Quizzes are easy just need to study the textbook and read the lecture notes (read the practice questions in the textbook). I learned quite a lot since he's really engaged with the class in lectures.

SUCH AN AMAZING PROFESSOR. He was the main reason for switching my major to psych. Made everything easy to understand and remember. He had three straightforward exams; there were no trick questions at all. All his lectures were so fun. just study the slides and read the textbook; you should be fine.

Professor Sy, I believe is one of the best professors any student could have on campus. He's very interactive and sociolable, making it easy for students to approach him. His charisma paired with his knowledge of psychology and modern humor pairs well with each and every student who walks through his lecture doors. 

P.S. cinnamon (his dog) is cute

Prof Sy makes lectures fun, lighthearted, and easy to understand. Lecture attendance is not mandatory, but you must attend and participate in discussions. Textbook is provided for free. You don't need to read it, but I recommended it. Your grade relies most on your exam performance, but he gave a +10% curve. Study and you'll do fine in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Sy brings a lot of energy and personality to his lectures. While you don't necessarily need to attend, it's worth going as he provides great examples. Using unstuck ai alongside the textbook can be really helpful for acing the exams.

Goated prof. Had him my freshman year for PYSC002 and now I have him my senior year for PYSC142. Lectures/exams were always online, attendance to lectures is optional but discussion is mandatory. Exams are multiple-choice and very easy. Personal development project is as easy as you want it to be. 

Easy A if u do bare minimum, entertaining prof
He's an amazing teacher!

You cannot help but like Dr. Sy. He taught the first college lecture I ever attended and it was a riot. You'll probably never fall asleep during his lectures cause he gives a lot of memorable examples. Sy's slides are also very thorough, so if you don't want to go to lecture you don't have to but I'd say go anyway cause he is great.
Good psych professor

Dude made the class super chill. It was amazing. I was a cs major so this was a breadth course for me and my god it felt like a breath of relief. He also genuinely cares about his students if you go to ask questions to him. He's also good at cracking jokes. Aced all three of my exams and easily got an A+. Most stress free class ever.

His lectures are entertaining & informative. He always told personal stories that always related to the lecture, making it easier to understand the concepts and easy to remember. I barely read the textbook. Not everything is listed on the slides, so it's important to take note of what he actually says during lecture. I never got homework. Love him

Prof Sy is really good at making entertaining lectures but the course topic isn't for everyone. Topic was kind of boring but the focus on leadership development makes it a worthwhile choice regardless of your intent to enter I/O Psychology careers.

Lectures are not required but highly recommended, he is very good at explaining things but his slides are hard to understand without any explanation. He doesn't record his lectures or post his slides. He brings his dog everywhere which is cute, but tended to be a bit distracting. Very funny, likes using group participation(call and response).

reviews.comment: He's a good professor but his lecture and slides are not very helpful. You don't need to go to class, just read the textbook and you'll do fine. Beware, his tests are tb heavy, and his participation in discussions is graded too harshly even after they were canceled because of the strike.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall good professor, I would have done better if I did all the surveys assigned. The tests are pretty simple if you go to lecture, WHICH I HIGHLY SUGGEST BEC THE LECTURE SLIDES ARE TO GENERAL. The only thing that was not a fun of was the mindtap he made us do which he gave little to no instruction on

Grade really depends on the three tests (final included). He teaches based on the free text book provided. Attendance is not mandatory just study the textbook. He has a great personality and his lectures are super fun to watch but he covers content slowly and not in-depth so even with going to lectures you need to review the textbook.

Super nice guy!! Lectures are always engaging as Professor Sy is able to make enough jokes to keep the audience's attention, but still gets through all the necessary information to prepare you for exams. Textbook isn't really necessary, just go to the discussions and lectures. Pay attention during his slides and you will hardly need to study.

This is tough because he's a very personable professor and good for someone who's intimidated by uni. However, since switching back to irl lectures, he's been completely unfocused. He spends the whole lecture doing crowdwork and giving poor psych examples so he can make jokes and talk with students. He curved the 1st exam +8% for tons of low scores

The pinnacle of breadth classes, easily the most fun I've ever had taking a class. Lectures are lively, Sy is a cool dude. Work load is minimal, and I forget if we even had homework. Pay attention in lecture and do notes on the reading and you'll get an easy A. As a ME major this class is perfect to throw into your schedule.
take this professor if u go to ucr

I could've done much better in this class. Professor Sy is a great professor, but I didn't know was that participation actually matters. The exams weren't easy so you should prepare for them. As long as you don't slack off, keep up with the assignments & surveys, and do well on the exams, it's really not that hard to get a good grade in this class.
Professor Sy is an amazing professor, it just matters I guess on what TA you have because participation during discussion does get graded pretty hard

This professor was overall great. The grade is based on 3 quizzes, a final paper, final project and participation. The quizzes are multiple choice and timed. READ THE TEXTBOOK and WATCH THE LECTURE RECORDINGS also take good notes. The test are open notes and based on the textbook and the lecture content Sy talks about.
