reviews.comment: Didn't study once and I passed. All you really need is to pay attention in lectures. Super enthusiastic and can teach you a lot about the psychology field. W professor

Technically there is a textbook but its free online and I didnt look at it a single time LOL Professor Sy is hilarious which makes lecture interesting and easy to remember. You are graded on three exams and one project (EASY). Highly recommend!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Best professor out here!

My favorite prof this semester. Most of our lectures were prerecorded because it was online but this would be a really fun class in person. there are 3 tests that are really easy. definitely recommend this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Honestly such an amazing professor. It really sucks that his lectures were online because of Covid. I would've enjoyed going to his lectures. Tests were open note and open textbook.

AMAZING!! Absolute best. I would definitely take a class with him again, he is super funny and sweet! You can tell that he really loves students students. You can message him anytime and he will always respond positively, even if its a stupid question. Not a hard class, discussions are mandatory attendance, lectures are all recorded. Loved him!!

Super funny and a great teacher overall! Took this class during the pandemic so the lectures were prerecorded. Had three tests and one paper at the end. Attendance isnt mandatory for lectures, but mandatory for discussions. Take notes on your own because the lecture doesnt include everything from the textbook.

His lectures are all pre recorded but they were fun to listen to. The class is really big so it is better to reach out to a TA if you have questions. Discussions are mandatory and are counted for attendance. He gives study guides for all exams and there are 3 total along with 1 short paper.

Professor Sy is a very funny and interesting man so it is somewhat difficult to not pay attention in his lectures. That being said, his lectures were quit long with a number of tangents. There are only 3 exams and 1 or 2 short papers, along with required research participation. The tests aren't too bad and he gives you study guides.
love dr sy. hes a great professor and a seeet man

Sy has a sense of humor and a passion for what he teaches (and teaching itself) that is infectious and results in a positive learning experience. He's always open to learning from the students as well. In addition to fair exams and lectures that are very well organized and engaging, there is EC. You definitely won't regret taking any of his classes
Loved his lectures and would definitely take again!

Dr. Sy is one of the best professors I've ever had. His enthusiasm makes the class all the more fun to take, but was always respectful when we were learning about sensitive topics. The midterms are very straightforward- study the slides and read the chapters and you'll be completely fine. Also, the final wasn't cumulative.

He posts the slides to lecture but I went since he kept class super interesting and a lot of things from lectures ended up on the exams. I'd also really recommend doing the reading since it gives way more examples and definitions than lectures. There are only 3 exams and they're all multiple choice. Super easy as long as you stay on top of things
Super cool guy. Very engaging lectures, but can feel a bit long. The coursework is pretty do-able, just read up for tests and use his study guides. Would love to have this prof. again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Best professor Ive taken at UCR. He is hilarious and truly cares about his students. There were 2 midterms and a final. Exams were very easy but make sure you go to lecture. He tests you on what he says in class. I came to love I/O psych because of him and hope to get my masters in it. A truly wonderful professor. If you take him you won't regret.

Professor Sy is so enthusiastic when he lectures that it makes the lecture go by fast. Do the study guides and read the chapters (he puts info from lectures and the textbook on exams - more so lecture) and the exams are very straight-forward.
This professor is really interesting.

Lecture was 3 hour long but he honestly made it seem shorter than that. His lectures were really easy to follow along and very straightforward. Exams aren't hard and he gives you a studyguide for it. Lecture isn't mandatory but exams are lecture heavy so it's good to attend. Overall, he's a passionate and hilarious professor. I would take him again

Professor Sy is one of those professors who's really easy to follow along during lectures. The class uses a free online textbook and readings are not mandatory but extremely helpful. What makes this class easy is that studying for exams is mostly memory based since the exams are extremely straightforward. His exams are VERY lecture heavy.

He is honestly a great professor that cares about his students. His lectures are really engaging and hilarious. You honestly want to show up to class. His tests aren't that hard either, he gives a study guide.

Overall easy class, you have 2 midterms, 1 final and four hours of research participation. Midterms and final are based on the lectures. Lecture notes are posted online but I suggest you go to lecture because Prof. Sy makes them very fun and interesting. Book needed for pop quizzes in the discussion portion, but Prof. Sy gives you the FREE pdf.
Overall great prof. Knows what he's doing which made me feel confident in all my exams
Best professor ever
He is great! reread the lecture slides and take notes on the textbook! his test are straightforward if you do the studying! my favorite teacher by far, i would take him again

Doesn't stress the readings but they always show up on tests. Memorize the study guide he gives you. Pop quizzes and participation points in discussion. Material is pretty simple. Go to lecture because he's more fun than the book and a few of his comments also end up on tests. Free online textbook

He recorded class so it wasn't mandatory, but I went every week. Tests are based off lectures and ask for specific examples used in lecture. The class was 3 hours long, but he kept it entertaining because he is funny. Pop quizzes in section are easy... tests are much harder. Learned a lot. If you enjoy the material and study you will pass easy.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: An easy class. He's a funny guy and gives really funny lectures. However, you really do not need to go to class. (I personally did because I like his lectures). He posts his slides online so that with the book will get you an easy A.

His lectures are long but he makes it funny, interesting, and interactive. He posts lecture slides online and you can pass without attending lecture, but the exams have a few questions that he covers in class and not on the slides. Reading isnt required but recommended. Overall it's fun and interesting class to take. Extra credit may be offered.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Professor Sy makes the class fun and interactive with his jokes. He's very straightforward with the material he provides students. He provides a generous curve when necessary. Overall, a fun and enjoyable class with a humble, hilarious and respectable professor. Highly recommend!
Funny guy. Makes the lectures more interesting and motivates you to actually go to class.

His lectures are long and he doesn't like breaks. But he is the most interesting professor at UCR. He is so funny and makes the material fun to learn! Course is easy as long as you pay attention because he likes to give questions on the exam that shows you were listening to him in lecture. Reading helps but not required. Participation matters!!!

Funny and charismatic. It does feel like he repeats the same info over and over every quarter. There's no up to date publications, stats or articles, so u have to believe what he says. He doesn't give you a break time, so it's tough to seat there for almost 3hrs straight. There's tons of extra credit and he curves. I would take his class again.

Hilarious professor with interesting stories that makes a 3 hour lecture go by fast. Some stories are overexaggerated but relates to the topic of psychology. His I/O class focuses mostly on HR and the workplace. Exams are a bit tricky with many confusing questions. His extra credit is a lot of work for what it's worth. Quizzes in discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is very definition based but his tests were hella tricky. He offers extra credit but it is a big task that makes you not want to do it. Overall he's a good professor. Very humble, and gives interesting lectures especially since this class was 3 hours long!

Prof. Sy is a great speaker and keeps lecture entertaining and easy to follow. There are 5 pop quizzes so attendance to discussion is mandatory but lecture is not. He provides study guides for the 3 non-cumulative exams. Easy A. I recommend reading the book if you choose not to attend lecture. Also gives extra credit.  Pretty hot! Go Buckeyes! :)

Really loved this class. Professor Sy is awesome. I took him for both PSYCH 2 and PSYCH 142 and he was possibly the best professor I've had at UCR. He really makes our 3 hour class fly by and his lectures cover the basics of the chapters, reading the chapter helps for the exams. His exams are pretty straightforward and non-cumulative.

Dr. Sy's I/O Psychology class was one of the first I took, and It's still one of my favorites. I made a few mistakes and didn't study as hard as I should have, and the exam questions are tricky, got a B. Discussions always have quizzes, so they're mandatory. You're doing yourself a disservice if you skip lecture; Sy is an incredible speaker.

My favorite professor at UCR. He's super fun and he makes the class fun. He made me want to come to lecture. He changed the textbook to a free version, but I didn't read any of it. Just his slides are enough if you know basic Psych already.  Easy A and entertainment all in one great guy.
Really liked the class. Tests are multiple choice and are basically based of the PowerPoint. Easy class and very interesting. If u rEally want an A read the book.
Funny teacher, can tell he cares a lot about the students, nothing in the class is too difficult.

Funniest professor ever! The class isn't too hard, and going to lecture is entertaining yet not vital. Posts powerpoint online making it easier to study for tests. Barely read the textbook and still did well in the class. I recommend this class to anyone looking to get GE's out of the way. He only teaches Fall Quarter though so plan accordingly.

I'm one of the few - but i found his lectures obnoxious and to be a waste of time. He posts the power points online - so just study off those and his guide and you will do well. The tests are not easy, but the class is an A if you put the effort in. Not a whole lot up for debate. Personally did not find his lectures amusing at all so stopped going.

Thomas Sy is an excellent, charismatic professor, but don't expect an easy "A". His exams have a lot of tricky questions, so you need to make sure you study well and have a firm grasp of all the terms and concepts. Attendance isn't mandatory for lecture, but he covers a lot of material so you really should go. Attendance for discussion is mandatory

I got Professor Sy for my Psych 002 class. Let me just say he is an amazing guy overall, but in regards to the class he is very clear in lectures and post the lecture slides on ilearn prior to class. His test weren't extremely difficult, as long as you studies his lecture slides as he pulled the majority of the questions from there.

sy's psych 2 class is almost ridiculously easy. Most of his exam questions are definitions or word for word thing from his slides. I went to like 3 lectures all quarter but as long as you take notes on his slides (which he posts) and also take notes from the book just to fill in the blanks you will get an A easily. And THERES NO FINAL!
AWESOME PSYCH PROFESSOR!!! He is really funny! Definitely take his class! :) He makes his lectures fun :D Exams are a fair-game
I was able to skip some lectures and was able to get either an A or B on the exams.

Love, love, love his I/O psych class!!! He was funny and informative, plus you can use everything he teaches in this class in real life. I got super close to a perfect 100% too. If you just come to class, read the book, and memorize the key terms from the notes, then you'll do fine. Definitely would take this professor again.

Class was extremely easy. I went to lecture twice the entire quarter and got an A. Trust me, all you have to do for the exams are read the slides and memorize definitions/key terms from the book to get an easy A.

Professor Sy is amazing. He is the one professor that I genuinely find hilarious and worth going to lecture for. He makes lectures really interesting with his humor and awesome personality. The exams aren't the easiest but they're doable.
You didn't even have to go to class because he post slides online. However, going to lecture is definitely fun because he's so hyper and funny
Professor Sy's lectures are amazing! He makes everything so interesting.

Sy is hands-down one of the best professors I've had.  He does not require you to attend lecture, but even then I still went, that is how interesting his lectures are. He is never boring! Always has a joke to keep you smiling. Participate for  discussion section because I didn't and that's how I ended up with a B. Exams are easy, just read slides.

It's a shame this class was 3hrs long because I got tired quickly and lost interest. However he is a pretty great professor. This is the 2nd time I've had him and if he taught other classes I'd take him again. 3 exams (including final)

I wish Prof. Sy taught more psychology courses. He really made one of my first psych courses enjoyable as a transfer student. He is quick to reply to e-mails and always willing to assist anyone who ask for it. Just going to lectures alone and taking notes I got a "C" , studying and reading the text was an easy "A" on the final. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

Professor Sy is one of the most hilarious professors. He tells really funny stories that relate to what we discussed in class.  His lectures are pretty much what's covered in the textbook, just like an abridged version.  There are pop quizzes in section, but those are pretty easy. Really easy class.

Professor Sy is hilarious and his lectures are entertaining, but I feel that I am not learning as much as I should be. Majority of the time he is telling jokes and relating funny anecdotes, and sometimes towards the end of class, we have to speed through the slides because we ran out of time. I don't do very well on the quizzes that the TA gives.
Seriously, this guy, THE best.
SY is one of the greatest teachers, he is extremely funny and helpful. All of his power point slides come straight from the book. His class is really easy so I highly recommend him.

Really cool professor. His lectures are not mandatory as long as you actually read the book and look at his slides. I aced two exams and I barely went to his lectures. If you do go to his lectures, they are pretty entertaining though. Do the study guides and read.
Dr.Sy is absolutely wonderful! I loved taking his class and look forward to  taking psych 142 with him. GREAT!!!!
Great!

He's so cool! I think he has the best personality ever. He teaches in a really interesting way so you never get bored. The tests aren't easy but they're not hard either. Just study off of his powerpoints posted online (this is basically what the tests will be on) and you'll be good. :)

AWESOME PROFESSOR! attendance to lecture is a must because his slides arent helpful unless you listen to his explanations of them! It's worth going to lecture though because he jokes around ALL the time and he makes examples that are funny that help you remember the material! Great professor, the material itself is really boring though.

This class is taught by an excellent professor who makes you feel very comfortable during his lectures and office hours.  There are three exams that are not difficult if you read a textbooks and professor's slides. I would highly recommend to take this course to everyone who wants to learn and have a joy at the same time.

You can only miss a class or discussion section if your arm has been severed from your body that day or if you are dead. So if you're a working student like me that occassionally needs to switch a discussion or attend late, THIS IS NOT THE PROFESSOR TO TAKE. Which is funny for an I/o psych guy not to understand needing to work for a living.
If you read and study consistently, you'll be fine. Had 3 midterms, no final. Easy if you read. Classes aren't exactly helpful to the tests, but they do help you have a better understanding.
Professor Sy is awesome! Great guy, and really funny. This class was very easy, and I recommend it to anyone who needs it for a breadth, or even your major. Great experience!
Great professor. Definitely take this class if you need to. 3 exams, no final. He's also super approachable. Easy A. For sure.

This class is a joke. Everyone says they love Dr. Sy so much because his lectures are more like comedy routines. You learn hardly anything useful. The tests are trivial. The book is essentially useless. Take this class if you need an effortless A.

EASY class, don't listen to the fool below me, this crap is EASY. It helps that Thomas Sy is a great professor. You don't need to go to lecture, he posts all the slides online and the exams are based directly off of the slides - but you'll WANT to go to lecture because he is so funloving and amusing! DONT BUY THE BOOK.

He is a funny professor. I didn't learn much from his class. Although his class was easy, be careful because the TA will mess up your grade. Don't take the class extremely easy as others have rated it because everything is unpredictable. If you need this class then take it, or else don't waste your time.
Sy, is an amazing teacher. He is funny, smart, interesting .. Basically everyhting you look for in a teacher. I strongly recommend taking his class.
Professor Sy is by far one of the best professors i have had at UCR. he is quite a character, i was never bored during lecture. He always made it interesting
HE IS THE BEST PSYCH PROF. YOU WILL EVER HAVE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! :D

EXCELLENT professor! Love him. Hilarious, definitely keeps you awake in lecture. Easy class. We were supposed to have a term paper, but asked the class if we wanted one or not and decided not to give one. Chill guy :) take him
GREAT PROFESSOR. Main tips - go to lectures, take notes on readings, very straight forward studying. How much time you put into studying will reflect your grade.

The class is psyc...its easy! Prof. Sy is hilarious and makes the material simple and fun to remember for the midterms. There is no final only 3 midterms and you have to go to 4 hours of research studies which they will sometimes pay you for. Attendance not mandatory but its always a very pleasant class!!

He is an awesome professor. His lectures are really funny and interesting. As interesting of a class psychology is, he makes it even more interesting and he gets the class(over 500) people to get involved. exam are easy too, just 50 multiple choice questions. Study what's on his study guide and you should pass high.

Best Professor ever!! He makes everyone laugh every lecture and is very clear with the subject.So far his the best Professor ive had @UCR. I highly recommend SY. All you have to do to pass his class is do the readings and go to lectures thats it!

Dr. Sy is HILARIOUS. Honestly, if you need a Psych class, TAKE THIS ONE! And you can't just take Psych2, it HAS to be with Sy. It just won't be the same. Oh, and if you get Amanda as your TA, she's also hilarious and really chill! =] trust me, you'll <3 this class. I did, I was actually kinda sad when it was over =/

Dr. Sy is extremely funny! I couldn't help but crack up in every lecture. He made me want to attend every lecture, and I did not hesitate to miss any of them! He not only incorporates funny stories and hilarious jokes during lectures, but I feel like I learned alot from him as well. He makes psychology more interesting than it already is.

this class is honestly a breath of fresh air, he is a really funny guy with a sense of humor, he will crack a joke every lecture.  even his TAs are soo nice and unique im not a psych major but the happiness and environment of the TAs teacher, etc is so amazing to me
Love him, his class, the material, take him for the A and much more hell have a lasting effect on you
I think we need more professors like him. His class was interesting for me even though I wasn't a psych major. I had no interest taking this class but he made it fun for everyone.

Adorable and so funny! He is very understanding and willing to give great opportunities to his students. Seriously guys if you ever need someone to talk to about career options about the military, IO psych,business, or psychology this is the guy to talk to! He's inspiring and his TAs are as well .

Great class, Prof. Sy is very informative, well-rounded, and gives well-versed presentations. You have to  work hard to get an A, but if you are consistent its achievable. Good class, I would highly recommend him !
PROFESSOR SY IS HILARIOUS! The class is easy. Come to lecture though, he explains everything really well. He's very approachable  and always open to helping students. I highly recommend him.

Great professor in class; unprofessional during office hours and outside of lecture. Makes blatant "mistakes" on your grade if he feels you should get a certain grade and is hesitant to review his errors(happened to a dozen others). Easy course; study the TERMS and outline the chapters and slideshows and you're set. Review grade carefully!!

Sy does not really teach. He just projects slides made from the textbook and reads them. Then he tells stories from his life. He had an interesting life, and he is funny, but I took this class to learn psychology, not about some guy. Not worth it. Ruined psych for me.

This prof is awesome! Funny and provides great examples in every lecture! 3 exams, clicker quizzes, disc attendance, and research participation and that's it. Study guides are given when exams are coming up but the terms are broad. I ended up with a B+ for some odd reason but believe I wouldve gotten an A- if I had put in more effort! Easy class!

Definitely the best professor I've ever had. He is very funny and will definitely keep you entertained and interested. His tests are right from lecture material. He puts the PP online and gives you a study guide to go off of that will guarantee at least an A-. If you need to take Psych i highly recommend you take it with this guy. Oh yeah no final.

Awesome professor! Definitely makes class entertaining.  Talks about his involvement in the army a lot.  Makes things easy to understand.  Tests are just 3 easy multiple choice exams (no final).  Lectures are not mandatory but there are occasional pop quizzes (clicker questions). Definitely the best professor I have had so far!
funny teacher had him for both psych 2 and now taking for 142 pretty straight forward. makes the class go by fast and don't have to study to hard to get an A. Definetly should take this class.

3 hr class but usually uses 2hrs. funny & u learn a lot from following along w/ the slides & listening to him lec. read the book, some question come from the book. go to class, 4 or 5 "pop" quiz. one term paper. fairly basic but you retain everything you learn bc of the jokes and examples he gives.
seriously, one of the best professors ever. you can tell he loves what hes doing and always makes class FUN. i highly recommend him, even if you're not interested in psychology!

Awesome teacher. He is really clear in everything he says & uses real life examples to clarify psychology. Not only is he funny but he's a great teacher. It is an easy class if you read the book, go to class, and do the study guides. His study guides are just terms you need to know and that is essentially what the test is. Def. recommend him.
Awesome professor!  He is the best I've had so far in my years here at UCR!
I took this class in fall 08. He's pretty funny, and he tries to make the lectures interesting. His exams are fair, and the material is not that hard.

Dr. Sy is a wonderful teacher.  This class is extremely easy if you go to discussion and lecture and pay attention.  Offers a good deal of extra credit.  Just do the readings and pay attention in lecture and the class is an A.

I love Professor Sy. MY favorite teacher by far. His lectures are FUN and intresting. I highly recommend him, he's an awesome teacher and very helpful. He's not boring like other Professors, he makes lectures intresting and exciting. He is super passionate about what he teaches and it shows.

I LOve Love prof. Sy i highly recommend to take his class his not offensive if you REALLY pay attention to his lectures you will understand him... i could honestly say best prof. i have ever taken at UCR... TAKE this class with him you wont regret it attendance is not mandatory. but TRUST him teaching you would want to go to class every day hottie!

Great professor to take if you want to get an A and never learn anything. On his best days his lectures are unprofessional and on his worst days just offensive. He is masogynistic and full of himself. Enjoy his first lecture where he brags about himself and insults you. Or better yet, don't go because he won't drop you anyway and you'll get an A.
Best class I've taken yet! He makes lecture interesting and the classroom was always really full! Really good intro to psych class for breadth requirements. Easy A if you pay attention in class.

AMAZING PROFESSOR. TAKE THIS GUY. He is seriously one of my favorite professors, his lectures were both informative and very entertaining by his jokes and examples. Class wasn't bad at all, the class average on the midterms were B+.

Sy is very concerned with making his students laugh, it seems more than them getting good grades. Pop quizzes in class but gives us a few seconds to ask those around us what the answers are, so easy A. Midterms pretty straight forward, gives study guides, dont have to go to class to get an A.

Sy seems to only be concerned with making his students laugh. It was hard for me to take the class seriously for a long time because it just seemed like a stand up comic trying to get a laugh out of its audience, but once you listen it is actually relevant to the material and overall made the class easier. If you study you will get an A easily.
Professor Sy is amazing, really funny, very clear and very charismatic.

Great guy overall. Very caring and considerate and spends a lot of time with students who need guidance and mentoring (grad school, life, etc.). Awesome sense of humor and also very, very serious and dedicated to his actions.

Very good professor who actually teaches and entertains at the same time.  Tests weren't too bad, but got kind of tricky after the class did well on the first one.  Has "pop" quizzes that only make up 10% and genuinely cares about students doing well.
No Comments
This prof. was very funny, made class interesting. Good prof. but hard test and had to go to class because of pop quizes which I HATED.

Great, funny professor who genuinely cares. Expect a heavy writing workload, like all the other UWP classes, it's tough if writing isn't your strong suit. Your experience will also depend a lot on the TA.

The workload felt heavy at first with peer workshopping. But I found them to actually be really helpful for developing my writing skills. Prof Vazquez is great. Her classes are worth it if you truly want to learn and be academically stimulated, but if you want easy grades, do not expect them here.
Dr. Vasquez is an amazing professor! Just pay attention in lecture and don't procrastinate on essays, and the class is a breeze.
All UWP classes are something you should not willingly take.
It's not hard to pass the class, especially with the amount of feedback you get on your essays (given as part of an assignment)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class is was the worst experience out of all the classes ive taken at UCR.

3 essays 1 final essay and attendance makes up your whole grade. As long as you do good on the first 3 essays, your final doesn't really matter. The workshopping in the discussions are super important to help draft your essays. Best professor I've had.

Generally good professor, is lenient when it comes to turning in assignments and usually gives extensions if asked ahead of time. Class time tends to be fun and sometimes you're let out early. Workshopping is done in which good criticism can be given to your paper ahead of time if you are the one workshopping that day.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Vasquez was a chill and awesome professor. She makes her students feel very comfortable in her classroom and does a great job of being helpful and kind. Not only is she knowledgeable about her entire course and her material, but she is always available for help and gives great feedback that I learned a lot from.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Jackie is super. Her teaching has inspired me a lot. Kind grading, and lots of written comments after each project. You will be fine as long as you put effort into your work.

Does not grade objectively. Holds writing skills from past assignments and grades them differently for newer ones. Most of the writing comes from peer review which is over 7000 words (more than the essays combined) which doesn't even help. She's a nice teacher but I wouldn't recommend taking her another quarter if you didn't do well the last one
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Jackie is one of the best instructors I've ever had in my life. She not only made me a better writer but also gave me confidence in writing and English as a whole. Her lectures are always so entertaining, her workshopping for essays is so helpful, and as a professor she is super understanding of her students. I am taking her ENGL001B as well.
the best professor at ucr! cares so much about her students and is an amazing person! if you have the chance to have her TAKE HER!

She's the best! I'm generally the type to show up to class, say nothing, & leave but I felt so comfortable approaching her & participating. I actually looked forward to coming in person to her classes. Make no mistake, it's not an auto A, but if you put in the work you'll be fine. She gives great feedback and has a peer workshopping system I love.

Probably the best English teacher I have ever had. Her class is not easy, but she is super caring and wants you to succeed in her class. She is fair and will actually help you, unlike any other English teacher I have had. I could not recommend her class more

Professor Vasquez's class is one of the few classes where I was actually excited to go. For me, every other class was just a class and I didn't mind going but I absolutely loved going to Prof V's! She makes class exciting and there have been countless amounts of times where I have laughed out loud. She provides so much helpful feedback on essays.

I was fortunate enough to randomly select one of Professor Vasquez's class for ENGL001A and got to experience how amazing she was!! I went out of my way to ensure that I got a seat in her ENGL001B class and I'm definitely going to fight for a spot in her ENGL001C. Professor Vasquez is one of those teachers who truly cares and lays out expectations.

LITERALLY THE BEST TEACHER EVER WOW! I cannot speak enough about how amazing Prof V is! She is an amazing teacher who really lays out her expectations and is there for her students inside and outside of the classroom. She helped me find my passion for writing and creates a fun classroom environment (even over Zoom!)

As a freshman going into college and taking English at the college level for the first time I was a bit nervous. Prof V made the transition and course not only a joy but a fantastic learning experience. She is a professor who really cares for her students and acknowledges that we are people too! I have learned so much and did it in a fun way!
One of my favorite professors I have taken a class with. She cares a lot for her students. She is really passionate about writing and helped me to improve my writing a lot.

Professor Vasquez is by far the best instructor I have ever had. Her class definitely requires you to put in a lot of effort and energy, but it is so rewarding! She is flexible, understanding, always available to help, and so passionate about teaching. I was lucky enough to get her for all of 1ABC and I could not be more happy and grateful!!

She is by far one of the best professors I have ever taken. She truly cares about her students success. She gives great feedback and allows you to correct your essays. You do need to work for your grade but she makes sure you understand the material. You will grow as a writer and gain skills that will help you for future classes. Amazing Professor

Professor Vasquez is GREAT! Her way of teaching is so engaging and you can tell that she is passionate about the material. She shows how much she cares about her students and is so determined to make each individual student a better writer. I've had a drastic improvement in my writing since entering her class. You won't regret taking her class.

Professor Vasquez is a great professor. She is super nice and wants to have a good relationship with her students. She doesn't always hold the class for the full 50 minutes and she is really understanding. I highly recommend her but beware her classes fill up fast so if you see an open spot take it! She really helped me improve my essay writing!
Gave great feedback and was very kind!

I took English 1A with her and I would definitely take it again. She has helped me improve my writing. She's such an amazing professor who helps her students improve and become stronger writers. I will most definitely take 1C with her

Jaclyn Vasquez is an incredible professor! I had her for both ENGL001A & ENGL001B. I fought to be in her 1B class, that's how much I loved her. Not only did she teach me to write better papers, but she taught me to become a better writer overall. Her personality is beautiful, she connects with her students, and provides amazing feedback for writing
Professor Vasquez is an excellent teacher. I typically struggle in English classes, but she has helped me through thick and thin, shaping me into a better writer.
Vasquez is super nice, chill, and really understands her students.

She comes into the classroom with a wonderful persona, and she believes that everyone's writing can be improved. She reminds me of hanging out with one of my friends, but she's really the teacher. She does a great job to make sure that you read, and she helps with comprehension. She grades essay(s) fair!

Prof Vasquez was a fair grader and she for sure helped me on my essays. I always enjoyed going to her class. The workload was fair but you have to put in effort. I think after her class, I learned a lot to make my essay's better so I definitely recommend taking her English classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I was very surprised to find that this quarter I actually did enjoy my English class (English isn't my strength). She gave very good feedback on every paper I turned in, and I found myself to have improved in my writing skill throughout the quarter. Shes one of the few professors that I would like to take a class with again.

Jaclyn Vasquez is the most amazing and caring professor I have ever had in my life. In high school I was not very good with essays, and I thought I would receive a B no matter what. She helped so much during office hours and I got A's on my essays! My writing style improved as well. Highly recommend!
Amazing teacher, super nice and makes class very enjoyable. Trying to get her for my 1B and 1C as well.

Best English professor I've had. She grades my essays with thoughtful consideration & always gives me feedback that helps me earn a passing grade on them. She really takes the time to make her students comfortable in her class by relating to them. Don't skip class because she gives quizzes sometimes on the reading. Definitely would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Probably the best English professor at UCR. Genuinely cares about students and their progress in her classes. Fantastic feedback on essays and written work. Lectures are always interesting and engaging, whether they be on paranormal activities or course books.

Professor Vasquez is the best English professor at UCR. She goes above and beyond during every class to make sure everyone is clear on what she is teaching. English 1C is known to be a lot of reading and writing but she definitely creates the class to be as doable as possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Jaclyn is without a doubt the best English professor at UCR. Her lectures are very student-oriented as she loves to hear from the students. Her feedback on essays is extremely helpful and will really help you improve as a writer. Shes super passionate about her job and her personality is awesome, making me look forward to her class! Must take.

Jaclyn Vasquez, is hands down one of the greatest professors in the world! I walked into English 1B with weak writing skills and poor grammar, but that all changed when she corrected my first writing assignment. I received a C-, and had zero hopes of walking out with an A. After a few trips to her office hours and training I improved and got an A!!

This professor  is my favorite, she is extremely helpful. She honestly cares about her students,always leaves useful feedback on assignments. She is very direct with what she expects in every assignment. She is approachable, easy to talk to. Overall I highly recommend this professor if you can take her class, plus I heard all other 1B classes suck.

Professor Vasquez commands the classroom, but at the same time creates a positive environment. Lectures are never boring, and I looked forward going to them. The feedback we get on essays is constructive, and you know exactly what you need to do for every essay. She never makes you feel stupid, and makes you want to excel in the class.

This was the most entertaining & best class I have taken so far at UCR.  The professor really cares about her students in a way that inspires students to want to show up and learn more. For someone who does not enjoy reading, this English class was not boring at all. Immersing in class participation is a factor. Best teacher award! 11/10 recommend.

My favorite teacher I've had so far at UCR. She's the best and most caring teacher I've ever met. I love the way she teaches and she explains things very well to us. Won't forget this class. Love u mama V

Dr. Sirbu is the best WRIT instructor! He made my WRIT020 class so genuinely fun, even though it was his last class of his day. Course is taught under the University as a Professional area, so 3 essays/assignments focusing on this. Easy grader! Great, caring prof. Would def take again if he taught other WRIT courses (WRIT 030).
vlad is a great teacher and you can genuinely tell that he cares about what hes teaching. hes one of the younger professors so hes not out of touch and also quite funny

Dr. Sirbu is an amazing professor!!!! He really cares about his students and wants them to actually learn. He is very clear in his expectations and always tries to help students succeed. I recommend him to other students who are willing to put in the effort and learn.
Lectures actually helped me, very good feedback, and very engaging.

Professor Sirbu is amazing! I was in his Summer 2025 class. He gave thoughtful feedback and I truly learned a lot from being in his class, even though it was only five weeks long. Professor Sirbu makes lectures interesting and humorous, and it's very easy to approach him if you have questions. I'd definitely take another class with him if I could.

I LOVE THIS MAN!! One of the two classes I was extremely excited to attend each day
He grades very fairly based off the amount of work you put in. He makes classes very interactive and fun to pay attention to

Professor Sirbu has definitely been one of my favorite and best professors by far. He is extremely empathetic, recognizes hard work, very respectful, and his teaching is extremely engaging. I never looked forward to writing the essays, but I was definitely excited to go to his class everytime.

What a great man. He is always on your side when it comes to outrageous university rules. He is always understanding, and kind in all his mannerisms. This was such a breezy class. He's an interactive professor, we discussed cinema, wrote papers and overall was an enjoyable class. I highly recommend. He's communicative and understanding, probably the best professor I've had..
Honestly the only professor I wanted to show up for consistently this quarter
Very good would take again
very helpful and fun!

Vlad by far is the best professor I have ever had at UCR. He is one of those professors you can tell have passion for what they do. Everyday, he comes in with a positive attitude and it's contagious. He wants you to learn, he wants you to succeed, he wants you to be the best you can be. His grading is simple, either get a good grade or don't.

Vlad is the best professor ever!! His lectures are fun as he makes so much humor and fun memes on the slides. He also gives a good feedback on your paper. When I am having some trouble in my paper he is easy to approach.

Professor Sirbu is one of the few academic instructors who I can honestly say is one of the best.

On the first day, he took a genuine interest in me as a student. I was never a name on a roll sheet. He was always courteous and willing to answer questions. As a result, I was always motivated to learn. I'm on my way to Grad-School, thanks to him.
Vlad cares about all his student! He is super engaging and understands the different abilities of all the students. I recommend taking him.

Vlad is so sweet and does his best to make sure that every student is working to their fullest potential. He's also really funny and uses fun memes in his lectures to keep things interesting. 10/10 would take his class again.

I had Vlad for GER1 and GER2. He gave a lot of extra credit. He understands that we have other things to take care of outside of class. He does not take points off if we turn things in late. Vlad Sirbu is without a doubt an amazing professor and human being. He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. While many professors lecture Vlad TEACHES. I love Vlad. He is an awesome person and professor. He deserves a raise for how good he is.

Nothing bad can be said about Vlad. Going to lectures is not difficult, he makes them funny and engaging. He only assigns homework to assist in learning. No busywork. Extremely accessible and understanding. Take one of his classes even if you dont get credit. Amazing teacher

Vlad was my TA for Greek mythology and was amazing. He managed to tie our conversations about classical stories to present day situations, as well as being open to the most humorous ideas we had. He was very understanding in regards to deadlines and it was a pleasure to participate in his classes.

I took the German Film class and would totally take this again! Professor Sirbu made the class fun, by allowing us to engage with the content the way that's most efficient for us. Guys... I never liked foreign languages. Period. I joined the class with a depression. I just wished he had taught Ger002 this Summer...

This class was a great introduction to German. You could tell from the first day that Vlad really cared about his students succeeding in German and helping them in any way he could. Perhaps one of the best qualities of this professor is his ability to engage the class in learning German. One of the most caring professors Ive had in my undergrad

Easy A if you just attend class, listen, and do the work. JDRV is very kind and supportive, and is a professor who genuinely cares about his students. He can be busy, but he is always helpful and understanding when you speak with him.

Bro makes me feel like a battered housewife. Everyday I get hit but I keep coming back.

You think you're ready for 118. You are not ready. I was not ready. My future children are not ready. Sundar speed-writes, skips explanations, and conjures assignments out of thin air. I aged 40 years in one quarter. Godspeed, soldier.

Disregard most reviews and do not diss the goat Professor Sundar. Just an overall bad teacher. Didnt learn anything but still had hard tests.

This class is not very intuitive material-wise, and the professor doesn't help much with learning it. I suggest taking it with another professor.
Once again, really bad professor, did not teach anything during the classes. At the start of class he would just start solving problems related to the topics and not explain anything.

Slightly difficult course but his lectures really helps. He explains the content well and will often crack jokes or make relatable/entertaining examples. wtf man.

Terrible Lecturer. Stopped going to lectures halfway through the quarter. Be prepared to teach yourself the content.

i took 6b its not listed but this class is so funny like all the tests and hw are on this one website that he uses so everyone just cheats like ur not learning anything from this class. his lectures are eh like they help to some degree but like ur just gonna chat gpt this class lol. he gives out worksheets in discussion that r mando for attendance

Wow just wow. Easily the worst teaching instructor I have had in my academic career. He mumbles during lectures while scribbling on the board in cursive. He only posted notes up to week 5. Class felt extremely disconnected - the homework was barely mentioned, TA's knew less about the class than students, quizzes were way easier than midterms/final, and the midterm/final were riddled with typos and included concepts you would only know if you listened to everything he said in class. reviews.comment: I hesitated in making this review bc he clearly had some injury & pain while teaching. But this class, esp towards the end, was horrific. Confusing lectures, no study guides, notes posted only to week 5, no curves, dipped the week before the final, & gave a difficult final with material he didn't teach. Most disorganized teacher I've ever had.

Many times the problems on the test were never seen before on lecture or homework. On the final, we were supposed to remember specific cases of certain problems we never heard, knew, or saw. No curve because there is 3-5 "extra credit" per exam. The EC may be those questions you just "remember" the answer to. Course, we never learned them.

terrible professor, ive had professors who barely spoke english that were way better than this guy. terrible lectures, no prep for exams, and everyone hated him. i really hope they remove this guy i am sure he has never even looked at the exams he gave out. so many questions asked during the exams and the TAs were just laughing at the questions.

Walked into class ready to learn, walked out questioning my existence. No notes, no guidance, just chaos on the board and exams from another dimension. Cheaters got A's, the rest of us got PTSD. This wasn't a class, it was academic Hunger Games.

This man lectures like he's being held there against his will by the math department. He mumbles formulas like they're classified and writes in cursive that even ancient scribes would give up on. Blink twice if you are okay, professor.

Half the class cheated, and he either didn't notice or didn't care. The median was inflated by frauds, and the rest of us got curved into failure. Studying felt like a punishment for doing things the right way.

This wasn't a class, it was a crime scene. Every lecture was academic malpractice. You leave more confused than when you entered, and that's if you could even hear him. It was the same since day 1, and I thought it was going to get better! But, boy was I wrong.
Smart guy, but teaching? Nope. Survived only thanks to Professor Leopard on Youtube, lecture is incoherent, tests unrelated, no guidance or feedback. If you like teaching yourself, this is your guy.
He stumbles in a minute before the final, apparently dreams up the questions on the spot, then calls it a day. We suffered so you don't have to.

The lectures are very hard to follow. Its hard to understand much of what he writes on the board. The exams are different from what he does in lectures and from the homework. Doesn't give practice tests.

My sanity passed the alternating series test. Initially positive, decreasing, and converging to zero.

The dread I felt in this class was unbounded above and bounded below.

This man acted he did not want to be here and it showed. He came 1 minute before the final started and didn't even know what was on it in any capacity. It's like the questions came to him in a dream and he just wrote them down and called it a day. He is truly just lazy and we suffered for it. Trust all these reviews and save yourself.

Posted only 5 weeks' worth of notes, doesn't respond to emails. He has no clue what is on his own syllabus. So many people cheated and no curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do yourself a favor: if you see his name on your schedule, drop the class. If I could give him a 0, I would. I'd pay money to erase the memory of this class. Every lecture felt like a live reenactment of confusion. He'd scribble hieroglyphics on the board, whisper equations like secrets, then hit us with exams that looked like NASA wrote them.

This man teaches like he's being held hostage mid-lecture. He writes in cursive like he's casting a spell, mumbles like he's in a horror movie, and vanishes when you need help the most. Tests felt like fever dreams. I closed my eyes and threw up a prayer, and I surprisingly past my final exam.
He's smart, but can't teach. The lectures are a mess, and he doesn't explain the “why” behind anything. I survived by watching other professors on YouTube.
He says one thing in class, the tests ask something totally different. No study guides, no feedback, and exams are brutal. You'll spend more time unlearning what he said.
If you like teaching yourself and guessing what's on the test, you'll love this. No guidance, no examples, just panic.

Took this with a group of friends and we all agreed, it felt like we were trapped in a maze. Every lecture felt disconnected. The lectures weren't even worth attending and the professor got sick on the last week of school. 
Fortunately, my TA was helpful enough.
Lectures were so rushed and sloppy it was physically hard to follow. Material that showed up on exams came from nowhere. Just pray you have a strong math background.
I've never had a class where the professor confused me more than helped me. It's like he's doing a puzzle with no pieces. Do not take this unless you have to.
The only way to pass is by ignoring the class and learning everything from YouTube. Exams don't line up with anything we're given. TA was just as lost as we were.
I got a tutor halfway through and that was the only reason I passed. He doesn't respond to emails, grades take forever, and office hours are useless.
It felt like a game of “guess what's on the test.” He says one thing, does another. No feedback, no posted solutions, and inaccurate grading. Absolute chaos.
The material could've been great, but the way he teaches it is completely incoherent. Homework feels random, and exams are last-minute announcements.
You have to teach yourself everything. Lecture is confusing, notes are promised but never posted, and tests are curveballs. Wood doesn't believe in study guides or in Curves.

He doesn't teach. Seriously. The lecture is mostly illegible writing. Tests are nothing like the homework or lecture. Prof doesn't communicate with TA's, and grading takes long. You're on your own from Week 1.

His lectures are too confusing, TA's know less than us because he doesn't tell them anything till last minute, grades super late, doesn't communicate well, and the tests don't reflect lectures or homework :/

There was no study guide for any of the exams that we took in class. There were questions that were on the midterm and final that were not covered in lecture or on the homework. reviews.comment: This wasn't a math class, it was survival. No structure, no guidance, no help. You're expected to magically understand material that was never taught. Exams come out of nowhere and are nothing like the homework. The bar is on the floor, and somehow he still manages to trip over it.

Completely disorganized and often forgets important information. He listed the topics of our Final just days before, and we were left totally in the dark about the format. Genuinely one of the worst learning experiences I've had here at UCR.

Every lecture was like decoding a puzzle. Between the mumbling and the handwritten cursive on the whiteboard, it was impossible to keep up. Exams were not fair reflections of the material. You will have to do a lot of self studying.
No posted notes. No exam prep. No guidance. Just vibes. This course felt more like an independent study than a real class. You will struggle alone if you take him.
I survived this course by using Khan Academy and YT. The class itself was a disaster. He didn't prepare us for tests, didn't post notes, and half the class disappeared by Week 5.

You are fully on your own. He doesn't explain anything clearly, skips steps when writing on the board (which is in cursive btw), and expects you to know things he never taught. Would not wish this class on anyone.
The entire quarter felt like I was being gaslit into believing this was normal. No study guides, no review days, no helpful examples. I only passed because I taught myself everything.

Nothing about this course made sense. He would jump around topics with no clear outline, and sometimes he'd completely skip over sections that ended up on the test. Felt like a waste of tuition money.

If you're thinking about taking this class, just don't. There were no resources, no feedback, and the midterm literally had problems we had never seen before. I spent more time on YouTube than actually learning in class.

Lectures were painful to sit through. He mumbled a lot and didn't seem to care if anyone was following along. Everything felt improvised. Honestly felt like we were forgotten about half the time. Would not recommend unless you enjoy chaos.

This class was genuinely the most frustrating experience I've had at UCR. No structure, no clarity, and no support. He doesn't reply to emails, doesn't give review material, and the lectures are so hard to follow that I had to learn everything on my own.
I would rather not take a course with him ever again.
Unorganized.
My High School teachers were far more organized

Super unorganized..

JUST RUN

Professor Wood is a great person and cares for his students, but his lectures were extremely difficult to follow. He would go to different slides and half solve problems. Prof. Wood is very clearly knowledgeable about the subject but his lectures are incredibly confusing and difficult to follow. reviews.comment: I had taken this class previously in high school so it was easy for me, but the way he taught was terrible. If I did not take calc in high school I would have definitely suffered in this class. He touched on TWO topics the last day of class with very non-specific examples and it was on the final. Nice man, but not good at teaching math.
The Class isn't hard itself, but he explains things in a very round about way. Has lots of examples on how to do problems but will spend most of lecture explaining an equation (how it was derived).

He's pretty good at explaining what he is doing. He reviews every problem, although on the board he does skip a few steps but he always clarifies what he did. Actually pretty helpful during his office hours and he is not a tough grader. He's a "tough grader" simply because it's math: either you get the answer or you don't.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Xu is a decent lecturer. He can be vague at times but he also clarifies and answers questions. His midterm was fair but the final was hard. The problems came  from the notes but they were the really hard ones that used material beyond what was taught in the course. So for his exams really practice the problems from the notes and homework.
worst teacher ever, harsh grader and unclear. ended up studying all on my own

He explains simple concepts in a way that's difficult to understand, and he talks too fast during lectures. His homework is NOTHING, NOTHING LIKE HIS TESTS, homeworks are easy but his tests are HARD and not to mention he's a hard grader too... just don't choose him unless you have to, like i did sadly.

Really hard grader and may or may not curve depending on the class average. On the tests he chunks off tons of points even if you get a single step wrong. He does explain the concept well though however his tests are nothing like the problems he does in class or practice final. Ok teacher, really hard grader.

Talks too fast, and would constantly skips steps when doing problems. Often obfuscates otherwise simple concepts and makes them difficult to understand, let alone apply them in homework and the difficult tests. Homeworks don't line up with lectures and would often be about subjects yet to be taught in lecture. Also, the average median curve  fail.

I get that 9B is a difficult course, but he still wasn't very clear. He would pull identities out of nowhere and do shortcuts that I (at least) wasn't able to follow. In a class like this, you really need to explain the methods. His exams are more challenging than his homework and he's even put in a couple of questions that weren't on the homework.

This professor is okay. He kind of writes small so I can't really see unless I sit in the front. I also can't really understand what he says. His tests aren't easy but his grading scale has a pretty good curve so you can basically get C's or D's on the midterm and final if you do all the hw and do well on quizzes you'll pass.

Terrible at teaching math.  Rather than teaching you how to solve the problem, he will teach short cuts for solving every problem.  You learn how to memorize solving a problem which is lame and will have to be re-memorized for every upper-division class requiring differential equations to solve a problem.
He's alright. Kinda quiet. He does a general curve.

His class was pretty hard, but it wasn't his fault.  He broke down each section into quick-to-follow steps so you could memorize it easily.  I got 50% on his tests and passed the class with a C.  There IS a curve unlike what other people said.  He even said it in class and wrote it on the board.
Dr.Xu's midterm and final are really hard. His practice tests and homework problems is nothing like the actual tests. He does not curve though.
Avoid Dr. Xu at all costs! His midterm is ok, but his final is ridiculously hard. He fails more than half of the class. His boring lectures won't help you pass this class. He does not curve at all.
Do not take this professor. Average grade in the class is an F? No joke.
Always have a perfect lecture with no mistakes. Strongly recommanded.

he doesnt do very many examples. if he shows some examples, they are nothing like what you will see on tests. sometimes its hard to understand what the question is asking, wording is very tricky on some questions
He is a very good teacher, and he make everything so clear for you to understad. Go to his Review for Midtern and final. He does a good review. Take him if you can.

Avoid Xu if you can.  He's a decent lecturer (if you can understand what he's saying), but he gives little to no homework.  His TA's are clueless as to what is going on with the class material, and the only thing you're graded on is the Midterm + Final.  Great if you're re-taking/don't need help. You're screwed if math isn't your strong subject!!!

...Decent teacher I guess... but COMPLETELY ANAL when grading midterms and finals. You get the slightest thing wrong on a problem, and he'll gash chunks of points off. He implements basic curves, nothing too low or too high.
Is horrible at explaining shows no examples
He's great in teaching.

He explains all the concepts very clearly. Sometimes he has a hard time understanding what the students are asking him, but in the end, he'll get it and give a stright answer. A great teacher overall. Also his midterm and final are stright from his study guide. It's great!

don't take him. i've took alot of math classes before, but he really does suck. really. although his midterms and finals look similar to his handouts, if you get a simple mistake, he takes off so much points, and like 1pt. partial credit. i'd rather have a hard teacher who gives partial credits.
You get a sense of "you get what you pay for" with this guy, meaning quality, clearness, and ultimately easiness. Although I got a B in his class, I felt I learned a lot.

I have to admit he does explain the material well but he failed like half the class(i was one) b/c he grades on no curve your whole grade is based on only two tests. He is nice but a really hard professor

Horribleproffesor to have in an upperdivision class, he wont let you use pevious mathemtaicalknowledge in his class unless he personally proves it in class. He failed like half the class cause he gave out no D's. Do not take 151 if he is teaching it

prof Xu was an awesome teacher...that being said, a lot of my fellow students felt he didnt explain things well enough (although I got an easy A-) and felt his tests covered material that had barely been covered...just read the book and you'll be fine.

a good teacher, fairly clear, could improve on his explanations of ideas though. homework load was very fair, just enough to reinforce lecture. i slacked off at the end, so the final destroyed me, but I still managed to pass. thanks!

very organized notes, but you have to memerize formulas that u've never asked to memerize before. Tests are hard problems taken from this notes and suggested hwk. I don't think he curves, 1pt = 1% of ur grade.
Grades very hard. Very little problems for an exam, so if you don't know how to do one then it's over! Do not take him. Expects you to memorize every single formula even though you won't use it.
No Comments
He is a good teacher and you can understand him. He always does a reveiw before an exam and his exam are not that hard.
great teacher. he writes very neatly, easy to follow his lecture.
No Comments

If you're planning on taking a G.E class from her thinking it'll be easy, DONT. lectures are very boring, tests are hard, she assigns 8+ assignments to read every week and most of them are more than 20+ pg each! her attitude is weird to her TAs and her students. goes by lecture slides too fast but doesnt let you take pics bc you'll "sell" them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Passive aggressive, not organized, no time management.The tests are incredibly difficult, gives a lecture before the quizzes leaving us little time to complete.Physical poster presentation that she wont be able to see in person is questionable because we have to turn it in online at the end of the day (makes no sense). AVOID HER! not an easy course
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: To be honest the class wasn't bad but I would not take a class with her again. Most of the time when it comes to tests she's very unprepared and she does not post her slides because people will “sell them” so you HAVE to go to her lectures if you want to pass and she gives you a lot of material to read. She's passive aggressive so beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Relies on lecture material and expects you to read multiple articles each week for discussion. reviews.comment: I took her class only for the reason to be considered a full time student and honestly thought (by reading the course description) that MUS008 would be a fun and easygoing class. I didn't expect the class to be attend and pass, I knew I had to study the material to succeed, but boy those tests were hard. Would not take a class of hers again.

Chavez is extremely rude to her students and seems like she bosses the TAs around. She's also very disorganized and expects a lot out of a breadth course. Do not take if you are looking for an “easy” class. The way she teaches sets student up to fail and penalizes them for doing so.

She is a very rude person. Very passive aggressive and targets students with snarky comments. Made attendance mandatory because shes too much and people stop coming to class. reviews.comment: She's really taking the breadth requirement seriously. It's like taking a class from the head of a department. There's something here if you are a music major of some sorts but if you want an easy and enjoyable elective, this professor is not it.
She is lovely and extremely funny. She is passionate and goes above and beyond for her students.
Maybe it was because everything went online but she wasnt very organized & communication wasnt clear until the very last days when exams & projects were due.

Good and fun class! She's also very sweet! Just get ready to read a lot every week and make sure you pay attention to the lectures! Especially the guest lectures! Notes are a M U S T but in all honesty, you should be fine. The material is all translated (if needed) into English if you don't know Spanish (not often needed though).

You know when an older person's only joke is "hahaha back in MY day! You, small itty bitty child, are too young to even understand!" and it stops being funny immediately? Get ready for that. She's very enthusiastic about the subject matter and is very generous with extra credit, her lectures just weren't my thing.

reviews.comment: Such an awesome and caring professor ! She does assign ALOT of readings but unless you're just looking to pass the class then it's the slides and lectures that you should really pay attention to, thus making attendance for lectures VERY important. Quizzes are mostly lecture based, but if you're aiming for the A then do the readings.

Professor Chavez is very enthusiastic, but she expects way too much. I only took this class because I missed my priority registration, and this was the only breadth course available. She gives quizzes that are pretty difficult, but she offers extra credit opportunities. The readings are fine, but there are soooo many music listenings.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Not only is she very engaging, but she is also very thoughtful. Exams are lecture based so take REALLY detailed lecture notes and also do all the readings. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Shes a very enthusiastic teacher BUT for a breadth requirement (Music of Mexico) she expects wayyyyy too much! She assigns 2 quizzes a midterm cumulative final and a big project. If youre taking this class to fill a requirement I suggest you dont.

Professor Chavez is a great professor. Taking her Music of Mexico class was very interesting and eye opening. Take notes and you'll pass. Her quizzes (2), midterm and final are easy because she gives dumb responses as answers, which allows you to distinguish which one is the correct answer. She just takes forever to put in grades.

reviews.comment: Dr. Chavez is probably one of the most caring professors I've had at UCR. She's passionate about music and is very enthusiastic in her lectures. 2 quizzes, one final, and a podcast. She brings guests to her lectures. She also makes sure to engage with her students by asking questions. Accessible through email and in person. Overall a gr8 professor.

I love her, had her for two classes, Music of the United states and Music of Latin America. She is a great professor that truly cares about the students her exams are not hard but you do need to pay attention in lecture which is where she bases most of her exams off of, the readings are still in there though. Go to discussion and try, Easy A.

If you don't have prior knowledge on Latin America or know how to speak Spanish in general this class will be really tough for you. There are a lot of things the professor already assumes you know about. Also says a lot of words in Spanish but I don't know how to speak Spanish so it was hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Chavez is fair & accessible. She has high expectations but she goes out of her way to provide extra resources for students. The quizzes aren't bad, just read the chapters and listen to her lectures. Fun Class and address about important topics. The person that wrote all the negative response is unfair and clearly mad that he had to read!

To be fair she is a very enthusiastic teacher, but honestly for a breadth class she expects way too much out of her students. She gives 5 quizzes and 1 paper during the duration of the course. Hey quizzes are unreasonably difficult and detailed. She assigns an unreasonable amount of readings per week and her lectures are basically the book.

The class is compromised on 5 quizzes (4 TESTS & cumulative FINAL) & a 5pg essay. Tests are based on broad subjects including lectures, readings, & listenings. She doesn't pass back tests which sucks since the final is cumulative but she'll permit you to revise them w/TA. Extra credit if you consecutively sit in front rows for a few # of classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: If you attend class regularly you will understand the material. Quizzes and material for exams, are based on the information presented in class. Great lecturer and will not put you to sleep very enthusiastic
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great class! We talked about really important topics and all of the assignments are relevant to what we discuss in class.

Attendance is not mandatory since she doesn't take roll . But She is a VERY fast speaker so it's pretty impossible to write everything down, and she never post the 80 slides notes online. It says 5 quizzes, but it's basically 4 midterms and 1 cumulative final. She really expects "respect" from you.

This class is not difficult at all. Make sure you do the readings and attend lecture. The professor is quite nice she allows a chance for extra credit if you sit in the dew rows of the class, also you are allowed your lap top if you sit in the 1st few rows. So extra credit to use your laptop. No final just 5 quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Okay, I took this class to fill up my minimum unit (12). I love music classes, and I always got A for all of them. BUT THIS IS NOT A MUSIC CLASS. AGAIN THIS IS NOT A MUSIC CLASS. haven't finished class yet but there's no way the other reviews weren't made by him.

He is always more than willing to help and he teaches the material in a very understandable way. The fact that the coursework load was more than fair is a plus too. He is probably the best professor to teach this class!
A very down to earth and informative professor. He will clarify after clarifying until we all understand the material and concepts. He made lectures enjoyable & interactive.

Very useful course. Extremely knowledgeable, motivating and caring professor. The best professor I had at UCR. Register early ! The seats got filled up overnight and many students hoped to get registered.
It took me a lot of time to make decision about which courses I should take. I am happy I have made a great chose by taking his class. I learned a lot from him.
One of my favorite professors. He is a master of economics. He can answer any questions you have in class. Highly recommended.

He is smart and inspirational. If you want to learn something I would like to recommend his course. After taking his course , I find out that economics is soooo interesting. It is combining science and art.
A GREAT PROFESSOR! A MUST TAKE COURSE. HE IS VERY KNOWLEDGEABLE AND EASY GOING. HIS CLASSES ARE ALWAY FUN AND FANTASITIC. NO ATTENDANCE REQUIREMENT!!! I TOOK TWO OF HIS COURSES AND GOT 2 A .
He could not teach at all and would simply read off powerpoints. His arrogant attitude and unwillingness to be understanding was a travesty and a horrible learning experience.

Worst professor I have ever taken. Even he was aware of how bad his class would run, completely abstaining from student feedback before the class even started. The absolute worst, poor excuse of a professor I have ever had the displeasure to "learn" from. If you see this prof is teaching a course STEER CLEAR! BE WARNED!

Worst professor Ive ever had. Extremely condescending and vague when asked a simple question. Got upset over it. Lectures were confusing, structure was hard to follow. She's super nice but thinks its bad to get 100% on homework and lectured us to tell us to stop getting 100% on the homeworks that are graded on correctness.

WORST professor ever. Bad explanation of lecture and assuming students to knows everything. Homework is heavily relying on reading textbook and self-studing, and it's due before lecture. She was by far the best Stats professor I've had at UCR, very knowledgeable and genuinely wishing to inspire success. Shares slides before lectures, making studying easier. Accessible for clarifications, office hours were invaluable. Final group project was appreciated, enhancing learning.

The class did so bad on the midterm that she changed the final to a project instead of an exam. The first quiz was really difficult, the second quiz was better because she gave a practice test. I've heard bad things about this class from others who took it in the past, but apparently she changed the format this quarter-- for me it was really enjoyable. I can see myself using her notes and R code for a very long time.

She rambles a bit and overcomplicates lectures most of the time. Curve on both tests saved me. Homework could be redone as many times as needed. She's really nice just reach out. This class is hard so reach out and it'll help.

Homework, lectures, and discussion quizzes all look different in terms of formatting so don't memorize concepts visually, but try to actually understand it. Well, she curved a lot, went from D- to C, so don't stress out

this class is so hard.
Tough, very confusing on grading and not letting student breathe, boring lecture and annoying quizzzzes

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Zhang is one the best professors out there for BUS020. Class was still tough due to the amount of homework you are required to finish weekly and how hard some concepts are to grasp
Super nice, very understanding, cares about her students, makes accounting so much easier.

Super nice professor and taught lectures very clearly. As long as you go to lecture and understand you'll be fine. There's one midterm & the final. Exams are usually easier than the study guides but since its multiple choice you have to understand the concepts in lecture very well because it can get confusing. Go to her OH she's very helpful!

Midterm and FInal are biggest chunks of your grade. Online quizzes and HW, in class participation, some ec. Attend lecture for participation via tophat. Make sure you complete all other assignments at the max score possible so tests arent as nerve racking. Practice tests help but go over slides too. Hard to understand sometimes so keep up @ home

Lectures are kind of heavy and at times seemed rushed, she posts her notes online but they don't include everything she discusses in lecture. Go over the notes and read the chapter before attending lecture and the class will be very easy. There are 2 exams, no final, exams are similar to the practice exams she posts. Pretty easy class.

BUS020 with Ivy was a great experience. There are weekly homework and quizzes as well as discussion quizzes every week. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

Horrible calc teacher. Never completed even one example during lecture. He would never give us the answers to any of our questions. there's an entire unit on the final that he didn't even get to cover yet. grade is just midterm and final. He can't solve his own problems and he spends one entire lecture trying to solve a problem.
