Never explained how to solve anything and kinda just expected you to know how to do the problems already. Tests were very hard (no calculator allowed). def would have to use all outside sources to pass.

Only lets me rate from 1-5 but I would've given him a -5. Didn't miss a single lecture and not once have I left class with an understanding of the topic discussed that day. With the way he teaches, it might as well be the TA leading the class. Teaching is a skill not everyone can have and Professor Xu definitely is not one who possesses this skill.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Xu is a horrible professor. It is impossible to hear him even with a microphone and he mumbles. His midterm and final are extremely difficult and lengthy. He does not do well in preparing students for it and even says, "It is normal if you do not finish all the problems and don't know how to do it." Avoid!!!

All I have to say is AVOID!!! I wonder where the school found him and thought he would be great at teaching. He reads off of his phone and doesn't explain what we are learning in class. To pass get ready to teach yourself and watch a lot of YouTube. If you want to understand what is happening go to discussion the TA teaches way better than him.

I have no clue where the school found him because he can't teach at all. To understand the material get ready to watch YouTube. Also doesn't explain what we are learning. He mumbles a lot which makes it hard to hear him even if he has a microphone. The ta for discussion teaches way better than him and actually makes sense. Overall AVOID!!!

By far the worse class I have ever taken. Xu cannot teach at all. Frankly, I don't understand why the university hired him. Fully expect to spend extra hours self-studying if you take his course. He has an abysmal grading breakdown which makes it very difficult to get a decent grade. He has no social awareness and is very disorganized

He eats during class, does not speak english well, stutters, reads directly off of his phone instead of using any kind of slides or visuals, and weights the final exam and midterm to a combined 75% of the grade. The midterm did not resemble the practice exam. Would have dropped if not assigned this class.

Where do I begin this guy was all over the place when teaching and never addressed what he was going to teach and expected you to know the material he was supposed to teach. Barely passed this class due to his ridiculous midterm and final being nothing like the practice ones. AVOID AT ALL COSTS SERIOUSLY!!

Great guy. He would be ALOT better if I could read his handwriting. He actually explains things very well, but I wish he used the whiteboard instead of his Ipad on the projector. Be prepared to copy very quickly. Course material is pretty easy though. He uploads slides that are very helpful.

The best math professor I have ever had. He is without a doubt the Greatest Math Professor of All-Time. No other math professor on this Earth comes close to touching the greatness that is Xin Yang. I can say with full confidence that Professor Xin Yang is the Future of Mathematics.

The best professor I've ever had, the best teacher I've ever had. I took him for 146B and 146C, and he made every concept sound so simple and easy to understand. He cares a lot about his students as well. An amazing professor, & an even greater human being. He is the gold standard not just for math professors, but as a person. He is the GOAT.

Literally always a breeze in his courses, cheat sheet policies are in place because of the material density but also makes it so you virtually can participate in the class asynchronously because he posts all his notes onto a class drive. Had him for B and C, so caring  and accomodating

Professor Yang is the greatest of all time. The material of the class is difficult but he teaches it in the easiest way possible. He allows cheat sheets on the Midterm and Final. The class is homework heavy, so it helps out to get points. The Final is worth 40% and the questions are way easier than the hw questions. You will pass trust me.

I'm graduating as a Math major and I can say without a doubt that Xin Yang was the best professor I had during my time here at UCR. He is so caring and accessible outside of class. I would email him homework questions late like 1 am and he would always respond. Fair grader and fair tests. Incredible lectures. Take his class

Best Math teacher at UCR in my opinion. Teaches difficult courses yet his lectures make the concepts very graspable. He provides clear step by step examples. Homework's and exams are fair. Knowledge of the material stays with me even much later on with his methods, highly recommend!!!

He is an understanding professor who wants to help you succeed in the class. The course content may have felt a little overwhelming sometimes because the homework is very long and a little difficult, but he gives fair exams and allowed us to have cheat sheets. His teaching style is very straightforward and provides very detailed examples and notes.

One of the best math professors ever! His lectures and notes were excellent and so easy to understand. The practice problems are very similar to the quizzes, midterm, and final. He ensured that we understood the material before moving, and his tests ranged from easy to medium. This class will be easy if you utilize the given materials well.
Absolutely amazing! Would take him again if I could. Very easy and his notes help a lot.
Really clear and great teacher, doesn't waste any time in lectures. Tests are very similar to practice problems given.

Pretty pog professor, I usually don't give reviews on rate my professor. Quizzes were online, lecture notes go into depth into what you need. Great and easy to understand examples, lecture recordings made sense. Very nice and understandable.

Professor Yang keeps lectures simple and makes the subject simple. It's easy to get lost in the abstraction of the subject, however plenty of examples make problems easy to visualize and solve. His class is very simple to comprehend and handle. Would recommend!

Professor Xin Yang is one of my favorite math professors here at UCR! I have him for Math010A and I am doing great in the class. He is a little hard to understand with the accent but his notes are absolutely amazing and easy to read. His grading scale is easy and he made the final open note! I wish I could take him again!!
He writes the best notes. you can skip the lectures and still understand everything just by looking over his amazing notes. Probably the best math professor at ucr.

Professor Yang is very nice and caring towards his students. You can easily tell he cares about each person's success. He is easy to talk to but his accent makes him a little hard to understand during lectures. The class itself had a lot of homework and tests yet they are very easy. The professor was genuinely great. 10/10

Dr. Yang is such a genuinely good professor. He very obviously cares about his students and makes an effort to make all of the material understandable. He posts notes before and after class. His lecture notes are very helpful. I would love to take another class with him at some point.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Xin Yang is the best at ucr math department. His lecture were clearly and easy to understand , and he made reviews for the tests. Highly recommend!

Really such an amazing professor. His lectures were really clear and easy to understand with his explanations. He takes care to go through the steps in solving things and even uploads reviews for his tests and quizzes to make sure you know the material to pass. Really an amazing teacher as long as you give some of your time to the class.

This professor made sure what he taught would actually be on the test. He would make the reviews in a way where it would truly prepare us for the exams and his lectures were always clear and made sense.

He is such a caring math professor and really wants his students to succeed! Throughout the course he relies on student feedback to focus on what students are struggling on, and he also makes study guides to help out

Hes definitely a very caring professor and very understanding. The grading scale is by points but is very reasonable. As long as you pay attention, youll pass the class! I highly recommend him as a professor.

This class is an easy A. I took this course online so it could be a completely different experience in person. Professor Yang cares about his job. I would say that Without knowing calculus before hand his class would be difficult. I made some nice friends along the way!
Very engaging
Good Professor. Teaches well. Exam is hard but she lets you bring cheat sheet.

Probably the best professor on Campus. Very caring and goes out of her way to make sure you are learning the material. Attendance is 100% mandatory and a heavy chunk of the grade in itself. But you will enjoy the class either way. I wish I could take her again!

Fall 2023: Class was tech-free, so we had to take notes by hand, but she had fun presentations. Readings weren't required. We had in-class simulations, had to take attendance selfies, and the only assignments were reflections on High 5 and DISC tests, 1 group presentation, a free-response HW, and no exams/quizzes. She was very kind and caring.

I think she's a great professor the only thing is she does give lots of homework but on the bright side making the class less test heavy. To do well, do the homework and practice exams and you'll do fine on the test. For the most part the test are fair and she also curves if the class average is low. Overall great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: MY QUEEN SARAH YEAKEL. Best professor at UCR. Breaks things down so that someone with algebra 1 knowledge could understand calc. Very lenient with grading and will literally curve everyone 25% which sounds bad but also very good if you pay attention. If you have even a little calc background you'll get an A. She should teach every math course here

Math 110* but I also had her for 9b years ago (equally enjoyable experience). Lectures were clear and straightforward, as were her expectations from us. Exams were identical to lecture material. Oh also lectures were very engaging, she asks a lot of questions to check for understanding.
Great professor, she really knows what she's teaching and she uses examples that is easy to understand. The class can be difficult if you don't put it in the effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The hw is rarely like the lectures, so be prepared to have to teach yourself some things. You wont receive full credit on tests, quizzes, and hw if you dont show all of your work. In addition to 2 worksheets every week, you also have online hw. She also lied to us in the beginning saying we would only get 1 worksheet a week.

The homework is nothing like the lectures, in fact there was an entire hw section about zuma-radians which we were never taught. She goes very fast during lecture, you can barely copy the notes in time so forget comprehending the material during class. Quizzes every week but we only get the last 15 mins of class to complete them.

Lecturers are fast paced and mandatory to attend for the lecture graded questions. Most of my learning came from the TA, lectures were not helpful for me. Lectures are recorded and posted on canvas though. Difficult class overall, first math class I have ever gotten less then a A- in throughout my career in academics. Otherwise good professor.

Prof. Yeakel is very excellent at teaching the subject matter, often times going down to the basics every lecture so it's easy to understand, even if you missed the previous lecture (trust). Exams are not difficult at all, especially with the fact you get to bring notes with you to exams. She also records lectures and posts the notes online.

Her lectures are pretty understandable and easy to process. All the homework, quizzes, and exams were online and fair compared to what she lectured on. You definitely need to dedicate time to the homework assignments but they're very doable.
Took Math006b in the Winter of 2023. Professor is patient and  If you finished your homework on time, you will get a good grade.

A great teacher! i had her twice! she explains and provides examples for students to learn throughout the lecture.she encourages the students in participating thru polleverywhere.she uses her time well and allows late passes in the homework and quizzes. she advocates for students to learn. she uses online source which gives time for you to work!

I LOVED HER! She is very clear in lectures and teaches the material pretty well. She actually teaches the material step by step. Her discussion worksheets can be a little confusing but you can ask the TA and collab with your classmates for help. She uses poll everywhere during her lectures which is why you should try to attend every lecture.
She is very clear in her lectures. Sarah is very patient and answers emails very quickly.
The work can be overwhelming, but manageable. She tends to go a bit fast during lecture, but she also records lecture so it's ok. Overall good professor.
Just a horrible lecturer
Yeakel is a great professor overall. She covers the content very clearly and explains the concepts really well. As long as you do the homework and review, the class is an easy A.

reviews.comment: Lecture consisted of mostly of working through example problems of material taught which helped a lot with understanding . Dropped certain lowest grades at the end of quarter. Class grade is exam heavy but exams are fair and not hard to pass as partial credit is given. Good attitude and was always respectful and responsive to students.

reviews.comment: Tests are unfair and a average of a D is not normal, poor teaching habits and rushes through lectures making you write so fast you can't comprehend what's being taught.

reviews.comment: Very unclear on what she wants and hw never matches lectures. Also a lot of the problem solving is done in discussion prior to be taught in class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: absolutely terrible professor. throws you into so much work and has terrible explanations. doesn't really care about her students and just throws them out there without teaching anything. first midterm average was 60% and she jumps over topics. super stressful class and i can tell everyone else is dying too, but she doesn't care

reviews.comment: She drops the lowest quiz, 3 of the lowest hw and parts of ur final replace ur lowest test. She was super nice and I would take her again. She goes in depth with problems and tries her best to help her students. She does a great job explaining her work in lectures and if you need help, her office hours are pretty much empty for 1 on 1s.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The class was ok but there would always too much time used to simply go over announcements instead of starting the lecture. She would teach at the rate that the slowest person was able to pick up the material. And she implemented a late policy that a passing final was required to pass the class which did trigger many students as it was last minute.
Do not recommend. She pretends she's sweet and supportive but she's not. This is for one of her entomology class.

I had her for the first half of Biol005A and she was a pretty good professor. She cares for her students and held midterm and final review sessions which were super helpful. Her test questions were straightforward and make sure to go to lectures or go through the slides she posts because tests questions are formulated mostly from them.
Did not make her quiz and midterm questions that confusing.

Tells you everything you need to know for exams. You could get away with skipping lectures and just reading the slides. Readings were assigned every lecture but they were optional because the lectures are based on the readings. Great professor that wants you to pass

Mainly read off the slides and tells you what you need to know. She wants you to pass and tries not to overload you with unnecessary information. Midterm questions were typically straightforward. We were assigned a chapter of reading every class meeting - it was so much work. Generous grading curve, though (an 80% is an A-).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Attendance not mandatory for lecture & they are recorded, but attendance is mandatory for the discussion section. I liked YG but it often was hard to learn the material because it felt like she didn't really know what she was talking about very well (wasn't confident in her knowledge). Office hours and midterm Q&A's will help you a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had this professor for the first half of the quarter. She makes is easy to follow what she expects you to learn and is friendly if you ask her questions after class or in her office hours. However, by no means is this class easy as the second half of the quarter greatly increases in difficulty. This class is a lot of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is really nice and organized and presents the material in a way that is really understandable. The tests are a fair demonstration of what she goes over, and she removes questions that she thinks are unfair and gives you the points. If only she taught the entirety of Biol005a, the class average would probably be much higher.

Professor Zhang is passionate about teaching math. His lecture notes are concise and easy to understand. By hearing how he yells in lectures, you can tell he genuinely cares for his students and math. Instead of teaching pure memorization, he explains concepts behind each theory. There is a bit of accent, but shouldn't hinder learning.

Speaks and writes very fast during lectures, so get ready to write a lot. On the plus side, the grading is super lenient. There are usually good curves on tests, and he drops your two lowest quizzes and three lowest homework assignments.

This class is extremely test-heavy. Homework isn't graded, but it is necessary to do well in the class. The tests claim to come directly from the homework problems, but the questions differ completely.

Professor Zhang is a very good professor. Although he spoke with a slight accent, he was completely understandable. The lectures can go a little fast, but he is very helpful during office hours! His TA Yuguo is also great and will explain the problems clearly. The most important thing is that Professor Zhang will write notes in class with student.

He is very knowledgeable in what he teaches, but teaches it too fast for us to catch up. Lecture notes were hard to read and hard to understand because he writes full on paragraphs to explain each step. It's hard to see how a problem is done since the steps aren't near each other. Online textbook problems really aided in quizzes though.

Zhang was average professor for me. He's a fast lecturer and sometimes do short cuts without explanation on how to get there. His exams were average with most doable and some difficult. His quizzes are based on the optional textbook problems he assigned. The only good thing were his office hours where he's very helpful. Overall, keep practicing!

He helped explain problems or questions after class. He also was good on updating us on canvas if things changed. There was homework that was due every week but the concepts were taught and explained well. He felt very approachable and understood that not all the class will understand the math. He has an accent, but it's not hard to understand

The mid term and the final were both 30% each for Math 45 which I think is ridiculous. He didn't have any resources for students outside of class except for his office hours and his crappy lecture notes. He also goes really fast during his lectures.

Zhang goes at a slow pace but his examples really help understand the content better. I think the way he teaches is alright despite not covering the last chapter (which made the final easier) and he reviews high school content a bit too much. The class overall is on the easier side with fair exams, 2 question quizzes, and not too much homework.

Highly recommended for math/engineering majors (might be tough for others). He has a straightforward outline and has multiple opportunities to obtain a higher grade. The final was the toughest part of the course because there were questions that made you think (apps with multiple steps). Overall he is very organized and wants success from students

Pretty good professor, but has a pretty thick accent & can be hard to understand at times. He really wants his students to learn & will make appts for students who can't attend his normal office hours. The course was mostly computational, even though he says its not going to be. Overall, he's organized, helpful, n don't forget to do HW & quizzes!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Words can't describe how low my cortisol was this entire quarter. Made me like being a student. Study a week or two before a midterm and you're fine, but who cares since she drops your lowest score and if you do good on the final both are dropped. The grade of the final being the accommodation for the mid term category, if final score is better

She is very nice and kind. She cares a lot about the students. She is very accessible outside class. Make sure to pay attention because the material can be hard. Attend lecture and take good notes. She moves at a fast pace, but always slows down when asked questions. She does drop the lowest homework, quiz, and worksheet grade.

Great teacher and human being, really cares about her students and their well-being, very approachable and understanding too. Do attend lecture though and take notes and try to engage as the material is hard itself, don't forget it's calculus. She drops the two lowest homework, worksheets, and even one quiz (midterm).
Shes going in my will her tests were so straightforward she didn't lie about what was gonna be on the test at all, she is my goat. If you take 9b with her you're gonna be chillin all quarter

difficult course but prof was great—lectures were engaging and clear. The weekly homework assignments were pretty long at least for me, but were good preparation for quizzes/exams. Course was overall well-paced and fair (+two dropped hw's/quizzes yayy)

Great class in learning how to write proofs. Homework is typed in LaTeX, which really helps build good mathematical skills. The course prepares you very well for upper-level proof-based math classes. Only weekly homework and a final, and the homework directly prepares you for the final. The course structure is extremely well designed.

Lectures help a LOT!! The midterm and final questions are just like the ones in the midterm/finals practices that she gives us, and those questions come straight from the lectures. If you pay attention in lecture, it is a really easy class. Discussions have worksheets that give more good practice.

She doesn't post notes since she writes on whiteboards, so I HIGHLY recommend going to lecture. So many concepts in lin alg feel so arbitrary, so it'll be difficult for you to understand where things come from unless you attend lecture, where she explains things well and works through questions. Also I recommend watching 3b1b's Lin Alg series :)
very simple to understand and straightforward
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a really chill professor and is pretty easy to contact. Lectures are based on the textbook so going over the textbook before-hand will help connect everything together. Averages for midterms weren't the best but he also curves as well which is a plus.

he goes pretty fast so if you zone out for a little bit, you'll get lost. but if you pay attention and lock in, you'll be good. class averages were pretty bad but imo it was because people didn't know how to study. just go to lecture and do additional study time and you'll succeed in dr. zhang's class.

He is a very nice professor and seems to care for his students. Tests are difficult if you are not very comfortable with the calculations. Overall, knowing how to do the calculations and understanding the concepts very well will ensure you a good grade on the mids and final. Average on both mids was about 55%, but he curves

He has a strong accent so it can be hard to understand him during lectures. The exams are 50% calculations, 50% conceptional and most of them require multi-step calculations. Do lots of practice problems to really solidify the material because the exams require you to know how to connect the dots of the information.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Jingsong Zhang is very nice and is open to giving help during office hours. If you read the textbook on your own time, his lecture slides will make more sense. It helps to cross-reference his lecture slides and the textbook to study for the exams. I'd recommend him over other chem teachers.

He's really chill, and if you study off the textbook, midterms a breeze, and high grades are possible. Go to office hours, he is genuinely so helpful and takes the time to explain every little concept, no matter how simple. Between him and Bartels, please choose Jinsong Zhang.

Reads directly off ppts that he records & posts so lecture is useless. Doesn't go over problems at all only theory. Assigns so much homework that you basically get no time to actually study for exams. The "practice exams" are only 2 questions even though exams are around 8 questions. Ive learned nothing throughout the entire pchem series here.

P-chem is hard but I feel like I learned a lot and was able to understand the material in a way that allowed me to exceed in this course. Prof. Zhang is also a very fair and caring teacher. Lectures can be a lot but I would recommend going to office hours since he is great at explaining the material one-on-one. Quizzes were also EC.

He is awful lecturer. His lecture confuses you more than it being helpful. Better off studying off of hw and quizzes. That being said his midterms were based on hw and quiz BUT finals were not. 50% of the final had stuff we never learned abt and went over briefly about. Class is definitely not easy and I just wish he would lecture better
His class was easy thank to the huge curve he has. he reads right from the slide show, and at times his class get really boring. he has a strong accent so its hard to understand.

Very difficult class but it is graded on a fairly large curve. He is pretty hard to understand at times (can't tell "gold" from "goat"). He reads straight from his powerpoints and puts them online so lecture is worthless. He is a nice guy but I would say take someone else if you can.
He's a Very knowledgeable professor.  He spent too much time on statistics for my liking.

Math is a requirement for this course. Unlike other chem courses, everything in this course is all calculus. Homeworks are really long and complex. Professor is a cool guy. He taught alright though it was his first time of teaching this course in Spring 2007. Midterm and final were not that bad but were long and create lots of frustration.
ok. maybe he does have an attitude but he knows his chemistry and is overall a good teacher.
very knowledgable. tough but fair. need to know the homework to pass tests.

this man cannot teach. unfortunately, he is the only teacher for two required upper division chemistry courses (111 and 140), both with very intense lab sections. his lectures are boring and unstructured, and rarely relate to the lab exercises.

As long as you go to lecture, learn the material, and do all of the assignments an A is very achievable. I really appreciated that this professor provided extra credit opportunities, more than 3. He is very respectable and will email back promptly, I also believe you can miss the class twice and it will not affect your attendance grade.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I took soc 189 with him and he's a good teacher but his TA was a horrible grader as he was WAYYYY too strict.N I went to all the classes and didnt miss one, I did all the assignments to the best of my abilities (course journal of 25 pg, and I did really well on his exams only to end up with a B which is disappointing for adding in all that effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Just an average Soc prof, he wasn't bad and getting an A is doable. His lectures can be very fast so don't count on him. The TA was really understanding. If you go to his office hours and ask for help, you will get what you need. Everything is online. But you do have to study because exams are using lockdown browser. Otherwise it's pretty chill.

I had him for Soc 005 when it was an online course and we were assigned readings to help with our homework. I could have easily passed the class by simply reading the textbook. It was hard for me to follow along with his presentations because he just reads from the slides. Now that I have him for SOC189 it's the same thing. He doesn't really teach.

Professor Zhao was an excellent professor for formal organizations. Although I had a lot of trouble understanding the assigned readings at times, his lectures would more than make up for it, he would go in depth on explaining each reading and would engage the students in a well thought out manner. Stressful at times but more than manageable!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I was always terrified of stats, but after this course with professor Zhao, it was so much easier for me! He was always willing to adapt to the needs of any student. He made himself available and offered extra credit in all homework assignments and exams. He is also super sweet and really wants all his students to learn and understand stats!

Really enjoyed this class. You can tell he has a passion for teaching. Class consisted of 4 write ups and a take home final. As long as you show up, participate, pay attention during lecture, and put effort into your write ups you'll pass this class.

Professor Li is great. Lectures rely heavily on the readings. Participation is IMPORTANT in regard to this class, so be sure to participate. Write-ups can be a little difficult and at times confusing but ultimately aren't too difficult, as the professor offers constructive feedback. Highly recommend this course
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I wouldn't rate it 5 or 4, but 4.5 at best. Participating in class is heavy, so if you don't like it then I suggest the discussion forums, plus don't miss class a alot, your grade will hurt. 4 required write-ups, which can get a little hard so pay attention. No midterm, just a final take home exam where you can work in partners for it.

This professor genuinely cares about real-world learning. His write-ups can be tough, but he means well and values clear, concise work. Lectures are amazing if you stay focused. One downside—he splits the class into electronic and non-electronic sections, so choose your seat wisely when making the seating chart.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class because it focused heavily on real-life applications, which made the material so much easier to understand and relate to. A lot of the topics covered really helped with my full-time career roles, the problem-solving strategies, financial planning techniques, or theories, everything felt relevant and useful.

Great teacher and accommodates for those who do not want to participate in class through canvas discussion boards. 4 write-up topics, one final term paper, weekly quick web assignments, creative extra credit, and participation matters. Overall, useful topics for business related things and decision making.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at UCR not only does he genuinely care about your grade but he took into account my disability and worked around me to make sure I not only understood the class but he just genuinely cares. It is so rare to find a professor that is as understanding and knowledgeable as Professor Li. 10/10 recommend

Professor Li was absolutely amazing and a genuine joy to be a part of his class. Weekly optional assignments, no exams, a couple group assignments, and provided readings-- very doable and engaging. This professor is a real REAL GEM. take him.
One of the great professor I have take so far

Professor Li was awesome! He was super understanding and actually loved his students. He's also realistic. He knows what it's like to be a college student and that sometimes things happen! No midterm, 4 600-word write-ups, and one final.

Professor Li was great! He is really nice and enthusiastic about what he teaches. Lecture was never boring. He makes the class and grading very clear for students so that we can get the highest grade possible. He is honest with feedback and only wants the best for his students. Reading are not too hard. Homework is simple and doable!

Professor Ye Li is one of the best teachers at UCR, very knowledgeable and passionate about the courses he teaches, and extremely professional and organized.  Grateful to have learned so much from the teachings of Prof. Ye Li!!

Professor Ye Li is one of the best at UCR, very knowledgeable and passionate, very organized. He teaches complex concepts in a simpler way with real-life examples which then becomes easy to understand, and encourages critical thinking. Grateful to have learned so much from the teachings of prof. Ye Li!!

Professor Li is an amazing professor, I always looked forward to going to lectures because they were very interesting. Professor Li knew how to keep his lectures fun and interesting with class statistics and extra credit opportunities. He has a clear grading criteria and sticks to the syllabus. I definitely recommend taking  his course!!
Amazing Professor! Loved his classes very interactive and engaging!!

Professor Li is a great lecturer and makes the class extremely enjoyable. I found myself getting "senioritis" this quarter so I skipped more classes than I had hoped. But I never wanted to miss out on Prof Li's lectures. He's overall super fun and easy to listen to. He also takes the time to learn everyone's name which makes him a personable.
You should definitely take his class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Li, made organizational behavior into a psychology class for business majors. I took MGT 216, and I learned a lot of real-world skills that I did not get from my graduate finance and information system classes. Attendance is MANDATORY, please show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof Li was by far one of the most thorough and passionate professors I've ever had at UCR. His lectures are well-paced and he does an exceptional job at keeping the class engaged. The variety of topics were nicely spread out throughout the quarter and overall, the structure of the class was great. He also provides a generous amount of feedback

Professor Li was great! By far one of the best classes and professors I have had at UCR. He teaches the course very fluidly and assigns work that guarantees your understanding of class concepts. Doing the work for his class makes you reflect and engage with class material, rather than feeling like you are doing necessary assignments.

Professor Li's teaching style and topics presented are very refreshing and genuinely interesting/useful. Workload is flexible, topics are enlightening, readings are a bit long (but are a must to maintain discussion/participation credit in class), but an overall great pleasure. Textbook not necessary. One of the best educational experiences at UCR.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's very entertaining with the way he teaches and is very connected with today's current trends.
Dr. Li is the best professor I met in UCR, if you have the chance to take his class. Don't miss it!!!!

Professor Li is literally the best professor I've ever had!! He's funny and always available to help! He's also super nice, he tries to learn everybody's names and always send email reminders in case you forget to do your work. Feel like he's there really to teach and help students learn!! The only class I've ever anticipated!! 11/10

Similar to BUS149. Lectures were interesting. The case studies were pretty hard. Make sure to read all of the articles for the cases to get over 20 points (max 25). Interesting personality, he tells you on the first day of class that if you don't like him to drop immediately or you will not enjoy the quarter. Participation & attendance is mandatory
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Li genuinely cares about his students and always tries to make his class as fun and informative as possible. Although he could be a tad bit of a elitist at times, he just wants to show off his passion. The final report can make or break your grade, so be sure to have a trusted partner, or else you might end up with a B.

Attendance is mandatory. However, the way he conducts his class makes it easy to participate and be involved. He gives a LOT of extra credit opportunity but only up to 5 pts will be allowed per student. NO midterm or final, only (5) 600-word write-ups that YOU choose to do. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!

Amazing professor!! Best professor I've had at UCR hands down. Really caring, easy to talk to and approach, gives great feedback and quickly, too. You have to participate in class and the class is really engaging. Wish he taught more classes! Grade breakdown: participation, weekly web assignments, 4 write ups 500-600 words, final partner essay

A great professor; you will learn a lot and read a lot. This class is taught like an MBA class and he makes you think outside the box. Take extra credit seriously. He also tells you how you're doing in the class via email. It can make or break your grade when the final rolls around; I honestly thought his final was pretty hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Honestly, the best professors I have taken. He is a professional in his field and is very passionate about the subject matter. Lots of reading and participation during class. Take every chance to speak in class and read as much as you can. The final is a take home but requires lots of knowledge on the subjects taught during class. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Not much to add to the reviews already here. Dr Li keeps it real and is pretty relatable. Some of the topics really hit home and I feel like I'm already making better decisions. I wish the classroom weren't so far away though...

Easily one of the best SOBA courses at UCR. Prof Li obviously cares about the subjects he teaches and uses student surveys to illustrate the principles he discusses in lecture. Participation is a central part of the class w/ optional work for those that don't want to speak. Assignments have clear-cut expectations and the bar is set just right.

I wish more professors here taught like him. He makes lectures easy to relate to and tries to connect to the students. Participation is required and worth 20% but I liked hearing what my classmates said. Write ups were hard because you had to write them based on research articles. Stop by office hours if you want some career/life advice!
Great and caring teacher. A huge part of the grade is just participation so as long as you're brave enough to raise your hand, you'll be fine. Also, the material is really interesting.

One of the best business classes I've taken at UCR, if not the best. Really enjoyed the way he taught the class. Wish he taught more classes. Should take if you're a business student looking for an interesting elective to take. Would take again!!

I appreciate how straight forward this class has been. His primary concern is making sure that we understand the material. His focus is on participation was a breath of fresh air. It was clear that you wanted our feedback to gauge or understanding and ability to apply the material, which is easy due to his clear, direct, and detailed guidance .

One of the best professors in UCR. He's engaging, gives good feedback, responds quickly to emails, and actually cares about his students. It's definitely not a super easy A, but if you put effort into it you'll do well. Participation is a huge part of your grade, but somehow, he makes students who hate participating more active. I would take again!

Even though I'm a pretty timid student, I felt comfortable participating in class. It's required to participate if you want to do well, but I thought it was a good thing because it helped improve my public speaking skills. I would suggest going to office hours if you need help. He gives some career advice and is approachable.

Good class to take whether it's your major or just an elective. Really enjoyed the class, you go to class everyday, do the assigned work he gives you and you get a final, no midterm. He assigns some kind of extra credit, he'll most likely give you 0 or .5 for each, 5 total. I got .5 because it was "too obvious" so unfair. do the work, get the BA

The best professor I had at UCR. He is very knowledgeable about the subject and wants students to learn, not memorize. While the readings are more difficult than average (compared to readings of other classes), but they are manageable. Classes are focused on discussions and he gives significant extra credit opportunities. Very interesting course!
Great Professor.  He is very thorough.  One of the best professor's at UCR.  Engaging and he really cares about his students.

You will learn about interesting topics and get a feel for what an MBA class feels like; it's worth it. His syllabus is very clear about the grading criteria so nothing is left unsaid. HIs class is structured around articles, 4 write ups, and a final take home writeup. No midterms. You learn a lot & he keeps you engaged through participation.

Definitely one of the most different classes I have taken at UCR. The best part was the active engagement between Professor Li and his students. Get ready to participate and engage in thought-provoking and useful topics. Take 143 with Li!

Class is structured by decisions because he gives the option to do the hw or not by a certain date. He does give out extra credit by playing a number game &additional findings of articles to help his class. No MT & final is take home essay. Lectures are great and engages students and genuinely cares about our learning. He is one of the BEST at UCR
One of the best UCR professors

Prof. Li has a unique talent for leading discussions. During his classes, I always felt completely engaged in the course content and intellectually challenged at the same time. He taught his students a lot and knew how to deliver the information in a way that we could make useful throughout our college career and professional career.

Super interesting subject. One of the best teachers in the business program. Would take gain if he was teaching anything else. The class isn't hard. Participation is required, but it's not very hard to participate. There's plenty of opportunities to participate. Write-ups can be a bit confusing, but will become easier overtime. Overall, very good!

Now heres a professor who knows how to teach and engage his students!! Great class overall, you will come out learning alot and actually enjoying the material for the most part. He is not an easy grader so you will have to work for it. Also class participation is mandatory, so go to class!

I feel like he is a mini Jasso, you either love him or hate him. I hate him, mostly because of his arrogance not because of the difficulty of the class. Participation is a major part of your grade and if you don't like talking in front of the class he pretty much says get over it.He is very responsive to emails,no books, no tests, take home final.
Dr. Zarinebaf is caring professor and she helped me develop intrests in historical research.

I loved taking Middle Eastern history classes with this professor. We got off on the wrong foot when we met, but we talked through it easily. Professor Zarinebaf was very kind and open to all of my questions. Remember to read!!! That's the most important thing. The material is interesting and worth your time.

She's an easy grader and did not assign tons of work. There were extra credit opportunities and readings but she covers them during lectures. Her lectures can be very long and wordy but she's extremely knowledgeable in the material. Attendance is part of your grade.

Lectures go fast and feel like an information dump, and also go off topic a lot. For some reason, she likes to do lecture online despite the class description saying it was in person (3 out of 5 class meetings so far was online, and 1 was canceled). Spend a ridiculous amount of time reviewing basic information in an upper-division class.

At first, I was of having to take this class after seeing the review left behind from last year but Professor Zarinebaf is really enthusiastic about her teaching and while the readings are lengthy I found them to be enjoyable. I don't think she grades harshly but she does go off topic at times. She's a lovely lady who cares about her students.

This professor is super condescending, expects you to learn all the material from the reading and the readings are HARD. Super disorganized lectures and goes off on tangents. She gives a participation and attendance grade despite the pandemic setting, and randomly calls on people. Super inconsiderate and grades weird, doesn't upload the grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The professor is very resourceful and has great lectures where she explains complex issues in a easy to understand way. Readings were hard at first but I got used to its language by the second week. Always do your readings before discussion and get ready to share if you want participation credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I've had her for two classes. She knows so much she can get carried away. The lecture is sometimes hard to follow, the powerpoint unorganized, and she jumps from topic to topic. She does much better when the course is focused, i.e. Iran instead of the whole Middle East. She is picky and unpredictable but truly interested in her students' ideas

Professor Zaringbaf is a very interesting person. She is very intelligent and knows the material very well. She is very helpful during OH and she grades pretty easy. Her class is honestly not hard at all. The exams were long but clear. As long as you keep up the readings and take good notes during lecture, this class will be an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She only had four real assignments and attendance if you do poorly on any one of these you are pretty much already at a C. She is tough but interesting take really good notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The reviews got me worried but this class wasn't too bad. She's an easy grader. One midterm, a group project, and a final (choice of take-home final or paper). As long as you paid attention in class and keep up with readings, you'll be fine. The group project is a short presentation on a chapter. Choose the right people and date to present.

This woman gave me anxiety. But she knows her stuff. Don't ask her questions about anything; she'll start her sentence with "if you read the assigned reading..." Such a shame.  I got a pretty good grade in the class but because of her, I no longer have any desire to study Middle Eastern history. Or history in general.

Her lectures are a little bit disorganized and she has a lot of information on the slides so it is difficult to take notes on both the slides and her lecture, but she's not a difficult grader.  As long as you go to class and can write coherently in your papers, you'll do really well in the class.
She was boring and monotonous. Her rubric for the thesis paper wasn't very clear and don't expect a study guide for the midterm. Plus she says "you know" after every sentence, it's very distracting.

I did not enjoy this class at all. I learned a great deal, but it was only through what reading I could have done on my own. The lectures are relevant to the class, but not helpful in understanding the material in any real way. Her lecture style isn't really engaging or very informative.
She Is Spicy!!
Amazing!!!!

show up to class...she hates it when you don't come to class, hence the reason why I have a C+ and aced every sinkin exam.  She gives a group project that sucks.  She talks about something completely different then what is on the power point, ignore her and write the notes.  That's what you get tested on.  She's a beautiful woman, not hot.
Sexy?  Are you kidding?  Boring, dry, monotone.  However, really nice lady, very approachable and helpful, just really dry.
very sexy teacher

An ok class. had no desire taking it but therefore i had little interest. i got an A. a lot of readings and lots of lecture notes but did not really need most of them. 8 pg paper w/no final. midterms were several easy ID's and 2 essays. sign in sheet at beg. of class.

For the most part, lectures were pretty boring where it was just the professor lecturing the whole time w/o any powerpoints. Had to rely on textbooks for the 1st half of the class but they become useless since there's no final but a 8pg paper instead. Not a bad/hard class but a little work required. Really sweet lady who is always willing to help.

Pay attention to the first weeks of instruction so you aren't confused on how to use anything. Do your assignments, check in for critiques, and you'll pass. Admittedly, he was fully absent for one class but it's hardly noticeable with how work in the class is structured. He was alright, I'm surprised anyone has a strong opinion on him, good or bad.

I had at least 2 classes with Amir, beginning photo and digital photo. He had a little humour, didn't like people to be late. He gave good feedbacks and created a friendly learning environment to encourage exchange of ideas. His work is amazing and inspiring. He didn't teach all aspect of digital photo, he taught the basic, you have to work it out.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had him awhile ago. I like his personality and teaching style.  A lot of people say he's "blunt", which is true.  But I tend to agree with the blunt comments he makes.  He is not being mean spirited.  I see him as being honest and direct, which some students don't like. They want their ego stroked, and he won't do that.  So suck it up buttercup.

Amir doesn't sugar coat things. He can tell if you put in the effort and if you don't he is not going to pretend you did. His words can be blunt but they are fair. He can recognize the students who really try and if he gives you criticism you can either take it like a victim or use it to better your work. Overall he is great

I regret taking his class now. He's left class early a couple of times.1 time he showed up for 5 mins. in a 3 hr. lab,left and never showed up later.If you asked for help he'll say he's coming back later and never show up.

I have no idea what these people are talking about. He has a great sense of humor and I think he's hilarious. He is blunt but that's a great trait of his - he gives you GOOD criticism. Not only that but it's very insightful and helpful.

He is not that bad.  He noticed I seemed iffy about the class on the first day, but I just clarified and told him I was nervous, and he just put me at ease. He does have his own special way of critiquing, but don't take it personally! I ended up getting an A. probably for effort. but hey, he's NOT THAT BAD.

The comments here about Amir are true, but only to a certain extent.  As cocky, and cynical as he is, it is because he wants you to improve your work.  He treats people rudely if you are the same to him, not attending class, showing little interest etc.  Like any professor, why would he be concerned about your well being if you aren't?

Took 3 classes with him, I know what I'm talking about.  In beginning photo - fine but realized was because I had no contact with him. In intermediate photo class, finally revealed himself to be the **** he really is. Cynical to the point of dismissing everyone as idiots. Makes assumptions and sticks with it. Only cares about his own opinions
He graduated from the UCLA MFA program and thinks he is God, what do you expect...
****-bag-o-riffic...  ...his narcissism is so all encompassing and his ego is so big that he's probably the one leaving the "sexy" comments.

I was actually a reader for this class back in '04, and I was appalled at the quality of writing exhibited by seniors in college.  Amir was polite to students, selected fascinating guests, and was much more charitable than me with the crap turned in by his students.  Being an art major doesn't mean you don't have to learn how to write, people.
Amir appreciates contradiction.  Is at the students back and is willing to help when asked.
No Comments

Zaki was great and his class was delightful to be a part of. The slide shows were interesting and the assignments were almost always fun to do. To get an A in his class just put effort, thought, and time in the work that you do. It is an Art class and you can't get a good grade with shady work no matter how sujective a professor may or may not be.

this guy is horrible.  he is rude, immature, thinks too highly of himself, negates students into a disrespected and low position.  he only accepts his opinions, he is a ****bag.  DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASSES.  you will regret it. he puts on a front like he's a nice guy and then he turns into an A-hole.
Dont waste your time in his classes.  The only word he knows is "no".  Beyond that he doesn't listen to his students and argues with them regularly in and out of class.

this man is very arrogant, does not respect students, does not respect any opinions other than his own. treats students like dumb idiots, doesnt even give them a chance. he doesnt like to give out good grades. recommend strongly to NOT take any of his classes

Amir makes class suck.  He is rude, childish and petty.  He says that he wants our opinion and then gets upset if it is not the same as his.  He makes it intimidating to want to participate in clas.  He doesn't seem to like UCR or teaching and has a very low opinion on most the students at UCR.

the most infantile, petty teacher i've had the misfortune of meeting. he is so bored with himself that it makes his classes unbearable. i've never met a teacher that was more disinterested in his profession. his nose is so far up the department's ass that he can't see how badly his art sucks.

I passed this class with a high grade, so my review isn't for the sake of "complaining."  Zaki does not give constructive criticism, nor fosters creativity in his lectures.  This class would be a complete breeze if you become a brown noser.  Not my idea of a good teacher.
I don't know about the sexy part, but he is a smart son of a gun.  He is easy to talk to and knows his material.
Puts the fine in fine arts
Easy to approach, sometimes funny, helpful, friendly and kind of sexy in a strange kind of way.
No Comments
No Comments

Super easy 1 credit P/NP class with a very chill and caring professor. Make sure to pick a good group from the beginning since you will be with them for most assignments in the class. Otherwise super easy workload with relatively interesting lecture.

Pass/fail class, you only need to go to the lecture 7 or 8 times to meet the pass criteria. He just covers what a MSE major will go through in their career, and has some alumni lectures. Really chill class and chill professor.
Fantastic professor would definitely take again.

there weren't a lot of hard things, if you can fully understand every concept it's easy to get a high score during the exam. Prof. Zagrebelnyy is trying to make everything interesting and he welcomes your question during class, sometimes he even has some comments on your homework XD he is a good professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: long time no see Ahmed. step foot in Trenton new Jersey and watch what happens
Very accessible outside of class. Clearly very passionate about the topics. Labs were in Java when the prereqs are usually in C++ so that took a while to get used to. Very nice person in general
He is so sweet and caring, always ready to answer anything. Although gives a lot of assignments, there will be extra credits given, so you can always make up.

Delivers amazing lectures throughout the term. You'll need to show up to class so that you enjoy it. Assignments are to the point and will require some effort to complete. Project options are awesome in the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor. Good Lectures. Easy grading but is strict about the deadlines.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This is the Amazing professor I never seen in my life, great lectures, and have a couple assignments need to be complete, and open note Midterm and Final and all complete by home, I will take it again in the future if it have chance.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Really good prof, easy class, accommodating and can attend lec through zoom if needed. Discussion attendance towards your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Ahumada is a phenomenal professor. Despite class sizes being large, she dedicates class time to ensure that every student has their questions answered and feels supported to complete the assignments. She is also very accessible and easy to communicate with outside of class. Overall, she creates a great learning environment!

ONE MIDTERM, DISCUSSION BOARDS, AND ONE PAPER FOR YOUR FINAL, WHICH WAS A VIRTUAL PRESENTATION ON THE PAPER. Overall attendance is not required for lectures but IS for discussion. TA carried, easy grader, and as long as you take notes on everything in the lectures since that's the midterm. Not many assignments. If you follow directions, EASY A!

Such a wonderful caring professor. One of the best public policy professors at UCR. Dr.Elaine always had a welcoming classroom and also keen to always be there helping students. I learned so much from her. One open book midterm and a final presentation+ a paper. There were 2 discussion boards to go with. Highly recommend. TAs grade your tasks.

She is a caring professor and helpful as well the class is almost like philosophy class as we learn about ethics and professionalism and the assignments are 4 online quiz on canvas and a discussion board in which you upload a video speech and one group essay paper about public policy issue along reflective essay and optional online final exam quiz.

Lectures were informative and necessary for quizzes but I found them boring and hard to pay attention to. Not much graded work. The final essay paper was confusing and had no clue what her expectations were, felt quite lost and would've wanted an example of an essay to compare to.
Very passionate about what he's teaching. Intelligent and professional.

Awesome Professor, not biased and always game for an open discussion. He is approachable and willing to work with you on grades if the grader is too hard. I took Middle East and California politics with him and got A's in both classes. He is nice so speak up during lecture.

Professor Motameni was awesome! The class itself was challenging, considering its a W, but the lectures were interesting and engaging. Three 7-8 page papers and one midterm, you definitely need to work for your grade.

Cool professor. There's 3 essays in POSC005W, and they're all 1800 words each, which gets annoying. Also no final exam, but your final paper is worth like 30% of your grade. If you skip his lectures, go to his office hours (very friendly), because you won't understand a thing from the readings. Also no textbook, all readings were online.

Mr. Motameni is the Best proffesor in the world! Whoever is having second thoughts about taking his class should not think twice! I took his class this semester and he was awesome! Hes also a cutie ;)
He's very passionate about  his teachings. He's the type of teacher that will actually teach you something. Plus he is very cute . Take his class you wont regret it.
This class was a bit confusing for me but still managed to pass. The only things that he gave out was the midterm and final. It is a fairly easy class if you understand the lectures.
Politics of the middle East summer 14. One of the best classes I have taken at UCR. Professor Motameni is an amazing teacher. If your a political science major take this class. Highly recommended.
AWESOME GUY! Knows a lot and is super helpful, even without any study guides.

Took politics of the middle east, grat class, great instructer, he's so interested in it that he wants you to be interested in it which is great and makes class exciting. Weighed participation really heavily which i enjoyed. took this in summer school, was a great class to take over summer.
Great instructor, great subject, great method of teaching it. Get's you engaged in what is taking place in the middle east.  Cake Walk.
Took this class for Politics of the Middle East, based highly off participation, he wants you to do well which is very nice! took it over the summer, was pretty easy!
Teacher is great! He answers questions in a timely manner.He is very helpful and responds quickly to e-mail. The material taught in this course can be difficult. He gives lots of extra credit.
Great professor! understands everything and explains everything very clear.. great guy in general. He is a very intelligent professor and knows how to teach it its impossible to fail this class.
Great professor.
Excellent and very knowledgable. Exams are a bit difficult.
This was unfortunately the worst professor I have had at this school. Avoid at all costs. He's a very nice guy, he just couldn't teach his way out of a paper bag.
His lectures will put you to sleep, and don't necessarily prepare you for his quizzes and tests.
He taught the class for a total of 1 day and believe me, he bored the whole class. Based on that one  day, I would say avoid him like the plague.
No Comments

This class was very easy for me personally since I had already taken precalculus in high school. But for anyone who genuinely needs to absorb information, you will not have a good time. Professor Ran's lectures often drift away from the current topic and a lot of times his notes and statements are incoherent. I would self study based on the notes.

, if are taking this level of math for the first time it will be difficult.  All the exams were online and self-proctored and you were given a couple day window to complete them so it was very nice. I would summarize it as if you want to learn it sucks but if you want an easy A its amazing.

Chill class, just self-study for some of the topics that might be more difficult to understand, and you will be chilling. Attendance for the lecture was not mandatory, but discussion attendance was. idk why everyone is hating on him, just do your hw assignments and quizzes and the class will be an easy A. 
I lowks just went to the gym during lectur

He has a really thick accent, but this isn't what makes him a bad prof. He gets off topic very easily and sometimes doesn't even answer the question at hand. He would confuse himself trying to solve practice problems that were supposed to help us better understand the concept.
This class is less confusing when you don't go to the lectures. He is relaxed on his grading, (what would be an A- is an A).

I only attended the first couple of lectures. He was usually behind in the topics we were supposed to cover. The syllabus states that attendance is mandatory and important, though, I am a firm believer that this course is primarily self-taught under Dr. Ran, as he does not teach all too well. Avoid if you are not great at teaching yourself math.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I literally never went to this guy's lectures. It's better to self-study then to sit through his boring & confusing hour and half long zoom lectures. All the homework, quizzes, & exams are on imathas. They are self-proctored and don't have a time limit. I studied at my own pace, and just occasionally checked imathas for homework, quizzes, & exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Self-studied the entire quarter, and his lectures do not match up with homework and exams. His attendance went from 120 to 30 students over the quarter simply because it's better to learn yourself. The content is decently easy (he overexplains) and understandable, and exams and quizzes are self-proctored. The homework/test system is very outdated.

My rating has been removed TWICE now. I have only been honest. Someone asked a question and he said "IDK why I have to go over this but okay." He doesn't teach well and there are problems types on exams that we have never seen before. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR IF YOU CANT SELF TEACH. If you have no choice, read the textbook and teach yourself. :)

Ziv is the worst professor. My GPA has suffered MAJORLY because of him. The exams had nothing to do with what he taught us. He just got the exam from some website, administered it to us with a completely different lingo then what we were used to, rush the last few chapters of class in three days. Absolutely horrible. Rude too. AVOID AVOID AVOID!!!
Worst handwriting and really hard to understand verbally. Nice guy though personality wise, and his homework policy is nice.

Avoid at all costs. Skip lectures and self study. Attending will not help. Changed the due date of 5 HW assignments on WebWork to 3 days earlier without notifying the class the week before finals. We were behind schedule (nobody asked questions so not sure why) and never went over the last two topics of the class but it is on final and had HW due
The worst professor, horrible grading scale and gave no credit for trying on the exams. Take another professor
No passion to teach
Very confusing, lectures don't help but make things worse. Doesn't have office hours, doesn't really care about teaching or helping students. Avoid if possible.

Just finished the worst quarter of math I have ever taken. His lectures were terrible. Overcomplicates the simplest concepts. Handwriting is awful. Average on the exams were about a 50%. Found TA more useful than him. Lecture isnt even worth attending.

Calculus 2 is a difficult class that requires a lot of diligence. His lectures usually start out with proofs but then halfway into the lecture he will go over practice problems that are very useful. I strongly suggest you actually do your practice homework to guarantee success on quizzes, midterms, and final; you'll do great if you stay focused.

Took him Fall 2021. Never went to class because he was confusing. Recommend reading the textbook, studying the hw, and watching YouTube videos. The only useful stuff is his midterm & final review. Grades based on hw, quizzes, 1 midterm, and the final. HORRIBLE WRITING! His answers wouldn't make sense too! Pray that you have a good TA!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Rav is actually a pretty smart guy. He tends to teach the class very conceptually and has very bad handwriting. However, don't skip class! He gives out hints on what's going to be on the midterm/final. He does provide practice exams, but only 60% of the exams are similar. Many students skipped out in his lecture and most of them bombed the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Ran is a brilliant soul and is very kind. His lectures are nice to attend and necessary because he does solicit very helpful tips on what he'd like to see on the midterm and final. Make sure you utilize your outside sources (Professor Leonard on Youtube!!) if you find yourself unsure at times. Take the examinations seriously and have fun!

reviews.comment: I just took this class and it was probably one of the most difficult classes I have ever taken. I struggled with the homework because it was barely explained, so I got poor grades on most of them.  But the test questions were related to the powerpoints being offered in class, SO TAKE NOTES!

Doesn't teach you the math you need for the exams and the book is useless. I got a D on every exam. The class average was 50% so he had to curve it. I went from a D to B. Avoid this class, not worth the stress of figuring how steep the curve will be. He is not helpful at all. Having TAs did make the experience a little less crappy.

Worse professor ever! He doesn't help you much with the tests and was very unresponsive with emails.   It isn't in the text book.  The text only helps you with definiton but that isn't enough to pass the midterms or final.  For the math part of the class, he doesn't teach you how to solve it.

Nothing is posted online, so you have to attend the boring lectures. then he just assumes everyone already knows how to do metric conversions (i still don't know how to). it was a hard class and I failed both midterms & the final. but so did everyone, so he curves it & gives a lot of EC.

His accent isn't hard to understand. The class IS difficult and his teaching needs work, but don't let these people fool you. GO TO SECTION. I went and completed the hw with 95's and scored HIGHER than the avg w/o studying. HARD TO GET AN A in the class SO TAKE IT P/F. It isn't hard to pass this class. 50 ec points to hw and probable class curve.

First of all, the subject is hard to understand. Then, his accent makes it even more difficult and boring. He also doesn't post any slides up, so you have to try to understand him in class. He drops one of the midterm and the homework helps, but it's still hard to pass. DON'T TAKE.

This class is terribly hard. Class was boring and his accent makes it even more hard to understand , materials was confusing. Big half of class did not do good on exams, even though 1 of the 2 midterms get drop. Do not recommend this class or professor at all.

He's a very nice and intelligent guy so I hate to leave a bad comment. However, this class is extremely hard. He drops the lowest of 2 midterm grades but even so  over HALF the class was failing after the midterms.. Section is useless and lecture is very boring.. only take if you have a STRONG interest in the material.. Otherwise you will be sad

His accent makes it really hard to understand the lectures, but otherwise he's a very humble person. Always active at the office hours and helps with the course materials. If you are not into such geography, I recommend you should avoid taking it.

He is helpful and an expert in computer science his assignments are 5 quizzes and 4 worksheet quizzes and he uses the website called Thunkable which is where we do and complete the 8 lab assignment along with extra credit and quiz projects using block code kind of like a puzzle game to run the fun programming application so please take this course.

He's far from the worst class I had. My main problem was just that his lectures were boring so nobody payed attention. At least it works as a good study hall. Attendance isn't mandatory and makes directions clear. He gives extra credit too. He'd defo improve if he had a mic and his presentations were a bit more engaging, but I can't complain much.

reviews.comment: I'm not a CS major and this was a beginner CS course. Attendance isn't mandatory, everything is on Canvas (worksheets, quizzes, lectures), and labs are on Thunkable (easy coding platform). He gives all the instructions to complete the labs, and you can work with others on worksheets. Lots of extra credit on labs, easy A! If you do the work...

He posts everything online so attendance is not necessarily mandatory. He does do attendance checks once in a while and they do count towards your grade but they aren't worth a lot of points and you can make them up in the extra credit he posts.

Labs were easy as long as you follow the instructions. Grading was clear. There was no exams just the labs which were online on thunkable (easy to use). There was worksheets and small quizzes but as long as you actually check the lecture slides he posts you're fine. Great class really enjoyed the labs overall.

reviews.comment: If you want to learn coding, take her class. She's amazing and smart. It was my first coding experience and it wasn't hard. An easy A for those who participate and attend lectures. She is amazing. She is really caring about your concerns and she is understanding everything. The final was heavy but if you really understand the concepts you will be fine. She gives you extra credits for mid term. Take her!!
This being my first coding class, I've thoroughly enjoyed it, largely thanks to my professor. I wish she could be my instructor for future classes. She is amazing and excels at explaining concepts.

Doesn't clearly explain coding if you have questions. Yes she does stay after class for a bit, but I'm left with even more questions after due to her insufficient explanations. Not that great at lectures, most don't usually revolve around her notes. Very difficult if you can't keep up with her coding speed on thinkable.

I loved this professor! She was very helpful and stayed behind after class to give students advice on their coding. Attendance isn't necessary, as she also posts her lectures online but you must show up for quizzes.

Most based professor, amazing analogies that relate to what we are learning in class. Taking CS153 with him and he is very helpful during office hours, very cooperative. Class is engaging and entertaining, operating systems are difficult to understand but professor Abu makes the concepts seem simple to understand. 10/10
Best professor I ever had, truly respect all the work he puts into teaching us this class. Trust me if you get him you are one lucky guy.
Good professor. Hard class but I learned a lot.

Deep, caring, honest, philosophical person who is interested in the development of a student as a person and writer and the development of process that will allow writers to continue learning craft outside the university. If you aren't interested in hard work and deep reflection, than take an easier class so you don't cry at the end.
amazing teacher!!! any chance you get to have him as a teacher YOU SHOULD TAKE!
Easiest creative writing professor I have encountered thus far. As long as you participate in class  you are destined for an A or B (depending on your writing skills.) Really knowledgeable guy..
good teacher
Amazing mind, links everything, can conceptualize anything.

Abani is one of the most unique CRWT professors on the campus. I learned from him that ANY type of art is meant to stir emotions into a person,not comfort the person. It is evident from his assignments that he wants students to think outside of the cube (Ex. using a video camera to write poetry about scenes. His classes are definitely a MUST! :)
He is a great person to work with. I can't wait to see him again after two years of being away from UCR.
abani is a diety. listen to all that the Oracle says.
abani is truly an inspiration.  hands down one of the greatest teachers i've ever had.  ever.  it's a shame he went back to USC.
Completely fabulous teacher. He is so helpful during office hours and his in-class lectures are driven by student discussion, not his own necessity to hear himself talk. Take his class...any class.
class will teach itself. he is great at guiding. doesnt work well with clocks.
love him. I just love him.
No Comments

Take his class, any class he ever teachers. He will be one of the best writing teachers you will ever have. He is not only a good teacher, but he pushes the entire class to be better students and to look 10x deeper at other peoples writing than do any other teacher.
Very funny and caring professor who gives plenty of opportunities for extra credit. She has very reasonable expectations and is easy to approach when things go wrong.
I had her for a few classes and got A's in each. She's a really nice & funny professor. Test are straightforward and open note. I would absolutely recommend!

3 non-cumulative, online, and open-book quizzes that had extra credit questions (LOTS of EC in general). I super did not go to classes or half my discussions snd still ended with an A. 2 disc. and lectures can be made up.

Professor Loyd was awesome! She teaches the course with passion and has this energetic attitude. Every Friday a mini reflection summary of 250 words is due and there is no final or midterm. reviews.comment: I absolutely love this professor- her lectures are interactive & interesting, test are online, tons of EC, & shes really nice. She makes the material really easy to learn. open note tests & no final exam. i wish i could have her for more classes!

The course was extensively organized, but it was confusing. Good, important class for the outside world more so than important class for college. Acker is a nice guy and his class was helpful but the discussions were way more important. Would have been nice if he wasn't so invasive in the class discord,
I took him for writing007 he was really chill and not an extremely harsh grader. If it seems like you are trying he won't be harsh.

Absolutely legendary professor. Grades very fairly and if you put in the efffort to try he will make sure you do well. Also very funny.
Great professor, go to his office hours if you need help. He is a great resource!
