quiet a bit of assignments but just get close with your TA and have them review your work before submitting and you'll do really well, midterm and final are 50 points each out of 1,000 points so its really not much

reviews.comment: Dr. Acker is cool and the fact that he doesn't take attendance is great. He grades fairly. His midterm and final are heavy on the materials covered in the lecture though, and the slides are not posted in full so you'd miss a lot of content.

Professor Acker is great. Attendance is not mandatory but the midterm and final depend very heavily on the lecture slides which he doesn't post on Canvas so I recommend going to every lecture. He also goes over sample papers during lectures to help with every project. Don't buy the textbook, its not really necessary.

reviews.comment: Honestly not a g

Professor Acker was honestly the harshest professor I've taken at UCR. He was complaining about how students left after taking attendance during the lecture. He changed the point distribution and going against the syllabus by creating a "professionalism" grade based upon an attendance audit that was carried out in one of the lectures. -50 points.

His attendance policy is egregious & ineffective. He tried working against students on attendance. Good professors would work with their students, not against them. The fact that students pay thousands of dollars to this school to be responsible for their damn education, is not to be treated like high schoolers with tardy slips.

Avoid this professor unless you want 8 AM classes with mandatory attendance. He rambles, tracks down absent students, and will alter the syllabus to fail you. Disorganized and doesn't explain things well. You have to teach yourself.

He doesn't really prepare for lecture. You gotta study on your own. He's a nice guy but too busy with his research to prepare for lecture. All his slides are lectures he did years ago so he stands there trying to remember what the hell the slide is saying before he teaches it. Causes pretty disorganized lectures.

Meh, his lecture notes won't help you that much. You got to read into concepts and know how to do difficult problems on the exam. Really know how to do the problems is key to doing well in the class. Doesn't seem to know it thoroughly, in my opinion. but gets the job done.
He's a great professor if you are interested in the subject matter, he pushes you to learn, grow in perspective.

I highly recommend taking a class with Prof. Aguirre. He does not use lecture slides just writes a few things on the board but honestly, you learn so much by the way he lectures. He is very honest and passionate about teaching. You just have a quiz every other week but honestly if you read (which isn't a lot) and pay attention in class  A or B.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took this professor once before, for one of those general education classes, and really didn't think much about him. However, after taking this upper division, 5-week summer class, I've really come to enjoy this professor. He tells hilarious narrative lectures that seem irrelevant, but extend beyond the classroom. Would definitely take him again!

I love this professor. I got a C but I could have done so much better if I would have read. YES, reading is essential but there's no book everything is posted online. You have to go to lecture because the tests will ask for information from it. I would love to take another class from him again. I really recommend it, period.

One of the best professor I had! Really funny and entertaining. Go to class, notes will help alot. He doesn't have powerpoints so you'll need to listen. His test is mainly on based on readings and lecture notes. He gives out extra credits on the finals. I would take him again if I can.

Such an interesting professor. He really opens your eyes about a lot of things. Although attendance is not mandatory, a lot of people went because of how interesting he is. He even admits he does not lecture about the reading. His exams are multiple choice, based on the readings and lecture. I strongly recommend this class. No textbook required.

THIS PROFESSOR IS JUST THE BEST SOC PROFESSOR. DOESNT MAKE YOU BUY A BOOK WHICH IS GREAT. ALL YOU DO IS READ ARTICLES THAT HE POSTS ONLINE WHICH ARE FAIRLY EASY, AND NOT TIME CONSUMING. HIS LECTURES ARE ALWAYS INTERESTING! MIDTERMS ARE JUST BASED ON THE ARTICLES AND ON CERTAIN OCCASIONS HE WILL POST QUESTIONS OFF HIS LECTURES. MUST TAKE!

I have had mixed feelings about this professor, but after taking him twice, I must admit that he is pretty easy. You MUST do the reading if you hope to pass. All exams are 95% based on the readings.  Lecture is practically useless. This is pretty much how all his classes are structured. TA Chis Vito was extremely helpful.

No textbook! just a ton of articles. Some are really long and uninteresting. you definitely HAVE TO READ if you want to pass the class. He doesn't go over the articles at all in lecture so that wasn't helpful. Lectures are at times pointless.

He is simply the teacher to take! has stories, jokes, and talks about real issues that are going on. not something off a text book. if you get a chance to take him, i would highly reccommend you do so. :)

Best professor. His down to earth and sometime blunt way of lecturing was very interesting. Loved his clas. Doesn't require a book, all readings posted on ilearn. Read and go to lecture and you should be fine. does more than just lecture, makes you think about life, and just how our society works, with a whole new perspective.

Good lectures. Says some deep stuff. The two things that I thought were bad were: 1. his grading style, only 100 points possible in the whole quarter for a 5 unit class. 2. The class is more of an ethnic(Latino) studies class than it is about American Soc. He doesn't really talk about other ethnic minorities in America and how they are suffering.

Best Professor at UCR! he will talk to you about things exactly how they are, He doesnt know what sugar coating is! except when it  comes to Ghiradelli chocolate lol. We didn't use a book only his readings. If you attend class and read you should be fine. ALL lectures are eye opening and inspirational.

Hands down, if you havent taken him...& thinking of doing so... DOOO IT! most amazing teacher i have thus far had here at UCR. Keeps the class entertained and has funny stories! Go to class and read articles and you should be fine. :)

What an amazing guy. Truly an inspiring professor... Go to lecture.. his final exam is all from lecture.. read the material because its on the 2 midterms. There is a built in curve. Take this class, seriously.. I was scared to at first.. but this class changed my perspective on life, and how I feel about UCR in general.

Most inspiration professor I've had yet. He gave me a new perspective on society and how we worked. I became kinda emotionally attached to the class. (: Make sure to do all the readings because our 2 midterms we had revolve around them. The final had questions from lecture and the readings. Should be simple if you attend lecture and read. (:

He was a great professor I did all the readings and I went to all but one lecture I am afraid I might fail. Guess I'm just not down with the way soc people talk. Overall though my favorite  professor I have ever had. I thought the class was inspirational and very interesting.Hope I pass
AMAZING professor! keeps everyone engaged and entertained..BEST professor I've seen at ucr yet!

Probably my favorite class I've taken at UCR so far! Professor Aguirre is an awesome professor and uses real life examples to explain the material. READ THE BOOK and listen in lecture. He uses his lecture material AND material from the textbook for his exams. I hope to get more classes with him as a professor in the future.

Professor Aguirre was a pretty good professor. Soc 163 contains 4 tests, each 25%. No papers and no attendance, although each test contains 15 questions, about 5 of which come from lecture. It is critical to do the readings and do them well. He wastes a lot of time talking about nonsense but the readings were interesting.

Hated him the first week. But came to really like him. He uses a lot of real life examples in lecture. Seems like he goes off topic a lot but what he talks about is relevant to the class. The tests were based on the readings, which were all posted online. Some of them were difficult to understand. Very easy A if you do readings & attend class.

Dr. Aguirre is the epitome of what a professor should be. His lectures are interesting and hilarious. He uses real life examples to explain sociological concepts. No textbook required. He posts all readings. Readings are easy to read and essential to exams. He is one of the best professors I have ever had at UCR. Highly recommend!
Dr. Aguirre was an AMAZING PROFESSOR. I had him about 6 years ago and am still grateful. You will learn a great deal from this man!!!

UCR Alumni..I can honestly say he's the best professor I've ever had.  I had him every quarter for the last two years of my college years and can honestly say those were the best times.  Very down to earth..Awesome professor..

He does not lecture much but rambles instead. Does not provide clear notes.  I ended up liking this professor a lot!! Gives interesting facts about the economy or about the school. Gave 3 extra credit assignments. Let us use notes and readings for last two exams! I definitely recommend him!!

UCR Alumni and I can honestly say that he really stood out amongst the rest in terms of his genuine desire to teach.  I learned a lot and his down to earth approach and easygoing personality made the subject matter easy to digest.  Enjoyed all of his classes.

He is one of the top professors he's great!!!!! I would take any of his classes he makes everything so interesting. He opens your mind to many of the social problems that we have here in the U.S. If you have the chance to take any of his courses I would highly advise you too!!!
He lectures about nothing then tests you on it
horrible teacher, does not use +/- for grades. Asks specific questions on reading on the tests that is only out of 20. Hard to get a good percentage out of those.

Really learned alot from the class. The required course book was written by him, which is really interesting. His teaching is not for the squeamish or for those who are too patriotic, possibly religious. The quizzes are based on the reading and specific lecture points, so always go to class.

he is a really nice guy, although the class is super boring, but he tries to make it fun by telling many jokes! i just don't like the class material. his tests are very specific on the readings and he looks for specific lecture examples in the paper. so for your own sake, go to class
Very easy...ALL Quizes on reading so read everything
I did not learn from him, he dissapointed me, tests are all on the readings, read, read, read! questions are to specific.
Teacher very helpful. Interesting to listen too. Easy A.
Aguirre is bomb!

As a UCR Alumni I can honestly tell you AA was my utmost fav. Professor and my best advice to you is to learn from him! He is incredible and full of knowledge. AA likes to joke a lot but he's so intelligent you really need to pay attention in his class. Get to know him on a personal level. AA gives great advice!
Verry funny and interesting. Easy A
No Comments
No Comments
He is really laid back and interesting to hear lecture. Easy A.
it was pretty kick back, just the midterm final and att. :o)

Aguirre is hilarious!  His lectures are great.  They're very interesting and if you pay attention, you could really learn a lot.  His tests are a bit difficult only because he gives you 20 question scantrons, so you can only miss a couple to get an A.  It's a lot of reading and he does not curve at all.  Questions are a bit tricky too.

This professor is one of the best professor I have ever taken here at UCR.  He makes the class interesting, fun, and exciting.  I would definately take this teacher again because he is really that AWESOME!!
very interesting teacvher. very pro-minority. definitely take this class. he wrote the book!
Has an interesting approach to teaching. Has the ability to burst your bubble.
This class was very intersting! Professor is very down to earth and very personable

For 165B: HW is on Wiley which is about $130. He grades pretty tough, exam average was in the 60s. Reads directly off the slides for lectures, but attendance is required. 
It's easy to pass, but he can be frustrating for his lack of effort or ability to provide answers to student's questions on the material.
Had him for 021, taking 165b with him rn. he was understanding, and the pace is manageable for everyone

This professor does not put any efforts into his lectures. He just reads off of the slides the whole time and makes attendance mandatory. He makes a 8:00PM feel a lot worse. He uses Wiley for homework which is around $130

Awesome teacher! Put in the work and youll pass. Hes great at explaining everything he is teaching and is sure to give you a good grade if you do all of your work and pay attention! Best math teacher I have ever had!

If you are not good at math like me do not ever take his class. His tests are pretty hard. His notes and lectures are definitely not helpful at all. There is barely any opportunities to bump your grade up if you messed up on one of his test. He helped a lot to anyone who went to his office hours, or anyone he knows/ remember them by name.
You have to pay attention and understand all of the material. All of the resources are available to you so the student has to put in the effort for a good grade.
If your not good at math don't take his class tough grader and really sarcastic i took this class at Moreno valley college !!!!

He's an awesome professor and is extremely fair. He gives a 3% weighted grade. An awesome thing is that if you get an A on the final, he will give you an A in the class. Good incentive. Office hours help so much. He is willing to do whatever he can in order for you to understand.
I thought he was easy until the first midterm came along. I was wrong. But overall he could be a pretty okay professor.
go to class! go to TA office hours before a exam, it helps

Jairo is great! His office hours are amazing. Honestly make a huge difference and sometimes not a lot of people show up so you really get one on one help. Def take advantage of his office hours. He curves the course. Great professor
He gives really clear examples and his lectures are really easy to follow. He curves his exams and finals by a little, but it helps. His notes are the best tool for studying.

Jairo is hot? yeah, i guess. Be sure to attend all his classes. He hands out quizzes in the discussion section of class so be sure to attend those. The midterm is hard if you do not study, but really easy if you do. The final was pretty hard. Overall good class.

Prof Aguilar really wants you to get an A in his class. Curves on exams, relatively easy but lengthy homework, quizzes are easy if you study, 2 midterms and a final. Go to lecture and discussion, do the work and an A is well in your reach!
i did not go to most of the lectures because i could never wake up in the morning, but if you do go, it will help a lot. but do go to all the discussions because there will always be a quiz!

Professor Aguilar is a very clear instructor. All his quizzes and homework are straight forward but when it comes to midterms and finals, they suddenly become hard. He makes his quizzes easy and midterms hard but overall it was an okay class. Just study your notes and really go to his office hours.

Math is not my favorite subject. I definitely struggled in this class. However, Prof. Aguilar is VERY clear when lecturing. He goes through each step of the problems. It is crucial to attend lectures, or you won't do so hot. He is very approachable and seems concerned with the students' understanding of the material. Definitely recommend.

One of the best professor I ever had. I took his class in the summer and went to almost all his office hours. He is very helpful & his notes are really useful. I still have his notes now for future use. He made made really easy but only if you try.
He was a really nice and available professor but the matter of the fact is that its math and you cant wait until right before the exam to study. keep up with the studying and you'll do just fine.
He is extremely helpful and clear when it comes to his notes. He answers questions and does not go through a whole lecture without asking for questions in between.

He is nice and really wants people to pass but his class is extremely boring and homework seems like busy work. He goes over the concepts well but tests are hard. He only puts 8-10 problems so it is difficult, also he does not curve. I give him an average rating, he's not the best but not the worst either.
His a good teacher, gives alot of example :D
If math is one of your biggest struggles, avoid him. Not having to use the textbook should have been the first sign. Lectures are not only long & boring, but he switches the slides too fast.

very good teacher. not really that easy but manageable. If you go to lectures he explains the concepts well. He actually gave us a curve on the first midterm but unfortunately not on the second. HOWEVER whoever Aced the final recieves a A in the class! I was unfortunate in that leading up to the final i had a D+... i studied and got a A! RECOMMEND!
Avoid if you can. He does NOT curve ANYTHING in his class. His notes are good and cover what will be on the midterm and final. But i suggest you avoid this guy.

has absolutely no clue how to appropriate grades. homework can take anywhere from an hour to multiple hours and is only a fraction of your grade. book isn't used. teacher is sometimes difficult to understand. AVOID if you can. awful teacher.

He is a good professor just that the class is extremely boring. I honestly only attended Lecture like 4 times through out the entire quarter and I still passed. DONT BUY THE BOOK we didn't use it at all except for examples. Discussions are mandatory because this is where you receive a lot of points and can ultimately decide your grade in the class.
Class was boring. Don't buy the book, you won't use it for anything except examples.
He is a great professor. You just need to study his notes well. He goes step by step and is extremely helpful. Do not buy the book! you will never use it.
awesome guy, did not pass but its cuz i got lazy, dont get lazy and youll be fine. very passionate man. overall nothing but good to say about the guy

I learned more from the TA than from the professor, sometimes I just couldn't understand what he was saying.The tests were too hard and at the end of the quarter most of his students didn't pass mainly because of that. He assigned too much homework from mathXL and only gave a few tests.

Good teacher. His lectures were fairly clear, his writing was impeccable, and although he had an accent it didn't affect my understanding. I did not buy the book; all the homework was online. He did assign a lot of homework, though. Oh, and if you get an A on the final, you get an A in the class! I had a C and ended up with an A- thanks to this! :D

I have to admit I am horrible at Math and was dreading taking this class. He is a clear, nice man, who obviously loves math. Half my class was failing and I stopped attending after week 7 because I was going to fail it no matter what, as I didn't but my best effort in the beginning and got myself into a hole.See him alot and do all the homework!
He is very clear during lectures and attending class is a must. The class is very fast paced though, so you need to pay good attention.
the class is very fast paced, usually two sections a class. but if you don't understand, hes very good at answering questions.
decent teacher but the midterms and finals are way too hard. He doesnt care if you pass or not. A large percent of the class got d's and below.

He is a good teacher. Notes are very clear! just follow them . Dont buy the book ($100)you hardly ever use it .. unless you want to check some examples from there. Quizzes are not that hard you can study from the Lecture NOTES .
Teacher is understandable. Notes are pretty clean. However not study guides are given you must study by your own, following given notes. He is kool
His notes are perfect. Can't miss a class. He uses all of his time.
Math is my worst subject, but I must say that this teacher does a decent job of teaching the material. Don't waste your money on the book...... all the homework is online. No open tests EVER.
DO NOT TAKE THIS GUY

Professor loves math, his lectures are super clear, and his handwriting is very neat. Don't even need the textbook, all the material you need to know is in his notes. Tests are graded hard, so make sure to study his notes.

Excellent professor. HE IS OBSESSED w/ math..lives, breaths, sleeps it. His lectures are very through and clear. DO NOT GET BEHIND..because it's very difficult catching up. Exams are an evolved form of the material..so STUDY STUDY STUDY. Overall, if you work HARD, you'll do fine.

Amazing and passionate teacher.  Can get boring at times but then again it is math BUT he tries to make it exciting and you can tell how much he just loves math.  Extremely helpful.  There's quite a few quizzes but you know what's on the ahead of time and they keep you on track forcing you to study what you should know so it's a good thing. :)

he is very nice and very clear the people that say that he is hard are the people that do not attend class. HE IS VERY HELPFUL. and goes through the material CLEARLY. I did not the book and for midterms it is easy because it is all on his lecture notes.
He teaches very well, it's nice and clear and understandable. The tests are a little tricky, but with a lot of studying, it's not that bad.
His teaching style is really good; he makes the material easy to learn.  I was really glad to have him.

He is a really good teacher. Make sure you go to class and take notes (he writes them very clear) or get them from someone else. Class is straight forward he warns you of everything ahead of time. Study often to guarentee a good grade. Otherwise get an A on the final. He was a fun professor. All homework was online. I never used my text book.

He is a good teacher,has a funny accent, but good nonetheless. the class is simple. If you get an A on the final, thats an A in the class. The notes are clear and just show up really , and take good notes. You will don fine. He goes out of his way to help( only in office hours) so use him wisely! Other then that, i loved the class and he was great.
sickest teacher alive. very happy to come to class. always uses ever second of his class time. if you go to office hours with him, i guarantee you will get an A.
i had him as a t.a. he's always willing to answer questions, but hes also always trying to prove he's smart so he can get annoying at times. other than that, he's a good t.a.

This class starts up really easy and can come off boring but he actually makes a lot of jokes. My T.A was really helpful and Ms.Lopez was always available before test and quizzes.There is a curve for midterms and final.The quiz,homework,and problem of the day are easy. In office hours answers your questions.You must show all wrk for FULL CREDIT!!

Professor Aguilar is an amazing professor! he has a lot of enthusiasm for math and really loves what he teaches. Professors like that are hard to find! He loves what he teaches and does very well at explaining the subject matter. He is also very helpful when you go to office hours. Keep up with the homework and do well on midterms. Great guy!
One of the best professors ever!!!!

This is a great teacher. He is definately helpful. If you are serious about the course and your grade, i definately recommend this Professor. If you need help, you should go to his office hours; he is very helpful. Two thumbs up, man!
He was a decent teacher, went really slow though, and class became boring.

Professor Aguilar is very consistent in his teaching.  Although he does teach at a slower pace than most professors, it allows for the student to comprehend the material.  His tests are consistent with the material that we learn.  He does not take attentendence for lecture, but is necessary for the student to go to class to understand the material.
he's ok. the first few weeks you dont really have to go to lecture but you should when starting trig. my TA was  no help at ALL! he was crappy!
he doesnt explain good and is sarcastic in a stupid way
He is clear in teaching the materials; I learn things I missed in high school. Though he does go slow and classes may become boring. But it really depends on if you make an effort.
Fair. He was pretty fair and generous when it came right down to it.

Goes really slow over everything. Final was bad  and didn't cover what we "learned" in class. Do not take this professor and I pray for whoever does. He is also extremely annoying, and failed out of Grad school, so that should explain his teaching prowess.

i think he's pretty easy he throws decent questions to make sure that you know your stuff. he ususally has huge class so there's always a curve. he's really helpful in office hours so go go go to his office hours!!
Avoid at all costs. Class Average for both midterms was a D- = what does this tell ya about him? stay far away!
Nice.
Great lectures, good homework policy, easy grading curve and cheesy humor! What more could you want from a lecturer? Aguilar is awesome.

He's an awesome teacher. Yes he has a hispanic accent, but it's not hard to misunderstand him at all. I'm hispanic, but if you don't understand him, you have listenig issues. Seriously.  But overall, he's a great teacher.
He sucks!!! he needs to slow down! math 5 is hard!!!!!!!!!

AGUILAR WAS VERY NICE WHEN I TOOK THAT DISCUSSION WITH HIM.  ALTHOUGH HE COULD BE CONFUSSING SOMETIMES HIS WHOLE INTENSION I TO BE CLEAR AND TO HELP U AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE.  I DO FEEL THAT HE GOES OUT OF HIS WAY TO HELP STUDENTS AND FOR THE STUDENTS TO ENJO

I found that this guy says the words "All right" in this weird whiny voice at least 20-30 times a a lecture. I counted it during math lab and I got about 22 around the end of lecture. Aside from that, he's good at going over everything and making everything look simple, i'm glad i had him over the other ta's out here.
Really helps the students and teaches excellently.

I took this class and I think he teaches much better than some other prof. He is a great TA!I really recommand you to take his class. Yes, he has an accent but even i can understand what he is saying. so you should understand 100% ! ^^
dumbest ever

I don't know what people are talking about.  I suck at Math I failed math five and am doing so much better this quarter.  As far as the accent goes yes you can tell he is hispanic but you can still clearly understand him.  his office hours are really useful. overall a GREAT TA!

Honestly, people who gave bad ratings don't know how to freaking study. If you just show up for class, you'll get a decent grade. He has a hispanic accent, but if you can't understand it, you're an idiot.
Aguilar may not have the best English accent but he is extremely nice and approachable. He is sometimes unclear in his explanations but that's very rare. He is a kind and good TA overall.
not very good at teaching

Mr. Aguilar is a very nice teacher. His class is NOT an easy A; however, you do learn a lot. He teaches very clearly. There is a quiz every week. He assigns lots of hw problems in the book. My advise: This is not a good teacher to take if you have NOT taken Pre-calculus during your high school year
Seems to be a nice guy, but annoying lecture. Lectures seem clear along with homework until you get tests/weekly quizzes. Only one midterm hard as hell...take someone else.
This teacher puts me to sleep every morning and he talks like Fez from that 70's show

Professor Loveridge is the best professor I've had at UCR. He is so knowledgable and has connected me to so many different work places, it is rare to get that opportunity. He is accommodating to essay due dates and the oral final was very easy. Take the time to build your network with him, he is very caring and will help you.
ROL is an amazing professor, super accommodating, and very knowledgeable. I highly recommend for everyone to take POSC 198!

Old school so no Canvas and everything is on paper. Former Riverside mayor and stellar person so respected and great stories. Sometimes hard to tell difference between story and course content. Occasional reading but will be tested on exam. Would recommend class if you want him as a connection for future political/public service career.

Dude is boring. Doesn't utilize canvas because he's “old school” and expects students to be engaged yet will put on a movie that goes over our scheduled time limit for class and talks in slow motion. And God forbid if you have a different opinion than him. Barely explains what the goal of the assignments are too. Its easy, but just annoying. 2/10.
Not that difficult but participation matters. The final project/paper is a lot make sure to make time to work and not do it last minute!
Amazing professor :)

This may not be a good class for those who take it as a short term gpa boosting class, He is a highly respected political figure in riverisde and was elected mayor of riveride for 18 years, Prof. Loveridge will provide you with a lot of internships and opportunities to meet local leaders, take advantage of this opportunity!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: Professor Loveridge is a professor who shows he is highly passionate about his subjects and he clearly cares about his students. You are graded by a few things and there is a lot of readings, but overall it is not a difficult course and I highly recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: What a fever dream of a class. Class lecture consisted of 3-4 guest speakers that you were tested on. Professor very rarely went over assigned readings or course material. The TA definitely carried the class. Stay away.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: I don't know where to start with Loveridge, but my advice: do not take his class. Maybe he's better in person but online, he does not know how to operate classes online. I stressed way more than I had to for this course. DON'T take if you don't have to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dont take this class. Its not about leadership its about trying to save local journalism. The class is unorganized, lectures are incoherent and the grading instructions are ambiguous at best. So many textbooks, so much to write, so little time. Worst of all, rather than hear out the students, Prof hides behind his ego. Steer clear
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Please avoid this professor at all costs. It will be entirely a waste of time for your academic tenure. I mean, if thats the case, youre better off spending time at the public library free at the expense or learning to code than taking this course. Hes ambiguous with his work and unclear with assignments and expectations.

He doesn't know what he's doing half the time and gives unreasonable amounts of work with a lecture that attempts to summarize the readings. regrettably the lectures are painful to sit through, and criticism can be ignored to protect his fragile ego. Literally take any other class, and the entire point of it is to know how to be a journalist. Don't
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I was excited to take this class, especially because of professors Loveridge background and experience in local government. But this class was a total mess with no organization whatsoever. Its very hard to engage with the class and be interested in the things he talks about. He just brought speakers to discuss local JOURNALISM not leadership

While he's very nice, Prof Loveridge should be avoided at all costs. Especially with this course, he doesn't seem to understand that students are under extraordinary stress and circumstances; not accommodating at all. Very unclear about what is needed on the assignments and overall messy class. He doesn't make good time of the class either.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Among the best PS courses with the best professor. Class focuses on fieldwork and the real ins and outs of local politics. One relevant issue for the quarter, readings will be focused on that. Quarter long project on a local city with in-person interviews and a final report. Oral final done with a group. Straightforward midterm. Highly Recommend!

Probably the most respected person in Riverside County. This course is super easy he sets you up with an Internship , great work experience and resume builder. An opportunity to be around ROL is one reason why you should take this. Always so helpful , gives great advice if you're a lost student who doesn't know what to do after graduation.

This was such a terrible course to take. For the first 8 weeks the course seems easy since all you have to do is show up to class. Then he assigns the midterm, which is a comprehensive final of all the course material and readings. All of the points (550) are accrued in the last 2 weeks of the quarter and the final is so difficult.

If you read you will get an A.  He tells you whats going to be on the exam before you take it.  You have to teach yourself because lectures aren't really lectures.  He is friendly and is fair.  It's a fun class.  Final was an oral group discussion so that was cool.  Again do the reading or you're screwed!

He is very interesting, and it's a good class to take if you want exposure to something outside of the University.  Unfortunately you kind of have to teach yourself because lectures are usually open class debates on outside political events.  Exams a re pretty challenging and take the entire 3 hours but do the readings and you should be fine.

This class is taught BY THE MAYOR OF RIVERSIDE. He is a friendly, approachable teacher who has first-hand experience  with P.S. He also has many interesting guest speakers. However, his tests are biased and very, VERY hard. The midterm *WILL* take 3 hours and so will the 1 on 1 final. Warning:THIS CLASS IS NOT EASY. DONT TAKE IT TO BOOST YOUR GPA.
Awesome class. Great Professor.

If you have the opportunity to learn from this guy, TAKE IT.  He is one of those rare political figures who truly demonstrate civic engagement and public service.  His assigned reading, especially "Bowling Alone," is fascinating.  You will have a new respect for the role (perhaps not the people in office) of local and regional government in your life, and the tools to become involved.  Plus, Mayor Loveridge takes enormous interest in students and may be able to refer you to an interesting internsh
Class isn't as easy as it sounds. A lot of reading and exams are very lengthy. Interesting guest speakers. Overall, great guy and good class. Just be prepared to do the work.

He is so incredibly kind. He is the best teacher that I have personally had and it it was up to me he would teach every class I take. There is a fair work load but it always is challenging in a positive way. He makes class fun and he is understanding. He genuinely cares about motivating his students. He does good lectures and clear assignments!

professor brown was a professor unlike any other. he was able to explain concepts with great detail and care. so much so that i was engaged the entire time. i really enjoyed the class because the topics were interesting and the readings were too. solid professor. very helpful outside of class too if you need help.
This professor was always so helpful with making sure what was expected on the essays by clearing up the prompts. He was also very helpful during office hours when I would need feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Sweetest man I have ever met. Really cares for his students and tries his best to make every class fun. He knows when people start to get bored and tries his best to keep everyone engaged. 10/10 best person ever take his class!
Take this class if you want to pass ENGL 4!!!
had a great experience from taking his class :)

Lots of papers, gives you every chance to turn in your best work though! If you decide to skip on days work is due your grade will suffer. Make sure you do the work and read the material. He has a good sense of humor and is adorable. Drops lots of blade runner references. He also is a bit of sci-fi fanatic.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I took his class during Summer session which was five wks only. Due to this reason, it was more intense than before. He is one of the graduate school students in UCR, trying to be a professor. He is nice in overall but a tough grader. He does have solid grading sheet that he is using. Be aware that even if you try your best, you can still get a C.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: He is a very nice professor. I read these comments and at the first lecture, I was hesitant. But seriously, he is not that bad. The material is challenging but its college, every class should challenge students a little bit. He explained the material very well with examples and illustrations. He has a lot of passion for cognitive neuroscience.

I find him unbiased and cool.  Then again, maybe that is my bias because he is adorable.  The whole of my impression comes from his lectures in which he seems interested in studying and teaching and portrays a good sense of humor and eagerness to help.  This is a challenging class.

Awesome professor! Motivates students to try their best to achieve an A. There are quizzes/attendence clickers in lectures. Very nice guy. Talked to him during office hour and was very helpful! I strongly recommend you taking him. Class is very entertaining and he uses videos to demonstrate what he's teaching.
AVOID THE CLASS BUT IF YOU HAVE TO TAKE IT TAKE IT WITH ANOTHER PROFESSOR!!! Difficult class and he makes it harder.

All I can say is avoid!!! He was very arrogant and told the class that he was used to teaching students that went on to get their PHD's, what a jerk! Boring Class! HArd midterms! saying um like a million times! dont take him!!

He explained things in a very confusing manner and did not answer questions clearly.  He did not treat us at our level, but rather as if we were the vast majority of the students from HIS school that went on to get their Ph.D.'s.  Tests were very hard and book was not too helpful.

He's a new professor and seems a little arrogant at times. He spoke to the class as if it was a graduate level class and the exams were difficult. Interesting demos but otherwise lecture was not so interesting. Please take Andersen for this class since he is the one that regularly teaches this class.

Brandon is amazing. For a beginning ballet class, I thought it would just be the basics, but he went way beyond that. He made sure we had fun while still understanding how to do the movements and it was truly a job and something I looked forward to attending.

The best professor I have ever had. He is truly truly an amazing person and teacher. I've taken three classes with him and I'm so thankful to know him. His courses have changed my life in the best way, and I highly recommend everyone take at least one class with Brandon before they graduate! He is the definition of an amazing human!

I took beginning hip hop. I love this class and this professor. He was amazing and definitely inspired me to get out of my comfort zone and DANCE. Let me just say this, I am not the best dancer, BUT it doesn't matter. He makes you feel comfortable and overall just a fun class. TAKE HIM.

I took the intermediate dance class and it was soooo much fun! I was not actually registered but he let me come in and learnt he dance piece for fun. That's right, I did this for my own personal benefit! :) He's a great teacher and he pushes you to learn quickly. I'm definitely taking this every quarter that I can :')

This was an excellent class! The class was very fun and was a great stress reliever.  It was a good workout with the warm ups and the choreography. He makes the class really enjoyable and wants everyone to be creative. He grades based on attendance and effort.

Great choreo, challenging enough to test your skills, but simple enough to learn quickly and add your own flair. I dont care what major you are, TAKE THIS CLASS. And hes hot, which makes it 30 times better:)
Awesome class and he isn't bad to look at.

He grades the class easy, but the actual choreography is challenging.The class was mainly full of women and I believe that has a lot to do with fact that he is sexy. All you have to do is try and your guarenteed an A even if you can't dance. His style is one of a kind and students are invited to watch him perform,must go.No book used and no hw.easy

His class is fun but if you're looking for a bit of a challenge or creativity he kinda falls short. His moves will become a little repetitive. I would highly recommend his class for newly starting dancers.

Took both dance 75A and B with him for Hip Hop. He's awesome, a good dancer, very helpful, very encouraging and a really nice guy! You can make up absences by taking his other or any other dance class for everyday you miss! Easy grade, fun class, and a great workout! :)
HELLA FUN CLASS! take it!! HE is honestly such a cool and nice instuctor! I would take it again =]
He is a great professor and the class is a lot of fun. Plus, you will never have to worry about an eye candy..wink wink! ;)
pretty much an awesome class!

Roy is a great professor but be aware of his final. There are quizzes every week but he goes over them and you will know what to expect-the exams are reasonable and if you do the homework you will be fine. But his final has some questions we never learned like unideal conditions so it wasn't fair game to those of us that actually studied his review
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: (I took both Physics C (mech/e&m)+ Physics B in HS) Aaron Roy is hands down the best physics professor I have ever had. His lectures are extremely clear and well laid out. Even though I played on my phone basically every class, his teaching made me put it away just to experience his inspirational lecturing. Tests were easiest I ever had in college
This class has no HW, but you have to prepare for the midterms that are not easy.

The final was killer. Don't take him unless you have months to study for it. I had an A in 40 A but ended up with a D in this class. He was very helpful and clear with the topics. I leaned a lot but I wish I would have taken someone easier. Avoid if you can.

Roy has the best lectures of any professor I have had. He is clear and direct with the material. He also makes lectures very entertaining and interesting. He makes sure that you know exactly what to expect for exams and quizzes, but they are tough. His teaching style is different but is gaining in popularity. He is changing the game. Recommended.
Teaches by example. Tests are hard.

He is very good. He prepares you for the exams. The quizzes are weekly and are given in discussion. He replies to emails quickly and will hold extra office hours if you need additional help. He is really funny in class. He had is laughing most of the time. I didn't do as well as I had hoped but that's my fault. The class was pretty difficult though

It was a tough course. The midterm was challenging but the quizzes were not too bad. The final was hard but I did well. I had an A- minus before the final and ended up with an A overall. If you want incredible lectures with state of the art techniques, take Roy. If you want to be tested on what's actually covered, take Roy. He's the best lecturer.

Best physics professor at UCR because his notes are very clear with lots of sample problems and tells you what is going to be on the exams.  Midterm and quizzes are easy, but the final is extremely difficult.  Had a 97% entering the final, ended with an A-.

He flies through topics pretty quickly and gives VERY simple problems in his lectures. Midterm is cake. Don't be fooled though. His final is extremely complicated. Even with extensive understanding of the topic, he does't give all the necessary knowledge to do well on that final. Curve was about 5-8% for this class. Don't screw yourself up.

the final he gave us destroyed my grade. i have never seen a test that hard. he is there for you if you need help or extra office hours. i had a C going into the final. his teaching is really good and he prepares you for the quizzes and exams well but i just couldn't keep up. i recommend taking him only if you have a lot of time to spend. brutal.

His exams are hard. The quizzes each week vary in difficulty and they are worth a large portion of your grade. The homework is tedious. He has the best lectures though. He's very detailed and shows all of the steps for solving problems. He is very clear on what he expects. He's also brilliant. He solved challenge problems for us in minutes.

Probably one of the clearest lecturer I have encountered in UCR so far. His notes and reviews is all you really need to pass do well on the stuff he made, but when it comes to ALEKS you still need to rely on the text book a little. I thought the tests were fair and quizzes to be pretty easyunderstandable.

I thought the exams were tough but expected. He gives really good exam reviews that tell you exactly what to study, which is super helpful. The quizzes each week are average difficulty. What makes Dr. Roy the best professor I've ever had is his lecture notes and lecture style. He's really good looking and absolutely hilarious. He's the best.

The Physics Dr. Roy teaches is very challenging and you really have to understand the concepts in order to do well. Dr. Roy is the best science professor I have had in college and is extremely clear on what he expects. You want to go to his class and he's super  funny! Some school needs to give him tenure soon.

after going through 1year of physics at ucr, he is the BESTTT. i regret not taking him for physcs 2b,2c. he is super easy, clear, organized. super awersome notes. makes you engage in class. i got 100 on the final, which was unexpected cuz i hate physics. quizes in discussion help you understand. easy midterms just same problems from the review.

I had him for 2a. I like his class because you don't need the book and no clicker questions. He has his own quizzes that he gives in discussion section. He is really helpful in office hours. The class is pretty hard but his lectures are so well done that I can follow along. He is the best physics professor at UCR.

This class is really hard. I'm not good at math but I did well in calculus but this class is going to end up destroying my gpa. The teacher is clear and really helpful but I think I should've prepared for what this class was going to be like. I took 2a and 2b with other teachers and I thought those classes were easier.

Class was always full, which I never saw in the other classes being offered. It's the kind of class that you "want" to attend. He's funny and talks really loud so everyone can hear. We never needed the textbook because his notes are really detailed. I would  take 40 B with him in a heartbeat.

I found the class pretty challenging. He does a good job preparing you for exams and quizzes and he has the best lecture notes I have ever seen. If you work the problems he does in class and pay attention to the exam reviews, then you can get an A. I got an A but it's the most intellectually challenging A I ever had to earn. He makes you think.
Awful. Can't stand him. very arrogant.
He's just amazing all around. He teaches what's important and is always helpful and makes class fun. Wish all my professors were like him.

My favorite professor. Physics is by no means an easy subject, but Aaron is seriously amazing. He is so helpful and caring. His personality is wonderful. You need to put in the work, however, but this is a University and this fact should not be a surprise. He will help you if you ask. Perfect notes. Great guy! The absolute best.

Great professor, very charismatic and eager to help. Tests are curved slightly; quizzes are not. The final was very difficult (whereas the midterm was normal). Quiz each friday, closed notes: DO WELL ON THE QUIZZES! They're 1/3 of your grade! Otherwise great professor for a hard class.
THEEE best.

Aaron is literally the best; as good as they get. He is so helpful, clear, determined, motivated, challenging, inspiring.. I could go on and on. He is the most amazing professor I have had and I am so pleased to have been his student. He has been my teacher, my mentor, and my friend. I had him for two classes. He is nothing short of plain amazing.

He is very clear and helpful when it comes to the material you need to know on exams. He gives MCAT questions and advice. He's a bit arrogant but he's great at teaching so he's allowed to be. You don't need the book. He posts solutions. Doesn't post notes online so you have to go to lecture (not really though but I did). Quizzes every week.

I've had nothing but bad experiences with physics at UCR. This is my first time taking Dr.Roy and I must say, he lives up to his reputation on campus. His lectures are laser focused, lots of examples (bio related as well) and he even has mcat type questions in his lectures. He presents the material at a high level, but he's so good at teaching it!

Aaron, is one of the best professors I've ever had. His notes are very clear, (all notes on PDF shown on projector) He has nice pictures to go along with lecture too! He's very helpful during office hours, facebook, and email. He will do what he can to help you get an A in his class. I've pulled off A's in his courses with his help.
difficult but good teacher

The best. In just a short amount of time here, he's taken over the department. Everyone is talking about him. All my friends are clammering to take his classes. The review he gave us for the final was epic. His notes are crazy cool. Awesome pictures and a lot of sample problems. Office hours are a lot of fun. The line is usually out the door. A+
The entire class stood up and gave him a standing ovation after our last class with him today. Enough said.
knows his stuff. tough class.

I'm an engineering major. Aaron's notes are groundbreaking. His lectures sound like an IMAX presentation of physics. He captures the audience, hooks you in, and then gets you involved. I have never seen anything like it before. His quizzes aren't too hard. His exams are pretty hard. You never have to look at the book. He's also very charismatic.
This guy rocks. Tells you straight up what he wants from you and his exams reflect it. Love the sarcasm too! Just wish i could have taken him for B.

Pros: Awesome professor, very detailed in his lectures-jokes around every lecture and uses real world examples. Cons: 30% comes from quiz which are weekly, attendance mandatory, hard grading scale (60% is a C-), midterm was okay, final was ridiculously hard (4/7 of the questions had no numbers)I'm not so great at math but I passed with a C- (61%)

This class was ridiculously hard. He hit us with so much material that my eyes bled. I completely agree with the others when they say his notes are detailed. WOW. I didn't even need to look at the book. He presents the material in a crystal clear manner and relates it to things that we know. The exams were challenging but expected. Quizzes ok.

Roy is an excellent Professor that provides the tools you need in order to succeed. Success in the class comes from putting time in. Do the assigned homework, even if it is not mandatory. Roy's tests arn't designed to trick you. Review his clear notes and work through the problems you will do well. Roy is a approachable guy, who will help you out!

This class was really challenging. Dr. Roy was great at explaining the concepts and did a large amount of sample problems. You are constantly writing in his lectures but I appreciated that detail come exam time. His lectures are 1000 times more detailed than my other classes. The exams are hard. Quizzes are average. He makes it very fair.

Roy is very clear on what he wants you to know. No, he doesn't post his notes online; but in class, he tells you exactly what you need to write. Heck he even gave us the exact topics on the midterm AND final! Also he's very helpful during office hours. Definitely taking him again for 2b

He is super helpful and responsive. He replies to emails within the hour. Office hours are a must. The class moves fast but his notes are very clear with lots of examples. His exam reviews are a lifesaver. I would definitely take him again.
Class was okay, taught by example, attendance mandatory because he doesn't post stuff online, 1 midterm not too bad, final came out of no where, very difficult. Difficult quizzes are worth a lot
bad thing is that you have to copy down every example and he doesn't upload any notes online. Very helpful at office hours !

DO NOT TAKE. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED. Absolutely useless to go to lectures, other than the extra credit points he may give out BECAUSE NO ONE ATTENDS LECTURE. He basically reads the textbook to you and does not go over examples because he is unable to do the work himself. Overall, worst chemistry teacher, but he's a fair grader. You shouldn't fail.

The professor is very helpful, but he use difficult materials. You can know more things if you really put your time. If you want to choose an easy course, choose a session taught by another professor. The exam is fair.

Although his accent is hard to understand, he is a nice guy. His class syllabus is really lenient compared to other classes. Quizzes can give up to 10% EC and he gave 3 separate exams (all not cumulative) and one of which could be dropped.

Lectures could be hard to understand (accent and talks fast), but will re-clarify and take questions. Mastering Chemistry was optional, and has used some questions from there in the midterms. Quizzes were up to a 10% EC. Not too hard, just pay attention and take note of what he says that will likely be in the midterms. "Final" was not cumulative.

He has an accent, but if you pay attention and follow along, he is easy to understand. He is very helpful and doesn't go too fast or ahead of students. If students need more explaining in class, he will re-explain. He is nice and office hrs are helpful. His exams are not hard, and it is easy to pass his class. Quizzes give up to 10% EXTRA CREDIT!

His lecture can be boring but if you pay attention it is really helpful, he can be hard to understand sometimes but he explains a lot in lecture. His tests were not too bad especially if you read your book
seems very nice but extremely difficult to understand. Get ready to teach yourself!
his explanation is very hard to understand. his questions are so confused.
thick accent, very hard to understand...
Dr. Nouh was always encouraging and always had time to go in-depth on problems or explanations.
great professor.  an amazing curve at the end

By far one of the most down to earth professor I have ever met.  He is always willing to help and goes above and beyond to help out the students.  Very approachable and makes students feel comfortable to ask question.  He brakes down the material so it's easier to understand.  He very knowledgeable and helpful. I had him for Math 10A, Math 120 too.

Very fun guy. Always a pleasure to go to lecture. He gives extra credit for solving problems on the board and for students that came to every lecture. If you understand the lectures then the midterm and final are no problem. The superquiz that he gives really prepares you for the exams.
Really easy, tests are basically exactly the study guide and he goes over that. Huge curves on exams.

The BEST Math professor at UCR, without question.  Go to class, read through the notes he passes out at the end of each lecture and you are sure to do well in his class.  He's the best SPICY professor ever!
THE funniest proffessor I have ever had, just do everything that you're supposed to do and You'll get atleast a B

Not as easy as some people said. I had a hard time. You should definitely pay attention during the lecture. That helps dozens. TA's go over homework during discussion. Doesn't give as much EC as people say either. We had none on our handouts.
Prof Ait Nouh is awesome and this is my second time being in his class. He is extremely helpful and gives super quizzes that are similar to the midterms. Sadly he wont be at UCR in the fall.

GREAT! Best ever! Knows how to teach concepts in an easy way. Simplistic. If you have the basics down than you will do well on the midterms. Study a little harder on the final. Do your work. He gives extra credit like its nothing. It's not easy to the point you don't have to do anything. You still need to work hard. Not as hard as other professors.
He is the best calc teacher at UCR!! Very clear, gives lots of opportunities to do well in the class. Take advantage of the extra credit assignments he gives. Review sessions helped alot :)

He is a great professor. He gets straight to the point and teaches what is on the test and exactly what he wants you to gain from the class. The exams are exactly like the lectures. Pay attention and it will be easy.

One of the best math professors I've ever had in high school or college. Has handouts after every lecture so you know what kind of problems you should go over. Has practice midterms and finals, and will go over them as a class during the lecture before the test. Very spicy :D
By far one of the best teachers here at UCR. He explains  things clearly and makes the class enjoyable. Do the homework, practice midterms/final, and handouts.
easy class. lectures okay. three hw a quarter lol. gives lots of extracredit. i didnt use book at all. final is tricky but midterm/superquiz is easy.

By far the best professor I have had at UCR. He gives many examples in class and also gives practice midterms.I learned so much in his class, he gives you all the tools you need to get an A all you need is to take advantage of the opportunities. Study hard, try to do all the extracredit, and you will do great!!

Mohamed is a great teacher! He makes sure that everyone understands concepts before moving on. Very helpful in office hours! Go to class, its always fun, he's really funny. Tests weren't too bad, just pay attention and you'll do great =]

BEST professor ever!!It was always a pleasure to attend his class. Super funny and nice! Really helpful during his office hours. He really does a good job at explaining things, and really wants to make sure that you understand the material. Take him if you can!! :)

If you can take a class with Mohamed, TAKE IT! Sometimes he gives you extra credit for solving problems on the board, so if you know your stuff, even better. Really easy to get a good grade. On a minus side, sometimes hard to understand. He is real easy going, if you can TAKE HIM, seriously! :)
Coolest guy ever! i loved his class. very fair grader and will try to help you! I strongly suggest you take his class
I loved mohamed!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Very spicy teacher! very helpful and fair grader!
Good teacher.  Worked out examples and gave us what we needed to be successful.  Funny guy.  Seemed a little distracted at times, but overall I would recommend him.

If you need to take a higher level math class beyond the section he is teaching, avoid him! He is unorganized and only teaches so you can pass his class, not so you are prepared for the next level of math.  His tests are pretty straight forward, but lectures are very frustrating, he cannot explain the material well at all. go over practice tests!!!
just one word. spicy chicken. hes a good professor. take him and get that a
easiest professor i ever took in my life...im not exaggerating..do you want to learn math and get an A, take him!!
he was very helpful and he will help you if you ever need it. as long as you study all the practice midterms you will get a good grade. plus hes funny and class isnt boring.
It was a pleasure to attend his class and he did his best to teach us whatever he knows. I enjoy to be in the class with everyone else.
Thank you so much Mohamed!
He is an excellent teacher who really got me to understand the material. I would highly recommend taking his Math courses !
very funny teacher

Dr. Mohamed has been a great and helpful professor! He is always there to help you whenever you need help and is willing to give extra points to those who are willing to work. I really recommend his class because he adds humor to his lesson plan so that his students are more interested in learning the material.

Dr. Mohammed has been a great and helpful professor! He is always there to help you whenever you need help and is willing to give extra points to those who are willing to work. I really recommend his class because he adds humor to his lesson plan so that his students are more interested in learning the material.

He is a cool teacher that doesn't require you to go to class, but go anyways because he gives extra points to people who show up everyday.  The book is not required so you don't have to spend $100+ if you don't want to.
The instructor's teaching was well planned out. He thought all the materials required to know on the midterms and final.

Professor Mohamed is a really good math professor. He explains the materials very well and provides you with many examples to help you understand. He is also funny and that keeps my strong interest in learning math. If you don't understand the materials, you should go to his office hours. He is really easy to get along with. I highly recommend him

I strongly recommend that you take professor Mohamed. First of all, his practice midterm and final will help you with the actual midterms and final. He is really a good professor and if you do not understand he will provide you with more examples. He is happy to help you with anything and answer all your questions. Take him, you will pass.

This professor was the best math professor I've every had! He's extremely helpful in class and does a lot of examples that make the material much easier to understand. Furthermore, he has a great personality and is very personable so it's easy to approach him for questions during office hours. If you can take him, I strongly recommend it!
He was a pretty good professor.Always talks about Spicy Chicken!His tests were very easy for 10A so there was no curve but I don't think he covered the material so well.

He's a good teacher, explains exactly what you need to know and doesn't burden you with unimportant stuff. He is funny and very helpful. He helped me in 9B even when he didn't teach me. Midterms and final are exactly like sample tests, no pop quizes, doesn't assign more than 10 problems..just take him!!

He's an enthusiastic teacher and can be funny at times. He's not always very helpful or kind though and I don't think he responds to emails. His practice worksheets are really helpful. His midterms and finals are almost the exact same thing. You have to go to class to get these worksheets and the HW assignment. Lopez was a very lenient-grading TA.
love him! he gave useful feedback to the presentation and jumps straight to the point during lectures and explains concepts well

I love taking his class. He's really cool! One of the best professors! His class was always engaging and fun. He's really understanding and available for us. There was a paper for us to write every week, and it helped us to think outside of the box. His class assignment, content, and feedback are valuable in terms of pushing us for the better.
Dr. Roman is one of the best professors I have had at UCR.  I wish he taught more classes as you can clearly tell he actually cares about his students.

Loved this Professor. His papers were easy as long as you did them. Group presentations were 5min and easy guidelines. Midterm and final papers were just as easy. No tests or anything. Definitely recommend taking him. He def cares about his students. Very straight forward.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Loved this guy! His weekly papers were easy as long as you understood the lecture. I like how he had everything posted on canvas day 1 so you can work ahead! Definitely recommend him for bus 109!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Alexandru Roman is a great professor. He does a great job in getting his students to critically think and offers great feedback. He is very understanding and has an impressive background that all students can learn from

Weekly application papers and quizzes. Also, group presentations and course papers are graded. Dr. Roman is kind and understanding. He makes the class positive and aspiring. Not sure why my advisor warned me the class would be taken as a higher level, senior course. Since, it was my lightest course this quarter.

Was a little sus on taking 109 this qtr. From the 1st class tho Prof Roman made it really enjoyable. Everything's available on Canvas from day 1. Weekly assignments are application papers, quiz & group presentations. Midterm & final are essays. Hybrid style course & attendance for lecture and discussion sections are optional. Fav class of the qtr

Professor Ali is super fun to learn from. He makes the topic of reading the Qur'an easy to understand. I felt like even though I had no past information on the topics that I left the course with a lot of new information that I will keep with me. It was a pretty easy class overall, but you still learn and are challenged.

Great professor for the class, I would highly recommend David as your TA for the course. The course is very self explainatory and the questions are not hard if you did the readings and the discussion questions. Overall it was not hard at all just busy work and I learned a lot coming out of it. Highly recommend the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: So much writing for the discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Really easy as long as you do the study guide. Theres two essays and three exams. The study guide contains everything you need for the exams and the prompts for the essay is not bad.
All his test questions come from the study guide so it was never a surprise. There were two essays 3 pages long. TA's were amazing as well.
Great Professor, and his lectures are good too. Easy pass if you just follow the syllabus.

1Midterm paper4-5 pages,1Midterm Exam,3response paper about2-3 pages.1 Final paper5-6 pages. Short presentation. Very accommodating, caring about students concerns. Lectures interesting. Participate & show up to class. It will be counted at the end. Did not have to pay for anything, easy grader. Almost everything due at the end. Would recommend.

I had a great time in Professor Ali's class. He teaches in a straightforward and simple manner. Professor Ali was also kind enough to take feedback from students when it came to important decisions such as deadlines for papers. He also reduced the page length for both of the essays that were due in class. You will definitely get an A if you study!

Professor Muhammad Ali is one of the best professors I have ever had! He is good at teaching and keeps you engaged in class. There is no regular homework except for two papers you have to do, an easy creative project, and a short answer final exam. He will extend deadlines for assignments if needed. I highly recommend taking him :)

Prof Ali is straightforward and doesn't make you do extra work for no reason. Semi-mandatory attendance, 5 2-3 page papers (super easy), 1 midterm paper, 1 final paper, (both 4-5 pages). one take home exam with 8 q's - answer 5. he also is super lenient, extends some deadlines, and dropped the weekly papers to 4 instead of 5 (because of corona).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Really nice guy. He has an accent but it doesn't really impede the learning aspect. The material may initially seem daunting; however, he gives a study guide which is literally all you need to know for the 2 midterms and final. He does clickers so attendance is sorta mandatory. Discussions are also worth 20% of the grade. Free A+ imo.

Professor Ali is so funny! He makes lectures enjoyable despite the dryness of some of the material taught. I did not use the textbook at all and still managed to do okay.
