reviews.comment: boring class
not a good lecturer and very passive agressive. changed the format of the final a week before but it was fair, but did cause some worrying. didnt enjoy the class as much as i thought i would
Her lectures are very hard to follow. Assigns 40-60 pages of reading per week. Very boring and unstructured class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Lucia was, overall, a decent professor. Her lectures were not in-depth, and it made reviewing them outside of class hard. She assigned weekly readings. Her grading incorporates film responses, in which you must watch a film and the reading it pertains to, and write an essay. The rubric is not concrete and confusing at times.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Everyone who takes this class is required to, so a good amount will be bored. I'll be the odd one out and say I actually found the content enjoyable. But it was confusing and there were so many readings. Cool info but not synthesized so it felt like a bunch of fun facts. Go to lectures :)

Made the class harder than it needed to be. She was passive aggressive and called students out for leaving early. Study guides and rubrics were posted late, and grading felt inconsistent. The 40~60 pages of weekly reading and monotone lectures didn't help. She also changed the final exam structure a week before, which made it harder.

Lectures were pretty boring and she would call you out if you were not paying attention or walked out of lecture early. A bunch of reading was required and questions based on readings showed up on exams. TA's graded work and were very inconsistent. Your grade depended on the TA you had. I would not recommend this class.
professor was generally pretty chill and very passionate about the class material!
did not enjoy this class.
There's also a lot of reading in the class. If you show up to lectures, then you should be fine. However, the content is not super interesting, so lectures can diffucult to keep track of.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures are very heavy and very dull, similar to the plethora of readings she assigns outside of lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I don't really remember this class it was incredibly boring, but I got an A and finished the final in 30 mins so… Sad, it's a very interesting topic to me but she was just a dull lecturer so I couldn't stay awake. I have no idea what we did in this class lol I think there was a giant final paper but I just made up stuff about a religious experience

Read the syllabus because its an easy pass. Do well on the research paper/miscellaneous assignments  and discussion is mandatory and worth more than the other categories. I wouldn't worry about the final either because she gives a study guide and its not worth half/a third of your grade like some classes. This also fills two requirements, win-win!
Intro class with lots of into American history, knowledge that if you study a bit you can remember.

took over the summer asynch 2 quizzes and one discussion post a week. 1 term paper, one final. prof was fine but grade depended on your ta as they graded discussions, papers, and frq on final. some ta's graded hard or delayed all grading until end of course. final had 70 mcq's and 3 2-3 paragraph essays and was hard to do in 3 hrs.

There were a lot of reading and movies/videos, 2 papers to write, but the weekly quizzes and discussion posts were pretty easy. Grading was not harsh and the work was manageable overall. The final exam was a bit harder than the quizzes but since the other categories are worth a lot of points, you could def still get an A with a lower score.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Professor Lucia is a very respected professor, however, her teaching style was something that I wasn't very fond of. She was a very nice person often making jokes to lighten up the mood, but it was a little hard to stay focused during her lecture as she would play videos for a long period of time and barely talk. This class has a lot of reading!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Lucia did not care about her students in the slightest and she was often extremely passive aggressive. My TA wasn't great which made the class extremely stressful and hectic. The assignments were not extremely hard but it was a really stressful experience. Would not take her again.

The class was made way harder than it could've been. Final exam had ~75 questions with 80% being multiple voice and 20% free response (takes a while). Not fun to say the least. There's also a huge essay you have to write and another smaller one. Usually there's either one huge essay or one huge final from my experience, not both.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Lucia was a great professor to have over the summer. She had great informative recorded lectures. She was ready to help with assignments and was a lot of help for the final paper. She was caring and fun to talk with. Great class with her to get credit for 2 breadth requirements.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: A really nice and passionate Professor who cares about her students. The discussion and lectures are both asynchronous. No midterms, but there are two papers and a final at the end. The study guide a really good guide for the final. Discussion grade really depends on the TA, but overall a very chill class and I learned a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Fairly easy class. You just have to make sure you complete the readings, pay attention to her lectures and do well on the weekly quizzes/discussions. Youre not required to attend any lectures or discussion meetings so its fully asynchronous. Overall, its an interesting class, but you just have to make sure to put effort in to remember everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lucia is great and class is laid out really nicely. Lectures are recorded and there are two papers and a lot of reading material. Quizzes, assignments, and content were really easy but the final was unnecessarily hard. Overall an easy class but definitely study for the final!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Loved her, Professor Lucia is kind and cares about her students. She's through goes deep into text material. She records all of the lecture so attendance isn't mandatory. Assignments are easy and is very open minded about the direction of our final case study.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Please take one of her classes esp during this covid time period of online school. She's very respectable, knows a lot about Indian/Hindu culture, and is sensitive to the times right now. She can read a room and adjusts her class accordingly, which makes it interesting and overall just makes her an ethical professor. You will not find many like her

There was no textbook used, rather multiple articles. The quizzes are super easy and the paper and exams are easy if you talk to your TA or the professor. It was quite a lot of heavy reading (dense articles), but they were interesting. Her lectures can be a bit boring, but the movies and clips she shows are good. Took moderate effort to get an A-.

reviews.comment: Lecture was very so-so; sometimes it was interesting, other times not so much. Material was interesting but unfortunately lecture was kind of a slog sometimes. If your TA isn't the best then you're kind of out of luck - most of the grade was discussion participation. People usually take this class because they have to, not because they want to.

I dont even know where to start. Too much homework. Too little readings. She curves a lot tho so that comes in clutch. Doesnt care. Not lenient. I felt stressed in her class. I wanted to major in religious going into the class. Now Im a CS major.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Lucia is clearly very passionate about what she teaches. However, the class is sort of all over the place. If you get a good TA you are set. If you're in the Honors Program you're required to take this class, so good luck. How you do in the class depends upon your TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This professor is so unorganized when it comes to lectures. She has no sense of flow and her slides are either big chunks of text or has little-to-nothing on it. This is especially infuriating when studying because the slide may at times just be a giant picture with no text.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very passionate about what she teaches, but I didn't learn anything. She needs to fix the structure of the class and teach!The TA is the one who gives you the grade. If you have a difficult TA, then you will have to work for your grade. The midterm had 10 questions and you had to answer them in paragraphs. The study guide is like the FINAL.

reviews.comment: Honestly the only reason I went to class was for the clicker questions. The final was just like the study guide. I didn't read anything and still got an A in the class. Her lectures were very boring. The grades all depend on the TA. If you have a good TA and an easy grader then you will pass. The essay was sooo unnecessary! GET AN EASY TAEASY A!

reviews.comment: Attendance is based on clicker questions, she talks a lot and has few things on her slides. She is passionate about her emphasis but tends to lack when teaching other religions. reviews.comment: The class is fine until the final. The final is way too specific and is FULL of intentional trick answers. The answer would be in one line of one of her 10,000 assigned readings. Filled answers that are so similar to each other. Gives a study guide but only 1/5 of the final is actually on it. Runaway. Save yourself like I couldn't.

Great professor and was really easy. She has a lot of movies in the lectures in order to keep the class more entertaining. The midterm was a take home free response exam. I definitely recommend that you read all the readings that she provides because the midterm consists most of the content from the readings.

Dr. Lucia's class was really easy and interesting. She makes a really big effort by balancing the lectures by showing movies in class (followed by a pop quiz on the film). Go to lecture because there are clickers. The midterm was take home and was S/A's. The final was really straight-forward and fair as long as you do the study guide she provides.

reviews.comment: Dr. Lucia gives lengthy course readings, which can be helpful to read (skimming is fine). She encourages class discussion and shows movies that are very interesting. Midterm is take home and final is easy as long as you use the study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Gives a very vague description of what she wants for each assignment and then penalizes you for not meeting the expectations. She thinks she's teaching some sort of degree-crucial class!! Very harsh grader, she can take a bunch of points off just because you left literally ONE word out. Her study guide is 11 pages. Assigns lots of useless readings

reviews.comment: Professor gives lot of reading and takes forever to answer any questions giving you less time to work on homework assigned. The professor is vary vague when answering questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Amanda Lucia is a great professor. She is makes her lecture entertaining and she knows how to manage her time during class. She engages with her students and will make sure to answer questions. She does assign lengthy readings but they're interesting and important for understanding lecture. She also gives you time to copy down the slides!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: As long as you pay attention in class, it's an easy A. There's a lot of readings assigned, but technically you don't really have to read it, and if you do, only enough to get through the discussion questions posted beforehand. The study guide is basically the final, so do it and you basically have an A.

Super easy class! I only ever read enough to do the discussion boards. She has clickers every class and it is a super easy way to get points (doesn't matter if it's wrong)! She is really nice and will go over anything if you're confused about it. Midterm was take home and it was LONG but it was not hard. And the final was easy (STUDY GUIDE)!

She is an awesome professor! Just go to class it will all make sense there. She really cares about her students gives really great feedback when it comes to paper proposals. She has quizzes but they are all movie based but show up to class one of them are given at random. Take home midterm fairly easy just look at her powerpoint and look at reading
Worst Professor ever. Extremely difficult grader and rambles on.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I love her. Super cool professor and super interesting. Took her for Yoga class, her test can be a little hard, but one was take home. She grades fair and will help you if you ask.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: It was an easy class if you do most of the reading and go to lectures. I wouldn't say it was my favorite class but I also wasn't interested in the subject. She gives great study guides for the midterm and final which helped a ton. She seemed like a nice lady, but it just wasn't my favorite subject but it was a fairly easy class if you do everything

Gives study guides that are at least 10 pages long. Serious life-saver. Lots of reading for the class but class is still passable without actually doing the reading as long as you pay attention in class. She really doesn't like it when people pack up/leave class early so stay til the end. Go to class - movie quizzes given (sometimes at random).

Most boring class ever, maybe if it's your major you'll love it, but it isn't as easy people make it to be, it's time consuming, but easy. And she isn't funny, like AT ALL. I don't know what the other people were talking about. Lots of reading, but it's not necessary, just know church is bad and whites are evil and your good (class in a nutshell).

Dr. Lucia was great! The grading was very spread out so even if you did bad on one thing you could still get an A in the class. Also, she tends to stress students out about the readings but they were hardly covered in the tests, & if they were it was just the main points that were discussed in classdiscussion. Read almost nothing & still got an A.
I really enjoyed Dr. Lucia's class. Not only  are her lectures interesting, but she's also funny!

Class has 1 midterm, 1 paper, and final. You MUST go to lecture for this course. The weekly quizzes are based of the notes she writes down in lecture. This class is an easy B, if you put in a little effort and study all the notes from lecture and her study guides you can get an A. Also you are allowed a note card on both mid  term and final.

She's a very good teacher overall. Her classes were interesting, and she prompted topical and insightful debates within the class. She isn't afraid to make you step out of your comfort zone and pushes you to do your best. I really enjoyed taking her class and would recommend to her highly!!

Lectures at some points are difficult to understand, but she has office hours and is willing to work with students. Don't be afraid to ask questions. The readings are intereting,sometimes long but help. She also shows interesting videos. There are short quizzes, short essays. If you listen and take notes you'll be fine. It's a good class overall.

One thing that amazes me is that professor Art talks connects his personal life towards the business topics we learn about in his lectures. He lets use a reference sheet for both the midterm and the final. The peer review assignment does sneak up on you. Overall, great professor.

Really charismatic professor. The class itself is pretty simple, the only complaint is that the mid-term and exam both have really specific questions that he does not teach you at all. However, all tests are multiple choice and true or false so it isn't that bad at all. I would take him again for sure.
Good professor and it's an easy class.

Great professor, but it's his first year monitoring a freshman class, so it was tough. Timelines for quizzes were off, and heavy group projects; he seems to have struggles with the grading. Go to his office hours; it helps! He shares a lot of life experiences during his lectures, but his exams are textbook-based, and beware of group projects.

Great lecturer and presenter. His class is lecture-heavy. He included questions about guest speakers and his common phrases. He allowed cheat sheets on all exams and provided study guides. We had 4 group projects which were worth significant chunks of the overall grade. They are done with the same group throughout the quarter, so pick wisely.

final had lots of random info from class like guest speakers that didn't really correlate with course material. Group projects are 35% of your grade and is a deciding factor on the outcome of your grade. I think he is a great person but not the best lecturer. The weighting of each category (eg. project, exam, attendance, e.t.c.) is very choppy

Lecture is not required but the exams have the most random facts from lectures. Guest speakers and what they talk about are on exams as well as student presentation. Also, heavy on group projects, you can get okay grades on final/mid as long as you get good grades on the project. Random textbook questions too. Overall 10% is random questions.
A good prefessor very upbeat and ready to connect with students. Syllabus states attendence is mandatory but only took attendance like the first week of class.

Professor Art is the best professor out there. He shared a lot of his experiences. He helped the students a lot, and he's always available for us during office hours. His assignments are not difficult. He made everything easy for us.

Awesome teacher, Easy A, I didnt get an A because i didnt attend all classes but class attendance points matters and exam is a 100 questions at the end of the quarter. There are cengage assignments and group assignments and thats it. Cool professor he was really chill. I would love to take him for more electives.

Professor Alcaraz is a great person and always does what's easier for students! Be mindful when picking your team, as you're stuck with them for the whole quarter and that makes up a decent size of your grade. He has a lot of knowledge and experience that he shares during lecture and I hope I can take another class he teaches.
He is a great professor. His lectures were very informative and inspirational and integrates stories into his class sessions to better relate our material to the real world.

Lectures can get a little boring sometimes, but overall professor is a really genuine and nice guy. Super understanding too so if life happens while taking the course, he'll be forgiving. BUS 154 with him wasn't too bad, just expect to do a lot of reading but it was a law class so that's expected.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor is very nice and caring. He really wants you to grasp the concept of the course. I thought this was going to be an easy course but it hasn't. He assigns homework on Cengage that is due every other week and it includes 3 chapters each time. Tests are lengthy and are not curved. Quiz was 50 questions and midterm was 100 questions, no notes.

He is amazing! He emailed me because my last name on MindTap didnt match the roster so it looked like I didnt take the exam. Took the time to contact me to see if something happened. He went the extra mile to check on me even with a large online class. He is fair & knows his stuff. I still email him regularly with questions and he is very helpful

online class bc COVID. case studiesgroup projects(not too bad to do and not like other big group projects)& you have 2 of them. The 2nd one you present in class. Most genuine and caring professor you'll meet @ UCR. The time given for the final doesn't reach 2hrs and it's a 100MC which makes you feel uneasy. uses textbook ALOT & nice PPT slides.

Took him for Bus 154 and he's one of the most genuine and caring professors I've had the privilege of taking. We had 2 case studies, 2 quizzes, and 2 exams and you'll be fine as long as you pay attention in class and have your book. He also gives great feedback and cares about the material he presents. Definitely take!

Not sure why there's bad reviews, but he's an amazing lecturer! Would get handouts with important quotes from readings, which are very useful for the assignments and for our understanding of the readings. His lecturing style is very engaging and he elaborates well on the readings during lecture. Reading heavy so come to class prepared.
Awful

Ignore bad reviews, He is an amazing professor, he is passionate about what he teaches. There is a good amount of reading to keep up with but everything he assigns is so interesting that you want to read it. Discussion with Miss. Abby was the best I miss our small group!

reviews.comment: WORST teacher! Pretty sure all the positive ratings came from him.I learned what he wanted to hear in the assignments so I did well but I learned absolutely nothing. Attendance is mandatory yet lectures have nothing to do with the material. So aggressive and would talk shit about students who gave him bad reviews.created hostile environment

this professor absolutely blows bro 
he grades papers unfairly ( does not adhere to a rubric ), loves grading through semantics and subjectivity. super hard to please, boring class, does not engage class well, talks way too much for a class that should be discussion oriented. one of the worst professors i had at ucr. run
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Garcia is a Great professor. Yes, he comes off a bit intimidating but once you visit office hrs or after class, he's approachable and will engage. I loved just about every reading and lectures were interesting. Make sure to take good notes and pay close attention.
Great professor! Would definitely take again. Very nice man
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: One of the rudest professors I have ever had! He is not personable and is most definitely unapproachable. He basically just liked to hear himself talk all the time, and never really said anything of importance. Also, there is no reasoning behind his grading style. He either likes what you write, or doesn't, and that decides your grade.

I agree with the criticisms, but Garcia's course is very interesting and he provides great feedback and clarification when meeting one-on-one. He is approachable during office hours and after class. Provides great feedback on essays and the readings are interesting. He always comes to class with energy and his witty comments are great too.

Professor Garcia was very unapproachable, rude and disorganized. He grades very hard and doesn't give reasoning behind the grade. His quizzes are full of abstraction and trick questions. He treats students very poorly. I would not recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Worst professor on campus. Very unclear, repetitive, and he would refuse to listen to students or respond to their questions. Very clear that he came to class unprepared and had no idea what he was doing. Did not give clear essay instructions, graded assignments the last day of the quarter, refused to give a majority of the class an A. Very hostile

He constantly repeated himself, but awesome Professor. He is as approachable as a person gets! Very nice man. His main interests are LGBTQ and gender readings allongside slave narratives. Very interesting class. I enjoyed my time in his class. Lots of reading, many essays, but half were one page essays. Not the hardest class I have ever taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Would take again

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved Prof. Garcia. He is clear on what he wants to see on papers and lets you rewrite them to up your grade. He actually wants to hear your opinion and argument instead of just regurgitating exactly what he wants to hear. I recommend him because he will make sure and put in the time to make sure you are successful in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took him for an MCS class and he was the real deal. Heard he was a tough grader but that wasnt the case for me in this class. Very helpful for the papers and you can tell he really cared about the students writing progression. I would recommend taking him at least as a TA.

Seems like a chill guy outside of class, but grades the papers like hell. Ok teacher, but has things to improve on. No one in my class got above a 70% on the first paper. Probably the toughest grader I've had at UCR. I'd overall recommend you avoid taking his class because it's legit impossible to get anything above a B.

he's very easy to talk to and most of the classes are discussion based. pretty funny guy, classes are enjoyable, but he grades essays pretty hard. but if you get started ahead of time and ask for feedback/go to office hours he's incredibly helpful and will give you a good grade.

Absolutely amazing. How do I even start with this amazing man? Firstly, he never overcomplicates his lectures. They are on point and CRISP. Second, even though his grading scale is mostly based on his mid-term and final with no quizzes for Math 009B at least, his homework and lecture notes translate very well into the exam.

reviews.comment: Truly an amazing professor, love his commitment to not over complicate topics, class is graded by few things and while there are no study guides he's right review his lecture notes and you'll be fine on the exam. He's super approachable after class and in OH. He really is committed to not over complicating topics and simplifies things great 100/10!

reviews.comment: This professor is hands down one of the BEST instructors at UCR. He truly cares about each student and will literally help give you a good grade in the class as long as you attend the lecture and are trying. His practice midterms/ lecture problems reflect the midterms/ final. As long as you are putting in the work you got that good grade.

Easily the best math professor I've ever had and maybe will have. Very straightforward class. Go to the lecture, understand, review and study examples, practice with the homework, and an A is guaranteed. Very happy to answer questions and encourage it. Tells you what to expect on exams, and there are no tricks. Great office hours too. 100/10

 .

reviews.comment: Professor Moradifam is an excellent professor. His exams are identical to his lecture examples and homework problems.
Amazing professor! Do the homework, attend class for notes, and you'll get an A. The midterm and final are very similar to homework, so study those !
One of the best professors I have had and exams are very similar to lecture notes so I recommend going to class.
amazing prof, wants you to do very good

Easily the best math professor I've had. As long as you go to lecture, understand his examples and homework, you are guaranteed an A+. He was very clear and answered every question, no matter how dumb. He held many office hours throughout the week and the exams aren't going to throw a curveball at you. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.comment: This professor is really good. I was really intimidated by the class when I first enrolled since the content was known to be hard but if you have him as a teacher, you are set. He is very helpful in office hours and if you have any questions at any time, he will happily answer them for you in lecture, through office hours, or even through email.

Overall a great professor. He cares for his students and does provide extra help during office hours. Lecture notes aren't posted so attending lectures are a must and the lectures themselves aren't bad either. If you understand what's going on in class and understand the hw problems, the midterm and final should be just fine.

Definitely my favorite professor so far at UCR. If you take notes during the lectures and make sure you understand every problem on the webassign hw before midterm/finals, there's no reason as for why you shouldn't get an A+. he always sends his office hour notes after office hours as well. very considerate professor

Professor Moradifam is the best math professor I've had so far. Attending his lectures is essential for success in his class, and fortunately, they are excellent. He genuinely cares about his students, which enhances the overall learning experience.

Great lecturer who really cares about his students and their grades. His midterm and final are similar to what he covers in lecture and the amount of homework he gives is reasonable with generous due dates. Definitely one of the best math professors I've had.

This instructor/professor is one of the best math teachers I had. Because I am already familiar with the material taught in this course, I can confirm he did an excellent job in explaining the material to his students and he knows what he's doing. He even teaches proof in the beginning of lectures to prove why certain concepts exist.

Moradifam was a great professor. It is easy to get lost in his lectures but just write everything down and do the homework and it is an easy A. His midterm and final is exactly like the homework and lecture examples (if not easier) with just some changes in the numbers. He is also helpful in office hours and attend discussion it helps a lot.
Attend every problem solving session and class and youre set up for an A. This professor is amazing and will work with you to get the grade you want.

His lectures consist of going over many questions. He doesnt provide and practice tests to prepare for the midterm. If you just copy down all his example problems he goes over in lecture and study them, you will get an A. He will not put anything on the test that he did not go over in lecture. The class grade is heavily dependent on his exams.

reviews.comment: Fantastic teacher. I never understand derivates too well during calc9a, but 9b seemed so much easier. He explains the concepts easily and his midterm exam is just like the hw. The HW is also relatively relaxed compared to other math classes.
Great professor! He holds many problem-solving sessions/ office hours to take advantage of. The exam problems are similar to the homework problems assigned.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: One of the best math professors at UCR. He is a great lecturer and has nice handwriting. Outside of class, he has many office hours. The homeworks are a bit tedious at times, but they're very important to your learning. His exams heavily mirrored his hw. Your grade is 20% hw, 20% Midterm 1, 20% Midterm 2, and 40% Final.

One of the best teachers at UCR, especially for calculus. I barely used the textbook, if I remember correctly. Calc9b was soo much easier thanks to him and he makes integration an easy concept to learn. There's barely any hw compared to other teachers. The midterm is an easy A because all the questions have been reviewe in class and some are hw q's
I first took math9a and hated it, but when I took math9b with Moradifam I loved it. He's a great professor who helps students learn by examples. I wish he taught higher math classes.

reviews.comment: This teacher is awesome. He explains very well and his office hours complement the lectures.

Amazing professor. Really cared about students understanding the material and made it extremely possible for  students to access him (problem-solving sessions, extra office hours, etc.) Easy to learn from, loved him.

reviews.comment: Perfect teacher. Best math professor I have ever had.
I thought he was a dull lecturer, but nothing's too difficult.

Prof. Moradifam is a fantastic lecturer and teacher who really wants to give you the information that you need so you can understand and do well. His homework is the perfect amount, his exams are completely fair, his reviews are an absolute must because of the content he covers, and he's always open to questions and explains everything perfectly.

He is a very good teacher and lecturer. The material is tough, and he does make you work for it. However, he does ALOT of office hours. He also says at the beginning of the quarter, if you go to class, do the homework and ask questions, you get an A. This is a class that you have to work hard in, getting an A is possible.

Great introductory Spanish prof, strikes a great balance between English and Spanish - learnt a lot! The amount of homework is ridiculous but that's just the department. Tries to help all her students, really kind. Fair grader in oral and written exams

Took her at Pitzer for GE spanish. Great professor, funny and engaging, assigns some homework, but is helpful and allows you to make up lost points with extra credit. Speaks in english if you cant understand, and is a great choice for an easy A.
No Comments
Ella es muy carinosa. Ella quiere que su clase aprenda mucho de espanol. Tambien, ella da los dulces durante la ultima clase. Por fin, ella es muy bonita.
She is awesome.  Really nice lady.
Please, think twice about taking any of her classes.

I was disappointed because the material was actually very interesting. Dr. Atit made the course more difficult than necessary. Unreasonable assignment due dates and harsh grading with very little explanations. Her feedback gives off hints of sarcasm and make you feel helpless and beneath her. I wouldn't take her again

Tough grader and when you reach out to her, she is not very understanding. She doesn't provide actual feedback to improve on assignments, and will just tell you to meet her at office hours so she can explain. Her explanation is not even helpful during office hours however. This is an easy class but the professor makes it difficult for no reason/

She is inconsiderate of student's hardships, if you email her about a serious health issue or a serious incident she does not care, she doesn't accept late work AT ALL, no matter the reason. She also puts in the bare minimum effort with her 5 min recorded videos.

Awesome instructor who wants you to learn. no midterm or final just an easy 3 page paper and 3 'quizzes' which are noncumulative. as long as you show up and pay attention the quizzes are straight forward. she does poll everywhere for participation points. she wants you to succeed and is one of the best professors you'll have.

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Atit for a first year seminar class and it was extremely easy. She is so sweet and cares so much about her students and what we, as education majors, want to change in education. She let's you speak your mind in regards to the (small) articles she asks you to read and never undermines you. I loved her class.
One of the best professors at UCR. Exams are tough but I learned a lot in this class. She brings a lot of energy and makes the class interesting.

I felt that this class was a lot more complicated than it needed to be. I took a class similar to this before and when we went over the terms again I was excited because I knew them already. By the end of the class, I didn't know what those terms meant because I was so confused. She asks you the smallest details on the test, take a different class.

Great lectures that were extremely clear and intuitive. Lots of review of linear algebra which helped with understanding the foundation of optimization. Notes and practice exams were posted online which were very helpful. Exams were extremely fair. Homeworks were easy for the most part. Overall, one of the best math courses/professors at UCR.

He knows his stuff and can explain things very well. He comes up with examples in class on the spot which goes to show how well he understands the material and how to teach it. Chill personality and willingness to take questions after class. Quizzes and tests are way easier than HW so if you really try to understand HW you will do well on exams.

Material is very challenging but Professor Attarchi explains topics very well and tries his best to allow students to understand. 5 (biweekly) quizzes, 1 midterm, 1 final, and homework constitute the grades. He makes the practice exams/reviews very similar to what you will see on the final and midterm exams.
Great Professor. Take him you wont regret it.

Grade is based on midterm, final, a couple quizzes, and homework. The professor is a great lecturer, going through examples in his notes that were similar to the homework and quizzes. His review is very similar to the midterm and final. One of the best professors at UCR!
Professor gave fair homework and exams. Worked through examples that were very similar to what was on midterm and final. Didn't give too much homework and exams were short.
Best lecturer and professor!

Excellent lecturer and professor. Had him in winter 2023, very caring and accommodating to students' needs or extensions. practice problems/notes in lectures were similar to questions on quizzes and exams. Midterm was more difficult than final but both were relatively easy. about two hw assignments per week

reviews.comment: Highly recommended. He is the best!

He very well knows his class. HWs were extended and tests were usually 1-2 questions based on the homework. The material isn't that difficult if your math background is solid. Absolute gem of a professor at UCR.
Solid professor. He gives really useful practice midterm and final. Tests are closely related to his homework. If you do your homework and read his lecture notes, tests are super easy.

He is not a bad professor, but he tends to ramble a lot during lectures, losing class time and falling behind. reviews.comment: He's not a bad professor by any means but he rambles a lot. Good teacher. Recommend. Accessable online lectures, seems very passionate about the subject.
His exam is ok, but he always makes mistakes on answers, which is very confusing.

I really enjoyed this course since the professors course theme was eco-horror. Course load wasnt overwhelming, and there werent any unnecessary busy work assignments. Assigned readings are pretty short, but theyre effective supplementary material for the essays. Essay prompts and in-person activities are engaging and creative!

Professor Attebery is such an amazing professor. She genuinely cares about teaching, and wants the best for her students. You do not have take quizzes, the essays are fairly easy (if you actually try), and she offers extra credit here and there. 11/10 i would recommend that everyone takes her for literally any english class.

Gives a lot of feedback but is passive and hard to completely satisfy.

I got her for engl4 and I really learned a lot in her class. She is a very very tough grader so get ready to spend a lot of time working on your essays. She gives great feedback on essays and drafts to improve your writing. It is a very relaxed class and there is only 5 essays including finals (might change).

I took her for 1C and her class was pretty cool, we watched Steven universe and movies and then wrote about them. Didnt have too much essays to do she was really smooth on the work load. I really enjoyed her class and this is from someone that absolutely hates English(Econ major). I recommend taking her shes a really good teacher in my opinion.

Homework given was to watch Steven Universe and write paragraphs... it's not that bad LMAO. Plus paragraphs done go into the final essay, so all you have to do is copy and paste everything together. Easy class work wise, but she grades based on the work you put out. Just follow the writing templates she gives and you're good. (taken summer 2019)

Professor Atkinson's differential equations class was my 2nd attempt at the class and the teaching method between him and the old professor I took at a community college was night and day. I enjoyes his class a lot and hope he teaches the upper division math classes I need! As long as you do the homework and pay attention in class, you'll do well.

Dr. Attaway is one of the most caring professors that I've come across at any institution. His lectures are easy to follow and he stops frequently to ask for questions. Professor Attaway is one of the best professors in the School of Business! He cares for his students and enjoy his teaching style, although he can run through lectures pretty fast. 100% recommend taking Attaway, especially if it's for an upper div class!

reviews.comment:
i really enjoyed this class. the professor explains it so well and keeps the vibe enjoyable and light hearted, this was def my comfort class within the other classes i was taking.
interesting material, easy assignments, barely any homework. you'll probably have 2 or 3 assignments in the whole quarter besides the midterm and final

Always ends lectures 20–30 mins early. The material can be a bit dry and boring, but attendance is required since he uses PollEV. reviews.comment: One of my favorite classes by far! Professor Attaway has a great sense of humor and sarcasm which will keep you engaged during the class. 4 quizzes, final paper (no final), group case presentation, and discussion attendance will be used in grading. Overall, this class was enjoyable and I would definitely take it again.
He is genuinely an amazing person and professor. He is extremely caring and gives super fair exams that are exactly what he lectures on!! Could not recommend him more honestly.

Prof Attaway is enthusiastic about teaching. The course is easy if you go to lectures and do regular review sessions on your own. However, it is a bit lecture, exam, and content heavy, which means if you screw up once, you probably can not get higher than an A. Attendance is required through Pollev, and two absence is allowed.
Cool guy but this class did not need a mandatory lecture. 1 midterm, 1 final, 1 group presentation, 1 term paper 10 pages. Extra af for giving us a term paper...

Honestly, the dude is chill and understanding. He makes lectures easy to understand, and he'll try his best to answer questions in a timely manner. There are a few quizzes (which are beneficial, so be mindful) one group project, and a term paper. Advice: Don't drag it out until last minute; take notes to help write the paper (it will save you time)
Yep, 5th try. Hopefully I'm not censored again for submitting a negative review. I wish I got more from the class. My opinion and that's cool.
Dr. Attaway is great i loved this lectures. There are 4 quizzes, 1 big term paper, and a group presentation. He provides extra credits. Best professor. I highly recommend him!

Dr. Attaway is one of the best professors I've had the privilege taking! Caring and compassionate about his students and the case studies he assigned were interesting and kept me engaged throughout the quarter. If you have the chance to take one of his classes, do so!!!!

I never thought I'd write a Rate My Professor review, but Dr. Attawat is that good! Best professor ever I had no interest in HR, but he changed my perspective. He's super chill, explains concepts clearly, gives real-world examples, and his material is easy to follow. His activities are THE BEST and he truly cares. Take his class you won't regret it

The professor was very kind and easy to get along with. His grading criteria were flexible, which I liked, but also made the grading criteria a little unclear at times to some students. Most of the course revolved around working with others for assignments, projects, and finals. However, all of the coursework was reasonable and not very stressful.

Dr. Attaway was interesting and fair. Wasn't my favorite professor, and I feel I could have gotten more out of the class. Attempt 4: stop reporting.
Take this class if you don't care to learn and only want a chill professor. The students love him because of how easy he is. Oh, and they delete honest but respectful reviews on here.
Dr. Attaway was a great professor who cares about students! If you have the opportunity to take a class he's teaching, do it! Uses a lot of emojis in his emails.

reviews.comment: Easy class if you just want to pass.

Very good Professor. 4 quizzes: 3 non-cumulative and 1 cumulative. Group project that is pretty easy and straightforward. Term paper due at end 2500 word max (500 words is a reflection). Attending lecture will help a lot and Professor makes it engaging and fun. Very useful class for anyone.

Great professor! I have him online; class was fun and easy to follow. He will upload his slideshow, so don't worry if you missed class. The group project is a case study. you can totally do it over zoom, but sometimes the timeline is kinda confusing. Overall, it's an easy class.
4 quizzes, 1 group project/presentation, 1 term paper, discussion attendance required/ lecture attendance not required, laidback and humorous class

Prof. Attaway created a safe space for discussion, which was critical for this class. His lectures were fun and engaging, and the class was pretty much stress free. No homework, but there were two big papers. Attendance not required but heavily encouraged!!!
Great teacher, not only was he kind and caring professor, but actually put in the effort to make sure that everyone who needed help received it.

1 group project, 4 quizzes, 1 final paper & extra credit opportunities. Discussion attendance is graded. Material is very easy & he spends time to ensure everyone understands. The grading is fair and he cares that you are taking something from the class which is great! One of my fav professors so far.

BEST TEACHER EVER! Most caring professor, its obvious he wants us to actually learn instead of stress over grades. Ive learned so much in this class and can actually apply it to my life, he makes the class so interesting. He takes time to answer EVERY students question. Such an amazing professor and individual. take him if you can its worth waiting

This class was fairly fun in my opinion. Professor Attaway is very personable and funny. His grading structure is 40% on four quizzes, 10% on discussion attendance, 25% on a group presentation, and 25% on a final paper for your total grade. Overall, not a lot of work but very stressful if you bomb a quiz or do poorly on anything else.

BUS107 was an interesting class to take with Dr.Attaway. There are no midterms in the course, just quizzes, a term paper, and a group case presentation. The course is pretty easy if you do all of your work, and there are extra credit mini-sims that are from the textbook. (you don't need to buy; just use the trial).
Extremely easy professor and course. You have one term paper, 4 quiz's throughout the quarter, and one group case presentation.  Overall really easy. Attendance is also only taken in discussion.
Amazing Professor! Communication was great between the TA's and Professor, and hes very caring and understanding! Would definitely recommend!

I had Dr. Attaway for Bus 107; he is a very knowledgeable and caring lecturer. He makes sure to stop and answer any questions to clarify information, and keeps the class engaged by having interactive (and voluntary) Q&A sessions. His coursework is not difficult, but does require some time management skills.

reviews.comment: Literally one of the best professors I've ever taken. Attaway is chill and laid back while also being amazing at explaining things in a clear and concise manner. He is enthusiastic about the material he teaches and is great at putting things into perspective. An amazing teacher who I would strongly recommend has a genuine passion for helping others
Very easy and chill professor. Def try to take him.

He is a very funny teacher and seems to actually enjoy teaching. I learned a lot about Human Resources and really enjoyed lectures. You have readings on Tuesday and actual group assignments due Thursday. You have group project presentation and Final Paper. No exams! I recommend to take!

Took him for Bus 155
There was a reading every week. Few people read them so we ended up going over them in class. Tuesday was for learning about the reading and Thursday had a short graded in class activity. Most of the grade is in the group project due at the end of the quarter, the week 10 in class assignment, and the final.
Lecture was fun

reviews.comment: Professor Attaway is amazing. I took BUS 107 class with him. Very fair class and attending his class is very important but not mandatory. He is very chill and funny.
I had Professor Attaway for 2 quarters in a row one in-person class and now in an online class. Both were really easy and helpful 10/10 recommend.

He was a new professor last quarter. He was an amazing lecturer, who really got the content across to us students well. His grading was super lenient as well, as his TA's were all really chill. The work was not hard, with reflections due every Friday, and two essays due throughout the quarter. Also, the two quizzes worth 5% were super chill.

lecture is not mandatory, discussion is tho. grading rubric reasonable imo. do not procrastinate on the 2 papers (10-15 pgs is a lot). uses pollev which i find makes lecture more engaging as our inputs are anonymous. v respectful of everyone's opinions and overall brings good vibes. he plays pokemon too, what more can you ask for? :)

Awesome prof that provides ethical scenarios at the end of lecture to solidify the ethical concepts learned and encourages critical thinking. Provides a comprehensive study guide for the final. Workload is def manageable, don't procrastinate the 2 papers. Loved coming to his lectures that were very engaging using pollev.

Dr. Attaway is a down to earth prof that explains material well and ties it into real-world events. The bargaining simulation in this class was extremely engaging and fun. Workload is manageable just stay on top of the readings. Super chill and easy to talk to. Overall a great prof! take his class!

Honestly so glad I was able to take his class, on the younger side so that's why it was easy to vibe with him, very smart and knows what he's doing. Besides the 5-8 page paper and 10-15 page paper, I would definitely take his class again! PowerPoints were informative, he had 2 quizzes, weekly discussions which were easy and doable.
Very knowledgable professor, the workload and quizzes were very fair if you kept up with lecture materials.

Nice prof. Lectures were kinda empty so it lacked a bit of people who participated. But overall lectures were really useful. Its not a very hard class but you do need to listen and he does take cheating very serious as some people choose to make bad ethic choices in this ethics class. But overall TAKE HIS CLASS!!
Savvy millennial prof
Really good professor. Enjoyed the structure and had fun in class. I enjoyed the simulation we did which we prepped for pretty well. Did two papers after the simulation, and a final after.
Great professor! You should take his classes.

Really good class and teacher! This quarter of BUS177 had 2 papers, a group simulation on collective bargaining, and a final. The Attaway is very chill and open to feedback, but a bit slow on grades. Heavily recommend taking this class.
Very cool and engaging professor that gets involved with activities and concepts. Idk if his email is bugged but he rarely ever replies so talking to him in person is always best

Professor Attaway was a great professor for Bus 177. We were graded through three things and including a simulation on collective bargaining. Overall there are two main essays and one cumulative final. I would take him again in a heartbeat! Stay on top of your assignments and you will do great!

Great professor, do the readings, participate in in class activities and you'll be fine. This class was a breeze!
He's just a chill guy

Professor Attaway is very caring and understanding. He enjoys teaching and informing students about ongoing news correlated to lecture. Many little simulations to help you get a grasp of the concepts.

Professor Attaway was a great professor in 102. He gave clear instructions for every assignment and was easily accessible. As long as you follow the course content, you should be fine. I was hesitant taking a labor relations course but during this quarter Prof. Attaway was able to make it fun and engaging. My favorite thing was the union bargaining simulation, it was fun but I also was able to learn a lot.

This was the professor's first time teaching a course at UCR and for a business elective I would say it was pretty easy with Dr. Attaway. He is a very chill guy, there's only two papers that you have to write throughout the course, with an in-class simulation. I would highly recommend taking a class with him as he is very easy-going professor.

reviews.comment: This class is an upper-division business class, and he teaches it so well. He did a stimulation in class that is similar to union bargaining and that was the best part of the class. I took away a lot of information about unions and labor relations in class and it was def a fun class. We have two big papers but it is easy to write in a few days.

Dr. Attaway is a new professor here at UCR, but he is one of the best I have had on campus. He is a very accomplished professor who knows what he is talking about and is passionate about it. Logistical directions aren't very clear (homework posted a day before the due date), boring lecturer.
You never know what he is saying

My favorite teacher this quarter. I have hated every other philosophy course I have ever taken, but I genuinely looked forward to his class. A lot of reading and some very confusing material, but he's got a real gift for giving entertaining lectures that make philosophy easy to understand. He really cares about his students and what he does.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I'm not going to lie, this class was a lot of work, but that's to be expected. It is reading heavy with 2 course papers and 1 applied cumulative final on everything you've read. However, with the help of his detailed lectures, the class is manageable, and interesting. He was also super patient and nice which made his class even better.
I had Avery for ENGL001B. He is a great instructor and gave helpful/detailed feedback for your essays. I learned a lot in the class and especially from him.

Teacher was very nice. The lectures were interesting sometimes. Essays were straightforward and lenient in grading. Basically told us the questions for the exams. Allowed to use a cheat sheet. Does require some long readings but you just need to remember the important things. Class was not based on memorization but on understanding, which I loved.

This class is an easy A. There are only three quizzes that are open note and no final. There is one essay involved but it's pretty simple to complete she is a lenient grader. The lectures and discussions are a little boring but manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Took her for urban history and she was amazing. Taught amazing material and had super fun lectures. I'm an engineering major and her urban history class is probably my favorite class I have taken throughout my years in college. Please take her, Asaka rocks.
Asynchronous during the fires in LA. Very interesting readings and lectures. Shes super easy to work with and very understanding of others. Honestly, pretty awesome professor.

Professor Asaka is amazing! I had her for my Historian As Detective class that examined Japanese-American incarceration during WW2 as a case study. She is very passionate about what she teaches and cares for her students. She is also a light grader. I didn't even finish one of my papers and still got 14/20.
she is so amazing, love herrr

Gives individual feedback for every reading response! Facilitates really good discussions with no awkward pauses. One paper at the end which you can write about what youre interested in. Honestly my favorite class at UCR, and its not even my major! Very respectful of COVID times. Discussion attendance mandatory but can turn camera off.

Asynchronous learning and split one lecture into 50 min discussion groups. Interesting readings and very passionate about the subject! Very comfortable learning environment and sweetest professor. Only had to do 5/10 essay's (1 page) for credit and a fun blog newspaper assignment for the final. Very accommodating during the current climate (corona)

I absolutely LOVE her! Probably the most amazing lectures ever, she barely used slides but everything she said just soaked into my brain. I loved how eloquent she was when presenting and this was the only class I would look forward to attending. She's so kind and WILL emphasize what will be on the exams. 1 midterm, 1 paper (5 page), 1 fina1 essay.
I took her when I was a sophomore, and loved this class. It wasn't a typical easy A class, but I learned a lot. I believed we had a midterm, final and a 5 pg paper.

Professor Asaka is an excellent professor. She is very nice and will answer any questions you have. Her class covers an interesting time period filled with diverse subjects, which were easy to have discussions on. The readings were all good, with most of them being online. Show up and pay attention and you should do well.

This was the professors first quarter teaching 105. The midterm and final were very fair in the questions asked, and how it was graded. The labs are not bad, as long as you set aside some time outside of the lab to finish them up. The homework did prepare us for the final and midterm accordingly.

The best thing about her is the fact that she teaches with students in mind and looks at us in her own shoes. If a topic is too hard, she understands and doesn't add that to the exam. Her exams are extremely fair and are the right challenge. Take her at all cost!
It was fine a little disorganized, but had more than fair tests. She did have a project, but provided most of the code.

Amazing. 4 total extra credit percentage points to grade for doing optional problems/quizzes and asking/answering online questions essentially. Very lenient test grading, tells you exactly what topics are on exams and where they can be reviewed, even provides hints on exams, and oh yeah, she also curves. Clearly cares if you understand the concepts

Exams were very similar to the HW and lectures. There are many easy ways to gain extra credit. The only concern with this class is that there is a lot of homework, alongside the lab reports, that can get in the way of other classes. She's not the best at explaining, but she is a new prof, so I think she'll improve over time and is open to feedback.

Had her for 1B. she gives a lot of homework but its only bad if you get behind. Do what she tells you and keep up in the work and your gonna learn a lot. I learned more about writing in this class than in all my other writing classes so far. She is caring and makes it easy for everyone to participate. Take her for 1B if you can

By far the best professor that UCR could ever offer. I had her for three quarters for different English classes, and she always cares for her students and provides insightful feedback on specific assignments. If you are looking for an A+ in the class, this is the professor you should look up.

I was excited to go to her class for. She welcomes everyone with a big smile and lots of laughter. She teaches English in a way that's super clear, helpful, and honestly amazing. If you see a spot in her class take it! You'll regret not taking her. Not just for the grade, but because she's the kind of teacher you'll always remember.

Easily my favorite prof this quarter. Grading is super clear and prof is always available for questions. Not too homework heavy except for essays and discussion neither of which are hard as long as you put in the work.
the best prof i have taken at ucr. she was so kind and helpful and I actually understood what she was teaching. great feedback on essays and assignments were helpful. hoping to take her again for 1b.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've taken. Very understanding and kind. I took her class my first year and gave use 4 free absences, no excuse needed. I would recommend her to any one who is normally scared of english classes. Her lectures and essay prompts are very straight forward.

One of the best professors u can find in UCR English departments. If you're struggling in BSWT003 definitely take her. She explains the structures of each essay clearly and gives out helpful quality lectures. She really wants to teach something into you and wants you to succeed as a writer. Stay on track and there's no way to fail the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This is my first college/public speaking course. I loved her. She gives great feedback, she's really funny, very understanding...overall a great professor. I would 100% take her class again, and I will try to take her English1A class in the future.

Professor Francesca is a great professor in the English Department. She demonstrates that she cares for her students and how they're doing in class. I, 100% recommend taking her for any class that you need, she is awesome.
Great in ENGL008. She was super nice and understanding.

Literally the best prof to get for 1a! she was so sweet and so understanding, especially when giving extensions. Normally she gives a small 10 minute lecture then we do small things for the upcoming essay, so pick sources or make a small thesis . Her feedback on essays is great! Attendence for the course was mandatory but you have 4 free absences.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best professor for english 1a. Made the class as simple as possible and made it clear as to what she expected. she was very caring all throughout and helped everyone get ready for the final. Not much homework besides the papers.

I would highly recommend taking her for ENGL004! She was so sweet and kind. She gives great feedback when grading essays. She is also very understanding and will and we wrote essays that were about 2 and a half to 3 pages whereas other teachers do like 5 pages. She helped me understand this class and it helped me pass the exam.

She was great! Very good constructive criticism, allowed three absences, ended class early often, and was very clear on what she expected. Very low homework load and she was very understanding if you had any issues going on. She genuinely cares about you and how you do in her class. She is very helpful and I definitely learned a lot in her class.

She is such a good profesor. She is very easy going and is clear on what she expects from students. Her lectures are enjoyable, and she often ends class 15-30 minutes early. She gives good feedback that is constructive and improves your writing. She is great! Attendance is mandatory but you are allowed 4 absences, Only 4 essays including the final.
He teaches well, he explains well, he can explain difficult theorem like linear algebra in simple english. I send my highest gratitude for him for helping me understand calculus
One of the best professors out there... no.. The Best Professor to exist! Really loved his teaching, so clear cut to the point.
very impressive

I'm here to thank Prof. Censor from the bottom of my heart.He made very complex cal-2 courses so easy and created a base so that we can study in depth of this topic from any book.
Once again thank you Prof Aviv Censor.
He made the course so much easier to understand, he is a very good professor.

A great professor indeed, I even started learning Hebrew because of him :D
Thanks Technion for this course, I don't know why you closed the comments section though, you would have received a lot of +feedbacks, I cannot think of a one negative thing in his courses, I watched them once and would definitely come back to them if I ever needed to.

I learned Abstract Linear Algebra for credits in my school, but sometimes the theorems are taught in a very boring and abstract way. Dr. Aviv Censor's course on Youtube helps me out! His teaching is so precise and clear. I can feel his passion and care about his role as a professor in class! Believe me, he is a good teacher!
Just watch the lecture " The geometric meaning of J" you will understand how Dr. Aviv makes difficult things easier to understand.

hello, Im an Italian engineering student , studing in Padova Italy, I personally follow prof Aviv, instead of our teachers cause his ability to make simple hard concept going very deep, i wish all my italian professor was like him. In italy most of the lession are extremly teoric and heavy, almost zero practice, very bad for an engineer i think

I am maybe not qualified to rate Professor Censor since I actually study at a different university. However, I owe a lot to his amazing skill of breaking complex subjects apart into small understandable lectures which can be found on YouTube. It's a shame that comments on his videos are turned off since I can only think of positive feedback.

I'm actually studying at a German university but because I didn't understand ANY of the my own lectures, I turned to youtube where I found Prof. Censor's Linear Algebra .His lectures explained everything amazingly well and with multiple examples; I finally feel like I understand what I'm learning. I'm in tears. Thank you prof, I owe you my life :,)
Great teacher, simplified complex subjects. Made linear algebra a lot clearer
Dr. Aviv Censor explains difficult theorems in a clear manner with easy and hard examples. His lectures are life-saver.
Aviv is a great professor. Would like to meet him in person and say thanks for his awesome lectures available on youtube.
Great teacher. Thank you Dr. Censor.

like many I am here from the YouTube channel because comments were disabled. After looking for many ways to learn Linear Algebra, I think I have found the one. The lectures are absolute bangers: simple, yet precise explanations and clear, visual (!) examples. After finding my Uni lectures becoming more and more tedious, this man is a lifesaver.
Great Teacher!
Aviv saved my ass on Linear Algebra. I was so far behind, lacked motivation, but his Youtube lectures energized me! Merci Aviv :D

I stumbled upon Dr. Censor's clips when I was looking for ways to understand linear algebra. I could not even emphasize how much of a life saver he is. He is very attentive to detail so you know he makes sure his examples are really relevant. I am so thankful to him that I looked for a way to thank him online. Hope to meet him some day.

I come from a technical university in Stockholm, where the Calc II is considered one of the most difficult courses in the first year, with 85% students failing. Our normal professor had horrible lectures, so i sought a different way to learn, and found Aviv's lectures on YouTube, and I just wanted to thank him for helping me pass this course.
You have saved me! I am studying Linear Algebra via correspondence from South Africa and your lectures have really assisted in my understanding of many of the concepts I was struggling to understand.
Came here from the Technion YouTube channel. Great lectures on Algebra, very useful and clear.
Great Professor

Watched Technion lectures on YouTube conducted by him. I had to come here to thank him as YouTube comments were disabled there. He is not only completely knowledgeable but excellent in being able to get very abstract and difficult concepts across. Helped me immensely  Thank you sir. My best wishes and blessings to u :)
Great Professor, and was always very clear and helpful.  DO YOUR HOMEWORK because he will use questions from that on EVERY quiz.
Censor is definitely the best math instructor at UCR. His exams are straightforward. Take him if you want a good grade.

Very clear and entertaining in lectures. There was no HW to be turned in, but there were pop quizzes in lecture every once in a while. The midterm and final weren't too difficult but beware! There is ABSOLUTELY NO CURVE in this class, so if you've been riding on curves in the 9ABC and 10AB series then better keep your guard up and do well on tests.
One of the best math teachers I've ever had. lectures are crystal clear, but if you get behind in the lectures and homework by even a little bit you're screwed.
You would be a fool for not taking Censor. He is a great math professor. His exams are designed for most students to pass. You cannot ask for a better math teacher.
You should take Censor if you have the chance. His lectures are easy to follow. I changed my major to math because of him. His final was really easy.
Only take Censor if you want an easy A. His tests, quizzes, and homework assignments are super easy.
Funny guy. Made Lecture interesting. Gives quizzes during lecture so, must attend. Tests are exactly like practice test. Overall, Ok class but you have to know your stuff in order to pass.
Clear lectures. Very helpful in office hours.
He is a really good teacher. He's really nice. One of the best math teachers ever. Has a sense of humor.

Censor is by far the best math teacher you can ever ask for. You don't need to worry about passing his class because he has a huge curve. His lectures are crystal clear. His homeworks and exams are a breeze.
Censor is the best math professor at UCR. His class is super easy.

Take Censor if you want an easy A. His midterms and final are identical to the practice exams. He is one of those rare professors who gives lots of partial credit points on exams. I highly recommend taking any math classes with Censor.
Difficult mid terms, should help students prepare for their midterms during lectures.

I was very disappointed when I had gotten Censor. In math 8B, I was able to understand the concepts and got an A+ in muraleetharan's class, but Censor has got to be one of the worst professors teaching at UC Riverside. His TA's are very lazy and the professor cares less to do the midterm samples.

Worst teacher ever. His midterms and finals are comprehensive but are only usually 5 problems. The questions are questions within the questions so it is REALLY easy to lose points. Make one mistake on the question and youre likely to get the whole problem wrong. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!

Prof. Aviv is a really good professor, but you have to put your effort in if you want an A in the class. His lectures are very thorough, but you have to do a lot of practice problems on your own to get ready for midterms and the final. I can tell he cares about his students. He's not going to give you an easy A, but if you work hard,it's possible.
Censor is a really easy teacher. It is not hard to get an A in his class.His exams are identical to the practice exams.
I recieved a "D" in this class, AVOID HIM; i worked hard too; the people who gave good ratings already learned the material in high school

Censor is the best math teacher at UCR. Other students keep complaining about his class because you actually have to do work in his class. His lectures are crystal clear. He is an easy teacher. Highly recommend him.

This guy is funny and keeps class interesting by picking on people who fall asleep and trust me if you will fall asleep.  He is actually a really good lecturer and you learn a lot, unfortunately there are piles of hw and his midterms are extremely difficult, especially since he is admittedly "anal" about how he wants answers written

He's a good teacher/lecturer, but his midterms are rediculously hard. His final was fairly easy, but found ways to minus points just for the hell of it. He grades REALLY hard and is stingy on partial credit. I worked hard and barely passed, don't take him!

Censor's class is not a breeze. It is quite the opposite. His exams are hard; you get no particial credit. He seems like an easy professor for the first 10 weeks of class, but wait until you an F on your course grade. This is no joke. Those who got A's in his class probably retook his class.

This professor is crystal clear. He may point out students and nag if they don't know something they already should know, but he strives to make sure you understand everything you need to know. He frequently encourages students to visit him in office hours. Passionate lecturer. Made math 9C a breeze.
Horrible teacher. Lectures are useless because he doesn't teach by example; he just quotes from the book. He does not curve at all even if people say he does.

Excellent professor, I always looked forward to his class because of his witty satire. He was very obviously excited about math which helped me focus, he loves what he teaches. Does require you to understand the theorems you use but it's not like he asks you to prove them, just state what you use. Best math class so far.

Not too bad a class as long as you attend and follow the lectures. Doing homework is important if you want to do well on the in-class quizzes. The final was hard but straightforward. the worst part was getting the right format for online homework answers. But I think they're changing the textbook so that shouldn't be a problem.

I should have listen to my friends; they were right. He gives you an F because TA's grade so hard on the final that you end up failing the final, therefore failing the class. Find some other professor you will do well in.

I don't see why everyone's bashing on him.  I liked the class, and got an A.  I studied a decent amount, but I can't imagine getting an A in math without studying..  he does wear a few t-shirts very frequently though.  Notice his tigger t-shirt.

This guy is really HARD!!! I was doing great on the only midterm he gave and the hw and quizes i was doing ok but the final is pretty much what ur grade is. the final was much harder then the pratice and after hearing that pretty much the whole class failed he still didnt want to curve. NO ONE should take him!!

gives pop quizzes which can be very annoying for your grade. midterms were curved and professor tries to standardize tests with other same level math classes. speaks perfect english but is very critical when asking questions in class. also is kind of goofy for no reason.

Censor is a great teacher. If you are willing to learn and look forward to his class then you will be fine. If you are negative all the time you will probably get a bad grade. Makes you understand the thereoms and makes you APPLY them in tests. Not a hard teacher just a REAL teacher.
horrible teacher, don't take him.

Censor is a very tough math professor. All he does in lectures is just write bunch of theorems that have little application. He barely writes any useful examples on the board. His midterm and final was very hard. Average grade for this class is an F.

He is useless. He fails you without a second thought. I am retaking math 10a and I have an A in my current class. I received an F from him last quarter. Pretty stupid IMO considering that I'm putting in the same amount of effort. I would recommend that this prof be avoided at all costs. He puts in mild effort for you to learn and gives hard tests.

AVOID THIS PROF! writes every detail about theorems and offers little examples on how to work out the math problems. If you don't get it, he will point you out and make you feel dumb. you really can't ask questions in class without being embarassed. Midterms are hard & he makes you write down what theorem you used. over 50% of the class failed.
Midterm was fair, but the final was ridiculously difficult.
Good luck with this teacher
AVOID AT ALL COST
This teacher is good but his grading is hard he failed me and i got around average. Not a D but an F. Dont take him he sucks

One of the best math teachers I've ever had, although the amount of detail he requires felt like pulling teeth. He has a dry, sarcastic sense of humor which can rub some people the wrong way. If you want to pass this class, do all the odds and check your answers with him in the office hours.

I think Aviv was a good professor overall.  The person who's comment is below me took the same course and he did grade hard on the midterm because we are required to write explanations for our answers which I wasn't used to.  He is a funny and interesting professor.  Grading is fair, and tests aren't that hard.  Grades are curved don't worry.

Avoid this prof at all cost! He failed 90% of the class on the midterm and said he was easy on his grading. He told the class that all or most of us should drop the class because he had no problem failing each and every one of us. Also, he does not curve.

I added Aviv Censor on ratemyprofessor.com just to tell everyone to tell you to avoid him if you're not going to be a math major. But if you ARE going to be a math major, good luck and have fun because this guy might make you change your major.

Zoom cams had to be on during lecture, randomly call names to answer questions. Assignments are clear but he would dock off points without stating why. Group assignments were fun and weren't too difficult. Good amount of assignments nothing overwhelming. Read the slides and the book and you'll be fine. Only had to pay for statleap.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Definitely tough, but class was informative and practical. Seems "old-school" sense of communication and teaching. Key to passing is to understand homework content- if you get this you will pass the quizzes.

Be very biased towards his "favorite" students is the first tip I heard from others before attending his class. And indeed he is; we all got lower grades for presentations that we have put so much effort into. Even class participation is not graded on actual participation but on subjective thoughts. Not worth keeping your GPA tank with him.
Extremely unprofessional man. Consider secretly taking videos of the way he inappropriately interacts with you either in person or through email. Report his unprofessional behavior to the school.
I had a terrible impression of the man in the first day of his class. Please, beware of him. This individual has a dark side and grades his students subjectively.
