Prof Sood is very direct when teaching, there are allot of group projects and allot of homeworks, there are two quizzes but if you are able to comprehend the homework you will be okay when doing the quizzes. Attendance is mandatory.

Lecutres are decent but the class as a whole was extremely disorganized. Slides, tests, and assignments were full of typos and other errors. Midterm had short answer questions hidden within mutliple choice questions and grading was wildly inconsistent. Final exam had nothing to do with the review material, questions were on areas we barely covered.
Professor Ashish Sood was patient and understanding.

Prof. Sood conducted a Marketing Simulation Workshop for our batch which involved organizing into groups and navigating simulated market environment with other teams as competition. Great content, amazing delivery and thorough analysis and feedback. Really got us thinking there!
Well Mannered, caring, intuitive, and an amazing lecturer!
I absolutely loved his teaching and the course. Thank you so much ��

Sood is a bit disorganized and wants students to participate in an online environment. He severely messed up the final test and played it down as a "typo," however, about 40% of the test had typos and duplicate multiple choice answers. He changed how the exam was graded afterward. The homework assignments were not very helpful in learning.

He seems funny in class, but he is a disrespectful person to students outside of his class. If you send nice emails to him, he responds in a passive-aggressive and unprofessional way. He does not want to help his students at all. Also, his final exam includes materials that he's never taught and he's such a tough grader. This class is meaningless!

Changes the score of the exam randomly. Disorganized. Participation matters in this course are 90% of the grade! If you don't participate every day in class he will deduct a lot of points. Does not go over quantitative pricing in detail nor does he explain his grading. Moblab assignments were useless. Unfair grader.

Pretty easy class, no daily assignments just read the slides. Participation, 1 Assignment, Midterm and Final. He curves depending on the class average. Don't wait till the last minute to study. Both exams were given through respondus in person with a code. Attendance is taken every session so don't miss too much. He allowed 5 excused absences.
Super chill guy, speaks really clearly with a lot of live examples, and honestly pulls up in some clean fits.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Prasad was great! His class consisted of 1 midterm, 1 final, and 1 3-page paper and that's it. His lectures are easy to follow and actually very interesting and I loved that he provided real world examples of each concept so that they were easier to understand. Great professor overall, attend all the classes and study the lecture slides!

This class was really easy. Attendance is mandatory through poll eval but sometimes she would give extra credit for attending. Exams (3) were fairly easy as she provided a study guide for each and drops your lowest score. There is one paper you have to do but it wasn't bad. Professor was really sweet and would def take again.

Easiest psych class. One assignment every week on a research paper, 1 paper, and 3 mini exams with one getting dropped. Lectures are boring and she reads off slides, but exams are on things mentioned in class. Topics are interesting and there's basically no work.
Lecture was boring but counted for credit through poll ev. Test were easy if you just went over the slides. Wished she actually taught so I could use it in my next classes.

Ashley is nice but her lectures are basically her reading off the slides. Attendance is based on Polleve. 4 mini exams drop the lowest, no open notes they are straightforward. Just make sure to study, lecture are heavy
Dr. Johnson is a great lecturer, he stays on topic, is engaging, and is passionate about what he does. Really enjoyed his class.
Lecture is really dense and packed with stuff but he tries to stay engaging. Lot of vocab though so you should read and study outside of class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Johnson is seriously super understanding. He is really personable and makes the class enjoyable. I hope he teaches other classes because I would love to take another class with him! He's probably the best prof I've had at UCR. Take him if you can, you won't regret it.
Professor Johnson is the most understanding professor that I have taken.

AMAZING PROFESSOR. This is a difficult time in our lives, but he is so concerned and empathetic for his students. There is a weekly quiz and two assignments for the quarter. Everything has a due date to stay on track but can be turned in anytime during the quarter. He understands his students are struggling at home right now. Def. Recommend
Super chill and helpful
The professor makes the class more difficult than he needs. No curve, confusing lectures but tests are based off the lecture. All your grade is based on discussion attendance and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Austin is great. His lectures are amazing and so easy to follow. He doesn't assign papers and doesn't require a textbook. There's just a weekly quiz + 3 exams, where he provides a study guide and is super helpful. The exams are a piece of cake if you try at least a little.. Gives 2% of extra credit onto the final course grade for good attendance.
EASY A!!! Studied one day before midterm and final and got an A in the class. If you have music experience this class is a breeze!

I've never taken any music class before but did play guitar (can't read music). EASY ass class. I but the least amount of work I could in this class (was taking two upper div. Engineering classes) and still got an A. Just pay attention during lecture, do the homeworks and you WILL get an A. No study required. Lamprey is awesome.

If you have musical experience (band, piano etc) this class will be REALLY easy. If you dont, its okay, she basically spoon feeds you the material, and theres a ton of practice. The only bad thing is its 8am and attendance is mandatory. other than that, prof Lamprey is really nice, and wants everyone to succeed in learning music.

This class was great and interesting. super easy A if you know how to play the piano or know basic music concepts. Make sure you go to class and understand everything she teaches in class because tests are straight forward. the TA is really helpful too.  Attendance is mandatory. You do not need to buy the book

lamprey teaches pretty well, and her exams are straightforward. if you know music, it's an easy A. if you don't know music it may be a little tough, but not all that difficult if you actually study. you do not even need to buy the book since her exams are straight from her notes. she gets made when people don't show up so shell add some pop quizzes

This class was pretty cool. Like, it's easy if you're a musician. I'm a musicain myself and I learned a lot. She made me realize how hard music is tho but She does an OUTSTANDING job of explaining Music theory. It sucks class is so early. The class is okkk. I didn't use the bk but if u dk music i recommend it. 1 mterm, conert report, final, proj.

A background in music will make this class alot easier. Although there is still alot of memorization and effort required. Go to class, besides the fact that she takes attendance, you need to get the notes. If you take good notes, you won't need to purchase the book.

If you are familiar with musical concepts, use to be in band, or have some prior understanding of musical theory, this class will be very easy. But if you are totally new to music, it takes some effort but it is still easy, because the concepts are very easy to learn. Attend class, 'specially toward the 2nd half of the course, and u'll be fine!

the material is a little more than what I expected. The second half of the course was somewhat challenging, need to memorize. Going to lecture is very helpful. TA is very into music, but ok. The goal for the final project is unclear that u don't really know how hard you should work for it while ppl just play "twinkle star" and pass it. Got an A :]

I thought this class would be very easy, but it is not. Theres a lot of stuff you need to know in this class in such a short amount of time. The teacher is  alrigght, but if you have no prior music experience, it wil be very challenging. Above all else, the ta, adam is just horrible. He gives out tough hw to do every week and doesn't go  over it.

If u dont have any music experience, this course'll be challenging. If u have some sense of musical concept, it wont be 2 difficult. But there r a lot of assignments such as weekly hw, 2 concert reports, and scale sheet. Adam was the TA and he's just a nerd. He acts as he's cool, but way he laughs will annoy you. No music experience, dont take it.
it's an ok class but the ta is a ****ing ****bag

I had a horrible time in this class. Lamprey was rude when people asked questions, and her TA, Adam, tried his best to make each assignment as tricky as possible. I still got an A, but unless you absolutely have to take this class, stay far away. This is a challenging topic if you're not familiar with it, and they did a terrible job of teaching it.

I play the piano, so this class was super easy, but even if you have 0 expereince, if you go to lecture and discussion and pay attention, this class should be easy for you too. Both Prof. Lamprey and David (TA) genuinely care that you get an A, & they are more than happy to answer any qyestions.
Although I had no music experience, I still liked the class. It's not so hard as you think. Just make sure that learning music is like learning a language.
class was okay

her and david (a TA) are the most helpful people ever. ive been playing guitar awhile, but havent actually had music experience. i got an A in the course. just go to lecture and disc and u barely even have to study

I went into this class with some musical experience, but no real formal instruction. She covers all the basics to get you proficient in music, and she has a sincere concern and inclination for getting students to learn the material. Would love to have her as a teacher again.
Lamprey does her best to teach music to students. If you had previous music experience, this class should be an A. If not, it takes some effort to get an A.

Like any online lecture turn up the speed because he talks really slow and has a thick accent! You can then hear him better. Besides that he goes off on a lot of tangents and is monotone. Slides were messy and had too much info but this is where the MT and final answers were! I stopped watching lectures after MT. Not a fun SOC class at all...
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor isn't great. He chose to not do lectures live due to the pandemic going on. Although, with his thick accent and messy lectures, it is hard to get through the class. His lectures are SUPER long and his tone of voice sounds boring and not enthusiastic so it is dreadful to listen to his recorded lectures. Please dont take him.

I had him during the COVID-19 & BLM Protests. His lectures were prerecorded & very long. Powerpoints were a bit messy in my opinion & overloaded with info. We had 2 assignments & 1 essay which was later cancelled. He assured us to not worry & stress with all that happened during our quarter. He replied back to my emails within a good amount of time

His lecture is literally based on the textbook. I didnt attend often towards the end because everything he went over in lecture was in the textbook. But the professor is honestly such a great choice. He is very smart and witty. If you need help, he is very understanding and can help you. I enjoyed his lectures. Very fun to listen to him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took this professor several times.  Sometimes his accent was difficult to understand, but the test material seemed to be covered fairly well in his lectures.  Sometimes it sounded like he was spending a lot of time trying to change your opinions.  This seemed to be common in sociology classes though.  Very helpful outside of class and pleasant.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I admit he does have a thick accent but he tries his best to get you to understand what he is taking about. GO TO CLASS! He gives out surprise extra credit and DO ALL THE HOMEWORK! Nearly all of hw mimics the midterm and final. Both the midterm and final were open book.

He's a great teacher, knows the material very well and teaches it in a good manner. The homworks are difficult and take up a long time, but they do prepare you for the midterm and final. He tells you what will be on the midterm and the final is open note. He is always available and wants to help. Def recommend him!
Hard to understand, but if you go to him for help he is very understanding and helpful. Go to lecture, he gave out a lot of extra credit.

I have so much respect for Dr. Kposowa. He is not only down to earth but he really places great interests that the students would learn and pass his class. Also, he is funny and he is humble. His exams are a bit hard but if you take notes and come to class you will pass.

I love Professor Kposowa! He is definitely one of my favorite teachers at UC Riverside! He actually cares that you understand the material and will take the time to explain it to you until you understand it! Although Soc 133 isn't difficult i had him for Soc 5 (which was pretty hard) and he made everything crystal clear. Take a class with him!!!!

Has a very thick accent, but I got used to it and understood him. He's very helpful if you actually go and seek help. Everyone who thought he is hard, it's the subject that was hard, it's statistics. He even tells you that if you don't understand him, go to him or the TA and ask for clarification. He is a good professor. Final was 45% of your grade
he was soooo boring, couldnt even understand his accent

He's alright. I would strongly recommend to go to his lectures because you can study his lectures than reading the book. That means read the book before you go to class, so you'll understand when he's lecturing. He gets in details plus he makes his lecture fun. Comedy~ LOL!

Should attend class to score well on tests. His lectures are boring and he always writes information on the board. His tests are hard. He's not very clear about his assignments or about the test material.
This man is the worst professor at UCR. His accent is hard to understand and his tests are too hard.
Class was much harder than it needed to be and not interesting. The book was much more interesting than the lectures. He can also be hard to understand and take notes from.

Prof. Kposowa is awesome! Personally I'm glad to see there's a professor unafraid to voice unpopular views in his classes. I hardly read at all, went to every class, and got an A- in the course, which he usually curves. Term paper was tough, but other than that I think he's a great teacher and you can learn a lot from him!

His class was 90% Lecture notes, 10% Book. So pretty much if you go to class and write down what he says, you can pass.It seemed that the problem people had with him was his views. But if you read the class description he says it is taught from CONFLICT PERSPECTIVE. Meaning he disagrees with the system. Funny guy, strong accent.
He's really nice.  You definetly have to go to the lectures because he adds a lot of information that is not online.  The midterm really wasn't that hard, just read the information.
Awesome professor! While he does have a thick accent, the exams are easy. People just need to take responsibility and study more, instead of expecting the instructor to do all of the work for them.

Has a thick accent which makes it really difficult to understand what he is saying, But make sure to take really good notes and study everything he writes on the BOARD!!! it will be on the test!.. the book is useless dont bother buying it..

Extremely difficult to understand, has a heavy accent  You have to pay attention and show up for class taking detailed notes as he tests on very obscure lecture details.  Book is useless, so plan on showing up in order to pass the class.  Try to avoid at all costs.
This class was dry, but he post his notes on ilearn. if you want to pass you have to go to class and take really good notes. Book doesn't help at all.

One of the worst Soc professors at UCR.    At first, i was like "cool!  Criminology!"   It's all statistics about how the poor are oppressed and how rich people's crime are ignored.  To top it off, the tests are VERY hard. He would pick the most obscure thing from his lecture and tests on it. Most of the class fail their tests. He has a  big accent

The course title should be renamed to: Soc 137: Demographic Statistics.  The material covered was very uninteresting, maybe there were two-three lectures worth attending.  Tests weren't terribly hard, just a lot of memorization.  Perhaps it's not the professor's teaching ability which is to blame, but the boring nature of the material instead.
just reads off from internet.
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments

Took Education 061 over 7 weeks during the summer and the class was pretty easy. Weekly quizzes, 10 page final essay, and classroom discussions. She's very nice and lenient , and provides help if needed.

Prof Aya is very nice. Her lectures go by very fast which is hard to catch up. The IEP project and Quick Guide project are easy and she and the teacher assistants are very helpful as well. You get time in class to do the IEP project. The final is extremely easy as well. The assignments are very easy and helpful to your learning.

She is a super sweet professor. Loved taking this class and was pretty easy. You are required to attend lecture and she uses PollEverywhere to determine you are there. The class was pretty clear with what we had to do. IEP project and a Brochure Activity. Professor Aya, was a great professor to talk with.

The best professor I have ever had. She helped inspire me to expand my major and become more passionate about education. Her lectures were clear and helpful, work was really hands on and tied to lecture. No final or final exam, just all essays. Very flexible with grading and assignments. Doing the inperson observation was my favorite. 1000/10 recc
Professor Aya is such a good professor and knows how to teach! She made all the material really easy to learn!
Available and wants you to do well! Would recommend to anyone!
Overall a good professor and very easy class. As long as you show up, you will be fine.

This class only requires you to do the readings and write four short essays, which he gives very good feedback on. You can honestly get away with just skimming the readings because he reads a lot of the poems during class. Clearly very passionate about what he teaches and just likes engaging with students rather than giving them busy work.

One of the best professors I've had so far! His classes can be a bit boring at times but he takes attendance during lecture so make sure to go. He's very respectful and listens to everyone's opinions. 2 small papers, midterm and final essay (all take home), make sure to go to office hours if you need help! he's very patient and understanding
Best damn American Poetry Professor!

Participation's matters, but doesn't make you speak if you don't want to; counts emailsoffice hours as participation. Note-taking is not that necessary, and there's no reading to do outside of him reading the poetry in class. 2 small papers, Midterm&final are in class essays. Grades a bit tougher than you'd think. Class is slightly boring though.

UCR has many brilliant English professors who encourage their students to engage in class discussion. However, Prof. Axelrod is NOT one of them. He is openly condescending and snobby towards his students. Compensation maybe?

Professor is very helpful and kind. Very passionate about the material. This class was pretty easy, as long as you do the work and put forth even a minimal effort you should get a good grade. Poetry has never been that interesting to me but we read some good poetry. Would definitely recommend taking his classes.

I took him for an upper division class and he was a nice guy but it was RIDICULOUSLY easy. I was bored out of my mind, the poems we were reading were obvious in there meaning. If you want to actually challenge your brain, take a class with Yamamoto or Latham.

He is one of the best professors I've had so far. He is so passionate about writing, VERY helpful and accessible in class and office hours (I highly recommend visiting office hours b/c he gave me the choice to change an essay grade from a B to an A if my next essay was an A). He is very nice with light humor.

Professor Axelrod is very passionate about the subject he teaches. He is enthusiastic and encourages student participation. For those who are shy, he counts emails as participation. Although poetry is not my favorite subject,I truly enjoyed his class. I would not hesitate to take another class taught by him.
I agree with the below comment.  He graded unnecessarily hard and it's not even a upper division class.  Not very objective when it comes to feedback, stay away if possible.

Not a recommended professor. He is NOT welcoming of different interpretations of poetry. I heard him tell students they were wrong on numerous occasions. His expectations for the class were unrealistic, especially for a lower division course.

Professor Axelrod was one of the best professors I've had so far.He is unbelievably kind, intelligent and truly passonate about poetry.He is always interested in students interpretations of poetry and encourages interaction.And he always has a great story to tell about the poets or himself that make the class more relatable and interesting AMAZING!

Very interested in his students' understanding of the material, kind, empathetic, has a deep knowledge of the works he discusses in class. Will tell interesting stories and anecdotes about the authors to make them relevant. If you are caught up with the readings you will do well.
I liked him as a professor. He provided very good insights on the texts we read. And his midterms weren't overly difficult. Recommended!

Axelrod is one of THE best Profs on our campus. He was incredibly helpful, and his lectures were very interesting and entertaining. His final was a bit hard, but if you take his class and do the work, you will not regret it. I wonder how many of the people who rated him down were the idiots who were on Facebook all through lecture...

Professor SG Axelrod genuinely cares about the progress of his students. He is always so kind and tries to help you out to the best of his abilities. Attend all lectures, do all the work, and you will absolutely pass. ^_^

Introduction to Poetry couldn't have been a more positive experience for me. Professor Axelrod is a very kind person, and is extremely passionate about poetry. He opens up a ones eyes to elements that they most likely did not notice before. I enjoyed his course very much, and loved every pressure write. That says a lot! He is fair, and approachable
Dr. Axelrod is amazing and talented and empathetic! He's a bright star at UCR and loves poetry and student engagement. He's a little shy sometimes but not stand-offish at all. He's sweet.

Truly passionate about poetry and what he teaches. A lot of the time I was admittedly bored out of my mind during the lectures but his enthusiasm for what he teaches is appreciable. He's also a very easy A; if you make any effort at all and do well on the paper assignments, which isn't hard at all, then you'll do fine.

He is so incoherent in lectures, and all he can ever really talk about is whitman, dickinson, and emerson. I went to his office hours and he was of no help, I might as well ask my pet fish for help. He has this monotone voice and says uh..uh.. about every four words. Puts you to sleep really. If you don't need a poetry class then avoid him.

Probably one of the best teachers at ANY universityl. He is brilliant and kind. I suppose he can be hard, but a good teacher should push you to the limits of your intellect. An amazing scholar and teacher!
This man is very very nice and approachable. He really wants to help you in the class. He is a generous grader.
Prof Axelrod knows his craft, but he wasn't a very good teacher.  He was unaproachable and it seemed that his interpretations on different works led back to the same theme.
The best professor I have had in four years of undergrad and two graduate degees. Not just brilliant and thought-provoking, but a kind-hearted, real person. Amazing.
No Comments
He was a great professor, and he made sure that everyone understood the material. He also made sure that the students felt comfortable coming into the midterms and final. Aw, I miss this class.
No Comments
Prof. Axelrod is a very approachable person.
great curriculum.  great teacher.
Great Teacher.  He was funny and enthusiastic and made the material relevant to us.
Nice guy.
One of the greatest English professors in the University of California system.
The guy says some really witty comments that keep class entertaining. He is really helpful and is eager to educate. He critiques papers really well, giving good advice to all.

I loved this class because he wrote a personal whole-page response to each of my papers. So I knew exactly what he liked and how to improve on my writing.  There was absolutely NO confusion as to how to get an on a paper.
amazing professor. so enthusiastic about the class and gets you excited too. take his classes if you can.

He is the sweetest professor ever! Professor Axelrod is very eager to learn form his students as much as he is to teach. He is so insightful and truly has a passion for his work. I enjoyed his lectures.
Really great professor, highly rec.
No Comments
Great professor. I hated poetry before his class, but he really helped me appreciate and enjoy it.  I wish I could have taken more of his classes.
I was in Axelrod's poetry class in 1994.  He made poetry come alive for me.  He stands out as one of the best teachers I've had.
A lot of reading and boring lectures but at least I passed lmao

I took this class over summer to finish my major reqs so that might change how this class goes normally, but this was honestly the worst public policy class I took at ucr. her lectures are awful she speaks super slowly and monotonously and its a drag. as for the tests, they were basically entirely short response. if you can avoid this professor
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: nothing more than reading off slides and tedious group work that was basically always just done by one person in the group

This professor was honestly very boring, her lectures lack substance and are very slowly paced. monotone, and is basically just reading off of other slide shows. basically just an attendance based class , felt like a prison sentence. AVOID AT ALL COST, but also an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a nice and helpful professor also strong passion for studying the social issue of immigrant along with statistical data. The class is easy to pass, but you must take attendance very seriously because it will impact your grade, Everyweek there is group work on reading assignment. There are 2 essay, 1 midterm exam, and 1 group presentation.

Professor Ayon cares a lot about her students; if there is a concern with due dates or with the structure, she will accommodate. Her lectures are great and thoroughly explains what she expects out of assignments so I think she's a very fair grader.
Professor Ayon gives amazing lectures, and I have learned so much about immigrant health. She is super flexible with assignments and very sweet in general. One of my favorite professors at UCR.

Professor Ayon is amazing! Her class thought me a lot. It was very difficult, she's a tough grader. The information that you learn in this class can be very emotionally draining but is important to learn from a policy perspective.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took Professor Ayon in Fall 2020. She def makes you work for the A. She provided 2 extra credit assignments (which I suggest you do both). She spreads out her research paper so that you don't get hit with the whole paper at once and procrastinate till the end to do it. Research paper is the Final (only 10% of grade which was nice). Do the work.

Dr. Ayon is 1 of the best professors at SPP. Class attendance is mandatory and highly encouraged because of quizzes. She is a kind and respectful professor, but she a hard (but fair) grader. Do the extra credit offered because it can make a difference. She wants her students to succeed, but you have to work hard for your grade.

The best professor Ive ever had. He has made such a positive difference in my life. I will never forget his" could be good, could be bad" story. He has several stories to help us remember information more easily. Ramadan has great chemistry with students. Actually, he reminds me of Robin Williams in Dead Poets Society, if you know what I mean.

Ustath is the best! My life changed so much after taking his class. I found a professor who truly values his students, and makes learning extremely enjoyable. He teaches students so much about culture, language and the necessity of generosity and respect. I promise you will never regret taking his class! You really don't want to miss class either.

A great teacher makes the classroom magic happen, regularly. he elicits his students' best efforts and engages their minds so that they leave class still alive with ideas and comments, and they talk about what went on in class with their friends, roommates, family when they get home too:)

Professor Ayman is one of my favorite professors at UCR. A kind soul, and a great person to be around, he truly cares about his students without a doubt. HE wants you to learn the language and makes the class enjoyable, there is a book for the class but it is not mandatory I think. You do not want to miss class, but you won't want to.

Best professor I've had at UCR. Before taking Arabic, I was bitter and wasn't looking forward to the 4 day a week schedule but I AM NOT JOKING - Ustad Ayman literally made the class so enjoyable. I looked forward to coming to his class because he cares about his students so much. You will not regret it, I promise.

Best teacher I've ever had! always available for his students and will keep explaining things in different ways until you get it. Very inspiring, passionate about the subject, and most importantly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. I wish more teachers were like this!

MOST AMAZING PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER TAKEN AND PROBABLY EVER WILL! His kind heart,patience, sense of humor,optimism, & so much more make him what every aspiring educator should strive to be! Truly the best! I'd say don't skip class, but trust me, you won't want to:)

Ayman Ramadan! Professor Ayman was like an inspirational person to my life he gave me a reason to live he gave me motivation and teachers really don't do that they just worry about them selves but with this professor he was like family he's a really great man and his class is really cool and he will teach you many interesting things easy grading
Never in my life have I had a more dedicated, understanding, amazing professor. He cares about the students and subject matter and he really wants you to pass. PLEASE TAKE HIM!
Truly superior professor, must take his class to know what I am talking about.
Truly superior professor,must take his class to know what I am talking about.

Absolutely phenomenal professor. Truly engages his students and makes sure they are on the right track. Makes the very difficult process of learning a foreign language fun and engaging. Professor Ramadan is also a man with great integrity and heart who truly cares sincerely for each individual student who makes an effort.

Great isructor,patient with students,very inspiring,he makes us feel like a family.I learned a lot last quarter about Arabs,the language,the culture and community.I can not wait for Arabic2.My favorite word in Arabc is ???. Could not have asked for a better profesor.
Great professor,I like his engaging personality and teaching style.I really admire his passion and enthusiasm and his knowledge and  highly recommend his class.

Great professor, enjoys his job - wants you to learn rather than among for the grade but sure enough the grade comes if you just out the effort. I would take this class even if you don't know Arabic, tries to help non native speakers as much as possible.

Great professor, really really wants to help his students. The class time is enjoyable but don't be fooled - and even he will say this: Just because he likes to joke a lot, doesn't mean you can take the class for granted. Arabic mastery doesn't come easy, but he is one of the best professors I've had. Very very easily attainable A.

Great Professor, really wants to teach you arabic - very appreciative of the language. I would definitley take him for higher level arabic courses, one downfall is that he tries to help you as much as he can before he gives quizzes, which ends up being a downfall b/c you barley have any points in the system.  Take him Nonnative or Native speaker

Her "lectures" are nothing but the students discussing the readings for the entire class. She does not teach at all. All she does is just stand next to the classroom computer and say "that's interesting." She's a nice lady, but a horrible professor.

She was very nice, lectures were basically a review of the readings assigned that week. Do your reading! Very important especially for the 350-word paper she assigns each week. It was difficult to keep up with the readings at times but overall it was okay, got an A in the class
Very Inconsistent grader. Does little work to help out.

I do not recommend you taking her class. I got an A in all of my other english classes, and I do not understand why she is such a hard grader. She gave us tedious work, and we had an essay to write every single week (summer course).
She was very nice and helpful but her grading is difficult. everyone in the class had a C before the final.
I LOVED HER!! She is very nice and ALWAYS helpful whenever you need her. Highly recommended as far as I'm concerned.

Yes, lecture exams are multiple choice, but the problem is that she doesn't teach well. Her lectures and explanation are subpar. Many students relied heavily on outside sources and other students. Over time, it seems like she doesn't care about us or the subject. I'm suspecting that some of the positive reviews are made up or inaccurate for most.

I took this class due to the reviews being good, but I felt catfished almost immediately because of how little she actually seemed to care about the subject. Tough courses like this should be taught by someone who actually noticeably cares about it. Also...three reviews made on the same day that sound similar? SUS. Beware of false reviews.

Professor Azami is approachable and easy to ask questions. Her lab and lecture exams are multiple-choice questions that you can ace if you actually study the slides. Only the first lab exam had some free-response questions. Lab final was cumulative but it was basically a review of the two midterms. Lecture final was not cumulative which was great.

She is not going to do the learning for you, it is your job to actively participate in the lab and lectures. She makes very clear lab slides for each lab experiment which are very helpful. Her lecture slides are very easy to follow. Of course there is a lot of memorization but this is expected from micro. Very bright and pleasant instructor.

Prof. Azami is very lenient and understanding, she would extend or change due dates for assignments if there were other stuff due on those days. She is fun, smart, and caring. She made the material fun and easy to understand with real life and funny examples. Overall, very pleasant experience. If you actually put a little effort you will get an A.

Azami is extremely bright! However, her teaching style is not for everyone. She can be hard to understand and is unable to breakdown complex concepts. She is fair but her grading system is rigid with no room for extra points (grade redemption). The exams can be wordy and hard to follow. Overall, pleasant. Brilliant, but definitely not a professor.

I took the 12 week micro with Prof. Azami, the class was hybrid and there were A LOT of online assignments and readings but she was lenient with the due dates when necessary. Her lectures were clear and easy to follow. The exams were okay, not that difficult if you were sufficiently prepared.

Took Professor Azamis microbiology class at SBVC. She is very kind, caring, and fun. She explains concepts very well with real life examples. The class requires a lot of work but as long as you attend the labs, read the lab and lecture slides, and turn in all the assignments then you will get an A.
By far the best bio/chem class I've taken. She takes teaching very seriously, and goes above and beyond to make sure her students are successful.

This professor was honestly chill. Ir noted learning about everything he spoke about, he always found a way to connect it back to philosophy. Anyone claiming he just rants without cause probably didn't pay attention too well, he's just a philosophy teacher LOL. Your brain will be picked. No homework, just study and make sure you understand concepts

Lam grades on very few things; attendance, 1 midterm, and final exam. Exams are a LOT of writing. Lectures were very interesting and honestly not bad at all. Only bad thing about this class is he requires you to buy physical copies of all 3 books needed for the readings. A good 80 bucks all together. Also gives good study guides.

Get ready to read. 3 books were required over the quarter, and the midterm/final is based on them. He made lectures pretty engaging, and you can only miss 2 lectures/discussions before it negatively impacts your grade. 30% attendance, 30% midterm, and 40% final. Your hand will hurt a lot after taking the midterm/final, as it is just writing
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance is 30% of the class. Exams are easy if you remember to bring your books. Good idea to at least skim the text pre-exam. Class easily derailed by students asking off-topic questions. If you took AP Lang in HS and got a 3 or higher you'll do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: midterm and final worth a lot so you actually have to do good. exam grade depends on TA. study guides are pretty much just like exam; one or two questions/scenarios will be pulled from there. just include extensive examples in every response.

does not treat serious topics properly, makes you spend a ton of money espesically to read his own book, overall lectures feel like a waste since he goes on tangents and circles. how am i supposed to learn about morals when this guy is so giddy to use ai to generate n@zis with babies?

Grade is based heavily on attendance +the midterm and final. He did allow you to miss 2 lectures for 100% on attendance though. There were 3 assigned books to read, and one of them was his own. The lectures are interesting and mildly interactive, despite small tangents. I'm personally able to understand him and the material clearly by the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Attendance is mandatory and a huge part of the total grade. Grades are based only on midterm, attendance, and final. He has you read after every lecture in preparation for the next, and we had to read a total of 3 books for his class. He also gives a study guide that was incredibly useful for the midterm. His lectures are super entertaining and fun
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really great professor! During lecture she goes over problems and some homework problems and is very communicative. Discussions are mandatory but she allows you 4 free skips. Easy homework due at the end of the week and super easy MCQ on the 3 exams. I usually suck at math but she helped me throughout this quarter.
I had trouble taking in all the info in the lectures but my TA was very helpful and the class wasent too hard , midterms are a mix of free response and multiple choice questions

One of the best professors if you tend to struggle/find it difficult with math, Dr. Banaian's lectures are very insightful, along with very clear and straightforward explanation regarding the material. Highly recommend taking her class, the midterm and final are very straightforward if you study the study guide provided from her.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's a good teacher for the most part and simplifies it well. I suggest sitting in the front. When you ask her questions, she's willing to help you out. The homework is doable but definitely sometimes a handful. The final is light work if you do the study guide.

The lectures felt bland but she explains the material well. Homework was a bit much, but easy if you understand the material. The worksheets during discussion were a lot harder and confusing than what was learned during lecture. Very helpful during office hours, I recommend going if your TA doesn't explain things well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Explained concepts well and recorded attendance through PollEv participation. The homework load was easy and manageable, we had at most 3 online assignments due weekly. She provided many guides and was available outside of class. Her teaching style is plain, but it is direct. Definitely understands the material and is not confusing.

professor banaian is a really nice and caring teacher and is moreee than willing to help you as long as you ask for it. seriously one of the sweetest people. I will say though, my TA was more lost than the students and I have no idea how he got the job. It did not end up being an issue though, and I highly recommend this professor!

one of the kindest, most caring professors at ucr. lectures aren't super helpful if you aren't the best at math, but if you go to office hours and ask for clarification she'll do anything she can to help! she really just wants you to succeed and she'll do whatever she can to make that happen. great professor!

If you don't like math, don't take this class, it'll make you hate it more. The way she explains things over complicates the topics so unnecessarily and honestly her teaching style is just her rambling.

Esther is very nice. Had her for Winter 2025 MATH 009C. Very easy to approach; caring to questions you have to ask. Go to her office hours if you need help! She is able to explain problems in alternate ways that you may not have thought of before. Ended with an A.
Professor Banaian is super kind and she is always open to helping out. Calculus is a subject I greatly struggle in but taking her class helped me understand the material and pass.

She has a fairly monotone voice during lecture, but it's honestly more chill if anything. She clearly knows the material well, and she explains everything sufficiently enough during lecture. You might feel super lost or confused at some points since some ideas feel so random, but if you just ask her questions she'll clarify with no problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor at UCR! Loved her lectures, made time for students at officer hours and honestly cares for their success. Exams were very straight forward! Practice midterms and finals are very similar to the actual exam so study! Discussion quizzes were fairly doable! Drops a quiz and midterm if you do better on the final. Overall caring professor

Your typical class with an average workload. I liked his lectures but they weren't necessary. Understanding the derivations is super helpful. Midterm, quizzes and final were super fair and doable. A set of problems from the textbook is assigned every week. He wants you to succeed in his class. I would take his class again.

I really had to work hard for the A. The practice test are similar to his midterm and finals, but you still have to study. He really doesn't care for his students. The average on his test is in the mid 50's. Got a high C on the 1st midterm, high B on 2nd midterm, high C on the final, 100% on HW, and B on the quizzes. Study hard and READ TEXTBOOK!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Bardeen was a really hard teacher for me. I studied sooo hard yet I still failed my midterms. I scored above average on the final and my final grade was a C+. He's okay. His notes are TERRIBLE! Its litrally just math problems all the time. No vocab or anything, just examples in every lecture. so annoying
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I like Bardeen. He made a few dad jokes here and there. Lectures are okay, skips steps but if you go to TA or his office hours you'll be fine. Exams are similar to his practice tests. This class wasn't bad, especially since he curves at the end. Very helpful during office hours. Overall, he was a pretty good professor.

Bardeen was okay at lecturing. Sometimes he made things more confusing by skipping steps, but it wasn't hard to figure out if you go to TA or his office hours. Both midterms and the final were super similar to the practices he gave so if you can do those easily you'll be set. Some people complained that the class was hard but it wasn't too bad

Throughout the course he was very open about the grading scale, but in the end there was a small curve of about 5-10%. He talks with his eyes closed throughout the entire lecture, but he knows what he's talking about. As long as you score near the average for the midterms and final you'll end up with a C. The clicker points are extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Bardeen was alright. He writes down lecture notes as he goes along, which I personally don't like because it's difficult to follow. He's a super smart guy and his exams are pretty fair, just do the practice exams and Smartworks and you'll be okay. His grade redemption does come in handy if you do better on the final than any of the 2 midterms.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Not that bad. Do better then average on the midterms, and final  and you'll get a pretty sick grade. Just do the practice midterms and practice final and  it will all be okay.  The redemption can come in clutch if you do poorly on a midterm. Gives extra credit for clicker questions which is kinda helpful. He is kinda funny I guess.

His test can be pretty tough. For the final i recommend going over both midterms and all practice exams he provides. The average for mostly all his exams were around the 60s. There is a little curve in the class and his clicker questions are extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Bardeen was full of corny dad jokes and assumed that all of his students read the book and know how to do the problems ahead of lecture. If u read the book and go to his office hours you'll be fine. love the guy
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He offers extra credit from the clicker and has a system called redemption point if you do really well on your final it may replace  your midterm score. He is a tough grader so do the sample final and midterm they are really helpful. He gives out quizzes every week and the hw is easy points. small curve for his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I loved Bardeen SO MUCH! The Chem 1B course is always difficult for students because it is very math based (which I personally loved). He has clicker questions that count for extra credit. His exams take on the format of his practice exams that he provides, so make sure you know those questions like the back of your hand. Overall witty and charming
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best Chem professor at UCR. He actually teaches, and his notes are very thorough.

I got a 72 on the first midterm, 75 on the second midterm, 180/200 on the final and received an A in the class. Generous curve - Don't read the book but rather do MasteringChemistry A LOT (repeat till you understand) For his final go over all MasteringChemistry, ALL practice midterms, and ESPECIALLY his practice final. You'll get an A for sure.

He was a pretty nice professor. He never put anything unexpected on the exams, everything is from his lectures. He's pretty straight forward and sometimes he tries to crack jokes. I thought he was funny, but I'm not sure anyone else did.
Easy professor, goes over a majority of the material in class. Didn't need to read the book at all. He can be a bit disorganized some times but other than that no complaints.

The easiest chem class ever. I got c's in 1a and b but in his class I got an a-. You dont really have to study hard because his notes make sense just pay attention in class and you'll do well. He tells you the week of quizzes what he's looking for so just pay attention to that and you'll do well.

I wish that there was another 1C class at the time. He laughs at his stupid jokes and makes the tests difficult and doesnt explain the topic well. The only reason I passed was because I read the book and did the problems. The curve never changes
Meh.. dude joked around too much. would laugh at everything, kind of annoying.. but overall an ok prof. follow pract exams.

I never ever failed a chemistry course in my entire life. I have been getting A's in other chemistry classes until I took Bardeen's class. Homework and quizzes were easy, but the midterm and final were really difficult because if you miss more than three questions, there is no way you can get an A.
Easiest chemistry professor I ever taken. You don't need your book at all. All lecture notes are online. T.A.s are extremely helpful. Midterm and final is easy if you just do your own homework.

U could not get help from this class at all; TAs were even worse- TA didn't know what to be doing or how to solve the problems!No one cares about ur needs. Office hours? U were lucky if TA was on time...;Grading didn't 100% go by the outlines...

As I think back, his class was pretty easy. Although his midterms were murderers, his final was pretty easy to tame. However, when you need help the most, he doesn't help you at all. He doesn't seem to acknowledge the students who are struggling to try hard in the class. In other words, he's not praiseworthy at all.
his class was EASY...I only  missed one question on the final and each of the midterms. It isnt hard at all like these people say

There were no easy task like people said here. He's a really good professor, but most time, you had to deal with TAs...those people sometime were really miserable, deal with stress from other classes, and Chem1C is a extreme demanding class, you got to put 200% effort to get barely OK-"good" score - class ave=50-65%.

Bardeen is a GREAT teacher. He's clear about what's going to be on the midterm and his practice midterms are really similar to that actual thing. The class wasn't too hard. You have to go to class if you want the notes because he doesn't post them online. I definitely recommend him.

His midterms are extremely hard and much harder than before since he reads this site & changed his exams...also, this quarter's TAs are worst ever, including lab TAs. They are so mean and don't care about if you pass or not, understand or not.

His midterms were fairly difficult. Maybe in the past they were a lot like his practice midterms but don't seem to be anymore. I would study and do follow up problems but I couldn't score well on the midterms.
Good lecturer, but needs to open his eyes. It really sucks sitting there watching him talk to the class without looking at them.
simple redundant material. you can just as easily read the book. hes really chill and grades fairly.

i admit he needs to open his eyes and he needs to improve his teaching style a bit. however, all you need to do is read the book and you will be okay on the parts you don't understand in lecture. practice midterms are almost similar to midterms. online quizzes are very helpful. overall ok teacher. tests are somewhat easy....so....yeah.
Bardeen was a good professor. Very fair with students.

chem 1c is a very demanding class. it's much harder than 1a and 1b. he has a mixture of hard and easy questions on the test, but the hard ones are really hard!! he only has like 20 questions on the test, which is really bad. cause when you get one wrong it's almost 4% grade lower.

he's a real jerk. i went in to talk to him and explain my situation and he didnt even let me explain. he seems like a nice guy but he doesnt help you out when you really need it. i barely passed the class while studying and reading the book. his midterms and final are hard. avoid if you can.

Smart but does not know how to teach.  Too many unneccessary examples, like one's that won't even be on the midterm/final.  It was very irritating to see him lecture EVERYDAY with his eyes closed.  It's like he'll walk into something and fall.  How can he see?!?!
Great professor
Great professor. The class is very engaging. If you do the work, you'll be fine. She goes above and beyond to help her students.

Ms. B is a harsh grader with vague explanation for your score on essays even though she supposedly uses a rubric. She rarely replies to emails. I didn't get much out of this class really. Hard to improve when there's only one draft per essay. Still, she's enthusiastic and clearly cares about students.

A sweet and engaging professor with her talks! I honestly learned a lot of writing skills because of her lectures. I expected her to be a tough grader from what people said about her. And at the end, I wasn't surprised by the scores I got on my essays for sure. She really does care for you and is there to help you out. Difficult, but somewhat fun!

Really sweet professor who loves engaging students and discussing books/ topics, but her curriculum didn't feel too educational towards essay writing. It didn't really feel like I learned anything important, hence the essays ultimately getting poor grades in regard to poor grammar and such.
Took this class for spring 2025, and honestly great professor. She makes things really engaging and helps you grow as a writer.

Pretty good Professor, I will say she is a very harsh grader and does take a while to grade. It is unclear what she actually expects from her students. I tried very hard to get an A- but did make me work hard. You have to go the extra mile.

She was sweet but when it came to grading she was TOUGH. Would highly recommend going to her office hours. 3 essays and one group project. We used a textbook that would sometimes be part of activities we did in class.

Professor Baughman is a gem. She truly cares about her students, wanting to see them succeed. The structure of the class is what makes it so difficult. Go to office hours, ask for example papers that scored high, and participate. Getting an A on an essay is very possible, just make sure that you meet the expectation of the professor.

She's a great professor and more importantly she's a very nice human being, but she's also the he worst or i can say harshest grader for sure. her feedback will never match the grade you receive. Its like she's a completely different person while grading papers.

She's SO SWEET. Super accessible outside of class and on a short notice. Always looked forward to seeing her. However, her grading system was way too harsh. Could never score above a B, but that's relatively the same for all of the Eng04 teachers. No matter how many times I went to the ARC or office hours I could never figure out what she wanted.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: very harsh critic when it comes to grading papers, never was i able to score higher than a B on them despite doing everything she asked in the criteria and even on the single revision we were allowed to do. :( i did enjoy her class, but the amount of work was tedious and exhausting, just stay on top of it and you'll be okay tho!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is a kind person, semi tough grader but teaches content really well, if you participle in class she will be more lenient.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: If you hate English, you'll hate this class. If you love it, you'll love this class. We wrote 4 essays, including the final, each about any topic we wanted, but with different writing requirements. I used SparkNotes to cover the required book for the final, so no need to actually read it. Does not give good feedback on essays, but allows rewrites.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very supportive and understanding has a clear grading structure, make sure you go to office hours for essay help and always ask for questions. Make sure you do readings she does pop quizzes. Otherwise I enjoyed her she is better than other English 4 instructors.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: She's pretty chill, just do the readings and you should be fine. She does pop quizzes but their easy if you do the reading. She's nice and understanding. Make sure to follow the rubric for essays and answer the questions properly. Otherwise you should be fine. I personally never felt stressed about this class except when writing essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I enjoyed this professor and made me feel comfortable in class. I attended office hours and that helps with your essays because my essay sucked. But she made me enjoy this class a little although it is a lot of busy work. and be prepared to be assigned with lots of work to do 4 essays and then the final
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Lorelei B., had clear expectation from the beginning of the quarter. She was very lenient when it came to my absences due to COVID, and would always allocate for my missed time. During my time in class, she was always lively and made sure to include all the students. She brought me out of my comfort zone and made sure others got out too.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Her grading was kind of unclear when it came to the essays. There isn't a lot of homework so most of your grade is based on the essays so don't skimp out on them. She's very caring and it's obvious she likes her job which is why I rate her so highly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is generally a good experience for me. While only receiving a C- on my first essay, hearing the feedback really helped me understand and pay extra attention during my next essay (4 essays and a final total). When I was sent home for 10 days because of State health regulations, she was very responsive so I didn't fall behind.

The professor is kind, although the course was not easy to follow since the system of submitting assignments through google drive was difficult for no reason. Ive emailed the prof about a question I had and never had a reply as well. The class just felt strange and felt a lack in organization.

Professor Baughman is an amazing/ lovely professor who tries her best to help her students. She's very good at explaining topics/ assignments and hardly anyone asks for clarification. Although she is a tough grader on essays, her grading makes you want to work harder. There's 4 essays, and you can revise one for a better grade.

One of the kindest, and best English teachers I've ever had. Really sweet lady. 4 essays, 1 final, expect to do some group projects and participate. Bit of a tough grader, but you get the score you deserve. Encourages students to ask questions and go to her when they need help. She explains the content really well. Readings we do are interesting.

This guy is awesome. All the tests are just regurgitated information from the lectures, so be ready to show up and take notes because the slides he GIVES are a little different from the slides he SHOWS in class. Grading is straight-forward and easy, just a little memorization needed (not too difficult to memorize the general details).

Professor Sullivan presents all of the material in an easily digestible way for the modern student, and tells you explicitly at the beginning of each lecture which terms will be on the quizzes. Super helpful, super devoted, and loves to chat before or after class about sports or history.
All exams were in person but he gives you one of the best study guides I've ever received in all years of schooling. Only way to fail this class is to be braindead. Take this class if you can.
Very laid back professor, one of best I've had.

He is a very well rounded good professor, tries to oversimplify explanation and make students involve in lectures which helps understand and pay attention. Doesn't give hard tests and overall laid back.

Dr. Sullivan makes it clear that he does not keep track of who shows up, but he doesn't post the slides with the notes. He is easy to reach throughout the day, and he puts in the time and effort to help the students fully understand the course material. Grading-wise, he usually only docks points when there is an answer that is absolutely wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: easy but all I can say is bewaree..run.. not nice

Easy summer class—just read articles. Ben aimed for a stress-free, discussion-based environment, but it often turned into a grilling on recollection of readings. While the material itself was informative, the lectures lacked real engagement and dialogue. Overall, lecture was simply inefficient.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really chill guy. No midterm or final, just online quiz homework twice a week and one essay paper. You have to read articles to do the quizzes and they're long but really interesting. If you want, you can just skim read them and still do really well. You can tell he really cares about his research.

Easy class. You have around three readings every Monday and Wednesday, which are easy and typically small reads, but they are free and provided by him via PDF. There are two super-easy quizzes per week based on the readings. Quiz-based class! He is very funny and understanding and has makeup options. Expect to be cold-called (very nicely) :)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very easy class that consists of 2 weekly online quizzes and a current events writing assignment as the midterm. If you're looking for a class to boost your GPA, this is the perfect choice. Attending lectures is unnecessary since he lectures on the material you already took a quiz on the night before. Overall, a decent class with a chill professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took POSC 145 with Newman years ago, and he was incredibly difficult. In lieu of a midterm, he instead had quizzes on Monday based on articles he would send us. The problem was, Newman often never posted the articles until maybe 8 PM Sunday night. Even if we emailed, he wouldn't reply until maybe 2 in the morning. I don't recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Classes were very chill and relaxed, nothing was ever too stressful. Clearly passionate about what he teaches and tries to make it enjoyable for the students. Light course work, mostly just reading a couple things per week (sometimes these can get quite lengthy) but classes really help you get to understand the material.
My favorite professor I've had so far at UCR. Love the grading system/class format, super engaging and cool guy

Had him for PBPL002 and PBPL185 and he is very consistent. Weekly quizzes based on readings that are super easy. No tests or finals and just a short paper that you can do in a day. He is really funny and chill and laidback, might come off as rude sometimes but he just wants you to participate and he is really passionate about what he does. Easy A

Ben Newman is a chill professor, although he can come off as rude sometimes. His class is extremely easy and primarily dependent on research paper readings and quizzes assigned before every lecture. As long as you read and attend class, securing a high grade should be no problem.

Professor Newman is one of the best professors I've ever had in person and online. His student expectations are so clear and his course requirements/ assignments are so easy yet informative. Your syllabus is your guide for ALL of his classes, so make sure you check it quite frequently to ensure that you don't have any slip-ups!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed taking public policy with Professor Newman. There are 2 quizzes based off the readings and a final paper. There isn't a final exam or and midterms. There is a lot of reading so keep up with that. As long as you skim/read the articles and chapters the quizzes will be very easy. The quizzes are 70% of the grade and 30% is the paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Newman has a very liberal way of grading students. No midterm, no final. Weekly reading quizzes determines a majority of your grade. Readings are very straight forward, usually is a chapter from the textbook and 1-2 scholarly articles. Quizzes are fairly straight forward. Newman also does not require attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Newman is very understanding and funny. The weekly readings are kind of a lot but you don't do much else in the class besides a paper that you can finish in a day so it evens out. You don't have to understand every detail of the readings, just have a general understanding. If you are struggling read the highlighted portions of journals! Easy A!!!

Professor Newman was super chill there was only one quiz a week and a easy term paper. Professor purposefully design the help student avoid overload during the quarter. That being said the readings were a bit rough since most of data driven political science journals entries but all in all would recommend. provides all readings as PDFs on ilearn

Pretty young professor, honestly looks like a TA. He's got the millennial humor that helped me stay awake during lecture and you can tell he cares about what he's doing as a researcher. He only grades with class quizzes, so no midterm or final. But you have to read to do well; usually we read almost 30-40 pages each lecture day (2 times a week).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures are never boring and his dry humor will keep you entertained. He encourages students to participate, discussion is on the assigned readings so be ready for class. Quizzes are straightforward if you read you'll do good. Knows how to get the point across and you actually learn more than just the average textbook material.

Weekly quizzes that count for 70% of your grade and a term paper worth 30%. The quizes are entirely based on the readings he assigns. The paper is clearly outlined on what he wants in it. Overall very easy class. I put in little effort myself and still recived a respectable grade. Not really a teacher (his words) but a great professor to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: midterm scores were really bad, final was duable. she replaces your midterm with your final if your final is higher and offered extra credit. does a lot of practice in class but not very reflective of the exams. i would study a lot outside of class and you other resources if you have her

The midterm averages were very low in both sections (one being 40%), and many students felt the exams were much harder than the homework and lecture examples. I had to do a lot of self-studying because lectures and course material didn't prepare me enough for the exam questions. Her office hours are useful.
...good luck if you will have her class its hard I felt like I was majoring in math
Thrives on students tears. Istg she laughed when our midterm avg was below 50%. If u get her RUN!
Professor Eastham offers lots of office hours and is chill. Content is harder than a normal precalc class, but she tries her best.

Even whilst getting a good grade in this class the lectures were extremely confusing, she would not work through problems just concepts and the way she taught was even worse, only way to get a good grade is tutoring and studying every week on your own, it's a completely self taught class grade is heavily dependent on final but it's open note

The professor is very nice but the material is super confusing so you really have to pay attention (and ask questions) to grasp anything during lectures. Honestly you'll be fine as long as you do the homework every week. Final is 50% of your grade so definitely study up. Focus on MyOpenMath and understanding word problems for the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She gave lots of extra credit when I had her class.  She was really nice to me and supported me improving me grade.  Just be sure to focus in lecture, when in doubt ask.

She is terrible at explaining things and talks extremely fast. Abbreviates three letter words and never explains what the abbreviations are for. Her teaching style is all over the place which makes things even more difficult.

Im only one week into my freshman year and she's already one of the worst teachers I've ever had. She talks too much about simple things and overcomplicates them. Her writing is difficult to read and she writes way too much for little things, she also likes to abbreviate everything even if she's only explained it once...
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her grading is tough.

I may just be bad at math, but almost nothing she says makes sense. You can see she makes an effort, but she skips a lot of the work as it is "self-explanatory" to her, handwriting is really messy, and she abbreviates randomly and no one understands. She does walk around a lot in class to answer questions and releases helpful practice exams.

Friendly, offers tutoring, and provides study guides that are kind of similar to the exams. However, she teaches extremely fast and overcomplicates a lot of the work. There were multiple occasions where she released study guides late, and with incorrect solutions which were sometimes never fixed. If you have the choice, do not take this professor.

Goes over a lot of information during lectures, but she complicates it and in the end it doesn't make sense. There is extra credit opportunity. Overall, I wouldn't take her again maybe if she went step by step with the math then yes. sorry

Overcomplicates the math during lectures, the test is pretty heavy, some of it is similar to the practice exams. I had to watch videos to understand the math. However, it was very unclear and I fell behind.

I say she's an average professor, she is nice, but she goes over way too much material in each class. She does talk really fast, and give a lot of homework. Overall, I would take her again if I had to, but she overcomplicates simple math concepts that can lead to confusion
She is kind and always accepts late assignments within one week. However, the class can be hard to follow because her explanations are sometimes unclear

She is very hard to follow in lecture. She has a decent grading curve (a 65% is a C), however, I found that in order to do well in her class I had to spend a lot of time watching videos or learning in other ways cause she verbally over complicates the math and makes it sound like nonsense.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The notes on the board, goes fast even when asked to slow down says "I'll try, we are behind". Isn't too understanding either; expected a video of my car not turning on the day of; I couldn't show up to discussion class; missed a quiz. She overcomplicates the math. Sweet professor but not understanding, not easy.
Kind, but topics aren't adequately explained. Homework questions are confusing/poorly written, and sometimes aren't covered in lecture.
great teacher, insane curve, anyone complaining is a brainlet

Not sure why people don't like her. She goes by a bit fast in her lectures, but if you're stuck, she's really useful in office hours. She only has a midterm and final, and the study guides for them are very similar to the actual exams. If you were in calculus before this class, it should be free. If you only took up to precalc, you might struggle.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I liked the professor last quarter. She is very friendly and kind to students.  Her uniqueness is she never use slides, just put all things in board. She never posted lecture notes on Canvas. In her office hours, she is very patience to explain some difficult questions.

From last quarter, I liked this professor. Because she is young, and she is nice to students. In her lecture, she never used slides, just put all things on board. In her office hours, she is patient to explains some hard questions.

She goes through concepts at the speed of light and overcomplicates basic concepts. I'm currently on week 4 of her 06B class (precalc) and I think I'm going to have to teach myself everything before the midterm/final because following her teaching might actually be impossible. Take another professor

Zooms through math work and just asks if you have questions. She overcomplicates every single concept for no reason. I am re-learning most of the material because of high school and she just ends up confusing me more than reviewing what I already know. She gives 5 minute breaks though I guess. You can tell she cares but no one understands her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I'll agree with other students that she may go too fast in the lectures, however you can easily go on youtube and review the concepts yourself in an easier manner. The midterms and final were very similar to the practice ones she provides so I'd recommend going over those heavily. If you study enough and efficiently, the class shouldn't be hard.
Awful lecturer. Zooms past the exercises like an F1 Driver and asks us if we have questions. I have no idea what she just did. DON'T take! It will kill your GPA.

Honestly, I only passed this class because I took calculus in high school. The lectures are informative but fast, so there isn't enough time to write down all her notes.  Study hard for those tests because if not your grade is dead. Even with Batman's levels of prep time, I don't know if she could properly plan out her course lectures. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I liked her this quarter! She was very accessible outside of lecture, however I only was able to get through the class because I spent an ungodly amount of time outside of the class. Her grading scale is very helpful though, as it's clear she WANTS you to pass the class! Note: She DOES NOT teach with slides -- sometimes hard to follow along.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: As someone who did not take Calc in highschool, this class is a nightmare. She tend to skip steps when solving problems and overlooks the concepts. The discussion ws/hw are unrelated to the tests. I think I might just quit engineering. Her grading system is also a mess and I'm expecting to fail at this point. Some ppl didnt even show up to final.

The professor goes over lecture material too quickly and makes this course feel like a part two, rather than an introduction to the course, the quizzes are tougher than the homework and cover problems that are not similar to any of the homework or lecture examples she provides. Don't take this course!
For the final review she asked us to prepare questions and literally could not solve two of them. I think I'd rather k*ll myself than take this class again tbh

Extremely difficult teacher and her teaching style is bad, didn't efficiently teach the material and sped through things until the end of the quarter. She was funny though and tried to make the class easygoing. Dont recommend it for students who have a hard time in math.

The lessons were too fast-paced and the professor's explanations of concepts were not always clear, making it too difficult to grasp the material in lectures. You will end up having to re-teach yourself most concepts. Quizzes were also way too advanced.

Everyone says this class is hard, but I completely disagree. She is amazing—her charisma and teaching style make learning so enjoyable. She's incredibly fair and lenient, making the class approachable and stress-free. If you stay engaged, you'll love it. reviews.comment: He is a tough professor. He gives a lot of homework and in class activities  For students who are lazy and not want to do any work, this is definitely not the class for you.
