reviews.comment: This class was okay, but if you get Diana as your TA,  switch out immediately.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The lectures are absolutely necessary. All the images and formal analysis of the art works are covered in lecture. There's not much studying required at all especially if you already know the formal art elements or familiar with it. The Midterm and Final are very straight forward. I would definitely recommend this class, it's not meant to be hard.
Davis is very refreshing. She teaches the class well, although lecture attendance is definitely a must to pass. The class is a lot of memorization (obviously, like any art history course).

She is a very tough grader!!! But also, nice and polite (just don't talk/whisper when she's talking) There is 1 midterm, final, 2 writing assignments. There are lots of and very long readings. I liked the subject very much, but she expected too much out of us (non AHS majors-students) I would suggest not taking this class.

Taking Professor Davis is like taking a breath of fresh air!  Not saying that the other art history professors are bad or anything in fact, I'm very happy with our staff but she has a sparkle in her eye whenever she teaches. Her enthusiasm is contagious. Great class, redundant information, especially if you've already taken 17C. I def recommend!

Her class consist of a midterm, final, and a 5-7 page paper. She grades fair enough, I received an A, considering that she in incredibly helpful so you can ask her about anything. Also she is very excited about what she is teaching, which really helps get her students more excited. I would recommend this class.

She is a tough teacher. Her syllabus was tough. You will have so much work to do, but in the end it helps you to write your essay. THe things you will learn in her class are interesting and will make you think a different perspective. Her grading is hard. She won't give you an A unless you are truely put a lot of time and effort to it.
she is really fake and rude. she does not really truly care if you pass or fail, she's out to fail every first year to prove she is "smart" seems to enjoy talking to women as to men....

She is simply amazing!  She is challenging though, but in a way that benefits students.  You won't get an A on your paper unless it truly is an "A" paper.  But the thing is, she will totally help you make your paper into an A paper.  Just go to your office hours and she will explain how you can improve your paper, and you will LEARN in the process!

I had jennifer as a TA and she is by far the most helpful TA on campus.  She goes out of her way to help you on class material and on any of your english work as well.  Very clear and easy to understand.  Not intimdating and knows her stiff. GO JENNIFER!
Jennifer is extremely helpful and just awesome in general.  One of the best at clarifying difficult material and analyzing texts.
Jennifer's class is very fun. She is great at making things interesting for the students and her curriculum is challenging while enjoyable at the same time. She also wears the best outfits ever.
The class was fun she was very organized and ontop of things.

As a language major this was a major disappointment because I really want to learn from credited teachers but it was just impossible in this class. I understand that she is not a native French speaker but she acts like her French is so perfect when clearly it is not. Worst teacher on campus!!!

People on this website seem to dislike her but I have nothing but positive things to say about Professor Bloom, her voice is interesting but once you get beyond that she is a very fun and entertaining professor. If you go to her office hours and introduce yourself at the beginning of the quarter she will be nice to you the entire quarter!

Generally a nice lady until you hit some of her nerves i.e. slamming the door when leaving, using cell phones in class, etc. The films that she showed for screening are quite interesting and the group projects that she assigns are fun, creative ways to get an easy A.

She knows her stuff, but she spends a large portion of class trying to figure out how to use Powerpoint. She shows interesting movies and the class is easy enough if you attend lecture/screenings. Has some unreasonable expectations (printing out readings every week), but grades fairly.

Most annoying MCS professor at UCR...mean-spirited, assigns way too much reading and projects/papers for a lower-division class, doesn't really know her stuff, most irritating voice in the world...avoid at all costs. It's a shame cause I was looking forward to this class...
She is not a good prof chose not very interesting french films attendance mandatory but useless. Bad Prof dont take!

Terrible! She talks way too much and doesn't let one get into the film that is being watched. She is nit-picky about being late and fusses when things don't go her way. Her fashion sense is horrible and I don't learn anything. Going to class is a chore. She took a fantastic class (food in film) and made it dreadful.

Hey! i had this teacher for 2years and shes crazy. She has some weird mood swings and if she does not like you it will affect your grade.  She takes it to the personal level. Could be very rude... if you dont have to take her class  avoid her !!

An all-around awful professor.  The vast majority of this course is common sense and reading; if you're looking to learn anything about film, look elsewhere.  Movie selections were quite good, but the professor herself is a conceited bore.

Sorry to say that this professor pretty much sucks. I found her class to be extremely boring and non-informative. As far as help...well you can just forget it! She rarely takes the time out to meet with her students outside of her office hours. To sum it up, any class you dread going to is simply not a good class.

Awful professor. I mean, I think you have to literally turn up **** out of your mind to attend her class. She never tries to focus on amazing authors like Victor Hugo, Dumas, but instead tries her crappy fairy tale rubbish. Absolutely awful, and by the way, she speaks VERY bad french.
very wierd, confussing at times.

She's a great professor, and a wonderful resource for information. She's very intelligent. Her voice is "unique," but once you get past that, she's awesome. She is incredibly savvy and teaches in a very lucid manner. I'll take her classes as many times as I can while I'm here at riverside.

I took her class, reading her resume. It was an impressive resume because of her institution she attended. However, I must sincerely express my deepest disappointment in her teaching. It was unclear, truly dull, and most of all, she needs to brush up on her French. Fo realz

This professor is truly incompetent. She speaks French with an awful accent and grammatical mistakes ( especially for someone who has been in academia for a while ). She is furthermore quite confused about teaching, and look out if you speak French almost like a native! She'll feel threatened.

I've never had such a good French class.  She had a way of picking out exactly where I was having trouble and giving me perfect comments on my papers.  Plus, she's just a really nice person who loves what she does and wants to help others love it too. (BTW:  Only boring people get bored.)
Easy but boooring, she could make her class a lot funner! Have had better french teachers. I didn't learn anything in her class either, it was kind of pointless!
She is very dedicated teacher. She knows her stuff and related a bunch of film genres and themes together. I enjoyed her class. Her quizzes are tricky though.

She challenges students and expects class participation. She takes roll and is strict on absences. She will call on people at random if no one participates. She knows her stuff and looks to find deeper meanings in film. Yes, the way she talks is strange!!
Is a good teacher in class, but outside fo class, not very helpful.
Not the worst professor, just annoying and dull.  She didn't make film and visual culture interesting at all or even give a good reason to take the class.
the voice has to got to go...
Easy class, great professor.
Took this class during Winter 2025. Great professor, always available for office hours offering lots of help. Lab was tedious, but she was always present to help.

She likes to do a lot of situational questions (you are being chased by a bear but you havent eaten anything recently, what is upregulated, etc). Exams were fair but alot of questions (avg 60-70%, but curved generously) BUT it was her first time teaching 110B, so it will prob be easier for future classes. Overall, she is good and she will improve

This class was obviously gonna be a mission to do well in, and it definitely is possible to excel under this professor. Lab reports not graded on how well you do in lab, but on how well you discuss the contents. Tests are not terrible, but get ready for some big FRQs here and there. Also offers extra credit here and there. Overall, she's very fair.

Super easy class. Honestly if you attend lecture regularly and take good notes you'll be fine. Discussions are mandatory, but the work is pretty simple. The projects are extremely self-explanatory! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for an easy breath course!

This professor isn't understanding. A professor has discretion on how to proceed when a student is struggling either mentally/emotionally, physically, or financially (in my case, all three) she isn't understanding at all. God forbid you struggle and need some time and space. Honestly if you can avoid her, just take another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Intro to nutrition is not the same with Dr. Bobadilla, it's a lot harder. Lecture isn't mandatory and is extra credit which is cool but you're not getting an A if you don't go to lecture. I also got a bad TA for this which made it harder, but the worst part is the midterm and final because she loves trick questions and it gets annoying.

Professor Ye left midway through the quarter but her test were pretty difficult and she was difficult to understand which made the lectures hard to understand. I recommend to rely on independent studying because her lectures don't cover all the test material. The extra credit definitely helped with grades though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: idk why her rating is so low. shes a very caring and cool professor. Material is pretty hard but she does well explaining with fun and engaging examples. only had her for half the quarter cuz she got in a car accident, but I like her grading system and she gives a lot of EC. Her tests are pretty hard but your grade is usually balanced by all the EC

She left halfway through the quarter, but what I did know of her she was very sweet and caring. The course can be very hard for a lot of students, but if you stay on top of your work, study, and attend lectures you'll be fine. I will admit, it is hard to understand her and her lectures don't quite cover all test materials so read the book!!!!

Professor Bohan is funny and good professor. The only problem with her class are the test. You only have 70 minutes to complete 52 questions. If you do not know your stuff, you will fail. However, she does give a lot of extra credit opportunites. Furthermore, the final is optional, but you only have 70 minutes on it and it iscumulative.
The class is relatively easy if you put in the work. However the average was lower than my ochem class for exams.

This professor shows little consideration for students facing emergencies, offering minimal flexibility or support. The course moves at a very fast pace, making it hard to keep up if you fall behind even briefly. Communication is limited, guidance is scarce, and mandatory lectures can negatively affect students regardless of circumstances. Overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Really nice and kind and funny professor that makes lectures fun with activities and gives out lots of extra credit opportunities. BUT, those tests are really hard so make sure you lock in (the average for each test was really low)

I loved Dr. Ye's lectures. She makes them so fun with lots of movie clips and also has games that you can play for extra credit. Not too much homework. There are two tests and an optional final. The tests are all open note, but they will still be challenging if you don't understand the material. She's very kind and energetic too.

This class is hard if you don't pay attention, the average is around a C but this is likely due to people not taking the exam seriously. If you put in some work(show up to class everytime) and average a 76% on the exams then you should get an A.

honestly, anyone who doesnt rate these profs a 5 just doesnt pay attention to lectures or doesnt read instructions. everything is clearly written in the assignment specs and they verbally reiterate this information in lectures. They put clear expectations and the instructions are not hard to follow at all. Take home midterm and final

Just literally give time to write the assignments and revise, everything they're looking for is clear and posted in the rubric. Gave stories that reflected material in class, was funny and very helpful. I enjoyed this class and would take it again. Not as bad as people are saying it is.
They didnt let me eat cheese in class. very frustrated

This professor was the simply the worst, it's a mandatory class so you have to take it but seriously they are so rude and condescending, they dont want to teach rather belittle and make your life difficult. I seriously do not recommend them but you dont have another option. they would make weird comments and statements and lecture was mandatory.
