reviews.comment: easy class, just follow writing guidelines. wouldn't take the class cos the final made me question my will to live (3500+ words worth of essays). and attendance is mandatory

I found my experience with this professor to be extremely frustrating. They were consistently rude in class, making students feel uncomfortable or unwelcome when asking questions or seeking clarification.  On top of that, the professor frequently strayed off-topic during lectures, making it difficult to follow the material or stay engaged.

She is condescending to students when they ask questions. She talks about how "men like to interrupt," but in all the lectures, she has constantly interrupted every SINGLE one. She is very egotistical and thinks that her knowledge is far superior to anybody in the class. Highly unprofessional yet, we're deducted points if we're unprofessional.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She spent fifteen minutes doing speculative fiction about 9/11. She said that the designer must have been "a little relieved that the towers collapsed straight down and didn't fall over sideways like a tree onto other buildings." Using misinformation and fanfic of 9/11 is just wild. She is also super condescending.
This is by far the worst professor in UCR. You get graded on how she feels during that day. If she's having a bad day your not ganna get an A. UCR needs a new professor for this class.
UCR should genuinely be ashamed they have professors like these, who disrespect every second of your interaction with her inside and outside of the classroom.

UCR should be embarrassed to have this be the only available "professor" to teach a mandatory class. Insultingly poor lecture quality and 0 respect from professors to students. Grading is extremely subjective and dependent if they like you or not, so be sure to talk in the chat! Final is a requirement of 3500 words for the sake of giving busy work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: 90 minutes of lecture, with 40 minutes reading the slide, 30 minutes ranting, 20 minutes telling her life story in which nobody cares, they don't always change the writing guidelines, saying you need to write the paper with 20 words less each sentences then suddenly changed it to >15 and still grade the paper badly.

Repetitive and overcomplicated assignments coupled with lectures that are equally as useless. Professors are rude and are "strict" to have their class reflect "real life work environments". I now know I would never want to work for a company run by people like these two, so I can thank them for at least teaching me that. Do better UCR.

I have never in my life hated a course so much until I took this one. This is by far one of the most annoying, pointless, boring, and tedious courses I have ever taken in my entire life. The final for this class is actually insane. For some reason Sharon and Bonni think having to make students write 5 papers is a good idea.

This is without a doubt the most frustrating course I have ever taken in my entire life. Bonni is nit picky in grading and marks unfairly. She tells class to ask question but if your question comes off as stupid to her she will takes points from you. I just really dislike this class and can not wait to never see this Professor ever again.

This professor enjoys wasting everyone's time by getting sidetracked. I also appreciate how rigid she is about the presentations, requiring a maximum of one minute to be spent discussing each slide. Yet she will ramble for 20 minutes talking about absolute nonsense.
You definitely want to find a different professor if possible

This class can be taught in a 2-hour long video, instead, it is a dreadful semester with a lot of writing assignments. The final is 5 essays combined in a week and a multiple-choice test, totally not necessary and you are just wasting time elaborating SIMPLE subjects. Other than the writing guideline the class is a total waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The class is pretty easy but the final is honestly a joke. 3500 words and the questions are pretty vague. Out of all my classes this one took about a full week to finish. One of the most unenjoyable papers I have ever had to write.
You can just turn your brain off and do the assignments and get easy 100s, just follow the writing guidelines. A lot of the stuff in the lecture is common sense, didn't learn anything in this class.

lowk goated. Mandatory to come to class though, because in-class work and essays are all the grades. You write 3 timed essays in class, but he guides you through them, and they were lowkey a breeze. Probably the best English professor you can get bruh, pray you can have him teach your Writ 20. Answers email super and super understanding.
Professor Bond grades your essays right in front of you during office hours. If you take the criticism to heart, you'll get a pretty good grade. Otherwise, your mileage may vary.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: actually one of the best professors on ucr! 3 in-class essays but you get a lot of time to write them, he always gives great feedback about the essays afterwards. you focus on 1 book and a few excerpts from a textbook, but def get him if you can

Genuinely one of the best professors I've ever had, he is incredibly encouraging and will add additional office hours just to make sure his students have one-on-one time with him so that they feel heard. Class is pretty easy, three essays and a book to read, as well as in-class activities, so attendance is very important.

He was such a good professor; there were 3 major essays you wrote in the class. There were quizzes on a book, but the questions were very open ended. He is very understanding so communicate with him. He gives feedback on almost every assignment and the feedback is clear and tells you what you did well and what you can improve on. Overall very chill
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is a good professor and he gives great feedback during office hours for essays. We had daily participation assignments and you had to be in class to complete them but other than that we had 3 essays that made up the majority of my grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall, decent guy. Liked his class but you have to go so hopefully you don't get an early one like I did. Papers weren't too bad, have to present in class so if that's not your thing don't take this class. Understanding if you have personal matters.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I loved this class! Essay prompts were really interesting & allow you to write about things you are actually interested in. Dr. Bond was an amazing teacher. He cares about his students, their opinions, and interests. He encourages participation and diverse ideas. Probably my favorite class I've taken at UCR.

I knew I took Dr. Bond for granted once I found my 1B professor. He was an amazing professor, funny and inviting. I'd like to believe that he was easy on grading but also gave constructive criticism. Great person overall and gave me allotted time when I needed so.
Really passionate professor and if you read the syllabus it is easy to get an A

Made class grading transparent and very helpful as a freshman coming into college. English was very understandable. Homework was easy to understand and relatively light. Relatively easy grader as well and pretty understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Bond is a very accessible teacher who is very straightforward, gives ample amounts of time to take care of edits and revisions with valuable feedback , and is a generally amazing person.

Professor Bond is pretty considerate on late work and it's easy to get a gauge on what he wants from your work from his feedback. However, be weary of your essay topics because if it is not something that he agrees with, the grading might be a little harsher than usual. Also, you must be super in depth with your summaries of the readings, so no bs.
Best English teacher. Not too much work and grades very fairly. Participate in class though
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Bond is a shining addition to UCR's writing program. He's a great example of why you should actually care about some of your GenEd courses and put some effort into them, but even past the teacher stuff, he's a very nice guy and super approachable outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Good Professor I ever had before in my English Class. Just come to his office hour and he will gives you useful feedback for your essay or any assignment
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: While he does assign a lot of work, his grading is pretty lenient. He gives a ton of good feedback, so go to his office hours for all your essays and presentation! Each time I went, he would fix any grammar errors and tell me what to fix, generally giving me a really high grade after. If you go to his office hours, you will get an easy A.

Bond is a really good professor. Thing is, he grades really hard and gives you a lot of reading compared to other professors my friends have taken. If you do take him, always go to his office hours to receive feedback.

Professor Bond is such an amazing professor. Very fair with load of assignments. Definitely will allow you to improve writing skills without overwhelming you. Not many essays compared to other classes. Very chill and down to earth person. 100% recommend him as a professor for any class offered.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Bond is a really chill teacher. He is very understanding of anything going on in your life. You may be intimidated in the beginning because he does require you to do a lot of extra work. To get a good participation grade you should have your camera on every class and participate a lot. Just be present and you will do good.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took his class during the summer and when he emailed his students that he was teaching English 1B I immediately signed up. Hes very lenient with grading as long as you understand the material and try. He knows a lot about the topic he teaches and picks interesting topics. He cares about his students and is really fun/chill. Best English teacher!

Professor Bond was one of my favorites out of the quarter. He was super chill and understanding about any situation you may be in. His grading and feedback was helpful and straightforward which was great and made me want to write better each essay. I think just reading is the main area to focus on in his class, but 10/10 would take him again!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Bond prerecorded his lectures and no Zoom. The class schedule was laid out. A few hw assignments a week, and every other week a huge quiz to complete in 24h. Reading the material the day of the quiz is a bad idea. The quizzes are worth a lot of points, and he puts in a ec quz that can help your grade a lot. Bond lets you pick your essay topics
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Bond is a great professor who does care about his students and their writing. Would highly recommend his course ONLY if you want to excel as a writer, because he will make you better if you use him. The grading is the only thing that may be a little controversial. Use his critiques for your essays and make sure to change what he suggests.
Great professor. If you have a chance absolutely try to take his class

Loved this class. Not usually a fan of writing, but from Prof Bond's feedback I had a genuine desire to improve my writing skills. Can be very chatty but is very helpful in providing feedback or just chatting in general. Best English professor you can take at UCR!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. At first I was scared about it since I heard how terrible the grading was, but honestly Mr. Bond gave me pretty high scores on my essays. You just have to go to as many office hours as you can and fix as much as you can. He'll understand that if you put in the effort and really want a high grade, you deserve one.

Personality alone is great! He's mellow and funny and can relate to his students. As long as you do the work (which isn't even that much) you'll get a good grade. He lets you use notes for quizzes adds a bonus extra credit question on the novel he assigns to help boost our grade. He is passionate and understanding, overall really great.

Legit the best English Professor hands down to have. Hes so laidback but at the same time can be professional. 4 papers and final ended up being a short paper pertaining to what we wrote on our 4th essay. There are 10 Journals he assigns weekly and he has in class quizzes but the brightness of it, they are BOTH OPEN NOTE AND OPEN BOOK. Take him.

Professor Bond was really interesting and laid back while doing a good job of teaching major 1A concepts on the fall. I thought his grading was fair but a little inconsistent as he took off points on things I did well. Ended up with an A-

He is a great professor except we had 4 reading quizzes that were a total of 100 points so it was important to read the readings because if not you could end up with a C in that class since they are worth 10% of the grade. Overall, he is a really good grader when it comes to the essays. I would recommend taking him if you like writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: he's explains in detail. he makes sure everyone understands everything he's saying. he's a bit tough on grading tho. but overall he's a great teacher. and he's also just amazing as a person.

Coming from Prof Sterling in 1A where I only got Cs on all of the essays, I was shocked to have a B+ my first essay with Bond. He thoroughly explains what he wants and doesn't have unreasonable grading standards. Bonus: He's super chill, inspirational, and funny. For once I felt comfortable going to a professors office hours. I'd take his 1C class.

One of the best professors hands down! His optimism radiates the entire classroom and it makes the class a lot more interesting. He is extremely clear on what he wants from your essays, and is pretty lenient in regards to the readings. Great way to begin college

He assigns about 4 essays but we have plenty of time to do them and get feedback before their due dates. Tells us when we are going to have quizzes, but they can be hard if you don't at least skim through the chapter.  HARD GRADER WITH ESSAYS! so talk to him to get feedback. Overall he's pretty chill and great at explaining things.
Amazing teaching methods. He talks about interesting topics that we can all relate to. Down to earth don't be shy just talk to him and be comfortable in his class.

In my opinion, he is not a very tough grader. He gave me pretty good feedback on essays and was very helpful when I would go to office hours.  I would completely take it again! My lowest grade in his essays was an 89%, so I pretty much aced the rest of them. However in my final grade, it showed up completely different:( (it must have been the final

He is very straight forward on how to pass the class. It does require time to prepare for the quizzes and essays, but if you do what he tells you, it is easy to pass the class with a high B or and A. Has good sense of humor and his lectures are always entertaining. Really enjoyed the class.

Extremely clear. Be glad you got him. He does a great job giving feedback so be sure to ask questions I promise it'll be worth it. Go to office hours for your essays if you are struggling. But I don't think he is a tough grader.I feel extremely confident in writing essays now!

Amazing professor! Great way to start off freshmen year. Super clear and organized throughout quarter. If you put the work and listen in his class easy B+ even an A. Very chill and understands and connects with his students! Definitely would love having him again!

Good teacher, fun class. To get an A attend all of the classes, and get help from him on your essays. Easy A if you're willing to put the time in. Also worth noting is that the class isn't boring like all my previous English classes. I recommend taking him.

Took the class Fall 13. I was terrified of asking permission to enroll in his class because of his ratings.(UCR Extension)He was understanding i had to commute by train& not at all mean he did admited to being a hard grader,but also encouraged everyone to attend office hours. He helped a lot &used "juxtaposed" frequently. Thank you mr. bond

I really enjoyed this class. Mr. Bond was great. He was very knowledgeable and helpful.As long as you do your work and take his feedback seriously there is no reason why you cant get an "A." If you are lazy and not serious about your education then you will not do well in his class. I highly recommend him. Excellent professor.

I had Mr. Bond for English 50, and I must admit he expects a lot. You just need to put in the work, he's a great professor. I enjoyed his class. He pushes you to do your best! If you don't take the class seariously...that's your problem. He taught me a lot, he spent time helping me perfect my papers. He enjoys teaching and I think he's awesome

He was the worst English teacher I had ever had. I think he made English 004 harder than it needs to be. If you get him, it's almost a guarantee C if you are lucky B- which seems like one or two of the class would get. I don't understand his grading system.

I have to agree with the people below me, this TA grades on a scale where an A Essay can be published in a book, standards are very high for undergrad. His teaching style is poor and does not do anything to help you improve a significant amount of points on the essays.Got A in previous part of series, but gonna get a C or fail with effort in class.

very ANAL at grading! Does not bore in class though. If you want an A, it is unlikely because only about 1 or 2 people get in the A range: A-/A/A+. You try your best, you might be able to get in the B range. This guy's a loser. :(
Not good. Not helpful. Do not take him! I felt uncomfortable around him big time.

For an English Class, he is very hard. He expects you to study the readings as thoroughly as you possible can and to read all the readings along with quizzes, presentation and 5 essays. For an English 1C class, he makes sure you work just to pass the class and pass the requirement.He also assigns short essays along with teh essays you have to type.

Good teacher overall but requires to much for a Eng1B class, wants you to go above and beyond for that A. Ended up with a B in the course and I know if I took someone else I would have got an A hands down.
he is soooo unorganized and can really justify your grade on a paper if u ask him

This professor is the GOAT. You must take him because he is a great example of what a professor should be. He makes the exams hard and the class is difficult (E&M is hard), but he curves 2 letter grades up and gives 10% worth of extra credit opportunities. I wish more professors were like him.

Great lectures with practical demonstrations and detailed slides. While the course material is hard, Hemmerling is very lenient with the grade scale and plenty of extra credit, making it impossible to fail the class if you put a decent amount of effort in. All in all, a very nice and understanding professor who's also approachable.

Heads up: his practice exams are not like the real exams. The course, homework, and exams are very hard (heavy calculus + concepts), but the curve is insane, 65% = B-. If you put in reasonable effort, you'll pass. Super approachable and genuinely nice professor.
Such a nice professor in terms of grading and homework deadlines. Approachable and his lectures are amazing.

It's quite crazy how much extra credit he gives; it's literally impossible to fail this class.  He's a very outgoing guy, and always willing to help you out. Unironically the most lenient professor I've ever had in college.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was the best physics professor I have ever had . I loved the class and always felt supported by the professor. He offered tons of extra credit as percent added to your grade . Homework was worth a good amount and was due at the end of the quarter. His tests were very similar to his practice exams . Grading scale was amazing and he truly cared.

Homework is not due until the end of the quarter. Lowest midterm out of 2 is dropped. Gives out so much extra credit, and genuinely cares about the stress levels of students, considering the depth of E&M as a subject. Amazing lectures/formatted slides, and genuinely felt interested in learning throughout. Always answered questions helpfully.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Had an amazing grading scale (80% was an A-) and had a lot of extra credit through mud cards, making a lesson video, and finding typos. Also somehow got extra credit for the pollev, which he uses for attendance. Midterms are similar to the practice exams. He dropped our lowest midterm score and replaced with a 100%. Honestly a good prof

this guy bro, hes the goat frfr. he does pollevs like every professor does so you should show up to lecture. however dont even worry about the exams. there's 2 midterms and finals, and lowest midterm grade was dropped. he gave sm extra credit and the grading scale got totally curved. practically impossible to get a bad grade.

After taking more physics classes with different professors, I came back to give this Prof. a positive review. Single handedly the best physics experience I've ever had, period. Clear lectures, super approachable, fair exams, no harsh deadlines and came out the class a year later still remembering everything from 040B. This is THE guy to take.
Had to come back and give Hemmerling a good review for when I took him winter 2024 after experiencing a horrible professor for 40c.

One of the only professor that made my life easy in Physics, simply a gem. I would definitely take him, exams are fair and are like the practice. Do the homework genuinely and you should be fine. Experiments were fun to watch also! It was a pleasure to be with him for 040B!

Amazing professor. Made me want to pursue a minor in physics until 040C, where the professor had the reverse effect of Hemmerling. This guy is a gem in the UCR physics department which is genuinely a mess. Interesting lectures, fair exams, takes feedback into consideration, and tries to reduce stress among students. Best prof. ever. Take his class
Professor Hemmerling is an amazing lecturer. His practice exams closely resemble his actually midterms.

prof hemmerling always tries his best to make his lectures entertaining through in class demonstrations, etc. his practice midterms/finals that he releases accurately reflect the difficulty of the actual midterms/finals and overall, W experience

lectures aren't necessarily needed to pass this class, but he does take participation in the form of poll evs. he brings experiments every week and likes to teach by example, but the lecture itself might get boring. i usually brought other homework to do during the lecture when i got bored. exams are really easy lmao
Such a good instructor. Enjoyed his lecture!

This guy makes lousy jokes and could care less about teaching students. He will literally direct you to other profs for help. I think he gets a good reviews because he just perform problems from the book in class like a discussion TA - i.e. you could skip class until the review day before exams & learn what you need to pass. Not worth tuition

The people who gave ones must have given their rating mid course and then later dropped the course. The first midterm was hard and nothing like the sample. But the next midterm and final were the easiest both averages were above 85% plus he dropped out lowest midterm. I thought he was bad after failing the first midterm but he is the coolest prof.

PHYS40B taken during spring 21(online). Good at explaining concepts, cares about student comprehension of material, moderate tests(do the practice exams and you'll be alright), and generous curve at end
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Hemmerling was one of the few professors who got me to really love physics. His passion and love for physics shines even through online lectures. Make sure to pick him if you're taking physics040b! Do the practice exam, attend lecture, and actively listen to what he's saying in lecture. He is very considerate with his grading.

Almost everyone in the class bombed the first midterm, second time around all the issues we had with the first midterm were fixed and the average went up to 58/70 - he's allowing us to drop a midterm or the final because of it. He's very considerate, his lectures are engaging and overall my only problem with the class is the painfully long hw

I dont get how this prof has so many ratings on here, the practice midterm was nothing like the actual one.I took it online so he should be more accommodating physics is a hard subject and the fact its online makes it 10x harder.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Writes godawful test questions that have nothing to do with the actual material covered in the lecture, or even what's given in the practice midterm
There are clicker questions every lecture for extra credit. Demos basically every week, keeping the lectures more interesting. Sample midterm and final are almost exact replicas of the actual test.

Captivating and interesting. Lecture was always fun to attend, compared to 40A. There was practically demos in each lecture, and they all related to the concept at hand someway. Homework is once a week, and it will take up the bulk of your time, but it helps with the mathematical applications. Sample Midterm and Final will help come Finals Week

This class was great, he posts his lecture slides online which are very thorough. He's funny and does a lot of interesting demos. Multiple choice midterm and final but I heard previously it was free response so it might switch. Have the week to do one hw assignment per week, Clicker Qs. He had a surprise demo for last lecture which was hilarious.

Great Professor, enjoyed taking the course with him as he was funny during the lecture and his slides are very helpful. You will have to come to class as there are clickers, but if you do not he posts all of his lecture notes and slides and they are organized by week so it is easy to catch back up. Sample midterm/final reflects actual midterm/final

This Professor's lectures are amazing. Physics usually puts me to sleep no matter what, but this guy's lectures keep me wide awake even after an all-nighter and no coffee. He performs demos in basically every lecture. He can be humorous too. You can tell he genuinely wants his students to learn the material.

Overall nice person. Lecture slides are very straight forward in material that is on the homework. Tests are difficult as it requires outside of the box thinking to solve, but is manageable. He is willing to go over step-by-step solutions in his office hours for confusing topics. Giant curve at the end of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Really nice guy. He's lectures are a little bit more based on explaining the theoretical aspects of the material you learn & his tests aren't that hard if you know the material. He did a lot of demonstrations, which were cool.

Half of the stuff he shows in lectures don't even correlate to the test. The tests are so packed with so many questions. Lectures were a snooze fest. Personally never taking a class from him ever again
he's a very boring lecturer and over explains. easy to fall asleep in class and he doesn't even sound passionate about teaching. overall most skipped lecture this quarter

You have a group assignment, a mini quiz (usually one question), and about 5-8 assignments which are filled with a lot of questions every week. He does give late passes to extend some assignments, but you have to be locked in since theirs an assignment pretty much everyday. Not that hard but very tedious so keep that in mind before taking the class

I've literally never met the dude, absolutely adored my TA though. Everything else about the class made me feel like I was on my deathbed. Foundational assessments are so annoying if you don't get the minimum grade required for full credit and there's SO MUCH homework almost EVERYDAY and EVERY point counts. Never again (I hope)

I get this is lowest level math course offered but this professor doesn't care whether you pass or fail. Don't even dare email him for help because he will respond passive aggressively and rich of him given that to this day, I don't know how this man looks. Theres a lot of hw. Good luck is all I have to say.
He is terrible, he doesnt want to help, and it's like a little kid you dont even see him half the time.

Easy class to get in A in if you try! Responds to emails within a day and even sends out weekly emails to remind students to finish certain assignments! Would recommend office hours for homework questions though.

I had Coya for math 3 online & math 4 in person.If I didn't take him for math 4 & I took Curtis I would have failed and been dropped from my major.The people complaining about Coya are the ones that don't go to his office hours or reach out to him. Recommend going to his office hours he would always explain throughly and made me like math again 5/5

never once did i see or meet Prof. Coya, i don't even know if he actually exists lowkey. but i did pass with an A+ because I had a wonderful TA. course was taught in the summer so it was incredibly fast paced, LOTS of homework, but manageable if you have a fairly free schedule.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I can't give Dr. Coya a review personally since I did not see him at all during the entire quarter in which I had taken this class. However, my lab leader, Artemis, was amazing. She's super sweet and understanding and makes sure to put the time into explaining certain problems people have trouble with. As a person, I give Artemis a 5/5.
He is terrible at teaching, he is test-heavy, he doesnt give clear explanation.

Honestly I'm glad I had Professor Brandon, he was a pretty fair Professor. I feel that math 007B in itself isn't an easy course which makes it harder to understand some of the more abstract concepts. I just wish that we did more problems that had an explanation on why we were doing it. If you have to take him, try your hardest in this class.

I am really struggling in this class. Nothing makes sense and I feel helpless. I did not do well on the midterm or quiz and I just feel Professor Brandon could be way more supportive.
Please help!!
Terrible. Just terrible.

Literally typing this meanwhile i should be studying for his midterm. His lectures are pointless to attend, he does not use power point slides, he just writes on his ipad and explains from there, hand writing isnt that great, he switches from the projector to a white board randomly. i literally cant understand anything.

Im honestly just disappointed, I've cried myself to sleep because of Mr. Coya. :( He's completely ruined my life and I might have to get dropped from UCR due to his carelessness and lack of love and care for his students. Please, do not take. In fact make sure you DO NOT TAKE! Peace out.
I didn't talk to him much for help but he was very open on letting his students retake midterms. Gives you more time to do assignments if you simply ask him.
he is so good and if you're struggling with the amount of hw you can reach out to him and he will open it up and or help you redo it
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Brandon was a really cool understanding professor. If you had a problem and explained it to him he would accommodate to your schedule. Make sure to use his office hours, they were extremely helpful and he would teach you 1 on 1 which was extremely beneficial. I would definitely have him as a professor again!
yes this was easier than high school now i do not hate math like i did 3 months ago
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took Math003 over the summer online but it isn't listed as an option here. Professor Coya is amazing! Whenever I had personal issues or conflicts he was so understanding and helpful with helping me reschedule exams and such.

Prof. Coya is excellent. He makes learning math enjoyable by demystifying it and breaks down concepts to their basic components. He makes himself available outside of class and encourages questions in class. Enough can't be said about him and his teaching style. I hope I can take him again. Advice, stay on top of assignments, tests are fair.
Brandon is the coolest! He is really smart and very helpful. Brandon made sure that the whole class was on the same page and was extremely encouraging. He also had a lot of cool t-shirts. Very hip :)
I really enjoyed taking this class. It's clear that he has a lot of passion and knowledge about the legal field, and he is so caring towards his students. I would love to take another class with him!

Take him! Amazing professor who is kind, caring, and genuinely wants his students to pass. Clear syllabus, fair quizzes with 2 scores dropped out of 9, plus a midterm and final. He explains everything well, answers emails fast, and is very understanding. Great class and great professor overall.

Very understanding of personal circumstances! Lectures were for credit, but were possible to get excused for sickness or doctors' appointments. Genuinely enjoyed this class and loved the teaching style!

Dr. Haas is very passionate about his subject and gives great lectures with lots of examples. He responds to emails fast and is helpful. Readings posted on Canvas. Lecture attendance is a bit disorganized, he used Canvas or PollEverywhere for attendance inconsistently. Weekly quizzes and two exams. I wasn't fan of the in-lecture group discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very sweet new professor who I find cares about his students' understanding of the material. Takes criticism very well and implements changes ASAP. IMO, too much in-lecture expectations for students to interact that can take away from the lecture but otherwise a great experience.

Dr. Haas's class was by far my favorite class this quarter. He is very informative with his slides, examples and lectures, always having an answer for any question you have in class. There isn't much he grades on, besides weekly quizzes and the midterm/final. Very approachable and respectful and welcoming of other viewpoints
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor! Lectures were taught very well and were very informational. Did a great job at answering questions and helping students dive deeper. 3 readings a week for the MWF lectures was kind of a lot but he covered them well in lecture. Also did group discussions in class, which was really nice as he asked insightful discussion questions.

The GOAT, he is an accommodating and cool professor. His lecture slides are mainly images, but they're not dense with unnecessary material. He provides extra credit and rounds grades. It's very manageable to get an A in his class, especially if you study the "quick reviews."

Such an amazing professor. He adapts to students needs (like adding extra office hours, and adding more words to the slides when students asked), makes his lectures interesting, and his grading scale and tests are super fair. I wish he was my professor for other classes. The only thing I wished was that his lectures were recorded.

Amazing professor, assignments all make sense, grading scale is AWESOME (like actually so goated), prof himself makes a real effort to make lecture fun and assignments and quizzes are very relevant to the course material and helpful for learning said material. Exams are fair and not super difficult despite the material itself being quite difficult.

His lectures are engaging, even with how difficult of a class immunology is. He has an amazing personality and is always willing to help, especially during office hours. The subject is very difficult, but he does everything in his power to make it easy and provides extra credit opportunities throughout the course. Overall my favorite professor!
He was passionate about lecture and made content interesting. Also helpful during office hours. Tests were fair. Overall really cool professor would recommend.

I was enrolled in Professor Brian's CBNS
120L. It amazes me how someone with a doctorate degree and such a deep understanding of neuroscience can be so humble. He's a wonderful professor and a lecturer, always willing to help and answer all questions.

If you're taking Immunology understand that the course will have difficult material. You will have to study a lot for the midterms and final. HOWEVER, the professor is very nice and chill. He makes the exams as easy as possible despite how difficult the material is and adds a LOT of extra credit points on the homework and online quizzes.

Easily one of the best class experiences I have had at UCR. Very fair with exams and is focused on learning rather than creating an overly-difficult test. This class is hard though, you need to put a good amount of effort to receive an A. Take it though it's really good!

I would rather eat rocks than have to take him again. Maybe it was 8 a.m. when I was taking his class, but he's so monotone. Also, he docks you points for the most random reasons on planet Earth, when the instructions didn't say to do something.

DO not take it with Collier, he sucks at teaching, goes way too fast, and the notes are impossible to understand. He also makes the exams unnecessarily hard. I've done really well in other math classes, but Collier's class was not it.

His instruction style was good enough, but you really have to be there for the lectures as the notes uploaded after-the-fact are near indecipherable. He doesn't have very good handwriting, and tends to write/scribble over things to change them or add more notes afterwards.

I liked taking Professor Collier for 10B. His lectures were high quality and easy to understand, but he can be monotone sometimes. Gives two (or three) grading scales, one weighted more for homework and one weighted more towards exams. Decent amount of homework, but not terrible. Overall, great professor!

I took this class as a 6 p.m. and I kind of shot myself in the foot by doing that. Great at teaching content and effective in helping students learn. We even had a sheet of paper to help us in the final that I feel like might've carried my grade.
Knows what he is talking about but seems very nonchalant in lectures. Tests are pretty hard but I think that is mainly due to the concepts themselves and not the prof. Overall good professor.

If you're coming from 9C calculus. There is a learning curve. New topic that can be very difficult at first to understand but once you get it you're fine. Have to put in the work for this class don't slack off. Not that bad of a class. The lectures r super boring though. Be prepared for a lot of self-learning.

He gives 2 grading scales to benefit students, one weighing hw more, other weighing tests more. 1 midterm, 1 final, 2 quizzes, and provides partial credit. Homework can be long but he gives a reasonable time to complete, even then you can get an extension. Drops lowest worksheet, do them, you get credit for completion, not accuracy. Great prof!!

pros:
nice grade weighting lol
------------
cons:
teaches a bit fast

Really good grade scale with 45% HW + worksheets. The midterm and final were somewhat difficult as not only were they extremely heavy on computations, but he also likes to test students' conceptual knowledge. He does offer an extra credit problem on both the midterm and final though and also lets students use a one-sided cheat sheet for both exams.

40% was homework, and 10% was worksheet (not regard right or wrong), which mean 50% free points. 
His midterm was hard and weight 15%, the average was a c.
But his final was very easy and weight 25%, the total points was 95, and he curved to 90. I got 90/90. And he allowed a paper of note!
Two quizzes, each weight 5% and moderate difficulty.

Very good professor who is understanding and has a generous grading system that GREATLY favors homework. As long as you do the many homework assignments your grade will be at least decent. He has prewritten notes that you can fill-in during the lecture and he records and posts every lecture online so attendance not mandatory, although very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Collier is really nice and his lectures are interesting + his grading system extremely generous and gives most students who pay attention and put in some effort a chance at getting a good grade. He was very engaging during the lecture, with my only gripe being that he uses advanced jargon that may not be understood by everyone.

He is the best math professor I ever had at UCR. Very accessible outside of class and he is the fastest professor at replying to student's emails. Weekly homework worth 55%, and he is very clear on what he expects. Moreover, he is a great lecturer and his class is never boring. Recorded lectures, and no force attendance for live which is great.

Lectures were bad and boring but he makes up for it by making homework 45% of your grade. Midterms were straightforward but the final was relatively hard. I had to teach myself most of the material. Homework is a lot but answers are found online for much of it.

hw was 45%! couldn't be better than that, didn't have weekly quizzes but group worksheets instead, practice exams were generally like the midterm but nothing like the final! final was super hard/vaguely worded but he's really nice and very accessible during office hours, don't fall behind/skip lectures and you will be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I liked this class and found the professor very engaging. He is clearly passionate about the topic and makes lectures interesting. I also appreciated that the course included hands-on activities and opportunities to learn research skills related to EEG.

Dr. Brewer is a great professor. His class relied on the statistical software JASP, and I honestly really liked that. All exams were open-note; there was little homework, and he was an overall very cool professor. If you're struggling in the class, he really helps to guide you to success. Highly recommend for anyone worried about stats.

This class was more challenging than it needed to be. R Studio is required for assignments and contributes a good portion to your grade. He's chill but rarely elaborates on the R materials and expects you just to figure it out! Hope for a good TA. Mine honestly helped me learn more about the R than his teaching! More of a coding class than stats.

Personally, I really enjoyed his class and the work was super mangable. Just make sure you ask questions you're confused and lost. He is super understanding and down to earth. Overall had a great time

Dr. Brewer is smart, but teaching is clearly NOT his strong suit. The class moved way too fast, and he often went on tangents that didn't help. If you don't have any programming experience, then the assignments are hard. His canvas and instructions were confusing, which just made things more stressful! The TA was more helpful in explaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof.Bowler is a hilarious and knowledgeable professor. His lectures feel more like a conversation, and he goes on frequent tangents. He does not post the slides, so it is recommended to attend the lecture. He is not a harsh grader, and the class is difficult to fail. The material itself is also not hard, and it is an interesting topic.

Dr. Bowler is a execptional professor. His humor and knowledge makes his lectures fun and interesting to watch. Just make sure to attend your discussions and pay attention in lecture and you'll be fine.

I'm aware of other people having a negative experience in this class, but that stems from (most of) them not even putting in the effort to read the textbook or attend lectures. Prof. Bowler is humorous, refined in political science, and exceptional as an educator.
Bro is very nice and fun, and he's British so he got an accent ;)
one of the professors of all time
the dude is pretty chill, you'll do fine if you attend lecture, attend discussion, and just pay attention in both

Professor Bowler and TA Sarah are respectful and caring. Highly recommend trying his course. 40% for both mid and final, 20%for DS. Just make sure you attend the discussion. Sometimes 20% is important if you know what I'm saying.

Professor Bowler, is amazing. He is a great professor and is very determine when it comes to teaching his students. I recommend going to lecture and paying attention. Overall, he respects his students and makes the class engaging.
Best political science professor ever! He's funny and passionate about his subject. Even though it was an 8a.m class, I always looked forward to his class! Take a class with him if you can!

This class is definitely not the easiest. Especially if you don't really know much about politics. It really depends on the TAs. They make the test and they grade the test/papers. Going to lecture is helpful because bowler does a good job clarifying confusing topics. It's not an easy A, but if you put a lot of effort you can get a good grade
IF YOU DON'T LIKE POLITICS, AT LEAST SIT IN ONE OF HIS LECTURES…funny british man…has a lot of character and personality.
Very nice! Amicable, accessible, and I believed made a morning class more interesting than it would normally be.

Bowler is awesome!1 take home midterm and 1 take home final with more than enough time to do them.No reason not to get an 'A' in this course.He is funny, engaging, and caring.Makes you want to come to lecture every day. Ends every lecture with "...land of mystery!" You'll understand if you take him.If he's teaching than take him, you wont be sorry.
krump professor
Funny, extremely clear, and helpful. Best politics professor on campus.

Cares about your progress, and cares that you understand the material. He sometimes goes off on tangents, but always brings it back around and drives the point home. One take home midterm and take final, each worth 50 percent of your grade. They weren't difficult, just tedious - he gives you more than enough info to answer the questions.

Bowler is hands down the best political science teacher at UCR. His lectures are well organized (even if his hand writing is a tad messy), his humor will keep you listening, and an extremely nice person. Take him whatever the class.
he is an awsome professor he keeps you laughing through ot the whole class u dont know how time passes

I thought he was a great teacher. He has a great sense of humor and does a really good job of explaining the topics. You need to go to lecture because there's no slides posted online or anything. I studied pretty hard for tests and I got A's on everything.
Awesome teacher. He'll keep you entertained the whole class and is always crystal clear with his material.
Funny, quite easy, and helpful.

Bowler is by far the best POSC professor Ive had at UCR. Hilarious & keeps you entertained. Attendance is crucial; no slides. Notes are taken as he speaks. However explains things very well. Only main book needed is the "power & choice"; don't bother getting the others. 1 paper and 2 midterms. Just go to class & take notes.
He is extremely enthusiastic, and fun, and clear.
I took his comparative politics, and it's really intresting. He does all kinds of fun atuff to make you to pay attention. Remeber, sit in front always helps.

This prof. defintely knows his material well. I have to admit however that i never looked forward to going to his class. I think it was just me though cuz he's got a british accent and i have more trouble than others understanding. but good class and interesting material. no need to purchase books or read, but get your a** to class and you'll pass
Great professor, enjoyed the class alot. Don't need to buy the book.  Class is mandatory, but it's worth it.
Very enthusiastic.Jokes around sometimes.Good professor.For me entire quarter 2 test 1 essay.
Great and enthusiastic

Bowler is the best; I laughed my way through the quarter. He's an engaging lecturer and has a cool accent. You won't fall asleep. Sit near the front so you can hear the jokes he mumbles. Also -- you probably don't need to do all the readings. I never cracked the books and got 99 percent on the midterm.
Funny and clear.
Funny, smart, and clear.
GREAT TEACHER! EVEN THOUGH IT WAS IN THE MORNING! HE WOULD MAKE U LAUGH! HE EXPLAINS EVERYTHING CLEAR!! COOL POSC TEACHER!TESTS ARENT EVEN HARD! DEFINETLY TAKE THIS TEACHER!!!

When I took this class, I had no interest in politics whatsoever; still don't. But surprisingly, I  got an A+ in the class! As long as you attend lecture and take good notes, you'll be fine! I didn't exactly do all the readings; I only did some of the readings. Just pay attention in lecture and in discussion.

FIVE WORDS! GREAT TEACHER AND GREAT LECTURE! You have to go to lecture everyday no matter what or else you won't be able to understand the whole in-depth of the class. It won't even hurt you going to class everyday too because he makes the class very exciting. Easy A class! if you don't slack off!

BOWLER IS AWESOME!! THE most energetic professors around. he has a great sense of humor, he cracks jokes all lecture long! does not post notes so go to lecture, no worries, he makes it worth it! TAs make the test & do the grading. 1 midterm, 1 final & 5 two page summaries due as homework in discussion. BOWLER IS THE BEST TAKE HIS CLASS IF YOU CAN!

This professor knows what he is doing! He keeps you interested through the whole class and he keeps you awake if you have this class in the morning. He has the TA's make the tests so it's really up to them how hard they are.

1 midterm 40% 1 final 40% 5- 2 page summary essays about reading turned in during discussion (20%). Great lecturer! Hot accent i could listen to him talk for hours! Very entertaining and informative. Tests are ALL WRITING, if you hate free response avoid this class. No PP slides or anything posted on iLearn. Overall GREAT TEACHER!! TAKE HIM!!
awesome prof. tough class on papers which you have to do about 18 pages for both for midterm and final!
Best teacher in the department! Classes are engaging and Bowler keeps classes entertaining as well as informative

Bowler is amazing! He forces you to stay awake and interested during the entire hour, and is HILARIOUS. He gave an inspirational lecture on the last day and it is because of him that i changed my major to political science. THE BEST.
good teacher, but the 10 page paper kills it!
Professor Bowler is awesome!!He makes lecture interesting and really explains material thoroughly in a way that students understand...if u need to take a poli sci class take his!
BOWLER IS GREAT!!!!!!
Fantastic lecturer.
this guy is great. actually had me paying attention at 8am

Fantastic professor! Interesting and just explained the nitty gritty of world political systems with such flair. Had him for two classes and he was simply amazing. Plus he looked a bit like Colin Firth and had a scrumptious accent to boot, haha.
No Comments

This Brit knows his stuff! He's a great teacher, very straightforward. If you follow the syllabus and make sure you know the material in the book that he covers, you will do fine in his class. I enjoyed his class, and he is very approachable. I def. recommend taking his classes.
AWESOME!! One of my favorite Professors!
i really enjoyed his class. he makes the subject matter interesting & i can honestly say that i was never bored in his class. i love his English accent :)
Great Professor.  Mr. Bowler is fun and knowledgable.  I was never bored in his class.  Even if you think Poli Sci is a drag, you'll like this prof.  As an added bonus, he has a great accent.

Prof. Bowler is one of the greatest teachers at UCR. Not only is he energetic and very animated in class, he is extremely intelligent about politics of European societies and is widely published for this. I feel sorry for any of you POSC students who may miss out on experiencing his class.
He is so funny and he gets you into the course material with his energy. I had him in the summer in the morning, and I loved going to class. I got an A!
i actually learned something at ucr.... you have to be stupid to get a B in his class.

One of the better classes I have taken @ UCR... very funny...great british accent...lectures are good, but you have to be a good note taker... the TAs do everything from writting to grading the test... very easy class
By far, the best professor I've ever had at UCR.  This guy is absolutely hilarious (keeps ya up at 8:00 am w/o coffee!), and his exams are easy - but that's probably because the TA writes the exams.

Cool class. If he doesn't interest you with the topic, you will be interested by his humor and accent. His examples nearly always tie in with Beer, since he thinks that is the only way to keep college kids' attention.
He is soooo funny. His class (at 8:10 am) totally wakes me up. He's hilarious.
He was very entertaining.... I got an "a"...
Although the matter in the class is not very interesting itself, he makes it interesting and easy to learn
He's great.
Very funny, great accent.  His humor keeps you awake.
I love the accent
No Comments
I learned alot, and the class was fun.
hysterically amusing at 8 a.m. with his diet coke and red shoes

She is overall the best part of Bio005a in general, she is an amazing professor for bio005a she is very understanding when their is an emergency and you aren't able to go to lab. The bio lab is easy if you just show up everyday and do the provided lab. Totally would reccomend as the midterm and final are easy if you have been paying attention.

Dr. Burnette's class is pretty easy, but a lot will depend on the TA you get. Overall, her midterms and Final were very easy. Online open note final where you can email her. Study, don't procrastinate and it's an easy A.

worlds easiest lab. dr. burnette subbed in for my TA once and it was some of the most fun i've ever had in my lab! my TA was also amazing. the research project that you work on over the quarter is also fun. midterm is an easy A as long as you understand lab procedures. pay attention & be genuinely interested and you'll pass easily!

The class was easy as your grade is dependent on lab worksheets and prelabs. There is a group project at the end which definitely can help your grade. Don't worry if you don't do well on the midterm as there are many opportunities to improve your grade. The TA does the labs, but Dr. Burnette is very helpful and always responds to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: horrible experience. accused me of cheating on the final and then dropped the case no explanation. easy lab but i'm totally off put but her lack of professionalism.
Bad professor cannot teach and TA had teaching and grading problems! Burnette does not respond to emails and is a unhelpful professor!

awesome! easy A but my TA graded really strict. if you do prelabs and read the lab manual before then the worksheets will be easy. midterm was a piece of cake. final is open book. if you do all the work, put in some effort, and actually care just a tiny bit for this class- you will get an A.

she is awesome! my ta was strict on grading though. if she offers extra credit take it! midterm is mcq and super easy. final is open book. overall if you pay attention and strive to get an A you will get an A.

Short pre-labs each week. Labs are not difficult and easy to get full points on. Midterm has questions directly from the in-class assignments. Final is online and open notes. Group project was not too time consuming and content is interesting.

BIO05LA is wayyy easier than the lecture portion. Just be prepared to read the lab manual because it will def help starting the worksheets in class that are due at the end of the lab period. 1 midterm in person and 1 online final which were both fair.

Labs never took the full 3 hours and got out early almost every week. Labs were fairly easy and understandable. 1 midterm which was super easy and 1 final which was open note and online. Genuinely an easy A class even if you're not doing good in lecture.

Took BIO5A-LAB in Winter 2023. We usually finished early and don't need the whole 3 hours of lab time. Her assignments were pretty straightforward. There was an easy group project the last few weeks. There were plenty of extra credit opportunities that just takes a little time. Don't be late to class. She's pretty strict on that.

Quizzes were easy, and she's really good at giving interesting lectures. You can tell she's passionate about what she teaches, and she tries to make as many analogies as possible. This class is one of the only times I have gone to a lecture on Friday evening and actually enjoyed it.

Not too hard, exams are easy to study for if you review worksheets + uploaded documents on Canvas. If you have concerns, she will kindly help you and quickly respond to emails! Interesting lab work which had a point and made sense! Good professor!
Great teacher, gives in-depth feedback and isn't punishing as far as grading. His approach to teaching in general is awesome. Makes heavy topics seem approachable

Super great class, if you're looking to fulfill breadth requirements then this is the one. Lectures are posted online, online open note quizzes, two easy creative projects, and interesting material to learn from! Attendance isn't mandatory for lectures or discussions but it is additive (extra credit) to your final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Budasz is such a chill professor. The class was super easy, consisted of all online open note quizzes, and two creative projects. Great GPA boost course or course to take when balancing other hard classes.

The summer session class with Dr. Budasz is an easy A. Your grade is based on 4 quizzes, 1 presentation, and 1 creative project. All you need to ace the quizzes are his lecture slides. Take advantage of his office hours; very useful. Overall, pretty chill class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor thoroughly explained the musical terminology for this course. Although his accent his hard to understand, I loved this class!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures may get dull sometimes. Covers many things in addition to music, which may sometimes be overwhelming, but instructor and TA were always helpful. Easy grader. Final exam was optional (everybody I asked got a good grade anyway). Extra credit for attendance and extra points in the exam. Maybe too many readings...

There wasnt a clear grading criteria, the professor usually let the TA give all the information for the final paper he was really unclear on how/when to turn it in, really boring lectures but easy points for attending class. Gave extra credit for perfect attendance, would not recommend I was lost pretty much throughout the whole course.
Easy GPA booster, great for breadth
Super amazing and understanding of students. Very easy to obtain an easy A if you genuinely try. Extra credit is offered, and cheat sheets are sometimes allowed!

(Late review) I took Professor Bucklin's class for Screenwriting and Intro to Acting. He's a chill professor and is quite funny. His class is pretty easy and chill, in my experience. I recommend taking his classes because not only are they easy, but they're fun, and you learn a lot about screenwriting and acting

This is the best teacher you could possibly get, this class was so easy and it was so fun, he gives short quizzes and they are so easy the plays are pretty fun to read, YOU SHOULD DEFINITELY TAKE THIS CLASS

One of the best professors I have had so far. He is very caring when it comes to his students he will do anything to give them a good grade. He offers lots of extra credit. Attendance is mandatory, but I recommend taking this class.

Professor Bucklin was a great professor. He cared about your success in his class, and he offers so much extra credit so make sure to take advantage of this. I loved the monologue assignment, as we got to perform on stage. As long as you show up to class, do the readings, and participate in class, you can easily get a A. I highly recommend.

He's a super chill teacher and I had such a fun time in class. Probably the best assignment we did was the monologue. He got me to love theatre and he kept the class engaged. Really wish I could take him again. If you ever struggle, there's lots of chances to get extra credit (usually by attending a play or the like). Easy A, would recommend.

Professor Bucklin is an amazing professor who cares about his students and their learning when it comes to screenwriting. Lectures aren't long as he keeps it short and straight to the point. There are a ton of extra credit opportunities throughout the class.

love it! really easy to get an A+, and lot of extra credit,
Interesting lectures

I loved Professor Bucklin. Easy A but he is also such an amazing professor that I started to love theatre. He understands that his students might not like listening to lectures so he does his best to shorten them and he offers a lot of extra credit. Definitely take his class!

PARTICIPATE. He gives out a lot of extra credit so if you want an A guaranteed, participate when he asks for volunteers. Three plays to read and three quizzes. Just read the plays and you'll get 100%. Midterm consists of the history of acting. Study the slides and you'll pass. Attendance is mandatory and is a large part of the grade. Very nice prof
Amazing professor, every lecture was really fun and he's really good at guiding students to becoming better actors.

Easiest class you can take. Prof Bucklin is fun, easy to listen to, and is really understanding (he'll give extra credit like crazy). I will say however, if you aren't interested in theater or acting it might be a little boring, there ARE performance assignments.

Simple, yet informative class with hints of fun and creativity! Although attendance is mandatory in lecture & discussion, the presentations are simple to digest and are also uploaded onto Canvas. Note taking is not particularly needed, but watching the films/shows required are key. You'll have a few assignments (simple) with plenty of extra credit!

Professor Bucklin is funny, informative, and passionate. The assignments are easy and if you turn everything in and put in effort you will most likely get an A. The lectures can be a little long winded and hard to engage in considering how big the class is though. Also attendance is quite strict for lecture and discussion.

For the most part the class is pretty straightforward. There aren't alot of assignments but he does offer extra credit. He takes attendance alot though so if you're not there you will be marked absent. But he's a good prof and teaches well

I absolutely loved this class and Professor Bucklin! He was incredibly inspirational and always super encouraging. His TA's are amazing. DO be prepared to pay attention and speak in class, he randomly calls on people.

One of the best professors at UCR. I really enjoyed having him for my last quarter. He made class very engaging. There were a few assignments, but very straight-forward and he gave us enough time to complete them. He is a very caring professor and was very considerate during this pandemic. 10/10! :)

He understands that people are taking intro to acting as a GE so as long as you try and take feedback you will get a good grade. There are lectures that you could skip but I wouldn't recommend it, as lecture usually ends early anyways, and he just focuses on the important info.

Bucklin is such a great professor for students going into the entertainment industry. He really cares about the field and it shows in his lectures. I will say though, he takes attendance religiously, so prepare for that.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I LOVE HIS CLASS! One of the best professors at UCR. I learned and appreciate acting because of Bucklin. He's a really good professor and definitely take his acting class! He wants everyone to do well!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Bucklin is such a great dude! He is funny, gives great lectures and is very passionate when it comes to the movie industry. His class is also very easy. Show up, read the book (which is actually interesting), participate, you get an A. Highly recommend! Great GPA booster.

Professor Bucklin was hilarious throughout the quarter. He mainly gave credit to everyone who have worked up to their ability on their acting skills. So it was mainly if you gave it a shot, you got an easy A! There was one midterm based on lecture slides and three quizzes based on books we had to read and understand the story of.

Professor Bucklin was an easy-going, hilarious, and respectable guy. The class in itself is pretty easy if you put in effort, attend class, and listen to Bucklin's feedback. There are 3 quizzes on 3 plays, one midterm, 4 performances, and one essay. Although, Bucklin gives you plenty of time and a clear grading criteria. Carissa was cool too :D
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: My favorite Professor I have ever had the opportunity to study under, Professor Bucklin challenged me in a way that I never have before. While the class pushed me to write better than I ever have before, he was able to make me feel like I was providing amazing work. His feedback makes you better in every way and he treats you like an equal.

My favorite class last quarter! Prof Bucklin was funny and understanding. He knew it was an intro class and made it easy and understandable for those who weren't theater majors. As long as you show up and participate, you'll get an A. He gives good feedback on your performances and encourages students who are nervous. Great professor and class!
