reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Don't take the class if it's online; he can't handle a classroom on Zoom. Tons of reading, slides with no words (and often only half-done), and no assignments aside from midterm and final. Exams are long and exhausting (focuses on readings a lot). Speeds thru lecture to have time for q's, but most q's will be about what he sped thru. DON'T TAKE HIM
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Out of all the courses Ive ever taken here at UCR Busacca was the one that assigned the most reading. No, Im not talking about 40 pgs... Im talking about up to 100 pages before the next class. I had his course Mon/Wed/Fri so it was pretty intense. You also cant miss class because he gives a quiz each class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: His teaching style is all over the place. He'll start with a slide that only has pictures, then move to handwritten notes which he projects on an elmo, then start writing on the whiteboard and he'll continue to go back and forth between the three all throughout lecture. Super confusing. Took the class again with Kim Dionne and she was 10x better.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: One of the toughest professors around, but completely worth it. Class consisted of 4 books, essays on 3 of them, exam on the other one. He is a very tough grader, office hours are a must! He will provide helpful feedback that's worth a whole letter grade. Attendance is tracked so show up. Don't take his class if you aren't prepared for a challenge.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: This professor has lectures with only pictures. He writes on a smart board type of thing but his handwriting is illegible. He goes on to fast that there isn't enough time to write down notes even if your typing on your computer. His notes are all over the place as he goes back to a topic discussed 5 minutes earlier. Don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors in the political science department. As long as you do the readings, the class should be a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: We read 4 books this quarter. We had to read 50 or more pages each night from each book. The final was a group project. There was a midterm. Also, a paper that is based on one of the books. Most nights,I didn't get sleep because of all the reading. There was a mini quiz at the end of every class. There is another paper that is apart of the project.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Literally just do the readings and you will pass the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Busacca used to have a lot more required readings for classes but has eased up due to feedback. Attendance matters, he tracks it via apps like Square Cap or Course Key. Attendance is also important for pop quizzes. Overall, he is a great professor and I would have to say probably my favorite professor in the poli sci department.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--SO MANY PAPERS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Ridiculously difficult just for the sake of being difficult
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I really liked the lecture style of Prof. Busacca. Tries to introduce class to new ideas. Gives good feedback on paper. Reading the assigned books are important, particularly for essays and quizzes. You won't pass class if you don't show up, particularly because he gives pop quizzes throughout the quarter.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He had us read 4 books this quarter, but the exams and essays are pretty easy to do even if you skim the books. Go to lectures! They provide a better understanding for the books. His midterms and final exams typically include multiple choice, several FRQs, and an essay question.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: As a first year political science major I can say it was the hardest class I have ever taken. Its important to note that I am only a first year and this was a lower division course. That being said I find Professor Busacca's class extremely important in the development of a political science major. As long as you work for it you will succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He teaches a lower division course and he knows it. His texts are a bore and his methods in teaching are erratic and leave you with questions you don't know you need to ask. His essay prompts are hard just for the sake of confusing his students. In a 5 page paper his prompt has 6 different questions being asked. Wish I had space to right more.

Somewhat unorganized, jumps around a lot during lecture. Good news is there's clear grading criteria but you MUST do the reading. If you don't you will fail every test and essay in the class. He's knowledgeable and clearly passionate on the topic, I would just prefer he focused his lectures a little more rather than jumping around so much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Whole class is based around the 3 books he assigns-- must read in order to do decent in the class. Pop quizzes about readings in lecture that count for 10% of your grade. Extremely boring lectures. Content is self-teachable and easy to understand, just skim the books. Releases study guide for midterm and final. Must put in work to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: HE IS TERRIBLE! Trust me and dont take this class!! He assigns three thick books and makes you purchase this 25$ platform where he tracks your attendance using gps location. His lectures are all over the place. DIFFICULT MIDTERM AND FINAL. I probably failed but lets hope not. Just dont take this class, save yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: The midterm this quarter was crazy hard. The study guide was lengthy and most of it wasn't on the midterm. The average was about a 67! And he barely curved it. We did have one paper, though. The final is cumulative, which is terrible bc we read 3 thick, dense books. He knows the class is hard and purposely keeps it hard. I think he is a sadist.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Professor Busacca is a great professor with a clear style of teaching. He is great at answering the questions of students. Attendance matters (uses Course Key which tracks attendance). Good class for discussions with an open environment.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: The class was pretty easy in my opinion. I barley even tried. He does use all three textbooks that he assigns, but his lectures are based of the books, so you can pretty much get an idea  of what you are suppose to read. The three essays he assigns are based of the main idea of each book and a section of your chose, usually out of theones he assign
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If you want to pass attend lecture, take good notes, do the assigned readings, and study for those pop quizzes! You cannot skip a lecture without failing a pop quiz! Also, assignments are worth a good portion of your grade so make sure you do the readings if you want to get a good grade. Good thing about the course was that there wasn't a final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: 3 books and 3 papers and one the same week as the midterm.  In lieu of the final was that last paper. Makes you buy a subscription to TopHat for quiz and attendance purposes. Professor was very nice but you have got to read if you are going to keep u with him in lecture. Read Read Read. Not bad to look at making time spent there more enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Three required book readings and three essays. If you read the text and do well on the essays then its a rather easy course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Great Professor, very much liked his grading system, logging in your attendance will help boost your grade, gave only 3 papers with plenty of time to complete, 1 midterm, and the best part is that there is no final exam for this class. Overall, Professor Busacca gave informative lectures, he knows what he's talking about compared to other UCR profs
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Not too bad, this class will need you to attend lecture just to get the history down. Without it, it will be alot of work to figure out what he wanted you to grasp. Theres a paper due every 2 weeks, roughly 5 pages long.  But overall, that sums up your grade, there are quizzes after papers are due, and a sign in sheet.

Honestly, he is a really nice guy but he is all over the place when it comes to his lectures. He seems like he has never lectured before and is really unclear when he gives assignments. It's hard to stay focus during his lectures because he bounces around everywhere and will go on tangents.

He never seemed prepared. Asks many questions but rarely remembered to provide the answers.  Unrealistic in the timing of his assignments and time to complete exams successfully.  Wouldn't recommend him. Stressful and felt like I taught myself out of books.
Assigns lots of papers. Usually every 2 weeks. However he even assigns one due the day of the midterm and then one due the day of the final.

I really liked this class! The professor brings in a variety of different kinds of books and materials and she gets a lot students to participate. There's a decent amount of reading, but it's a literature course, so that's kind of expected.

She is an pretty tough grader when it comes to essays. SO much reading as well, you have read 50+ pages of the book each class. Not strict on due dates, is nice, leactures are enjoyable. She accused me of using AI on an essay I didn't use AI on. Luckily, she did not report me, but be ready to dumb down your essays in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Finishing up semester at MVC. Professor Buckner has a wealth of knowledge that she imparts on her students. She encourages engagement and helps you develop a growth mindset when it comes to reading and writing. Put in the work and asks questions, youll be pleased with her direction. Great Professor!

One word: AMAZING. Her lectures are very informative and they pretty much turn into a class discussion because she actually cares about everyone's reading of the text. Do the reading and engage in discussion in class to prepare you for the midterm and final and you'll be fine. Highly recommend.
This professor is super sweet. Make sure to visit her in office hours, she is always willing to help. He class can be boring at times, but her power points are useful for future essays.

Sarah is not only an excellent teacher, but a very sweet person as well! I enjoyed discussion because she created a structured and encouraging atmosphere for expressing ideas about the literature. She also brought donuts in on the last day, so what more can you ask for, really. A true qweeen <3
10/10 teacher! Put in the work, go to office hours, and you'll reap the fruits of your labor. Hope she gets a permanent job at UCR!

Sarah is hilarious! I had her for English 1C and not only were the book choices phenomenal, but she's great at leading discussions. She was always really open, and I appreciated knowing that when I spoke up in class, my voice would be treated with respect.
Chill professor but his class is a GPA destroyer.

Chill dude, honestly, his style is weird and confusing at first, but you will get used to it. He's simple, 4, 1500-word essay, one of them being an in-class final essay. Little HW. If you wanna do good in this class, you MUST visit his office hours for each essay just to get a peer review/feedback from him. If not, he's going to harshly grade you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Chill ahh and nice professor, good lectures and feedback. Def recommend going to his office hours once for every essay. Tough grader though, very tough; I believe the majority of the class had their first essay graded between 70-80s. Recommended if you really want to learn and challenge yourself, not recommended if you're just trying to pass easily
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Buchan genuinely cares about his students and is interested in what everyone has to write about. He pushes back due dates if he sees the class needs more time. There are 3 major essays, but he's lenient when choosing your topics if you follow the prompt. His grading is tough, but he gives great feedback. He's a great professor! Take his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is overall a nice professor and a really chill guy. I think that he just wants you to add a lot of depth into the paper and wants you to go outside you comfort zone when writing a paper. There is like 4 essays during the whole class time. I think I would take him again, but he just has a little bit of high standards.

Attendance is mandatory but Dr. Buchan is very chill. Scores on papers pretty much make or break your final grade, but he always makes sure to give pretty effective feedback. So if you go to office hrs once in a while and go to class you will be fine.
n/a
Take this professor you will not regret it. Go to his office hours it helps. Great person and a even better teacher.

Chill ass professor, was very nice and overall was just a good English teacher. He lets you write about anything you want as long as you follow his prompt. Attendance is mandatory so just show up to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Buchan is one of the best English professors I've had during my time at UCR. Take him!!

Professor Buchan was very kind and was always offering help. He does in-class assignments that are very helpful but he talks A LOT and attendance is a chunk of your grade. He seems very frazzled and always takes up the entire class time. Very little homework but sometimes calls on students to hear about essay progress, topics, or their opinions.

Professor Buchan's class was a writing oriented. While his grading of the papers can be tough, the feedback provided is super helpful. Buchan cares about his students and overall is a great teacher. My only complaint is that he can be a little chatty and get off-topic during class time.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Buchan is an extremely caring professor and truly wants all his students to succeed. He really focuses on grammar and sentence structure which is very helpful and by the end of the class you will see your improvement as long as you take his feedback. He is a very engaging professor and likes to have discussions in class.

He is an engaging teacher. I learned a lot about sentence composition and paragraph structuring from his class. I also enjoyed his method of using a Google Doc as the class whiteboard. He likes to talk a lot, often about off topic subjects. Personally I didn't mind it, but I could see it getting annoying if you're not interested in his ramblings.

Dr. Buchan is an amazing professor! He cares about his students and pushed back due dates if he knew we needed extra time. He tells hilarious stories and is really engaging with the material he teaches. He searches for pretty specific things in your essay, but he gives really good feedback.

Dr. Buchan is very positive and full of energy, which was helpful because I had him for an 8 am class. When it comes to essays there are four and a final. He does a great job of developing essay topics with us and coming up with ideas. He is very nice and even sets back the essay due dates for us if he knows we are still working on it. Great class!

Not too many specific guidelines that you *must* follow, which is either a blessing or a curse depending on the type of student you are. It's hard to get an A in the class in my opinion, but at least not artificially so. He genuinely seems interested in the topics the students choose. First ENGL teacher I've had who made me feel excited to write.

It took a while for me to get used to teaching style-- a lot of sentence level writing. I hated the class at first because it felt like a lot of work, but I got used to his teaching style and I think I've improved my writing by a lot! If you put in effort and go to office hours you'll be fine. I thought I was gonna get a C, but ended up with A-.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Butz is the super sweet and incredibly passionate about this subject. You should go to lecture because 1) she takes attendance and 2) the slides are just images, so there is no text on the slides meaning all info is spoken by her and everything she says is fair game for the exams. Grade=2 papers+midterm+final.  Enough effort+time = A+
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She gives a study guide of what exactly will be on the test a week before. Attend her lectures because  she goes into depth about a topic/artwork its most likely on the test. Very easy class if you attend her lectures and discussion.

DO NOT TAKE HER FOR A BREATH COURSE. Mandatory attendance to lectures/discussions along with 2 major assignments/midterm/final. She wanted the entire class to somehow go all the way down to LA to go to a museum for an assignment for some reason. She changed it so we could still do the assignment on campus but like bro what.

Professor Adams is possibly the best professor I had at UCR! I enjoyed his lectures because of his wit and intellect. Honestly was never bored within this class. You owe it to yourself to take one of his classes. Remember Attendance is important but I don't think you would want to miss a class of this awesomeness. :)

Dr. Adams is one of my favorite professors at UCR. He's funny, interesting & lively. Took this class for MCS upper div. Just attend lecture and pay attention & you will pass. Lecture is never boring because he teaches in a very fun manner. Highly recommend taking this class. Easy A

Dr. Adams is one of the most inspiring and encouraging professors I have ever had.  If you attend class and pay attention, you will do fine on the quizzes; they're not as intimidating as one might think.

Also had him for Music History, and MUS133. Just go to class and you will do fine. Do the like, 2 assignments, and couple of essays. He isn't hard. Tries to intimidate you, it works, but then the class is not that hard. HES AMAZING. SO hilarious. theres never a dull moment with Dr.Adams. He's famous for a reason.

Dr Adams is fabulous!...he's very passionate about the material, loved his sense of humor, very sassy/sarcastic, and he is supportive of all students whether they are LGBT or not.  His class was very refreshing in this stifling county called the Inland Empire, where culture goes to die!

I took Dr. Adams homosexuality and music course and I'm convinced that he is one of the best professors in the entire UC.  Do not miss Dr. Adams Homosexuality and music course. I highly recommend Dr. Adams without hesitation.

I took his instrumentation course and it wasn't anything I expected.  He taught me more about my own instrument than anyone ever has.  He's clear about what he wants and he grades on how we utilize his advice.  He is bluntly honest and one of the best professors I've had so far.  Dr. Adams, there's the chili pepper you requested :-D

Excellent professor. Extremely knowledgeable and passionate about the subject. Lectures were informative and entertaining. He does seem to favor some students though which can hurt your feelings if you're trying very hard. But this class was top notch and I recommend it to anyone.

Took lots of classes with Adams. He was also my faculty advisor.  The material of HISE 153 was difficult to digest, but he made things clear. If you attend class, participate, and work with him on your paper, he will give you an A.  And if you're smart and hardworking, he will write you an AMAZING recommendation letter.

One of my favorite professors at UCR. Very versed on his topic, informative, great sense of humor. At one point in his class, he made everyone get up and dance to the YMCA, himself included. I learned so much, and the class was so interesting. Make sure you do the readings, go to class, and turn in your final paper, and you'll do fine.
Hard class
No Comments
He's a decent teacher and can be most helpful, but only if you speak up and earnestly ask and try. He's tough, but that's good.
Dr. Adams may be a hard grader...but he is also a good teacher.
No Comments
No Comments
Great teacher.  Very helpful and entertaining.

I found Professor Carpiano okay. He tended to ramble in his emails and expected everyone to laugh when he made mediocre jokes, but he was great at giving clear information and knew what he was talking about, especially when he could relate it to public health in which he specializes. He is very educated with multiple masters degrees and a PhD.

Quizzes in the beginning of every class, one midterm, 1 final, 2-3 essays (TA strike). lockdown browser for midterm and final. the topic itself isn't hard, his grading policies are just very unclear. He is a kind professor but I will avoid him for future courses. He assigns too many readings so don't take too many units.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class is really lecture-heavy, as he mostly summarizes the textbook readings during class. There were three one-page essays, three quizzes (one of which was dropped), and a final. I did really well on the essays, as the instructions for them are easy but for the quizzes and final I did poorly on but you can still pass if you don't read the book

Dr. Carpiano taught PBPL006 with enthusiasm and passion for the subject, midterms & final are multiple choice, the 3 essays are very manageable and not harshly graded with clear criteria. Lecture attendance isn't required, lecture slides are posted to Canvas. Some multiple choice questions are harder than others but both midterms were curved.

Lectures are long, but he posts the slides after each lecture before exams. There were 2 midterms, 1 final, and 3 essays. Fairly easy except his exams were a bit confusing so pay attention to lectures and study. In lectures, he gives many examples to help us understand the concept better. Lots of jokes and a great teacher.

Professor Carpiano was a truly exceptional professor. He was a bit quirky, but that always gave me energy for the lectures. There were 3 midterms and 1 final, but he had to cancel 1 midterm. There were also essays to be done after the midterms, which was another part of the midterms. The discussions are required for attendance and participation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Dr. Carpiano's class. There were 3 one-page essays, 3 "midterm" exams, and the final. This quarter he dropped the lowest midterm exam score, and curved all three. Very Engaging lectures, and an energetic person overall, but you must take notes to understand the material. You can get by without reading all of the textbook readings.
Loved loved loved this class. Very funny and lenient, but the grading for essays is no joke

He is a heavy lecturer and grading is based on midterm, final, and 3 essays. The exams are very difficult and does not share the study guide until a few days before. No laptops are allowed to take notes, and discussion is mandatory. Exams are in person on lockdown browser. Do not take class unless you need to.

The best professor at ucr by far!! Carpiano very clearly understands and loves what he teaches which is so clear in the enthusiasm and presentation of his lectures. His lectures were not at all a drag and I was very excited to be able to attend them. The tests were very fair and if you understand the basic foundation of things you will do great.

This class is an easy A if you study. Attendance isn't mandatory. There are a couple of essays, which should be easy if you ask the TA for assistance. The exams are basically a bunch of vocab words to remember.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very engaging and enthusiastic lectures, Dr. Carpiano is very knowledgeable. The grading scheme was pretty tough, based on very few assignments. Take the writing assignments seriously and actually read the criteria. You lose a lot of points for formatting issues or not writing enough. Exams are tricky and include questions based on the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very enthusiastic and engaged, just had an annoying syllabus and essay structure, was very hard to tell how you would be graded.

He's actually been one of my favorite professors so far, his lectures are engaging and so far the midterms are quite fair! as long as you use the study guides and review the lecture slides, take notes, youll be fine!

He is enthusiastic about teaching so it makes lectures more entertaining. There is very little homework, only 3 one-page assignments. Your grade depends on 3 midterms, the assignments, and the final, so it's important to study.

Posts the lecture slides, I went to the lectures but you can pass without going. 3 exams, 3 papers, and a final. Exams curved, 3rd was the hardest. As long as you study you will do well. Gives study guides, I recommend using them because everything on the final is on it. You can get away with not doing the textbook reading but read the articles.

Carpiano was my favorite professor this quarter because of how passionate he was. Never missed a lecture simply for his personality! Very understanding, charismatic, funny, and genuinely cares about his students. The exams are VERY fair, based on slides and all have study guides posted two days before. The content is genuinely very interesting!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great Professor! The only bad thing is that he posts the study guide late. He would sometimes post the study guide the day before the midterms so I recommend studying early.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Attendance is taken at discussions but not for lectures. 3 midterms and one final but he provides a study guide for each one. You do have to write a one-page paper after each midterm. Funny and charismatic.
Not a good teacher.
Greta professor. Really passionate. Gives out a VERY useful study guide before exams.

He's a good lecturer, but dear God this man can not post grades to save his life. He'll say he'll post them on some day, but he'll have you waiting the entire quarter. We had an essay due on Feb 1, and did not get the grade until March 1st. It's finals week, and we still do not have 2 essay grades or our final exam grade. Unbelievable and disappoin
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Carpiano is the sweetest professor out there! The material is super interesting and all lectures are recorded and posted. You submit 3 short essays (2 pages), and there is 1 midterm, and 1 final for which he provides study guides. Do yourself a favor and take him, you won't regret it!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Carpiano loves this subject and it shows in his lectures. He's really nice and funny, and even sent a weekly cooking recipe to help distract us with everything going on in the world. Grades on a few things, timed midterm, 3 papers(drops the lowest one) and one final. Grading timing has been WAYYY off! In week 10 we only had 2 items graded. :/

Dr. Carpiano is such a great professor!! He is so caring and funny, and he is really invested in Medical Soc. There was 3 1-page papers, 1 midterm, and 1 final! The midterm was timed not great, but I was able to finish in time! If you do better on the final (at least for this quarter) he will adjust your midterm grade to your final grade!

His timed exam is ridiculous. Youre graded on 2 papers and 2 exams. Its week 7 out of 10 weeks total and I found out now that Im failing the class because of how late the grading goes. This is a stressful class for no reason because of how poorly its structured.

Dr. Carpiano is passionate about this subject. I think he is a great lecturer and has a great personality. Class is made up of discussion attendance, 9 pop quizzes, 3 essays, 1 midterm, 1 final. He drops lowest essay and lowest 4 quiz scores. Exams tests memory of of concepts as well application it. Grade distribution is fair and he has EC. Easy A

I took his class not knowing that the tests would be as hard as they were. The midterm was maybe 11 multiple choice and the rest was short answer. The final was online because of the corona virus but that was hard as well. It was 41 questions and he only gave us 50 minutes. Needless to say i did not do well in that class. He has pop quizzes. RUN!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Great professor! He's really nice and has a straightforward grading criteria. There are 7 pop quizzes but he drops the lowest 3 scores. Also 3 essays, 1 midterm, and the final. There's extra credit as well so it's very hard to fail this class! Lecture is not mandatory but pop quizzes so I would go! Lots of reading so make sure to not fall behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Drops lowest quizzes and exams. Overall funny and caring. Lots of reading, and three 2 page papers. Offers extra credit. Pop quizzes usually at the beginning of class. Will move it to the end of class if he notices a pattern of people leaving after the quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I loved having him this quarter I'm surprised no one has reviewed Carpiano on here! he is the sweetest and tries to make lecture fun. beware of pop quizzes for sure! There is a lot of reading the quizzes are based off of them. Lectures are also uploaded online. tests are pretty straight forward you either know it or you dont. take his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: I took his POSC102 course. There was no discussion, only lectures. It was a bit boring at times, but the material was easy to understand. Both exams were easy and graded easily.

The lecture was three hours long. Was not very accommodating and the grading heavily relied on the TA which unfortunately was not good. He knows a lot about the subject, but it was a difficult class overall even though it was interesting.

there's only 3 grades: midterm, final, and discussion. i never went to a single lecture and passed with A-. study concepts well because you write essays about it for the exams and he asks you to define concepts as well. my TA Rudra was great he grades fairly and his discussion slides are super helpful

Dr.Carreras is a very straightforward professor. The class was based on the midterm, the final, and the discussion section. Lecture can get a little boring considering it lasts 3 hours, but he tries to blend in videos to catch your attention. Siqi was a really good TA for the class and honestly, it was not a very difficult class. Quite enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: a super chill prof doesn't let his title go to his head, the lecture can be a lil boring but honestly a chill guy and as long as you just pay the slightest attention you'll pass, made attendance not mandatory for my class he just does what he needs to do then leaves isn't extra fs like most profs at ucr. would recommend if you want a chill class
first of all he is Argentinian. boring three hour long lecture. does not answer questions. No clear course structure. 40% midterm 40% final, 20% discussion participation. TAs are just as bad.

Honestly, This professor is a solid choice. A lot of professors at UCR are pretty unreasonable, but this guy is good. The syllabus is clear. Two essays, attendance, and discussion make up your entire grade. Try to write above the limit/ standard. If the instructions state write 4 pages, write 6 or 7. If you do this you'll be fine. Would recommend!

Professor Carreras' lectures are clear and to the point. There were only 2 papers assigned during the quarter, one during midterms and one for finals. Besides that, there is no homework except to watch the lectures which we could do on our own time. If you stay on top of those and give yourself ample time to work on the essays, you'll easily pass.

you wont get an A on the midterm or final unless you have a VERY deep understanding of both the reading and the lectures. not just reading and watching, but devoting INSANE amounts of time to them. the lectures themselves are super boring because the professor doesn't know how to passionately present the material; readings also feel pretty lifeless
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: ran out of space to type the one that said midterm is 8 pages long. Midterm is hard asl and is based on readings. he assigns too many readings and most are 50 pages long, yeah I don't have time for that so I improvised on the midterm. but yeah TA is horrible and I told her I can't show up to section and she literally told me my badfortakingthisclas

ok where do I start, the professor himself is not bad at all. He posts 3-4 hours worth of lectures every week but expects you to actually watch them. I have watched a single one and I am in week 7 and im doing good. the bad part of this class is the TA Felicity. Worst TA I've ever had and does not accommodate with you OR COVID. Midterm is 8 pages
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: With all respect, his voice makes you want to wander in lecture and not really focus on the material. Midterm and Final are easy if you do some of the readings and look over the lectures. I don't advise this unless you're well at improvising, but you can skip ALL lectures and still pass. Section is mandatory, though.

Easy A as long as you pay attention to the lectures everything that is in the lectures will be in the midterm and final he also gives study guides which are super helpful, readings are optional I never read them and still passed with an A, the tests are written short answers and an essay (more essays for the final though)

Attending lecture is not mandatory, but discussion attendance is. Do not miss a single discussion section (there is a week 0 discussion in this class). There are only three grades in his class (midterm 1, discussion, and the final). Tests are completely lecture based and require you to specifically cite the readings and lecture. Attend lecture!

Easier than expected. You do not have to show up to ANY lecture and still pass with an A , although they do help and keep you from slacking off. He posts all powerpoint slides on ilearn, with the readings for the class so you don't have to purchase a textbook. He's a very sweet guy, 1 midterm, 1 final gives topics to study for exams:) Great TA's.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Took this course over summer, I'm a straight A student, and more then knew the topic of Latin america having taken 3 courses on the subject and passing with an A in all courses. Received a C because I missed 2 days of the 5 week 3 hour 2 days a week course. Show up and speak up.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: i would sit around the front because his accent can be difficult to understand sometimes. his lectures are very monotonous as well so even though the subject was interesting it feels boring (if that makes sense). there was only one midterm and then a final, all written no multiple choice so i would really pay attention, study, and go to discussion

lectures are sort of long but this guy knows his stuff. He's really sweet and provides the class with readings on ilearn so that we don't have to spend money on a textbook. He makes complex subjects easy to understand. The tests are somewhat difficult but he provides a list of terms to study a week in advance for the test

Great professor. Really made learning about U.S-Latin America relations interesting, but the 12 page paper he assigned was a bit much and a pain to write. Aside from writing a long paper, his class was enjoyable and informative. Midterm and Final are just terms and and an essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Best professor I have had in a while. Posts slides on ilearn, uses many examples to help you better understand difficult topics, and goes over the  last classes lecture very briefly to refresh everyones memory. Does not require textbook as he will post free chapters from various books on ilearn to help you along. Review sheets were fantastic!
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is pretty informative and helpful when it comes to questions and lectures. He doesn't give any homework at all but 80% of your grade is based on the midterm and the final (35%midterm & 45%final) He posts his lectures online and if you just read the readings and take good notes in lectures and from PowerPoints you will get an A!

Professor Carreras posts the lectures online which helps when reviewing for midterms and finals. He talks full time during lecture, but he is very informative and will explain any questions asked. I enjoyed his class.

I'm not even a polisci major but I've taken two of his classes just because of his teaching. He does have a very thick Argentinan accent so if you're not patient don't go. He is extremely well traveled and speaks 4 (I think) languages so I really respect and want to learn from him. Sweetest guy, visit him during office hours if you're struggling.

Awesome professor! Explains a lot of the material on tests in lecture so make sure to go to them if you want to do well. Relying on powerpoints will only do you so much since some slides are just vocab words. No textbook. He assigns PDF readings weekly. Tests are essay questions. Overall, a really interesting class!
Pretty easy A if you attend lecture and section. He does have an accent but once you get past that, it is a very enjoyable class. For sure do all the assigned readings. Definitely would take it!

I really enjoyed Prof Carreras, he has a very thick Argentinan accent so if you're not patient do not take this course. Otherwise he was extremely helpful especially if you went to office hours and he was really nice. He's well traveled, and respectful of the material. You don't have to go to lecture because he posts slides online, Would take again

This was a super easy breadth course! I showed up for the first two weeks but never went back to lecture. His slides are very comprehensive and as long as you do the readings and go to discussion then you will be fine. Tests are short answer and essay but not too bad. You don't need to know specific details just the general ideas.

Professor Carreras is new. We were the first class he's taught, so keep that in mind. His lectures are long, he does have a Hispanic accent, and is a bit monotone. But, he was very nice if you talked to him after class. He had high standards for a low div class though, 1 midterm 35% (1 essay&i.d. ?'s) final 45% (2 essays&i.d's) & sec 20% (quizzes)

Easy class however pretty boring content. All the test content will be on the slides, make sure not to skip class because she can do attendance at any time and also she does do quite a bit of extra credit. There is a 4 point opportunity at the end, and she gave us some credit for the practice quiz and a few other things. Good Luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Incredibly easy class. I feel like the tests were common sense, my lowest score was an 80% and that was with ZERO studying. There are some questions where she asks about specific examples that were given in class, so I wouldn't ditch entirely. Graded by points out of 500, and she offered 20 points of EC. Probably the easiest upper div, take it!

The class is graded based on 5 quizzes, discussion participation, 2 midterms, and a final totaling 500 points. Her exam questions were straight forward, and she also offered 20 points of extra credit.

2 midterms, 1 final, 5 online take home quizzes. Dr. Guzman was a wonderful professor who was fun to watch lecture. Speaking of lecture, ATTEND LECTURE! Many questions are based on what the professor verbally says so go to lecture and you will do well in the course; given that you're also paying attention.

decent professor, but penalizes students who don't attend lecture by posting recordings without audio or not posting them at all (said she would post vids). offers extra credit, some are poorly communicated or limited (in-lecture activities or a single winning team in Jeopardy). said that she couldnt do anything to round grades bc of EC points

Took her for 5B, 5C, & 116. She is probably the easiest bio professor at UCR. Class is based on points not percentages. Honestly, as long as you do all your HW & attend/participate in discussion, & do decent on all the exams you can get an A. Plus, she had plenty of EC opportunities & the TAs were really nice. Lectures are recorded.

Easy class, but  I wrote my first name and last initial, and she refused credit, saying she needs full names to identify students, even though I'm the only one with that name in the class. If there is another student with the same first name and last initial I would understand but there isn't, don't understand how there could be confusion.

One of the easiest class and explains concepts very well. However, doesn't usually regrade so make sure you don't miss anything as the class consists of a lot of both exams and take home quizzes that can bring your grade down if you miss them.

very easy class but very boring. content in this class is almost like a review of the previous bio05 series and ap environmental if u took it. only studying i did was looking over the slides she posts a couple hours before the exam which have simple straightforward questions. really hard to not do good in this class
Take her, I never went to a single lecture after the 2nd exam/barely studied and still ended up with an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's goes off on a lot of tangents but her exams and quizzes are straightforward and easy if you just read the slides. She posts recordings also.

Cabrera is probably 1 of the best biology professors at UCR. Her exams are easy, but you need to memorize & understand all of the content. It sometimes can be a lot. But the lectures & slides are always posted on canvas. If you want a good grade though, know that there is little room for error, cause there is no curve & she only gives 4pts for EC.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Tests are super easy straight from the slides, super sweet professor but not the best lecturer

The professor was amazing and straightforward, no surprises on exams! She records her lectures too so if you have a sick day or missed a concept you can just go back and watch it. She assigned quizzes that were also based on what she says in lecture. The midterms are 25 mq and the final is 45 questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor has a heavy accent and you can't understand half of what she says. She never answers emails. When asked about quiz questions, she can't explain why answers are correct or incorrect, one is just "more right". Heavy tests and doesn't care about student outcomes.

Cabrera is a great professor. I took her for Biol5B in the spring w/ Jenerette. Her exams very much reflect her lectures and she'll explain anything you ask her. The only downside w/ taking the class was Jenerette because his slides don't make sense & his exam was hard. The class had 2 midterms, online weekly quizzes, & a final (noncumulative).

You can tell she's passionate about her work which is nice to see. 90% of the exams are from the slides. She won't post the lectures if there's low attendance so go to class but go regardless bc it was quite helpful (a given kind of lol). Gave some EC. She really likes to use pictures & graphs from the slides on exams just fyi. She's really nice !!

You can tell she is passionate about her work which is nice to see. 90% of the exams are off the slides. She won't post the lectures if there is low attendance so go to class but I recommend going to class regardless as it was quite helpful. Gave some EC. She really likes using pictures & graphs from the slides just fyi. She's really nice!

Had her for Biol116 in the spring. It's easy to tell when a STEM professor is actually passionate about what they're teaching (as most aren't) and she is a rare example of a professor who is. Super cool lectures, very fair and easy exams. She records lectures but you're missing out if you don't go, one of the only enjoyable STEM profs

Had her for Biol116 in Spring 2024. Tests are straight from the slides. She records but will stop posting if attendance is low. I recommend going though. She details a lot of info that isn't on the actual slides. There was some EC. I never talked to her but she seems nice and is clearly passionate.

A professor is very passionate about the topic. Lectures are interesting topics. No curve and no extra credit. Test questions are very straight forward but it is pure memorization. Only 25 questions per test
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Best Professor out there; sucked that she only taught half of the course. Her exams are very straight forward and 100% reflect the material on her slides. If you studied the slides and watched/went to lectures you undoubtedly get an A if you put in some effort. 

Class Grade is based upon 3 midterms (45%), lab (20%), online quizzes (35%). No Final
lol just read the slides. i never went to a lecture
Didn't really go to any of the lectures and still got an A. Just read the slides. There is no curve in the class as the average person gets a 90% for each exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a great professor, and there are no surprises on the exams. I honestly did not attend any lectures, and would just study a couple nights before with the lecture slides and got an A. Exams were very fair and she cares about her students a lot

Elisa is an amazing Professor who really cares about her students! She listens to issues that arise during the semester and helps to find a solution. She really is passionate about what she teaches. Really sad to see her leave Okstate because she was one of my favorites but hope she is loved at her new university.
Her exams are based off of her lecture slides and it really helps to read the textbook. Never felt lost because concepts are explained very thoroughly in lecture. Really enjoyed her class.

She is a new professor but she teaches pretty well. She makes her exams based on lectures and nothing we have not been taught. I would take her again. The only thing I think she needs is to get a better microphone to hear her a little better but overall great professor. 10/10

Dr. Canalizo is super sweet and genuine, she responds fast to emails and is always willing to compromise. She assigns hw and 2-question quizzes every week, as long as you do the hw, you are 100% prepared for the quizzes. 2 in-person non-cumulative exams, they were 50 mcq. Lectures cover most of the hw, no extra reading, overall easy and fun class!

She is an amazing teacher! She is passionate about the class, and she is so eloquent in how she explains it. As someone who never got into astronomy, I became the biggest astronomy nerd after this. She genuinely wants people to like the subject; she posts slides before class, she gives fun extra credit, and the cheat sheet for the final clutched.

Easy class! Weekly quizzes during your discussion section. A few different extra credit opportunities for points on the midterm & final, also extra credit from PollEv attendance. Attending lectures makes it easier, the weekly quizzes are a few questions (like 2) pulled directly from weekly homework (not graded). Midterm & final were easy, open note

She is super passionate about what she teaches and the class overall is super interesting and makes you want to learn more. Overall it's an easy class and if you do the work and participate you will do good. She takes attendance on Poll EV and discussions are mandatory. both final and midterm are open book and online

Class was made up of weekly quizzes with 2 questions drawn from the weekly hw. Attendance was not taken at lecture and Poll EV was used to give EC to students that did come to lecture. Lectures were easy to understand and relevant to the homework and tests. There was only one midterm and one final. Prof is super caring and offers EC out of class

Class is pretty chill if you go to the lectures, which are amazing and easy to follow. There are weekly quizzes in discussion but they are pulled from the hw which you can ask ask the TA before the quiz starts so ask questions and you'll do well. Midterm and Final are based on lectures and aren't too difficult.
Test are literally the lecture if you take good notes. Study and you will be fine. Weekly quizzes in discussion, not hard, just do not forget to study before test.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pretty good professor. Allowed us to take the final and midterms online. Material can become a little to much information to retain and remember near the end, but overall the class was set up to be rather fair for each student.

Edith is by far my favorite UCR professor. She is so passionate about what she teaches. It made me enjoy learning about astronomy. Attending lecture helped, but the discussions were what helped me ace the exams. The textbook is free and isn't mandatory to read. The weekly quizzes were super easy. I loved every lecture and hope to take her again.

She is an amazing professor and the class isnt hard at all and neither are the discussion if you go to lecture. I never read the book and i got over 45/50 on every midterm. Shes really passionate abt this topic and its inspiring to hear, she got me really interested in this subject and even gave us opportunities to see planets. highly recommend

The exams were so hard. She told us that for our midterm we would only need to study our weekly homework. On the 50-question exam, there were maybe 2 questions relating to the homework. 
The final was in person, and 300+ students were crammed in a lecture hall at the height of COVID for a 3-hour exam. I studied a lot and only got a B on the final.

She is so caring and understanding. The concepts are not difficult. Class consists of two midterms and a final, with quizzes. It may sound daunting, however, I recommend to take this course if you are actually interested in the material.

Synchronous zoom lectures, but attendance was not mandatory. She recorded and uploaded them all. Weekly hw consisting of 10-14 questions from the lecture material. Book was recommended but not necessary. 2 midterms and a final all multiple choice. As long as you understand the concepts you should be more than fine. So nice and open to questions.

I freaking love this women. She has a passion about the cosmos that transcends through her illustrations of the Universe. I love how open she is to questions too. She is very respectful when it comes to asking questions and her lectures are very thoughtful bringing regular concepts into the laws of physics and space. Highly recommend Dr. Canalizo!

love her sm!!! shes so sweet and her lectures were so interesting! you can tell shes passionate about what she teaches and it shows through her teaching! exams were super easy (i just listened to the lectures again and got As). she was accommodating and understanding during covid which is especially useful!
amazing professor! please take her if you can!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Canalizo is so passionate and well versed in her field. While she does post lecture slides, going to lecture helps way more. You get to miss 2 discussion sections and the quizzes are only 2 questions each, so I pretty much would leave 15 min early every discussion. Midterms aren't difficult if you pay attention and take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: 10/10 WOULD RECOMMEND PHYSICS 006. This was one of, if not the BEST class I've ever taken. I've found a new interest and love for astronomy/astrophysics, plus a whole lot of knowledge that blows my freaking mind. This is a perfect non-physics major's physics course; you learn and work just enough, and every bit is worth it. Prof. Canalizo is A1 (:

Prof. C really cares about her student's success so she will give you every opportunity available to make sure you get that A.  Homework and Quiz weekly, 2 midterms, and final. Some concepts are hard to grasp but she is willing to go over any questions you have.  Also has fun extra credit opportunities. Worth taking the class with her.

Most amazing professor I ever had. A lot of class material to remember, especially for acumulative final, but it's very easy to understand. Textbook not required, just study from the slides. Homework is given but optional to do; the weekly discussion quizzes' problems are 2 homework problems. Class isn't curved but 2 lowest quiz scores are dropped
Professor Canalizo is the best professor I have taken at UCR. She's intelligent, and she makes the material really get you thinking about the Universe. Would definitely recommend.
Super easy and interesting class. You don't need the textbook. Just study the lecture slides and homework questions and you can get an A.

She is a great professor! Easy class, you don't need to attend lecture because she post very clear-cut slides online. You do need to attend the discussion sections because there are quizzes every week, but they help with the midterms and final. Don't need the book, unless you want further explanation, but I think she does a great job alone!

This class is mind-blowing and almost had me switch my major. She is an amazing lecturer and she is so understanding. She allows you to use books from past editions and even then, she even says you don't really need the book. She makes the class so doable and easy on us. Completely worth it.

Canalizo is definitely passionate about what she teaches, and she's totally willing to help in office hours. There are weekly quizzes in discussion, and the exams are based off those quizzes. She offers extra credit (if you're gonna choose astrophotography, be prepared for stress and another paper).

One of my favorite professors UCR! Very approachable and humble. Yes, this class is an easy A but you still gotta work for it (a lot of information). DO THE EXTRA CREDIT, I barely made the mark for an A- because of it. Textbook not needed at all. Take this class!

Professor Canalizo is a great teacher! Lectures are not mandatory and she posts her lecture slides online. However, I recommend going to class. There is a quiz every week based on the non mandatory homework questions. 1 midterm, 1 final. The key to getting an A in the class is studying and understanding the homework questions. TAKE THIS CLASS.

She's so cute and enthusiastic about teaching us. She has demonstrations in class that are super fun and cool. Don't need the book, you can study off her lectures. Do the "homework" though because the TA's pick questions from it from the quiz. Would definitely take any class with her. Super easy class, didn't study as much as I should have.
This class is so easy. She is very helpful and interesting. She truly cares about what she does and wants students to learn.  Need more professors like her. 100% recommend.

Prof Canalizo is so sweet, kind, and well-respected that you will prob feel bad (or even worse) for disappointing her by failing the class.. which is nearly impossible if you go to lecture at least half the time and cram a bit before tests

Honestly one of the best professor's i've ever had. Lectures aren't mandatory (and she posts the slides on ilearn) but most of the class still comes because it's just so interesting! Weekly quiz in dis, but she uploads the questions a week before. she also offers extra credit that adds points to the mc final. Really fun class, definitely recommend!
She is the best professor ever in UCR!great lectures as well as all the homework assignments really helpful!must take her class!
She's is one of my most favorite professors here at UCR. Her lectures are fun and clear. I would take this class again if I could!
PROFESSOR CANALIZO IS THE BEST!!!!! THE VIOLENT UNIVERSE IS A GREAT INTERESTING CLASS EASY TO PASS AND UNDERSTAND IF YOU GO TO LECTURE AND DISCUSSION, YOU DON'T NEED THE BOOK!

she is like the best professor in riverside! she is amazing, the class is really interesting and the attendance rate is really high even though it is not mandatory. quizes are easy points but you need to study for midterm and final! love this class

Dr. Canalizo's intelligence, sense of humor and kindness make her a very attractive and appealing teacher. She's a great lecturer who clearly loves what she does and her enthusiasm compels even the most science-averse to learn about astronomy. UCR needs more professors like her. :)

She is one of the best professors I have ever been taught by. She loves what she does, making it an overall great experience. Super clear, and office hours are a great resource. Weekly homework/quizzes, one midterm, one final. Very easy if you attend lecture and take notes. Definitely recommend for CHASS physical science requirement. Loved it!

One of the best professors at UCR. She teaches the material in a very understandable manner. Easy class if you go to class, take notes, and keep up with the material. Homeworks come directly from the slides. I recommend this class to anyone.
Awesome teacher. Really enjoyed her lectures, one of the few teachers in Riverside that actually enjoys to teach and does it with a passion. Glad I took this class, recommend it to anyone.

Great class i never bought the book you don't need it. she says what is on the power point is on the test. never went to class just read the slides at home easy tests and go to review session before mid terms she will give you answers.. hardly tried and got a B+
She gives really great lectures. Prepares get enthusiasm and material to make sure her students understand her lectures and materials. Goes over things very clearly and answers anything unclear.

Class was really interesting & very easy to follow along. The professor will break down the chapter fairly easily during lecture so I suggest you GO if you don't read the book the lecture sums it up VERY good. Exams were easy. The final is culmative so it makes it a tad harder to memorize a whole quarter's worth of work, but its an enjoyable class.

Science is not my forte but this prof made class easy and fun. I'd actually learned a few things&attended every class. theres HW but its only to help you study for weekly quiz in disc. TA will give you all the ans at the end and its very helpful for midterm&final. Info tested are all on PPT so no surprises. highly rec for those whos bad in science

She is an awesome teacher. She makes you want to learn about physics and helps you understand the material even if you had no prior knowledge. The notes are all online and the tests are based off the notes. I recommend her to everyone.

Professor Canalizo is really helpful during office hours. Powerpoints lecture notes are posted on ilearn but it helps if you attend and listen to lectures as well since everything given on powerpoint and what she says in class will be on the midterm and final exam. Very interesting class about the galaxy, stars, and solar systems etc. Learned a lot

Very easy class. Material was interesting. Attendance isn't really necessary (since no attendance is taken) but go to class a lecture before the 2 midterms and final. Lectures are all on iLearn so study that and you'll be fine.
A decent class, not very difficult. Hardly went to lecture and still pulled off a decent grade. Just make sure you study all the lectures. 2 midterms and 1 easy final.
Fun class. So sad that it's over. The things she discussed in class were so fascinating...at least to me :) It really got me thinking.

she's really nice and the material itself is interesting, but her lectures are really boring. tests are easy and book is totally not necessary, just print out lectures and go to class and take notes. she says things in class about the midterm so you should go and take notes. easy class, dont have to memorize any physics or formulas. shes smart too
I had a TR class with her and the time passes fairly quick in her class. She is funny and really tries to help you understand. Lots of visuals.
shes very nice, but lecture is mandatory because notes she posts on ilearn are slightly different from in lecture.

Awesome class. Very interesting. It is a pretty easy class if you go to class but if not she has all of the notes on ilearn. Go to discussion its worth 10% and its easy. Midterms weren't to bad if you were prepared. Definetly take her if you can.
Fun class.

Professor Canalizo is one of the best professors I have taken at UCR. I struggle with science and did not have an impossible time in this class. The professor as well as her TA's (I had Mariana) are very very helpful and approachable. Utilize Professor Canalizo's office hours. The textbook is unnecessary. Final is cake if you do well on midterms!

Excellent professor! I have a lot of difficutly with science, but she lectured in a way that made the material understandable, while never being condescending. Extremely well organized, very enthusiastic, and will motivate you to learn in the class. Most highly reccomended

Dudes, this teacher is one of the best.  Very great lectures, great topic, tests are challenging enough so that you pay attention in class but not hard enough that will make you upset or bummed, and she's very nice. And she has an awesome accent!

Very nice professor. Midterms were kinda hard for me at least...there are three midterms(she drops lowest) and there are quizes in discussion everyweek(worth 10% of your grade but she gives you the answers before hand) I missed almost all of my discussions and got 84% on all my midterms...but got a 94 on the final(really easy btw) Ended up with B+
very easy to follow
She's awesome. Extremely interesting topic, and she presents it simply, but not shallowly. I was never bored in this class, she's very funny and really nice too. HIGHLY recommended.
She is awesome!!! take this class
Really great professor.  Tests were on her lectures like it should be.
her lectures were to the point and the midterms were a breeze.
Very good professor.  Interesting class and isnt very difficult.  Aced all 3 midterms and the final without putting forth hardly any studying.  Most of the material is common sense anyway.

She is a good professor, her final is very easy, but there are 2 easy midterms and 2 hard ones. You really have to know both the lecture notes and the reading to do well, or else you can get confused on the midterms. Don't take this class if you just want to zone out and not think.
very nice teacher ... she uses very detailed powerpoints and posts them on ilern too along with vidz ... she puts a lot of effort into her work and is clear wit everything

She presented the material in a clear, logical fashion, something I would think to be a very difficult task when trying to introduce general relativity to non-CNAS/Engineering majors.  Tests were relatively well written--very few questions with ambiguous answers.

Not really sure why there are such low reviews on this professor, his lectures do get a little tedious but the slides are organized. Grading is also pretty reasonable, there is lots of information so get ready to read, there is also lots of homework but they are helpful for exams.

reviews.comment: I took Cengiz for a different course that isn't listed here, however I doubt his competence is better anywhere else. Avoid him if you'd like to actually learn something.
Great teacher. Always helps if you are confused.
Great teacher
No Comments
The class was very informative I loved it. Cj was an amazing professor! They are very nice and understanding.
Such a great class and professor! They are so kind and I learned so much!

CJ, they/them is such an amazing professor and makes class interesting. Their grading criteria is clear and fair. They were very understanding and empathetic with personal issues and is willing to offer extensions on assignments.
