reviews.comment: Made lecture interesting! Alot of information but gives you time to write everything down. Overall, easy class if you put in the work, highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Although the test is not easy and a lot of writing, I'm very enjoying the lecture! Very recommend to take this class!!!

reviews.comment: Lectures are told in story form which helps to be able to visualize the information. Goes over a lot of information but it's not too tough. Tests are pretty okay, you just to really study the information, he gives study guides and gives words/events that you need to know.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: i hate history but his class was the first and very well might be the only history class ive ever loved. if you have a change to take hist010, I highly recommend taking it with him. this was a great class and he tells history like a story.

Don't be hesitant just because this history class is in the era of way back whenever, literally a great class that's pretty easy. Lectures are basically everything and you don't necessarily need to focus so much on outside reading. Lectures are very straightforward and honestly one of the only classes I am alert and fully awake throughout.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This is literally the first time in my life that I enjoyed a history class. Super interesting and insightful lecture, make sure to attend and write down as much as possible (if not all) of what he says, makes it easier to study for the short answer and essay questions. Lots of memorization but questions are usually pretty straightforward.

I hate history but Dr.C makes sure you want to take all his history classes. Keeps lecture interesting, tells it like a story. He speaks slow so you can write everything down. He doesnt post slides, go to class. There's movies for extra credit. Also, don't ask stupid questions in class, just listen. Midterm super hard but final helps you recover

reviews.comment: Take his class, it's the best thing you can do for yourself as a UCR student. His midterms are purely based on his lecture notes, and you only need the textbook to look up vocab definitions from the list he provides. reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Chrissanthros is hands down the most amazing professor I have had UCR. His lectures are gold, it feel like he's telling you a story rather than it being forced. If you're planning to take a history class, do yourself a favor and enroll in his course. The tests are purely based on his lectures so make sure to attend class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: His lectures are amazing. His voice is like drops of gold and he makes history interesting by telling it like a storyteller. You COULD skip class and read to pass but he is REALLY worth going to lecture for. Easy A and only 1 essay.

He's a great professor & gave the best lectures I've had. There are no online slides so you must go to class & take good notes to receive the information. Study guide is just a list of terms. 5 page term paper due during last lecture. Midterms were split into 2 parts. Final was 5 short essays. Easy class if you pay attention & review terms.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Just took Chrisssantos History 10 class for fall 2016 and all I can say is that he is a great professor! Must go to lectures and take notes in order to pass! Midterm taken in two parts, he gives you a study guide of the terms for all the exams and the final. There is also a term paper It is all based on lectures. Reading is waste of time and money.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great Professor but must go to class as you must write down what he says (no notes online). Easy A if you study the terms he gives you. Ignore the reading as it takes too long

Possibly the least boring lectures I've ever had. Lectures like he's telling a story, knows how long to pause for students to write everything down (no slides, just pictures). Book reading doesn't count in class but WILL show up on tests.

Chrissanthos is the BEST professor I have had at UCR. History has never been one of my favorite subjects, I've avoided it as much as possible but his lectures are absolutely amazing! It makes it very easy to absorb the material and easy to recall during tests. If you're deciding between the breadth history courses History 10 is the way to go!

Very clear on all lectures. For the tests, a vocab list is given so just study that really hard and you will be fine. One paper is due around 9-10th week and 3 tests total. Very chill. His voice is like gold. Would take again.

I was expecting this class to be a LOT harder than it was. No homework, 3 exams & 1 paper. He may seem intimidating when it comes to grading and his expectations but in reality as long as you thoroughly go over the study guide, you'll do fine. Attending lecture is crucial because with out the notes, good luck. Flash cards are essential!

Over all this class was pretty easy if you studied for exams in which the textbook is necessary. You won't need the "sources" textbook since you'll never use it so don't spend your money! His lectures are like he's telling a story so you'll remember them quite easily. You may also notice that he has a specific favorite shirt he loves to wear (lol).
Probably one of the best classes I have taken at csuf. The lectures are very interesting and history is my thing once again because of the class. I might even major in it.

I really recommend this professor. There are no powerpoint  slides, but he lectures in a way that makes it very very easy to follow along. He lectures as if he was telling a story so you must take good notes if you want to do good on the exams. Plus, he pauses for a small moment after he says something which gives you time to write everything.

Best lecturer at UCR! I actually looked forward going to his class. I was never a huge fan of history but Chrissanthos definitely changed that. He lectures without PowerPoints, but it's better that way in my opinion. Take really good notes and read and you'll do fine. The class is so interesting and it goes by fast. Take this class!

Best instructor I've ever had.  His lectures are entertaining and informative.  He lectures as if he's if telling a story which it easy to pay attention to and remember the material.  Very fair 10/10 would recommend.

Attend all lectures and you'll do fine in the class. He tells a story to make it interesting and to help you remember the events. The midterm on the other hand was ridiculous. He expects you to study and know over 80 terms that are either battlespeopleevents, but only around 10 were on the midterm. Other than that, the class was very interesting.

Great great professor. His lectures are very clear. He lectures as if he is telling a story, so it makes learning fun and easy. You absolutelyMUST go to lecture, or you won't even get a C. I EMPHASIZE that lecture notes are MAJORLY IMPORTANT. If you have to miss lecture for some reason, beg for those notes from somebody sitting nearby.

No powerpoints in his lectures, but he does show pictures and occasional movies of events. I was led to believe you don't need the book to pass, but I regret not buying it. I fell so far behind having only 2 tests, a midterm, a 5-7 page paper and frustrating final to be graded on. He is an interesting professor, but I wouldn't take this class again
Great prof, no slides but lectures are straightforward. Exams are pretty easy, passed them all without reading and only studied right before exams. Very generous grader.

He's a great professor! He's very old school in the sense that he just talks throughout the class' entirety. If you want to pass you have to go to class even though attemdance isn't mandatory. All you gotta do is take good notes, read, and study. His grading criteria is pretty straightforward and he is there to help you if you need it.

Honestly the class isn't THAT hard. Lectures aren't mandatory but is essential to pass, so pay attention! Tests are somewhat hard so study 2 days prior cause there's a lot of material. I really liked the class and found it interesting. Term paper is broad but easy so utilize your TA. Final is super easy! GoogleDoc helps!

Taking notes in his class are extremely easy. He lectures like a story teller making it easier to listen to. Hardest part are his tests. They are difficult and take a lot to study for. Professor is really great and cool though. I recommend his class especially if you enjoy the subject and are willing to put in the work for your grade.

If you skip his classes you for sure won't get an A. He doesn't have power points and you really have to pay attention when he talks because thats the only way you will get the notes in his class. If you miss a day of class, you'll miss like 6 pages of notes. He is really clear when he teaches. study hard for the midterm and the final too do good!
I really enjoyed this class. Great Professor who knows his material.

He's a great prof. The tests actually aren't that hard if you do the review sheet he gives you. He'll ask for 2 to 4 details about a key term and you can literally put bullet points down. Just make sure you attend class. He's attractive for an older guy, so that definitely is a bonus.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Especially if it it the 2 hour and 45 minute class because he takes every single minute of lecture. He posts nothing on titaiam except our study guides that consist of 80 terms that aren't helpful what so ever and the study guide for the final is 9 terms, he doesn't even give you the questions. Worst class I've taken at csuf

I wouldnt recommend taking this professor. He doesn't use PowerPoint slides, he talks the entire lecture. The only balance you have for your grade are the 2 tests, the midterm, term paper & the final, so failing even one puts you in a horrible position to try and pass. & if you don't do the assigned readings there's no way you'll pass his tests.

I loved this class! The exams were tough - 2 midterms, all fill in the blank and short answer. The final is easy - a few short essays. There is also 1 term essay. Attendance is MANDATORY! He posts nothing online, and there are no slides. He keeps class interesting and lectures as if he is telling a story. Put some effort in, and you'll pass.

Excited because of rep. Took it while taking upper-div hist. Focus is Greece and spent three weeks on it. Everything else felt rushed. Curriculum could use improvement to cover more non-Greek histories instead of heavy required reading. Not as hyped about it now. Wish I took it w/ Randolph Head. Good for people who don't care about history.
He makes his class really interesting during lecture but you must read the book in order to succeed. I really enjoyed his class and I recommend it.
He is clear in lectures and really knows what he is talking about. Side note: He sounds like Buzz Lightyear.

Not a bad teacher at all. This is when of the classes where he speaks, and you just write. You need to either make a friend, or just attend every lecture. He makes each class seem like a story, extremely interesting. Overall, I really enjoyed this class.
Lectures are usually very interesting! He even shows movies during class sometimes. But WARNING** his exams are crazy hard, study a lot a lot a lot if you're taking this class!

Awesome Professor. He is a great storyteller as well. Storyteller as in his lecture style is like someone telling a story and is very understandable. He is very clear and takes his time. The papers weren't bad. Do the reading. Take his class. Had him for Summer '13.

Chrissantos is a great lecturer, almost a story teller. Class wasn't boring and always full of info so you should go. 2 midterms that involve ALOT of memorizing (fill in the blanks require specific names and terms and short answers), 1 essay, and an easy final. The midterms seemed to cause most ppl problems. Got a B+ with some effort.

Paper due at the end of the quarter, a midterm and final. He gives out study guides, but sometimes there are topics not mentioned in the guide so you should read the chapters he assigns. Also, his lectures are really easy to take notes on once you know his teaching/test style.

Prof Chrissanthos was nothing amazing. He made everything clear, but didn't like how he hid info in the book. There was a google doc so that helped a lot. I didn't like the essay and found it useless. I received a 261/300. You can only lose 30 points to get an A. Study hard and study the material in dis. This class was decent, but nothing special.
Amazing professor! History is my weakest subject and he made it very interesting and easy for me.  You have to put in the work to get that A!

I loved his class! He really does give his lectures like if he was telling a story which makes it easier to learn but you have to go to lecture since he doesn't post lectures online. The tests were hard because it's all fill in the blank and short answer but if you STUDY then you should be able to pass.

I took this class because all the rating underneath me said he was easy... BUT HE'S SO NOT. Tests are very hard- he gives around 90 terms and only tests us on max 20 of the terms. Theyre all FILL IN THE BLANK & some names of the people are so confusing. Most TA's grade harshly.  Professor is great but is still a hard class. Study your butt off.

This class was extremely interesting and the professor is very knowledgable about what he is teaching. However, this class is not an easy A. You must do all of the readings, come to class, and study really hard for the tests. The tests are pretty difficult and you are given on average 85 terms to mesmerize. It was really interesting yet really hard

He doesn't post any power points or notes of any kind so you have to go to lecture everyday. He talks slow enough so you can write everything down, but you can just bring a laptop and type everything too. His tests were mostly fill in the blank with key terms he posts as a study guide. Your TA will really affect your grade. Dan Bellum grades easy.

Overall I really enjoyed this teacher. He makes his lectures interesting, almost like telling a story. Attendance is optional but there are no lecture slides, so go to class. Tests don't have any trick questions, very straightforward. Just study the terms he gives you and you're pretty much golden.

He is by far my favorite professor that I've ever had. He is clear and helpful and makes the subject  interesting. The tests are straightforward and very doable if you study the key terms. Lecture is recommended but not mandatory. (They're really interesting anyway, so most people end up going.)I very highly recommend him.

This professor has an amazing way of making his lectures interesting unlike most history professors. The way he lectures makes the material extremely easy to learn. He also provides study guides for his midterms and finals which also helpful. As long as you attend lecture you will be sure to get a good grade.
Great Professor! You HAVE to go to lectures! But he speaks slowly enough that it isn't hard to take notes. For tests you must study the key terms, since there are fill-in-blank sections.
Lecture is mandatory because he doesn't give lecture slides. Very interesting class and most of the time you will be taking notes. Great teacher. Clear.

He makes history interesting. You wont fall asleep for sure. No slides. Discussion sucked- weekly assignments. Term paper- on any topic. Tests were fill in the blank. Easy if you studied all your notes. Final is FOUR essays- intro, concl, three paragraphs. If you want an A you can only miss 30 points all quarter.

I absolutely LOVED this class. Chrissanthos seriously made me consider double-majoring for history it was so interesting. His exams are actually fun to take since the material is just SO easy to absorb with the way he lectures! If more professors lectured the way Chrissanthos did, college would all be an easy A, while grasping ALL material as well!

Had him for many upper division history classes. Imperator Chrisasanthos is simply one of the best history professors. His lectures are always interesting because he focuses on the most interesting aspects of history IMO(military and political). Take any of his classes, you wont regret it.

I loved this class!! Because of his lectures, I was actually intrigued by the material, and the chilli pepper doesn't lie, a fiiine man indeed. Soothing voice too. Easy to understand & always ask students if they have questions. Textbook is not needed tho the book for discussion is. Make nice with your TAs since they do majority of the grading.

Awesome lecturer, really cute and interesting. Class isnt too hard, have to read to do well on tests. Get his opinion on paper topic to get a better grade. One bad thing - I do not think he cares aa lot about students - just like research and lecture. Promised to write me a grad letter - and never did!! had to ask another professor last sec..ugh.
The professor was a great lecturer and made the materials interesting. Tests are fair but do the reading because even if he doesn't talk about it he may test on it. 2 midterms 1 final and 1 essay.
His lectures are very interesting. Just attend his lectures and take notes. His midterms are super easy and so is the final.

This class was a blast. I took it during Summer. The material covered was very interesting. He is EXTREMELY easy to listen to. If the book is available on reserve, it's probably not extremely important to buy it. However, you MUST read it. There is stuff he does not cover in class. Coursework: Paper. Midterm (multiple chocie). Final(5 essays).

Great professor! Make sure you go to class because he moves through information pretty quickly, but slowly enough for you to write everything down (whether you take notes by hand or by computer). Doing his readings is a good idea but I wouldn't say necessary because everything he tests on, he goes over in class. One of the best at UCR.

Fun class! He has a charming radio personality voice! Don't buy the book-- all the test stuff is from lecture or you could wikipedia what you missed. Easy tests, essay is easy A, class is easy A. Loved his class!

Lectures are mandatory but are worth going to because he lectures so well. Read the books and take good notes and you should do just fine.  Definitely one of the best history teachers that UCR has to offer.

Very interesting teacher.. he makes class sort of interesting but must be a good note taker and pay attention in class. w/e he says in lecture will generally be on the tests.  tests are decently ok but grades leniant
One of the best professors I've had at UCR. Attending class is essential because everything discussed in his class will show up on his test. There are no surprises.
Great Professor. Tests are super easy, barely need to study if you go to class. He basically tells you every lecture what is going to be on the next test. Take Him!!!

not an easy class since there are so many names of the battles, emperors and terms need to memorize. Whether this class is difficult or not really depends on the TA because TA grades all the things. I think Colin is a pretty good TA, recommended to get his discussion section.
Easy easy easy. Only need the textbook for looking up terms for the midterms. Definitely take his class.

Probably the absolute best professor I've had at this school. He does not use power point slides, and he directly lectures to the class slow enough for you to write down everything. He was understandable and made the lectures feel like story time. I highly recommend taking his class if you get the chance. He was amazing.
Best Professor ever. No joke. If you take history with another teacher, there's something wrong with you.

I don't want to reiterate what everyone else said already. He is simply the best History 10 professor you will ever have. End of story. One thing I dislike, even though it doesn't affect the course, is that he uses hard to understand abbreviations in his email. haha. That's the only bad thing.
Best History teacher alive,his class is story time, didnt miss a single one class.
history can be a boring subject, but this professor keeps it interesting. basically study the notes, go to lecture, and memorize all the battles.

Excellent professor. Challenging, but fair. Lectures prepare you well; all exam material comes from them. He drops hints too. The readings are necessary for the essay and final! He's very knowledgeable and willing to help with your paper also.

I have taken every upper division class this professor has taught so far, as well as many of his lower div.  He is amazing! The tests are pretty hard, but they reflect the readings and lecture notes almost perfectly.  Class with him is like a never ending story which he tells wonderfully.  I have never come across a better hist. prof!
Easiest teacher for history alive. If you fail his class, then you aren't going to lecture. His lectures are really interesting. It's like story time!
Great professor, knows what he's talking about and you are never once bored!

I thought this was going to be a regular boring history class but it isin't. He paces himself very well and makes the lecture funny sometimes. His class is easy if you go to lecture which you would like going to since is fun and interesting. I don't read much from the book and I still got a B on my first midterm. and he shows movie clips

Prof. Chrissanthos is a great professor. His lectures are the perfect pace for note taking and he does it all without slides. Midterms are straight forward, all fill in the blank, and short answer. Finals an essay. Names all sound super similar so know the difference. Take good notes,  follow the study guide and you'll be fine. 5-7  page  termpaper

Great Teacher! He has a way of teaching that makes it so interesting and fun to learn. I liked going to lectures, which is good because his tests are based on his lectures. I never read the book. I got 97% of final, its a couple essay questions, but they are easy if you study!A 5pg research paper, TA walks you through it though. Great class!

hard tests! but read his book, it helps in the class! you definitely should always attend lecture, but its not one that you want to miss anyway, he presents the material like he's telling a story and he's not hard on the eyes either ;)
knows a lot of history, knows how to teach it, can keep a class interested, good sense of humor and yes, I found him distracting, but I guess he can't really help it haha

If you don't like history this is the class for you. Chrissanthos tells history like a storybook. You must make sure to attend class; the test are based off his lectures. There is an essay prompt but your TA will work you through it. Final is on the hard side because it requires you to write 4-5 essays. Be prepared to look over notes everyday.

Hes an excellent lecturer, very entertaining, and is willing to answer questions during lecture and talks slow enough for people to keep up in their notes. Very helpful during office hours for term paper ideas by him. Only downside, he has a personal reader for the tests and term papers. Definately reccomend his Roman Republic class though!

Great lecturer, you will generally enjoy going to class. He obviously enjoys the material and talking about it. Does not do his own grading, however, which is a bit of a downer.  That aside, if you want ancient history to suddenly become interesting and enjoyable, he's your man.

reviews.comment: Attendance mandatory+a good chunk of your grade, lectures = recorded but there's always something wrong with it, don't depend on it. The professor was amazing in teaching the course. He was always energetic and had fun teaching his class. He really cares for his students. He considers feedback and makes sure to help us prepare for the exams. The quizzes, assignments, and exams are fair. He allows one sheet of notes. If you do terribly on them, then it's on you at this point.

PLEASE TAKE HIM. Chillest prof I've ever had and prolly ever will. He makes a boring lecture really interesting and engaging. If you fail his tests, I genuinely think you're dumb; First day of class he literally went "you guys can use chatgpt on my exams, I really don't care because I know that everybody already uses it." Easiest A of your life.

Honestly one of the best professors I've had so far.Take if you want an easy A. Fun and engaging. I highly recommend this class to fulfill social science requirement!

Very clear that he loves teaching and cares for students. Is fair and lenient with the grading. Exams are all open notes, online, and you can do it any time you want before its deadline. Gives extra credit and drops 4 lowest quiz grades.
She's nice. The only qualm I have about the class is that late work by literally just 1 minute gets %10 taken off of it.

Prof. Cruz was not only caring but incredibly entertaining, I loved taking her class. I was initially dreading three hour long lectures, but it wasn't too bad! Just be sure to stay on top of your writing assignments and you'll be a-okay.
Amazing professor! If you're interested in poetry this is a great place to start, highly recommend. The class is long but pretty fun, just be ready to participate.

Professor Cruz was very fun and eager to read our prose poems and flash fictions. crwt 045 is an easy breadth. you write 1 short story + reply to peers stories for hw and 1 short story in class every week and its graded on completion. final portfolio is 2 works + self reflection and it's easy to get all the points. i missed a few assignments but ended up with a 99% because i did extra credit. super easy and fun class!

This was one of the best courses I've ever taken here at UCR. If I wasn't a psychology major I'd retake this course all over again. I really hope to take some of her other creative writing courses. I took this class last quarter and I already miss it

She is the best professor I've had so far at UCR! She is SO sweet and caring to all her students and you can tell how passionate she is about this subject. shes very kind and all her assignments are easy.

Prof. Cruz is the biggest sweetheart ever! She cares about all her students and speaks to them in such a nice and understanding way. Reinvigorated my interest in writing in a classroom setting. SHE IS A SWEETHEART

Dr. Rachel Cruz is my most favorite professor ever because she is good at teaching and she is such a kind professor. Make sure to show up the class because most of the class is graded based on participation.

It may sometimes look like you can not keep up with everything she's assigning but as long as it is turned in on time you will pass. Essay prompts are hard to follow at times, but doable.

Not organized; run if you still have time. I've never had a hard time with any of my English classes, but I did for this one. She gives a lot of random assignments and, for the most part, won't grade them. She expects certain things but won't even mention them until she grades! She expects you to figure out everything on your own.

I feel like this class would be much better in person, but given the circumstances, I am happy to be free from it.

reviews.comment: Julie is EVERYTHING. This is honestly the best English class I've taken at UCR. She's such a fun teacher and I always looked forward to going to class because it was genuinely interesting. She really wants her students to learn! Just make sure to keep up with reading, put a lot of effort into your assignments/essays, and you'll be good to go!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Julie was genuinely one of my favorite teachers I've had here at UCR. She truly cares about her students and tries her best to make them succeed. Her class was really fun and I learned a lot about essay structure and organization. However, she does assign a lot of work, so be prepared to do reading assignments and have weekly quizzes.

Professor Cline was one of the best professors Ive had at UCR. Her organization is not that good, she often assigns assignments last minute and really causes as tress for the student, let alone time crunch. Other than that, I would definitely take her class again. I absolutely love her and her class was amazing. The class was so so so so much fun!

This professor is very caring and puts in the effort to help her students but is very time-intensive. She assigns lots and lots of busy work and a lot of readings to do. If your looking for a class to get an easy A you better RUN because you will have to put in the work. Put more time into this class than my other STEM courses combined.

Professor Cline was always available to help during office hours. Most professors refuse to read through your whole paper during office hours, but she will. The class was very organized and covered a lot of interesting material. She's amazing and I would definitely take her class again!
Really harsh grader, workload heavy. You'd be better off with another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is a very good English teacher! She will help you improve if you struggled with English in high school. If you go to her office hours often, you are very likely to get a good grade. I felt like just because I went to her office hours she gave me a better grade on all my essays. She has a lot of readings, but they are fairly simple. TIP: READ!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Caring and kind. She is a great professor and loves to interact with students.

Professor Cline is an easy grader, and if you work hard your grade will show it. She gives great feedback and if you go to her office hours she tells you what you need to work on. She gives pop quizzes but they're easy, and sometimes she allows you to work with a partner. Really great English professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Inspirational--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Julie is a really good English professor and learned so much from her class. She is definitely NOT an easy A; you must work extra hard for your grade in her class. Not because she is hard, but the topics themselves can be tricky to understand and most people do poorly. There are weekly pop quizzes so do your reading! Textbooks are a must.

Professor Cline is my favorite english teacher at UCR. She's great at teaching and giving feedback, interesting subject material and relevant. Two textbooks are required (not expensive if rented) and random quizzes weekly. Great class and fair grader. 4 essays throughout the quarter so there is work to do. Highly recommend Prof. Cline!
Super helpful and sweet! She really wants her students to succeed, 10/10

I think she is the best English 4 prof . She gives u lots of choices to earn point. Homework heavy but give u a higher score than other teacher , espectially essay 4 in class essay 190/200 wow!!!!!! Take it!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Craig think he tuff fr

Prof. Schroeder is a great professor. CS130 is meant to be a very difficult course, and it is. The average course grade was a B-. If you put in a lot of effort and have friends to study with, you'll be fine. I also recommend studying some of the content ahead of time. You can access his website and find the syllabus, slides, etc. You learn a ton.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The hardest thing about CS100 is the labs, which is outside Dr. Schroeder's domain. Dr. Schroeder is a great professor. He provides good insight with personal experience when it relates to course topics. He's very very knowledgeable! (I only put a 3 on difficulty only for his portion of the class; Labs included, I would rate the difficulty a 4-5)

Professor Craig gave very good feedback, but sometimes her explanations about certain elements of craft were a bit hard to grasp. She initially required us to print a lot and planned to have us read a book, but dropped those requirements. Not sure if they'll be included in future quarters. Providing feedback for other students can feel like a lot

Never have I met a professor more respectable, polite, well-spoken, honest, intelligent, beautiful, and approachable than Prof. Craig. She is easily one of the best professors at UCR, both in CHASS and CNAS. I highly recommend her, especially for a workshop. She is so insightful and knowledgable and will truly make you a better writer! She's a gem!

She is probably my favorite professor at UCR, and I've had many wonderful professors. Extremely intelligent, insightful, thoughtful, and engaging. She challenges her students and it is clear that she is invested in them and their growth. Take her course if you are genuinely interested in the craft of writing and want to improve as a writer.
Professor Craig is, without a doubt, the best Professor I have had in my undergraduate career.

It's plain criminal that she's been downrated; she is brilliant, beautiful, fair and kind. Participate with earnest effort and you'll not only do well in the class, but you'll be better for what you're sure to learn. Highly recommended.

Engaging professor, easy to approach. She always found a way to make a difficult concept easier to grasp, put easy concepts in a fresh new light. Work load is reasonable. I would take her class again in a heartbeat.

This professor really just likes teaching about bugs & I respect that. But the only problem is that he has an accent which makes it difficult to understand him at times. But overall just focus on the study guides for exams as most of the questions were from there. Would take again.
One of the last professors I ever had but definitely one of my favorite. Smart and super caring professor who just wants the students to learn and be as fascinated with bugs as he is!

I love this guy! He is very sweet and is happy to just be teaching. I am scared of bugs, so I was nervous to take this class, but overall, it turned out to be one of my favorite classes ever. There are quizzes every Friday that are required to be in class. The discussion was fun, and we were able to see many bugs in person.
Very amazing professor. For sure passionate about insects. Discussion was interesting. Great class, would take again

This teacher can't use technology correctly and the tests are graded so incorrectly with no slides ever being posted and the entire course being graded by 2 tests and 4 homeworks that he doesn't give any curve on even when half the class fails
absolutely not it. avoid if possible. lectures are so long, speaks to himself, can't hear him.

Honestly the professor isn't too bad, it's just hard to follow along in lectures at times because his slides aren't as organized as other profs. It's basically self-studying for the midterms and final but it's the same as the homework problem sets, so you'll be okay as long as you understand it! (Repeating it helps), TAs are also really helpful too
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Your grade depends on if you can teach yourself the material & hope you get a good TA. The lectures don't apply to the HW/tests at all, he's very hard to follow & dull. He is not very accessible because he is not tech savvy. 
1 midterm, 1 final & they are both the exact same as the problem sets. If you master the problem set HW, you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
HE FORGEOT TO CURVE US IN THE END OF THE QUARTER!!!
HE DOESN"T EVEN KNOW THE ANSWER AND HE JUST BLUFF EVERYTHING OFF< TERRIBLE 
DO NOT TAKE< TAKE DURING SUMMER INSTEAD<
He is a super picky professor. He grades super hard and does not teach well. I would not recommend taking him
Professor Mclauren's class is very easy if you do the homework
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: wonderful professor
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: lectures aren't exactly related to the exams but it's easy to do well on these exams if you do the hw. very accommodating professor overall and definitely wants the class to do well

TOOK FOR ECON102 NOT 103. Professor McLaren's class was intimidating at first. make use of the cheat sheet as he allows one for both the final and midterm. Although his lectures were confusing and at times a bit tedious, overall experience was amazing and averages on midterms/finals were high.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lecture did not match what was taught in the discussion and did not prepare us well for the assignments. The final was changed from online to in-person a week prior to the exam despite the syllabus. If it can be avoided do not take this professor.

Most unorganized course. TAs & prof have 0 communication. Beware of syllabus change mid-quarter (exams got moved to in-person). 3 hws, discussion, midterm, final. Lectures available on both canvas/irl but are useless. Midterm & final look exactly like the hw sets. Accidentally posted answer keys to things then accused students of cheating.

Professor McLaren is really kind. The class is lecture heavy and he tries his best to make them entertaining but the subject itself is kind of hard to do so. The homework assignments are harder than the exams but he goes over them thoroughly before the exams. He grades the homework by completion and effort which is really nice.

McLaren is alright, lectures are kind of boring but he does his best to make it funny. There are a couple homework assignments throughout the quarter, 2 midterms, and the final. Exams are not hard but pay attention to concepts rather than memorizing.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Mclaren is my favorite Econ professor. He is passionate and funny. I love his lectures. Not too much homework.

CORRECTION ON LAST POST-FINAL IS CUMULATIVE! 2 midterms non-cumuative. Take notes for weekly HW questions that  you'll reference it for the final. Took me a long time to do hw but paid off because I could go over all my notes. Found out at the end  D;  that there is a tutor in the ECON department so look into it if your struggling!

1 x week HW 19-26 questions. I needed the book to learn the HW. 2 Midterms 1 Final-NOT cumulative! First test failed but then had Cs. Curves tests. Study def.s on lecture and take notes when doing hw to reference for test. If you find the class hard its because its a hard class. Stats was about the same difficulty. Very nice gent so ask for help

I had McLaren a few times at UCR from lower to upper division classes. Lectures in the form of PowerPoints, which can be tough to follow. Makes cheesy jokes occasionally. Read over the slides and knowing how to do the homework is the best way to pass the class. It is easy to get a B , but hard to get an A. He is a very nice guy if you talk to him.

Super relaxed professor, gives corny jokes during lecture. Material's not that bad if you keep up with it; first midterm he gives is basically a collection of the homework up to that point, while the second one and final were tougher. Not that bad, if I tried harder I could've gotten an A. If you want easy credits take this guy.

If your passion and major is Econ skip this professor you won't learn anything. If you need this class for breadth credit TAKE THIS CLASS. Easy B+ class. Dont bother showing up to class; only show up if you really want to know about econ and get an A. Study the Hw questions, understand them (dont memorize entirely) and you'll pass.

He keeps lectures short and entertaining because he knows that economics is a difficult class to wrap your head around and is a fair grader that curves so overall, I really enjoyed my time in his class.

Lectures aren't very helpful unless you're familiar with the material beforehand. Text book is useless - he doesn't use it so it's not very helpful. Discussions are crucial if you're struggling but attendance isn't mandatory. Homeworks are online and you can submit multiple times for a good score. If you don't take the class seriously you'll fail.
Worst professor I've ever had. Super rude and super slow at responding to emails.

McLaren has a curve from the beginning which should REALLY help your grade at the end. Did not open the textbook once and just showed up to class I ended up with a B-. He has a calm demeanor so lectures seem a bit long.

McLaren is grandpa, that's just it. He gives you the material straight forward and throws in corny jokes left and right that are adorable.  The homework is extremely similar to the tests so as long as you do that you will be fine!

He posts what he calls "handouts" weekly online which is a condensed version of all the important stuff you need to know from the lectures. I rented the book but never opened it once. I rarely attended class. Tests are very similar to homework. He likes to make the test questions opposite of hw questions, so don't just memorize the answer.

This is the most easy going professor I have ever taken. 2 midterms, 6 online homework (multiple choice style) and a final. All categories are 25% of your grade. Tests are not based on his slides but on the homework. Don't buy the book. Know the opposite because he likes to twist the hw questions and put them on tests.
Vague lectures, doesn't really provide insight, lectures are unorganized, does not provoke thought. Would recommend to wait and take with another professor.

You can pass this class so easily without studying very much. But ironically, if want to get an A, you have to study really hard. It was not easy for me to see what to expect when I study for the test in this class. But I was able to see that professor's some effort to teach. If you want to get an A, beware because he uses 2 textbooks.
Class and two midterms were fairly  easy but the final was pretty tough.

A pretty decent prof. for a dry subject. He is somewhat boring, but he tries to make it fun with cheezy expressions and pictures. :) And he takes questions from the HW and a test bank and places them on his midterms. So google search questions on the HW, typically quizlet will help. And understand the opposites, increase or decrease etc. & UR fine.
McLaren is super cool. He ends his lectures early, uses homework questions for midterms and finals, and very approachable. One of the easiest Econ classes. He explains clearly  the material.

All the homework is online. Don't buy the book. I went into midterm days not knowing what to expect. I did not know what my grade really was in the class until week 9. Hated the class because he is super boring. His tests are okay.

Even though he just reads off his powerpoint, he does explain the material and tries to make things more interesting by using animations and sound effect. Like the effort, though. His tests are literally pulled from the homework and online, as well as the homework questions. If you try, you'll pass.

McLaren is a really nice guy, but his lectures and endless an long. He has 2 midterms that have questions from the homework, but the final was terrible. I didn't understand anything from the final at all. But he has a 10% grading curve. So f you get a an overall grade of a C, hell give you a B, which really helps a lot!

Homework is online tests with two tries to get the most points possible. Study the homework 'cause it's exactly what's on the exams. Uses videos and silly jokes to keep you awake because Econ is BOOORING.  I applaud his effort to try to liven it up.  Curve at the end will save U if U get behind but not by much. Put in the effort!

Funny guy. Very clear cut grading criteria, huge curve at the end of quarter. Does his best to make class interesting. Very conceptual, may need to do a lot of studying. Eager to help with any confusion. Overall a great into econ class.

This class was not structured at all. Homework is worth 40% of your grade (about 40 multiple choice questions per assignment), and the midterm and final are each worth 30%. His lectures are not very informative. If you read the book, you should get an A.

McClaren really has no structure at all to his class, which is what makes it rather difficult to get an A. You pretty much go into his exams not knowing what to expect, however, most of the HW questions do end up on there. The lectures are dry and could use more thorough explanation, the only major pro is that he has fat curves for grading.

Class was so boring. Discussion actually helped because the topics were explained a little more clearly. He puts reviews before the test which are pretty helpful. I went to lecture maybe 5 times the whole quarter and got D's on the test but still managed to get a B- in the class.

He is pretty useless. And he changed our homework percentage from 25% to 10% on week 9. He makes lecture confusing and can't answer his own questions. Even Siri doesn't understand him. Trust me, I know from experience. He changes the answers to everything. Book is not necessary cause it won't save you. He posts reviews in no relation to midterm.

Memorize the study guide questions, but also UNDERSTAND THE CONCEPTS BEHIND THEM. The curve is based the average final grade and go to lecture esp toward the end. There's clicker question extra credit. I don't think he was THAT easy. I didn't have to study for hours on end, but I did struggle a bit. I was close to A- so maybe that's why I'm bitter.
Nice guy, high curve but can be hard to follow in lecture sometimes.

3 midterms. First two are easy, just do the study guide and you're fine. Last one is a little hard, so actually pay attention and review rather than just relying on the sample. (The last midterm is not just memorizing answers from the sample.)
Pretty easy class if you study. No one goes to lecture. Kind of boring, but he's a really nice guy and usually ends class early.

Easy A, but he is a horrible lecturer. I stopped bothering going to his useless lectures. I just read the book.  I got an A+. He curves the total grades where the lowest B- gets set at median or 80% whichever is lower. He also offered a ridiculous extra credit this quarter. It was 5 questions from the book. And your total grade goes up 10% Nice guy
Great, but never answers emails...ever..
I love this prof. He is a really nice person.He gives curve to the exam. Also his mid term is pretty easier and similar to the homework!

Took this class during summer sesh. It was easy. I aimed for an A+, but the final was a little harder than the midterm. Do the hw, the reading, and pay attention in lecture; you'll ace it. Final grade is curved. His lectures are entertaining with videos every now and then. He is nice, makes dated and obscure jokes (which was cute). Take his class!
great teacher. entertaining lecture while also teaching the class. recommend teacher! study hw and put some effort and you'll do great. one of the best teachers i've had at ucr
i only went to class to check out the teacher. easy class if you study the homework
Hes so cute. Easy teacher and very understanding. Study your homework and you will do great.
Really nice and reasonable. Tries to make class interesting. Homework helps a lot. Best econ professor ever ... and i hate econ.

This professor has a grading scale of 40% homework, 30% midterm, and 30% final exam. I suggest studying the homework because the tests are super similar to the exams. Also, very nice teacher to get a long with. :)

This professor has a grading scale of 40% homework, 30% midterm, and 30% final exam. I suggest studying the homework because the tests are super similar to the exams. Also, very nice teacher to get a long with. :)

The homework is 50% of the class and dicussion is 20% of the class. Yeah.. so do those you get a guaranteed C. This professor is really reasonable if he sees that the class is failing then he will make the curve really ridiculously easy. During my class he said if you did the homework then you are guaranteed a B. EASY CLASS.

He's a fairly nice guy who's willing to help you out during office hours. Only thing that you need to watch out for is how awkward the grading structure is. Literally makes the final worth half your grade. Lowest quiz out of 4 is dropped. Literally kept getting 90s on everything with his nitpicky grading, and ended up with an A-, unfortunately.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Take Costello for MATH004! Attendance is not mandatory and he posts lecture slides on Canvas before class. You should go to discussion though because those points add up. He posts exams from previous years which is very similar to the actual exam. If you use the textbook and 'The Organic Chemistry Tutor' on YouTube, you'll do great.

Best math professor I have had at UCR so far. His lectures were easy to follow and he gives many examples. Since I attended every lecture, I did not have to study much outside of class. He gives you potential problems that will be on your quizzes so as long as you understand them, you should be fine.
Super good professor, didn't feel confident for this class but ended up walking out confident for the rest of my math classes, highly recommend him.

This review is actually for his EE 020A/MATH 045 class; there's no option on RMP for it. He's a very caring guy, and helps you out during office hours with whatever you need. If you properly study the lecture slides and do practice problems, you should be fine with this class. HIs grading scale is a bit weird, and the final is worth almost 50%!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: To do well in this class, make sure to review lecture examples and homework. Professor also provided previous exams to help you review. Understand these examples then you should be in good shape

To be honest, the people that complain about this guy and his tests probably just didn't put the effort to understand things. I'm not good at math rlly but he was pretty easy to understand and he is pretty lenient when it comes to grading. He was also a really nice and nerdy guy; lectures are a bit boring, but nothing bad about him at all.
Genuinely hated this class so much why was the final worth so much. Professor was rude when I went to office hours wouldn't ever recommend

Professor grades very harshly trust me. The median for midterm was a 40% and final was like a 50% most student did not do well on their exams. Including me they graded very harshly almost everyone in that class had a very difficult time. Not an easy one and never will take his class again. Midterm and Finals are both in person and proctored.
Best Math Professor, he post notes and posts old exams that correspond to the exams you will be taking. Funny guy and you'll see him with his cup of coffee during lecture or Office hours.

Costello's lectures were engaging and clear. He always has good answers to your questions so always ask, and his office hours are SO HELPFUL. He's honest about what's going to be on each exam and he releases super helpful practice exams before each one. Homework is very doable and there's always plenty of time to check it out and ask for help.

Lots of assignments, tests, and quizzes. Prof Costello is very nice and encouraging but he tends to make mistakes when lecturing and assigning homework which makes me wonder if his grading is accurate.

Very easy, simple math. He did a good job with providing lots of practice in the lecture slides, homework, pratice exams/problems, and discussions. You did have to buy this online course which you did the homework on, but that is the only purchase for the class. Overall good professor!
Math 004, Pretty much high school math, I suck at math that is why this class was hard but everyone else was doing pretty good. His study guides were really good.
He makes lots of mistakes here and there during his lectures, very hard to follow while doing notes. Final and Quiz are graded very hard.

So I took him for Math004 but it isn't listed yet. He explains somewhat poorly, slides are filled with useless words, and a surplus of typos. However his office hours were more helpful as he seems to explain better one on one. Homework is light and tests are pretty fair. Overall not a hard class, just lectures feel useless.
math004

Took it for math 004, but it wasn't listed. This class sucks. He didn't really teach. He also takes forever to grade and put stuff in. Also lied about the grading for the test. He said that he would give back points for trying but did not do that. Should've dropped when he said it was his first time teaching the class. Good luck.

Professor Costello is a pretty good, he is perfect for if you have never taken calculus before because his lectures go at a slower pace and are understandable. The midterm was not hard but the final was much more difficult, just make sure to do the homework every week and attend lectures.

Nice guy. He provides slides with lots of examples. Posts past exams/keys for practice. He wants you to pass. He tries to make it as easy as he can while making sure he doesn't carelessly pass someone who doesn't deserve it. Gave curve at the end. I just didn't like discussion, all the TAs conduct their quizzes differently.

Costello is really amazing and chill at lectures with being informative on how to do each calculus problems/concepts step by step. His office hours/emailing him were also very helpful as well if you have any individual qs. His exams and discussion quizzes are fair and manageable, not too easy nor too hard w/o  calculator. Would recommend taking him

Had him for MATH 007B. Good professor. His lectures were awesome, and the midterms were really fair and similar to the practice ones he provided. The final, however, was unreasonably hard and not similar at all. Overall though, a good professor. The class wasn't curved.

Really good professor. Doesn't ramble, doesn't teach unnecessary things, all his exams were very fair. He's not the most outgoing guy but hes an amazing professor and you will have amazing knowledge of Calc 1 by taking him. If you want to do good in a course and understand the material, he is a very rare professor who gives both.

This class focused on his area of research so he was clearly passionate. Took it in quarantine and I think he did a really good job dealing with that. He recorded and posted lectures regularly. Not too much hw, it was a bit challenging sometimes but prepared you for exams. Good at explaining complicated things. He's pretty funny and has a cat (:

I had Professor Costello for Math 007A. He lectures very well and teaches the concepts in a way that is easy to understand. You still have to do the homework and study for the quizzes but he formats the grading to where it's possible to get an A. The class consists of 2 midterms and final.

I have to say Probability is not an easy subject. U have to push urself hard on it. if u have something u dont understand, just go his Office hour, pretty useful. He's so kind and nice to everyone. exam related to HW, but HW is kind of hard though. Once u get it, u will be ace in this class

Your grade consists of hw, two midterms, and a final. He allows a cheat sheet for his exams, thus easy A. Honestly, just write down all the practice exam solutions and hws onto your cheat sheet and you're good.

He's a great lecturer, and gives you a lot of  really helpful materials to study for exams. Very helpful in office hours. As long as you try to go to lecture everyday and do your homeworks you'll be fine. Don't underestimate the difficulty of the exams, make sure to study all the materials provided thoroughly, it helps tremendously.

I took the honors program version of this course, but the material was the same, we just went into a little more depth. Good professor. Sometimes he'll go quick through the material but don't be afraid to raise your hand and ask for him to explain more. He wants students to understand it. Also, he can be pretty funny during lecture!

He's a pretty good professor. For this class there wasn't much of a "curve" to begin with, so you have to keep pace with the class and understand the material as you go along. His lectures are a bit dry, but they get to the point and make sense. His examples are real good and if you know them (alongside the HW!!), the exams should be not too bad.

He is a truly fair teacher. He wants his students to best and is willing to help you no matter what. He was always helpful when I went to office hours and would go slow and help me understand any concept I didnt get. He is great and posts solutions to all homeworks, reviews, midterms and finals after they are turned. Makes a great study tool!

Extremely helpful and fair professor. His tests are very similar to the practice ones he gives out. He doesn't trick you with crazy problems. He actually listens to the students and spends time to work with you if you need help on anything.

In class he is really scattered, doesn't do a good job teaching the material and is boring. Learned late in the quarter that office hours are the place to be. He obviously doesn't do well in front of big classes because he's a studdering mess but in office hours he's clear and does a great job explaining the material. GO TO OFFICE HOURS EVERY WEEK!

LOVED THIS PROFESSOR!! His practice midterms and finals reflect the real test. I always went to office hours, and he never made me feel stupid. He is EXTREMELY helpful. His lectures are kind of boring, but he explains the material really well. I recommend this professor!

Very helpful and very knowledgeable; lectures aren't necessarily crystal clear, but they are certainly ones that students can follow. The midterm and final come almost directly from the practice exam; he doesn't try to trick you. Ask him questions via email or talk after lecture, he will help you.
His final was super hard. There were so many hard problems. He did not prepare me well enough for the final.

He's a very nice teacher, but his class is kind of hard. I already learned all the information prior to starting this class. However, his way of teaching was difficult to understand. In this class, you have to study on your own. Also, you have to go to all your discussion classes to help you understand the material.
Gives lots of examples, have to pay attention and do recommended problems to do well.
Pretty alright professor
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There are two short papers, a four minute presentation, and a final paper. Contreras is a great lecturer and his work is super interesting. I genuinely enjoyed all three books we read in this class. Lecture could be awkward because other students didn't participate but I had great conversation with Contreras. 10/10 would take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In class presentation 5% that takes 2 minutes, 2 one page papers, and a final exam. Class is okay, teacher relys on students talking which can be awkward, but you can get through it.

Attendance is NOT mandatory but it helps a lot to go. I made the mistake of not going so my grade was a bit lower than I would have liked it to be. He doesn't post lectures online so if you go to the lectures and take notes it will be an easy A. Graded by little to nothing so make sure you go to discussions and lectures!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Contreras is one of my favorite so far, he manages to add a comedic touch throughout his lecture, making it easier to engage and interact in class. His lecture style conveys the passion he has on the topic and he encourages students to share how they relate to the material during discussions or through the reaction papers.

Dr. Contreras is friendly, but his class is unbearable. Lectures are unnecessarily long, filled with students who love to talk solely to hear the sound of their voices, contributing nothing. Without intervention, 60% of class time is wasted on yapping instead of actual course content.

Easy class. Skim over the weekly required readings before each lecture so the material is easier to understand. Show up to lecture even though attendance is small because he will give hints for the exam and also gave extra credit to those who showed up. Also, take write down what is on the pp slides. Not a lot of effort is needed for the A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: "Fair" is probably the best way to describe my experience. Nothing more; nothing less. You have weekly readings, a mid-term, and a final. The exam format is a timed-essay. You also have a paper, as well as a presentation on said-paper. Best advice is to take pictures of the slides, and take notes on what he says verbally (most important).
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

He is also a bit of a hypocrite saying he doesn't listen to Joe Rogan then using direct quotes from the podcast as if it's his own work on multiple occasions from what I've noticed.

3 essays total, one presentation about a paper, final is also an essay test. Weekly readings. Participation is required but he downgrades students who don't show up to class. Vague about what's on the exams. Take good notes about summary on weekly required, the final uses the weekly readings. A bit boring and repetitive material.

reviews.comment: Don't be hurt that students don't show up to class when attendance isn't mandatory.

reviews.comment: He was very vague about his essay exams which is why most people bombed the midterm. But do the readings and have solid understanding of them bc essays are like analysis of them. Discussion easy points, just go to them. Other than that easy A. Class was more like a discussion so saw on point in them, just do the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy A. Super long lecture, got somewhat boring but as long as you do the reading and pay attention in discussion section it's an easy A.

The class is on the TV show "The Wire" and you watch the first 2 seasons. His lectures are kinda boring but his life stories are really interesting! You write two 1.5 page reaction papers which you can do whenever you want as long as you "present" one in class. 1 final the last day of class and a 2000 word essay due after. Overall a great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Super easy class, he doesn't post the slides online but his lectures are interesting. The class is one midterm one finals and a two-page single spaces discussion essay and discussion attendance. Midterms and finals are two questions you choose one.

The class isn't hard. His lectures are kinda boring and he doesn't post them. But if you read from the book its straight forward. HIs midterm and final were the same, two questions are presented and you answer one. Although, his class was alright, he he's funny and loves to talk about his past lol

Honestly a pretty chill teacher. I like his story about his life and he really knows his stuff about crimonology. He's pretty funny and his class is not hard at all. 1 paper, a midterm, and final. Attendance isnt mandatory but keep in mind he doesnt post his lecture slides on BlackBoard. Highly reccommend, though!

Extremely approachable and kind. If you're struggling, just go to his office hours—he genuinely wants everyone to succeed. The tests are based entirely on his slides, so take good notes. Highly recommend him for anyone nervous about this subject!

You can tell he loves what he does. His energy makes even the boring topics interesting. He uses a lot of real-world examples that make the concepts stick. I actually looked forward to going to this class, which is saying a lot for an 8:00 PM

Honestly one of the best professors I've had. They make the material so easy to understand and are always willing to stay after class to help if you're confused. The grading is very fair—no surprises on the exams. As long as you show up and do the work, you'll do great.
Love this guy!
I loved his teaching style and he was very enthusiastic about the topics. Learned a lot!
Great teacher, MUCH better than the rest of the ME department at UCR.
Hes a great professor and he teaches like he wants to teach and not just teaching for the research money.
So much better than Sundar. If you have the opportunity to take a class with Professor Sinisa take it. He teaches well and is a fair grader!

He kept the class engaged during every lesson. Even though he did not allow technology, there was never a point in the class where I felt where I wanted to use my phone. His explanations and teaching style was also very good. He would explain each topic and then solve practice problems with the class.
Amazing Professor. Phones were not allowed in class, but he made sure that every lecture was engaging and fun. I learned so much from Professor Coh. I would love to take another class with him again.

One of the best lecturers at UCR. Reading quiz before every lecture, engaging teaching with audience discussions, and voting on problems. This was honestly the only lecture this quarter that I looked forward to and actually learned from. Midterms and Finals are tough - only exact numerical answers accepted (units matter), free responses tough!

Required reading prior to lecture w lectures focused on difficult & important topics. Lots of interaction with polling and discussion w peers. He grades harshly but clearly and will take the time to explain why you earned/lost points on exams. Super helpful in office hours! He's awesome - he even bought the class croissants to eat on finals day :D
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Coh was the best professor to take thermo with. He had mandatory readings and reading quizzes every lecture, but they helped reinforce material and in conjunction with his lectures which we held as more of a Q&A in my opinion, I learned thermo on a deeper level with Professor Coh.

Treated a graduate course like a high school class...
Good at teaching, but has "interesting moments". Harsh grader though.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Cares about students, be sure to do the assigned readings and you will be okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Really caring professor. Thermo was enjoyable with him

Class is overall not hard. Pretty easy reading quiz every lecture so reading and attendance is required. Midterms and final are straight forward if you use the resources he gives you and study what he tells you to study. He's very fair and you can tell he wants you to do well and understand the material.

The first half of the quarter consisted of short three question quizzes from the textbook. No pop quizzes. Syllabus says day He gives you a pdf version to it for the first couple quizzes so you still need to buy the textbook. The quizzes are meant to see if you read not to trick you The final is just a group project so choose your partners wisely.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Conceptual quizzes were based on assigned readings were given every lecture. They were about 3- 4 questions each and were worth 30% . Problem solving questions were given during discussion and were worth 10%. They quizzes were not difficult. Practice guides given for midterm/final reflected the actual midterm/final. Final class average was a 82%.

This class is just an S/NC class so it isn't too hard to begin with, but Dr. Coh explains the concepts well and it does give you a good glimpse into what Materials Science and Engineering is. The final is just a group project, so make sure you know who you're working with otherwise you might get stuck with shoddy partners.

Very fun professor, and very relaxed on grading. 4 essays, quizzes on online comic Drive once a week - 10 total (the comic is lowkey good). Time in class to write. Explains essay prompts thoroughly and funny. Very responsive and helpful, just have to ask.
GOAT! She is not a harsh grader, as her goal is to not make you stop writing. There are no reading quizzes, and the final exam was a mix of MCQs & FRQs. A study guide is provided beforehand.

This class was easy. we had 3 papers 1 of which was a group essay and the first essay was just an outline. we also have a group project but we were able to be creative with it. the class was enjoyable different from other english classes which was cool.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Not sure if it's because it was summer, but grading was pretty light and she was kind enough to let us revise one of our essays!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very awesome teacher who is very understandable about personal situations, and although she gives duicussions boards and quizzes the discussion questions are short answers and the quizzes are to help you to gain extra points to have a better grade. Her essays are also easy to understand and you can ask her for help if you need it.

She's not a bad professor, but not an awesome one either. We read one comic book but have 2 essays that's like a group project, and 2 by yourself. Based on the chapter of the book we read, we had weekly quizzes every friday. Her grading for the essays, it was hard to get an A.

Professor Knight is lenient and very understanding of her students' conditions! Her class is well-structured and very reasonable for an english class. She gives 4 essays, one of which is a group project. Focus on your essay structure and make sure your paragraphs are not too long. That's what she cares about most.

Very passionate and fun professor. She will really help you with becoming a better writer and she chooses fun prompts/topics. The reading she gave us was super light and made the final super easy. Papers are time consuming, but that's probably the case with all English classes. Overall would take it again.

He grading is weird, I have no idea what she wants. She seemed not patient at all when I went to her office hour. And office hour does not help. She is vague in giving comments/annotations in grading essays.

Professor Knight was honestly great this quarter. Her essay topics were really interesting. The only annoying thing is that she didn't have a lot of great evaluations on essays. For one of my essays, she said that I had slight grammar issues and yet gave me a B-.

I was a little scared reading the reviews for Dr. Knight here, but having just finished up her class, I would like to say that I genuinely enjoyed having her. She was nice, respectable. Just some cute old Lil lady. I probably failed though cause I'm an idiot and didn't do an essay, but it was an interesting class, and a pleasure to be her student.

There are 4 essays in this class, 2 presentations, quizzes through Kahoot! or Google Forms. You have to go to the BUS100w workshops to get a grade for this class. I spent most of my time this quarter on BUS100w. It was very draining and tiring but ended up with a solid A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Knight is actually one of the easier professors at UCR while the W part of 100w adds a lot more weird things such as workshops which is not up to her the class is very simple. CLear Garding scales and not hard to pass. The only tough part was the TAs because they are the ones that grade the essays. office hours with Dr. knight's help.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures--So many papers

reviews.comment: A very hard class. She's a complete full of it. I don't like her and nor many people because her class is hard. Her lectures are interesting tho but the essays are just hard. She makes everyone attend workshop. It's tough. I don't like the class nor I would ever take this class again. Packback is a waste of money!!!!!

She is super nice and passionate about the subject; however, she grades the papers extremely hard. The books are not necessary! There are ten pop quizzes throughout the quarter, so thats pretty much attendance. Make sure you go to your TA's office hours. Midterm is easy and based on definitions and lectures. Final is a paper based on an article.

girl... what was that. Just took 100W and let me tell you... confusion. I felt like I was taking two separate classes. Her lectures are disconnected from the papers you write. Worked more with the TA and workshops than I did with her, which rumor has is impossible (never responds to emails). I went to my TAs office hours all the time to earn my A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Knight engages students in the lectures. There are four assignments to complete. Also, the class teaches formal writing skills. The quizzes and midterm are straightforward. You cannot ditch discussion classes and workshops. Also, attend office hours for the TA. Do not stress over the oral presentations. There is no need to purchase books.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Took this professor for english and she is a good teacher but not a good grader or good communicator outside class. She takes too long to reply and is unfair when grading. She is confusing because she asks for certain things in the essays and when it is presented to her she grades badly and claims it is not enough. She plays favorites so beware
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Don't take her class. She does not care about the student's success. Even you put enough effort in, she seems not to see it.

She was great but absolutely impossible to contact outside of class. Reads emails but refuses to respond to them and then brings it up when she sees you in class once its already too late. Made things much more difficult than it needed to be.

Corinne gives too much work all for one class. On top of pop quizzes, extensive essays, and OUTSIDE class workshops, the costs for this class were way too much. This class forces you to pay for PackBack which wasn't necessary at all. However, she is great at presenting and is pretty funny during lectures. Other than that, this class ain't it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Not a tough class, but you have to work. Grading criteria is nonexistent, assignments are very subjective but objectively graded. Kind of silly, but make sure you get a good TA, each one grades differently. Lectures are pointless, with the expection of tiny details you are expected to remember for quizes and the midterm. Textbooks are a waste of $.

Be ready to do the absolute most and still not get a good grade. I dedicated about 20 hours a week to this class and despite me being a strong writer, constantly meeting with my TA, and having tutors with English phd's read and revise my essays, I still couldn't get an A. Your grade is very dependent on your TA. There is no clear grading criteria.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Really a poor professor. Lectures are useless, only show up for the pop quizzes. Assigns multiple major papers, never lectures on how to write these papers or what exactly she wants. Gives no guidelines, then proceeds to grade the papers very difficulty. In summary, terrible professor who should be replaced. Really a terrible experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is one of the worst professors I have ever taken. Hands out essays and does not explain how to actually do them. NO CLEAR GRADING RUBRIC. Enjoys making her students suffer.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is a very tough grader. I went to her office hours all the time to get some help and told me I improved my writing throughout. She still gave me the same grade. I got C's in all my essays. The final was even worse. She does not seem to care about the success of students at all.

Course was just extremely tedious; great amount of assignments worth little credit. Poor TA's really did not help. Lack of clear instructions, & nitpicked at every opportunity. - Very tough grader. - Doesn't seem to care about the success of the students. - Wants everything completely perfect. - Stay away from this class

reviews.comment: She's the best! Assigned approximately 5 essays and gives you a clear prompt. She lets you express your creativity in your work. St. Martin's Guide was used throughout the quarter, try to find online for free.

Professor Knight has enthusiasm for the subject but her TAs grade pretty hard. Theres an essay every 2 weeks. BUY THE ECONOMIST SUBSCRIPTION IN WEEK ONE. Overall, you wouldn't need to go to lecture if it wasn't for the pop quizzes, but material is pretty straight forward.

One of the hardest classes I've taken so far. The papers are graded by TAs who are TOUGH graders. The fourth essay is irrelevant and unnecessary.
