Weisbart usually just over explains a lot of topics. He's very lenient on due dates for homework. He's very caring and your success is his #1 priority, ask him and he'll help even if it means no sleep for him.

He make literally every topic more complicated than it should be. For a large portion of the class, the homework (both written and online) didn't even match what he was lecturing on. His lectures are lengthy and not a lot gets done, but if you miss them, you will do poorly. That being said, he is very genuine and kind and tries very hard for a pass

The most genuine, caring professor I have ever met.  He really wants to see you succeed in all the things you pursue.  He doesn't teach BS shortcuts that prohibit your ability to wholeheartedly UNDERSTAND the concepts.  Take him if you want to learn.  "Highschool teaches you how to be a mechanic.  College teaches you how to be an engineer."-Davie

David was a great teacher.  His lectures have a lot of information but the concepts are straightforward. Take advantage of his online office hours to reinforce the concepts you learn and just try your best. My favorite part about his class was that we were able to apply pre calculus concepts to solve Calculus/Physics type problems.

Professor Weisbart's lectures are very heavy with information, so you should come to class if you want to pass. He uses ALEKS instead of a textbook which might seem like you will save money, but you have to pay for the prescription.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: The material that you learn can be easy at times but he manages to overcomplicate things. He makes 1 step problems into 5 step problems. His lectures are okay but can be hard to follow sometimes. Other than that, he is a great and caring guy and is willing to help students. Very approachable

The concepts are really simple, however, he explains how to get the formulas and the meanings behind formulas, which is very confusing. Shows many excess steps, but he is a very cool professor & very funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He has a lot of extra credit opportunities, make sure to do them. He goes on tangents in class, but other than that his lectures are okay. He tends to show his work in many steps, though it can be done in one. His practice tests help a lot! Weisbart is willing to help students outside of class so definitely take advantage of his office hours.

It's an easy but you still have to put effort. The practice midterm and final is similar to the actual exam, so make sure to study those. His not very organize and he's hard to reach. When you email him, he doesn't reply, so don't expect an email back. It's better if you go to his office hours. Quiz in discussion every week. Requires a book.

While lecture isn't mandatory he does occasionally do pop quizzes in lecture or will randomly take roll. He's a nice guy and a pretty cool professor but he tends to start rambling about something unrelated. Make sure to go to his office hours though! He also does Online quizzes in discussion (or  additional lecture) every week as well as homework.

I took this class back in fall quarter when he was still a new teacher. He was still adapting so the class were the guinea pigs for tests, homework, etc. He is a great professor that wants students to learn but he makes everything confusing. Also had A LOT of homework from Aleks but he probably changed it bc it was too much to handle.

Professor Weisbart is a great person, but can be super confusing. Considering this was 8A, easy material, he would take a problem I thought I understood and turn it into something completely different. Also LOVES to talk about himself. And handwriting is nearly intelligible at times. His study guides are almost EXACTLY what's on the test though.

Assigns weekly homework from the textbook, you must complete 8/10 homework assignments or else you fail the course. The weekly discussion quizzes, only 1/2 problems. He is welcoming & funny, attend office hours for extra help.  Practice exams are identical to tests. His lectures can be confusing. He is a great teacher and wants you to succeed!

Weisbart is probably one of the nicest professors I've had. He truly cares about what you learn and take from his class rather than the grade you get. Chances are, if you go to his office hours, you'll pass the class simply because he's always so helpful and willing to put time into ensuring you know the material thoroughly.
super nice guy test are really easy one of my favorite professors does make stuff a little confusing. also practice test are almost identical to the actual test.

His lectures at the beginning were a bit confusing but as long as you go to class you'll be fine. He gives practice exams before the midterm and the final and they help a great deal. He likes answering questions in class so don't hesitate to ask. He claims he gives out pop quizzes often but expect very few.

He's a great person but his lecture make no sense. He makes a simple problem uneccessarily complicated and ends up confusing the whole class. He is hard to follow sometimes and his handwriting is really difficult to read. Definitely would not recommend to anyone who isn't already familiar with the material.

Dave is a great guy. Yet, he still lecture to us like we're UCLA kids that already understand the material. I don't think he realizes that more than 75% of the class is not paying attention because it is darn near impossible to follow him. He makes a simple problem that should take 2 minutes into one that take 30. He's way too used to Calculus kids
He teaches how to understand ideas, not just how to memorize steps to solve a problem.

Amazing curve saved my grade

Do homework. Attend class, pollevs count

Final is non cumulative,.

I got 70-90 pts on my midterms and got an A, don't stress too much.

Great professor. Very caring and knowledgeable. Lectures are not great but the slides and HW are more than enough to do well on the exams. Material was interesting, and I wish it had gone into more depth. Only thing I didn't like was that the polls were graded on correctness. But just do the HW and you'll be fine.

Debus isnt the best lecturer, but his slides are thorough and good for studying. he is very straightforward of what you need to know. had him this quarter for 163 and 184 and he is very fair. overall good experience, kind professor, fairly easy class.

Dr. Debus is extremely caring and compassionate towards his students. he will go far out of his way to accommodate students and make sure they have a good experience. But, he is not the best lecturer. he tends to ramble and jump around topics. it is clear he is extremely smart and knowledgable but he lectures at a very high level

Professor Debus is not a great lecturer to say the least. However, it's clear he knows what he teaches and seems to care a great deal about his students understanding the material. His exams are straightforward and directly from lectures. Very generous grade adjustments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class isn't too bad, but I also understand it can be tough. The lectures are kind of boring, but I still recommend going bc he does poll questions. Concepts he emphasizes during lecture will usually show up on exams like 1 or 2 questions (exams are short). Also do the homework and study that and you should be good.

If you're picking between teachers, I wouldn't steer clear of this guy. He is a good teacher. His tests are hard and his lectures are a waste of time but if you go to his office hours they can be a lot of help if youre actually studying. You can tell he does care about what he teaches but you need to go talk to him to learn anything from him.
Class isn't hard as long as you do the practice problems and review lecture slides. That is ket to getting a good grade in the class. Professor is great. Super fair tests, nice guy. 10/10

He's a good guy and clearly loves what he teaches. He's just not that great at teaching though. His lecture slides are just a bunch of formulas and how to derive them. He reads directly off the slides and is the last to enter the classroom and the first to leave. Homework will save your grade because there's nothing else to go off of.
Wish he would do something other than read off the power points.

This is the review for the wetlab portion of BCH101. Be warned it is not easy. The TAs are tough and the professor is barely helpful. For final study: equipment( know how to draw and label), why something was used instead of another, REREAD EACH MANUAL BEFORE THE TEST!

One of the worst professors I had. He is unclear in lectures, derives the equations the whole time. You pretty much have to teach yourself. The book is also horrible. Curve is decent, but you really do have to earn your grade you want.

It's very hard for me to follow along in class. I prefer having math being written out and explaind slowly. But here, lectures are through powerpoints that are sped through quickly. Have to study notes and book after class a lot!

the teacher is really nice. If you understand the homework you will do fine in the class. Though his lectures are really boring and he mostly just reads off of powerpoint he really wants everyone to do well.

Very intelligent and enthusiastic. However, lectures are so obscure because he always rambles around. Still, you will do fine. Pay attention, read some posted articles, go over study questions and talk to him. Free-response exams. No multiple-choice or fill-in-the-blank.
hey is a good professor, there is alot of notes to take in teh class, but the test are exactly like the HW, so do the hw cuz it is collected
Should be a chilling class. It's true that lectures and discussions. NO conceptual questions on the tests, just simple calculations. Do HW's and that it. BTW, Professor is approachable.

HE TALKS FAST!!! He is a nice guy, friendly. And comes around every once in a while during lab to check... However as with any other lab class: it is ran by the TAs... DO GOOD ON YOUR LABS, average on midterms are low... so if you can keep the A average on your exams and like a C on exams you are golden.

I LOVE this professor. His lectures are boring and is unneccessary. Doing HW problems is key to passing the class w/a GOOD grade (so an A).  No need to do anything else besides the HW problems. Don't even read the book. Prof. is very nice and approachable and does your hw for you at Office hrs!
I took him for both pchem 109 and bch 102, he is a great professor, with great knowledge of the material. A splendid teacher to learn from.
Good class, you should take it

Dehesh is a great lecturer!! Warning though, any little detail on any lecture slide is fair game on the exams. Just study the slides, you'll be fine. She's all about POWER and is very enthusiastic when teaching. If you don't enjoy Dehesh in the first half of the class, just wait for MG in the second half. You'd wish Dehesh taught the whole class.

The lectures did not reflect what would be on the midterm. Her midterm is worded really weirdly and people passed but the concepts she covered were not on the midterm. She won't tell you what type of questions will be on the midterm either. There aren't much assignments that are graded so if you fail the midterm you fail the class.
Professor Dehesh was so incredibly difficult, do NOT take her!!! The exams did not reflect what was covered in lecture and lied to students about what was going to be on the midterm.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Only had her for half the quarter but her half was incredibly easier than the other half. Prof definitely cared about the topics but the lectures don't reflect the midterms or final very well. Avoid if possible, and if you can't, start praying.

She is a good professor who cares, but her lectures dont reflect the midterm. Some q's on the midterm werent even covered and were a part of the upcoming chapter. Avoid her if you can!!! IF not, get ready to read ALOT

She always kept her students entertained during her lectures. The average for the first midterm was around 50% so be aware. Her questions on the midterm aren't too impossible, but make sure you pay attention to her lecture questions as one appeared on the midterm. She wants all her students to pass but her tests are difficult, not impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: super sweet but midterm was tough avg was below 50%. read chapters covered in lecture + take good notes and then pull up to lecture you will understand it 5x better. get all discussion points possible. if ur stuck then go to office hours, your ta, arc, of if youre reading this the day before an exam youtube is your savior good luck xoxo

She is a great professor however her tests are difficult. Her lectures make sense however I feel that in the test it is difficult to understand. She is definitely very knowledgeable and uses fun words like power to keep everyone entertained.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dehesh taught the first half of BIOL5A, her questions make up most of the first midterm and a quarter of the final. Her teaching style is engaging and I wish she would've taught the whole course. When Martins-Greene took over, the class became more challenging, and how she explained the content was more confusing than Dehesh's.

Professor Dehesh was an excellent professor, and she really pushed in making the students involved with the lectures. Be it from the funny jokes she told to getting to know the students individual names when questions were asked, she was able to relate and gain a familial respect from her students, also making the concepts understandable.
Had her for the first half of Biology5A. Dehesh wants to feel your power. She is an amazing lecturer and makes the audience have a lot of energy. Her exam questions are easy and straightforward.

Dehesh is an incredible and caring professor, but I just want to put this out there: don't expect her to remember you or care about your professional endeavors no matter how often you went to her office hours lol. 
If you want a fun easy professor this is who you're looking for, but she's far too busy if you're looking to build a close connection

Professor Dehesh was my favorite. She is so passionate about teaching and i actually understand what she teaches. The class is not that difficult if you study. She makes class fun. Attendance is not mandatory and she does post recording of the class online.
She loves POWER and makes Biology fun, but I will say textbook is necessary for the midterms to be passed.

Great teacher. Teaching style involves lectures. Lectures are very informative as professor has outside the classroom work experience, in the industry.

Compassionate educator, group projects are interesting, and I would definitely take this class again. She should teach this class, all the 3 quarter at UCR.

I waited 3 quarters to take her class- it was worth it. 
Prof. Swati is really interested in teaching. She should teach all 3 quarters. Lectures -good. Power Point can be lengthy. Tests- easy. Group Projects are interesting. 
She always responds to emails & answers your questions. She should stick to schedule/syllabus.
Prof. is quite approachable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
I am taking this class currently and this is one of the best class on UCR campus. Prof. Swati is actually interested in teaching! Very knowledgeable & informative lectures. She responds to your emails & is always answers your questions.
She assigns lot of reading but Group projects good experience-can give more weightage to Projects in Final Grade?
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment:
There are group projects in this class and those are graded. Be ready to work on those. Tests and Mid terms are easy, Prof. is accessible and willing to communicate. She is really interested in teaching. Her classes are lecture heavy but she posts her Power Points on class website.
I would take her class again as it's quite informative class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Swati Desai is an honest professor. Sometimes lectures can be boring. Easy Tests & Exams. Group project is fun & easy. I would take her class again, as she has good Power Points. Reading material is up to date & she has time to answer your questions. One of the best professors at UCR. I waited for 3 quarters to get  her class. I got an A.

Interesting class. Professor Swati Desai is really interested in teaching. She is knowledgeable. Shares all information and update on Real Estate in class. Great teacher .....replies to your emails...Lectures can sometimes be too long but you get a good grade... easy to get an A.

Professor Desai is very flexible with how she does things. Everything goes with the flow. Lectures can be very dry and she always goes over time. Homeworks involve a 1-page review of an article related to real estate. The tests require some simple math and are pretty straightforward. Not very tech savvy but she makes it work. Not a bad choice IMO.

Good professor who is  interested in teaching. Kind-hearted professor.... Groups projects should let you choose team members- random assignments of groups is difficult. This professor shares lot of information. Sometimes, can get monotonous....but you get to learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
Great professor, great teacher. Shares industry ideas with the class. Interested in her work. By far, one of the best class I have taken at UCR.
I would recommend this class to students who need electives. She should teach this class in Fall Quarter too. I had to wait for 2 quarters to take her class...
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are interesting. She needs to manage her time-well. Last quarter, I took her class and she would always keep teaching even after the time was over. Other than that she is a good professor. I wish she can teach more than 1 quarter at UCR. There is always a long wait-list for her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Desai is one of the best Professors at UCR for undergraduate classes. Her class is lecture heavy but her slides are good. An easy class, lot of reading. But, she makes the class interesting and she always answers her emails. She is pleasant to talk to. The class has group projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Desai is a good teacher and always willing to share ideas. She even posted job opportunity that she received from the Real Estate company in her contacts. Her classes are very informative and her lectures are packed with information. Sometimes, her lectures can be past class time and she can alter the syllabus but she is a good teacher.

I took this class last year. Very good class, interesting. I am pursuing a career in Real Estate because of the inspiration from the professor. Professor Desai is a good person and cares to teach. Very informative. Easy to get an A.
The professor has very good Power-Points. Easy Tests and Quizzes. She is interested in teaching. Lot of information about the Real Estate Industry.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honest Professor. Lots of ideas and information. Experienced in Real Estate, Took this class in Winter 2021. My friend took the class in Spring 2019 and got the best recommendation. Good teacher.
Knowledgeable Professor, cares for students. She has inspired me to pursue a career in Real Estate. Shares Real Estate experience in the class. One of the best professor in UCR.

I didn't want to take this class at first, but I ended up enjoying it. Slides were a lot, BUT most of it was repetitive information. Stick to the "questions to consider" for that week, and you will be fine. I took this class, along with three other major science classes, and this was my easiest one.
Avoid her at all costs.

Tests are straightforward and all material pulled from lectures. Easy class but hundreds of slides tested. Very petty in lecture attendance and puts info from lectures on exams as extra credit. Thinks her class is the most important as she expects you to review supplemental materials she doesn't even lecture on. Every lecture directly from textbook

Prof. Mitchell is kind and understanding. She addresses the concerns and needs of all her students. At the same time she presents course material in a useful manner and planned a trip to UCR gardens with all the students. The tests are very predictable and no surprises. You can easily tell that she loves teaching and enjoys helping everyone.

I loved Professor Mitchell's class! She takes the time to get to know you. The class is very dense with information by nature, because it covers all of plant bio in depth over a short period of time.
Professor Mitchell makes the lectures and material understandable. However, if you're a senior looking for an easy A, this class isn't it.
I don't believe anyone in my class ever got full points on essays. He's a tough grader and sometimes rude, but overall he is an ok professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Fair grader.

I honestly don't know how he has so many good/decent reviews. He picks on students for no reason. His class layout is also very confusing and unorganized. He truly makes you feel as if you're unimportant and doesn't teach you how to do his work. Overall a very bad professor..
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: A very insecure individual who uses profanity and calls out students in order to intimidate them. A very hostile class, this is my last quarter as a NEURO major and I have never had professor that belittles students. Should be condemned to teaching high school. Very immature and an insecure individual in order to be picking on students.

I was nervous to take his class after reading such negative reviews about him on here. I hated his class when I was in it. He gave more work than my friends in the same course(with diff prof.). But now being in English 001A, I'm prepared. He was really helpful in what was to come next and actually really kind. It is difficult, but I do recommend.
rude professor, not professional

In all honesty, one of the most difficult courses I have taken in my entire student life. The essays are graded extremely harshly, and although sufficient feedback is given, the class truly is the definition of a C+ class. If you are to have him as a professor, my condolences. I pray for your mental well-being and good health.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Hackleton was a funny guy but he is a very tough (putting it lightly) grader. There are only 4 essays but with it being combined with extremely tough grading it makes up a huge part of your grade that makes it rough to get a good grade. He helps a lot if you communicate and talk with him a lot though. Not an easy pass in the slightest.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He isn't as bad as the reviews make him to be. You obviously have to write a couple essays and he does grade them harshly, but he gives a clear rubric and goes over the requirements he wants in lecture. There are a few readings, but it's honestly not that bad at all for an English class. He can be rude and difficult to talk to though.
Honestly was conflicted to take this course because of the ratings, however he was a good teacher. Just do your work and you wont fall behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: As long as you don't take him, you'll pass the class

English 004 was ironically a really difficult first class. He was super negative and generally rude to most students. Also, it is nearly impossible to get an A on an essay, but does let you rewrite the first two papers for a better grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Hackelton wasn't as bad as I thought. He will pick on you in class discussions if you don't show up to class. Its hard to get an A on an essay. They are reading quizzes. He allows you to rewrite the first two essays to get a better grade.
Stay away from him or drop his class, otherwise you will only be able to give him some negative feedbacks before the end of the semester. Whoever chose his summer section of English 1b, good luck!

Whoever took his class wanted to leave some negative comments for him on the ieval. If some of them did not, it just because most of students don't want to waste a minute of their time for him anymore.
Incompetence professors who only intimidate students. Take care if you are not native speaker. Doubtful how he became a professor. He treats students pretty rudely.

He is not approachable. He is a tough grader. He gives critiques, but even if you fulfill them he will find something else to mark you down for. I think it's odd to grade students on their writing style simply because you don't like it yourself. Definitely not recommend.

He grades very hard, but his office hour reviews are very useful. He offers revisions for the first two essays, but not the third. The grading scale is very specific, no round ups. The essay were all 100 points and the final is 40 points. GO TO OFFICE HOURS.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I had him for English 4 and he was a tough grader and at first it's hard to understand what he wants you to do. But go to office hours and have him revise your work because he will not revise your rough draft only your final.

Hackelton was a good teacher because he was open and easy to communicate with. He does follow the textbook very closely and essay prompts are slightly hard. He also does grades pretty tough. He helps brainstorm with everyone in the class and makes jokes sometimes. Great educator, would take it again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hesitant to take this class because of other reviews; glad I ignored them. The only reason I didn't get an A was my own fault. Read the material. Go to OFFICE HOURS and bounce your ideas off of him. Proofread! Pay attention in class, he sparks ideas for essays. No curve. If prompt is confusing, go to office hours. put your pride aside and ask him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I personally enjoyed having Professor Hackelton for my Spring 2022 quarter. He was always making jokes and allowed us to participate during class time which I enjoyed. Homework points are very easy to get. It is honestly easy to obtain a C+ and/or B- average on essay scores only if you go to his office hours! Super important. Definitely take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: One of my least fav classes. The WORST essay prompts i've ever seen, I'm a strong writer, but his prompts made no sense. When I tried to participate in class I got shut down for not directly quoting, and I never went again. It was condescending and irritating. You can 100% definitely pass, but it's not a great experience.
Super hard grader.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Hackelton is not an easy teacher to deal with to say the least. He is unclear about his expectations and his feedback wasn't helpful either. I was only able to obtain a good grade in his class because of my own initiative. If he is your only option, I would suggest looking into taking another class that fulfills the ENGL1C requirement.

Class basically teaches you how to write different types of essays. Its challenging, however, it takes you out of your comfort zone. If you are having trouble, ask for help. If youre afraid to ask for help at his office hours, go to the ARC! Thats how I passed. Make sure to read syllabus due dates and do the assigned reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was BY FAR my worst experience taking a class at UCR, in fact my only negative experience in any class at UCR. By having taken Organic Chemistry to Upper-Div Math, this class (an ENGLISH class) was very unreasonable, and destroyed my GPA. People told me not to take him, I read his somewhat ok reviews, and it was my biggest regret. STAY AWAYYYY
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hackleton's English 004 is very hard. He is a tough grader. Everything that doesn't satisfy his well will be below C. PS. I didn't pass a single essay in his class. However, he is a very helpful teacher when it comes to essay structure and grammar issues. If you like challenges, you can try out this demon class. Pease :)

This guy grades so harshly it's unbelievable. He has nine kids, so if you want to go to his office hour, get there early. I waited outside his office for an hour just to make sure I was first, because my roommate got to his office hour 20 minutes after it started and he never got to her. Office hour is useless, doesn't tell you how to fix essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He's a really nice and funny teacher, but he grades too harshly. His grading is divided evenly into two categories: grammar and content. Your essay can be really good and show your understanding, but you might still end up with a low score on the paper because he'll mark things HE considered wrong like word choices. Go to his office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Hes cool and has really weird humor. Really easy to get a B in his class if you semi-try and an A is definitely achievable. Definitely be prepared for the pop quizzes and participate a lot in the beginning of the quarter while its still easy so he'll like you enough to grade easier on you later when it counts

Hackelton was a very good professor who made students think outside the box.  Go to office hours, but make sure you know what you want him to check or answer. A lot of essays and assignments are based on the readings/textbooks so make sure to have that. The quizzes challenged your memory and thoughts on what you read, so make sure to read!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He's a tough but amazing professor.  Make sure to go to classes bc he does give (pop) reading quizzes at the BEGINNING of class.  5 papers total: 1 in class, 3 assigned as homework & 1 take home final.  If you're struggling with papers, GO TO OFFICE HOURS.  He's extremely helpful & will tell you all the flaws you have so you can fix it & get an A!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He is a great professor who is willing to work with you to help you improve your writing. He's homework are not hard, but reading is required for the essays, homework, and final. If you are willing to put the effort you won't have any trouble.

Good teacher. I have nothing bad to say about him. To be honest I never was a huge fan of his readings but he's really helped me on my essay writing a lot. The prompts were actually pretty interesting. I never went to office hours but I got an A in his class and on his essays. I'd definitely recommend him.

It was my 1st time experiencing a teacher that grades very critically on essays. He marks even the smallest grammar errors and anything that sounds incorrect in HIS mind. If you want a teacher that is easy, he is definitely not on the list. However, he is a teacher that can ACTUALLY teach English and prepares his students to write essays very well.

As long as you show up to class, you are guaranteed at least a passing grade.  The in-class discussions really help guide you towards what he is looking for.  I really recommend going to his office hours; I went to his office hours for each paper and managed to get AA- on each one. He tries to be funny but he is overall very chill!
Chill Class, lots of discussion, good taste in books...  Do your work, follow his rules and he and you will both be happy.
The guy is as chill as the other side of the pillow. Im talking ice cold freezer burn chill. take his class.

He was a pretty difficult grader, but was extremely helpful in telling you what he wanted to see in your essays.  He had a lot of in-class discussion about the books, which helped a lot in finding things to write about in your essays.  Overall, a really good professor.
Great professor and is extremely fair and honest in his grading. Keeping up with the reading is essential to understand what's going on in class. His papers are pretty tough.

Prof. Hackelton was very helpful and his class was very interesting.  His grading is a bit challenging, but as long as you put SOME effort into working on the essays, a C grade or a B grade is possible.

The professor tells you exactly what he expects. He is challenging. While it's not necessarily mandatory to attend class, missing a class can be extremely detrimental as he will discuss simply the "to do" or "not to do" for assignments.
Pretty good professor. he grades fairly. Attending class is mandatory!!!!! so go!

He's a very great professor. He knows how to write and is qualified for teaching, also he's a very funny guy. However, he grades the crap out of your essays and because of that, you might struggle with his class. Make sure to follow what he says and you should get through his class fine.

Great teacher, office hours are really helpful. He still has pop quizzes, which arent hard at all, just read. I got an A in the class and that was with going to office hours. He's great, funny and a tad odd. I love his new haircut! No more mullet. HAha

Class is helpful and clear, he describes exactly what he expects from you. DO THE READING! and attendence is important, he has "pop" reading quizzes. Class is straight forward and easy, and the final is usually optional. Great teacher, take him!

Great Professor, Does not grade as hard as others claim he does. Attendance is important as well as reading but the curriculum is interesting and he makes the class fun. Would definitely take his class again!

Really easy class.  Make sure you go, miss one class and your grade drops!  He kept the class interesting.  Not a lot of notes, I took two pages the entire quarter.  I thought his grading was easy, but he did grade harder each essay.  Would definitely take him again.

One of the comments I read is very true of this professor.  He thinks he is much smarter than he actually is unfortunately.  I don't like the way he generalizes his students i.e. all college students are the same and all do the exact same things.  Also goes off topic and talks about things that have nothing to do with what we are learning about.

No complaints here. Hackelton is a pretty cool teacher. He keeps us interested in the topics and cracks a few jokes to lighten the class spirit. His quizzes are simple and straight to be point. I think he is an easy grader. You should enjoy his class.
He thinks he is smarter than he is.  Funny, but a hard grader...
I learned nothing although it was easy, for the essays i actually went back to notes from an old prof

Dude the mullet..........thats almost all i have to say.....oh and that the class is super enjoyable and he is bit of a hrd grader but if you do the work you should be fine. Missing assignments will KILL you//////i would take him again.
relatively easy class AND he rocks the mullet!!
he is a hard grader on essays. but his class is somewhat inetrersting.
Good teacher..hard grader..nice guy
This guy is just too freakin' cool.  He's funny, personable, and doesn't demand too much from you.  He's a great teacher and makes the class enjoyable.
This guy is tight! He sports a mullet and teaches and grades well.
He is very funny and is way chill.  He might be strange at first b/c of his mullet, but he is smart and helpful.
he's a cool professor. he rocks a mullet and looks like he just stepped out of the 1980's. his class is easy and he is a nice guy. he is an easy B, hard A.

He's ok i guess. He's got some spunkiness sarcasm to him, and he's not that funny, but he's alright.  We got to do one fun thing in class besides read and write, so that was cool.  you should try sucking up to him

Dr Panikker was flexible and lectures were pretty interesting to me. I don't remember ever really doing the readings (I took this class awhile ago) and I still got an A. Standard final paper that required a good amount of research/effort.

personally i enjoyed this class a lot, introduced me to new things. there are weekly responses based on reading/lecture. be ready to take notes on lecture and readings. quizzes are based on listening so study those. final paper is easy if you find a topic/event you care about. occasional guest lecturer and performance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I liked Dr Panikker when I took him for MUS008 but for this class he wasn't nearly as lenient and the final project was way too elaborate for a gen ed class imo. It was hard to stay engaged with lectures but you have to try your best bc the tests will be difficult if you don't attend and take notes during lecture.

Lectures were made boring by the professor. Sometimes the content was interesting but the professor was boring. Attendance is mandatory but no need to pay attention. Just memorize the listenings to pass the quiz. The TAs made the class fun. My TA was so amazing which made Panikker look even more boring during his lectures.

Dr. Panikker is very chill. There are 300-word responses due every week that correspond to the readings. He gave 3 quizzes for the entire quiz. There is a final paper that needs to 5-7 pages long. You need to take notes because his lecture slides do not have much info.

As long as you pay attention during lecture and keep up with the readings and weekly assignments you'll be fine, and you don't need to go too in depth with the readings either. Dr. Panikker was pretty flexible with deadlines and even gave us a mental health day once during the quarter. Did polls during class for attendance.

I had more of an issue with the material in the class rather than the professor. Albeit the class was an easy A with no final, 4 quizzes, and 1 paper, the material was no something that I expected to be when it comes to Popular music in America. Anyways the prof was fine, he was human and showed it which I respect.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Synchronous zoom lectures, but he'd upload them all after class. 4 quizzes throughout the quarter, no final, one 5-7 page paper, discussion mandatory. The professor is really nice and chill. Most of content for quizzes is from the book and they were open note so that was a plus. Pretty easy class. I just found the material boring .
took for UD elective. class was chill but he's kinda sassy and u don't end up learning a lot. curves a lot tho so you'll be fine if u just try.

Terrible. Just, terrible. Took him for an upper-div Econ (not 104A, my class was not listed there.)
Spent $200 on the mandatory textbooks ($130 one, and another $70).
Will mess your grade up if you ever miss a single submission date. 
Does not even care about students if they object about certain thing.|
Awful.

As a person he wasn't very engaged in the students and can seem pretentious at times. However as a professor he was generous and very clear about his grading system. He definitely gave you different opportunities to increase your grade and was fair in everything he graded. Discussions aren't important to attend. Strictly speaking for Econ003.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: pretty sassy, but very easy grader. rarely attended lecture and got 100.5% overall, just had to do pollev's and stuff. very generous curves on quizzes and exams. tests were not that hard in general, just do practice problems (pollev's) and you'll prolly be fine. discussions can be skipped too, just have to drop off hw and then ur good to go.

If you have to take Econ as GE go for 003 with Jay. Don't be scared and he's not bad! I think that he deserves a better RMP. His teaching skills are not the best and the class was basically self-study. BUT HE CURVES A LOT. (Like crazy curves up) So just do your work and you will pass. Cheerful during office hours and not rude at all!

Jay Dhar's class demands the amount of work you would expect from an upper div. It's not particularly easy or hard. He curves but you absolutely cannot rely on it to get a good grade because the tests require thorough understanding of material, so make sure to study well and go to office hours. Having an amazing TA was also very helpful.

If you study the concepts, all of them, they aren't that hard. He has improved by a lot. Gave a 32 point curve on the final, which got me a 118% lol. Also he has office hours and people hate on him because he has a distinct personality and his teaching philosophy requires a bit more work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The course textbook is difficult to read, but the extra credit that Dr. Dhar provided was beneficial. My recommendation for this course is to take advantage of Dr. Dhar's office hours, which are held six hours weekly, as they can be helpful if you have questions. Also, make sure to study for homework and submit it on time. You will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you're scared of taking him, don't be. His class is very doable, super easy tbh and I'm not a econ/bus major. You do have to study for the midterm and final(no study guide) but attending the SI review session helps get you a good score. Exams are MC and few FRQ, HEAVY curve (15-20% of exams). He does only read off his slides but overall not bad.

People like to complain and don't put the effort in. Honestly the reviews are all just people complaining about the class, but it really is not difficult at all. The professor is good, organized, and as long as you show up for the class and just know the material and review and put at least somewhat of an effort to succeed, it is easy. I got 118%.

IDK why everyone else is frustrated. He's not a great teacher but ECON003 class is easy. You're not trying to beat him or his grading you're trying to beat the business majors who don't study 

Why it's lightwork:
ended with a 103.2%
only went to 3 discussions
only went to 2 classes 
only have to participate in polleve 
gave +12 points for midterm

Listen to the reviews. His content itself isn't too hard it is just a lot and very overwhelming. On exams bring everything and understand it, and you will be fine. Take any actual professor, you will be better off. He curves hella but don't rely on it. Lectures are boring, they don't teach.

Despite all the hate he gets, the class isn't too bad. He posts slides which are incredibly thorough. He allows unlimited cheat-sheet on Exams, and adds a massive curve. Not too much HW, but his due-dates are weird.

He is an OK professor. Is he nice to you in person; not really. Is he a nice grader? Definitely. It's really hard to fail this class, as he curves like crazy (especially the final). You can honestly pay half-attention in lecture & self-study/group-study on your own time (really just the poll everywhere's and lecture quizzes), & you'll be fine.

Not a terrible professor but not the greatest either. Like other reviews have said self studying skills are essential to pass this class. He curves every exam and homework is graded by completion. If you can't self studying well I recommend attending study groups which helped me a lot.
This professor is absolutely the worst professor I ever had. He has no respect, kindness, or care for his students whatsoever.

I am not sure why does many people don't like him. Through I was attending his lectures, I got too many useful things. In class, he uses PollEverywhere, this helped me on exams. In lectures quizzes, many questions are reviewed and previewed. I went to his office hours many times, he explained to me patiencce.
Honestly hes not a good professor if u wanna learn something from him. Cuz he's so bad at teaching. But he did curve a lot. You can try his class if you can self study.

honestly people are hard on him. he did push the midterm back and the final was somewhat a mess with cramming material in at the last minute, but he acomodares. 104b is an upper Econ div the material itself is suppose to be challenging, and half the people complaining rn didn't show up to lecture ended with 102% go to lecture and do the hw.

The lectures are mainly reading off the slides, with PollEverywhere's being used. There are also weekly homework assignments, 2 midterms, and a final that require you to self-study. The lectures do cover the material in the textbook and the homework is reflective of the tests, however there is a high level of self studying necessary for this class.

Curved so much especially on the final. This class is very easy if you've taken any Econ before. People complain that he doesn't teach, but as long as you can self study a little you should be fine. Most questions on midterm and final are from homework anyway.

I really don't understand why everyone rates Dhar so badly. While he does come off as rude sometimes, his course is easy to understand, resources are clear, HW is reasonable, and he curves generously for the midterms and final. He is certainly not the best professor, but he does not deserve the low rating he currently has.
People don't get the hates? Go take his 104b instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is the most reasonable professor he grades very well. Like deadass if u cant pass his econ003 blame yourself like wtf hahahahahahahahahha. his tests are hella curved. his syllabus really helps you pass the final and midterm. LOVE YOU JAYDHAR
Don't understand the hate. Great professor and nice guy. Was very easy on the grading and the curves was high. He made sure everyone passed. If you couldn't pass, blame yourself.
All I know is that TA Yeonjoo is the goat.

I don't get all the hate? It's an intro econ class that isn't super interesting but if you take lecture notes and follow along with the simple math problems it's an EASY A. Weekly hw, lecture quizzes, and 3 exams, and he curves! As a CNAS major it was a breadth for me and I didn't love the class but the people in these ratings need to grow up...

Absolute waste of a professor. Horrible at communicating with students, lied multiple times about when he would post resources and practice tests before our exams, always waiting last minute. Only able to spend a lecture and a half on the last chapter due to his disastrous time management. Took class for credit, ended up teaching myself everything.

Only went to first few lectures and not any more after week 3 because Professor Dhar reads off his powerpoint slides word for word and the content of the PowerPoint slides are the exact same as the textbook word for word. Read textbook, skim over PowerPoint before exams and you'll have an easy time. Lectures are waste of time besides PollEV.

The class itself is easy, but it will be hard if you can't self-teach. I skipped most lectures and got an A. Don't panic intro econ is doable. Lectures are kinda useless, just look at the slides and do homework and you will be fine. Most people put bad reviews because of the 39% final which is fair.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!! Literally told students to not come to office hours because he was focusing on ECON003 when we were the upper division class. It took him weeks to post slides from his lectures that he would promise to post over the weekend and had to move the midterm because he was so behind. Has a crazy high ego too which doesn't help.

Just an ordinary unprepared, newly hired professor. I understand his method of providing educations to students may not satisfy everyone. However, this is over the line. 
Self-study on your own pace, complete the homework and quizzes. I have obtained A+ before a final so far. 

P.S. Whoever rated him 5 stars, hey Jay! Did not expect you to egosurf.

Professor Dhar is just awful. He literally cannot teach. He's very unprepared for the class and didn't post the slides in a timely manner. TA was the only way anyone could learn anything. Professor was not able to finish teaching what he intended to based on the syllabus and moved our midterm to week 8. We then had to take the final 2 weeks later.

They're right. RUN. AS FAST AS YOU CAN. If you study your own, you will get an easy A. 
However, I just cannot with this guy. 40% grade reliance on the final and terrible lectures. Whoever gave this man a 5 star rating, they're... won't say more. 
I recommend taking another professor if there is one. Or, just take BUS020 and take this course later.

Jay Dhar did a horrible job the material for Econ104b. He always was late from posting his lecture slides, a couple weeks late. Also he couldn't extract the material that he was showing the class to a better understand of the material. He always did errors, major errors on the midterm and the final. The average midterm was a 50%, which horrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: To be honest people in here r lwk dramatic like yes he sucks as a professor and isn't friendly but his poll everywheres are helpful and he curves relatively generously. Also he makes the questions on the exams exactly like the lecture quizzes and poll everywheres and the class is easy. Just make sure you understand the concepts

This professor is unprepared, solving textbook problems on the spot with frequent errors, relying on students to correct him. His poor time management left us three weeks behind. He's sassy, avoids accountability, and even discouraged office hour visits. Lecture slides were often illegible and late. Generous curves were the only saving grace.
He's a terrible professor. I hope he gets fired

The material is very easy to understand, tests reflect the material well. Lecture slides are posted on time consistently and are easy to study. Professor Dhar is extremely rude but he does explain things thoroughly. It's easy to do well in this class. 2 midterms and a final. He curves very generously.

Probably the best professor at UCR, I love the way he teaches, he's midterm and final was very easy too only 10 questions(good luck😈), he will keep slides updated every day and follows up with students individually, honestly everyone should pick him, well done to UCR Econ department, y'all just hired a best teacher ever!

I highly disagree with this professor's teaching theory of teaching yourself the material first then going to lecture. The best classes I've been in teaches you the material in lecture and then you go over the material at home for extra practice.

Jay Dhar is a good professor. I don't mind his teaching style and I also don't see people are hating on him. He ensures that we all understand the concepts he teaches with PollEverywhere, weekly homework assignments, and Canvas quizzes. 2 midterms and 1 final exam. His tests are close book and notes, so you have to memorize, but it's not bad.

Took 6-7 weeks for the first two chapters. Expects to teach the last chapter within one and a half lectures before our final exam. Super unprepared and unprofessional towards students, lying about when he's going to post slides and upload content. Be prepared to teach yourself.

I hope all of these ratings are the reason why he gets fired. He doesn't deserve to be a professor in our Econ department. No matter how hard he works, he'll always be a joke. I hope he sees this and know that every single review was a result of his character

Everything Jay Dhar touches is a mess. He couldn't get his midterm right. He couldn't post slides promptly. He couldn't teach a soul if his life depended on it. He's giving us two weeks to learn content that makes up 75% of the final. He epitomes the word "failure" and everything this man has done forces me to rethink standards UCR professors have

Does nothing but read off slides, genuinely I learned the class completely on my own. Also during exams, he would not stop talking. Even plugging my ears during exams I could still hear him and wasn't able to focus.

Jay Dhar is the best professor at UCR. I am honored to be part of his first class in this university. He clearly has a passion for microeconomics. I don't see why this class gets the hate that it gets. He makes sure that we all understand the concepts with PollEverywhere and homework assignments and even generously adds points to curb exams.

RUN AWAY. Don't even bother bro. He does not teach well. He just repeats what's on his slides and doesn't even add on or go more in depth. You can literally do that at home bro. He is so rude and sassy. I have not retained a single thing from this class and I truly believe its because of him. I actually have TO DO HIS JOB OT TEACHING MYSELF. RUUUN.

This is the worst experience I have ever had with a professor. He is arrogant and very rude. He only reads off of slides and does not teach the concepts on them. The class average for midterms was a 50%. IF YOU SEE HIM ON REGISTRATION RUN. I have not been able to learn or understand a single thing in his class.

I thought this class was going to be easy/manageable because my first Econ class went great, but this class I ain't learning. My first Econ class we were allowed to use notes during our midterms and this class is all about memory. I learned way more from my first Econ class than this class. This class definitely more harder for me.

During the midterm he kept changing the set up to a question and said he would grade that one more leniently, then didn't. The average for the midterm was like a 50% before the curve, then every time he mentioned the curve as if we should be on our knees thanking him. If you see his name when registering for classes, just run.

Just overall not ready as a professor. I can clearly see he wants to take a control of his class but not a great method is used to do so. Awful participation method of providing a very little time to solve the quiz, and it is yet mandatory for gradings and at least half of the class cannot finish on time. Very harsh grader, does curve "generously."

I learned to be grateful for the other ECON teacher because OH MY GOD. Professor Dhar is horrible at teaching lectures, caused bad mid-term grades (blamed all the students even though everyone did bad) instead of reflecting on his own teaching skills, and only reads off of slides (not really teaching the concepts on them) and occasional EVpolls.
AVOID THIS PROFESSOR AT ALL COSTS.

Reads off slides during the entire, unengaging lecture and can't teach concepts properly. Blames his students first for bad midterm scores and not being able to understand his poll questions instead of self-reflecting on his own teaching skills. Messes up such simple concepts during lecture.

Jay Dhar messed up his own midterm. He couldn't get the externality graph correct and changed it three times, making it harder for us to get the correct answer. It's ridiculous and we'll end up getting a lower grade because he couldn't get his own concepts right despite having a Ph.D in economics. Avoid him
AVOID THIS PROFESSOR IF YOU CAN!!!.

This professor is so egotistical and annoying dude. The workload is very easy and manageable. He is constantly derailing class over nothing and is very unhelpful and uncaring about his students' health and safety. During the L.A. fires he essentially sent out an email stating that we have no reason to skip his class and should be on campus!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A direct quote from him: "Please do not come to my office hours this week if possible-my ECON003 sections have a midterm exam, so will be busy with ECON003 students." If he doesn't like your class, Jay Dhar will make sure that your class isn't taught efficiently or well. It's incredibly unprofessional and students are losing out on chances to learn

This professor is awful. Honestly avoid him if you can. He makes many math errors when solving problems. He does not post slides when he says he is going too. In his syllabus he was behind a couple of weeks. He does not have well planned lectures. Midterm pushed back so far close to finals weeks. UCR Econ dept did a horrible job hiring him.
He's utterly woeful at his job. It's a shock he even has this job is ridiculous and single-handedly brings down the standard of education at UCR

Every second he continues to be here means that more students have to deal with his inability to teach, inability to provide content in a timely manner, and woeful organization. Every struggle about this class comes from his lack of skills as a professor, not the content. He should be fired and any record of him teaching should be scrubbed from UCR

I registered for this class assuming it would be an easy A and I was met with the worst professor I have ever had. He has an insane attitude, is extremely egotistical, and does nothing to help his students succeed. He creates favoritism between his different lectures. He grades attendance based on PollEvs answered correctly, not completion.

Worst professor I've ever had the displeasure of having by far and no one comes close. Unorganized, claims he'll post lecture slides by the end of the week and doesn't for the next 3 weeks, told us NOT to "come to office hours this week as it'll be mainly for econ003 students", and overall just unreliable and untrustworthy. Self study simulator.

Unbelievably bad. Uninspiring. Egotistical. If you were to ask, not a single student could say a single positive thing about how he teaches. He expects us to somehow learn when he sabotages any chance we have of understanding any of the content. To any student who has to take this class, avoid this class until he's the one not teaching it
I'd rather drop out than to ever take a class with this professor again

Jay Dhar exemplifies the failures of higher education. Economics is an application of mathematics and requires multiple years of advanced mathematics to master; How is it that undergraduates have to correct a professor on algebraic math examples he chooses? That's one thing, but to come back at students who correct him with sass is ridiculous

the 3 tags i picked, he is the opposite. literally stopped students from going to office hour because he "wanted to focus more on the lower-division class he is teaching". never answer emails. he can't do the algebras on his slides. we are currently 2 chapters behind. midterm exam belayed to week 8. posting lecture slides every 4 weeks.

He blamed students for him being unable to open a quiz on Canvas. He pushed back the midterm because he couldn't teach efficiently. He told us to not go to office hours because he prioritized lower div's. His TA's are much more suited to teach this class and every dollar spent on Jay Dhar's income is a misuse of school funds/taxpayer money.

To list the things he's good at is to list nothing. He cannot post slides ahead of time and takes weeks to post slides he uses during the lecture. He took 7 weeks to go over half the content of the class in the quarter system. His existence as a professor in this school is a strain on everything higher education promises to students

This professor was so unbelievably unprepared to teach an upper div course. He delayed lectures week after week and then delayed the midterm because he couldn't post the slides that he PROMISED to post by the weekend. We can't study ahead because he provides no lectures before class. He takes no accountability either when it comes to his mistakes.

Doctor Ditta is awesome, she inspires and gives exigence to many undergraduates if you get to know her. When I took her class, I did not know I would want to do psych. She cares deeply about the students who show up.

Was super nice! The class was easy and nothing was due till the end of the quarter. DO NOT procrastinate though, you will hate yourself if you do. There are weekly quizzes so 10 quizzes at the end of the quarter will make you regret your choices..

God, I would kiss her if I could.  She's very nice and interesting to listen to.  She's a younger professor and gets the knowledge across well.  She's literally chef's kiss.  Class is easy and interesting. Literally, if you need credits and want something interesting to learn JUST TAKE THE CLASS.

Amazing professor! You'd be lucky to have her; lectures were interesting, and so were the discussions that came with it; grading is very lax, and instead of a formal midterm/final, you have a midterm & final project. Overall, very chill & informative!!

Really easy and chill class. she give you everything (slides mainly and great lecturer). participation counts, dw abt weekly quizzes, focus on your projects and sona study requirement. Again, super easy class, very clear and helpful. Great class if you need to both lighten your load and get a good gpa boost.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Ditta is an amazing professor. Her lectures were interesting and engaging. Most of the class is graded on participation except for the midterm and final projects each worth 25%. It is clear that she cares for her students and is always willing to help when needed.

Prof. Ditta is one of the best profs I have ever had. Lectures are mandatory but very interesting. 2 projects 40% of grade each which are graded by TA. Disc is 20% of grade, all you have to do is attend. Extra credit up to 2% if needed. Easy A if you do all the work with effort.

Easiest class ever its literally just two projects and everything else is just participation based. You could literally fail every test (you get 100 just for showing up) and do the project the day before and get an A. She's really nice too and makes the class engaging

Super easy class 100% take for general ed. The workload is light. The assignments are easy. The midterm and final are projects which are easy but take time. Rarely went to lecture but when I went they were amazing. She is super chill and considerate of everyone. Attendance for class and discussion are mandatory. Written notes can make up attendance

her good reputation is deserved. really straightforward, adapts to the times with new tech like AI and zoom lecture makeups. connects topics to real life. asks engaging questions. offers some extra credit. she makes sure that non psych majors also feel included, AND even connects psych majors to resources! all above and beyond for intro psych class
really easy class but almost failed bc i forgot attendance was mandatory and dropped my grade to a D right before finals week.

Professor Ditta was an absolute gem. She is so caring and genuine. Her lectures were always interactive and interesting. She was very flexible, and the class was genuinely really straightforward. No exams, just midterm, final, and extra credit projects and pop quizzes during discussion. Her TA's were also excellent.

Professor Ditta seems like a great person. Her lectures were interesting and her class was very easy. There was no in-person midterm or final. The final was a project which wasn't very hard. This class was a great one and the professor was friendly and encouraged questions and discussion about the subject. The attendance was based on PollEv.

dr. ditta was really kind, funny and we were taught very thoroughly about the topics we needed to know. the final was a little difficult, i pulled an allnighter to finish all 3 parts. however, unlike me, if you work through the quarter and don't procrastinate you'll be fine! my ta was also super kind :)

the class was structured very well. there were two midterms, problem sets every week, and a final exam. lectures and discussions are mandatory BUT she records lectures, and you can still get lecture participation points by writing notes from the lecture and turning the notes in. for discussions, u can miss two with no penalties.
Very high energy and caring professor! Not a difficult class. I hope I can take her in the future!
Lots of homework but not hard, easy to get points, have chance to makeup, she is nice.

I had Professor Ditta for both PSYC001 and PSYC011 and I feel like I learned so much in both courses! She makes the material easy to understand and I heard many things about PSYC011 being a difficult course but I feel as if I understood it well enough :) Yay
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Class is an easy A if you just pay attention in class/lectures and take notes. Finish your homework in your discussions and complete the inquisitive quizzes and you'll do well in the class. Midterm and Final are short answer open note, so as long as you understand the concept, you should be able to get a good grade.

Very helpful and caring to students.
 Clear/thorough lectures. 
Always making sure students understand the materials/gives clear and helpful answers. 
Engaging.

There's a problem set every week. Midterm study guide is part of the problem set for that week. Answer poll everywhere for participation points during lectures or if u miss lecture/discussion, u can make it up with handwritten lecture notes as she posts her slides. I thought it was hard but it's actually not at all if u go to discussions at least.

I loved this class!It was very interesting and she gave off great energy. She is very lenient when it comes to grading so make sure to communicate. The only thing I slacked off on was the inquisitive so be sure to stay on track with those because they do impact your grade more than the other assignments. The exams were pretty decent not too heavy::

Prof uses Poll Everywhere for lecture attendance. She has lecture in person and on zoom while also posting her lecture recordings on canvas so very convenient. TA's grade your free response exams. Attendance for discussion is also mandatory for points. P easy as it is an intro course. If you got lower than an A then there's something wrong with you

Not super difficult class, but the midterm and final were very much so based on the information during lectures. Has a unique teaching style and acts a lot like a high school teacher during lecture with having students participating.

(PSYC 001) First and foremost, she is very kind and understanding. Her class was super fun and only boring sometimes. Love the way she gives her tests-open resource. great professor!!! Absolutely amazing. If she was a professor for all my classes I would be so happy. UCR is so so so so lucky to have her. Makes the other assistant professors in the department look bad. Love you Dr. D.
