Class did not focus on memorizing but understanding/applying concepts. Be ready and willing to share in class. No textbook but does provide articles/videos. Ask questions if something is unclear. All course readings provided from the beginning. Group discussion every lecture. Easy to follow if you pay attention. Very flexible and fair grading!

This professor was great! Had her for Soc3 at UCR for a class with over 100 students and yet she managed to make every ingle one of us feel important. She cared about our grades and was very understanding of us as students.

Participation is graded but if you miss some, you can speak to the professor about making them up. Assignments are able to be redone for better grades. Professor is extremely understanding and lenient with students, one of the best professors I've had. I would like to disclose a slight accent for those who may have auditory issues.

Professor Dina is so caring and understanding of her students. Her lectures are mandatory, and participation is part of your grade, but receiving participation points is not difficult! I recommend taking this course with her!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Aly is a very caring, patient, and welcoming professor. She allows students to share their opinions and ideas throughout her lectures, creating a strong learning environment. I hope to take her again in the future!

Dr. Aly is definitely a teacher who wants to see the students suceed. She was very understanding and was also considerate of student's time. Lectures were good, also during lecture it was discussion amongst students giving their thoughts on theories. She does allow extra credit opportunities as well.

Dr. Aly is quite possibly one of the most caring, inspirational, and considerate sociology professors at UCR. She made sure we had everything we needed to succeed and worked hard to help us understand the course material. She was also extremely inspirational & it was clear she cared a lot about the subject. I will be taking her classes from now on.

Dr. Aly is kind and accommodating professor. She had 1 mandatory assignment in which you would keep turning in until you got your desirable grade. She offered a handful of extra credit assignments too. She is patient and answers questions about assignments numerous times. I highly recommend her. Attendance is required half the quarter but just go!!
Great all around

Dr. Aly was one of the best professors I had.  She helps you with any questions you have.  We had a quiz that was open note and a final essay answering 3 out of 8 questions.  The final was take home so you didn't have to come to class.  Her lectures were helpful.  You can go to zoom if you are sick.

Dr. Aly is very good at teaching her teaching style is amazing. She is always thinking about how to make class better and easier for her students. She is a very kinda and flexible teacher. She is very passionate about her classes and it's very easy to pass this class the work she gives is not hard at all.

I will take her class 100%, she cares about students' academic performance. The logical structure of the course is very clear, making the challenging topics easy to understand. The course is very simple, don't have homework. You can choose online if you are sick.
súper sweet made first semester really simple
Professor Aly's Theoretical Perspectives Sociology class was good. I enjoyed the lectures and learned a lot.
This professor is foward with what is expected in the class from the start. She is super understanding and helps out in every way possible.

I don't even know what to say about Dr.Dina because she is absolutely the best. Always so wonderful and caring. Accomodating to students' needs and super flexible. More importantly, she is so knowledgeable and passionate about Sociology. Love you Dr.Dina and it's my pleasure to be your student! I'm always so excited to learn in her class.

One of my favorite professors at this institution. Her teaching style and class structure are very accessible and inclusive. As someone with a more hands-on learning style, I thrive in this kind of classroom setting best (interactive); she gives students multiple chances to receive the best grade they can. Would love to take another of her classes!
I'm very happy once again having the opportunity to take another class with her, she's caring, an care about her students. And I had not had any issue understanding her lectures.

Took Dina for Soc 129 Racism in western society. She is an amazing professor! Super engaging and funny as well. I love the fact that she's not super strict on her grading. She emphasis class participation but she makes it fun! I also love that she's really understanding of students life outside of class. I will most definitely be taking her again.

Amazing Amazing professor. I think this is the best professor at UCR! So caring and kind and makes you learn so much going on in the world today. If you want to take the best professor I would recommend taking Dr.Dina!

This is the second time I took a class with her. Hands down to the BEST Sociology professor at UCR! Super kind and accessible. Also very knowledgeable for Sociology. Her class is like a big tea party/discussion and you just have to participate and speak up. Everytime when I walked into the class, I know I'm ready to learn! Love you Dr.Dina!

This class was very different from other classes I've taken before, as there wasn't really a clear agenda as to what we would cover. I looked forward to attending class because we would discuss real things going on in real time. The professor created a safe space the classroom to share our thoughts and experiences aloud, which was very enjoyable.

The best teacher I have ever had she actually cares about her students, she sits down and answers any question you have and she's so supportive she's always telling us "you are all so smart, I care for you guys" the sweetest soul ever. You have 2 big assignments and one open note final exam that can be taken online or in person. 10/10 I loved
This class is very easy if you do the work. Flexible if you can't make the lecture in person there are Zoom options.
I took one Soc 028 before, so I took Soc 003 with her and had a great time.

The professor was SO GOOD, one of the best professors at UCR. She is knowledgeable with Sociology. Classes are offered both in person or via zoom. BUT I would highly recommend going to in person lectures because the lecture was so much better and interesting. If you have questions, go to her office hours on zoom. Participate, speak up!!!! So good!

the class was fun and more engaging. Students are graded by participating and engaging in class. Anyone who likes to interact in the class would have a great time. The instructor offers class to have an optional zoom for those who can`t attend for personal issues, physical health, and life circumstances.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is very fun and easy to conversate with during her lectures. Her class debates are fun and interesting and it's not hard at all. She gives us the resources and textbooks we can use(not required, but recommend to read) and there's only 2 assignments. Definitely should take this class bro.
She us the option to attend in person or on zoom. Assignments were straightforward and simple

Dr. Dina Aly Ezzat is a caring person who makes sure that we all is comfortable in class by building a relationship with her students. The class is very easy, easy to understand the assignment. I'll definitely take the class again if I could.

I really enjoy how the professor makes this class seem different everyone's opinion is valued. I personally am a very shy person but with her class, I get a little more confidence to be able to speak my opinion and not feel super intimidated.

This has been one of the most interesting/ fun classes I have ever taken. Professor Aly allows us to say our opinions and discuss what we think about certain topics. She is very open to new ideas and does not give a lot of work. She is flexible when it comes to the final and gives us more than enough time to get it done.

The professor is very kind and her lectures are engaging. She offers a zoom option for students that can't make the class. She only has two assignments that we have plenty of time for and one final. Lectures are engaging and offer different perspectives. Don't expect much slideshows and expect more in class discussion. I am happy I took this class.

The professor is super sweet. I will say this class is very different from other classes I have taken in a sense that  there are no a lot of written notes. I feel that this class is very student input based and I do enjoy hearing other students input, but sometimes it's a lot of talking from some students and it gets off track from the main point.

The professor is very clear in what she expects and relays this to her students, this is shown through her accessibility in and outside of class. She is consistently available for help and does not make the grading criteria very difficult to understand. This is a very easy class unless you are lazy and make it harder for yourself.

I love this class and her as a professor! She literally the sweetest and one of the very few that actually want to hear your perspective. The class itself is very engaging, and provided either going in person or zoom which is awesome. Literally take this class!

I would take the class again. She had a good teaching approach and we had a lot of discussion about the corse. If there is anything you don't understand she is approachable to talk about and help you understand. This is an easy fun class and she a good professor. :)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The Professor allows us to use outside resources for the final and the coursework is very easy and straight to the point. She allows us to go in person to class or over zoom which is very convenient. Participation matters but she wants more of your opinion and gets you to actually pay attention in class.

A very caring professor who genuinely cares about her students, and aims to help us succeed!!! The syllabus is tentative and subject to change with the order of topics, but there are very few assignments (2 due at end of the quarter and one final exam with you answering 3/6 prompts). I would absolutely recommend :) Offered class via Zoom as well!!!

I took this course for a breadth requirement and I thoroughly enjoyed it. She had a hybrid setup, lecture available on zoom and in-person. The topics she focused on were important and super informative, most being topics professors would be afraid to talk about. She also gives students the option to speak about their opinions about the topics.

Professor clarifies that syllabus is subject to change in the beginning of the quarter. Her lectures consist of participation. If you do not like to talk in class and engage, this is not for you. I enjoyed participating and learning about others' insight and perspectives so I really liked this class.

The class is very engaging and it is nice that the professor offers a zoom option for those that can not make it to the class for any reason. Her class is not hard its just 2 one page essays and one final, no midterm.

Very accessible and has both online and in-person lectures. Her lectures are very interesting if you participate and cares about everyone's opinion. She likes it when you challenge her own opinion or think differently than others. I would take her class for other classes if I could again. Awesome teacher.

she is TERRIBLE @giving directions for assignments tht it is SO HARD to follow. her syllabus is also completely off. it said tht our final would be multiple choice, but it turned out 2 be a whole essay which made us all feel unprepared. she is so disorganized&goes off topic when she "lectures." her notes r also terrible, theyre not even ppt slide.

her syllabus was not clear at all, the grade percentages pretty much said that the midterm and final will be the only things that will be graded, so everyone thought that the "paper" was the final. but the paper and final were separate things. she is not clear about her class structure and coursework.

She is late to respond to emails and even TAs got frustrated working with her since she didn't respond to questions about the midterm, and would often be late to their own lecture meeting by 20 minutes. No issues with lectures themselves but she is either horrible with Zoom or so horribly unprepared for a lecture where she reads off a slideshow.

Great class and professor. Dr.Alh is very approachable. Gives good feedback and is patient. Provides lots of examples to study for exam. Pay attention in class and on slides and if you need extra help go to office hours.

Dr.Aly is an amazing professor. Truly offers all her time and lots of effort to her work. Just seeing diverse women in academia is an inspiration. Class is straightforward. Make sure to study the slides and attend the lectures. Her lecture style is very involving and makes it super engaging. Definitely recommend.

For Fall 2021- Dr. Dina Aly's lectures were kind of unprofessional and all over the place, but fortunately, she uploaded her lecture material. There weren't any tests, but there was an essay due by the end of the quarter. Her content was so easy to understand, so no difficulties there. She's hard to get a hold of through email though.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was by far the one easiest classes Ive taken. Dr. Aly is very kind and understanding and while English my not be her first language its not impossible to understand her. We only had 1 midterm 1 final and 1 term paper to do and everything is in the lecture she goes over I never even used the text book. Im even taking her again next quarter
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Ayl has a new fresh way of lecturing. It was informative, insightful, and eye opening. She is always available to work with you and give you a clear understanding if you should need one. Be patient with her as she is very patient with her students. This class broadened my views about gender, other cultures, and how fortunate we are in the USA.

Dr. Dina Aly is by far one of the most caring and understanding professors Ive had here at UCR. Its obvious that she enjoys what she is doing. I really enjoyed her lectures. I recommend anyone to take her class, you wont regret it!!

Best professor ever! So kind and understanding! Never met any professor as kind and caring, always polite and always there if you need help with anything! had zoom meetings from 12-6 everyday in case anyone needed help with the paper. Helped me edit my paper to make sure I got a good grade. I would take another class with her, super kind and easy

I really enjoyed the classroom environment and the way the professor taught the entire quarter. She was very helpful and very very very! understanding and accommodating! I defiantly hope that she teaches more at UCR she is amazing I had gotten sick during the quarter and she was so understand!

Hands down one of the easiest classes. 3hr 8am sounds grueling, but she covered all the material way before the end of class. Dr. Aly is one of the kindest professors, very understanding and accommodating. Miscommunication sometimes, but she clears up any ?'s. Barely any hw, topics were very interesting and easy to grasp, midterm/ final very easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Her class is super easy. She is very kind and go to her office hours. She's not a tough grader. She actually gives you a good grade if you complete the work. Our group only had 4 pages to do for the final paper and she helped with everything! you can use one of the midterm questions which is way easy because you have to only do 2 pages now. Easy.

All the reviews are so bad but I honestly think she is the easiest class I have had at UCR. There was only one midterm which all you have to do is answer 3 questions and it is all in her slides. If you go to her office hours she explains everything so much better. Theres a paper that's 8-12 pages but what do you expect if she left no work. Easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took her during the pandemic. WORST mistake I've ever made in my college career. She started the course a week late, fell asleep during lecture multiple times after showing up late, and does not respond to any emails. It baffles me how she is a professor when the TA is the one who did all of the work, and was equally as confused and frustrated.

Holy cow, she does not teach well. If lecture starts at 7:30, be prepared for her to either cancel class or show up at 8. She repeats everything and does not respond to emails. Expect your TA to teach you everything you know. Her workload isn't a lot, but damn you have to have a lot of patience with her. The language barrier is an issue.

Tried to be patient with her due to the pandemic, but it was hard to when my other professors could handle the transition to remote learning & she could not. For 3 weeks, she never held class at the correct time or didn't hold class at all. Didn't respond to emails for days. Just a huge waste of time. Hope you never have to have her as a professor
Tough grader ngl. should have gave me better than that fs

Great professor. Dr. Galella really wants students to learn and engage with the material. She is inspiring but you must put in the effort to earn the grade. I took her for two separate classes in one quarter and it was a lot of reading but the material is interesting. Favorite professor at UCR.

Includes lots of readings and occasional quizzes but nothing unexpected, her syllabi are straightforward. Her method of teaching is excellent because she allows for plenty of discourse and student participation within her lectures (believe me, you'll want to speak up!). She has opened up our minds about theater in so many ways. You won't regret it!

Professor Doyle is an amazing teacher! In class, we had one project (a small presentation on little sections of a book), and we had four essays, two out of class, two in class. The only issue some had with her was her attendance policy. If you were not in class at the exact time it starts she takes off half participation points for that day.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is very sweet, arrive on time to class because she can be a bit annoyed by late students disrupting her, yet she shrugs it off but will mark you late on attendance. Read when assigned and take notes on your reading for discussion in class. She likes participation. Would Recommend taking her class.

Amazing professor I had such a great time in this class she truly shows a lot about how much she cares about her students. Her class always felt judge free.If you aren't good a writing or unsure of your essays I really encourage you to go to office hours! Trust, she will not judge u she is always super sweet about it and gives you detailed feedback
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: By far one of the best English professors I've had at UCR. She truly cares about her students and genuinely wants us all to succeed. Just attend class regularly, and you'll have no trouble doing well in this class.

I think she might be the best prof I have ever had. Her classes are so engaging and you truly learn a lot, even tho ENGL004 is one of the hardest English courses it felt like a breeze with her. She amazing in every aspect and truly uplifting, you won't regret her! Only thing is she is strict on attendance and makes u do make up work for what u miss

Her class is extremely engaging and her essay topics are pretty interesting. Definitely go to office hours for essay feedback, it's really helpful. Very few readings and she's super nice. Best English professor I've ever had.

I struggled in the beginning of the class because it was my first english class at ucr and i kinda suck at writing but a lot of my peers got As. she was rlly helpful during OH (i recommend going if u struggle with writing as well). She gave helpful feedback and was really kind and caring in class too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Honestly good if you're looking for a moderate English class, The work isn't necessarily that hard but she does have certain criteria for grading, (let's just say not the easiest to get an A on essays) however she gives thorough and good feedback. Understanding about your personal situations, but requires you to make up work for missed days.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had so far, I always enjoyed going to her class. The feedback she gives on essays was extremely helpful for me and her criticism didn't feel harsh. Participating in class was really fun too and she really cares about her students.

LOVED HER SO MUCH, she really dives into literature and cares about her students. Please go to ALL HER OFFICE HOURS if you struggle with writing! She really wants her students to succed in college and do their best. Hoping she does english 1C. Best Professor here at UCR!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This was one of my favorite classes. She lectures in a way that makes you want to participate and input your opinion. She's super welcoming and always open to your ideas and theories. There was rarely any homework and the 3 essays were clear on their requirements and honestly fun to write. She's super helpful during office hours too.

Moderate to light work load if you don't wait till the last minute. The professor is very excited and passionate about the class and teaching, gives good feed back, and is always ready to help. Students are expected to engage in discussions about the texts or papers they had to read, but it was pretty chill. I didn't need the writing textbook.

Emily is a wonderful professor! Every day I went into her lectures feeling positive and ready to share my thoughts about readings. She's extremely caring and passionate about her students and encourages them to be their best. Although she does expect a certain style of writing, she always provides feedback regarding your writing. Would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I absolutely love her. You could tell that she cares about her students and she puts in effort to getting to know them. Attendance is mandatory but her lectures are very useful and she gives you great criticism. She could be a tough grader but if you need help then she is happy to help you.

I would say Emily is very kind. She creates a community in the classroom. She truly and genuinely cares for her students and makes sure to hear from every one of them. I would say she's a harsh grader however, in English 001B at least. Other than that she's an awesome person and I would take the class again.

She's such an amazing professor who obviously cares about writing and the minds of her students. If you love writing or want to improve, take this class. I wish I could go back in time and take this class all over again. <3

Emily is by far one of the best TAs I've had at UCR. She's funny, considerate, and she gives amazing feedback on everything. The structure of the class is very organized, and you know from day 1 what is expected of you. She fosters a community environment in her classes and I made great friends. I highly recommend taking anything she teaches.
Really straightforward and easy course. Topics and material are interesting. Exams are really easy, but attendance is taken every lecture.

This course was challenging but extremely rewarding. Even when I struggled early on with homework and Midterm 1, the professor was very helpful and supportive. She is passionate about NLP and AI, and that energy clearly shows in her well-structured lectures. I was able to make up for the lost points in later exams and through the bonus homework.

Easily one of the most interesting classes I have taken in college. Professor Dong explains deep learning and NLP concepts in a way that builds a strong foundation. There are quizzes every class, which I was initially worried about, but they are simple and help keep me on track. She is also very responsive and understanding.

I enjoyed my time with Professor Dong. The exam reflected the HW and content taught during lectures, and there wasn't too much HW. Strongly reccomended to have a baic background in ML (via CS171) before taking this course, as basic ML will be touched very briefly. Office hours were very helpful.

I took CS171 with professor Dong in the summer session, the course was 6 hours lecture for 5 weeks and we have weekly assignment. The lecture was very well organized with lots of math but the homework is easy.  I learned so much about machine learning and I think this course prepared me to pursue a career in AI.

Took CS 173 in Spring 2023 with Yue Dong, one of the best profs at UCR. The class load is heavy but manageable with quizzes almost every lecture, biweekly homework, hw4 gets harder we even built an RNN for translation. Practice exams are close to the real ones and she is super approachable. I learned a lot of AI in this class.

Took the course this summer. It seems like she is not interested in teaching at all. She is always in a hurry. She does not even prepare her class lecture, uses other professors slide directly!! She reads slides in the class. Felt like an English class more than a ML class. I wonder why no one has complained about her in the department yet!!
It's an NLP course, but she focuses very little on NLP itself. The course materials are scattered everywhere. It's not a good course if you plan to actually learn something.

Do NOT take with Yue Dong. SO MUCH WORK. 16 Quizzes, 2 Homeworks, 3 Midterms, 1 Project, 1 Presentations. LOL. She does ROLL CALL. All USELESS. Took this class as a graduate student and deeply regret doing so.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors at ucr. Does not know what she is doing, super unorganized. Does not go much deep into a topic, can't answer questions students ask, lol.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She destroyed everyone in the final project. With no exceptions. Course in the end was more about how you write reports vs if you actually managed to achieve something technically. For as much as it was advertised as a research oriented course, turned out it was more English literature. NLP no pun intended is more to do with English. Not AI.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Kelly Downey is an amazing professor. She is kind and helps anyone who is facing doubts in topics they are struggling with. She makes her classes interactive, which is a key highlight of her teaching. She is strict about using devices while she is teaching, but remember. She wants you to pass with flying colours.

Her lectures are always so fun, and she is mindful of the students as she makes sure we are not tired! Just don't have your phone out and pay attention during lectures. The class is pretty easy if you read the Zybooks and do all the activities. You can even retake the quizzes. No midterm, and the final MC was very light. Overall, a good class!

Listen up good. Kelly Downey, the CS "professor", had made me wish I woke up with an hernia before I went to her class. She acts like we're still in high school; "Guys phones away please", "Okay guys let's stand up and stretch". Please, just teach the class. We read the material, just expand on it, don't make us answer your dreaded questions.

Really easy class and really nice professor. The homework and reading are straightforward and take less than an hour if you really focus. Labs are also easy and allow you to work with a partner. The programming assignments are really easy and the quizzes give you too much time for how they're done. No midterm, so be ready to study for an easy final
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Homework is online and easy. Assignments are take home but no collaboration, a couple in person quizzes and then a final. As for the lecture , no public speaking, you could work with others on in class participation activites, engaging lectures and clears up confusion to prior zybook readings. Gave out candy and did good demonstrations on topics.
it was an awful class and professor./
She fell asleep in class once but otherwise, I love her! She gives good information in lecture hard class attend office hours and ULA to pass and don't cheat!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good professor. Just do the reading and keep up with the homework, do both and you won't have to bother studying for the quizzes or the final. Usually the questions you have are answered in lecture so definitely attend. The in-class activities can feel useless but are good learning opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Kelly was great! I'm a noob and had no prior experience, but she kept me engaged and was fair. Mainly used zybooks which was our interactive textbook, it helped a lot when it came to studying. She even brought us snacks on two occasions! No midterm, only four short quizzes, and the final, which wasn't very hard. GO TO CLASS THO! Trust :)

I like Kelly she's amazing and helpful if you go to office hours and get to know her more. Just be careful about using tech in the class (phones or laptops) since you are not allowed to use it only a tablet flat on the table only. First time programmer here and this class is hard but as long you use the resources then with luck you will be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I had never coded before this class. I was a little nervous but with Downey, I had no reason to be. For this class we learned through Zybooks. VERY lenient late policy. Very helpful office hours. Highly recommend for first time programmers.

Very easy class if you have some programming experience. Lectures are mostly pointless since you self learn everything on zybooks but you have to attend class to get points in participation activities. If you do all the zybooks activities and labs the final exam is easy.

She is not a good professor, she goes over real code during her lecture, but quizzes and final is all pseudocode and conceptual stuff. Which often times are hard to interpret. TA's get mad for no reason and don't seem like they want to help students. Also, making it that you have you get a 70% on the final for an intro course is ridiculous.

Kelly was AMAZING. She is a great teacher, and does a lot of examples which is really helpful. She doesn't just lecture the whole time but stops and has us work on things. She helps us get to know other students. She was always enthusiastic and SUPER patient with us new programmers. I'm so glad she is teaching the first programming class.

Cool professor except for a few things. She does not allow technology in class (e.g. phones/laptops) except for rare times. Her lectures are also informative but pretty boring sometimes. But overall she's pretty accommodating and helpful.

This class in general is hard, I recommended taking notes on your online textbook to really get the material and do practice problems. The final is heavily weighted so, if you don't pass the final you don't pass the class. Going to her office hours helps a lot. She doesn't really teach it is more self-taught. Good luck if you take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: spends more time in class yelling at students to put their "tech" away then actually teaching
Loved this class and honestly the class was fun but you do have to put in the work. If you do the work, everything else will be easy!
I went into this class with ZERO programming experience. She was amazing and very engaging during lectures. I really enjoyed having her for this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's a great professor and exhibits a respectful manner. Coding requires extreme precision which makes it hard, but she was helpful during office hours. There were 3 assignments due per week along with 2 programming projects. The programming assignments were time-consuming, so it's best to start them asap. Just put in the time and you'll be fine.

Professor Downey explains contents in a non-engaging way where it is easy to zone out and get behind. Her lack of engagement with the class's understanding of the content was striking. Seemed to explain concepts she struggled with as a student, not what the class is struggling with. Accessible, nice, just not my first choice for lectures.
Her materials are kind of messy. She does give sample tests but never the answer sheets.

Prof Downey was pretty nice. There were labs due every week and a programming assignment for the midterm and final. I think there were too many labs for the class but it was doable. You just have to have time set aside to work on them.

I heard Kelly is a good instructor that's why I chose her for 61. However, she is the underprepare professor I've seen in UCR. The content she gives scatters everywhere, plus a lot of unnecessary in class activity that does not help. I get annoyed a lot in her class. If you are taking 61 please go to Allen's class. He is a passionate teacher.

I had a really good experience. Her class is very straightforward. She is very helpful in lectures, answering every question thoroughly with such patience. Genuinely sweet and loves to interact with students. The hardest part of the class is the programming assignments. I hope I can take her again in later CS courses.

Idk why she has good reviews because she is not a good professor, she tries to be funny and relatable but then is horrible at actually being a compassionate professor. Students had trouble with accessing their midterm, she didn't care. Students email her, she doesn't care. Students tell her they are sick, she will ignore their doctors note LOL

I previously had Professor Downey for CS10A, and she was pretty good. For this class, not so much. Her lecture slides were wrong and didn't correlate with what she was lecturing on about half the time and she would just assume that we could figure it out ourselves. She's nice and is good for CS10A, but for high level stuff, she isn't the best.

reviews.comment: I had very little programming experience, but Downey did a good job in helping me become an adequate C++ programmer. Really cares about students and has a passion for teaching. She completely understands the material and explains it in a way that makes sense conceptually. If you have prior programming knowledge, this course is a breeze.

reviews.comment: Kelly was chill, and the class atmosphere was always lively. A lot of the class is "self-taught" and going to lectures was a way to review what you might have learned the night before. Be careful though, not passing the final will cap your grade at a c-.
Exams were very easy and all based on homeworks and examples from lectures.

Ms. Downey is an amazing professor. It is obvious that she is very passionate about programming and her students. She assignments homework through an online website that explains every single component in the class thoroughly. I highly recommend that you complete your assignments earlier in the day because her homework deadline cuts off at 9 pm. :)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

Kelly is very passionate for the subject of CS, she is also very helpful and answers questions any questions throughly. The readings are essential to your learning and programming experience beforehand is recommended. Programming assignments are very time consuming, be sure to start early. Exams are very tricky, being able to trace code is a must.
Chill class

This class isn't real programming, it introduces you to the fundamentals using an animation program called Alice. It's actually kinda fun. ok like i didnt go to lecture at all but his tests are mostly based off the practice exams and some of the hw. if u understand the hw and really understand why the answers are what they are in the practice exams you should be fine. average for the mid term was like 56% and i got a high B. he doesnt curve exams but the final class grade its okay ig?

His lectures are clear and understandable, and as someone who loves Economics, I came out of this class with a thorough understanding and appreciation for the material.

Professor Lee is nice. He uploads all the materials on Canvas. This course is DIFFICULT! Try to avoid if you are not an econ person. One midterm and one final. Four assignments, four pop-up group exercises during lecture. The exams are difficult but he gives really good curves. I thought I would get a C but end up with A-.
This guy is not a good professor and there is a reason why people always skip his class. He does not provide resources and does not care for his students at all. There to just get the money and dip.

The class is really difficult and exam average is usually a F. Tests are really difficult but the curve is decent. He is a really nice person but I would not retake the class if I could go back in time.

Lectures and discussions are not mandatory. some exam questions are from the discussion. give out practice exam which is exactly the same as the actual exam but he will change numbers and/or wording (e.g., increase to decrease, etc...) As long as study the practice exam he gives well and did go to every discussion then you will get an A for sure.

Entire class failed his midterm. He is hard to understand. His homework setup is punitive. He weighs homework very heavily for some reason. The point of homework is to LEARN and make the mistakes then and not during the exam, so that it isn't held against you. Great Lectures!

reviews.comment: Writing this rn cause my grade is a D. About 5 hw assignments and 1 midterm (which I failed). Lectures non-mandatory and uploads the recording of them. reviews.comment: The professor is very smart but sometimes has trouble communicating with students. You need to pay attention in lecture. Most kids do poorly and he curves around an 85%. I got a C- on the final and got an A in the class. Pretty easy if you put in average amount of effort.
Professor Lee is a very knowledgeable macro-economist, hence his lectures are engaging and very applicable to current events. Take your macro series with him!

DongWon is honestly amazing. He might be the best professor Ive had at UCR. Hes so clear and informative and is always willing to help us out. If you have a chance to take this professor, DO IT. He is the easiest professor I have ever taken in all my three years. Not only because of his awesome curve, but his lecture notes are godly. He breaks it down for you so you can understand easier. It's a lot of content so make sure you review notes after class and go to office hours for help.
If you really like economics as your major, definitely take him. He will give you all the tools and help to succeed in Macro. Test are tough and tricky, but he curves in the end.

Lectures are hard to understand. But go to them because he will do problems in class that could be helpful in doing homework. Homework is hard but once you understand the material they are very easy. His test are mainly correlated to the HW questions so use them to study. He also curves the class very generously.

The exams for this class were more brutal than I was expecting, and they were worth a lot of the final grade. Prof. Douilly is a caring and funny professor, but his philosophy on lectures is a little troubling, as he refuses to post slides, which are very crucial to exams. Otherwise, he's good!

Easy breadth credit, easy class. There's weekly assignments but it honestly isn't hard. Make sure to attend lectures because basically everything on the exams is discussed in lecture. Exams aren't hard as long as you study a bit. Never attended discussion section but I still ended up with a B+. It really isn't a hard class and the movies were fun.

great professor and overall great class. if you're looking for a simple breadth requirement class heavily recommend it. Three assignments a week - movie worksheet, reading worksheet, and quiz. Three exams. Attendance is taken through Pollev. I did struggle to understand because of his accent at times but pretty clear and to the point in lectures.

Amazing professor! His lectures are fun and super informative. He always updates his slides to stay on top of current day events and the tests are very fair! Overall a super fun and interesting class I highly recommend. 
Weekly homework is a movie + movie worksheet + reading the textbook.

Professor Douilly is an amazing professor. I found myself looking forward to each lecture simply because they are so fun and informative. You should attend every lecture because he does not post the slides. Three assignments due every week. The study guides echo the exams almost exactly. Easy homework. Take this professor.

Professor Douilly is one of the best professors I've had at UCR. His study guides are exactly what is on the test. He gives great feedback to questions about real world, current natural disasters. I would take this class over and over again if I could.

45% of grade based on 3 tests (not cumulative), 10% poll ev's, 30% reading and movie worksheets, 15% quizzes. Very easy class, copy slides word for word and do the study guide for exams. No extra credit, 90% is an A, 87% is A- in his class.

Amazing professor. The study guides he gives for 3 midterms are exactly like the real test. Having the book is unnecessary, just come to EVERY lecture and take notes on his slides--that will be enough. Reasonable grader, discussion is not mandatory. Such a carrying professor!

Professor Douilly is truly the best professor I have ever had. His lectures contain thorough powerpoints and he provides a study guide. His class was really intriguing as a non major and they were fun. There are many assignments but they are easy and take very little effort to complete.

He's just a solid choice and if you want a decently easy class that still requires some work. reviews.comment: This class was very interesting and I like the approach Professor Roby used to teach the course. Professor Roby is very nice and cares about his students.

I loved this class. I used to be really into science but once it got more complex I decided to take a different direction. Professor Douilly revitalized my interest in the subject. I really liked this class. Prof Douilly is incredibly passionate about the subject matter and teaches it in an engaging way. he's a great professor but you won't pass his class just by looking at the slides he posts later. try to attend his lectures, since he includes additional info that won't be in the slides. he gives you notes go fill out for his class on the topics that he will cover in his class. always attend his office hours after every midterm multiple choice

GREAT TEACHER AND SUPER EASY CLASS. I got a C+ on first midterm but ended with an A+. TAKE THIS CLASS.

Great Professor! Easy to follow, showed a lof slide illustarting geological events.  She is very influentual and supportive.

Dr. Smith is a pretty cool guy. the class was really easy for the first half, and slightly more difficult for the second but if you are already understand logic then you don't need to study.

I actually like the professor but class itself is very boring but he's very good at getting into contact with if you need help with something.
