She claims to be flexible with those who are out sick but really isn't. Professor is also extremely petty with those who are giving criticism/ trying to express their hardships. She doesn't let us see our grades even when it's within her power. Don't take this class if you aren't passionate.
Does not accommodate at all and gives no idea as to what the tests will be on

Really interesting professor. Makes lectures enjoyable, she does small in-class assignments or "PollEv" questions for attendance. Labs are fun, moderately diffucult. Midterms are pretty hard lol. Aside from that you shouldn't get below an A on midterms, so that boosts your grade. Midterms are not cumulative, final is.

Go to every lab they really count. Her final is cumulative and mostly involve brand new questions (for the most part she doesn't recycle from previous midterms) which is annoying because there's a lot of material, but it isn't impossible to get an A. Go over every single powerpoint before exams multiple times, take notes and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you're someone who puts 100% to get the A (going to office hours and to EVERY single lecture), this is the class for you. I'm a CHASS major, who's garbage at science but still got an A. Her ppts are confusing because they repeat (and she goes rly fast!), but take notes on what you can then go over ALL the ppts again later at home before exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: GO TO LAB. It's worth a huge chunk if your grade, because there is a weekly quiz too, but I've never stayed for more than 1.15 hours. Tests are mostly memorization based so take good notes, and pay attention to top hat Q's.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She made me want to change my major to bio, but then I realized shes not the only bio teacher and I changed back. Good class and labs were super easy.

If you get the chance to take a course with Mary, do it. She is amazing. She really got me interested in paleontology. Make sure to attend class, because TopHat questions are given each lecture for points. Study for tests. Get to discussion on time, a quiz is given each first 5 minutes of discussions. Labs are easy and actually engaging.

She is very passionate about her teachings and seems like a very nice person. She drops the lowest of 3 Midterms. The midterms were average but doable if you studied but they covered a lot of info. The final however was much easier since she gave you slides and topics to focus on. Attendance is mandatory. I personally did not need to use the book.

The tests were basically all memorization from A LOT of information, which made it quite hard for me, especially as I had no interest in the topics. Although she drops your lowest midterm the class averages for the 3 were 77,64,68 showing that they were pretty hard. If you really love Geology you might like this class, if not I don't recommend it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a great wealth of info and is passionate. She let's students know she's there to help The class isn't hard but you must study and review notes to pass exams. Exams and labs were straight forth. There is a lot of material to cover and remember but if you're interested in the topic you'll do fine. I would definitely retake  any of her courses!

Dr. Mary Droser is a good professor. She is accessible, her lectures are interesting, and the class is not too taxing especially if you are a Geology major and have taken some other upper division classes.
Dr. Droser knows the ins and outs of her field, and she always brings a lot of enthusiasm to class. Holuthurians (Sea Cucumbers) make her happy...so remember those if you take a class from her.

Ha! "Professor" Droser doesnt even show up to class, she left the 2nd half to be taught by grad student Kristin Keenan who has lectures with 60-90 slides EACH and makes all the (3) tests...class average for them = 69% and oh, NO curve. Plus the professor sent an e-mail that basic.said "i kno many will fail this class so its being offered in summer"

Ok, i don't kno whats up this quarter but this "professor" let a grad student teach for the 2nd half of the quarter and she didnt show up to class after that at ALL. the grad student (Kristin Keenan) posted up slides online and there were about  60-90 slides on EACH lecture which is INSANE for an INTRO course! average for midterms = 69% - no CURVE!
She's an amazing teacher!  She keeps the lectures interesting, and genuinely cares how the students do in the class.  The tests were very easy, multiple choice, and the labs were fun.

She is the most wonderful little woman ever! Super easy class, but you learn a lot. Fun, interesting labs (though they need to be revised and updated). If you are a geo. major, go to her and she will help you with classes and everything. Amazing woman.
Very funny teacher. Lowest midterm grade dropped.

This has to be the best teacher in the entire school.  She gives three midterms and drops the lowest of the three and her exams are so easy.  To pass the class all you have to do is memorize her notes and watch movies about dinosaurs.  Best class ever.
she seems friendly at first but is quite nasty once you get to know her, avoid

Andrew Ivey was an extremely good professor from my time and experiences with him in ENGL 001B. He was typically very easy to get ahold of outside of class or after and the feedback that he gave on essays was excellent. All in all, a great professor; learned many good writing techniques, and left this class with a better repertoire because of him.
If you need an English requirement take this class. This class is so fun and easy for the most part.
Loved having him as a professor! The class itself was pretty easy and the midterms and finals were open-note. His lectures were also interesting and easy to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He was great! Lots of essays, but they are pretty easy if you listen to the weekly lectures.

Professor Ivey's class was asynchronous in the fall, however his lectures were powerpoint based which was useful. His lectures were also interesting. He engaged students with jokes and memes. His midterm and final are similar but cover different topics. The class was lecture based for exams however you do have to use the book for the essay portion

I loved this professor and his teaching style! His PowerPoints and lectures were very informative and entertaining, had a lot of memes and jokes in them that made information easy to learn. Graded based off of two midterms and one final. Open note for all of them. Just do the reading, enjoy the lectures and you'll get the A!
Average to mid lectures. Extremely unresponsive to students over email, and does not provide extra material for exams. When I took the course, the syllabus was never posted online.
A great teacher, that is all I can say

Ke Du is such a inspiring and amazing figure! He lights up the entire classroom. His class can be pretty difficult, but he is always happy to sit in study sessions with me and he always helps me out on my assignments. Some may say he is a bit strict, but I think he is very kind and he is always very amazing. Thanks to him, I got a A+.

Professor Du is nice but leaves much to be desired as a teacher. His lectures are PPT slides that he reads to the class. He gives quizzes every lecture but only grades them for completion for attendance. The exam questions have no correlation to the HW or lectures. He doesn't reply to emails or even show up to his own office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It's been two years since I took her CRWT course and occasionally i still think about how great it was. she has no due dates and allows you to submit any # of assignments at any time and grades based on effort and gives feedback on your assignments. This lenient teaching style actually encouraged me to participate more than i normally would
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She's genuinely the best. So caring and passionate. Her "ungrading" structuring of the class makes to where you really get out what you put in with the class. She gives amazing feedback and is so approachable. I'd take every class I could with her. I can't sing her praises enough.

Where do I begin! Dr. Doyle is honestly one of best English professors you will encounter at UCR! She was so sweet and made the class so enjoyable. As mentioned below, her grading structure makes the class not stressful at all and the assignments are easy to do. Not to mention, the writing assignments were really enjoying to do!

Professor Doyle is the BEST. She gives students a variety of assignments to choose from, and students can essentially choose what to complete based on what grade they want in the class. She doesn't believe in grading - you get full credit or it gets sent back to you to revise! She is so accessible and caring, and her lectures are amazing. Love her.

I absolutely loved having Dr. Doyle this quarter for ENGL020C. Her "ungrading" scale took so much pressure off of the class and made me focus on actually enjoying working on assignments. Every lecture was worth attending. She gives you lots of freedom to create as you feel and it helped me so much with improving my writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: doesn't grade, all assignments are automatically 100% as long as its turned in. Def helps reduce anxiety about getting an As and makes you want to write.

Professor Doyle is very knowledgable, accessible, and caring. She's one of the best ENGL professors I've had. She accommodates for her students when they are struggling or trying to catch up, and she allows us to "customize" our workload with her ungrading system! I'd recommend all ENGL majors/minors to take her classes!

Professor Doyle is very passionate about her studies and super friendly and loves to get us to particiapte in discussion. The professor is part of a new teaching movement called "Ungrading the Syllabus" which basically means she gives you a grade based on the number of assignments you turn in rather than how "well" you do them

any English major at UCR is bound to tell you- she's the best professor you could ever have. its crazy how much she cares about her students psychological wellbeing. wish more professors were like her

One of my first and best professors I had at ucr. very caring and wholesome person, definetly get to know her outside of class. The material she gives is always v interesting/alternative, much to comment on. Overall if you want to pass just go to class and turn in your work.

I am so glad I had the chance to have prof Doyle as my professor. She is the epitome of a professor who does their job right. She respects and loves her students; she wants them to succeed and write about what they enjoy. This course didnt seem like those courses you dread to take. She made the papers and notes very enjoyable to write. Great prof.

Professor Doyle is very knowledgable about the concepts and theories in this course. The assignments comprised of: 2x "Turn in Your Notes  Exam" (15% each), "Unpacking Difficulty" (20%), "Final Essay" (25%), and "Discussion" (30%). She did go on tangents from time to time, but she cares greatly for her students. Very accessible outside of class.

This class is quite easy. You can get an A by doing the bare minimum as she is a bit unorganized but this works. For the midterm and final you just turn in notes, so those are free points, one assignment that is really simple, and a final essay which is also simple. Discussion is 30%, so participate there! Not much English in an ENGL class...

She is better than I thought. I was so happy because she canceled the final for the class and instead gave more points to the essay that was due at the end so that boosted my grade a lot. If you just do your essays on time and go to section, you will do fine in the class. It is reading heavy, but I never really read and still passed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: PROFESSOR DOYLE IS AN ANGEL!!!! She's genuinely passionate about the subject matter she teaches and she cares! The class of hers I took was really fun and the readings were interesting so they were easy to read and get the general jist of. It was literally one of my favorite classes at UCR.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lots of reading, but it is an English class. Only had to buy two of the books, cheap, gave rest to us online. Participation worth most, 25%, which is just talking during each discussion. Actually enjoyed going to lectures, very interesting, & she is so passionate! Great professor, if you pay attention and do the reading you will pass.

Professor Doyle is Amazing! She truly loves her job and cares about her students. Yes there is plenty of reading but its an English class what can you expect. Do the reading and show up to lecture and you will pass. She's very open to new ideas for essays and very linient. So nice that she cancelled our Final! We even saw a couple of movies! :)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Honestly, this class was super easy and Professor Doyle was really nice and generous and we even got our final cancelled! She's a little scatter brained with her lectures and goes from topic to topic really quickly so it gets confusing, but I really enjoyed the lectures. Lots of reading so I recommend going to lecture! Participation is also a must!

LOT'S OF READING! She tries to make it go quickly, so it's hard to keep up with it. Syllabus is not related to class, no clear understanding of what she wants out of assignments. She is very nice, and will try to make things more understanding, but you have to go to office hours for help if you really need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Though I have not finished the quarter, I have loved Professor Doyle since day one. She is very upbeat, quirky, and just so hard not to love. She really loves literature and you can tell by how passionate she gets during lecture when we are discussing the reading which is what I think a lot of professors lack, but that is why she stands out.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Doyle is the best thing that could have happened to UCR. If you invest the time in her class you will walk away a better academic and person. She is inspirational. I would take her class every quarter if I could.

Professor Doyle clearly loves what she teaches, and her enthusiasm was infectious. I loved having her as a professor and genuinely enjoyed most of the readings and assignments. Her teaching methods aren't your typical PowerPoint and lecture, but they were interesting and they worked. Would definitely recommend taking one of her classes.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Doyle is really enthusiastic about the topics she discusses in class. Make sure you do the readings or else you would be very bored and fall asleep. She gives very good feedback on your essays (total of 3) and she encourages creativity in writing.

Professor Doyle was great personality wise. However, this class was not the best. At times, it was hard to follow the material and keep up in class. Despite this, she was accommodating to students who needed feedback on written work and created many forums for students to discuss the material. This class was mostly about gender rather than sports.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She doesn't really teach, she mostly spent lecture having conversations with her TA while the class just listened. I wouldn't really recommend her, not a lot of work, just a lot of reading, she doesn't give a lot of chances to earn participation points, 3 papers, and just a final that was more like a quiz
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Engaging lectures,  good at getting back to you. It was a Sports Lit class. As for textbooks, I didn't buy anything, she posted some online, then I got rest from county library free :) 3 short essays (300, 600, and 1000 words), easy final if you did readings, maybe 5 quizzes in class. She was open to creativity and encouraging! Take this class!

Professor Doyle is one of the most caring professors I ever had. She genuinely cares about her students' progress in learning. Her lectures are eye-opening and entertaining. She's also very enthusiastic about what she teaches.

Recommended! Excellent educator, super brilliant and always communicative and helpful with students. Two short papers and one large group research project. Participation 25%.  In short: If you like stimulating conversation and are OK with research, this class could be for you. Note: Read course description! Subject-matter may not be for everyone.

Doyle seemed to be more interested in art galleries than class. She would often cancelend class early to attend to other priorities and was not conventional in her teaching. Our assignment was a group research project and the lectures were unstructured (not at all corresponding to our research). The textbooks were expensive and irrelevant.

Very jarring class, but if you're at all interested in the relevance of critical theory take 20C with Doyle. She is probably the best lecturer at UCR, so even if you disagree with her politics, showing up is still a great pleasure.

Honestly if your an English Major you will either love or hate her. She doesn't stick to the canon at all and most of the works deal with similar themes of racial and gender equality.Also has a very specific focus on LGBT works and not much else. If you enjoy these subjects shes the professor for you if not then you can do well as its an easy class
Easy A class! If you attend every lecture and have some ideas about the time periods of the literary texts, you will definitely get an A!

Be prepared for a history lesson. She is an Okay professor but would do a better Job in the History Department, or even Philosophy. Yet you should attend lecture, but if you don't you'll be fine. The midterm was super easy, you don't have to answer all of the questions to get an A. Pay attention You'll be fine.

Great teacher, extensive vocabulary, but her teaching methods are not for everybody. So much group work that I started to feel very overwhelmed at the amount of time I had to spend on it outside of class,especially after one of our group members dropped it... Wouldn't recommend it.

She is an amazing professor! The material shown in class was awesome-and she really does engage you in it and actually learn. She is very helpful and always makes time for students to help you. Her TA'S are amazing as well. The class is not an easy A, attendance and readings are EXTREMELY important.

Professor Doyle is a fantastic teacher. She is passionate about what she teaches, and she passes along insight to students. There is alot of reading, but it just adds to the experience. Exams and assignments are secondary, and even those were enjoyable. Take Professor Doyle's class if you actually want to learn something from a brilliant instructor

Doyle is passionate about what she is teaching, granted the topics are often a little self-servicing, but she chooses subject matter that everyone should be exposed to (however taboo). She is incapable of giving clear directions, but the TA's are aware of this and act as remedial instruction givers. Assignments are easy, just go in open minded!

She is the absolute WORST teacher I have ever had at UCR. She turned my english 20B class into a class solely about her! If this were a class about her, I could definitely get an A, in terms of an english class...GOOD LUCK

Prof. Doyle is passionate about what she teaches. I loved the fact that she went out of her way to teach academia standards as well as material many would dub irrelevant. She inspires her students to excel and reach their full potential. Her pedagogy may be some what all over the place; however this is her style of teaching and it works for her.

She's a great lecturer - the info is fascinating & she's absolutely hilarious & charismatic. Her energy keeps the lectures entertaining. She does give you a lot of work though. Make sure that you ATTEND CLASS. I cannot stress enough how important attendance is in her class. Work hard, put in the effort, and you will learn so much.
uses the class to spread her marxist politics... should be a poli sci teacher not an english literature teacher, there is no literature in her class.

Very exciting to listen to. I wish I had taken her class earlier, it would have taken me to a whole other plane of thinking. She's so fun when she lectures; her mind works too fast for me to writ notes on. I admire her so much! (supah cute ;)
Her love for literature explodes with passion in her lectures.  She is a fair grader and is very funny.
She is a brilliant researcher, an amazing teacher, and a kind soul.  Her classes are well worth while for any student.
Class sucks. Easy, but pointless.

Amazing techer: style, knowledge, books, and everything else about the class was great! All the materials she assigns are wonderfully difficult but always wonderful. The more you do, the more you will get out of it. If you don't read and don't understand that is your problem; she encourages office hours and is ALWAYS responsive to RELATIVE e-mails.

class not what i expected: not a traditional teaching of satire. we dealt almost exclusively with race and gender. doyle is energetic, but her lack of organized lectures really bothered me. hard to take notes. office hours a problem, either too busy or not there, and she didn't email back regularly. thought class was boring and a waste of my time

She is a fascinating lecturer, very interesting and very energetic. I learned so much from her and she strengthened me as a writer. She assigns a huge amount of reading, but most of it you don't have to do to get a good grade in the class.

Doyle's class is fun!  She brings a lot of energy into the room.  Its fun to just watch as she goes off on a tangent, still relevant to the material, while answering questions.  The difficulty of the class is up to you, its hard if you do all the reading. She is extremely helpful in office hours and understanding so she is flexible about deadlines.

I took her for several classes, all easy A's, don't even have to read much of the material, show up to class, pick a line out of a text and you can have your paper done in no time. I am now just catching up on her assigned reading and I graduated 5 years ago.

Although there was a lot of work involved (reading and writing), she was lenient on grading and very helpful!  She's also soooo much fun (and very funny too!)  I loved her so much I'm taking another class with her next quarter!
This professor was slick!! Even though I read comparative literature texts in my sleep, this class was something that transcends mere time and space. Very cool. Can you say "GPA Boost"?

She is a very sweet teacher. She is flexible with her assignments and interesting. She is funny and understanding. I just took this class and I am taking another one of her classes next quarter. She's truly a sweetheart!
Loved her classes... taking another of hers this quarter!

Prof. Doyle is the greatest teacher ever! She is flexible and helpful along with being funny and interesting in lectures. She has one of the greatest minds in 19th Century Am. Lit. and Lit. and Sexuality. Take her classes as many times as possible!
No Comments

smart lady.  funny lady.  she is very willing to help and is always up for exploring themes related to anything learned in class for paper topics.  a bit jittery and tweaks out on coffee often...but that adds to her charm.
No Comments

Doyle is completely disorganized and passive aggressive.  She talks incessantly and rants off topic for over half the class, which she claims is centered on student discussion.  Then, she  yells at the students for not talking enough.  We discussed almost none of the material each week.  Horrible, ineffective, narcissistic, speed freak.
She is way understanding, enthusiastic and classes are a breeze, just show up to class and you can get an A
She was a very energetic and witty teacher.  But she can be picky and demanding.  In any case, the class wasn't as difficult as I expected.

very interesting and empathetic. cares about your learning and understanding. funny and quirky. show up to class everyday and you'll do fine. material is a little difficult but she is always willing to help you understand.
She is so great, in so many way. Good about everything, read it makes the class better.

Professor Doyle is very innovative with the points brought up in class. If you are having trouble with critical reading of texts, then she will most likely lay out an excellent blueprint for you that you can follow just from listening to her spin on the novels.
was very energetic, but highly disorganized. I did not learn one thing from her class: I'm not sure she put anytime into thinking about what she was going to discuss before coming to class

Very interesting professor.  Came to each class on a coffee high, very interesting and open. The reading isn't necessary for a passing grade if you just pay attention.  She was even so merciful as to let my friend and I make up for the final we missed, a true saint!
Awesome teacher. Very funny, understanding, open to her students' ideas. Very different from what I was used to.
she is a great speaker and lively. Her T.A Dane Barca, is awesome.He is very helpful, and nice.

I've taken several classes with Prof. Doyle and have found she is the best and the smartest of all the English taechers at U.C.R. She is helpful, really makes sure you understand the material and never puts you down. She actually cares about her students!
Great at explaining stuff, and always on a coffee buzz!!!
she is a mezmerizing speaker. great teacher; listen to her and you'll learn a lot!
No Comments
Not bad, if you get on her good side early on and you talk during class you shouldn't have trouble.

I enjoyed the lectures I learned so many new things. The assignments were pretty great it was like as if you were an ethnographer. He seems very passionate as well and gives great feedback on the assignments
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The course is very straightforward as far as learning objectives and expectations by prof. Duong. As long as you do the readings, attend lecture and engage with the content, you will pass. Even if you don't do the full reading, he always provides a powerpoint recap. Midterm&final are both online with clear instructions and grading criteria.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Do not take him! His lectures are not related to the course. Lectures are repeated and extremely boring, you will not learn anything. He leaves long homework's. You get bored by looking at him I don't even know why he is a professor honestly. He is extremely rude when it comes to answering emails and questions. Once again do not take
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Probably the easiest class you could take at UCR, I only showed up to one class and still got an A. While attendance is mandatory, just join the Zoom, fill out the poll everywhere, then dip. The midterm/final are both online and are mainly multiple choice problems with 2 free response questions you can write out before you take the exam.

Very easy class and professor, but I do not think we learned anything. The lectures were repetitive, did not cover new content and were extremely slow. This class is simple, but does not have any direction. And papers and assignments are graded on sentence requirement like we are in the 5th grade again

The class was interesting and the assignments are simple. As long as you do them, you will do fine in the class. Very clear grading criteria. Overall, a decent professor. Only downside is that he is a bit monotone which can make you sleepy but he is nice.

I'm a high GPA student and have not seen such a professor in my educational career. Took forever to grade exams that were written poorly and graded harshly. YES!! Hard exams, poor written, very in depth. Lots of readings here and there that confuse the students as far as the source of the questions. Very late on grading papers. Just terrible

He was straightforward with what he expected and his exams were based off of his lectures and the textbook. If you pay attention and read the textbook it's a relatively easy and interesting class. Puts a lot of care into his lectures and slides.

Super easy class, just read the book and the supplemental readings before class and you'll be fine. He provides study guides and extra credit. Allows you to miss 3 classes (attendance points given). It's interesting but the material can be dense.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easy class, but boring. He graded off a point system, and only assigned in class assignments, a midterm, a final, attendance and an easy 3-5 single spaced research essay. On both the exams, the questions were word for word from the textbook. Although the context of the course may be boring, his thoughts and arguments were very well put.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Tough grader

reviews.comment: His lectures are based off the book, if you read and show up to classes (has attendance points) youll pass. Had one term paper due at week 10 and one midterm one final. Has in class assignments that are just two questions. Honestly not a hard class just boring
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Duong is one of the best professor that I have had so far. The readings are enjoyable and thoroughly deal with the topic of the class. His exams are very straightforward, he does not trick you. The in-class assignments/discs. were nice because we were allowed to express our opinion. He is very knowledgeable and I enjoyed taking his class.

I attended class every week. He gives two free days to skip and have it not affect your attendance grade. I failed both the midterm and the final, but still got a B+ in the class. You can take notes to both exams. The final paper is a one-two page cover letter to a grad program. He is very well versed and confident in his material. Easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: she is a great person super friendly and make you feel seen. there is alot of reading assigned but honestly you can just skim it as you review it in class as well. there is a ton of extra credit its amazing. alot of assignments too but just try a little and you'll be fine.

Shes super nice and strives to make class fun. There is alot of assigned reading but honestly you can just skim it and you go over it in class anyways. There is a new assignment everyday but as long as you try ur fine. a ton of extra credit its amazing. she sets us up to succeed.
Professor Garcia is a great human being, she cares for her students and gives extra credit as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Did not like this class at first because of the amount of participation required, but got close with my classmates. Dulce makes sure to know everyone's name and wants you to do well. I always left that class in a better mood and haven't communicated with an instructor this much since high school. There is five percent extra credit you can get too!

I am taking her for Spanish 3 currently and she's an extremely nice Professor. I don't remember much from the previous Spanish classes but she never puts me on the spot or judges me for not knowing the material. Very kind and caring lady. Definitely would recommend taking Spanish with her over someone else.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!! Professor Garcia is such a great, wonderful, and understanding person. She increases your desire to attend class because of her positive attitude. She makes sure that students feel welcome. There is a bit of homework, readings, and quizzes, but it is easy. PLEASEEE take a class with Prof Garcia! You will LOVEE her class.

She was very sweet and funny. Her class was really easy and she and she offers a lot of extra credit. She had 2 online test that were graded easy. She also excuses 2 absences and isn't strict on homework.

I LOVE Dulce. She is by far the best Spanish professor and has so much energy with her students. If you are able to take her class, don't hesitate. She's really passionate for what she teaches and loves to help out her students. Easy A! Only downside is that the department assigns a lot of homework.

She's one of my favorite Spanish teachers, we switched to online learning for her class and she was understanding, accessible, and caring about her students. I believe the only reason she was not more lenient was because of the overall instructor but she's was great teacher who always had a smile on her face and really cared if we learned.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: dulce is super nice and helpful but the class itself was V difficult. there was homework EVERYDAY and the tests were graded really harshly. I would recommend only taking this class if u have an easy schedule because trust it's gonna take up your whole quarter. I've never had so many mental breakdowns over a class before
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I absolutely love Dulce. She is my favorite spanish teacher I have had at UCR. I took a 7 am class so she could be my teacher and I commute one hour. She cares tremendously about her students, explains every detail with tons of patience, and if I could take her for the third time, I would.  With a very strict department, she makes passing possible

she's REALLY NICE & EXTREMELY helpful. the people who said she grades "hard" are tripping.. seriously, it's a part of the grading rubric that's given to her. OVERALL, SHE'S EXTREMELY NICE, HELPFUL, AVAILABLE WHEN YOU NEED HELP & SHE'LL ANSWER ANY QUESTION THAT YOU HAVE. you should definitely take any spanish course with her!
you must take her...hands down one of the best teachers at UCR

A decent teacher... but she grades really hard. You miss an accent mark and it's like you killed someone.... she's a nice lady and goes out of her way to help you... unless she's grading. You need to be perfect otherwise she will find something wrong with your work.... SHE IS PICKY... if you can... don't take her
Presently in class. Although having a difficult time, Dulce goes out of her way to help me succeed. Wish I could have her for Spanish 2, 3, and 4.

I loved having Dulce for Spanish 3. She makes learning fun and she acts out the words she's trying to get you to understand. It's hilarious. She really cares about teaching the students and wants all of her students to do well. She's always saying "Ven a mis horas de oficina!!" Her class was so much fun!!!
Very good teacher to have for any spanish 1 2 or 3 class.  Very helpful and wants all her students to do good in her class. Funny too!!

The professor is nice but has a difficult grading scheme with no partial credit for multi-part questions. My TA, Satish, was unresponsive and unhelpful. Despite maintaining a 98% throughout the quarter, the "non-high stakes final," worth 20% of the grade and only 4 questions long, dropped my grade to a C.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: feels like prof durham's trying to ensure students get an a with his grading system. little homework; weekly quizzes that you get three tries for; final only 14% grade; no midterm. aims for students' understanding. style of teaching may seem disorganized like others have said but i found it fine. definitely recommend; very stress free class

Just finished the winter quarter with him and at first, I thought I was going to have the worst class of my life. Since he was definitely disorganized, and we had a quiz from the first of class all the way through to the end of the quarter. Overall, it is an easy course, but its more frustrating more than anything since he his a bit underwhelming.

Please do yourself a favor and just don't take him. I am lucky enough to have had a great professor for the math class prior to 9B who taught me all I needed to know for this class but Durham is such an ineffective teacher. And I say this honestly and not spitefully because he is a nice person.

had him for 9b and hes chill asf. his handwriting sucks but if u go to the lectures you'll be fine. lot of in class activities which help with new material. gives a lot of time for hw and its short. if u need help go to the online textbook bc he gets most of his material from there

Mathew Durham is a fair and caring professor. Even though his lectures can sometimes be boring, it is helpful for homework and especially the midterm. I don't understand how you would not pass this class unless you skipped lecture. HIS LECTURES ARE MANDATORY! He doesn't say it is, but if you skip them, you're in for a whole world of hurt.

Although Professor Durham is definitely not an easy class, the class is definitely passable. If you attend the lectures and discussions, you will pass. Also, he is very caring and aware of his students' situations because of covid and the protests around the nation right now and made substantial accommodations to relieve stress during these times.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I don't know what the other reviews are on about but Mathew Durham is a fair and caring professor. His lectures, although boring, are pretty helpful and if you pay attention and actually applied what you learned from his class, the homework and midterm were no problem at all. The people that are failing are people that probably skip lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: - spring2020 covid-19 lockdown terrible at teaching. explanations during lectures are hard to understand (lots of uh's, um's, pauses in the middle of the sentence, loses train of thought very often). only gives 1-2 examples for the numerous sequence/series tests in 9c. avg for midterm was 64.8. doesnt seem prepared. better off watching youtube vids

Terrible teacher. Does not know how to teach series and sequences. His lectures are pointless. Just go onto youtube or google it. He can be hostile to students. He's very monotone and dry so it's hard to stay awake or pay attention. He's ignored my questions in lectures multiple times. Stay away from Durham if you can. Terrible professor 0/10

Matthew cannot teach at all. He gets overly distracted and forgets what he is saying in the middle. He doesn't reply to all of this student's emails and seems to ignore them. In class, Matthew does not explain concepts thoroughly but expects us to know and understand topics on our own. His tests are okay. I would not recommend taking calc with him

Worst math professor I've taken at UCR so far. He's inconsiderate of his students. For our midterm he made it on crowdmark. There was no timer so it was up to us to time ourselves for 70 mins. He never told us this. He proceeded to email us to tell us that he repeatedly let us know of this issue. He keeps making things up that is irresponsible.

She is the best. An amazing person. The advanced classes will feature a lot of reading but she is more than willing to support you. I have taken 3 classes with her. One time, I straight up just forgot to submit a midterm assignment. After a few days, she reached out to me and asked if I was okay since I am usually a good student.
I want to be her when I'm older

(Took this class during the pandemic) She organized the class well, always sent encouraging emails, made the class more interesting by suggesting French films, and offered alot of extra credit opportunities. Her grading is fair. She really cares for her student's understanding of the course and made sure she was someone we could go to.

Prof. Duverg? is a great professor. She really encourages you to speak and learn the language without fear, which is essential for the course. She makes the class interesting and tries to focus on each student individually. If you show you are trying, she takes it into account when grading you.

Professor Duverge is great! She is very clear and her lectures are always neatly presented. She is a fantastic professor who is serious and cares about her students and their understanding of the material, awesome prof would love to continue with her.

Professor Duverge is on of the best professors at the foreign language dept. No other professor would want their students to succeed as much as she does. This professor is very dedicated and serious. She knows her material very well and does not waste any time. Inspirational! Take her class if you have an option! HIGHLY HIGHLY HIGHLY recommended!!

Professor Duverg?  is an amazing professor. She is inspirational, caring, and smart. I enjoyed every single class I took with her (FREN 04, FREN 15A, and FREN 15B) and I wish that I had time to take more classes with her. She is very helpful and makes all the material interesting.
AMAZING PROFESSOR.

Duvergé has done it again. She is an amazing professor who is incredibly intelligent when it comes to literary analysis, although she is a little demented, she will keep your interest in the French Language alive. She's such a sweetheart and very caring, very approachable. I would higly suggest Duvergé, best professor ever@

Amazing Professor! She taught the medieval literature and the Renaissance poetry in a way that was simple to understand. Participation and attendance is a must though. Not easy to get an A though, you must work hard for it.

Requires in class participation, otherwise she becomes a bit upset. You have to present your essay in class. She is awesome though. She may seem a bit intimidating at first, but she is one of the sweetest professors I've ever had. She is incredibly gorgeous!! :]
She is a hard teacher but she does her best to teach in way that all her students understand what she is teaching. Stay on top of your readings and do well on the tests you will get at least an A-.

She's great! I love the way she teaches, it's just so logical and clear. She gives a fair amount of essays, and is a fair grader. She tries her best to make a non native speaker understand the intricacies of the French language.
Fantastic professor. Always helpful and clear. She always keeps the interest of the class with her choices of film and literature. And she's gorgeous. Haha.
The best professor I have ever had. I never knew a professor could actually be this amazing! She was engaging, funny, sympathetic, and was just fabulous. Loved her!!

Professor Duverge is an absolutely brilliant professor. My class was literary analysis heavey and she understood the difficulty of writing in a second language. She really gave us the tools write elegantly in French.

She was a great French teacher! Having placed right into French 4 after not taking 3 years of French I was a bit scared but she made it very comfortable and not awkward at all. Great pace of the class and was very understanding if you "forgot" your HW. No oral exams - which was great! Only had to contribute your answers to questions about the book.
My first french class ever taken at UCR. She was really easy she was very clear in her lectures. HW was not that bad it was a lot, but I guess that helps. I would recommend prof. duverge.

I adore Professor Duverge! You know all the stereotypes about French women- intelligent, beautiful, stylish, confident- that describes her perfectly. She is very helpful and always willing to clarify. There was a good amount of reading and writing, but she thoroughly goes over the material. Easily the best French professor I've had.
Great professor, best french teacher I have ever had!  Grades fairly, quite a bit of work but I suppose it helps.

Duverge is great! She's very intense and fast-paced though, so if you don't keep up with the work you will fall behind. I had her for French 2 & 4, and like her a lot. Go to every class and participate and you'll be fine! She's super nice too, so if you have problems you can talk to her. She appears intimidating at first though.

she was a great teacher. Not too hard, but she gives enough work to make sure you know what you are doing. Super hot, and makes class a joy to attend. If u can take her do it, best french teacher ive ever had

Prof. Duverge is the best French professor I've had at UCR.  Her classes are always interesting anf literature/film heavy (which I liked).  both classes I've taken with her- French 04 and French 15B- have been heavy on essays and reading, but they haven't been extraordinarily difficult and certainly contributed to my knowledge of the language.
Great French Professor. Makes class as interesting and fun as possible. Totally chill as long as work is done.

Christine's a great professor. Lectures are interesting and entertaining to go to. Midterms were pretty straightforward, and didn't have any tricky questions or anything too hard. Online homework was a little excessive, but you benefit from it. Like all French classes, the class is only hard if you don't study. And yes, she is pretty hot.
She is by far the best french teacher i have ever had, and she is super hot! She sort of makes me excited to go to french class 4 days a week.

A fantastic professor (and easy on the eyes to boot), you won't dread coming to her class four days a week like you might with some other foreign language classes. Totally helpful and approachable, I was very lucky to have her.

She's a very nice and enthusiatic professor.  If you try in her class you can easily get an B or A except in French 4 is a lot more tougher so I got a C.  There's nothing scary about her and she's in her 30s and she's HOT!  I'm saying that and I'm a girl.  You'll enjoy french with her!
No Comments
No Comments

I've had Mme. Duverge in French 4, 15b, 150W, and now 101C. She is amazing. She is so devoted to teaching her students and turns every classroom into a safe community where we are challenged to think. She is humorous and concerned, and is very personable in office hours. I couldn't say a single bad thing about her. She is simply phenomenal!
A very good professor, very helpful and the class was interesting although at times it seemed a bit repetitive because it was the same thing almost everyday.  Really good prof though.
This professor is sensational. She is smart, has a great teaching method, and she is loved by all her students. She is the most charming lady ever, beautiful intellect and personality.
Im drooling. In this class u wanna do the hw! She is a rare breed. She is hot and smart.
she is smoking hot..........

Prof Duverge was intimidating on the first day. It seemed like she was a slave driver, but all her assignments really do help you improve in french. She's an awesome and understanding teacher. I would recommend her to annyone taking french.

On the first day, she seemed intimidating. But she is so not. She doesn't give you too much where you can't handle it. She doesn't pick on you or call on you when she knows you can't answer. I liked that part about her. She's really kind and helpful. Take her for French.

Great professor! I would recommend anyone to take her if you would like someone who speaks french correctly and truly cares about each student. Her course actually teaches you something valuable! She is also a very nice and caring person.
I would never have made it through French 4 if it wasn't for this professor.  She was so helpful and encouraging, never intimidating.  Take this professor!
Prof. Duverge is an awesome instructor.  She really cares about the students understanding the material.
She is very nice and concerned about the students, definately take her.
The best professor hands-down, very nice, very understanding, and very good grader. Her feedback was great and she's very flexible. Highly recommend if you can have her!

Her contract grading technique make things a lot more flexible and it's really not a hard concept to follow. The readings she gives out are really good and she definitely helps students prepare for essays. Really understanding towards her students. It's really not that hard to pull of an A in her class.

She does provide a lot of reading, but it is entertaining and relevant. She is absolutely wonderful, super understanding, humorous, and is easy to reach outside of class. Her assignments are fun and don't even really feel like you're doing much work. Definitely the one course I looked forward too because the environment was not stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Tara is the best Professor hands down. She is young, passionate and understanding. She gives great feedback AND willing to give extension if students need it. She is honestly the best professor Ive ever had TRUST ME! She really cares for her students and their health so she advocates for mental health and take it easy.

Tara was a very caring and understanding teacher. The workload was not bad and she graded fairly easy. She gave extremely good feedback and helped you develop your thoughts whether it was during class time or in her office hours. 10/10 RECOMMEND!
She is an easy grader and allows for extensions. Wish I could have her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Awesome professor! He genuinely wants students to pass and goes out of his way to have extra study sessions and reviews prior to midterms and finals. If you seek his help outside of class your grade will certainly show it.

Econ2 is not the easiest class in the world, so straight off the bat you'll have to put some effort into it to earn the grade you want. Dymski is a very great speaker and he'll inspire you on many levels. He was always available for help and even hosts his own study sessions before midterm and finals. There was also a curve.

Dymskie is not the best teacher. His tests were beyond dumb because they did not cover most of the things he taught. You HAVE to read every chapter he assigns or you will be screwed. He has insanely huge curves because the class midterm averages are usually around 50%-68%. I got a B+ almost A- Disliked the teacher and learned absolutely nothing.

He uses clicker. The questions for midterms and final will mostly be from the homework. But the book he assigned was RIDICULOUS. And the analyzing and graphing part too. He does have a curve, but the grade range were really small. Overall, don't take if you want an easy class.
Mr. Dymski is super hot! He made class so worth it.

Professor Dymski is a hell of a guy! Really wants you to succeed.  He's an easy grader with huge curves on both mid terms and the final. The subject is a bit difficult if you don't keep up, uses funny clicker questions for attendance. Definitely recommend getting him :)
Amazing professor. Very interesting to listen to and talk to if you ever get the chance to. Class is not too difficult, not too difficult to get an A.

He knows a lot and would use up all of the class time to cover his slides. Homework and attendance (in lec and dis) are very important. His midterms are hard, however he would have big curves to make sure no one truly fails. He's willing to help everyone. Managed to get an A- in the class!

Dymski was a really nice professor, and he truly cared about how his students did, hence the curves on the midterms/final. HW and attendance is worth alot, so make sure you do it. Powerpoints are all online. Also there r clicker points!

Professor Dymski is a great professor and doesn't just go by the book like some teachers do. He makes people is very encouraging. He is very helpful during review sessions. I recommend you go to his office hours. he will definitely help you. Going to SI helps you understand the material covered in class.
super hard. read, read, read, read. attend class. he take attendance with clickers. what he talks about in class will be on your exams. pay attention. hard class though.. passing with low C -__-

Dymski is a BEAST. He trys to make it fair for everyone. Exams are curved and he trys not to fail anyone. Some Lectures are Boring and some are interesting. I didnt really use the textbook due to going to office hours and Supplimental Instruction. Overall, Dymski is a nice guy and will take care of you grade wise.

Mr. Dymski is a hard econ professor.  However, he does curves the exams.  You do have to attend and participate in every lecture, discussion, and do well on the homework in order to pass the course.  Also, I noticed that Mr. Dymski is a Keynesian economist.  In fact, he admitted it in one of his lectures.  Overall, Dymski is a nice person.

If you plan on skipping this class then your pretty much screwed. He writes stuff on the board which you MUST know. Read the book, go over the power points, and attend class. He uses clickers for attendance and you recieve points for those and they slowly start adding up. His tests arent easy but there are curves. Stay focused and youll be fine!

I cried after taking second midterm. I have never taken such a hard class before in my life. The first class average for the first midterm was a solid D and the best part is that there wasn't really a curve because we "earned" what we got. Broke my moral for attending college. Worst quarter of my life. I think I might cry again thinking about it.

I think he is a great professor. Not only does he teach you about the course, but about life lessons and great techniques and strategies towards becoming successful. I'm so glad that I have him as a professor. He encourages me to proceed in my major! Gets boring, but all professors are... tests are a little tricky, but reasonable

Attendance is a must because you will have clicker quizzes. He's a fair man. You must read before going to lecture or else you will not know what he's talking about! The tests are hard and it's impossible to do the hw without reading. He focuses in world events, so read the Financial Times. SI sessions highly recommended!
Dymski knows what he's talking about, he just sometimes has a hard time explaining everything fully. His lecture slides can be confusing at times, but if you do the readings, you'll be fine.

he's a funny and nice guy, but class was boring and we had lots clicker Qs. i fell asleep in about 75% of them. he's new at teaching this course at this school but he has a lot of experience. unfortunately, he was trying to feed too much info too fast. exams were not hard but not easy, and as an intro class, he expected a little more than normal.
Very hard, but very helpful.  Really nice guy who is really concerned about fairness to everybody.
Professor Dymski is a nice guy but not the best professor. His lectures are confusing but the tests are easy. There are clickers so attendance is mandatory.

You have to read in order to get through the class, because I didn't I ended up with a C+ from...what I know from my own knowlegde! His lectures slides are always confusing for reviewing for the midterm or to follow in lectures. REQURIED attendance, EVERYDAY!!!! I think if you decide to take ECON002, you should him instead of the Indian Lady.

He's a funny guy, but his class is super hard, because he except you to follow him through the class and he fk'd because his syllabus says "Midterm 2 Ch 11-15" so I read it ahead of time and I was skeptical, because we didnt learn this in class yet! So I emailed him and he says trust him on the Review Sheet which said Ch 5-10. FAIL!! ):

Really cool teacher, really fun class! Must attend every lecture, he utilized clickers (although they're more for your learning). Do the readings, do the homeworks. He's really funny too. Sit in the front of class so he knows your face.  He'll CALL OUT people in a big lecture room who are talking. It's hilarious. I got a solid A in the class.

The professor is a nice guy who attempts to be funny, but you can tell he is very knowledgeable about the economy. His lectures are boring and often diverge off from what needs to be covered in lecture. 2 midterms and one final, and the final was WAY easier in comparison to the first 2 midterms. I personally do not recommend him. You'll regret it.

I had Dr. Dymski while participating in UCCS.  I actually have a different opinion about him than the previous poster.  Dr. Dymski is a very approachable person.  He is open to anything and willing to help you out in any way that he can.  He shows a true interest in who you are and wehre you came from.  He's definitely a good professor.  Take him.

This teacher is awesome.  I took him for two classes about 10 years ago.  I don't remember exactly the names, Urban planning and another one, Banking and Finance.  I don't know what the other poster is talking about, unless he has changed in the last 10 years.  Perhaps that poster rec'd a bad grade because he or she is an idiot.

If I never have to hear another thing about urban planning and housing, I will be the happiest person alive. This guy is a closeted bigot who thinks he's ethnic just because his lover is from South America. -Only talks about what HE wants to talk about and is solely on the liberal agenda, not presenting any other side to the story. I'm unimpressed.

Prof. Rodriguez is passionate about educating students on the disparities affecting communities of color. We had a big group project on advocating for the formerly incarcerated. This class was so enlightening, and the readings were interesting. Prof is very cool and keeps you engaged. Pop quizzes on readings and all readings were provided free
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Respected

reviews.comment: MCs 160No exams only pop quizzes, amazing lecture but the reading is quite hard

By far the best professor I have taken at UCR. He literally changed my life and viewpoint on the world and I am so grateful I ended up in his class. The class was very conversational. Take home essays for the midterm and final. There's a lot of reading so be prepared! Overall, a great professor and person.

Prof Rodriguez is very passionate about his field of study if your taking this for an easy A this is not the class for you HOWEVER if you really want to know why racism still exists in this country today and where it all steams from this is perfect. Open note open book test you will learn a lot!

Prof. Rodriquez is a very passionate teacher and I definitely recommend going to all lectures because his midterm and final questions revolve around definitions and key points that he gives during lecture. Yes there is a lot of reading, did I read every word from the 600+ pages he assigned? No. Skim, make notes for the open book tests  A.

Dylan is extremely passionate about the stuff he teaches and I love that but his class is ridiculously hard!! He expects you to read all the material he assigns.He assigns a lot of reading be prepared when you take his class,he is not an easy grader. Cool guy but his class was ridiculously hard. I scratched a C+ and I did just about everything

I've taken 2 classes with him and DO NOT expect any of his classes to be easy. LOTS AND LOTS of reading, always. Very biased about race and tries to force his views on you. Uses really hard vocabulary in lectures that's hard to understand. But in my upper div class, he's not a hard grader so just work hard to get through the readings!

One of the most amazing professors you will ever have the privilege of meeting. Every one of his lectures is as emotionally provocative as an MLK speech. He teaches you knowledge that can be used to making this world a better place.

He speaks with such a large vocabulary its like i have to spend two minutes trying to decipher every single thing he says. It might be impossible to understand what he's saying witout a good explination from your ta. Readings are ridiculous, wayy too much. But pay attention to what the TA says and do allll readings. I got an A+ so itsnot impossible

Lots of readings. Hard to understand, but if you ask questions he'll be more than happy to explain. VERY VERY TEDIOUS WORK, but I learned so much from this class. You will definitely see things in a different light after taking this course.. Main tips on getting a good grade - GO TO ALL HIS LECTURES, make use of discussion, AND DO THE READINGS!

If you're looking for an easy A, I don't recommend this class. There is a lot of reading and if you fall behind, it is almost impossible to catch up. But it is defiantly an interesting class though.  Sections are helpful, so are his office hours. If you are a dedicated student, I recommend this class. Good luck!

The class was interesting. A LOT of reading, 1st test was hard, the rest were easy. He is very helpful and likes talking to students. He has a high vocab & at times it's hard to understand but once you read your notes you realize it's not so difficult to understand. Great professor! He definitely opened my eyes, recommend this class 4 hard workers

Professor Rodriguez is a really good profsor! Yes, the readings are alot, but if you make study groups and dedicate some time to studying, you will pass, i have an A! Go to lecture, read and discussion and you'll get an A or B!

This professor is tough. He requires over a thousand pages of reading.He requires you to do all of the readings which on top of other classes is extremely time consuming. His lectures are hard to keep up with and overall this class was tough.

The amount of reading you have to do is ridiculous, so beware before taking this class. He seems like he's passionate about what he teaches, but that doesn't make the class any easier. The reading is interesting, but extremely time consuming.
Hes a good professor, and loves teaching his class is pretty interesting and the midterms arent that hard you just have to read and the reading are worth reading. Take the class.

The good thing is that he's very passionate about what he teaches. However, the amount of readings you'll have to do will be extremely overwhelming! His lectures are hard to understand because he doesn't get to the point and uses difficult words. To do well, it is a MUST to join a big study group and divide the work!

I was so lucky to have passed this class. The only reason why I passed was because we formed study groups and studied our bottoms off. He makes you buy five books that all talk about the same thing just different races. He also makes you print a 600 page course reader that you hardly use. Don't take if you want an easy A

Fall 10 of this class was super lucky. We setted up a huge study groups and made study guides together n met up n studied. I pretty much didn't read at all but I still got an A-. I tried to study with ppl to understand what was going on on the books. He's a good professor..but it was a huge midstake to make us read all that(which i didnt)He's smart

Do not take Ethnic Studies if you are looking for an easy A. Professor Rodriguez definitely made it hard for students to get an A. There are 200-300 pages of reading each week and we have to print around 1000 pages ourselves. His wording is confusing.

He is passionate about the subject he teaches, but he is very incomprehensible. Uses tons of huge vocabulary that makes it hard to understand any of his lectures. Assigns heavy reading. It is easy to pass the class but you have to work hard and make sure you study and do ALL the readings.

Very good professor. He is passionate and knows his stuff. I enjoyed this class, but got kind of overwhelmed by all the readings. If your taking this class be sure to keep up with the readings and don't fall behind!
Rodriguez is very smart..he knows what he's talking about..be prepared to read more than 300 pages a week!! Interesting class overall

Tries to brainwash everyone. Occasionally, someone will challenge his point of views but he puts them down or makes it seems like they don't understand. Thinks everything is influenced by "white supremacy". He thinks by using fancy words during lecture to make it seems hes always right.
Wow...you will have no life in here
2 much reading.
Hard Class...lots of reading.
do not take this class if ur taking it just as a breadth.  way too much work for just an intro class.  he likes to hear himself speak
Terrible

worst professor ever! Him and the TAs try to convince you that white are horrible people and if you don't believe that there is something wrong with you. There is too much reading and his lectures are incomprehensible. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!

Dang I hate this guy. He literally assigns 300 pages of reading a week. this is supposed to be an INTRO LOWER LEVEL class but it feels like an upper division course. his tests are insane you have to look through about 600 pages of reading to answer short answer questions. his lectures are incomprehensible he goes too fast. he is arrogant and rude
Horrible. Worst professor ever.

Professor Rodriguez is undoubtedly inspiring and absolutely passionate and engaging.He has studied and analyzed the United States in terms of racial and ethnic injustices, preserved its records, and absorbed the lessons and problems, of our history. I thought I would hate the class... but I ended up in love. You either hate him or love him!

Really cool professor! Assigns heavy reading, takes attendence in lectures if not a lot of people show up, at the end of the quarter he gave a couple open note quizzes on the readings because he felt like no one was doing them.  Only 3 papers and that's the only work you have to do.

one of the best professors i've ever had. go to class and take lots of notes and use them as a reference when writing your essays. when writing essays, also make sure to think critically yourself. he's also friendly and great to have as a professor.
This class was uber interesting, but if you're not ready to think outside of the box and act like a theorist, you will struggle with the essays...
He gives a lot of work. Be ready to work your ass off.  The good news is he is easy to talk to and is open to conversation.

I recommend that anyone majoring or minoring in ethnic studies take this professor. Extremely helpful and open to what you have to say. Wants everyone to get As in his class. He'll get you thinking about issues in a way you never thought before. Excellent professor.

Dylan is one of the best lectures and professors I've ever had. He is so easy to talk to and poses questions to get you to think outside of your comfort zone. He isn't afraid to use certain words and speaks out against so many things wrong with the government.

I would have to saw the most elaborately and well spoken professors I've ever had.  The vocabulary and diction he uses during lectures outshines the rest.  He does open your eyes to a lot of things...some say a bit too radical in a sense, but does make sen
No Comments

Lectures are loaded with solid theory backed up with solid resources. This guy is my hero because he is very passionate, and puts everything on the line to expose you to things he knows you might be uncomfortable with. Hence the mixed reviews.
Knows what he is talking about and has proof to back up what he teaches

Dylan actually TAYLORS his class so that he doesn't become pedagogal. He wants YOU to figure things out for yourself. UCR is a VERY neo-con school and the haters are the unintelligent, closed-minded people who can't take raw truth straight up.
