He would apply interesting real-world concepts/examples for lectures (ex: Tesla v. Mirai for chapter: electrochem). Exams were average to some that are difficult along with FRQs. You do have 1 re-take for midterm.
really a watered down chem class, i wanted to learn college level chem but just a waste of time

(Winter 2022) LOVE his point based grading system. Self-taught myself all the content; he gives great study guides before the midterm and final exam. Fill those out and you'll succeed! Exams are multiple choice and free-response. Also gives a lot of videos (imbedded questions) + online quizzes, but those are open-note. Lots of extra credit!

Easy asynchronous class - only 40% of the grade is based on tests. The rest consists of CHEM101 homework, online quizzes and video questions, and discussion attendance. Tests were fair and he offered +10% extra credit as well. If you find a group of people to study with it will make your life a lot easier.

Professor Eichler is one of the best chemistry professors there could be! His lecture videos were mostly concise and contained a lot of information. His lectures were excellent, and he gave a study guide before the midterm and final, similar to the actual exam. It is not hard to fail, but it requires work to get a B or A.

Dr. Eichler is an amazing professor. This class was asynchronous but we had videos and quizzes due by end of each week so that was something to help us keep up. He is very generous with extra credit and I would definitely recommend him.

Amazing professor overall. His videos were very clear and easy to learn which helped when taking the quizzes, midterm, and final. This class isn't hard as long as you take notes, study for the exams, and understand the material.

very good at explaining and would stop to make sure there was a good understanding. there are clicker questions for the lectures, but they can be made up with homework. the online videos explain what you will learn that week so watch them before
Took it in winter 2022. It was asynchronous lecture with mandatory in person discussion. Grading was point scale and he offered a lot of extra credit. He is a good professor and I would recommend hm.

Eichler is engaging in class and the recorded homework videos are very helpful. Clicker questions matter for grades, so attendance is mandatory. He cares a lot about his students and is prepared to help you understand. He offers a fair bit of homework and extra credit points to pad your grade. I really enjoyed this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's okay, took Chem1a with him but he used chem100w videos to teach which made things difficult. Midterm is easy and so is the final. He was behind so the lab did not line up with the class. Heard he's better than the other chem professors tho. TA/discussion doesn't help too much so study on your own. Make a discord & try to pass together.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class. His classes are asynchronous so you basically watch prerecorded lectures and take quizzes on your own time. You only need Chem101 and canvas. No textbook and no attendance. The midterm was doable and easy if you review notes and videos. However the final was HARD if you don't study in depth. He gives ec so it helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Online lectures, ez quizzes if u watched his video lectures, open book midterm but not final ( he curved though). He's really nice also

Dr. Eichler is a great professor. Had his asynch chem1A class. He's very good at explaining chemistry. I would recommend going to his office hours, he tries to learn everyone's name that goes. Quizzes are easy and midterm and final reflect the course content well. He gives a lottttt of extra credit so it should be an easy A.

The whole course was fine except for 2 things. 1) The exams poorly reflected the overall course material. 2) He changed point values last minute, making the last few quizzes worth over DOUBLE their normal value. Besides these 2 heavy flaws, the rest of the course was fine. Wasn't great but wasn't awful either. Pretty mediocre.
Eichler was unprepared majority of the quarter. His pre-recorded lecture videos were sometimes not helpful and his syllabus didn't match with the work we did throughout the quarter.

Everything was online, never been to a synchronous meeting with him. Gave an abundance of quizzes (two a week) which were worth a lot of points. His lectures were pretty easy to follow, but they did have questions imbedded in them for points, so its important to watch them closely.
Great at teaching material thoroughly and clearly.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seemed disorganized about the point totals since some of them didn't add up according to the syllabus. The class was asynchronous and there were weekly quizzes and video questions. Quizzes were worth a lot of points.
There are many many many quizzes, but you can stop them and come back to them at another time. Lectures were prerecorded but there were a lot!

I took this class asynchronously. For an online class, his class is very organized. One quiz every 1-2 weeks, the lecture being 5-10 short yet in-depth youtube videos. If you take notes while watching the videos, you will barely need to do any extra work because as he teaches, you understand immediately.

Eichler is overrated. On the surface, he seems like a nice passionate guy that is good at teaching, but he is a very unfair profressor. If his test forms have difficult discrepency he does not care. If people barely missed getting extra credit by half a % he wouldn't care. If you go up to him to adress this issues he says they arent a big deal.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I wish I would have listened to the reviews on here. its true he goes over case studies that don't even matter in the test. The concepts were so easy to understand, but he made them harder then it had to be. My friend in another class scored the same scores and she given a higher grade. AVOID taking his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I love this class. Midterms and final are so easy!

Honestly I didn't really like his style of teaching. He takes students' spare time to teach certain material (aka the online quizzes). He studies the case studies much more in depth compare to the main material needed. Its not an hard class, but it should be more like a 7 unit class over the regular 4 unit class. Other than the quizzes no hw

He's fair teacher. No, he does not curve anything, but that is because he offers an insane amount of extra credit over the quarter, so it evens out. His tests are average, but I would really study the case studies he discusses in class because they will be on the tests. Only thing I wish he didn't do was FRQs. Lots of clicker questions too.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Absolutely ridiculous. He is the reason why I am switching from a chem to me major. He seemed to be more chill back when he was teaching 1A, but 1C is a different story. I think the case studies were an unnecessary use of our time. It really didn't allow us to focus on the core material. Exams were difficult because of the case studies.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: No homework, very test heavy. If you dont get cucked by the midterms, you definitely will get cucked on the final. Not only does he test you on concepts that he never talked about, he expects you to answer them in FRQ style. He has no curve in his class and implements a fraudulent exam redemption policy. Please do not take eichler!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Eichler is a somewhat funny teacher in my experience. Sometimes he can give assignments that are more related to biology and biochemistry. The clicker questions that he gave are quite easy. However, you need to use your own technological devices instead of the actual clickers. He doesn't give SmartWork, but he does give quizzes. It is on iLearn
Professor Eichler really has a passion for chemistry he is a good choice.

Great professor is readily available to help outside of class. Lectures are mandatory because its a clicker class and theres often 4-5 clicker questions each lecture. He gives a lot of opportunities for extra credit which doesn't seem like its a lot of points but they add up at the end.

Very well organized chem class that taught material well. Attendance is a must due to clicker points and the homework quizzes are really important so do well on them. Definitely one of the easier science courses on campus.
Great lectures! Easy class.

Dr. Eichler is very passionate about the material. Attending lectures are mandatory as you will have multiple clicker questions which are fairly simple and straightforward if you've read the chapter (online book) prior to the lecture. His tests reflect what was covered in lecture and the TA's have worksheets that show what you need to review.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Fairly good professor. Didn't feel approachable when it came to speaking with him on a one to one basis but was able to convey material in lecture. Wish he'd explain material a little more thorough or save it for later rather than rush it just to be able to include it in the following test.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The class is very clicker heavy so you need to go to class. You have an opportunity to get extra credit from clicker points. There are two midterms and one final. Be careful: the second midterm and final are more harder than the first midterm because he does not explain the concepts in the later half very clearly or in depth.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He was such a great professor. His lectures were straight to the point, and the test were all about points. if you put in the work and show up to class you will pass .
Easy A. Gives you a periodic table and useful equations for each exam. He explains each topic pretty well but can rush through concepts if there's a time crunch. Office hours are helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Here's the deal. Dude gives extra credit throughout the quarter. Clicker points are worth 200/1000 points so if you don't go to class, you probably won't pass. The final is hard and You NEED to know more in depth than you might think given how easy the midterms and online quizzes were. Final can drop you from A+ to B+ quick
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Would take again

reviews.comment: Prof Eichler is an amazing professor that knows how to explain all of his content material very well. He has amazing lectures with barely any homework and the midterm was literally so easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Easy class and a fun guy.

he was not a horrible professor, but if you want to pass class make sure to attend lecture he always has clicker questions which are worth 20% of your grade. His midterms were okay, but his final was difficult

This prof. over explain things which make things a lot harder than its suppose to be. Tests are hard, so you should read the book. Class is MANDATORY with clicker questions. Pretty bland when it comes to lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: great professor

a terrible lecturer. Put too much effort on case study and doesn't teach necessary part. He asked us to draw organic material's structure which we didn't learn in general chemistry. Be careful about the online quiz because sometimes it would on another folder.

Great at what he does in the classroom. He enjoys having students read 5 "case studies" throughout the quarter which can seem redundant, but each will be tested on the final. He is very heavy on clicker questions, which count for 20% of your grade, so go to class. Midterms are much easier than the final, but an easy class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: The material covered in chem c had the simplest concepts and was by far the easiest to understand in the series. I think Eichler knows this and intentionally screws everybody over. Answers will be like "ALWAYS this, sometimes that, both a and b, both b and c" like bro cmon. He is very arrogant and seems to pride himself in people failing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Honestly pretty easy and I've always struggled with chemistry. His lectures were alright but his iLearn videos were what helped me understand things better. Study the slides and the case studies/activities and you'll do fine. Clickers are mandatory but it's  pretty easy to get an A or B as an overall grade for that category and that helps a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's really not a good teacher, extremely overrated, poor teaching style; relies too much on clickers.  On exams, he is not fair, and chooses to emphasize his "case studies".  Overall, I could have taken another professor with far less hassle and a greater understanding of the material.  Not bad, but definitely not the best professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I honestly felt he wasn't the most motivational professor for 001C. He is definitely better and easier going on 001A. I felt the material was taught in a decent way but the exams were extremely difficult. He had us do free response questions only and his grading criteria for the exams was really specific. He was also slightly rude during office hrs
A really caring professor and motivational. I learned and understood all the material because he goes over lecture step by step. SUPER RECOMMENDED.
Did not like his teaching style. Not very friendly personally.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you don't go to class you will fail! Clicker questions are worth 20% of grade but as long as you go to class you will get all the clicker points. His quizzes online are easy as long as you open his youtube videos while doing them. Go to discussion for extra credit and the class should be easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Eichler is a very good professor. He makes the class very simple but what hurts your grade in the class are the midterms and the final so study the powerpoints and the practice tests he has. Office hours will be your friend. Be prepared to laugh at his bad jokes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Eichler is very funny when he conduct a lecture! He usually has a lot of clicker credits given during the lecture, so you basically can't skip any lecture because clicker points count towards your grade. The tests were generally okay if you study all your material. BUT BEWARE OF THE FINAL, IT WILL AFFECT YOUR GRADE IF YOU FAIL!!!!
horrible teacher! does not even teach! spends class time doing useless participation activities. midterms are somewhat okay, one harder than the other. the final wrecked me!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Attendance is required since there are clicker questions. Expects you to know everything prior to coming to class. Doesn't really spend class time wisely. You're practically meant to self teach. A lot of at home work like pre-lecture homework. Does not curve so don't even bother asking. Makes too many dad jokes, like stop.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Confusing, didn't know what was on his own online homework we had to buy. Pointless clicker questions. Had to buy subscription to online test taking software. The software was difficult to use and buggy. His lectures are lackluster and his tests are more difficult than you think. I will do my best to never have him again.

Professor Eichler has very engaging lectures which are very easy to understand. He is very funny and extremely helpful to students.  The only thing I did not like was the online exam format (ExamSoft). I was also surprised by the difficulty of the final, as his midterms were a breeze.  Really pay attention to clicker points and have fun!

Prof. Eichler's class was very easy to understand if you simply show up to class and do the homework.  The ALEKS homework takes a ridiculously long time to do though. DO NOT PROCRASTINATE on the homework, it will catch up to you.  Overall, easy class to pass :)
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Overall he is a really fun professor. Although his office hours were online he cared a lot about his students in the sense that he will make the time to help them. He gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. Although the homework, ALEKS, was a lot, it was VERY helpful! Understand and do the homework and you will find the tests to be very easy!

He is definitely one of the easier professors, he does offer some extra credit and is very clear on how he will be grading (no curve). If you get 90%+ the clicker questions he gives you 20 bonus points. All of his tests were taken on a laptop in class, using softest (incl. the final). The final is worth a good chunk of your grade, so beware

Eichler was one of my favorite professors. He was funny and made chemistry very approachable. I came out with a decent enough grade and was very pleased, because chemistry has never been my best subject

Eichler is funny and very easy to understand. Lecture is not mandatory, but you have to do clicker questions every lecture and those count as extra credit if you get a certain amount. You will pass if you don't slack off every week.
Students are given many chances to gain extra points for the class. The study guides posted for the midterm and final are also very helpful.

Dr. Eichler was a great professor. He is very enthusiastic and a great lecturer, as he makes the material easy to understand. Honestly, the class is not too difficult to ace.  Just study for the exams and do the extra credit and you should be good.

This professor is amazing. He has a great personality and it definitely shows through during his lectures. He's very funny and makes the lectures easy to understand. He gives a lot of clicker questions and uses Aleks. There is 1000 points available and you only need 600 to get a C-. Theres a ton of extra credit too. I highly recommend him.

JFE is a great prof. He is reasonable and quite lively. Some tips:  1) Read the textbook and take notes before class. It helps. 2) He uploads the important case study information on Course Materials. Download it, read them, read them again.  3) Pay attention during lecture. He'll ask for questions. If none, then he'll go to a clicker.

I dont get why everybody loves him so much, but he's an OK professor. Tests are kinda tricky but bearable, the extra credit opportunities saved my grade. For some reason he is much harder for 1B then he is for 1A, but that also could just be me since i hate math and this course has a lot more calculations than 1A.

I had him for Chem 1A and Chem 1B, his lectures definitely help understand everything as he is clear and has clicker question which help further understand the topic. He has extra credit opportunities, so take advantage as he does not curve the class at all. Attend lectures, do the homework, put in a bit of studying and you'll have a solid grade.

He wants the class to be more lighthearted so he likes to make jokes to make us laugh. In class, his lectures are really easy; but homework is aleks and it will have hard problems you have to do to move on that eicher wont even mention in class. help is there when you need it, go up to him or ask questions in class.

Eichler is a great professor. He is very interactive with his students, and he simplifies difficult concepts. He often makes jokes about concepts which makes them easier to remember. He gives a good amount of team work assignments in section, but all and all if you attend and pay attention you should do well.
Pretty good. Pretty okay.

An excellent professor and definitely one I would recommend all my friends to take. He is a perfect transition from high school to college for the general chemistry series, making his lectures as clear as possible and having his tests focus on lecture material.   I didn't use the book, but I got all A's in his series. Tests  tricky. Just study.
Tests are pretty fair. Funny guy

He is funny, interesting lecturer. Exams are not too bad, just study his slides. Uses aleks which sorta forces you to study and do well. Big on clickers. He could be a jerk sometimes but he is a good professor overall. Definitely recommended!!!

Eichler was a great professor, you'll never be bored in his class. Very fun and enthusiastic. He gives a lot of extra credit so you have a good chance in getting a good grade even if you don't do as well in the midterms. Make friends in class so you can assist each other for the clicker questions.
LOVE HIM

I have always struggled with chemistry in the past but after having Eichler as a teacher it's like I have seen the light. He makes lectures interesting and has a true passion for the subject. He gives plenty of extra credit and his powerpoints are online. He is honestly the best chemistry professor I've ever had.

Eichler taught 2 sections in my year and about 25% of his students either got AA-'s, 35% of his student's get B's, 35% of his students get C's, and the rest gets D's and F's. His class is pretty doable, you just have to put in work! He is an amazing lecturer and study the powerpoint and clicker questions because he tends to reuse his questions!

Dr. Eichler is probably the best chem 1A professor in UCR. I got a bad score my first midterm but I was able to bring it up. He provides more extra credit than the usual professor so when he assigns extra credit, DO IT. It's possible to get an A in there, you just have to work for it.

Professor Eichler is definitely one of the greatest professors I have ever had. He makes Chemistry extremely enjoyable. If he taught every single chemistry class on campus, I would switch into chemistry for my major! His tests are so and so because his midterms are 15 questions so if you miss one, you are down to an A- . Overall, an amazing class!

Eichler is an amazing lecturer. It is very possible to get an A in this class; you just have to show up to lecture and put in a good amount of time into studying for the midterms and finals. He makes you do ALEKS which is an online homework site and is a very helpful study tool.

Eichler was a really great teacher that knows his material and if you go to his office hours, you'll really get to know him. He isn't exactly a research professor yet, more of a teaching professor, so he's really good at teaching the chemistry material. During class, he's really funny. However, whatever effort you put in it is the grade you get.

Great professor.Love that class is mandatory with clicker questions that may be on the exams. Very enthusiastic about chemistry. Like and hate AlEKS, the homework system he uses. It's tedious, but will make you learn ALOT. My other concern is his tests. Tests are usually 10 or 15 questions and  2/3 FR. Get 1/2 MC questions wrong and its a grade dwn

I had the honor of taking 4 classes with him. He's a wonderful person and I wish every professor was like him. He really knows his subject inside and out and is really willing to help you. Take him if you can. Wish he taught OChem! It is really possible to get an A in his class.

This class was harder than 1A, for sure. I hated thermochemistry, but other than that, it wasn't too bad. His midterms are tripped up--10 questions, so one question wrong and you drop a whole letter grade. Very clear during lectures. A lot of clicker questions, so it's worth going.

So much homework for a lecture, so be prepared to work your butt off. He is very approachable, and only give 10 questions on his midterms, and like 36 or so questions on his final. The ALEKS assignments, although tedious, are very helpful, and I am currently taking his class for 9B, and will have him for 9C as well.
I would be a Chemistry major if he taught every Chemistry course on campus.... Period.
Absolutely my favorite professor. Hands down, the best of the best. Very helpful and passionate about what he is teaching - awesome teacher and amazing person.

The only professor I have had thus far who goes absolutely above and beyond to help his students; he helps his students' friends, as well, when he is not required to do so at all... he is so clear and funny. He truly cares and is very genuinely nice. One thousand percent recommended.
He is the best professor!!! He is really clear and helpful in office hour. He is funny and makes Chemistry so fun. I would definitely recommend him!!!

He is an awesome professor. Although one thing is that I didn't like using (and paying)  for the ALEKS hw system because it took away time but he's an enthusiastic professor and his explanations make concepts simpler. He really tries to help.

Eichler is SO wonderful! He is so amazingly helpful  and caring. He puts so much work into what he does and he loves it - it most certainly shows. He is so helpful cute charming, ahhhhhh. Greatest teacher and person!!! He rocks!

Eichler is the best!!! He made me love chem! I actually looked forward to his lectures because he is hilarious...forces students to act like molecules & relates everything to mosh pits. I wish he taught every chem class on campus & I'd be a chem major! No curve, but don't need one b/c he actually knows how to teach! Down to earth, super cool guy

I have hated Chemistry for as long as I can remember... It is now one of my favorite subjects. I have always loved Biology more than anything, but I really enjoy Chemistry now; and I'm really very good at it. Dr. Eichler is absolutely to thank for that. He is so helpful, a wonderful person and teacher, and such a supporter. Love him!

THE best for chem!!! Down to earth and engages the class by discussion, clicker questions, and forcing students to come up in the front of class to act like molecules. Has many mosh pit analogies. Keeps it fun! I like chemistry b/c of him. Small curve, but that's no problem because he's ACTUALLY A GOOD TEACHER & tests are reasonable.
Good professor with appropriate use of class time - clickers, open discussions, case studies, lecture, and problem sets. Good overall learning experience. Definitely recommend.

Eichler is a great teacher. He engages his students in every lecture and is quite fair with his grading scale. Be sure to go to office hours and ask questions if you need help. Overall a great experience.
Very fun guy, wish every teacher was like him. Watch out for his ALEKS though...

Read the study guide and the slides he post up and his clicker question and study his practice problems and you are set. Gives extra credit opportunities frequently. You will be using your calculators a lot for the exam.

Not as easy as I thought it would be. Definitely need to put work into this class. Lectures are helpful and clicker questions are extra credit towards final. HW is long and tedious but also helpful. Overall the class is very helpful and tests are very fair. Final is very similar to midterms. Had a 50% going into final and ended up with a B.
Great professor. He doesn't go into extreme details during his lectures so you'll have to read the book but his tests are very fair and his final can replace your midterm grades.

Eichler is very fair, clear and relatively easy. He has a policy of replacing your midterm grades with the final grade if you do better on it (which gave me an A in the class). His lectures follow the textbook directly, but he doesn't test you on everything. I usually went to lectures, and used the textbook for clarifications. Loved this professor!

Very interesting professor. Funny jokes he makes up and he makes the class engaged. teaches well and has both powerpoint and paper notes that we can copy. homework is online and helpful. midterms and test are fair, so study and you should get an A.

Eichler is a good professor. Keeps the class entertaining and you definitely learn a lot and should go to lectures. Stuff you don't know how to do, ALEKS homework really helps reteach it to you, despite how tedious it is. I was terrible at chemistry before this class and actually love chemistry now. 2 midterms and a final.

Prof. Eichler is seriously an awesome professor! He is very helpful and what is even better is that he makes introductory chemistry interesting. He tells a joke in almst every lecture at the beginning, and he has helpful powerpoints as well lecture notes. All of his course materials posted on iLearn are helpful, as well as his study guides.

Prof. Eichler has to be one of the best professors here at UCR.  Exams aren't difficult if you attend lecture and at least try somewhat in the course.  The SI's really helped a lot so I recommend going there, plus you get more practice. problems.

his class is very entertaining and fun. he makes cheesy chem jokes here n there. he writes his notes on the board, extremely helpful. GO TO OFFICE HOURS! its really helpful, he will give the most detailed help. most recommended teacher for CHemistry

Midterms are easy. As long as you read the book and DO THOSE PRACTICE PROBLEMS, you will get a good grade. As for the final, I saw some questions that were on mastering chem so again, do the exam practice problems at the end of the chapter and do homework that's on mastering chem. It will really help you on the long run.

Pretty descent professoe. He teaches. Sometimes he only goes over concepts breifly in class, so it's important that you read and go over some practice problems by yourself. Go to lecture, it'll help you before you study.
best teacher ever.He makes all the lectures interesting and fun.

Excellent. He explains the concepts really well and has multiple opportunities for grade redemption. His exams are based off the optional homework and the examples he does in class. They're really straightforward as long as you  go to class and pay attention. Take his class! You won't regret it.

AWESOME teacher. :D His lectures aren't necessarily "mandatory" buuuttt if you don't go, the powerpoints he posts online will not be helpful. He does most of his notes on the chalk board. He's very entertaining and helpful.

HE'S THE BEST CHEM PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD. HE'S FAIR IN GRADING AND HE MAKES SURE YOU UNDERSTAND THE MATERIAL. BOTH THE MIDTERMS AND THE FINAL ARE FAIR IF YOU KNOW THE MATERIAL AND TAKE NOTES + PAY ATTENTION IN CLASS. :)

Best chemistry professor I've ever had. He's amazing at explaining the concepts in a way that you'll understand. He is really helpful and if you go to office hours, he'll make sure to remember your name. Midterms aren't too hard as long as you know the material. Final is much easier than the midterms. Good luck!

He provides a good amount of extra credit / ways to slightly boost your grade if you're willing to do the work (clicker q's, outside online practice problems). Quizzes are easy as long as you understand the general concepts. Midterms are straight forward, though the first one was much easier than the second. Pay attention,take good notes in lecture

I had Eichler for CHEM 1A and I can personally say that he was the best chemistry teacher I have ever had!! I do recommend taking him if you ever have a chance. His two midterms and final are reasonable so you shouldn't be too worried. Just keep up with the lectures (and actually read your textbook!) and you should be fine. Got an A either way! :D
Fantastic teacher. You won't regret having him. He knows how to teach and you can tell he loves teaching as well his subject. Take him!
Very good teacher who really enjoys what he is doing. YOu won't be bored in his class!

He is very straight forward about his lectures No curve but offer grade replacements if you do better on midterm 2/final Exams are based off practice exams online. tests are tricky though. He will teach you how to do a problem, and give you a tricky question. OH are chill except theyre outside, by coffee bean so seating is limited and uncomfortable

Prof. Eichler is EXTREMELY HELPFUL. very clear in his lecture. you can tell immediately that he loves teaching and doing his research! TAPPS is helpful (allows you to try the problem on your own first, then discuss it in groups after)! he's very approachable! of course, study b/c his exams are fair and somewhat hard but challenges you to do better

He teaches well, but his first 2 midterms suck, I think his final is easier and if u study a lot for the final ull probably get the grade u want. I got F's on both midterms but a B on the final which replaced my two midterm grades. Just try ur best and dnt give up coz 1B isn't easy

Professor Eichler is one of the best professor I have had at UCR. He is very lenient on grading exams, exam days and answers can be argued, and gives lots of extra credit but without any curves. His lectures were very well organized with powerpoints and clicker questions(also extra credit). Eichler is also very tricky in his quizes and exams!
He's way to hard of a proffesor. There is NO curve in the class; thats going to kill you.

Yea his lectures are really good, and he is a very helpful teacher BUT there is NO curve what so ever in the class! Seriously, what type of science class doesn't have a curve. And it is for this reason that he is a HORRIBLE proffesor, take Scott instead.

I'm proud to say that I got my first A in Chemistry from Dr. Eichler.Like so many OP's have said, do the homework even though it is optional.He has unique teaching methods such as allowing students to work in groups on problems for bonus problems.He is funny and very intellectual.But,credit should also go to my S.I. Leila Magistrado!

I wasn't looking forward to taking Chem after having Hill for 1A, but being in Professor Eichler's class was amazing. He knows a lot about chem, and is an amazing teacher. HW is optional, but if you can make the time, DO IT. A lot of HW questions on the tests. Also, read. It helps. Loved the class. He looks like Matt LeBlanc. So cute :))

My favorite professor at UCR. Take his class!!!! He makes lecture interesting, and he is also very helpful and easy to approach after class or in office hours. His tests aren't too hard as long as you do the exam practice questions on mastering chem.

Overall, the class was fair. Homework is optional, but a few of the questions and concepts come from the optional. I suggest doing the homework and reviewing the homework before midterms/final. I learned most of the material doing the homework.
Excellent professor hands down! Deserves professor of the year award! He is very friendly and this tests are very fair.  SI's are really helpful too! They prepare you for tests like no other!

He is very nice to look at...very VERY nice to look at. He is also attractive and pleasing to the eye. Not that it's important, but he is also very intelligent and a good teacher. If taking chemistry choose Eichler!!! <3 <3 <3
He is a really good teacher who knows the material. He has a tough grading scale but as long as you understand the material and go to lectures you should be fine.  His tests are all multiple choice.

Dr. Eichler is a great professor.  Yea, the class is difficult, but if you put the time and effort into it you should do well.  He's always available for office hours (he has them 2x a week) and explains concepts pretty well.  He's also approachable, friendly, and responds to emails fairly quickly. I recommend taking him

Dr. Eichler is a great professor.  Yea, the class is difficult, but if you put the time and effort in you should do well.  He's extremely approachable and friendly and he's available for office hours twice a week.  I really recommend taking him, he explains concepts really well and his tests are fair.

eichlers freken awsome! i loved him as a professor. he tries to make people laugh. and his tests are not hard actually. as long you do the practice midterms. the questions are exactly the same. he didnt even change the numbers. he will help you i you ask. he is good looking, ill agree. good professor overall
there is no curve, but he sounds exactly like owen wilson.  he will help u alot if u come to office hours, but all professors do that

He is a really good professor and likes to help his students.(office hours are outside) I'd say he is one of my favorite professors. Tip: just pay attention and do the practice exams he offers and try to redo the midterms for the final. Overall, he is awesome and very cute! like how he smiles.
He was very hard and I ended up with a D in his class. There is no curve and the the questions on the final were totally random.
Really great lecturer but really hard exams. Don't fall behind in his class. He looks like a combination of Tom Cruise and Matthew Broderick. :]

He was very good. He cared about the students. Tried to memorize the names of whoever comes to office hours. He encourages everyone to go. Pretty funny. Makes the class interesting by having questions to solve in the middle of class either individually or in groups. He gives a lot of material from which to study from. different sources and stuff.
Hottest professor i've ever had. Just beware there is no curve so do well and go to class. He's very helpful and you don't want to miss lecture because he might be wearing his blue sweater ;)

He is one of the best chem prof in UCR! we need more prof like him here. there is a slight curve only for C range. His midterms are two parts, one in disc and one is lec. they were tough, but if you put time on studying, go to lec and office hours, you'll be fine.  YOU MUST attend every lecture.  it is going to help you a lot. TAKE HIM!!

Yes, he is a kind man but his class is way too difficult for an introductory class.  He may seem easy because there is barely any homework and the tests are multiple choice, but this is not true.  The averages are always low and his grading makes it very difficult to get a decent grade.  Weighted system with old fashion "A" (90-100) with no curve.
Dang...his tests were hard.  But he is a pretty cool guy.

He is a nice and funny guy but his grading is very difficult on the student.  There is no scaling or curves to help your grade.  I thought I aced the final after an all-nighter of practice exam problems.  Turns out I received devastation in the end in that I got a D on the final that seemed so easy.  For an A in the class, miss no more than 5 Q's.

hated chemistry until i took his class. his exams are really easy, just study off the practice exams. attending his lectures is def. mandatory, you do not want to miss this eye candy. can't wait for chem1c. ;)

He was such an awesome professor! He's funny and nice. He's also very helpful during his office hours. His tests are very similar to the practice problems he gives, but he doesn't curve. Oh, and he's HOT

honestly guys. i hate chem. but eichler makes it all awesome. you'll actually WANT to go to class. yes, there's no curve, but c'mon. his midterms are EXACTLY like the practice on mastering chemistry. i mean, i got a 98% on a CHEM final. oh and he gives extra credit during class which is a plus! very entertaining professor. TAKE HIM!!

He keeps the class interesting by offering extra credit points during lecture and he also thoroughly explains the conceptual things. However, if you're looking for a curve for grading, don't bother because he doesn't apply one.
The best professor I had so far. He makes chemistry fun and interesting and explains the topics very thoroughly. Midterms are easy if you study/do the practice problems. Take him if you can!

the best teacher ever, makes everything interesting, is able to make everyone participate even though we are in the unlh, incredibly funny, and makes the material very understood and clear. must take him if possible, hes the absolute best!
He is a great Professor. The best I have had so far. Always explains everything in the easiest and clearest way possible. And he makes the class fun, interesting, and easy! Loved him!
Best professor I've I had so far at UCR. Study questions nearly are identical to Midterms. Great at explaining concepts  while keeping the subject interesting.

Very Eurocentric class. The professor constantly focused on what Europeans “invented” and made uncomfortable, dismissive comments about other cultures. Also showed sexist attitudes in how he talked about women in art. Overall, a very uncomfortable experience.

Very strict on attendance-- you can't miss more than two lecture OR discussion meetings without getting dropped from the class. Treats us like children, watches us like a hawk for any usage of devices in the lecture hall. The course itself is easy enough.

Endres is really nice when you talk to him in person. His class becomes really fun when he asks questions and moves around. Remind him about the roll call paper he might give you extra credit, lol.
You need to take two quizzes per week; no big deal, all are easy, and two papers that are no longer than three pages. I'd give him a 9/10 as a professor

reviews.comment: Do readings and watch lectures and youll be fine. It seems like a lot but hes so consistent about posting the resources that you can definitely plan ahead. He is a really nice professor. He answers emails pretty quick. The whole course is based off quizzes, a few projects, a midterm and a final. There is like 15 quizzes, so make sure you do good because those are the majority of the class. WATCH THE LECTURES!

reviews.comment: He is a good professor that will give a lot of little quizzes typically on Top hat. If you dont in ow what top hat is he is one of a few professors that I have found to use it. You may get lucky and not have to use it after having this professor. He is a good professor.

Although more difficult than your everyday class, Johannes's seminar was worth it. He might seem demanding, but all the readings assigned are canonical, and I used the notes for basically every class this quarter.

reviews.comment: Endres is witty, cultured, and well-read. He respects his students and genuinely seems interested in their input, and he has a great dry sense of humor. reviews.comment: If you have to take CPLT 193, take it with him. Of course it's not easy because the point of this class is to write a 12 page paper, but he helps prepare you for it. Gives a broad topic that you don't even need to relate back to literature. Weekly reading responses and mandatory attendance.

Lectures were interesting and helpful in understanding the readings, especially since I slacked off on reading during the first couple of weeks. No midterm or final, instead you have four short essays each worth 25 points. She talks really fast during lectures so taking notes was kind of difficult but other than that I liked the class

Lectures are great and entertaining as you can tell she's very passionate about teaching and the material she's prepared. There were 4 essays and no final, she even let us out of lectures a week before finals to allow her TAs to grade properly and to let us work on our 4th essay. Last two essays had a creative option to it!

reviews.comment: I LOVED Professor Stapely!! She's extremely considerate and her entire class is basically all participation graded. If you do the work, you'll pass the class. Some of her lectures are a bit difficult to understand but ask questions and you'll be fine.

I literally ADORE professor Stapely! She's an incredibly considerate professor, her content is great, and her lectures are fun and interesting. Her grading criteria is both very clear and not too difficult, she's easy to get in touch with, and she gives really great feedback on papers. I took 3 consecutive courses with her, and would love to again.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: An amazing professor, super caring and understanding, even took off a paper ! Her lectures were really good, easy to follow and I learned a lot. Wouldve loved to have her in person but alas, it is what it is.

I had Stapely for Spring 2020 for online courses. Although the method of teaching was unconventional, Professor Stapely was caring, considerate, and flexible with mistakes. The assignments were relatively simple and essays were graded fairly.

Loved her class from beginning to end. The texts and films watched through the course are engaging and interesting. I took her class online spring 2020 and there were an average of 6 papers with the length being 3 pages. Do the readings and listen to lecture and you will pass
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Stapely is one of the kindest and most understandable professors at UCR. She goes above and beyond for students and always gives clear and understanding lectures! The workload was not too bad in my opinion, and it isn't hard to pass her class with an A. Given the circumstances faced this quarter, she taught the course very well!

Going into this quarter I was really apprehensive about the quality of this course given that it was online due to quarantine. But, Professor Stapely went above and beyond for her students. She accommodated us in any way she could, mainly by provided video lectures instead of requiring attendance. An amazing instructor and an excellent course.

Stapely should be a model for what professors strive to be. Kind, caring, and invested in the success of her students. Stapely provided excellent feedback, made class incredibly accessible in all aspects, and came prepared for each lecture. Every class was impactful and important. I would gladly take any class she was teaching. Absolute perfection.

Professor Stapely was amazing! I thoroughly enjoyed her lectures. Her assignments were a chance for us to speak in our own voice, which is rare in an English class. Not only was she so funny, but she was so informative. She truly wants her students to succeed, which is phenomenal.

By far Stapes is one of the Best Professors at UCR! Her lectures are incredible and are so full of passion. She respects everyone's input during lecture and never makes you feel dumb. She is so nice! She is always willing to help you in office hours. Her exams can be pretty challenging but she is a fair grader. She wants to see you succeed!
Stapely is alright

Love, Love, Love Stapes. Her lectures are absolutely amazing. She gives great insight on almost everything she teaches and she's hilarious. You don't have to attend lecture to pass, but it is definitely recommended as she gives in- depth explanations during class. I love that she encourages against your typical 5 paragraph essays. I highly reccomen

I've only had Stapely once, but she is by far one of my most favorite teachers. She is a great lecturer and she is enthusiastic about what she teaches. Her class gave me a new perspective and her lectures are also very insightful. She provides great feedback on essays and truly wants the best for her students

TAKE STAPELY!!!!! She gives us AMAZING feedback on our essays, she's fun to chat with in office hours (super charming), and she genuinely cares about her students. On top of all that, she is the MOST BRILLIANT PERSON you will EVER have the pleasure of learning from. You will walk away from any one of her classes more woke than you could imagine.

Literally cannot recommend her enough. Emma is by far my favourite professor that I have ever had while attending UCR, and I'm so excited to see her grow as both a scholar and a professor in the years to come. She has sparked in me a long love of sound and close reading, and for that I cannot thank her enough. Plus she's hilarious omg. luv u stapes

I took her ENG126A & ENG131. She provides pdfs for majority of readings. Tough essay grader, LOTS of readings, but very appraochable and helpful in office hours. I took her twice just because her lectures are extremely thought provoking and engaging. She is amazingly brilliant but hella funny and super cool. A student favorite, no doubt. Take her!

She's an awesome teacher. I don't think there was one class lecture where no one responded to her questions. She is so open and approachable. You do have to work for your grade but it's college so it's kind of a no brainer.

She's one of the best english profs at ucr! Her lectures are well organized. Gives you plenty of opportunities to ask questions both during lectures and office hours. Keep up with reading though! It can be a little overwhelming, but definitely worth it.
Amazing Professor, Amazing Class! Hilarious and obviously cares about all of her students! Definitely a professor you must take!

My favorite professor at UCR. Hilarious without cheapening the lectures or material. Respects her students and treats them like smart, thoughtful adults. Lots of reading (keep up!) and tough essay grading, but papers can be revised for a higher grade. Well-liked and respected by all. Super understanding and friendly. Gives a bunch of extra credit.

Stapely is the best. Straight-up awesome. She is brilliant but down-to-earth and funny, and her lectures are thought-provoking. She is approachable, friendly, and easy to talk to. Her essay and test grading isn't too easy, but go to office hours and you'll get get tons of help. She cares about her students and wants you to do well and learn a lot.

Professor Jo started off pretty rough but smoothed it out towards the end. She is new so I can understand. Communication and overall guidance was lacking making the class rather mysterious. Once she knew students felt this way, she did make an effort to change and be better. At the end of the course period, things were smoother. She is improving.

Professor rambles a lot and he likes to stay distracted during lectures. His organization is a straight up abomination. Unclear lectures, really bad attitude towards students, and clearly doesn't know how to handle a class. This professor makes multiple choice exams, where he makes questions that can have more than one answer based on one's opinion. He does not post slides on canvas to review material before exams. Very rude and self-righteous.

Easy A if this is to fulfil your ethnicity requirement. Lots of writing but honestly super east. Probably spent like 2 hours a week for homework, which is basically nothing.

I enjoyed having him as a professor. We watched four films as homework and had to write a one page analysis on them. Professor was disorganized and unprofessional. He was not accessible outside of class and did not provide feedback. Class was graded on weekly essays, a midterm  of 4essays, and a final of 3 essays. reviews.comment: I really enjoyed his class. He is very passionate about what he is teaching and he really cares about his students. The readings were interesting and the movies we had assigned to watch were really informative. I loved this class and I hope I get the chance to take another class with him again.

To be honest, I don't understand the hate. Personally, I took it to fulfill my GE's he wasn't hard at all. He was a bit disorganized from time to time but definitely doesn't deserve a 2.1 grade. He gave one homework per week, a mid-term, and final. All Essays. If you're passionate about ETST wouldn't recommend it, but to fulfill a GE he is great.
Honestly just don't take his class. Like whoever you are your life is worth so much more don't bother with it.

The WORST professor I have ever had during my time here at UCR. This man is extremely unorganized, stubborn, and awful with lectures. reviews.comment: I added #hilarious because he is one hell of a joke. I am a bio major and I have taken OChem with Pirrung, y'know: the ruthless old white dude with a god complex. He is awful. He'll spend about 98% of the class going on tangents and the other 2% vaguely going over material we need to know. He contradicts himself constantly on what he expects from us and never gives a rubric for assignments. Do not take his class.

Basically this professor will not teach you a thing but as i mentioned above it is a show up and pass course. He showed us about 2 films a week and canceled every other Friday. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Took his class Spring 2013 and he was awesome! Super nice teacher and attendance was mandatory, which was good. Interesting and fairly easy grader! I got an A and I learned a lot. It wasn't an easy A, but if you try, it's easy. I recommend this professor highly.

This is by far the easiest class I've taken at UCR. You must read in order to do well on the quizzes, midterm, and final. The quizzes are true or false, so that makes it even more easier. The movie write ups are pretty easy as well. This is an easy B class.

I thought I left all the useless teachers in highschool, but this professor sure isn't what I thought college professors would be. Very biased and favors particular students. Do not recommend taking his courses.

I hardly learned anything from this class. Professor could have done more to supplement learning from the textbook, but instead he just made us watch movies that didn't quite help us prepare for the exams. You'd think he'd tell us exactly what he wants on his film write ups, but we were totally in the dark on that too. Not very helpful to students.

Teacher is nice as A PERSON. Teacher is disorganized. The book is more important than his lectures. He does not tell you what he wants you to write on the video write-ups clearly and contradicts himself. He changed our midterm date and then FORGOT that he changed it. I do not think he puts effort into teaching. He is a BAD teacher.

Professor Lopez is a nice guy but a really lousy teacher. People in the class like him because he's funny (sometimes) and lets you hand in work late. But if your really interested in learning about Chicano history or Chicano education, I'd suggest taking another professor. He also grades hard and expects a lot in your papers when he doesn't teach.

I agree with most of the reviews, his class is laid back and easy but his grading is not. You will not gain any actual knowledge from his lectures but you will from the textbooks- which are what the quizzes, midterm and final are all based on. He is quite funny but if you are not comfortable with profanity, I do not recommend taking him.

Enrique is a funny guy and the class is really laid back. All you do is write write ups on videos shown in class. I'm not gonna lie, I agree with how one other person said Enrique doesn't really "teach" - he just rambles and goes off topic a lot. However, his class wasn't hard at all so I can't complain
His class is not hard... he seems like a very light and easy grader, but he can fool you. He is a lil wacky and goes off topic, but u do ur readings and have questions to ask then he has answers...

DOES NOT TEACH. He just shows movies and wants you to do a writeup on them, then penalizes you since you don't know what to write about. He talks about how he is an easy grader, but is actually quite hard since he has no set grading rubric and does not let you know about his standards until he hands back all work. He is a joke. DOES NOT TEACH!!!!
It seemed like the class wasn't really on his priority list, but it was an easy A and the material was interesting.  He was pretty lenient on grading and I didn't have to work hard at all.
this guy is great human being and down to earth. great teacher, the readings are long and his quizzes are sorta hard but it should be an easy B.

Passionate, understanding, fun, comical, easy to talk with kind of teacher. His best interests at heart are that students understand how race affects the lives of people of color. Good class, all you do is watch interesting videos, quizzes  may be hard but they're true/false so guess if you don't know. Papers aren't difficult as long as you read.

Lopez is a great professor.  He was very interested in the students and their learning.  He is able to realate to most students and is very dedicated to what he does.  He is compassionate about his work.  At first it may look like he requires a lot of work, but once you're in the class it is really easy.
He gives quizzes on the reading, kind of hard, so were his tests, but he graded easy. Too many videos. But very nice looking

Hard class, but very professional and caring professor. 1 midterm 1 final, he provides study guides that are almost identical to the exam plus mcgraw hill homework weekly with unlimited tries. Content in 168B was much more difficult so don't slack off on understanding the principles in 168A.

Love Professor Allen, took him for both 168A and 168B. Great course set up, interesting lectures, and moderately challenging exams. He's extremely knowledgable in this topic and easy to talk to so definitely ask for help during in class problems when he's walking around. If you're taking any tax class, do it with Allen you'll learn so much!
Bus 168A is a tough class, but you will learn so much about taxes which is super applicable in life. He helped me do my taxes during tax season. Great class whether you're a business major or not!

Prof. Allen was an amazing professor that was able to explain things in a clear manner. He has a lot of actual experience in the subject, and I genuinely looked forward to attending class. Definitely read the textbook, and watch the pre-lectures. Very accessible outside of class, and he's pretty generous with grading/ gives partial credit.

Honestly you don't even need to be Business Major to take this class. It was so informational and Prof Allen taught it in the most simplified way possible. I HIGHLY recommend taking this class, you will not regret it and if you actually put in some effort you will easily pass. And to top it off he made the final online and he curves.Goated guy.

Material is very detail oriented but he provides a ton of resources & is extremely helpful along the way.
