reviews.comment: Definitely one of the hardest professors I have had. You can never skip class because you will be so behind. She's a tough grader. You can never know what she expects of you because her directions are vague.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Lots of freedom within the essay prompts. Show up to office hours and expand on your thoughts. Be ready to present your thoughts-- don't expect her to hand them to you! Lots of in class work each day, not a BAD class. Annoying? Probably.
Shes a horrible professor. She expects you to figure everything out and she doesnt explain what she wants on the essays. Class was a total GPA killer.

She makes things hard to understand. However, she does leave an open window to write about something that interests you. The class itself isn't hard. She just makes it complicated to understand what she wants! No homework really.. Just 3 essays and a portfolio.
Good teacher. Lets you write on whatever you want as long as you are able to apply it to the prompts. I highly recommended asking for clarification if your confused.

Isn't very specific on what she's looking for in your papers. She answers your questions with a question. Will make you do oral presentations without warning and expects you to have your thoughts together. Will ask for silence, but will continue to make small talk about non related topics, even during the final. Very disorganized. Not recommended.

She claims to be so helpful and and such an easy grader, however she is quite the opposite. She never specifies what she wants from each essay but assigns vague prompts. Answers students' questions with questions. Her way is the only way.

She makes you think critically for your essays. Fails to convey necessary articles and resources needed in essays. Tends to mix up her classes on what she's discussed, and with who. Not personal with students, meaning she doesn't pull you aside to ask about your absences, work, or grades. Make sure to participate, or else you'll get a low grade.

She is really condescending. Her prompts for every essay are the same and really broad. She had us fill out an midterm evaluation survey. Instead of trying to work on the things we suggested, she interrupted us while working on peer reviews, and told us how our opinions were wrong.

This woman is just flat out weird! Makes the class read 40+ pages worth of essays/novels for the weekend because we were a day off the agenda for the class. We were a day off because the first day of class she didn't have the keys to her own classroom. She expects the student to know everything about literature as a prerequisite. Don't take her.

Very repetitive with words and phrases, specifically the question "Right?" Also, she likes to hear deeper meaning in your thought process, and not the first general conclusion you have. Means well, but is very nitpicky, but claims not to be.

She is not the easiest grader. YOU MUST TURN IN ALL GENERAL MATERIALS WITH YOUR ESSAY OR SHE WILL DEDUCT YOUR ESSAY GRADE BY A LOT! Barely made it out of her class alive. READ EVERYTHING WORD FOR WORD.

Honestly, I am not really fond of English class. However, she made the class a lot better with the topics she allowed us to write on. She really made us think about what we were writing through her class discussions as she pointed out  almost every flaw in our argument. She gave us a lot of freedom with our essays. Great class!

Was an amazing lecturer, and above all, a great person! I always felt super comfortable approaching him after class and during OH. Although I took his class a long time ago, I wanted to come on here and say that it really set me up for success in my major/chosen field. Would jump at the chance to take a course with him again!

Just got a job based on 120B. yay embedded systems! professor was great, super positive, lots of examples, would talk then have us work on small problems, kept us awake, it was fun. At end of quarter big line of people to thank him and some were actually crying when they thanked him. Never seen that before. Wish more professors were like him.

First of all, this prof is a businessman, pretty pretentious in general. Second, you could tell he wrote the whole rate my professor himself, you could see how fake those positive commons are, he will not let you pass, DO NOT Take this person in any classes if you want to pass, take my words

The class is easy just make sure you attend lecture and zybooks. The labs are a little time consuming but arent too bad if you ask for help. If you've taken Automata/Organization/Logic this class will be a breeze. There is nothing in this class that holds you back.

Grading was extremely inconsistent. Assignments randomly marked as zero, similar with exams.
Complaints ignored.

He's nice in lecture, but if you can avoid this class I'd recommend against.
He failed teaching and give 70% of his student a D or F, do not take this person!!!

The professor does his best to create a fun and enjoyable learning experience. There are quite a lot of activities for homework, but super easy if you went to lecture. reviews.comment: You had to participate through chat throughout the lecture where he'd go over examples. Really kind and caring prof that likes to interact with the class. One of the best professors I've had at UCR. He teaches things simply and really cares about his student's success. This professor was the reason I got into CS and I don't regret it at all. Fun class, labs weren't hard, content wasn't that hard either, just need practice. A lot of reading through ZyBooks but this class was a pretty easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Coming into CS010A with no prior coding experience, Professor Vahid was an amazing teacher! The programs are tough and frustrating at times, especially after Week 6, but he has resources, like discord/ office hours, etc. that really helpyougetby.10/10
Amazing. Was super understanding of the whole coronavirus situation going on and adjusted accordingly.

Really tries to help the students as much as possible. Eliminated usual midterm/final for in-class quizzes and final project to give students a better chance of passing. Gave lots of extra credit opportunities. PA's are kinda a lot but easy to do. Pay attention during lecture because it will help a lot with CA/Labs. Easy A if you just do the work
Will go out of his way to help students pass, creates multiple opportunities for students to achieve a better grade in class

reviews.comment: Very nonpersonal if youre looking for a professor you can bond with this is not the guy. You can however get an A if you do the work.

His method of teaching is excellent. Although it's an online class, he can help you get in touch with other students for help with anything. Working together is encouraged for everything, as long as the collaboration on the quiz or homework is mentioned. Keeps lectures active and engaging. Keeps a light, friendly environment.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Doctor Vahid was understanding and nice. He cared about students. At first I didn't know this was an online class and I was wary. But now I think online was even better than in person. I absolutely loved this class.

A great teacher. His lectures were very clear and informative. His expectations for his students are high but reasonable for the course. Project oriented. If you pay attention and work hard, you will leave the course feeling that you have gained serious insight into the subject. Can't recommend this course, with this professor, enough.

In class, he just gives a lectures on finding a job/interviewing or other inspirational stuff like starting a startup/getting a patent etc. The actual lecture is useless for the class as it's just there to help you once you've graduated. The lab part where you do your project is also pretty easy. You don't have to do any hard projects. Easy A!!!
Great professor. He makes you read before class. He does a lot of examples. He brings a sense of humor too.
Inspiring guy.

Took 10V online. Do the readings, pay attention online, and start programs early, and you'll pass. Try to take shortcuts and you'll just spend more time. Vahid was chill. He mostly does examples which is cool cause it shows how to make a program. I tried his way of writing a little and compiling and it helped. TA was pretty cool too.

I took his class online. He did a lot of programming examples and I thought that was helpful. Especially when he explained mistakes. Programming is hard. Plan to spend a lot of time and start early so when you go to online lab you can ask questions. Vahid had online office hours and was helpful though usually it was only me and like 1 or 2 others.

Do not take this class online. He is a horrible teacher and rarely helps students out, on top of that the class is very time consuming. I literally spent more time on this class than my other three classes and still wound up with a D.

You'd be better taking this class in person especially if you struggle with programming and/or it is not your major. I spent more time on this class than any of my other 3. There was not enough help available and that is why I have to rate it poorly. He's a nice guy, but he's not available for help. The TA wasn't much help either.
Very clear, knows his stuff. Friendly, has interesting stories, funny too. Programming was harder for me than others but he was always saying no problem, that's normal. That really helped.

State machines rule! I love how he tied the technical stuff with real world stuff. He has a really comfortable way of teaching that kept me interested the whole time. I actually LIKED coming to class. Weird, huh. The class is lots of work, but I know I learned a lot of useful things. Go to class, do all the labs and homework, you should do fine.

He is a great professor. Makes u work a lot but u learn a lot too. His book is good and he gets u a discount so its almost free. Do his homework! And I had 61 with him, dont know why the other guy is complaing, 61 was solid.

Vahid was clear. Tough but also chill. I don't know what the last guy is whining about, we did the same stuff as my friends in other quarters. And I love his books, I can actually read them (my cousin at Texas A&M used one too, I guess the books are popular)

Take Vahid if you don't want to learn anything. Hi doesn't teach a single thing when he teaches CS61. When I got an A all of my friends said I hadn't learned any of the important stuff. Also the 120 series are classes that could be fit into 1 class and those were made by vahid. He makes you buy 2 of his books and they're slower than CS61.
Great professor!
awesome professor! he really knows how to teach in an effective manner. his lectures are simple and easy to understand. one of the best professors i've had.
Very inspirational. easiest teacher
Knows how to challenge student to rise up. I learned a ton. Grading was fair.
A good teacher. Big ego, and a little self reitous. Great class!

He makes class very interesting.  He's a well balanced guy, and he's fair. He explains things clearly. He speaks English fluently, and knows how to TEACH. (This is unique since we know that professors don't need teaching credentials).
His class was the only class where I actually welcomed the challenge, rather than wish that the class was easier.
I learned more from this guy than any other teacher. And not just about the class, but about life.
Wants you to learn. Course is a solid amount of work, nothing unreasonable though, and I learned a lot. Keeps lectures fun.
Awesome prof. Very clear, and makes class fun.
He makes the class way easier than Linard did, and I'm learning more the second time around.
Smart professor if you work hard you will get a good grade else you won't and you will complain like these other idiots.
Really cool course. Good prof. but not merciful on grading. exams not that bad.
beware of this guy - DISHONEST !

Vahid is the best professor in all of secondary education.  He cares about his students and his knowledge of his field is only outdone by his compassion towards the people that cross his path.  It must be a graduation requirement to take his course.
Extremely hard class and tests.  He will go out of his way to try and help you pass.

most caring teacher i've had at ucr... cares about his students as people both inside and outside of the class. also takes the time to learn each student's names and their interest. gives alot of work but feel like you've accomplished something at the end
Vahid is awesome.  I found the class material interesting and the presentation even better.  There's a lot of work, but well worth it if you have any interest in the field!

CS and CE majors will ace the class while EE majors will stuggle. This is mostly a CS class and should NOT be required for EE's. EE's are at a greater disadvantage. The only 2 EE's in the class got D's while the CS's and CE's got A's and B's.

Good teacher. Has a high intelligence level and a fast teaching pace. Good for students who can pick up ideas on that pace, tend to lose the slower students. Probably good to study chapter beforehand before lectures for those students.
You learn a lot, very informative, extremely good pedantic skills
Very good teacher, material isn't really easy but you learn a lot
Very interesting teacher. Makes you wanna learn. Don't expect an easy class though. Likes to challenge people. Take his classes, highly recommended
wouldnt round my grade, easy teach

Professor is decently nice, but his tests are on another level. I have taken so many psych classes and never gotten anything less than an A until this course. His exam questions are so time-consuming and require multiple pieces of specific evidence. Don't take this unless necessary or you want to specialize in this area of development.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: You can't help but like Prof. Franchak; he's very caring, funny, and considerate, and makes a conceptually difficult class smooth and organized. Everything is laid out for you, and Franchak himself is quite thorough. The material for PSYC012 is heavy, but very manageable. As long as you keep up week by week, there shouldn't be any issues.

Overall, the class was pretty easy. I enjoyed that it was online because we could use the time that was dedicated to lecture to do other things and study! The paper was probably the toughest thing to do but you can send drafts to your TA to get feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easy online course, homework is online and unproctered quizzes. One big final paper, and a group project, most of the time you will spend time in your lab working on it so get ready.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: The professor was kind and wanted to answer our questions if we had any. The research paper was assigned a bit later in class and it felt a bit rushed. He is a great guy but as a professor I would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was a hard class. His lectures were boring and hard to follow. He assigns readings throughout the week and is organized on the class page in the modules.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: he is passionate about the subject he teaches. the slides dont contain a lot of info. he goes fast in lectures. assigns a paper that needs 10 sources. he is kind and will help if you have questions. overall good proffessor but his exams are challenging even open note. only 25% class got above a 85% on our midterm

I agree with the previous comments! He was dorky and kind, always willing to give feedback and help you understand the concepts. The study guides he provided made studying for exams easy and his format was not bad. 10/10!

This class was asynchronous, so there weren't very many instances in which I met with Dr. Franchak. However, he is a very dorky and helpful man, and it was great to see him in the times that we could. Labs synchronous, with a few assignments and a research paper. 5 tests. Small chapter quizzes. Professor made it easy to understand.

I took his class Spring 2020 and for so, there was 1 Term paper, 3 midterms and a final. Take notes in great detail in order to understand the midterms. Midterms are non-cumulative. InQuizitive purchase (small pop quizzes). Do not procrastinate the Term Paper.

The best professor at UCR!!!! He is so understanding and really wants you to get a good grade. His lectures are very interesting and his voice is so soft so it is easy to stay focused throughout the lecture. He also offers a lot of extra credit and his exams are super easy as long as you go to lecture
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: 2 research papers. 3 midterms and a final. Tests were easy just make sure you know the slides. Attending lecture helps but you can pass w/o. Inquizitve and tophat. Random EC during class. Papers were straightforward but lengthy so manage time wisely. Follow the rubric to the T and you will get an A. Cares about students and is easily approachable.

Very soft spoken. I'd say this is a pretty standard level of difficulty for the average mandatory-for-your-major class. Missing class won't kill you but you'll need to study more on your own. Study efficiently and effectively for exams by reviewing the lecture slides that he will upload. DON'T PROCRASTINATE ON PAPERS.

Prof. Franchak is very approachable and wants you to succeed. He provided clear criteria for the 2 papers and the study guides are straightforward; exams are multi choice but do require some crit. thinking and application. His powerpoints are on the simple side, but the textbook helps with filling in the blanks.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very soft spoken, so it made it a bit hard to pay attention but very well-organized. Also really friendly. The exams were very easy as long as you study his slides & the study guide he gives you. The difficult part of the class was the long research papers. He does expect a lot for them, so definitely get as much help as you can and start early.

Amazing professor. Very clear, very understanding. He is very approachable. He gives out small extra credit (ours was worth up to 3%). Make sure not only to know the material, because it is a lot of definitions, but to UNDERSTAND the material. The test questions go beyond the definitions. Tests require critical thinking, but they aren't too hard.

The material was straight forward but the tests were pretty hard. What really helps is reading the book for the tests, the slides only skim over the material. However you don't really need the book. He does give extra credit throughout the quarter and none of his exams are cumulative. The class overall wasn't too hard for a 6 unit class.

I believe this quarter was Dr. Franchak's first time teaching at UCR. For a first timer, he was pretty good. The material is really straight forward, but his exams are pretty hard. Read the book, study the lectures, but make flashcards; definitely helps a lot. Take seriously; the class is 6 units after all and is needed for psych upper-divs!!

During one class meeting she orchestrated an ambush of me of sorts, in which she called on a student so that he could voice his - and her - disapproval of my comments I had posted to the discussion board in reaction to an assigned reading. Utterly unprofessional to say the least.

She's so AWFUL! she does not care about the students success and she will fail you even if you do well in everything! I did so well in her exams but she still failed me anyways because she is so evil! She will also humiliate you infront of the whole class if you don't do good in your project and she will also be so mean to you if you ask for help!

One of my favorite classes. Amazing professor, changed my perspective on important world issues + used films to teach. I do regret not participating, made the class more interesting.

reviews.comment: she was a really understanding teacher as far as our class went. it was an upper div class so the workload was not light but the topic of the class was pretty cool so it wasn't hard to write about the material we viewed/read. she would give really in depth feedback to the points made in our discussion posts and summarize the most important ideas
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: To be honest, she gave out the midterm/ final Qs & Ans on the review days, so pay extra attention. It required to read a lot of articles and few homework. She really encourages the class to participate and sit in the front. Overall, she is a okay prof. if you pay attention and do the reading, you'll be fine. You'll need to work for it though.

If you don't read the readings that she assigns then you will have hard time on the exam. The class consists in 35% midterm, 35% final, 20% discussion participation, and 10% in lecture. The exam is take home.

reviews.comment: Incompetent, she does not do a good job in explaining any material. The readings assigned are bland and hard to comprehend. In general, I don't think she should be teaching students especially because she states that she struggles with particular readings herself.
