reviews.comment: she is so specific in the answers she looks for, will tell you that your opinion is wrong if it differs from hers. difficult grader on tests as she looks for specific answers which mirror her opinion, she posts readings on ilearn which are bland but she will test on them. she seems like a cool person but she is not a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is an extremely tough grader and very specific in what she expects. She assigns A LOT of reading and you have to watch movies/documentaries on your own time (some are extremely dry, some are good). You HAVE TO do the work or you will not pass the class.  She is very passionate about the subject and she treats the course EXTREMELY seriously.

Really did make this Intro class feel like an upper division class. She was really opinionated about certain topic and if you didn't agree with her she completely ignored your point. Participation is asked for but its difficult to participate because if you say the wrong thing she shuts you down making you feel bad for even talking.
Made this intro class feel like an upper division. Do not take MCS1 with this professor.

Doesn't care about her students, and does what she wants because "she's the professor", shortened the final to 2 hours long for her own personal reasons without compensating the content of the final to match the amount of time given to us.
ridiculous styled test
Feel like she makes up half the stuff she says. Nothing really makes sense. You are wrong if you interpret anything differently.
She is such a sweetheart , she teaches well and she is helpful. I didnt aways show up to this class but i still got an A. She is nice and understanding and the class is pretty self explanatory.

A great professor who lectures all over the lecture hall to make sure that you hear. Shes really willing to speak with you whenever you need to talk. The class itself is a bit boring at times but the material has to be covered. Didnt require any books to be bought, all material was on iLearn. The TA's grade the midterm and final, discussion was fun
I took her for Intro to Latin American film, lectures could get a little dense and boring, but we watched some great movies and we had an easy take home final, all in all pretty good class.

I thoroughly enjoyed taking Prof. Schiwy's class on Latin American Film. We watched some good movies, had a lot of interesting class discussions, and read some thought-provoking articles. Class isn't too hard, just pay attention in class and watch all the movies and you should be good. She's also pretty friendly and approachable outside of class.

Interesting class. I took her for Latin American film and it was fairly easy. If you dont go to lecture or screening you WILL get lost. Otherwise, you should be fine. You have to read a couple articles but no textbook work. She asks a lot of critical thinking questions and often makes you work with those around you and it kinda becomes awkward.
Easy class, if you take her you better expect talk a lot about Latin American Indigenous film
Easy class no textbook she shows the test questions to the exam so you can study them just go to class read material and you should be fine

No coherent thoughts, just babbling about topics that have very little to do with the class. Little structure leads to confusion running rampant and extremely difficult essay style final and mid-term.

Andean film class had the most convoluted and intricate ideas I've ever seen applied to such a large range of complex topics ever. Too much theory, not enough film and the focus of the theory was lost at times for being irrelevant. Chaotic class where the final will kill you if she gives those deceivingly cute paragraph essay questions.

this professor makes students get involved in class even though i never had an opinion on the subject.. why i never dropped this class is beyond me which i ended up with an F.. her exams were hard where u had to basically write paragraphs for each question... i basically gave up on the final exam
Great class but you must get involved. She asks her students all the questions and the student involvement creates the flow of the class. Really kool.

Very helpful and interesting. Had her for Intro to Latin American film and loved it. That TV class not so much but I think it was the material that was boring and almost pointless. Take her for a film or latin american studies class. AVOID INTRO TO TV!

Completely incomprehensible. Did not know or understand the material herself! COPS is not a crime drama! Sometimes felt like she was making things up. Can't blame her, she is specialized in Latin American studies, but this is what the TV class felt like most of the time! Latin American studies! Awful, avoid at all costs. TAs were not helpful either

If you're a good writer, you'll do fine in this course. Do the readings, but going to discussion will really help your paper. There's a good amount of reading, but I mostly skimmed and just listened to Frost and my TA summarize everything. You only need to write two papers, but there's a weekly journal due every Sunday night.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Lots of reading and writing, but relatively easy class. There are two main papers you need to write and one journal you need to keep up with for the whole course. Professor Frost was relatable and most lectures were interesting, but not mandatory. There are audio files offered for every reading, so that makes things easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Frost is such a genuinely good person that even if his lectures sucked, I still would've been happy. Lectures were kinda boring but still interesting (and not mandatory). Help is really accessible and the work is relatively easy, you just have to do it. I'm not knowledgeable in philosophy but it was a good intro course. love him
A good professor, the lecture are well organized and sometimes adds a funny skit that goes with the lesson from the lecture.

Kim Frost and the TAs really emphasize learning over studenting. There is a rubric, but only for the basics (like thesis, hook, transition sentences). The discussion is mandatory but essential since it really prepares you for the essays. You get to redo one of the essays if you didn’t like your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Inspirational

reviews.comment: I took the class online and it was pretty much entirely asynchronous. Two papers, both of which were reviewed extensively in discussion. Weekly homework assignments that were easy if you watched the lectures. Overall would recommend!

Weekly readings and the lectures were rather long. You might not need to view the entire lecture. I would usually watch it in1.5x speed, and would click only to the portions I had questions of. You don't need to take notes, and only discussion mandatory. You get to revise one of the two essays you write at the end, grading is straightforward.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Class was very hard to understand maybe philosophy isn't my thing. I thought this class would be more about learning life but really digs into your brain instead. Lots of reading & super long lectures. If you are busy this class will drain you. I would sit at my computer for hrs staring at the screen for the lectures. Its doable but I did not enjoy
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The worst part about this class is the grading system, there are no numbers only need improvement, good, or excellent. It comes from good intentions to make it less about the grade, but with revision opportunities, there's really no way to know how you're doing on the papers grade-wise. Bonus tho if you get Dan Green as your TA, he's great.

Prof Frost's lectures were basically all asynchronous, w the usual discussion w TAs. There are three 5-6 pg papers, one 2-pg paper, and that's really all for assignments. Make sure to show up to discussion and the workshop zooms meetings to get participation pts, but besides that, as long as u put in the effort, it will be an easy A.

If you prefer multiple choice tests there's none, every week a short answer question is due along w a discussion board post - miss one and it's an automatic fail. It's a really easy class, he simplifies all the readings w the lectures and as long as you have a basic understanding of the topic then you should be able to get at least a B
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's good at teaching, although his classes are lectures heavy. I would recommend to use a recording app to record and turn them into notes. He went through EVERYTHING you need for the exams. He gives out a lot of extra credits too, and the credits are very generous. Gives good feedbacks. Just pray that you don't get any TAs as graders.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hands down the best lecturer I have ever had. He makes each lecture a cohesive and interesting story that will make you want to listen. Listening to his lecture is like watching a YouTube mini documentary and they were all incredibly entertaining and engaging.

He gives amazing and rich lectures. However, he doesn't provide actual information in the slides, he only uses pictures. Which imo makes it difficult to memorize the content. You really dont have to attend lecture to pass the class you only need to read the text that are given and go to discussion to review the material and you'll pass the class.
He has pretty good lectures but its super hard to take notes on his slides. the midterm and final are very easy though if you take good notes and the grades you get on his papers depend on your TA.

Prof. Fullerton was amazing! Got an A+ and all I had to do was attend lectures and engage a bit in the discussion, know your vocab words, and make sure you understood the overall themes. His lectures are really good and are similar to story-telling so it's not completely boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He gives his lectures as if he was telling a story, so it's very easy to understand and remember everything! Loved his lectures, only two short essays for the entire quarter and the midterm and final were easy. As long as you attend the lectures you will be ok! Lectures feel very short, he takes breaks to answer questions, very engaging.

It is only half way through the Winter Quarter, but I think he already deserves a review. Professor Fullerton's lectures are so AMAZING. Every time I go to class it's as if I am sitting through a tv show. He uses rich vocabulary at times, but talks at a slower paces and explains well so that you can understand the content. one of the better profs !

Discussion was mandatory, but lecture-wise you don't have to attend. Prof. was great, but be prepared to learn by listening because he does not provide textual slides. You mainly just need to know vocab words and read the assigned readings to do well in his midterm and final. There was also 2 essays assigned as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: To be honest, as long as you attend the lecture and your discussion you will be fine. Class consists of 2 essays a midterm and a final. There are readings, but depending on your TA they might not be necessary. Overall this class was great Dr. Fullerton is awesome

I recommend this course with this Prof. to anyone. Just pay attention in general and do your readings. He is charismatic during the lectures, and very engaging. Encourages students to participate and reminds us when stuff are due.

Professor Fullerton really cares about the work he puts out. The downside is that you would have to attend all lectures, however they are very interesting. 1 midterm, 1 essay, 1 final. Final and midterm are the same but only writing. Just attend lecture and pay attention and you will be fine. Not too hard if you study and put in some work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Slander and Libel in Western History: 1 paper, 1 midterm, and 1 Final. Gave you 3 scheduled opportunities for your paper and allowed 1 chance to redo paper if you take up the 2 earliest due dates. Midterm/Final was defining terms mentioned throughout lecture and an essay. Participation and attending lecture is the only way to succeed in class.

Tooked him for Henry the 8th and Six Wives class was amazing and he was fun, chill, and hilarious! This class required 3 essays which he grades slightly tough but does give good feedback and really wants students to do well ! Make sure to listen very carefully since lecture slides has no bullet points for note taking . Also participation matters.

Graded by collaboration reports, quizzes, + attendance. Collab reports was talking with a partner bout reading then writing 300 words. Quizzes were on reading, 7 MCQ 3 FRQ. No big exams. Attendance is mandatory. Do readings as quizzes are comprehension-based. Fun class, engaging material, great peer interactions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I forget the course code as it's been some years, but I enjoyed the course Romantic Seconds very much. Dr. Wang was my favorite professor throughout college. He had a way of teaching without imposing himself on us. He was a class act and I admire him to this day. The impression he made on me will last a lifetime.

Intense reading pace but expected for a class on all Austen's books. 6 books and 1 close reading for each, and an annotated bibliography for the final. Grading was really generous, no need to stress. Also a presentation on 1 books & a presentation write-up but once again low stress. I enjoyed getting to see everyone's take on the books.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: Professor Wang was one of my favorite professors. I didn't like poetry going into it, but the class was pretty easy and fun. As long as you follow the instructions on the assignments, and turn them in on time, you'll get an A. There is one live recitation, but as long as you do it, you get credit, regardless of how badly you mess up. 10/10

One of the best classes at UCR. There is kind of a lot of reading but it is super interesting and readable. Only graded on 3 close readings (1000 words) & a final paper (1,500) along with a presentation+presentation write-up. He is an easy grader and super laid back. He provides the textbook so you don't have to purchase it! Super caring Professor!

I heavily enjoyed Professor Wang's class. His lectures are very insightful and inspiring. Every poem that was read was covered with ample discussion and explanations. He is easy to talk to and very inclusive with the material and the students. He is very comedic yet very knowledgeable. Loved this class.

He has online lecture videos for each class and then there are recitations in-person. Don't stress over the recitation & get it over with the beginning of the quarter. Grading is very clear, so you will get an A if you follow the directions. No midterm, final is long (you have 24hrs). If you passed AP Lang/Lit you'll pass this one. Would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He accommodated for the pandemic and provided every lecture day 1 of class. His grading is lenient and provides good feedback. Be ready for close analyzing - he assigned 3 different authors throughout the quarter and for each we had to write a close reading. 3 Close reading papers, 1 in-class recitation, 1 Final paper (comparing author's works).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: While the reading pace is quite intense, Professor Wang was extremely caring and attentive to the students' needs. His online grading was really generous and he was a true gem of a professor. 6 books and 1 close reading for each, and an annotated bibliography for the final. Made Austen enjoyable and fun, and interacted with the class amazingly!

I really loved taking Dr. Wang's class! He was definitely at a disadvantage with us being online and our focus being other places, but I can tall he's an excellent in-person prof as well. The assignments really helped balance our grades out, and we got a week to complete our open-book final. :D
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Wang really accommodated for the pandemic and even provided online technical lectures which were really helpful. His lectures are interesting and don't sound like a boring history lesson when he teaches about the era. He is very understanding, don't be afraid to ask questions and participate in class :). You do have 1 recitation.

Dr. Wang is the best professor I've ever had in my 4 years at UCR. He is understanding, he explains in detail, and his classes are interesting and informative. His teaching style is easy to absorb and his classes are just the best. If you're not interested in poetry/literature, it'll be hard for you to be interested but that's true for all classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Wang is a wonderful professor. He does require students to read a lot, but he teaches Upper Div courses. By memorizing poems and texts, he is helping students learn how to read closely. One of the best professors at UCR! Guess what?!? If you do the work, you pass the class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Worst English class course Ive taken in my four years at UCR. Class is basically memorizing a ridiculous amount of poetry and definitions. He makes it seem as though non-english majors are welcome but then expects you to have some great background on all things poetry. Class is graded by a poem recitation, midterm, paper, and final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I did not enjoy this class and the exams were annoying. Honestly the worst of all 16 college English classes I've taken. Professor Wang is mediocre at best and even had the same test layout as Lloyd. Get ready to memorize a bunch of boring Romantic poems and vaguely learn about the era. A poetry class should entail close reading essays, not exams.

This is my very first review on this site. I created an account just to review Gareth Funning. I sacrificed my GPA to warn future students never to take any class with him. This professor is extremely egotistical, thinks he is funny when he is not, and is the most grueling essay grader I have ever encountered.

P.S. Essays are your main grade
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Its introductory geology so the material is not too complicated. However, for the specifics it is important to go to lecture. He has high expectations for your written work, but will drop 1 midterm and 5 quizzes.

I took this class because I liked rocks... Gareth is a professor that is very passionate about his work and presents material in an easy-to-understand manner for students. I learned a lot in this class... The book is needed since he gives small quizzes. He allows the use of index notecards for every midterm and final.

Labs 45% - Labs are confusing and tough, so if you TA is helpful and you like the way he/she instructs, then continue. Otherwise, please switch. (IMPORTANT) 5 essay exams 45% (it's really hard to get 5/ 5 on an essay unless you are ENGLISH and GEOLOGY major. Be prepared. before class quizzes 10% - this part is manageable. Questions are tricky.

Professor Gareth would have online quizzes before every lecture to make sure that you read, but they help him look at what needs to be covered and explained more during lecture. He's nice, always leaves feedback after his midterm essay grading. You will never get a 55 on one, though. Very careful with lab final. Study since you start lab.

Grading is honestly pretty ridiculous. Lab is worth 45% of the total class grade. Lab final is worth 20%, and the averages for lab is around 60%. Just due to this, you're already fighting for a B. Not a class I would recommend to anyone and wished I had looked up  this professor beforehand.

While this class is very difficult, Gareth gives you the tools you need to succeed. It is really important you pay attention in lab, and you really study so you get a grasp on the concepts learned rather than memorization. Essay tests but he drops 1. Lots of quizzes, drops the 5 lowest. Overall a great professor.

By far the worst class i have taken. If you are not interested in rocks DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!...for our lab all we did was look at rocks!...i had to change the grade basis for this class, or else my gpa would have been grately affected...midterms and final consist of writing essays which he grades extremely hard. Wouldn't recommend class!!

If you don't like science Don't take this class. If you don't like rocks and minerals don't take this class. He will help you learn about the science behind rocks and minerals. Don't like it? Drop the class.

The Worst Professor EVER. I had a 4.0 in college and let me tell you after this class I don't. He takes your essay's you have to write and tears them apart. Tells you to go back to high school and learn how to write. He dosn't want to help you at all. Dont take this class you will regret it. On 5 people have A's in my class and they were geo majors

The Worst Professor EVER. I had a 4.0 in college and let me tell you after this class I don't. He takes your essay's you have to write and tears them apart. Tells you to go back to high school and learn how to write. He dosn't want to help you at all. Dont take this class you will regret it. On 5 people have A's in my class and they were geo majors
Sarcastic, rude, and over all obnoxious. Sure, he knows what he's talking about, but God forbid you ask any kind of question, because you will be sorry you did.
for those getting C's and D's in GEO 1, simply because you guys are not capable to handle college level works...

all i can say is "difficult." even though he wasn't the main professor of the class, he was the main lecturer and grader of midterms/final. he expects you to know a lot about geology (even for an intro class), which is why he is a tough grader. i guess this is what happens when you get a graduate from cambridge AND oxford as a lecturer...
Get out as soon as you can.  Boring lectures and extremely difficult labs. I wouldn't recommend this class unless you really enjoy learning about rocks.

What can I say? Horrible class and so boring. Lectures are not helpful at all. I did like the fact that the exams are open note. The labs are so hard and the professor has a bad attitude. Get out while you can.

Great teacher overall, gets a little carried away with tangents sometimes especially with the more show-offey students who are always ahead in lecture. Also gets snappy when people try to get him back on track, especially for office hours. However, if you don't mind that part, he is a great teacher to have for CS10C
Easily one of the best professors to teach 10C. Made it really fun and enjoyable!

Probably the only CS141 professor that won't give you an aneurism. In all seriousness, he can break down some incredibly complex concepts into simple words. The homework/exam is well within reasonable. If you are lucky enough to see a CS141 section that is being taught by him, please do yourself a favor and register.

If you have a chance to take 10C with Jamour, 100% do it. The workload was very fair in my opinion as well as the final exam. We used zyBooks but he did not require us to do the little activities. There was no midterm, just quizzes, hw, labs, & participation. He’s super funny & keeps lectures interesting. One of my favorite CS professors so far!

Fuad is a funny and energetic guy, although his lack of hands-on coding assignments makes it more difficult to create algorithms. He pounds in the key conceptual ideas better than most professors and genuinely cares about helping students understand why something works. Would recommend for lecture-enjoyers!

. He really cares about his student and responds to emails quickly. If several people are struggling with a lab he will extend the deadline. There are class participation activities so I recommend going to class also the lectures were enough for me to learn and do well in the class. He gives a lot of extra credit chances.

Gives loads of participate extra credit, really thorough in lectures, and generally a really good professor. You are lucky to get him, he is the best professor I have ever had and clearly cares about doing a good job.
great professor, easy class if you have no clue what you're doing, even easier if you do! absolutely recommend

I loved this class. Prof. Jamour is a very understanding and considerate person. He never made me feel discouraged about asking questions, going to office hours, etc. He makes sure that the content is understood before moving on. He was very clear with any changes made to assignments on the syllabus.

Professor Jamour is a great professor! His lecturing is straightforward and his assignments are fun to do and ensure learning. He gives alot of help on assignments by going over examples in class or even holding an extra session dedicated to lab help. Overall, one of the best professors I had at UCR. Also, he gives next level smoothie recipes!
He shows that he truly cares about his students and that he wants us all to learn and succeed.

Great professor, is understanding of everyone's circumstances and will accommodate to what works best for the majority of the class. He gives clear instructions on what to do for the assignments and gives little smoothie recipes. 10/10 would recommend.

He is passionate about what he teaches. Participation helps him become more engaged and makes the class more interesting. He truly wants his students to understand and enjoy the subject. He was able to make us think about the information and challenge us but not to a terrible stress level. Very sweet man. Participation helps everyone enjoy the clas

He was honestly an amazing professor! If you have to take a CS class, make sure you take him! He was always available after class (even for really long hours at a time). He had a passion for what he taught and that made the lectures all the more enjoyable. If you ever need help, he is readily available, so don't hesitate to take him!

One of the best professors I've had. He was so caring and understanding to fit the needs of the classes and answer all questions we had. He worked at our pace and did not try to cram in quizzes, worksheets, projects. There's a lot of room for extra credit. The labs were enjoyable and he liked us to get creative with it. Take the class!

I wish I could give a lower score. Does not share slides with students and makes quizzes unnecessarily difficult. It would be reasonable to just say study for the quizzes but even that is pointless because of how difficult he makes them.

This professor's assignments and quizzes are formatted weirdly. He doesn't offer much guidance and help for them. We have no way of studying and understanding the concepts in order to be confident in our answers for the quiz. He doesn't allow us to see the correct answers which make it hard for us to understand what we did wrong and learn from it.

There will be a group project for lab. I've taken him during the summer and there was 4 lab quizzes. In my opinion and what I have gathered from other classmates, the quizzes get harder. The last quiz is the worst so make sure that you blow up his emails to ask questions because other than that he doesn't give any guidance for the lab assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Everything on the reviews is gonna be on quizzes and test so if you review what he tells you to you'll do well. However he explains things in a really hard to understand manner so you'll have to do a lot of self study if you want to understand the material. He does take time to answer questions but if this is your exposure to calc 3 you'll struggle

Pretty chill professor, takes good feedback from students. Not very good at teaching in lectures, you'll have to study independently outside of class. lecture attendance is mandatory and there are quizzes in discussions. Study the quiz prep documents inside out because they make up most of the exams. overall, his course is tedious but an easy A.

Fred's exams prep is fantastic for midterms & finals. His guides cover almost 90% of exam questions. Quizzes match his prep word-for-word. Lectures can be tricky, but his examples clarify the material. Not sure why he gets hate!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: i love fred! he was an amazing 10a teacher and made me enjoy and get an easy a in the class. he is straight forward with what is on both the midterm and the final and gave goody bags at the final. he is funny, his lectures are amazing, you literally can not hate the guy.

Genuinely a great guy, cares about  students and makes 3 sports references a week. Very upfront about what is on exams. Didn't like how some quizzes were basically just memorize a theorem or a true/false question and regurgitate it word for word, especially since this was on the final too. Gave goody bags for the final, you can't hate the guy.
Amazing professor and overall great teaching method. Would definitely take a class with him again.

Honestly a sweet guy, but is poor at teaching. To make it worse, attendance is mandatory when you're better off studying alone. His exam preps are way different from the test. There's weekly quizzes just study his quiz preps. For exams make sure you know basic calculations from homework and should be ok. Not bad, just misleading with test preps :/

Avoid him!! He felt rude whenever I went to office hours it felt like he had to show he was right and like how do you not know this stuff by now? His midterm and final prep were not that great. It was underwhelming and you just felt like you had to review everything since he was unclear. Lecture were boring and attendance were required.

He is not good at teaching content. Better off watching YouTube videos, but lecture is mandatory. His "Midterm Prep" and "Final Prep" are utterly useless as he mentions things to study "guaranteeing" 70% or so of it will be on it, but not that much is on it and is a majority other stuff. At that point he's better off telling us study everything.

He is not the greatest but is decent. Attendance is mandatory. Lectures were boring. He is also a very bad communicator. Midterm prep was not like what it was stated. Same goes for Final Prep for some. He kept making mistakes for those and it's annoying. Good grading scale but is a very nitpicky about questions regarding exams.

Terrible communication regarding midterm and final prep, be prepared to be all alone except for vague, cryptic messages via email filled with typo responses and mistakes. Please be well prepared to look at the study guides given, and seeing no specification whatsoever. It might as well be that he never gave one in the first place.

Avoid this professor attendance mandatory, and somewhat unclear during lecture. Does not drop quizzes. However generous in some aspects but don't rely on a curve or extra credit. TA were amazing though.
Felt like he always needed to be intellectually superior to you. He turns every interaction into a verbal fight. He's mean, abrasive, and rude
Too many to study.
Really annoying class.

You may feel lost at times during lectures, but Fred answers any concerns and questions very quickly and clearly. Watch youtube to strengthen knowledge. Lots of extra credit, Homework, Quizzes, Final, you name it. Gives a detailed outline of what you are tested on Midterms and Final, study this outline to the tee and you will leave with an A.

At the beginning of the quarter, I wasn't sure if I was going to do well in this class. However, Dr. Wilhelm provides a decent amount of extra credit and makes exams/quizzes similar to homework, so he won't test you on anything that you have never seen. After taking other math classes at UCR, I finally realized how much of a gem Dr. Wilhelm is.

Professor Wilhelm is a very well-respected professor. Efficient with the presentation of the material. Although some content can be explored slightly better, his teaching style is profound. The professor provides many visuals, which is nice. He is extremely fair with the exams and structures them well.

Dr. Wilhelm is awesome. He has a great personality that makes learning enjoyable. Definitely choose him as your math prof if you can. As long as you have a good understanding of the conceptual and calculation components of the class, you're set to receive a good grade. He offers a modest amount of Extra Credit too.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Real funny guy, makes a lot of football references, he takes pride in playing football in high school. Anywho, the questions and solutions he gives on the quiz preps are identical to the weekly quizzes, not much studying is needed for the midterm and final if you do all of the weekly homework on WebAssign. Textbook not needed, website is pricey tho
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There is weekly homework, weekly quizzes, a midterm, and a final. Homeworks are doable, but Wilhelm is more than happy to help at the end class and in office hours. The quizzes all have a corresponding quiz prep, which are exactly like the actual quizzes. The midterm and final consist of similar homework problems and the quiz preps. Ask questions!
Tough material, but professor Wilhelm does an excellent job and teaching this material. Good professor and encourages questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: If you do the WebAssign homework, study the quiz preps, and study the midterm/final prep, you'll do well. He is helpful during office hours. He emphasizes on asking questions during lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you're going to have this professor for 10B, then I suggest that you start using the textbook. I didn't understand what he said during lectures, and I regret not using the book sooner. He knows his material, but he can't explain it or express it clearly for his students.

Dr. Wilhelm makes his exams unlike other professors as he makes us do lot of memorization at least of half of my mid term and my final consisted of definitions and a true false questions. He allowed us a cheat sheet and it was almost mandatory to have one due to the number of definitions and true false questions.

Definitely one of the better professors that taught 9B back in 2015 Spring (didn't think about writing a review until now), he actually managed to explain the proofs and the concepts behind them very clearly and also provided plenty of example problems to apply what was taught to homework/tests.

Professor Wilhelm was a really easy A! Especially if you're semi-alert in class, I'm talking about no coffee needed but also don't nap. I'm pretty sure you wouldn't miss anything but just don't do it. There's a quiz every week in discussion so prepare for those by studying the quiz prep and do your homework. Take advantage of the TA's help as well!
Go to class, study the quiz problems, and do the WebWork. Oh and did I mention.. study the quiz prep problems.

He's a really funny guy and he tries to make the class interesting. I didn't learn anything from his lectures. I just studied off the homework on webworks. Just do all the homework and study the quiz prep and you should get an A

Professor Wilhelm is a really good teacher! He clarifies everything if you ask for help. His midterm and final aren't meant to trick you. If you study the quiz prep problems and the webworks problems, you will get an A!! Good class and good professor!

Assigns a lot of hw. Do it ALL because it REALLY helps on the midterm and final. His way of teaching is for you to learn the hard way and test the EASY way. He has two grading scales (hw15, q15, m30, final40%) & (10,10,10,70%). If u do bad on the midterm, then make it up on the final. He's nerdy, weird, and laughs unexpectedly. Gets the job done.

Wilhelm was very enthused about Calc. but had an obnoxious way to teaching. Exam's were no surprise, but what's the point of having a professor if he's bite your head off upon asking a stupid question?
Several years after graduating UCR, I can honestly say that he is one of the best professors I have ever had. Well prepared, serious, knowledgeable, and neat. Good job Fred!

straightforward easy tests-wont pick the hard material from the course to test on and questions look exactly like hw+quizzes. Final followed same format as midterm...Will try with all his might not to lose his temper if you ask a stupid question. Assigns LOTS of hw. con: didn't cover enough material in lecture to help with hw-nice guy great class
Nice guy although he may seem like he wants to tear your head off. Do the exam prep problems and the exams are easy and strait forward. Helpful in office hours if you don't understand something
He is "intense" sometimes, and nerdy, but he's a very good teacher.  Do the exam prep problems and you will have no problem passing the class.

Just took the midterm and it was so sweet and easy. Yes, he can be unclear at time because he assume you know your stuff from 2 days ago that he have taught you. But he ask the class for questions so if you're too chicken to ask questions then it's your fault. His office hours is useful and he's really crazy/quirky. Anyway the midterm is tight.

tries very hard to make the material understandable. unfortunately he assigns a GRIP of homework. if there were 50 questions available in the texbook in a given section, he would assign at least 40 of them and call them "exam-preparation" questions. how exactly are those exam-preparation when you don't know which problem to prepare for? thumbs down
Reminds me of Professor Frink from The Simpsons.  Nice guy, fun class, could be a little more helpful in his office hours.
No Comments

He's nerdy and dorky in a funny kind of way and he tries to make his lectures more interesting by coming up with nerdy remarks or jokes. "OUCH HOT" Pay attention in his class and do your hw and exam prep problems and you'll definitely pass the class if not an A.

While some may have found him boring, I personally thought his explanations about the text was extremely insightful. They might be boring but he tells you exactly what you are supposed to write about in your essays if you pay attention to his lecture. 5 quizzes and 2 papers. He's quite nice and I personally like Shakespeare so I enjoyed the class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Funk is a good dude, a bit awkward, but he knows his stuff and is more than willing to help if you're having trouble with the readings or papers during office hours. There were two papers and biweekly quizzes, which were straightforward and fairly easy to do if you went to class and paid attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He is not very approachable. He is a tough grader; gives critiques, but even if you fulfill them he will find something else to mark you down for. I am an english major and I've never received a B on an upper division paper, and I think its odd to grade students on their writing style simply because you don't like it yourself. Would not recommend

Prof. Funk lectures are student led & he knows when the class hasn't read. It frustrates him when the class doesn't participate and will call you out if you're not paying attention. He is a hard grader, but leaves good feedback for you to improve. Overall, we had 3 discussion posts, 5 quizzes, and two papers. Not too bad but Shakespeare is Boringg!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Great professor. He looks intimidating and strict and all, but once you meet his standards and let him know that you're into the class, he will help you out a lot. His lectures are always clear, kinda forces you to participate, but he's really nice when you participate. Just don't miss classes and don't goof around during class, and you'll be fine.

Fusco may be intimidating, but he is an EXCELLENT professor. I enjoyed attending his classes and I improved alot on my writing skills. He is very helpful at office hours so take advantage of that! Also you MUST ATTEND class regularly in order to do well. If you get a chance to take him go for it!

Fusco is a great professor. He knows his stuff and makes sure his students understand what he is talking about. I HIGHLY recommend taking him. He made me a better writer. He is intimidating at first, but you will find that he is a really nice guy. Just work hard and youll be fine!

This guy knows how to teach, how to analyze, how to engage, and how to work out (seriously, his muscles are HUGE). He will yell sometimes, but only if someone's being a ruhtard. If you have the opportunity take him, you won't regret it.

Fusco at first seemed like the kinda guy I wouldn't like because he was like the buff new jersey kinda know-it-all, but then as I got to know him he's actually really smart. He is very easy as a TA and I recommend him :)

He may be tough on you, but once you get to know him and learn his teaching skills, it can be helpful to your essays. He is funny and does his best to help you learn how to write an essay a lot better. He may be a tough grader, but you will learn a lot from his class.
FUSCO is the hottest teacher at UCR. At first he is strict but once you get to know him it is clear that he does have intellectual skills and is there to help you.

Fusco is an intense teacher. At first he is intimidating but once you get used to his style of teaching you become not only a better writer but a better thinker. Fusco really engages his students to analyze their thoughts and then translate them onto paper. At times he may be a hard grader but he wants you to do your best. Helps greatly in officeho

I am intrigued with all these comments! I had him as a professor Spring Qtr and he was always on top of things, asking for questions. He is challenging but it makes the class only more interesting. (p.s. He is the hottest teacher I've had on campus!) He is a MUST TAKE!;)

im really surprised by these comments. this guy must of seriously lightened up, because i think i took his class when he was new at ucr. but anyways when i had him he was a very strict grader, he would just start yelling at the class and he would put students on the spot and humiliate them.

Professor Fusco is a pretty good teacher.  He is challenging, and you have to make sure you follow his directions carefully.  I took English 1b with him and the course was centered around the St. Martins Guide.  Follow the examples from the textbook in your writing and you will do well in his class.

Fusco is a really great teacher. Make sure you attend 95% of classes though or you will fall behind very quickly. He can be pretty intimidating but as long as you don't goof around in class and show him you're putting forth effort in your hw/essays and participating in the in class discussions you will do well.

he is a really cool teacher but the class can get hard if u fall behind or miss interpret anything he says. he assigns a lot of essays pretty much back to back. he did teach me to be a better writer. also on the final day of class he provided pizza and soda for all the students. he is a must take professor.
Great professor but there are a lot of readings needed to been done in this course. Overall very doable class and reading quizzes were easy and fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: All I can say is get ready to read. If you skip one class your grade will drastically drop. She does a reading quiz or writing quiz every lecture and she is insanely strict on those too, having TAs walk around. Discussion is also mandatory, it's a lot of work for a breadth course and I wouldn't take this course again. NOT AN EASY A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Be prepared for a heavy workload and lots of reading. Attendance matters since there are frequent in-class writing assignments and quizzes. The writing isn't too bad, especially with partner work. Stay consistent and manage your time to avoid falling behind. Overall, it's challenging but I learned a lot and enjoyed the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: if you genuinely love reading non fiction and learning about latino culture you're gonna love this class.i only bought two physical books which came out to like $16. FOR THE LAST BOOK LOOK FOR IT AT AN LA CITY LIBRARY. there is a quiz or written assignment each class but it's very easy if you read the material before. very thought provoking class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is very demanding and not for the faint-hearted. Expect to spend around $40 on books and keep up with heavy reading, sometimes up to four chapters before class. The professor enforces this with quizzes at the start and end of every lecture, making attendance mandatory. Not recommended if you're double majoring or have a heavy workload.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: really simple/upfront stress free class with lots of extra credit. he makes concepts easy to understand, you can tell he loves what he does which makes the class enjoyable. the reading can be kinda overbearing sometimes, but skimming over the chapters is just fine as its basically the same thing as the lectures, just more in depth in some places.

I had him winter 2021 and he was great! I really think he deserves a better rating, his exams are just based off his slides and he is a good lecturer. He gives extra credit opportunities in every lecture so this class is an easy A (unless you don't try). Super interesting class, I would recommend :)

This class was by far one of my favorites; however, you do have to work for your grade. Funder gives 4 40 question midterms that are easy to pass as long as you do your reading and in my opinion attend lectures. He is an old school lecturer, so he doesn't read off of power points but his lectures are really interesting and easy to follow.

Dr. Funder is an amazing Professor! I thoroughly enjoyed taking his class. He gives 4 midterms over the course of the quarter and the final exam is cumulative. The class is pretty difficult; you definitely have to work hard for a good grade. He wrote the textbook and all of the midterms are 100% from the textbook and lecture so you have to READ!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: YES textbooks. Need to go to class? NAH. BUT, he throws in about 4 extra credit opportunities that go straight towards your midterms & finals so I mean the choice is yours. It really saves your grade though. He made the exams esp hard for FALL 2018, so he gave us a generous curve in the end. The exam is on the harder side, so study a week+2 in adv

He a really great professor! He knows his stuff. Lots of info learned in this class but exams are pretty straightforward. The textbook reeaally helps on the exams and it was interesting to read. TA's go over literature relating to personality topics, but are pretty separate from the actual lecture material. I enjoyed this class and Funder a ton!

I loved his class, but keep in mind there is a good amount of people that don't. You have two books, and yes you do actually have to read them BOTH! Overall there is a lot of work; so do not slack! The first exam was week 2 on at least 4 chapters. Still his class is manageable and definitely worth taking. He is brilliant.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's an amazing lecturer, really inspiring! absolutely love him. Attendance not mandatory but if you go he gives extra credit that goes towards your exams. No electronics allowed whatsoever, no slides, he hands out the printed lecture outline & just talks. Quiz every week based on 2-3 articles, plus 2-3 papers assigned. Oh yeah plus he's hilarious.

Funder was great, he teaches using outlines that he provides prior to lecture and while lecture is not required it is HIGHLY recommended as he does "pop quizzes" (which are actually extra credit points for the exams). Even if you get the question wrong you get 1 pt for your name. Read the textbook!! Most of the test questions are based on the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Buying the book is a must or scan it at the library. Reading is more important than lectures. Most of the exam content is straight from the book. I found exams to be more difficult than they needed to be. Extra credit pop quizzes in lecture. Roughly 8 bonus points per exam. 3 2-page essays throughout the semester. quizzes on weekly readings.

Dr. Funder's class was 100% lecture style. He didn't use powerpoint, just an outline he handed out before class. You have to take notes on his lecture, which I didnt find hard because I prefer this. Also, if you attend class regularly and pay attention to his anecdotes, you'll get a ton of extra credit on exams! Graded by few things but not hard.
reviews.rating_tags: LECTURE HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Go to class, he gives "Pop quizzes" which is really just extra credit, and these points are added to your midterms. his pop quizzes usually have to do with the stories he tells in class. you have to read the book for this class! I cant stress that enough

Great Professor. Professor Funder's class was really interesting and engaging. His book (which he wrote) adds on to the lectures and students should read it. Attend class, easy extra credit from the pop quizzes! Pay attention to class real well and you'll do good. Helpful outlines and loved his class. I took the class Fall 2014.

Extra credit points in beginning of lectures (Go! it may save your grade) Midterms aren't as hard as some people are saying. Remember the main points of each chaptersection and you'll do fine.  Not going to lie, chapters are long so don't procrastinate on reading them. Quizzes on readings are simple and straightforward

Lecture attendance will earn you extra credit that will be applied towards tests through pop quizzes. The exams are almost entirely based on the textbook. It's not enough to understand the concept but know the who and what behind every theory introduced and so forth. Class appears to be graded on a curve.
great class!

He will definitely make you think a lot about your life, and remind you how lucky you are for going to college, which I really appreciated. His exams are heavily based on the book. Read every word in each chapter, most of the time its enlightening. Don't think you can pass without reading the book. Lecture notes are not enough.

Really going to miss this class. Dr. Funder was hilarious. I didnt mind his digression because his anecdotes were amusing. Extra credit points, which he gave in lecture, helps. And also, those who say his tests are hard--yes they are, but the TAs write them, not Funder. I would recommend his class and I would also take another class if he taught.

Test are very very hard!! But everything else was not. Extra credit points if you go to class were helpful. His test questions are mainly from the book and barely any of the questions were from lecture. He kind of just rambles in lecture....
Really good lecturer, but hard tests. Really need to buy his book (expensive). But he and the T.As are very friendly. The homework assignments in section are easy, tests are hard.

Whoever say he is easy is lying. His test are hard, and u are screw if u don't buy his book which is expensive. Study ass off and barely pull through. This class is consider as hard as psych 12. Easy essay though

PROS:This class was VERY interesting, probably the most amusing I've had. Funder had me paying attention to every word. CONS:The text was a must for me (but also very interesting) and the short essays got annoying. Also, on a personal level, he seems very into himself & not very willing to help, BUT I would take this class again just for fun.

I love Dr. Funder's class. his classes of personality is not only important for all the psyc major students but for everyone who likes psychology.You come here to learn to enjoy and to improve. I thank him very much. Besides, TAs are awesome!

Tests were primarily based of the book.  He picks very detailed statements from the book. Lectures are helpful too, especially for extra credit pop quizzes.  He gives quizzes right at the beginning & gives very little time to answer.  Prof. starts digressing and doesn't cover all the material that appears on tests.

there are weekly short articles to read and 3 responses. as far as the ?essays? go; they aren't essays; a paragraph or two will suffice. he lectures exactly what's in the book; reading  from the textbook is not necessary. i did not read one page from it still pulled a high A. quizzes are EXTRA CREDIT; they don't count against you.

I wanted to simply say that this man is one of the greatest professors I?ve ever had at UCR?but now that I see the absurd rating below me, I MUST clarify. First off, this class is not a lot of reading. Yes there are short articles to read and 3 responses to write. However, the articles are condensed and rather short. As far as the ?essays? go?they

This class is a LOT of reading. You have to read the readers and write 3 essays a week. He also tests on the OTHEr textbook and has questions that are verbatim from the book. so its a MUST that you read both texts thoroughly to get a god grade in this class. He hates slackers and quizzes often in lecture.

Dr. Funder is probably the greatest professor at UCR. The man knows his stuff and is extremely helpful by providing lecture outlines. It is one of the few classes at UCR I would take over just for fun. This man doesn't just lecture about research findings and proposed theories, he expands on them with his sense of wit and vast wisdom. Awesome!

Dr. Funder is a really good teacher, he gives out tons of extra credit over the quarter so make sure you go to class. His midterms are easy but his final is really hard, be careful because he recycles questions from the first two for the final so go back and read your tests over again.

really nice guy, makes class super interesting. his book is great - the first text i actually wanted to read. he's really funny and it's obvious he knows a lot. his midterms aren't very hard either. study up and you'll do fine.

You learn a lot in this class and it's fun to hear the stories he tells. He's one of the best teachers I've ever had. The information is straightforward and if you go to class and listen, you'll get an A. TAKE THIS CLASS!

GO TO CLASS YOU WILL BE GRATEFUL YOULL GET +2 FOR EACH SHORT (RIDICULOUSLY EASY) QUIZ HE GIVES ADDED ON TO THE NEXT MIDTERM...IF YOU ACTUALLY LISTEN TO HIM...HE SAYS A LOT OF GOOD/INTERESTING THINGS...GOOD LUCK!!

Gives extra credit for coming to class on certain days, but it is not required by any means.  Teaches almost right out of the book, reading and going to levture will get you far.  Section is boring as well as the articles you are required to read and comment on; and they are worth a pretty big chunk of your grade.
Fun lecturer. As long as you pay attention in class, take good notes, and read the book, an A is guarenteed in his classes.

Good lecturer, made it interesting at least but the class was way harder than it needed to be. Discussion was a joke - you are required to go every week and talk about articles you read, which you aren't even tested on. Waste of my time. Tests are very hard, as well.

Aaagh! I absolutely hate that we have to come to lecture because he may give extra credit quizzes... we're adults and we should feel free to skip a day if we have other stuff to do. it also sucks to miss section; you have to get a doctors note etc etc if you're about to miss it. not a great class overall.
His class was definitely challenging but he made it fun and interesting as well.  I had a great time listening to his lectures.  He had some memorable stories and his book was fantastic.
No Comments
Yawn.
No Comments
Dr. Funder was entertaining! I had fun and enjoyed going to class all the time.  I felt like what he said was definitely useful and could be applied toward my psychology career.
Horrible.
No Comments
He is a great professor. Out of all the psychology classes, this has been the best class for me. His book is well written and very interesting!!!!!!!!

One of the best professors I've ever had. Lectures are fun and he uses entertaining examples to get points across. Makes you use his book, but not a problem as the book is alot more interesting than most other psych books
Very entertaining class!  Would have enjoyed it more with a different TA (not naming any names).  His book is one of the best textbooks I've ever read!
Egocentric (always wants people to use his textbooks), too experimental, unclear lectures, and not understanding
Moderately funny, tends to take himself kind of seriously. Goes crazy over ringing cell phones during lecture.

lecture slides were long, dense, boring. many quotes and citations just pasted in lecture slides that were hard to read and understand (the choice of words for the slide information were hard to understand). tests had t/f and mcq (includes all of the above, none of the above, more than 2 of the above) and tested specific details
One of the worse Profs I have experienced at UCR. He lectures on 80+ slides and tests on the most specific concepts. He does not give any room to mess up. I would avoid him at all costs.

He knows his stuff well. The issue is that his slides are hard to memorize and sometimes they contradict one another. Lots of lecture questions are arguable imo. He reuses some lecture questions on the midterms and he also reuses midterm questions on the final. Not hard but you have to work for a good grade. Took it async with online discussion

Theodore Garland is a pleasure to take for BIOL174. Exams are very easy. His lectures are also really interesting and he allows an option to view them online in case you cannot attend lecture. He also is very passionate about what he teaches. This course is very straightforward.
Fully online course. Exams are extremely easy if you study his slides.

I got a raw score of 86.9, ended up with a B. He only curved for people who didn't do too well. Very unfair, this professor basically sucks. Oh well, whatever. I also got screwed over on grading on one of the midterms, bc he dropped questions, and they were ones I got right, once again helping out people who did bad and punishing those that study.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: if you just read through the slides and learn then you should be fine. Don't just memorize, understand it/

this class was very tedious. The lectures that were given were just powerpoints we had to read. No videos, no audios. From past experiences of taken multiple online classes, this is definitely not what I expected. It was so boring to have to read these long lectures. It wasnt too difficult, also not so easy. Only take if need to.

Super boring. Long lectures. He just used the lectures that were available on the UCR website so for the most part he doesnt make his own lectures. I feel like he doesnt even put time into the class which makes him seem lazy. Content itself is already boring and he makes it worse

Online. No sample midterm, apparently they were suppose to have one but "there was no time." Super long lectures that are extremely boring. Takes off points if you write more than 2 sentences on weekly essays & will also take off points for grammar which is dumb bc idk how to english, i almost failed english class. Not enjoyable but not that hard

it was online and lectures are very very (x10000000) boring. You basically have to read the lecture slides. There's no videos or podcast which would be so much better. It's not the best class but it's not that difficult (still have to really study). It's really hard to get motivated because of how boring it is.

The lectures are basic. Fairly long, but not too hard to understand. The class itself won't kill you, but Garland's disregard/competitiveness for his students as future scientists is evident, if you talk to him during office hours. He'll talk down to you and isn't interested in being your friend. Not very encouraging if you want a recommendation.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Easy to get a B, hard to get an A. Curved slightly! Exams based off readings and class notes. Midterm one is SUPER EASY, very close to the practice.
Great lecturer and interesting material! He is not a hard professor at all. His exams are extremely fair so as long as you understand all of the lecture slides and go to class then you will get an A.

He's a fairly good lecturer, but his exams have some ridiculous questions. He'll throw out some vague questions that didn't really have much to do with the experiment or example. He's also really crazy about graphs and statistics, but luckily those weren't really prominent on the exams.

This guys midterms are easy because he gives you a sample which is super close to the actual thing. But he didn't give us a sample for the final and that's what screwed some people over, we no longer knew how to study for his test. And he DID NOT curve at the end of the quarter, I was kind of shocked.

This guy sucks. His lectures are literally abobut 20 pages worth of powerpoints for each class. He expects you to remember all these dumb experiments either he did. He goes too fast sometimes and he doesn't really explain things well. His final was pretty hard a lot of questions like "one of the above, all of the above..." Hayashi is better
great clear organized and easy...read articles and lecture notes and all will be fine. He has a lot of stories to tell and keeps class interesting but a lot of the material can get boring...

I really enjoyed this class. He is a very good lecturer. I never looked at the clock. The tests are fair but it is important to study everthing, even the minute details and very important to read all the articles. Overall great class!
class is an easssssyyyy A. study lec notes and you'll be fine.  take his wife saltzman for hormones/behavior as well..good class..hot prof.
His lectures are based on the articles that he wrote himself, which were extremely long and confusing.  He was helpful in office hours though.
Reminds me of Jennifer Anniston's Manager at Chotchkie's from that movie Office Space.
No Comments

This class was fun and he was a cool prof. His tests weren't very hard. Be able to define any key concepts he went over, and the rest is multiple choice. This is the first science class I got an A in, just to show you all that it isn't a tough course.
Garland was a great professor. His lectures were clear and interesting.  Make sure you go over the practice midterm it is like the actual midterm.  His tests were easy...if you studied.

This was his first quarter teaching at UCR, so he was getting used to it. He is a caring knowledgeable professor. He is passionate about what he teaches. If you go to him with concerns, he will listen & make changes. Assignments and clear and easy, no midterm, just final (topics/sample questions/answers given). Curves. I got an A, minimal effort.

This was both the professor's first quarter teaching at UCR and on the quarter system. That being said I understand some disorganization. He does care about his work and is knowledgeable, but everything was all over the place for the class. With a better structured curriculum I have hope for future classes and wish them better luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Assigns a big project where you have to interview a business owner and it MUST be local. Not all of us are from the IE but okay. Grading is weird, things are unaccessible. and a SEATING CHART in UNI. Probably one of my worst profs - highly suggest to avoid.

AVOID!! instructions are unclear and very unorganized. grading is also not clear AT ALL!! rubrics aren't given until after the assignment was due and the instructions had little to no detail so it felt like turning in an assignment blind

Honestly, I don't get the bad reviews. The class is structured differently, which can feel unorganized, but everything is in the syllabus no surprises. The final project is easy just interview a business owner and you're done, its like 5 questions. The lectures can be hard to follow but very useful.
Honestly one of the worst professor I have taken. Super unorganized. Assigned seating like actual assigned seating. It seems like the TA doesn't even know whats going on.

Assign a mandatory project requiring you to interview a business owner. Egnore that not all businesses want to provide contact information for their staff, If you happen to talk to a staff member but he doesn't answer the phone number you left on report, they'll give you an F.

I really do agree the lectures can be a lot and confusing but his TA, Rasam, actually made things easier for us. He creates really detailed materials and breaks things down in a way that makes sense. His discussion sections are helpful and you can tell he puts in the work. Solid TA honestly. I also like his accent :)

Lots of his assignments are unclear as he always needs to send out clarification messages about every assignment. Sometimes the TA will provide a more detailed instruction for assignments but when assignment is due a couple of days. Assigned seating (like for real), not good! 5 thumbs down!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Never in my 4 years at UCR have had assigned seating in a course before. Complicated, annoying, and waste of time (not middle school). He doesn't leave instructions on assignments themselves but instead makes you look in the syllabus. Lots of reading on Harvard which is $60 bucks he makes you but. Professor and TA are not on same page. UNORGANIZED!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took her for the History of Winter Olympics. Very interesting class and all the content is on the slides and no textbook. She gives you the exam questions before the exam too which is nice. She does not post lecture slides on Canvas so make sure to go to lecture.
She is so clear with what she teaches. And very easy with test!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's cool, and the class is easy as long as you go to the lectures. She stresses that you can't just look at the slides and copy them down, but you really can, and it'll be fine. She also doesn't post lecture slides, so make a friend on the first day for your future self. If you miss a discussion, emailing the TA will probably get you out of it

She is amazing. No homework. In-person midterm, online final. She gave the key terms and prompts in advance so you could prepare. The TA grades everything. Attendance at discussions is mandatory for credit. Doesn't take attendance in lectures, but lectures really help for tests. Office hours help. Highly recommend going to her office at least once.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There is absolutely no homework for the class other than a few assignments in the discussion section. Most of your grade comes from the midterm and the final, which are essay format. However, she gives you everything you need in advance, so if you come prepared you will do good.

Amazing professor and amazing TA , both were very easy to approach . Attendance is mandatory and she doesn't post the lecture slides to try to make friends or take the class with a friend in case you need to miss a lecture for whatever reason. One graded assignment, the midterm is really easy if you take notes during lecture and study.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance is required. All information is covered during class. Personable but direct. ATTEND LECTURE, everything you need is there, and she does not publish slides. Fair with grading. In-class participation will give you extra credit, and it's not hard. Only covers relevant information. Highly recommended if you need an extra class :)

One thing that I would really take advantage of his how she doesn't require text book reading or anything of that sort. She goes through her slides fast, but simply attending her lectures and actually paying attention really helped me thrive in that class. Shes funny and really flexible to anything. gotta write 3 essays for midterm but doable.

Not an easy A. Class was HIST 30 Rise Revolution. I major in History, and this class requires more writing than the majority of Upper-Div History Classes I took. lectures are not online so you have to attend, and she also takes attendance sometimes. Final was a 2 Q's (10 paragraphs min.), online, given in advance. Too much writing for lower div.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I LOVE THIS CLASS! It was easy because she doesn't require and textbook and all the information is in the lecture class. She is a really great professor overall and the TA's grade all of the exams! The midterm was just taking about 15 key concepts and the final was taking about 30 concepts I believe. But it was very easy to get an A!

Dr. Gage cares a lot about her students and she makes her lectures engaging for students to understand! Attendance is mandatory to understand the content and there is one minor project, however the class is very smooth sailing and topics are thoroughly explained.

Dr. Gage is an amazing professor! She is very passionate about the subject and her lectures are fun. Nothing much is given to do outside class other than a little project which isn't hard at all but rather fun. Your grade is based on attendance to discussion, mid-term, and final. Even if you aren't a history person, you will enjoy this class.

Dr. Gage is clearly passionate about History and made it interesting. She doesn't require any outside readings, but attendance is required to get the information for the exams. The class is graded on 2 exams each worth 30%, but questions and key terms are provided before the exams as well as an assignment worth 10%. The rest is based on discussion.

Very kind and passionate professor. Super smart and focuses on the social side of American history. Only two tests in the class and as long as you pay attention to the lectures, they are not difficult. Lectures are always interesting and fun. Even if you don't like history, you will love this class!

This teacher is by far one of the best teachers I have had. Sports in America was so interesting and going to class never felt like a drag she was well paced and well informed she always knew what she was doing and never was repetitive in her lecture. There are 4 assignments which are really easy. Book quiz, Research paper, midterm and final.

At first, I thought that this class would be hard because many people told me that U.S history is the hardest in the history course. After taking Dr Gage's class, my mind changed. Her lecture was interesting and she gave students an easy time. I recommend taking this class.

Lectures are not mandatory, but it is recommended you show as much as you can since lecture slides/notes are not posted. Assignments are on the lecture material and textbook. Very easy class overall if you attend regularly. Prof is very understanding and has interesting lectures.

reviews.comment: Very nice professor, super caring and extremely helpful. reviews.comment: Professor Gee is absolutely wonderful. She's so caring, sweet, also so good at teaching. I didn't need to go to her classes because everything in this course is stuff I knew, but her lectures are very helpful for those who dont

The way professor gee speaks is so sweet and she explains the material well, which wasn't too hard. We used Learnvia, which integrated AI to help us with math homework. Quizzes and exams were like the homeworks and I always got A+ on them.

Dr. Gee is an amazing professor. She is really there to help you, but reach out (don't be afraid to; she's really sweet). Her notes are easy to follow. The homework isn't a lot; it's really just based off of her lecture material. Go to class; it's not mandatory, but it's really helpful.

I absolutely loved this class, she is super sweet and lectures are optional but super helpful. Savannah is a sweet lady but she doesnt know the math shes teaching. Her lecture notes are saturated with neon colors which is not appropriate for a math class. Worst professor at UCR! Doesn't even know 2+2!

Dr. Gee is a really engaging professor!! She genuinely cares for students' progress and although she might be a bit strict on attendance, I do think it's beneficial for students. Her study guides are very helpful and reflect the exams. Go to office hours!
Best professor ever. Be prepared to put in the effort however she is so supportive and will do everything to help you. If you get this professor you are officially blessed.

Professor was very passionate about teaching and honestly goes step by step for everything. It was like a sweet reminder of highschool. But if you have her, you will do great AS LONG AS you actually put in the work and STUDYYY! You will pass with flying colors girlie pop

reviews.comment: easiest class I've ever taken, lectures counted as extra credit, and I've never understood math more! Midterms and finals identical to practice.

I had her in person MWF for lecture for Math 007A. She is the BEST TEACHER I HAVE HAD IN MY WHOLE LIFE. GOD BLESS HER SOUL SHE IS SO SWEET. I LOVE her. I finally became good at calc after being horrible at it for so long. She's truly amazing and you're truly blessed if you get her for Math007A.

Get ready to read a bunch of texts and books. He wasn't clear on the written essays we had, and he was harsh. Wrote me passive aggressive comments too. I'll start out by saying that this Professor is by far one of the rudest I've ever had. He's a very tough grader, and his expectations exceed the reasonable scope of the class. Unrealistic expectation over the understanding of reading material

reviews.comment: It was so hard to get an A in that class. It was so bad I no longer attend UCR.

reviews.comment: Do not take his class if you care about your GPA.  gives exams without study guides, wants specifics and does not elaborate on what specifics he wants.  Unfair in his grading process and ambiguos as to what he wants on his papers and tests.
I absolutely love Michels; He is uber smart ! Be specific in tests and you will do great. READ AND PARTICIPATE!

TAKE HIM FOR SENIOR SEMINAR. I took him for Women in Russian history, and it was amazing! He really, really, really cares about students writing their senior paper about a topic that interests them. Great professor. Lectures are interesting, which I didn't expect considering the topic didn't sound very appealing. Actually enjoyed this class, not that hard either. Would take prof Michels again

Michels is great at lecturing, he comes with notes and never really gets off topic. Themes and Personalities is such an interesting class and he helps you even if you havent done the readings. the tests arent too bad and the lectures are great if you enjoy history.

Dr. Sarraf is so understanding and supportive of his students, especially when they bring questions or concerns. Prof. George is so sweet. He cares about his students. Econ was a hard class but he made it as enjoyable as possible. I'd love to take more classes with him.

I the class during covid, so things were online. He uploaded his own lectures based on the textbook we used for homework. Exams were thought provoking and not too difficult. Overall great teacher, wish I had taken the class in-person :(

Not a great teacher. Did not adapt to online very well. Some weeks he just sent youtube videos instead of his own lectures. Class graded on 3hws and 3 exams. reviews.comment: He doesn't curve. Class average was a D+. Graded by only a few things and you have to really self teach. Good Luck!

He is the worst professor on campus. The professor literally did not even teach the class. He just send links to YouTube video and expected a random YouTube professor to teach the course. His teaching is sub par. Only take this class if you absolutely have to.

Class is made of 2 midterms, 1 non-cumulative final and 3 homework assignments. The tests are nothing like the homework and what 's taught. Horrible at teaching. Wow this class was terrible. Your grade is mad up two midterms, final, and 3 homework assignments. I put a lot of effort into this class and still ended with a 79.56.
