reviews.comment: Great professor. As a business major, I was worried about taking intermediate macroeconomics. Professor Sarraf made the class straight forward and his lectures did explain the materials well. He gave lots of extra credit on the tests. Exams were not difficult but you'd have to study for this class. Macroeconomics is not an easy subject.

This is not an easy A class. No curve per se, but gives extra credit questions on midterms and final. I got an A- in this class by religiously reading the textbook and taking really good notes. Getting a good grade is very possible in this class if you put in the work. Hold yourself accountable for the material if you want the A.
No curve or extra credit opportunity. Class average was a C. His final is worth 40%, study or you will final. His lectures don't help because of his accent.

He is a great professor and a funny one too! Homework problems are straight from textbook but TA provides the answers. 2 midterms & final-all multiple choice.  Final is non-cumulative but study well as final is 40% of your grade.

This professor is ridiculous. Class avg for the two midterms+final we had were sooo low yet he didnt curve the class at all. He bases the whole class on 3 tests and rarely gave homework. The class was so boring and only 1/3 of the class showed up literally every time. He's really nice but needs to improve his teaching technique/grading criterias.
One of the best instructors I have had. I would definitely take him again. Midterm was easy and final was not bad. I got a B+ but I should've done better.

I'm currently enrolled in Dr. Sarraf's class and so far, everything that they say about him here and at UCI is true. He's a great professor, clear lecturer and really has the interest of his students in mind. One of the best parts of his class is that homework is HANDWRITTEN (not Cengage). Thank you, Dr. Sarraf!

One of the best professor's iv come across. He wants you to get involved in class and is very helpful. He is the kind of professor who would make you like studying economics. His tests are all application oriented so you dont have to mug up your textbook. If you understand the concept then you are good

I'd highly recommend this professor if you want to learn the fundamentals of finance. Pr. Sarraf is very helpful and approachable during his office hours and by emails. He makes you feel comfortable in his class, and he has a great sense of humor. He is one of the best professors that I have ever had in my student life.
There is no curve in the class, the avg is a 60 percent. The grading criteria is also complicated.

She is a wonderful teacher. very clear lectures and nice handwriting. Posts lecture notes which helps a lot. The content itself was hard for 7B but study hard beyond the lectures and it will be ok. Her office hours are helpful and she's very patient.

I'm one of the firm believers that I suck at math so that's why my grades so low. But Courtney really is a good professor. She is super kind and understanding. Her notes are really good and easy to follow. Your grades mostly depend on the midterms and final. But she does allow your final grade to replace your lowest midterm grade so that's nice.

Prof George is easily one of the best professors I've had so far. I had her for 6B and while the lessons are already set up by the math department, she creates her own notes and throughly explains material. She is there to support students and will answer any questions or concerns. Definitely recommend!

Your main grade is based off of your final and attendance. She is an amazing lecturer, and helps you when you go to office hours. Practice with the online final (program and practice finals) and you will be totally fine in her class.

reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

If you show up to lecture and go to her office hours you should be good.

reviews.comment: very empathetic and i really got the sense that she wanted the class to succeed and was doing everything in her power to make that happen. Felt very approachable with questions and the class structure felt forgiving and fair. very highly reccomend

Very enthusiastic and amazing lectures. Uploads easy-to-read lecture notes after each subunit. Weekly homework assignments on Pearson (with unlimited attempts) and occasional EdPuzzle-style assignments (one attempt, only worth 2-3 points). Provides feedback on midterms using Gradescope. No attendance taken except for next-day post-exam surveys.
I liked the class set up and she was always happy to answer questions. I would love to have her again!
Amazing professor. She is incredibly kind and went out of her way to help me catch up on work when I switched into the class 2 weeks late. 10/10 would take again and I highly recommend her.

Has a very heavy accent—hard to understand 90% of the time. Lectures are very disorganized, boring, and repetitive. Only 7–8 people show up regularly. reviews.comment: The professor is extremely nice and caring; however, his lectures are extremely boring and hard to follow. He prewrites his annotated slides and barely gives students enough time to write it down and when asked to slow down he says it's be recorded and to rewatch the lecture outside of scheduled class lecture hours. The material is difficult.

super funny, exams were weekly in discussion, multiple attempts for each exam but gets a bit harder each time. changes one aspect of each problem in next exam attempts. decent curve. very caring and nice and helpful in office hours

Very passionate & excited to teach in lectures. It is IMPERITIVE that you grasp how to score well on the quizzes as quickly as possible. In discussion section, take as many quizzes as you can each week. Review the answers to the quizzes you take (and the corresponding hw) and then retake the quiz the next week. Same questions, different numbers.

he's such a caring and sweet guy. his quizzes did get harder over time. his points system actually sucks cuz i was 4 pts off an A and didnt wanna round :/ (i retook multiple times but his tests get harder its impossible)  lectures arent the clearest but hes extremely passionate about chem, hes always so happy to help in OH

His lectures were very funny and engaging, but his tests were too brutal. We were given 3+ attempts for each open-note test; but they got increasingly harder and didn't reflect the textbook(yes, I read it) OR the lecture material. I felt like I was learning algebra while being tested on Calculus. Take if u wanna pass, but not if u want to get an A.

Genereux is a funny lecturer and genuinely cares about students. The mastery exams are difficult the first time and last time you take them, but you have a golden period on the 2nd attempt to get a perfect score. Lectures are a bit mismatched, but OH can clarify literally anything. No final is you are satisfied with your weekly mastery exam scores.

Honestly, he's one of the easiest professors I've had. You don't have to go to the lecture, but make sure to read the textbook because many of his quiz material comes from that. You have multiple attempts for quizzes; if you put some effort than you should easily be able to get a good grade.

Do not take this professor's class. Chemistry was always easy to me until this class. There are 7 unit exams, retake-able yes, I have passed 6 with a 90 and above, just because you might not pass one you will drop a whole letter grade. Personally I don't find his lectures engaging, and it is very easy to get lost in his notes. Avoid at all costs.

The lectures were optional, but I recommend going, as they are entertaining while educational. The class structure allowed for the opportunity to succeed at your own pace, as the bulk of the grade comes from Weekly Mastery Assessments (MA) that can be taken multiple times throughout the quarter during discussions or some in-class opportunities.

His lectures were entertaining and did teach the material in a pretty productive way. He has weekly quizzes (mini exams) instead of midterms and the final is optional. The quizzes weren't ever very difficult. As long as you lock in on homework, do his polleverywheres, and study a little bit for the quizzes you'll get an A.

Okay, so. The RMP looks really intimidating, but guess what?

Our course structure is different. Trust me when I say it's good. No midterms, no final. 9 weekly quizzes can be retaken up to 5 times each, highest grade used.

He also teaches well if you pay attention in class. That said, you don't need to. Lots of homework, but u can self study w/ it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Winter (2024). Loved him. Made lectures really interesting. Unit exams were HARD. They get harder in each attempt. However, he is always available through OH or email (responds within 24 hours even during finals week). Most ARC tutors will not know how to solve the mastery problems, go to your SI. No final if you don't need to retake unit tests.

Chem 1B is a difficult course, and while I believe the class structure was well handled, I can also confidently say that the only reason I passed the course was through attending TA office hours, as he isn't very helpful in his own and his lectures are messy and hard to understand. He's an extremely nice and caring person though!

Chem 001B is a difficult class, no matter who your professor is. But Genereux is one of the better professors. He is very kind, approachable, and truly cares about his students. Exams are very expected when it comes to content covered, not to say they are easy. If you do the homework and put effort into the tests, you will get a good grade.

CHEM1B is a tough course, but Professor Genereux is an overall great option for this course. This quarter he used the Mastery system which is a game-changer, with no midterm and optional final. Take Professor Genereux if you want to understand the material and succeed in this course.

His lectures didn't help only reason I got an A+ was because I snuck into Hartman's lectures. Graded by 3 Midterms and Hw. The first midterm I got a 60. Final is optional and replaces any midterm. Copy down Hw prob and the steps and use in the exams. This got me 96 and 92 on the 2nd and 3rd exams. Retook the 1st midterm got a final grade of A+.

Anything I learned in that class only came from reading the textbook.

Tests are extremely tough, so get all of the points you can outside of tests. His lectures confused me, but I appreciate that he cares and tries to accommodate as many people as possible. He gives a lot of extra credit too.

The tests and homework were pretty straightforward and he didn't throw any curveballs. The lectures can be a little fast sometimes, but that's just how it is. Some classmates didn't like his lecturing because they felt it was like a "stream of consciousness", but I didn't have much of a problem. Discussion sections definitely helped!!!

He may be friendly and funny but his midterms were the reason I was not doing well in the class (even though the exams were open notes but they did not help me at all). I had him for both Chem1a and 1b and i did better in 1a but thats because i tried more then. Truly have to work to comprehend the matter but he is willing to help as much as you ask for help.

Hes a good professor, but his tests are very difficult. There was about 1 and a half hour for his midterm and not a lot of students finished even though it was only 9 questions. However, he was accommodating and the other midterms and finals he gave us days, which I really appreciated. Tests are hard, home work is average.

He takes the time to make sure you understand the information. The homework really helps you understand the material and get a grasp of what a test would look like. The exams are a bit tough, but they are manageable. There is no extension for homework, but you have a week to do them. Optional final to replace your lowest midterm grade.

Avoid this professor at all costs for chem 001B. He makes his exams so much more difficult than the homework. He is enthusiastic but it's no good because he barely curves and I think he enjoys the entire class failing. Avoid this professor and Bartels at all costs!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: His tests are way harder than the homework and his lectures are very confusing i hardly ever understood what he was explaining. AVOID AT ALL COSTS CUZ HES THE HARDEST CHEM 1A PROF

Although he ran the class with such enthusiasm, I do not feel that he taught the material very well. His notes felt scrambled and I never felt like I learned anything. His exams hardly matched what we were learning. Was not prepared going into Chem 1B.

For a gen chem class, he makes it so much harder than it needs to be. He is much more detail-oriented than the other CHEM1A profs. His lectures are more stream of consciousness style, he doesn't offer extra credit or curve, and his tests focus on very minute details. The quizzes every week in discussion are designed to lower your grade. TAs useless

Great teacher! He makes a boring subject entertaining. The class I took was all about how different instruments work and when you might need to use which instrument, that's pretty friggin' boring. He was always willing to help either directly after lecture or during office hours. There was a lot of homework, but ALL of it is related to the test!

Lecture slides are missing a lot of information so make sure you go to class. Very good lecturer; however, I just wish he added more information on his slides. Take very detailed notes and read the book for clarification as I know it helped me a lot. Do the recommended homework and it will benefit you a lot. Huge curve at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I really need to brighten the mood on this page. Great professor! Not only is it easy to get by in his class, but he prepares you so well for future classes! It's not Joey who makes the class hard; chemistry is already hard. You'll have a blast in his class. He's funny, he's nice, he's great. I'd strongly recommend Joey as a professor.
Got lucky and got an A. But in all seriousness, too much unnecessary work and confusing lectures. Just avoid this class and take it with someone else.

Expect a lot of unnecessary work like case studies, ALEKS hw, clickers, etc. The whole class can be a lot simpler but he makes you do so much busywork. The material isn't too bad, but he adds so much additional stuff that you don't need. It's ridiculous. He's new to teaching though so it's not a huge deal.
His lectures are very confusing and boring. You need to  read the book, honestly you're better off reading the book than his lectures.

He's willing to help you if you ask but he is really bad at explaining things even if it's on a one to one basis. I went to class prepared and often left more confused than before. If you like chemistry and are willing to teach yourself then take his class but if you struggle with it and need at least a decent teacher DO NOT TAKE HIM.

The professor is very nice and tries his best to adjust to students. He has a forum-like site where you can ask questions, and he responds fairly quick. The class isn't easy, but it isn't too difficult if you study and read the book. He also gives practice midterms, which are helpful. There are clicker questions, so you have to go to lectures.

The professor was nice and wanted to help the students, but his lectures were confusing and tests were difficult.  He curved one midterm slightly but the other midterm and final were not.  The clicker points were difficult and had a minute and a half to complete, but were only slightly curved. The overall class was not curved.

There are no curves despite a low average on exams i.e. midterm averages were D's this quarter. His powerpoints are busy  and his lectures can be pretty confusing. His explanations are also unclear as he goes through powerpoints and explanations pretty fast. If you ask him to re-explain something, he will, but you may be left more confused
He is super nice and helpful, but he makes his tests really really hard.
The quizzes and tests are hard and his samples aren't very helpful.  He doesn't curve the class.  You have to go to class because there are clickers.  The case studies are difficult.

Clicker questions worth a lot more than they should be,Explains math with theory and theory with math: it leads to nowhere,Tries to tie it with real life examples but just makes it more complicated. difficult/unecessary case studies,Tests are hard,Lecture doesn't correlate to homework (ALEKS),and a lot more but I can't fit it into the characer cou

Ghosh's class, though not difficult, was disorganized without a TA, impacting learning. His teaching didn't effectively convey the material, leaving little retained knowledge. Hope to avoid this professor in future. Avoid if possible.

This professor should not be teaching at UCR. He is super disorganized, can't explain content to students, and the exams include some content that wasn't even covered in class. You have to learn the material on your own and take good notes based off of what he says in class. The class is graded on a curve and he's generous about grading exams.

Dr. Ghosh is an amazing lecturer. He explains equations and concepts through use of book examples. I recommend going to class and reading the book definitions to further solidify concepts. Very funny and friendly. He assigns relatively large amounts of homework, but the midterm and final were a few homework problems 100% copy and paste. So as long as you do the homework and get it right, you will do fine.

BEST math professor EVER!! He's super funny and the class is easy!! He takes problems straight from the hw for the midterm and final AND lets you use notes! So if you want an A, do the hw and go to OH for hw help. I only went to TA OH though because for his OH he makes everyone stand in a line and only helps one person at a time. But great prof!!
Super fun professor and very friendly! TAKE HIS CLASS! (:

I had Dr. Gierz for 10B, 171, and 172. With the exception of his lecture notes being a little difficult to follow and frustrating, I have nothing but nice things to say. His lectures are clear, he's SUPER friendly, his office is ALWAYS open to students to ask questions, and he WILL resolve your questions. HIGHLY recommend!
His sense of humor will put you at ease, when the material will not.  But man, this guy laughs at everything.  I like him.

dude this guy is awesome. super chill and super easy to understand. he makes funny jokes in class and his exams are easy since they're the exact same problems from the hw. he makes math seem like a walk in the park.
HI DAD!!!!
HELL YEAH!! TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!!
My diffy Q teacher is still one of the best!  He made this material easy for the entire class

this is by far the best math teacher that i have had here!!!  he is very clear and explains problems so that they are easy to understand!!!  he is also a very nice guy if u go to his office hours. he is always happy to help!!   his midterm and final were problems exactly from the homework so there is no excuse for messing up!! i did all the homewor

Class is nearly too easy to be true, but it is. midterm and final problems are exact copies of homework problems. His lectures were sometimes confusing, he would go into something w/out providing some context for what he is explaining. His voice is a little abrasive. Online notes were pretty dense, and a little tricky to understand, me being a non
No Comments

Wow! All his test problems came directly from the homework problems without any changes.I never went to class and got an A by studying his homework problems. He's very easy, very nice, and approachable. Go to his office hours and he'll be happy to help you with homework problems. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. You will enjoy hisclass and of course your grade.
Awesome teacher and extremely helpful. He is not modest about his laziness and makes an effort to present a course with no suprises.

his teaching methods are very liberal, but at least you don't need to buy any books. he is VERY thorough , so if you have ANY doubt in your mind about what he is teaching ask right away. midterms are based off the final but like someone said earlier he won't blink twice to fail you. has funny stories to tell too though, but a very hardcore professo
his homework and quizzes on mathxl were very easy. the hardest part about his class was the midterm and final, both of which are a great percentage of the final grade.
Excellent teacher, very easy to sak questions.  Always welcomed to answer questions.

Great guy! uses scientific workplace in class for lecture and mathxl to turn in hw. a quiz every week which are easy and the midterm and final aren't bad either. Just be willing to spend about an hour and a half on the computer everyday. easy A if you keep up and ATTEND LECTURES(20% of grade).

All the homework was turned in online...so you should study the problems from the website, not the textbook (hardly touched it); it may have been easier to study if I could have looked at examples from the book more.  He grades partially on attendance so you have to show up to all the lectures.

This guy is a good teacher but he has no feelings. He will give you an F and not blink. On average he fails 50% of his students. If your going to take him, look thru his website first. A's will be very scarce.

decent professor. funny and with a great accent to boot. fair curve, fair tests, only reason why i did so badly was honestly my own fault. only thing i didn't like is that he didn't use a textbook. i think with a text, studying would've been easier.

Well this guy is very bubbly personality wise and cool. but as a teacher, he's very liberal in his teaching ways.  i dont like the whole scientific workplace hw where i only know how to let the computer solve the problem. but he is a good teacher when he actually does written examples
Very good professor, has all notes online so you dont have to worry about rushing to get notes.
great guy. he has a great teaching method, although it requires that you must attend class and submit homework online.

Good teacher. Uses Scientific Workplace too much for my taste, but very helpful in office hours and determined to help students understand. Tests are hard, but easy curve (in 145A, getting a perfect score on any question of any test/quiz guaranteed you at least a C). Recommend.

You will die in Math 144. Gierz is a great teacher, but the material and the exams are extremely hard to do. Lots of material and it's difficult to know what to study for. Thumbs down for that course but thumbs up for the professor.
Lots of homework though none are due, but will DEFINITELY help if you do all of them because they come back on the midterms and finals.
you gotta attend the lecture.  He sometimes takes attendance.  If you go to the 2 of the 3 lectures where he takes attendance, you'll almost be guarenteed to pass.

You got to love the German accent.  Tough to understand in the begining of the quarter but you get to understand really quickly.  If you are struggling GO TO OFFICE HOURS.  He will do anything you ask him to do and makes sure you know what to do.
he's kind of weird. like's making arnold schwarzenneger impressions. good teacher with a very unorthodox teaching method. veeery hard final, but the curve's great.
No Comments
his teaching methods are different than most teachers/professors.  he could've been more clear.  go to class, he ends up curving grades.
No Comments
good teacher who shows you half way and you learn the other half which makes learning rewarding
No Comments

only midterm, final exam, and brain anatomy final is graded. Lectures felt too crowded with other information that I couldnt get the main point. It was hard to retain everything at 9am. Exams multiple choice but done in a way to second guess yourself "all above, none above, only a&b..." Getting a 100% on the practical is essential.

reviews.comment: He has well-detailed notes that go along with the lecture. Review the lecture and pay attention you'll be solid

If you don't have to take Stanley's class, DON'T DO IT!! He's stuck up and doesn't care about his students. He believes the only opinion that matters is his. Seriously, don't take him if you don't have to lol
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Switching to remote learning was unexpected with covid19 and if students are expected to adapt so should a professor. Did not adapt to online teaching like other professors did.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Midterm Final and Practicum r curved. Lab/Lecture not mandatory. He records lectures and puts them online. Dont need to read the book just pay close attention to him in lecture. He explains well. Study the lecture outlines and you should be fine on midterm and final but if you want an A you really need to have a CONCRETE understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Clear and concise lectures. He provides lecture notes and all his recordings (unless theres an upload error). Practical should have been more efficient but it was still easy. Midterms were challenging, if you don't study the notes and understand them down to the axons, well good luck Charlie. He's funny and wants you to learn, definitely recommend
One of the best professors I have had at UCR. There was one midterm, a final, and a practicum. All the material needed is provided in his lecture notes so there's no need for the textbook.

Prof. Stanley is very passionate about what he teaches. He understands the material is tough and constantly checks in if we have questions during lecture and tries his best to make everything as clear as possible. His lectures are very nicely designed and thought out. The course itself is graded on a few things, but that's usually how 106 is.

Great professor! He gives out 25 percent A's. This is definitely not an easy course to take. However, Stanley is a great professor and really takes the time to ensure that you understand the concepts (he tries to make it interesting too). Go to class and STUDY!! And you will do well. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Stanley gives out 25% A's in his class. This incentive promotes competition and it was good to see the product of your hard work in the end of the quarter. A raw score of 77% and above is an A in this class.  Beware of his tests because it is very very tricky -- memorize the ins and outs of the notes and practice tests and you'll be fine.

Focus on memorizing the notes and knowing the ins and outs of the practice midterm/final. I scored 40/50 on the midterm, 24/30 on the practicum, and 75/100 on the final and ended up with a B+. There were too many smarties this quarter I guess.

Hard class, a lot of material. You have been warned. Stanley is an amazing professor, he's passionate about the subject. Top 20% of the class will earn an A in the course, which is a very nice curve, it just increases competition. Read the book and do not fall behind in lectures and attend office hours, and you'll earn that A.

Class is helpful in terms of clarification after the midterm material. I went on and off and still received an A. Never used the book, just memorized the notes. He has a very generous curve as promise. 25% of the people get A's.
Real chill dude, curve is pretty legit. I got a 21/30 on the practicum, 36/50 on the midterm and a 77/100 in the final and got an A

He is a very nice teacher. Very helpful in Office hours. If you need help GO TO HIM...he is willing to work with you till you get it. Midterm 1 was easy the final was a lil hard but reasonable ...I gotta B. Take him.
This class is so easy. I never attended class and got an A. It's impossible to get below an A.
The material and the test were hard but professor is very clear and helpful.

He gives you everything you need, and questions are worded in way to test your knowledge, just not your memorization skills. Go to class, take addictional nots, study the lectures, do the reading youll be fine

He's very descriptive in his lectures and will let you know what will be on the exams. His midterm was fair; however, if you don't do well in the final, you mostly won't do well in the class. He curves based on the class-- Top 16 students who get the highest scores on the final will get a final grade of an A.
good professor! he basically gives you all the lecture notes and those reflect the exam. basically go to lecture and read the note and you are going to pass.
made it interesting
His lecture notes have everything you need! They're very understandable and concise. His lectures also make it easier to understand. Study the notes and you'll be good for his exams :)
He's Awesome! just study your notes and the class is easy. He's very helpful.
Stanley is a good lecturer, he's very clear and concise.  Study the lecture notes and you'll be fine.
The worst teacher ever to grace this school. One would hope that he loses tenure so that he never teaches again.
Decent class, with ok curve. Study Lecture nots and practice midterms and you should be fine.

Gotta say, this guy sucks. He really doesn't have a clue. If you take this class, make sure you get the other professor. this guy is boring, arrogant and assumes way too much. I have never caught up on so much sleep in one course.
No Comments
She is horrible but she is required for Econ majors

Not helpful at all. Doesn't care about her students. Difficult to understand due to accent and bad handwriting. Materials in tests are not clearly introduced in the lecture. No practice materials(practice problem/exam). TAs do all the grading and teaching. Blames her class for not doing well. Average test score was 40 and seems she doesn't care.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Exams are worth 90% of your grade (40% from 2 midterms, 50% from final). Test averages are in the 40's but she blames the class for choosing not to do better. Wait for another professor who wants their students to do better because Econ 107 is hard enough as is.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This professor doesn't respect her students. She had us waiting for her for our 8am and didn't show up. It wasn't until 10 minutes AFTER class started when she had her TA (couldn't even bother to take responsibility herself) email us that she had an "emergency."
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is clearly an expert in the field and extremely knowledgeable. The class isn't fun but all it really involves is memorizing formulas and knowing when to apply them. Pretty easy to destroy the curve in a class of 100+ if you pay attention.

Chair of econ department, a total mathematician. She makes you work hard for your grade, tests get harder but she does have a curve. If she sees improvement throughout the quarter on your tests and HWs, she will cut you a break come grading time.

She is the chair of the econ department, which makes her a total badass. However her midterms and finals' difficulty is increased exponentially. The first midterm easy, 2nd hard, final insane. She expect you to do ALOT of calculator math without a calculator on the tests and u have limited time. She curves but barely.

One of the worst professor I had in UC Riverside. She has a strong accent and bad handwriting which nobody can read. She's not helpful at all and does not care about how her students are performing. TAs do all the grading and teachings. No practice exams and other helpful materials. Curves at the end but overall she doesn't know how to teach at all
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There are 2 midterms and a final exam. The midterms were mostly definition based so make sure you know the formulas. There were about 6 problem sets. Lecture was not helpful to me, but given that there are no practice problems for the tests you may want to go. A plus was that there was a good curve at the end.
nice professor but it doesnt seem like anybody is actually learning much from her lectures. and she does not give out any study guides or practice midterms.
She teaches as if we've had the same decades of economic research as her. Not really approachable if you try to ask for clarification. Most of the help comes from TAs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is one of the best professors at UCR. Very helpful, cares for students, and also very generous. The class itself is tough, so be ready to put in alot of time in this class. Overall, exams were not too difficult if you study her notes and do the homework. I will definetely recommend her.

She is an amazing professor! The subject matter can be challenging, but she is very good at clarifying everything. If you barely passed a stat class, you might want to review the concept before taking this class. If you like math and econ, this is your class!!
I would recommend taking this class: very useful for the future, great professor and fair grading. The professor is helpful and shows interest in her topic. The class is not too hard.
Best Econ professor at ucr !!!

Tough but fair. Do the homework,  go to class, lab, and discussion and you will do fine. The TAs are extremely helpful; go to their review sessions! Barely used the book, do not even bother buying it. Overall pretty easy if you put in some effort.
great professor. wrote recommendation for graduate school

has a strong accent but teaches the material well, curves class at the end, can be a tad bit boring but largely due to subject matter, doesn't show examples while lecturing whch would help A LOT! All in all she is a  good prof

This was probably the worst class I've taken in my 4 years at UCR. I've taken econ for business (econ 48) w/ Linda Penas and she was lovely, so I expected a similar experience with this...HAH! No study guide, no valuable input and the book was my only source of real help. She obviously wasn't collaborating effectively with the TA's either.

The most difficult course and professor at UCR in my 4yrs there. This class has little to do with econ, and more to do with stats. Take good notes and do the homework to the best you can. The lab work is just as difficult if not harder. The midterm and final are on the verge of impossible due to the enormous amount of info. Take another instructor!
If you think professor's help this guy completely doesn't! Got sick after a good start to his class and received no help from him following that. Very irresponsible and disorganized.
Very unclear and not helpful, overall doesn't know how to teach college students.

Signing in for attendance was mandatory because it was worth 30% of our final grade.  The notes were posted the night before every class so you could download them and just read along/add little things as he went over them in class.  The design binder took a while, but it was broken down over the whole quarter so it wasn't too bad.  Very nice guy.
Great teacher... He absolutely enlightened me. A lot of reading but so worth it.

For all the people complaining about how he grades hard due to essays and discussions and attendance... Shame on you. It's your choice whether to fail so stop blaming it on him. I found his lectures interesting and he truly does want you to pass his class!!!

Tough professor, really good though...wants you to pass his class! He's a tough grader but he sets aside time where you can have him check your work 2 essays 2 tests tests are pretty much from the reading-theres alot of reading-and essays are worth alot! Attendance is necessary-you will fail course if you do not attend lect. and discussion!Gd tchr

THE WORST TEACHER EVER. DO not take him!!! the worst most annoying teacher ever he gives huge assignments way too much reading. And he gives horrible comments on your essays like "Do you even care about your future at ucr" or "talk to your counselor about attending a different school" or "you failed to do this and this and that" very degrading.
NEVER EVER take him your first year he is soooo demanding and i hated his class. his lectures are the most boring ones i had taken. Honestly its horrible try to avoid him.

Glidden is a genuinely nice guy that truly does care about what he teaches, and practicing what he teaches, and truly cares about the well being of his students. However, his class is very difficult and the paper that is two thirds of your grade will mess you up unless you put extensive effort into it. Not a bs-able class.

I am shocked the number of negative comments; I thought Professor Glidden was in a class by himself; a liberal minded man who actually LIVES his ideology.  How rare is that?  Highly knowledgeable and endearing in a self-professed 'geeky' sort of way.  I just loved him.  He didn't 'teach' the class, he was the class.

If you don't attend discussion he will fail you like he failed me. I missed three discussion and he straight out said you better drop the class because I am failing you. Over three missed discussion!!!

A lame duck who tries to punish students of non-Phil majors by giving them as hard a time as possible on a intro breadth course.  If you are clever enough and a good writer for the term paper, you can get a A without reading the books, just take good notes in lecture and skim parts of book you need.

He is quite difficult.  Very soft spoken individual who definitely knows his stuff.  He is very kind hearted and is willing to help you if you are in trouble.  He takes improvement in the class to determine your final grade rather than just scores.  Never undermine him when he tells you that you have to read everything...because he is serious.
Great Professor.  His lectures were always interesting and the format for his class is pretty easy.  It's just a couple quizzes and one big paper at the end.  Highly Recommended.

David Glidden is a wonderful professor. He is very passionate about what he teaches and teaches the material very well. I was never too interested in the material he taught but he somehow managed to keep me awake in class. He expects a lot from his students. Despite of my initial impression of him, he was easy to talk to.
David Glidden is the salt of the earth.  If you think his classes are too hard, you probably shouldn't be in college to begin with.
No Comments
No Comments
It was not a hard class if you did the reading. The midterms are easy if you study the notes. The final paper however can make you or break you in this class. Ask you're T.A. for help it might help.

An Ivy League scion oozing rank elitism, but strangely I am not taken aback. A refreshing throwback to the Old Left.  A "conservative" liberal with a nostalgiac, faraway look in his eyes, pining for True Meaning, seemingly unable to come to grips with the Age of Irony.
A very interesting and thought provoking class. It is not the easiest phil class, but the professor is very talented and a great lecturer. Take this class.

you'd figure, intro course, easy right? well, not with this guy.  tests are stupid, asks greek terms religously. Gives students the same excuse everytime why he doesn't curve or as general answer. Him and his TA's act like they are better than everyone, don't ask for help, unless you will be talked down to, or if your a know-it-all who brown-noses.

Granted, he likes philisophy but com'on where do we draw the line?  I saw him go into StarBucks and he put his name down as "Plato".  needless to say, his tests are relativly difficult because he tests on very specific details from reading. so pay extreme detail to reading. Final paper is nuts too.
Lectures can be a bit boring and abstract but the tests are easy if you just study the lecture notes.

Over all an extreamly boring lecturer... Impossible to stay awake and he believes in testing on minute details.   Beware, read throughly and if you are not willing to work really hard, you will not do well at all.

Great prof, but be warned he teaches it more like upper division.  Expects more than most.  His personal anecdotes are pretty cool, and he REALLY knows the material.  The tests are cake if you do the reading.  Term paper is harder, 10 pages, analytical essay.  Lectures are a must.
Aside from reading out loud in class, the only thing you learn from Glidden are his lame personal tangents. Not a cool guy to work with if you need help.

Glidden is very interested in his subject and conveys his interest well in his lectures, which are clear, well organized, and thought provoking.  He is also very approachable during office hours and such.

Glidden is challenging, but what do you expect? He knows his subject and is passionate about what he teaches. I don't know how I did on my first paper yet and don't care. i have learned so much in the few weeks I've known the man.
hes nice BUT his class is so hard
really hard.  expects too much.
Kind professor. Human and approachable. Fair lecturer, though classes could use more *bite*.
He doesn't care to listen to students legitimate complaints whitch is annoying.  Also he can't go more than 1 or 2 words without saying  aaa   aaa .
First midterm was hard.  Second midterm was really easy.  Kind of a boring lecturer.  Curves your score even more if you did bad on the first exam.

He is the best professor at UCR, he is the only professor that's cares about his students. Professor Gonzalez loves when people ask questions and he explains everything so incredibly well. If you ever have the opportunity to take his course, take it. He is very friendly and other professors should take notes from him.
Bro is the goat of math professors.

He's the most patient professor I have ever met. The class is pretty straighforward and his notes are amazing! One of the best teachers I've had. The quizzes, Midterm, and Final are all very easy. They don't choose the hardest problems, they choose problems they know students will do good on. They want students to succeed. Overall very good class.

I procrastinated this quarter, so I missed one homework and didn't study as hard for the four quizzes or midterm as I should've. But I locked in for the final, and solely from the lecture notes and Jose's advice, I passed with the grade I did. Definitely recommend.

Amazing professor. If you get him, it will be impossible to fail the class. He cares about his students and always answers questions with a lot of enthusiasm. Although the topics can be difficult, the quizzes and exams have questions you have seen before and he gives you hints on the questions that are on the quizzes and exams.

I genuinely love this prof, if i could get him again I 100% would. He is a very caring prof that wants his students to succeed in his class. The class can get difficult if you dont stay on track, but thats math. He offers office hours and he always tries to get the class to ask questions. He never makes the exam too hard but just right. 10/10

Mr. Gonzalez is an extremely enthusiastic professor, making it clear from the first lecture that he hopes to help his students succeed. The homework and lectures make it doable to do well in the class, though the midterm and final exams are on the more difficult end of the difficulty scale. Make sure to review his notes before each assessment.
He was the enthusiastic teacher I have ever met in my time here. The homework was very straightforward and was on webworks.

Super chill professor, doesn't care what kind of question you ask him. Covers every topic really well, but he's just a bit monotone at times. 4 quizzes, midterm, and final make up the grade, but quizzes are usually 1 question on 1 chapter, and the midterm and final are chill.

I've had this professor for a little over a week now and I must say that he is very nice and caring. He answers everyone's questions with passion and genuine interest, he says "great question" no matter how good or bad your question is, and I would definitely like to take for future math series.

If you see any bad reviews on here just know they are probably fake. He is the best math teacher I have ever had at UCR, he is very approachable, caring, and has amazing teaching skills. Everything that is on the test you have seen before. As long as you pay attention and do the homework you will pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've had, his lectures are really easy to follow and if you miss class he posts the notes. There are quizzes in the discussions and he will inform you on what to review, same goes for the midterm and final exam. He makes it clear from the start he wants his students to succeed and has passion.

Professor loves to focus on theory & proofs that take most of class time, and doesn't do much practice problems. If he does, he crams them in last minutes of class and decides to use ones where their is extra integration rules that he never tests you on. He used like 30 extra rules and only used 1, which was on the final exam.

His lecture notes are godsend actually. They're color coded so it's super easy for me to understand the calculation process. I liked his lectures a lot although it kinda sucked that it was an 8 am so I was just half-asleep through most of it. He's very approachable. Would take a math course from him again if it were scheduled at a later time
Was able to pass despite the fact I barely attended lectures, learned from posted lecture notes and textbook assigned was more than enough to prepare for midterms and final.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The best teacher I've ever had in all my years of academia. He is always caring to all the students and tends to their needs. He deserves the most.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Jose has a awesome personality as a professor, but horrible at teaching. He goes in-depth about the theories of the equations/methods that takes most of class time; he crams the practice problems during the last 5 minutes of class, which is the only thing you will be tested on. Avoid this professor if you learn math through practice problems

Professor Gonzalez was extremely kind and understanding to his students. He really wants the class to succeed, where he always shows up in time to his office hours and took the time to host a 3 hour study session for a final on a Saturday. I emailed him once and he responded within 24 hours, very reliable and puts much effort to help his students.

Amazing lecturer. Positive energy in class. Always happy, trying to set the right mood every lecture. Very keen to help and assist. Available outside office hours. One of the best math teachers I have seen.

Prof Gonzalez is a great guy. He makes math super easy and understanding. He's ready to break things down to the finest terms for anybody. He speaks solid English with a moderate accent but nothing that should hinder your learning. If you're coming from AP Calc everything before the midterm is a total breeze including the midterm.
Amazing professor! So helpful and great at teaching.

Professor Gonzalez was amazing, even though a lot of things didn't make sense. Was very understanding of students' struggles and confusions. He's also very kind and approachable. Would not mind having him again, although I'm almost done with lower divs at this point :(

Professor Gonzalez was fantastic! He was caring, answered every question students asked, and were happy to clarify specific steps. Midterm was similar to practice. The final was online but easy. Quizzes were similar to homework, and the lowest score was dropped. Homework is long and gets tedious, but it is manageable. Overall had a good experience!

The professor is very understanding and patient with students and questions, even over zoom. He covers all the material in detail and tells you exactly what to expect for weekly quizzes and midterm/final. Helps to have a good TA though. Homework and quizzes are easy. Midterm and final are hard if you don't study
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing prof, wish all professors were as encouraging, interesting and good at teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He really is awesome. His accent isn't bad at all in my opinion. He posted the notes for us. He will sit there and answer every question even if somebody else had already asked. Sometimes this causes him to rush through the lecture at the end. Super caring, funny. Midterm was carbon copy of the sample exam. Overall, an awesome professor and person.

Amazing and very caring. He always dedicated a lot of time to questions and was always very excited to answer them. Midterm was exactly like the practice (20%), hw was ok (15%), quizzes were easy during discussion (20%) and lowest quiz gets dropped, final was on webassign but it was very easy (45%). Highly recommend.
His final was 45% and unexpectedly hard to some extent. Though he deserves a 5

Excellent professors. Lectures were online. Anything confusing could be learned from youtube or Kahn academy. Great energy. Homework over-prepares you for the quizzes/test. Sometimes goes too slow/fast, but good pacing for the most part. Would take again
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Prof Gonzalez is very caring and quite awesome. He can go too slow and too fast at times. It feels like he accommodates for those struggling, then he goes turbo to get through the days content. The final/midterm are JUST like the study guides he gives. He has a thick accent that gets easier to understand through the quarter. He is a gem.

Professor Gonzalez is the GOAT. He is super understanding of his students and is always patient with everyone. You could ask him any question and he would be happy to answer it. I feel lucky to have had him as my professor.

From the beginning I knew this was going to be a good class. Professor radiates good energy and is funny. He deeply cares about his students and is extremely approachable/helpful! He explains really good without any judgement. I'm not going to miss math but he's the best math professor! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!! Also don't slack on hw and come to class!

Best professor I've had at UCR. He really cares about his students and wants everyone to succeed. His office hours are extremely helpful and made the information a lot easier to learn considering MATH 131 is one of the hardest math upperdiv classes at UCR. Definitely would want him as a professor for any other Math class.
Best Math teacher so far.
A ray of sunshine. Best professor I have had thus far. So inspiring and motivating. Posts his lecture notes online and they're all you need to pass the class. Loved the class.
Great TEACHER. Ask questions and he will clarify no problem. Learned a great deal.

Amazing professor! Super caring and clear during lectures, he gets excited to answer any question you have. Honestly one of the best Math teachers available here at UCR!!! You can tell he loves his job and is extremely patient with however many questions you give him.. Strongly recommended

I really enjoyed his class! He was enthusiastic, caring and patient. Helpful during office hours. Practice exams help prepare for the midterm and final. Some homework problems were hard but the exam questions weren't as difficult so they're good practice. Textbook is free online.

Professor Gonzalez is incredible. He is unbelievably patient, and cheerfully answers any questions that students may have. His practice exams (posted on iLearn) are very similar to exams given in class. It is obvious that he enjoys his job, and genuinely cares about student success.

his handwriting is so nice. He has a usual accent, but it is fine. his TA is good, as well. really helpful for students. you have to understand his teaching well after class, otherwise,  you will get lose. homework is a kind challenge but through it, you will memorize what you learned in the classroom.

Amazing lecturer. His notes makes the math easy to understand. Definitely cares for his students and he's patient, so you can ask as many dumb questions as you want. Homework was hard but he goes through them in office hours. Quizzes and tests were just like the homework. So as long as you go to office hours and class, you should be able to pass

Nice handwriting and his accent is not hard to understand, which are rare qualities for upper-division math profs. His midterm and final are similar to the homework. The homework can be challenging but he is very helpful in his office hours. He really seems to care about his students.
Really good at explaining topics, very nice when it comes to grading, can be a bit abstract for math but it is okay since office hours are really helpful

kind of condescending towards students if you ask a clarifying question that he previously covered, but it's fine otherwise. 2 midterms, 3(?) quizzes, and a final, but he gives practice midterms and finals and they're relatively on par with what's on the actual exams.
Took for CS 005, and Math 140. Bouth super easy.

Professor Goyal gives the best lectures! The class was hard but the material was never boring, especially because of how he taught it.

He is very accessible through office hours or email.

He is generous in his over all grading, dropping the lowest 2 quizzes and home works (online and written). 

I would absolutely take his class again!
Awesome! Cares about his students and prepares you very well for exams. He is very helpful in office hours and answers any questions. Hard class though.

Dr. Goyal is a caring person who genuinely wants his students to succeed. He provides clear tools, guidance, and all resources that make math concepts manageable. His dedication to our success creates a positive and empowering learning environment. I took 4 upper-math classes simultaneously and have a toddler- if I got a B, you easily get an A!

Professor Goyal is really a great lecturer. Even though he has a pretty heavy Indian accent, if you just put in any effort into paying attention, that won't be a problem. His consistent cursive handwriting is the cherry on top of his really nice explanations for concepts in lecture. He posts all notes and exam solutions (after exams). 95% is an A+
This is a great professor, he uses up the whole class time which is appreciated because he explains everything in good details. show up or don't thats on you.

reviews.comment: He was very well at teaching material and he tried to incorporate fun examples sometimes in his lessons! Take this class he is an amazing teacher!

Absolute goat of a professor. Never tests on anything he didn't teach, shows plenty of examples in lectures, and is super quick with email responses. One of the best professors. He has an accent but it's not too hard to understand. He has perfect grammar and can explain things better than natives. I LOVE PROFESSOR GOYAL! The amount of resources he would provide on the canvas were very helpful. As a person who struggles with math, I learned so many things from him. Easiest math class! He is also very generous with grading and provides extra credit opportunities. Go to OH. If you did bad, thats on YOU! :) You have to do abs NOTHING to fail.

Dr.Goyal is a great teacher, I would highly recommend going to lecture, but most importantly I would recommend watching youtube videos on topic before each class to prepare yourself for the material. He explains math concepts well. Tests are not hard at all. As long as you know how to solve the homework and quiz problems, you should have no problem getting a solid A on the midterm and final. He is willing to help you when you don't understand a problem. Honestly, it was such an easy class.

This was really an easy class. Sure his handwriting is hard to understand but he explains the math concept well. As long as you do the homework well, you should be able to get a solid A on the final. Lectures are confusing and hard to understand because of his accent. Tells you what questions will be on the exams and they are not that difficult. Make sure to do the optional problem sets as they are more helpful than the actual hw.

Hard to understand some concepts as they are explained in a way that feels abstract and too "mathy" (even as someone who did well in math in highschool). Prof. is nice but his accent can make it hard to understand sometimes. Attending lectures is good but notes are posted online. Grade depends heavily on midterm and final but lenient otherwise.

If I had to take this class again, I would he is enthusiastic and knowledgeable about the material. All his exams are based on his slide material, there is a lot of memorization but the class is fairly easy. Make sure to go to the discussions, the weekly quizzes really do help prep for midterms.

Prof. Love is a good instructor and lets you know what you have to do to get a good grade.  Can't ask for more than that for a huge class.
Professor Love is not very personable, however he does offer 1 midterm drop as well as 2 quiz drops. Everything in this class is pure memorization.
Good chance of an A if you keep up with the course. He knows a lot about the subject and Earth history.

One of the best instructors at UCR.

Professor Love gives great lectures and the course is well structured and organized.  He lets you know what you have to do to get a decent grade.  Not easy but not that difficult either if you keep on top of the slides.

Very fun class you just have to review a lot because if you don't you will fall behind.

Some of his quizzes are hard but thankfully he drops two of the lowest scores. The midterm and final is easy since it is all m/c and straight off from the Slides. No need to attend since he posts all the material you need on the slides

class is not mandatory. lecture is boring and all the slides are online, just memorize them and u will do well on the exams. Take him! he drops one of the midterms and 2 quizzes, final is 40%

i did not attend any lectures yet still managed to get and A+. study his slides.

Good Professor who makes ideas clear. Top Scot.

Excellent Professor. Witty and knows what he's talking about. All you need do is attend lecture and pay attention. His slides were all I used to study!!

Fair and easy class. He lectures based off the power point and later puts it up on ilearn. Don't buy the textbook. You wont use it. Everything is based off the slides. The material isn't hard. He talks funny with accent.

Cool teacher....weekly quizes are pretty easy!! Just read the lecture notes!
The class is very straight forward, and graded on a curve. Just show up to lecture for your own benefit and be sure to study.

dont buy the textbook. It's hard to even pay attention in the class cus of that scottish accent.boring! boring!

he is so inconsiderate! i had the flu and the doctor on campus specifically told me i am not allowed on campus and that i will be excused from class. however i had a midterm the next day and i emailed gordon love with the doctor's note. professor love replied that i am not allowed to retake my midterm...

He does explains all the concepts and facts on his slides. He is a fair grader, but his teaching can be very dull. His Scottish accent does not help, but even makes the class more boring. TRUST DONT TAKE IT!!!
Prof. Love was sympathetic and understanding about personal problems that affected my progress. Quiet but seems like a good guy.
He teaches the subject well and puts together a well rounded story bringing everything together.

I studied for the final in the exact same way I did for the midterms (getting As for both), but got a frustrating C on the final.
