He is a good professor. He knows what he's talking about, but he does it so boring. You don't need to attend class, but must study all the slides in order to do good on quizzes. The midterms & final are hard so try to find someone that has the head TA. He actually gives out study guides so you don't have to study 17 chapters worth of notes.

i agree, this class def wasnt easy. no study guides, so you have to know almost all the info on the lecture slides. The final is cumulative of 17 chapters, so dont think you'll just cram. he does drop the lowest of 2 midterms. Ta's vary, some are hard and some easy. Try to get chris. He's way chill.

Honestly, this class is a pretty difficult class.  Unless you're good at memorizing really specific facts and i mean A LOT of specific facts, you'll do fine. Because he hits you with a lot of those. Even with studying, the best I could get on quizzes was a 7/10. If you can, try and take another EASIER geoscience. Oceanography is hard!

G. Love does have an accent, but he is still understandable. The class is boring, but he does know this subject thoroughly. Attendance is absolutely not mandatory; however, you must attend your discussions for quizzes! They are worth a chunk of your grade. Do not bother buying the book! Just review the slides he posts on ilearn and you'll do fine.

The class is not the most thrilling, but he presents the material well and if you go to class and review the slides he posts on ilearn, you'll do fine.  Go to the discussions, the quiz's are worth a third of your grade.  Focus on the slides above all, you can basically leave the book untouched. If this class counts as G.E. credit take it, its easy.

going to clas helps but its hard to understand im w/ his accent. go over slides on your own & learn from there if you have a hard time w/ his accent. he suggests buying the book but its not worth it. pts come from quizzes, so do well. 2 midterms but only takes the grade from one. final is a mix of material from both midterms & some new lec materia

THE Scottish Sensation (his code name among my friends) He's really approachable, and is always prepared. He's very approachable, and always willing to help whenever one is in doubt. He definately knows what he's talking about. Yes, he's breathtakingly handsome...never a bad thing.

Don't take this class if you actually want to learn how to become a better writer. This class is extremely easy. You just need to show up and do the mandatory in-class assignments, study for the midterm for 10 minutes, and you'll get an A. The only thing you do for the entire class is basically just freewrite for different periods of time.
Very easy class and amazing professor I would recommend her to anyone. Attendance is mandatory but you can miss two classes and it won't effect your grade at all.

Very kind and loveable professor. The material of this class was not enjoyable. If I wasn't a CRWT Major, I would be scared to ever take a CRWT class again. You are graded on how "messy" your writing is. It rewards being disorganized and as person with OCD, the class was very stressful. The class is doing that over and over and it's unfortunate.

I only have good things to say about Prof. Long! She's very inspirational, funny, and caring. The class is incredibly easy, and is mostly graded on participation/attendance. The syllabus/points system can be pretty confusing, but you don't have to worry about them too much as long as you're attending lectures and discussions.

(Late Review) Professor Long is the sweetest professor I've had at UCR. She encourages people to write whatever they want for their assignments as long as it does not target anyone. While I may not be the best writer, she is patient. I feel more comfortable sharing my stories with her than with other creative writing professors.

Lecture is mandatory, as 70% of your grade comes from in-class participation. The other 30% comes from one big, long quarter project. You start by writing a 1,000–1,500-word story, and by Week 10, you're supposed to have cut it down to 650–750 words based on her teaching and TA feedback. Very easy to get an A—just write whatever you want.

no attendance, lecture has in class assignments, very easy. Grading rubric is clear: effort points (automatic points for doing it) & progress points (main paper has 4 drafts, then you self assess how you improved). Rarely any homework, but takes about 5 minutes to do. Gives extra credit: effort points. Super nice and funny, engage with students.

I think you either love or are mildly annoyed by Prof. Goldberry and the majority fall into the latter category. If you're a bad writer, her rubrics might help you improve despite struggling to do well. If you're a good writer, you're not gonna like the rubrics and it's easy to get a good grade if you ignore how you want to write.

I only passed this class because of my amazing TA; that's not to say Professor Goldberry isn't good—she's a relatively easygoing teacher who is clearly passionate and cares about what she's teaching—but you need to care about the work you're doing. I got depressed halfway through the course but my TA was understanding and passed me.

Great prof. Attendance is mandatory. Basically one written "story" spread out into 10 weeks, Follow instructions, go to lecture, and do all the extra credit and assignments and you'll get an A. Only difficult part was getting up for an 8am class, however winter quarter will be in afternoon so basically no excuse not to go.

Wonderful and charismatic teacher. Attendance required, but you can miss two lectures and still get an A. You work on one project for most of the class, and you just need to improve in five skills (really easy in my opinion).

Professor Goldberry is kind and understanding. Her class was still “under construction”, so she knows “life” happens sometimes. Go to lectures! Your grade is based on IN CLASS only writing, simple discussion course assignments, small video quizzes, online assignments, and a large writing assignment that will span across the whole quarter.

Professor Long's class was always a fun and safe place. Writing classes can be intimidating, but this class was not at all. Professor Long is funny and engaging, and really brings out the best in her students. She expected us to put in the work- you have to do the assignments- but you want to, because the assignments are worthwhile.

I took Goldberry Long in the summer, meaning she had to fit ten weeks of content into five weeks. Instead of rushing through content, she cut some things out of the class for the summer session and really took her time to ACTUALLY teach what we were learning, not just doing it to do it. Incredibly nice lady and understanding. Also wrote her ownbook

I needed a liberal art course to get my degree. I am dyslexic so this was always a challenge.
GL said she would be fair, but gave me low marks.  Ms Long s not fair and only passes people she likes. Watch your politics around her. The university should fire her before they face some future lawsuits.
A teacher this polarized shouldnt be allowed on

professor goldberry is amazing! super caring and always willing to help. no final or midterm - just working on the project due at the end of the quarter which you will work on throughout the weeks. she grades based on progress btw! lecture is NOT mandatory - would recommend going though. awesome class take it with her if you can!

Professor Goldberry is the most encouraging and empathetic professor I have had. She understands what it is like to be in our shoes. The class consists of a decent amount of homework, but they are easy to do. Throughout the quarter you write a story of your choice, revise it multiple times, and then turn in the final draft at the end of the quarter

Goldberry Long is a very sick lefty, and she will fail you if she thinks you are a Donald Trump supporter. She is greedy, married my cousin, and has suppressed his heritage by not raising his children Jewish, because she is an anti semite, and has no place teaching young minds. I abhor her deeply.

Prof. Goldberry is probably one of the most engaging professors I had so far. Really passionate and really energetic. Only thing that was bad about this class was the workload and the class organization. It wasn't the best and she gives out too much work/homework. What I liked about the class most was that it was really engaging!
she assigns way too much work and all of it feels pointless to be honest. class is super unorganized and take up too much time

Probably one of the best Profs at UCR. Her lectures were amazing and I felt like I really learned about creative writing. Class is more about effort than anything which was helpful. She is super nice during Office Hours. Truly the GOAT

she's nice and all but she assigns way too much work for no reason. not an enjoyable class and not worth the effort. this is supposed to be creative writing, but she gives a bunch of rules on how you should write. for ex: she wants you to remove all adjectives and adverbs in your stories. take a different prof if you can!!

This professor is amazing!! When winter quarter shifted from online to in person, she was super understanding and offered her lectures both in zoom and in person. There is no final, just a paper and her classwork actually helped me improve my writing! Definitely would take her again!

This class has great content, but the professor was so unorganized it drove me insane. TAs and students were so confused by what we were being graded on and what we needed to do. Technical difficulties occurred every day, even more when we went back in person, which made it impossible to learn anything. The class itself is easy but she's confusing

Prof Goldberry is the kindest professor who would do her best to make sure you are comfortable with your writing. As a STEM major, I struggled with writing and yet in this class I felt like a CHASS major when I was writing for her class. Take her take her take her! Totally worth it.
She's super sweet!

The class is an easy A. Lectures aren't mandatory but you basically should go since its you do get handouts and 'exams' on some of the topics. Midterm was both a narrative draft and an essay question test (optional so you don't have to take it during finals), and final was a revision plus a 3 hour exam with essay questions on lecture concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is a teacher that really allows you to open up and her lectures are really interesting because it's like a time to reflect upon yourself and really get to know yourself through writing. Midterm was a rough draft of a story writing and final was the final draft of that. Class is easy A and Professor is amazing.

This course was much more than I expected. I felt comfortable in this class even with terrible writing skills. Goldberry empathizes with students more than any professor I've had. She is not afraid to put herself out there when she asks her students to do so. Her positive attitude and humor keep students on the edge of their seats all quarter.

You gotta participate twice in lecture and in once or twice in discussion, but other than that it's an easy A. You don't even have any midterms, you just work on this project for the entire quarter. And by project I mean, a single writing piece you redraft over and over. Lots of hw tho, but I'd rather do that for the easy A.

Professor Long is a really funny and makes the hour and half lectures interesting that time flies by. Participation is a must and you need clickers in the class. Make sure to show up to discussion since it's a part of your grade. TA's are nice. You have ton of writing to do from the booklet (beware many errors in the book  frustration).

Prof. Goldberry had a wonderful and work-heavy criteria. She's very willing to help her students; very caring and patient. Her lectures can be boring sometimes but they really do help with the assignments by making everything more clearer.

She makes lecture optional, but you do have to attend all discussions to make up for it. The midterms was a 300-750 word paper and the final was revising the midterm. You have to create a portfolio and critique yourself on the rubric. There are about 2-5 smaller assignments due every week, but nothing too difficult.

She told some of the funniest stories I have ever heard and really made lecture fun. You have to speak twice during lecture for participation points. There's a lot of busy work, but it's not hard and is more for your own growth as a writer.  The midterm is a rough draft of your final project basically. Really enjoyed her and this class.

She is an amazing professor. I loved the class and she told amazing stories. Really inspired me to become a better writer. I wish I could take her again. She assigns about 2-4 assignments due every Sunday night. But they are easy and can be done quickly and are fun. Midterm is the rough draft of the final that you revise 3 times. Great class.

She tells funny & amazing stories. Just listen during lectures; no need for notes. Final & midterm is a 56 project w/ self-assessment & other things. About 2-3 FCEs due on Ilearn every Sunday. She has clicker questions & you have to speak during lectures about 2 times through the quarter to get the participation points. But she is my fav professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This class was super easy, and it felt like I was back in high school.  She uses obscene language, since this is a creative writing class, and her lectures are always fun. She does clicker questions for credit and powerwrites are always fun. She doesn't really lecture (no notes), but more or less gives you tips on how to improve. Easy A.

Goldberry uses obscene language and controversial remarks extensively. She locks out students if they are late so they can not write their powerwrites (needed for participation). I benefited more from discussion sessions where I learned how to refine and be expressive in writing. lecture topics were scattered. No electronics.  Felt like high school

In this class, you will find someone who rambles on for the whole duration of lecture about her life and things that have recently infuriated her off.  She has no respect for authority nor for her students.  If the IT equipment malfunctions, she will call the UCR staff and leadership incompetent.  It's easy to pass the class. participate. do hw.

Made an interesting concept more interesting. Provided new ways of thinking about writing: every class we had to write for 10 min straight--no stopping! Cant think of anything? Write that. Discussions more helpful than lectures for hw. There was supposed to be a published compilation of students' final work but it didnt happen, kinda disappointing.

Tons of pointless assignments and reading. Lectures are rambling and tangential with very little helpful information. Very sweet and funny, but if you've taken her lower-div class, you'll not get anything new in any other class with her. Was not open to experimental concepts; ideas were rudimentary at best. Constantly changed grading scalesyllabus
Easiest A ever. Just do all the assigned work and you're good.
Great professor. She cares about each and every one of her students and is a kind person with lots of great insight to share.
EASY A. Lectures are all common sense and cliche. Do all the assignments and you will get an A easily.

She's a easygoing lecturer with a couple fun stories but I don't understand why people said this class was "super duper enjoyable." It was all a bunch of depressing people telling depressing stories. Ending the day with this class makes me feel hollow inside.

I dont know why everyone's praising Goldberry. Sure she is a good lecturer and whatnot, but most of the stuff she says are on a tangent of what she's really presenting about. Regardless, easy A and I slept in class all the time. Just no technology allowed at all in class.

She is amazing! You will never be bored no matter what. She easily captivates your attention and has the class interacting with each other. You also get a personal satisfaction of writing your own story so I suggest taking this class no matter what!

Such an interesting and enjoyable class! Goldberry is the best, so funny and good at her craft. Loved this class, and although there is a lot of writing, it is a writing class so should be expected. Very effective tactics at teaching creative writing, was kind enough to share some personal stories that only made her more likeable and interesting.

Didn't need the class but I read good things on here & decided to take it. Best decision ever, she really is an amazing professor. The grade is based on completion of assignments, not how good you are at writing. Hw is due online every Sunday, you must do that if you want an A. Lectures were mandatory but they're interesting. She is one of a kind

Best teacher at UCR. Ms. Long motivates you and makes your education feel as if it's actually worth it. Her stories are amazing and she will try her hardest to get you to understand the concept. Take her! Do the work and you'll do great and learn a lot about yourself.
She is the best teacher I've had. Even after I had her class, I still drop in and visit her. I would recommend this class to anyone. Do your work and you'll get an A.

Goldberry is an excellent teacher who uses stories, music videos, and well just any great material to get her concept through. Going to class is a must and it isn't like you won't want to because what she teachers and how she teaches it pulls you in. She is alot of fun so take her. Best Professor so far at ucr

Easy class and awesome prof. A really interesting class too. Do the work and you will get an A. You have to go to pretty much every lecture and discussion because you turn in stuff each class. People who said this class is hard must have a super easy major because the work is very easy compared to all the classes I've had.

REALLY fun and EASY class! As long as you do all the work on time, you'll most likely get an A. The only work you pretty much get are blog entries due on the weekends. Lectures are mandatory because you do freewrites, but that's pretty much the only thing. There's also one midterm and a final, but just pay attention in lecture for the terms.

All you have to do is attend class, listen to her quirky lectures, and you'll get an A, guaranteed. No textbook needed! She is very helpful, understanding, and hilarious. She tries hard to make the class interesting and fun. If you want an easy A, this is the class for you. Just make sure do all assignments, and go to class. Tests are EASY as hell!

She's fun and really teaches her course. She can go on and on about her personal life at times, but she always connects it back to the lesson. No textbook needed, but lectures are mandatory since freewrites are collected at the end of class. Totally recommend taking her class.

Goldberry is by far the most interesting and fun professors I have ever taken in my entire academic career. She will teach you how to write a story - not how to write a scene, or how to make your sentences flow - an actual story. She will make you a writer, whether you like it or not. So quit delaying and sign up, or you will regret it.

there might be a little bit of reading to do but its easy and inspiring (just like her). everything is simple if you just try a little bit. you have to be LAZY to not get a good grade in her class. she is by far the best teacher ive ever had. you can learn so much from her

Amazing professor.  The classes were kept light with her story-telling, and the workload was extensive, as were readings, however, they were completely do-able.  I had an awesome time studying under her, and would like to take another class with her again.
Greatest professor at UCR. Tells really interesting stories every lecture. Her class is very easy, grade is mostly based on completion, however everything is up to your TA's.

Awesome professor. One of the best at UCR. I took the class because I like writing and I had to fill units up for CHASS requirements, and it deff. paid off. She lowes her students and tells amazing stories...all the TA's were awesome too

She a wonderful sort of eccentric. You can tell she is excited about the material and everyday she has a colorful story to tell. Not only are the assignments easy, but they end up being fun and self-fufilling. You grade depends almost soley on your TA. And she docks a letter grade for every three abscences!! But besides that she's very interesting.

So far, one of my favorite professors on campus. You could tell that he cares deeply for his students, and I was excited to go to his class every day, even though I don't like writing. He always brings the energy for the class and you're only graded by a few things.

One of the best professors I've had! He's super approachable and always willing to meet during office hours. The concepts were always clearly explained and was overall a rewarding class. Thanks to Grant I  was able to pass my WPP exam. This class was my favorite part of this quarter.
He is an absolutely amazing professor!

Professor Palmer was amazing! Took him for the 5-wk summer english1c, and while it was very fast paced, he's very understanding and is very lenient in grading. My essays were well below the word count, but he cares more on the content of the paper. Attendance is mandatory but his lectures are entertaining and is always open to help out students.

10/10 prof. Very engaging with students and is very open to working with you if there is an issue with due dates or what not. Definitely recommend if you just need English as a breadth class. 3 essays during the quarter and a pass/fail final. Always had a good attitude and kept the class engaging.

Honestly one of the chillest professors I've ever had. He seems to genuinely care about his students. He's always willing to help and I found his lectures enjoyable. He doesn't grade too harshly, which made this class a nice balance while I was juggling harder courses. Highly recommend if you want a supportive & low-stress working environment
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a nice and passionate professor who truly cares about his students. The class isn't too hard. I recommend taking this professor.

Take this professor if you can! He is so friendly and was always willing to help. The workload wasn't bad at all and gave constructive criticism on my writing in the nicest way possible. He seems passionate about his job and I have a lot of respect for him.
Has to be the best English professor here at UCR! Clear syllabus and wants the best for you. He is extremely clear on what work you have to do.
Just a chill guy

His lectures are very helpful and he's very understanding and lenient with his assignments/attendance. You do have to ask him in class or either office hours for feedback but he's very helpful. Definitely will be taking his class again if he's teaching ENG1!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Palmer is a great teacher. Even though this course in not very interesting but he makes it very understandable and easy to pass. Favorite UCR professor ever.  Lectures are chill.  He was very generous with any circumstances I had, and gave me extensions to his essay.  His essays are average.  As long as you write what he asks for, you will get a good grade on his essays.  He even allows you to revise an essay.  Not too much homework, we had weekly discussion posts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: If you want to pass Engl 004, pick this professor. I never got any As before in my previous writing course, but he was the first professor who gave me an A. reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: He's one of the few professors who is caring about students having a life outside of college. I had this professor for 1C and I thought he was amazing. The pop quizzes and essays could be revised for a 10 percent boost as long as it is under 89 percent. The instructions for writing the essay is also really thorough so you know what to write your essays about. He is also lenient about late work and he is pretty quick to respond to emails.
My favorite professor I have had so far at UCR.  Always looked forward to showing up to his class.
Was very understanding and lenient. Cared a lot. Assignments were not hard and there was not a lot of it.We did have to do a quick-write everyday which counted as attendance.

reviews.comment: the goat professor. He makes it less of an English class and more of a critical thinking type of class. I was excited to attend lecture each day since he always had something thought provoking or eye opening to say.
had him for ENGL 001C. Best teacher I've ever had! TAKE HIM you wont regret it. Explains things very clearly and the work you put in is reflected in your grade.
amazing! I loved his class.

Cares a lot about student learning and gives very positive and constructive feedback to encourage you. Lectures are interesting and worth attending. ENG 172B fir upper division. Very straight forward with assignment expectations. Never gives more work than is reasonable. One of few professors who cares about students learning. Attendance is flexible.

reviews.comment: Great Professor/TA. Cares about students and offers an extension for every paper.

Professor Richey is my favorite professor at UCR. reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Richey was very consistent in lecturing and explained topics thoroughly in a digestible tone. I especially appreciated his telling of finance in a round-about way; rather than jumping from topic to topic, he explained the rationale in sequence and how it relates to material we would learn in future BUS courses.

I struggled a bit with the material and attendance, but the professor was super kind and understanding.
Because of that I was able to not only pass the class, but with an A.
I hope both sides of his pillow are always nice and cool.
Super chill professor. Exams were decent and should be easy if you study the course material
this professor was cool and he explained a lot of concepts very simply for us to understand. Curved every exam but his exams are very fair.

This Professor is awesome and cares about students. His class had three exams, three group homework assignments, multiple projects, and a stock market game. His exams are very fair and are based on the power points which I respected heavily about him.
Easy Class, easy exams, no homework and only several projects.

Dr.Richey is a very inspiring person, he always replied email very fast. His lecture is amazing and tests are base on what he taught in the class ppt. I would definitely take his class again if I can! Great Professor!

Readings before every class and quizzes beginning of each class.GO TO OFFICE HOURS and not because you're failing but because it REALLY helps especially for the essays.

reviews.comment: Honestly he is a horrible lecturer. Nice person though. His exams are difficult and I definitely struggled in his class. I was shocked to see I received a B when i was 2% below average. Easy B. Have to work for an A.

This class was very difficult. His notes and lectures were very hard to follow. Even when I recorded them. catherine is a great professor i came to class every time and i was thrilled to show up i loved the vibe i will forever remember the impact she had on my development at the end of my college journey please take this class be open minded. there is alot i can say but for the assignments they are easy dont stress and relax and enjoy the class

Professor Gudis is an amazing and caring professor. She is really one of the most outstanding faculty members at UCR. Everything learned in this class is so pertinent and meaningful, 10/10 would take again.

I initially took this class just to fulfill my upperdiv elective. However, Professor Gudis' lectures are genuinely interesting. This course covers so much ground it will open your eyes even if youre listening passively. Professor Gudis is also definitely one of the most accommodating professors and there were no hard deadlines

Professor Gudis is the best professor I've ever had. She's brilliant but totally accessible to students. She loves her work and brings aspects of public history into her classes. She expects participation but is a very soft grader, the readings and assignments are very manageable.

Gudis is so excited about teaching the subject at times that excitement can rub off on you. uses powerpoint with lots of information but also continues to expand on it. post the powerpoints online. there are 5 quizzes which she tells you wants going to be on it, a midterm pretty easy and take home essay final. recommend taking this professor
By far the sweetest professor ever and is so understanding and helpful.  Lots of reading but it was all very interesting.

I loved this class and Prof. Gudis obviously loves teaching it. There is a LOT of reading, but most of it is interesting and relevant.  Great PowerPoint slides in which pictures take up lots of space, which is great BUT make sure you take more in-depth notes than just those on the slides. Good teacher, really nice lady. A lot of reading, but interesting. Not too hard. Paper a little difficult. Must go to lecture to do well.

She's a great lecturer.  Her powerpoint lectures are well-organized with lots of pictures (helpful for us visual learners).  I like her focus on social history. Really good professor

Dr. Jin has most definitely been essential for getting me to where I am today. She is so passionate about what she does and what she teaches. Great Professor, full of enthusiasm and energy! She is a great researcher too, inspired me to pursue further research!
