He actually cares for his students!!! I am currently taking him and definitely would take him again. You should go to class and take good notes. Also write down when he says "this will be on the test"

Horrible professor. Master the study guide and the HW he gives and you can do OK. But dont expect anything more than an F on the final its 19 pages and looks nothing like anything from the rest of the class. I would avoid at all cost.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The final is 50% of your grade and it was 19 pages long. Prof Guo is a very clear professor, but your fate lies completely in your hands. Just follow along and take amazing notes.
The exams are super hard. Be wary of full free response exams, no multiple choice. Also, there are very few questions. Example: Midterm 1 & 2 were 3 questions each.
Hardest final I've had so far in my 3 years of college. I was pretty confident about all the material and still thought the final was ridiculous.
Terrible professor! Probably the worst and rudest professor I have ever seen.  DON'T TAKE HIM!

He has a strong accent but its not too bad. The professor is incredibly rude and arrogant. He does not miss a chance to humiliate students and is obsessively picky on his grading. It doesn't matter if you show you know everything if you don't write exactly how he wants it. The topics are interesting but the rudeness is unbearable.

He tells you everything straightforward and the concepts are clear. It's hard NOT to understand. The TA is also very helpful. Take this class, but look over notes after every class, you should be fine. For the final, you need to look over every single thing he taught because it will show up on the final.

He's clearly a professor with years of experience behind him. He really knows how students think. While he does have an accent, his speech is very clear and emphasizing. Pay attention and take good notes.

Best intermediate macroecon you can have. Teaches the class in extremely clear and concise manner and speaks really loud so it's hard to fall asleep in his class. He actually cares about students well-being and will do everything in his power to help you out. He chooses a qualified TA who grades fairly. Definitely take him if you have the chance.
Professor Guo is the greatest professor I have ever had.

Prof. Guo is strict, as he wants all electronics off and wants you to stay in lecture until he's done, but he's worth the effort of studying and learning. First two midterms are short and easy. The final is about 20 pages and takes the whole three hours, along with being cumulative and comprehensive. But, if you study good enough, you will ace it.
Few have the privilege to be Professor Guo's student :)
First two midterms weren't to bad but the final was 19 pages long and took the full thre hours.It was insane! It covered everything! Take good notes in class. Should go to class.

Econ is my least favorite subject.  In fact, I failed econ classes several times.  Professor Guo explained everything and taught extremely well that I actually understood econ clearly.  Guo is definitely my favorite professor. You EARN your grade.

You MUST go to every lecture; book isn't bad, but isn't the source of test problems. He announces during lecture "this will be on test", so write it down! Class bombed the midterm, but I still got a B in the class, so it wasn't that bad. Class is hard, but not twisted, much better off than Franco. Write down ALL he says, and you'll be okay...

This professor is one of the few professors around today that actually cares if a student learns. He is not an easy A but you learn a whole lot in his class, just go to class and understand the  material and you will do good. I studied pretty hard and got an A.

Professor Guo is really intimidating during lecture and gets mad really easily. He always thinks he's boss and makes you say "yes" whenever he says "huh". He has an accent but you can still understand him. The midterm was OK but the final was really, really hard. He doesn't have any multiple choice, it's all calculations and intuitions. Good luck!

Take Guo if you want to learn, but not for the easy A. He's intimidating and strict in class, but thats because he sets a higher standard for his students. Extremely helpful in office hours. His midterm is easy, but his final is killer. Drop the class if you do bad on the midterm, or you will have a chance of failing the class.
Hard as hell.

Professor Guo is very intimidating but he is one of the best Econ professors I've had. He's very tough but fair. If you're just in it for an easy A, avoid him but if you're in it to really learn, definitely take him. He gives a lot of hints during lectures about what he will test you on and he really will! I busted my butt and got an A-

Ok, he is definitely not attracting, attitude wise. However, I think he is an excellent lecturer. He is very clear about the material and he definitely knows what he is talking about. Midterms are easy, just study the handouts, however, the final is super hard compare to the midterm which requires a lot of critical thinking and of course, studying.

Lectures are easy to understand - goes at a nice slow pace.  Very helpful if you go see him during office hours.  FINAL EXAM WAS RIDICULOUSLY DIFFICULT!  He doesn't curve (or at least he claims he doesn't).  He seems a bit sadistic at times... make sure you turn off your cell phone at the start of class!!
No Comments

Probably the worst teacher I have ever came across.  I didnt know whether I was in class or at boot camp.  Extrememly unfair with an unnecessary attitude.  If you care about your GPA then I suggest not to take him. He's an ****

Although he is very intimidating and has a bad temper, he is an excellent lecturer.  His grading might seem harsh to some students, but I think it is because he sets very high standards for his students.  I thought he was horrible at first, but once I got used to his style, I liked his class very much.  It's quite possible to fail his class, so stu

I guess his class is not that bad after all.  But he looks hedious.  He's bald and cross eyed.  And he has bad temper.  He likes to yell at students.  And he always looked and sounded like he didn't want to be there.  He has bad accent and can't pronounciate some words correctly.  If you do not do well on his midterm, DROP the class!
He's great but watch out for his finals, you'll take longer than you think completing the final.
This guy was funny and his class was easy. Went to see him during off. hrs, and he was totally helpful.

People of UCR: I just came out of the final. I think he is unhelpful in term of office hours and exam perparation. I asked him about course material and he told me to look somewhere else for the anwer. Very asian type of conduct.

This guy is hardcore... the final took all 3 hours and some people probably didn't even finish it. He's crazy about cell phones going off in class and don't try to leave early. My advice: don't take him.
No Comments
Let's see here, he's boring, annoying, anal, uninteresting, and hmm what else? Oh yeah he can't speak English very well. I think you guys know where I'm getting at.
He's very intense in his lectures, but helpful when you don't understand something

AVOID!! he is a really anal grader when it comes to homework & he trained his ta's to be anal about grading the midterm too!! he does curve..but the wrong way! i had the 8th highest grade in the class and ended up with a B+!! THAT'S CRAP! He failed almost half my class and I worked my ass off! His final is a death senctence!!Bandy is way better!!

He's strict because he used to be an officer for the Taiwanese Army. He's a very good teacher and really wants you to learn. I respect him and he's a very enthusiastic lecturer that makes you want to pay attention. He might be anal, but it's for the benefit for you. It's about time a teacher is not that lenient and makes you want to work hard.
This Professor sucks!!! he doesn't care about his students

Prof Guo was a decent professor. Even though he was extremely rough and strict, he was very knowledgeable and clear. As long as you respected him and did your job as a student, you'll do fine. He was much better than Bandi for sure.
He knows what he is talking about and he gets his points accross. His classes interested me so much that i decided to choose Econ as a major.

Very easy teacher, and you learn a lot in that class. Anybody who says otherwise are probably one of those sorry ass who got embrassed by him in his class because their cell phone went off or trying to leave the class early. those people are retarded, how hard is it to turn off the damn phone?

He's pretty cool and knows his stuff, he does seem to be a hard ass but is just trying to display some discipline. Midterms are cake but finals are hard. He made me understand econ, which not many professor's did.

He appears to be a harda$$.  Don't ask him any questions cause he'll make you feel like your dense.    His midterms aren't hard if you go to class everyday and study.  His final is a killer though! Study more then usual in the begining it will pay of later.

This professor is not too difficult.  He can be very rude though. I think he does it to intimidate but don't that what he says to heart because he's just trying to set an example out of you.  His lectures are clear and he tells you wants on the tests but you must study for the final...a lot.
hes aiite

he's not as hard as everyone on this site says; don't listen to them. he's a funny teacher, doesn't like disturbances, and rewards those who try. his 2 midterms are easy and his final is kind of hard. so if i were u, i'd take advantage of the many who don't study hard for the final. trust me.

This guy has his head up his ass. Seriously, if one thing doesn't go his way I think a vein might pop out of his face. No one is allowed to leave the class, not even 1 second early or he will embarass the**** out of you, and if your phone rings, WOW, he'll pop a vein for sure. He's hard too, later.

As a teacher, he is average at best. In class, he is arrogant and disrespectful of his students. He allows his silly pet peeves to become more important than the presentation of the material. Example: Cell phones do not disturb the class- his tantrums do.
I skipped most of his classes and got B+. He is easy on grading. Make sure you attend all the discussion sessions and then you are set for the midterms. Final is hard though.
How can anyone not say he's easy.. His average is a B+!!!
Very clear lectures, goes over things very well. Don't you dare let your cell phone go off or leave class early.

I find Prof Guo a very, very good teacher. And don't let his habits annoy you...He teaches WELL. Midterms were a breeze! They were based on hw..Although, his final was HARD. Decent curve...median is a B+..take him.
midterms are easy, so what.....need to spend all 3 hours to do his final...FINAL IS SUPER SUPER HARD...final is worth 50% of the grade -.-

This guy is very annoying. I can't understand how he can teach the whole period sticking his tongue out. Ask anyone about his final exams. I got two A's for both midterms, and somehow ended up with a C in the class. Take Prof Bandi instead.

Did not like him _at_all_.  He says "study this, it will be on the test" and then something else is on it.  The tests ended up being word for word definition tests, with a small calculation problem and a graph or two. He is also crazy.
His knowledge in econ is very limited but you can feel his arrogant all the time. His communication skill with students is horrible. At least that is my impression.

as others have mentioned, turn off your cell phones. he gets pissed whenever a cell phone goes off. but, he is very funny, helpful and patient. he may appear to be a hardass at first, but, is very passionate and softhearted.
Appears to be a hard ass, but, overall is a caring and understanding professor.
He sucks!
he should not be teaching until he learns to speak some english.
I think this teacher is very easy, and very funny.. but you MUST turn off your cell phone~ or else..haha... anywaz.. EASY~~~~~ there are ppl tat actually asks him to make the class harder!
No Comments

The final is really really hard but everything else is alright.  He is also pretty funny at times but if he will embarrass the hell out of you if your cell phone goes off, if you leave early, or don't find a seat.
TURN OFF YOU CELLULAR PHONES!!!!!!!!!!
No Comments

The course itself is not hard, however, the exams are very lecture based, which makes going to lecture mandatory. If you go to class, take detailed notes, and go to discussion, the class should be fairly straightforward.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was very light in terms of work but the exams are pretty tricky. He was great professor though.

One of my favorite classes at UCR has been BUS144 with Dr. Haselhuhn. He is such a down-to-earth guy and is clearly passionate and extremely knowledgeable about negotiation fundamentals. This class uses mock negotiations as the baseline of the curriculum, which made the class a very fun experience. 

10/10 would take again if I had the chance!

Professor Haselhuhn was a great professor! His negotiation class was interactive and highly engaging. We had a negotiation each week with an assigned partner. Not as scary as it sounds! 2 exams online based on PPT and some readings. 2 papers (only 2 pages double-spaced), and 1 group paper (6-8 pages double-spaced). Great class!!!
Great professor, lectures were engaging and fun. Weekly paper, some with a group, but that was pretty much the only assignment there was. Highly recommend his 109 class and him as a professor.

Super light work load - weekly discussions & readings & it's easy to keep up with the material. Lenient grading, participate & it's an easy A. The two exams can be tough because they are easy to overthink, but it's all multiple choice & you'll still do well if you're familiar with the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Assigns easy reflection paper every week, have to respond in discussion posts (also easy), and a final essay that is 6 pgs double spaced which you can work on with a group. 2 exams, just go over the study guide and they're not that hard. Haselhuhn was very chill and pretty understanding as an asynchronous professor.

Reflection papers, discussion posts, 1 final project, and 2 exams. Watch the lecture videos, and discussions. The final project is done throughout the course so you can work with a group or do it solo. The study guide is given but you kinda need to read the assigned readings and watch the videos to get a decent score on the multiple-choice exams.

Super interesting course. If you have the chance, take it with Prof Haselhuhn! Exams are pretty difficult if you do not review the study guide (especially the second one). Assignments are pretty easy, just put in the appropriate effort. Overall, would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This is the second class I took with Haselhuhn. The workload is wayyy less than other professors for the same course. Exams are multiple choice. One 6-page essay due at the end of the semester. Gives you the option to work in groups. I highly recommend him over anyone else.
Haselhuhn is an easy professor if you are willing to actually put the effort in. Do the readings, watch the lectures and take good notes, your grade will reflect your effort.

By far one of the easiest courses I took at UCR. Most of the time I was on autopilot. That said, you are expected to attend every single lecture in order to get credit for the negotiations. No textbook but you will have to spend a few dollars on course materials. You can get a lot of practical knowledge from this course. Highly recommend Haselhuhn!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Haselhuhn's Negotiation Fundamentals is a class I would recommend to everyone regardless of their major, because we're ALL going to have to deal with others in our careers. So happy this was in-person instead of online, as certain interactions only work face-to-face. Really enjoyed the class, midterm/final a bit tough, so study!

I took this class through online format and this class has weekly discussion posts, reflection papers, a group project, and two exams. His midterm was very easy but the final was a bit hard. As long as you do the work, read and watch the lectures you will do great in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Class consists of 2 exams, discussion boards, a final group project and reflection papers. Exams are moderate in difficulty and make sure to read the textbook assigned readings. Lecture videos are straight forward and interesting. Overall great class, but will require you to put effort and enough study time to fully understand class material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Textbook is required but the case studies in the TB are quite helpful (textbook material separate from lecture for second half of quarter!) Midterm is hard but professor curved generously. Final is easier but still make sure to study or have a really nice set of cheat sheets. Exams  open notes. Both professor and my TA were responsive (TA more).

Just because a class is easy to pass does not make a good professor. Yes we are in the midst of a pandemic, however, students are looking toward professors to express leadership. He seemed to sulk more than most of the students. One of the worst profs at UCR. I had far better Instructors in JC.

One of the best professors I have ever had. HE IS A REALLY UNDERSTANDING PERON. The first exam was extremely difficult than expected and I got an F After the exam, my friend and I went to office hours and he was really helpful to explain to us why were got questions wrong. End up with a 100% on the final. The main point is GO TO OFFICE HOURS!

I'm very disappointed in how this professor conducted his class. He really hurt my GPA by not allocating points I earned, and when emailed about it, there was no accountability on his end. I have proof of the completed assignments, but no points. My education is out of my own pocket and I have made huge sacrifices, so I take it very seriously.

A fully online class and I actually enjoyed it. The MT was open book but harder than expected but respected students by curving 29% and canceling the final due to world crises. Those without good grade after curve truly didn't get the material since you had to apply it to scenarios in exams. TA's graded nicely on weekly responses. Term paper also.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: It was online for the Spring 2020 Quarter. All the lectures and hw&discussion were online and submitted to iLearn. The exams (midterm and final) didn't sync with what he taught. Exams were significantly harder and gave lots of scenario-based typed questions. Also gave a group project in this pandemic. Curves only ONE of your exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is enthusiastic about his subject and is incredibly clear in his syllabus. The subject was really interesting and he is truly a great professor. Take him if you can. He is clear in his syllabus and lectures. He could explain what would be on the midterm and final better but that's the only criticism I have. I took him in the summer.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This was by far one of the easiest classes that I have ever taken at Riverside. Easy grader and the group work and paper isn't that bad. He gives extra credit not that you should need it and his tests are really easy. Definitely take this class if you want an easy A. Participation matters and you do have to show up to class in order to negotiate.

One of the best professors at UCR. He's modern and extremely organized; definitely knows what he's doing. He sets an example for what a good professor should be; you'll learn a lot in this class and it helps in real life too. So glad I took this course. He's wonderful!

I wish the professor provided more practice questions especially for free response because we have no idea what style of questions will be asked. Her Mcqs are so tricky for no reason. There was also no clear grading scale provided to the students.

Dr. Yamanaka is an amazing professor! This is, by no means, an easy course. You certainly have to put in the time and hard work, since systems neuroscience is a very intricate subject. She is a great lecturer and is always there for her students, which made me feel very supported. Highly recommend!

I had her for systems neuroscience and her lectured were delivered in a systematic fashion. Clear learning goals provided in lecture slides and she executes them throughout the lecture. Sure it's a tough course, but I think if you're genuinely interested it helps internalize the information.

Great professor! Lecture pace is somewhat slow and slides are very detailed, she gives extra credit during lectures so definitely go. Material may be heavy but she does a great job explaining. Multiple choice and short answer exams, the discussion is mainly club journal.

This class is lecture heavy but she does upload her notes on canvas. I do recommend going to lecture because she does give extra credit opportunities during class. You can receive a max of 20 extra credit points. She grades based on a midterm, final, and discussion. You do not need the book, everything on her powerpoints is on the exam.

The class was online Spring '20. Grading was generous because of difficult circumstances. It seemed like an easy class, but if it wasn't online and for extra credit, I probably wouldn't have gotten the A. Make sure to pay attention in class and study hard. The book wasn't need but it was really lecture heavy (even though lectures were not long).
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Hartmann is an amazing professor. His grading criteria are nice because he splits up each unit to count for 10% and has the final count for 20%. It is easy to get a higher grade. He also allows 3 retakes per unit exam, so there are many opportunities to get points. Highly recommend him!

He's great at lecturing and makes lecture materials extremely accessible to students. He also allows retakes on quizzes and has a fair grading policy. Overall a really good professor. My only grievance is that he is somewhat difficult to reach outside of class.

pretty good professor. cares about students' learning. i liked the oli system he had, great for learning and review when you fall behind. i had to withdraw due to a hospitalization. dr hartman's office hours were also fun. he's super passionate and it shows.

Grade was my fault. Midterm could replace all your first unit tests if you do better. Final could replace everything. There were retakes for unit tests. Lectures were okay and they sometimes cracks a few jokes. Very organized and the whole unit is uploaded before it starts.
Very easy class, and grade breakdown as well as exam retakes make it very possible to do well in the course. Professor lectures well, and is always available for help

Mastery grading system was used for 6 unit exams and we could retake them multiple times as he takes the higher of the scores. His textbook, OLI Torus actually taught me chem super well compared to his in-person lectures, which usually consisted of him reading off his slides. Dont fall behind since most units build on each other. Effort pays off.
Loved Hartman. Take him if you can. Got a C because I did not try hard enough but he gives you all the resources to succceed. Doesn't want you to fail his class unlike other professors.
Very kind professor and provides retakes for his exams except midterm and final. The final and midterm replace lower prior exam scores.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Will take forever to grade and update Canvas so you'll have to manually calculate to keep track of your grade but the mastery grading style is a lifesaver. He gives you a lot of resources to succeed like practice tests, and OLI practice problems. Very chill guy and makes lectures interesting.

Use the OLI textbook, it has a lot of practice and even AI for help. If you don't understanding something, you can always go to office hours for help, he is very willing to help his students. Overall, great professor with forgiving grading system considering he gives unit exams with retakes. The class is designed so you don't fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: LOVE OLI TORUS, a platform that he assigns hw in and what i used to study for this class as his lectures were a lil boring. HE GIVES 3 RETAKES for the unit tests, has practice exams for all units, midterms and final were good if you practiced a lot! doesn't consume a lot of my time as it is basically a review of first sem of ap chem

He is a great professor that helps explain the rough concept of chemistry. The class is more so difficult due to the subject rather than the professor. He does weekly quizzes that take up study time yet help weigh your grade from the midterm and final. Just take this class seriously and put in effort in understanding, and you will get by.

Free elo, highly recommend. The class material isn't that hard, and a ton of the grade is from these super easy tests you can retake that you have super similar practice tests of. In my opinion if you want the A you have a lot of control over it, and the class is formatted to be very forgiving.

Amazing professor! He explains concepts clearly in lecture and gives extra credit on exams. Homework can be challenging, but the exams are much easier than it. There's barely even any math on the midterms or final, which I thought was a little weird for a quantum mechanics class. Overall, super easy class and a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Gave us surprise quizzes in lecture. His lectures were solid but expect a lot of self studying outside of class and to be attending office hours regularly. This class made me reconsider my life choices and I changed my career track if that says anything. Labs were harsher for this class though, don't expect an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Definitely the best chem professor at UCR (though that's not saying much). I took MWF and the grade scale was 6 tests 2 midterms and a final + hw, each worth 10%, It's stressful because you have to do good on all the tests, but you can retake and they can replace eachother. hw is a lot but helpful. He is very caring and I did learn  for once.

I personally felt like this class was unorganized, due to his "mastery" grading scale that he utilized. I wasn't really sure how to keep up with the class most of the time, I was also confused as the homework assignments didn't have a due date until the day before the final.

used a weekly quiz structure where u got to take it 3 times and keep the highest score- allowed for u 2 keep trying until u got a concept. also had multiple homework attempts. The multiple chances system made doing well accessible. my only complaint is that often our lectures would fall behind homework and it would be due b4 we covered the topic
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Like many people have written before me, he is very good. The class is by no means easy as it requires a lot of study time. There are mastery assessments each week, but you have 3 times for them so it's nice. He is very caring and will fix any mistakes from grading.

Hes the best chemistry professor the campus has. My friends had other professors that were way harder. Unit tests are only ten questions, and he gives many resources that are very helpful for learning the material. 100/10 would have him as my professor all throughout chemistry I could. He is a cool young guy who really wants his students to pass.

The professor makes lots of mistakes and doesn't explain well. He gives practice quizzes and a lot of times, his answer key is wrong so students get confused or wait for him to reply. 

The quizzes and exams are long and hard to finish on time. Great personality but terrible teacher.

Amazing professor. Homework is lenient (multiple retakes + webpage). Drops lowest 3 grades. Quizzes have retakes which are very helpful. Midterms and finals arent worth much, and aren't that bad if you just study the material (he doesn't deviate from the topics at all its very straightforward whats going to be tested).

the best chem professor. such a nice man who genuinely cares about his students. goes above and beyond for them. the lectures and his videos were so helpful. very easy to pass his class with him while still retaining the content.
Best chemistry professor at UCR. Take Hartman!!

Hartman was a very chill professor but his lectures were very meh. If you want to succeed outside of class you will need to study a good amount but all the materials are given to you as well with a lot of practice quizzes so the class itself was not that bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Joshua Hartman has an amazing grading scale, and allows for multiple retakes for each test, which are worth 10%, just like the final. And, if you do poorly on the midterm, you can always do better on the final, where he simply replaces the midterm if you get a better grade on it. Fun professor, great grading curriculum.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Best chemistry professor I have ever had, I wish I would've had him more than once.

Cool guy, fun professor. Homework is so annoying, it's only 5% of your grade but if you wait until the day of the final to do it you're screwed. Tests are quite difficult. The class is very curved, just stay on top of things and work hard. Final score replaces every other test score. Test averages are very low, usually failing. Participation req.

Hartman decided to take on a different approach to grading with our section. 90% of our grade was based on the exams. Practice questions given through the free online textbook were helpful. Good at explaining topics. Stay on top of the information you'll be fine. I only went to the final, did no homework yet passed.

Hartman provides many opportunities to do well in his class. However, he teaches concepts quickly and does not do many practice problems in class. If u are looking to do well in 1C without having to put in much work, Hartman is a great prof. If u are looking to actually retain the info and get good at 1C, u will have to do ALOT of work on ur own.

He's extremely kind, organized, and caring. His teaching method worked for a lot of people but for me his slides were a jumbled mess that didn't relate to his exams. There's no due date for his homework but do it as he "recommends" to or else you'll be at the end of the quarter with 25 unfinished assignments. Fat curve though. DO PRACTICES EXAMS!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor was disorganized and unreliable. I was able to teach myself to get through it.

Dr.Hartman is a great professor who cares about his class. That being said, make sure you do the practice tests for the exam in canvas as well as the OLI practice problems. Make sure you do ur HW at the correct pace vs cramming last minute. Lastly, he curves well but still prepare properly. All in all, great class, just do ur hw early lol.

Just got my grade in today. Awesome professor and he goes nice and easy on the lectures for everyone to understand. He really emphasizes this on his teaching and just genuinely wants everyone to do well. Midterms were a little challenging but you are given so much aid in practice exams and alot of supplemental aid. There is a curve and extra credit

I took his class for both Chem001B and Chem001C and he's a really good lecturer for how hard chemistry is (for me at least). Had weekly quizzes that I could retake up to two or three times. However, the time limit was disproportionate to how hard they were. My final grade basically carried my grade as I actually had time to finish it.

Basically a self pace and self learn class (He has an program to help you out and counts as hw). Good lecturer, go to office hours. Midterm relatively much easier than final admittingly. great transition class from high school to college and lucky if you get him for whole gen chem and o chem series.
he's very messy and his lectures are hard to understand, also did not have a clear grading criteria whatsoever. but his mastery tests were nice, especially with the three attempts.
Amazing lectures and super organized. Graded on 10 different exams, easy A.

It's a really easy class as long as you do well on his little mini tests. I don't like that he used our quarter as a way to test the textbook and we dealt with a lot of grading errors. But overall, the class is very easy but might screw you over if you take the later chem classes (I literally did not learn a thing and still got an A)

Fall (2023). Didn't get the best grade; didn't enjoy his lectures-only made it more confusing. Cares about his students and only wants the best. Uses own textbook called OLI (hated it). Would have homework problems where it would be wrong, and he says he will fix them (don't know if ever did). Just a lot of problems with the class structure.

Had him for the entire CHEM001 series. Best professor I had so far. Gives you so many chances to get an A. If you put in the effort, you will do well. You can get zero on all the exams but if you get an A on the final, you will get an A in the class. Very nice dude and definitely cares about students learning!

One of the fairest General Chemistry professors I've taken. Lectures were extremely informative exams had info based on his slides. HW was semi-difficult but helped with content. For this class practice problems will be your best bet for getting an A. Hartman cares for students and will help you as long as you reach out.

Professor Hartman was the most involved professor I've had so far. He was clear about wanting us to actually LEARN the content instead of just repeating stock questions. He let us have multiple attempts at mastery tests that really helped me see what I did wrong and improve upon them. He also encourages office hours and gives a LOT of resources.
Allows multiple attempts on quizzes which are 10% of the grade each which gives you a chance to see what you got wrong. OH and review sessions are also very helpful

Amazing teacher that genuinely cares about his students. Gave practice tests that were very similar to the actual test and allowed test retakes for full credit. All lectures were pre-recorded and posted on the canvas as well.

Professor Hartman definitely cares for his students and ensures they have all of the resources needed to pass his class. Though his class came with a lot of extra work, his methods were incredibly effective. However, I would say that his in-person lectures aren't the best. I would recommend watching his videos instead.

Professor Hartman genuinely really cares about his students and wants us to succeed. Very easy to schedule appointments with and flexible office hours (2 hours twice a week). His mastery grading system allows for many retakes to build up your knowledge. Great guy!

Professor Hartman is the best Chem teacher I took so far. He can explain the problem very easily and he will give you many chances to do the test. And the best part, he make up the office hour he missed.

Each week you take mastery exams worth 10% of your grade, but he allows three attempts for each test. His class is easy to follow and do well in. Each homework assignment is graded based on accuracy, but gives you five attempts for each one with feedback and tips.

hartman is a really nice lecturer, and he posts a lot of practice problems on canvas. mastery grading also helps a lot, you get 3 attempts at every unit test, and midterm and final can replace your bad unit scores. he seems like he genuinely wants to help students understand content and do better. overall a really nice class!

Overrated. Practice homework was unnecessarily difficult and last grade was saved instead of best grade. Quizzes/tests did not reflect lecture or homework. Teaches the content well but so many tests and quizzes I could not keep track of my grade until it was too late. Grade is not curved either but to be fair, he does offer quiz retakes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very approachable and kind. He offers a lot of opportunities and retakes to get a good grade. Textbook is free and easy to follow and basically is the same as his lectures. Study hard and you'll do great! I found that he was the easiest to learn chem from.

Arguably one of the best professors in CNAS. Takes so much time out of his day to help students and make sure they are well educated on a subject. Although tests can be difficult, he makes sure to give enough practice in order to let anyone succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Immensely great prof! Exams are difficult, but HE GIVES YOU EVERYTHING POSSIBLE TO SUCCEED!!!! The reading modules on his OLI software are insanely descriptive and he gives countless practice tests on Canvas which prepare you very well for the real quizzes/final. Definitely not a free A by any means, but it is a very fair class. 100000/10 prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Hartman is a very nice guy. However, I had trouble following his lectures and found his masteries to be more difficult than his given practice, which made me score lower on them than anticipated. He is very respectful and accommodating. I would suggest besides his lectures, watch YouTube to really grasp what you will be tested on.

Do well on final, OLI homework, and answer all the questions he asks on lectures, you'll definitely get an A+
For OLI homework: 3 attempts for each, and this only records your LAST try (Instead of your BEST), so be careful for that :)
Overall, easy

Prof Hartman is a really caring and smart professor. His OLI homework helps you to understand the concepts (although there are some issues in OLI). The midterm and final replace other exams scores, so as long as you apply yourself you should do well! There are many opportunities to learn and improve, and his lectures are clear. Definitely recommend
Great Chem professor

Although Professor Hartman really cares about his students, his class was a bit unorganized. The weekly mastery assessments (worth 10%) are usually more difficult than the practice questions, and honestly the OLI textbook was the most helpful at explaining things. Everything seemed kind of rushed in the end of the quarter.

Super engaging and approachable, always helps out with any questions you have. 3 attempts per exam, and the midterm & final grade can replace lower exam grades. The OLI homework helps the most with the exams because most of the questions are math based. Def recommend his class!!!
Fun guy , a lot of unit tests but you get 3 tries per test. Homework on OLI helped solidify information. He uses fun examples in class. He tries his best to help students get the best grade possible.

Weekly unit exams (10 questions, 25 mins) on canvas during discussion, worth 10% of grade each. I spent a lot of time studying the content and did well on the mock unit exams, however did not do well on the actual exams. I feel like the questions were trickier than what you study, but not enough time to figure it out. Good teacher though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best chemistry professors, very caring about his students and extremely generous with extensions and tests, each test is 10% of your grade including the midterm and final and you get multiple attempts on those tests, and there the OLI program provides a lot of examples to work on along with instant feedback which are very helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: One of the best chem professors and you can see he really cares about his students. Teaches content very well on OLI and online videos and has a very generous test grade policy. However, he also goes through content very quickly (luckily, you can review through posted videos) and is kind of disorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Online Savvy

reviews.comment: assigns a lot of homework. allowes retakes on quizzes. hard if you slack off. just try to keep on track, it can be a lot though. there is a lot of math required in chem 1b
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great professor with great resources. Make sure to keep up with the lectures every week so you don't fall behind because there's a lot of material and it's easy to fall behind.
The best chem professor I've had!

I would recommend him as he uses a new grading style and offers retakes for mastery quizzes (each 10% of your grade) when I had him he allowed the midterm to be retaken and allowed the final to replace the midterm score. Super friendly and accommodating to all students and will adjust the class based on the class and students needs. 10/10 amazing!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great Professor!

Would get off topic during lectures sometimes but office hours were there for questions. A lot of homework but I think it gave good practice. Would give us two chances on midterms and would only count the higher of the two scores.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Could not have enjoyed chemistry more Dr. Hartman made It easy to follow and also intrigued me in order to push us to our limits.
You learn more from hw than class, tons of hw. Says things he cannot stick to sometimes, but still tries to give all students a chance at doing better. Not a bad professor overall though

Generous when it comes to extending deadlines & overall a very kind and approachable person. Two exams (each have makeups), the final, & online hw assignments. Chem is not my strong suit, but I managed to get an 89.6% with his teaching. Only complaint is that my grade didn't get rounded up b/c the breakdown was changed in the last few weeks.
Favorite TA. He's literally the best. So very intellectual and helpful! Awesome guy! Great, great TA.

I took GSST 168(not listed)
If you want to learn, Professor Hafez is amazing. If you want an easy A, not from this prof. I felt a bit intimidated at the start of the course, but if you show up, pay attention and participate, you will understand the course. She is extremely intelligent and really cares about her topics, you will learn a lot from her

Professor Hafez had asynchronous lectures, which I honestly did not look at and still got an A+. The TA I had was not the greatest but discussion was graded on participation, so there was no problem getting good points there. I don't remember having much homework with this class except a 2 page essay. Don't quote me on that.

As a STEM major who loves reading and writing, it's very refreshing to take a class like Prof. Hafez'. The course was pretty hands off, it was just reading some essays, articles, etc. and then writing reaction papers. Prof. Hafez gives amazing feedback (at least to me LOL) and I would def take her again. I took this last summer as a 5 week class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class was easy, there were 2 essay quizzes 1 multiple choice quiz all three you had to complete in 30 min but could take at whatever time you wanted. The midterm was multiple choice with one essay response and you had three hours to complete it. The final was a reaction paper to one of the reading and had to be 2-3 pages.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall great professor and easy class. Consisted of 2 essay question quizzes, 1 midterm w/ multiple choice and one essay question, 1 multiple choice quiz, and 2-3 page paper as final. There were a lot of weekly readings but they were beneficial to read for discussion section and not have to rush to read them during quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took the honors seminar on Gender Politics, Hafez is a great teacher and cares about her students, just make sure you participate A LOT. Material is very easy and discussions are basically all you do, take notes and do the readings to prepare you to participate and you'll be fine.

The professor basically gets paid to do nothing. They just record audio of them reading off slides and call it a lecture. I just skimmed through all the readings. Couple quizzes and exams, but nothing crazy.

Professor Hafez was a fair grader and I learned a lot from her class. She graded on-time and was very fair about it. The course was very quiz-heavy, so make sure that you know the material well. It was asynchronous too, so you could go at your own pace.

Everything was basically online and lacked structure. The exams and work would open an unreasonable times(1AM). She never responded to emails, even though she expects up to be "commited and to access the material and respond in a timely manner."

Highly recommend professor Hafez. Participation is a key component for grading but she makes the lectures so clear that I didn’t have to fully read the assigned readings to understand. She’s caring and works with you to ensure you get the grade you deserve in the class. I’d definitely take another section offered.

Dr. Hafez was one of my favorite professors at UCR. This was actually the second class Ive taken with her, and both times I had a great experience. Shes extremely knowledgeable as an anthropologist, and incorporated that into GSST. This was my last quarter at UCR, but if I had the chance I wouldve taken her class all over again.

I would take another class with Professor Hafez in a heartbeat if given the chance to do so. Her lectures are incredibly interesting. She is very knowledgeable in the material that she teaches. The quizzes are not easy but they are manageable. Overall, I enjoyed that Professor Hafez took the initiative to listen to the students concerns. Recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Strict about people leaving during class and technology, talking etc. Wants students to participate during lecture and get Dif perspectives which is interesting to hear. class is common sense but her exams reflect the readings, and the authors arguments in them so definitely read everything assigned as she has quizzes on them. sweet and caring!

The class is basically all common sense but as long as you get a basic understanding of the readings, you will pass all of the quizzes and exams. If you don't like reading, attend the lectures because she goes over the readings in class. There is a 4 page essay required but nothing too difficult. She doesn't allow any technology in class FYI
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is an amazing and intelligent woman. Although attendance is not mandatory for her class; I would never miss it because her lectures were interesting and captivating. I am currently planning on minoring in Gender Studies because of this class. Thank you, Dr. Hafez.
Professor Hafez is wonderful and caring excellent class! I highly recommend it.

She explained the readings very thoroughly. So you almost didn't need to read. The class was very interesting because many of us were able to connect it to our personal lives which made it a lot easier. She was pretty funny too. I loved the class.

Hafez was an amazing professor- she really does care for her students. If you do not participate in class and aren't willing to challenge yourself, I would not recommend GSST10. 3 Quizzes in lieu of a midterm (45%), attendance is mandatory (2 skips), 1 take home final (10 pages 30%), & group presentation (not formal). This class will change you!

Profesor Hafez was a really good professor. She elaborates on her notes. She also uploads her slides and power points online. If you go to class regularly, it is an easy A. She does't give pop quizzes. As long as you get the main concepts, then you'll be fine on her quizzes and midterms. enjoyed her class very much!

I love this professor! Her lectures are all unique and interesting, and she's genuinely into what she teaches - which makes it exciting! She's super helpful and loves her students (and we love her back)! She's a fair teachergrader, and if you attend, participate, and do the work, you'll be more than good. :)

This class really taught me a lot about myself and the modern world. I'm a bio major, so I wasn't doing well in the class since I didn't keep up w readings & connections, but Hafez helped me SO much and made me read all the readings with a new pair of eyes that were no longer for science, but more critical thinking. Loved this class and Hafez.
Best professor at the school by far

Professor Hafez truly cares for her students. If you need help with anything, she will explain it in full detail. You need to participate at least once every class because participation counts a lot. The readings are not that long, but she assigns groups to summarize them and send them to everyone. I just read the summaries and I was fine.

Prof. Hafez is great. A lot of readings though (1-2 15pg. readings for each lecture). Only 3 quizzes, 1 midterm, & 1 final, but reading is essential to pass the class. Readings are interesting and you have to make connections between them. But Prof. Hafez will help if you're behind or unclear. She's awesome & I would take a class with her again.

I loved this class! Prof. Hafez is a  great teacher who really executes her lectures and messages about readings proficiently and engagingly. I struggled in her class (we have to make connections w readings), but Hafez was willing to take the time and energy to work with me & get me caught up. I am so appreciative of this class & Prof. Hafez!

I am a women's study major and took this class as one of my upper devision requirements.The class was very challenging,and you have to do a lot of critcal thinking to do well in this class(at least to get a B)(you don't get the answers straight from the text books!)However,I found the class very interesting, although challenging,and I recommend it!

I gained so much from this class. I was a little intimidated at first & thought I would fail. But managed to get a B. 1 midterm, 1 final, 1 group paper. Readings are quick & easy. This class can be challenging but I would recommend it

Professor Hafez rules! She's so clear in explaining everything and you're never behind in class because she offers a lot of help if you go to her office hours. Her workload and reading assignments are interesting, useful, and doable. Take any of her classes if you can.

Amazing professor! Her class was my favorite this quarter. I loved the way she lectured.  Do not take her class if you are not willing to step outside of your comfort zone when it comes to thinking about sexuality. She was definitely the perfect professor to teach this course (sexualities & culture). I would definitely take a class with her again.

She is a remarkable Professor! She is the first Professor out of my 9 quarters who reached out to me. She is extremely helpful and her class is enjoyable. TONS of reading and a presentation but not too difficult as long as you participate. I hated missing her class when I was unable to attend. She made me want to minor in WMST!
This Professor taught me so much about the world! She is an incredible, incredible professor! The best class I have ever taken--hands down!!!

AMAZING teacher! I learned SO much in the class! If you want to get some worthwile education in during your time at UCR, take a class with her!You will not regret it I promise! It requires a decent amount of reading and prepare to do a lot of writing. She's always in a great mood and willing to help. I got an A, so it's possible to do well.

Great class! a good bit of reading but not overwhelming. Always interesting and not the usual choices either. Professor Hafez is one of the finest teachers I've ever had, even though I didn't quite get the grade I'd hoped for. (I was late with a paper) She's a really understanding and fair person. I'm giving serious consideration to a WMS major.

She took us from a disparate group of incomplete thinkers to a community of learners. Encourages you to really think and make your case. Creates a stimulating and safe place to learn. Expectations very high but always fair. Best part was experiencing so many viewpoints respectfully handled. Hafez well deserved the standing ovation on last day.

What education means to be. Not realizing I possessed many classic male attitudes and initially put off by Hafez's forceful insistence on challenging assumptions, I came away a CHANGED person. Many of us carry ignorance and prejudices buried in our luggage. Hafez has the key. Great experience! Apologies for the lazy boys whining from the back.

She is a wonderful person and professor. She goes beyond what she should do. She does tend to extend al good perception of what she wants us to know and gain knowledge from. I learned so much from this class I will take with me forever. It gives you an innate knowledge about the world. Read the articles and do well on the papers. TAs are strict!

I love this professor!! She is great and it is obvious that she knows what she is talking about. She walks around the class and she will randomly pick on students to share their opinions. I have learned a lot from her and the readings she assigns are easy to follow. I highly recommend her for wmst 001.

Very nice and interesting woman. Her lectures some days can be boring, but then they can be very funny the next. Three response papers and no midterm. Final had 2 essays, MC and 5 short answers. Reading powerpoint slides really helped to learn material. Reading the book also helped too because lectures were based off of book readings.

Took her for WMST 151 and 162, to sum it up she is an AMAZING professor!! The work she gives is relevant to the course and interesting.  She received a standing ovation from our class at the end of the semester =)
No Comments

The professor is very smart and she knows what she's talking about. We had to write 4 response papers (easy. 2pgs each) and a 10 page essay as a final. no tests, no finals. I would take the class again. It was very interesting and mind opening. Make sure you participate in class, that will help your grade big time.

Prof clocks in, drops banger one liner, and clocks OUT! Bro's efficient and you can tell he's been teaching for a hot minute. He considers anything greater than or equal to a 91% a solid A. Attendance for lecture isn't mandatory (section is tho) but if you don't have anyone to ask for notes, you should go.
Life changing lectures. I would love to have another course by him.
Literally the goat
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hakwins was a really cool guy. The midterm, movie review paper and final are all based on his in-person lectures so it really helps when you include his actual words into them, it worked for me, I got an A+. Attendance isnt mandatory, but you really need to be there to take notes unless you have a friend in class that'll share.

Incredible professor, definitely one of the best! His lectures are mandatory but extremely fun and engaging! The class was graded only on discussion attendance, a term paper (based on readings), and a midterm + final (based on lecture), but as long as you put effort in and go to your discussions/lectures, it's very easy to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was probably the best professor I've ever had. His class is lecture based so you have to attend to get the notes and discussion too, but it's honestly an enjoyable class. I never dreaded it. He is so enthusiastic and made me love history as a bio major. His lectures keep you engaged and the class is very doable and manageable and easy.

Professor Hawkins was the most enthusiastic and greatest professor I've had so far. His class lectures are always interesting and informative, so if you like history, I doubt you'd lose interest (coming from a Business student). No HW. The midterm and exam are strictly lecture information, but go to class. Discussion is mandatory, but super easy.

Dr. Hawkins is an awesome Professor and his lectures and related material are very informative. Just attend class, pay attention, take notes, and you will do fine. I would take another of his classes anytime. He is awesome!!

Best prof here. You have to go to lecture to get an A but its so doable when he tells it to you like a story. 1 midterm/final based on a prompt where you dump all your memory from the events given during lecture. 2 reading assignments which are used for a 4 page paper but its easy and doable. He doesn't give note slides so be wary of that.

Hawkins is very passionate and enthusiastic. You do need to go to lecture or get recordings from someone because that's the only way you'll do well on exams. Exams are essays; essentially just a brain dump of EVERYTHING from the given prompts, so you definitely will need to study/memorize. Term paper was based off readings and not too bad.

Don't believe they said this class is an easy class Because the prof has changed the exam from online to in person. On the exam TA expected you to write every single information from the lecture,and there is no readings you'll need to take good notes His lecture are superficial like high school level lecture You have to spend a decent amount oftime
Great Professor
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He was very funny when teaching the material in this course. He only grades off of two exam ( Midterm and Final) and one Term paper the is due at two weeks before the course is over. Make sure to take notes because they help so much while studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Im not a big fan of history, but Professor Hawkins definitely made the class interesting and engaging to follow along with. Highly suggest taking his class, because he's honestly one of the best professors I've had in college

Very entertaining lectures and feels like a 10-week long story about the subject making it easy to follow. Lectures are practically mandatory as midterm and final are based on the lectures, so take in depth notes. Midterm and final are heavy on writing depending on how in-depth you go but the more in depth, the easier it is to get an A in class.

One of the best professors I've had in terms of lecturing. His lectures were engaging and the material itself was very interesting. In terms of getting an A however, I've felt like that really depended on the TA. The grading difference and requirements among the TAs were radical and not accounted for by the professor.

Professor Hawkins is one the BEST professors that I have encountered. He is very passionate about what he teaches and is really straightforward and hilarious. His lectures were fascinating, and I always walked out of the lecture hall with new thoughts. His midterms and term paper were fairly easy. I highly recommend taking his class if you can!! (:

You cannot skip class unless you have a way to see the lectures because the exams are based completely on topics covered in lecture using only information said at lecture. The class was not too bad in terms of work, though, with a midterm, final, and a term paper only. Also, I hate history but this class was incredibly interesting and engaging.

One of the best UCR has to offer. Very passionate about the subject. 2 Midterms and a paper. Very clear course expectations. Lectures were very clear and coherent. It was honestly like hearing a story for 10 weeks straight. Eye opening course too. Barely went to lecture tbh and still earn an A-. 100% recommend prof. Lynda V for TA 100% to her too.

Honestly, the best prof. I've had at UCR. Makes lectures engaging and jokes around a lot. He makes lectures mandatory since most of the content comes from what he says. Open note midterm and final and one term paper based on readings. Easy A if you go to class everyday!

Professor Hawkins is a great professor and really makes classes enjoyable! Graded by a three things: (1) midterm and (2) final (free response ID terms and essay) and (3) essay based off the assigned books.

For the Midterm and final paper you can only use material from lectures. He doesnt post recording and slides are pretty minimal so youre mostly writing what hes saying. The term paper is based on 2-3 books and your grade is entirely based on how nice your TA is, since they grade everything.

If you had world history ap or world history, you don't have to even come to the lectures to pass. He doesn't post lecture material online so it is "mandatory", and I went most, but I just end up playing video games. If you don't have these past experiences, the lectures are pretty interesting, especially because of his comical teaching style.
Professor Hawkins is a great lecturer. If you have questions do not interrupt to ask during class, ask after. He always available. Show up, listen, study and you'll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hawkins is good, you get 1 midterm 1 final and one term paper
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: All test are essay format and your answers should come directly from his lecture videos (1.5 hr average, 2 per week). There is minimal homework, so do try your best on those essays/tests which are graded by TA's. Professor Hawkins is knowledgeable and makes it history a little less boring for those who are not particularly interested.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Inspirational--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Hawkins has been my favorite professor at UCR. Before taking his class, I hated history. His hilarious humor and interesting lectures makes you want to learn about history. He class is pretty easy as long as you listen to lecture but believe me when I tell you, his lectures are the best! TAKE HIM IF YOU GET THE CHANCE

Professor Hawkins is great. All of your content for tests are solely from his lecture videos. His lectures are pretty long and may be multiple a week but he tells you exactly what you will be writing for your exams which is helpful. Take notes on lectures for exams.

Loved, loved, loved this class. Read three books and 100 years of history and this professor made it all worth it; easy to understand and brought a sense of humor to class. Two exams based on lecture, final paper based on class books. Your TA can make or break your grade, so participate in section to know what your TA expects. Great class overall

2 tests and one term paper and weekly discussion, your TA makes or breaks your grade honestly. got low 70s on first test but got 95+ on last test and term paper so I ended with an A. recommend if u dont like history lol

Such an inspiration that I am even taking one of his upper-division classes over the summer and thinking about minoring in history! He is a great professor and covers a lot of interesting topics in a short amount of time. Easy midterms- just given 2 essay prompts and given 48 hours to complete. The Final was also an essay and we were given a week.

Professor Hawkin is an amazing lecturer! His lectures are recorded and posted so that they are accessible to students at any time. You are graded on 2 midterms (essay format) and 1 final (also essay format). Attendance to the discussion is mandatory but not a lecture. You are assigned 3 books (all online for free). I would def taking again!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: love this professor, very inspiring and motivating. You can tell he loves what he teaches and wants you to pass. I have taken him for multiple classes (both in person and online) he has also been very understanding and flexible with his online class grading through the pandemic, Thank you Hawkins!

His lectures are very interesting and interactive. You have to attend class to hear the concepts. He gives you the exact test as a study guide. You would literally have to try to fail. Two papers, a midterm and a final. Hes pretty straight forward.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: AWESOME professor! I hated history coming into this class, but HOLY COW I still remember the dates from what we covered. Super straightforward exams because the study guides  everything you need to know. 2 exams, 1 paper. Talks a little fast but will repeat self a few times. Go to lecture bc he gives you all the info he wants you to know-- no TB.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Im a psych major and this was by far my favorite class at UCR. I learned so much during this summer course. I think all students should take this class because it has so much to do with how we live today. He is an amazing lecturer. I was never bored in this class. I enjoyed the readings as well. I will definitely take another class with him!

This guy is awesome. Best professor and best lectures I've ever had at UCR. Makes the class so interesting and engaging, and he fits in a few hilarious jokes as well. One term paper, one bluebook midterm, and the final. No textbooks but 4 small cheap books (you only need one for the term paper). Not a history major but I'm taking him again just bc.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Honestly one of the greatest professors out there. His enthusiasm for the class sucks you into the lecture and that hour flies by. There are lecture notes but they are very vague notes. So it's best to go to class because he will emphasize whats important for his exams which are identification and essays, both very straightforward
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very enthusiastic and funny speaker which makes lectures interesting. There are readings for discussions that are very separate from lecture. The final is not cumulative and everything after the mid term is left behind. He also gives out study guides that give you EXACTLY what will be tested on, so literally just memorize what he provides.

He is probably my favorite lecturer on UCR campus. I am a history major but he KNOWS non history majors are in the class to fulfill a requirement. He tries to make it relatable and interesting so it doesn't feel like another course you have to take. Test information is from his lectures but he gives study guides (no surprises).

I hate this Professor! WORST EVER! He doesn't answer questions, doesn't shut his mouth and keeps on blabbering on forever repeating the same thing multiple times in multiple ways; SO FREAKING ANNOYING! Would not recommend this guy at all! And plus, his TA's do all the grading; you think they'd be lenient or at least fair!

Harry tom is a good lecture guy.  Big curve for us cuz he got warned by ucr due to high curve 2 yrs ago.  his test is hard but everyone in the class is a fool..cuz I am the top 9 of the class..I got A+

This guy throws a fat curve on the entire class. He gives a lot of points for homework, labs and quizzes. Final is really tough but if u did all the rest of the work, u can get a really low score on the final and still pass the class, even get a B or an A

His exams are very hard, assigns a lot of work, and doesn't care if students pass. Rushes through lectures and doesn't get too much into detail to help students understand. expects you do learn most of the material on your own. WORTHLESS!
Does not really care if his students pass. Rushes through material without much detail. He does give sufficient homework help during office hours, but that's pretty much it.
he's the worst professor ever!  he doesnt care if you have time to do the hw or not.  he doesnt give a crap about students.  exams are hard.

Easy exams with very high class averages. Practice Midterms look EXACTLY like actual midterms, and even a couple questions are the same. expects too much from students, don't take.

avoid!!!
unclear grading criteria / hard grader. would not recommend.

Professor Heraty is a good lecturer but expects WAY TOO MUCH from his students. Do not take this class unless you are genuinely interested in systematics. The subject is oh so boring so it didnt make learning any easier. There are 2 midterms + a final, Discussion wkshts due every week, and 3 assignments worth a great deal of points where for one of them you must do a presentation in front of your class. Its an assignment/work heavy class, 3 huge time-consuming assignments+2 MTs and 1 final. Heratycaring/kind but actual class? its a no
dont

Prof Heraty is an amazing lecturer! He really makes class interesting, and provides you with a (free!) outline of notes for his half of the class on day 1 (basically your textbook). Although, he covers a LOT of material. You'll have to memorize definitions to do well, and definitely practice the discussion hw assignments for the tests.

reviews.comment: Honestly Heraty is a fun professor.  I got an A- in the class and the whole time I was at a B standing, so he had to have curved the class. I didn't think the class was hard, there was a lot of material and Heraty really stress definitions and comparing and contrasting on his exams. If you study you will be FINE. Plus he is really helpful!!

His class was very difficult.  We had very tricky exams, and with every exam, the question were harder.  There is no curve for the class and with the very difficult material, many students received poor grades.

Do not take her at all !!! Her tests are nothing like the practice exams or like the homeworks. It is so hard to study for the exams because she tests things that weren't covered on the slides. Our midterm averages have been so bad and she has made many mistakes on her gradings. Avoid her at all costs. Not a good teacher at all.

I have been sitting here trying to reverse engineer where I am losing points on the homework after 24 attempts btw since she refuses to show which ones you are getting wrong. Although she is very passionate and knowledgeable about the subject, she is a bad instructor. She makes (what would be simple financial topics) more complicated than it should be. Her tests and HW questions can be confusing and uncessarily difficult. Would not recommend taking this class. Would be much easier to just self-learn these topics.

reviews.comment: She's great at explaining the concepts and relating them to modern news. It was very useful when she demonstrates how she analyzes investments through different online website tools. She's nice and very understanding. Her test was somewhat similar to her practice exams. Recommend looking back and understanding homework!
