reviews.comment: Bad professor that not teaching you class at all. Put all of materials online and told you to study by urself. Not curved even 1%.
She really knows her stuff and makes classes interactive. Be prepared to spend lots of time doing writing assignments and make sure to read articles before class for participation grade.
Lots of assignments but doable! Material isn't confusing at all. Put in effort and you'll pass! I def recommend! Very kind too!

She is almost always available for questions and responds to emails promptly. She is not a difficult professor and likes to interact during lecture so we understand concepts in fun ways. I would warn, do not underestimate the final project because it takes longer than it seems. Its not hard just lots of information

Super nice and caring professor! Very easy class. Attendance is mandatory, but can make it up by submitting notes. Lectures are easy to follow and materials are super accessible. No homework, only exit tickets which are open notes/lectures and two projects. She is very easy to access through office hours. Would take the class again!

Professor Hendley's lectures are very engaging, whether you are a psych major or not! She gives a reasonable amount of work throughout the quarter and gives clear rubrics for the 2 projects. While attendance isn't mandatory, it is part of your grade, but there are make-up assignments available to get the points back. 10/10 professor!

Nicest, kindest, sweetest, and most engaging professor ever. It's actually a really interesting class. I had this class at 9:30 AM, and this was the one class I wasn't falling asleep in. Even though you don't have to, I still suggest you go to lectures, makes the work easier for sure. Going to miss this professor... my goat.

very understanding and straightforward professor. easily accessible outside of class and responds to emails quickly. a lot of little assignments but very do-able. no exams at all, and the two required projects are super easy and you're given ample time to complete them

She's really nice and emphasizes the use of her office hours. There's usually no homework, only upcoming projects and exit tickets. There are no tests. You do a lot of activites in this course which makes it fun.

She has a great speaking voice and presents the slides nicely. Nearly all of the assignments were graded by the TA (I had Zachary Kelly) and he was just as great. PSYC001 is an easy class as long as you try.

Easy to understand lectures. You'll do well if you attend lecture and review the slides. I liked how she recorded every lecture since so you can review before you take the weekly quizzes, great way to make up attendance too. The projects were a little difficult without good examples that met grading expectations. She makes it easy to do well.
The professor was very nice and understanding. There is no final, and the class is mostly graded on projects. Content is interesting too
Very understanding and caring professor. Many projects but no quizzes or tests.

As a Transfer student who technically already took Intro Psych (which only counted for PSYC002 and not 001), this was super easy. However, it is easy regardless of whether you know the subject material. There were no tests, only short papers. Lectures use PollEv, but you can watch lectures at home and turn in notes for credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Hendley for PSYC 1 - Intro to Psychology. Her Lectures are very easy to understand and very good. The prep-work can be annoying, but it was overall really helpful. The weekly quizzes were really easy, and she explained the concepts very well. One thing is that the class is basically project-heavy. The Midterm and Final are both projects.

Professor Hendley was really great and  understanding u can skip her lectures since she records them but you do have to do hand written notes for credit but she also doesn't do finals or midterms she js does exit tickets at the end of the week but overall she's really good and I really recommend her if you are taking psych 1 !

Super nice and understanding professor, so far my favorite class of the year. She goes slow in lectures and keeps everyone engaged throughout with questions and polls. Her office hours are easily accessible and shes super easy to talk to. Overall a really great person who is passionate in her work.

Really sweet professors and lectures were really interesting. Weekly HW and quizzes that can easily be found in lecture slides, and just one 20 minute video presentation instead of final exams. One of the easiest and low effort classes I've taken.

She was amazing! Free A for an elective upper div class for Psych majors. Participation is taken in lecture but if you don't want to attend, she records the lectures and just has us submit 2 pages of handwritten notes to make up for the poll questions. No exams, just a really simple 5-7 presentation that you write on a topic in the class.
She is very nice and doesn't give out lots of work. No final or midterms!! Weekly quizzes are given, but they are fairly easy if you do the prep work.

Amazing professor!!!! She uses different ways of assessing our knowledge through projects, tests, and papers. Her lectures are interesting and the work for the class is very little but does require thoughtful work when needed. She is so kind and listens to her class!
Dr. Hendley is super nice and patient. Attendance is required through pollev. Only one online canvas final and weekly homework quizzes.

Truly recommend taking this class if it is your first PSYC course. The professor herself is nice, caring, and understanding. Attendance is mandatory in lectures (PollEv) and discussion groups. No midterm exam! Only an online "take home" final. Very small writing projects every 2-3 weeks, small weekly quizzes based on readings, and 3 SONA credits.

Absolutely recommend! No midterm and take home final exam. Online, at-home quizzes that are due at 11:59 every Monday that make up the majority of your grade. Easy and fun class with great professor and TA!
Clear speaking voice, didn't give us a midterm, and our final was an online take-home. Loved having her!

Hendley honestly isn't the best at lecturing or explaining things - it was pretty obvious that during lecture she was reading off of her lecture notes, and pretty much all the content in lecture was all from the required textbook readings in the week beforehand. Other than that, she's super kind and cares for any situation you're in if you just ask
One of the best professors I have had at UCR.

Offered makeup points; some points won't match work required though. Could skip lecture polls by watching lecture vids & submitting 2 pg bullet points of what you learned. When canceling office hour appointments, personally reached out to accommodate your schedule. Weekly quizzes based on articles/youtube. Exams based on lecture (1 open note).

Dr. Hendley was one of the nicest professors I've had in UCR!!! I would take all of her classes if I could, but I found this gem too late. Wonderful and fun lectures. The only down side to the lectures is that they start at 8 in the morning. But still wonderful professor!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: LOVE HER! She is a literal angel, she cares about your future and success . Final is all online avaliable all day as well as the quizzes. No midterm! Her slides are very informative and gives us resources. Very helpful during office hours. Minghui is the best TA. Gave us many practices during disc. Disc post are due every week. Take her!!!

Amazing professor with very informative lectures. My only qualm is that she can be difficult to reach outside of class. Otherwise, she and her TAs (especially Brandon Nolasco) are really great to work with. I 100% recommend her if you get the opportunity!

Easiest class I ever took. Never went to lecture. Has good slides to look back on. The discussion post were easy. There is reading for the discussion post but it's a very easy A in this class. There is quizzes every two weeks and extra credit. The discussion was easy just talked about what we were learning about and kahoot.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER & EASIEST CLASS EVER. Take her. Her lecture isn't mandatory but her discussion is. You have to show up to 8/10 which is pretty easy. The class is based on 5 quizzes and 1 final. All online. TAKE. HER. IF. YOU. CAN!!!!
Extremely nice and caring professor. class consists of weekly discussion posts and biweekly quizzes and one final. Attendance is also taken at discussion. Very easy and informational class.

She read off the slides, and there were weekly quizzes that could be found online for the lectures. No midterm and the final was online. Discussion was mandatory and there was more work to do for the discussion than the actual class.

Really nice professor. It is a shame people spoke over her and made noise when she ends her lectures despite her letting us leave 30 minutes early. Online quizzes/tests but discussion attendance is mandatory. You need to know both the textbook and the slides as the test/quizzes contained info from both.

quizzes every other week and a cumulative final but they are taken online. Take notes before coming to class because she goes pretty fast. Attendance isn't mandatory in lectures but is in discussions. Weekly discussion posts but super easy! also does polls during lecture but they do NOT count towards attendance they're optional. Readings posted!
One of the easiest class. Prof super nice. All quizzes and exams are online. Weekly discussion post. Never went to lectures only discussion since you get graded on your attendance.

reviews.comment: most everything we did in this class was online, all quizzes and final included. need to do a quiz and a small homework/discussion post every week, she was super nice and wanted us all to know about important resources on campus

The class has weekly discussion posts that are pretty straight forward. There are no midterms, but there are weekly quizzes that are open note and textbook that are taken online. The final is similar to the material taught in class and is taken online and is also open note open textbook.

AMAZING professor! Exams are curved very generously and are straightforward. Lectures are alright, I think reading the textbook is more useful. If you are interested in biology, this course is a must take.

SUPER easy. lots and lots of extra credit. attendance "required" via pollev, but in discord gc we just posted the polls so you didn't have to go to class. She is nice and orients the class around the tests, which are again easy and all multiple choice. Scantrons required for tests. Inquizitive every week for homework (not bad but don't forget).

I have no complaints about Prof. Hickey. She was funny, charming, and super eager to answer questions. You have two midterms, a final, small online homeworks, and discussion credit for your grade. Definitely take this class to knock out your ANTH credit EASILY. You do have to pay to do homework though, about 50 bucks.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She gave really good assessments and curved a lot which was much appreciated. There was a lot of assignments, but still doable. Overall very nice and helpful :)

I personally really liked this professor! Super nice and she tries to make her lectures entertaining. How much effort you put into studying for the midterm and final pretty much reflects ur grade for the class

Ms. Maureen is one of my favorite professors that I've had so far! Her lectures are super informative and truly replicate what will be seen on the midterms. She does post extremely helpful study guides and makes sure that you guys really understand the information. She makes the lectures really entertaining and has a good sense of humor!

Ms. Hickey is an amazing professor! While her lectures can be a bit in depth, they really do help simplify what's in the textbook. She very kind, funny, and approachable, and won't hide any information for midterms and finals. Her study guides are very useful and are mostly the same as her exams. She is an amazing professor! She makes everything very clear, is passionate about what she teaches, is hilarious, and makes lectures very enjoyable! The course content itself is very easy, and so are the two midterms and final exam.

The class was super easy and her lectures make it really easy to understand the concept. As long as you study the concepts on the study guide you will be fine.

reviews.comment: Attendance isn't taken but she posts "poll everywhere" questions almost every class which are for credit. There are 2 midterms (these were curved) and a final + InQuizitive hw. I'd suggest finding the textbook online to save you some money since you do have to pay for InQuizitive. Prof is a bit "quirky" but that's how she tries to keep us engaged!

She does polls occasionally for lecture participation points but ngl you don't really need to go to class to get a 100% on the midterms. she's lowkey chill and pretty lenient with late work if u email her. Honestly just study the textbook + her guides, do the inquisitive, and you'll get a good grade, i liked her as a prof.
This professor is a quirkball but interesting to watch in lecture.
She's a little quirky but great
Very good professor. Attend the lectures and pay attention and you will do well.
I never attended class and I got 110% on a midterm and a 100% on the final. Work together with your comrades on the study guides since they are exact copies of the exams.

Admittedly she's not as organized as most experienced professors but she's very lenient and willing to admit when she messes up. She tries to keep the class organized with enthusiasm and jokes but most will fly over your head. She's very easy to talk to and open so very chirpy. Honestly, her attitude was very contagious.

Unorganized in her lectures. Tests made no sense nor did her study guides. Grades unfairly study the wrong stuff get an A study the correct material get a C. Overall, really easy just read the book.

reviews.comment: He was incredible at teaching. He explained complex topics very clearly. There was 1 midterm and final, where he pulled questions from the homework assignments. HW was also light since he will take the 4 highest scores of your homework. Overall, he was a fantastic professor.
All I will say: He's my GOAT.

Professor has a very clear/methodical lecture style and he explains concepts well. He follows the textbook structure and hand-writes notes on the white board during class. All the lectures were recorded and attendance wasn't mandatory either. Midterms and final are identical to the homework and practice problems covered in discussion! Easy A

You only need to submit 4/7 HW's
The exams: one midterm and final are literally the same as the Homework. All you have to do is study the HW. He has a great personality and very nice!

I would recommend taking this Professor, super nice and his lectures are actually helpful. He posts examples on how to do the hw. Drops the lowest graded hw assignments and exams are exactly like the hws.

Nice professor. I liked his teaching style. He makes the material easy to digest by explaining everything thoroughly. For this reason, I didn't go to the textbook to relearn concepts; the lectures sufficed. He was always available for student questions and was a friendly person. His grading system was very fair and gave leeway for missing work.

Great lecturer and wonderful professor. Grade is based on 45% Take Home Open Note Final, 55% Homework (total of 8 hw assigned, drops the lowest 3). Posts all lecture videos, slides, and notes. Couldn't ask for a nicer prof, his exam was exactly like the homework he assigns. TAKE HIS CLASS !!!

Only take this if u like marine bio. The class has a lot of memorizing fish species and anatomy. Labs include dissections and weekly quizzes. There's 1 midterm, 1 final, and a final iNaturalist project. The professor is nice, but the course isn't the fun upper div i hoped itd be.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: might be one of my fav professors at UCR. super engaging in class, office hours are fun, super accessible and easy to talk to. i thought the class was going to be difficult bc of the course name, but he made the topic super interesting with real life examples and in class demonstrations to help us understand the material better
Great professor. Lectures are interesting and he makes content easy to understand. So far my favorite class/professor at UCR.  Tests are pretty easy as long as you go to class.

Professor Higham is a very smart person however he does not value his students at all. He doesn't give much effort in his lectures; he usually lets the class leave before the lecture is done. He bases his grades off of one midterm and one final. He is one of those professors who is only focused on his own research. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance was not mandatory but not everything he talked about was not on the slides so going to lecture was important. Midterm was difficult but he gives you a study guide that helps a lot. He was a great lecturer and was very helpful whenever I had any questions.

This class was a lot more difficult than it needed to be. Would not recommend to anyone. You need to go to lecture because the slides barely have anything on them and not recorded. Syllabus and class organization was messy and all over the place. Very harsh grader, frq and mc exams. Very confusing on what you need to study.

It was Dr. Higham's 1st time teaching the exercise bio class so that may explain why it was poorly instructed. My biggest issue was I did not know my grade until he graded the final, his midterm exam average was a D, his quizzes and exam questions came from small info hidden on the slides, and he curved to the highest grade instead of bell curve
Class was okay, midterm was hard, Final was easy. Promised Curve but there was no curve. Interesting class.

He is clear about what information is fair game for exams. Exam answers should match exactly what was said in lectures. Not everything is on the slides so you MUST pay attention to what he say/adds during lecture. Office hours helped a lot and is very understanding.

This class was so much fun! Lectures were very interesting and he gave us breaks during them and even ended early most times which is good if you're like me and can't sit for too long. He's a great lecturer and a really awesome guy. We had some really fun field trips too! Tests were fair if you study rlly hard. Barely any assignments. Lab was great

Had him for biomech in the summer. By far one of the most pleasant experiences as far as STEM courses go. I really enjoyed the material and thought he presented it in a way that wasn't overwhelming. Classes were half live/ half asynchronous and they were online (because of the pandemic-- this might not always be the case). Definitely recommend.

The class is interesting and he is nice. Field trips would be cool if COVID didn't cancel them. MT/Final + the 10pg paper made up most of the grades. You have to put effort into this class. I found it similar to molecular bio in difficulty. The paper was a lil spooky, but we had many weeks to write it. If I tried harder I would've gotten the A.

Seems like a nice guy idk how to feel about this class... we got our grades week 10 & are still missing 6 lab grades. Additionally, we still have a 10 page paper & final test. Didnt do anything to change the course to accommodate during this unexpected time. Claim to remove a 5% field portion but we couldnt have had that anyways bc covid.

Confused at the positive ratings. Was excited to take this class but he has no compassion for students. Didnt get midterm grades until week 10. Doesnt change anything in the class even though other classes are having finals canceled. We have a 10 page paper & a final due still. Doesnt seem interested in teaching the class online.

Dr. Higham is the best professor I've ever had at UCR. He is super kind, understanding and funny. His tests are very fair and he is really easy to talk to if you have any questions. You can tell he wants his students to succeed. Take his class if you get the chance!

Professor Higham is one of the best professors for Bio5B. This class itself is a weed-out class and hard class in its reputation, but Dr. Higham tries to make it clear-cut and he's definitely way easier than Dr. Chappell. He's passionate and willing to help his students understand the lesson. Great guy and I would take a class by him again.

I took him for Bio 5b. He is a great professor. I honestly studied everything he told us to study. He emphasized on the readings so I read the whole list but failed the test. The key to success is put all your attention on the powerpoints and not the reading. Honestly, reading DID NOT HELP, and it was also not on the test.

Professor Higham was truly a miraculous professor. He is so interested in human physiology and makes the class funny and a joy to be in. I did average on his midterm because the information in 5B is A LOT but overall, I enjoyed his portion of the class more than any other science professor. Take him if you can!

The average for the midterm was 61% but I made silly mistakes and got 80%. The tests are only hard if you don't study the lectures. He tested us on some small details he goes on but didn't say it was gonna be on the test BUT when he starts describing it in detail thats how you know its gonna be on the test.
cool guy!

To get an A in his class, you literally need to get an A because the students in Anatomy 161B are all battle hardened from 161A. Hence, I suggest you take this class seriously. Otherwise, you will get the grade you deserve and not the one you want.
Interesting Professor, the class was difficult in itself but he did everything possible to make sure that we understood the material to our best ability. Over all an awesome Bio professor to have.
Dr. Tim Higham is the best professor I have ever had in my university career.
Great professor

This class was so worth. You will need to study a ton to score well. Densest lectures I have ever witnessed, I spent hours looking at slides it took him minutes to present. Low barrier to get help from him, you can ask to clarify topics or ask specific questions. Either way, I would not have set the curve on our 3 exams without asking for help.

He's an excellent instructor. All his material is straightforward. Same goes for his exams. Make sure to go to office hours if you have any questions. He's always willing to help explain as long as you come prepared with questions.

Dr Hille is the most Stellar professor in the Department of Biochemistry. He doesn't read off the slides and his lecture material is very smartly designed. I have learnt a lot of research techniques from his lectures. His tests are usually easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Excellent professor.  He is extremely knowledgeable on everything taught in class. He is also a fair grader and has a more than fair curve. Small class with smart students (pretty much seniors and grad students only). Would definitely take again or at grad school level if he taught it.  Makes me interested in working with enzymes in my lab.

Professor Hille is one of the most knowledgeable people I have ever met. His Enzymology is no joke and lots of graduate students take it. Be prepared to dedicate hours in order to fully understand everything if you want to get an A. Overall though he is probably my favorite professor at the school, I highly recommend his class, you will feel smart.
class was decently easy, i never went to lecture and still did well. exams are straight from the slides and the final had many questions from the midterm.

He was really sweet! His TA Sarah was the problem- acting like she was the professor. She was grading us so hard that the averages in class was an F-. It was obviously her! Dr. Hickmott's TA Ivett was sweet! Dr. H was available and always responded to emailssss! He is a great guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class is hard! it was a huge pain. We are being graded harshly for something we do not know how to do. Half the class is failing. He is purposely making the class harder than it needs to be. He also doesn't really even want to help...

Professor Hickmott is so nice and really funny! Lecture isnt mandatory but if you want to pass you must go. The material is not something you can cram overnight. you NEED to study ALOT. He doesn't try to trick students on exams, but you MUST know the processes of the material and terms. He curves very generously depending how the class does.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: the concepts can be hard so you really have to study in order to understand and pass the exams. however, they're all open note so as long as you have a basic understanding and attend all classes then you should be able to pass no problem. hes a good professor, tries his best to simplify hard/confusing concepts which was really helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor is an excellent, excellent lecturer. If you enjoy auditory learning, he is the professor for you. However, the power points are heavily lacking at most points, to the point where you can't tell what's going on. The class consisted of 3 tests, so get ready to study HARD.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hickmott was one of the few enjoyable professors I've had. Grades only come from two midterms and a final but the questions are straightforward from his posted slides. He doesn't require the textbook but I used it to help get the concepts down. Would still recommend sitting in/recording lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is no easy A but the subject is fascinating! You can tell he is very passionate about the subject matter and he is capable of breaking down very intricate concepts and theories into a comprehensible way. If you made it this far in your degree, no upper-div course is going to be easy, so expect to do the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor. If you don't understand jargon (key concepts), make time to learn it. This is not a class where you can chill for the first 2 weeks, and learn the material within two days prior to the exam. The first 4 lectures are fundamental to the whole course, do not skip those.

Hickmott is honestly a fair grader. Tests are tough, but he gives generous curves on exams. 2 midterms, 1 semi cumulative final. He recycled previous exam questions on the final so go to TA office hours after a midterm to see what you got wrong. Go to & record lectures to relisten later. Take notes. Doing this gave me an easy A! Great class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Charming and entertaining he may be, this man needs to understand that undergraduates are not as advanced in neuroscience as he is. He uses incredibly advanced jargon and terminology. His lecture slides are incredibly easy, but when he's lecturing alongside them, he needlessly complicates things. Rely on your TA; they'll probably teach you better
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: 120L is just a hard class. But, Dr. Hickmott made this class really interesting and fun. It did get frustrating sometimes, but it's doable, just don't procrastinate on your reports. He's super helpful & friendly. You learn A LOT and apply your knowledge. You get to do dissections! Wouldn't take this class with anyone else tbh. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Note: 5/5 busy work. On the last day I walked up to him and said "I absolutely hate your class, but I learned a ton." He said "good, that's how it should be." An absolutely legendary professor that will talk with you about anything, and will challenge your knowledge on the topics - but isn't beneath helping you understand even the simplest things.

i recommend going to discussion bc the TAs summarize in layman's terms his lectures. Still show up to lecture though bc he tries to clear up any confusion (IF YOU ASK QUESTIONS). This a science class so prepare yourself, Psych Majors. Very different from what you're used to. 2 midterms, 1 final, (Added points to all  exams!) survived wo textbook.

Professor Hickmott is a GREAT LECTURER. But that doesn't mean the class is easy. The trick to passing with a B or higher is going to class and literally listening what he says word for word. Whatever he says is relevant and going to be on the tests. Don't read out of the book or look, Just listen to his lectures and ask the T.A's and him.

An awesome professor overall. Very quirky and humorous, and will go the extra mile to answer questions. Attendance is not mandatory, but you will have difficulty studying for exams if you miss class (there are no study guides). I recommend recording the lectures. Textbook is not necessary.

Overall an awesome professor; quirky, humorous, and genuinely cares about the material. The class shouldn't be a problem as long as you attend all classes (almost no textbook use). There are no study guides so studying for the exams would be extremely difficult without quality lecture notes - recording the lectures is probably your best bet.

Great professor! He's a really quirky and likable.everyone says this is the hardest psyc course but I did really well to my surprise. lecture is mandatory if you want to do good and bring a laptop cause he talked too fast for me to write. Don't bother with the book its all in lecture. adds points to exams depending how everyone did.

Hickmott teaches very well. I loved taking this course. It was not as hard as the TAs said it was. However, the exam questions were hard. You have to understand the material entirely to answer those questions because the options are more hypothetical then anything. The final was easy. I also recommend listening to your recordings for exams.

Hickmott is an amazing professor! I loved this class and learned a lot! you have to stay on top of your material to do well on the midterm and final. I studied about 4 days in advance and did well above avg. Discussion has a presentation, easy points just tedious work each week. Highly recommended! One of my favorite classes at UCR thus far!
Probably the hardest psy class anyone will take. Tests are so tricky and his slides are unclear. Office hours are helpful, but not helpful enough. Definitely avoid if you like your GPA

Professor Hickmott was a good teacher. Come to class and I highly advise students to go to discussion. Lovelace was an amazing T.A., who clarified course material. Tests are reasonable. Study his lecture notes and you will do well. Also, gives extra points on tests, so students do better. Overall, I enjoyed this class :)

FOCUS on lecture slides only!! You do not need the book. He does not curve but only add a couple points, depending on how many students missed the questions. VERY HARD. Study and make sure you know it and can teach it to someone else! GO TO OFFICE HOURS. side note: he's funny in lecture
He is very helpful in office hours, just study the lecture slides  and outlines no need to buy the book since the test is more lecture based. overall great professor.

Ok, this is the chair...what do you expect. But he is extremely intelligent and likes helping. You just have to get past your fear of him. He's actually a really great professor and I'm sad I won't be taking anymore of his classes. (Gotta lov his shirts!!!)

I took a few classes with Hickmont. The problem with Hickmont is that his lectures are meant to be heard and not listened to. His tests rely heavily on the exact language from the textbook. Overall he's very interesting to just listen to, he is detailed in how he explains things and he will engage you if you ask questions in class.

Dr. Hickmott is a very knowledgeable man.  His lectures can get a little confusing.  There is a lot of memorization and class/discussion attendance is very important.  Study the material as the course goes and you will do fine.  Not a neuroscience major so I had a little difficulty, but the class is definately passable.
easy course just understand the outline concepts.  multiple choice, no need to buy the book. make sure you understand the outlines and can answer them by yourself and you are sure to get an A.

wow pls dont tell me psych students are this dumb. as a CE major this was like the easiest class ever. simple memorization and its freaken multiple choice tests come on guys! no homework, projects, or papers.  dont buy the book, just study the outlines.

This class is basically neuroscience and as such, there is A LOT of memorization, and it can get confusing because it, of course, is very science-based...but here is the key to doing well in this class: STUDY EARLY! i cannot emphasize that enough!
OH MAN this was a TOUGH class. But neuroscience isn't really my thing. Extremely knowledgeable individual and highly respected in his field. Seemed like a cool guy overall.

There is a lot of memorization for this class and a lot of jaggin to remember. If you go to leacture you will do fine. GO TO LECTURE very important! The tests are based on lecture NOT THE TEXT, you really don't use it.
no way around it try your best and you will get a good grade...

Class was extremely boring and so it was hard to stay awake and pay attention. The book was extremely helpful, to be honest it is more clear than the professor because he goes through the slides really fast. This class is doable, you don't have to read the book but it helps a lot. I got an A.
Prof. Hitmock is great in his lectures!!! However, his exams are not easy. The final is cumulative! 60 MC. There are few points extra credit added toward each exams.

cool teacher.  dry humor.  book is recommended if you are a slow learner and is also very helpful when he skips through his slides.  GO TO DISCUSSION for it was that class that helped me pass.  study early and you will do fine!

Gives very detailed notes, class and material is extremely boring but he teaches the stuff well.  Show up to section and pay attention to his notes.  Book is totally supplemental, he covers more than in the book and only some of the material is in the book.
One of the best professors I have had. The material is dry but he knows how to liven class up. Attend class to find out what the core material is and then go to discussion for a better understanding.

A++! Dr. Hickmott is interesting & VERY thorough. His study guides can be copied into MS Word & used as a study guide (SG) by adding notes, PowerPoints are detailed, use book as optional reference. Note: his voice is soft & the material is dry, it is possible to drift off. Study the material emphasized, attend EVERY lecture & discussion, make a SG!

He's not that bad, I find him to be alittle out there, eclectic perhaps..but he's kinda funny. I didn't think I'd  do that well in his class but I came out with a B, so I was surprised. Study the handouts and don't skip discussion.

Pretty cool guy, the class sucks in general though cause it's more biological. Don't bother buying the $120 textbook because I didn't use it once and still got an A. I'm still waiting for a personal refund from Hickmott considering he told us we needed it.

Good guy; great class in the sense that he GIVES YOU ALL THE NOTES you will ever need;all you need to do is read them/understand what's going on.He will confuse you a little when you ask for help,so be prepared!But for a class of this difficulty/dryness, he makes it kinda easy, especially the tests.I got way higher than i expected on the midterms!
not bad.

He's been pretty well organized for this class. He always passes out the notes for us at the beginning of class so we can just follow along (you don't need the book at all!) Even though he occasionally skips around in the notes, he's still understandable enough to get by. I think he's doing well.

Loved the class very interesting, however he is very confusing and doensnt tangent at all. He is scattered brain and has a hella hard midterm i wanted my mommy when i left that test. Final is really written by ramsey(TA) and he rocks. Read the notes and must write detailed notes. Only read book for
HARD AND IS A HORRILBE LECTURER!  BUT U CANT GET AROUND THIS CLASS CUZ WE ALL NEED IT AND HE IS THE ONLY ONE THAT TEACHES IT!
This teacher is crazy! His lectures are very confusing and he doesn't take the time to really go over things.
Hickmott talks to fast, makes his exams confusing with purposely confusing answer choices and I really disliked his teaching style. Now, on the other hand, the TA (R.S.) was great.
He is so boring and his lectures are hard to understand.

needs to go into detail more. he starts talking about something interesting, then says its not within the realms of the course. treats us like we're stupid. bio was a req for the course, he should teach w/that in mind. love his tshirts. is really funny.
No Comments

He taught developmental neuroscience, because the normal professor was on sick leave.  His lectures were good, and he barked at students who kept opening the door to get into the next class, while he was still lecturing.  His final was reasonable.
hes a good teacher, if you have problems with biology then you will have to work hard in his class, its upper division...what do you expect...CS8?

at first, you get so overwhelmed by all the info, but the tests aren't as bad as you think. the final is cumulative though, so it was harder than the midterms, in my opinion. he kind of rambles too much...kind of funny guy though.
Don't stress all the details....only tell us what we need to know!!!!!!

Very strict professor. Left for half the term and didn't teach at all (aside from the textbook and videos). Not allowed to have laptops in the lecture. Does not answer questions well, not even worth it to ask a question. Do not take this class, especially this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very good and easy class. Graded by a few things which can hurt your grade if you get many points knocked off. So do well on them. There are instructions on each assignment. FOLLOW THEM EXACTLY to do well. Overall funny professor but she is okay.

Honestly, she is okay. Not the best, not the worst. Graded by a few things which you must do good on otherwise your grade will suffer. One midterm, one final. Pretty straight forward and easy. Wouldn't recommend her unless she's the only professor available. Pretty funny though.
Very strict, dosen't allow laptops and gives you no credit for late work. Your grade relies on the one midterm and one final. Not great at answering questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Waltz is Amazing! ive had her 2 times, going onto my third next quarter. The material may get difficult but she is the sweetets, willing to explain and wants you to learn! yes you have to pay attention and study, but overall she is an amazing professor who cares about her students.

Her lectures are very tedious as its very boring and she talks slow. The good thing is she provides a chapter concept ws every week which is super helpful. If you have the book u can teach yourself. She grades hw on accuracy so beware. The concept of the class is easy if u apply yourself  but she teaches very confusing. Seems rude most times.
Maybe I'm not a linguistics fan, but the class content was so lame, and I don't think I learned a single useful skill from it. The professor is sweet, though, but hard to understand at times.
Quite boring, but if you pay attention and study a little bit, you'll be fine. She requires a textbook that I never used.

There's no lecture attendance but you must go. The textbook is handy, but you will be fine just using the library copy. Fill out her guided worksheets. 20% grade is discussion attendance and easy homework. Prof answers questions pretty well if you ask them clearly. With a few flashcards, you will be fine. This class is totally beginner level. Fun.

She's a good prof! in my opinion you don't need to read the textbook b/c of the guided learning sheets and if you pay attention in lecture. 
My few main points though:
- Midterm was def harder than final 
- The content is intuitive (you already know this subconsciously)
- If you read the book you can skip lecture
- ASK FOR HELP!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures can be hit-or-miss, but readings and discussions are very helpful. Expect a heavy emphasis on exams, so staying organized and utilizing study tools like unstuck AI are key to success.

She was such a sweetie. Idk why people are hating on her sm because the class was easy if you just paid attention. I only read a couple pages of the textbook (it was legit not important at all). I mainly just took notes during the lectures and it was more than enough the pass the exams!
Overall, when it comes to lectures, she only puts in the main points of the textbook

Lectures give great examples of the material, but are expected to self-read outside of class as she briefly goes through the material for each lesson. Attend lectures and keep up with readings. Mandatory discussions that extremely helpful and the tests are weighed heavily. Make sure to understand the keywords from the lectures and textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, however is very strict, there isn't really a lot of homework nor extra credit so you really have to rely on the midterm and final exam for a good grade, meaning you have to get an A on both in order to get an A in the class, if that is what you are aiming for. Doesn't allow laptops during lectures. Don't ask questions in lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class was very very interesting. Go to lectures, read the book, and participate in lectures if you can (are brave enough.) in my opinion, she is a good professor the subject is just a bit difficult, but I enjoyed the class. Just try to be as active in the class as possible. Prof. Walt says, "You learn best by DOING."
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She sometimes gives unclear explanations and doesn't explain concepts well. Had to self-teach sometimes. Once I understood the material though, the class was a bit easier, but there's a lot to go over, so by no means was this an easy A. Make sure to pay as much attention in class as you can and study with other people so you can help each other.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She was very dedicated and was very passionate about the subject. Lectures are not mandatory if you read the book, if you don't read the book attend the lectures. I didn't read a single page of the book and passed the course. The HW is very light and easy, but I highly suggest attending discussions because those are points towards your grade.

Easy but make sure you are organized, please read the syllabus and the textbook, get help from classmates and TA. Not much hw but thats because there was alot to read. lol. 1 mid term, 1 final and half of it were things that you may think you dont need to study, but actually needed too (well for me atleast) she's silly though and caring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures are long and boring. Lots of tangents. Discussions suck, they're boring. She has somewhat of an accent that kinda inconveniences the whole course, considering a huge part of the midterm is about sounds that letters make and how words are pronounced. Her syllabus is clear, read it.

One of the hardest classes, besides her phonetics class. Make sure to attend and learn the material on your own alongside what she teaches.  Though, due to her being so strict and sarcastic it forces you to try besides the pressure on your own grade. Test heavy class, but don't skip any attendance or homework if possible. Every point matter

She is not the best at explaining things and gets confused by questions a lot, has an attitude a lot of the time, and makes snarky comments. I will say that I've somehow managed to learn the most about linguistics in her classes, though, out of fear of failing. *shrug* So just study up the wazoo and don't forget that she has no problem failing you.

Hardest class I've ever had to take! Based on keylets, homeworks, and midterm + final! Towards the end, the whole class was struggling to even pass. I would recommend studying a lot, going to her office hours, and if you don't remember much of phonetics, it's tough!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: attendance only mandatory for discussions. approximately one homework assignment a week. the tests were based on the homework and guidelines were clear. the content could be a lot to remember, but discussion section is used to go over practice problems.

It's very important to attend lectures to understand the homework and the following lectures. She always encouraged going to her office hours if you needed extra help. We had 6 homework assignments, the midterm, and the final. Everything is pretty easy as long as you pay attention and go to lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Her lectures are VERY boring and she's honestly a rude professor. She got mad at a student for asking a question and made it seem like it was an obvious answer. Make sure to attend class though cause it's useful and will help towards the midterm + final.

Great professor, she's accessible outside of class. Her lectures are very important to attend. If you don't attend then you'll read a lot to pass. Easy grader. Barely gives out homework and the work is very minimal. Easy to pass if you attend her lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is incredibly rude, to start, and WILL make you feel stupid for asking questions. There were 7 HW assignments + lab attendance, + midterm + final + a couple extra credit assignments (make sure you do those!). Her grading criteria is not clear at all for exams and a lot of people failed/did poorly. She wants to see key words but won't say which.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly, don't believe too many of the bad reviews. This class is a great breadth course and isn't too difficult. If you just follow along with her lectures and take notes (especially on what she clearly states is important) then you'll be fine. If you are struggling, you can just go to her office hours and she is more than willing to help.

Do not take this class if you want an easy A. Professor's lectures were not helpful because she would go on tangents but she is really nice. One midterm, one final, both online and homework is graded on participation. GO TO CLASS!!!! You'll fail if you don't. Rely on the book and read it thoroughly and prepare to teach yourself.

Textbook is needed for HW (found it online so you do not need to purchase it at all). Attendance isn't required for lectures BUT needed for a good understanding of the readings and HW. She is nice and answers questions you may have. Midterm AND final exam are online. Does not allow laptops during class for notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very hard class. Confusing for many of my peers and myself. TA was a strict grader. She took points off for the most simplest things. She made it mandatory to turn camera  on during zoom. She made students present on the board in person and embarrassed you if you got it wrong. Would not recommend taking this class. Hard class!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was very difficult. You cannot expect to pass without going to lecture. Lectures are not mandatory but Discussions are. I recommend not missing either because lectures help you understand discussions. Waltz will help you if needed. She answers emails quick and will try to adapt to your schedule if you want to meet with her in person.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Graded by 10% discussion attendance,15% midterm, 35% hw (5 assignments each worth 7 points) and 40% final. Lecture is in person but midterm and final were online with open notes and everything. The professor is strict about her rules and stuff but otherwise i thought she was fine. Very easy class if you have any grammar knowledge.

Waltz is a terrible, lazy, and very rude instructor. She only offers 30 mins for office hours a week. If you have questions, she won't answer them but refer you back to the textbook over and over again. Be prepared for self-teaching. DONT take her class if you don't have to. Stay away from her.

One of my worst profs so far. Horribly explained lectures. Pretty interesting subject for a god-awful teacher. Also really rude to students... pls dont make the same mistake i did by taking ANY of her classes

She is a good professor but the class can be hard if you decide to slack off. The class can be difficult but if you study hard and make sure to get the work done it'll pay off. For those who are looking for an easy class to take I wouldn't recommend.

Didn't watch the lectures. Her lectures were on the textbook so I took notes on every assigned reading instead of attending. Homework is VERY short and straightforward. Multiple-choice exams. Overall boring and not very interactive but maybe that's because it was online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Her lectures are kinda long but it all is going towards your homework and stuff it isnt random ramble. She has many many office hour opportunities, her lectures are straightforward and she explains everything well. As long as you watch the lectures and read here and there (the bare minimum) you are more than likely to pass! I recommend this class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Her lecture videos were very long and boring. Theres a couple of assignments, a midterm, and a final. I really couldnt understand the material halfway through the quarter but thats just me.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Mmmm not hard but I wouldnt retake her class.

Attendance is mandatory. Her lectures were boring but I found them helpful when I could actually pay attention. She responds back to email and has office hours if you need help. Grade is made up of some homework assignments and the midterm and final. She takes off points for wrong answers on hmwk. Tests are open book. Lots of guides that help too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures were very hard to get through mostly because they were just boring. I recommend just reading the book. Grade based off discussion attendance, midterm, final and a few hw assignments. The midterm and final were fairly easy and she gave more than enough time to complete them.

Grammar isn't my best subject but she makes the class relatively enjoyable and easy considering the amount of material discussed. She is very sweet and approachable. She goes over everything that will be on the exam so there are no be surprises or trick questions. It helps that she records her lectures to be able to rewatch them while reviewing.
The content itself is pretty easy to understand but her lectures are terribly boring. Everything is based of the book, so it'll be your best friend.

Make sure to buy the book, it's needed for the homework and discussion section. You don't really need to attend class if you're willing to teach yourself through the book. Everything she does in lecture is from the book. Homework is assigned every other week. There is a midterm and final that is based on the topics she teaches, it is an easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I wouldn't recommend this class for people that don't like grammar, but if you do, it's awesome. Prof Waltz is a very clear and enthusiastic lecturer. I learn more from her and I just use the textbook for reference. There's just a midterm, final, and 4 HW assignments in between that can be done in 30 minutes. You'll learn so much from Prof Waltz.

She taught the subject so well!! I would definitely recommend her. You got to practice and pay attention in class which will make it easier for you to pass. This class certainly gives you another perspective in literature.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: If you like doing grammar in high school, this is the class for you. At first, lectures were boring but they became fun once we started learning how to draw sentence trees, which make up the bulk of the course. Lectures are mandatory since she won't post the notes online.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: To be completely honest, an A in this class was attainable but you just have to be 100% paying attention in class and keeping up on the reading. On the first midterm, I received a 71% but I still managed to get an A- in the class from the final, homework, and discussion sections. There's no extra credit so just be sure to do well on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I'm going to be honest, Prof Waltz was initially boring in the beginning of the quarter. However, as the quarter went on, the material got more interesting and thus she became more interesting. There is not much homework and the exams are very straightforward. Lecture isn't mandatory, but it is still important. Make sure to read and attend lecture
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Overall it really wasn't that bad of a class. She doesn't post much of anything online so going to lecture is pretty crucial. You don't really need to read the book unless it's for homework or if you're confused on a concept. Just go to class and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: TOO MUCH WORK FOR A BREADTH REQUIREMENT! Lectures are bad enough, but this professor makes them unbearable. Super boring and just reads back from the textbook, she does highlight info for midterm/final. Thought I could skip & get away with teaching myself from the textbook.. but I was very wrong. Content is too confusing and hard to keep up with.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Attending lecture/discussion is crucial to fully grasping the material. The exams cover nearly everything, so you actually have to study to get a good grade. Overall, Professor Waltz was an okay teacher. The concepts taught in the class are fairly easy, but they can be confusing if you dont pay attention/practice.

She seems really kind, and is amazing and passionate about what she does. I feel like the discussion would be very helpful, but I didn't have a great TA. The first half of the course is the hardest, so don't drop after the midterm! First half is memorization, second half is more conceptual and interesting, but you actually need to study a bit.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You have to attend lectures! Reading before the lectures help a lot (pdf of the book will do just fine). Memorization is the best way to get through the IPA section of the quarter. Gives out about 5 homework assignments through the quarter. One midterm and one final. No essays. No laptops are allowed (but I used mine during discussions bc of book)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Would take again. Lecture is important and are the readings!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Even if minimal effort is put in, you should be able to pass with a C. There are only 7 homework assignments and they take less tan 30 mins to complete. Everything on the study guides is what will be on the midterms and exam. During lecture, she works through examples and thoroughly teaches material. Just make sure you do the assigned readings.

I can understand why people had a hard-time. If you already have some background in grammar, it would be an easy A. My recommendation is to make sure you go to lecture and if your stuck, go back to the book. She goes really fast so make sure you dont fall behind. Midterm final hw and discussion for overall grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 6 verb types, & own rules made this an extremely difficult class. Especially the diagramming. She moves too fast. If brave enough to admit you need more explanation she will slow down & explain again. The main problem: not enough TAs; only 3 for a full class need double. Why? Limited office hours & no alternatives means not enough help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: There is no passion in her teaching. She simply reads from the textbook during lecture and explains concepts when needed. I still find it hard to understand because she doesn't elaborate and is very disjointed with her explanations. I had to look up videos on YouTube in order to learn the material. We need a professor to be clear and concise.

You need to go to her lectures even though there's no participation points. Study a ton! There's only hw, a midterm, and a final. You can't fail the midterm or final. Little things graded. Lectures are short and you NEED TO READ the chapters in advance before class starts or you will be lost. You don't read, you fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Honestly I couldn't understand what the teacher was saying half of the time. The class wasn't that hard but I had to self teach it to myself. I would not recommend this class, but if you like falling asleep in a class you can't understand then by all means take It.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Awesome professor!! Straight forward class--the bulk of the knowledge is learned in the first few chapters--get to know the material and how to properly identity the functional bits of a sentence and its 'chicken pieces'. Don't make stupid mistakes and if you are on-time on Friday, when homework is submitted, you are actually five minutes late.

The midterm and the final is all based off of your homework, lectures, and readings. Attendance is not mandatory, but if you miss the first 15min of class, you'll most definitely be lost in your homework. So if you ditch lecture, you'll fail. Overall easy class if you do your stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Her lectures are very boring and she teaches the material like everyone is an expert in linguistics. Her finals are very long and her study guides are basically "study everything we went over".
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you already have a good foundation in grammar, this class will be an easy A, but if not, I can see why a lot found it difficult. Prof has a thick accent & the lecture can be boring, esp b/c she doesn't allow technology in class. But if you show up to every lecture & do the hw, you should do fairly well.

Everything you need to pass the midterm and final is in the lecture. If you attend the lecture and do readings you'll pass the class no doubt. She has a subtly humorous personality that made the class interesting for me. Follow her directions on homework and you'll do fine. Homework is assigned once a week (for Tuesdays and Thursdays classes).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: she's very lecture heavy and expects you to know your stuff, I mostly taught the class to myself.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's FAVORITE person at this University; her lectures are coherent and she is extremely knowledgeable of the field. Mind you, she held this department by herself for many years. I have taken her for most of my years here and I must say I'm glad whenever I take her!!!!!
She's very lecture heavy. She's very broad when you ask about specifics on the midterm like examples of how they might look.  I would never take her again. Not a fair grader.

She's so sweet and nice! Really tries to engage with the class and does in class practices to help students understand the materials. Yes, you do need the textbook to do the hw but tbh you can just get the problems from your friend. I never read the book unless I got stuck in some problems. Tests are all based on her lectures. Overall, easy A.
She's amazing!

Dr. Waltz is a pretty good professor. good memorization skills will help. read the book. HW assigned is easy and good cushion points since she gives you full credit regardless if ur answers are wrong. 1 midterm and 1 final. some of the material was interesting, most was boring tho. she is very helpful and sweet. funny in her own way

Professor Waltz is a very nice professor. The class wasn't even hard. Just do the readings, show up to class, take notes, do your hw and you will definitely pass with an A. Her lectures sometimes doesnt make sense but if you ask her to clarify in class, she WILL clarify it. Her lectures are really just summaries of the readings.
Super tough class. Dr. Waltz is not the best professor at UCR.

Dr. Waltz is a good professor.  It's a very easy class if you pay attention to what she says and do the readings.  She expects that you've read the chapter before lecture (it says so in the syllabus) and the lectures are basically watered down summaries of the chapter. Tests are exclusively on the lectures. Homework is a breeze.

The class in general was super tough, but she did a great job teaching it. She teaches directly from the book, if you don't have it, you will not pass. Homework is straight forward, tests are somewhat tough, I would create a study group with other students. You need to study for this class to pass, it's definetly the hardest subject I've taken.

Very boring class and the material is not clear at all. She does not take the effort to make this boring material interesting. She doesn't want to help in office hours unless you really show her that you understand the material. Gives good study guides, homework are due every week. 1 midterm and 1 final. read the book and take very carful notes.

Really sweet, going to office hours helps. Simple class if you put in the effort obviously. Memorization skills are good when you reach the IPA part. It's a really interesting subject, would recommend.

She's easy to understand and the homework really helps.  I love her accent, it's so cool.  I miss like 6 classes and read about 15 pages in total but still have got an A- in the class. Just do the homework and figure out what you got wrong, get the right answers.  Study from the correct homework and you're set.

I am not sure why so many students had a hard time in this class. She's not a bad teacher and the subject is really simple. I did not use the book once and just attended every lecture (I did same thing for Ling20). I passed both classes with an A, if you're stuck go to her office hours and she'll help you thoroughly.

First thing she said in the first lecture, "Are you sure you want to take this class? You are very brave if you do." Super scared at first but she is very clear in her lectures and helpful during office hrs. Very approachable. Read the book before class and before midterm/final and you will be fine. Homework every week. Definitely TAKE this class!

the class is so boring and dull. the teacher has an accent so it is hard to understand her sometimes. also, trees are so repetitive. the class overall was pretty hard in my opinion and i am pretty good at grammar. i do not recommend this class.

Difficult professor but sticks to the point with her information. As long as you read the book and know the terms from the book you will get a good grade. Very helpful and kind if you go to her office hours. Highly recommend going (even for Ling 20 also)

I loved this class. The professor is fun and really helpful during office hours. After taking this class I even decided to major in linguistics. It's a really interesting class, but if you're not a language person, you probably won't like it.

I only took her class because it was a requirement. She has a weird accent or could be a slur problem. Subject can redundant which made me prone to sleep. Her class only consist of 8 homeworks, 1 midterm and a final. She values more the homework than the midterm so make sure you do ALL of the homework for cushion points

I took her Grammar class and really the most important thing to learn is the verb types. Make sure to understand those. The class overall was challenging, but simple. Attendance is not mandatory, but is greatly recommended. Use of the book is required (and pretty useful). Class consists of 1 midterm, 1 final, and around 8 homeworks. Pay attention!

I took Ling 20 and overall it is a good class. You must study though before tests. Her class consists of a midterm and exam and homework due weekly. Make sure to take you homework to a T.A. so they can check it. I probably could've gotten a higher grade had I studied more. However, be aware that lecture can get BORING! Overall, it is a good class.

She is a silly funny teacher.Well I thought her class was pretty easy.The class only consists of homework once a week,and midterm and final.The exams, to me,were not hard at all because she actually tells you  and gives you what to study for the test.It's all grammar and English. Lecture can be a bit boring but easy. HER CLASS IS SO EASY!

She is a very funny professor. Her accent is a little difficult to understand at times. I found the subject to be boring. Overall the course was simple, homework once a week, one midterm, and one final.
She is very funny in her own way, and she's not that bad of a teacher! Just go to all her lectures and you'll be fine! (:

This class is not an easy A class. If you do the readings and pay attention in class, you will survive. Also, I would go to the TAs to just have them check my homework (once a week)and they were very helpful too.

I wasn't that engaged in learning about linguistics. Overall the class was interesting, but this class just seemed difficult. The exams were difficult. The multiple choice seemed tricky and there seemed like so much information to remember. I think the teacher was enthusiastic, but it didn't help in making me more interested in the class.

Trees were a pain, but she really tries hard to help you understand in lecture. Provides study guides for midterm and final that are really helpful and similar to tests. Homework assignments are given credit no matter what as long as you do them and looks like you tried. Got an A and didn't have to try that hard.

I hate trees. Failed midterm. Did all the homework. Passed final (I'm assuming) - got a Bminus. Hate trees though. If you're interested in it, take it. if you're good at breaking things down, take it.
Not a super easy class if you dont pay attention in lecture or if you dont read. one or the other. Nice and helpful. Can be confusing material.
I Love Her Comparison to Nouns and Objects to Chicken Peices! She is very Lovely and She is very Helpful when you ask questons. Love Her !

Got an F in her class. Too much reading and not enough content in the lecture. Very confusing. She didn't help me either. I had to drop the idea of a double major because of this class. I love linguistics but since I had her, I had my doubts.
Terrible.  Worst teacher I've had in my career as a student.  Terribly unorganized also, accent makes her quite hard to understand. And that is important because she's teaching LINGUISTics.

I have no idea why everyone is rating so badly, the professor is a super sweet lady. How interesting the class is just depends on what your interests are. If you don't like grammar or languages, stay away. Professor Waltz herself is really nice though. She has an accent, but it's easy to understand her. I liked her and the class a lot :)

very very easy did not understand a thing yet was able to get a b+ don't need to buy book her lectures go over everything seriously just go to lectures take notes and everything will be fine even if you don't get anything
I don't know why everyone rates her so poorly. I really liked this class. I had to work hard for my A, but it is not impossible. This was my favorite class last quarter.

Do not take this class unless you have a strong desire for linguistics. I thought it would be an easy A and I liked that there was no discussion, however the class was horrible. The lectures are so boring and drag on forever. Not an easy A class.

This class is much more than just pronouns adjectives etc its not that bad. She is super helpful,as long as you do all your homeowork you can pass. All you have is homework assignments here & there, 1 midterm, 1 final. She does not ask much of you. I failed the midterm did all my homework and asked her for help for the final and got a B.
This class was extremely difficult, stay away from this class. She tells you it is easy, but it is not. The book does not help you at all! Please stay away from this class if you cherish your GPA..

Don't listen to the other guys. This class is fun and easy. You have homework every week, but it is always less than five questions. And it is very easy. Just go to class, do your reading, and take very good notes and you will do great. The stuff she goes over in class is what is on the test. Office hours are also helpful as are the TA's.

If you find yourself not sleeping at night, come to her class it will knock you out completely. Her "notes" is just what you hear come out of her mouth. MC is just A-B-C. I had class at UNLH, and imagine 550 students getting up at once to turn in homework/pick up homework. UNORGANIZED. Easy to pass with S/NC as an elective...have fun...sleeping.

I don't understand how she's still teaching in the first place. Warning: worst class ever, save yourself. I honestly think if a different professor was teaching this course I would have very much enjoyed learning it. The material is fine, she's just very unprofessional about teaching it.

I don't even where to start. She is by far the worst professor I've had at UCR. She was late to every lecture. She is impossible to understand. Her class is incredibly unorganized. Lectures were pointless because you can't even hear her. You'll want to scream & pull your hair out. The book doesn't help at all.

Prior to attending this class, I was warned by many people not to take this class...I should have followed their advice. Linguistics could have been a great opportunity to learn, but in the end it all became pure boredom to the core. I am usually one who does not fall asleep in class, and well, I've now perfected napping thanks to her.
Worst teacher at UCR!! Impossible to understand and unbelievably boring.  Do not take this class!! You will want to kill yourself. No Joke
class is ok. HW due every week from the book. good class to take as an elective

Class was hard at first but then it clicks once you get the swing of it. Class should be no problem to pass. Tests were fair. Attend all the lectures, she is a good professor. I don't recommend this class if your grammar is poor.

i can honestly say , that if you didn't pass this class it's your fault. if you study you will pass. she's helpful when you talk to her. she tells you to read the chapter more than once. do what she says and you'll do fine.
wow this class was stupid and useless. shes so confusing and the book doesnt help at all. horrible. dont take this class

If you want to learn about the origin and history of language, this is the class for you. This class is easy as long as you do the readings, go to class, and do the homework. Make sure to ask questions if you are confused. You may find this class difficult if you don't attend class. She gives answers IN CLASS for homework and tests.

Attempting to fulfill my interest of linguistic while completing my requirements, I am sorely disappointed in the end. Her class is super boring with some humor here and there.  The information from class is redundant as you can self-teach yourself from the book. Only half of the required readings for the final was placed on the exam. UNORGANIZED
Dr. Waltz is extremely kind and considerate, and is always available to help during office hours. Definitely one of the better teachers in the Comparative Literature dept.

She has a definite love for linguistics! She always made herself availible whenever possible and she answers any questions, big or small! She has a bit of an accent but she can make very abstract concepts crystal clear! I never really had to read much because she always went over the core stuff. It was quite an enjoyable class!

Professor Waltz is extremely enthusiastic about Linguistics, and it's hard not to be interested in this course with her apparant love of the subject.  The class is pretty easy as long as you go to class and take notes during lecture.  Waltz can be a little temporamental, but as long as you don't ask stupid questions in class you'll be fine.

Dr. Waltz is incredibly sweet.  The class is easy and if you attend lecture you will do wonderful on the midterm and final. She is funny and although she has a slight accent she is 100% understandable. I recommend this class!

A very easy class, just rely on the book and you don't have to go to lecture. But if you do go, you'll pretty much have no use for the book. She seems like a nice lady who really liked what she taught. Recommended!

Prof. Waltz is a great teacher and her enthusiasm for her work really shows through her teaching.  She makes sometimes tedious work fun and grades fairly.  As long as you keep up with the course, an A is no problem.

Like many said, don't take the class "just for fun." I LOVE Professor Waltz! She makes a relatively dull subject seem very interesting. She has such a snarky sense of humor and she teaches extremely well. Her explanations are clear, she is ALWAYS available for help, and will repeat something if she knows her students don't understand it.

Great professor, very friendly. If you're not into linguistics, don't take this class because...like the course name says... that's what it's about. Requires moderate studying. I spent about 4 hours a week reading the book and another hour or two with notes. Not an easy A, but if you study and show up you should have no problem getting one.

First of all, how is she a poor teacher? The material is so EASY and she is always available for help!  As for the unprofessional comment: I think YOU are mistaken when you think she was being unprofessional when she had embarrassed that student in front of the whole class. How do you come to the final and not know what PP stands for?!

I just finished taking a final with this professor and felt moved to comment-in many ways this quarter (Fall 2008) she has proven to be a poor teacher and unprofessional. She yelled at a student who asked a question because she misunderstood it, and interrupted the entire lecture hall over it while we were trying to concentrate on the final.

Boring boring boring. She made no attempt to keep the lecture interesting or relevant in any way, i stopped attending after a while because I couldn't see why it was worth my time. She certainly made it clear she did not want to be there either. She was late to almost every lecture I attended. keep away from her

Heidi is an asset to UCR.  She should be a professor of something, and not just a senior lecturer.  Her class was very informative and eye-opening.  She repeats things until you get them.  The tests are mainly multiple choice and can be a little tricky, but if you have studied, you can get a near-perfect score.  She makes linguistics interesting.
Class tends to get really boring!!! But the HW is a breeze and if you study, it's sommoth sailing. A good thing about Heidi is that shes very sacrcastic in a very funny way.

Very nice lady and very humorous.  She is thorough and wants to make sure you get it.  She is very knowledgeable in her field and is available for questions during office hours.  There were only about 8 homework assignments and the tests are easy if you have understood the material.  Just pay attention!

Dr. Waltz is a fabulous teacher and her passion for linguistics is evident in her lectures.  Her door is always open to offer help to those who ask for it.  If you show up to class and take the effort to actually participate, you should pass.  She presents the subject matter in a fun way and gives lots of opportunities for class participation.

Don't be persuaded by these con's, enjoyment of the class has alot to do with one's personal interest in the subject matter.  As far as this professor's teaching, she is so clear and understandable! She has a passion for what her field that transcends everything she says and does. I love her. Key: Do the READING, and you Shall Pass w/ Flying Colors
So easy...I don't know what people were complaining about
The homework is very easy to do and Prof Waltz doesn't give out much. Homework is once a week and it helps a lot towards your grade. Study guides help and attend class regularly.
want to kill myself taking her classes....
worst teacher. worst class. very unclear on material. avoid at all cost!

Oh man. She is the LAMEST teacher. She's not compelling. I will never be interested in Linguistics because of her. She is lazy and unhelpful. Her accent's not the issue, it's what she doesn't say; she's  horrible at preparing students for exams. BEWARE: there is a lot of busy work and boring lectures. Try to make her your last resort.
