Okay, to those of you who thought Professor Chatterjee was hard, I don't what "hard" means in your dictionary, but she was a really helpful professor. She actually explains the material better than the book does during lectures. Her tests are doable, and she's always available during office hours. The homework she assigns is from the book, too.

Very hard to understand but you'll get use to it. Never updated the grades so I basically had no idea what I had for most of the quarter. Online homework assignments due each week on MyEconLab. Never posted up the grades for the final so I had to email and ask her. It was curved.

She  wanted to be a good professor, but I think that she taught lots of classes this quarter, so she had no time to prepare all of them. I learned this class by myself and from my TA. She confused all students during the lectures and  everyone like "what are you talking about" I went to every lecture for pop quiz, but  quiz worth nothing at the end

She isnt clear but doesn't need to be to be honest. I took intro  microecon and it really wasn't hard. She puts the slides up online so you never actually need to go to lecture, I only went twice and ended up with a B. You're going to learn the most from the discussion section, this is where all the math is done. Need a good discussion leader
Unclear during lectures because she seems extremely unsure of herself. "Pop" quizzes during lecture, that are pointless. Does not command respect from the students. No one ever went to lecture.
Hot hot hot

Professor Chatterjee wasn't the best teacher. Most of us didn't know what she was talking about. She also had quizzes in lectures instead of the discussions which were extremely annoying. She also says "right" an excessive amount.

Love this professor, she really helped me out both quarters I've had her, pretty easy grader. Wasn't prepared for my midterm at all but I got an A. She takes attendance but has let me make up assignments to make up for days I've missed and she's very energetic and adorable. One of my favorite professors

Going to class = participation points. Midterm and Final both MC format 50 Questions, all from the quizzes and lecture slides. Boring material for the most part, but it is a pretty easy class if you take the time to study and pay attention. Nice teacher too!

Worst professor ever...i advise for your own good do not take her...she just reads of power-points and seems confused when you ask her questions..midterm/quizzes/finalall are 30pages of notes to study just HORRIBLE..she grades everything last minute and does not work with students grades its her way or your pretty much screwed
Professor is very good and knowledgable!
She was a horrible teacher.  All her lectures were based  on photo copies directly from the book. (pages and pages of notes)

I took her during summer, so it was a lot of work with homeworks everyday. But, her tests were pretty easy, they came directly from homework. Her lectures were very clear and she explained the topics very slowly
Her lectures are directly from the book. Just do the homework and you should be fine. Bug the TA's for help. Exams were easy so don't sweat it. Also she is really sweet and nice

May fall asleep in her class since she's soft spoken. She shows good examples to get a better understanding in what is being taught. Extends homework assignment due dates and may take some homework off towards the end of the course. Midterm/final is easier than the practices one. If you can do those, you'll probably do fine in her class.

very soft spoken so its easy to doze off. very helpful though and she is not that bad looking. exams are no hard as long as you do the homework. the exam questions are from the book pretty much. Do more problems in the book than whats assigned for hw to get an A.
Very Nice and so helpful. Always extend the hw due date if you email her that you have problem about the hw. VERY VERY NICE AND CLEAR at what she is teaching.

She is so helpful and very nice. Always extend the hw due date if you email her that you have problems on it. Extremely nice and organized. Her midterm is not bad at all if you do the practice midterm.

Prof. Irene was absolutely amazing! The homework was mainly online and directly connected to the digital textbook (which cost $130 if I recall correctly). It was a pretty decent workload, but not anything crazy. If you pay attention in lecture, you should be able to get an A no problem!

Professor Hatzopoulos was genuinely the nicest, kindest, and hardworking professor I have had at UCR. Her care to not only the class subject, but to the students taking the class was truly amazing. The class was a tight knit 40-sum family and she treated us with the upmost respect and dignity. Would take again, seeking more classes from her.

I took her for 042 .If you can take Prof. Hatzopoulos. She is such an amazing professor and I wish this class were longer. The readings were interesting, the Final and midterm were so easy, and you responded to some questions. You had weekly reading responses. The only bad thing I would say is that the readings were a lot. Overall 9.5/10

I absolutely loved taking this class with Professor Hatzopoulos. Attendance is mandatory but her classes are so enjoyable and go by so quickly that you wouldn't even want to miss it. All of her readings are super interesting, there are weekly reading questions due, a midterm, a final paper, and one presentation. Please take her classes if you can!

While the class content was interesting, attendance can make or break your grade which wasn't ideal. Missing just one lecture dropped your grade 3% and she was reluctant to excuse them even if you had valid reasons. Overall she wasn't very helpful nor caring and she often complained, other than that the class was easy.

In my opinion, ETST098 is one of the easiest ETST class out there. So I highly recommend to TAKE THIS class. Grades were consisted of 3 assignments+a take home final. Dr.Irum was also caring and I had a wonderful TA. However the only downside is that attendance was mandatory, which I don't see the point. Otherwise, this class was inspiring.

Dr. Shiekh was a great professor and very kind. I learned a lot about the history of Arab/Muslim culture. It can be a bit boring at times, but still great. Beware of TA's though. My TA was super strict with grading things so watch out as TA's basically dictate your grade. Make sure to attend as there are PollEV questions daily.
This class was awesome!  The teacher was good at explaining the concepts and making them interesting. It was very relevant to what's going on today.

If you aren't too interested in Muslim/Arab culture then this class can get pretty boring I won't lie. Nothing of her fault though. The class overall is pretty easy. You have to put in some effort when it comes to midterms and finals to prepare but it is open note so as long as you aren't braindead you will be good. I would recommend ou take this!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is so straightforward and easy to follow. There are a few readings but even if you don't do them, they're discussed in class and not heavy. She uploads the lectures online too. The course consists of an open-note midterm and final and a few very short papers, you'll be fine. Loved this professor though. I 100% recommend it.

VERY easy class and a kind Prof. Lectures are optional/ discussion mandatory. Grade made up of 2 discussion posts, 1 midterm, 1 final, discussion attendance, & EC. Took class during UC strike so none of our grades were posted. Did not find out grades on assignments, Prof just uploaded overall grade to transcript. Please take this course, easy GE.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Shiekh shows passion for what she teaches, it's an easy course overall and as long as you do what you need to do you will be fine.

professor Shiekh is a little hard to swallow. I found her class to be incredibly interesting and I loved learning about Arab and Muslim culture, but prof is blunt and kind of rude and dismissive toward non-muslim students. she doesn't have a great grip on technology and doesn't post the lecture slides which is annoying. pretty easy class, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Shiekh is not a bad professor. Her assignments are relatively easy. Attendance is MANDATORY! Two cons about the class - 1. she uses a sign-in sheet for attendance that circulates around the class and 2. she does not post lecture slides on iLearn so make sure to take PHOTOS of the slides especially when she switch slides really fast.

Something unbelievable! Professor Shiekh's class was an amazing class and I was very fortunate to have taken her before I parted from UCR! It is very rare to find such a Profesor who is so confident (passionate) with the subject and, in addition, helpful! Very much into the learning process and learned everyone by a first name basis!Take her Class
was a great teacher. very helpful to her students

The professor grades off of only 4 essays and a final which consisted of 2 mini-essays but is super considerate if you're unable to turn something in on time. He's also a funny professor and his class is really enjoyable for just an English class in my opinion.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super nice prof, he was very straightforward with what he wanted. He makes class pretty short which is cool but sucked a little for commuters. You lose points after having 3 unexcused absences and there are a couple of essays due, 1 timed in-class one and one on zoom for a final.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pick this prof. Put in a little effort, participate in class, and you will probably pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Great teacher but I didnt receive must feedback on my papers which is fine as he wasnt a very tough grader. Do what youre told and youll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: 4 essays, 2 quizzes, and the final. Very flexible with essay due dates. Wants camera on during class and will call out students if no one is participating. Overall great professor!

I loved him so much LOL like others have said you just listen to him talk all class time and tell his stories and jokes. Occasionally speak up and laugh at his jokes! He gets annoyed if you just turn on the zoom and don't respond lol. Easy A for me. 3 essays, 1 in-class, (we only had 2 quizzes) and a final! Wish I could take him again for 1C!

Amazing professor. During corona when all you want to do is skip class, he gets you excited for class. Explains the coursework while going on just enough tangents to keep you INTERESTED in both the class and him in general. 5 Essays over the 10-week course with 2 books read along the way. Grades well with nice feedback.
easiest engl004 prof. easy grader and it was an online class

The highlight of the week. We didn't do much in his class except listen to his jokes while talking about the reading assigned which were always super short. I loved his class, especially after a long day. His quizzes are credit or no credit, so you only need proof you read what was asked of you. He was fantastic and always wore a Hawaiian shirt.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The best English professor ever. One of the easiest graders ever as he mostly grades the essays on grammar. Goes off topic in lecture sometimes, but he's still a very interesting person. He's also pretty old but very friendly and funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He's annoying but an easy professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Cool Professor, super boring class though. All english classes should be online
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: THE GOAT
Professor Innes is the best English teacher. He is really a hilarious guy. I am really lucky to have him as my 1a and 1c professor. Just show up to lecture and you will be fine.

Innes is the best English instructor I ever had. He is strict on grammar, but lenient on content. By providing the students with a variety of prompts, there should be no excuse for not earning a decent essay grade. Also, he provides the students with sufficient time. After taking this introduction class, my confidence in writing grew tremendously.

He is a genuine professor and prompts real questions without being scary. He is super fun, and relevant to the news, and brings up relevant world topics into class in a fun way. Often goes off topic, but that's the best part of his classes.

If you struggle with English and need to pass a class, this is your professor. I failed English twice because of how hard my other professor's were and I got an A with him. Go to class, do your work and you'll do just fine. He understands students have problems and tailors to their needs. Forgot to bring your paper to class? let him know, hell help
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: Essay topics are flexible and broad, not hard to understand. He will usually answer them thoroughly in lecture, so pay attention. If he likes you, youre very likely to get a good grade. Participate in class and he will have a good impression of you. Go to every class. He is very blunt and calls people out, if you're shy you might not like that.

I would recommend him if you want an easy A. Because of some issues during the quarter I had to skip class at least three times, submitted essay's late, and even skipped an in-class timed write BUT still managed to get a B+ Also a lot of people says he goes off the tangent &  random but if you listen closely this guy actually has a brilliant mind.

Colin Innes is hilarious and inspirational for his collection of stories while being mentally attuned to the needs of his students. He values the array of perspectives that his students provide. As long as one can articulate himself in a clear manner, the workload should be pleasant. Excellent feedback is provided at office hours. I miss the lad 3
Easy! He grades the essay mostly on the grammar. His lectures are fun and he tells us about his life and stories.

Very nice professor and is very enthusiastic when it comes English. He never bores me out since his jokes can be funny. Very helpful and clear on what he expects from your papers. Can be very picky on grammar so that is one thing you have to watch out in his class. He has a high passing rate in English 4 and I hope to get him again in the future.

Sweetest prof. ever! If you talk to him he will understand and he's flexible. Talks A LOT but he's funny and his stories weren't bad. TAKE HIS CLASS! Go to class; definitely don't skip. He takes attendance everyday. His class is fairly easy

Innes is amazing. He is probably the easiest professor for English 1A. He likes to talk a lot and make jokes that are relatively funny. If you have him go to class, don't skip!! Skipping class may affect your grade.
He's simple awesome! Best professor ever.

He's a very funny professor that likes to talk a lot. He goes off on a lot of tangents. Anyway, he's a pretty good choice for an English professor. 1 textbook, 2 reading books, 3 essays and a couple one-page papers. I would advise to borrow the textbook from rivera library because I ordered mine and its not worth the buy, seeing how often I used it
Very funny and brilliant, you have to write well in order to get an A, passing with a B easy. I loved going to class- take him if you can!

HE is such a good teacher, He looks LIKE SANTA CLAUS, and is so funny. You deff don't want to miss class, you will get a good laugh. He grades fairly, dont expect to get A's if your grammar/clarity is off. I wish I could take him for 1B but its full :(
Great
This guy is a freaking beast he Knows most of us want to get English over with. So he makes it relatively easier. Talks alot but just listen and write your 4 essays and you have a guaranteed A!

His class i really fun, he doesn't do anything in the books. He has his own way of teaching, the workload is not the much. He gives you plenty of options to choose for essay topics. I highly recommend to anyone to take this class

SANTA!!!!  Professor Innes is an awesome teacher with a Scottish accent!  The class is very chill and the workload is just essays.  4 essays 1000 words and 6 short essays for the entire quarter.  Talks ALOT in class.  If you can keep the conversation going in the class, it will be a blast.  The essays are a breeze.  Take his class if you have him!

Definitely an awesome and funny teacher. He'll tell random stories and jokes, helps you out on your essays, and tells you what to fix. You don't feel like he's talking down to you. Very PICKY about grammar. Make sure to put effort into writing and no wrong grammar. Ifyou have both then you get an A. Very laid back, but don't take advantage of him.
hes a really good teacher, talks alot and very rarley does work in this class. 4 essays 1000 words each and read 1 book
hes super awesome and i thought he was really funny

He looks like William Taft in case anyone was wondering. He grades a bit easier than any normal english professor. He gave 1-2 quizzes 2 essays, talks a lot on tangents, you get to watch death of a salesman, read 1 book and write 2 more essays last minute. He let's you out early. He actually grades pretty hard. Overall 8/10.
Very funny!! he goes off on a lot of tangents, but that's what makes the class so much fun. learning wise, meh..

This was by far the easiest class I have ever taken. He never cared if I went to class and only gave four essays(very easy ones) for the entire semester. Only take him if you're looking for an easy A.
He is one of the best english teachers ever. He's easy and talks about random thing but you still learn a lot. And he's very laid back and funny. TAKE HIM!

He is one of the coolest professors you can ever have. He is really funny and down to earth. I noticed that if you write something interesting and have no grammar mistakes, then he gives you an A. He looks like Santa Claus... in a good way. :) I am going to definitely miss him and his class a lot.
BEST ENGLISH PROFESSOR, TALKS ABOUT RANDOM THINGS BUT LEARNED ALOT, FAIR GRADER AS LONG AS YOU WRITE A PAPER WITH NO GRAMMAR MISTAKES, EASY A

love him!! great english teacher. the class is pretty random tho, which keeps it entertaining. he starts talking about one thing then goes completely off track. but u still learn something out of the randomness. he is fair in grading and as long as you do the essays you should def. pass with an a or b. he was great.
best english teacher you can have. take him take him! dont need to do much and still gets a good grade. great teacher for lazy people like me :p
You must take a class with him! You will want to go to class just to hear him speak,( he's British) he tells random but funny stories and will make you laugh. Basically get into his class

He's the funniest english teacher in the department in my opinion. He would let you turn in papers late if you didn't turn it in already. He's extremely lay back and chill. Very hilarious fellow!! Take him if you want a good grade!!

Such a great professor! I can understand the people in 4A's point of view, although the only thing you need to know to pass the subject A is to not write like you were taught in HS. You never learn much in an English class anyways, just reading and writing, and he was very generous and always helpful when needed. GET IN HIS CLASS!

Tells a lot of stories about teaching and what not. You write 4 essays(department requirement). mostly its reading from our text book, discussing it, and going off into tangents. (We went from the story "the kiss" to Brittney spears in like 3 minutes) Entertaining class.

what can i say? prof. colin innes is the easiest english 1c professor. his grading is based on essays and attendance, only did 4 essays for the entire quarter. essays were also easy cuz u choose ur own topic. best of all, u can just listen and relax in this class. this class is basically a free A and u  have more time to study in your other class.

He loves to tell stories about when he was a **** kid in Ireland and he usually lets you out of class early.  He loves Greek and Latin words and either origins.  Essays were easy, participation and readings were wayyy easy.  Hes a nice guy, def suggest taking his class :)
i love this teacher!!! fun class!!!

Funny and straight forward. Lets you choose your own prompts. No crazy maniac things to read, no insane essay topics to write on. Lots of jokes and off-topic discussion makes the class go by very fast . If you take this Tuesday/Thurday towards the evening, he'll usually let you go early when discussion dies. Class ended after 20 minutes a couple ti
pretty good teacher. nice guy, hes really understanding and funny. Loved his class!!

This guy's a slacker, but that's what makes his class easy. No final, just an essay...pretty sweet. However, his "lectures" (just sitting around and telling his simplified opinion and overall notion of funny things) weren't too insightful. If you asked about an essay though, his feedback was pretty useful.
Such a good teacher..hilarious
He is an awsome teacher!!!!
prof innes is hilarious. he has a monty python-esque humor and its wonderful.
Sooo easy. He forgets when we have essays due, but when we do turn them in we get good marks. Really easy and laid back. Allowed to miss 3 classes

easy class, and a great guy to talk to.  Everybody tries to sign up for his class again.  You don't learn too much, but if you pay attention you can catch things that other teachers would never dream of lecturing about.

Easy class. We only did about 2~3 essays. Has sense of humor, but he tries too much to make the class laugh. Always gets out of topic. It's cool for 1st few weeks, but it gets annoying later. Didn't help anything to help us pass the Subject A. Easy class, but too much of getting out of topic. Got B.

He's a funny guy. You really won't learn much but it's an easy A and a nice way to end the english 1 series. You don't have to put any thought into your essays and you can still get A's. He's really nice too. You'll have fun in class.

This guy is so fun. Most of the times he tells jokes. However, he does give you advice at times or useful things. He doesn't grade hard. So take it if you want to have fun in class and hear him make jokes of everything. Really easy.
funny big scottish man, but i didnt learn a thing....you can write up a piece of crap essay and get an A....take it if you're lazy but dont expect to learn much

this professor is really nice and fun...he never gets angry, he always try to lighten the mood and make things more fun...he is considerate of everyone's busy schedule...he is really helpful, any questions u have he'll clarify it for u..
he is funny and he always goes off topic.he is pretty easy and pushes back deadlines.overall best teacher so far
very cool guy really liked his class, and yes, the accent rocks

He likes to get off topic and that's cool and all, but often he doesn't get to what he needs to for the class. When he is teaching he is a great teacher. His accent rocks and he obviously enjoys his job.

He makes jokes half of the class time and it is not always funny. Often, he does not teach what he is supposed to teach. His class is easy though, because he does not ask you to do much. Not a good professor if you have to pass Subject A.
he's awesome
Great sense of humor and makes the class very enjoyable.  He's not the easiest teacher but you'll definitely learn a lot and have fun at the same time.
I absolutely loved his class. Learned more from him than any book I have ever read on the subject. Got answers to questions I could not find in books.
Super boring class, just memorize his powerpoints before taking the midterm and final.
dry monotone voice, boring...always goes on tangents. if you need to sleep this is your prof.
No Comments
The type who does not enjoy his job, very unhelpful and critical. Lectures hard to follow and tests are on info not covered in class. Most of all *MONOTONE* voice.
LOVED this man, took him more than 10 years ago and he stays with me, made me LOVE history. Worked very hard, but got a lot out of it. Did NOT love my TA.
This guy... he's pretty funny... well I thought anyways... easy class.. gives you the outline on the BlackBoard.
Funny little old man.  Very nice and approachable.  Knows his stuff.  Tests are moderately easy.  Take good notes in class.
Good prof. Great class

yeah, the ENTIRE grade is up to your TA. so get a good one, even though you have no idea which one you are signing up for ;) Wall is very knowledgeable, but he ALWAYS keeps class going overtime. i stopped showing up to class, read the book!!!

Idiot.  Has trouble staying on topic, managing his lecture time, keeping his personal politics out of the lecture hall.  Honestly.  Too bad this is a required class and probably the lecturer you're going to get for it.

History 20 was the best history class i've ever taken. Prof. Wall is excellent, but tends to show a liberal bias [which i have no problem with :)]. His essay exams are both easy and hard. Warning, your grade is in your TA's hands.
No Comments
Actually made history NOT boring, quite funny, and just a great history prof!

He is a great professor. Extremely helpful but a little hard to comprehend because of his accent and the fact that he talks a little fast sometimes. I would recommend him though, he really tries to give easy problems to help the students.
Very chill professor. Has an accent but you get used to it. Goes over lots of examples and tests were straight forward. Would definitely recommend him.

He is a very organized and helpful professor. He knows what he is teaching and how to get the information across to his students. He has a slight accent, but he is understandable. I HIGHLY recommend taking him if you can! VERY good professor. Glad I took him.

Bagci knows exactly how to teach. His lectures are very informative so make sure you go! His exams cover everything he discusses in lecture. His examples are very clear and easy to follow. If you ever get a chance to take him, make sure you do! You will NOT regret it!
Bagci is a very laidback teacher, talks kind of fast. But easy to understand his examples. He explains the materials clearly, and does the work step by step. The test was not too difficult.
Super nice! tests are that not hard.
Great professor! He's extremely helpful to all his students. His tests are very easy (almost like practice tests)

Irfan Bagci is an easy Math 9B teacher.  In fact, he is one of the easiest Math 9B teachers on campus.  If you can't pass his class, then you probably cannot pass Math 9B.   Do the homework, study and practice for the quizzes, midterm and final and I will guarantee you can pass his class.  If you see his name, get him.

He's a fantastic teacher.  I came into the class with no Calculus background at all from high school, but Irfan is the best Calc teacher here, I'm sure of it. His accent may worry you at first but he's very eager to answer any questions you have, and pauses frequently to make sure you understand each thing he says. If you can GET HIM!

Tests and quiz's are straightforward and relevant to what hes taught us and on our homework. His examples and stuff he writes is clear, his voice however, not so much. Slight curve, but not really needed.

Professor Bagci was alright.  He was one of the easier 9B teachers this quarter. His midterm and final are easier than the practice. Know your avg. value and integration techniques.  He extended every homework assignment this quarter. Just try to get used to the accent as soon as possible. A lot of example are given in class.  Good job Irfan!!!!!!!
Good professor. He's patient, straightfoward,and fair. The final was a little harder than the midterm.
Easy teacher, thick accent but understandable. Practice midterms are helpful... He gives students clues even during finals and midterms... would take math with him again...

Bagci has an accent but it's understandable compared to other teachers. He moves a little fast sometimes but tries to make everyone understand him. Office hours are helpful and midterm and final curves are pretty good.  I would take him again if i had the chance.
The professor is very clear in lecture and he is very sensitive to the progress of the students.  I would highly recommend everyone to take his class.
Best teacher ever! Has heavy accent, but you get used to it after the second class. Very helpful, easy tests and still curves exams  :) take his class, you will not regret it!
Good professor. Thick Turkish accent, but he makes the material easy to understand. Read ahead of time to make the best of his lectures.

bagci is a great teacher. u need to go to class in order to understand whats going on. hes very nice and does his best to pass you. he even holds review sessions before the midterms where he answers all ure questions. i would recommend him for further calculus classes
Tests are like the samples he gave out. Assigned homework, but didn't collect it. Good guy and good teacher.
Hard to understand- but sample tests are identical to real tests, few questions on homework assignments but lots of assignments
Good teacher. Explains everything in detail. Midterms ans finals are identical to practice exams.
Pretty straightforward course. It was hard to keep up with her sometimes, though, and it always felt like she was just reading off of the slides rather than actually teaching. Overall, pretty okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very caring and interactive with his students also there are 3 quizzes, 2 assignments, and Bookblue mid-term exam, and an online final exam and she has great knowledge about the European Union and European Politic. I love her story of working in EU as internship and I had a great time with her and it was a really fun class to learn about it.
she's cool.

She is the best. Her class is very easy - 3 quizzes, 1 midterm, and 1 final. She posts all of her lectures and slides, and offers extra credit randomly throughout the quarter, so it is really easy to get a good grade! I will be taking as many classes with her as possible :)

Fantastic breadth class. Lectures are pre-recorded, with very minimal workload. Weekly quizzes are easy if you at least skim the material. Very nice person, offers extra credit. Can be boring, but easy A if you try a little. Final and midterm aren't too bad, take decent notes and you'll be fine. 10/10 would take again.

This professor was super nice and her lectures were very informative. They had a lot of info, but she always posted them afterwards. You can get away with not paying attention to the lectures, just make sure to attend discussion (where attendance IS mandatory) and to review the slide for the midterm/final essay, as well as quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would definitely take her classes again! The discussion class required attendance and participation was very important (however it may depend on your TA) . She had some live lectures and some recorded.

The best professor I've had so far. I've taken two of her classes and love her teaching style. Her lectures are super interesting and she is very knowledgable and passionate about Political Science. One of the most caring and respectable educators. Highly recommended.

This professor is passionate and knowledgeable about poli-sci. She is a great professor for first time poli-sci majors. She posts A LOT of lectures but tbh the midterm and final were easy! There is no reason you shouldn't pass as all the answers are on the slides. Hardly used the book, only buy if you're doing EC. If not get free version online.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Carreras is really great. She is very knowledgeable and approachable. At times the class can get slightly boring, but that's political science. There is a lot of reading involved, but that's pretty much every CHASS class tbh. Just stay on top of the reading, attend the classes, complete the study guide, take notes, and it should be an easy A.
Solid professor, in this class especially. Just stay on top of everything, and boom you basically get a passing grade.
She is a nice professor. Especially for those poli sci majors who are just starting.

Professor Carreras is great! I enjoyed her World Politics class so much I am now taking her Comparative Politics class this quarter. Her lectures are very engaging and she genuinely cares about the success of her students. You will do well if you listen to lectures and put effort into understanding the material as usual. Great class!

Easy class. Very interesting lectures. Quizzes are participation based (100% if you take them), and the midterm and final were take-home and open book. No papers. Attendance is not mandatory for lecture, but TAs have different requirements for discussion sections. I wish I got a spot in her Winter 2021 course she was teaching because she's great!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: she is very organized and her lectures are very clear. really enjoyed the structure of her class and the material

She's so organized with the lecture materials. She utilizes Yuja for all videos. She records live lectures, places up PowerPoints, and additional lectures outside of the live ones. All material is in one place when it comes to midterms. Professor Irepoglu Carreras is well detailed in lectures and I highly recommend her if.
I retook this class because I failed from another class. It was clear to understand yes alot of vocab but easy if you go to class and listen, reading also helps
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: she may be a nice person but her class is terrible. Loads of things to understand in such short amount of time. She just throws information at you. Tests are all written response. GL!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor is very passionate about subject matter, excellent at what she teaches. Clear powerpoints that are posted online, but 5 random attendance checks each worth 1%! Lots of videos and outside reading. Definitely need to read and put in effort to pass and do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Carreras is clearly very passionate and knowledgable in her field. However, her World Politics class is more like a World Economics class. If you aren't interested in how world economics work, this probably isn't the class for you. But I rarely went to class and still got an A on both midterms. Midterms and final are just like the study guide.

Professor Carreras is eccentric in her lectures, I think she is a wondeful lecturer. There are random pop quizzes so you should attend every class but that shouldnt be the only reason. Definitely go to her office hours if you are having trouble, shes friendly and helpful and honestly, is a quality Professor as well as a person. Get to know her!
She is a really nice professor, but I found her class difficult to pay attention to. The class seems never ending and she is extremely monotone.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures could be draining if you are not a politics person, but if you read the book it's basically all the same things she goes over. Posts study guides w/ free response questions and multiple choice examples that help greatly, if you do them you'll pass the exams easily.

Dr. Carreras is not the best professor! She goes way too fast during lectures and it is difficult to keep up with her paste. She uses the book pretty heavy and if you don't read you will be lost during lectures. Her T.A's are not so great either. Some T.A's give pop quizzes weekly. But she does provide a study guide for tests.

Professor Carreras really knows her subject, so if you are interested in IR she is a good choice. Her lectures might be boring sometimes, but she still tries to engage the class with videos and examples. There are 2 midterms and a non-cumulative final, and she posts study guides and the short-answer questions on iLearn, so the class isn't too hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her voice makes you want to fall asleep. Midterm and final aren't hard just be sure to review all vocabulary b/c its basically what you're being tested on. Discussion is the samemake sure to look at the vocab before a quiz. Class wasn't hard and everything you need to know is posted online. Don't spend your time reading it's a waste. Don't buy bk.

Professor Irepoglu's introductory POSC class demands that you keep up with your readings, so get ready to read! Although her tests are not easy I think they are considered fair. Plus, if you dont understand something she is also available and welcoming in her office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: You don't even need to go to lectures, as long as you carefully read the textbook you should be good. She's very fast paced though so at least brush over the content before going to lecture if you have the chance.

As long as you go to lectures and take really good notes you should be fine. She goes through her lectures really fast, but theyre available online. Do all your work and go to her office hours! Shes an awesome professor. My TA really helped me prepare for the exams, so be sure to see them during their office hours as well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One midterm, one 6-8 pages paper, one final and 5 pop quizzes (she drops the lowest grade) Fairly easy class as long as you keep up the reading she post on iLearn and go to class regularly. She posts slides so if you miss lecture couple times wouldnt hurt. She is very smart and easy to talk to, but a touch grader. I sure worked hard for that A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: If you don't like reading, then going to lectures better be your best friend. You get graded on 3 exams and discussion. Exams aren't too hard, as long as you pay attention. Her lectures are boring and make you wanna fall asleep. She posts slides online. Easy to talk to. No extra credit or pop quizzes. She says "Um" a lot in lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: really easy class as long as you either 1) Read the book or 2) go to class, but as long as you do one of these you'll pass with a B easily. The lectures can be draining, but the tests mimic the lectures and the study guides she provides. However there's not much room for error because you're grade is based off of 3 tests and your discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She's a great professor! Would highly recommend her to everyone! Her tests are really easy if you study a little bit. Easy A if you study! Plus she's pretty cute!

Great prof! Test material is taken straight off the lectures, take notes and you'll be fine. Discussion and book will help a LOT, however the book is not completely necessary if you go to lecture. Easy tests and makes sure you're well prepared. Studied the night before and got a 97.5. Put in the work and you'll be completely fine
Very intelligent and highly prepared. Her courses do require heavy reading though. She is also very nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Such an intelligent woman. Her lectures mimic the test and the study guides are a tremendous help. I do recommend reading the book, even though the reading can be dense. Overall, such a great class and an even greater professor.
Very good professor. Easy to follow along and encourages participation. She is also very respectful and helpful in office hours. If you don't do well its your fault.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: If you go to class and do the readings and take good notes, you should be fine. Her study guide helps a lot if you actually use it. It's easy to get at least a B in the class. People who don't do well are just not paying attention/doing the work they're suppose to do. The readings aren't even bad, only a few pages each.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Lecture is draining, needs to work on public speaking. You only have 3 grades- midterm, final, and your section/discussion attendance grade. There's no way to improve your grade if you want to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very unclear during lectures and difficult to understand. Seems to spend much too long on one topic and not go into depth on what really matters in the course. Our lectures were so confusing and unclear that many students would tend to zone out. Not a good option for your first Poly Sci class.

Her class was VERY DISORGANIZED. She was very unclear about what was on the exams, and when the exams came around, it was hard bc she asks very obscure details about the material that are not crucial to the overall concepts. Does not seem to care about students, did not answer my questions, moved on to next student. (also has a strong accent)
Professor Irepoglu Carreras is sophisticated, well spoken, and intelligent. The subject matter was tough, but she explained everything well and was a fair grader. A lot of reading, but worth it.

Professor is a very nice person.  The ob class wasn't that hard as long as you understand the basic concepts.  Professor took time to learn the hard names of the students unlike other professors.  Professor also brought chocolate Ferrari for the whole class which was very generous of her.  Her grading was fair, and I learned many useful materials

She was clearly interested in the subject material and extremely well prepared. Every lecture felt like a Ted Talk. I've never found a class as interesting as I found this one. The test questions were directly from lecture, and if students had a problem with any of the answers and presented a decent argument, she would also accept the other answer.
Easy class IMO. Got a 98.6% pretty easily. ALL the test questions are directly off the PowerPoint slides and the essay questions out of the book. Very easy if you put forth the work.

6 weekly assignments that are 2 pages each and the lowest one will be dropped. However, the TAs tend to grade harder on the first two papers to make sure that students will do all 6 papers. Tests are tricky and hard to prepare for since no complete sample midterms will be provided which makes it hard for students to expect what would be on the test

This class, at first, seems easy, but it gets difficult after the first week. If you are a senior and want to have a lessened workload, do not take. If you are up for a challenge, this class is for you. Attend class everyday as the prof teaches different approaches than the book to solve problems. She is helpful in office hours, and is very hot!
Great professor, easy exams, research sounds interesting, Great professor overall.

Just know many students are writing letters to the dean about Kaloshians unprofessionalism and disrespect during zoom lecture. We are afraid for retaliation, making our midterms extremely difficult due to sticking up for ourself during lecture. Rethink taking this professor 100 times before enrolling.

KaloshiaKaloshianhorrible horrible professor. She told me she didnt care that my family celebrates a religious holiday during the day of the midterm even though she is giving the midterm on the first day back on campus from being remote. Was very rude to students in her class that expressed their concerns for in person instruction for a 200 cla

This professor is terrible!!! she spent 20-30min arguing with students about covid protocols. She does not care about students what so ever!!! I have no idea why she is even a professor to begin with. It takes more than brains to work with students. Kaloshian is disrespectful and im sure she will get reported several times this quarter!! Terrible!

The most uncaring and disrespectful prof here. Cares more about her research than her students. We fight with her every lecture about her teaching methods, we get belittled for asking questions. She invalidates students cultures and traditions simply because it doesnt apply to her. Cut her research, she isnt made for teaching.

Personally has lots of experience in public sculptures; his passion for art is rooted in professional practice. Participation is expected, expect fun stories. Reading articles and writing response papers  about them are assigned around bi-weekly.

Jim is not an easy teacher but he is a great teacher. There is no BS allowed. If you are willing to work hard and are open to criticism then you will really get something out of his classes. If you are an art major don't leave UCR without taking one of his classes, you will regret it.  He is a plethora of knowledge and experience.

A lot of people will complain about his no-nonsense approach to critiques and assignments, but that's because they're used to the culture of the "easy A" that has permeated the UCR art department. He's a great professor and you will learn a lot if you put in the work.
Excellent, excellent professor.
Where else can you have class on Fashion, Advertising and Design?

Hard professor!A lot of work!Participation is a big part of the grade and you have to talk in his class. He has a required textbook for the class and always shows slides every week and has written assignments plus 4 sculpting projects.
"if you complete all the assignment, you're guaranteed to receive a B grading." that's what it read on his syllabus. it's A LOT of work for an intro class, but he really helps you learn.

People that take art cause they think it's an easy A should not take a class with him, or any art class for that matter.  That i said; if you want an interesting teacher that will challenge you and make you think and work then take his classes.  he's smart

his art assignments are kind of a pain. somewhat offensive if he doesn't favor you or if he doesn't like your artwork. made a girl cry once. pissed me off once asking if my artwork was really art. doesn't seem to have much of an open mind about different types of artwork. wait for another professor if you want to take this class.

Group Project is tough. Make sure you can spend time on that else you will not clear this subject. If you read what he assigns for each class and pay attention in class then it's easy to get the good grade. He is sharp so do not try to fool him. Choose project and team wisely. No assignments but before class textbook reading is important.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: His writing is more like scribbling. He gives a lot of work and stuff to read which will take days to complete after he does not have a minute to patiently listen to students. He does not respond to email immediately. Teaches programming languages(Ocaml) and scripting languages(latex) which are not really related to subject. Gud luck, u may need it

The material he taught was very good. He had a clear grading criteria. Very good project to learn and gain experience. Most of his projects are necessary to get experience for applying internships and jobs.
He gives you either an android or ios project as a part of group project. Very decent in grading.

Had to attend class to attend to popquizzes, which only accounted for 5% of our overall grade.  The material Professor Neamtiu taught in class was clear and coherent and closely related to material on the midterm.  However, the only difficulty is staying on track, because of the lengthy assigned readings and the amount of material covered in lec.

I didn't understand the class and the lectures and practice exams didn't help me when it came down to taking the actual exams . The professors doesn't release  your actual grade until the end of the semester. Also they use lockdown !

I had this professor for PSYC110. She takes attendance randomly 6 times throughout the quarter. 3 exams, one paper based on a video, and a video project. She makes practice exams and uses multiple questions on the actual exams. Easy class and sweet professor, just make sure to study and go to lectures bc it can get complicated.
The lectures were interesting, and it wasn't super hard. Attendance is mandatory. I would take it again.
My favorite class so far at UCR.

This is an INTRO CLASSS...clearly not for this professor. If you want neuroscience intro, take this course. If not stay away. It's too much material for an intro class. Had to study for hours for the exams because there was so much information. Don't even have to take notes for class bc the professor just reads off the slides.

This professor was so nice. She really takes the time to help you during her office hours and answers her emails fast. Make sure you attend lectures, though. Attendance is mandatory. The class was relatively easy.
She invited guests to the course, so we can learn more about CAMs and environmental health. It was an interesting class. Yes, I recommend it.

Taking her class is my worst mistake this quarter. Her lecture is extremely boring, with countless pages of presentation. She studies neuroscience so her lectures is full of neuroscience even this is a psych 001 course. She also takes attendance for 8am lectures. To prepare for exams, you need to memorize all her presentations. Avoid at all cost.

Actually needed to put effort into this class to get a good grade. Discussion on packback (a website you need to pay for) every week. A video project. Both midterm were taken in person so you need to actually study. The final was cumulative. The practice quizzes were helpful but there is way too much information you need to memorize.

I took this class last quarter. It was relatively easy and the professor is so sweet. There is one group project in the class where your group has to present a research article during the discussion section. But I think everybody got a good grade on that. Other than that, it's pretty much a standard class with 2 midterm exams and 1 final exam.

This class is actually Psyc 001, not Psyc 002, which is taught by somebody else.
Anyway, I love this course! She always asks many questions, and we also watch videos during the lecture. Attendance is mandatory, and she checks attendance randomly, so you have to be there. The exam isn't that difficult as long as you study.
This class was so interesting. The professor was really nice and explained everything. I would definitely take it again. Make sure you attend the lectures; otherwise, the exam will be difficult.

For a intro psyc class you actually had to pay attention, the midterms and final were term heavy and in person so you have to study for it. The study guide she gave wasn't that helpful either. The class mainly consisted of packback (ONLINE discussion u PAY for) and a SciComm project. Attendance was taken random but it was part of your grade.

the class set up is simple. lecture attendance is not mandatory. The test were exactly like the lectures. The class covers a wide variety of topics which is the only 'hard part', as long as you study the lectures youll be fine on the test. no busy work was given which was a plus.

Lectures are extremely boring and unengaging because all she does is read from the slides. Also, because she's just reading, she faces the wall and hardly projects to the room, making her very hard to hear. Tests had a lot of confusing, poorly worded, or trick questions. Study guides are vague and don't cover niche things she puts on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You do have to study, but the professor is very passionate about the topic, so her lectures are very informative. She puts everything on the slides, so you'll get an A as long as you do the work. Two exams, a discussion board on Packback every week, one video project, and SONA.
My favorite class so far at UCR.

This professor is an exceptional educator who genuinely cares about their students' success. Her passion for the subject is evident in every class and is truly inspiring. She integrates real-world applications into the curriculum, making the content relevant and exciting. I recommend this class to anyone.

I was very happy with the course materials. The professor showed videos in class which really helped understanding teh topics. Make sure to study her slides. They are well organized and everything you need to know are there. I would definitely take it again.

I took this class last quarter. It was relatively easy and the professor is so sweet. There is one group project in the class where your group has to present a research article during the discussion section. But I think everybody got a good grade on that. Other than that, it's pretty much a standard class with 2 midterm exams and 1 final exam.
This class was really easy. She is a very caring professor, and I enjoyed the class.
I really enjoyed this professor's lectures. We watched videos, and she also asked some questions. She made the material enjoyable. The exam wasn't that hard.

You had to attend lectures to do well on the exam. She went through everything in class that she wanted us to know for the exam. So, it was not that hard as long as you were taking notes. I enjoyed the lectures; it was interesting, and she was very nice.

I took PSYC178 with Dr. Gabriella. She's super nice. Just come to lecture for EC points and do the weekly assignments for an A. Mandatory readings were assigned, but never came up on exams. Class out of 100 pnts, 10 for Discussion Presentation, 14 for Packback, 8 for Discussion Attendance, 14 per Exam, 20 for Final, and 20 for Final Paper.

She's a person, I just wish it reflected the class. Her lectures were boring so I stopped showing up after the first exam. She offered ec for showing up though. The midterms were okay but the cumulative final was like exam 3 since it didn't include everything we've learned. I would take her again if my grade wasn't counted for upper divs.

Class consisted of lecture, 2 midterms, final, discussion posts, and group project. Lecture was boring since she reads the slides & faced the wall. She offered 1 extra credit point if you attended. More than half of the questions on the exam were outside of what she lectured or told us to study. 100% would not take this class or professor again.

Lectures and the class material was very easy to understand. As long as you read the lecture slides you'll pass the 2 midterms and the final. Final is cumulative but it was mostly 90% about the last 3 lessons. 1 group project very easy. Would take again.

she's a nice person, but she was prob one of the worst lecturers I've ever met. She just reads off slides and some of her questions on her exams don't make any sense at all, making u think extra hard for nothing. Has random extra credit polls she'll take at some lectures, but as long as the whole class works together free points for everybody lol

Boring lectures, she read it off the slides, you have to be there for a random lecture attendance. 2 exams and 1 cumulative final. The tests are awful bc she words it really weird and have tricks questions for no reason. She will tell you to study 6 lectures slides to just test like 2 lectures. She's very nice but no don't take her class

Lectures are extremely boring and unengaging because all she does is read from the slides. Also, because she's just reading, she faces the wall and hardly projects to the room, making her very hard to hear. Tests had a lot of confusing, poorly worded, or trick questions. Study guides are vague and don't cover niche things she puts on the exams.

reviews.comment: Professor Gabriella was a great professor for PSYC 001. The lectures can be a bit boring, but they are interesting. She has a clear grading criteria and it should not be hard to get a good grade in the course. Graded on a midterm, scicom project, weekly questions, and a final. Some extra credit was given throughout so make sure to attend lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She mostly read from slides, which is info from textbook/DSM. She has videos/articles that don't seem important but ARE on the final. She is very sweet & answers questions to best of her ability, but lectures are not engaging/necessary to learn. Weekly discussion Qs, group presentation, + essay using "AI software" that was difficult + unnecessary
Lively, cheerful person. Always ready to help. Do not bore. His lectures were interesting to me. Professional. A living classic of Religious Studies. But you need to get used to his style.

scatterbrained is a good definition for this guy. He's nice, but he rambles on about the most useless stuff. All the tests are based from his book. No one ever showed up to class unless we were taking a test.

This class could have been interesting, but this guy is wayyy weird. He seems nice enough, but he's pretty scatterbrained and does NOT appreciate any opposing viewpoints ("the problem of religion", eh?). His papers and quizzes weren't horrible, but we basically taught ourselves, and wrote whatever he wanted...Not a good professor :(

Hard, unclear professor. Plays favorites and does not take kindly to opposing views. I do not understand how he has a good rating. He is a nice teacher and a friendly guy, but he speaks in a way that is confusing to everyone, his readins are too dense to comprehend, and his tests are bogus, opinionated 'short answers'.Dnt take him if you want an A.

Very nice and helpful professor.  The quizzes, midterm, and final are nearly all reading-based so you HAVE to do the reading (hint: take good notes while reading it will help you remember the details).  If you do that, you will get an A for sure.

i took a course on RELIGION & SCIENCE with strenski and he spent the entire, ENTIRE, lecture before the midterm showing a ppt slideshow of his dogs, he's useless and i learned absolutely nothing from his class, even the TA apologized for the class bc we had learned nothing to test on, waste of time, never take him ever
Awesome teacher! Kept class fun and interesting. Quizzes are freaking easy. :) Kewl teacher.

He is one of the few professors on campus who does not look down on his students.  He is very helpful with paper topics and yes he assigns a lot of reading. If you know classical music, he will love you in his class.
Took numerous courses with him as prof.  Good and fair grader.  Smart guy.

He assigns ALOT of reading and the lectures in class doesn't relate to the readings. He tends to stray off topic but the good thing is that the midterms and finals aren't as hard as you may think they are. As long as you read, you'll do fine in the class
A really,really nice guy-but he assigns sooooo much reading!
Great professor to learn from, he is one guy who will not let you down when it comes to teaching. Excellent methods, great lecturer, fun classes! You wont be disappointed.
great guy...but yeah, wayyy too much reading is required
Very funny man.  Good guy.  Easy to talk to.  Knows his stuff.  Lots of reading though.
No Comments
Interesting lectures.  VERY easy class.

Great professor! Definitely attend lectures as he tells you exactly what will be on the test (and it was just a fun lecture!). Offered a good amount of EC and grading was very fair. Tests reflect the lectures and group project is easy. Super nice, funny, and engaging. Highly recommend!
good prof I just wasn't good at it

goated professor. Best lecturer of all time and tests are tremendously fair and easy. slides are well put together and heavily reflect the exam and presentation isn't graded harshly at all! To this day I've never met someone who didn't get an A in his class. Def top 5 profs in UCR CNAS.

Good professor and tells you what you need to know for exams. Everything is on the slides and wants you to understand the material. He chill and easy to talk to. The group project is easy and TA is super chill. I would retake this class with him.

3 non-cumulative + 1 group presentation; each worth 25%. Really cool dude overall and exams are very fair. Lectures are not recorded but regardless GO TO LECTURE, he is very honest with what is on the exams. Funny dude I liked his jokes and if I had to take Micro again I would wait for him to teach it :)

Go to class. He will literally give questions on the exam to those who show up. The material can get dense but none of it is cumulative so you can dump all the info from your brain at the end of a midterm.

GOAT. Based his midterms solely on his slides. If u asked what was on the midterm, he'll tell u what to prioritize. 2 midterms + non-cumulative final, each 40 MCQs. Discussion had a presentation. Lecture wasn't recorded or mandatory, but he answered questions about exams/told u what was on it to incentivize ppl. Heavily graded on exams, don't throw
lol easy class. went to 0 classes and barely studied. take bro. hes super chill

if theres anyone whos the goat, it's most certainly Rothman. this man is a walking microbiology god and he provides you with everything you need to succeed, its up to you to use it. and hes FUNNY! he tells you verbatim what will be on the test if you attend lecture, and as long as you study and know the material 100%, it is ez dubs!

In my opinion, Professor Rothman is one of UCR's best professors. His lectures are engaging, easy to follow, and he gives you the exact concepts that will be on his tests. He paces his lectures nicely where he would end lectures early so that he has time to answers any students questions.

Great prof!Lectures are fun & engaging.He gives hints on what to focus on, but don't rely only on that; some Q's were unexpected. Exam 2 was the hardest.Low workload, but keeping up & making flashcards helps.Going to class is key since he expands on material & explains better. Overall, he's fair, entertaining, & a great lecturer.Highly recommend!

Overall helpful and gives you a lot of "hints" for the exams. Exams are multiple choice but they are also select all that apply so beware of that. Scientific Paper was graded slightly harsher than I expected despite him telling me that it looked perfectly fine in office hours. So if you want a full score on it put in alot of effort. Labs were fun

reviews.comment: Do not take him all the other professors are better

Be honestly, someone who gets A grade on this course should not be a member of our university. You are obviously accepted by mit or something. I have never thought a course as torture. When other class was taking multiple choice test. We were suffering the difficult questions and there would be no help, no sample midterm final. Enjoy your disaster.

Wang did not give us a practice final and made the final extremely difficult which is the reason I did not pass considering it was worth 45% of our grade. I attended every lecture and studied religiously outside of class and still did not pass. Avoid especially if you can take another prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just going to lecture was not enough to do homework or exams, so I had to self teach myself everything. Midterm was easy enough if you did the practice midterm but the final was too much and too different from in-class examples and homework. I will say though, he was very accessible outside of class. He responded to all my emails in a timely manner
Don't take him if you have another option. Honestly you have to do the majority of learning on your own but it is physics so I am not surprised. Good luck! I survived ;)

Jacky was a professor that proved to be a little difficult to work with towards the end but overall showed that he wanted students to understand the topics. His lectures weren't really beneficial, and I learned more from self-study and labs. His midterm was doable however his final exam was a bit too much, he didn't even give practice for the final
