-JW
So tricky guys. I am mental.

OMG dont get me started on this guy. After the final, he ruined the class because someone exposed him for rigging the test. I dont blame that guy for doing that. 

He gets mad at people if they answer the Poll Everywhere from outside the class and presses everyone in class about it, especially after he finds out someone posted this on Reddit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hardest class of the entire physics series and it wasn't because of the material but because of the professor. He doesn't give practice midterms or finals, doesn't post solutions to midterm, doesn't let you see what you got wrong and worst of all is that he doesn't do example problems in lecture as he just focuses on conceptual stuff.

He's a good lecturer and a strict grader. He said he was disappointed in us with our 48% midterm avg. He made the problems from midterm 1 himself but for midterm 2 and the final he got lazy and basically gave the same test from professor Hai-Bo Yu and just changed the numbers. He's very adamant about not giving practice tests and he does not curve.

Took in the Spring 2024, I attended every lecture, did all of the homework, studied on my own, regularly scheduled tutoring appointments, and still received a poor grade. Put in substantial effort; I have never been the best with physics, but this was a terrible experience. Sucked bc he was a cool guy but a terrible prof. RUN while you can.

He doesn't curve or give practice exams and he's not transparent about your grades, he uses gradescope for the automatic grading but doesn't make it visible for students so you can't see which questions you got wrong. He's very strict about the poll everywhere and tries to get students in trouble if they answer them from home.
He is valid. I got an A because the competition was not good. Lots of Mech E students cry about him, but the exams were valid. Just practice a lot and don't be butthurt or scared of studying.

Professor James is an amazing professor, this was my second time having him as a professor. His class was very easy and straightforward. I learned so much about my major and gained an understanding of what I want to do with my degree because of him. 100% recommend, he's also very interesting! I really enjoyed his stories!

Professor James was extremely passionate about this class. He is very caring and genuinely wants students to be engaged and learn. He always stuck around after class for discussions or questions regarding lectures or assignments. Assignments were self explanatory and very simple.

honestly one of the greatest professors at UCR! He takes the time to answer questions thoroughly and make sure everyone understands the material before moving on. Dr.James is  knowledgeable and always provides helpful feedback. I would definitely take this course again or enroll in any course he teaches :D

Easy class, he posts everything from lectures. The only assignments are the midterm and final, and really short ones done for discussion, never wrote more than a paragraph. I had Mingyue she's an easy grader and walks you through everything. Easy A. I started the final the day it was due. You either do an essay or 7 minute video presentation.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: lectures were boring so i stopped going after week 2, assignments were mainly from discussions so you should go to them, my TA was really chill and very supportive. no midterm, no final, just a final essay/project. did my project the day it was due and got full points. very easy class, low stress, nice prof
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Omg I'm gonna miss going to this mans lectures. Such an amazing professor!!!! He is relaxed and teaches very well. Besides this amazing class and professor, I will say I was not quite happy with my TA so choose your TA wisely. TA's are easy graders though and the assignments were sooooo easy. Would 100000% recommend him if you need an Antho class.

his class was so fun and really easy. the class was genuinely interesting and his language workshop was really fun to do. his assignments are very straight forward and there technically isn't a final but tits just a paper or project which is really easy. i loved this class
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Genuinely one of the nicest professors I've ever had. Super down to earth and tells great stories. Lectures aren't mandatory but I would try going to a few because he's truly such a kind and amazing person. Grade is mostly discussion participation, a project outline, and the final.

Excellent professor and easy summer course. He talks about relevant topics and he's such an interesting guy. Light work and majority of your grade is a final 6-7 page paper and the rest is participation/attendance/weekly exercises which are extremely easy. Highly recommend!

This is one of the nicest professors at UCR. Take this class with hard classes because this class is super easy. It was pretty much participation and a final paper about how you will use your time for the remainder years at UCR you have left.

Relatively easy class. There were a lot of readings, but if you're smart, you could get away with not reading all of them. Attendance wasn't mandatory (not graded) but you'd be pretty lost without the lectures. There's a one written final and one presentation midterm. Professor was really kind and entertaining.

Super chill and caring prof! All the materials/readings he uses in lecture are provided for you online on canvas. Attending lectures isn't necessary but he's so sweet and a great storyteller so I'd say attend a few :) the final is a decent amount of work but you have all quarter to work on it so you should be fine + I'd say it was graded easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor James is one of the easiest classes I've taken. Attendance wasn't mandatory, very little hw, his midterm was just info that could be used for your final, and he was always available outside of the classroom. He had "group" work but just with the people around you, not hard at all. He loves to yap though, but his stories are interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Extremely kind and considerate and genuinely cares for his students. Class was really easy but if you have a hard time, he will be accommodating. Lecture was honestly boring, though, not a lot of people showed up and still was able to do well in the course.

The biggest portion of the course is the final paper on how you plan to navigate your time at UCR (or post-grad depending on your year). There are graded exercises that help prepare for said paper though. Attendance is mandatory but I didn't attend lecture much and made up for it with the extra credit presentation. Overall fun class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is very easy, You have 5 small assignments that lead into your capstone. For your capstone you have a website to make, a presentation, and a research paper due the end of the quarter. He very caring and I have taken him for 3 courses. I would recommend attending all classes because he has workshops that help with all part of your capstone.

Lectures were my favorite, the professor would talk most of the time or show videos / readings. There was only 1 final essay to turn in, but discussions helped with that. Overall, would recommend if you are a Liberal Studies major.
One assignment which is the final project. Discussion consists of answering weekly questions of 150 words for credit. Overall an easy A and would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor is a very nice person because he cares about his students. You have small assignments that lead up to you final research paper that you are allowed to pick your own topic. Attendance is required so make sure to show up, you also get a chance of extra points. Overall easy class and would take professor again.
Easy class, didn't show up to lectures but went to discussions.

Professor James is very caring and care about his students. He does do lecture by the TA's does all the grading for his class. Lectures could be boring but they aren't required to attended. Discussion is where you have to attended. NO MIDTERM just a career paper for final.

Super easy class. Just a short paper, a website, and a video about a topic of our choice. Lectures are long, but he makes it interesting. However, he takes a while to respond to emails and I haven't had anything graded at all. Very kind and helpful professor. I would take this professor again.

Learned a lot about the Liberal studies degree. Few assignments, a "final" that includes a paper, presentation, & website. Cares more about students than grades, he's not trying to fail anyone. Show some effort & you don't need to worry about your grade. Easy to reach outside of class & provided great feedback as I worked on my final assignments
I feel like he was a little boring, easy class. You only have 1 paper at the end which is your "career plan".

Passionate about the success of his students and learning from them too. Literally the perfect example for what an instructor should strive to be-- assignments are student led (projects of choice, media of choice) and he checks for progress. Only thing is that he doesn't respond to emails fast, but due dates are negotiable.

Intro to Anthropology (001). Has a passion for Anthropology and his lectures can be interesting if you like the material. Will have to write a few papers but nothing too difficult, and you will have to write on discussion posts but most of it is on your own life experiences. Stephen James is a good teacher and it is a very easy, flexible class.

As liberal studies majors we learned so much we can do with our degree. Their are very few assignments in his class, with a "final" that includes a paper, presentation, and website. The only downfall on this professor is grades are not implemented until finals week so you really do not know your grade for the quater until it is already submitted.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
This review is actually for Cultural Anthropology:
Class was mainly asych despite occasional zoom check ins during this quarter and assignments are mainly from discussion as well as research paper which are graded !

Professor James is a well-rounded, caring individual. He actually taught lessons that mattered not just in academia or the workplace, but are also applicable to life. He is also very accommodating and understanding; it is clear the students matter more to him than the grades. I would definitely recommend his class.

Easy assignments and he isn't a hard grader at all! I love how he gives us his personal experiences to teach us life lessons and to take on/challenge new experiences and opportunities! He is very caring and understanding towards his students so if you have any questions or concerns he is very accommodating! Definitely recommend taking his class!
The class is really easy to understand because it is so straight forward. The professor is also very nice and just wants his students to learn and pass.

This was such a positive experience. This professor takes his students into great consideration. He has a very appreciated perspective and knowledge of the world. He is very understanding and inspirational. He teaches and encourages students to take on the world in new and helpful ways.

This was one of my favorite classes taken at UCR. It's very eye-opening for Liberal studies majors and encourages you to have an open mind when learning new knowledge. He's very understanding and encourages his students to do their best. He constantly asks for his students opinion and shows to be very knowledgable in what hes teaching.

Very unorganized class, dates of assignments always changing and not stated if changed. Does not cover many topics in class. TA was very chill, helped as much as he could. Have to stay on top of all weekly assignments, there was a surplus of unhelpful assignments.

This professor is absolutely amazing, he makes a huge class interactive and invested in his lecture through his passion on the subject and teaching. He explains concepts very clearly and his teaching style is very optimized for retaining information. Class is only hard if you fail to show up/pay attention in lecture.
Lot of participation in discussions, and decent amount of homework, but you get 10 late passes.

Mr. Jeff is genuienly one of the nicest teachers Ive ever had! He cares about his students and everytime I went to his lectures I understood what was taught or got a good grasp on it. If you ever found/find yourself struggling or needing clarification, Mr. Jeff is always there and held/holds many office hours and opportunitites to ask questions!

Make sure to attend all of the discussions and the lectures because they are like 20% of your grade. Also, make sure you keep up with the homework because there are a lot. Overall, the class is very relaxing and there are many extra credit opportunities.

Professor is nice in teaching the class. Even though he assigns too much homework such as Post-discussion write ups and study guides, they're easy to do as long as you go to your discussion section class. TA was also nice in helping students succeed, but overall, very nice and lenient professor. Grading wasn't also strict which is good.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Jeff is very kind! Make sure to attend lectures because he does LivePolls for attendance, although they can also be accessible from home as long as you log on at the correct time. There is quite a bit of weekly homework, but not too much to where it is overly stressful. Midterm and final count a lot towards your grade!

Average math class, definitely pay attention and try to learn from the rational reasoning as well as lectures because the lectures will only carry you so far and there are some dots that don't connect as well if you don't.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. Jeff is really nice and enthusiastic, he tends to over complicates things but just pay attention to his lecture slides. The class isn't really hard just understand how and why you got the answers to the homework and you should be good.

I enjoyed taking this class with Dr. Jeff and feel I learned a lot about applied linear algebra. I liked how he emphasized foundations like vectors and transformations, which helped later topics. The last weeks felt rushed, but the quarter moves fast. I also appreciated late passes since they helped me balance work and think through problems better

Dr. Jeff is knowledgeable and passionate about math. He wants students to grasp concepts and apply them. Put in the time: read the book, do homework, and stay consistent. Dr. Jeff offers plenty of office hours, fair exams, and sometimes extra credit. You'll learn a lot and enjoy the class! (p.s.: He uses his own online book, no purchase needed).

Really good professor honestly and seems to actually care about his students, the only thing I didn't like about this course was the amount of unnecessary work that is given, but besides that I would highly recommend taking this course with him.

He is a great professor, knows how to teach and engage the class well. However, he gives A LOT of homework and post-discussion from Week 0 all the way to Week 11, which I think was not necessary. Besides that, linear algebra is a very different class (more conceptual than computational), but he does a great job in teaching it.
Great professor, lecture heavy so lectures help and attendance is mandatory. Not so strict on grading but don't call behind because i did.

He is really nice and good at teaching unlike my other and actual professor I went to his office hours and he's really good and what he says actually makes sense I wish I had him for all my math class's instead of half of these teachers.

He is a great professor who is very enthusiastic and approachable. However, he assigns a lot of homework and post-discussion write-ups. What can be frustrating is putting in the effort to pull an all-nighter to finish everything, while juggling other classes, only to find out the next day that deadlines are sometimes extended.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: fiyaaaa prof 100% recommend if you like math. Classes are very collaborative, and he gives students feedback nearly every class. He's very caring; he rly wants you to learn. P heavy workload, there were a couple of weeks that genuinely took me out, but his classes are set up to prepare you/guide you through it. Exams took forever to return.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Jeff is one of the best professors I've ever had. He is very knowledgeable about linear algebra. There are some challenging concepts in the class, but Dr. Jeff explains the material very well. Exams are based on mathematical proofs written for homework. Provides many extra credit opportunities.

Dr. Jeff is a great professor. He is enthusiastic and passionate about teaching linear algebra. He explains new concepts well. Studying for exams is straightforward and only proofs that are done before for homework will be on the exams. Dr. Jeff also offers opportunity to get extra credit on each of the exams. Wants his students to succeed

He made it clear he wanted to make a connection with us, as well as his enthusiasm with the material. He seemed to waste a good chunk of time (25 of 50min) recapping the "big idea", but that only helped a bit. Exams were more similar to our worksheets than he led on. Other than that, homework was helpful to our learning and the class wasn't bad.

Dr. Jeff is likely the most caring professor that I have had at UCR. That being said, he also probably has the most homework that I have had for any class at UCR. However, if you attend class, most of the answers are basically given. I would definitely recommend.

Dr. Jeff is one of the most enthusiastic professors I've had. He knows his stuff and more than anything, he wants his students to gain something from his course. If you take any of Dr. Jeff's courses, ASK QUESTIONS. He's always willing to help.

Honestly, I am very terrible at calculus but Jeff made it better to understand even if he over elaborates a bit too much. However, his teaching will help a lot and made me connect well with physics. Too bad he's not teaching the class I wanted to take this current quarter. He genuinely does care for his students so don't feel shy!!

I think Dr. Jeff is a good professor, but I copied everything he wrote in class, so I was confused the whole time because I felt like I didn't learn anything from it. I believe that he is very passionate about math and is good at what he does, but I think he doesn't explain the formulas that clearly. We also didn't get to finish worksheets on time.

Dr. Jeff is a passionate and cares about students and applying concepts. His exams are tough if you rely on problem-solving rather than conceptual understanding. Lectures focus heavily on concepts with few examples, making homework and worksheets difficult. Good prof. but I could've learned more if the lectures went beyond understanding concepts.

Dr. Jeff was a great instructor. His clear, well-paced lectures and use of visual aids made complex topics easier to understand. He actively engaged us with practice problems, helping us apply concepts. His office hours and review sessions were also valuable, offering clear explanations and breaking down difficult material.

I'm taking his 7A class; he's an amazing professor. Dude genuinely wants you to learn in his class and takes his time to answer your questions. I'd recommend taking a course with him if you can. I suck at calculus but he makes it manageable if you put in the time and effort. Also he doesn't record lectures, so I'd recommend you go in person.

Dr. Jeff is kind and accessible during his office hours. However, his lectures covered material that felt very simple compared to the homework + worksheets. The HW was much more complicated, and referencing what we covered in class was often unhelpful as they felt very different. Midterms were not easy, but doable with studying the right stuff.

Love this guy so much, he genuinely loves teaching(and is good at it) and wants his students to succeed. Do the online and discussion homework as that will definitely boost you grade and where he gets the questions for the exams and quizzes. He's very understanding and gives students 10 late passes for the homework for the quarter.
This guy is annoying bruh he yaps way too much about serving vectors i genuinely dont care about serving vectors and his cereal

Dr. Jeff is an amazing professor. He truly wants you to grasp the meaning of material rather than plug numbers into a formula. Read the textbook reading before class to understand it more. The homework is very identical to quizzes and tests so practice and ask questions. He is very energetic and cares for everyone. Ton of HW. Definitely take him!

She was good at responding to emails, and I liked her personality because she was funny and easy to talk to. Unfortunately, she assigned too many busy work essays, barely graded anything until finals week, provided little feedback, and said she "never gives 10/10" (even when all directions are fully followed) + there's no rubric half the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: shes an interesting teacher she will keep the class entertaining so you wont fall asleep that often.  she has many cat stories and cat references to make.  i like her personality i would take her again if i had to take more eng classes.  the only problem is that she grades a bit hard. also her required readings are interesting books like sherlock

Is obsessed with her cats so be ready to hear about them every day. Though she gives great feedback on your essays, she leaves you completely clueless when writing them. Her lectures are useless so you're kind of on your own when it comes to the essays. She's not completely horrible, but try getting another professor if possible.

She is just an awful teacher.. If she doesnt agree with your viewss she will give you an undeserved grade. Its really hard to focus when she's all over the place.. She can't spell to save her life. Please avoid her at all cost. I went into her office hours, she was nice but really unhelpful.. I really feel she lacks experience.

She was a really great teacher! Some times it got a little boring. She also calls on people of opinions and participation. Other than that she is always happy and happy to help you. I would recommend getting her.
She was very unorganized and not helpful. She relied too heavily on student participation for discussion. Waste fo time.
Really cute, and she keeps the class totally interesting!  I don't know what's wrong with the other posters on here--I like cats and think her stories are great!  Totally recomment her.
He was not the best teacher but his tests were very specific on topics that were not discussed in class. Also. He doesn't return grades in a timely fashion and doesn't answer emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Murn for BCH110C and BCH185. A fantastic experience on both accounts. Not often you're reminded you're being taught by world-class experts at UCR, but Dr. Murn balances tact in his presentations with a strong level of pedagogy. Very reasonable final exams. The guy really wants you to learn... and learn you will!

Dr. Murn wasn't good at teaching. He generally went over topics but tested on highly specific material he didn't teach. He took forever to grade and doesn't answer emails. I'd recommend taking another professor but HE'S THE ONLY ONE THAT TEACHES THIS REQUIRED CLASS!

Tough, tough grader and only superficially touches on topics. For the his exam and the written qualifier exam, he was very late when turning in grades. He was hard to reach outside of class via email. You're better off asking him before or after class otherwise it'll go unanswered.

Dr. Murn is not an effective teacher. His test questions are nothing like what he teaches in class. He offers no practice problems and zero feedback. This course is all dependent on two exams which is already setting up the students to fail. Going to Harvard doesn't make you a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took him spring 2022 and he taught the second half of the class. He was not bad, I enjoyed the topic, and he explains them quite well. Office hours help if you're not sure with the material and he's willing to help you. Class was only graded by 2 tests, which is scary so you have to be on top of things. Tests were usually free response.

Dr. Murn is a very nice professor but his portion of molecular biology was based off of one test. His test questions were vague and the study guide wasn't helpful for what material was on the exam. He tended to go off on a tangent and would not address all the material that is important. He's a smart guy but lacks in his ability to teach.

took her intro to korean film class thinking itd be fun or interesting. apparently not. her and the tas never gave me feedback or grade for a single assignment. i came to every single class period and STILL FAILED. her and the tast are impossible to reach

i cant believe i failed a class that youd think would be easy
The department chair, dean, and academic advisors had to have a private conversation with her about how unethical she was being as a professor.
The good reviews on here gotta be lying, she was actually a nightmare on every aspect-

Professor Jeong isn't as bad as the other ratings suggest. She's a bit scatterbrained, doesn't smile, and is a dry presenter but her lecture content is engaging and she's a very lenient grader. You have to put in effort to fail and she's very understanding about personal circumstances.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Even though I got a semi decent grade her class was EVIL. She was hard to reach, changed how the class was formatted mid quarter without even telling the class about it. Attendance was mandatory which isn't uncommon for a class. But, herself and the TA's didn't grade any of the work given throughout the quarter so we had nothing to go off of.
SIUUUUUUUUUUUUUUU
THE GOAT OF ALL TIME THE MESSI

I got an A-, but it seems like most people in my class failed. Top 3 worst profs I've ever had, and I'm a senior that's had a LOT of bad experiences... Uncaring, strict, and baits you with her syllabus (which is abhorrently vague). I feel so bad for my peers. I haven't gotten a grade lower than an A in a WHILE.
I do not pay tuition for school to be treated like that by a professor.
That was a 0/10 experience.
If a couple students get a bad grade from a professor, it is probably the students fault. If everyone in the class got a bad grade from the professor, it is most certainly the professor.
She is the type of professor that wants her students to fail.
Everything you don't want in a professor is in this professor. Beware!
All of the other ratings are true, she is the worst professor I have ever had.
She is one of those professors that has a superiority complex. She made a faulty syllabus and structure for her class and making her students take the fall for her.

I don't know what happened to her, when I picked her class she had amazing reviews. But after the way she treated my entire lecture, please avoid her. There are not many professors who are actually bad at their job, but she is one of the few that are.

Please, do not take this professor! She blindsided everyone with bad grades after acknowledging it was her fault and then created a whole headache for all her students to try and fight the grade, wasting everyone's entire winter break. If you want an easy class, take intro to chinese film or something. PLEASE AVOID HER!
By far the worst professor I have ever had in my entire academic career.

I completed all of the assignments and consistently scored between 8–10 out of 10 on the quizzes. I attended every lecture and submitted all of the required reflections. However, the reflections weren't graded until the end of the quarter, so I never received any feedback along the way to understand what I was doing well or how I could improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly, disappointed in the way this course was graded. Worked hard throughout the quarter just to be met with a C and ONE assignment in the grade book. When I asked for help, I was met with how many students faced similar issues and next quarter would be structured differently. Tanked my GPA despite my strong writing skills.

I did not have a good experience with this instructor. The class lacked structure and clarity, and feedback was rare or unhelpful. It often felt like she was disengaged and indifferent to student concerns. Overall, it was a stressful and unmotivating environment that made it hard to succeed or feel valued as a student.

This instructor was extremely disappointing. Communication was almost nonexistent, and it felt like she didn't care about students' learning or success. Grading was inconsistent and unfair, often feeling arbitrary. There was no support or transparency, making it a frustrating and unproductive experience overall.

This professor showed no concern for students. She graded quizzes well but ignored reflection submissions. All grades were posted late, with no feedback or rubric. When I asked for clarification, she refused and gave harsh, inconsistent scores. It was unfair and not professional throughout the course.

Avoid this professor! Grades were based on quizzes and reflections; I did well on quizzes but received no feedback on reflections. All grades were posted after the quarter ended, with no rubric or comments. When asked for feedback, she refused and gave harsh scores randomly.

She ignored emails and never provided feedback. On final grades, I got a D despite working hard. Her emails were condescending and insulting. She accepts she made a mistake but never did anything about it. She lacks professionalism, respect, and communication skills.

Never updated any grades or responded to any emails when asked for feedback. Day of final grades, she gave me a C? She was very condescending in her emails and was insulting. I worked hard in my assignments and she even admitted she made a mistake! Still refused to regrade assignments or explain the grade. No offense, but she shouldn't teach.

Did all assignments with strong points and good writing. Grades on quizzes and essay-based homework. No grades were ever updated. On final day, I was got a D without any reasoning. Her response felt super rude and demeaning. I put lots of effort into my work and she accepts she should've been transparent but does nothing abt it and fails you

Not sure why an intro class is graded so harsh, yet with no explanation at all! When asked for reasoning on why you got a bad score, she says she can't help you and “I'm sorry”. Gives no guidelines other than write in academic tone and word count, but failed so many students bc of harsh grades on writing assignments w no explanation! Save yourself

never take this professor, doesn't care for students at all! Class graded on quizzes and reflections; did well on quizzes but never heard back from reflections. graded them all AFTER quarter was over w no rubric or feedback so students can't track performance. When you ask for feedback, she refuses to! Gives harsh scores bc she feels like it

I completed all assignments with strong points and good writing. Weekly quizzes and essay-based homework. No grades were updated. On the final day, I was given a D without prior feedback. Her response felt dismissive and slightly insulting. I put lots of effort into my work but she refused to review, regrade my assignments or even reconsider them.

Her entire quarter she did not update any grades or respond to any emails. At the last day for final grades she gives me a D. She was very condescending in her emails and was almost insulting. I put a lot of work into my assignments and although she admitted she made a mistake, she refused to regrade my assignments or even look at them.

MCS and KOR 047 ARE THE SAME CLASS BTW !!

good prof and i had friends in the class take her because she is known to be "easy" & failed or got low C & are upset when they did not take the class seriously. shes a very polite person & I think people lost the narrative college is not supposed to be taken lightly. stop taking advantage of professors!

Weekly quizzes & lectures. Attended every lecture and my average quiz score was a 10/10. My discussion prompts were clear, coherent, and responded to her requirements, however, I ended with a B in this class. She never updated grades and did not give us a rubric for our assignments so students were not given the chance to track their performance.

Did all the assignments with good points and writing. No midterms or finals, just 1 quiz every week. I did every assignment and quiz on time but ended the class with a C? Super harsh on grading the writing assignment and did everything I asked her to in the writing assignments. No AI usage at all and just pure research and note-taking.

Professor Jeong is a really bad lecturer and she seems a little scary, but she's really nice and her lower div classes are easy credits. Weekly quizzes are based on slides which are on Canvas. Discussions are just weekly or biweekly responses to the movies. There are readings, but you aren't tested on them. And no midterm or final!

i had her for the fall and the first few classes were in person, but she had to switch to online due to her personal reasons. even when switching to online, she made sure to make the lecture entertaining, although it ended up being boring HAHA. i still really enjoyed having her as my professor for this class!
Her lecture is a little boring, but she is an easy grader and has no midterm and final!! Weekly quiz(ten multiple choices) and tiny paper(one page) so if you want easy credits take her KOR047.

really enjoyed her class. shes extremely knowledgable in what she teaches. highly recommend her class if you want to learn something interesting without it being just for credits. Shes really sweet and easy to approach. love that she records some lectures too. it made it easier for someone that doesn't have good wifi connect 24/7

At first, I was really scared of Professor Jeong, but she is incredibly smart and can be sweet. She might come off a bit crass and cold, but I dont think she means it. Yes, you are required to do some heavy reading before every lecture, but its only to prepare you for what she talks about in class. Overall, she was great.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is a very intelligent woman and has a high intelligence on the topic. No official homework except (boring) readings that must be done before each class. She lectures about the material in the reading for that day. Lectures are her just talking AT the class though. No Powerpoint. Hard to concentrate for visual learners. History-heavy content.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Class is extremely dry, especially because she does not put up powerpoint slides and just talks on and on about the readings. The readings are also very boring, dry, and long, so when she talks about it in class, it's really hard to follow her. She only writes words on the board here and there but that's pretty much it to the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Jeong is a great professor! She made the class enjoyable and easy to understand. This class will be a piece of cake for native Koreans. The class consists of:  Quiz Total: 30% Homework Total: 20% Formal Presentation on Korean Culture: 10%  Film Essay (1-2 pages): 10% Midterm Exam:  15%  Final Exam:  15%

If you got this far, this class should be a breeze. There's just a few workbook pages to do each day. She required a PPT presentation related to Korean culture (speaking all in Korean of course) on a topic of our choice. There was a final exam.

TA but no discussion. No homework. TA grades the exams and hands them back. Very easy to talk to. Quite a number of non Koreans who took the class and did well. Very interesting material covered so I don't recommend skipping class!

Class was an easy A, not even Korean. Allows for 3 absences, uses sign in sheet everyday. Don't buy books, just go to lecture. Download the questions before lecture; she goes over all the exact answers in class. Best to type them out, sometimes she goes fast. 95% of the tests are exactly the same as the questions she posts (exception of movies) GL!

Professor Jeong is one of my favorite professors! She is extremely helpful and intelligent and will explain things more clearly if you just ask. It's not an "easy A" class. You'll have to put in a lot of effort, but it will be worth it and you will learn a lot.

probably my favorite professor at ucr!! she does take attendance but going to class its't bad at all, time passed by quickly because the material's so interesting. grades fairly, just do your work. now that the class ended i actually miss it! i might take her again for a class i don't even need just cus she's that awesome!

I found the essays and midterm(final I'll have to see)fairly easy - A's on everything. She honestly gets boring at times, as do some of the movies shown in screening. However, I believe if you just suck it up and take notes and study hard, you should be fine. And she is not biased towards Koreans - I'm not Korean, yet I'm doing well in the class.

Strict. Takes attendance, docks points, docks letter grade if you miss more than 3 classes. Too much reading, expects you to read long, boring readings. Note enough class activity. No organized notes. No power point notes, writes on board and talks about something else. All her exams are in a bluebook. If you dont go to class, you will fail!

Rambles and rambles in her lectures. Goes all over the place making it really hard to follow even though she has discussion questions for students to follow. Demeanor can be from slightly playful to seriously pissed off, mainly the latter. I had a hard time approaching her because she looked so angry sometimes. Wish she would lighten up a little.

This teacher is really awesome. The readings are extremely interesting. Participation is extremely important, and I know as a fact many people do not want to participate at Riverside, but if you want an A in this class raise your hand every day. Doesn't grade too harshly, midterm and final were simply from her very informative notes.I RECOMMEND !

Her lectures are incomprehensible.  She will ramble on from subject to subject, write something on the board then talk around it never quite elucidating a point.  The screenings are incredibly boring and often not relevant.  She is biased towards her Korean students and even had us watch a film in Korean without subtitles.

This is my 3rd time taking Simmers, and I will always recommend her to everyone!! She's one of the few who understands we have a life outside the classroom. Lectures are engaging, and she uses real-world examples. Workload is also light, and you can easily secure an A if you do all assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: shes the best soc prof here

Dr. Simmers is a very caring professor who has a lot of passion for what she teaches. Her lectures are short yet informative, and there are weekly assignments and bi-weekly quizzes. No midterm, no final. Class does rely extremely heavily on the textbook so its absolutely necessary to read it.

I took her at my community college for Intro to Sociology and really enjoyed it! This class was also amazing. Lectures are optional and posted online, there is no midterm or final, but she is very inconsistent with classes (she tends to cancel a lot). I was not a fan of her TA (Neel Thakkar) but other than that I really loved this class.

She is amazing. She makes the classroom feel so safe and accepting. She gives great lectures and lets us go early. She has cancelled quite a few classes but her slides seem to give enough information for the quizzes. She has no final or midterm, only a weekly assignment and quiz. Attendance in discussion is extra credit. She is amazing! Take her !

People saying Dr Simmers is a really easy A are right, but that does not make her a bad teacher. I learned a LOT in her class. She is very kind, and she clearly really cares about what she is teaching. Weekly assignments and no midterm or final. Very chill environment that opens up room for conversations and passion

Class is an easy A. Just beware that it's VERY easy to prove her wrong. Sociology is basically a group of opinions not supported by facts. Many of us proved her wrong and her response was “Well I have a doctorate!”. It cracked us up.

shes an ok professor but flaky. she canceled class last minute for over half the quarter and at one point we thought she was gonna drop the quarter. assignments/quizzes were easy for the most part and discussion is extra credit. however her last test had many questions on things that were NEVER covered. its still easy to pass this class though.
Easy class, fully online. Lectures were posted online, no need to attend lecture. Discussion paticipation was given extra credit for. Quizzes were posted late sometimes tho. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Simmers was amazing when I had her in the Fall. Unfortunately, she had to take medical leave, but the TA who took over the class was still interesting. I'd definitely take her class again if she returns - easy A and engaging lectures. Unstuck ai was a big help for exam prep too.

professor is very passionate about the topics and kind to students. i've taken her classes before but this specific class was unorganized and she would sometimes forget to posts quizzes (later waived). it may have just been a rocky quarter for her. regardless, this class is very easy to get an A in and i would recommend.
The class felt lost and at times, it felt that the professor had given up on the class itself. There is not much to say, but sort of straight forward on the assignments.

Class was asynchronous. Pre-recorded lectures that are easy to follow and used for quizzes. Weekly assignments that are fairly easy for summer. TA was super nice and helped boost your knowledge. Take soc001 with simmers if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Too bad she wasn't back for WINTER quarter, she was amazing in the Fall. We were stuck with a T.A who ended up being the head of the sociology department, he was interesting to say the least...
 I think she left on medical leave and has not came back... she will be missed
professor was really cool and very engaged with all of her lectures. Sadly did not get to have her all semester due to medical leave but if you get the chance to take her, do it!

No finals or midterms but a quiz every 2 weeks based on reading or assigned videos or lecture. An assignment every week with 2-3 prompts short answers based on readings/assigned videos which may take up some time, it's due by every midnight Sunday. The discussions are extra credit attendance, so they are not mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Simmers is a very caring instructor for her students. She makes the class as easy as she can for us to actually understand the material but to also not put too much pressure on us. She also emphasizes mental health which I have never experienced in a professor before.

Dr. Simmers is an amazing professor and I had a great time taking her course. She is extremely passionate about sociology, super kind, and funny. She tells a lot of stories as examples for what she is talking about, making it easy to understand. If you do all of the assignments, its an easy A from a lovely professor. No final or midterms!

Hands down the best Professor I have ever had. The class was completely asynchronous, but even meeting with her in office hours, she is so kind and understanding. Quizzes and assignments once a week, but so so so easy.

Very funny and an easy A. The issue I have is when she is argues against by someone using facts she says I have a doctorate. It got to the point where we called it a magical doctorate. The subject is sociology and anybody with half a brain knows not to believe or trust anyone that is silly enough to major or be involved in it.

Great pro, easy A. Only a few assignments and I did not have to attend any zoom meetings which is a plus. No materials needed to purchase (great when your in a pandemic) TA graded assignment which was weird grading but overall not bad. I try to take prof Simmers because of how good this class was & I enjoyed learning the topics used.

At Pitzer, Professor Simmers drew our attention to really important issues in society while keeping class humorous and light-hearted. She has a lot of intriguing and relevant stories to tell, and she focuses more on making class-time interesting rather than giving too much homework. Highly recommend!

I really enjoyed this class up until week 8 of the quarter. She prerecorded her lectures which were over an hour each and your grade was mostly quizzes and homework. But what sucked was when I found out about a 10 page research paper 2 weeks before it was due and she was completely unresponsive the ENTIRE quarter. She was also passive aggressive.

Professor Simmers was extremely disorganized and made it really hard to know what was going on. The class was easy but I didn't learn a thing because she never uploaded lectures for us when she said she would so all of the information for the quizzes came from articles that we were assigned to read each week. Would not take her again.

I just found her to be a little boring and monotone. She posted lectures from last spring when I think it's important to adjust to your current audience. She really wasn't understanding at all for any special circumstances (especially during covid) and completely unresponsive. I personally wouldn't recommend her. Made me change out of my soc major.

The class only consisted of weekly quizzes and assignments, which seemed more effective and much easier than a few big tests. Prof. Simmers is very laid back and approachable, even online, and I'd love to have her again if I had the chance. The syllabus was a bit confusing, but other than that the class was great.

I'm not a sociology major, but I needed this class. Even through pre-recorded lectures professor Simmers was entertaining, and made a 2 hour lecture not feel as long. I'm not changing my major anytime soon, but Simmers is a pretty solid professor if you need your sociology credits met. Class is work, but manageable.
one of the best professors ive ever had at this school. genuinely cares and teaches in an engaging way. this class never felt like work to me because of how great of a professor she is

Although I didn't get an A, I would still take her class again and she was 100% fair and I got what I deserved. She is the most kindest and understanding professor with everything that went on during Fall 2020 quarter. She was aware and understanding of the pandemic and she even gave us a week off during the election week. 10/10 professor!

Probably the best professor I've ever had!! Such an easy class and she is so understanding and kind. She let us take a whole week off for election week because of the stress. I love her so much, and I really don't understand how she doesn't have a 5.0 and a 1.0 difficulty. Go to her office hours, and talk to her!! Love her so much

This was my first class with Professor Simmers, and I'm upset that I'm about to graduate! She's absolutely incredible, and so understanding. She's one of the most human professors I've ever had. She has an excellent clear-cut teaching style, and it was a breath of fresh air, as my other professors did not.

This is my second time taking her and it is so easy. She is super chill and understanding. She gave us the week of elections off which was cool of her. Sometimes she can assign heavy reading but its rare. One of the best professors I have had here. She makes he class interesting for sure.

Absolutely amazing professor!!! The greatest SOC professor UCR has. I wish I could take her for every quarter. Asynchronous classes. 10 quizzes, 10 assignments, but we only had 8 or 9 quizzes and 10 assignments. No final, no midterm. Absolutely love her. Gave us the whole week off for election week

I've had her twice and I've completely fallen in love with her lectures and her personality. She is very "woke," straightforward and hilarious. She is always very reasonable with her expectations for the class. Her class is a real joy to be in, I would not pass up the opportunity to be in her class again.

One of the best professors ever. We had an assignment and a quiz every week. Readings were relevant and on topic. Material is taught in an accessible way and easy to understand. She doesn't want to trick you, she wants you to succeed. Her effort and teaching style reflects that.

I really liked this course. It was Gender in Global Perspectives. I gave it a lot of effort so I got a high A (99%). She is funny, intelligent and easy to listen to. It's possible to do extremely well in her class. She is not a very tough grader and gives a lot of leniency. For my course, she dropped the lowest quiz and gave an extra 10 point
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Simmers takes her time when lecturing and makes sure students get everything down from ppts. Class consist of 1 paper (3-5pages). 2 exams and final which are 15mc and 3 short answer questions. Gives short answer questions ahead of time to prepare. She chooses 3 out of 4 questions and are worded the same. *She might change syllabus around

Professor Simmers is one of the best professors I had to far. Professor Simmers is really straightforward about what she wants and on the exams. As long as you review your notes then you should be fine on the exams.

This professor does not respond back to emails, cancelled classes the day of, and gave study guides 3 days before the exam. We mostly watched films and the PowerPoint sides were based on definitions. And she goes off an tangents most of the times.

I took her class in spring 2019 the second midterm was hard. she gives you the option not to take it and it will be replaced with your first midterm grade. if you did well on the first midterm don't take the second one. extra credit available go to discussions you can get an A. overall good class.

She had a rough Spring 2019 quarter. Cancelled class a couple times and raised the difficulty of her midterms and final after she got an angry email from one of the students. Extra credit if you attend discussion and do the last synthesis. Without it, I probably wouldve had a lower grade. Final is non-cumulative
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Attend lecture/make sure to do the readings. I would do the extra credit synthesis at the end because it could make or break your final grade. First exam is the easiest, second exam is significantly harder, so don't underestimate the course. But as long as you study well and do the readings, you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took this class thinking it would be an easy A and that I would actually learn but I was sorely mistaken. She does not prepare you at all for the class and only tells stories. The only good thing about the class is that there are synthesis activities that help your grade but the class itself was horrible and I have never experienced such apathy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I wanted to take this class but was disappointed. Her lectures were personal stories that did not prepare us for the exams. Her lecture slides are just definitions. The lectures are only necessary during synthesis activities. Attend these because they will save your grade if you do horribly on the exams. A very difficult intro class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Even though I read the textbook and was so prepared, her exams were still difficult. She expects us to read, but the lectures do not help. She will tell stories on random things from her point of view, and it seems like she want us to share the same ideas with her. She is aggressive and not approachable. She always ignore my emails. Bad experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: i don't understand why some of her exam are so hard its an intro level General education class. no one cares about it.

Simmers never fails to make her classes fun and interesting. Make sure to do the readings otherwise you'll have a hard time with the exams. Uses real life examples to make the material that much more easy to grasp.

Literally the best Soc Professor at UCR. I wish that I could have taken more classes with her sooner. If you get the opportunity to take any of her classes, doesn't matter the subject, just take it. They are all amazing. It's nice having a professor that actually cares about the students and what they learn. 10/10.

What an amazing professor. She is hilarious, caring, and just a joy to be around. There are a couple of in lecture assignments. Attend all of them, one is counted as extra credit. Exams are fair and straight to the point. She does not post slides so do not miss lecture. Exams are lecture heavy with a some questions on the reading. Do the readings!!
Not a hard class. Very interesting. Just read and attend lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This was a pretty easy class as long as you do the readings. Shes super chill and tells a lot of stories during lecture. I would def take her class again!

The professor cares about student's grade (she gives out extra credit which is synthesis activities). Her exams are pretty manageable (the last exam was reading comprehension but most of her exam are based on vocabularies and sociologists). I would say that missing some of her lectures is fine but she does show videos that will be on the exams.

Simmers is hilarious and her class is great. My class created a Google Doc to help study for exams, which was super helpful, and Simmers even reviewed it to make sure all the info was correct. Attend all the synthesis activities and discussion sections, they really help your grade. GO TO LECTURE! They're fun, and what she says may be on the tests!!

Jennifer Simmers was an amazing professor who constantly kept students engaged. Lectures are not mandatory but you have to show up for the synthesis. Read book and just take notes on lectures and you will get an A. Discussion classes were pointless. First class where I actually wanted to attend the lectures.
Her lecture was so fun and she had great sense of humor !!!! you wont regret taking her class
She doesn't upload her slides online.

She is so funny! There was never a dull moment in class. Make sure to get the book and READ because her exams are unpredictable and may include random things that you may not get if you dismissed the readings. Super approachable and very open about certain topics, so don't take things too seriously. Only had two exams and no Final, so study!

Simmers is hilarious. Her lectures can become invasive and personal but you'll get used to it. There's a lot of reading but I did probably half and got an A. She has weekly activities that you show up for and get credit. I would take her again if i could. I learned a lot from her notes. She really knows how to intrigue you and keep you interested.

Professor Simmers is the BEST professor at UCR. You do have to read many articles but if you read them and pay attention during her lectures you will pass. I did not read for the two midterms and I got a C's but the 13 points extra credit she gave out I ended with an A.

Simmers is one of the best professors you'll ever find. Her slides are clear but not posted online, she tells you the funniest stories to go along with the lesson and gives you an opportunity for "extra credit"; just pay attention to the guidelines. Tests are based of readings and lecture; 2 midterms and a final (both easy if you put in some work.)
Best professor I have ever had.
Simmers was pretty cool. Her stories were entertaining and the class was interesting. The only thing that sucked were the readings :(. I totally failed one of the midterms but still ended with a B

Dr. Simmers is the best professor at UCR. She is hilarious and lectures are never boring. Be prepare to read but if you go to lecture and read the assigned reading you will pass. Test are not long and are not tricky. Definitely take her and the synthesis activities are super fun and easy.
There was never a time in this class where no one laughed. I found this class very enjoyable and enlightening. There is a lot of reading, but the class is very worth taking again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Prof Simmers is a very hilarious professor who brings up her own personal experiences and very easy to understand examples to help connect the real world to what we are learning in the course. Attendance is not mandatory but she does not post her notes online so its better to go to class. She really cares about her students and was a great teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Simmers is very funny and her tests are pretty straightforward. They are straight from the notes, which you have to go to class to get. There are readings assigned that are on the exam as well so make sure to do those. She's pretty funny and I would recommend taking her class.
Professor Simmers is a really good sociology professor, if listen and read you will pass with an A

Dr. Simmers is a charismatic and caring professor and mentor. I went to her freaking out about the next midterm and she calmed me down and reassured me. She gave the class free points on the midterm. 2 Midterms total and a 1 final all mult. choice. She has fun synthesis activities. Her lectures are engaging and interesting. She makes you talk.

I absolutely loved her lectures, they were always very entertaining and productive. The way she taught the material we had to learn was through stories that she had and they were always very funny. She knows exactly how to keep the class engaged.

Professor Simmers is hands down my favorite professor at UCR so far. She's so funny, and her lectures are never boring. Her exams are fairly easy if you pay attention and read all the articles she assigns. She doesn't post her notes online so you actually have to attend class to get the material, but it's worth it.
Honestly, super funny
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

Simmers is by far my favorite prof at UCR. She's the reason why I decided to major in sociology. Lectures are entertaining and interesting. This class is an easy A, just go to her lectures because she doesn't post powerpoints and do the readings. Tests are 20 questions.

really funny and makes sociology001 a fun class to take, lots to reading, depending on whether it's mwf class or mw class there are synthesis which you need to participate in, lots of reading and participate in discussion, need to go to class to take notes or else need to ask others for it, need to do read and study to do well on midterm, no final

She's real funny and makes lectures entertaining.
She is really

professor simmers is honestly the most hilarious professor ever, she doesn't have a filter at all. a lot of people complained that we didn't actually learn anything but she made class really fun. my only issue that isn't really an issue is that i had a c for almost the whole class and got a c on the final but ended up with an a in the class.

She was a really funny professor. Although attendance isn't mandatory I never missed lecture because her lectures were just so entertaining. I just skimmed through her readings most of the time and I got an A. Her readings can be lengthy but they count for the 2 midterms. We had no final. I am taking another one of her classes again and am excited.

reviews.comment: Took this class fall of 2016 and wow! what an experience. Best Sociology teacher (in my opinion) at UCR! She makes sure her lectures are fun and educational so there's no reason not to go. She didn't require a textbook but she did give a list of readings that you had to complete every 2 weeks (Average 5-8 articles every 2 weeks for 10 weeks)

Dr. Simmers is the type of professor you can tell cares for her students. She's very upfront in lecture about the matters discussed which helps a lot, I mean it's sociology of course it can be disturbing. Dr. Simmers covers all the material and allows us to review on it through her synthesis activities. She's honestly an inspiring professor.

reviews.comment: SHES POPPIN.  go to class. READ READ READ. go to office hours. and you'll be fine. reviews.comment: She is the best professor I've ever had. Not a lot of work. Easy test if you follow her lecture notes.

But in lecture, Simmers often doesn't even show us more than two slides of the PPT because she is storytelling. She definitely makes us think about social matters/issues though.

reviews.comment: She's really blunt. Lecture can make people world weary (if they aren't already). It's a really easy class and Simmers gives thought-provoking lectures.

She's so funny and super easy. I enjoy her class every single time i show up. Test are easy if you study. A lot of readings. I only read for the first midterm... other than that, this class is super chill. I studied 2 days before the final and I did fine.

Very unorganized and frequently canceled class. We were surprised if she did show up to class, and often she would show up 15 mins late. I did not learn anything in class.

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've had. She does not teach the material that she tests us on. Do NOT take this class!

reviews.comment: We had 2 midterms and a final, 30pts each. Do the readings and you should be fine. Simmers is hilarious and a great speaker, but would sometimes go on extreme tangents for the entire class instead of teaching relevant material. Group, in-class assignments every Friday, so at least go to those.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Simmers is really funny and her lectures are really entertaining. To get an A in this class you just need to do the required readings and understand them. Also write down her notes word to word and memorize them for her tests. Also participate in discussion and you will for sure get an A. I would love to retake the class and the teacher.

Dr. Simmers is awesome! She's hilarious and can definitely relate to all her students. She is very open and very funny professor. There are 5 exams worth 30 points each. However, you can do the flash mob to replace the final. The tests, despite what people say, are a little tricky so go to discussion. Easy class. Got a 96 percent. You can too. :)

I really enjoyed going to lecture. They were always fun and interesting. I honestly thought her class was pretty easy. There are 4 test that are usually taken every other week. Also, she gave us a chance to either do a final exam (30 questions just like her other tests) and a flash mob. I took the final and passed the class with an A. Plus no hw!

I've never had a professor like professor Simmers. She is very nice and very funny! It was so easy for her to lighten up the mood in the class when we are having a discussion about difficult topics that in general are very difficult to address. If you take her class you will always look forward to going to lecture.

TAKE NOTES OF HER SLIDES and STUDY THOSE NOTES and you'll do fine, she makes her tests from her lectures. Very cool, down to earth & relatable. Doesn't care about attendance, but you'll miss out on a lot if you don't have good friends in the class to update you. Sit up front, smile at her, participate, make sure she knows & sees you (it'll help)

Simmers is a great professor, I really enjoyed her lectures although they aren't really mandatory. Class is made up of 5 tests based on readings posted on iLearn. If you actually read the articles, you'll be fine.

Dr. SImmers is very light hearted and Hilarious. She bring up tense issues, but makes everyone comfortable. You could say she doesn't care what anyone thinks of her and that translates into her down to earth and hilarious demeanor. Awesome Prof!!!

Enjoyed this class because she was hilarious but also learned a lot. Readings were hard to decipher & take notes on, esp. since her midterms were only 25pts, questions are a little tricky & you don't always know exactly what she's looking for. Don't wait until week of midterm to start studying. She has random in-class assignments so go to class.

She's pretty funny most of the time but sometimes you get red from embarrassment for her. Yeah, it's a mixed bag. 5 tests, that's the whole class. She does not post slides, and her lectures aren't based on reading. So you have to go to class, AND do the reading. But her tests are easy if you have done both. Section is NOT mandatory. I never went.

Simmers is a great professor. She has a lot of enthusiasm and passion, which really shines through so that the class is not dull and boring. The class is in general not too hard. There are assigned readings for the week that get excessive at times, but she goes over them. The tests are short and ask very general questions about the readings.

Prof Simmers is so down to earth and just a funny professor. I enjoy her lectures, especially the way she makes the concepts relatable to real-life examples that makes it a lot more easy to understand. Her exams are usually not long, 30 questions. Straight to the point. No tricks. If attend lecture and study notes, easy A.

Such a hilarious professor! I always looked forward to coming to her lectures because they made me happy and put me in a good mood! She connects her powerpoint lectures to her life, which makes it all the more interesting. Her lectures are both entertaining AND educational! But get ready to read and test like crazy. There's a test every other week.

I went to almost no lectures and I got an A. Piece of cake. You have 5 test (we had 4 because our final was a flash mob). If you do the reading you get an A if you don't then good luck. Got the notes from a friend because you do need the notes too but only about 2 pages front and back worth of notes per test. She is super hilarious and really chill

She is a very laid back professor. Her lectures were always short because she would spend a lot of time telling stories that related to the slides. You have to know the main points of each reading in order to pass the test.
Most funny professor I've had. Loved her, wish I could have more classes with her as the professor.

Fall 2014 Simmers made me actually want to go to class to hear what she had to share and teach everyday.  She taught the class using common life events which most people understand and can easily relate to and was funny doing so.   The grade was solely based on readings which were fairly easy, and were discussed in section to make it even easier!

Professor Simmers made the class interesting. She's hilarious and the lecture is never boring! There's a short test every other week, but most of the questions are common sense. 5 tests, no projects or papers. HW is just "reading" the articles. Just skim the articles and you'll do fine on the tests.

A crack up every class. Interesting lectures and talks alot about her personal life. Tests are short which makes them kinda hard.  Fair amount of reading, the book is boring. Fun in class discussions.  Overall a good professor.

Professor Simmers was my professor for Sociology for Fall 2014 and honestly she was great. The tests didn't demand too much, just readings and lectures. Her lectures are basically stories from her life that she tries to intertwine with the concepts of the class; she can be funny and she appreciates student participation.
Loved loved loved the way she taught this class! The material itself was uninteresting but she made it extremely fun to learn. She's great. Take her if you want to be amused lol
Why do they let someone like this teach.
She is great, makes class fun and interesting.  Very helpful and honest.

She was helpful, but then again the class was somewhat hard so we needed all the help we could get. She can be lenient but can sometimes use time in class to go on and on about things that have nothing to do with class and aren't really that interesting.
she was very helpful....all you have to do is read your textbooks...
Jennifer is amazing! She will keep the material interesting and help you at all times! Take her if you get the opportunity.
Greatest teaching assistant ever!

Final-50%, Midterm-20%, Attendance-10%, HW-20%. He is very passionate but just not an amazing teacher, he's just not very clear in how everything connects and doesn't fully explain or even finish the example problems that he goes over in class. But I cannot really complain cuz 80% on the exams is just knowing what formulas to use. Overall six-seven

reviews.comment: Professor Wu is a very caring and passionate professor. All tests are open note and open book, however the content in this course is very difficult. He likes to lecture from his knowledge instead of having a clear chronological method. His lectures were all over the board, and he did not have a clear direction of what he was teaching. He was disorganized. We had to figure out on our own what content he was teaching. He is very smart and passionate.
Good effort for teaching this, he has a passion for what he does. his english is a little off but you get used to it. the midterm and the final are fair. just do the homework and ask questions.

He really tries to get us to understand the material, he used powerpoints for my class which were virtually worthless because i never actually followed. However he uses the book alot and those examples are good. test is fair, not easy but not impossible.
Dr. Wu really cares about his students and is willing to help out. I learned a lot from him.

Very difficult to understand, His lectures were basically worthless for me.  I felt very unprepared for the final even though I probably spent more time on this class than my others.  Wish I had a better thermo teacher.

This professor is really smart, but he does not know how to teach. He makes stupids feel stupid when they go to his office hours or ask him how to solve problems. He needs to learn how to not be rude to students when they ask him for help.

His lectures are very hard to follow. Has a bit of an accent and very monotone. No midterms, just quizzes. Quizzes are conceptual, Final is not so is very hard to study for the final. He is a bit of a jerk, if you ask him a question he'll give you attitude or make you feel stupid.

Clear and easy to understand, straightforward with what he wants you to take from the class. If you follow each lecture and do the homework in a timely fashion, you shouldn't have a hard time mastering his exams because its mainly a reflection of the     HW.

I took this prof before for ENVE 176. This class made me realize that what I knew about knitting before this class was based on faulty intelligence. I got a B on the assignment. It doesn't get any better than this... I should know, I know all about geology.
He'll give you a D in the class and announce it in front of the whole class. totally not cool
Avoid. Doesn't explain concepts well & test are extremely hard
Beware, this professor will report you to conduct for any little mistake. Course content is straightforward and not hard if you show up to lecture.

Professor C was nice. This class is not an easy A though. The formatting of the research proposal instructions was pretty poor but I think that's just the class format and not the professor's fault. He gives a lot of EC. You have 5 quizzes every 2 weeks which sounds bad but if you stay on top of lectures, they're easy. Final exam too!

One of my favorite professors I have had at UCR. He is extremely caring, he makes the concepts and lectures so easy to understand and he really cares about the style of teaching in order for his students to succeed. The difficulty of the research paper really depends on your TA though. His quizzes were pretty easy as long as you go to lecture.

One of the best professors I've had at UCR. His lectures are so entertaining and informational, and he really cares about his students! Go to lectures, complete the textbook readings, do the Inquizitives, and you will succeed! Overall this class was a 10/10 for me.

I really loved this class, Dr. Calanchini was kind, inspiring, and great at teaching. The class is set up in a way to allow you to learn the material, and nothing assigned feels redundant or unnecessary. His lectures are extremely interesting and he made himself available to students often. Definitely would take a class with him again

It's kind of hilarious that people think any English 4 class is going to be easy. But I guess that's why this site is not that helpful. But this teacher is laidback and organized. I'd take another English class with him.
Clear and nice teacher. Go to office hours and you'll be fine. Honestly, it's not that bad; it's just college isn't supposed to be easy.

The teacher is nice. I got a lot of feedback on my writing too. The class was hard but the school makes it that way. It's not a specific teacher thing. I'm not a great writer, and I did fine. So I would recommend!

Took his course last year. Prof Winter plays favorites, especially toward the women in the class. He's overly eager to help them and responds instantly, but if you're a guy, expect to wait. The energy was off. A few of us picked up on some uncomfortable behavior that felt a little too familiar and inappropriate. This dude is unprofessional.

You'll spend more time trying to decode the assignment than writing it. He's passionate, but it's hard to follow someone who forgets due dates, changes rubrics on the fly, and still gives you a C+ for “clarity.”
Will tell you one thing, then change his mind mid-sentence. Thinks he's right 100% of the time, until he's not. Grading feels completely random. I got better feedback from Grammarly.

Genuinely a nice person, but so disorganized it becomes stressful. Constantly forgets deadlines, rubrics, and what he said the class before. Feedback on essays felt rushed, like he skimmed the first paragraph and called it a day.
Hard to follow, hard to pass. Feedback doesn't line up with grades. Doesn't feel like a class meant to support learning.

Strict grader, vague instructions, and no room to ask questions.

Doesn't explain expectations clearly and grades harshly. No feedback makes it hard to improve. Would not recommend unless you're okay playing guessing games.

reviews.comment: Very kind but suffers from ADHD, very forgetful. Will argue with you on things he is clearly wrong about, then realize he was wrong at the end of class. professor expects a lot and is very eerie

not the best but absolutely not the worst

Good class for what it is

reviews.comment: Nice and organized. You need to do the work, though
Great! A lot of sour grapes comments here.

Had him online of summer 21 so that I could clear my ELWR... passive aggressive emails when I ask harmless questions. Went to his OH for paper review and solidifying my ideas, kind of helped? We had the opportunity to rewrite 1 of 3 papers (besides the final paper) if it got under a C. Difficult + not much time to do so bc of the amount work given.

reviews.comment: My first English course and it was nothing but torture. Many students stopped coming to class and I probably know why. Class activities almost made me fall asleep, class work was so unnecessarily long I had to do it for homework, homework was graded like you were submitting an application to Yale. Lastly, a C- to C is the highest grade he gives.
The highest score of our class didn't reach 80%. His score is very strict. It's difficult for you to get B from him. The highest score of several essay with a full score of 250 is 190

There were 4 essays for this class that he made us turn in with a packet. The packet was graded fairly, but the essays were graded very hard. He leaves comments on each of the essays that could help if you go to the office hours and go over it with him. Overall, his class was not bad just sit through the lectures and do his work and you'll be fine.

Four speeches. He gives a rubric of what he wants but he's a pretty tough grader. He also gives a lot of journal writing and he toughly grades those too. LOTS of group work. Be prepared for lots of group work. Lots of class participation too. I wouldn't take this class again because of the amount of group work and class participation he wants.

Professor Winter is honestly not that bad. He does many activities throughout class and puts in the effort to come around to help us with questions. Even though he does have many powerpoints, they are given to us to help us improve our writing. If you follow his advice, it is definitely not hard to get an A in the class

reviews.comment: Nope. Nope. Nope. It is presentation after presentation with this professor. There is no interaction, there is no assistance. I am barely within my third week in the quarter and I am so done. He has no personality and makes turn in a huge packet of papers alongside with your final draft. He is unacceptable, would not recommend.
