reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She does not post her slides online, you must attend in person. Take notes, and listen the songs thoughtfully because you will be quizzed in the discussion and tests. Mostly multiple choice, true/false, and listening. Listening questions (require active listening) must be in your own words using music language explaining why the song is important.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is a nice professor. Class was a lot more work than I expected. I don't mind writing, but the weekly assignments for this class were so difficult to sit down and finish because of long, complicated readings and 4 page analyses of those readings. Go to class as she has a sign in sheet every lecture. No dropped assignment and rarely emails back.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Homework: listen to music and analyze the techniques used; read short passages for quizzes in discussion Class: most things taught in class are subject to be on midterm/final Quizzes/Midterm/final: study guide almost identical and select music subject to be on test Overall: An EASY A with minimal effort; highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Weekly assignments on long readings with a thousand word responses. Takes points off but doesn't give a good reason. Final project is worth 50 percent of your grade. She's a nice person though so if you talk to her you may be able to boost your grade.
Marks everything partially wrong.
Tests on random facts and does not post powerpoints online.
This class was fun. Midterm & final were very easy but make sure you attend lecture because she won't post them online. Weekly quizzes and no textbooks. Overall, good professor and class.
This class was very interesting! No book. One midterm and one Final. Mandatory to attend lecture because she will not post the notes. Heard very good music and had presentations to do.

Easiest I have ever taken in my life. Everything is online and Prof makes a weekly checklist of everything that's to be done that week. In-class Activities/quizzes big part of grade + required. Just check your canvas to see what will happen and you'll be okay. Every assignment and quiz were extremely easy. Done in 20 mins tops.

Professor Sang-Hee is very smart and inspirational. HOWEVER, As a student - I found her teaching method to cause unnecessary complexities that are not required. Ex: Professor provided a second option to take a quiz but would NOT give us our original score. one of the most unnecessarily difficult considering her personality is bubbly and kind.

Weekly quizzes, discussions, activity. Quizzes timed not enough time to work on. Group work was HORRIBLE. People do not do their part her answer is to deal with it. Same answer when students expressed concerns. Everything all over the place, date changed constantly. Some hw due mid-week giving us only 2 days to do it. Not open to hearing students.

Hell no. Extremely disorganized and will assign assignments with due dates all over the week. You have to check constantly for anything new; very difficult to get into a rhythm with. Has conducted classes in different classrooms than the assigned, with last minute notice. Lazy grader, will rely on student screenshot submissions instead of checking.

I was very excited to take this class but left feeling disappointed. Her exams seemed like a second thought because the lectures and exams didn't correlate much. Her assignments werent explained and the due dates frequently changed. Many students didnt even know that the final project was due when it was and found out after the fact. Dont take.

I love Dr. Lee! I took this class my first quarter after transferring as it was also my first Anth class. I came in as a psych major and left her class as an anth major. She has much enthusiasm and loves this subject. She jokes a lot and she seems more like a human being than a lot of professors. Uses clickers, so go to class cause it's easy points

I absolutely adore Prof. Lee!! She is really excited about the subject, which gets people pretty excited too. She is extremely nice, sweet, and funny. Her class is really easy. Great Prof. she is amazing. she uses creative teaching methods. yeah there is work but hello its college no one said it was going to be easy!.. take her one of my favorite courses.

class is appropriatley difficult but she is super. easy to talk to, fast with e-mails, helpful and actually wants you to understand the material and gets really excited when you do. shes great. love her!

this class is so damn hard. not an easy A but an easy F or D. dont ever take it. the lecture is hard to stay awake just don't take it. but the TAs are cool...I LIKE THEM!!..but the class in general is not easy..

But he doesn't do power points so you have to pay attention in lectures and do the reading, which are long e-reserves and book readings. Lots of reading. The material isn't very hard though

Lectures are boring because he rambles a lot and does not provide details on the readings. There are textbook readings, online readings, and a boom for the term paper. Overall, there is a lot of reading that does not help at all. Take home easy for midterm and final, term paper, 4 quizzes, 1 gets dropped. The quizzes are very detailed.
Very cool guy but the lectures are a bit boring. There is a lot of reading that has to be done and a number of written assignments but if you need help he is extremely helpful.
Oblivious to students workload. The amount of reading we had to do each week was impossible. You'll get through it. But do not take unless you absolutely have to.

Ok, in the beginning I got super frustrated due to the tremendous amount of readings he assigned, but then the midterm and final are take home essays! there are 4 quizzes 20% total (based on the readings and the text book)this is the difficult part for me, just try to study for them. Shouldn't be too bad.

He is horrible. For a breadth class, he assigns WAY too much reading. With the chapter reading, the extra textbook readings, and many e-readings, it's just way too much too handle. If I was a history major, the workload would have been appropriate. Don't take it unless you're really interested in reading about 60 pages of world history per week.

He is very passionate about what he teaches. He talks alot and gets a little boring at times but he is a great teacher. cares about students. Assigns ALOT of reading. you have to go to class to get info for tests but overall class is an easy A.
Another far left ideologue, whose only job is to try and indoctrinate every young student he can.

Great Teacher!Teaches more about the culture in history rather than the facts. had him in the summer of 2011 does not use powerpoints just straight oral lectures the only thing i did not like was he would assign over 80 pages a week to read but only give us 10 multiple choice questions. there was no need to make us read that much for only 10 MP ?'s
straightforward, clear, & real to objectives...he is not pushy and is sympathetic to students' needs

Pretty good teacher. There is a good amount of reading, but no assignments. Just short multiple choice tests and an essay to turn in on exam days. Lloyd was nice and seemed interested in the subject he taught.

In order to pass his class I recommend actually going to lectures because everything he talks about ends up in the midterm and final. His exams consits if multiple choice and a essay which he hands out a week in advance. Overall easy class.

first rating ever, so thought I should put this out there. He does not really teach history, its more of a english literature class than upperdiv history. He assigns a lot of literature to read EACH week, and overall you really don't learn much about history. Grades on english literacy of the novels rather than hard facts.

Really down to earth guy,great learning experience. Can go off tangents but try to keep up draws alot of Multiple Choice from lecture. Make sure to go to lecture as the book is useless and skips around alot. Gives Final Essay Q's ahead of time so just type them up before the final so you know what you are gonna write and go over your notes for MC

I have taken 2 classes w/ himand will take more. Dr. Lloyd is super cool and own to Earth, always willing to help.  If you don't like history, some classes can be dry cuz he just lectures, but there really isn't much you can do w/ it if you don't like history, it is what it is.  Lloyd is awesome though, highly recomend.

There's 1 midterm and 1 final both with multiple choice & 1 essay. DON'T GO TO CLASS!!! IT'S NOT WORTH IT! If you read the book or wikipedia everything, you'll do fine for the multiple choice. For the essays, he gives out the prompts before hand and one of them is on the test. So outline those and you're good to go. Fairly easy, I ended up with a B

I honestly think he's a good professor, but seriously, am I the only one here who thinks he talks WAY too fast? I mean, 20th century history is an extremely broad topic that covers an extensive amount of time which is difficult to absorb to begin with, and combined with the fact that he can pull out information in a minute is just ridiculous.

Honestly I don't know if it's just me, but I feel like I'm never learning in this class. ALL Lloyd ever does is talk, talk, talk. You lose students' attention easily like that. All he does is put an outline on the overheard and just elaborates on it. Not very thrilling. And I could care less about the whole rock and roll thing...

One of the coolest teachers ive had. He plays guitar and actually played at our first lecture of the course as part of his lesson! He rambles on sometimes but he throws in some of his own humor which makes attending lectures fun. Overall great professor.

As with most req classes, this class is extremely dull although I am a history major. However, Proffesor Lloyd tries to make the class engaging and has several interesting ideas and tangents to tie into the subject examined during class. However, the additional reading on top of the required text is VERY large and he likes q's from those readings.
Had some interest in this class before I took it. Blew away my preconceived notions of rock and roll. Got to read the material, tho. Easy to get an A if you're interested in the subject.

VERY chill, likes to go off on tangents but overall, sticks to his material. Provides little-known tidbits and basically leaves the class up to you. He presents his material (which is relatively engaging) and lets you synthesize it. His papers are doable the night before and his topics cover material that can be improvised w/ a good opinion. A++
boring teacher. get the right ta. he babbles a lot on useless information so it's easy to already know the subject from your own experience than learning it from him.

He is a great teacher. I don't understand where the other comments about him being a bad teacher come from. He is a very laid back professor WHO does care for the students. Problem is...students don't care about the subject. So IT IS the STUDENTS who should re-valuate their priorites. Fun class, though.

I have taken 3 classes from professor Lloyd & I think he is a great teacher! He chooses engaging texts, is a fair grader & his lectures are fabulous. I had him for my senior seminar & he made the paper writing process less painful. If your interested in the connection between the civil rights era & popular music culture take a class with him.
I took his rock and roll class and was very disappointed. Not good at all.
Really boring. Dull. I love history, this guy does not. Get the right TA or else you do really terrible.  Never responded to any of my emails.

I am an A/B student. The class average for history 20 was about 70%. His midterm and final really nit picks and wants real specific details and so you must read the book & pay close attention to details. Lecture is important for key points. His multiple choice is HARD! I got a "B," but that required a lot of work- more than most history professors

Prof. Lloyd is boring, but he is informative in his lectures. Maybe too much infos that overloads you even. He tends to mumble whenever he goes off-topic. But he plays his guitar for us and sings some Bob Dylan's songs. That was amazing. Overall though, not that great of a lecturer. But the class is moderately easy.
get the right ta and this is easy class. the professor is blah blah. but an easy a.

maybe it was the ta, but probably not.  this guys is really boring.  he is NEVER in his office during the posted hours and he NEVER responded to my email.  easy B, but really bad attitude, and really not a friendly professor, seems to have a lot of anger.
Very limited in his understanding.  Avoid this class if you are into 80's and 90's rock, this guy does not know anything beyond hippie rock, and is weak even on that.

Lloyd is very interesting.  His understanding of the music and culture of Rock n' Roll music is vast.  Anyone, who takes his class, will look at the music of the 50s, 60s, and 70s in a different light.  Books are interesting.  Lloyd was an aspiring rockstar so he has a first hand understanding of the overal material.  This guy is jocked by the females in the classes he teaches.  Easy grader!
I loved Prof. Lloyd!!!  He is very knowledgeable and the books he assigned were very interesting.
He is a great teacher with alot of knowledge to impart.

I loved the history of Protest in USA in the 60's!  He started our very first class with Hendrix's National Anthem from Woodstock.  AWESOME!  Really set the tone.  Easy to understand, very helpful.  I enjoyed his essay and key terms tests.

I took his 20, which was boring but a very easy A, then took his hist of Rock and Roll.  How can someone make that subject boring and make you hate it? Take this guys class. Total boredom. No direction. Never replied to one email. This guy is stuck in the 60's and has some real issues. AVOID.

One word: ZZZZZZZZZZZZ. The most boring professor known to mankind. And he doesn't really know his history either. Someone get this man a cup of coffee. Unavaialable most of the time, and unapproachable. Asking for help was always difficult. Also, the whole rock musician/hippie is tired, so he should shelve it. Made me hate history.
The History of Rockn'Roll was awesome, I would totally recommend this class to everyone, the best is when he brings his guitar to class and plays it throughout lecture.

BORING - but really easy A.  I did not learn much, and thought my first exam was a D or F, but I got an A.  No need to go to lecture, which is a waste of time and he actually gets some stuff wrong. Never was in office during office hours.

Really poor at lecturing, eyes glued to his notes, he is very good looking, easy A as I did not learn really anything and I got an A.  Never responded to my emails, never in his office during posted hours, seems really distracted.
Very interesting class and material was presented well.
No Comments

I like this professor a lot! He gives key terms and your final essay question IN ADAVANCE.  How cool is that? I just needed the day before amidterm/final to get everything down....not that im suggesting you to do that....

Pretty straight foward and laid-back professor who used to be in a band.  Midterm, Final, and Discussion are worth 1/3 each.  He tells you exactly what will be on the MT/Final, so just memorize everything the night before, and you'll be fine.

Pretty strait foward and lets you know what to expect, but gives way to much readings. most of it is not even on the test, he stresses using the text book, but evey thing you need is in his lectures, and random other reading he gives you.
the questions of the MT and finals will be given before exams.. there's only Terms to define and questions to answer... no multiple choice though.. is all writing exams.. pretty easy..

She doesn't give a workload of homework, there are many readings but not too long. The assignments are clear and straight forward. Lectures are going over what we read and informational. She lectures good and doesn't make the class drag on or make lectures boring. Overall a good professor and very respectful. Would definitely take her course again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: she's a very sweet person! lectures are pretty mandatory because she discusses everything in them, even the readings. there was a few papers and a final paper but they're fairly easy! lectures were pretty interesting and it wasn't a hard class at all.

The prof and TAs need to discuss what they teach more because sometimes what we talk about in discussion doesnt match up with what the prof says. A lot of work and it is hard to get in touch with the TAs
Kind, respectful, and straight-forward. Communicated with the class effectively and went through readings in class. Has thorough and informative slides. 10/10, would take again.

Amazing professor. You can tell she really cares about the well-being of her students. Not too many assignments. Course consists of 2 critical reflections, mid-term and final. Lecture is not mandatory however discussion is mandatory. 40% of overall grade is based on your discussion class. I did not go to lecture for the majority of the quarter.

She was a good professor, I got a little bored in the class. Attendance isn't mandatory, no exams. Discussion is mandatory, for some reason she will not put your overall grade on CANVAS, so you have to ask you TA what your overall grade is.

She really nice but during lecture she goes off topic. Make sure to attended discussion because it a huge part of your grade. You have 8 discussion post and 1 APA research paper due at the end of the course. You also have a create a loteria card. Overall okay class.
Attendance isn't mandatory, 2 critical reading responses, and midterm+ final. discussion is mandatory. she provides readings. overall super easy

I absolutely loved this professor and going to her class was always so interesting and eye opening. Even though it was an early morning class, I never saw it as a hassle to attend, that's how great she is! The overall course material was easy to understand, and I hope to take her again in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Gutierrez is great, she had us focus on doing a Loteria project for the class and it was broken down into smaller assignments due throughout the quarter which made it easier and helpful. She is very passionate about her work and also understanding. I will admit, I was intimidated by her at first LOL!

There's a lot of discussion. She's open-minded, & you can tell she cares for her students & her work. She tries to make the class engaging &  has a mix of papers & non-traditional projects. She's very in tune with campus & the community & will change the content sometimes bc of it. I highly recommend her if you like ethnic studies/chicanx studies!

The professor herself seems to really care about what she teach! But she is heavy influenced by her PHD research which tends to go off topic to the course topic. I felt as though it was upper-division but it was just an intro class.

I love Professor Gutierrez! She goes above and beyond for her students. She is a very inspirational professor and she teaches from her heart. Take this class! Very informative and was never boring! You will have a 5-page paper and you will need to create a Loteria card. The other work you do is very minimal and it's pretty simple.
Rubrics/Descriptions for assignments weren't always clear, ask TA for clarification. Other wise very easy and interesting lectures.

During COVID. She is really nice and understanding but pretty unorganized. My class relied on the groupchat because she would take a really long time to respond to emails or not respond at all (ask questions during lecture instead). TAs did most of the grading. Discussions were more like office hours. Goes over readings during lecture.
She was caring & very understanding. She answered any questions we had & is super nice! She really cares about her students.

She is very hard to reach outside of class and will not respond to emails. There are a lot of readings but she goes over them in lectures so I would go even though they arent required. She messed up due dates a couple times and gave us the wrong prompt twice which was somewhat a headache but it was fixed quickly. Papers are pretty straight forward.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Took during COVID, she was very understanding and flexible. Tied the material to our current situation, and really understood what we were going through as students. Had bi-weekly discussion posts, no midterm or final. Instead we had two short papers. One of the best education classes, she really lets you express your opinions and supports you.
Really great professor that encourages your creativity and individuality in assignments

Very passionate about education & community. No book, provides PDFs of readings that she summarizes in class. I picked 7 out of 23 to completely read based on 3 essays assigned, which were graded based on how well you can relate them to eachother and urself. 1 group project at the end, no final. Easy A if u put the effort in to understand concepts!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is honestly an inspiration to her students. She cares about the subject matter so much and her class was one of my favorites. There are many readings but considering you are looking at this, you might be interested in actually doing them. The readings fit the subject matter so well.

Prof. Gutierrez' lectures are very clear and easy to understand, you need to attend because she does take attendance. She makes sure to not require any textbooks and provides all the readings. A total of 4 papers that aren't bad at all. The class really gets you thinking about the school system.

The quarter could not have gone any slower in her class. The grading seemed as if she chose the same grade to give to everyone on assignments. Show up to class. You don't really have to read... she goes over in lecture

One of the worst experiences of my life. Grades are seemingly arbitrary. You get a score but no feedback on how to improve. Condescending during office hours and rushed me out. I think I did well in the class based on my midterm but who knows, bc she never updates grades. Week 10: 2 updates total, despite there being attendance + other assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof Gutierrez never responds to emails and is really hard to reach. Went to her office hours to tell her about my email, said she would write me down for priority, yet has not emailed me back after 2 weeks. TA's are useless and say they can't tell us what we did wrong in assignments as it is "not their job." Lectures are boring and long too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Lorena Gutierrez doesn't reply to emails often and it can be hard to reach her. But, she's nice to talk to in person. Her teaching involves lots of in class participation and partner discussion. The TAs are the ones grading. So make sure to take a good TA. Would not recommend Arturo as a TA. TA Nevarez is a tough and unfair grader.

She's a great professor no midterm or final but you have to write a lot. 3 reflection essays with 2 papers. My TA Racheal was amazing she was super nice and an easy grader. Get ready to read in this class. Tbh it all depends on your TA and how they are. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: an incredible professor who keeps an open mind and an open space for conversation. This class will make you think about things you didnt before like race, gender, ability, sexuality and anything you find is a good point of conversation. no midterms of final. there were short in class writings and a group video project + 10 page paper.

Professor Gutierrez is such a nice person and her lectures are very interesting. You have to show up to class because there was a lot of unexpected in class writing assignments. There are 3 critical reflections which weren't too bad. The midterm and final are also papers. Pretty easy class as long as you do the work.

One of the best professors I have had at this university! She is very passionate about what she teaches and you can feel it! She pushes her students to use their voices and creates an incredible and safe atmosphere in her class! Would definitely recommend to all those passionate about education!

Professor Long's way of teaching did not work for me. Entire course was self-taught. If you want to do well on his tests, you really have to understand how to derive different formulas. Some hw question is harder than exam questions while practice exam is easier than the exam. Don't bother looking at the 100 problems per chapter questions he gives.

Owen Long makes his exam different from the practice exams and homework. Both of them do not adequately prepare you for the types of problems on his actual exams. He often talked to me with a condescending tone when I asked him questions during lectures or office hours. He often seems full of himself, and is not the best at lecturing. Take Peng Wei

The practice exams and homework given are not adequate in preparing you for the exams. The professor gives out harder questions for the actual exams that you may not be prepared. Take Peng Wei over this guy to actually get a good grade. You are bound to get a B or below.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Honestly, he's just not a good teacher. Like honestly if I studied more I would have gotten an A, but you got to put so much effort outside class. I looked at RMP before, and it was bad. I thought that I can still thrive, but I was wrong. He doesn't care about you. He just wants to do Physics. Find better teacher. Multivar calc is easier than him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Owen seems more interested in hearing the sound of his own voice than actually teaching. Lectures are disorganized, with concepts rushed through without any effort. He likes to make the simplest problems seem impossible, and the explanations are often vague. When asked for clarification, you're met with impatience or a condescending tone.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Was a very tough class for a course named colors and sound. Every exam had three versions, all very different in difficulty from 1 another. For the 2nd Midterm he made a error with the copies then proceeded to remove the curve from the exam. So he punished us for his mistake. Very stressful and unorganized professor. Don't Take 08. 10, its better

Professor misled students the whole quarter. Told students to study the practice midterms and next thing you know, there is nothing similar that was on the practice exam on the exam. He accidentally gave everyone wrong exams. Some copies had only 6 questions and some had the full 21. He still continued on with the exam and wrongfully graded us.

As the quarter progressed, his class grew more confusing and challenging, with him missing deadlines and not responding to emails. After each exam and final, a practice exam was administered, however, no questions from the practice exam appeared on the real exam. His lectures were both exhausting and tedious.
Great professor gave 5% extra credit if you filled out a survey after each class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Prof. Long is a decent teacher. His lectures started out great and as the quarter went on, became less and less helpful. Make sure to read before class as he uses lectures to skim the topic as he expects you to know the concepts from reading. He gives about 5% extra credit which is great! His exams can be tricky but study enough and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: consists of mastering (~10 problems per week), pollev participation, extra credit, 3 noncumulative midterms. lectures are straightforward & easy to follow. previous exams are given as practice prior to the exam which helped a lot. midterms are straightforward & doesnt use tactics to trick you. i hate physics but i did well in this class.
Homework questions do not prepare you enough for the exam questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This teacher really cares for his students. He always does his best to make lectures engaging. He expects students to read the textbook in advance and to come to lecture prepared. He puts in a lot of effort into making his lectures and it def shows. Do not expect an easy A esp in a physics course. To prepare for tests do the hw as many book probs
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Honestly he's a good professor but his lectures are very supplementary to the reading and the homework. He uses a lot of poll everywhere questions and introduces material in lectures, but your real practice for exams will come from homework. His grading scale is nice but his exams are a bit tricky, so you'll need to put in extra effort to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: All you need to do is ask and compare the class average of Long's class to any other Phys40B teacher's class average and you'll know what your dealing with.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was a complete joke, and in the bad way. From test questions that are absurdly harder than the HW and in class questions to an absurd amount of HW, its almost like the professor wants you to not do well. If you want a more actually fair time for PHYS40B, take ANY of the other professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took Prof. Long for PHYS40B and let me tell you.. beware of this guy! His lectures are not very engaging and the material he teaches in class is way harder than what is presented in the exams. The poll questions are ridiculously easy while the conceptual questions in the exams are much much harder. Would not want to take another class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Long is a great lecturer. Enjoyed the poll questions very much which made the class engaging. Although the class was more oriented to guest speakers, on the times that Professor Long did lecture, he made it very interesting and inspiring. Overall, great professor, great class.

PHY39 is a class designed for physics majors who want to learn more about the path they are taking, and Professor Long does a great job showing us what we can do. He brings in guest speakers who have jobs in the fields he shows us and its very helpful. Grades only assignments he assigns, no tests or quizzes!

He only teaches the first half of 41C. He's a great professor. He's very clear in his lectures, and helpful in office hours. His quizzes are brutally straightforward. There's no tricks in the quizzes, but you really have to know everything he's taught.
One of the best lecturers in the department, by far. Extremely knowledgeable and very clear in lectures. Recommend him very highly.

AWFUL. Clickers during every lecture but only about 15% of the class would get the right answer. Most people were failing. Practice exams were useless. You could sit in class with no distractions and still have no idea what he's talking about. Hw= 15% Final=45%. If you MUST take him, do each of the hw problems yourself & reallyy understand them

Yeah, this guy isn't good. Tests are SUPER hard, even after he posts the solutions for the free response section. The average grade on the final exam: 46/146!! Clicker ?'s are hard. Practice tests won't help, do ALL hw problems if you want to pass.

Did well in the class, but this professor is useless. His "practice" materials are 1/10 the diff. of the actual exams. Throw in his condescending attitude to the class and poor teaching skills and you have a rough quarter.
Horrible professor. Tests are too hard and homework is much too plentiful. Absolutely hated this professor.

clicker quizzes so class is mandatory, tests are hard, majority of students failing the class. he did not even start working out problems on the board until the middle of the quarter, but he's a decent professor. the class was extremely difficult..

hard class. class average was a 15%, he speaks clear english but he goes too fast on the slides. tests are hard, no curve. he's good at teaching, but the class is just too hard. attendance mandatory cause you have clicker quizes
Helpful and fair professor.  Exams are relatively easy if you study.  Both midterm and final had perfect scores.  Only A I ever got in the 40 series...
I blew off the homework getting like 35% total, went to lecture twice, discussion once, and still passed with a C so ya.
He speaks clear English, and his lecture is related to the Exam. But the class overall is really tough.
Very good professor.  His lectures are very thorough.  Just know which equation to use during the exam and you'll do fine.
No Comments
Homework assigned by this professor is absolutely unbearable. Has little to no consideration of your time outside of class. Please avoid at all costs.
Your grade in the class is purely based off of the group evaluation for the final project. Very unfair grading structure.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took both BUS 123 &125 with Professor Gao. He's very supportive and replies to questions quickly. The classes are well-structured—if you keep up with lectures, homework and put in effort, it's an easy A. He genuinely cares about students' success, so don't be hesitate to email or join office hours. The content is also helpful for future careers!

If you need help, don't bother going to the professor. He will make you feel dumb and tell you to go rewatch hours of lectures instead of actually trying to help you.
He doesn't answer messages
Material is complex and requires a much better teaching model than whatever he is doing.
You will probably have to somehow self-teach.
Good Luck

Class is hard to rate because a lot of useful topics, and the class is ultimately very useful, but the Professor himself isn't the greatest at teaching. It also doesn't help that he isn't very understanding or accommodating at all. If you're someone who works better under pressure, you'll do well, but studying and understanding are very necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: This a tough class that challenges your logical and Excel ability. Stiff learning curve. I am glad I stick to the end. Very useful for your future career.
Word Professor of my entire life. He doesn't give feedback or respond to emails. If you just take his class use caution
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Individual assignments every week, group project is 40% of class points. If you have a bad group you're screwed. The class is okay though. Just do assignments every week, He is really helpful and goes through excel every class so thats nice.

He doesn't even have an external microphone. His voice cuts off during the zoom lectures and it's very hard to understand him. He makes the material complicated than it is. He just throws the class materials in a Google Drive without really organizing them. Scares people with saying this is heavy math but it actually is simple when you google it.

Took it in the Summer Quarter and tried to graduate ASAP. Never imagined any professor would give out so much work in a one-month class. 4 extremely hard Excel simulation Homework, 2 group presentations, one exam, 1 group business proposal and one big final group project. Take this class if mandatory and MAKE SURE you have advanced skills in Excel.

Lectures can be confusing and hard to understand. Take time to study and submit everything weekly. It was hard to talk to him about difficulty with course assignments. Has high expectations for us to understand material quickly and throughly. Felt like a higher level graduate class not an undergrad class. Take if mandatory!

I highly recommend taking Dr. Long Gao's BUS125, one of the most useful courses I've ever taken at UCR, and the content of this course has been applied a lot in my work after graduation; Although it is not an Easy A class, it is indeed a really very useful class.

Do not take this professor, his lectures made no sense, he teaches on the board and says now do it in excel. His lecture example every day was literally "imagine it like tossing a coin", sure that makes sense but when you expect us to use excel formulas like a bino.inv formula using rand() nested inside an IF statement, that comparison folds.

Very challenging course where you can learn many useful models and how they are built. One thing to notice that if you choose this course, try to spend as much time as possible trying to complete the assignments on your own rather than just relying on the examples given out.

MGT 201 is not an easy course, but don't worry you won't be able to keep up, because professor Gao is so kind that always put the extraordinary effort to help us catch up with the class. He gave me the opportunity to learn how quantitative analysis works in the world, it was an invaluable experience. I would highly recommend his class to everyone.

Avoid Professor Gao at all costs. This class is extremely difficult and time consuming. I went to professor Gao multiple times for help and he would just tell me to reference the simulation notes and lecture notes. Homework is not even graded by the professor. Class started off with 60+ students and half of the class dropped by week 5.

Given the difficulty of subject, I think professor did a great job. He helped us with our hw and project solutions. However, I would request him to be more lenient with the finals as its a tough course to complete.

Long Gao is easily the worst Professor. Please do not take this class if you do not have to! UCR has had several complaints about this Professor but he is tenured so nothing will be done. Hes so bad that he opts out of evaluations. His group project is insane and on topics hes never taught and the final has nothing to do with the course. AWFUL!

Please do not take this professor if you dont have to. I wouldnt recommend anyone to do their mba at UCR. The school of business dont care about students and they havent done anything to fix professor Long Gao.

I would not recommend anyone to take MGT 207 with Gao, specifically in the online setting. The course is assignment heavy and group project heavy, but expect to have little to no direction in what the assignments are. His exams reflect all of his lecture problems and his practice exam problems show up on the exams as well. He teaches in a fun interactive and easy to follow manner. Highly recommended since getting a good grade in the class isn't hard and the curve is huge to get an A

Professor Lui was one of the worst professors I have taken at UCR. He really does not care about his students and is very lazy. His lectures are useless, as he basically repeats the book word for word. On top of that, he posted practice midterms, but did not post an answer key because he "did not have one".

I had no clue what was going on in this class. He went very fast during lecture, never gave us the chance to comprehend info, and gave tons of homework. Midterm is 20% and final is 45%. Not an effective teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Lui Chun is a real gem of a professor. His class is very manageable and he hand writes notes during all of his lectures instead of reading off of slides. Go to all lectures and pay attention. He's very caring and as long as you put your whole effort into the class, you will do well. Exams reflect his homework and lecture very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He's a very young and new teacher; however hes very open minded and has a very understanding nature towards his students. He has a no laptop no electronics policy and it keeps the class focused! All his notes are HAND WRITTEN. BIG CURVE (75%A) He keeps it very light hearted! his notes are very simple but sometimes he stumbles over his words lol
Typical college professor. Not bad, not good.
Love his no-laptop policy, maintains the quality and environment of the lecture. Lecture style was pretty okay and notes are great.

I thought twice before taking his class since he was a new faculty at UCR. To my surprise, he's really good in explaining things, makes the concepts really humorous on the paper projector itself. Textbook is a must for this class, he takes all concepts from the textbook, textbook's well-written too! Test were very fair, a typical college level test

One of the worst psychology classes I have taken. I really enjoyed my TA but severely disliked the Prof. She tests on material from her own book and requires you to buy it. The tests are rough as she quizzes on the smallest details. You could completely understand the material but you need to know and memorize the small stuff to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I found the class enjoyable and interesting.  Assignments were straightforward but the exams were a bit difficult mainly because they covered a lot of material (both lecture and readings). There were multiple readings per week, many of which were long so this class is not a small time investment. She does curve the final grade

Probably the least enjoyable psychology class I have ever taken here. Majority of lecture is spent with the professor talking about her own work or other material that won't even be on the exams. Rest of the time she is busy promoting her book. Way too much material and barely any guidance. If you want to pass, read the texts and go to your TAs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The class content is actually super interesting & I learned a lot. HOWEVER, the exams are unnecessarily hard & are mostly based from the readings. She DOES curve tho which will probably save us. Also, she's kinda not humble and sort of conceited?? You'll see when u meet her.

The study guides are useless, and she's on vacation so much we barely had any in person lectures. Exams are 70% of your grade and she makes them unnecessarily difficult, they are heavilyyy based on the readings which are also a lot every week. The class average for all of the exams never went above a C, psyc110 was easier fr.

Learned a lot from this course, however, the exam was heavy on other material rather than the slides itself. As a professor, she should worry about attending her class rather than going to New York, going on vacation with her daughter, and attending events. Wants us to buy and read her own book (profiting from her students). Exams worded bad …

Could be an easy class, but the way its organized & how the study guide isnt helpful, made it difficult. I learned a lot on the topic, but the exams never relied on lecture nor main topics of the articles. u have to basically memorize all the articles, which are about 3-4 a week, & also read 2 chaps from her book. If ur busy,don't take this class.

There are not enough characters here to fully explain my issues with this class. Here are a few: 1) Teaches non-peer-reviewed material/research (mostly her own), 2) Makes bold claims and then backtracks, 3) Focuses on slide material during class, but mainly tests on the readings, 4) Confusing exams. Trick questions, contradictory statements, etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Expect it to be a high pace class, loads of material, and grades to be handed out for exams whenever they get the chance. This class has so much potential to help everyone that takes it, however all exams cover so much material it is a mission and half to study for them. Then once you take the exams be prepared to wait SEVERAL days for your result.

This Professor, was decent! I was extremely excited to take this course! Based on the reviews, she was clear in her lectures, however her exams are overwhelming even if they are open note! The test are based on many things so READ! However her curve saved me so much! However, this is not an Easy class! Also shout out to the TAs!
One of the best courses I have taken as the content is great and Sonja is very dedicated to the field. Plenty of informational reading that is fairly easy to go through. 10/10 overall.
she is so kind and caring to her students. I took science of well being with her and she has taught us so many things that we can actually use in our daily lives. i love her!

A very insightful professor & prideful in happiness. Her way of teaching is straight foward as she reads off the slides & elaborates. She makes you feel included by asking questions in class. Simple class:Read online slides&attend discussions=B. Guaranteed A=study hard, attend dis & do well on midterms. Reading isn't too important in my opinion.

This class is only easy if you are willing to study. Her exams her basically just notes from the study guides. Sonja was very helpful at office hours and so was her TA Katie. I thought it was an easy A class and ended up getting an A+ in her class. The only thing was she used many big words in her slides that was pretty confusing.

shes famous! anyways.. dont be underestimated by the title of the class. theres a lot of lists to memorize for the midterms and final exam. the questions can be really tricky. you need to study really hard for her tests if you want a good grade. she gives generous curves and overall shes a really nice teacher. i would recommend taking this class

I was super excited to take this class withe the famous professor, but it turned out to be awful.  She basically just read off the slides and spent half of the class asking students for their opinions, which got really annoying.  Not very good at lecturing and  exam questions can be confusing.  Just Do the readings and study a lot

her tests are a little bit more difficult than they need to be, but the class is not hard. Just REALLY study for tests, and in the book just read what she talks about in class, there will be test questions on those sections from the book.

She is difficult but very approachable in her OH. She is willing to give you credit for missed questions on midterm if you can show support for your answer. She knows her stuff! I recommend taking her, she is renowned in Psychology and we take it for granted that she is very knowledgable and can give alot of insight! :)
May seem easy at first, but watch out..her test questions often times confusing.  Go over the lecture notes..Read the book if you want because she lectures strait out of the book
NOT GOOD...DONT TAKE HER...HARD EXAMS AND NOT VERY APPROACHABLE...:(

Is very organized and makes sure you know the info. She gives you the lecture notes, which is very helpful. I agree with the last person--she does do weird cow-like movements with her mouth. Some questions on the exams are ambigious. But overall, a good professor.

made the class interesting. is a good teacher but sometimes test questions are interpretive (what is the overall lesson learned from social psych?) she does this weird thing with her mouth..it kinda reminds me of a cow...its distracting. but shes a great teacher. id take her again.
She is a good professor. She really knows how to make everything clear.
I like the way she gives detailed example through the use of slides and videos. Great Job!
clear and understandable
Best Professor
Very nice professor who was passionate about the class. Tests themselves were easy as everything covered was on study guides, also gave out so much extra credit for just showing up to lecture.

Lyons is incredibly passionate about what he does and really nice. He gives out a bunch of extra credit, he drops the lowest midterm, and he curves grades. You will take a midterm and a final together on the same day, but it's not that bad. The material isn't difficult as long as you understand the concepts a little. His study guides are helpful.

I honestly loved professor Tim, he's an amazing professor and pretty funny during his lectures if you pay attention to what he is saying. Not a hard class at all to pass, just do the work and listen to his lectures + the lab and you're good. His exams are also not difficult at all, he's really generous in them + he gives extra credit. Loved him!

Not going to lie, the tests are lecture heavy so attend lectures. The tests itself are like 60 questions long but all MCQ. Just study and show up, he gives out tons of EC for showing up real easy course.
Amazing professor with amazing lectures where he shared personal experiences, 4 exams in total but had extra credit and in total it was 55 points. One of the best professors at ucr!

Great professor and super passionate! This class was super fun to learn as I learned about everything he and professor Kane had to teach about our universe. Good curves and there are extra credit opportunities. Overall, as long as you put the work in and ask for help, you will do great! Many study guides available for each exam which is goated.

Really enjoyed Prof. Lyon's class, 4 exams (two in final timeslot and lowest score dropped) and your lab make up your whole grade. Lots of extra credit/participation given via poll everywhere and a few EC questions on the final. The labs and lecture had similar content, which was nice, take notes however you like because you'll take A LOT :)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Gives extra credit if you attend lectures, has 3 midterms but they cover usually 2-3 topics so it's not too difficult. Final is cumulative. He's very passionate w/ his work and loves telling silly stories for engagement. He cares about us. tests aren't hard as long as you attend class and study a little. Overall an easy A to earn.

Lectures can sometimes be a little boring, but it's not that bad. 2 midterms 1 final, he drops the lowest test score at the end of the quarter and curves every test. Tests aren't that hard as long as you study. Labs are very helpful for understanding the next day's lecture. He can be funny and relatable at times, he's just a chill guy.

professors can't really be worse. spends the whole time lecturing us in the most confusing way possible and as a non-major course his TAs grade so harshly. 75% of our grade is based on tests which are ridiculously hard (no extra credit). no office hours and hardly reachable. labs are redundant and graded on accuracy and is 25% of our grade.

Terrible professor that does not present useful information in the most confusing way possible. Lectures and labs are boring and himself is hardly reachable. 75% grade based on tests which are completely hard and not lecture or lab based. Labs are graded on accuracy and all TAs are tough graders. He made the tests so much harder than it should be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Terrible professor, hardly reachable and gives extremely hard tests. Lectures are boring and information are hard to understand and they are completely useless in my life. He made the tests so much than it should be. Geology is definitely one my least favorite subjects, but I don't have a choice as it completes my "breath" requirements. Avoid him!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: grade is based on midterm+ final and Lab grade. The tests aren't bad as long as you study. His study guides are super helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Did't like the class in general, it was a hard breadth course. 75% of ur grade is best on tests and they are hard for the most part.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tim is an amazing professor. He cares about his students and is very knowledgeable about the subject. Labs take an hour or less usually, and all materials are posted. Go to lectures, take good notes, study hard for midterms and you will do great. Midterms and finals are curved, and they drop the worst of everything. Seriously, take this class.

Everything is on slides or lab handouts, study guides are SUPER helpful. Labs were harder than the 3 exams + final, drops lowest of everything (even labs). Long lectures but I only tuned in if he specifically mentioned it would be on the test. He's pretty funny and really passionate; slides are a bit all over the place but you learn to read them.

I love Lyons, he's a man with a lot of passion for his field and it shows. If you put the work in and attend lecture (which you MUST since his slides are mainly pictures) you'll do fine, especially since they're also fun. The tests are honestly not too bad and the curves are quite heavy, if anything I'd watch out more for the labs and lab quizzes.

Really funny and witty professor providing some really interesting lectures about things that affect us everyday. However, tests are pretty hard, although curved, so I recommend playing close attention to lecture, taking good notes, and studying before tests.

His lectures were not helpful at all and they were only pictures. He has 2 midterms and 1 final that is cumulative. HARD tests and the class average was usually around 65 . I would not take again because I definitely struggled and he was no help either. But he seems like a nice professor but he is hard to pass.

I honestly hated the lectures in this class lol. They were entertaining but there were no words on the slides, just pictures, and he would go off on tangents so it was hard to know what we were supposed to be writing down. The study guides that he sent out before tests were helpful but I always ended up using google instead of my notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Excellent professor. Taught everything very well and made it so interesting. The concepts were a lot to handle, but he helped to make it manageable. I would take any course of his!

Such a kind prof, couldn't recommend him enough. Gave multiple opportunities for extra credit and genuinely cared for student success. Non-mandatory lectures (but highly recommend), records lectures and posts them after. Would 100% take him again.

Clear and entertaining in class. No HW, just weekly labs, midterm, final, extra credit-- all open notes. He is happy to clarify things, easy to understand, passionate, has good TAs, funny, and talks about real current events. Cannot say enough good things, and I wish all my electives could be this great. 10/10 suggest this class.

This class really makes you work hard for it but the grading scale is very lenient. He drops the lowest lab,midterm and offers generous extra credit. The tests were pretty easy if you studied a lot and understood the lectures. Labs were pointless to me.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: his class consists of 3 midterms and 1 cumulative final. Midterms are based on lectures and his slides. His exams are multiple choice, fill in the blank and T/F. Pop quizzes for every lab, and I recommend to attend lectures if you want to understand the material and to record him.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: People who are good at science tend to think that the concepts they are teaching are easy. Professor Lyons will try to persuade you he is a generous grader; I strongly recommend not believing him. Go to lecture and ask to record. Many times throughout he will tell you some of what is on the test and so watching/listening to recordings help a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is a class you have to put effort into. The concepts are very complex but they're not impossible to grasp. The professor and the T.A(or at least mine) were very helpful. Lectures are informative and I feel guilty for falling asleep but it was really bc the chairs were so comfy and I was exhausted from walking all the way to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the best professor I've ever encountered. Good lectures with specific hints about what will be on the tests. Approachable and really helpful, assigning all TAs specific materials for reviewing and foreshadowing of lectures. Attend the lecture and get the meanings of concepts on Powerpoints, the grading would be fine. Learned a lot with him.
Besides, he curved 14 points once on a midterm.

Professor Lyons was a great professor. He really makes sure you are understanding the material, and is really passionate about what he teaches. There are 3 midterms and a final. The last midterm and the final are on the same day. He drops your lowest of the 3 and curves the score. Lab was cool too. Lowest lab quiz and lab are dropped as well

This class is not hard, if you go to lecture and study before the tests you're fine. He drops lowest midterm and curves each test. He is really informative and tries to make sure everyone understands. People who don't try will get low grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Take this class if you want to challenge yourself. Don't take this unless if you really need to.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very specific and good lectures, which the tests were based on. He was fair in grading, and would curve,  and even ask for feedback to accommodate for students.  He created his own workbook for the class for $30. Labs were helpful and were part of final grades.

Attend lectures and take good notes, you'll be fine. Test materials come directly from his lecture. I'm a foreign student with totally no Geo basis and I was absent for the first two weeks. Even I can still catch up. 3 midterms, lowest is dropped. He wants to help you and is well organized. Very unbelievable to see this many "extreme hard" ratings.

People giving Prof Lyon bad reviews are people who never attended lecture or paid attention in his class. Everything on the tests are right from the lecture slides and what he discusses in class. He really cares about his students actually learning and retaining the material. This class was my favorite the entire quarter and I had a blast every lec
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He makes you work for that A that you will not likely receive. Grades very hard. He admitted towards the beginning of the quarter his class average grade over the years tends to be a C and that's after curving tests. Seriously, if you're looking for an easy A do not look here.

Tim is a great lecturer but he does not use a book. All his tests are strictly of powerpoints. The problem with this is that his powerpoints are often to vague for alot of the material on the test. As well my TA was crap and honestly knew nothing about the topics in class and admited it. I have taken alot of stem classes and his tests suck.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I did not find his course interesting, the lectures need to present  more visual explanations to let me feel hat I am involved, or at least, to feel that I understand something. The exams are extremely hard and have a section with fill in the blank.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: While Dr. Lyons does cover a broad array of topics along with a few specifics that some people considered hard (i.e. the Coriolis Effect), he gives extra attention to those parts to make sure you understand, even giving a physical description by putting on a quick skit to show you. If you love the idea of Martian life, he'll talk about it!

I was nervous to take this class because of the reviews, but I thought it was easy as long as you study. The labs were extremely easy as long as you followed instructions. I thought the exams were fair if you studied, I got a 98 and 102. You need to really understand the material and make flashcards to make sure you REALLY KNOW the power points.

Professor Lyons is a professor that challenges you to learn the material and master it. However, if you don't have any background knowledge in the topics he mentions in class it will be extremely hard to pass this class. The exams are extremely hard and have a section with fill in the blank.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS unless you have to for your major. Lyons does not curve the course and if he does its barely anything. Midterm averages are usually in the 60s. Labs are long, pointless, and boring. Midterms are solely on the lectures. Need a lab manual. If you need a physical science as a breadth, do not take this class.

This course was interesting, but if you do not understand the material clearly, you will not get an A. There are 3 midterms, a final, and 5 or so lab quizzes. One of the midterms gets dropped, and there is a curve, but they are very difficult. You will need to put in a lot of effort. The labs are graded extremely hard and they are not very helpful.

I have never had such a bad experience as with Prof. Lyons. He does not care if students understand his lectures. Also, his lectures are boring, no excitement about a subject what he teaches. I felt that the subject of this course is faraway from his interests.

class was cool he expalins everything really well i actually was interested in the things we learned, he is a really nice guy too. three midterms and a final, one of the midterms gets dropped the curves were great! his tests were pretty difficult but you jus have to put the time and effort in studying. passed with a b, overall not to bad!

Great lecturer. Posts Powerpoint slides online, which is all you need to study for the exams. The tests are difficult, but curved.  The lab is difficult and not helpful, but easy enough to get a passing grade. Study the slides and you'd be fine.

had him and he's a very entertaining professor. I fell asleep in class a lot because it was kind of boring. If you study the powerpoints and pay some attention in lecture you should do fine... My t.a. was horrible and didn't really understand what she was talking about. but if you wanna take the class ... good luck

nice guy and explains really well but i think i just do not understand geology had to work very very hard for my grade the class super hard the labs were also hard overall to me it was really difficult and i do not recommend this class
I love his voice. Quite the intellect.

EXTREMELY BORING! HIS VOICE PUTS YOU TO SLEEP! I fell asleep in almost every class. No one shows up to lecture. His powerpoints are in long paragraphs so you can't even take notes. Thankfully, he posts the powerpoints on iLearn ahead of time. He does curve on midterms. He is also entertaining at times. TEXTBOOK & LABs & TAs do not help at all!!

I didn't think this class was very hard at all.  If you put in some time (either by going to class or studying), you do fine.  I do think that some basic Environmental Science classes should be a prerequisite for this class, but that is not the professors fault.  He was entertaining, approachable, intelligent, and thorough.
Lectures are quite boring. He elaborates too lengthy, not much gets done. Labs are hard and everything is graded rough.

Good lecturer, but sometimes assumes students already have an extensive knowledge of chemistry, which he incorporates into most topics. The textbook was useless and a waste of money! He curves the class 16% because his final and 3 midterms are hard. Drops lowest midterm and quiz. I had an 82% and got an 83% on the final and I ended up with an A! :D
A really good teacher. Makes sure students understands the subject matter before moving on. Offers a generous curve and lots of extra credit.

This class was ridiculously hard!!! He was a really sweet teacher but the lectures are really boring and all the material is boring. Not very clear and although the lectures are poster online they don't help much

Optional book was nice, except it made it a lot harder to study.  I couldn't get in touch with him when I tried and got no help when I had to miss a week for surgery.  I learned more in the labs but the tests are based off the lectures.  Don't miss the labs and ask the TA's questions there for clarity.  The info is very basic but important.

This class was so difficult. The teacher is a nice man but his lectures are boring and there is a total lack of clarity.Book is optional but it would better explain topics. The TA's are just as worthless as the lectures and most of the time they are just as confused on the subject as the students. I would recommend this class...to my worst enemy!

You don't have to use the book for this class (it's optional). But because of this, it seems like the info isn't organized. His lectures and the info he gives don't always tie together. He's really nice though.
he is a great professor. take him and u'll learn a lot!!

Prof. Lyons expects a lot from his students but there is no homework, labs are easy, and his test consist of only things that he says in class, so if you dont read the book you can still do well if you take ok notes. Overall i would recomend the class to anyone.

This class is a breeze as long as you show up to lecture and do the presentations. But when it comes to the papers hes expecting you to write in a way that appeals to him. Hes not objective. This was the most frustrating part to me because he claims to embrace opinions other than his own. He remembers information in a particular, outdated way.

Still a class I wish I could take over and over again. Lectures can get dry but the information is so interesting. I still listen to the music from this class to this day tbh! Paper was music 1 vs music 2 style and you got to pick. Go to lecture and discussion (discussion was fun) and you will be fine! Final is also non-cumulative (took <1hr)
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is great. One of my favorite classes by far! No homework, just bring good ideas to your discussion section. Notes aren't uploaded online so you must go to class. The music is interesting and he hints during lectures as to what to really pay attention to for exams (multiple choice). Overall a fun A and good class to balance with tougher ones.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Really interesting class! Was the only class left over since he had older bad ratings but he has definitely changed. No longer have those weekly assignments, there are 3 tests and 1 final paper. So long you study you will get the grade you ultimately deserve. Awesome lectures, can get dry but the material is interesting.

Lysloff's lectures can be a little dry and hard to pay attention to, but if you can pay attention than the class will be a breeze. Go to his office hours, he will quiz you and help you prepare for the exams which really helped me. Listen to the musics he posts as they are part of the exams
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: AMAZING CLASS. AMAZING PROFESSOR. Going in I was scared because of the old negative reviews, I discovered how great this class is. It is super easy! Go to class (he blasts the music and it's very pleasant!), and GO TO SECTION, study a bit and you'll do well. I honestly loved that class

This class is easy and you likely won't have a problem with it. His lectures can be boring at times, but he doesn't post his slideshows online, so go to lectures. Didn't do most of the readings but I still did well because my T.A covered them in discussion. There were 3 exams and 1 term paper but they weren't hard. No clicker questions either.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Lysloff's class was very easy. There were 3 exams and 1 term paper and the lectures aren't too boring either.

After reading some reviews, he has changed. There are no weekly assignments. But i must touch on this, he does ramble quite a bit and his slides are not all that helpful and nor does he post them. I went to most lectures and every discussion, I probably actually only learned in discussion.

Ignore all the bad reviews people are giving him. I've had two of his classes now, and he's really a great professor. He's really enthusiastic and passionate but at the same time really relaxed and chill. If you do what you're supposed to do, you'll be fine. I highly recommend Professor Lysloff. One of the most interesting professors I've had.

His weekly essays are due every Saturday night at 11:59pm effectively putting a huge gap in a well deserved weekend. You might say,"Well, do it earlier in the week". He only had discussions on Fridays, which makes it hard to write a good essay before then. His lectures are a huge waste of time and only the discussions are worth attending.

Probably one of the worst professors that I've had. The readings are dense and repetitive and written by people that like to think of themselves as academics simply because their work is convoluted. Lectures are mandatory but utterly useless for writing his weekly papers.

He is not organized at all!  Instruction on essay take home exam was not clear  at all.  He said that he was interested in our thoughts and ideas on the essay and when it came time to grading, it was another thing!

boring, q's on midterms were ultra specific and random, his odor is pungent and can be smelled from across the lecture hall, mumbles and goes off on random tangents sometimes........does care about the subject though so that's a plus?
Don't know why people think this class is easy. It is quite the opposite. He gives tricky multiple choice exams and grades hard on term papers. Avoid this professor if you don't want a low grade.
He is a really kind professor, but his tests are super hard. It class is not like what people say.

This is one of the most interesting professors I've had in my 4 years of college. He can really liven up a class with his enthusiasm, and he is a very fair grader if you are willing to absorb the material and put in the effort.
Lectures might make you fall asleep sometimes but he tries to make the class interesting. Nice fun class.
his lec are very boring

This class was way cool. He spent the first 20 minutes of class ranting about the government. He has an excellent teaching style and grabs your attention from the start of class until the end. I never thought I would love so many musics from all over the world until I took this class.
Probably the coolest professor in the school.  He has a horrid smell of cigarettes but only an infantile retard would get anything less than an A in his class.
such an awesome and easy class.  whoever got lower than an a just didnt do the listening assignments.
the course is mostly guest talks without learning anything useful. her classes are very boring.
Very unorganized.

Easy class overall. She is very lenient in grading and curves also if people do not do well. There is 5 quizzes with the last being optional and 1 final. Final was pretty hard but she curved the question great. Group Project was light also just have a good partner. Advice would be to attend class and ask questions to pass. She has lecture slides.

The lecture was boring, but she gave clear explanations and some simple examples. Also, some demos are available. She does care about students, but grades are released late. Not much to request a re-grade. HWs are heavy but doable. Exams are broadly on slides, hard to catch all the key points.

Very dry lectures, never answers emails, you won't learn in this class. Surface level teaching no examples but will have the audacity to put full page questions on exam. Never gave grades out until 1 day before she was supposed to turn them in although she had multiple TAs. DO NOT TAKE.

The grading criteria are very unclear, and some grade criteria never appear in the assignment description.
The answers to the assignments are given the day before the exam.
The class is very boring, just reading the slides, and there is no desire to listen to her class.
The course content is very long and I don't know what the main points are.

She is disorganized with mistake-filled slides and superficial teaching. She rushes through topics while exams require in-depth knowledge. She ignores emails and provides unclear assignment/project specs, often changing requirements last minute, causing frustration. Her responses are confused. The TA is equally unhelpful, lacking communication.

2 qrt project class. She gave us a lot of room to work. Very understanding of issues, problems, or hiccups our projects would encounter. Weekly sprints with lectures dedicated to workflow or overall project designs. All around very chill and dare I say fun class I looked forward to doing. One of the goats fs.

She was the first professor to ever teach this class and I think it was pretty good. More python coding than expected but it was never too difficult. Grading was extremely slow, probably because it was the first quarter. She's very nice and knowledgable about the topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Her class was great. Not only cover the basic theory but also talking about the current database trends in Industry. I got a lot of knowledge from taking her class. She cared about student hardship in the assignments or understanding the material. Even She opened an extra office hour before the final exam. Thank you, Professor!

Professor Salloum was so kind and helpful! It was my first time taking a Computer Science course and she made it very easy to follow. She would repeat herself if someone asked. She held office hours and if they didn't work for you she tried to meet when you were available. She made the transition to online courses less rocky.

Professor Salloum is nice, but she does get sidetracked so easily. It's almost like she wants to be your friend and not your professor. I feel like I definitely suffered due to this because lecture would start late or run late because she was too busy asking about what we did that weekend or get distracted talking about the Office during lecture.

She gave a lot of chances to give feedback on the lab assignments we did (were they too hard, too easy, boring, etc) and adjusted future labs which was great. She also helped us get started and gave hints during lecture to help with projects and assignments, and she was really helpful and understanding in office hours. Really enjoyed the course.
Great CS Professor overall.

Way too high expectations. Choose your teammates and project very carefully as they are responsible for 20% of your grade through peer reviews. All the assignments are graded extremely harshly such that you will still do poorly even if you believe you meet the rubric requirements. Most of the teams are just trying to pass now.

For colloquium bien001. very down to earth, just show up and take notes -- its a pass fail class but honestly everything he says is interesting and his professional development is incredible. He truly wants every student to succeed and I know he will make a lovely grumpy old man. 
Also spell his name right.
Great professor that showed the foundations of bioengineering and how students could have opportunities in the field.

Dr McKee is very caring and kind, his class is very hard and I spent most of the quarter thinking I might be failing. Going to class is important since not everything is on the slides and everything is fair game for tests. It was stressful but I felt he was a good professor who is very willing to answer questions or slow down when too fast.

The course requires asking 2 questions in front of the class to pass, it is 35% of the grade, and sometimes only a handful get to do so, but Dr. McKee provided plenty of opportunities to get extra credit. The lectures are guest speakers from industry, grad students, and professors. The assignments are easy just writing resumes, emails, etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Mckee has too big expectations for groups and has this imagination where all his groups will make great products and bring products to market. He will berate you in meetings with him that destroy your confidence and make you question if you chose the right major. Two quarters into senior design and majority of the groups are just trying to pass

Grades tough for no reason. For senior design, he tries to derail you and your team as much as possible, at times can be beneficial, most of the time the questions are out of nowhere. Interrupts during presentations. Overall a bad experience, could have tried to understand and help the group more, but spends time trying to belittle the project.

Someone told me Professor Mckee had a bad score, so I had to come here to set the record straight. His Biomats class was amazing. Was it easy? No. But he covered a wide range of topics-from mechanics to bio interfaces and talked about their real word apps. He actually cares about the class and is an absolute legend. Everyone I know loves him
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Robert McKee is the worst instructor Ive ever had. Senior design is the most anticipated course in all of bioengineering. He threatened to split up senior design groups for 7 weeks at the start of the course which amounted to nothing. He also did not give us any insight as to what our grades were until the final quarter of the class. Ridiculous.

Dr. McKee is a great professor, anytime I see hes teaching a class I know it will be enjoyable. He actually cares about his students and wants to see us all succeed. He's absolutely great, take him!!! Tests are fair so study but he always gives extra credit at the end for filling out iEvals and tbh every class I took with him I ended up with an A.
