Professor was rude and condescending in OH and lecture. Exams and quizzes were unnecessarily difficult. He does supply a lot of extra material that makes the class doable, but I couldn't stand getting steamrolled every time I had a question.

Only the top 15% get an A- or A. This makes a terrible learning environment. Pitting student against student disappoint me. Exams are unreasonably difficult & do not follow the class. Do the extra credit paper. Fairly unfair in general especially considering COVID. I'm scared to get help because of the terrible learning environment. BEWARE!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He give sout his own textbook and practice exams. YOu have to go to the class because there are quizzes for points, but most of the time you can work with other students. Topics are super interesting and this class is a must if you want to apply to medical school.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The summer class was not that tough? Midterm exams had averages 63%,61%,62%, so maybe he's lightened up since spring. It was awesome not to have to attend the class and he provides his own 100-page notes that he wrote himself.
I had a 56% average on the exams and got a B+, so who cares if the tests are hard. The average grade was a B, so as long as you were at the average you were guaranteed a decent grade.

The short videos worked for me. It's hard to sit through an hour of any class on Zoom. Tests were tough cause you actually have to understand the concept . The questions were all different, a lot of students got mad trying to get answers with chegg or google and ran out of time. If you let yourself get bored and stop caring youll do bad!
Worst teacher Ive taken at ucr so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: unless you want to spend all your time studying and learning basic bio just to do horribly then i would not recommend

Bruh, you have to be out of your mind to read these most recent reviews and decide to take this class. Took this in Spring quarter during pandemic and tests were the hardest I have ever taken in my life. Tests were meant to be extremely tricky and he made his own questions so they were 10x more confusing. Used crazy synonyms in tests to trick us.

Professor Maduro's tests were the hardest tests I've ever done. They did not have much to do with the lectures. The lectures were videos which was nice, but each lecture video contained (on average) 3-6 questions to answer for points. These questions were super difficult to answer, especially since we learned these concepts only 30 seconds earlier.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: It was great not having to sit through lectures and doing short videos on my own time. Duh it's a pandemic folks, the exams are going to be harder because he said they would be un-proctored and open-book, and students think they can do well by cheating instead of actually studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The class for me was difficult. At a glance I was confident however over time I realized his set up was not for me. The lecture videos I feel do not give enough information to properly apply towards the in-depth exam ?s. Thought there are many resources, some questions I noticed were a bit inconsistent between practice and real exams.

I would say that this class is not an easy one per se. Professor Maduro is very funny and accessible. No textbook required because he writes his own "textbook", more like notes really. Read through his notes. Do all the sample exams. Going through the exam questions, you will find his pattern of questions. Once you get that, you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: DANGER!!! This is an awful professor who derives his feeling of self-importance from giving students a hard time, and he bitterly resents those who end up doing well in his classes - like myself. He is a very deceptive person, and does a good job of appearing to care about students. Avoid him at all costs; fail to do so at your own peril.
Horrible professor Extremely Rude Huge ego AVOID

This class has been one of the most interesting classes I have taken so far. Maduro is very prepared and provides MANY resources that will help you perform well in the class if you use them. Study the practice exams. Create study guides from the lectures and videos, and put in the time to study. The class was very difficult but very rewarding!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: During the Pandemic he made his tests twice as hard which is understandable since most students will cheat with open notes, HOWEVER, along with increasing the difficulty of the exams he failed to adjust his notes and video lectures to Complexity of the material in the exams. I dont recommend.
horrible. save yourself and don't take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: obviously a very intelligent teacher but his ego gets in the way of it. makes things as hard as possible & doesn't want people to do well. he lets his pettiness get in the way of what is fair for the students. avoid at all costs!! unnecessary stress for such simple material, especially during remote teaching. got mad bc people complained.

Maduro is a very informative professor who is passionate about what he does. However, he has an ego. If students are struggling, he blames it on us and doesn't attempt to help. Taking this class in the middle of a pandemic and riot showed his true colors. Called us names and yelled at us. (Look at the ucr reddit for more opinions)

Genuinely a very good teacher. DO THE PRACTICE TESTS. His tests are challenging because they force you to really KNOW the content, but not impossible. He seems to have a pattern to the types of questions he asks and on which parts of the lecture as well. Three midterms, so your grade has lots of chances. End of the day, you get what u study for
The WORST. Please avoid at all cost. His exams are impossible

Maduro made this really awesome type of "lecture" by making lecture videos on ilearn. You just watch and answer questions as the video progresses which really makes you pay attention. It was a really different experience but it was super effective. *Fair warning* he will roast the hell out of you if you ask a dumb question during lecture.

I had to re-take Bio 5A. The first time I took it was in Fall 2017. It may have been 2 years, but I feel like I really understood the material and content a lot more this time with Maduro because of how straightfoward the videos were and the optional midterms and finals.

This human genetics class was amazing. This is a course I waited my whole undergraduate to take. Prof Maduro is really knowledgeable and gives students his own textbook. If you have a solid backgound in genetics and intro bio and are willing to put in the work, you can do well. Definitely not an easy A though.

This class really taught me so much. The test were difficult,but it is possible to get an A. Maduro really wants you to understand the material and if you don't then you won't do well . First midterm was easy, the other two were okay. If you focus and really put in the work then you will get an A. 97 1st Mid, 86 2 Mid, 88 3rd Mid, 66 final.

My class was a hybrid class so attendance was not mandatory and his videos could be watched at your own pace each week. His videos were very well put together and sometimes very interesting to watch. Although I did not interact with him much, the times that I did he was very helpful and funny. For sure a great addition to UCR.

best professor I've ever had. it takes studying to get an A but its really easy to get a B. PAY ATTENTION TO THE ONLINE LECTURE!! go to actual lecture if you can because he gives tips for exams and explains things more in-depth

Professor Maduro was one of the best professors out there. He is so organized and if you have any questions he is there to answer them for you. Gives you so many resources to help you prepare for your midterms and final.!! 11/10 for this man. HE IS AMAZING! PS: He is also an amazing singer, look him up if you have the chance to!

Short videos instead of lecture  the BEST format for 5A! The videos have questions to keep you paying attention. He still runs an optional class which I attended but most of my friends didn't go. The exams are challenging, but no more than those of other bio profs & he gives a ton of old exams for practise. Great class, wish 5B was like this.

Maduro gives out notes, powerpoints, videos, past exams, etc. Human Genetics is hard and I wouldn't take it if you got a low grade in intro genetics (bio102?),. But the classes are super interesting and entertaining and his style/humor made me look forward. The exams were challenging, but the curve at the end was generous, the ave. was around a B.

Toughest multiple choice exams ever. 55-70 avgs. Felt like a verbal section of a standardized test. Massive critical thinking required. Prof meticulously crafted his tests for deep understanding, WILL try to trick you, as good tests should. Rigor required comparable to elite schools. Very enthusiastic and jokes around with self-deprecating humor.

By far one of the best professors I've ever had. He is respectable, his online notes are extremely helpful, and I actually retained the information he taught. I would definitely take the class again. However, do not procrastinate in studying for his final. The final drop me down 6 percent in the class.

By far the best professor I've had at UCR. He knows his material and is very good at explaining it. He's easy to talk to, and he's hilarious. It's not enough to memorize information, you MUST apply that information, which makes his class on the more difficult side. Wish he taught all my classes honestly, I'd probably have a better understanding....

WHY AM I CRYING IN THE CLUB RN??? BC THIS PROFESSOR IS AMAZING. Y'ALL WANNA SURVIVE IN BIOL 5A?!! WELL TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. I'm actually really sad that I can't take him for the rest of the series. He doesn't like the lecture style, so he posts videos online. And boiii let me tell you. They helped so much. Use the resources he gives you!

Dr. Maduro made this class so enjoyable. It was really great learning about all the genetic diseases and how they are passed down from generation to generation. He gives a lot of pop quizzes, though, so be sure you are on top of your material. Clickers are required. Gave a little bit of extra credit at the end. He is a very fair professor.

Dr. Maduro is one of the best professors Ive had at UCR. This class has a lot of information but everything was fair. He provided detailed notes & explained things really well. Tests reflect the notes and lectures. He prepared you well, it just took a lot of time & effort on your own. Overall interesting human genetics class, and great professor.

Man was this a difficult but interesting class. Topics were current and up to date which made the class interesting. Maduro is a really good and engaging professor. Exams are very difficult with averages in the low to mid 60's. However, he does have a pretty nice curve at the end.

BIOL115(Human Genetics) with Prof. Maduro was one the most interesting classes I've taken. This professor has very high standards, but really does care about his students. If you're interested in the subject and ready to make the time commitment, this class will be very rewarding. If you're simply looking to get an upper div easy A, look elsewhere.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Maduro is a very good professor and is very engaging during lectures for bio 115 human genetics. The material is actually interesting and he explains concepts well. However, the class itself is very difficult and takes a lot of effort to pass. Clickers every class, however you must be present to get the points. Avoid if u want an easy A.

Hands down the best professor at UCR and my favorite I've taken so far. If you really enjoy biology take it with Professor Maduro. He really makes you work for your grade, but he's an extremely talented lecturer and gives so many resources to his students. I loved every single lecture of his, and wish he could teach the  whole bio 5 series.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: If you take his class, be prepared to work. Hard. However, if you do you'll come out with an incredible understanding of the material. Caring, engaging, approachable. Very human. My favorite professor. I wish he taught engineering courses.   Book is useless, UTILIZE HIS RESOURCES!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took this class two years ago and i still love this guy! honestly my favorite professor at UCR and my favorite course even though i received a B.  Test are demanding and he does put a lot of focus on the causes and effects of certain events.  His lecture notes are better than the book and have almost everything you need for an A.

One of the best prof out there but you have to understand the material to do well in class. Simple memorization wont help so you have to stay on top of your studying. Exams  are extremely fair and reflect what was emphasized in class and practice questions.  Attend the office hours because he is really helpful. Highly recommended!

He is a very eloquent speaker, and very good at lecturing. He has one of the best attendance among any big lectures that I've ever seen. In terms of difficulty of exams, he purposely makes his exams somewhat tricky, and truly expects the student to have mastered the content.

Professor Maduro expects A LOT from his students. Too much for a 10 week course. He talks extremely fast, so print out the notes. The quiz questions were ridiculously specific. Even though the midterm and final were mc, there were the ones with multiple write answers. IMO Biochem series was nothing in comparison.

Dr. Maduro is a very good professor who keeps you interested and cares that students succeed. His notes have a lot of information, and it is pretty much necessary to attend lecture in order to really understand, but it's worth it with him. He makes a difficult course much more enjoyable.

Dr. Maduro expects a lot from his students, but he cares a lot about student success and will help you as much as he can. He moves very quickly through lectures, but he posts notes before class. Pro tip: print them out and follow them through lecture. If something he says isn't in there, write it down. It's the best way to keep up.
Awesome teacher, The other half was taught by Ray who completely sucked, but this guy was great

I loved his teaching style and it is truly a unique experience compared to any other course. You truly get out what you put in. Probably the hardest multiple choice I've yet to take, but if you stay on top of the material you should be able to take on the midterms + final. Great class though, super interesting and very fair.
Funny and never dull. Approachable. Knows his stuff and gives fair tests. Definitely utilize the book! Supplement lecture notes with reading!

Professor Maduro is great. He really knows his stuff and he expects his students to as well. Read the textbook after lecture to clarify everything. He tests you on the concepts so don't just memorize everything. He's super funny and his class was a joy to attend.

Maduro is the best bio teacher period..  He's very clear and concise on what he teaches.  You have to know the concepts in order to answer his questions.  Questions aren't tricky in any way and are straight forward.  All the answers look good to someone who doesn't know the material.  I'd definitely recommend him to everyone.  He's hilarious too.

He can be repetitive during lecture, but he actually understands the material so he expects you to understand the material as well. Don't expect to memorize the conceptual things because he expects you to actually understand it, otherwise you will not do well in his course. The curve is not that favorable as well.

This guy is great. A lot of younger professors don't teach too well, but he is REALLY good. And he's funny! Never a dull moment. Make sure you understand concepts and themes and don't just memorize. He understands the subject can be dry and finds a way to make it really interesting. Also really helpful in office hours.

Expects a lot. but its good for your own understanding of the concepts. as long as you read and work hard this class will be a breeze. curve was nice.      had this prof along w/ Cardullo and i would recommend this class..

His tests were difficult, but if you study you can do really well.  You will get out of this class what you put into it.  He is a great guy.  Sit in the front and get to know him.  He is really generous with his curve... especially if he knows you.  This class was amazing!

Great and funny lecturer. He knows his material and teaches it the best way possible. The course was difficult and tests were a little tricky. Overall, if he had not used clickers I would say I loved the course. However, he is one of UCRs best professors.

he is a good professor but relatively fair on the midterms and final. he knew exactly what he was talking about and taught it really well, but the final was really hard. it had stuff that was not covered in class. really study hard if you want to pass.

Awesome teacher! he is so funny and will keep you awake the whole lecture. His tests are tricky so get a good feel for his style with the clicker questions and quarter midterms to prepare for his exams. I'd recommend him to anyone.

Along with Dr Thompson, I loved Maduro as a professor!! he is hilarious and seems so so smart and just listening to him lecture is entertaining. I never missed a lecture, always looked forward to lecture, never looked at the clock and I definately hope i have him as a professor again.

Greatest professor and funniest. He is a fair grader in this course but the material is not easy. His notes are clear and straight forward but it is a lot of material. Tests are not difficult and average was in the 75/100 range. By the way, bring the clicker.

great class, great professor. there are some days when i wouldn't feel like going to class, but would go anyways because he made it fun. he's funny and helpful. TAKE THIS CLASS! and if you keep up with the reading, it's pretty much guaranteed that you'll get an A.

Pretty easy going guy, pretty sarcastic. His lectures are understandable, but when it comes to the midterms, its like you never have taken the class. He says all the material comes from his lectures and lecture notes (he is against using the book), but apparetly not everything is from his lectures, which fraustrated me. Better than Dr Thompson thou
Great teacher, easy to understand his lectures. His test are clear and straightforward. defiantly would recommend to every bio student

At first I thought I was going to hate biology, but Dr. Maduro made everything awesome.  His tests are very fair, and he is extremely helpful during review sessions.  He is very knowledgable and he is a great asset to UCR.  He also cares a lot about the students.  We need more professors like him.
Really sarcastic, yet teaches very well. Thinks the top students are not social or not cool, yet his analogies relate to ipods and gossip. He's ok.

Hella funny!! I guess compared to Dr. Hymen, he would be the hip one. One class he actually free-styled to an eminem song.. haha what a nerd. But besides that, he makes lectures really interesting and understandable. Review lecture notes and read!! Office hours are really helpful too.
GREAT PROFESSOR + like to use computer related vocabulary/analogy to explain

Loved this professor..he's simply the best at 5A..and if you're complaining that he's hard try taking another professor..you'll come running back to Maduro.  He gave me hope that I could accomplish anything when I had been struck down by Hyman's advice.  Made the class bearable and made me have the confidence to succeed in the class.
No Comments
Funny guy, talks fast, tests are tricky. What is covered the tests is the points in lecture that he doesn't emphasize. Do the reading, always.

Bio 168 materials are hard, but it's very interesting. He presented the lectures very well and his good sense of humour keep you from dreading going to class. Approachable and extremely helpful during office hrs.

Professor or stand up comic?  Take your pick, he's great at both!  Hands down the nicest and most entertaining prof I've had at UCR, and he knows his stuff and (I think) explains it well too.  I wish I could steal him over to the college of engineering...

First teacher that didn't make me feel stupid during office hours.  He truly cares about the success of his students.  Very friendly in his e-mails and etc...  If you like MP3's and know a lot about them you will love his lectures.  He always relates the subject material to MP3 files.

Very helpful teacher during office hour and very considerate. He's very funny and make biology less boring than it seems. If you are computer literate person, you will love his analogy. Looking forward to having him in BIO168.

Good professor but makes a few too many jokes (the immature guys in the class all love him for it!)  Doesn't explain the material quite and thorough as one would like.  Talks fast but is very approachable and considerate.  I would reccommed Hyman over Maduro but both working together were great

Maduro cares about if the students are learning in his class. GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS! cant stress this enough. He is a very approachable professor... you will never feel intimidated to come up to him. study hard for bio 5A. and remember: INTEGRATE YOUR MATERIAL FROM BEGINNING TILL THE END!
his lectures are funny once in awhile, even though he doesn't truly explain everything.  But he makes it up with his cute look...
good and amusing teacher. he's young and very educated. he sincerely cares about his students and is very approachable.
He has a great sense of humor, but when it comes to the material, make sure you've done all the reading because he does not explain things well enough to completely understand whats going on.
Great professor; he helped to clear up a lot of things and gives good advice. I'd recommend him to everybody.

Fairly easy class, only one 50 minute online discussion per week. Roughly 3 assignments a week with one test every other week. Tests are open note (including google). Fair policy on AI, you just disclose how and why you used it. Awkward due dates such as Thursday's at 9 pm for tests and some assignments. Class is entirely ran and graded by TA's.

I would only take this class if you need the credits and you want fully online. There was a ton of homework which took me away from my major classes. The discussion is fully ran by the students which is annoying. She would say some assignments weren't creative enough so she would give you a D on those.

Please, i highly do not recommend this course!  I assumed this class was going to be interesting and inspiring but i was wrong. The lectures are long and outdated, the grading is unreliable, and it's difficult contact the professor or TA's. It became a stressful situation where it took me away from my other courses and responsibilities.

The instructions are unnecessarily complicated. Her lecture videos are outdated - more than a decade old. Her wordings in the syllabus and canvas page are inconsistent which makes it more confusing. The only plus is my TA - who gives me some clarity and explains the readings for the week.

I believe Prof. Murphy deserves a fairer rating. I took Dance007 online, and it was both easy and inspiring. What surprised me even more was that the TA provided feedback on every single assignment. This is a foundational course so although you will be asked to dance at home every week (but only 1 at the beginning that requires to upload video).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Lot of work for this class; regret taking it.
She posts lectures from years ago. Entirely online except for discussions. So many assignments with awkward due dates. Very stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Worst Professor Ever!

So many assignments for this class. She never really does anything but posts old lectures from YEARS ago and never actually talks to students. My girl needs to retire because she clearly doesn't want to be here.
Does not know how to communicate at all! You can only get through to her through TAs because she never responds to her emails. Overall, she seems unmotivated and tired of teaching.
Took her during remote classes and she was so unhelpful! Did not respond to any of my emails and left the communication to the TAs. Her lectures were also very boring.

The professor literally never spoke to us (the students) and her lectures were prerecorded from (probably) years ago. The TA's do everything but they have to follow her guidelines and course layout/schedule with specific due dates which SUCK and are very unrealistic. There are quite a lot of assignments per week, too. Google will be your friend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Not worth taking this class. The TA did all the work and throughout the course I emailed the Professor on 3 different occasions and not once did she email me back. Too much work for no reason and literally the longest lecture videos ever. If you want to pass write down EVERYTHING on the lecture slides, you will thank me later.

I would not recommend this class at all. A ton of busy work and its basically all just reiterating the same thing over and over. Some of it is easy enough work, but you do (unfortunately) have to put a lot of time into this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: There are many assignments for this class and they were all due by 5pm, which took getting used to. I never directly contacted the professor but the TA was helpful. The only time I emailed the professor about a test, I received no response. Overall, it was a lot of work and I would not take it again.
She didn't do anything. The TA did all the work. I emailed her once and she didn't respond. This class is alot of work! They make you work for that grade chileeeeee.

definitely a lot more work than i expected but very doable. the assignments are easy just a lot each week. stay up to date and you should be fine. your grade is dependent on the ta, i only saw her once during the first week when she came in during our first zoom call

The online class is well organized and paced. Shea Murphy knows her stuff and has some great guest lecturers. You are graded on attendance, so show up to your session. Your TA grades most of the work, so be nice to them. There is a nit-picky assignment of questionable value due almost EVERY OTHER DAY. If you're not organized, stay away.

DNCE 007 online was more work than I expected. The class is really easy because all you have to do is watch video lectures, readings and reflection quizzes and a dance journal each week. Had to pay to take final, when midterms were open book and open note :/ Mandatory attendance of dance event for essay and final group project took some time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: NOT AN EASY A. Definitely makes you work hard for an A. You have to pay $25 to take your final, do a group project w/ recorded presentation, attend a live performance & write an essay about it, SOMETHING DUE ALMOST EVERY DAY, & the TAs DO NOT grade easy. I barely watched the lectures & did the readings but luckily had help from someone. DONT TAKE
should've just taken CS8 .____.

Very rude and condescending! The TAs grade super harshly as they expect too much (doing the bare minimum isn't enough). WAY too much work. Don't think this is a laid back class you can take with your hard ones. This class constantly gets in the way as there's always so much work (hwk due like 3 times a week, long midterms every other week). Avoid.
AVOID AVOID AVOID. PLEASE I REGRET TAKING THIS CLASS SO MUCH IT MAKES ME WANT TO CRY.

Yoga class was a waste of time.  She waste time with confusing wordyexplanations. Do poses cold. Obsessed w props. I learned a lot about folding blankets. Not serious for anyone inreasonable  shape with an ounce of body awareness.

Such a lame class. But really easy if you do all the work. It is essentially all busy work with a little writing here and there. Just think about it, its a dance class how hard can it be... Did all the work and got an A.

Thought it was an easy class but it's not...for this class, you really need to be interested in the analysis of dancing in order to do well. Lectures can be boring and are very long. There is also tons of work due very single week. Sort of regret taking this class.

i hated this class. although i got an A-, it was very difficult because it was so boring i would fall asleep everyday! i only got an A because of the essay and final. the final is easy if you study but the readings she assigns are pointless and like 40 pages! sucky class but due-able.

I took her DNCE075A yoga class, which i enjoyed going to. She individually helps every student with specific concerns or problems. Every day we worked on a specific portion of our body and one of the days we practiced yoga positions that are beneficial while we're sick. I recommend taking this course you just need to show up and you'll pass.
Not a good class...

Let me tell you about her. Since day One she walked in late to class. She is very Technologicaly challeneged when she would show us videos as a reference.  If she doesn't like your comment she would just ignore you. Her readings are pointless because she gives about 40 pages to read and theen 1 or 2 questions to answer! Dont Recomend!
She does not know how to teach, and picks on students who do not bow down to her.  She cares about her students, but she does not know how to be fair. She is judgemental.

Trash professor. Extremely difficult exams that require a ton of memorization. Please believe me when I say that the other reviews that gave this horrible professor a 5/5 are stupid and are completly lying. I got an A in ochem and a B- in this class. That is how hard this class is.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Despite lots of memorization, identification, and knowing the facts of bug's biology, life cycles, and pathogens, Dr. Murillo teaches well and pretty nice especially during office hours. You must attend lectures to fill in lecture notes as slides will not be provided. Overall, pretty interesting course especially learning mosquito's pathogens.

PLEASE DON'T TAKE!!! First off, you have to collect 20 different insects in 12 different orders. That is basically impossible and she doesn't curve or grade generously. The exams are extremely difficult and are based on very specific details from LAB slides. The lectures aren't posted so you have to attend or borrow someone's notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: PLEASE DON'T TAKE!!! You have to collect 20 different insects in 12 different orders (like bettles, flies, etc). The exams are extremely difficult and are based on very specific details. You have to bust your ass off in this class. She is also an extremely strict grader. I always get As in my classes yet I barely got a B in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The material was not hard at all but it was just a lot to learn. She is a pretty nice professor and tries to make each lecture a bit easier with note outlines. Study and memorize outline notes to do good. The bug collection was the heaviest part to complete. Quizzes and lab material are just for attence points but it gets a bit boring.

Prefacing the review by saying this is my second B in college; this class is just too much work for intro entomology. Lectures aren't posted, if you miss class GG. Insect collection is worth as much as your exams and fulfilling the requirements is basically impossible unless you're looking every single day. Exams aren't easy either.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!! This class is as difficult as Ochem 8B. Her exams are very hard and they require memorizing A LOT of material and she doesn't post lecture slides, just audio clips. As a smart and studios guy myself, I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND taking another class because you're gonna have to put in a lot of effort in this class TO EVEN PASS.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A large amount of info that must be memorized. Don't miss a lecture or you won't have important notes for that day. Must collect 20 different types of insects which is quite difficult. Exams are pretty difficult and labs are kinda boring, as a large percentage of it is just the TA lecturing even more notes that will be on the exams.
Dr. Murillo is one of the best professors you will ever meet. She is kind, and so easy to talk with. Take her you wont regret it.
same reviewer as the first one.... accidentally mismarked the difficulty and can't change it..... it was a pretty easy class.

Dr. Murillo is amazing. The course is a lot of information but she breaks it down and translates it in such a digestible way that you kind of have to try to do terribly. She saw a lot of people didn't do well on the midterm so she offered extra credit to make it up. She makes a lot of jokes and references to better remember material.
Good professor, and very clearly knowledgeable in his field

He was a food teacher but attendance was said to be necessary but not really since he would post the slides. He goes into depth about the subject to where it may be too in depth from the test. Theres 3 exams using bluebooks. Was monotone and an accent.
You only have two midterms and a final for your grade. Lectures are a bit heavy but he goes over the material in detail so its a little painful. A textbook is mandatory but I never used it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Flexible with remote examsthat is the only nice thing I have to say. Grades are based entirely on 3 exams, which are graded somewhat arbitrarily because there are no comments or feedback so you have no idea where you were lacking or how to improve. If you email him with a question, he will purposely ignore you if he doesn't like your question.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Absolutely loved this class! You can really tell that Professor Muller is passionate about the subject he teaches. The class is solely based on three exams - two midterms and one final. If you attend lectures, take notes, participate in discussions, and study at least a week in advance for the exams, you'll most likely get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Pre-recorded lectures that are pretty lengthy, but could be sped up tp get through them faster. Discussion not really mandatory but they do take attendance. He had 3 short answer midterms but cancelled the last one due to covid which was nice. The final was an essay. He's super nice and accommodating and the class is pretty interesting

Took the course online due to corona, the lectures were pre recorded and were long, sometimes boring, but overall interesting. I personally have lots of notes from lectures. Discussion was great for me. The midterms were easy, and the final is pretty much the same. Overall a great class and if you like philosophy you will be just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Solid class. Professor sometimes tries to say a few jokes to lighten the mood. Lectures are boring, but I recommend going just because. If you decide not to go, at least attend discussions. Go to both if you want to understand the material in more detail.

If you don't go to lectures, read. If you don't read, go to lectures. You really only need one or the other to do well. One midterm, one paper, one final- easy enough. Pay attention at all and you'll do just fine. This guy's not bad and genuinely cares about the subject.

If you do the readings and understand them you honestly don't have to go to lecture. If you don't do the readings, attend lecture. He provided a study guide for the midterm and final which helped. Just do the readings.

He does not take attendance for lecture, but you are strictly only allowed to miss one discussion. The only grades at the end of the term are the midterm, final, and essay. He is EXTREMELY monotone, you will fall asleep at every lecture, and his accent makes difficult concepts impossible to understand. The content of the class is very interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I hated the class as I found the actual content to be boring. However, he was my favorite professor the quarter I took the class. He does a good job of breaking down concepts to make better sense although I found myself still needing to attend lecture to truly understand some concepts and they did a better job of concisely wrapping it up.

Very monotone teacher, which made the ancient material even harder to understand. However, my TA David B., was awesome with helping us summarize the material learned in lectures. Definitely had to do more studying than I expected since the material is ancient. Went to TA office hours a lot and got a higher grade than expected.

Professor Muller is so helpful. However, class can get boring if you do not have an interest in the subject. You learn so much and the TA David B. is just amazing! Great class with lots of reading, one essay, one midterm, and one final exam! Exams are easy, but only if you study and if you attend class regularly! I strongly recommend this class!

Muller is very hard to understand and so monotone that it is hard to stay focused or even pay attention to what he is saying. He also speaks so low you cannot hear even if he has a microphone. As for the class it was very boring for me, his TA Meredith is the only reason I found this class sort of interesting. I used the book maybe twice.

Unfortunately the combination of ancient philosophy, professor Muller's accent, and that this was a lower division lecture class made it tough to want to do anything. Barely read the book, went to discussion, passed. Nothing truly exciting.

Everyone says he's gorgeous but he's honestly just your average professor. His accent coupled with his softspokeness makes lectures difficult to understand. There are only 3 components that make up your grade so if you mess one up you can pretty much kiss a decent grade goodbye. Pay attention and ALWAYS go to discussion.
Hotest teacher ive ever had and his accent wow. Its kind of confusingg but its philosophy i dont think its meant to be easy. His class is mostly boring but sometimes makes you really think.

Professor Muller has an interesting accent which captures your attention. It is, therefore, very easy to pay attention and grasp the material. The texts, lectures, and discussions are critical to your success. Listen, understand, and be able to repeat what you learn and you will get an A.

Dr. Muller is great outside of class but in lecture he is very dry. I hated going to lecture because not only was it boring but it was hard to follow and it was in the UV. Overall it was an easy class because he is easy, but his TA John, was super hard. Buy the book, do the readings, and go to lecture (section is useless) and it won't be too bad.

Jozef Muller is hot, but he doesn't teach the class very good. It's easy to get lost and fall asleep since he is soft-spoken and very self-centered about his looks and hair, which makes it very useless to learn about the material. But, he is a lenient and easy grader. However, if you want learn something worthwhile, he isn't that type of professor.

Fall 2011 was his first quarter at UCR. Very organized lectures. Pay attention in class and take good notes. Class contains: 1 midterm, 1 final, 2 papers. He provides study guides for both exams. If you study those you will ace the exams. Do well on the papers too to ace the class. Overall, good professor.

Easy class, but don't ever buy his textbook. He encouraged us to buy it because it would be "very helpful for review." He never addressed it ever again and it didn't even line up with our lecture content so it wasn't useful for studying at all. Make sure to go to section and you'll be fine!

He was a nice and funny professor.  The lecture was heavy and he didn't post it on Canvas at that time, TA had to do it.  A midterm and final.  Both were from the weekly homework he assigns.  TA goes over that homework at discussion.  Textbook was not necessary.  He was caring and asked us if we had any questions during the lecture.

Professor did not upload lecture slides on time so I had to take pictures of every lecture slide during lecture. He also didn't communicate with the TAs very well and didn't let students know exam dates until a week before the test. There are only two exams the midterm and the final and then there's homework which is an easy 100%.

The syllabus was pretty unclear - didn't have dates for midterms or final - let us know a few weeks in advance. I skipped a lot but wish I hadn't. I left the class feeling super inspired, he is such a passionate and caring professor and i highly recommend taking  any class with him. Also wish he wouldn't make us buy his OWN book.

I would not recommend this professor based on how unorganized his class was. No clear communication between him, the TAs, and the students. You could pass the class if you attend lecture and take lots of notes, but its super stressful. We got all the quiz grades towards the end of the quarter, and the final counted for 50% of grade (never again)

DON'T buy the textbook. (It's not worth it.) You don't have to attend every lecture. Everything you need to get an A is on the powerpoints.

HW is MCQ and get reused for exams. Lectures are very dense, so don't try to memorize everything. No midterm study guide, so gently berate your TA to review the important stuff so you know what to memorize.

This professor is very caring and inspiring! He made accommodations to us seeing as how the first few weeks of winter quarter were online and transitioned during midterm seasons. There are hw assignments every week that help with the midterm and final exam! Very fun class and would take again!
He gave me the confidence to study physics.

Professor Bahram Mobasher, was extremely dedicated on his lectures and was extremely passionate for his material! However, the grading system was unorganized by either him or his TAs. Although his humor and dedication showed throughout the quarter! In addition he let us use our notes during the final & midterm so that was great. Sweet Professor!

Dr. Mobasher is a terrific professor! Class is not that hard, open notes exams. Downside is that Final is worth 50% of your grade. Weekly HW's and lowest HW dropped. HW questions repeat on exams so study those. Didn't personally use the textbook. He is super sweet and knowledgeable and wants us to pass.

The TA and Professor were never on the same page with grading or even the syllabus. Exams are open notes but the material is too dense to understand so you'll need good notes. 100 question final in 120 minutes. 50 question midterm. Class is not curved despite averages being low. If you score higher on the final than the midterm it replaces it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Mobasher was a joy. He truly cares about his students, I took him during the pandemic and he was genuinely concerned for our welfare. The exams were all open note which was extremely helpful. As long as you try your best he'll be proud of you. 10/10 recommend

This professor is very caring and kind but the material is very dense for nonscience majors. I struggled a lot but the weekly homework is okay since you can retake multiple times. The midterm is very soul-crushing class average was a C but yeah might be easier for science majors, but a very hard breadth class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: LOVE HIS CLASS! His teaching style is amazing, he does talk fast and puts slides up, but i recommend just paying attention to what he says as opposed to reading the slides. He is passionate about the class(students), he is hilarious as well! just do the readings, study your notes and the weekly Homework plus Exams will be a breeze!

Professor Mobasher is a great professor who prioritizes your learning over a bunch of random work. The class' workload was not that bad, i believe final was cumulative. Definitely requires a lot of studying, but exams are heavily reliant on homework questions so do them. Lecture and discussion attendance isn't required but will help a lot.

Really nice professor, makes lots of dad jokes. Lecture and discussion are not mandatory. Discussion was basically used to go over homework, so I didn't go much. Prof Mobasher will go out of his way to help you. Kind of difficult material, but easy tests that are exactly like the homework. Got the textbook but didn't need it

Professor Mobasher is a very inspiring teacher. He cracks jokes here and there and he really cares for you. Overall the class was definitely work. The slides and presentations were often filled with dense information. To supplement this, I suggest reading the textbook chapter in order to gain a better understanding and to connect the dots.

Professor Mobasher is an amazing professor. He makes the lectures go by fast and genuinely cares about whether students understand the information. You must read the textbook for this class. You can't complain about the homework because every answer to every homework question is in the book. Attend all lectures and read the chapters to do well.

Took this class because everyone said it would be easy, but it actually is not. Midterm and final are hard, especially the final was worth 50% of your grade. Never went to lecture because it doesn't help or make sense. Even if you have 100% on HW, you need to get an A on the final which is 100 questions, with no study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Honestly took this class bc I thought it was going to be easy, but which was I wrong. The professor is chill but his lectures are so hard to keep up with. There's so much information it's crazy. The midterm & final were also harddd!!! Just doing the hw & reading the slides ain't enough. I'd if I'm even going to pass cause the final is worth 50%
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: One of the chillest professors out there. The homeworks are all online, due once a week. Lectures are quite interesting because he does put effort and answers all of the students questions. The midterms and the finals are surprisingly easy. if you wanna pass the class, just memorize all of the homework answers. SUPER LENIENT.

One of the most enjoyable professors I've had! Lectures are a bit dull but makes cute little jokes here and there to lighten the mood. He assigns homework once a week. I went to discussion twice but it might help if you are constantly confused about the homework. Exams are based off the slides (posts online)and homework. Make friends to study with.

AMAZING. Going to his lectures cheered me us each time. Because all class material is covered in lecture, if you skip, you wont learn it anywhere else because his slides are very confusing, so in lecture he summarize for you. Very inspirational, loves teaching, caring, and even on demand office hours. The Origins is a very interesting class as well

He is the best professor I have ever seen in my life. Not attendance-based class and only weekly assignment with less than 15 multiple choice questions. He is nice and has very clear instruction. Lecture is very good and I encourage to go because his midterm and final will be lecture and homework based. Midterm and final are not hard at all.

he cares about his students so much and i love that. he doesnt want anyone to fail his class and hell definitely work with you. i borrowed the book from a friend but didnt use it until the final. his powerpoints are a little weird so i just study the homeworks

Professor Mobasher is perhaps one of the most inspiring and caring people I have gotten to know at UCR. His passion for astronomy and his work shows in every lecture. He shows that he cares for the education of his students; at the beginning of the quarter he told us that he hoped to change our lives with his class--he was right.

This is the most loving and passionate professor I've ever had. He truly cares about his students. The class is interesting but attendance is not mandatory. He'll even work with you if you're unhappy with your grade. The book isn't required but around week 5 I ended up buying it anyway since it's interesting and makes your life much easier.

He's a really funny lecturer who tells Dad jokes. Lecture isn't completely mandatory but it's really nice to go and listen to what he says. But definitely always go to discussion. Hw is super easy, test are a little hard, you really need to study for it. Book, honestly don't buy it, just take pictures from someone else who buys it.

Prof Mobasher is a great person in general with a cheesy sense of humor. But his lectures are boring if you're taking for breadth. He posts slides online (although late). There's weekly homework (we had 8), which is 25%. Midterm 25% and final is 50%. He recommends buying his textbook which was $70. But I still got a B studying off his slides only.

i thought i was interested in cosmology, i was wrong. it will be personally preference to whether you like the class or not, i was bored most of the time. all his power points will be on ilearn, same with the homework. tests will be more tricky be they are cumulative and they change up questions and answers from homework and lecture.

If you attend lecture and study the ppt notes/ homework for the exams then you will do fine! The homework is very easy, but you need to make sure you understand the problems and not just have them memorized for the tests. I didn't buy the book. The people who thought this class was hard were probably the ones who didn't show up for lectures

I was recommended to take this class bc it was supposedly easy, but that is not the case.  50% of your grade is the final 25 is Hw, and 25 is the midterm.  HW is an easy 25% you can find many of the Hw questions on quizlet or studyblue In prior years there was no book, so both the midterm and the final were based solely on hw... not any more.
awesome professor, pretty hard class though. you need to really pay attention and do the hw, since most of the midterm and final come from there.

Definitely not my favorite professor! Homework is easy but the midterm and finals were hard! hw and midterm are worth 50% finals 50% of your grade. Some questions are coming from the book which is pretty lame because he "recommended" it and told the class a week before midterm. 100 questions for finals with NO STUDY GUIDE WHATSOEVER!!!
favorite teacher, go to class cuz hes funny but not necessary to pass. do the homeworks

He was the best Professor  I have ever had!! His lectures are so interesting and his H.W. assignments pretty much go over what you learn during the week. He has a lot of knowledge and knows his stuff pretty well.  He is pretty funny at times... wish he taught another class I would so take him again!!

It's an easy class, the guy still works with NASA so he's in and out of class and has his TA's do a lot of the grunt work, which is understandable. He includes anecdotes from his time at NASA, working with the Hubble space telescope etc, makes lectures more interesting. He cares about his students and he's bursting at the seams with love for life.

Midterm was harder than the final for me. I got a C+ on the midterm and a B+ on the final. Because of my C+ on the midterm I decided to play safe and take this class pass or fail. Don't, it's not that hard. Midterm is 75% hw and the rest is lecture. Final is like 85% hw and the rest is lecture.
No book. Easiest most recommended breathe course. I did not attend one lecture  and got an A. Discussion is not mandatory but it helps. Take it. Easy and understandable. All slides posted on line

When you learn what he teaches you and see how much of an impact he has on you, you will be forever grateful. Learned more from this class than any other. By far best professor and best class; no other professor/teacher even comes close.
He's super helpful and funny. Definitely a class you'd want to take if you're looking to knock out a physical science breadth.

Professor is very interested but many people were not so attendance is really low. As long as you go over the slides and homework you will do fine. Try to go to class even if it may seem unnecessary. Easy class if you study key points.
He's really nice the class is easy. Don't buy the book you definitely don't need it. Just go to class and discussion. My TA told us the answers to all the homework. Good class to take.

He is a fabulous professor! He is very passionate, and truly cares about what he teaches, and the students. He makes the lectures fun and interesting, although it is not mandatory to attend. You do not need to buy the book, and the midterm and final are basically the homework assignments. Easy class, and fantastic professor!

Really passionate and knowledgeable professor! Attendance isn't crucial because slides are posted but I would suggest just going to listen. SUCKED at science before this class but I ended up with an A and actually understanding the material! I really enjoyed having him as a professor and if you're not too lazy to do the work you will too.

Mobasher truly loves his students and is very passionate about what he teaches. He cracks cute jokes all the time and makes class interesting. He is one of the great professors on this campus. I am truly grateful of having him for a professor. He even came back to watch us do our last final with him. Great teacher overall.

An amazing professor who truly cares for his students. He gets a round of applause after every lecture and he earns it. Do not buy the book and attendance isn't mandatory, but people go to see him, his passion, and his corny jokes. Should be a role model for others.

He is the sweetest professor ever! Is very passionate about what he teaches and is beyond brilliant. He makes physics super interesting and easy to understand even if you are not a science person. His accent makes NO difference because he still is able to get his point across clearly without any problems. Loved his class!
He was amazing! Super nice and funny. His class was easy and super interesting. Would love to take a class by him again :D
Great teacher!Funny at times.Cares about his students. The class is easy overall.DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK!Midterm and final are based on notes but more on homework.
Great proffesor, easy class.

DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK! You don't need it! The lectures notes and discussions help with the homework and the tests basically are the homework. Lectures go into a lot of detail, but you do not need to remember most of it. Pretty easy class.

BEST PROFESSOR. he is so nice!! midterm and final are based off of homework. lectures are definitely not mandatory and if you do go, you'll learn its hard to understand what he's saying because of his heavy accent. He cares deeply for his students and hes willing to help anyone. hes funny and so adorable. seriously, take this class.

This class is unbelievably. DONT BUY THE BOOK, NO NEED TO ATTEND LECTURE!! Trust me on this one: just attend all the discussions (that's where every single homework question is answered) and the midterm/final comes DIRECTLY from the homework. I stopped attending lecture after the 3rd week of the quarter and ended up receiving an A+
His class is real easy

A really great professor that knows what he's teaching. He goes through the slides a tad bit too fast, but since he posts them online it's not that big of a deal. He's also funny and I really enjoyed taking this class. Also if you ask him for an extra day off for Thanksgiving he might say yes. (I know this from experience that he does.)

This class is really easy as long as you do the homework and at least go over the lectures. The professor is very smart and clearly cares about his students. He will take time out of class to answer students questions. Textbook is not required since all his exams are based off his powerpoints (which he posts online).

Okay, this class was definitely not a cake walk. I thought I knew most of the material before walking into the final, but I got a 66%. You have to do well on the final, or you are not guaranteed an A or high B. I think there should have been a curve, if not on the midterm then definitely on the final. His lectures were alright, not mandatory.

Treat this professor well because he deeply cares about his students. Grade based on HW, Midterm, and Final. I would say that his tests are mostly based on the homework questions, but also review those slides carefully because he throws some questions from them too. Overall, he's good and so is the class. He even gave the class 2 days off!
Lecture was useless, he spent most of the time answering random questions. Discussions was where the teaching/questions were actually answered.

Don't let people fool you, this class isn't a cake walk. Must do well on hw, understand at least some hw, and memorize it to do well on midterm and final. As a guideline understand and memorize the homework for exams. Most questions will be exactly like hw, but some are not and that's what gets you. Lecture is useless, read slides & go to disc.
One of the best professors at UC Riverside. He genuinely enjoys teaching. Midterm & final are based almost entirely off of the homework.

His class is very boring, you will eventually learn that going to class is useless because it is very hard to understand what he is saying due to his accent. 75 percent of the test are from homework, exact question. But I would recommend going to discussion to get the other 25 percent of the test questions.
hard to understand him because of his thick accent. 25% hw, 25 % midterm, and 50 % final. 100 questions. you decide.....

He's a laid-back person. Overall it's an easy class, however, although he says that you don't need the book, I would recommend that you get it anyway. His accent is hard to understand and his powerpoint notes are unorganized and confusing. The midterm and test are MOSTLY from the homework, but not ALL which is why I will say again get the book!

Professor Mobasher was a pretty good teacher in my opinion.  He described the topic of the universe in great detail and explained it in a way to relate to the students.  This class is no gimme, you have to study the lecture slides for a while because there is so much information at times.
Really care about his students doing well and was enthusiastic throughout the course. His lectures were posted on iLearn and made it easy to catch up if you missed class.

Excellent professor. Hilarious, deeply cares about his students, has huge enthusiasm for physics. He makes you look forward to going to class. Tests and homework are a piece of cake. The best professor at UCR.
Only downside was he has a very thick accent. However, his class is very easy to pass. I literally NEVER went to class and passed. Textbook not mandatory
He really knew his stuff. He is a renowned Astro-physicist from Iraq. Just get 100% on the HW and you'll pass the class..

He really knows his astronomy.  He is also ridiculously easy.  Just do the homework, look over the PowerPoint slides, and you're set. :)  I also got an "A" in that class without putting in that much effort or even attending lecture that often. lol
Great professor. Tests are based on his weekly HWs. And lecture is not mandatory. Discussion/workshops are not mandatory, unless you want the answers for the HW. Take him! Guarantee a passing grade!
This class is really easy. He is a good professor and is funny. Discussion or lecture doesn't require attendance. Lecture notes, homeowrk, and tests are all easy.

Mr. (Maxwell) Murphy was honestly a pretty hard teacher, but honestly, he provided good feedback and whatever you needed help with, he would offer to help. He responded to emails in a reasonable amount of time and provides enough resources to pass. With that being said, the class is rather lecture heavy, so be ready for a lot of listening.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
Way too many lectures and the slides and material learned were too much info making it complicated to learn. 
I would not take this class again, He takes a very long time to grade assignments so I have no idea of my actual grade. Over class is too complicated and not well oganized. even reading the slides in the lectures does not make sense.

He gives a lot of reading that isn't always covered in lectures so its a little frustrating when you read something that didn't end up being discussed. He likes to go on a lot of tangents which could be a little confusing. The study guide is super long.  However, the tests end up reflecting the material covered well. Not a lot of class discussion.

Lots of reading. He uploads the slides on blackboard but puts way too much on them. Class wasn't as interesting as I thought it'd be. He held a review section which was kind of helpful. Overall, I dreaded going to this class and thought it wasn't organized well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's good professor, but if you don't do the read then you're fudged. He goes over the readings, but most of the time only focuses on one book and touches upon the other. Just  make sure you do the reading he doesn't focuses as much and you're good. Over all the class was interesting, but the lectures are long and kinda boring. Just scan the books!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Mulligan is clearly passionate about physics. His lectures are helpful and reflect the material on the exams. The class is graded on 3 exams each worth 25% as well as homework and discussion. His class isn't too difficult as long as you study.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Mulligan was a great professor. His grading scale was very generous. Physics is a difficult subject but he made it easy to understand. The old midterms he offers are a great representation of what to expect. He's the type of professor you want to teach the next course in the series (in this case PHYS002C). Highly recommend!

Great professor, as he concisely explains the matter at hand and answers any questions students have to the best of his ability. GENEROUS grading scale as a C- is 43.5%, but that does not mean slack off. Tests are graded by only 10 questions, so be sure to study as much as possible. Overall, his class is very passable, so be sure to take if offered

Took the accelerated 5-week summer class version and managed to get an A. 3 non-cumulative tests dictate your grade and he posts lectures on YouTube with additional practice exams. The homework is harder than the exams in my opinion. Ask questions!!
Such a good professor. Very respectful and helpful to students.

Out of all the professors at UCR, I would say Professor Mulligan is the most organized and helpful professor I have had. His lectures are clear, he goes over lots of examples, and the test reflects the homework and lectures. If you can't pass with him as your instructor, you may not pass.

Mulligan is a decent prof. Took him this summer and the class itself is in no way easy, but he makes it doable. He has a create curve, but you need to do well on the midterm because the final is much much harder. Midterm was similar to the practice ones.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I think Professor Mulligan is one of the better Physics professors. Others aren't so generous with the grading scale and his midterm was doable. Study and know what you're doing and you'll be fine. Make use of his office hours. He's fair with the grading, respects and cares for his students to do well in his class. Would take again!!
Great professor. Really wants his students to do well.

Professor Mulligan is a wonderful guy! He provides good lecture notes and he cares about students' thoughts. Sometimes he kinda mumbles in the lecture but if you go to his office hour he would explain clearly to you. He definitely wants his students to pass. Exams are doable. One midterm and one final. Midterm was easy but the final was harder.

Midterm is durable, it reflects the lecture notes and practice midterm (maybe easier than the practice one). I had a nightmare with Robert Clare in Phys2A, but Dr. Mulligan saved me. He wants his students to get good grades and feel comfortable with the class as much as possible. He gives a lot of example questions -> they appear on the exam.

GREAT PROF!! his exam is easier then his practice exam as long as you know the formula you will be set not hard to get B in his class might have to work more to get an A clickers are pretty easy to do i got 80/100 and discussion is easy point ! he is nice to his students want them to pass

Wonderful prof, his exam are doable his practice exam are quite similar to his actual exam the average came out to be a 63 % which is a B based off the curve he always double check too make sure we know our material during lecture he only gives out 10 HW for the whole quarter and I can say that the HW he gives actually helps you for the midterm
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: probably one of the most boring physics professors i have taken. His lectures are him reading off the slides and the examples he works out has different steps than the ones in his slides. He tends to confuse himself often during lecture and can sometimes not explain things well. 70 percent is an A- so i guess thats a plus. Avoid if possible

Dr. Kone is a great and down to earth professor. She started ever class with a music video that related to our topic (we saw Jay Z's The story of OJ). she made class an open forum where we can speak freely which I really enjoyed. class is very easy but also so interesting and entertaining! she brought great guest speakers too!

Prof. Kone is actually a good professor, but I wouldn't take her again. I feel like she assigns a lot of unnecessary work. Eighty percent of our grade was a project that consists of papers and an art piece. While it wasn't difficult, it was very time consuming. The rest of the twenty percent was discussion attendance, participation, quizzes.

One of the most memorable professors you will ever have. She is very engaging and up to date with pop culture. Always starts the class with an engaging music video that relates to class! Let me put it this way: as a class we saw Cardi B's "Bodak Yellow" for the first 5 minutes of class (as it was relevant to the topic that day concerning Sex Work).

his notes are very good and useful, but you only get it in lectures. he explain things clearly but sometimes he goes a little too fast and skip his works. A lot of homework towards the end of the quarter. Quiz every other week. 1 midterm 1 final.

Have to go to lectures to do decent and a lot of homework.
We had to memorize everything for the midterm and final. 
Sometimes didn't understand him exactly during lectures but he wrote very clearly and so it was still fine.

Take this class with some friends. 50/50 would take him again.

Professor Potomkin is passionate about his subject, he can look intimidating but is very sweet and caring on the inside. Chase is a great TA and helped my class a lot in grasping the material. Very easy midterm (1) and final. Note: MT samples may seem VERY difficult, but the actual exam is sooo easy!
Very organized and has neat, easy to read slides. It's clear that he wants his students to do well. Practice exams & quizzes are identical to the real ones. Overall a great instructor.

This math professor is very passionate about teaching. He makes sure the students learn the concepts and is very accommodating. His syllabus is clear and gives enough time to do the homework. Lots of office hours and opportunities to earn extra credit.

Amazing math professor, he is a little dry and his voice made me almost fall asleep a few times BUT he gives homework and reviews that actually reflect the midterm and final as well as quizzes. His lectures make sense and are organized, very easy to understand

Sharp guy. Take him if you can. Personally one of my favorite professors here at UCR - very approachable and can give you great advice outside of academics and a GPA.
Taught very well to make the class easier to understand. Tests are similar to homework, just a lot harder.

Dr. Myung is a good professor. Clear directions, and expectations. Very approachable during office hours. However tests can be a beast and he's harsh on grading. His Exam's come from "homework" that is to say book problems, do your homework and you will be fine, He explains everything and doesn't skip steps. Great guy too.
Dr. Myung is a really great professor and is very clear. He is willing to help out students and gives review sessions before the exams. I learned a lot from him.
This is a hard class so dont expect an easy time. His teaching style is pretty great but his exams are ridiculousm especially the final.

This professor should not be allowed the teach. He grades exams like they are desertions. His lectures are a waste of time. The T.A. is definitely not helpful. I would not recommend this professor to anyone even though I passed this class.
Super NAZI you have no choice but to take him and he is hard as hell
He's extremely helpful and puts in a lot of extra time to help his students. He sometimes throws a curve ball on his exams

Very approachable during office hours, but he will give you a guilt trip if you pester him outside of his office hours. Very clear, very fair and will go out of his way to help REALLY pass the class. He emphasizes complete understanding of conceptual material. I recommend this Professor.

The subject was understandable. He was a tough teacher that gave us a good challenge! He was there when we needed help and made himself very accessible whenever we had a question about anything. He is easy to get along with and generally cares if we are learning the material.
I don't like him. he seems very naive

Good teacher whose enthusiastic about chemical engineering and helps his students to be as well. Very approachable demeanor, easy to get along with. Clear and organized lectures. Also good to work for him in his lab!!!
hard exams!!! i don't like his lectures
his final exam is very very long!!!

Dr. Natsuaki makes statistics easy to understand, but you have to attend her lectures. She does give three midterms, but she drops the lowest scored one. She also gives you a 3-page cheat sheet for each of the midterms and on the finals, you are allowed to use a 10-page cheat sheet. Be aware for Two-Sample T-test and ANOVA.

Dr. Natsuaki is super nice and provides students with details about exams beforehand, along with lots of cheat sheets. Statistics in general is complicated, so it's not so much about her teaching, but the amount of time you're willing to put to understand it.

Generally OK as a Professor but insane amounts of confusion caused by miscommunication between TAs and herself for the term paper made the class much more stressful than it needed to be. Also some of the test questions seemed strange. Class is just fine if you read the textbook and compare it with her lecture slides though.

As someone who hates math, I did not have a terrible time in her class and I actually understood what was happening as she makes it easy to understand. There's 3 midterms (1 on Week 10 but your lowest score is dropped). Do the homework problems as they will help you out on midterms and final. Very nice and considerate with student's outside lives.

Class is difficult & must attend lectures or it'll be hard to understand topics. 3 midterms (1 in 10th week & lowest dropped) 1 final, 1 paper. Attendance w/ poll everywhere (lecture). Prof is very sweet & understanding. If struggling w/ mental health, communicate w/ her & TA and you will get an extension. If you work hard, you can do well. STUDY!

Grades are based off lecture and section participation, weekly discussion questions, 2 papers and 3 exams (she drops lowest exam score at the end of quarter). Dr. Natsuaki is a very amazing intelligent professor! Her class was so informative & I'm honestly surprised at how much I learned. She is a great professor and an amazing person! I am currently taking her for PSYC 152 (winter quarter) and she is great at what she teaches and really cares for her students.

she gave a midterm on week 10... It's so unnecessary to give a midterm on week 10. 3 midterms in total and also a final. 2 weekly assignments. Also have 1 movie response paper. Only way I got through this class is because it is open-notes

She was a great teacher, super easy! She was very nice and sweet, as well. Tests were all open note, open book. Recommended!
