If you were failing the class she personally sent out an email telling you to withdraw from her class. Sure, that can seem thoughtful but more than half of the class withdrew from the course. She also assigned a whole project the week of the midterm and made it due the day of the midterm. No one wants to do a whole project when they want to study.

This class was a mess. Maybe it's bc of online learning, but there were too many busy work assignments and the TAs were never on the same page. Exams are easy if you study/memorize the slides. It's not a hard class, but the prof is unorganized and communication in the class needs to be better
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: So, I am not going to lie, this class is A LOT of work in the sense that it is.a bunch of busy work and memorizing. BUT it is do-able. I was able to get an A in both lecture and lab with studying 1-2 days before the exams. Exams are memorization based and half is multiple choice and hald FRQ. Those who are complaining didn't put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Worst upper div! She is extremely disorganized on both the lab and lecture sides of things. No curve in the lab even though the averages were unfair and some classes were easier. She needs to re evaluate herself and her class. She wants very specific answers and will not accept the answer (even though it is correct), unless it is what she wants.

NOT easy to pass! Worst class I've ever taken at UCR. About half of the class or more withdrew, and she even encouraged people to withdraw. No lowering the cutoff, even though most of the class was verging on failing. Don't assume the writing activities are easy points. She wanted very specific answers for the free response portion & delayed grades

Really poor at communicating, lab sections were disorganized and a mess. Lectures were all over the place and pretty unclear at times and the material was not straight forward considering massively overlapping topics. No curve at all which is surprising considering low averages for an upper div; very late grading for exams, assignments, and grade.

This professor truly cares about her students. She is very approachable and answers every single question. Her lectures are neat and organized, but very dense with information. The tests are fair, but very long and ask about specific details. If you memorize the lectures completely you will do fine. Not an easy A, but an interesting class

I really enjoyed this class. It not difficult at all. There's a lot of things to remember but its not bad. A lot of the concepts are gone over in lab so it makes the whole class really easy to understand. Exams consist of multiple choice and short response. She's one of the most caring professors I've had in my 4 years here.
Dr. Van Norman is a great professor! She's very enthusiastic and caring. She makes the concepts very easy to understand.
She was a really enthusiastic professor. Her plant bio class was easy compared to most upper div bios
Dr. Noble is great teacher, super flexible, and chill.
Exams are pretty hard, but very fair. He is very helpful and gives a lot resources. Make sure to not slack off and you will be fine.

Super caring and genuinely wants his students to succeed. His class is heavy on theorems, so not the usual computational math but more conceptual. It was a little difficult to adjust to his teaching at first (coming out of high school) but he is a great teacher. Do the homework, go to lectures and you'll be fine for the midterms and final.
Focuses on theorems a lot

Pretty cool prof. Had him for his first quarter teaching so a little shaky. Much younger and more sympathetic than 99% of professors. Different kind of math, much more theoretical. I bombed the midterm but he offered the final to be worth both midterm/final grade. Tests were worth a lot so study for those. Funny guy, if you try you'll be fine.

He's such a great guy who tries to make the learning experience more interesting and fun. He likes to crack jokes and does well communicating with the students. Very understanding especially considering the difficulty of the course itself. The lecture material felt a little confusing/disorganized at times; expect a lot of studying.
Novakovic is a leading Hegel scholar at the cutting edge of studying his concept of experience, and attending her lectures will transform your view of Hegel. Cannot exaggerate, incredible class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Novakovic is one of the best professors ive ever had. I took her phil 1 class and then signed up for 152. She is easy to follow along and makes lectures really interesting, unfortunately shes leaving UCR but her class was well worth the studying. I found it to be very engaging and the student participation made it unique as well. 10/10
Just pay attention and you'll pass. Great professor, she made philosophy so interesting

Andreja runs her class like you would run a conversation amoung friends. Don't be afraid to get involved with theories and postulatiosn and you'll do very well. Do the reading, spend time highlighting and learning the text and you'll pass with flying colors.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Novakovic really knows how to explain these difficult to understand philosophical concepts. She has a mellow and straightforward voice. I've had her for various courses and she never seizes to amaze me. Great professor who really cares about her student's learning experience. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She has a soothing voice and talks really slowly so I always fall asleep in her class. But she's a nice lady and always answers questions during lecture. Sit in the front.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She explains the readings very well so you don't really have to read them. The concepts are pretty hard to understand alone, but if you go to her lectures it will be fine. Exams are very straightforward and should be simple if you study and go to her lectures.

The readings aren't really required because she covers it all during lecture. The subject itself is hard to understand, but once you get it, it gets easier. She is a pretty good lecturer. Attendance is mandatory, but I didn't mind it because it's the only way to really understand the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Novakovic explains the materials really well, and wants her students to understand the materials before she moves onto the new topics. I would recommend you to record her lectures because they can be confusing at times. Her exams are pretty straight forward as long as you study well for them. She makes the course fun to learn!

Professor Novakovic is one of the most clear Philosophy professors I've ever had. She knows how to break down complex concepts in a way that is understandable, and got me excited to learn every class session. Discussion is encouraged, and she's always courteous to different student opinions, as well  as very knowledgeable in her subject area.

I absolutely love this woman she is so caring she truly takes the time to learn and respect each individual classmate despite it being a lecture class. Her test can be difficult and to really pass with a good grade you do have to study since Psych is such a vocab heavy subject. But that should be something expected from college.

TAKE HER! She is the best. Not an easy A but you can get an A if you work for it. You will really learn in her class. Take advantage of all of the resources she offers to help you succeed. She is such a sweet and caring person.

Brynn is amazing! She's always so encouraging and supportive. She truly cares for her students and wants them to succeed. Her positive personality brightens up the room. Her class is tough, but study notes & you'll be fine! She always has fun activities planned & is more than willing to help her students. She has the kindest heart - best professor!

I had Brynn for social psych at Chapman and she is literally so amazing. By far the best professor I have had in college. She cares so much about her students and really loves what she does. I had her for 3 hours on Tuesday nights and her class always wizzed by! She is real tough on grading but just pay attention and you're good.  STUDY STUDY!!
she is the best TA! She is very helpful and makes it fun! She actually prepares you for a test unlike many TAs.

Oh yes as other people said, she was the best professor. Very entertaining, clear, and thorough. Every professor has to teach just like her. You will never get bored in this class. Oh midterms are kind of hard if you don't study. I absolutely recommend this professor. Take Psychology 2 with Nodarse Brynn.
She was a very awesome teacher.  i always looked forward to her class, she not only talked but also made it really fun.  best psych teacher that i have had...=)
awesome, easy, sympathetic, and wonderful in every way.
best professor i have ever had at ucr...made me like psych even more...TAKE HER!!!

Brynn is AMAZING!! she makes class fun and learning the material easy. She can sometimes go off on crazy stories, but in the end you remember the material because of them! I would definitely take ANY course Brynn is teaching!
Very nice and caring teacher an easy a if you do the homework and read the book

I thought it was going to be easy because her lecture was fun and stuff.... but I didn't study that much believing that I would do good without studying.... then I end up getting B-.  nice Professor, and well organized. but it's not easy A.

Brynn is an awesome professor. I can honestly say she is the best professor i have had by far at UCR. She actually cares about her students. She is very encouraging, positive, and enthusiastic. I loved the class.  She is great.
brynn is amazing. her teaching is very entertaining and fun. attendance is not necessary but you'll want to go. easy A. :)
she was an excellent teacher who made me WANT to go to class. It made me look forward to the Monday, Tuesday, friday classes
Wate of time going to her lecture.  She talked about her myspace boyfriend for 30 min., & made us retake the midterm when she didn't even show up.

She is simply amazing! I love this chica. She goes out of her way to get to know each and everyone of us in her class. You'll love psychology because of her super hilarious and entertaining techniques of teaching. I love Brynn!

Could she be any better?!  I think not!  She's perfect.  The best professor ever!  She helped me so much (even with stuff not related to class), she went out of her way to be there for me when I was having a hard time with some stuff.  You have no idea how much I appreciate her.  Take her class at any cost... you won't be disappointed.
Hilarious. She made this class bearable.

AMAZING!  She's the best teacher that I've ever had at UCR.  Her lectures are so entertaining.  Her stories are hilarious.  I couldn't believe that in a class of nearly 600 students, she took the time to email each of us individually and see how we were doing in the class.  I switched my major to psychology because of her class.  She's incredible.

AWESOME TA and BEAUTIFUL person!  She was so nice and helpful.  I love her so much... I'm graduating this spring and can say that in all my time here at UCR, I've never had a TA as wonderful as Brynn.

love brynn! i first had her as a psyc 1 ta couple years ago, but now she's teaching a lot of the lectures and in my opinion doing a better job than the professor! gives good feedback, great help, and is VERY entertaining!
she really cares and understands the subject. Brynn makes the lectures easy to learn.
Brynn's so sweet! and she's hilarious! I really enjoyed 150..she actually cares about you doing well and who can say that for the majority of professors/ta's???? She also dresses really cute hehe
shes awsome

Great teacher. Topic is not really hard, actually interesting because it you can apply the material to things or people you've experienced.  Easy class, discussion is very important.  I got mostly A's on the exams but totally messed up in discussion and ended with a B. Still an easy class though.
She is so nice and she is funny and her lectures are actually interesting. Plus she went out of her way to help me with a problem I had. She is awesome.

Brynn is the best teacher!!!!SHe makes the class so fun!Shes always telling us stories about how these things have to do with her life like her cats eating her shoes. And she says the craziest things sometimes but thats what makes the class so much fun! I wish she taight more classes so I could have her again. She ginuinely cares about her students
AWESOME TEACHER.

OK, so this teacher remembers students by names, if you are willing to get to know  her. She would even email her students on how he/she is doing in class. Her lectures are interesting and she likes to dress totally different everyday. She's cute too and very tall. For some reason I'm 100% sure she is reading this, she thinks like us students too !

I love Brynn! She's amazing, funny, nice, and loves all of her students. There is a lot of material to cover but she makes it interesting and makes you want to keep going back to class. I would definitely take one of her classes again.
Brynn...  You ROCK!

she is an awsome teacher. she is always trying to find ways to keep you interested and is always concerned about you. there is never a dull moment and falling asleep in class is not possible. she is makes the class interesting. this is one class you will not regret taking.
I think shes hot. and how she talks about her dreams. This is one of those professors that can keep male students awake during the lecture simply by her sexy apperance and humor.
She is wonderfully talented, dedicated and all around just an awesome professor to have.
She's really, really awesome!  Very encouraging and approachable, and she loves her subject, so her enthusiasm is contagious.  If you do the reading and go to lecture, this is an easy and fun class.
She is the best teacher i ever had in UCR

Brynn is the greatest teacher ever. She takes an individual interest in every single one of her students, even with 500 people in the class. Her class is interesting, informative (and thus totally worthwhile) and so much fun, she is hilarious. I can think of no reason NOT to take this class with her.

OMG. Brynn is the coolest. You want this class with this professor because she makes it so fun, clear, and is so supportive. This is my favorite class ever at UCR.  I even switched my major to psychology because of her!
easy as hell
amazing teacher. i look forward to her class every MWF.
Great TA! Love the way she teaches. Very enthusiastic. You'll love to have her around.
Great teacher. She puts a lot of thought into  her teachings...just great
No Comments
She was a great TA.  She knows the subject and keeps things interesting.
Great teacher! Puts a lot of enthusiasm and emotion into her lectures and her work.
Great TA, wonderful person, totally organized and very very helpful. Best TA ever!!

I had Brynn for a TA last quarter and she totally saved me.  Seriously.  I don't know what I would have done if she hadn't been there for me. It means the world to me that she cares so much for her students.  She's so fun to listen to (her stories are so dorky and funny) and I learned so much.  Whoever your TA is, she'll help you.  She's like that.
I've never had TA care for me like she did.  You want to go to her sections because she is totally funny and easy to understand. Excellent TA and awesome person.
She's the best, seriously.  She cares for her students and really helps them with the material.  She went out of her way to help us. I love her!!!  You totally want her as your TA.

If it were not for Brynn , there is no way I could've passed Pysch 11. She's SO HILARIOUS! she pretty much gave us the structure and approach for the final, made the ENTIRE discussion our equation sheet for the final. I LOVE BRYNN!
She was hilarious.  I love the way she explains things.  She's the best TA I've ever had.
Seriously awesome. She did the most helpful reviews for tests and was fun to learn from.  I hope I have her again for a TA because she's the reason I am getting an A in this course.

Brynn is the best TA at UCR.  She is so helpful, sweet, and caring.  I have never had a TA work so hard for me.  She is always nice (and she is so funny).  I wouldn't have got through this quarter without her!

She goes out of her way to make sure everyone understands the material and gives out extremely helpful worksheets and study guides.  An irreplacable asset to the psyc. department.  Very cool and very funny.
One of the most beautiful people (inside and out) that i have ever met. SHE TOTALLY ROCKS!
awsome teacher!
Brynn is so awesome!  She makes it really clear and she is so much fun to have as a TA!  Very cute too!!!

Really horrible professor likes to go on tangents and ramble. Really hard to piece lecture material that will be incorporated into assignments against his constant incoherent rambling nonsense. If you can DO NOT TAKE
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: His teaching style is akin to rambling and incoherence. He spouted words that weren't in the dictionary. He liked participation, so I participated a lot since no one else would chime in. I was dismayed when I reached out to him to discuss my grade, but he went out of town. I have all A's in all my classes except his. That one C affected my GPA.

Professor Nunley is a great guy. Honestly, he is very funny and speaks his mind which makes things interesting. However, what he discusses during class he will then change when it comes to the tests. His tests are extreme and very stressful you never really feel prepared. If you can try to take another class. There is only a midterm and a final.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I actually really enjoyed this professor. Always learn so much and challenge myself. Yes his test are a little difficult but if you do the readings and participate you're set to succeed honestly. He cares about the material he presents and let's the students participate which isn't the case a lot of time. If you want to be engaged take the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Most of what is discussed in class is not on exams. His exams are very confusing and unclear, there are a lot of errors on his part, and is very difficult to get in contact with him in order to correct them. Exams are the main things he grades so if you don't do well on them you will not pass. I do not recommend taking classes with him at all
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Let my folly be your salvation. Don't take his class. Don't do it to yourself. His grading style is unpredictable & unknowable. If you try to contact him via email to figure out how you received a grade, expect a response when Frodo returns from the Undying Lands. His lectures are often tangents that provide little relevant info for exams. Beware!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Class has no structure. Lectures are all over the place. Poorly written exams. A lot of technical difficulties (chat was disabled in our zoom for an entire month and he didn't fix it until our last lecture, takes forever to respond to emails, hasn't fixed our midterm grades and it is already the last week of the quarter). :/
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He rambles in class and to be honest, its borderline incoherent at times. The midterm was incredibly difficult to decipher and there were typos all over it, and he grades HARD. Most topics on the exam were brought up maybe once in class. He seems intelligent but he is not a good teacher.

Prof Nunley is an intelligent, interesting man. I would love to have conversations with him about literature but this does not translate to his teaching. He his hard to reach outside of class but insists on appointments for office hours. The class lacks all structures and the exams are cryptic and upsetting. Even if you put in the work it is HARD.

He's an amazing person as an individual. As a professor? Forget it. You will spend more time trying to decipher what he's asking in his tests than writing down answers. He is inaccessible outside of class and does NOT follow his syllabus. His exam answers are meant to trick you and cover things he's mentioned maybe once in lecture. GOOD LUCK
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: With classes being online this quarter, I was trying to give him the benefit of the doubt but no. Professor Nunley is very unprofessional and this was honestly the worst class I have ever taken. His grading is terrible and unfair, the lectures are slow and off topic. He is impossible to get a hold of, and I plan on filing a formal complaint.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Nunley was one of my favorite English professors at UCR. If you're looking for an English course that focuses on the importance of imagery, metaphors, themes, etc well this is not the course for you. Dr. Nunley stretches beyond textual analysis and uses rhetoric to discuss important issues related to race, violence, and humanity. 100% reccomend

Terrible. Had to drop the class because he spends SO much time talking about irrelevant stuff instead of actual class topic. Made it a point to be a hard grader which is only bad when lecture is broad and questions are confusing. Do yourself a favor and take a REAL English class or philosophy course instead. 5 books plus extra readings for summer.

One of the most unprofessional professors I've ever met. His exams were all over the place and many of the questions had nothing to do with the course. His grading criteria is based on whether or not you visit him during office hours and if he likes you. Would never take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: His structure is horrible. He is all over the place in lecture, he makes the test to the point where you need to take notes of every little thing he says in class because they might be on the test. We had no study guide nor real sense of what was going to be on the test. Extremely dissatisfied with this professor and I would highly not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Nunley was a very inspiring man that helped us see the world through different lenses. There was an essay, a midterm, and no final. There were two books we had to read and few articles throughout the course. Unfortunately, he was very ill this quarter but he does count for participation, so staying for office hours or after class helps a lot!

I really like Professor Nunley. Unfortunately, he was sick before our first midterm and was unable to finish the quarter. His class was very interesting and it did change me completely but for the better.

Dr. Nunley is an extremely interesting, different professor! Definitely go to his office hours as much as you can because they are worth POINTS to your grade! He is extremely helpful in all ways, from essays, reading, writing, tests, class, to everything. Since he has a strict criteria of what he wants to read from your essay, go seek his help!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Nunley was extremely personable! You can talk with him about anything and he helps you think very insightfully and intuitively. He fosters a wonderful learning and thinking environment. He does take long to grade but nonetheless, he is great! He holds office hours at students' convenience but is demanding in terms of reading and writing.

Professor Nunley is an okay guy; He's entertaining and engaging but ultimately i wouldn't recommend him to anyone.  He's unorganized and lazy about pre-planning lessons. Most of the lectures are him just rambling about random things. Tests are ridiculous. Difficult is even the right word;they're more like cryptic and lazily written.

Prof Nunley is a really amazing person and gives very inspirational lectures and is a a very genuine person. Very disorganized and a bit forgetful, so don't miss lectures and get your questions answered right away. Email is not a good option.

He is a very Inspiring professor who encourages students to challenge assumptions we make. I always leave class with a lot of interesting material to think about and  ponder further. His class really allows students to figure out how to look at things through a different lens and in doing so make connections most other English majors would not.

Not a bad professor, but he was very confusing at times. He required a lot of reading but I survived without doing hardly any of it. Despite being confusing and a hard grader, he is very helpful, all you have to do is ask, so don't be afraid to say your lost, but sometimes his explanations can leave you more confused that you were before.

Nunley is incredibly confusing and his lectures lack clarity. He doesn't always stick to the syllabus and it is unclear what he's looking for from him students. I received little feedback and no grade on the first draft of my essay, and the mid-term questions were not topics we covered in class. Most students failed this mid-term.

I really enjoyed Dr. Nunley's Harlem Renaissance class; he incorporates music, videos, and online articles relevant to the material. Make sure to attend every class; midterms and finals have very detailed questions about what lectures covered, sometimes even the names of songs. You have to earn your grade, participate each class, office hours = A.

I loved Professor Nunley's classes. He makes you engage in the readings and connects it to life. He makes you think differently and deeper about what you are reading. I never missed a class because I always left THINKING about the world. He challenges what you thought you believed about the world. One of my favorite professors. Highly recommended!

Nunley is easy going and very approachable. I disagree with all the "poor quality" comments, especially because I got an A in his class, and all I did was go to class 90% of the time and go to a couple of his office hours. He helped me EARN that A, so don't complain if you got a poor grade, cause you probably deserved it.

Dr. Nunley is probably the best professor i've had at UCR, hands down. His class is based on belief about your opinions and how you argue them.  I always sat in front of the class, participated here and there and saw him in office hours and it got me an A. He is very intelligent and knows what he's talking about. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

I honestly don't understand all the negative feedback about Professor Nunley. He is one of the most brilliant professors I've ever had. His class is no cake walk but come on people, we're in college! A university, no less! We're expected to go above and beyond. I would reccomend Professor Nunley to anyone willing to work hard.

His class isn't too difficult, just read and pay attention in class. He is, however, extremely pompous, and tends to think that his nonsensical ramblings are extremely intelligent. I feel bad saying that, because he is a nice guy and tries his best, but he often actively attempts to highlight his own intellect, and it's just silly.

His unorthodoxy is not interesting but mildly entertaining, at best, when you want a concrete answer. He's at times too post-modern but good teacher nonetheless. He tries to play the cool card, too hard sometimes.

He is very one sided about alot of issues. Most of the time his comments will help very little come exam time. Study the terms and pay attention to names. He will say don't regurgitate material but that is exactly what you need to do in order to get a good grade on his class. He tends to ramble. Take the class if interested or its a requirement.

Dr. Nunley is one of the best professors I've ever had.  He made all of the material we discussed in class relevant to our real-world experience, and he challenged many of our preconceived notions about the world.  Strongly recommended.
He is a good man!

Kind of non-sensical.  Has favorites and it is extremely beneficial to your grade if you one of his favorites.  He's incredibly nice.  Take notes during lecture and then just repeat what he says on the test to get an A.

Dr. Nunley is one of the most intellectual professors I have ever had.  Reading others negative comments on him quickly inform me of what kind of students they were.  Dr. Nunley is not the professor you want to take if you think you could just slide by.  Honestly, his class is so interesting I am not sure why you would not want to attend.

This class proved nothing more than a waste of time for me. Prof. Nunley is extremely unorganized, biased, intimidating and gives useless advice. I learned nothing in his class but how to go on websites that provided examples on grammar and sentence structure. He's extremely egocentric and always highlights his level of intelligence which he lacks.
I like him. I found him to be very approachable and smart. The way he explains things is very clear.

Dr. Nunley is a great professor. His materials are relevent to the past as well as the present. He obviously puts time and effort into his classes. His use of video clips and songs as well as outside materials make this class one that is very interactive in the approach to learning. This is my second calss with him. I would take another..

Great lecturer--but TERRIBLE at assessing his student's learning.  He has no grasp on how to make a coherent test that adequately reveals what students know.  They're full of typos and bizarre matching sections that defy logic.  Don't expect your mastery of the texts to count nearly as much as your attention to the songs and video clips he plays.

Yes, it is true that he is a very hard and intimidating teacher, but if you talk to him, he can be very nice and helpful! His class is soo fun that time goes by so quickly.  Even though he is a hard teacher, his class is super fun! If your looking for an easy class, this class is def. not for you...but take his class anyways.  It's fun! ENJOY!!
Professor Nunley rewards those who come to class to think and learn and exposes those who are trying to slide by.

Prof. Nunley was one of the BEST teachers I've ever had.  He encouraged us to no end, even going so far as to force us to go to office hours to speak with him one on one, which, for shyer students, is a very effective means to get questions answered.  If you want a class where teachers spoon feed you information, then his is not the one for you.
Interesting class.  Its odd reading this bad reports about him when i thought he was a great teacher and not intimidating at all.  I felt i learned lots of valuable material.
He was so intimidating... I was scared to talk to him

Nunley is hardcore, but he does it to push the students into understanding what he is trying to say.  He'll call you out if he thinks you are bs-ing.  Read, take notes and thats all.  If you got a bad grade, you probably deserved it.

Prof Nunley is very unapproachable, his answers are often useless and make u wonder why you would ask a question in the first place.  He is very egotistical and biased, he doesnt try to help students succeed nor improve...but rather enjoys the fact that there are so many failing his irrational graidng scale.
No Comments

I enjoyed the literature in this class. The professor was the worst I have ever had. He was moody and unapproachable and inarticulate. Worst of all he gave multiple choice and matching exams, in upper-division english class! (not ot mention everyone practically failed them) Run away my frinds, run!

This teacher was horribly unorganized and devastatingly unprofessional. i was shocked and apauled by the form of his tests and his grading capabilities. He made the class interesting, but he was inconsistant with so much of the material.
It was a fun class, but the tests were odd. Make sure to take good notes, even a recorder, because he tests you on the in class material, like songs and movies that relate to the text.

Great professor; the class itself is very interesting and I recommend it highly Quantitative approach to genetics with emphasis on Hardy Weinberg, pedigrees, and evolution The professor curves well and the lectures are great
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Weekly discussion worksheets. They're not hard, you just need to do them. His notes are messy but he posts the recordings so you can figure it out. His tests are fair and they are open note. Do all the provided problems and understand them and you'll be fine. Make sure to ask him or the TA for help if you need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dont skip class! Take REALLY good notes on things said out loud and written on the board. Do (and redo) the problem sets and practice exams! He pulls exam questions from there (same concept, different variables). Office hours, to ensure that you understand how to do each problem, is HIGHLY recommended to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: This guy is not as awful as other people say. I got way above average in his exams. You just need to read the slides, everything on the exams come from there. Some people feel like he is asking the smallest details from the slide, because there is really not much to ask. Know how things work and know the examples he used in slides, you'll be fine.

I took his class twice and both times the midterms and final were way more difficult than the clicker questions. You really need to MEMORIZE all his information, his tests are very specific to the most obscure details and extremely tricky (a lover of the classic a and b/ a and c/ all the above). Huge difference between him and the other lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Everyone seems to fear Nunney but I don't really get it. The dude was pretty nice and fair, even gave you all clicker credit if you at least answered them all. Definitely no chappel. I will say his test are based HEAVILY on the lectures but as long as you memorize everything on them you will do well on his test. There is a curve as well.

Never knew what was going on in class. His clickers were easy, but the midterm and final questions were so much harder. Also has unfair grading system for final grade as averages were low, but there was only a small class curve, that I didn't even receive for some reason. Even after emailing him, he refused to explain the curve and my grade. AVOID!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Came into this class and was confused the entire time. I would suggest that you write whatever he writes on the board and record the lectures to study later. There is a problem set, but he lets you know what problems you can do each week so you are able to spread the work out. You have to know the notes really well to do well as he asks specifics.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Avoid taking at all costs! Midterm average was a 59% and final was hard. Everyone figured the curve would be huge because the averages were so low, but the class curve was 6% and he wouldn't respond to any emails and took down his syllabus that had his grading scale. Unfair teacher and didn't learn anything.

Nunney is nice. He does clickers in class which he treats like an examination, but the good part is you get full points no matter what answer you put. His questions on the midterm was very detailed. If you don't learn what is on his slides then it will be a problem. Has a big curve. 45 is a C!

Nunney is rather intimidating and mean. He takes clickers way too seriously (makes you put everything away and not speak). He also awkwardly calls out people who are disobeying. I only attended for clicker points then zoned out. His exams are very confusing because of his weirdly worded answer choices. A do-able but not an ideal choice for bio5c.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He's really nice. His British accent kept me entertained. Final for me was easier than his midterm. A lot of the questions came from the slide. I never read the book(I don't even have one) got a B-

He's very unclear about what you need to study. He told us we needed to know the eras since Earth formed. That's a lot of years and he didn't clarify which period to focus on. Prepare for lots of "How long did ___ live on earth?" Tough exams, has clickers, read the slides religiously.
Hard professor, but big curve because of it, exams can be hard, very similar to clickers. If you don't really over think everything it can be hard, but if you're neurotic about it, its no big deal
Clicker questions have nothing to do with the lecture. Most of the test questions are from powerpoint slides but the questions are tricky and difficult.
Exams are tricky, not a good lecturer, will not respond to emails at all. Take the other two professors if possible

Don't buy the text book, you won't need it. Do the problem set well because that is where he pulls the free response questions for the midterm from. To me he seemed kinda intimidating in class but the one time I went to his office hours he was really nice and helpful. The class was hard but not any crazier than the prereqs for the course.

WOW he is so disorganized. He only gives you 1 week to do a problem set. Doesnt really provide detailed answers either. Discussion is pointless but mandatory because of attendance. Class is mandatory because he writes his notes on the board

Class and discussion is mandatory. For discussion be prepared to read 20-30 pages a week. The reading was useless and just a waste of time. If you miss class it will hurt you because he doesnt post notes. He is pretty disorganized in my opinion. He doesnt post grades or tells you how he curves the class. Overall i didnt like him.

going to class is mandatory! he assigns alot of reading for discussion. He only gives you 1 week to finish a problem set. Overall, I didnt like him because he never posts grades and how he curves the class...

Took this class thinking it sounded interesting, and for the most part it was.  Dont buy the book, its useless.  REALLY pay attention to what he says in lecture though, that is what you are tested on, and DO the problem set.  One midterm and one final.  MC and work out problems from the problem set.  I would recommend this class

Great professor with some great stories that apply to the material! Pay close attention to the examples that he gives and take decent notes.  Tests are looonnnggg and you probably won't finish (lots of writing) but if you try to write as much as you can about the topic, you WILL get a good grade.

Nice professor who cares about his students.  Covers a lot of ground in each lecture, and tests on ALL of it.  Your hands WILL be sore after his exams.  Uses relevant and engaging examples to illustrate his point.  Overall, a good professor.

Lectures are very dense and very long (51-65 slides avg) and it's easy to get distracted in the class but get ready to really study hard otherwise you won't pass her class. she is super hard because the exam material and even the practice exam material she gives out are all application-al based. Hardest class I had ever taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Connie's class can be a very difficult subject. At times she is very vague and her teaching style isn't too helpful. She does curve on a historic curve however it is still a hard topic to grasp. 3 midterms, 5 quizzes, and a final. Her grading is specific and hard. Make sure to do the problem sets and attend lecture regularly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: You will definitely have to understand the concepts to do well in the class. Simply memorization won't do it. But she is such a sweet and helpful lady. Go to the office hours, ask questions, do practice problem, attend lectures (for extra credit clickers) and you will do well. Cell bio can be challenging but she is great at making things relevant.

This class is not an easy A if you don't put in your effort. Reading the book is necessary to clarify some of the vague concepts. Her lectures do NOT cover every detail of what she says in Class. SO DO pay attention and take good notes in class -because her EXAMS are mostly based on what she teaches! Also, DO all the Problem Sets!!! It is a must!
Dr. Nugent is an awesome professor, but this isn't a just memorize class. You really need to understand the concepts and such, office hours are a MUST!
This class is difficult, but if you invest the time and attention you can do well. Be sure to complete the problem sets and attend office hours for clarifications.

Very nice and clear professor. So many clicker questions every lecture. If you get them right it's a bonus point. I recommend recording and listening to her lectures before exam. All exams were fair. Very interesting and organized. Lots of helpful material and do the practice problems and practice exams! They are incredibly helpful!

Lots of material. Must reread lecture slides and do problem sets to help understand material better. Clickers provided bonus points and sometimes appeared on exams. She really simplifies the content and is super nice and helpful!
Not easy, but not hard either. This class is about understand concepts rather than memorizing. Put effort in- you will get a good grade if you don't then expect a horrible grade.

Whoever says 161A is harder than this class is full of sh*t. Nugent is a great professor because she's challenging but very straightforward. And a very nice person. Really clear in office hours and no surprises on her tests. You do need to know everything to do well, but it's very doable. And her class will help you SO SO much in other upper divs!

CBNS 101: She can't teach and she also expect a lot in one quarter.  She has numerous lectures and you also need to compose 3 essays + discussion.  If you need to take her, I suggest not taking more than two sciences. Her husband is a bit better at teaching CBNS 101.  Note: her tests are brutal!!! Knowing everything may not guarantee an A

Who is this fool telling you that Bio161A is easier than this class? Most people who have taken both would disagree. Don't listen...Nugent is straightforward and knows what she's talking about. Stop being lazy and ask for help in office hours. This class is more than just memorization

Nugent really knows her stuff. found her to be one of the best professors at ucr. She simplifies the material but at the same time still expects a lot from her students. Very approachable and helpful. If you want to do well, she will do everything she can to help you. Just don't expect her class to be easy and show her some respect

this class in general is difficult because a lot material is covered. her tests really make you think which is fair. don't expect upper div classes to be a walk in the park. she's a great professor who's very passionate about science. she's really helpful too. grow up and think people that's the point of going to college!

Dr. Nugent is a great prof.  Most students say teachers are bad simply because they are demanding.  But to learn cbns 101 you have to study a lot!  Go to office hours and study the practice sheets.  She actually makes you think which is why people may not like her because they want to get an A with no effort

I did well in this class and here's why.  Go to the office hours and just talk with them!!  Anyconcept that you don't understand, they will help you out.  Outline your notes...I was one of 3 to get an A and it wasn't easy but study and or rewrite your lectures notes so it sticks in you head better!!

This class was one of the hardest classes ever. Honestly, do not take this class if you do not need to, especially with C.Nugent. There is so much information you need to know in order to get at least get average in this class. It is not worth wasting a quarter if you dont need this class. I'd rather taking bio 161a over this class any day.

The material is not hard, it just depends on how well you study it.The exams are extremely hard and students tend to not knowing what exactly the question is asking for.Make sure you keep up the reading and get help from TA's office hours.

I totally underestimated this class. It seemed easy at first because the material seemed to overlap, just like EVERY science class at Riverside (not necessarily a bad thing). I thought the class was interesting enough and I'd recommend it. Helps if you get a good TA though and visit the professor during OH if you don't get it.

I understand why people could be upset with this course because it is demanding, but their failures are their own fault, this class is approchable only through intense studying, if you're not prepared to do the work, you shouldnt be prepared to comment. BTW I am still in the class and havent recieved my grade.

The amount of material in this course makes it a really HARD class. Also, Nugent's questions are not easy. Her lectures might be lacking, but she's really helpful in office hours. If you're gonna cram, you will NOT get an A. So my advice-I got an A by the way-is to start studying at least a week before each midterm and go to her office hours.
connie stop writing positive reviews for yourself!
SOOOOO HARD!!
She is great, I don't understand why she has gotten bad reviews
Don't know why the bad reviews. She may not be a good teacher, but she is very nice and helpful. Choose Melissa for a TA, she rocks!
No Comments
easy A..does not know anything. must learn by yourself..kind of a ****
She is absolutley clueless. DO NOT TAKE CLASS!
She seems to have some difficulty talking in front of a large class, but individually she's very helpful and approachable.  Her tests are straightfoward yet demanding in application AND memorization.
Does not nkow the material and threatens to lower grades if questioned on gradin

Very easy class. The lectures were great and the supplemental videos are always nice to watch. You had an essay per week to write and along with them, you had to comment on two people's submissions. You also have a quiz a week, but those were easy and you get two tries per quiz. There were like two extra credit opportunities. Nothing too difficult.

This Professor gave small quizzes of 6 question every week, but if you paid attention to the lectures then you're fine. There was one retired book and he assigned essay summarizing and reflecting its contents. There were was no midterm of final. It's a pretty chill class. I recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: choice of doing 10 quizzes, 2 theses, or a final exam. 2 reflection post w/2 feedback. Book reading posts with 2 feedback. A book club meeting. Eco-ethnography project ; includes proposal, feedback, and the final paper. climate critique post. READING AND WORK HEAVY! will not lessen workoad for any reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I am not exaggerating when I say he is the best professor I have taken so far. He genuinely wants his students to succeed and takes feedback and actually changes the homework/ readings based on it. He is extremely knowledgeable about the subject and suggests extra credit that is actually really interesting. Take his class if you can!

Loved taking his class. Very clear communication with students and understanding. Reduced our workload after asking students for our opinion. Quick to respond to emails. We only met once every other week for a presentation. There are weekly essays so be ready to write quite a bit. Choose between 2 Thesis or 10 quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--So many papers--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Young Hoon Oh is one of the kindest, most compassionate humans on this planet. As a professor, he excels in his knowledge of the subjects he teaches. He is accommodating and beyond fair in his grading and teaching methods. He does have a strong accent, but he will gladly clarify for you if you ask politely. I loved learning from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: He assigned quite a lot of assignments and readings, but he is overall a really kindhearted professor. I will admit I never read all his assigned readings or attended all the lectures, but I still managed to get a pretty good grade. As long as you complete assignments and get the general idea of that week's material you should be fine. TAs are nice

Overall this class is based on 7 pop quizzes (3 questions each) and they are heavy based on the readings read before class if you want to pass. I recommend to record the lectures since the slides will save your life. He has a semi understandable accent. No Midterms, two 600 movie reviews (term papers), 7 pop quizzes and 1 cumulative final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Young had pop quizzes during random lecture days but he would tell you what to read before hand in preparation and the questions were straight forward and simple. The pop quizzes were 3 questions each question worth 10 points. We had a very easy research paper and for the final we could use our typed notes. Easy A for a breadth course.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Oh truly was my favourite professor this quarter. His class is fun and genuinely interesting, and inspired me to look into taking more religious studies classes. He does have a bit of an accent, but obviously over time you'll get adjusted to it. DO THE READINGS AND ATTEND LECTURE and will 100% get an A
Dr Oh is a really nice professor. He assigns A  LOT of coarse work. Be prepared..
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He has a pretty thick Korean accent, but after sitting in lecture I could make out most of his words. He stutters a lot and you'll likely fall asleep in his class. We had 4 papers to write, easy but tedious. Straight forward midterm, and the final was pretty simple. It was cumulative, but just make sure you have a solid understanding of the topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This professor had a really strong accent, which is saying a lot from me since I'm Korean, too and even I had a hard time understanding him. So, I just didn't really go to class and only went to discussions. I read the book, bs'ed the paper and the written portions. Finished the final in 30 mins and got an A+. Do the practice tests.

Professor Oh was a real gem, he knows about Asian religions, and his lectures are really similar to the powerpoints he posts online. The class is fun and there isn't much work if you want to get rid of some breadth courses, just don't slack on the research paper or readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: The tests were straight forward, every question was covered on the lecture slides which were posted on ilearn. Really have to study the lecture slides if you want a good grade on the tests. Offers EC
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lectures were kinda hard to follow because his accent is strong so I will emphasize how important the readings are, but does post lecture slides. Was generous enough to tell everyone the final exam essay questions prior to the final. Also bonus extra credit quest. in exams. Interesting class overall -- I think I might stay at an A (hopefully).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Fun class! Her counsel in critiquing other students' art is well-balanced. She explains complex techniques of photography without being overbearing. I strongly suggest taking this class as is it a once-in-a-life time experience working with old black-and-white cameras and developing film in the dark room.

While you are working on an assignment she will give you another and expect it to be done within a week's time. She keeps you busy with in class projects not allowing lab time.  Do not procrastinate in this class.
thoroughly enjoyed this class thank you so much

Avoid this teacher, spends 2% of class time on useful material that u need and rest on useless junk. Photo class is very costly both time and money. Unless ur already an art major and u need this class i suggest u avoid it.
Extremely helpful and patient.

He is a very good professor. He wants to help you. I never used my textbook because the homework assigned on MATH XL was enough help for me. There are 2 midterms, 6 quizzes, 1 final and problem of the day everyday during the extra lectures. Go to the lectures, and you'll be fine for all the tests.
Pretty good professor for a fast pace class. Two midterms and one final. He wants to help you. Go to the reviews and office hours!

Attendance is not mandatory but she does give out extra credit opportunities sometimes. There is A LOT of reading in this class along with 2 essays which are usually only 2-3 pages long.   She provides study guides for the exams which are very helpful as well.

I wasn't too familiar with Buddhism but after taking this class, I now have a good understanding. She's a great professor who cares about her students and their success. In the class, there's A LOT of reading. There will be a midterm, paper, as well as a final project. I got a B- with so-and-so effort. Definitely take classes taught  by her!
Loved her. even though it was 8AM, she made it so fun and interesting I rarely missed a class. She is a great teacher.

She is very nice, sweet and caring. She does go off topic once in a while but tries to clarify everything. She is traveling a lot so she might miss class twice the quarter. She tries her best. My class wasn't as hard, she would help and assignments were not too difficult. I would enjoy taking another class with her.

I have taken two of this teacher's classes and I did not like either of them. She is a hard hard grader. I studied for every test, worked so hard on every essay and could not get above a C in her class. Never had this problem in any of my other classes. She does not care if you fail.

Her essay prompts are ridiculously vague and unclear. AVOID AVOID AVOID! The material in the course is not difficult, she makes it difficult. Her exams are not hard either, but if you write something that doesn't correlate with her beliefs then you get a poor grade. Can't stress enough, but you should AVOID her.
this professor is horrible and she never goes over what is on the test. she never clarifies what she goes over and expects to grade us at a high standard. this class was a joke to the UC standards.
Class is difficult! Do NOT take especially if your TA is Toby. Hard grader. Not helpful. Low averages. No curve. Boring. Need to read ALL the books assigned for essays (50%) and exams (35%).

Nice professor. Hard tests and quizzes. Papers are graded very hard. All books are used for course. You must be willing to read and pay attention, class is always at 8 am. She does not care if the whole class fails, she will not curve. :(

Most unorganized book and class ever. It made it difficult for me to follow what she was yapping about. Read the text and extra stuff and still got a D on her final. I was on the DeansHL last year. If you like having organized notes and your a little OCD run awayyy. She super nice though.

this class wasn?t that difficult. i never attended lecture but i ALWAYS did my reading. sometimes questions on midterms/finals are not going to be in the reading. i look at the question and i?m lmike WTF?! i studied and read how come i never even heard of this?!.. she doesn?t curve either.. no matter how bad everyone did on her tests.

This class does not play around. I had to study SO incredibly for this course and I managed to get an A-. It is possible to get a good grade just be prepared to work hard. She gives two midterms worth 20% of your grade, an essay, and an INTENSE final. On the up side she really knows her stuff and she is super nice. Just wished her tests were, too.

?Intro to Asian religions?, the first giant inconsistency this class holds. The teacher seems nice , but the tests are made for that of a grad student. No matter how much you read or try in this class, an A will be far off. The teacher does not curve any test, no matter how bad the students do, and do not expect her to help you when you are a few p
The best professor I have ever had! She is really nice, fun and engaging. Take her Buddhist Literature class! Its alot of reading, but the class is fun and you learn alot.

One of the most disorganized teachers I've ever had. She also has mood swings in class where she'll walk in and yell at the class for sending too many emails. She doesn't allow laptops, but will only post her pwpts the morning of the 8am class. Don't take this class.
Cute professor! Do your readings, or else you'll end up like me, working on the paper from midnight to 10 AM.
She is the nicest professor I've ever had. Class is fun. Lots of reading, but it's all very interesting. You have to take her!
Awesome teacher. She is so nice.  Class is worth it's weight in work though. She makes the class at 8am on purpose but she is great to wake up too. I would recommend that you take the class with her.
By far the most helpful, nicest, and most CARING AND KIND professor I've had.  Definitely pay a visit to her office hours to see what I mean.  You will love her, and she will love you back!

Absolutely WONDERFUL teacher! She shows a lot of concern for her students and is very helpful. Although it may not seem mandatory to attend her lectures, you should go. She makes the subject interesting and fun. The downside: She has this class early on purpose (8:00am) and there is a lot of reading. You must buy all books she suggests.

Prof Nyitray is great, I don't think there is anyone else out there quite as helpful as she is.  There are plenty of chances to "go the extra mile" in her class, and while there are a lot of internet posted readings, no text book is required.  Had a lot of great hands on experiences in her class.  Highly recommended!

Love love love her. I had the pleasure of doing directed studies with her this past quarter, and not only was she incredibly helpful. brilliant and insightful- she was also terrifically sweet. She really knows her stuff, and is very good at communicating it- something often lacking in other professors.

The best. No doubt. One of two or three best instructors I've had in many years of undergrad and professional training.  Brilliant.  Knows where each student's intellectual interest is at and responds accordingly.

She is very intelligent, but so much so that she is arrogant at times. She literally speaks like 20 languages if you count various dialects. Knows confucion phil and could be considered a modern confucionist. overall I would recoommend her in general and if you like religious studies then you will love her.

Great prof. Easy to understand. Interested in how well e understand and how/where what we are learning is germane.  Approachable.  Polite.  Cool.  Funny.  Mature.  VERY intelligent without being snobby!!!

GREAT CLASS! The most interesting class I've had so far. Very insightful. SUcked because the class was at 8am, but aside frlom that, the class is very do-able. She's great with clarity and very approachable if u need further clarification. She's a sweet lady too. I recommend this class whole hearted-ly.
Don't take her!!you gotta really dissapointed!! Class tests are damn hard and avg was like 67...sux!! I took RLST 005

Nyitray is AWESOME. You gotta really work, but she provides a lot of really useful study tools online. As someone else said, talk to her a bit about subject matter, she'll always help with understanding it. She constructs her course in a very interesting manner and never failed to hold my interest. I absolutely loved the class and the professor.
Too much information. Too early (8-9am). Class is hard. Essays are graded hard. But the teacher does put sample quizzes on ilearn. Failed the class. Make sure you are ready to work your ass off.

very sweet, understanding professor.  Make the effort to talk to her about subject matter- she's more than willing to help.  Definitely knows her stuff... class was packed with info.  Enjoyable course, I kept up on readings and got an A- so if you're willing to put in effort you should be fine.
No Comments
Sloooooow grader. She's very reluctant to give A's, so don't expect one. She knows her stuff, though.
Pretty interesting professor.  a bit too much reading and hw but still an okay amount.

She's everything someone could expect from a professor. She cares about her field and her students. Anyone who disagrees hasn't asked her for help, and probably wasn't interested in what she had to offer in the first place. I intend to take more classes with her.

This professor taught this introduction class as an upper-division class.  It was ridiculously and unnecessarily hard. I bet 2/3 of her class failed, which says a lot about the teacher. Her 3 quizzes were unbelievable, I can't believe how things were graded. I do not recommend you take this class.
Interesting class, she's very intelligent but readings are a little too much. Have three quizzes that were a little hard. Overall the class was okay, not that bad
hard

People just don't like this class because they probably cheated on the midterm since 10% of the class did. Otherwise, this class wasn't even hard. Only two exams! JEEZ...Of course, if you weren't interested in the class in the first place then you shouldn't have even taken it.
very knowledgeable and passionate about what she's teaching.. interesting class, she seems very nice.
didn't like the class at all

Wonderful, brilliant, interesting even at 8 in the morning.

I did not find her classes interesting.

reviews.comment: She might come across like a sweet lady, but she does harsh things at the back.

She is an easy teacher if you actually go to class, read the lecture notes, and pay attention in class. Go to discussion and SI because she will give extra points if you do. Do all of that you will get an A

DO THE SUGGESTED PROBLEMS. If you do these problems and understand the concepts you will get an A. The quizzes in discussion are also straight out of the book. This class can be very easy if you simply do the work.

She is a great teacher and she puts all tha notes online so you don't even need to go to class unless you don't get the notes. She teaches very clear and if you study the midterms and final will be easy
Easy class. Just read lecture notes and you will do fine.

The class was easy since it was mostly high school chem. You dont really need to go to lec if you read from the book and do the assigned problems. midterms and finals were easy and there are alot of resources if you need it.

Midterms & finals are easy if u do the hw prbms assigned. She uses most of the prbms in the book on the midterms. Know important def. She's old and rambles a bit.Posts notes online but changes last min. Study guide gives basic idea of tests NOT exactly. Lectures are boring.Generous grading scale.Do the extra credit she gives.Remember to do ARIS hw!

She is very straightforward. More examples than concept. The class isn't that hard if you study. I didn't have AP Chem but you still can learn it with ease. Her grading scale is very generous. The TAs don't help so form study groups and you'll pass for sure.

DO NOT TAKE HER. Her lecture is SO BORING. her mock exams are NOTHING like her midterms. She makes so many mistakes in her notes. The homework is super easy but not at all helpful in studying. She's super picky about not using graphing calculators.

DO NOT TAKE HER. Her lecture is SO BORING. her mock exams are NOTHING like her midterms. She makes so many mistakes in her notes. The homework is super easy but not at all helpful in studying. She's super picky about not using graphing calculators.

Exam questions are very straight forward.  Lectures are semi-inspirational (if you are a SCIENCE fanatic like myself).  Homework is super easy.  This class should be a review of general chemistry to you if you take AP Chemistry back in high school and know what you're doing.  I would suggest you to take her for Chem 001A.

Dr. O is a very smart professor. She knows her stuff and is helpful if ur confused. If you take AP chem test in high school, and passed then u dont even have to go to class, its a regurgitation of info from AP chem. But yeah, exams are straight forward and doable.
Completely pointless teacher! She mixes lessons and her teaching is confusing. She gives lectures and homework, they DONT match!

Her exams are straightforward and is based on her notes and the book. I never went to class because notes were posted online, she just went over the notes - not interesting.
