reviews.comment: I took this class in F23 as an 8 AM T-TH class. Our grade consisted of three 100 point midterms (up to 10 points of extra credit), a 50 point group assignment (presentation/one-page paper), and 50 points for attendance (sign-in sheet). Dr. Olawole was an amazing professor. He is extremely caring, understanding, and easy to talk to!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Made questionable comments and baseless assumptions regarding our performance. He reads off slides and tends to stretch short lectures into the full 80-minute lecture. You can do well if you're solid with self-studying slides, though there is a lot of information. He was adamant about not curving but did so after the final.
Hilarious professor. Can be intimidating, but very very helpful if you approach him. Test are difficult, but not if you study. Take him! You won't be disappointed.
chris was a good, funny, and friendly guy. his tests were really hard. you have to study for the notes in order to do well on exams. the lab work was big even the pre labs
His test are very hard but you have to study the test. He is funny n friendly.I love his class because he will help you to review the test online.
I love his class! But he is very  strict n you have to study the test or take the notes all the time. Also you have to listen to him. And you have to pay attention to the class.

Oglesby is a very enthusiastic professor that kept me engaged for a few weeks. However, this course has a LOT of content and the weekly homework assignments are time consuming, usually taking an 1-2+. This class isn't too difficult but its also not an easy A breadth course. Theres 2 midterms, a final, a final project, and weekly quizzes and HWs.

Professor Oglesby is a very sweet guy and super enthusiastic about what he's teaching, but the lectures tend to get boring quickly. The weekly homework assignments due every Friday were extremely time-consuming and difficult to complete, especially towards the middle and end of the quarter as they got harder to understand.

Such a sweet guy, but his grading is hella weird. The class average for the midterm was like a 55% with the highest grade being a 71% so obviously he'd doing something wrong. I like how passionate he is, but it's a pain in the a** type of class. Wouldnt take again.

Probably the most caring Professor I've ever had, extremely passionate about the subject and makes the lectures interesting. Has 2 midterms but drops one as long as you pay attention in class or study the videos he posts you'll be fine. Only problem is the homework is pretty complicated, takes an hour or two and is what makes the class hard.

My biggest issue with his class was how he weighted the grade book. It made it very hard to recover from a bad assignment. By attendance is mandatory, I mean for discussions in which to have to participate for credit.  To do well in his class you have to devote a crazy amount of time so I definitely do not recommend for a breadth or elective.

Oglesby is an incredibly passionate and caring professor! He cares SO MUCH about teaching and making sure that students will understand, he always wants to help, he loves when people ask questions. Its hard to understand if you don't go to class. There was no textbook, and the homework got explained well. I would definitely recommend as a GE class.

He's a really nice and passionate about what he teaches. Interesting lectures but sometimes gets boring. Tries to post recordings but in person is better bc sometimes you cant see what he writes on the board and there are a few technical difficulties(forgets to record). Take good notes. He explains concepts really well and gives multiple examples.

It honestly pains me to say this, because Professor Oglesby is so caring and passionate about earthquakes, but his class is very hard. Lectures are boring, and he gives no extra credit. My entire class got an average grade of 60% on the midterms, so its definitely something wrong on his end. Very nice guy, but not the best professor.

The course material was very straightforward, it was the same assignment program each week just a different topic. I absolutely loved my TA Jordan, he explained everything in so much detail and basically summed up the lectures in the 45 minute discussion. I highly recommend you take this has a science requirement if needed!
Great professor. Worth taking.

Oglesby was an amazing person and was so passionate about the subject. He always came to class excited to teach but his lectures and the lack of a textbook made his tests hard and his homework hard. I had a great TA, but if you're unlucky and don't it will be hard.

Great professor, 10/10 He made himself accessible all the time to help students with material through office hours. He even set up review study sessions to make sure we felt prepared before exams. 2 midterms- lowest one gets dropped, final and some hw activities. Show up and take good notes- you’ll get a good grade :) Would recommend this prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Taking Oglesby for one of my breadth classes is probably one of the worst mistakes I’ve made at UCR. His tests are incredibly hard, and contain questions that should be for someone who has studied the subject like him. He is passionate about the subject, but he needs to lessen the workload by A LOT. Don’t take this class for a breadth.

Oglesby is a good professor! He is really passionate about the subject and truly tries to make the concepts understandable. The class was interesting but homework assignments took up a lot of time. Quizzes were easy but exams were tougher. Everything is graded by the TA and there is a final project at the end that uses all the material from class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor if you need flexibility. Late policy despite being in a pandemic is non existent. 1 second late is a zero. Doesnt even follow his own syllabus and doesnt care about computer and personal problems. His class is supposed to take up your whole life. Easy material, needs a better instructor.

The most motivated and dedicated teacher I had at UCR. Go to class and take notes, but more importantly, pay attention in class. This is easy to do in  Geo4 because the topics are actually interesting. If you pay attention in class you will understand the concepts and be in a better state of mind studying for the tests. Overall an awesome class!

Professor Oglesby is probably one of the most passionate professors I've had so far at UC Riverside. His lectures are always mandatory because he does not post powerpoints but rather writes out notes and explains concepts during the lecture. His class is always filled and the average for his midterms/finals are always very high :)
Professor Oglesby is a wonderful professor! Since there's no book for the course, attend lecture! For additional help, check out the book on reserve. He's extremely helpful in office hours.
super easy class. I recommend it if you are looking for a GPA boosting course that requires no more work than an 9th grade Earth science class.

Frankly David cares way too much about earthquakes and not enough about teaching a class that his students can actually pass. Our entire class almost failed despite there being a promise of a "substantial" curve. GPAs were affected and students are on AP/Subject to dismissal because of him. Stay away.

Professor is Amazing, he loves his job, knows his stuff etc etc. With that being said Geo 8 is a joke. Its more math for most of the course than science. And Depending on what TA you get, you could be screwed. Plus its a 500 person lecture so 1 on 1 help requires going to office hours. If your not good at math dont bother taking this class.
Watching on TV and I love it

This class was the best. The midterms were easy and straightforward, but you do have to actually go to class and study to do well. He does drop the lowest score between the 2 midterms. There are 5 homework assignments. He is extremely helpful during office hours so GO TO THEM it will benefit you so much.

The midterms had at most 30 questions on it and final 78. Very few questions were given and so if you missed a question it affected you greatly. I studied for the midterms and a week for the final and I STILL did poorly. Avoid! Its going to screw up my GPA now.

Super cool, easy class. For exams don't learn definitions focus more on concepts and little things like "what direction did the wind occur if they were caused in the West" . Make sure to get Greg as a T.A Julian is horrible and grades hard. 40% is homework so get a good T.A

I have been a straight A student for my two years at UCR until I came across this class. Avoid this class. The professor puts very few questions on the exams, so basically if you screw up even a couple questions, your grade drops significantly. Office hours becomes mandatory because lecture is not enough to understand the concepts.

He doesn't have a textbk or put his slides on ilearn so it's mandatory to go to class for notes. If you miss something, it affects the homework activities that he has every week. 2 midterms, one finals. Lowest midterm dropped. The grading for the activities depends on your TA so best go to the TAs office hrs to ask the answer they are looking for.

The class was difficult, but if you're willing to put in some hard work, the class is not impossible. Going to lectures, understanding the concepts, writing down notes, and doing and understanding the homework were all essential keys to doing well in this course. Also, I would recommend going to office hours because your uncertainties may clear.

It's definitely a hard class, but if you're willing to put in some work, it's not impossible to do well. Attending class, understanding the concepts well, and doing + understanding the assigned homework will all really help. Go to office hours too because many of the questions you have will be answered there. Overall, a good class.

This class was really difficult. You really need to go to lecture to understand it. It feels like common sense science but its not. He is very enthusiastic but it is really difficult for a person who is not a fan of science. be careful in choosing this class.

This guy makes the test wayyyyyy too hard. Its a breadth geo class, not a math class. There is quite a bit of math involved. No textbook, slides dont help so attendance is mandatory. The hw is worth way tooo much and they grade the hw way too hard. He puts way too few questions on the midterms(about 20 MC) so if you mess up a problem, that's 5%....

Most difficult thing about this class is having no textbook. Gave us a pdf with some key terms, but no helpful. You really need to go to lecture to understand the concepts. It's ALL about understanding concepts.. no just regurgitate definitions. There will be some math. Hw worth way too much, and grading's pretty strict. He's enthusiastic though.

Oglesby is really something. You sort of need the textbook for the class but most of the time you don't, it's just good for the homework you have. Attend lecture though and take notes on concepts. He is a big person on concepts. And he says he doesn't quiz you on trivial things but he does, so know some trivial stuff about SoCal.

The class is extremely boring first couple weeks, but it gets more interesting the longer the course goes. Tsunamis, Earthquakes, Tornadoes, all interesting stuff. SO MUCH HOMEWORK. Easy A? Not this class, wayy too much home. Discussion has a required "Prep Sheet"(notes on lectures, etc) and a couple hours of homework each week.

Great teacher! Lectures can be a bit boring but he is enthusiastic and knows what he's talking about. His tests are tough and the TA's grade extremely hard and aren't really that helpful.Overall his class was pretty cool minus the TA's and their discussions

The class is somewhat difficult even going to his class lectures. You really need TA assistance and outside help of class to understand the material. There are 3 exams given: 2 midterms and a final. Lowest grade of a midterm is dropped.

This class was very hard, and the TA was  not helpful at all. There were weekly reports due every week that were graded super carefully. The TA and professor did not offer much help, and the clarity of his lectures were terrible. Very sloppy handwriting, and we didn't get out study guide for our final until two days before the final. Take this clas

Natural hazards and disasters. VERY BORING content but he obviously loves the sciences. Can drop one of the first midterms, as he has his own style of test writing. Only problem was I was in the hospital during midterm 1 & he wouldn't let me make it up... really screwed me over... Really didnt seem fair. If you don't like science u will be bored

This professor and his TA's are garbage. Half the stuff on the midterms aren't even in their lectures or textbook. Unless you already come into this class with major Geo knowledge, you're gonna have a helluva time getting a good grade on the tests.

Very good professor..truly wants to help his students learn. Tests are easy if you attend class because they're based off his lecture notes. Homework is worth a little too much and the TA's grade pretty hard on top of that. He drops the lowest midterm and the lowest HW grade.

His passion for his subject makes class fun and interesting. Material was complex but he found innovative and memorable ways to convey the info. If you participated in class and took notes you got an A. He truly wants all of his students to succeed. Those who sat in the back and ignored him rated him poorly.Teachers this good are unfortunately rare
even though the subject was soo boring, he made it interesting. pretty funny, in a nerdy way.

I disliked him a lot especially his homework grading...TAs GRADE EXTREMELY HARD ON HOMEWORK and homework is worth 40% of your grade...kind of ridiculous.  Out of 2 midterms the lowest one is dropped plus a 3rd midterm.  PAY ATTENTION during lecture. He curves, but doesn't elaborate on how much until the end of the quarter.

homework is worth way too much. final grade is 8 homework assignments and 3 midterms. he drops the lowest hw assign and the lowest test. there are not enough points available in the class so you really have to stay on top of things. homework is due at the beginning of lecture, can't turn it in late no exceptions - a really annoying policy.

Lectures don't cover all that's on tests. Homework worth too much. It's 33% of your grade and accompanied with policy that is extremely unfair for people who must deal with traffic. He wont take it if you're 2 minutes late! Homework should be for PRACTICE! TA's lost several assignments. Extremely un-accomidating. Don't take unless you have to.
Geology rocks.

I didn't like his teaching because there were no books for his class and I felt that his lectures didn't cover enough material to do well on his exams and they also had a lot of misleading questions.I took a geo class more difficult considering the amt of information required but I got a lower grade

He is a great prof and his lectures are fun. If you miss it, the discussion sections cover it all. He expects to you understand the concepts fully. Exams are moderately difficult, but easy if you take the time to study. GREAT CLASS! He really helps if you ask. ALL the TAs are awesome, esp. Boyer.
this guy looks and acts like if he just stepped out of a startrek episode. This goofball doesnt want to post anything on ilearn. Overall, unless you're a geek and into rocks then dont take it.
He does not use a book, if you miss class you miss the entire stuff!
Very good professor who explains things very well in lecture. speaks at a good pace in lecture, not too fast. wants to make sure students understand the material. always wants to help.
he looks like ross from friends, and is kind of cool too. one time he got up on a desk and could not get down. He ended up jumping, it was the most hilarious thing ive ever seen. great class.

Freshmen seminar: World Of Waves - Mr. Oglesby is a very funny, enjoyable, and easy teacher to work with. He is very nice. He is a great teacher, and cares about the students. Would definetly recommend!!!
He's a great prof. funny and has a lot of enthusiasm for what he teaches.  As long as u attend the lectures, you'll have no prob w/the tests. Plus, he's kinda cute in a geeky way :)
i thought that it was important to go to class but his tests are tough and i hated his ta's

He was a very interesting professor most of the times. The first two tests are a little tough. Just make sure you learn all his notes. It's pretty easy if you put some effort into it. Oh, and the final exam was really easy. TA's were also very helpful.
Make class fun. His exams are a little tough though. You need to make sure you understand the material entirely and know the ins and outs of it.

Very passionate about the class. Does a good job of facilitating the material.Always willing to answer questions. Though, too much math in the class. Also, you become scared of earthquakes after taking the class. lol

Prof. Oglesby does a great job talking about earthquakes.  I learned a lot in this class and found it quite interesting.  This class is not an easy A and you will have to do some studying on your own! Don't forget to attend lecture, that helps too.

professor is nice and ta's are all helpful but if your looking for an easy A, this is not the one..it'll take some work.  But, you get to take one of your lowest test grades out and h/w, if you get help, is ok.
Lectures are boring and dry but the class is easy so who cares?
His lectures help a bunch so make sure you attend lectures.  The information isnt hard to udnerstand when he explains it but on the test, it's kind of tricky. but it's nothing you can't do
Oglesby is an excellent professor. This class is only difficult if you spend no time on the actually trying to understand the material and if you never attend class.
Interesting topics, just confusing mathematical concepts

I thought this class was very interesting and I could always tell who didn't go to class because they would be freaking out after the midterms...You get to drop one of the midterms or the final whatever is lowest and the homework is sooooo easy...

This is NOT a graduate course, so why is he teaching it like it is?  BEWARE!  He doesn't give straightforward formulas to the many mathmatical concepts he EXPECTS you to know for this course and isn't too great at explaining jack either!!
Although this is a difficult class, he tries hard to make it work for the students
Unless you're a seismologist, don't take this class.
I was scared to take chemistry, but she made the material easy to learn. Plus she gives you other ways to boost your grade. I highly suggest taking her!

Amazing professor! She recognizes me out of class and always makes sure I understand everything thoroughly. She is always looking to help and makes this class easy to succeed. I am definitely impressed with her.

Very helpful, nice, and engaging. She assigned homework, but we didn't have to turn it in. It was an incentive for students who did it though because some of the questions were on the midterms and final. Its a chass science course so study enough and the A is easy.
very easy to understand
She is very helpful! Always makes sure that students understand the material and if you get lost go to her office hours. In other words she's always ready to help!
Very helpful..she a great TA
extremely helpful! very polite! she makes sure you understand all material before you leave.

Not very helpful.

I have never met a more monotone boring teacher. The lights off and he just talks. Id rather just go home and read the book on my own. no learning is going on. I just wanna sleep thru his classes. BORING. zzzzzz

Very nice teacher, And a fun classroom, But jesus christ there is almost no focus you'l get weird grades on your assignment and will not know why because he jumps all over the place  talking about things that have nothing to do with anything. I honestly don't know if I learned much In this class nice teacher though.
Best professor ever !
He  is awesome and his essays quizzes all work is easy

I had Masa as a professor for Political Science. He had essay quizzes every two chapters and one midterm and one final in addition to two papers. Many found his class to be challenging, but if you read and understand the material, you are golden. Very nice guy and loves Neopolitan ice cream.
Great instructor! He uses interesting analogies to explain the material (****ing, pizza, etc.) and is very approachable.

Like everyone else has said, awesome TA! He relates the theories to examples we would understand and remember...like ice cream, pizza, and drugs. And do go to office hours it seriously makes a difference.
Awesome T.A!
AWESOME TA! Goes over the material a lot better than the professor and answers any questions you have.

Absolutely THE BEST TA hands down. He was very helpful during office hours, FAIR GRADER, willing to work with you, and approachable. In fact he was better than the professor! If you can get into his class DO IT. You will be happy you did. USE his office hours it helps! Boosted my grade and he got to know me and the way I write. GREATEST TA @ UCR.
No Comments

I took Prof. Ordonez for 3 dif. classes, received an A in each one. She is amazing. She cares for her students deeply. Each class was different but if you struggle you can reach out to her and she will work with you. It is a lot of papers, but mainly just opinion connected to readings. Final meme project for ED5, final papers for other two.

5 wk course w/ 15% paper due by the second meeting. 40% participation. No Exam. 30% project. Inaccurate syllabus needed updating. Conveyed a "chill" sentiment that was incompatible with tough grading. No cohesion between & within discussion sections who where allowed to have their own syllabus and assignments. Great content. Disorganized. No iEval.

Prof. Ordonez is very caring and chilll. She assigned memes for the final project and I can say that I never have done that before. It made me think about education on whole new level. She does make you do free writes in lectures. I wish she didn't because it's hard to pay attention to long lectures online or on video.
Assigned a lot of readings, quizzes, and assignments for a five-week course. Be prepared to read and write in lecture and for exams.

reviews.comment: Pat is a great TA! She is very accessible to students and treats you like a peer rather than a superior. She definitely makes you feel heard and is very caring! She does help you on papers if you seek that help! I would recommend to anyone who is passionate about education!

Professor Ordonez is clear about the goals of the class, and she reminds us every day what our end goal is. She is thoughtful and included our expectations of the class in her lessons. This is my first class in the major, and it helps that she really introduces the field of education and what we can pursue in it. You can tell she works hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Oselin is really caring and obviously knowledgeable about the subject. Attendance is important and its a lot of group work. There is one midterm and one final, which are both hard but she gave a fair curve. Easy weekly homework. Very kind, passionate person

I feel like the flipped learning/classroom style negatively impacted my motivation to learn and the timed, online, proctored midterm and exam were not it even though they were both open note. SO VERY HONESTLY get ready to read the required books, usually I get along just fine without doing assigned readings but this class actually required it

Professor Oselin is a good professor, but this flipped classroom style wasn't it. I disliked it very much and I'm pretty sure a lot of my fellow classmates would agree. It wasn't until after week 5 or 6 that we started getting more help as the way discussion was ran changed and the TA actually went over material more thoroughly.

reviews.comment: Method of teaching changed, doing flipped class room. No class one day but class another day. Relied on pre-recorded videos, did not teach when we met & did group worksheets instead. Too many readings, never clarified readings, even in lec videos. TA did not help at all. YOU HAVE TO TEACH YOURSELF. Tests R hard bcs of too much material to cover
As long as you show up to the lectures and take good notes, you will do good on the midterm and final. There is a research project but it's clear what she expects and the work is quite manageable.

Oselin is pretty lecture heavy, but what is on the slides and films shown in class is on the tests. Text was a bit pricey. Her personal book is cheaper on the net. She does assign a breaching paper which is cake if you follow the rubric. Tests were kinda detailed but if you go to lecture or get the slides, you're good.

reviews.comment: The TA was a better instructor
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Deviance is interesting and she does a GREAT job at explaining the multiple perspectives on it. Overall it's a great class but the readings are super dense. She'll explain the theories really well in class but the readings are a bit complicated and will 100% show up on the test, so you gotta read! Tests aren't super easy, but the course is doable.

Knowledgable on her area of research but I get an air or arrogance from her. Looks at students weird if theyre eager and try to make a comment about the readings that didnt meet her expectations. Also seems out of touch with reality and the amount of work she assigns. Meh overall, take her if u have to but prob wont be ur fav

Her instructions for projects are not clear, and she gives so much work that she doesn't even grade herself -- it's done by the TA. This class was a GE class for me but it definitely was a waste of time because the material wasn't new or interesting (it's stuff you learned in high school or common sense). She gives so much busy work and readings!

Professor Ossman is amazing. Her lectures are structured but her instructions can be vague. She only does papers, midterm & final were take home essays. She grades fairly. Readings are interesting & simple, no actual textbook is used. She genuinely loves her research and what she teaches. she also very understanding and easy to talk to.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Ossman is a very knowledgeable professor with vast experience in different fields. Her lectures are clear and straightforward, PPP slides are not posted online, therefore, taking notes and attending lecture is encouraged. We had 2 papers ( 2-3 pages), group project, 1 mid-term & final (multiple choice, T and F, short & essay ??), map quizzes.

reviews.comment: Professor Ossman is a great teacher. Very helpful and motivating in class. Took Global Studies courses with her and she absolutely understands the subject well. Definitely wants her students to read all the material, which is damn near impossible, but if you participate, and at least looked at the assignments you'll do fine. Really good professor, and knows her stuff.

She knows her stuff, and attendance is mandatory. Sometimes it may seem difficult to follow her just because the topic is very broad, but nonetheless easy class, easy grade. And make sure you participate.
Horrible lab coordinator. He doesn't even help for the lab exam review. Better off going to the TA office hours than his lab review sessions.

I think Oross wrote about himself on this site. I nvr heard he was sexy from a anyone at this school if u think that your blind he is not in anyway far and he doesnt care about students. The two ppl at the lower portion of the page are full of **** Oross is the biggest piece of **** this school has to offer. Very rude and offensive I did well in the labs all on my own. Dr. Oross is very fair and skillfully average without giving anyone special treatment. He adequately runs a department deficient in resources. It's tough love, but he definitely has a heart. He does what he can.

course is not hard. lab manuals, which are written by oross, are unclear on what is expected in your graded work. little feedback unless you attend office hours. you are SOL if your classes conflict w/ OH's. oross's philosophy: give no guidelines > you lose pts = great lesson.  keeping oross at any UC is a disservice to the state of cali.

This guy really, REALLY makes me mad. The most useless academic coordinator ever. UCR needs to kick this guy out. I waited 2 quarters to get into a bio5a class and i still have not gotten in. i never had to struggle so much just to get into a class. other departments let me in even when full but this guy does not help at all. he just doesnt care

Very unorganized. Review session was a waste of time. The final wasn't as hard as it was made out to be; KNOW THE LEARNING OUTCOMES!!!!! The guy was a joke during the final exam. He yelled random nonsense across UNLH for nearly 20 minutes. I would never take this guy for an actual class; he apparently has no interest to teach.
this guy is a peiece of work, he is only here to fail people

some people are saying he is helpful, he is not.  I have gone into office hours, and he yelled at some of my questions, saying they were disrepectful to him ... I just wanted some clarity on an issue.  His grading seems impossible. BAD, but you don't have much choice, he is the only guy.
Test are crazy, even harder then the lecture tests. Make sure you get a easy TA or else you'll have nothing to bring your grade up.

I agree. Some comments were probably made by people who failed the course and who cheated. Don't listen to bad comments!!! Dr. Oross seems intimidating at first but he is really helpful. He grades super hard though. You'll have to work very hard to get good grade. He is willing to help you when there are concerns about course materials.

I dont know what everyone is smoking, but Dr. Oross is one of the nicest professrs out there. He comes across as intimidating at first, but once he knows that you are putting time and effort into lab, he is always willing to help you. Granted his final was difficult, but he's just giving u a wake up call on what is soon to come.
he's a horrible co-ordinator.  Not helping at all.  Very rude.  His lab section is not that easy either.  Have fun! Oh, and don't let him bring you down if you run into him.

Overall i think he is a really nice guy; he looks intimidating, but is really approachable.  he wants you to be able to master techniques in lab so you dont have to waste time readjusting the microscope for each slide. Lab just depends on how good your T.A., they basically grade everything you have and Oross just gives the grades.
He's plain sux and a mean head who stalks on everyone and fail us.

he's a nice guy that just dealt with too many freshmen. biol 5la is basically a wakeup call, and honestly, lots of premeds need to realize that they're not cut out for the major. oross does need to write a better lab manual though. the current one just plain sucks.
This guy sucks. He's THE worst person at UCR you will ever come across. Expect to fail Bio 5A. Stay away from this guy.

He's a bad professor who makes you feel bad about yourself.
He is mean and uncompromising. He does not care about students. He ruins kid's dreams.

He's actually a really nice guy, esp if you go to him for help...its basically freshmen students, and it appears hes trying to get them working, instead of copying or not studying...and he's got a great sense of humor, and more than willing to help...

He is intimidating but nice if you go to his office hours. He is in charge of all Bio labs as well as making the lab books. He wants to keep you on your toes and able to master the material quickly. He doesn't take kindly to slackers.
he is soo terrible i can't even start. if u have to deal with him at all....ur dead....

He doesn't care about students' complaints.  He wouldn't open another labs for 40 students, who couldn't add into the lab.  Those students had to wait two quarters to enroll into that class again.  Dr. Oross, overall, is a pure ****.
Mofo is all i can say.

I though that Dr. Oross is intimidating at first, but when you go see him during his office hours, he's the nicest man alive!  besides, the labs are supposed to be done by students.  he can't give you the ANSWERS PEOPLE!!

Grading is very harsh and you usually get nothing for feedback on what youve done wrong unless you go to office hours. Wouldn't recommend taking a lab when he is in charge, but most of the time you do not have a choice.
He is so mean and ignore students. He is a bad teacher thats all i can say.
Rude, mean, intimidating, and condescending
Great prof.  Exams are all based on memorization.  Good curve at the end.  Previous comments must have been made by failed students.  Overall he is funny and enthusiastic!
Oh my goodness. I totally agree. Scared me half to death.

Ignorant, chauvanistic, total disregard and lack of respect for students and staff alike. Unprofessional attitude and inability to relate to students should disqualify him on any educational board let alone teach

One of the best professors from the Latin American Studies department! I've taken 2 classes with this professor and they were both easy and I actually learned something in them. He's extremely helpful and wants his students to succeed. His lectures were never dull and he would explain and make everything crystal clear. Simply one of the best.
Very good professor that really cares about his class and his students. Go to his office hours he will help you out with anything.

Wow! Easiest class ever! Really nice professor.  Not a big lit fan but made me a fan.  He taught me things I never knew about lit. and how to analyze lit.  Definitely taking him again! Didn't need textbooks for this class! My 1st A+ ever in a lit class!

Did karate for 9 yrs before going to UCR.  Two yrs with Otis destroyed my knees as HE choose the worst katas for my knees & then joked about my knee braces.  Got so bad I had to quit as I couldn't go up stairs and was starting to have trouble walking. Now I can't train anymore as my knees swell after 10-15 minutes. Wish I hadn't taken his classes.
This class was great!! He got the class thinking.  Easy study guide and extra credit!! I took it my freshmen year and would take it agian if I could.  You should take this class.

most amazing teacher ever! he's brilliant, interesting and easy. even if you don't need this class you should take it, you wont regret it. i took this class the first quarter of freshman year and still remember what i learned! YOU'LL LOVE HIM!!!

his lectures are interesting, although his tests are pretty much directly out of the book.  he gives lots of extra credit, and is an easy grader on all papers.  i ended up doing alright in his class despite getting a bad grade on the midterm.

I took a course he taught with Childers. Not the easiest class, he's not the most helpful, but only to get you to think for yourself. He's very engaging, intelligent. I loved going to class, cause sometimes he'd sit next to me and we'd b-s and talk smack. :-) Cute, in an 80's way.
this professor is so awesome... SOOOOOOOOOOO fun... his is one class i actually look forward to going to and regretting if i have to miss... just so cool!!
he scares meeh.
Very charismatic and inspires you to do your best. Seems to understand you from the outset... great teaching style, wonderful karate classes. Classes are tough but worth-it. Three-thumbs up!
his classes are hard and demanding but its an awesome workout. Also you do get much better endurance and techniques after you're through. He is the best sensei to train with at any level.

Otis is a down-to-earth professor. His lectures are as clear as it can get and he is very understanding. His class isn't easy but it isn't hard either.  Just pay attention to lecture and you will come out okay.  He's a great professor!
No Comments
He is funny and a good trainer.
Amazing martial artist both in skill and knowledge and very very very good teacher, makes me feel bad not being able to take more karate classes (i know its not a real class but still).
Very enthusiastic in everything he talks about, his classes keep you thinking long after lecture. Probably the best professor on campus.

Dr. Owen Baker is the best math teacher I've ever known in my 19 years of existence. He tells the funniest jokes +o- !!! Great artist. Important visuals aided my learning experience. He is very considerate of the students and explains amazingly. One time, I told him I couldn't make it to lecture in his office hours and he provided so much help!!

Dr. Baker is an amazing professor hands down. His lectures are remarkably entertaining. Also he wears the same clothes all the time :P Tests aren't hard if you study. Homework is REALLY hard if you don't pay attention in class. Remember to go to officer hours. HE WILL HELP YOU! Also be active during lecture and dis, ASK QUESTIONS!!!Overall amazing!

The way Dr. Baker helps students with the subject material helps a lot. He knows how to teach discrete math in such a way that it helps students out a lot. I normally didn't go to office hours because of conflicts from other classes. When I did go, he helped me out with homework and course material I had struggled with.  tl;dr: Baker is the homie

Professor Baker is an excellent teacher and does whatever he can to help you pass. He provides gives a lot of easy points, like attendance points and improvement points. He's great at explaining concepts and you'd know what to expect on his tests/quizzes as long as you go through the previous year quizzes (that he posts online.)

Baker is a pretty good professor. If you've taken AP Calculus in high school, this class is a piece of cake. I showed up at all the lectures, but only stayed for like 15 minutes. Attending discussion sections is more essential, I would say.  There is online homework, so be prepared for that.

If you do the work, you will not have a difficult time. Professor Owen is extremely helpful and as long as you do all the practice quizzes and tests he puts on ilearn, you will pass the class. Math is not my best subject but he definitely made it manageable. I would recommend this taking this professor.

Class lecture is helpful. Although notes are posted online, attending class lecture is helpful. Homework assignments do not have to be turned in until the last day of week 10. Offers practice tests as extra credit points. Discussion section is mandatory for bi-weekly quizzes and help. Small green scan trons are required.

Dr. Baker is a great professor. I will warn he has short assignments (10-15 mins) due at the beginning of every lecture.  The longer assignments are due 1week. They take a while. He posts all his notes online which is great. He set a minimum curve, but ended up curving more. I would gladly take him again.

Professor Baker is one of UCRs best math professors. His lectures are amazingly clear and there is no way you can not understand the material if you attend class regularly. His examples are very good and he goes through the thought process behind problems rather than just showing you how to plug and chug. I HIGHLY reccommend him.

Class was straightforward. Had extra credit. The grading scale was weird though. An 83 would be considered a C which i didnt understand. He doesnt round up even by .5 of a point off. His class would be easy if youve taken calc before.

Professor Baker was a very respectable lecturer. The class had a clear grading criteria with a bunch of extra credit opportunities. 3 midterms - all multiple choice and no final. Unlimited attempts on the homework problems.  If you need to take Math 22, take it with Professor Baker.

If you took Calculus before, this class would be easy for you. His practice tests and quizzes are really similar to the actual ones. The more you do the practice ones, the likely you'll ace the real tests and quizzes. Professor Baker is really nice, he would stay really late on campus to help his students. Overall, it's pretty easy if you try.

Math 22 is basically AP Calculus AB except for the last two weeks which it is multivariable calculus. Three tests, all 100 points each. A lot of extra credit opportunities - it is worth it. It helped my grade immensely. Practice quizzes & exams online that are basically the same question format as the actual quiz or exam.

Professor Baker was probably the most helpful professor I've encountered... He goes the extra mile to answer his student's questions and genuinely wants them to pass. dont usually do rate my professors, but with his quality... would recommend him!

He is a really awesome professor. Really helpful and cares a lot about his students. Will go out of his to help you understand the material. I took away a lot from his class. One of my favorite teachers at UCR.

Efficient lectures with class notes on iLearn. Speaks clearly and keenly. Easy midterm, challenging homework and final in comparison. Grading is pretty lenient. Helpful in explaining new and reviewing older concepts. Supplies students with many tools to succeed. Approachable, though a bit quirky. Overall, great professor.

The class was very fair. Homework was given through webworks due every other day (partial credit for late work). Homework was a little harder than the actual midterm. But, don't slack. The final was just as hard as the homework. Do the practice tests that he gives out. The format of the tests are very similar.
She was very nice and helpful. Enjoyed lectures but exams were pretty hard.
Her ways were pretty stern at first, however after, hours of constant dedication and sacrifices, I was able to attain a hard earned A.

What it is yo. I was fiendin for a teach that not only understood a brotha, but helped one as well. Bottom line, she on point like a box cuttah. Very new at what she does, a little hard to understand. Asumes too much that evrybody is going to dedicate six hours of study time, when they have three other classes and a full time job.
She treats students like colleagues.
I'm taking anthro of social movements with her. Its def challenging. She's dedicated and fun. Big on team work and class community. Amazing course so far

reviews.comment: Dr. Potuoglu-Cook is an excellent teacher!!!

This is my 4th year at UCR and Professor Cook is the most AMAZING professor I have ever had! She has a completely different teaching style as she is really into class discussion. Which is great because she makes sure everyone understands the material. No textbook but there were online readings she provided. She is so great, I  really recommend her!
Prof Cook's one of a kind. This class changed my life

Dr. Cook is one of the best professors that I've had at UCR. She is loving, caring and very respectful of her students. She treats her students and talks to them on the same level, unlike other professors. There is regular reading of articles and excerpts from chapters, so no books. Also, she has us form groups for an advocacy research project :)
As a math class should be
If u get it, take it

Nice professor. In lectures sometimes he will go on tangents and not fully explain how to do concepts. Homework helps a lot and the TA (Kevin) is amazing. Lots of quizzes every discussion and sometimes in lectures. Midterm and Final are a big chunk of the grade. Does offer some extra credit for both. Exams are easy if you do the homework and study.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best professor in UCR so far, he's so caring for his students and understanding.

Very straight forward and generous prof. Gave a lot of extra credit,  made a discord to communicate with students, took our live feedback and adjusted.  Midterm/Final was the practice exams.  Best math prof I've had at UCR!

I got an A+ in Math10A, very easy class. He gives you a list of all the questions to study for midterm and final, zero reason to get anything less than a B on them. Good teacher, just don't cheat and use AI to do all the homework or else you will learn nothing and bomb the final and midterm.

Nice professor, good lectures. ~40%  of the grade is quizzes and ~30% is homework, with the lowest homework and quiz dropped. Extra credit on final exam, gives question bank for midterm and final. Quizzes are easier than homework. 10/10.

Interesting class when I took it.  Materials is fairly challenging!  Most students at UCR are of his taste.  Dr. Dearricott is seeking a more intellectual bunch and hence why he decided to visit UCLA.

Unclear during lectures, some interesting test problems (integral of cos^2 ? - double angle formula was needed..), For the final, he had some unsolvable problems. Basically your grade is composed of the midterm and final, which are both curved. 'B' grade is achievable but an 'a' is near impossible. avoid if possible..
You know those t-shirts that say "just do it" DONT DO IT! YOU WILL FAIL! I took AP calc BC in passed both BC and AB, but his midterm and final are IMPOSSIBLE! He doesnt help at all!
Very challenging, but fair prof. Engages students in a true study of mathematics with theory and practical applications. I enjoyed the course, but be prepared for heavy hw.

As a Computer Science Major I was worried about his class, but his willingness to clarify any confusion during lecture really helped me through the course. I am glad I chose to take him last quarter rather than wait another quarter for another professor

hmm..well, this class was kind of awful to say the least. i had taken ap calculus in high school and did great in the class, and 8b is basic calculus and i kept getting D's and F's on the midterms and somehow i pulled off an A in the class. It was a miracle. Bottom line, try to stay away from this teacher. You could definitely get a better teacher.

This professor is hard to understand during lecture! math is my subject and he is just unstructured and very unorganized in his lecture. i mean he is a challenging teacher if you are up to the challenge.
Professor was alright but he was all theory based. I did all my learning with my TA. Luckily I had a great TA.

Wow had a amazing quarter with him. It started off rough with alot of proofs, but just go to office hours and he helps alot. The key is come prepared to lecture and everything will make sense and you will learn alot. I recommend him as a professor he really challenges you as a student. I feel like I have the material mastered from his course.

WOW. This man is by far the worst professor I have ever had at UCR. His lectures are a joke. He just rambles on and uses the same examples for everything, and the examples he uses aren't even that understandable. Get this someone asked him a question and he said, and I quote "if you don't get it, you don't get it." DON'T TAKE HIM!!
HORRIBLE PROFESSOR! DOES NOT HOW TO TEACH. HE USES MATH TERMS THAT NO ONE UNDERSTANDS. HIS CLASSES CAN MAKE ANY "A" STUDENT, CRY AND WANT TO FAIL MATH. DON'T TAKE HIM.
Extremely difficult assigns A LOT of HW and has very hard tests is a struggle to pass I did very well in my other math classes but this was a challenge I really do not recommend him
WORST PROFESSOR I'VE I'VE HAD!! AVOID AT ALL COSTS! I'D RATHER TAKE A CLASS WITH SOMEONE WHO DOESN'T SPEAK ENGLISH THAN TO HAVE TO SIT THROUGH ANOTHER ONE OF HIS LECTURES.
OMG! His final is really hard! I recommend all students to avoid his class, honestly. I'm not being over dramatic or exaggerating.

I had professor dearicott for 10A and 9A. His lectures are very confusing because he teaches calculus in theory and only really demonstrates proofs. There is a massive curve however and its possible to get a good grade if you invest the time into studying.
read the book.. it is really hard to fallow in his lec.
Satisfied.

Course materials are fairly challenging.  However, if one invested enough time into this class it is not hard to earn a descent grade.  Professor Dearricott is helpful during office hour.  I would recommend this class to anyone who truly wants to learn calculus.
OMG! THAT FINAL WAS THE HARDEST THING EVER! ~15% ON THAT FINAL + C- ON THE MIDTERM = B!!!!!!! IT'S A MONSTER CURVE! However, the midterm determines your grade, not the final.

The class final was the hardest crap ever.  I've taken 8 AP classes in High school and they were like merry-go-rounds rides compared to this.  The Final is SICK curved however, so there's still a chance that you can do well(ok, average, meh) in the class.  Just don't expect to be able to retain your sanity.  Prof wasn't as bad though...decent

Very bad prof. doesn't know how to teach, or maybe he just doesn't care. I had him for calc 1A, all he does is just write the examples in the book on the board. Hard to understand, and very difficult test, except you to know A LOT more things that he doesn't teach. Good thing i had a good  TA, don't ever take him.
very demeaning. during lecture one time he asked us if what he had just said was "too intellectual of a statement" for us.

He is a horrible teacher and doesn't really explain anything at all. When you don't understand a concept but ask him to reteach it so you can comprehend he looks at you dumb then teaches it the same way or with more mathematical terms nobody comprehends. He is a crazy hard grader and his midterm/final is the hardest thing you'll ever take.

I think he is really nice in person but he cannot teach.he makes every harder than it really is. you might as well learn from the book because it is more helpful. his quizzes, final, and midterms are hard. he has an Australian accent that you can get used to.
AVOID DEARICOTTS CLASS! he knows his stuff, but deffinatly can not teach it! I was a math major untill this course. (no joke)

First half of quarter he did way too many proofs and not enough examples. Second part he improved, but it still was kind of difficult to follow him. Make sure to study and PRACTICE for the midterm (30%) and final (50%). Don't worry about quizzes because everyone pretty much fails them. Fortunately, there seemed to be a steep curve in all areas.
horrible professor.

Try to avoid this teacher if possible.  I struggled in his class despite I passed AP Calc BC with 4 and AB sub 5.  Lectures are proof base and examples in class are 90% identical with those in textbook.  Exams are fairly challenging.  He gets angry and impatient if you ask too many questions during office hour.  Strong Australian accent.

He is one of the worst math professors i have ever had. he will knowingly quiz you on material that he has not even covered yet. He is very rude, disorganized and hostile. If you have to take his class, then prepare to work very hard to understand the material.
AVOID DEARICOTT!!!! no examples at all during lectures! If you ask him for help he'll tell you to ask your neighbor. kinda hard when everyone in the class is lost!
best teacher evar!!! <3
A+++ Will learn from again!

Does proofs all day in class. No examples. I have no idea what he is talking about.

I did not take her at UCR but for a PSYC9 course for Norco College. I will say, she's very understanding when it comes to extension and overall was an amazing professor. I took this course when I was a freshman but failed, but redid the course now as a junior. It was very simple, very direct assignment instructions and I loved that. Great class.

Taken in Fall 2024. Professor Jonnalagadda is extremely approachable and understanding regarding her students. Her lecture notes are extremely organized and the material is extremely digestible. Slides are comprehensive. Lectures very interesting and are recorded. Three midterms and a final, the lowest score is dropped.

Super lenient, educated, and fun! Lectures were formatted so nicely, she responded quickly to emails, very transparent and forgiving when it came to scoring exams. Attendance was mandatory but she uploaded recordings of lecture + slides were so detailed, but it's best to go since she says things not on the slides.

One of the most caring and considerate professors I've had. Not a lot of work and your lowest exam score is dropped. Her lectures were really interesting and made it easy to understand the information.

This class was very interesting and not difficult for an upper division. She responds to emails so quickly and genuinely cares about students. Exams are not cumulative or hard, just has info from lectures. Lecture not mandatory but she doesn't record it. Weekly hw is not hard, just reading a research article & writing the main ideas + 1 question.

Lectures were interesting and Pavani was very nice and friendly. There are 3 multiple-choice exams (which are fairly easy as long as you study well), a paper, and short weekly reflection paragraphs. She curves exams when needed. Overall this class was great!

3 non cumulative tests that were based on lecture slides, some information not shown on there that she talks about is tested so you have to go to class. She's very nice, if you need help go to office hours. People complained about tests but she curved a point even though the avg was alr a B, just remember the definitions/studies and you'll be fine.
Keep your notes organized and have a textbook since you can use them during tests. Didn't really understand him during lecture, but the textbook is super detailed and helps a lot.

Ozer is a good professor and knows what he is talking about. Really needed to pay attention in his class in order to pass if you have never taken statistics. But it is great because he teaches the problems step by step and goes over before exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Ozer is a great guy, I just couldn't really read his writing. Not sure if that's the smart board's fault or not. I kind of felt more confused when I went to lecture, I understood some parts though. The book will be your best friend unless Ozer gives you formulas, then Ozer is your best friend.I felt the TA discussions were helpful. STUDY UP KIDDOS!

reviews.comment: Go to lecture, do the homework, and it isn't that hard.  Has good sense of humor.

one of the more rude Professors on campus. I struggled and went to his office hours only to receive an attitude from him. The TA's didn't help for that particular quarter. And he spent an entire lecture going over material that was never going to be on the final...

overall, i hate math so it was difficult for me but he made it real easy to follow along. everything is open notes so keep your notes nice and organized, separate them by the different tests that they are and so on. enjoyed the class got a B. make sure you understand the material. not all that hard if you try. good prof.

Professor seemed like he knew what he was talking about. But did not put it in the most simplest form for everyone to understand. Class was not mandatory and going to lecture wasn't helpful. I had to ask my TA to clarify almost everything the professor went over. The professor does not grade on a curve. What you see on your test is what you get

Ozzy presents his material in the simplest way possible. He gives you formulas and teaches you how to use them. The exams are open notes & book, but you still have to understand the problems and why you're using the formulas. I recommend doing the hw and following the examples he gives during lecture.

Only went to the lectures for three weeks throughout the whole quater, but aced it with a great TA! Study the textbook and go to the TA's office hour before exam!!!! Lectures are not mandatory and not helpful at all cuz I never understood what he's talking about anyways.

He's very interesting to listen to, but u REALLY need to understand what he's talking about to understand a lot of his lecture.  He speaks as if everyone understands, which isn't always the case, but if u raise your hand in class and ask for clarification, he will do it.  He's an overall nice guy.
Clear and thoughtfull lectures, overall great class
Go to lecture-- lots of information you need to pass the exams
Great lecturer! Just read and practice the examples in the book and you'll get at least a B or an A. He curves the exam grade based on a 4.0 scales. Easy class! Highly recommended!!!

Gives clear lectures. Only problem is that he often uses words that I've never even heard of. Having a good T.A. is what helped me not get lost. He's very serious and not the most approachable professor. The course is not very easy, it takes alot of practice.
He's not a very good lecturer, but if you do and understand the homework than you should do fine on the tests... the problems are almost exactly like the homework and the class examples
I dont know what everyone is talking about. He is clear, knows what he is talking about. His test are a little hard, but if you keep up you will do well. Besides, he dresses well.
Hard to understand. Unless you keep up with the homework assignments, the subject is hard to get. Make sure you go to all the discussion sections too.

Can you say million dollar word usage? I mean, I know he seems to know the information, but geez, present it to people in english. Had to retake it with another professor & aced it. What's up with that?
I had no idea what he was talking about... It would be nice if he tried to talk on our level.

Willing enough to help during offic hours, but thinks in formulae, so when he wants to explain something, he writes a formula on the board and expects everyone to say  Ah, I see it now.  He will respond well to questions during lecture.

Professor Chung is a good and fair professor. Go to every lecture! He tells you the questions he REALLY likes and what to practice for the exam. Book reading, unnecessary. Never expected to have such a disrespectful teacher in my 3 years at college. Just reads off his slides and is extremely rude when students have a question. He is not great at teaching, his lectures aren't very applicable to exams & he doesn't explain them well. Discussion attendance is graded. It will be self-taught HOWEVER it is totally doable! He provides a lot of very helpful resources, & the tests are almost completely based off the textbook.

i don't even know where to start but please don't take him unless you want your life harder. you'll be studying on your own with your own resources and barely pass.

Honestly, this Professor is not that bad. If you don't follow the lecture, you'll fail. He is straightforward, which is nice. He doesn't surprise you on exams. He'll either put questions from his lecture or the textbook. The person before me probably doesn't go to the lectures or do the homework.

prof. chung is a knowledgeable finance professor with some experience. however the class is lecture heavy and midterm is worth 30 and final is worth 45% of your grade. even hw (15%) is graded on accurcy. you have to put in lots of efforts on your own to succeed and do well.

I thought most people on here were not giving the professor a chance.

Honestly this professor is a waste of space at UCR. The whole class has been confused and teaching themselves off youtube and everywhere except the actual lectures. Good luck to you in this course. I left this class knowing nothing and confused.

overall, knows a lot about finance but is tough on students. its an accelerated class so be prepared to do a lot of work on your own to feel caught up. i recommend reading the textbook on your own, because the one he uses is up to date and actually explains well and in modern ways. tests are hard but he just changes the numbers on the study guide

he stretches simple topics into detailed ones, may confuse at times with that. He is really critical with everything he does, so no point in convincing him to do anything. TA's will be what help you understand teacher.

Professor is clear in explaining the content of this course well. The Exams accurately represent the homework and what is taught in class. reviews.comment: I think I am a reliable source for the professor evaluation because I didn't miss a single point in the class. The TA Jamie was great and I spent about 3hrs studying for each exam.

The more I look back on his class, the more I understand how smart this professor was. I took him during the fall with lots of transfer students, and it was one of the best classes I've taken in UCR. He knows what he's talking about and teaches one more chapter than the board mandates because he knows we need to understand fundamentals of business.

Homework due for every chapter and 2 midterms and a final. Exams are difficult, but If you go to his review sessions he basically tells you what to study for. Exams are also curved. reviews.comment: go take it if you have the habit of practicing. homework every week but similar to the exam.

Go to lecture and do the HW and you'll be fine.

I thought the exams were pretty easy, you really have to be self motivated and do a lot of independent research to understand the material. Don't just rely on the book and the professor. reviews.comment: I really like Finance and this class was a bit of a challenge. Gives hints on what's on the test and lectures are clear. I read the book for a better understanding. Goes through a lot of information during lecture, so make sure to go because powerpoints have many many blanks.
Peter is knowledgeable.  My problem with him is he is straight up rude.  UCR should be more careful about hiring ill-mannered professors like Peter Chung and Long Gao.

Professor Chung is one of my favorite finance professor. He knows his stuff inside out and very clear in explaining concepts with real world example. I don't know why others are saying his 106 is difficult compared to others. His exams are not multiple choice, but it's not easy to get an A. The best thing is he curves the class by a lot.

Took two finance classes: BUS 106 and BUS 134 with Professor Chung. His midterms are fairly easy compared to final exam like most of the classes. He gives you study reviews before every exam and you are pretty much guaranteed B+ given that you studied all those. As long as you know his lectures, HW set A and study review, getting A is not difficult

Smart guy.. Tells you what to study so going into his exams aren't too difficult, given the assumption you actually studied. The median is set at B-, so passing this class isn't too hard. Overall the class is good, but Chung himself can be a bit "insensitive," although, it doesn't take away from his overall knowledge.

Definitely one of the best Finance professors at UCR. If you are a Business Finance major, then it is in your advantage to take Chung for 106. Chung knows his material and is a very knowledgeable man.

I took this class twice because i never understood NPV, FV and fell behind early in the class. took this over the summer. one midterm and a final. Homework is easy. I got an A- and ill tell you how you can succeed. I READ every chapter after lecture and before discussion. Take notes during class of his PPT and ATTEND CLASS!

Make sure to learn NPV, PV, and FV early on in class. Understand these three key concepts and how they work. If you do, then it'll be less hard to understand the course later on. Be careful if you're taking this class with 104, 106, or any Jasso class. If you do, work HARD. I like Chung, he knows his stuff, which is why he's not easy.

Class is tough. He is not very helpful and is very snarky towards students. Practice midterms don't really help because the problems are completely different on the test. Only good thing about the class was the huge curve because the class average on midterms was 60%

Slides have blanks, so he requires you to come to class to get the notes. His exams are extremely difficult and nothing like his practice problems. He is sarcastic and rude. He does not care about students at all.

Very arrogant and sarcastic. He thinks his funny but he's not! Exams are ok, have to study a lot. He is clear in his lectures, notes are always posted on ilearn. TA sessions are mandatory and also homework about once a week. Don't like his attitude at all but he explains the material pretty good.

He knows what he is talking about. All his tests are free response, so do not expect multiple choice. Depending on your class, the curve is either really good or really bad. He gives you everything you need to know for the test and drops major hints about questions. If you did not do well, its your fault not his. He does his part to help you pass.

Awful instructor. Intensely focused on theory and over-complicating subject matter to feed his own ego. Zero interest in students, arrogant, and more interested in failing students. My honest comments about peter chung: Has absolutely no interest in students.  No charisma.  Poor manner.  No passion in teaching.  Cold.  Unhelpful and arrogant.

This guy answers his cell phone in class. It would be one thing if it happened once, but it happens almost every day. Total disrespect for a graduate class.

You better understand time value of money within the first 2 weeks of class. If not you'll just get more and more confused. Financial calculator is highly recommended, because fooling with time value tables will eat through test time.

This is a finance class, no matter what it isn't going to be easy but this professor is great, probably the best the school has. Go to his lectures & review section, and you should be okay for exams. Like finance after taking his class. Textbook is not required. No homework. As long as you understand the material he is teaching, exam is easy.

Chung is a funny guy, cracks jokes in class! Class is super hard, need to constantly be on top of the material. Grade is only based on 2 midterms and finals all 30%. Tests are hard and need to study hard but Chung curves the test a lot so as long as your within the majority of the class you should be ok. Study his study guides and lectures!

Tough class, tough professor. As long as you go to class and the review sessions, you should be okay. Problems from book are similar to test. Everything he gives on his exams is in his lecture and review notes, but the class is still pretty difficult.  If you go to every class and take notes, you should be able to pass the class.
he's hard, but you'll learn.

the prof and the course were terrible. i liked finance, but i could honesly not learn anything from this course. by the way prof. chung should stop posting comments for himself on this page - not too many students i know would write positive comments for him.

He made the class fun and understable even the finance is a hard field. The exams are based on the lecture and study guide. We don't really use the textbook.  He is the one of the best professor in UCR.

He is actually a very interesting professor and very funny. His test are kind hard though, he really does test you on whether or not you know the stuff. He is actually a very interesting professor and very funny. His test are kind hard though, he really does test you on whether or not you know the stuff. Corporate finance was haaaaard! If you don't get it and start falling behind, you're effed. I didn't like his teaching style. I'm really bad w/ numbers and math and junk, so this was my worst class at UCR.

he does speak fluent english, very funny, sure know the stuff, and very professional! exam is not so hard if u stick to his lecture and actaully study, then you will be fine! he also points out what will be on the exam, nice professor!

Decent professor, cares about his students. Exam questions are very similar to his practice questions and homework.
