reviews.comment: Very nice guy, always helpful during office hours, the class itself is hard but going to lecture and truly paying attention and asking questions helps a lot, recommend going to get extra help in his office
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: idk why he has a bad rating. i really enjoyed his linear algebra class, he made the material understandable and the lectures were interesting. i would take his class again
His homework problems are harder than the problems he does in lecture. I had to rely on khan academy because his explanations are confusing.

9B w/ this professor will be easy if you have knowledge from AP calc AB. 1 midterm 1 final. the practice exams that he posts are helpful. voice is lowkey kinda boring so I always fell asleep in his class but if u ask him questions he will explain it well. homework is MUCH harder than what is tested or quizzed. get notes from friend if u skip class!

Usually only have time to go over 2-3 questions over hard concepts in lecture. Homework due online every Friday. 6 quizzes, 1 gets dropped. He is tough grader on exams. Exams seem harder than the study guides he posts even though he claims his exams are easier. Got a C overall but would rather take another professor for 9C.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: TAKE HIM. He makes students actually want to participate in class. The assignments are straightforward. The final project is a compilation of all the short essays (3), copied and pasted onto a website. Very easy and fun class.

AMAZING professor! Attendance and participation are mandatory. He grades papers within hours of submission, provides feedback, offers extra credit, explains class material clearly, is very approachable, and wants you to succeed. He is such a sweetie pie. There is absolutely no reason why ANY student cannot be successful in this class.

Amazing professor! Didn't require us to purchase any textbooks for the assigned readings, and he conveniently provides all of the readings through downloadable PDFs. Three manageable projects for the class, with one of the three being the final for the course. Lectures are very engaging and his instructions are easy to follow. Would recommend him!

Professor was good and new; he taught short story. You didn't really have to show up to class but if you are confused it would be helpful. Theres only 3 papers you have to write, around 1.5 pages each. He is willing to answer any questions and is ready to support you. There are readings that are important, about 12 total. Good teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lecture content helps you understand what to look for in the readings. Lots of readings and movies each week.  Participation is heavily encouraged.

I don't even know how I'm able to write this, as my hand is numb from all the writing professor perez has made us write. I ended up in urgent care last night with a broken wrist due to the immense amount of writing. I now have to wear prescription glasses for all the reading he made us do. I will be put into a psych ward as of tmrw. Do not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lecture content is useful for papers. TAs grade everything. 2 papers with long/hard prompts, 3-4 pgs, in class essay final. Some lectures felt like a waste of time. Reading inconsistent, some wks short while other wks were a whole book. Doesn't respond to emails. Larry was my TA, he grades harshly. Papers are based on readings and video lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: The class is manageable with a good TA. Lectures are asynchronous, but engage with them and the readings to nail the essay prompts. For study prep, unstuckstudy is a helpful tool alongside the usual suspects like ChatGPT. Overall, a solid course if you stay on top of the work.
He is passionate about what he teaches. Honestly to get a good grade in this class all you have to do is show up to lecture and pay attention. I had Val as a TA and she was amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Grade consists of 2 papers, discussion, and the final. The grading on the paper depends on your TA, but overall I think the grading was fair. Lectures weren't mandatory (discussions are). The final is 30% of your grade (15 questions -> 2% overall grade/question). Before taking the final I had a 95% in the class, and the final dropped me to a B.

The grade for this class is based on three essays and your attendance/participation in discussion section. The prompts for the essays can be kind of unclear, luckily my TA (I think his name was Ramon Pineda) was really helpful and thoroughly outlined prompts for us. Content is pretty interesting but you don't have to stress out trying to keep up.

Dr. Perez is knowledgable about Southwest Native Americans. He assigns a lot of reading. He has an awesome ability to bring out the best in a student. Scheduling office hours is a must if a student plans on passing with an above average grade.

THIS REVIEW IS FOR THE TA's, since they will determine your grade in this course.
Jazmin-Did not go over readings, was unable to answer questions about the readings when asked, did not respond to emails, and frequently replied to questions regarding important concepts or information with, "that's a really good question". 
Larry- see reviews below
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bro rlly didn't do nothing all quarter. We had like only 5 classes thru out. He's cool though

I am giving this rating for the TA's teaching this course. All prof does is upload lectures, but the TA's grade all three papers. I would avoid this class as the TA's, specifically Larry Smith grades so harshly overall and takes so many points off on simple grammatical issues. Also, prof is hard to reach and the course is unorganized.  AVOID!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Perez is a great professor and he is fair when it comes to grading. The lectures were asynchronous and long but will move to be in person and probably be shorter in the future. There was quite a bit of reading but it's very informative. He was hard to reach this quarter, but he should be more accessible when classes are in person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Terrible, stressful, chaotic experience. My TA left during week 8 and had to get switched to the other TA. First TA hadn't graded anything so I did not have a grade for the class until Week TEN - so no option to drop if needed. Prof is not accessible, doesn't have internet. New TA didn't want to talk to students in my section to help them. AWFUL!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Asynchronous lectures helped with the essays, but Perez was NOT accessible AT ALL. No office hours and no email responses. Your grade is made up of discussion section attendance and 3 essays (all graded by your TA). The prompts are posted 1 week before each deadline, so go to your TA's office hours to see what they will be looking for when grading!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Perez is fine, he's clear and understandable in the lecture vids (asynch). But he's totally offline - no office hours, no email responses. You're relying on your TA.
Essays are your entire grade and the prompts are incredibly specific so make sure you keep up with lectures and reading. Lectures 120-180 mins/week, reading 100+ pgs/week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Perez is a great choice. The class is easy and extremely informational. The reading doesn't take more than some commitment maybe twice a week, and the essays don't take more than 3 hours to type. The prompts directly relate to the reading and the lecture material. Your grade is made up of 4 short essays (3 pages) and participation in discussion.
Very passionate professor. There's only 4 essays but the prompts are so specific and he practically addresses them in lecture. Easy A. It's REALLY hard to fail this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Perez was one of my favorite professors yet. He is very passionate about teaching and does a good job at teaching. Only gives 1 midterm which is an essay, but he allows one notecard. The final is also an essay but does not allow a notecard. However, he gives prompts ahead of time. If you have a chance to take his Native American class!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor was super boring in my opinion. Only went to the first 2 or 3 lectures and went to every discussion and passed the class with an A+. A lot of reading for the class but I didnt read a single bit.
Professor Perez is an amazing professor. Present information clearly and logically. Lectures reinforce reading. I would take him again.

I took Perez for Race and Ethnicity and it was good. It was a 500 person lecture hall but I was lucky enough to get an awesome TA (Frank Perez). Going to lecture was long but still really cool to listen to Perez lecture. There is also a couple quizzes and they're all spread out. Your main grade is in the discussion class. I definielty recommond!

He is an amazing instructor. Makes class interesting with his story telling. Technically there is a lot of reading, a few hundred pages, but you do not have to necessarily read it all to get a good grade. I only did half the readings, showed up, and tried on the exam and got an A+. Easiest A I've ever had. Only dedicated 30 min a week to this class
As long as you do the readings and get the main idea out of the reading, you should be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I liked Professor Perez and the class is easy enough. But his TA's are super arrogant and very disruptive during lecture. One of the TA's is constantly on her laptop during the lecture. Thankfully I had Brian as a TA, he was tough but his discussions were super helpful.

This class should be called the History of Ethnicity and Race not an Intro class. Basically talks about how horrible white people were and all the horrible things they did. Does let you bring in a notecard for the test but the test question is so broad that you don't have a chance to answer it in a short amount of time. Big book, lots of reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I liked Dr. Perez so much that I'm taking another one of his classes even though I don't need the credit. He is extremely objective/honest. He might seem tough at first but he is super nice and is worth talking to outside of class. He assigns a good amount of reading but it's all relevant and helpful to you, no busy work. I highly recommend him.

I absolutely loved him, fav professor at ucr by far!! hes so passionate and makes lecture fun. Extremely down to earth guy. Just do your readings and you should be fine. he clearly states midterm/final prompts in advance and you get a notecard to write whatever you want for them!!
He is a good storyteller. I learned a lot about indigenous people. We watched a lot of movies in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tests? Not many--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: As long as you annotate the readings, skim through them get the main concept , you'll be fine

Professor Perez is a great teacher, who is extremely passionate and knowledgeable about what he teaches. I would definitely take his classes again if I get the chance. His lectures are amazing and the readings he chooses are actually very interesting. All readings are posted, so no books necessary. He gives you the prompt for midterm ahead of time!

He is amazing. Honestly. Yes he's tough because he expects you to work for your grade. This is college. Honestly I'm a lazy student but this subject is just so interesting. I changed my major because of him. He is so inspiring and thoughtful. His three hour lectures make me pay attention because of how interesting they are. But be prepared to READ!

Professor Prez is a great teacher, he assigns a lot of readings. But you kind of don't need to do all of them, just do the one that the asks you to reference in paper and you'll be fine. He gave the prompt for the midterm to us to take home and write on an index card and then copy in class. One paper to do at home. And the final was take home too!
Teaches very boring. Long and unnecessary. Hyprocrite

Mandatory reading every week - approx. 100 pages. Multiple choice midterm, 8-10 page near the end of the quarter, and a relatively difficult in-class essay final. During lecture, Prof. Perez stated that his class was NOT going to be an easy class at all. Thank god I "S/NC" this class.. If you're looking for an easy "A", look elsewhere

Overall Professor Perez is pretty cool. He made the class concise and clear, but I guess it helps that I had him for discussion. There is plenty of reading, so if you are one to skip the readings, don't take this class.

There were weekly readings/homework assignments, 1 MC midterm, 1 8-10 page paper, and 1 essay question for the final. This course requires lots of reading. All his exams/essays required pulling quotes from the readings. Lecture was a waste of time. Do the readings, go to your TA for the essay questions, and you'll be set for an A.

Lots and lots of reading involved with weekly summaries. Material was interesting and Perez made lecture engaging, but it was a pretty depressing class. 1 MC midterm worth 20% of grade, 20 Q's. 1 term paper 8 pages, and an in class essay as the final. You can get a B if you put in effort. Skim the reading at the very least.

this class was SO HARD. LOTS of reading and lecture is pretty much mandatory if you want to do well. ALL of the midterm questions come from reading. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU DONT WANT TO READ A LOT. Try to get John as a TA, he makes things fun and interesting. overall a good class though and i'm glad i took it.

This class was ridiculously hard. Took it for a breadth req and was a complete waste of time. Everyone did bad on the midterm, lecture is pointless, there's a 10 page essay, and the final is an in class essay. It is was too much work for an intro class. There's also a lot of reading and weekly reading notes. Get John as a TA, that's what helped me

While Dr. Perez knows what he is talking about and is extremely enthusiastic about his work.. his class is pretty bad. The lecture notes were useless on the tests. Really boring articles in a required reader that you can only get from one place. Essay questions ask about a million questions for one essay. 7-10 page paper for a intro class...

Took this class as a rec. It was a waste of time, makes you read useless articles and never uses any content from lec on tests. One 20 question MT, 1 8page paper, and an in class essay for a final. Don't take this class, specially if its just for a rec. Haven't taken stupid final yet. So over this dumb class

I'm currently in his class for history on SW Native Americans. Without a doubt the most dull, erratic, and absurd style of teaching I've encountered at UCR. He loves hearing himself talk. If YOU enjoy hearing a middle aged  mediocrity lecture all whilst scratching his face with a pointing rod, please take his class.

This class was epic!!! in my opinion. We dealt with the beginnings of racial views and how society structured racism. Doc Perez showed us some very touching stuff when it came to race and ethnicity. My TA Meghan was very helpful and very pretty too!not a bad site too:) go to discussion it counts and is very helpful when it came. Best class ever!

The class was not bad, I learned a lot. Notes from lecture are not really needed, you dont use them for tests and the essays. I felt like he used a lot of class times to show unnecessary videos, some are relevant, but some are not. Hard to keep up with reading, but do it! I think one of the main reasons I got an A was cause my ta graded easy

Overall the class is not that hard. There is a lot of reading, but most of it is interesting. We watch a lot of videos during lecture that are interesting as well. And Professor Perez is a great professor!

overall straight forward class. Put a good effort forward and you can easily get a A. One midterm, one paper, and final. There is a lot of videos in this class most of which are interesting so it is not just lecturing for hours.
Not very clear and has a very hard midterm.  Only 20 questions so if you miss one your grade drops significantly.

This was one of the hardest and also the best classes I ever took at UCR. Unfortunately I took this in my final quarter as a graduating senior because I really would have wanted to take another class with Dr. Perez. I've already used the research skills he taught us in my new job and can't thank him enough. A great teacher. Take him for 191R.

Very helpful prof! Met me in office hours three times to help me with class. He's a really good speaker and I found the class engaging.  The class was "easy" I guess, but the assignments were challenging and I actually learned something.  Overall, thumbs up.

I loved this class.  It is not hard, but if you put in the extra effort you can learn an amazing amount of valuable information. It really opened my eyes to the inner workings of American government and history. Prof Peres is a good story teller and really held my attention. I was eager to go to class every day. I highly recommend!

Honestly, i dont know why people are complaining about this prof. He speaks clearly and hes passionate on the subject. His assignments are ridiculously easy: skim 20-80pages a week and you're good to go. Anyone who complains about the assignments&papers is clearly a chass major or isnt willing to spend 1-2hrs a week on hw/papers.

This class is not easy, but it's not impossible. Obviously if you want to succeed you need to do the readings and go to discussion. My only real gripe is that he gave us about an hour and half to write an essay that really needed at least 2 hours to write given the amount of questions he asks.Then again, we had the finals during week 10.

"one multi choice midterm, one intense 8-pg paper, and one final in-class essay prompt given ahead of time. giving us 1hour & 20 min to write a paper that could could be 10 pages easy if you answer all the questions and cite all the quotes the prompt ask you to use" says it all.

one multi choice midterm, one intense 8-pg paper, and one final in-class essay prompt given ahead of time. giving us 1hour & 20 min to write a paper that could could be 10 pages easy if you answer all the questions and cite all the quotes the prompt ask you to use. =/ would not recommend him ever.
Class is not easy. Extensive amount of reading. Make sure to get help from your T.A's or it will be a bumpy ride.

One of the best professors I have had. His courses can be very difficult and the readings extremely long but it is only to challenge you. Like most of these reviews say, if you want an easy A and a laid back course, Perez is not the professor for you.
crazy hard, dont take class if u think its gonna be eazy..readings are long, some hard to understand... professor supports your own opinion... man, lots of info on indians, i got a B+
Have to disagree. Perez is the BEST profesor I took in the last three years. Worked my butt off and got an A for the grade. Learned alot and he let us express our own opinions. Totally cool.
The worst teacher I have ever had in my entire life. Unorganized and a horrible teacher overall, said many insane things to his class during the quarter. He's an idiot.
Confusing, unorganized, didnt really know what he was doing...
You have to read the reading he assigns because all the essays and tests are on the reading, everything he lectures in class is useless. But it wasn't to hard

I could rate Dr. Perez if he actually lectured. Lecture was canceled twice, we had two guest lecturers, and at least 6 other full lectures were spent watching films. When I pay for my education, I expect to actually get something that I couldn't have just watched on YouTube.
Uses the book ALOT, lots of reading 100 pages or so per lecture. Lectures are boring so are the films. But is clear on history behind the readings.

Took a class on California Indians. Was extremely boring. Most of the lectures were so irrelevant, I admit I skipped about half of them. Do the readings and you will be fine. He obviously loves what he teaches and is a nice man, but god he can be dry
He assigned a few hundred pages of reading from the course reader a week.  Final, midterm, two papers were the bulk of the grade.  The most harsh grader and doesn't accept dissent.

I found the lectures to be a little dull, but contrasting that were all of his first hand experiences that he shared with the class. I didnt think he was too tough on grades, it just felt like he really wanted "A" students to earn their "A", and not just breeze through.  Very knowledgeable and helpfull, as long as you speak up.

He's not the WORST professor, and he obviously cares a lot about his subject. But lectures could be dry (interesting stories though), readings boring as hell. Tough grader,funny how the students who seemed more anti-European seemed to do better. Coincidence, I guess. Lots of annoying people in class,which isn't his fault but something to consider.
Great professor.  Extremely dedicated to his subject.  Although some issues are quite controversial, he is always straightforward and hones.  Had a great experience in taking this class.

Not the easiest professor to have but he isn't as bad as some of the other reviews may lead you to think. The grade you will get in his class is what you put into it. The class isn't hard if you at least put some effort into it. Perez actually does give a damn about effort.

All of Dr. Perez' classes have been usefull, challenging and rewarding.  I thought that is what going to school is supposed to be, not an easy class. His teaching techniques are essential to our learning experience.  I feel appalled at the negative comments I have read. I would like to see more classes carried out like his.

TERRIBLE teacher. His tests aren't really trying to measure your knowledge, just TRICK you. Very detailed paragraph questions. I'm not saying this because I am bitter--I received a B in the class. But if you wanted to take an easy, laid back class, this is NOT the place to go.

I'm upset but not surprised at some of these comments. NOT the easiest class, but the most interesting and empowering one I've had in college. Prof P never forces his views on you no matter how different they are from your own. I learned more about this country and our true history than I have in 13 years of school. Best prof I've had yet. Thanks.

super hard professor...ridiculously hard midterm and final... a challenge...if you don't read, study, attend class you are screwed...if you want to learn it is the best class... but if you want to cruise...you gonna get bruised...

class is definitely hard. if you can avoid taking it then do. there is soooooooo much reading. and test are basically based on the readings so you must read. i got a b+ in the class but if it was any other class with the amount of work i put into it i would have got a A+. boring and hard but you can pass.

Worst professor i have ever had. Assigned horrendous amounts of work for a freshmen class. Also had an episode where he offended the class, refused to apologize and told all those offended to leave because "he would teach his class as he saw fit."
He is very boring but nice to look at. His tests are super hard and he assigns a ridiculous amount of readings. Its out of control. All he talks about are Native Americans. Class is boring a dry

He has a somewhat boring lecture style, but I always found the content to be at least interesting and at times really eye opening. If you're looking for an easy A you wont get it here, but if you like to be challenged and want to hear some controversial ideas then this might be the man for you!

He seems like a smart professor, but he is absolutly BORING! I've gone to every single 1 of his lectures and fell asleep through 90% of them and I sat in the front...I just couldnt stay awake! The readings are just like his letures, boring. I dont know, maybe I didnt like the subject, but I did take the best naps in that class. When he talks he kin

I don't know why the heck it would matter how the guy dresses or talks, because I learned the material perfectly fine. His lectures are really full of information, and you MUST do the readings, but his midterms are easy if youve just skimmed the readings, and he's more than happy to help students.

Perez is a good teacher. He assigns a lot of reading, but his tests aren't too hard. If you go to lecture and do the reading, you'll be fine. Some ppl have complained about the way he dresses and talks, but I don't have a problem with it. He is more informal but you still learn a lot. His lectures don't match the reading, but both are relevant

great professor.dont know what the person below is talking about.very informative and he is not the only teacher who wears jeans to class.His tests are off the readings and lec so if u study ull get an A.he doesnt make lec mandatory but its better u attend. he does his job. he teaches u. the rest is up to you.

Absolutely unprofessional. Wears jeans and shirt, and ends his sentences with something along the lines of "you see what I'm saying." His tone at times is also very unprofessional, and because of an exercise he has lost his credibility as a professor. I expect UC caliber teachers, and from the looks of it, he isn't a very good one.

With an exception to the required readings, Perez is an easy A. The essays are completely open to interpretation and your opinion on the subject is irrelevent. In other words, it doesn't matter what you write, so long as your papers make logical sense and you don't have any massive grammatical issues you should easily end up with a A or B.

No structure to lectures, just ranting.  I took this class thinking I would learn some interesting obscure religious myths and rituals, but instead the class was 80% about how the white man ruined Native American life. If you like to read 2-3 hours everynight take this class. No curve. 3 Essays each worth 25% and a mandatory section worth 25%.

Really cool Professor, keeps class interesting. Very helpful.  If at some point history hasn't made you mad, then you haven't  learned a thing. you'll be shocked by what you get out of this class. if you're looking see something you have never seen before, this guy will show you.

Not the greatest lecturer in the world. You will need to read. He tells you one the first day of the class, if you do not read, you will fail. But if you do the reading with any sort of determination, there should be no way you get any less than a B. Gave a take home final. He has his shortcomings, but he's not as bad as everybody makes him out to

This is not an easy class, but very interesting and useful. Prof Perez tutored me one on one during his office hours and offered to help anyone. You really have to do the reading though. One of my fave profs. I'll take another class with him.

I went to every class read everything and still i dont know what Perez' fkn point was.  DURRRRRRRRRRR Perez makes no sense with his lectures.  Take Nazi Navarro instead.............. The mid term adverage grade was 16/30 .  He just reads off dates of history that are connected to race problems.  NO Substanceand no structure...
Three words to ultimately describe this course: LACK OF STRUCTURE. He some how always manages to incorporate native americans into the lecture.

Perez is passionate about Native American Culture because he himself is Native American. I feel he should have covered other ethnic backgrounds more in the class. The reading is REQUIRED. If you can, take someone else.

That last comment just goes to show how this website gets misused for politcal agendas.  Who wrote it, Bill O'Reilly?  Interesting class, and Perez doesn't grade you on whether you agree with him or not.
Worst prof on campus.  Has some really twisted ideas. Did not learn anything except that I will never take a class from this prof ever again.  Unless you hate America, stay away from this clown.

Is this guy for real? Worst professor ever! How about a little structure next time? Perez really is terrible.  I am not happy that I spent money on this summer school course.  He just rants and raves. He must have a really, really small brain. Peres is the least informed prof on campus. AVOID!

Just took this class for summer session and pretty much agree with the last review. This is not the easy A I had heard it would be. But it was a very interested class and I feel like I have a lot better understanding of this country's history. He doesn't push his views on you and has some good stories. If you want a challenging different class, OK.

Just took this class for summer session and really enjoyed it. Dr Prez is funny, engaging, but a little intimidating at first. Do the reading and go to class, you will get a B for sure. He seemed pretty open minded to me and likes to play devils advocate. I'll probably take another class with him.

Even my TA thought he was awful. That has to be some sort of validation for all the student comments. I'm not being the bitter failed student either. I got an A-, but seriously, this teacher is definitely the worst professor I've had so far.
those good reviews are nuts. this is the worst professor on campus. avoid at all costs.

Terrible teacher.  90% of the class he spent on Native Americans and their problems. Basically, he indirectly tried to tell everyone to hate all Europeans. Had only 1 lecture on Japanese people. The reading and writing assignments were insane for an intro course. I got a B but it's bad for such an easy course. Take another teacher!

This class wasn't too bad, but it is a lot of work. There weren't any test but there were 3 essay which require a lot of time. the guest speakers were interesting. Class attendance really doesn't matter.

I wanted to defend Prof Perez too from negative comments. Teaching style is very kool, thought provoking but gotta pay attention. Totally helped me with my paper in his office. I think certain people dont want to listen to the truth,he tells it like it is and I thought he presented both sides well. Will definitely take another class. He's great.

I was really shocked by how many people wrote negative and vicious reviews of Dr Perez. He is the best and most interesting teacher that I have ever had. I worked hard and got an A in the class. I talked to him a couple times after class and he was really helpful and open minded. Take this class if you want to know the real history.

This prof is bad news and maybe the worst prof at ucr.  No organization to his course and very unrealistic expectations.  The reader that we had to buy from some guy in the alley was a crazy mix of articles that made no sense and cost $55 and is real garbage.  Run from this prof.

if hes teaching the course..DROP IT! hes boring...mean...unclear..the TAs are great...but perez randomly selects papers to grade himself..if he does take yours..dont expect As or Bs..he also randomly calls on people in class..and if you dont know the answer..u get a F in participation...DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS

I agree with the comment below. simple one of the worst UCR professor I have encountered. His class is unorganized, sells a book that he has no copyrights to. he is deliberately tyring to make this class hard. He hates his students the moment you walk in the class. he is not helpful at all! dont take this class if he is teaching.

I think that Dr. Perez should teach the way he does by lecturing in the class, I don't think many people shows up if they know that they will be called on in class.  I thought the class was very in depth about the historical context, and just 'YOU' explaining it would be enough.  You're the first lecture that I had a teacher call on students@random

the first thing the professor said was that never email him. he is extremely boring in his lectures. He just gets up there and starts talking without connecting his current lecture to his previous lectures. He tries to make the class hard by giving three 10 page papers to write. Simply the worst professor I have ever had.

This teacher makes me angry.He is heavily biased, and he insults the students' intelligence. He takes opinions like a grain of salt, and is obviously very bitter towards the white race. He is also very petty and willing to give failing grades to students who fail to show up to a lecture, even though they have worked hard on the essays and whatnot.

The professor isn't all that bad if you talk to him outside of class he's cool. He is a bit eccentric but apparently he didn't want to teach this class so it makes sense. This class is harder than your average breath requirement but it's really interesting if you give it a try.  I was a poly sci major and changed it to ETST cause i liked it so much
Worst professor ever
Hard, unorganized, unclear on everything.  On lectures on Indian stuff. Has too many guest lecturers and it makes everything even more confusing. Stay away!
No Comments

this guy is bad news.  only teaches about native americans in a class that is supposed to look at all american ethnic groups.  we are almost to the end of the quarter and we still don't know what the exam schedule is.  seriously!  he has brought in a bunch of ****s to give guest lectures. this is an awful experience.
He is extremely biased in his lectures. It would help if he could provide both sides of arguments to the class. He also doesn't respond to any emails and  is not very approachable.

this teacher is feakin hard to get an A in.  has no grading rubric, has a harsh attendance grading policy, and drowns out dissent.  A's are given out to only about less than 5 percent of the class.  Another 10 get B's.  So 85% get C's or lower... r u willing to take the risk?

note to honors students: this prof. only gave out 1 A on the first essay midterm.  proceed with caution. he talks in a very mono tone manner and he seems like a jerk and inapporachable but if you ask him for help, he'll help you. he seems really stern and mean but outside of the class, he's a really good guy. borderline cool. i think that people kind of judge him without really trying to get to know him. he's really not a bad guy/prof.just talk to him
should change his class to native american studies not ethnic studies...get outta here mann

With a doctor degree, he still doesnt know how to teach!
Crazy awful professor. His ethnic studies is all about native americans and nothing else.  Really angry, does not do email or telephone.  I am paying alot to got to ucr and he is ripping me off.

He is rather harsh and you have to kind of agree with him to get the best grade possible. He is stern looking, if you are white or asian avoid his class otherwise you should have a better time. He is not **** he just "prefers" certain people. I admit I think his class is a waste and his lectures are never concise-they wander.
I don't know what these negative comments are about he is very approachable, he despises a kiss a## and grades based on your effort put into the class. he keeps the class as interesting as possible.
For an introductory course, it required a lot of work and writing.  Not a very approachable person.  Interesting in his lectures but seemed very harsh and strict.

He is a extrely knowledge individual whom tells you the truth about Ameican and Indian Historty.  Additionally, many people who critisize him are White people who either do not beleive what he says or do not beleive that their ethnicity have and continue to depress "minorities".

I might come late to his class from time to time, but I have a lot respect for the stuff this man teaches.  It's not easy to teach a class like that (after most of us have been brainwashed by our U.S. History textbooks in high school or wherever).  You can get a lot out of his class!
horrible! doesn't give any kind of feedback, and assigns random grades.  there is no "grading rubric" which means u gotta be a big suck-up to get on his good side.  DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASSES! trust me

not helpful AT ALL... very unorganized... he has NO email... NO phone number... and half the time, he's not there during office hours!  on top of all that, he pretends to be open minded, but is very hypocritical... it's kind of like... "you can have an opinion as long as it agrees with mine"

He is a very proactive teacher that requires you to think out of the box.  He prizes opinions and questions.  He is a very interactive professor and provides thoughtful stories, guest speakers, and  videos.
He's an ****, but if you talk in class and pretend like you care you get a good grade.  I got an A on a paper I ended with a Billy Joel quote if that tells you anything.
I was a freshman and i had my first dose of cultural theory - yeah!!!  and this guy has the best stories; the BEST!!!!
Real down to earth and very informative teacher. He is willing to work with you and easily accessible. His classes demand you deal with new approaches.

Classes rely on quizzes for grade so be prepared to go to all lectures provided because nothing is from the provided textbooks with an exemption being from possible class projects or extra credit opportunities. Barely stops for questions during class so write notes fast and wait for after class personal questions, he arrives at exact start time.

reviews.comment:
RUN!!!! If you're thinking about taking him, DON'T! He is a hard grader and does not provide good feedback. He does provide "help" but it is not helpful. You're basically on your own. 
Nice guy but has insane standards. If you take him, get ready for an overwhelmingly stressful semester.. and regardless of all your hard work, you will get a B or C

Only issue were the quizzes because they were a lot of points and not open book/notes. We had to read around 4 books in the quarter which was very challenging. Also, he's an unrealistically hard grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this professor a couple of years back so things might have changed? His lectures were good with loads of info! His quizzes were hard because its a lot of info to remember. Almost impossible to get an A but easy B/C, I'd say. Very handsome prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Lehmann makes lecture interesting and is a genuinely nice guy. His quizzes destroyed my grade though. Very difficult to pass those. They're over 20% of your grade, not open notes, and HARD. Def going to tank my gpa with this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: These reviews do NOT apply to my experience. His quizzes are EXTREMELY DIFFICULT and the amount of reading is overwhelming. He expects way too much and considering it's just an elective, this is ridiculous! Very kind but very unreasonable. It's impossible to get an "A".
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Lehmann was absolutely amazing. He was a great lecturer and was one of the most helpful professors I had. He has a deep understanding of the material and was always happy to help in office hours.

Dr. Lehmann is great, he really cares about his students. Very understanding and accommodating. Material is super interesting, and clear/broken down well - therefore easy to understand. Few assignments are the whole grade (an essay, a project, and reading analysis). Notes are posted as videos, and are 2 hours worth per week. It's a good one!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Great lecturer. Makes sure everything is clear and understandable for his students. If you have questions, ASK! he's great with working with you. Also, he brings German cookies to class. Beware of pop quizzes, so make sure you keep up with the readings. Sometimes the readings are a bit much but most aren't dense and are actually entertaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! Very supportive and genuinely wants to see his students succeed. He's also very flexible and understanding, and will always help you if you reach out. I really appreciated how approachable and encouraging he is, he is definitely one of the best professors I've had!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Took Professor Graham over the summer and it was a fairly easy class, as long as you watched the lecture videos ahead of time and took spot on notes. I was wondering why there weren't any recent ratings because I really did learn and get a good grade at the same time!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Took his class back in 2004 so if I came back to comment you know he left an impression. Everything you learn about philosophy will carry over to some of your econ classes. AMAZING professor stop being lazy and take a professor who will teach you

Such an amazing professor!! Enjoyed his class sooo much! If you have the chance to take him for philosophy...get him! He keeps the class really entertained. I wish all UCR professor were like him. Btw, he is also the associate dean of the philosophy department

I took this class to raise my gpa as a senior.  I'm currently have a D.  This is the only class I've ever had to take as S/NC. The tests are so unnecessarily hard.  You'll study for hours and then fail bc you forgot one word in the definition. taking this class was easily one of my worst decisions ever, PLEASE DONT TAKE IT PLEASE

Super funny teacher. He knows how to teach his subject while cracking a joke or two. I definitely recommend this teacher. He just knows what he is talking about, and he also makes if worth your time. Lectures=mandatory. Tests are not too hard, if you study. He does give out study guide, so focus on that. I worked hard in his class and it payed off

He is the best professor I've ever had- FUNNY. The material is only confusing if you don't study, read the book and don't attend lectures. He incorporates humor into his lectures and makes it really interesting. The mid-term and final is easy if you study daily. If I had a chance I would take any class with him and would re-take this class.

He goes off topic most of the time! He can be offensive towards some cultures but you have to be open minded plus that does help you remember stuff for the midterms! Other than that he is a great teacher!

If you really really do the exercises, much of the lecture will be review and clarification. Also, his exams are super tricky which can be annoying at times. Just study like crazy. Graham really does look like Frasier, though. Good, corny sense of humor, too. Overall good lecturer, just tough.

He is a lot of fun during lecture. If you don't read, you MUST go to class. If you do read, then it'll help a whole lot more to go to class. Study hard for midterms and final 'cause that's what he bases his grading on. He tricks you in tests, watch out for that. All in all, he's not that bad, but do work hard in his class. Get close to your TA.

While I don't like him personally, I probably learned more and worked harder in his class than in any other I have ever taken. This is due to the fact that there are readings which are very dense at times & anything is game on the daily quizzes, including info that was mentioned 1X in passing a month ago.He's funny but has an unapproachable vibe.
Study daily.

Teaching style is comical at best, he lacks the ability to actually tell you what to review for the tests. So when he gives you a study guide make sure to create a better, more comprehensive one than his cryptic excuses for guides that end up being irrelevant for the tests.

Graham maintains his status as one of the best in the excellent UCR Phil dept. He makes Phil of language fun, especially though the use of some examples/concepts that are not really on the syllabus but does add to the learning. Tests are fair and are not that hard. Responds to emails and is in at office hours. Does not follow syllabus though.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS UNLESS YOU ALREADY KNOW THE MATERIAL! If you have little or no background in philosophy, this class is not the place to start. He assumes you know a lot already and he never responds to emails. EVER. That said, the material is interesting but you must take extensive notes and study constantly. No textbook. No study guides.

peter graham was an overall good professor. his material was interesting and he always made the class laugh. from his irish/scottish accents to his subtle jokes, the class was always entertained but learning the material really well at the same time. awesome professor with awesome ta's and teaches interesting material.

I recommend not taking him unless you have some prior background in philosophy and are a phil major.  It will suck otherwise.  He doesn't reply to emails and when students ask him to explain a concept he'll only repeat himself, he won't try to teach another way.  The book barely helps and he doesn't follow the syllabus or book very much.

Although he mainly teaches Philosophy, he volunteered to teach a workshop, so to critique him of how he teaches and how he is approachable, I would say this guy is funny. It was either he came or not, and me and the classmates found out that he only wakes up by the alarm. Anyways, he also understands other students' ideas.
This guy is utterly useless. Totally unreachable by phone, email or in office hours. I could even confirm simple administrative matters that required nothing more than a simple yes/no answer.
A very easy class. He is approacheable and very helpful. As long as you take notes in class and read the assignments once in a while, you should do okay in this class.

Class was fairly easy but he took forever to grade stuff.  Actually I never even got one of my papers back, after I reminded him like 5 times that I needed a grade he just said that it didnt matter that the new paper would overwrite my old grade.

Love this professor. A pleasure to listen to. Made lectures interesting by constantly involving the audience. Really knows what he is talking about, even if he isn't the greatest of spellers. Extremely nice and easy to approach. =)

Kind of annoying but not intentionally.  Fairly interesting material and strong lecturing abilities.  Makes exams needlessly challenging and unclear.  Impossible quizzes given every other day.  Unreliable office hours.

He is so great... he has passion when he teaches, and he has a slight arrogance which is so funny to see. He is such a smart man and you can see that right away.His course is not  hard but just do the READING,He is sooooooo HOT. I could he hear him speak for hours,he has such a sothing voice. And is outward apperence.he looks like a hot fraiser
he's pretty good

Best professor I've had at UCR. He's very intelligent and educated and presents the material in a clear way. It's not necesarily an easy subject, but there's not a reason to fail his class unless you never go. Great Great professor!!

I like him. I hate epistemology. The reading is extensive, self explanitory, and current. I think he thought I was wacked out but in the end understood where I stand and respected it. See him one to one and he is pretty open and available. We never saw eye to eye but I respect him and he earned that respect.

Funny, effective, but with a definite slant to his lectures.  He's in the business of indoctrinating students to see certain "problems."  If you don't see the problems, either you are not looking correctly or you are some kind of intellectual mutant.  Loves to challenge, hates to be challenged.

Great professor. Takes time out to explain difficult concepts. He is very approachable, easy to talk to, and very funny at times. He makes the class exciting, yet intimidating sometimes. Overall, he's an awesome phil professor who teaches well and connects with his students well. Take one if his classes if you get the chance.

Awesome professor...the best by far.  It's a great class.  He's very approachable and he encourages everyone to go to his office hours.  He explains the material really well.  If you don't understand, he's there to help you.  He's really funny too.  I guarantee that you'll enjoy having him as a professor.

Professor Graham is definitely the best philosophy professor in UCR!!! He is very approachable and if you want to improve in class, he will teach you how. It's a great learning experience to take his class! He's funny too....or at least not boring like the others!

He is the best philosophy prof at UCR for sure. he knows how to answer a question directly and take whatever is said and tie it into the points he is making for the day. the entire time you are sitting there actually thinking about class.. he makes it awesome
definetly a hottie, i think he knows this, very engaging, love the way he teaches, pay attention and he'll make you feel stupid and smart all in the same lecture
Graham is the HOTTEST Philosophy professor at UCR.  And I'm not even into dudes

He's lectures are very interesting and ingaging.  They geat a little complicated and confusing some times, but if you ask him questions he will clear it all up.  He'll challeng you and make you think critically.  But it is really interesting

reviews.comment: Co Kim has a great understanding of the materials that she delivers. The class is doable if you attend lectures. Homework is heavy but fully comprehending it will prepare you for the tests. Exams weren't hard but tricky due to synonyms/proverbs. There's a group project at the end of the quarter. Overall, if you put in the effort, you will do great!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: (VNM003) Homework requires MANY hours of typing in Viet, and is redundant busy work. Her tests and quizzes WILL include questions about things from previous chapters, and even though you never learned it in this class. It's so frustrating. If you don't speak Viet, taking this class is a bad idea. You also don't know your grade until the very end.

Try to pass the placement test rather than taking any of her classes. Her exams make no sense and she gets mad if you have any questions about them. She nags more than she teaches. The class is a huge waste of time and you leave being more confused than actually learning anything.

One of the best professor I have met in UCR. In lecture, the professor gives really practical and sometimes full of reference examples to demonstrate certain physical concepts. The homework video checks your learning by having you explain your thought process on how you approach certain problems. Overall really positive experience in this class.

Professor Tanedo is one of those people who you really respect/wish was your friend. He isn't pretentious, tells you what you need to know and makes class very interesting. Definitely take one of his classes - it's an experience (a positive one).

One of the best physics class I ever taken. Professor Tanedo structured the class to be easy to digest and not overwhelming. I learned a lot from the explainer video homework where we have to teach problems to other peers of the class. Professor Tanedo is able to relate the physics concept to some quirky references which made the class entertaining

Professor Tanedo's class is the best class I have ever taken. He has a unique class structure that helps reinforce concepts through explainer videos. Along with explainer videos there are weekly homework assignments and weekly surveys to check on your understanding and what should be reviewed more in class. He is always willing to help you as well.

She does publicly ridicule students! Beware!

reviews.comment: This professor has definitely changed. I was nervous coming into this course as I've seen so many negative reviews, but after being in her class this quarter, she's actually very sweet! Attendance is mandatory  and there's homework every week, but lectures are straight forward. We use a workbook daily too. Overall a good class and I learned a lot!
Very not respected and uncaring. Not accommodating at all. Not tech savvy, but will blame any inconveniences on you. Tough grader and does not have an ounce of understanding for your circumstances

From someone who had her online and in-person, her class is pretty hard, so dont take this for an easy A even if ur viet. Her hw is long like 5-8hrs per week. Personally, her in-person classes and tests are a lot easier than online. She grades on effort so be attentive and polite, kinda like high school. be warned to not get on her bad side tho

Literally the worst professor I have ever had. Isn't understanding and is literally on a power trip. She will bully you in class. Her exams are brutal. The exam averages are always in the 60s. Avoid this class even if you're a Vietnamese student. It is not an easy A.

Don't expect her to be understanding on anything, even if something out of your control happens to you. Tests are taken online using Respondus Lockdown browser, and in combination with the Viet keyboard, which is awful. If it fails or crashes during the test, you're SOL and its somehow your fault. Even if you're viet, don't expect an easy A.
rude and on a power trip. rude and disrespectful to students.
High amount of homework that takes at least 8 hours without actual help. Never ever take this class. Avoid at all costs.
SO DIFFICULT AVOID AT ALL COSTS. Class is nothing compared to what is on the test.
