reviews.comment: By far the most hardest class I have ever took in my life, coming from a straight A student. This was supposed to be an elective for me, but I felt like it was way more difficult than an any upper-div class that I have taken. Chapter tests were brutal and there is no leniency for students. It is almost impossible to get an A.

the amount of hw she gives you alone will make you hate this class. idk what the other reviews are saying bc shes extremely NOT understanding. her lectures are long and confusing. she shows no sympathy towards her students. i only took this class bc I need it to graduate but don't try to take it for an "easy A". would give 0/5 if I could.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was 3x more work than any of my upper div courses and the homework was absolutely ridiculous. Attendance is mandatory and you have to turn on your camera. Her chapter test are made to be confusing and no one ever passes with a good grade. When you try to explain a mistake to her she argues back and makes you think that you're at fault.

Professor Pham is very organized when it comes to structure of concepts but is very unclear when it comes to requirements for those concepts. Exams are hard and homework is very tedious. She's not as understanding to students and is bias. If you want to pass, study study study. There is no way you will pass unless you absolutely master chapters.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Co Kim, online, is extremely unorganized and not understanding. She blames her students for her lack of clear directions on assignments and students laptop or wifi not working. Her material is very hard and she expects students to do well on her tests when Viet parents don't even understand what she's teaching them. AVOID HER AT ALL COST!!!

Professor Kim is nice. I like her as a person because she tries to help us learn the material as best she can. I think that although the class is fine, the homework is way too much. I almost dropped the class soely because there was so much of it. You definitely have to use your time wisely or else you will fall behind and stress about it later.

Co Kim is very nice and even funny! I took only her viet 3 class but she gives lots of hw and the exams are pretty straightforward to what we learned. You'll struggle if you can't read, but you're supposed to learn that in viet 1. Take her for your language!!

Co Kim has a bit of humor, at times, she likes to joke around with her students. The class is pretty easy, exams are not that bad, and the homework is pretty long. The hardest part of it all is first learning about the tone marks, but after that, it gets better.  There are individual projects that are pretty easy and straight forward as well.

She is a very nice teacher but be warned! She grades you based on the way she thinks of you. I took Vietnamese 002 last quarter and my score was much lower than my quiz scores in Viet 003. Yet I still got a lower grade in Viet 003. Therefore, make sure she admires you in class otherwise the grade you get will not be the grade you deserve!

Best professor! Loves her students and makes sure everyone understand the language and culture. Even though homework is due everyday you have class, the work she gives you will benefit you in your quizzes and your final is a big culture quiz and the group project. Recommend anyone who needs a GPA boost to take it!
Co Kim is very nice professor and the class is fun depending on your classmates. Easy A OR B even thought there are a lot of bookwork due everyday, the book work helps you improve your vietnamese

you are prob taking her class bc you are vietnamese. well lemme tell you. it's an easy class and she is a VERY nice professor! there's loads of hw. It's easy, but very tedious. I would recommend it to vietnamese students. it'll be a little more hard if you're not vietnamese, though.

DO NOT TAKE HER, WORST TEACHER EVER! TOO MUCH HOMEWORKS, OFF TOPICS ALL THE TIME, NEED                           A VALID EXCUSE NOTE WHEN ABSENT. THE ONLY POSITIVE THING: WAIVED SOME HOMEWORK ONLY IF YOU'RE THE HELPER.
good and very helpful teacher

Co Kim is very helpful and understanding with her students.  She let you make up your quizzes. Her lecture notes are well organized and easy. It might be a little difficult with the homework and tests but overall it was a pleasant to have her as a teacher.

She's a sweet lady who loves her students.  It's kind of hard to get away with politics considering that nearly all Viet Kieu are some by-product or product of the war.  She doesn't focus completely on Viet language, but goes into deeper issues that concern many of her students.  I think this is enriching for our education.  Way to go, Co Kim!

This teacher is nice one on one.  The class is fairly easy if you come to class everyday.  She is very biased though in her political views and never stops talking about the corruption of the vietnamese government.  Fun class to take nonetheless.
so easy. if you want to take a class to boost up your grade. this class is it.
He was one of the first TA's I had at UCR and he is so wonderful. If it wasn't for him I don't think I would have passed. Hands down the best TA I ever had!
Respect
Without his help, I couldn't pass the class.
Hand down to the best TA of UCR. His discussion helps students review for quizzes and tests. Take him.

Math 046 is hard, but Tri is a good TA. He holds more office hours than he has to. Easy to access outside of classroom. In the quiz, I made a mistake and copied a wrong number from the question, but he still gave full credit because my answer is correct with that mistake. Best TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Had him for MATH007A's discussion. You have to do the homework/study before his class or you won't do well on the quizzes (which are usually given each class). He sets up study sessions before big tests (like midterms and finals) so he's really easily accessible and wants his students to do well. Really glad I had him as a TA!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is a great teacher but show up and do your work and you will pass. He is very slow at grading but if you do your work you will pass. He is funny and outgoing and makes class fun. You will do most of your work in class so its best to show up because lecture is about 20 mins. I failed this class online with a D so I recommend taking in class.

Taught the course with amazing clarity and easily accessible outside class. Easily one of the best professors in UCR. A lot of homework during the start of the course but eases during the end of quarter. Midterm is based on notes and fogler. Exams are concept tricky, not so math intensive and gives a lot of partial credit.
Homework is more difficult than the 110 series, but overall great professor. Tests aren't too bad.  Office hours very helpful.
Great personality, really knows how to teach a class and keep us paying attention.
Best professor at UCR. Hands down.
Dr Christopher is an amazing professor. Very clear and very helpful. I recommend him to anyone.
Awesome class

I thought he was chill during lectures, he made the midterm straightforward for us and let us bring cheat sheet. however when it came to the final, I was left speechless. He made the final extremely difficult and the study guide was irrelevant. His curve made almost no difference and he never responded to any emails throughout the quarter
Such an amazing prof would definitely take his class. 10/10. The course material can get pretty rough, but he is really good at giving examples and answering questions. An inspirational guy

Great professor! Class is densed, so the material makes it difficult. Lectures are fast paced, but brings an abundance of real world life examples (he runs his own firm) so it helps a lot. Very passionate, so his lectures are exciting. 2 exams MCQ, 1 big project, hw due once a week. Study outside of class and you'll be fine! don't fall behind!

Material is extremely dense & requires effort/time to understand. There is 1 midterm & 1 final that are slightly challenging but no surprise if you pay attention & complete your work. Attendance is taken each class. He is a really great prof, always answers questions quickly & tries to help as much as possible.

This class has mandatory lectures and discussions, with random attendance checks—especially after midterms or on bad weather days. Lectures can be dull, but the professor talks about his businesses to keep things interesting. Exams are concept-based and tough, and homework is extremely difficult without Chegg. The TAs aren't helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Teaching isn't his day job and it shows. he brings in a lot of real world experience and exams from the accounting world in order to help prepare you into becoming a CPA. 
There isn't a "curve" but he will weigh assignments differently because not everyone is great at exams.

Inspired me to pursue a CPA. Super succesful ($$) and experienced in accounting industry + business in general. His lectures are interesting but the content is dense. Cengage exams are hard and you are on a time crunch so make sure you understand the HW perfectly before. Gives a lot of context with real examples from his work.

(Wint 2022) This class ran on WileyPlus, which was used to access the textbook and do the required homework. The professor cared about our learning, so there was no busy work, though we had one simple term project. His lectures were interesting, and he could answer any question about the accounting world. The WileyPlus exams were very hard.
Great professor! He's funny and make lectures fun to watch. You can tell he is really passionate for accounting and it's inspiring.

Very nice and caring professor! Your grade is primarily made up of the midterm and final. Assigns homework worth a small percentage of your grade. Exams are doable but you must put in an effort to study.

Great professor. Very helpful to the students. Has a great understanding of the course content and is eager to make sure the students understand the content as well. Reasonable amount of workload. Exams accurately reflect the course material. No need for textbook but need to buy Cengage access.

Does random attendance checks. Communicative& always willing to help. Approachable& a young professor. Midterm&final is your major grade but curves which will help but still need to study. Slow to input grades in. Group project which is fairly doable
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: He's a really great teacher! Tax is intimidating but he tries his best to make it clear and manageable. Really friendly and always ready to give help. Midterm and final are most of your grade but he curves so don't stress too much. That said, you still need to study!! Tax isn't something you can just teach yourself the night before the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Pittard is a charming and knowledgeable teacher. He cares about students and enjoys helping them. One of the best professors at UCR! Group project is to file a tax return based on the case he gave to the class. Work ahead and ask him to check during his office hour and your team should be fine. Tests r curved but grades a bit slow though.

Piya was an incredible teacher/ mentor she was very easy to work with and explains everything in her class thoroughly. If you attend class, this class will be a very easy high grade for you. She gives extra points for almost every assignment along as you put the effort in.

Wonderful professor and inspirational woman. I loved her class. She's smart, funny, and passionate. Class isn't easy but worth taking it. She is not anti male or anti White people. She's just very big on social justice and women's rights.

She makes the class seem like it will be a lot of work but she usually changes the syllabus because of time constraints and the amount of work she has to grade. Usually she's behind on her lectures and ends up talking about subjects not related to the class but I definitely learned a lot.

Chatterjee is kind of awful. She is very unclear about what she wants for papers and projects. The first couple weeks are guessing her expectations... She is rude to students and interrupts them. She has a ridiculous grading scale, where she thinks a 94 is an A-. She is a super feminist and only likes students who agree with her.

This class will not be as hard as she makes it seems. 6 homeworks out of the ten weeks, they're simple. 2 quizzes on key terms, and a group project.The readings can get heavy but just try to keep on track until after the second quiz.After that, you wont be tested on them.For the project, she looks for quantity. She seems intense but she's cool.

Honors-I liked her. she gives a lot for the honors section but it is all do able. You dnt get any tests or final just work and if u work hard and bring ur best effort ull get an A. coming to discussion was very chill. I recommend this class u learn a lot and can leave with a new perspective. She is very nice and with time u get to really like her =

You dnt have to buy a book, the readings are online...you have no midterm, 2 tests, 6 hw outlines and a 9 people group project...hard to get an A coz its 95%,but easy to get a B and if u work hard u can get an A-.she is nice, but she can be arrogant and cold, you have to come 2class EVERY time or you lose a lot of points and u need to buy a clicker

Her class is demanding but flexible. She is fair and open-minded. Her views may deviate from mainstream American norms, but they are well-informed and allow us to hear another side of most of the stories that are very much too simplistic especially in the media. If you don't want to work hard or is not open-minded, no offense, don't take the class.

ok class.not hard but there is a ton of reading that is extremely bland and hard to comprehend.very passionate about the material which is good,but sometimes so much that she rants on for 40mins.also loves to interrupt students CONSTANTLY.you can barely get a word in when she starts talking. also anyone who disagrees with her is not good for them.
I did NOT want to take this class at all. But she isn't a bad professor. She is nice and is fair. Just do what she tells you to do, do the readings, don't suck at life and you'll pass with an A. =P

Professor Chatterjee is an intense teacher but I liked her a lot. I think she is misunderstood due to cultural differences, however she is very nice, fair and helpful if you take the time to get to know her and show interest in the class. Personally, I was very happy with her class. Two thumbs up!!

Professor Chatterjee is probably one of the most narrow-minded teachers I have ever come into contact with. It almost seems like she believes that her students are still in grade school. She restricts cell phones, lap tops, and even looking at the person next to you (to an extent). Do not take her class!

If you are male or not a minority, avoid this professor at all costs! She will constantly interupt any student who expresses opposing views when talking to her. Although she is passionate about the subject, she is ridiculously close-minded and hard to get along wiht.

She is a really amazing professor. She is passionate, intriguing,and extremely nice. She generally wants to make an impact and to obtain knowledge from her students...a proactive experience. Plus the class it pretty easy...just go to class and do the hw and you're good to go!
no no no...  no talking, no writing notes, no phones, no looking at each other... and super femenist... like to the point of closemindedness :(

She is so unapproachable and she's way too set in her thinking. She has no real world experience, only academic experience on women's issues, so she thinks she automatically knows everything. If you don't agree with her opinion, she'll make you feel stupid...really really stupid. If you're a man or white, I don't suggest you take her.
Shes not a bad professor. She is bias though and her main message is that "everything is the whites fault." Unless you are a minority and agree with her views she will constantly interupt you.

Prof Chatterjee was way too set in her thinking.  If she saw one view, she would smother students expressing the opposite view.  She likes to interrupt students a LOT - making it hard to say more than a few words. Teaching teams were assigned, but very few teams actually finished their presentations because of interruptions.
There is a lot of work for this class. Its hard, but she is really nice.

The professor is great and she makes the class very interesting. Also, she has a lot of strong opinions. There is a lot of reading for this class but the reading is not that bad. Overall, very interesting class.

Horrible person. Not straight on facts, believes government should provide EVERYTHING for everyone. Basic message "white people suck." She had the class "teach" instead of her, but you can't get two words in without her interrupting for 30 minutes.  Beware.
No Comments
No Comments

this woman is all over the place, Her lectures are horrible with no structure. not really sure what shes looking for, never explains anything tries to get her point across by asking students questions then nver saying if the answer is right or wrong. other than that its an easy class.

psychotic amounts of reading. Massive paper take home final. SO much work with this class. You have to write essays, take a quiz every week, going to class is mandatory, you have to participate in discussion every week too! Friggen A!

If you're a guy DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. i've been sitting through boredom for the past 8 weeks. You won't agree with anything. Can't argue. However, the class is pretty easy (take home final cus we "were good" this quarter).
Amazingly self-absorbed/self-indulgent. Fanatical and preachy. Was told she was fired from the anthropology dept originally and I can sure see why.

An amazing teacher and person.  She has so much energy that you could sit through her lectures all day and never get bored.  I learned a lot from her, not only about theories and histories but also about how to be a curious, questioning and brave human being in general.
Very helpful and easily approachable.  Her passion and zeal for all subjects is infectious.  Wise beyond limits.
Scary nut-case, enough said!
If you can deal with her fanatical PC ranting and intolerance of other viewpoints, check her out. Otherwise, I'd suggest you run for the hills.
Awful, self centered and all about being powerful
No final.  Very passionate about her teaching.  Interesting, clear, not too much reading.
easy work no final

Pierre was sooo unprofessional. He would drag on his classes and was hard to understand and constantly rambles and seems like sometimes he doesn't even know what he's talking about. Never set up a proper Canvas page like we asked, never posted assignments so things would be confusing, didn't grade our midterm til after the final. Don't take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would most definitely take another class with Keller, Pierre if I could. He is a great professor and he is also a reason why I chose to switch my major. Everything is very straight forward, attendance was mandatory, in class lectures flowed with that nights reading and his requirements were not too excruciating.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: At first I was unsure of this class, but I'm glad I took it! Professor Keller has a rambling sort of teaching style and lectures off of slides that are available online. He can be very ambiguous, but Keller makes sure to focus on the most valuable parts for the test (4 total, drops the lowest score). He takes attendance every day using Top Hat.

Professor Keller is very passionate about Kant. Great lecturer but sometimes he'll repeat himself (however, it'll be useful as you will be more likely to remember for the tests). He gives three midterms (one is optional, you get your lowest grade dropped) and a final. Overall the exams are very easy if you pay attention to his lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He takes attendance every class- sometimes twice but the second one is extra credit. The lectures are long and sometimes really boring. He tends to ramble a lot, leaving you unsure about a lot of stuff. GO TO DISCUSSION. We had 3 midterms (lowest one is dropped) and a final. Honestly, save your time and money and dont purchase the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's a really sweet guy but drags on in lectures; you might just sleep. He's also extremely disorganized, even in lecture. Sometimes he'll just go on a tangent or use examples that are kind of awkward. Stopped going to lecture like 3/4 of the way through b/c he didn't help. TA IS YOUR BFF, GO TO DISCUSSION ALWAYS!! Mandatory participation. STUDY!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The professor is very good at his job, he is really passionate about philosophy and he shows that every lecture, lectures are kinda long because of the 1 hour and 20 minutes so sometimes it drags on, would recommend, but make sure to discussion

Love professor Keller's lectures! He was one of my favorite professors as a philosophy major.  His lectures are heavy so if you are interested in the subject you will be inspired and truly amazed.  His exams are essays in class, so be prepared to show him that you know what you are writing about.  He is a kind person and a truly great teacher.

Super sweet guy, and very willing to help. His lectures are honestly not hard at all to understand as long as you are actually listening. Attend lectures and be interactive in your discussion and you can get that A!
Really nice man!
Gives out more A's than most Professors.  Super helpful if you just ask.
Honestly, not a good class. VERY disorganized. Many tech issues occurred. Talks in run on sentences. He tries really hard but it just doesn't come across. It's a tough subject.

This professor knows what he is talking about there is no doubt about that. The problem is his clarity and how he explains his lectures. He pretty much explains the lecture which flies over everyones head. It feels like he thinks we (students) know what he knows, which is totally untrue. But overall,good teacher if u know watsup with philosophy.
He is very kind, even though many people feel his lecture is boring, but he is a really good professor!

This professor knows the material so well, but the problem is clarity. He does poorly in clarifying possible questions that students may have since he just repeats himself. The final format was confusing. However, the class itself is pretty easy if you keep up with the reading.

Good professor, knows his stuff, but it's still philosophy (so kind of confusing at times). He gives fairly detailed lecture notes, but can be hard to understand if you're not reading along in the texts. Go to discussion! It's the only way you'll survive!

He's a great guy, it's just really hard to pay attention, let alone grasp the information that is thrown at you. Discussions are where you must be in order to pass the class. You need 3 books for the class but I actually didn't buy any of them. The professor is so informed about the books, it makes them unnecessary. He loves philosophy.

I took this course just for a Breadth, but ended up enjoying it! Prof. Keller is great because he is so passionate about his subject, and my TA (Luis Montes) was helpful and excellent at making the material clear. Sit near the front, ask questions, and attend discussion- you will get so much more out of the course!

I took Intro to Philosophy. For the most part, he was hard to understand and wasn't too clear. But he has a good heart and will help you out. The curve is pretty big so if you get the gist of it, you should be fine. The class was 2 midterms and a final, but he was pretty lenient on grading.  My TA helped me to understand a lot so go to discussion.

Lectures are pretty hard to understand unless you are good at listening, especially for 2 hours. The TA classes are not to be missed, they are just so helpful. All three books aren't important since you can either get them on sparknotes or you only read a couple pages. The TAs cover it anyway so no matter. Overall not hard class.

The text material was very hard in itself to understand. Dr. Keller understands that we might not be able to fully know what's going on, so he grades pretty easy. I really enjoyed the class. It's my second class with Dr. Keller. He's a great Philosophy professor!

The materials can be difficult, but he tries his best to make students understand. Having a good teaching assistant to clarify philosophical terms definitely helped me understand the materials. If you can answer his questions on the study guide, you will do well on the exams.

I loved this class. He was an extremely helpful professor who really cared about his students. He wanted us to pass with A's and gave us second chances. No need to buy the book(s)...because his lectures are really detailed. One of the best professors at UCR forsure!

Professor Keller is awsome,very easy, dont even waste your money on the books he as everything on the slides. He gets into the lectures, although sometimes they can get somewhat boring. but this is an easy A class. highly recommend taking :D

I don't know why people say he's a bad professor. I got A's on all my midterms. Easy Class. Has sign in sheets sometimes during Lecture, but not much point value. I never went. The key to passing is going to discussion. Study Guide is given advance before midterms. The midterm is the basic concept from the study guide. Learn it and you'll do fine.

First of all, Kant is difficult for everyone.However Keller clearly recognizes this & does his best to keep everyone engaged. While others have criticized his lecturing ability, I can't see how ANYONE could make Kant any clearer than Keller.Sometimes extremely bright people are unapproachable,not him.Take the class-stretch your mind-record lectures

bless his soul, he reminds me of wayne zalinski from hunny i shrunk the kids. the class is only tough because TA's are hard graders. i got a C+ but if i went to every discussion i woulda got a B. go to discussion and youll do just fine. 3 in class essay tests that come straight from lectures. take good notes and read a little

He is sooooo boring but if you go to all your discussions you will understand the material. Texts are pointless and confusing. Just go to discussion. He gives you the midterm questions prior so just memorize them. It's easy.
he really knows his stuff and is excited about philosophy, but hes sooo boring! i would recommend taking another phil class thats more interesting. both him and the TAs are so weird.

Brilliant man, but not so great of a teacher. Never wen to lecture, too incoherent. But because I still wanted a good grade I went to every discussion. Luckily, my TA (Gregory Aisemburg) was really helpful and easy to understand which made the material bearable. If it wasn't for him I probably would've failed. Midterm questions are given prior.
Do not take this class if you are not interested!This class is not easy! Courtney grades hard! This class is tough if you have no clue about anything in Philosophy
DISORGANIZED.HARD TO UNDERSTAND. DOES NOT ANSWER QUESTIONS DIRECTLY INSTEAD GOES ON AND ON ABOUT IT. REALLY BORING. DONT TAKE IT IF YOU ARE NOT INTERESTED IN THE SUBJECT.

UCR's best. Pros: he's excited about the material (very much so), cares about the students, is hilarious, and is a fair grader. Cons: extremely unorganized & repeats himself a lot. It's nearly impossible to take "notes" other than writing down a few quotes. Great guy; will take every course of his I can.

Many don't like the way he teaches because he is hard to understand and tends to be complicating in the way he explains his material. He is a genius though, and if you need help, he is more than willing to listen. Readings are the most important. He gives out study guides so his exams aren't too difficult.
this man is good, that is all you need to know, this is a UC, take the frigging challenge, it is really worth it

Prof.Keller is a great guy. He cares a bunch about student learning, but he can be difficult to understand during lecture. He will make things clear if you ask him to explain what he's talking about. His grading is extra easy, so even if you are having trouble with the material you'll probably do fine on the assignments.

took him for german idealism, one of those professors that change the way you think. At first your thrown off by his complex sentence structure, but then that'll go away and youll start talking similarly, material was hard but he was extremely linient. It should be required to take one of his classes, unless you find the english lang cumbersome

never attended lecture n still got an A+ in the course. just make sure u go to all your discussion classes n go to tutoring sessions for help on the midterms n final exam. long as you read n study a lil youll pass the class

Keller's a cool guy, and even though he's kinda hard to understand, he has like all the books memorized. Plus he's really smart, so if you don't understand something, you should ask him after class or during his office hours. He was always very helpful to me. and And! he tells bad jokes, which kicks ass.

Keller wants to make sure that everyone understands him, so he repeats himself in 10 different ways hoping that his students will grasp the point he is trying to make. However, in doing so he tends to loose everyone's concentration. Keller also tries to lecture off the top of his head so his lectures are pretty disorganized. He's a good guy though.
No Comments
WTF?!?  He's easy but you can't understand him AT ALL.

This is the worst class I've taken at UCR. I have never written one of these, but I had to warn future students about this professor. His monotone voice and writing-heavy lecture slides make an exciting class dull. He also fails to include essential information in his slides that he expects you to know for exams. If you can, avoid this class!!!!!

reviews.comment:
A bit sarcastic for the sensitive crowd.Just a heads up! 
Great professor with AMAZING lectures. Lectures consist of everything you need to know for the exams so please review them! Class is not mandatory. He posts the slides a few days before test. 
First prof to make lectures entertaining. I recommend:) 
PS.Lots of tricky wording  in his tests!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class. Exams are based mainly off lectures but he does upload his slides. Focus on that and you should be set to get an A in his class.

He gives a lot of information at once, but it's actually not as bad as it sounds. He posts "study guides" and slides before exams and they're pretty useful. He's a solid professor and if you have the opportunity to take him you should.
one of the best political sciences courses I’ve taken. he is very knowledgeable about the topics he teaches and very funny as well

In order to do well in his class you need to excel in each exam since your grade is based on the 3 exams, and theres no assignments or homework. I barely did the readings but 90% of the exams are based on lecture. Study Guides basically tell you everything that will be on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's great all around. Has a way to inject humor into lectures so that it's memorable to you. Grade based on 3 exams (1 w/ short essay) with easy to reasonable difficulty.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: PB is one of UCR's best professors. The class consisted of 3 exams, attendance, and discussion grade. One assigned book plus weekly readings online. You can get by without reading but the lecture is a must. Study guides are thorough. Would take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Would recommend to take his classes if you're a political science major. Lectures are straightforward. He provides a study guide for midterms and final in the course. As long as you try, you should be able to get a good grade. His Posc 162s class has two midterms and 1 final, no paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Highly recommend this professor! He explains even the hardest of topics with ease and is incredibly informed. There were 3 exams, all multiple choice and an essay. Show up to class and you will do well on the exams! His sense of humor fit the class topic pretty well too so the class was very enjoyable. Plus his TA this quarter was a cool dude.

I truly enjoyed POSC 150S (Human Rights) with Prof. Pion-Berlin. Easy and straight forward lectures. Lots of reading every week in the textbook/reader and online articles. However, his tests are multiple choice with a few short answer essays. They are easy as long as you attend class and sections.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Had him for CHASS F1RST YEAR learning community. Super easy to understand. Lectures are boring but he gives you everything you need to know for the exams. Awesome guy!

Awesome Professor! There really is not reason whatsoever not to get an 'A' in this course. He gives you all the necessary tools to succeed. Lecture is your best friend. Go to lecture and you can do not worse than a 'B' in the course. Office Hours are also very helpful. He wants you to succeed! Also doesn't hurt that he's hilarious and friendly!

Awesome teacher.  He really knows what he's talking about.  Took about 5 of his classes, they all relate to each other.  He usually uses the same cases in all his classes.  Posts lecture notes towards testing time depending on attendance.  Take his class if you love Latin American Politics, he'll interest you a lot.
Though his class is a bit boring he loves what he's teaching.  He uses powerpoint and the notes are very clear.  All you need are the notes for the tests and you should be fine.

He is a good teacher. His classes are a little boring, but if you pay attention and take notes you will do fine.  No paper, 3 test, provided lecture notes, and even a study guide. Test were not bad , just study. Only way to fail this class is if you are lazy and don't study and don't attend lectures. But isn't that the case for any class.

This guy is humorous and the subject is interesting. He seems a bit hard to engage but visiting him in office hours helps. Once he gets to know you he is very eager to help. Tests are easy and all the readings for class are posted on ilearn...therefore no need to buy textbooks.

He was a cool guy n I went to lecture and I was in the HOnors sctn so I got like more help.But I ended up getting a C- in the class... Idk why... 1 mterm and final, both w essays.Class was cool. He was organized.His voice is monotonous tho. X_X but he knows his stuff and does ppt notes online but'll take em away if u guys dont attend class.
great professor knows a lot about political science and he seems to have a slightly sarcastic side at times which was nice. he taught the class well and made the material interesting

The best professor hands down! His is extremely knowledgeble about the military, which quite suprised me since I'm an army vet. The books are not needed, his lecture notes pretty much cover everything. However you'd want to attend class, since it is rather impossible to get access to his notes. The only time he posts his notes online is before test

Most boring professor I have EVER had in my LIFE.. I dropped the first class I ever took with him after a week.  I decided to give it a second chance but I ended up dropping his SECOND course too.  Monotone, uninteresting, no humor and over all just plain sucks!!  I gotta hand it to him he's a very smart man & researcher but he should NOT teach.

he was really into crimes against humanity very into this subject and lectured like a movie; it kept you on your toes. all his power point lectures are posted on ilearn and he gives you study guides. the midterms are scantron and essay but there are NO PAPERS! but keep up attendence because he took away a couple slides from us due to poor attendenc
He is very boring and unappproachable.  He can be amusing at times, but his lectures are not interesting.
This guy is the best professor ever. I love him so much. He is very smart and very clear. Basically he ****ing rocks.

Wow! He was such a gret professor! I wish I could have him again. His class was very cool and unlike what others think he did not push his ideas. I'm a rep. and never felt upset in class. He is great I think everyone should take him at least once!!!!!
He teaches the basic stuff half of the time, but pushed his biased views and bashes on Bush everytime he pushes his biased views. So I give him an F.
No Comments
the most uninteresting professor! I use to fall asleep in his class every day out of boredom

at times boring, but go to class anyways cuz notes are helpful for midterms. notes posted on ilearn can be helpful too. recently, he's added the readings to the midterms, so try to keep up as much as you can.

Politics and Arm Forces.. Very interesting topic! and Professor Pion Berlin is EASY EASY EASY EASY EASY! Study the note he posted online.. you will do just fine~ Lectures are helpful but a bit dry.. best of all.. THERE ARE NO PAPERS!!!!!!!!

ive taken every single class he's taught here at riveride...he's totally anti-Bush but he's still a wonderful teacher!  He's the only liberal i like so i guess that tells u something! and his lectures are pretty boring and monotone-ish...
good slides.  little obnoxious when opinionated

Really knowledgeable.  You'll learn more than you think you're learning.  His tyranny class is especially good.  But he can be a bit short-tempered when he needs to get a journal article in and the deadline is looming.
He was kinda boring. HOwever, the class was horribly easy. TO me, it was interesting cuz I'm  in love with posc, but if you need to jsut take it for a requirement, it's an easy a.

This class is all about notes. You can skimp on reading if you have to, but you need the lecture notes to pass. He posts the notes before tests, but they don't drive the point home as well as hearing them in class and writing them down. Nice professor.
Easy Class..test based all on notes..just go to lecture or get em off ilearn.

His class is boring, but it's easy.  Go to lecture, even though you can print the notes online, because he adds information that only comes from lecture.  Tip: Don't bother to read the books, midterms and final material are only from lecture

It's sort of an easy A, kinda not. I was pretty confused throughout the whole class, mostly because the lectures were pretty hard to focus on since he never really gave a clear idea of what we were talking about. Mainly focused on discussion posts and one essay, which isn't too bad... I just wish he lectured differently.

Never Ever EVER take this teacher. You will have a solid A all quarter because this is supposed to be an easy introductory class and 3 days before grades are due your grade will drop 10%+ because he leaves out 40% of your grade until its too late to withdraw (and thinks that's how it's supposed to be). If you don't like surprises steer clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The class was not organized at all. He gave assignments with really vague or little information on what to do. Lectures are him talking most of the time with a presentation that consist only of images. His lectures were pre recorded and really hard to focus on. He went on tangents during the lectures. Also he input grades the very last minute.

He is an extremely understanding professor. He did give out a lot of long texts to read, but he would go over everything in the lectures. Attendance is mand. and it just helps you understand better. His grading is not extremely harsh and as long as you understand and explain general concepts of the class you will be fine. He is also really funny.

LOVED GABRIEL! He's so funny and his lectures were very easy to understand. That paired with getting a great TA (Lewis Luartz) made this course easy for me, despite the fact that I only ever did part of one of the readings. Midterms were an in-class essay and a multiple choice test, final was an essay. Glad to have one fewer exams during finals.

The course was pretty hard for me personally because I fell behind often in the reading. I advise you make time for the packets. There is weekly readings and even though it is a big lecture, he still takes attendance through poll everywhere so attendance is mandatory. Discussion also has weekly questions on the reading so be mindful of due dates.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: EE-010 is a class that relies heavily on attendance and turning in homework. If you don't show up for class, don't expect that A. And if you don't turn in homework, don't expect that A. If you don't know how to do an assignment, just turn in whatever you have and get credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: No Comments

he teaches from the book, doesnt really have notes. covers what he beleives is important. he cares about the students learning and emphasized important topics. could be better when presenting material.
final was suprisingly difficult... otherwise course was alright. good teacher, little attitude problem though

guy's freakin hard. his tests are pretty hard. hes a smart professor so he expects u to be smart. expects alot out of his students. went to his ta office hours for help and most of the time he would say "you should know this".

Engaging lectures. Grades are very hard but he gives unlimited retakes. He interrupts students constantly and never lets anyone finish their sentence. Aside from that he is an interesting and effective teacher.

Potter is a good guy. He comes off as a jerk but really he's just trying to help you understand the material. I feel as though he did help me with my writing quite a bit. He's not always clear in the comments he writes on essays so make sure to really clarify what he means. Final was no biggie and done at home. Nothing for the first few weeks.

Great teacher, I feel like it was a love, hate relationship. The class itself is fun & interesting but he is a tough grader. I took his course during the summer for 5 weeks. We had four papers, he does grade hard. He did allow for revisions on papers. Make sure to ask specific questions. He will not help if you do not know what you need help on.

Hardest A+ in my life. AVOID him if you don't want to drain your mentality in ochem. His lectures are dried and not very clear. He wants you to know everything from the textbook from start to end with lots of rxns, mxns, and nomenclatures. Self-study, practice hw/chapter problems, and heavy reliance on TA,ARC, outside help are a MUST to succeed!

Sometimes he talks fast, with his accent may make him hard to understand. He’s not the kind of professor to ask questions during lecture. Midterm and final were extremely fair — exactly like the practice midterm/final, homework, and quizzes. A fair professor.

reviews.comment: He is very good at explaining and posting all his material from lectures so it is easy to review for his class. The quizzes are very easy and normally just 1 or 2 questions. He responds to emails quickly. The midterm and final are very doable. You do need to put in some effort and review but the class is not very time-consuming.

If you took AP Calc AB, the first half of this class should be a breeze since it's all review. There are very few homework problems after each lecture and he posts sample finals and midterms before the exams. He does write somewhat fast during lectures so pay attention, but he posts his lecture notes and scans online.

I took 10A Fall 2018 as a freshman. He made it really easy to learn and conceptualize the material. Lectures are very clear and there are practice tests for every exam. Quizzes were not bad because the TAs and the professor prepare you thoroughly for what would be on it. He made the class a breeze and gave me a great introduction to college math.

I took him for 9B fall 2017. i had ap credit and a lot of the class was really just review to me so it was a lot easier. he makes his lectures and lecture notes available online so you have the chance to understand the class better. Going to class will ensure youll get an A. He has great examples and is willing to help you understand!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: A very easy going professor. His accent can take getting used to, but he makes the class easy by assigning little homework every week. He genuinely cares about getting to know each student and ensuring they understand the material taught.

Dr. Chen is an extremely easy A. His homework and classwork (including practice midterms) very directly reflect what you will see on your exams. The course material itself is easy, and he only teaches the more basic concepts. Homework is absurdly minimal, which is a rarity in mathematics. I am blessed to have completed my math reqs with him!
The tests are very confusing, the wording of her quizzes and exams are tricky. She provides slides but you need to attend lecture to view what her answer is to the questions on the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not the typical exam questions/ wording. Both students and TA agreed exam questions were confusing for most. Lectures recorded, no curve/scaling no homework so grade was based solely on those exams and quizzes in your mandatory discussion time. Although some extra credit and other stuff helped boost your grade.

Dr. Campbell was a pretty good professor. 3 Midterms, 1 Final, and 6 Quizzes. Lowest exam grade dropped, including final, and lowest quiz grade dropped. There was a total of 24 points of extra credit available. Her exams were very fair and, although the lectures were dense, the homeworks and discussions helped guide you in what to focus on.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 1st time teaching this class, but she was receptive to feedback. 3 midterms on weeks 3, 6, 9 (all cumulative) + 6 quizzes + final. 1 quiz + 1 midterm OR final dropped. Discrepancy on what u need to study to ace exams, sometimes practice problems > memorizing slides, or vice versa. Overall, pretty fair and I'd say prioritize practice problems more!
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Campbell makes the subject of Animal behavior interesting by tying concepts with real world examples. The tests are a bit tricky if you just zoom through them. Overall if you study well you won't have an issue getting an A.

Professor Campbell is an amazing professor. I benefitted a lot from going to lecture- it allows you to participate and ask any questions about the material right then and there. There is a lot of material so it is best to keep up weekly instead of waiting last minute. She is very kind and accessible during office hours! Go to class!!

Dr. Campbell explains in a very easy-to-understand way, she can go into details and will not go onto tangent subjects. Her lecture videos are entertaining and she explains with such enthusiasm. You will have a weekly quiz and three midterms in total. As long as you are keeping up with the lecture/lecture videos you'll do alright.
Her tests are closely related to the slides. If you study, you will be fine. Nice person, too.

Awesome professor! Told us to read the textbook but you can get by with just her lectures. Her quiz questions are super fair and you can tell she loves what she does. Overall, would definitely take her again.

Campbell is amazing, I really felt like I was learning from her and she's very passionate about the material. She's also very friendly and helpful. Take thorough notes and the quizzes and midterms will be super easy. Reading the textbook helps but I don't think it's necessary. But it is a lot of information very quickly, so be prepared for that.

This was a great class! Everything you need is in the lectures and they are always interesting because of the many different cool and fun examples! Professor Campbell is also super helpful outside of class if you need anything! I would recommend if youre interested in letters of Rec or grad school to talk to her! Great professor with a big heart!

I absolutely loved having Dr. Campbell as a professor! She's super passionate about the subject and explains concepts really well during her lectures. Her lectures and powerpoints contain all the information you need to do well on her exams. One of my favorite professors at UCR!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: BIOL 160 was one of the easier upper division courses I've taken at UCR. Everything on her powerpoints are fair game for the exams. She is also easily approachable to ask for help in the class.

reviews.comment: really hard class, she's very monotone, you will work for your grade

reviews.comment: Print out slides and take notes directly on them during lecture. best way to make sure you know everything is to take notes from the textbook on the topics covered in the slides then MEMORIZE IT VERBATIM. her voice is very monotone and doesn't do clickers so not many extra points other than test and lab grades. MAKE AND KNOW THE PHYLOGENETIC TREE!!

dr poon is hilarious and i never got bored during lectures. his teaching was engaging and effective for me. i had to withdraw due to a hospitalization but i miss him every math class i have now. make sure to actually read the textbook so you do good on tests.

His lectures are harder to understand imo, but Damla (my ta) was amazing. She explained the concepts pretty well and I understood the concepts way better. Dr Poon is very straightforward but humorous. He gets confused during lectures sometimes and we point out the mistakes but overall, he's an ok prof. Hated how microtutorials were on the midterm

Very passionate about the course content and was happy to review any content that wasn't clear, as long as you asked. Bro sucks at teaching calc007B. Talk about using AI to solve math for himself all the time but won't even let us use a scientific calculator on tests. Midterm class average was 50% no curve. Do the study guide he gives you as it'll be similar to the test and do the homework. Good luck.

Yat Sun Poon has a great course; he's funny, caring and teaches well. Was kinda scared of him at first but he is super understanding and cares for the success of everyone in his class. Discussions are VERY clear and straightforward and class is fairly easy.

Great Professor! I attended most of his lectures and came out of it understanding what I was taught! First time I understood calc! I'm still butthurt about the fact he didn't show the answer key for the final review, but his reviews for both midterm and final reflect almost EXACTLY to the real thing! Just try your best, you'll pass!

Shi not that hard ngl. He says that u should read the textbook, but I didn't read a single page and I was chillin. The midterm and final was VERY fair. The study guide he gave for both HEAVILY reflects the test. HW was easy, if you use your resources. A 55% is a C and a 70% is a B-, but the 2 tests made up for 70% of your grade. HW costed hella tho

super sweet prof. if you don't understand lectures then ochem tutor vids got you. go to arc tutoring and office hours for help. do practice problems often. study the microtutorial problems. study for midterm and final. if you actually put good effort into this class you will get an A.

One of the worst professors i've had in my two years in ucr. Class was very hard because it was mostly based on difficult exams. The average was around 50%, and he didn't curve. There were few chances to raise your grade with assignments. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PROFESSOR. With all due respect if you're happy with your mental health listen to me

Go to office hours/study sessions for help. He is blunt and will call you out if you you don't understand something you should. Tests were a bit difficult. reviews.comment: Average score for midterm was 56%, average score for final was 59%, with no curve. His lectures are very unorganized, unclear, and not helpful in my opinion. Loved the class! The teacher is funny, approachable, and always willing to reteach. It's a safe space to ask questions during lectures. Tyler, the TA, is also funny and incredibly helpful. Highly recommend!

This guy is funny! Genuinely, he's a caring teacher and is VERY helpful during office hours. Yeah, the homework was a lot, but it's very good practice. Professor Poon is a very kind and caring professor honestly people are too hard he truly cares for students and will always be there if you have questions on the material. lecture was basically useless, couldnt learn a thing. Hoped for better study material with answers provided. Tests were hard and this was overall a bad class would never take again.

he knows exactly what hes doing. he doesnt only tell you what steps need to be taken to get an answer but also explains the reasoning behind each step. you understand the concepts as well as formulas in this class

hes so awesome, i had him for an entire year for 9b, 9c, and 10A. posted lecture, no hw, except for 10A, midterms and finals are jus like the suggested problems and examples in the lecture notes

Great teacher! Knows how to teach the material. If you do everything he assigns you will easily pass the class and learn the material really well! Dedicate time and you will succeed.

Very well organized, well prepared, knowledgable, and fair.  The best thing is that he put his lecture notes on ilearn so you can download them, instead of copying like crazy in class.

reviews.comment: Professor Ponisio is probably the worst professor Ive had so far. Shes proven that she cant adapt to online learning and isnt willing to make compromises for the sake of her students. Following students voicing their concerns, she messaged us saying emails would be disregarded then DELETED our slack workspace to erase evidence of this happening

I had her last quarter, if I didn't have to take her I definitely would have avoided it. She's extremely unprofessional and disrespectful to student's time and not understanding at all to any outside circumstances. Instead of listening to student's concerns, she gets extremely defensive.

Honestly probably the worst experience I have had at UCR. Prof is very unprofessional, unhelpful, and condescending. If she want a low average for these midterms, why can't she have a free response exam instead of the horribly worded multiple choice one. I would prefer having 30 questions in 50 min instead of now having those 5 extra credit ? count
