Class seemed hard until you actually take the test... it's simple.

A starry-eyed leftist True Believer. But then again, so are most of her sloganeering students. An irrelevant but curious note: I was routinely and maliciously jostled by my classmates for having an intelligent vocabulary.

Shes boring, but shes easy. She gives journal assignments and extra credit to help you boost your grades.  Not only that, if you study off her study guides before midterm/final, you'll do fine. She curves grades, and makes sure her average is a bit above the C average.

So my total engagement with Professor Reyes was approximately 5% of the course, her TA ran everything, including grading all but the last essay. reviews.comment: Course was very engaging and covered several subject matters that are often overlooked in much of recorded history. Professor does her best to facilitate a good environment and works well with students. I recommend taking this course if it's offered again in the future.

She is a really easy professor and it's easy to get her off topic (especially if she is talking about herself). A quick A class and barely had to learn anything to pass her tests. She's nice, but seems very full of herself. Just stroke her ego a little and you'll be fine.

Overall great professor! Course consisted of three assignments that you could choose to answer prompts in a creative way or by an essay. Another big portion of points came from discussion section, so make sure you attend. Course had a lot of readings, but I recommend you read them when assigned because you have to refer to them in the assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I enjoy the readings she assigns, and overall, I enjoy her lectures. Dr. Reyes is very helpful and available if you need help with the material. She cares about her students!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Reyes is sooooo understanding, kind, and considerate. Her lecture videos were concise and efficient. I could clearly understand and learn from her. Amazing professor!!! She assigned a book, but I didn't read it, and I usually skimmed it. 2 free response exams, discussion participation, and a short final reflection
Dr. Reyes is a great professor! Class was too easy so I got bored sometimes but she did change my thinking about some things and made me want to take more soc

Her lectures were kind of all over the place but it was only because she wanted to make sociology accessible to everyone. She made things brand which made it easier to do the free-write questions on the tests. she is super helpful and caring. I loved her class and it was even better getting perfect scores on the the midterm and final!

Never went to class and still got an A. She gave us the midterm questions and let us use a flashcard. We had a take home final. Attendance was not mandatory but weekly Packbacks were required. Discussion was worth a third of our grade but as long as you showed up, you're guaranteed the points. Don't buy the textbook. Easiest class I've ever taken
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Easy class as long as you show up and take notes or read the txtbk since her lectures mimic it. Is very caring towards students and cares about what they want, so study guides for exams helped tremendously as she allowed us to choose the format for them. Thus its an easy A intro class and is interesting !
This is a dumb easy class guranteed A if you at least go to discussion.

Professor Reyes has a unique teaching approach. It is a bit unusual but the good part is that the students can influence grading structure. There is a midterm with about 3 essay questions. There is a final, but not for honor students ;) There is also weekly Packback questions, so reading the book is not mandatory but it is needed for the questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Reyes is a great professor and she is willing to help out her students. I also think it is her first year teaching at UCR. She is clear with her grading criteria and is approachable after class and in her office hours. There are two midterms which are short answers each two paragraphs long and a 5-7pg paper (Must read). Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Ali REALLY likes in-class participation, but it gets a little awkward at times when the same people at the front raise their hands over and over again. Other than that, she's good at explaining programming principles and concepts, and the exams reflect that well. Two "mid" terms, no "final" exam. Make sure u get a good group for the proj

Good professor, subject matter is interesting and very applicable. She sometimes has in-class assignments that are due during lecture, but nothing too bad. The midterm and final are all open note. Most of your grade is dependent on the final project and labs, which weren't too bad, but make sure you choose good partners for both.

Lectures and discussions are really important so attend those, if you do it is almost a free grade on the exams, both midterm and finals are open notes. But the main grades come from labs and projects, please do them early and get a good partner with them. If you have a good partner it is a free A.

Really nice professor! Lecture content can be self taught, but she takes attendance sometimes. Grade is based on final project, labs, two exams (w/ cheat sheet), and ethics (easy points). I would recommend having good partners for labs and final project, and to do the project milestones according to the rubric. Overall, a very easy/doable class!

Nice person, not sure if shes a good professor. She talks A LOT A LOT A LOT without saying much. 50% of the lectures are how to do group work, not CS. 
Lecture is technically optional, but she randomly gives in class work so skipping is a gamble. 
She hates laptops. And will make a comment about laptops every class. 
Very boring class.
She is a good professor and will never let you down.

Make sure to get a good partner for labs and solid group for the project because that is the majority of your grade. Tests aren't too bad just make sure to attend lecture and study that material even though it's not too relevant to the rest of the class because that is what's on the test.

DO NOT start on the labs late!! Also get a good partner for the labs, that is so important. She's very clear in the lectures and midterms are a direct reflection of lecture material, plus midterms are open note. Also start on the final project early! She's very nice and willing to explain topics in depth if you don't understand something.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Reem had chill Zoom lectures for CS014, I recommend taking it or CS100 with her if you have the choice, she's a very good lecturer and passionate while also being considerate for our class

Had her for CS012, again for COVID-CS014, and will have her for CS100. I'm looking forward to having her as a professor for a third time. Although there is a lot more to cover in 14 than there was in 12 she tries her best to answer any question and explain anything that may be unclear. She can go fast, but if you ask her to go back she will.
She is a solid professor, and takes time to answer any questions with examples and different approaches to explaining concepts.

Dr. Jess is one of those professors that make you look forward to coming to lecture. Her lectures are super interesting, she speaks her mind 100% of the time, and is overall a great professor. I enjoyed this class a lot and if you get the chance to take this class with her, you won't regret it.

Wow super brave and super engaging as a lecturer. You need to get passed the first couple of weeks to truly understand her characher. She is super knowledgeable and very passionate about her material. I would take her class again for sure!
The format of the lectures felt more like a discussion of current events and their history. I loved her take on certain topics as it goes against the common belief and she isn't afraid to say it.

THE BEST PROFESSOR AT UCR!!!! i love dr jess, she is hilariously entertaining in every lecture and extremely well educated. she ties course concepts into current events and engages students. she gets a bad rep because she's blunt and will challenge you on your opinions. would take any course she teaches ever!

Rude and condescending. Provides very vague explanations of the assignments, does not provide a rubric or examples. Grading is extremely harsh and subjective. Lectures are a waste of time as she spends most of it going on tangents that are unrelated to that weeks topics. Very disappointing class.

Honestly, I don't understand why Dr. Jess has such low ratings on here. She's amazing! She has a bit of an edge but isn't truly mean. You can tell she cares about the course content, and this class made me want to take more gender studies courses. Lecture attendance is not mandatory, but discussion attendance is.

reviews.comment: I loved taking her class. She is very interactive when lecturing so participation is needed. There are a lot of readings but nothing too bad. Overall amazing professor!!

reviews.comment: a mean professor

Attendance is only taken in discussion. Current events are woven into lecture topics and discussion sections. Doesn't pick on people to discuss the assigned reading homework. But the readings are chosen by them and are fairly interesting. No quizzes, only creative midterm and final that are presented informally.

reviews.comment: The professor is a powerful and inspiring woman. Her violence against women course is engaging, with creative assignments (meme & zine) instead of exams. Class discussions are encouraged, and attending lectures is recommended as they help with weekly reflections. Very easy class and super interesting, definitely recommend taking it!

I do not see her as rude or condescending at all, she always emphasizes that she is not criticizing your opinion and is merely offering her opinion. What happened to discourse or disagreements? Not every prof has to hold your hand and agree with every little thing. Class is easy A and very entertaining. All tests are online and there is one paper.

BEWARE! The professor is absolutely biased, if you disagree with her she WILL humiliate you in front of the whole class. If you aren't Muslim, she WILL mock your religion. You have a one page reflection due every week that she won't grade until the last day of the quarter.
Worst of all time
Avoid taking her classes. She will ruin your grade if you disagree with her.

Awful, awful, awful, one of the worst human being and professor ive ever met in my life, has no respect on any religion, if you dont agree with her perspectivd or views shell laugh at you and clown you in front of the entire class, have watched few people going through that, it was unnecessary and painful to watch, avoid at all cost

easy class, low quality professor. do it for the easy A. As long as you put up a front that she is intelligent enough to be listened to and you don't care about the truth, you will do fine. If you are bold, not the right class. she wants a group of people to listen to her for hours a day.
Not a good professor but easy A. She openly denigrates people's religion except hers. She needs some self help but she is old anyways so she is not the future.

At first, she seemed mean/uncaring. However, this was not the case.throughout the quarter, she gave extensions, helped the TAs, and provided thorough slides that really helped during tests. She has a strong personality. However, I recommend actually attending an O.H. and getting to know her. Overall, I had a good experience and would take it again.

When she was introducing herself, her expectations, and the syllabus, it did seem like she was strict/rude, however, that wasn't the case. Though she seemed hard to talk to it was quite the opposite. She gave extensions, had open office hours, and helped TA's. Quizzes and tests are mainly info in lectures; it's better to attend.

i certainly understand why she has such divisive ratings lol she really has a strong character. My best advice is to keep your head down, dont try to argue, and go to lecture. A lot of the time her quizzes are verbatim what she said in lecture(with the intent to screw over people who didnt go) so just write her slides down exactly and youll be fine

This professor is very nice and it's an easy class to pass if you attend the lectures. It was really relieving to have a class and a professor who tried connecting with the students. In the beginning of the year she said “i like to argue” but that wasn't the case, she genuinely cared about the students participation and was open to learning more.

Prof. Rehman made this class extremely easy. Don't listen to other reviews, she's hilarious and makes the class fun. I barely went to lecture, the final and midterm were exactly from the lecture slides. She was a good professor and I highly recommend her.
Easy A. That's the only reason why she is still a professor. Boring class, just sit in class and do what is required.
She is a good teacher with many great points but unfortunately she doesn't realize that she contradicts herself when she uses terms like Latinx.

I would strongly recommend that you avoid this professor. Her strong political view points got her off track and away from the material. She uses inappropriate language in every sentence and is very rude to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: very lenient with lectures, usually ended early and gave extensions when needed.

She is unpredictable. At times she is friendly and enthusiastic, but she sometimes gets angry at students for no apparent reason. The readings are more helpful than the lectures, but there is a lot of reading. Use readings and study groups, and make sure to do well on the tests! There is also an analytical paper but it is graded by TAs.
I loved her and her class. She is super generous and her class was doable. I would love to retake one of her class. And actually, I took RLST 005.

She was kinda weird as she'd always complain to us that she was tired and wanted to go home early. She isn't the most likable person out there but if you want an easy breath course just take it as all of the exams are taken online. My biggest complaint was that it kinda felt like a gender studies class rather than an asian religions one.

Other reviews about her personality and beliefs are very true. She'd go on an hour long rant & then class was over, but a very easy class. There were a lot of readings/videos & you need to do them for the exams and quizzes. But split them up with a group and you're good. Also, quizzes and exams are very straightforward.

Professor is very opinion based. Just adhere to her opinion. Class consisted of couple quizzes, 1 midterm, and 1 final, which were all online. Lectures and discussions were pretty difficult to follow and understand, but workload was easy.
All quizzes, midterms, and finals are online. Dr.Jess is just crazy with her words, and doesn't care about students. TA's do all the essay and assignment grading.

Dr. Rehman is childish, and I have observed multiple instances of rudeness in her interactions with students. She only listens to her own opinions rather than fostering an open environment for different beliefs. She favors students who share the same views. Due to this, students don't learn anything. I would avoid her!
Hella mean bruh
kicked out the entire lecture within 10 minutes because she doesn't want to teach.
whoever hired her got hit in the head or something. these "5star reviews" are probably all written by her. all she does is cuss all day at us and says racist things in an asian religion class smh

Professor kicked out entire class and ended lecture after 5 minutes because several people were not doing readings. This is unfair to those who DID do the readings and assignments but have to get screwed over because she was mad that other people didn't do their part. Only compliments is that workload isn't bad and she is kind of funny.
dr rehman is an amazing professor! she's very smart and says everything as it is. her class is easy as long as u read the material and attend lectures since theres random quizzes.
Childish Professor

This class was fun, the professor was open minded and talked about things that society often shuns or disregards. She goes off topic at times but relates it back to the content. Participation, quizzes, weekly reflections, and final were mainly easy as most of what was said in class was posted online.

She was not respectful of opinions other than her own, but if you share her views, then you would probably like her. The worst part is that I never learned a single religious myth or ritual in the class because she saw it as cultural appropriation. If she was so concerned, why not invite guest speakers with those beliefs?

Lacks focus, thinks only her opinion is valid. Her lecture is like listening 2 smbdy complain for 1 hour.
4 the reading assignment, she will only grade it if she agrees with U. If U write abt smt that doesn't align with her worldview, she will give U a 0%. She teaches the class as if she has some moral high ground. Some of her rants r hard 2 watch.
She is very kind and she does make you change your view on the world. As long you engage you should have a fun class.

Prof. Rehman is a truly inspiring individual. She comes off as unapproachable but she totally is. She can say things that have the potential of rubbing folks the wrong way but that does not make it less true. I enjoyed going to lecture and the discussion groups. I think she is definitely a professor that makes you see past your world view.

Easily the weakest professor I had during my first quarter. She lacks focus so the class frequently goes from talking about religion to some sort of post-modernist feminist ideology and arguing with students. I think you could count on your fingers how many times she says the word, "Religion" in the hour and twenty minutes of lecture. Easy at least

reviews.comment: PLEASE take Dr. Rehman for RLST-012!! She's an amazing prof who cares about her students!! I learned more in her class than I have in my upper-div courses, that's saying a lot. She goes off tangents here and there but still engages with students and makes lectures interesting/ fun. Probably one of the best professors I've had t UCR.

She was an amazing professor, very passionate about the topics she teaches. Reading is key for her class, pay attention in the lectures if you want to pass. She tries to make the class easier for her students. She may come off as unapproachable because of the jokes she makes, but she is very caring of her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: RLST 004. Show up for every lecture if you want to at least pass.Many quizzes and they were at times confusing; they can come from the smallest comment made in lecture. She is often antagonistic and discourages her students from approaching her with questions about their grade or class. Reading was heavy but helpful. Not an easy breadth professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great class!

I had Jessica as a TA during the summer. The class was super easy. You have to present once in front of the class with a group of 2 or 3 people about the topic you pick. The presentation is graded as well as the 1 essay due at the end which is four pages long single spaced but its easy. Participation matters. Attendance mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So, this guy will grade your papers not based on the papers themselves, but rather by whether or not he agrees with what your argument is. He pushes the topics of racial inequality in an English course. Not really the place, but whatever.  If you want high grades, just write what you think he wants you to write, whether you believe it or not.
He puts a modern spin on English class and incorporates social/political texts which are interesting and necessary for the modern student to read and understand.  I love his class!
Dr. Rhyne is a demanding but understanding and fun professor.  Highly recommended.

Dr. Rhyne is amazing. He really forces you to criticize everything. I hated his class at first, but he changed the way I looked at the world, which I realized later. He influenced me so much. He uses pop culture, which keeps it interesting. He's awesome!

Ridiculously leftist.  The only teacher I know to have ever given a "C" paper because he didn't agree with a definition from a dictionary for Affirmative Action.  Pompous teachers like this really show no respect to people with contrasting views
No Comments

This is coming from Indiana University of South Bend...all of you must be liberal, left-wing fanatics if you have found Rhyne to be an agreeable and excellent professor--because he sure is not currently!
YAY Dr. RHYNE!   He's a big sweetie! He's understanding and his assignments are actually kinda fun....   Definately a great professor!
This teacher is great. Fun, easy, and very lenient in grading. His quizzes are easy and only assigns three essays the whole quarter.

Awesome teacher, shows a genuine care for his students and encourages his class to participate actively while keeping it humorous and fun. Gets to know each student individually.  Argghh!! This pirate approves of Dr. Rhyne!

He may not possess the best communication skills, but I learned so much not only about Finance but also about life. Go to his office hours and get to know him. He was a great visiting lecturer. However, I believe it's NOT ok to take advantage of UC students by forcing us to memorize all the financial formulas. Success in life is access to info.

Do not take this class. Reads his own lecture notes during class which are grossly underdeveloped. When going over calculations he used excel and plugged numbers in rather than working through examples. He repeats what he's said when asked to explain further. Inefficient use of lecture skims through material and gets whimsical about making money.
Just don't take this class. It's possible to get a good grade by just memorizing how to do the homework, but you will learn nothing, and it will still be very challenging.

Most useless professor ever! Class is easy since his test are made from the homework. He doesn't care about the students at all, all he cares about is getting a good evaluation. Easy to get a B with the extra credit homework. Says attendance is mandatory but its not. Wasted my time going to class, didn't learn a single thing from him.
awesome prof, took his combinatorial optimization class and it was so fun! goemans-williamson really is the best algorithm of all time

I do not know what that other review is about. Probably someone who flunked his midterm despite getting a study guide for it. Silas is awesome, and knows how to get his points across. Also takes the time and effort to make visual slides for us. He's also a very kind and knowledgeable person, and would not mind taking him again for an upper div.

Unless you absolutely love math, don't take this class. He teaches math more than cs to a point that you forget this is a cs class. He is also in love with recursion so get ready to do a crazy amount of recursion.  Extremely disorganized professor who does everything last minute and he admits to this regularly. Doesn't use canvas.

The course is hard. And yet Silas made it clear that the grading will be lenient if you give the effort in class because all he wants is for students to come out of the class learning something new instead of worrying about test grades. Never met a professor this passionate in a field like him. Definitely would take another class with him.

Prof reeeaalllyyyy needs to reevaluate the course structure. The course is just extremely high level Maths, like really super complex, I can't even remember what all this has to do with Computer Science now.

reviews.comment: Take with caution, material is extremely confusing. Requires Cengage course ($150+). Grades hw on completion, gives 2 midterms and 1 optional final similar to practice exams and allows for 1-2 sided letter cheat sheets + calc. DONT TAKE IF YOU'RE NOT WILLING TO SELF-TEACH OR DONT LIKE FLIPPED LEARNING. However, I respect her knowledge in the topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Excellent professor in theory! The best professor I have ever met at UCR. Her grading really distinguishes the good students and lazy guys who should not have a chance to be in university! If you are a student who really wants to learn something in the university, don't miss this professor!

She never reads emails, no one goes to lecture since it doesn't help at all, her final had a few questions that we had never seen before. Try to avoid this professor at all costs. The average for the final was 28% which is outrageously bad. If it was something like Ochem then it would be understandable but it's an intro course.

Terrible, her TA's are awful too. Impossible to contact. Midterm average was a 40% and she makes you do an assignment for only like 10% more credit. WTF??

And her and the TA's all grade arbitrarily and it's almost like the class is intentionally set up for you to FAIL.

This professor did not respond to a single email sent by any student for the entirety of the quarter. The lectures are hard to follow.  I can honestly say that i didnt learn anything from this class, not one thing. The average grade for both the final and the midterm were well below 50% and she did not curve. this class will hurt ur gpa pretty bad

Try to avoid if possible.

She cannot teach. Never responds to emails and super hard to contact. Spends her lectures explaining things in such a complicated way that no one learns anything. reviews.comment: If you can, avoid at all costs. She explains concepts and theories at the most elementary surface-level possible. Also, tests are nothing like the hw. reviews.comment: 25% homework 25% midterm 50% final! boring lectures is really repetitive and homework is tooooo long for no reason even if we have two weeks to do it. hope for a diff professor
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Not a very good professor at all, maybe it was her first time teaching online but she did a bad job, super boring and repetitive lectures. Homework were way too long and took way to much time. also the TA's never really helped

One midterm, 5 HW, pop clicker questions, and the final. Final is worth 45% of grade while midterm is worth 25%. Midterm is exactly the same as past midterm and review questions she posts on iLearn. Final is mix of both multiple choice and free response. Good teacher and explains things slowly and clearly. HW takes a while and due every 2 weeks

reviews.comment: Excellent professor who genuinely cares about student success. He makes real estate concepts engaging and practical, and even hosted a real-world competition with actual monetary prizes. He also supports involvement beyond the classroom, including opportunities through the Real Estate Club at UCR.

After reviewing these ratings, in fairness, I felt compelled to rebut the comment below. Professor Hernandez runs an applied, real-world course with expectations clearly outlined in the syllabus and rubrics. The group project is educational, not “free labor,” and expectations are explained upfront. Students who engage learn a great deal and invest.

ROI class. Beast games. Investor caps. Marines. The hood. Real life theory. Negotiable. 

W PROFESSOR!

Professor Ruben Hernandez, founder of EGA Homes, is a great professor that not only cares for his students, but wants them to succeed. He is the only Professor I met at UCR that wants students to come out of their comfort zone for the better, and excel in life. He provides so many resources and makes sure that he is on the students team.
The lectures were really interesting and the professor knows how to get the students' attention. One of the best course here at UCR

I am an exchange student from Italy, and Prof. Hernandez's amazing lectures were transformative for my study experience, pushing me to explore real estate investments from a unique, practical perspective. I highly recommend his course - It fundamentally changed my approach to investments and view on my future career path.

Professor Hernandez taught us key fundamentals of how to become an investor. During the past 10 weeks, he didn't just lecture the way many professors do, he provided real world guidance on best practices which allowed me to buy my first investment property... In less than 10 weeks! This, by far, was the best course I've ever taken...

Professor Hernandez is such an amazing role model. His ability to simplify complex concepts and share real-world experiences made me see the potential for financial growth through real estate. His guidance inspired me to pursue opportunities in real estate with confidence and determination knowing that his class gave me key foundational skills.

I thought I wasn't ready to invest but through Ruben's teaching and mentoring I have come to realize that I am able to invest. Ruben reshaped the way I think about investing and because of him l'm more equipped to enter the world of real estate. I can truly say he changed my life for the better.
Thank you Ruben for this amazing course.

Ruben Hernandez is an amazing professor. His true passion for real estate is demonstrated through his teaching. Ruben was always accessible outside of class to answer any questions I had about the course and how to personally begin investing. Not only did he help guide me through the land of real estate but I can consider him a true mentor.

Everyone here is a complainer. Yes, the professor is strict and at times a little bit disrespectful but he genuinely does care bout the students. He incorporates real-world speakers and work, as well as helps students get internships with his company. He is tough, but just read the textbook, attend office hours, and go to class and you'll be fine.

Class was a 3 hour night class one day a week so it was sometimes hard to stay focused but overall the class was okay. The midterm was confusing and had little to do with the homework. However, the final was more focused on the homework/lecture examples. I do wish we did a little bit more with Rstudio.

Not a good teacher. Exams are nothing like what he teaches in class. most of the grade is exam grade and exams are super hard. His classes are so simple and exam is really hard like what???
He is accessible but it doesnt help because what he teaches is nothing what comes in the exam

reviews.comment: Awful experience. He doesn't respect his students, and he always mumbles in class. Super heavy test. Avoid if you can.

Worst professor I ever had, doesnt know how to teach at all. Disrespects to his students, mumbles a lot. Makes 2/3 of class confused all the time, the hw has no relate to his exams. Dont take his class if you have choice.

He was very condescending towards students sometimes when they would ask him questions. Labs were extremely time consuming and very confusing. Doesn't really teach, just expects students to know the material from the labs for biweekly quizzes, which must be taken in person.

reviews.comment: Decent class, you don't really need to pay attention to the lectures unless if he's giving an ICA. The only downside is that he glazes AI art for majority of the lectures and the quizzes may not make sense for some questions. Overall just okay.

It's an easy class if you just do the work and turn it in on time. He gives lots of extra credit opportunities but at some point in the term he will gatekeep instruction because he thinks you don't need his help anymore. He's a chill teacher though.

the reason why there's conflicting reviews is probably because he's going through a tough time with his family. Neither the professor nor the TAs were helpful. Great amounts of detailed assignments given that the teacher doesn't give details to.The due date of the assignment would be on the same day the teacher gives complete instructions...

He's a pretty good professor. He's funny and pretty flexible. Just make sure you do the assignments and it can be a super easy A. The quizzes are kind of hard, but he drops the lowest score and gives lots of extra credit. Some people mentioned he doesn't help at all, but he really gives you what you need, just wants you to understand stuff yourself
He's rude and expects you to know how to do coding stuff he hasn't taught. Stressful class.

i took this class and its honestly so easy if u dont procrastinate. Just do the labs he assigns each week and if you submit it on Friday you get 8% extra credit. hes a super chill guy but you kinda have to teach yourself alot of the stuff and just figure it out. its really not that hard just do the work i finished the labs thursday.

Honestly, as someone who has had multiple computer viruses and doesn't even know what buttons do copy and paste, this class was super easy. Just do all the labs and turn them in when they're due because you get tons of extra credit for it and study for quizzes and you will be chilling. He is pretty chill dude and cracks jokes, just pay attention.

I have never, ever see that so strict teacher in Campus!!! Plz don't choose this course! he didn't give you any helpful PPT or recording. He just ask you if you have any questions then ask to TA! And lots of assignments you have to finished, I don't know why they are so many awesome reflection. And I just want to tell you guys one word: RUN!!!

Professor Rusich is awesome, funny guy and his lectures are super interesting. I would recommend this class with him to everybody. It's not that hard, do good on the labs and try your best on the tests (study the slides). I would definitely take this class again if I could. There are 5 quizzes but he drops the lowest grade. Final is a group project

For a class with easy content, it surprises me to see a professor carry themselves the way he does. He has a genuinely difficult attitude, and can't answer some questions without cutting you off or talking over you to some degree. Definitely has a heavy handed approach to teaching. Make sure you show up to class, it's hard to fail.
big chunk of your grade comes from labs, so do them. its easy. you need to try really hard to fail. he gives extra credit just for turning labs in early.

Professor Rusich is a chill guy and average professor. He is very knowledgeable about CS and his lectures can be interesting when he talks about the right subject, but a lot of the time was him going step by step on the labs while using pop quizzes to pull students into these unnecessary lectures. Maybe he should have an optional space for lab help
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took this course over summer 2024. This course was very intensive as it was covered in 5 weeks instead of 10. There was 5 programming assignment and 6 labs. There was also a midterm and a final. Ryan is a good professor and teaches well but he is strict and has high expectations of his students. Do the programming assignments EARLY!

The professor talks fast and can be hard to understand if you're not used to fast-pace lectures. He is a funny guy but comes off intimidating and he sets strict boundaries. You can get an easy A if you do all the labs on time. Lots of extra credit. Lectures are mandatory since he does pop quizzes, but they're not hard if you listen.

Easy breadth course. Though, lectures are boring and may do a pop quiz. Also does a project where you have to work with a partner and to research a topic. Final was kinda difficult, but as long as you don't do too bad on it, you could still get an A since the labs make up a large percentage of your grade (he gives alot of extra credit on the labs.)

Took this class online over the summer. I really enjoyed the class and the labs were actually kind of fun. During the lecture, he would show you how to do the lab and he would encourage personalization. Quizzes were a little difficult, but besides that I think the class is def manageable. Block coding helped understand coding basics

He is a little rough around the edges but an extremely fair guy. +8 points of extra credit for turning assignments in on time. I took this class for a math credit as an English major, so I knew nothing about comp sci, but labs were super easy and a lot of fun. You will rely on classmates for labs and one group project, but not a hard course at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Labs are not that difficult. He does tend to mumble, so it's quite hard to pay attention in lecture. Good late work policy and extra credit opportunities. Extra credit allowed me to get a decent grade despite the fact that I did pretty terribly on the tests. The tests can be challenging and can draw from the smallest comments made in lecture.

my only complaint is lectures can be a bit hard to understand, so just read slides. there are a lot of labs, but with clear instructions + good extra credit opportunity. as long as u study the in-lecture quizzes and his slides you will be okay on exams. he also makes pop quizzes when attendance is low so try to show up often.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS AND THE PROFESSOR!!!!! Especially if you never learned CS before. This class is not for beginners. The professor talks super fast and mumbles a lot. I went to the first 3 lectures and he already taught 48 slides of presentation. So I dropped it! I'm so happy that I've done so!
The course matter was easy however my advice to other students is to look up if your major allows you to take this class with an alternative professor. During my time this was the only option.
he talks way too fast, exams were hard but he did give some curves. labs werent too bad. his airpods would keep randomly connecting during lecture and they were named "daddy's airpods".
Presentations were kind of boring to listen to. Watched someone in front of me play club penguin the whole time. Thank god I didn't have to present my final project on targeted ads.

If you'd like to learn about the professor's conversation with Sage (what he calls Chat-GPT) or his latest piece of AI art for an entire class period, then this class may be for you. If you want to learn what's on the syllabus, then perhaps go elsewhere. At the very least, the actual workload itself is fairly easy, and the late work policy is fair.

Lots of tedious homework. The labs made me have a couple mental breakdowns throughout the quarter. The final was long and cumulative. Lectures were pretty boring too. Also he's not that understanding if you've had an emergency. Take this class if you don't wanna do math but otherwise I'd skip.

I don't know why I have to write so much in my programming class.This is a science, not a liberal arts. My homework was marked down for not reaching the descriptive word count of a certain "text." His exam contains a lot of content that I have not seen in his lecture and ppt in canvas. He even asks you to know which well-known hacker said something

I honestly loved having him. He's a very cool guy. I was nervous at first because of all the reviews but he makes the labs so easy to follow and understand. I am not a CS major and am kind of new to this but he made me feel comfortable with the material. 10/10 recommend!!!!

DO THE LABS AND YOU WILL PASS. honestly, he's really generous with grading so as long as you get a really good grade on all the labs which basically cake once you get it and if not attend zoom office hours. I bombed the midterms and final and i still passed. This class was the least of my worries
