reviews.comment: Attendance not required BUT has pop quizzes which you can't make up for. System for grading coding labs includes possible extra credit if you submit on time/a day late; if you submit 2 days after you lose points. Talks fast during lecture. Uploads video guides for coding labs ALONG with instructions. Be prepared to learning internet statistics.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This professor is incredibly rude! He doesn't answer emails and is hard to talk to in person. Finals and midterms are straightforward but ask for coding questions that no one knows the answer to because the lab instructions are copy and paste. Has a no late turn in policy, which becomes a problem when he doesn't answer his email! AVOID!

he gives these in lectures which I hated bc I wanted to skip class a lot since attending class was almost always pointless. this is bc you can't understand what he's saying, mumbles so much. He also goes off by slides which he skips so fast I couldn't even take notes. He calls out ppl randomly in passive-aggressive ways. class easy tho.

Note that he teaches pretty fast during lecture so sitting in the front is beneficial. Starting his labs early is key especially since submitting on time gives you a possibility of getting MORE points.

I'm not gonna lie, I was scared to take this class bc of what people said about the professor but he ended up being fine. He was ok for the most part but he mumbled A LOT. There are 6 labs all online, 2 midterms, a final, and some post-lecture, in-lecture, and pre-lecture quizzes that are easy. There is a group presentation but that was doable.

Class is pretty great. Lectures were quite fun and entertaining. Towards the end of the quarter, you're expected to do a project with a partner. Midterms were ok, yet some of the questions in there are quite confusing. Final exam is cumulative and is open notes. Attendance is somewhat mandatory, especially for days where he gives out in-lectures.

This class was a disaster. !! Slides have way too much material and he wants u to know all of it for the midterms. Everyone in the class failed the final exam including me who finished with a 90 in the class.

For the first four weeks we were online (Early 2022). Because he was scared of zoom bombing there was no way for students to unmute and no chat to ask questions. He used the hand raise emoji to mean we understood. Communication was difficult and if only got worse when we went in person. He gets angry for no reason and is kinda unstable.

The professor overall is really rude/disrespectful. He called out students in class for no reason. If someone has a question, he will ignore it or get mad for asking a question in the middle of the lecture. There a at least 2 big assignments every week. Does not provide any info on what to study for the exams, let alone if it's cumulative. AVOID!

We had an 8 slide presentation, 6 labs, 2 midterms, and a final. All open book. Previous quarters he gave 88% total in the class an A. He's a chill professor who knew that most people taking the class were seniors. Only 2 groups actually presented for the presentation over Zoom. You could lose a lot of points for the labs and still get an A.
He's one of the worst UCR professors.. Doesn't bother responding to emails and when he does, he's not very helpful... SKIP

Easy class. There was at least one lab per week but they weren't hard at all. Some took more time than others but were completely doable. The class consists of 2 OPEN BOOK midterms, one OPEN book final, and a presentation of 8 slides only. I didn't show up for any of the classes and seemingly passed with a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: An "easy A" class taken to fill out lower division credits. Professor Rusich treats his class like this is everyone's major course. Gives more work and expects more time from the students than upper division Biochem courses. No preset schedule or any semblance of uniformity. Assigns work when he sees fit including last minute group project.

Definitely don't take his class! I took his class as an elective and heck I regretted it... I worked so hard in his class... and I'm not even a CS major and his class is not even 5 units but it seems like it. He's a tough grader and his lectures are all over the place, he's teaching way too many classes so he doesn't care and overall bad experience
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Ryan is an overall good prof but he mumbles A LOT during lectures (which are non-mandatory attendance) so I end up just zoning out. He made us do 5 web design labs, most of which were straight-forward. It did get confusing quite a lot just because it got overwhelming. He also uses top hat which requires a subscription so be aware of that.

Most of this class is self-taught. In lab3 there were 3 difficult topics(normally takes 2-3 weeks in the normal quarter) not introduced to us which he just referenced us a c++ article to implement and learn ourselves. While I understand summer session has less time, this class should definitely be better organized and assignments more reasonable.

Worst professor Ive taken at UCR. Rude and condescending to students asking simple questions. Has a really short temper and has no problem yelling at students in class. Lectures were completely useless mostly just reading off slides or sitting in awkward silence waiting for him to figure out how to work Zoom. Super unprofessional. Do not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures were entertaining and material taught is actually useful outside of academia. Homework, labs, and quizzes were assigned biweekly, so the class is spread out nicely. Labs are relatively easy. Quizzes were a bit confusing, but he drops one. Lots of opportunities for extra credit. There is one presentation that is only 8 slides long.

I was hesitant on taking his course after reading all the reviews on him. However, his course was actually easy and he was very accommodating to students and honestly trying to help you get an A. Labs and homework are VERY straightforward. Quizzes are based on his lectures and he drops TWO quizzes of the FOUR. He also gives extra credit on labs!

Do not take his class unless you have to. I dont mind the tedious work, every professor has their own way of doing things. But his attitude and the way he talks to students is really disappointing. He gets mad and annoyed over simple questions. Takes things way too personally and is super unapproachable.

For someone who is in the computer science field and teaching about how to use the INTERNET he has a pretty weird/difficult way of showing it. Instead of making it easier to follow along in lecture, he requires we use about 3-4 different websites to interact with the class. He's condescending and not understanding at all of students.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Lectures are entertaining but his quizzes and final is tough even if you study and he always throws tricky questions in. He also has a lot of tedious HW and Labs worth 100+ points each so missing a couple and try relying on the quizzes and final to make it up think again. For a Breadth requirement course, he should curve the course or grade easier.

I regret taking this course with this professor. He gets mad about every little thing and yelled at at least one student during each lecture. At some point, I stopped showing up because his lectures were completely useless and I was able to teach myself better by looking over his slides. He is not very patient and expects his students to be perfect

I had Rusich for CS010 in the fall, and it was definitely my favorite class that quarter. Tends to go through stuff a bit fast but he usually catches himself and makes sure everyone who cares understands the concepts. Just make sure you're ready to write code on paper because that's like a third of your grade, still I would highly recommend.

Rusich is alright, but for an introductory CS class, he does the job well enough, however, I would recommend mostly focusing on Zybooks as that is where the grade mostly comes from aside from the major tests. It's also hard to understand what he says sometimes even if you sit up close in class.
He knows the content for the classes however he has a bad approach for it. He is very passive aggressive and expects a lot from non-computer science majors.

I wasn't required to take this course - just did it for the units. For an introductory course, this class had a lot of tedious work. "Quizzes" are more like exams that you take every other week. He has high expectations and very little patience, and is condescending if he thinks your question is stupid. I regret taking this class.

Is easily angered by very small things. Gets distracted by students simply asking one another to borrow a pencil. Can be condescending at times. Has very little patience. Actually pretty good as a lecturer. Teaches content well. Exams/quizzes are tough yet fair.

Summer session. Overall, I learned a lot, the professor cares about his students, and is very fair. Time management could be improved, since long announcements and redundant revisiting of material at times prevented us from getting all the way through new concepts. I think with a bit better planning, Prof. Rusich's lectures will be very effective.

I had Ryan Rusich as a professor during UCR's summer academy in my CS 005 class (I was a high school student who took summer classes at UCR). I personally loved my teacher and I thought he had a great sense of humor as he was teaching. He does get upset a little too easily but he is a great teacher for CS. Great experience overall for me.

He's an average lecturer. Something that stands out is that he has yelled at a student every single lecture up until now. He lectures at UCI also, not Riverside now. He gives unreasonable deadlines for assignments. For example, my lab was due within 4 hours of starting. It was very unfair to people who had internships/work.

Horrible teacher, shows up with ultra high expectations and believes be knows how to explain things but really doesn't. He knows what he's doing but has no idea how to teach. Do not take him you won't learn cs.
Wasn't difficult, but the final was. I had an A and it dropped to a B+ because of the final. The programming assignments tend to take a long time and quizzes are a bit difficult as well.

His final was crazy hard, but fair. Had a sweet curve though, 16%. Much harder than CS12. Makes CS10 look like humanities. Exams were fair though.  Midterm was way easier than final. He'll ask you homework stuff again on tests. Do the homework. Quizzes were pretty tricky too, but he dropped the worst one. Seemed to want the students to do well.
Was a major help in reviewing for the final. I wouldn't have done so well if it was not for him, period. He didn't give any freebies on the projects, however. Extreme effort for a B.

He is easy to talk to when you are stressed out about your grade. He doesn't act like he's above you or you are stupid. The material isn't hard, just be sure you dedicate enough time to it. If you are unsure, ask him and he will explain it really clearly. Easily one of the best TAs at UCR for CS. Wish the class had a curve:( Highly recommend him.
the worst TA ever. he doesn't  know anything.

WOW, he is so horrible i cant believe it...Everyone in the class could get a sense that he doesnt want to be there, and if you ask him a question he ignores you...glad hes not a real professor and that hes not teaching CS 61 this quarter so I dont have to drop the class
No Comments
No Comments

Great professor. She is sometimes strict in terms of teaching but actually wants students to succeed. The course material is clear & helpful when learning new music. The grading is mostly based on attendance, so overall pretty chill.

For some, she can be a bit fast-paced when learning new music. If you already know how to read music or sing, you will do fine in this class. Attendance matters HEAVILY, but if you have an external or internal issue, just let her know & she'll understand. Audio recordings of the songs given for your part that you can practice in your own time.

I think Dr. Charloff has to be one of the best conductors I've played under bc she's a consummate professional with so much experience and understanding of the repertoire that she gives out freely. She can be intense, but as someone who's been through some things, never mistake her intensity for cruelty! She doesn't have a cruel bone in her body.

Despite being incredible at conducting and teaching material for the most part, Charloff does not have a balance when it comes to her attitude. She has a strong demeanor and can be very discouraging to the students at times. She likely doesn't mean to, but it's unwarranted regardless. If you're new to music, I'd advise against taking her courses.

Does not know how to speak to people with respect the way she demands of them. Does not know how to give constructive criticism w/o being rude to students. Knowledgeable in her area, yet can't master basic respect. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF!!

Dr.Charloff is extremely competent and has a strong "no BS" approach to class. I would only recommend taking this class if you have thick skin and are actually passionate about music. She can be very snappy, rude, and intimidating at times, but she will absolutely push you to become a better vocalist.
caring, considerate, and knowledgeable. firm but not harsh or mean. does not waste time. one of my favorite instructors at UCR and highlight of my undergrad

Hi upper div music fam, be careful. There is a LOT of reading and homework, and the tests can be quite long. Honestly, the textbook was more useful than the lecture itself. There are 4 essays, a report, 4 non-cumulative tests, and 1 cumulative final. She does care though, so be honest and tell her if she's going to fast or giving too much work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's a great conductor. Rehearsals are extremely efficient and chosen repertoire is fun to play. I respect her for obviously being an amazing and knowledgeable musician and for not wasting any time during rehearsal. She is moody and will snap at people if she doesn't like something which I think is a bit unprofessional.

Great choir director, but has issues with personal respect and outside of class responsibilities. Expects nothing less than the best, and is very qualified for her role. Probably will not be the director you have a close bond with, but cares immensely about the overall well-being of the choir.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: There are few people in this world who can take on as much as Dr. Charloff does. I really respect her because she does everything! Not everyone would be able to do what she does. She is really knowledgeable about everything she teachers and shows us how deep music can be. A pleasure to work with her these past years.

Very organized, professional and clear with everything. She chooses good repertoire. I have been with her for one year but learned a lot from her. She does a great job getting the students to perform well. She expects you to know your stuff and know what you are singing. A little hard to keep a conversation going with her but inspiring conductor.
Very good teacher! Help alot!

Totally professional and she is a great teacher - especially explaining the history and relevance of pieces in addition to stressing the performance aspects.   She is strict when she needs to be but always treats individuals with respect.  A class act!

A great conductor who really knows how to pull the musicality out of the performers and the ensemble. Takes care of business and runs rehearsals efficiently. Demanding of students, and doesn't tolerate flakes, mediocrity and lack of preparation. She expects you to know your stuff.
The class was fairly easy and was helpful during office hours.
The class is easy. But she cannot teach. I aced the class all because of my TA. Stay away from her. And just make sure you know the study guide. And do the readings. She is worthless.
doesn't take constructive criticism and too blunt with her own comments.

Awesome choir director!!! Very strict though. Make sure you know what you're doing b/c she expects nothing less than the best. She's helped so much in improving my musical abilities. She's fine about asking questions unless you ask too many or if it's something she's covered about 3 times already.
She grades easy on the assigned work. Test are hard
Expects excellence, make sure you get on her good side, or else you'll be doomed for life without recourse...still, best damn choir director I've ever had! :)

An effective orchestra conductor. On occasion, can be strict but I've only seen it in cases where a musician didn't put their entire effort into their performance. Work hard and you will learn from her.
Simply a ****!
Moody and doesn't take constructive criticism.
watch her moods.  she has her moments, but she can also be ice queen.  comes off a bit snobby.
she thinks she is god and there for if you aren't perfect she thinks there is something terribly wrong with you... i quit orchestra b/c of her and my best friend quite singing b/c of her

She thinks shes the ultimate athority  and very egotisitcal.  She doesn't like people asking her questions. Her assignments are easy, but her midterm and final are extremely hard.  She expects you to know details of every pecie of music.
No Comments
well-prepared. madly efficient. often moody. slackers WILL get their tails kicked. you've been duly warned.

She's a good professor, but I almost never understood what she was teaching. This might have been because it was an accelerated course, but I'd spend hours at home trying to decipher the notes. On the other hand, she gives a lot of extra credit, and as long as you pass the in class quizzes you'll get an A. For the final...study the study guide!

I wouldn't say to avoid this professor entirely she's learning as she is a grad candidate.  She does weekly in-class quizzes on Poll Everywhere which is over the content in class as long you pay attention and go to class. If you also attend a discussion the TA is very helpful! This class content may be hard but if you ask/go/get help you are good!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is a very good professor and gave us many opportunities to pass the class. The quizzes and exams are exactly like the review sheet she provides before the tests. She gave weekly homework but it wasn't too hard. Just make sure to pay attention during lectures because she can go a little fast sometimes.
she is really good looking and dress like kpop idols and a really good professor with great understanding of math

A very easy and flexible grader. For 7 weeks, was assigned one assignment, had a whole week to be able to turn in. Had extra credit. lectures were hard to listen too, because she talks quietly. Quizes were so easy. Practice midterms and finals were the same as the midterm and final exam, just different numbers.

This class drags on and on. There was no clear criteria pertaining to the staged portion of the directed scene nor the filmed version. Russin is disorganized where it concerns what he wants on the assignments. Guest speakers provide little to no valuable insight. You will not know what to do. TA didn't know either.

If you're taking this class to learn how to direct for screen, don't. He's better for theatre and this takes up the majority of the class time. It was supposed to be half stage, half screen but we're nearing the end, still in the stage part of class. Even worse, he was planning to have a guest speaker on our performance day. Good luck.

Prof. Russin is a nice & smart guy, but I didn't get a whole lot out of his Shakespeare in Performance class. It's an easy class (though you will have to read and analyze three plays), with two papers, a short performance of a monologue + mandatory lectures. Keep your wits if you work with him in a creative capacity; he's definitely hardheaded.
Best professor I have ever had.  I loved his class.  He had a very well balanced selection of reading and clips from movies and the like to help us connect to the text.
His lectures were always interesting and relevant. It's great to have a professor who's actually worked in the field.

Had plenty of useful information for students.  However, his rotten attitude and obvious disdain for those students who didn't meet his over-the-top expectationsmade me not want to take another class with him.

Theatre 66: easy!  Theatre 166AB w/ Russin: hell!  Overly critical to the point that creativity was stifled, if not sedated. Promotes conformity to his narrow-mindedviews on writing.  My gardes: A-, B+

screenwriting made easy. lecture can get somewhat boring if you dont know the movies, but i was still intrigued. midterm is a paper analysis on your favorite movie, and final is first 10 pages of your own script. but it was a great class. oh yeah, some movies are boring, but eh, who cares, right?
best class i ever took, this guy is so awesome, everyone should take his screenwriting class.

learned lot from the class.  he can talk quite a bit, but he knows what he is talking about, and the course improved my ability to write screenplays.  no tests either =)  sometimes keeps you overtime for screenings, though...

Barely taught us, didn't care. Seems nice but instead of curving for a C after I slaved a 8 week course with him he gave me a D. Terrible, terrible time. Don't take him. Also never let us know why he graded the way he did, he doesn't show you your test with his markings or anything.

He is a great teacher. Explains thing very well and very helpfull when i go to his office hours. His quizs are easy but his test are hard. Some thing we never even covered in class. But i think he is a great teacher and i wish i had could take him for all my clases . funny guy i will add

This professor is now at LAMC. He's not terrible, but I don't recommend him. He barely explains anything, and puts questions on the tests that you never went over. He also doesn't manage his time well. Before his class, I got all A's in math. Almost everyone in my class got a C or lower, and the highest C grade was a 72%. There are better teachers.

Yamada's midterms are a bit challenging, but if you go to office hours and do all the assigned problems, you will be fine. Try to find someone who took his class and look at their past tests, it will help you a lot. He never replies back to emails, he doesn't really care about his students as much. But he was very helpful in office hours.

Yamada is pretty sarcastic and tries to be funny. You have tons of math XL hw, quizzes every week. The two midterms are hard, final is difficult its nothing like his study guide. He does not make you feel welcome during office hours. He is rude overall a bad teacher.

Well, I had him for 8A and the class isn't hard, but it's a lot of material to absorb. So, it's crucial to stay on top of things and study!. He gives out problems to study for quizzes, It will really benefit to do these problems to ace the quizzes, and the midterms and final are just like the quizzes. Homework is a piece of cake. It's possible to p

Hm.... Well let me put this out there. If you just found out that you got this guy for Math 8A pray that your TA knows math. If it wasn't for my TA, I probably would have failed. Try to get another professor, you will learn so much from other teachers like Curtis.

Educated teacher who knows his facts.  Take great notes and show up on time.  Didn't really help students in trying to absorb material during lecture. Never repeats himself.  basically, if you are a math wiz, then this class is a breeze.  if you need asistance, the learning center is in the Surge building because yamada is not reliable.

He knows his stuff. However, he gives you the examples of easy problems in lecture and then his midterm and final have the difficult problems. I think he may be socially awkward because of what a friend told me when he went to office hours. You need to study and get perfect 100% on Math XL AND the quizzes and Problem of the Day.

He is a hard grader and his test are difficult. Make sure to get 100% on math xl it will boost your grade up. For quizes make sure to do all the book questions assigned before the quiz, because most of the question come from the book. Make sure to study really hard. you wont pass the class if you don't put any effort.

Ryan is eh. His students on average get 50% on the midterms. If you study though, and do the reviews, then you'll be okay. MUST  STUDY. Quiz problems are taken from book....Midterms seem easy....yeah...not so much. STUDYING IS KEY. Failed the class once already, taking it now...It's going better this time around. Would not recommend though.
I learned more from my TA than him. He chooses to do easy problems in class and when it comes to his midterms, you'll get questions he has never gone over. I basically taught myself.

Teacher is a JOKE! Assignments: usually about 20 probs long, miss 1 point and get a 3/4 overall. Tests/Quizzes:No prior review to exams. Expect outrageous large fractions. He gave my class a handwritten test that I suspect he wrote the day of. He avoids helping u for upcoming exams. Class:writes and talks as fast as possble. Has fashion sense of te

mae sure you get 100s on every math xl, get perfect 3s on the problem of the day, go to discussion, and study for the midterms and final exam by doing the extra stuy problems he gives, since there is no study guide.hes interesting but his FINAL IS HARD!!!!!CHANGES EVERYTHING AROUND
He explains things clearly. Honestly, he's a great teacher it's just a hard class. :)

This teacher was horrible ! He gives you the easy questions in class and explains them, but when it comes to the exams there's questions you have never seen before. Do not expect a helpful study guide, they are waste of your time instead do problems from the book, the hard ones.

Yamada was a great teacher, funny and personable; he always took questions on the homework.  There were quizzes every Tues. and homework was due every Thurs.; even though attendance wasn't mandatory, you wanted to be there.  He dropped 2 quizzes and 1 test of 4.  He gave reviews for each test but no answers to the review.  I would take him again.
THIS INSTRUCTOR IS NOT VERY GOOD AT TEACHING MATH..THE TA WAS BETTER THAN HIM, THE TA ACTUAL BROKE THE MATH PROBLEMS IN SIMPLER TERMS.. THE TEST WERE HARD AND COMPLICATED..

BEST MATH PROFESSOR EVER! He explained things EASILY (so easy that I even understood everything and I am terrible in math!) and he was a very very very approachable guy! His tests were not even that difficult because he gave the supplementary problems you needed for them. I strongly recommend taking his class.
Explains everything in detail and is very approachable, class is quite challenging. A lot of studying is necessary, but he makes the course more understandable.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Of all the professors at UCR, Dr. Ryan Joseph was my favorite. Although the class itself was hard, Dr. Joseph actually cares for students and does everything in his power to work with us (unlike most professors). He makes learning as it should be: an enjoyable opportunity in a comfortable settin rather than pressured to perform for a letter grade.

Really nice and obviously knows his stuff, however I took the class online and the lectures were very boring because they were all pre-recorded, hard to focus. Very understanding during these times though with generous grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Ryan Joseph is the GOAT! 5B is one of the hardest classes any Biology/Life Science major will take because of the amount of material you have to memorize, but Professor Joseph is very good at preparing students for exams and is very fair on exams. Do the end of lecture questions and put in some effort and you'll be rewarded in his class.

TAKE HIM! 2 midterms, one final. Really study his lecture slides, you will get a good grade. Got B+ on his first two, and an A on final, I really just did his study practice questions and review his slides a few days before the test. Curves on midterms and at the end of class. He's super fair, nothing tricky. He's really wants everyone to do well.

Honestly, if you need science requirement for CHASS, this is your professor to do so. Study his lectures slides and you will get a A, he takes out questions on exams and curves the exams too. He then curves the class at the end, you really can't fail him unless you just don't study. He's really there to help but his slides are kind of long.

2 midterms, I was on average on for both, for the final got a B+ no curve. Quiz and poll questions during lecture points went in and I got an A. Exams (2 midterms, 1 final) and the two quizzes were curved based on the average. No textbook needed. Super chill, easy to ask him questions during the lecture.

This was his first time teaching an LC and he definitely expects a lot of conversation.The first midterm average was a 36% but he did give out extra credit. He does take feedback from students and tries his best to accommodate to our learning styles. I definitely stepped out of my comfort zone and I think it helped me in the long run.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Unbiased review: The nature of the course is difficult and his exams are very difficult because they are open note with 50-55% averages year round. He doesn't cover everything on purpose. READ THE TEXTBOOK and study his slides and you should be good. Huge curve at the end of the quarter, top 15% get A's, 40 or so is passing. 46/150 got A's.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: First exam average was 50%, but "too many people got A's" so he made the next exam harder which sucked. Tests are open book, but super short (10-12Q's in 30 min) so they're pretty hard. Offered some EC. Very sarcastic guy and kinda intimidating; doesn't feel very accessible bc you have to personally schedule office hours with him. I would avoid.

He makes you work for your grades. You will need to do lots of outside studying in order to do well in this class. Even though his quizzes were hard, I believe they were pretty fair. Majority of the questions related to the HW that was available to do. There is also a huge curve, and open book quizzes and final.

He only has recorded lectures (30 mins per chapter). Expects you to learn everything yourself and gives hard quizzes. Gets better as you go on but he's brutal. Would not recommend him if you want a good grade.

Took this class as the last of the general chemistry series thinking it would be fine but the absolute worst professor I have ever had especially for a course that has a lot of new material. Pre-recorded lectures and Slack are the only things used and honestly neither are very helpful. Get ready to teach yourself a hard course with this professor.

Got better as the quarter went on. His lecture videos aren't super helpful and he has no live lectures, so the only way to communicate with him is through Slack. Quizzes can be really tricky and I had to prepare weeks in advance to do well on them. Slack is a generally good system for learning. Final was ok. Probably would not take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: 3-4 videos, 10 mins each per chapter which are overly dense; you're teaching yourself. Expects you to know things in the textbook that he did not mention in videos. Quizzes and cumulative final are most of the grade. No live anything, even office hours - everything was done over Slack. He's not kind either, very sarcastic and standoffish.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took him for 1B. He was a good lecturer and did his best to help students understand all the concepts. Chem 1B is very math heavy and he helped us by going over examples of what would be expected on the test. But you must read the book, as he pulls conceptual questions from there and I remember there being some info staight from book and not notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hes a pretty awesome prof. :) You are required to read quite a lot & practice Qs from the textbook. However, all of this helps when it comes to the test. Nonetheless, Ive learned more from this prof than I have from other chem teachers. Tips: read the book & understand the material, practice hw Qs, & write plenty of notes bc it was open book.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: A lot of people give this guy hate for being a sarcastic and hard professor. I found him to be a really great professor, maybe not a nice one, but a really good one. His teaching methods really taught me chemistry and helped me build a great foundation in the subject that I have kept to memory a whole year later. Do watch out for the sarcasm.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Super sarcastic. You have to teach yourself the material ahead of class because he will ask you about it. Overall the class was a lot of work, but I learned/retained a lot of the information.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Monotone, He is a powerpoint guy and goes through them fast, his exams are hard and I wouldn't recommend him, he feels misarble teaching students and is somewhat rude during office hours
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Bit monotone, but funny kinda like Sheldon Cooper. His slides aren't much in detail so pay a lot of attention in lecture. DO NOT underestimate his exams, they are pretty difficult and detailed. I definitely felt like I needed to read each chapter of the book in order to pass. Learn from my mistake and READ. Also, do the practice questions they help

He covers the main principles of each chapter but I HIGHLY recommend that you read the book and do the problems in the book to have a good understanding of the material. He is very helpful during his office hours and all his exams are open book for the last half. Do your end of the bargain and you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He was able to simplify many parts of the chemistry and actually make me interested in the subject. You will need the textbook since his lectures don't cover every part of the tests and you will fail the tests without reading.

I was fortunate enough to have Dr. Julian be my professor for honors chem 1c because I actually learned something compared to other classes (like Eichler's) where I they barely scratch the surface. Although I ended up with an A-, Julian goes in-depth into the material which is its own reward. Be careful though, his tests are all free response.
Lectures are not focused and tests are not straightforward. Ok curve, got a B minus. I would personally avoid taking him.

DO NOT TAKE JULIAN AS A PROFESSOR!! If you have the option, take Dr. Eichler!  Dr. Julian is boring and his lectures don't even help! The curve was generous but you're going to need to know the material for future Chemistry classes.   TAKE DR. JULIAN!!
He spent a lot of time lecturing on material that was not even covered on tests.

He's pretty sarcastic. However, his class can be boring because he does have a monotone voice. Aside from that, a lot of his lectures where very basic and general so it was essential for me to do my readings before and after the lecture. Some material on the test was not covered in class . Uses some clicker ?'s on tests.

Pay attention to clicker questions and lecture notes plus what he verbally says and you'll be fine. Definitely need to study for midterm and exam. If you do poorly on midterm but do better on the final, he will replace your grade. Also can use notes for half of the exam. Overall would recommend if prior experience with chem like ap chem. Good curve

He's very monotone, so he's hard to pay attention to, and his lectures aren't very helpful. His curve is very generous, but the class is difficult to begin with. You need to do a lot of learning on your own if you want to pass. His midterm and final is open notes. If you don't like Chemistry, this class isn't for you.

Esay to get a good grade,curves a lot. He does not go over a lot of things in class, so if you want to learn sometime, study on your own and don't rely on him. Quizes are once a week and easy. Clickers are required. Midterms and finals are open notes and open book, but problems are often not covered in class.

Easy professor. Quiz is once a week and easy. Clicker required. Midterms and finals are multiple choice but often not things that are covered in class. Curves a lot, but barely goes over anything in class. Need to study on your own.

Lets you use notes and textbook on midterm and final and disc quizes which are weekly. clisker question every lecture easy points, extra credit homework online, go to disc and do the optional homework, helps so much, go to SI as well, final and midterm are fairly easy all multi choice, get his class, easier chem teacher

Professor Julian can be boring at times. But he is really aware of his Chemistry. He can make the class fun at times, but other than that he goes straight from his power points. Midterms and Finals are open book, and are curved!
Good Professor. Lets you use notes for test. Just make sure you attend class and understand the concepts since tests are OPEN ANSWER.
he is very understanding and helpful when you seek for his help. As much as you hate English he makes it fun
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Tough grader, but is lenient at the beginning of the course. It gets harder as the course goes since he expects more of your papers, but gives you the tools you need.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Ryan is the most down to earth professor that I have encountered at UCR. His lectures are enjoyable because he engages with his students and he is able to relate to them too. I enjoyed his course very much because we worked in groups often and shared our perspective on one topic. He also gives great feedback and essays and they aren't too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Ryan is the best professor  I have encountered here at UCR.  He is able to assign long papers and make it into a way that is manageable to his students. He is very understanding and is always willing to help his students. I highly, highly recommend taking a class with him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Sullivan by far has been one of the best professors I have encountered at UCR. He is great at what he does and he is always motivating us to do our very best. He is also available outside of the classroom and could work around your schedule.

Ryan was an AMAZING English teacher. I have never been a big fan of English, but he made it bearable. He was a lot of help even with assignments that weren't for his class. But just a quick tip, do what he says it makes life easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Ryan was one of the best English teacher I have had in my small college career. I was impressed with his sense of caring for his students. He really wanted us to pass the class and helped us a lot to be able to pass. Office hours are very helpful if you ask him questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Ryan is the most down-to-earth & sassy professor you probably will ever have at UCR. Words can not described how much I have learned from all the readings, essays, & lectures. Every class is like one big therapy session where you get to talk smack about anything & everything. Class isn't the easiest but you don't mind bc the class is interesting.

Ryan is an A1 professor. He's constant use of in-class discussion helps make the classroom feel more welcoming, while also forcing the students to actively apply the critical thinking skills they learned from the class. He's ability to assign a large workload without the students feeling its weight, shows how effective of a educator he is.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Ryan is one of the best english professors at ucr. He is not a tough grader as other presume him to be but you do have to work hard to get a good an A. This course is challenging but rewarding.
Ryan is great! I highly recommend him. I don't ever rate my professor but I'm doing it for him and I'm putting some thought into it because he really is awesome and I want you to know that.
BEST PROF EVER!!

Ryan is by far my favorite professor on campus. He gets theat life happened and he relates to us in class. He is constantly pushing us to participate and conversation. By far the best English professor I've had in my school career. TAKE THIS CLASS

The best English professor on campus.  No quizzes, but he expects you to do the reading so you can discuss them with the class. That where participation matters, just read & discuss in class. Encourages everyone to discuss & participle so attendance is a must. Easy A class, I did all my essays the night before and got good grades. Easy A if you try

Ryan is by far the best TEACHER, whether it be a professor or TA, that I've had in my 3 years here. Ryan is very passionate about what he teachers, and that passion inspires his students to do their absolute best. He is always available to his students, ONLY gives constructive feedback to make you better, and really is just the nicest soul. 10/10

Listen to me. Ryan is the best teacher I have ever had in my entire life. He is willing to go above and beyond for his students, and will not hesitate in tailoring a lesson plan specifically to your needs. In the last few years he has elevated my writing and inspired me to pursue my career (which is... his career lmao). I cannot thank him enough.

Sullivan is the best professor I ever had! He pushes you out of your comfort zone and has you to think critically on the social and racial issues in our society. I actually learned in his class unlike the other classes I have taken.

No textbook but requires you to buy a lot of books. Teaches very interesting topics that relate to current issues. It's like taking 3 different classes (soc, anthro, theory) all in one english class and it is pretty mind bending at first but clicks by the end. Tough but very informative and rewarding class.
You learn in a fun way

I had Ryan as a TA, he is really the nicest guy ever and respects ALL of his students so long as you respect him. And he WILL help you and analyse your papers if necessary!!!! If you get him as a TA you are very lucky :)

Ryan is a pretty chill professor. Easily approachable and is relatable. His readings for the class were, for the most part, interesting. Reading was essential for the class because there was a lot of in class participation required.  Ryan was a tough grader, but going to office hours solves that problem just like any other English class.

Class consisted of daily readings, Short summaries for them, a research paper, and final paper. Participation and class attendance was mandatory and crucial to passing the class! Ryan used a lot of modern day examples to help us understand LGBT issues taking place in the present time. He gives great feedback and awesome lectures. Would take again!

Down to earth guy. Gives interesting readings and makes sure you learn enough to readily place into the next course. Essays started off easy and became more difficult w/ time. Office Hours were always available, definitely recommend going to them. The quarter ended in a passing grade and class party.

Mr. Sullivan helped tremendously when it came to doing the work needed to pass the class. There are four papers that need to be written for the class but he provides a substantial amount of help so writing the papers shouldn't be difficult unless you wait until the last minute. He makes the class interesting by using modern day examples to help us.
Great teacher. He teaches a lot of great stuff that is applicable to other papers you write. Work is not that bad. Readings can be lengthy but most are interesting. Definitely recommend him.

Mr. Sullivan had a way of connecting with the students and was very helpful in giving out the necessary instructions needed to complete the tasks he gave. Although going to class was mandatory, it wasn't that bad because his is one that you wouldn't want to miss anyways.
He is very helpful!He is a chill professor but won't do the work for you, you learn depending on how much effort you put into the work. I recommend him!

Professor Jean Schroeder is such a warm and caring professor who shows that she really wants all her students to succeed. She is flexible with due dates as long as you communicate with her. She really makes sure everyone knows she is available outside class for help if you need her, and is easy to contact. She is overall an amazing professor!
Underrated Professor, I love her she is nice and caring. Unpretentious Professor, UCR should be proud to have her!! Letsss gooo

it was such a pleasure to have her as my eng prof!! i'd totally recommend to take her class. she definitely cares about her students and is very lenient/chill and available outside of class if you need anything. there's 4 essays in total (including final) + weekly quizzes but they were all fun and engaging imo !

She is one of my favorite professors here at UCR; an amazing person overall. She really cares about her students and tries her best to make the class engaging and fun. 001C was based on 3 essays and 1 in-class final essay. The essays were more fun and easier to write than 001B. I barely got a A- in 1B but ended up with almost an A+ in her class.
amazing and so unproblematic!! 10/10 would recommend
cool teacher, just do the work and she'll be simple

Carrie Jean was such a sweet professor & very understanding if anything comes between you and your ability to do the assigned work. Pretty much the whole grade was based on a few essays and some small quizzes during class. Her feedback to the essays were really helpful. She made it clear that she is always available outside of class for anything :)

Take her class. She was very nice and kind and would let you get away with anything and she will give you extensions whenever you need them and she's just nice in that kind of way. she doesn't grade the essays though, so I even though I did well on them I know a lot of my classmates didn't because the grading isn't in her hands.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Schroder is really sweet! She cares about your education and is available in and outside of office hours if you send an email to her. She does take a bit of time to grade your essays, 3 throughout the quarter w/ an average 1500 words, but thats because she takes the time to read each essay individually and give awesome feedback!

Awesome professor. She's very understanding, assigns homework that is relevant to the essay prompts we get, and will give extensions if you just ask her. We had a total of three essays + the final essay (all of which were great to challenge and help improve our writing). Overall one of the best English professors.

Professor Schroeder is an accessible professor who is present to assist her students in anyway possible. She was one of the sweetest professors for a first year to work with during their first college level English course. Though her grading was tough she explained why it was incorrect, and led her students on the right path for the next essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Don't take her class, especially Eng001B. You can hardly learn anything in this class, and your writing ability has not improved after the class. I feel that this course is just writing and writing for different assignments, not a learning process. BTW, the professor is nice but a tough grader, she is super strict on everything in this class.

This class was ok. You had to write 4 essays which included a draft, a peer reflection, and a self-reflection. There were 6 quizzes and no midterm, but there was a final which was a short essay. The thing about the professor is that she will nitpick every little grammatical error. You're also allowed to revise either essay 1 or 2.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Do not take her class!!!  Lazy on grading!!! Essay 1 's grade was released on week 7, most of the class gets an average of 70% on every essay. Homework was useless and painful. She makes you watch a two hour film and answer 60 questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She's honestly a great person, super kind and ready to help. However, unless you're an amazing writer, be prepared to fight for your life in that class. The professor grades the essays super harshly. Take this class if you want to challenge yourself :)

I had her in the Spring of 2021 while everything was still online. She is beyond a sweetheart. A fair amount of reading needs to be done, and the papers require a fair amount of detail and effort. Go to her office hours, and she won't sugarcoat what you need to improve on. I got A's on all four essays. Quizzes were fill-ins and not too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I had her for English01C online. She is very nice. Go to her office hour because she can go over rough drafts with you. I went to her before every essay is due and I got As on all of them. You dont necessary need to take all her advice it is more important to show her that you care. She let you choose your own essay prompt too.

Professor Schroeder may come off as a nice teacher but, she does not help you improve your grade. I had to do everything to improve my writing on my own and she would still give me the same grade. Her grading format is flawed and her lectures are not very informative. I still find myself as the same writer I was a year ago. She's a poor grader too.

DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. She never gives out perfect scores no matter how much time or effort you put into your work. She is always sick and never available, and keeps changing and pushing deadlines. You never know what youre going to get with her and for a class people need to pass in order to graduate, thats not a risk you should have to take.

I had professor Schroeder for English 1A and loved her so much that I decided to take 1B with her as well. She is an amazing person who genuinely cares for her students. Definitely participate in class and make sure she knows that you are putting effort. Go to her office hours for essays and take her revisions very seriously and you will do awesome
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Her class isn't easy but isn't difficult either. You really just have to put in effort for a good grade. Throughout the quarter you write 4 essays, read one book, and read the textbook. She gives quizzes for readings. She's very nice and will help you if you attend office hours, but she is a tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I really do not get it how people rate her so nicely. She is a nice person, I guess. I went to her office hours every time, but I sill got C or D on my papers. Do not take her if you are seeking for an easy grader. I took this class during the summer.

At first I did enjoy her class. She is very nice and will help you if you go to office hours; however, I went multiple times to office hours and she would say my essay was good and that she liked it. The grades I would recieve reflected the opposite of what she said.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The professor is incredibly nice. She tries her best to always give feedback and do anything that may benefit the student. One key tip is to always go to office hours, it's really helpful if you want any corrections on your essays. She grades pretty hard on grammar and the content, so remember to always back up your ideas.

Professor Schroeder is a good professor and gives good feedback on your essays but she is a really TOUGH grader. I never had a hard time typing my essays. She is really picky when it comes to grammar. Make sure you go to her office hours for help (and to receive participation credit)
Go To Office Hours To Get Help On Revising Your Essay, Very Helpful and she is available to contact through email.
tough grader. Glad I passed
If you want a teacher who is fun and helpful, get her but if you want a good grade, no really harsh grader especially on essay.

Honestly one of the best professors I have had at UCR. I came into this class dreading having to write essays, but she ended up making it rather enjoyable. There was a lot of reading with a few quizzes but nothing too difficult. Definitely get this professor.
She's a really nice and friendly teacher. I really enjoy taking her classes and she is very down-to-earth. She recognizes talent and effort when she sees it.

Very cool teacher. i highly reccomend her. i dont know why people would not like her. she does do random quizes on textbook. its usually on the first day of every new essay she will asign. funny. easy grader
She is awesome!Be sure to do the required readings because she likes doing random quizzes-readings are short.She's extremely helpful.
Pretty helpful English Professor I had all year and approachable. Makes all class discussions very open all people with different point of views to participate.

She's an awesome teacher! Class is usually based on discussion about the readings and essay help. Very helpful with the essays. I went to her office hours for every essays, and I received a lot of good feedback. Picky with grammar, but that's English. I noticed that my writing had improved greatly because of her help. Take her if you can!

I was actually surprised to find out that previous reviews were all positive. This teacher is lazy and doesn't know how to be lenient with the grades, especially on essays, even if I tried my best and went to her office hours for multiple help. I think there is a problem with these reviews because she is opposite from previous reviews exceptlazines
Best English teacher I have ever had!

Very straightforward. Speaks her mind - cusses. More lenient than others. Don't be late with your papers. It'll cost you. Uses the book alot. You're going to read call of the wild. Has surprise quizzes. Easy if you read the assigned reading(not long). For essays, follow her requirements, no grammar mistakes, support your thesis and you get an A!
she's super easy and understand, and constantly cusses and lets you speak your mind, she's simply amazing and usually never assigns homework and grades verrrry easy if you go to class!

very unorganized but cares about the kids and will help. I am a horrible writer but i received an A becasue i showed her that i was interested and i went to office hours a few times. Good person and an easy A, but very unorganized and lazy

So she is a bit of a slacker, a couple times the whole class showed up but she didn't which was okay with me. Take her if you can!
She's such a great professor! So sad that she's not teaching 1b this quarter, or else it would've been great! recommend her to ANYBODY! :D

I had her last quarter, and she was so cool! she's the coolest teacher in Riverside. REally, if you get the chance, take her. all my friends from eng 1A is taking her again for eng 1B, and we are hoping for her to teach eng 1C too!!!
She's a GREAT professor.  Very understanding. If you let her know in advance about attendance, she'll let you make up missed pop quizzes.  Pretty easy.  Definitely take her if you get a change to.

Great teacher to have. The grade is mainly based on four essays.  Pretty easy.  Stongly recommend that you go to her office hours b/c she tells you what she wants and corrects your essay for you. Nice and very understanding.
Awesome teacher.  I highly recommend this teacher to anyone entering university English.  She's very easy to understand and always willing to help.
second time i took english 4a, and man Mrs.S helped ALOT, improved my english 4 grade from a D to a C+, she makes things THAT CLEAR and easy to understand.

Very nice lady, and helps you out whenever needed. Assignments were whatever... and she gave pop quizzes randomly. I think it's pretty easy to get at least a B if you talk to her regularly during office hours on how you can improve your essays, and she likes that.

Carrie is such an awesome teacher, anybody who does not take her will regret it. She is absolutely one of a kind. She is very concerned with her student's progress and she teaches you to look at things from a different perspective.

She let me write about whatever I wanted. She's more interested in helping people learn how to express themselves than she is about the production of rigidly structured essays. Just make sure she knows you care, and you'll get a good grade.
Awesome Teacher! Definitely take her! Easy grader, and easy-going.... your gonna regret NOT takig her class... i took her twice .... =)
this teacher is kick ass. that's why i took her twice. enough said...
This chick rocks. Take her class or be sorry you never met her.

She seems pretty hard, but once you get to know her.. she's not that bad. I tried, and she'll give you a lot of constructive criticism, but in the end.. she's fair and also a generous grader. I would suggest all of you to take her class.
No Comments
she's a huge buffy fanatic...we watched sOo many of the eps in the class, but it correlated w/ her lectures.  works w/ the student sOo much and is sOo nice...death to smoochy rocked socks...
What a great professor. She's outgoing and willing to work with you if you have any problems. Great to see a professor with such enthusiasm.
Awesome lecturer.  Fun class.
No Comments
She's a fun teacher.  really willing to help you with your papers if you need it.

Awesome teacher, makes class very fun. Also comes up with fun essays to write, doesn't grade too hard, gives useful feedback AND lets you redo papers. Got an A- without trying too hard, got to watch Death to Smoochy for the final!

Great teacher.  Even though I slacked a bit near the end and got a B something, she was always really helpful.  She'll give you extensions on deadlines if you can make a good case for it, but she can tell if you're bull****ting.  We watched Daria in class
He's a really great english teacher; she's really easy-going and makes learning fun!
She's absolutely amazing~!! She's so into her students and it's actually fun to participate in this class...yay~!
Carrie Jean is a fantastic teacher!  She makes learning fun.
No Comments
Very approachable and takes time to correct papers. Lets you redo them too!

You can tell the professor cares about her students and wants them to succeed in whatever they are set out to do. She always comes to class with a positive attitude and is easy to talk to. I recommend engaging as much as possible during lectures and discussions to maximize your learning experience in the class.
She did not respond to emails and did not explain when we deviated from the syllabus, which made it hard to plan the semester. Did not create a welcoming environment
Did not welcome opposing viewpoints and lacked common sense communication skills.
