reviews.comment: Talks a big game about social justice but really is a colonizer.
She has trouble explaining concepts and did not follow the syllabus at all. Moreover, she never returned emails.
She never responded to emails and struggled to express herself in English, which made following lectures extremely difficult.

Professor Shigematsu is a very fair and intelligent professor who manages to get to know mostly all the people in a lecture hall, especially if you sit in the front and participate a lot. She is extremely left wing and so am I, but she usually respects the beliefs of others and gives students ample time to speak their points. Loved the course too!
I took 010 and 154 with her. She is an amazing professor; I loved the content she taught. Three tests, 30%, 20%, 20%, need preparations, but you have extra credits to earn along the quarter.

Shes pretty cool and manages to learn everyone's name in a 500 person lecture hall so you should go to class especially since attendance matters. You have a paper to do at the end of the class which hinges on your TA, but the subject matter is overall pretty boring even though she's a very very chill prof who rides an electric scooter to class
Great lectures and straight forward exams with one project. Your grade is discussion heavy so make sure to go and do the reading which aren't to bad
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Attendance is mandatory and google form is used! Questions on exam aren't too bad but if u miss some main points of the reading, u will fs get something wrong. I went to every discussion cuz extra credit was offered but it was taken back at the last second cuz prof didnt approve.. 3hr lectures are always a pain but with new friends not too bad!

Ok so 3 exams. Yes, they are multiple choice.. but they are sooo heavily based on reading. The questions are specific to the readings AND videos in the class so it is easy to get them wrong. Participation was whatever unless you wanna be put on blast with a mic in a lecture hall so it was really pressuring with social anxiety.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Contrary to the previous rating, Prof. Shigematsu's tests are on the course materials and lectures, and the material is relevant. This course has been a true eye-opening experience. Although the lectures are lengthy, there are breaks. A very welcoming environment for discussion even in a 200+ class lecture. Take Shigematsu, you will not regret it.

honestly just took the class for a breadth class and ended up enjoying it more than i thought. the class is very easy in terms of content and grading, i didnt do a single reading until the day before each test and got 100% on everything. the lectures are fun and you talk about topics you normally dont get to discuss and get out of your comfort zone
She is amazing and makes learning fun. This classes grade is mainly on participation and the journals based on the weekly readings.
She is awesome. The best professor in UCR. Attendance and participation is important than the test. The tests are online. A lot of reading and videos. She is so nice.

I've had Setsu for multiple classes now and I've loved both of them. A very fair class that really encourages participation (it's a seminar though, so that's not unusual). You will learn a lot and be very engaged. The first couple weeks are very heavy and then they slow down a lot, so don't be worried. My favorite prof at UCR so far.

Professor Shigematsu created a space that allowed for students to be the creators of knowledge very often which is rare and appreciated. Professor Shigematsu also provided a breadth of alternative knowledge that is easy to grasp and apply in the future. I recommend this Professor to anyone who is interested in learning more about alternative media.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Shigematsu is one of the most considerate profs at UCR. Shigematsu is heavily invested in the success and of their students. They have made my time here deeply fulfilling. You will not regret taking their classes, as they create an atmosphere that is intellectually nourishing and inspiring.

I wish I would have founded Professor Shigematsu earlier in my undergraduate studies because they truly are one of the best professors UCR has to offer. Not only are they caring and understanding, but they go above and beyond to make sure students needs are being met. Every lecture is filled with inspiring passion that truly motivates me.

Professor Shigematsu is one of the most caring professors I have met during my time at UCR, as evidenced by how xe starts every class with a check-in on how xir students are doing. Xe also expresses great interest in the personal, political, and academic projects we are undertaking and is willing to assist us with whatever resources xe can provide.

Professor Shigematsu cares so deeply for her students and there is a great sense of community in any atmosphere xe's in . My favorite part of the Senior Seminar was how intimate it was. We even had personal check ins at the beginning of our classes. I've also never wanted to share more in any educational setting untilnow, classes were so engaging.

Dr. Shigematsu is one of those professors that truly change your life. Their person-ability and strong character reflected throughout the entirety of the course and experiences in one-on-one time. While it was academically rigorous, this class transformed my perspective on Black Marxism and TJ. This professor and their classes are a must-take!!!!!

DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND TAKE THIS WOMAN. She is the most caring Professor at UCR and truly invests in her students! Professor Shigematsu is so accommodating and understanding. Truly one of the two professors who shaped my undergrad experience.

Professor Shigematsu assigns an average amount of work for upper div courses, but everything is extremely interesting and she always found ways to relate what we were studying to contemporary society. Her lectures are very engaging, she gives great feedback on papers, and truly makes her students a priority. I wish all professors were like she is!

The most intense class I've taken. Lots of reading and work (journals, screenings, presentations, etc.) but everything was so interesting and Prof. Shigematsu is very friendly and well-respected. Plenty of discussion, but NOT an "easy" class. Take her, but put time aside to do all the work. She has such a good score on here for a reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Great class! We discussed a bunch of controversial topics in a very interactive way and her lectures always kept my interest. Attendance was taken every day, but Professor Shigematsu made me want to be there every day, so that wasn't an issue! Short tests every other week, extra credit opportunities, and 1 paper. I would definitely recommend her!

This class wasn't particularly easy, but the all the readings and most of the film screenings were extremely thought-provoking. The knowledge I gained from taking this course will stay with me for the rest of my life! Professor Shigematsu cares about your progress throughout the quarter, so take advantage of her provided office hours! Great class!

Professor Shigematsu was amazing. The class was a 3 hour class and she taught it wonderfully. This class is not an easy A. You have to do the readings and come to class, but I promise it's worth it. She's also a great person and always willing to help. A very intelligent woman indeed.

THE best professor I've ever had and will ever hope to have...her class will seriously change your life and the way you look at society! Is challenging but VERY rewarding, I encourage everyone at UCR to take one of her classes at least once. She's also really funny and helpful :)

Professor Shigematsu is THE best professor I've had at UCR. I would even go so far as to say her class was life changing. The concepts she introduced were very interesting. There was a decent amount of reading, but not terrible. The midterm was somewhat hard and had a lot of material to study for, but she was a very fair and understanding grader.
Great professor! She really makes things clear and is very helpful in office hours.You may not agree with her ideas, but they will get you thinking.

Wonderful Professor that enthusiastically engages her students to fully understand the curriculum. ideology is a bit radical and may not appeal to everyone, so beware before adding. Also, she is extremely HOT!!!!!! Too bad she is already married :(

Setsu is a true all star. She is Canadian, which makes her even cooler and tougher. She is full of "attitude," kind of like a way more political, radical, even more talented version of Madonna. Setsu should be paid an all-star's salary because she's an all-star teacher and scholar. A TRUE ALL-STAR!!

Did 111 and 115 with her. Both were the same. Midterm, final, group project, and 4 case studies. Very easy grader. The only way to fail the class is to not show up and do the work. The midterm and final are her slides/case study.

Super casual lecture style, tries to be the "nice professor." 4 case study papers just 2 pages each. Group exercises in every lecture for participation/attendance. Fast lectures, moves through slides really quickly to make time for activities. Very organized class structure. Made jeapordy for midterm review which gave half of the exam questions.
Pretty fun professor. She goes very fast on slides, has a jeopardy game thats pretty fun. The group projects aren't bad at all. Attendance is always taken. Honestly pretty solid class.
Fun Professor! Goes through slides fast but manages to get through with enough time to spare. Fun group projects and relatively easy exams. Great class!

He wasn't that bad, it was also his first time ever teaching.
He told us he has a phd in geology or something like that and was invited at the last second to teach by his advisor.
Final was kind of hard but only worth 10%.
Apparently, he curved down cus too many people did well.
Took in fall 2023.

This lecturer bullies students. He will say incredibly inappropriate things about your medical stuff if he knows about it. He should not be interacting with students. He also has been asked to teach subjects he does not know about and will skip large sections of vital information. Avoid if you can.
Unbelievably difficult final. The average was a 30%
So unorganized and never responded. R'web says A- but I actually got an A, he messed up a lot of students grades. Seems like a nice guy but the TA seemed to be more involved than the professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bad at teaching. I honestly don't feel like I learned anything from him. His grading is forgiving, however, his exam questions are not consistent with the lecture & a lot of them were trick questions. The only way to prepare for tests is to do past-exams - but at that point, why even hold lectures? Easy class but I would not take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall a nice person. His lectures get a bit boring but he does cover a lot of material. His grading is very forgiving. There are weekly quizzes. Tests are HARD! Do the 2020 exams, better simulate the midterms and final. Make sure to review his slides in detail and write notes on the practice exams. Gives you a cheat sheet but you barely use it.

He def kind of just rolls through his lectures with minimal breaks for Q&A, but, he walks through problems step by step to ensure we understand. midterm average was a 66, so he curved it to make the average a 70. EC on midterm. 2 midterms, 1 final 9 quizzes lowest score for quiz dropped. midterms are curved pretty well. Material can get vague.

I took him during the pandemic, he accommodated for it really well and had open book exams. Most of the questions would come from the in-class problems, practice midterms or were based heavily on them. He also curved the first two exams and made it so the best out of the three midterms (no final) counted more and the worst one counted less.
Nice person but sucks at teaching, I had to teach myself. Does give extra credit, you are going to need it.

Dr. Cutler was a great professor for this class. His lectures were very clear (and includes interesting examples!) and although his tests were tough, they weren't very unfair. If one works hard to do well in this class and studies correctly, getting an A definitely isn't impossible (or in my case an A+)-curve is pretty fair. Take him for Bio 5A!

Memorize the lecture notes and powerpoint slides because that's exactly the level of detail that he will cover. As long as you take his practice tests you should eventually get a feel for his midterms and finals. Lectures are pretty useless aside from the optional clicker questions, but he posts the slides anyway so i stopped going.

Dr. Cutler was a good teacher but his tests are something else. You really need to read the questions and make sure you don't get tricked. If you pay attention in class, participate in clickers, read topics and understand them, AND PRACTICE PAST TESTS you will for sure get an A. I got a B but that way my fault cause I didn't work hard enough.

He's such a wonderful professor. You'd rather not miss any lecture. His clicker questions and practice exams are helpful. His tests are very challenging, so  STUDY HARD!!  Each midterm worth 25%, quizzes 10%, and the final exam worth 40% of your final grade. The average score on our final was 61%.  It is hard but not impossible to get an A:)
He sucks.... He doesn't know how to teach and students sometimes correct his lec... Tests are extremely tricky....
Tests are challenging!!!

Dr. Cutler's class was the hardest class I have taken during my first 2 quarters as a freshman at UCR. His tests were challenging in a sense that you have to validate each answer choices since his test questions are extremely tricky. Through perseverance and handwork, I managed to get an A. If I can do it, so can YOU! good luck!

The questions he asks on the tests are very specificeasy to get wrong unless you really understand what he taught in lecture, but he is a good teacher and makes it clear what you should focus on. He does clicker questions in class and we have discussion quizzes that help you with learning the material. The tests are tough but overall a great class

the other reviewers are right, his lectures can be kind of confusing, but all the practice questions, notes, and other resources he gives you make up for them.  in this class, the past exams he gives you are your SAVIOR as they'll show you exactly what kind of questions he'll ask on the midterm and final. This class isnt easy, but its doable.
This is one of the best profs I've had. Awesome class!
Easy and lenient.

Cool professor. Very lenient. Of the entire quarter, I only went to the two midterms and final. Never went to lecture. His tests are very easy! Blackboard lecture notes are so awesome, I didn't need the book

His Lectures suck. He used Dr. Maduro's notes and tests. Mainly because he does not give a .... about students. He clearly sated that his research is more important to him than students' success. His tests were weird. He is just not helpful. He's a bad lecturer, and his thoughts are scattered which makes it hard to grasp what he wants you to know.
He's the best. I absolutely love him! Definitely recommend. Awesome teacher and mentor.

He is an alright lecturer. Clickers are fair sample of good conceptual questions for exams. If you get lost in lecture, just pay attention to what he says. Don't take too much notes as it is all uploaded as Powerpoint slides.
He's Fair!! not that great of a lecturer but his power points are gold!! No surprise on his exams.

37% Final, 40% Midterms (2), 23% clickers/discussion board/quizzes.  Almost didn't take him due to low reviews, but he's very fair.  His lecture notes are freaking gold!  They're organized and look pretty and he teaches from slides. Read the textbook.  Lecture notes + textbook + lectures will give you good grades.  No curve ball test questions.

So-so prof. At times seemed a bit unorganized. Exams aren't too hard, make sure you do homework problems to prepare. He does offer E.C. to help with low exam scores but they do req lots of writing. Try to go to the exam review sessions, gives you an idea of what to expect on exams. Quizes can be hard if you didn't do any homework problems.

I dont know how to say this without being mean, but this guy CANNOT TEACH! He is a nice guy, and he holds reviews and tries to help, but he is a horrible teacher. His lectures are incomprehensible and his powerpoints are just pictures with no words. His tests are ok but some questions are really vague or poorly worded. He shouldnt be teaching

Only prof I DO NOT recommend strongly suggest waiting if he teaches ur course. Unfortunately Bio 102 is a gateway class so had to take it, but this guy cannot teach. Ppt lectures were confusing and unorganized. TA saved our grades. Unhelpful and unclear during study sessions like he didn't want to be there. W/O extra credit most ppl would fail
No Comments

3 doesn't seem high I know by Schmitt is genuinely overhated. Genuinely very nice and funny. His lecture "slides" are just a google doc with bare bones information. The lectures can feel a but cryptic but if you take notes on his lectures and the text book you should do decent.
I would not take again

Tough grader. Exams are online, but extremely difficult, long, and timed. The questions are confusing and really make you second guess yourself. I would recommend doing all of the readings before class and attending all lectures as his exams are lecture heavy. Also, I would not recommend taking two of his classes during the same quarter.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Professor Schmitt for two courses already. Soc 001 and Soc 003 this winter quarter. He dropped hints for those who attended lectures but the only thing is, his exams are nothing like his lectures. You might as well read the textbook and memorize it because that's what it is based on. He is very kind but if you go up after class, he's sassy :)
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very sweet guy, but doesn't teach very good. His slides and his way of teaching isn't the most understanding as I feel as it disorganized. Lot of the questions on his test are really hard, and some weren't even in the textbook or slides, on top of that, the class is graded mainly by midterm and final as it's 40 and percent.

I had Schmitt for four years in undergrad & I would feel frustrated that his test didn't align with what he taught in lecture. I didn't think much of it until a friend also had his class & mentioned that his exams wasn't relevant to lecture. I regret taking his classes bc I attended every lecture & didn't see much of what was taught on the exam.

I took this professor for soc1 and my experience was roughly the same. He is a very nice guy but personally, his teaching style does not work for me. His slides are not very helpful & he does not touch on the things we talk about in discussion. However, I recommend going to lecture because he will talk about things exclusively in lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Your grade mostly depends on your midterm and final grades. Not even the extra credit was helpful.
Long lectures, does not convey material clearly. Exams are not from his lectures but rather from the book. More than half the class dropped the course.

Grading is unclear and challenging. Lectures feel pointless as little is taught. He calculates part of your midterm score using random visuals or phrases. Grades rely on two online tests, accessible but requiring extensive study as they're ambiguous and lack curves. This GE course was harder than my major classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is a very chill and seemingly nice guy, however he is a tough grader. I would say if he offers extra credit DO IT. I tried to communicate to him how I was unsure on how to study, several times, but to no avail. That was my biggest issue. I got 100 in discussion, went to mostly all lectures + sat in front, read + took notes on book. still failed
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: good person but not a good professor. final grade is only made up of quizzes/ midterm/ final (all multiple choice/ timed). u take quizzes online but it's v difficult to pass them bc of the confusing wording. attendance isn't mandatory but he doesn't post notes so u have to attend to pass. avoid taking if u can bc it's not an easy A class.

That's my biggest mistake I made for 2024 Fall quarter without checking RMP of this professor and registered his class.
Even you carefully check the text book, exams are very difficult. In addition, the grading system is horrible. Mid term is 30% and final is 40%.

The best Sociology professor, I've taken classes with professor Schmitt 5 times(had 2 classes with him this quarter) at my time at UCR and he's up there at the top. He's very kind and as long as you attend lecture and listen to what he says you will pass the class. All your tests are online and pretty straight forward all based off of lecture.
Boring lectures, drops random midterm/final answers in lectures. Tests were super hard for me. Had to do so much reading. Harder than my actual major courses. Don't take this ged.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Schmitt was a great professor. He teaches Sociology well and all that comes with. All his exams are take home exams and you are given a couple hours to complete. Definitely attend lectures because, it helps with the tests. Overall he was super caring and you can tell he cared for his students. Easy 8 am class.

I loved listening to these lectures. He is a super kind man and has a lot of care for the topics he teaches. I wouldn't say attendance is mandatory but he does sometimes throw in weird things during lectures that will appear on tests (code words, images). All of our quizzes, midterms, and final were online.
loved both classes i had with him! super easy class for me!

I know that most soc students either love or hate this professor, but personally, as someone with a short attention span, his lecture style kept me engaged with concise/image-focused powerpoints and related anecdotes. Some might call his teaching style a bit disorganized but I enjoyed his lectures.  I took his class winter 2023.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
The professor himself was amazing! you can tell he loves what he teaches!
- Attendance NOT mandatory.
- Be ready to read!
- 1 Quiz with Multiple choice and a writing portion + Final was all Multiple choice (ALL ONLINE).
- His lectures though had most of the time pictures instead of notes to write down.
- 1 movie day which will be on the Final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Anything he lectures on/anything in the assigned readings can be on the exam, and there aren't many things you are graded on. You get a quiz, an awful midterm (so long), a little extra credit, and a final. Go to every lecture, he has random things from lectures on the tests (ex. the word "button") and the exam questions are very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I recommend this class. It was super easy and fun and the content is engaging. Consists of 1 quiz, 1 midterm, 1 written midterm portion, and a final. ALL ONLINE.

Grades are based off of assessments (midterm, final) so make sure you read your materials and understand it. I didn't attend most of the lectures and did fine but if you need to listen to learn you should def go. If not just read the textbook and you'll be fine! The assessments were all online but still just make sure you know what you should.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you do the readings and pay attention in lecture, it should be a breeze. The lecture slides are not helpful. He only puts the topic of conversation up there so you need to be at lectures and take notes of what he SAYS.

Never really did the readings for his class because most exams and quizzes are lecture-based so as long as you can write down most of the things he says during lecture, you are pretty set for the exams. The only time I tried to read was for the TA's discussions. He is really good at lectures and he goes at a good pace for you to take notes.

Reading is mandatory to be up to speed in the lecture. The ppts aren't very detailed, as he elaborates more verbally and gives few assignments. Midterm and Final are very lecture and reading based. Overall not a difficult class. If the effort is put in, you can achieve an A or B.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor is chill, but when it comes to attending the lectures, his lecture notes don't give too much information that can help you out with the quiz, midterm, take home component that goes with the midterm and the final. I find his class to be very difficult and stressful because of how little information he gives you. Be prepared to read.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Schmitt is a superb professor and lecturer. He expands upon chapter notes clearly. Attendance and textbook reading are a must for his classes! To absorb the material and better prepare for tests and quizzes, don't expect his powerpoints to explain everything. He is pleasant to talk with and provides convenient office hours for students.

His lectures are confusing and he provides little to no guidance with his slides. He does post them, however, they won't help you. The class is almost solely test based being that there is one quiz, the midterm, and the final. His exams are also so unnecessarily wordy and confusing. I don't recommend taking this professor if you can help it.

His lectures are confusing and his lecture slides provide practically no information. He does post them, however, they won't be much help.  He has one quiz, the midterm, and the final which were all difficult and worded weirdly. The discussions are also mandatory. I don't recommend taking this professor.

The overall class grade is based on the one midterm and the final, and the test questions are challenging. Discussion sections are mandatory and although lectures are not, I recommend going to them as the tests are heavily based on the lectures and the textbook. Be prepared to really work for your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Schmitt is extremely helpful if you go to his office hours or email. Each time Ive taken one of his classes I have learned a lot and you do have to put in the work to get a good grade but overall his classes are not that difficult and if you actually try you will get an  A or B.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: He is honestly a great professor. His exams are lecture and textbook-based. All exams are ONLINE even tho it is an in-person lecture. A take-home midterm is also included. He only has critical words for lecture slides so make sure to take good notes. Go to office hours if needed and ask for help and he will help you. In the end, it is your choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Schmitt is pretty fair even if the quizzes/exams are challenging. There are a ton of readings, but if you just follow the text book, you'll be fine. He often gives hints for the answers and isn't really trying to trick you. Just be careful and study because there are not many chances to get your grade up beyond the midterm and final

This class was challenging and most of the class is the midterm and the final. You have to read the textbook in order to do well on the exams and write 7 essay questions on the take-home part of the midterm. It's best to take lots of notes on his lectures and the textbook if you want to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was 90% graded on 7 essay questions, a midterm, and a final. You have to do the reading and take notes or else you'll struggle on the exams. Be ready to do lots of reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Your grade is based on 2 exams which are very difficult. If you bomb one, prepare to fail the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Schmitt is a good professor who clearly cares about his students. The bad reviews worried me before I started the class, however as long as you follow along, the class is relatively easy and straightforward. The tests are not hard as long as you study.

For all you CSBA majors out there who have to take this class, beware its hard but because its only offered once a year, you have no choice but to take this guy. Way too many readings, midterm and final made up 85% of grade as of Winter 2022. Take it with a group of friends, you'll thank me later. Pay attention in lecture. Tests are hard af
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One midterm, One final. Discussion attendance is mandatory. No homework or other point basis so your grade is how well you do on the tests. This seems very flawed. His presentation isn't thorough and can't be for the content expected from 13 chapters. Either you read sociology chapters thoroughly or else. Pre-recorded lectures.

A horrible professor doesn't care about students and all his lectures are prerecorded making it hard to get in reach with him. The grades are based on Midterm and final heavily so no opportunity to make up for your grade. I would not recommend professor Schmitt to anyone at all.

Did not like the teacher at all! He isn't too bad of a teacher, but is so textbook heavy that it's hard to memorize the entire thing in order for the tests. Everything needs to be memorized, and midterm was almost six hours, with few results!! The only things that go in the gradebook are the midterm and final.

Avoid at all costs, this was an absolutely miserable experience. You get graded on two real things, a mid term and the final, the discussion section is only 9% and there's a silly little quiz at the beginning worth 1%, you can study but that won't help since he asked the most niche questions possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would not recommend him at all, can not even hear what he was talking about, so much reading so much unnecessary reading. The final is like 45% of the grade and the midterm is 35% however the test are timed and the test is are pretty hard 1-10 they are 8 being hard
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Although his test exam questions are all self-written and can be kinda wordy sometimes, Professor Schmitt is caring for his students when you need him. He understands that we as students go through unpredictable struggles as well and he tries to be super respectable about it. Might not be the easiest professor out there, but def. kind and caring.

I was scared to take Schmitt b/c of his ratings, but he's not as bad as people make him out to be. Yeah, you're going to work for your grade, but isn't that expected of any student? His exams are straight-forward and he's actually really nice. I was able to pass from his lectures only by taking notes on what he was saying, not just the slides.

The reviews from the past scared me, but once actually taking his SOC 003 class it wasn't all that bad. You do have to take notes down on what he is saying because the slides do not tell very much, but that also makes sure you're paying attention to his lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: A lot of us were supposed to graduate this quarter myself included! I guess I won't after all. Thanks a lot Schmitt!

It sucks there are no homework assignments to cushion your grade. He is a tough grader. The midterm is made up of the exam itself and two written answers which must be at least a page each. You cannot go back on a question and he expects you to take only one minute or so on each question. A lot of it was on readings instead of lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I have taken Schmitt three times and my first Sociology class was with him, SOC003. He's an amazing lecturer. This is what a college class is supposed to be like. You need to listen to what he is saying and take notes. I have received an A in every one of his classes by just attending his lectures and did not read any of the material required.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Schmitts is wonderful. People say his slides are vague but that because you need to write down what he is saying, which is easier online and you can pause. He is always available during office hours and does a great job using real-world examples to compare topics. He is one of the Best profs I have had during covid, very understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Schmitt isn't the best instructor. His lecture notes are so confusing and unorganized/all over the place. Most of his slides contain only one word and his tests are the same way. It is very difficult to understand the concepts or even understand the test question from a word or short phrase. Take this class with someone else!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I dreaded this class because I did not learn much from the professor himself. His lectures are all over the place. Most of his powerpoint slide consists of one word or a phrase, but then the exam are true/false and multiple choice on certain sociology concepts. Do not take him. His tests are ridiculous and he isnt the best teacher.
Ive taken Schmitt at least 4 times in my time here and each time has made me anticipate the next, hes so sweet and understand. his classes are hard YES but hes kind

I was scared to take his class based on what I've heard, but he isn't as terrible as people make him appear. Maybe its diff cause its online. Yes, his course is challenging but these courses are also upper division. The readings are what got me through the exams. I wouldnt mind taking him again. He's a nice guy

Not an easy A class, but also not an impossible class either. I cant speak for previous semesters, but at least for fall semester, the professor has been very relaxed on grading. All tests are curved, so it really gave you a big cushion to make sure you do well in the class. The class goes through the entire book, so be prepared to read!

He is a nice man, but as far as the teaching goes, his class is a bit too difficult for no reason. I'd definitely recommend some sort of study group to get you through. We basically got only one shot with his exams, and our entire grade depended on just 3 tests. His class was difficult to say the least.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is very wordy with great intentions. He is difficult because he expects you to have a higher level vocabulary- it takes breaking down all the info he gives you to truly grasp it. Having a good TA helps ALOT. He is very smart and if you take good notes you should be fine. It helps that he records his online lectures.

This class was a disaster. Timed exams where you can't backtrack, lectures with little effort and makes questions on exams very wordy and hard to follow by. Material is simple and understandable, but his execution of this class is by far one of the most frustrating I've ever dealt with. Harsh, harsh grader.

He's a nice guy, but his teacher methods are mediocre. I'd recommend downloading OBS and recording the lectures because they're pretty boring, and he asks quiz/midterm/final questions based on the lectures. He posts lecture outlines, but they're really vague. Discussion only helped a little bit because only a few topics from the lecture are covered
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Long informative Lectures Timed Quizzes and Test.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Schmitt has been understanding especially during this pandemic.

He is super boring and makes the class unnecessarily difficult. The readings are dry and lectures don't help. Plus, no study guide either. Some people should not be teaching. I know that is not news, but taking his class sure reminded me of that.

I took Schmitt Summer 2020 & luckily, it was the only class I had for the 2nd session. Thus, I was able to study harder & took DETAILED notes on the readings. The midterm is 45% of your grade & the final is 50%. The class was happy he offered extra credit because it helped at the end. I wouldn't take him again. He was unorganized in his lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He will teach you things that you will use forever A lot of students make fun of soc majors saying they dont learn anything useful, as a Business Econ major at UCR, I can honestly say Professor Schmitts class taught me more valuable life insight then any major related courses I took. Finally, the professor was very understanding, offered help! E

Make sure you pay attention and listen at all times during lecture. He will purposely say random phrases or place things around the class in the middle of lecture then ask you about them on the exams to stump you. His exams are awful so study hard and take super good notes. This is not an easy A or an easy B course, but its possible with HARD work.

This is the hardest, yet most knowledgable professor I've ever had. He doesn't use traditional slides but relays info just like a friendly conversation to teach. You must be willing to really grind for a decent grade and write EVERYTHING he says. Exams are incredibly tricky & he loves seeing students stress during them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly, his class was not as bad as I thought it would be compared to what everyone has said about Schmitt. I never read the textbook but still managed to do well on his exams. Just write down everything down he says during the lecture and spend a couple of days before the exam understanding the notes. His midterm guides and quizzes are extremely
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The school seems to only have one professor who teaches a single course. All the students get stuck with him and fail. His online class is no better. Even with notes you will fail. 50 minutes for 2 essay questions on a midterm. No powerpoint or lecture notes to go on and the reading material is extremely difficult and almost impossible to finish

All of the material is stupidly straightforward but his constant barrage of terms and concepts make this class unbearable. His tests are ridiculous and his TAs are merciless when grading papers. Don't take Schmitt!
extremely hard, not recommend

ive taken schmitts class 5 times throughout my ucr career and got A-, A-, B+, B, B-. heres the secret: EVERYTHING THAT COMES OUT OF HIS MOUTH SHOULD BE WRITTEN DOWN ON YOUR NOTES. yes, that means use a laptop. yes, that means attend class everyday. yes, u will have about 30 pages of notes by the end of the term. andypark8@yahoo.com for sample notes

He is a really chill professor but his exams are tough for a sociology course. As long as you do the readings (and actually understand them) and go to lecture you should be fine. I regret not doing more of the readings. He also gives extra credit. Take advantage of it you will need it.

Lecs are mandatory. paper questions had nothing to do with the class. i read every single reading and could teach the class myself and still got an F on the final. relied mostly on the TA to teach me and he though schmitt was full of it. STAY FAR AWAY. the only way to pass is to literally write everything he says down and memorize it. Good Luck.

Lectures r mandatory & 10% of grade relies on clicker points. They r vague & slides r nothing bt subject titles. tests are IMPOSSIBLE. Midterm had a take home essay & a scantron portion which 100% of the class failed. The final is  even harder & is only curved 5 points . Avoid him; regardless of effort, it won't be good enough for the tests.
lemme tell you something about smittttyyy.... seems like a wonderful guy. once you hit midterm and finals. he is hard. & his test make you wanna cry.... good luck if you can handle his class.

Tough class! A lot of writing and assigned readings every lecture that HAVE to be read to pass the class. 1 midterm and term paper based on the readings. 1 extra credit assignment and final also based on readings. Takes clicker attendance every lecture and slides are short and not in depth, not posted on iLearn. Be willing to work hard.
Looks and kinda acts like the guidance counselor from the tv show Freaks and Geeks. Good show. Good teacher. Semi hard tests, understand the reading.

Guy is pretty chill, definitely puts work into his lectures, when many times it seems like he's just pulling together analogies on the spot. If you put in just a little bit of effort, you will learn some interesting stuff, if you put in more effort it's still pretty cool.

Here's what you need to know about Schmitt, and I've taken him MANY times so I think I've got him figured out.. He will distribute a midterm and a final that is so hard that he will grade everyone based off of the highest grade in the class, so hope and pray you are smarter than your peers. ATTEND LECTURE, he's pretty informative and bright.

I didn't buy the book (went to the library) and ended up with a C+. GO to class! He does daily clickers and sometimes when there aren't enough students, he gives extra credit. Also, he doesn't post his lectures online. Listen to him while in class, he says things that are vital to the exams!!!

I managed to receive an A in his class. I stress doing all the readings. They are very important as his tests draw upon from quite a bit of the readings. A helpful tip in doing well in one of Schmitt's classes is to actually take an interest in the material.

He gives way too much material on the study guide with only 1 week in advance before the test. On the study guide you have to answer 3 pages of questions which may take you 4 days to finish with a study group (do not attempt to do it alone). Then when you are done, you have to soak in 15 pages of answers in the next 2 days before the test.

NOT INTERESTING and NOT FUN, VERY HARD TESTS, I wouldnt take a class from him ever again. Lectures are all over the place and he thinks HES a good prof just cause he gives crazy tests. Fails to connect topics to the bigger picture

I studied very hard for his tests and prepared for like 10 hours for his midterm and yet it was still SUPER difficult.  It all comes down to not knowing what his expectations were for the tests, and he isn't very good at communicating that.  It is a giant memorization fest of way too much material to cram into your head basically.

Took course over summer and even though it was extremely inconvenient, I am glad I did. I knew going in that Dr. Schmitt was tough, having had him for Soc169, but I also knew I would learn something. His lectures are informative and compliment the readings. He is not a prof you can coast with and I appreciate that.

Great at lecturing information but goes fast. Gives an extra credit assignment for all his classes. His exams are hard. He curves 5 pts on exams IF the average is below 70. 5 pts sounds a lot, but if the average is a 64 and he curves, you get a 69, not so great, but he gave my class 8pts. Don't take two of his classes at once, it'll hurt your grade

This professor is definitely  hard when it comes to tests and lectures; but hes fair in his grading. he gives extra credit, curves on the exams, and if you attend class regularly, he takes that into consideration at the end of the quarter. people who complain are students who didnt have interest in the subject, or just straight up didnt study hard
Tests are crazy hard.  Does not care if students pass.  I would not recommend this professor.
He was not very clear and he didn't seem interested in whether people understood the material or not.  Tests were extremely difficult and he tested over how much you could memorize.

WORST TEACHER EVER. Doesn't care about students. Tests are ridiculously hard and he tricks you on purpose using A B C, A&B, A&C, Only B&C all of the above or none and demands clicking into lectures. Asks for several essays throughout the quarter. He will talk to you condescendingly.

Great Prof. He's tough but explains theories using easy to understand examples. Provides various ways to increase overall grades. Exams are hard so in depth studying and attending all his lectures are a must. He is very approachable and takes care that you understand when you ask for help. Enjoyed his class immensely.

just had the first mid-term. STUPID HARD! some of the questions i did remember, but most of it was hard. Fill in the black/short answer type questions along with multiple choice. Don't take this professor unless you want to fail

Great professor!!!!!! Its going to be my fourth time taking him!!! He's not that easy, but he's very fair!!!! There's extra credit but you have to attend class in  order to receive the full points. You must also have a registered clicker!!!! His papers have specific guidelines to follow and his study guide is very straightforward!!!

Really nice teacher and interesting class.  Class was easy as long as you went to lecture, took clear notes, and did the reading.  Paper was easy and gave extra credit.  Clicker was used just for attendance, no questions were asked.

Nice guy...terrible instructor. He made Sexualities a lot harder than it needed to be. His tests were insane, especially 7 pages of material in a 50 minute class. Tests/clicker questions were extremely tricky, and seemed to be a bit cautious/conservative when teaching a class where one is expected to be quite liberal/frank with the material.

I took him for soc 150 & 151, both were very hard classes. You absolutely must attend lecture and reading is also important. His paper is both easy and hard, 4 2pg essays. Not impossible to get a good grade but you have to put in the work to get the grade you want. He's very helpful during office hours.
go to class and read. he is hard but not impossible. i think people forget they are taking upper-division classes which require effort if you want a good grade.

Seems like a nice guy. He's got long uncombed hair and rides a bike to his classes... reminds me of a natural hippie. I'm sure he's smart but appearance makes me not want to take him seriously. His slides are confusing. Difficult to tell whether it's a continued sentence or another bullet. To keep it short: no good.

I won't lie, his tests are hard and the phrasing isn't great, but if you are unsatisfied with your grade approach him with valid arguments and reasoning and he will work with you. Doing the reading is an absolute must, but it's okay because there's really not a lot of it. He's very understanding and I wouldn't mind taking another class with him.

Men/Masculinity was interesting, but he managed to ruined it. I'd walk out of class more confused. He should focus on improving his powerpoint slides than be incorporating his family album. Clicker questions/exam very difficult.Exam includes:multiple choice, matching,short answer, essays,fill in the blank (and more! all in one exam). Paper was ok.

His lecture slides lacked depth and content.'Sexualities' was interesting, but he purposely makes his exams difficult and 'tricky' (I often missed all the clicker questions although having done the assigned reading). His exam included material that was not 'assigned reading', but was 'recommending readings' on Ilearn (hint). Journal/paper was ok.
you have to read the material and go to lecture and if you do both ull do fine in the class.

Soc 20 was a fairly interesting class. No prerequistes. Very passable. The reading was not overwhelming. The major issue seems to be his testing method, which I guarantee if you come to class regularly and be slightly attentive you can pass. I studied for my final for only two hours before taking it. I got a 102. I dont see why everyone complains.

teacher was cool, but soc 157 was not what i expected. unless you like making graphs and figuring out paths, diameters, density and things like that about how people network with each other than its not for you.

Fair teacher. The class is pretty easy if you just do the reading and pay attention during lecture. I'm guessing the people that did really bad in the class -- didn't read and didn't pay attentinon. However, the paper assignment was a little bit difficult and  harshly graded.

He is such a nice guy, and he's really helpful, but his class was so hard!  I went to every lecture, usually got the clicker questions right, read everything, and still failed the midterm!  When he says read the intro, read the whole chapter!

His lecture notes are NEVER complete and his tests are made to be TRICKY. This is the seocnd time taking him. I did not know he was teaching this class, if I knew before I wouldn't have taken him! Nice guy, bad teacher!

After dropping him the first time, I'm taking him again and I think he rocks! YES, he's tough and his tests aren't easy: you MUST read, take notes, attend class to get the material down, but he's great at explaining it and a really cool, nice guy. Recommended for people who want to learn!
please, please do not take this prof. schmitt. he is awful...his test is so hard. his test answers are (a,b,c,d,e) all of the above, none of the above. worst prof. in sociology.

Do not take Schmitt. All his TA's may say he's nice guy but he's not. His tests are super hard and he makes them tricky with the scantron wording  (A,B,C,D, none, all or A and B only crap). He talks really boring and makes you read for clicker/attendance points.

DO NOT BE FOOLED BY HIS DEMEANOR! nice guy! but this Professor makes his tests REALLY HARD! as in, even if you studied your assss off..be prepared to do some hard mental analysis during the tests..THEY ARE NOT A GIVEN! YOU MUST READ EVERYTHING, UNDERSTAND EVERYTHING to do good on the tests..if not, your skrewed..sorry

Schmitt really made this class interesting. He's straight to the point & makes the material and concepts extremely understandable. I earned an A- because I did an awful job on the "notes" assignment. I thought I had more time. READ the text. If he writes, take notes. If he says it'll be on the exam, it will. GREAT PROF, I'd gladly take him again!
Super Cool Prof! This class was way easy, as long as you go to class most of the time... especially during the second portion of the quarter (he gives extra credit)

By taking this class under this professor you will learn alot but, he is really hard on grading, and his exams are "confusing". SO, unless you're gonna study your ass off don't think you are going to pass... IT is true he curves but then you'll have to deal with the agony of not knowing whether you are going to pass or fail

Easy enough if you go to class and take notes.  Tests will be hard either way, but are much more manageable if you show up and have some idea of what he is talking about.  Curves at the end of the quarter, but a lot of people were at F's before the curve, and they wound up with C's.
He makes his tests really F-ing hard, but he curves the class at the end of the quarter so grades turn out ok.
Generous curve. Do NOT fall behind on homework and you'll be okay. Prof is caring and clear, and lectures were easy to follow for the most part. TA Yitong was awesome!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Computer graphics is just difficult to learn in general, but Prof. Shinar does a great job explaining the material! Easy to approach and ask questions. Lectures had pollEV Qs so be sure to show up. HW has coding and takes a while so start early, asking help from her after lectures is recommended! She also curves at the end of the quarter too
Wonderful and very accommodating instructor. Covered a lot of topics but in a very intuitive and approachable way. I think I'll be referring back to my notes on this course for a long time.

This class is just generally difficult to teach. The curve will be massive but Shinar makes a good attempt at explaining the material. The HWs are what you need to look out for because they can slice your grade. Participation is graded. She explains the material really well in the lectures which is necessary to do the homework.

Professor is great!
Material and long written/programming homework are difficult.
Each programming homework builds off the last. Miss one, you won't be able to do the ones after it.
Know some people who dropped out cause they couldn't continue the homework cause they are stuck on a previous one.
Plenty of math.
Your time will go towards CS130.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
One of the best and nicest professors I've had. Two project assignments (ray tracer + rendering pipeline) and somewhat weekly labs. The projects are fun, it won't be stressful if you following the course structure and do them iteratively. Labs aren't my favorite. The two exams were fair.

Ask any questions you have bc she's the nicest person.

Shinar is a real gem man. Super patient during lectures, and always makes sure that questions are answered thoroughly. 2 Programming Assignments that are graded by a Python script so you can check it yourself before submitting. Your TA makes or breaks your Lab Grades though. Midterms were easy and Multiple Choice T/F. Content is hard-ish tho

Dr Welles' class is easy to follow. She breaks down complex topics and is always willing to help students. The class is graded based on 2 midterms, weekly quizzes, attendance, and the final. Easy class would take again.

Best professor at UCR, honestly. She does go thru topics quickly but if u pay attention and ask questions, it will make sense trust. Also go to SI sessions, Artem breaks things down so much so well that a toddler could understand it. Her class is structured to help you not deter you and the exams are straightforward if you study the lectures enough

dr welles is very committed to the success of the entire classroom which is what i really did admire about her! first unit was very easy, second and third get confusing and muddy as lectures start to go all over the place a bit. still, welles is always there to help and is incredibly passionate. you definitely get out what you put into this class

Her lectures were very easy to follow and she posts the lecture recording after class. She has group office hours where she provides worksheets and answers any questions students have. Her midterms are easy & final is mcq. She did curve one of the midterms and provides extra credit. There are poll questions every class that are graded. Great class!

Not a bad class but the limited feedback given was just not helpful. Many ambiguous exam questions. The professor based the overall class's previous knowledge off few students at the front she already knew. Didn't even provide an answer key to the discussion material to make sure you were on the right track before exams, but 2% grade curve helped

Dr. Welles is a knowledgeable professor, but the pace of her class can be challenging. The first unit was clear and manageable, but the second unit felt rushed, with topics moving quickly from one to another. I also find the slides difficult to use since they are blank and require filling in notes. The annotated version would be helpful if posted.

This was her first time teaching Evolution and I would say that she was an excellent professor. She provided activity sheets, which were submitted on Gradescope at the end of lecture. Quizzes every discussion, two midterms, and a cumulative final. The exams cover lecture material and case studies from discussion.

Get ready to put in effort into this class, there is poll everywhere for every lecture as well as activies in class throughout the quater, corrections, reflections every week. Exam averages were C's but I will say she does do a lot of stuff to help if you are feeling stuck

Her teaching is disorganized and out of place. The way she teaches photosynthesis, cellular respiration, etc. are not clear so you'll have to learn yourself. Everything she teaches is out of place so you'll have to piece everything together yourself. Her tests are tough and barely no curve. I survived thanks to my notes from AP Biology.

i love dr welles! she genuinely cares about students' learning and gives many many resources for practice and studying. i had to withdraw due to a hospitalization but i am taking her class again because i loved it so much. it's hard content, but if you ask questions you'll get by. artem is also an amazing supplemental instructor. great team.

The office hours are very helpful. The content is fast-pased so make sure you understand each topic before going to the next lecture. The pre-lectures are super important. Go to the supplemental instruction (SI) sessions; they are very helpful. She loves to get to know her students as well. Tests aren't too hard, but they also aren't covered.

Go to office hours! they provide a worksheet that is really helpful for understanding the class. Attendance mandatory, especially with class activities. She provides lots of helpful answers w/ questions. Pre-lecture concepts on tests so don't skip through. Study diagrams too. Tests not curved, but also not hard. Overall I learned a lot from her.

Dr Welles is a professor where her personality is what makes lectures enjoyable. She's so nice and always willing to help IF you go to her office hours or email her. Please study for the second midterm as the midterms are 140 points and final is only 80. She gives extra credit at the end if you do the assignments. One tip: STUDY THE PRELECTURES

I don't really get the low score. Yes she's tough in terms of content but its pre-med AND the content is interesting.TAKE NOTES AT EVERY LECTURE, posted slides are mostly empty. You HAVE to understand a web of ideas and how they connect for each concept.DIAGRAMING systems is the best by far.Lectures specify too much/little often.Go to office hours!

She is a very caring prof, some topics she explains really well and others not so well. Normally, asking her the topics again in office hours can help you better understand it. Study everything you are given and you should be fine for the exams.

Class consisted of 2 midterms(around 21% of your grade each) and the final(around 24% of your grade). Class didn't have weighted grades; just point system. Office hours are pretty good so I recommend going to them and she gave a lot of extra credit. I admit her lectures weren't the best but review the concepts you struggle with and you'll be fine.
Polite lady, but bad at teaching, tough grader on FRQs, PollEV for showing up to lecture

She seems nice and offers assignments to cushion your grade, extra credit, and study materials. However, the 2nd midterm FRQ and final were difficult, with questions on minor details barely covered in lecture and no curve. Slides use research figures that can be confusing. She can be passive-aggressive. Supplemental instruction is helpful.

I would say she is a good teacher; but definetly not a good test maker. I feel like the tests were insanely hard, the study guides weren't helpful. I understood the concepts as she explained them well, but the tests were brutal. I did poorly on one FRQ and my grade was tanked from the point on.

Very fair professor. If you pay attention you basically pass. You need to put in effort if you want to pass but overall very good teacher. Most people pass easily with an A. Pre-Lectures are annoying and easy to forget but just try to stay on top of things and you get an A..
yall just dumb n lazy asf, this lightwork

She has an mazing personality and is a lovely person to listen to, but oh my god she cannot teach her class. Please rely on the TAs for advice on how to study because this class will have you breaking down after completing the exam you felt extremely prepared for. practice exams don't help so don't study off those study off the what to know slides

Study prelectures, make flashcards, and study every bit of content. All study guides for the exams are 10% useful, don't rely on that only. If anything base your studying on the prelectures, the “what to knows” and pray. Lots of test content are material she went over for a solid minute. Polls everywhere gives extra credit. Professor is very caring
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor was really hard to reach out to. When emailed to ask for extended office hours she would say no and tell you to go to other people. Study guides given didnt reflect the exam.FRQ's on the exam are extremely difficul,she subtracts points youve already gained in the frq if you put the wrong word.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I feel very mixed about her. She's a very nice lady with easy points from reflections and pre-lecture vids. She also has a lot of resources to succeed with amazing TAs. However, points were super easy to miss AND the tests were way too brutal, especially the final. She did curve a bit and had some EC points, don't rely on it.

Neither good nor bad. I feel very neutral about Shana because she's a good person. However her teaching style feels inefficient and you will definitely struggle with certain concepts if you haven't studied Biology at the college level before. 

Some tips if you want to succeed; Flashcards, YT videos & ask the TA questions.

Can be hard if you haven't taken AP/IB bio before. During lecture, slides are initially blank, but is filled throughout lecture. Personally, I liked this as it forces you to not just copy and paste notes, but this structure may not be for everyone. MT 1 and 2 had a curve on the FRQ. Final was all MC with no curve. Work on memorization strategies.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly, I had the worst time taking her class for my first bio class. If you never took AP Bio then you're gonna have a hard time. Her teaching is confusing and her lecture slides are mostly taught through her recorded lectures. Her office hours are very good so rely on that if you need help. Expect the midterm to save you for your overall grade.

lectures are awful and your grade relies on your midterms. she doesn't put ANYTHING on her slides and expects people to learn audibly. MCQs for midterms are 20 questions worth 2 points which takes your exam grade down by 5% if you miss one. for an intro bio class she makes exams way harder than needed and is horrible at explaining easy stuff.

I love Professor Wells. The class is hard, but if you watch the pre-lectures, study the material, and take notes (I had to buy an iPad as she draws out a lot of concepts) you'll be fine. 2 Midterms, MCQ with a FRQ. Final is just an MCQ. Go to lectures, review for discussion quizzes, and do the worksheets in class (basically free points).

Miss girl should probably not have so many assignments, because I lowkey forget to do the pre-lectures and reflections and whatnot. Yes, it's an easy way to get points but this system makes people not want to watch the videos. She is a good prof though, she just makes you go to lecture which I hate.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She's okay but idky ppl say she's amazing. She's not. She's just okay and the way she words things (lecture and tests) is way more confusing than it needs to be. Worst bio prof I had.

There are 4 midterms and the final can replace your lowest score. The exams are very specific and can be tricky but you just need to study and you'll be fine. It's kind of hard to actually fail the class. Dr.Welles is a very kind woman and always available. Her lectures are like fill in the blank definitions and then she elaborates.
Welles is a good professor. I had her for BIOL 5C and while her lectures may be confusing and her exams are very detailed and specific, the class is fair and she cares about her students.
Good Professor happy to answer questions. Midterms and Final are basically the entire grade, but tests are mostly multiple choice. Need to attend lectures, but overall good class
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
good professor, attend lecture to get all notes, but she records too; participation is random times throughout quarter; test material correlates directly to lecture notes + practice exams
might be hard if this is ur first time doing biology ever
Tests directly cover what is covered in lecture. Lectures are recorded, but there is a graded in-class assignment per week on random days. Not extremely content heavy but lots of memorization.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Most lecture material is not written down on her slides; instead, it is just spoken by her. Her lectures are recorded and posted to Canvas, so if you find a topic confusing or missed during lectures, you can rewatch lectures. Her tests correlate heavily to her lectures, but some questions are barely/lightly touched during lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I wouldn't recommend it if this is your first time taking biology. During her lectures, she'll show you images and forget to write down key details about what she's explaining. The way she structures the class is also weird if you don't already know biology. She is very helpful during office hours, so rely on that.

Dr.Welles was an amazing professor! She taught well and really helped you understand concepts that were tough. I would just say  study as much as possible for midterm 2 as that is what brings most people down in the class. It is a lot of info and sort of confusing but you can get through it.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is AMAZING!! Tons of resources to help. If you are ever confused about anything PLEASE PLS go to her group office hours where you can get ALL the help you need. If you go to her classes and actively pay attention (take notes) you will do VERY well. She also records and posts her lectures online if you missed them anyway. Again, she is AMAZING!!
Shes actually really good, has accessible office hours, and has group work office hours!

The lectures were a bit slow, but everything on the exams was straight from her lectures. She doesn't try to trick you on the exams at all. In-class activities for participation, but she doesn't tell you when they will be. just go to lecture and take notes, super easy; weekly quiz in discussion, 4 questions from the lecture material

Her lectures are set up so they're really easy to understand. GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS they're so helpful and she gives great answers to your questions. Midterms are similar to what's taught in class and the final is cumulative. Quiz in every discussion but pretty easy if you have an idea of what's happening in lecture.

very fun and caring professor. I don't understand why a lot of people dislike her as her class was pretty easy. I'm assuming the people who gave her a low rating just didn't try in the class. You have to study and attend lectures AND discussion to pass. Her exams come directly off her lecture slides.She gives offers point adjustments after exams.

I took this professor twice, first quarter was a rough experience but second time around I feel like she really adjusted her teaching based on the feedback she's most likely getting. Its a pretty difficult course but as long as you put in the effort you should be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Loved this professor. Study hard for the exams if you want to do well, memorize everything, questions can be hard if you don't. Having a tablet to write on the slides for notes would help you a lot. Lots of OH. Very test heavy. Your points earned=your letter grade. Do supplemental worksheets. SI section helps. FRQ and mult choice, final only mult.

Very nice teacher overall that genuinely wanted her students to succeed. Class consisted of weekly 5 min quizzes, 2 midterms, and 1 final. The FRQ section on the midterms can be very detailed but the curve makes up for it. Just show up to lecture and take notes and you will be fine

THIS IS THE ONLY REVIEW TO READ. Other reviews  in my same section this quarter are lying , because she has curved all of our exams thus far. No homework. Weekly 5 min multiple choice quizzes, 2 midterms and 1 final that are ELEMENTARY LEVEL multiple choice. The only thing about this class is you really have to write notes in lecture

She's a W. I don't know why people are hating. Her class was so easy, and she curved and gave us extra credit for doing the evaluations. The only reason she doesn't get to finish in class is that the class asks dumb questions. She wasn't slow; class slowed her down. She's nice & wants us to succeed. Her tests are easy, high school biology classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Get ready to teach yourself biology. She does not finish slides in class, and simply skips over them. Midterm and final questions do not match material covered in lecture. She talks very slowly, and takes about 30+ minutes (of a 50 minute lecture) to answer irrelevant questions. No curves on anything. Points system, and attendance is mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Just pay attention to the lectures

She has such a great way of lecturing. The important stuff is left blank on lecture slides; you have to pay attention and write it down during the lecture. She was also pregnant during our class and that's when all these bad reviews came in so give her some slack. The 20-point curve at the end was a lifesaver.

I took her for bio5b. Three exams with the final included and the final isn't cumulative. She has two parts to her tests. A MC and a free response both worth 50%. For the MC tests they were fairly easy. They're very simple and straightforward questions. The free-response was more challenging imo. Don't rely on any curve to save your grade.

Dr. Welles was a great teacher but sometimes, her lectures required more explanations in some areas. Bio005A was a lot of content and I believe she taught it very well. She is also very helpful in OH and she held 3 OH sessions for around 2 hours each, which made it easy for people to attend. She is also very encouraging. I would highly recommend!
Dr Welles' grading was clear, and her lectures were easy to follow. There are two midterms that are a large portion of your grade but as long as you follow along in lecture you should be fine.

Took Shana Welles for Biol005A. Your grade is based on discussion attendance & quizzes, in class activities, 2 midterms, & a cumulative final. she offers group work hours where she provided supplemental worksheets that you & your peers can work on. her office hours are very helpful. if you put in the work, you WILL pass. she is a sweetheart
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: really enjoyed this class. in lecture, she goes through her slides and writes in lecture content. attendance not mandatory but will randomly do in-class activities. midterms and final were pretty easy, all questions based on lecture. gave a lot of extra credit opportunities throughout the quarter. also really helpful outside of lecture as well.
just take very well notes and go to office hours for any questions
high school level teaching, college level tests
can tell you right now nobody is passing this class.

Without a doubt, the worst class experience I have ever had. Lectures are practically of no use (she doesn't put anything on the slides), the midterms contain an FRQ portion which require ridiculous amount of memory. No curve simply because she does not believe in one. She seems like a nice person but MAN there is some fixing to do

reviews.comment: One of the worst experiences of my life. Professor would NOT give us a curve because "she doesn't believe in one." Lectures are unorganized and hard to understand. The mid term are WAY too difficult, she teaches the basics but her tests require you to be a literal expert on the subject.

the course is the easiest in the series, she's just a bad teacher. Her black lecture slides are not well organized. FRQ expects to have a photographic memory of slides. Vaguely goes over topics, but frq expects u to know em in more in depth. the only curve is when she gets rid of questions she messed up on when writing the test. PASSIVE AGRESSIVE
i just hope i pass. no curve.

absolutely not.. take another professor instead.. if you enroll in this class, you're gonna have to teach yourself because her notes are so vague and illegible. she does not care if the class is struggling and one of the ta was so strict with the quiz grades like the other ta gave me full credit for something she gave me a 0 on. dont ever take her.

Her notes are so vague. You pretty much have to teach yourself this class because she doesn't. Worst professor. She has office hours that are supposed to help by giving you a worksheet but she does not provide answers. DO NOT TAKE HER, if i could go back in time i would've rather stay behind than take her.

Zooms through lecture material and isn't very helpful with preparing students for tests unless you go to her office hours. She is pretty passive aggressive and will get mad at the class if people start leaving before she dismisses the class. I do appreciate her not giving homework though and she does give a few extra credit assignments worth 3 pts.

Swears that everything in the tests are from her lectures but her slides are literally blank, and you have to go to class to be able to know when she does a random activity thats worth a huge chunk of your grade

terrible to the point it hurts LOL. her lectures are useless, no information is placed on the slides. everything learned in class is through her verbal sayings. THE CLASS IS NOT EVEN CURVED??? People are failing her exams

Would have taken the other bio prof, but didn't have an option. She's insane and don't know why and how she's a professor. 2 midterms and 1 final, no curve. Tests are ridiculous and she words them in such a weird way. Will tell you to know one thing for the exam but doesn't even put it on the exam. No study guide and ta's weren't helpful at all.

0/5 Avoid this professor. Absolutely the worst. Most of the people I talked to got a C- or a D on both of their midterms. No curve at all because she doesn't believe in curves, but doesn't give a study guide because she doesn't believe in that either lol. She doesn't know how to teach and her notes are just all over the place and so is she.

5A: as an into class she made this feel impossible. As other reviews say she is terrible at explaining things but loves to rant about off-topic biology concepts. She'll tell you one thing and then tell you "Well that's not completely true in Ochem..." like miss girl I'm not in Ochem so why are we talking about it? If I could give a zero I would.

goes over lecture content really fast and wont fully explain concepts sometimes but would expect you to know it for exams.never showed us practice exams/study guides, no help with exam prep whatsoever. hand writing often illegible. never told us how grades were marked down so i have no idea if im going to pass. passive aggressive at times.

There are two mid terms and a final that together make up about 85% of your grade so you have to do good on them on every single one or you will not pass. The other 15% is made up of discussion participation and quizzes. I would not take her

i literally cannot understand her, in class activity packets are dumb

first midterm was fine. 2nd midterm was really hard (frqs are ok)

Her lectures are tough to understand because she puts down words in her notes but doesn't explain them. Lectures are so hard to follow. Her FRQs are pretty hard, she grades based on spelling and doesn't give a word bank. She goes through so many things but at the same time doesn't explain things well, but expects you to know all the details.

5B. lectures feel crammed and she is not concise with her words (can be confusing and difficult to understand). lecture attendance is graded in a way where in-class activities are part of the grade, and if you miss that class, you cannot make the points up. she can be quite passive-aggressive. the exam FRQs are tough and honestly the worst.
Lab is very poorly designed. Makes no sense and does not relate to lecture in the slightest. Very unfair but theres only 1 lab coordinator, just pray your ta isnt bad unlike mine.

reviews.comment: This prof tells us never to send her an email because she's never gonna respond. Worst English prof I ever had, graded most of the assignments in the final week. The first essay was assigned randomly and in person after she was absent for two classes. She wants us to know everything, even though students are taking this class for the first time.

She's cool. Honestly really enjoyed her class and I hate English. She really is caring about her students and helped me guide to get a grade i deserve for my essay. She is a fair grader and honest. Feedback for essays can be better but she is good. Overall Dr.Simpson is chill and you should take it.

I took her ENGL1A class and its terrible. She doesn't give you a good grade regardless if you follow her outlines or not. DO NOT TAKE PROF IF U WANT A GOOD GRADE
