reviews.comment: Took English 1C with her in Winter 2023. She was very helpful and gave good feedback on assignments. She takes a while to respond via email but is super accessible during office hours. We did a lot of peer reviews in class. Very important to stay on top of readings and homework.

I loved having Professor Simpson for my first quarter! She has a vibrant personality and genuinely cares for her students. We wrote four essays this quarter, and she helped us by clarifying any questions we had to ensure we understood what we were reading. I would recommend her for ENGL 004!

I do not recommend taking her class. She takes a long time to respond to emails and does not give you specific feedback even though she only has 30 students. She also grades most of the assignments on the final week. She expects you to know everything when it is your first time taking this class. You wouldn't be able to make a zoom appointment.
No phone rule, but it helped with engagement. Fun class!

Not only was she nice And helpful but she is really cute. She helped me a lot as I was going through a hard time in life. She really cares about students and our success. She will be a grate professor.

Andrea was my TA for Congressional Elections with Dr. Bishin. She was an outstanding TA and encouraged participation in such a way that was helpful to me, I am now in grad school & know that she helped immensly. She does require participation, but it is guided and helpful, she is a GREAT instructor and knows what she's talking about!

Andrea was a good summer professor.  She really knew her stuff and made economic policy interesting.  But I was really depressed after because I learned about how Wall Street totally is screwing us over.  I would recommend this class highly.

She was my TA for congressional elections and was so helpful. SOme may disagree and think she was hard but thats because she pushes you to learn but requiring you to participate, but not in a pushy on confrontational way, but in a way that fosters learning and she doesn't make you feel bad if you don't know something but rather helps you learn it.
This class was so hard and the only thing that saved my grade was the cheat sheet. Lectures are incredibly dense and honestly boring. Curve was basically non existent. She is a sweet lady though.

reviews.comment: Really hard to get an A (less than 7 percent of the class got one). Only two percent curve since curve was based off highest scoring person being the max grade. Unfair final in my opinion.

Pros: lectures are all recorded. She is genuinely nice. Recognizes when there are issues with the exam and will give partial credit. You get a cheat sheet. 

Con: slides and lectures are dense. Only 6% of the class got an A or A+. Exams are very difficult. The curve is not your normal bellcurve but based on the highest score.

very dense and fast paced lectures, but exams are fair and practice exams are quite similar. 100 pts/2 midterms, 180 pts final. weekly discussion quizzes that are pretty tricky aswell. does give extra credit and is a very nice professor. attend class/watch recordings and dont fall behind. curves to the highest grade, so expect maybe 80-85 being A.

Professor Sladek made learning genetics very easy and interactive! Genuinely cares about students and offers extra credit to help students grades!. Allowed cheat sheets for first midterm and final exam. Tests are based on lectures so pay attention and DO PRACTICE MIDTERMS! Similar questions too! I loved this course because she's a great professor!

2 mid (2*100)+ 1 cul final (300)+ 4 quizzes (4*10 easy points)+ 4 assignment (4*15 easy points) + 1 group presentation (70 with average 65), lots of info. memorization, very intense. Exams are similar to past posted exams. This semester is online and open-noted, so average is around 90, for midterms, but it was used to be around60. not an easy A

reviews.comment: VERY!!! HARD COURSE! I really wanted to learn more about cancer bio, but this course really threw me off. There is soo much material in such short time. Her exams are the most difficult exams I have ever taken. Avoid this class if you want to maintain your GPA.

reviews.comment: Yo this class was NOT easy. But it was super interesting and I'm glad I took it. Tests come straight from lecture notes and discussion slides. DO. THE. PRACTICE. MIDTERMS. It is a heck of a lot of material so don't you dare cram. Pretty sweet curve too. Do not take if you got junior or senioritis.

This is probably the most difficult class I have taken, and if I could go back I would not have taken it. Professor Sladek is nice, but that doesn't make up for the fact that this class is extremely difficult. Do yourself a favor and just don't take it.

THIS CLASS WAS LITERALLY THE MOST DIFFICULT CLASS I'VE EVER TAKEN IN COLLEGE. I took this course because I wanted to learn more about cancer but boy was it challenging. This class is purely based on memorization and tbh I'm pretty bad when it comes to memorizing info. But I really busted my butt off for this class&am grateful for the end result!

Dr. Sladek is an amazing professor. Her slides are helpful but going to lectures would boost your grade since she comments on certain things that aren't included in her notes. Exams are a mixture of multiple choice, fill in the blank, but mostly free response. Study hard and practice writing answers to sample essay questions and you'll do great!

Dr.Sladek is a great professor. There are a lot of stuffs to memorize for this class. Exams and quizzes are very straight forward. If you go to lecture and memorize the notes, you should be able to get an A.

WOW, such a hard class, it is cancer biol after all. The first class i felt i learned something. You have to work in this class but the payoff is great. Avoid this class if your lazy, a minimalist, or rely on others for your A. But if you like learning about medical things, this is THE class to take.

Dr. Sladek was by far one of the greatest professors I have ever had. Cancer bio challenged me to reach my fullest intellectual potential, and I learned more then in any class i took. This class is very difficult, but if you bust your ass, you will be alright. Even though she reminds me of a nun, she is very helpful, friendly, and approachable.

Professor Sladek is the best professor I have had at UCR.  The class is definitely hard, there is a lot of material and you really need to study to do well.  I tried really hard in the class and got a B+ but I was taking 3 other upper divison bio classes at that time as well.  Such a good class you will learn a lot.
great class, just memorize the details of the notes
great class. liked organization of notes.  exams/ weekly quizzes based off lecture notes. ALL readings are optional.  memorizing details is key to success.

I liked this professor a lot at the beginning of the quarter until the end. Our final was pretty difficult even though we got a cheat sheet and he made it in person for our quarter specifically. He also never answered any of my emails I sent him. He's a nice professor with good intentions but the ending of the quarter was a bit questionable.

His class is extremely easy IF you go to lectures. The subject material in the beginning is a little tedious, but after he just gives out straight gold during lecture. There was low lecture attendance my quarter and he literally gave the entire midterm to us. Participation = extra credit for you, if he likes you he'll make you pass.

the goat, examples were explained really clear in lectures, and he is mad chill. just try the best to participate in class, try to answer all the questiones he asked and get them right, ur secured to get an A, test are not hard at all. shout out to my TA miss liu. 拿就对了，中国人不骗中国人。

The class was easy, as mostly everything was online and easy to access, which includes the homework, final, and lecture notes. The homework has infinite retries, while the midterm is based on the homework, where you are also given a full-page cheat sheet.

All the learning material was found in his lecture slides, so no need to get the textbook listed in the syllabus. Quizzes/exams were very much based off the homework. Amazing lectures, and you can tell he's very passionate about what he's teaching.

Fall 2025 grading scale: Midterm [in-person] (40%), Final [online] (40%), and Homework [unlimited attempts] (20%). 

Great lectures, but you do really have to study and put in the effort for both exams. He's kind, and answers questions nicely. I believe I was about to end the class with an 89% (B+), but literally got shifted upward to an A (~93%).
Straightforward class, midterm is very similar to homework, final is online. Going to lectures definitely helps with understanding material. Clear grading criteria and a good professor.

ECON 002 with Dr. Velovici was very easy. The material on the tests matched all of the online quizzes on canvas. For my class, he made the final online, but I am not sure if he does this for every class. Do not be afraid to ask for cheat sheets on the midterm and final, as he granted our class both requests.
Final was online, midterm and final is based exactly on the homework. He says there will be no math on the final- there is math. Only went to around 7 lectures and passed with an A
Take Velovici. Great professor, and he makes the class relatively easy. He wants the students to succeed and do well. Very unstressful professor.

Homework's are all mc and are completed by TAs in discussion sections. Tests are also mc, with 
most questions based off hw. 1 pg cheat sheet is allowed. Final project is probably the most difficult part as you do a lot of calculations on excel but you can work in groups.

Lectures are a bit boring and the class is a tad unorganized but he is passionate about the subject and wants his students to do well. It is pretty much impossible to fail his class. He makes it pretty easy to do well. Show up to class and you're good.

I went to like 3 lectures, so I'm not surprised I did alright. He grades things very late, and is very unclear about what he expects. 

Despite this, he is passionate about the material and is very easy-going. Not my cup of tea, but still a good professor nonetheless.

Very approachable as a professor though he repeats himself a lot in lecture. The content is generally very easy. His syllabus outline isn't the most clear. No mandatory attendance for lecture nor discussion.

Dr. Velovici's lectures were clear and easy to understand. He made sure to point out important topics. His homework reflected what was going to be on the exam. His class was graded based on the midterm and final each worth 40% and homework worth 20%. His exams were similar to what was presented in class.
Decent Professor, responds to emails and exams are easy to study for if you pay attention. Uses the same examples over and over again and sometimes has a thick accent though.

reviews.comment: Super friendly and makes sure students understand everything he teaches thoroughly.

Exceptional person & professor who genuinely love his students. tailors his approach to their needs and well-being. lectures are not only insightful but also incredibly useful, connecting real-world financial markets to the classroom. His passion for teaching is truly inspiring & impactful. understands a student's life which is very rare for a prof

His ratings here are super misleading. Had him for intro to microeconomics. His lectures were all over the place and impossible to learn any concepts from, coming from someone who economics comes naturally to. All he does is state random, unconnected facts and go on tangents. If you want to do all your learning alone, then take him. Easy tests tho.
He is an incredibly understanding professor and is always open to in class discussion. Unlike my other Econ professors; he tailored the class about our level of understanding.

Professor Velovici is very caring. His lectures are engaging, and he tries to connect the course material to the real world. His assignments are directly related to his lectures and readings, so as long as you keep up with the class, you will do well. Overall, he is an effective educator.

Prof. Velovici is 1 of a kind. He has ample knowledge of finance & stock market with ample prior work experience. His lectures are well taught. Moreover he is willing to help regardless of what probs you have and loves and cares about his student from the bottom of his heart. You can easily tell that he is passionate about the subject and students.

*I actually had him for Bus172 but it wasn't made an option*

10 HWs (20%), 1 midterm (40%), 1 Final (40%). All multiple choice. Both exams exactly like homework and take home. Material can get a little rough at times but for the most part the material is pretty easy. Would definitely recommend this class. Prof is super chill too
Good professor. Makes sure you understand the concepts and you won't need to memorize any formulas at all.
He's one of the best Econ professors at UCR his exams are based on the lectures and homeworks so no surprises. Very chill and easy going professor. Would take again

Econ102. Very nice professor. He really cares for the students and tries to help everyone get a good grade. He may be a bit blunt at times like an Indian father but he is trying his best to get communication from students to see what he can do to help. Good guy.

Very good economics professor. Knows that he is talking about and makes his course very clear-cut. Majority of the grade is based on midterms and finals, but he allows cheat sheets, which should guarantee everyone an A.

ECON102. This guy is so boring. No one goes to lecture and just shows up for exams. Make sure to get into the discord. The quizzes he post are basically the exams so study those or put on ur cheat sheet. Cancelled our 2nd exam and put more weight on our final.

The professor was boring and inefficient at lecturing. His exams were based solely on the homework and you're allowed a cheat sheet so you can do well if you know how to do the homework. Not much homework except the project. I wouldn't take him again tbh.

he was so good and actually wanted the students to learn. you can tell he knows a lot about the stock market. majority of people stopped showing up to lecture after the first day, but i recommend going if you want to know how to do the project and if you actually care to learn about investing. nice guy for sure
The great professor would be taking the course again.

His powerpoint slides are really detailed. He purposely made students' lives easier by teaching the important stuff and skipping the less important. The exams accurately reflect the HW. If you do the homework quiz and utilise the lab sessions seriously, the class can be a breeze. He's also accommodating, flexible and understanding. 10/10 professor

tbh, class isn't very organized, but he can teach good. The uploaded slides are sometimes duplicates, and he lectures off those slides, so sometimes nothing new for the day. There was very little hw. 2 midterms and a final(open note), which was easy to get a good grade. I didn't show up much at the end.

Boring professor but efficient. He gives extra credit when a few people she up to lecture and he gives extra credit for answering questions in class. 2 midterms and a final not hard. he is a good guy and teaches well

like... please provide more relevant questions.

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Managed to turn an interesting subject into hell. Her lectures weren't helpful and she was too lax. Most of the help in understanding the topic was from the TA's. Not to mention, your final is 100% of the grade, with hw and participation amounting to miniscule extra credit.  I took her for MCS005, too. This was DRAMATICALLY different.

Pretty simple really just show up to the lectures and take notes, show up to discussions and participate a few times, and read the material (usually 10-20 pages a week) and turn in the assignments (1 a week). That all there is to the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Her class is easy and straight forward. The class grade was based upon the notes you took during class and the weekly reading assignments. You will not regret taking this class as long as you attend every lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She assigns weekly 2 page essays and if you miss more than 6 classes/papers you have to write a 20 page essay at the end of the quarter. Bright side is that their is no final!

TAKE THIS CLASS! IT IS THE EASIEST YOU WILL TAKE! Only requirement for the class is a page summary of weekly readings, show up to lecture, take notes, and turn in your notes. If you do that, you'll get an A without trying. BEWARE the lectures are boring, BUT it is a super crazy easy class that you can not pass up on. NO tests. NO papers. NO hassle.

Super easy class and super easy professor. No quizzes, no midterms, no final. All you have to do is show up to lectures and discussions to take notes that'll you turn in at the end of each section. 2 page-ish papers due every week from the reading, and that's it. Doesn't matter how good your work is as long as you do it. Also, no textbooks.

EASY CLASS! TOUGH READINGS! 2pg paper per week on the reading. No MT/Final. Don't be a fool, take her classes! Just scribble everything she says down on your 2pg paper and turn it in. If you get a redo, just redo it! WHATEVER YOU DO, DO NOT TAKE TRACK B! You will know what I mean when you're in that class. :) She's awesome.

Great professor and she kows her subject. It's hard to believe that many students believe they can get through college with minimal reading and writing but in this class, you will develop your skills. I learned a lot from her class and I wish more prof.'s were like her- she made us write every week.

I took Professor Smith for MCS 172 with emphasis on Native-American spirituality and I loved her class! Furthermore, she grades you based on the number of absences you have. There is a lot of work to go along but she does not test you on the material. I would highly recommend anyone to take her class. Oh, and she never has screenings out of class.

Prof. Smiley is very disorganised, lacking a syllabus and refusing to use Blackboard/ Ilearn. She often changes things at the last minute e.g. the book to read for that week's class, and give very little specific criteria for what she is looking for in a good essay. You never really know what is going to happen in each class so you have to turn up.

ATTENTION: Beware if you take this course. If you are looking for a fun crwt course to take for your upper divs, this isn't the course for you. This class sucked. We were assigned a novel (200+ pages) and had to write 2 essays on them in a 2 week time span. The professor has no syllabus and doesn't use Ilearn/ Blackboard. You won't know your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. Smiley has an impressive career that demands respect. It was a privilege to be taught by her.  Though the class is a tad unorganized (no syllabus), she is very approachable and will answer all questions. She is very insightful and chooses very appropriate texts for study. Participate, write with proper grammar, & provide deep analysis for As.
Great professor.  Punks are better molecular biologists.

This guy was awesome!  he really cares that you learn the material and goes out of his way to help you prepare for exams.  Exams arn't hard as long as u study his lecture slides.  he is a very cool guy and is very nice during office hours!
No Comments
GREAT
I've never had to so much work for a class before. There were so many videos and assignments to do, it felt like a never ending cycle. def have to watch the lecture videos to pass
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Not having 8AM lecture is amazing since online. Since its online, the lab and discussion experience is really bad. Lab consists of using Excel and is very tedious. Discussion is waiting until the quiz is available during class. Thankfully, the lab and discussion is not worth many points. I had to wake up at 8AM for midterm and final, which sucked
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor and I'm so grateful to have had her in the midst of mandatory online classes. She has clear grading criteria and explains the subject in a way that is easy to understand (I have never taken stats before). She will explain it in multiple different ways to make sure everyone understands. She's also very accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Seems very passionate about what she teaches, it is hard to focus in class sometimes but if you pay attention shes great at explaining concepts. online homework (once/twice a week), 2 midterms, one final, all MC. she makes her own note templates that you can print out before class so I suggest printing it out before class so it is easier to follow.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Definitely need to go to lecture to understand. She explains everything very clearly and is very helpful during office hours. There is weekly quizzes during discussion which you go over related material during discussion. Make sure to find a good TA for help & focus on practice exams in order to pass midterms. Final was pretty difficult. REVIEW

Professor Smith was excellent! She was really aware of our progress in the class. Her lectures were very helpful, and she even uploaded supplemental material when needed. If you miss class, you'll miss notes. She doesn't upload her annotated notes. However, she's very accessible as well. Her grading criteria is also very clear!

Great professor. She teaches very well, and don't be afraid to ask, she'll answer your questions. The quizzes are ridiculously easy and are open-note. The midterm and final aren't too difficult as long as you study the homework well and the optional textbook. I got an easy A+, and I didn't even study that much. Probability sucks, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a very great professor. Very coherent during lectures and very clear grading criteria. Labs and quizzes are straightforward. Midterms are not too bad. Final is a little tricky, but still not too bad. Not hard to get an A with. She is also very nice and caring. Highly recommend!

Take Stat100A with Prof. Smith!!! Amazing class and an amazing professor!! You can use your notes on the quizzes, and the 2 midterms aren't too difficult if you keep up with lecture and study for a few hours before. The final is a bit more difficult, but definitely doable. Overall an AWESOME professor, an A is definitely achievable!!

Professor Smith taught 100A and this class was a little tougher; however, similar format. Weekly labs and quizzes were straightfoward and open note. Notes were fill-in-blank and printed before each lecture. Two midterms and a final, based on homework and sample problems recommended from textbook ( the only time I really needed the text). Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Professor Smith is amazing! She is very forward about what is expected of the course. Printed lecture notes before class, and you fill-in-blank for each lecture. Weekly homework assignments are long and you had to pay for it (but lasts until 100B). Labs and quizzes straightforward and open note. Two midterms and final are based on homework. Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Was not as easy as my friends told me. You have to put in the work to get the A. Midterms are out of 100 points with 105 maximum (5 extra point per midterm). 15 questions, 7 points each. The final was significantly harder than the midterm (DO NOT UNDERESTIMATE IT). But then again.. I did not go to lecture for half the time. So go to lecture please.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: 2 midterms, labs, quizzes, and final. Midterm 1 and 2 are easy just do the homework and practice midterms. Lab is an easy, but busy work. Final was a bit challenging. Not hard to get an A but you need to work hard from the beginning to get that A. Each question is worth 7 points so midterm 1 and 2. Be careful! Awesome professor.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Good professor. Coherent, good lecturer, she's hot.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Extremely easy class, if you didn't get anything higher than a B, you probably didn't bother to go to lecture, lab, or take your homework even slightly serious. This class is structured with so many different grading aspects, your grade is bound to be raised by so many things you do, which are all relatively easy. Ended up with a solid A
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I've had Jill for 3 statistics classes. Her format is often repeated in all her courses. Discussion quizzes are easy if you write down and understand everything your TA presents. Midterms and finals do require outside preparation (reviewing hw, quizzes, practice problems from text). Lecture notes are provided but need to filled in (go to class!)
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Smith is great professor, She gives weekly homework on webassign. The class is composed of 2 Midterms and a Final, which are all multiple choice , so there is no partial credit given. The final was the most difficult test out of all 3 exams. The homework is sometimes hard, but the quizzes are fairly easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Smith is a great professor. I had her for 100A and got an A. I also had her for 100B and this time got an A-. 100B is much harder based on the material and the fact that a decent amount of her test questions are conceptual. But she is very fair and does her best to help you in every way. Her lectures are very clear and well organized.

Good class. Professor is very clear and will answer any questions you have. It's very helpful during office hours. Much more complex than the perquisite for the course but the professor is very descriptive and helpful. Homeworks are great practice but you need to study and practice other problems before exams.

Great professor. One of my favorites. Very clear during lectures and if you are still confused she will clarify even further. Homeworks, labs, and discussions are very helpful and good for practice. She provides formula sheets for exams and posts practice exams. You get to use your notes on quizzes. Great class.
She's clear but tests are weird....

Professor Jill Smith is very experienced and very helpful. I didn't always go to lecture, but when I did she was very clear and helpful. Her midterms are super easy (Got 105% on both) but her final was fairly difficult because I didnt study too much. Ended up with an A.

She's very clear and understandable. She ALWAYS makes sure that everyone knows what is going on. She posted sections of notes online and we brought them to class while she went over them. Her and the TA's help combined with the homework, quizzes, and labs,  makes it extremely easy to get a good grade.

The median midterm scores out of of a class of 100 were in the low to mid 70s. The median final was around 66.  She's not that harsh of a grader, but you do have to really know the material. You're given far less information on tests compared to homework, and many people run out of time. Textbook is terrible but somewhat necessary.

I hated this class. Her tests are harder than hw and sometimes she just skims over an entire hw so you'll have to google it. In all honesty, if you put a good amount of time into this class you'll probably do fine -- meaning you better get used to  studying. Study everything, even if she only spent 5 seconds on it, it's going to be on the test.

Everything about her course is  straightforward and her notes are great! Be careful tho, don't be like me and underestimate exams! There's only 15 multiple choice questions on the midterms, so if you miss even just a few problems by accident ur score drastically changes. It's the reason I got a B+ in the class. That A, so close and yet so far. :'(

Professor Smith is a very nice lady. She is a very good lecturer, talks loud and clear, writes slow her writing is easy to read.  15% of grade is HW, 10% lab, 10% discussion, then the rest is the 2 midterms and final. Average midterm score was 84% so relatively easy class to get a B in, put the work in and an A grade is very possible.

One of the best teachers I've had so far. Makes hard to understand material easier to understand and is also an avid sports fan. Very clear on what she looks for and the midterms and final are very similar to the practice ones.

Great teacher. very helpful and understanding . tests can be tricky however and there is very little margin for error, the midterms for each question take you down 7%, and Final 3%. Just do your work and master the material, and u will be fine.
The class was tough but she was a very good professor. She was always helpful during office hours and made sure that everyone understood the material

Attend class and take notes on the outlines she provides online. Make sure to do your homework and take your time to understand lab. Discussion quizzes are also helpful. Her exams are multiple choice--very easy to mess up. If you practice and look over the homework/quizzes you should be fine. Don't underestimate the class though, it's not an easy A

The exams were way too long to be finished within the given time, not to mention that they were also hard and tricky. Midterms are 100% free response; Final (cumulative) was all multiple choice and took all 3 hours. Lecture notes do not really help, HW REVIEW is a must! STAT155 is a challenging class if you've never taken a statistics class before.

Great prof!! Knows how to teach w/o confusion! She is also nice & as helpful as can be. Take her! Not an easy A though- must ace the midterms for an A b/c that's the majority of your grade. I'm a 3.7 student & got a B+. Don't buy the textbook! You don't need it- it's a waste of a ton of $.

I believe that Jill Smith is the most helpful professor I have had my entire time at UCR thus far. Teaching is 50% the teacher and 50% the student. And Prof. Smith does everything within her power to make sure she does at least 51% of that. It's really inspiring, enough to make me strongly consider statistics as a major.

Ridiculously easy. Gives you guided notes, does practice examples, tells you where students historically have problems, posts practice exams. You have to buy webassign homework access, but it comes with a free digital copy of the book. The labs were a good study tool for the exams. Don't rush, it's easy to make stupid mistakes.

This class was a little tough for me, but the professor was great and taught at a slow pace. Study the hw/practice mids, her exams are easy, but they have subtle tricks. Final was hard, so you must do great on the first two mids.

This class isnt overall to bad. First exam was easy, just like the practice exam. Second exam and final I felt were pretty hard. But as long as you go over her notes and the formula sheet, your good. Lab is a joke and super easy, and the online hw sucks period.

The exams were way too long to be finished within the given time, not to mention that they were also hard and tricky. Midterms are 50% multiple choice, 50% free response; Final was all multiple choice. Lecture notes do not really help. I would suggest taking STAT155 with another professor if you can, especially if you never took Statistics before.

Jill Smith is the best Statistics professor on campus hands down. She is very clear in her teachings, she goes at a very good pace for slow learners. She is always willing to help anyone out during lecture, or in office hours. Homework is mandatory and will help you out during exams since it's very similar. Exams are also easy !

Honestly one of the best professors I've had in a while; she is very clear in explaining the material and has a very straightforward schedule, so you always know what to expect for the next lecture. The discussions, labs, and exams are all very simple. The homework ($75 to buy) was very easy, but tedious. Also, she was a MILF, which was a plus LOL.

Not the easiest class, but she made it better since I went to her office hours. This class requires some studying to pull of a B (I only studied for the final and got a B and B in the class). For the final study all midterms.
Professor Smith is EXCELLENT! DEFINITELY take any of the classes she teaches. Very understandable and is just GREAT at teaching.

She is a nice lady, but she confuses me at times. Office Hours guarantees an A+ if you work hard. Have to get 100 on every discussion quiz and laboratory. You cannot make any mistakes or you won't get an A in her class.

Lab & dis were free points. 3 midterms, no final. 15 multiple choices each. If you get one problem wrong then it is a whole letter grade. There is no room for mistakes in this class. However, she does give a second chance - which is to drop the lowest midterm score if you get a 60 or better on the third midterm. If you need this class, take her.

She goes thoroughly over her notes during the lectures and helps us prepare for our midterms and finals. The average for the tests were around 70% but that's because we had a lot of smart people in this class. Go to her office hour. She is very nice, caring, and helpful.

The class is extremely easy given that you attend class and do the provided practice midterms. Labs may be a pain, but try to get full points on those. Finals are a piece of cake as mentioned by the previous commenter. Definitely take this class.

The easiest class I have taken in Ucr.  Just attend class take notes and practice midterms.  Very easy class to get an A in.  She's one of the best leturers going slow for students to understand.  She is an amazing Proff!! highly recommended.  Midterms and Finals are cake!

Do not ditch lecture. She teaches you the material in class and its better than teaching yourself. Homework is very do-able. If you ever need help the T.A's and The professor are very welcoming. Overall the class was easy.
She is AWESOME!  If you attend her lectures and take notes, you'll be fine!  Do the assignments and go to lab and discussion for easy points!

I had Prof Smith for 100A and 155. Put in a little work and study to get an A in 100A. 155 is a bit harder but Prof Smith is very kind and helpful in office hours. Pay close attention and have focus in class because she explains the material a tad fast. Understand the homework and practice exams to be golden!

difficult to learn during lecture, but it was a morning class, mostly taught myself the subject when doing the hw. not that difficult of a subject you just have to actually try learning and understand what youre doing when working on the hw.

Pretty easy if you've taken any sort of statistics class before. First midterm is an easy A. I recommend going to office hours towards the second half of the course because there will be things you've never seen before. She is a pretty fair teacher, and the test questions are simple. Everything is easy until the final.

She's a very nice person and very helpful in office hours, but the exams are ridiculously long. The average always turns our low simply because of the time that is given to complete it. Other than the exams, everything is easy and straightforward.
she goes really fast in lecture, the material is hard, people who says its an easy A are probably math and stat majors.  when she says no curve she means no curve, nuff said.

She's probably one of the nicest professors out there.  The test averages were pretty low, but I thought they were easy and people just didn't study enough.  She typed up tons of notes from the book so I didn't even buy one.  The only complaint is that the tests were too long for the time given.

She's really good at speaking and teaching the material, she makes it easy but the homeworks and exams she gives in 155 are ridiculous. The homeworks are way too hard, she has turn in set up weird and her exams don't give you enough time at all

She's very clear during lecture and never skips a beat...seriously. She finishes right on time and finishes her slides. But if you don't go to class you're gonna miss vital info that is missing on some slides. Have to add a mandatory "extended lab" (extra 2 hrs). Open-note quizzes in discussion. I really like her! Take her class! PS she loves to talk about sports.
Excellent professor.  She is very clear and has approaches the material from a practical perspective.  Fair tests, homework, and other coursework.  Take her class.
EASY CLASS, labs are simple, midterms are simple final did in my sleep
EASY A
Cares about students :)  Very clear :)

never bought the book & no need to since her notes explain the basic concepts of statistics. 2 midterm w/ 15 questions & the cumulative final is 35 questions worth 25%. the midterms are ok, but the final was ridiculous. know the rules (ie if a graph is skewed to the left, median>mean even if the #s prove median<mean). i got a B+ overall.

Jill Smith is a pretty good teacher. I honestly thought stats was going to be a lot harder than this, but honestly to do good in this class study all the notes. She pretty much bases all the tests on the class notes and make sure you do the practice problems she posts up for the exams....They are VERY similar to the test questions.
STAY AWAY FROM THIS LADY. SHE IS HARD AS HECKKKK!!!
Hard Professor. I didnt learn a thing from her. Homework was harder than examples from lecture notes. Stay away

I don know why everyone's saying she is a hard teacher. I took her class in the first quarter of my freshman year, but actually her statistics class was easier than the one I took in high school. By the way, you MUST go to her class to get a good grade. Everthing including homework and midterms is from the note... Good Luck

Jill is a great professor. She makes the material very easy, teaching you shortcuts and little tricks here and there. Lectures are pretty mandatory because her slides are missing half the notes so you have to go to class to get all the material. HW's are tough but do them early and if you get stuck, go to office hours, she's really helpful there.

There was no point in attending lectures, the homework online is at least 5 times harder than the examples that she lectures about. Also, when you sign up for this class, make sure you know that there is another extended lab not including the one hour lab you signed up for. It's another USELESS 2 hrs to your schedule!
Didn't learn anything in lectures, labs, or discussions.  She should have curved the class

She puts stuff on the midterms and final that wasn't on the reviews or homework. Really tricky. All I can really say is try and do your homework, go to office hours, don't skip ANY class. This course is not a walk in the park. Good luck
Very Helpful in Office Hours and very clear in expressing the material for the class/

Never felt like lecture was to heavy but still was very informational. Final and midterm were good as long as you did the practice ones since he pulls a ton of question from them to have on the actual final and midterm. Homework is easy. Only complaint is that I had to by the textbook but it was under $100 so not the worst. Over all great.

Straight-scale, no curve, provides extra credit worth 3% of overall grade. Textbook is required. Attendance for lectures/discussion sections is required. Solid lecturer, handwriting needs improvement. Exams are word for word from the practice exams. Study practice exams for just 1 day before, easy A on exams.

He was one of the nicest and easiest professors I've had yet. He went out of his way to make videos for many chapters and posted exams from previous quarters on canvas. Just focus on doing homework, extra credit and participation and the class should be pretty easy.
He is usually a good professor and lets you replace the midterm with the final. Be sure to do the extra credit dynamic study modules as they saved my grade and give an extra 3%.

Professor Sorensen is a really good professor, econ is a subject that does require time to understand and need to work for it. Does give a decent/handful amount of homework, DONT just study his midterm/final review provided from him; take the extra step and study on your own. If you fail his midterm you can still pass this class.

Organized and clear. Very kind and will answer any questions related to the class, economics major, or even personal issues. Office hours were pretty busy, though. Would love to take a class with him again.

Great professor and really nice person overall. Hw is pretty easy just make sure it all gets done. Midterm is also fairly straightforward but the final at least for me was extremely difficult. Ended with an A just make sure to do your work, go to lecture, and study hard for that final exam.

Hilarious and helpful. There are many extra credit opportunities and curves on exams. His office hours are usually packed, so I tend to reach out to my TA more. The extra credit module is very time-consuming, but it does help with studying. Don't skip classes or discussions. His lectures are fun. Homework is predictable, structured, and repetitive
if you fail the midterm, just doing better on the final can make it up.

Sometimes he rambles a bit too much in his teachings but I think that's not only charming, but really helps cement the concepts for you if you actually pay attention. Overall, as long as you do the homework and optional extra credit you will get a good grade in the class even if you don't do that good on the midterm or final.

AMAZING professor. Truly one of the very few UCR professors who actually care about their job and their students and isn't lazy. Very generous and genuinely wants his students to succeed. Gives EC/curve.
ssssssssss
Irrelevant questions in homework. take any other micro professor unless u hate yourself
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Mr. Sorensen is an excellent teacher very clear in his lectures and helpful. He is adorably quirky and provides lots of supplementary info to help you out. Not an easy class but if you study you'll do fine.

Really does teach at a quick pace. Took for 103 and 003 this semester. He uses a lot of pod cast which helped out for the final, however the midterm material was completely different then what was in the class. Definitely go to lecture otherwise you will be lost on the test.

He is really indulged in post-20th century econ and the recent financial crisis, and will spend the whole quarter applying it to ECON103. The material is really confusing, and his lectures only made it more intimidating than it should be. The text is a really helpful guide. His podcast assignments are really interesting but pointless.

I loved this professor so much I took him three times for three different classes in my college career. (lower div, intermediate, and upper div). I love how he explains abstract concepts so clearly. And he is suppppper cute in a geeky way... also has funny anecdotes that he says during lecture sometimes. I wish I took another course with him.

He was a very good and interesting professor. One midterm and final. Uses clickers for attendance, but lets you miss two days ( in case your clicker breaks). Has a textbook but doesn't use it much. In lecture he told a lot of stories to keep things interesting, but never got too off topic. Overall a very fun class that I enjoyed more than I thought

SO ADORABLE, he's very funny and he makes class so fun. He's young, but he knows how to teach well and he knows his stuff. He uses Myeconlab, which is expensive but really helpful and easy. Go to lecture, you won't regret it. Definitely my favorite prof this quarter
Great teacher, loved his class and made lecture very entertaining.  I would love to take another one of his classes

Professor Sorenson is a great professor. Sorenson would retrace or reexplain himself when he feels his students are not understanding the material. He does go a bit fast pace, but his explanations are effective and I have learned more about economics than I have in my last two economics classes at Riverside.

Great Professor but teaches at a very quick pace. Had 2 podcasts per week. Clickers and Disc are 5% of the grade, homework and midterm both 25%. Ok midterm and tricky finals. He doesn't put a curve till the end of the class but its not much just about 3%.
Not a big curve. other than that the class is fine. teaches at a quick pace. He is D.W.I.G.H.T (Determined, Worker, Intense, Good Worker, Hard worker, Terrific)

The professor is nice, but the material is difficult- especially all the graphs. He counts homework and attendance for 25% of your grade which is helpful, however his exams are tricky and he curve is minor (about 3%). Read the textbook on your own and go to his office hours!

Professor was nice, however his lectures needed more clarity and organization. He could've provided students with better notes and explained topics clearer. Final is tough, so study up! And do all the homework and attend class and discussions!

Sorensen is a great professor for econ. His midterm was easy and straightforward from his study guide. Clickers and dis were a freebie, 5% each. Homework was easy since the TAs gave us most of the answers. Final was challenging so you got to read the book also instead of the study guide. I got a 80% in the class, the curve made it a B.

Sorensen class was pretty straight forward one midterm and one final. the first midterm was pretty easy but final was tricky. HW was pretty easy. Not a boring professor keeps you awake anyone can easily pull off a B or A with effort

Didn't curve for midterm, said there will be a curve for final but lied. Gave out crappy HW that wasted 100 dollars of mine. Pretty much you're on your own. No curve nothing. Final way different from what was on review yet. That's why I told people to give him bad reviews on his assessment.

Took the final and prof posted an announcement online saying there will be a curve and a couple days later he posts up final grades saying there will be no curve?? what the heck??!!, what a tool I'm glad I gave him bad reviews on school assessment...

The class was pretty straight forward midterm was decent but when final came kind of threw a curveball on the final. Ask alot of detailed questions there. The final review sheet didn't really help much...

really great professor. he's quite funny and his lectures make the material interesting. he also knows the subject very well and seems genuinely interested in how well students understand and do in the class.

I took Intro Micro-Econ in Todd's class my Freshman Fall Quarter of 2010, and I will admit he is a cakewalk, despite being a little difficult. Homework is 1/4 of grade and his curve is genuinely impartial. The only downside is he gives medium-difficult tests, which is mandatory to study for. But overall, it's worth the learning. Got an A+. LOL!

He's a really great professor who always tries to keep the class interested and engaged. HW is 25% so make sure to keep up with that as well as attendance. final replaces the midterm so even with any grade on the midterm, it's entirely possible to get an A. I sincerely recommend; this class was thoroughly enjoyable, although somewhat dense.

Sorensen was a great prof: very enthusiastic and comical. His exams are a bit challenging, but if you understand the hw and practice exams, you're on track. All in all, I learned a lot, but the clicker quizzes were annoying (T/Th night class). Don't bother with the book either, you get large excerpts for free with the HW which is all you need.

Great professor, lectures were quite boring but he had threw in some personal stories/opinions that were funny. Curve was 85 for an A. Homework 25% of your grade. Pleasure taking the class, would recommend to anyone interested. Good stuff here!

This class is not your average easy throw-away class, but it's great to get by. Sorensen makes the material look easy, despite the book's impression giving you otherwise. Homework is challenging if you don't engage reading, but it's a definite grade booster. Tests and final are curved enough for you to pass if you put the effort. Attend for clicker

Sorensen is really smart and very passionate about labor economics. He kept the class interesting with funny anecdotes and his quirky-nerdy sense of humor. He uses clickers, but it's really to see if you've done the reading, the questions aren't hard at all if you have. Great professor, wish he was teaching another course I could take.

Wonderful professor that gives great examples for what he talks about. Tests aren't unreasonable and the homework helps you understand the concepts. Friendly and casual in office hours. Good experience!

This class was so hard. Ruined my first quarter at UCR. This class was like a second math class. A lot of graphs to memorize. The professor was okay, the subject was just so dull. I should have gone to office hours. There were 2 midterms I think, lots of online homework(work in groups), and the final. Huge curve, 10% when I took it. Good Luck :)
Hard exams but have a huge curve. Knows his material very well. Just go to office hours and im sure you will do fine.

Class is easy as long as you pay attention during lecture. Clickers are used for attendance. Speaks loud and clear, makes jokes sometimes. Got an A in the class, never touched the book. Used MyEconLab for homework when I had him.
Great professor.  His class is hard but his intentions for students to do well shines clearly.
Fun lectures and easy to follow. Sometimes it became boring, but overall was an okay class. Be sure to study from the book on your own though.

He is a hard teacher, but he makes it easier for you if you pay attention in class and do the homework/study guides. Seriously, the study guides are basically the exams with different numbers. He makes the exams hard to separate the students that study and work hard from those who go on auto-pilot. He doesn't fail students unless they deserve it.

He was a great guy/teacher. Super cool and laid back. Class was mandatory, clickers needed for attendance. The subject was hard to grasp. Homework helped so much, so try to get a 100% it pays off in the end for grades. My homework grade was a B+ and midterm was a C average. So yes, homework and attendance helps a lot.

This class is not going to be easy.His lectures are fun and interesting, but if your like me and you don't cling on to economics as easily as others, you will be lost at some points of lectures. Use any SI or tutoring hours you can. Read every chapter assigned and try to understand.He gives a big curve at the end.
Hes very entertaining, great teacher, just go to the class and youll do fine.

He really knows what he is talking about. He speaks in an economic dialect lol which may lose some people, but if you pay close enough attention and stay up on all of the assignments and what study for final/midterms, this class is very passable. I got an A- as a first year and im not a fuggin genius, I just tried
He does not know this material and is just good at making stories - he only cares about his reviews !

He is extremely helpful, since he got his Ph.D when he's very young he can related to you very well. Though the class is extremely hard; however, he curves though so as long as you attend the class and the review session you will get an A. The Aplia homework sucks though, but if you go to his office hours he will help you out. He's awesome

He's nice and willing to help if you ask. He makes his lectures interesting by relating his own stories to the material. I'm going to see what other classes hes teaching next quarter so I can take him again.

He is not the worst.. but not the best... he is annoying in general though.. high pitched voice....squints a lot... he walks and talks like a puppet so its kinda weird. Go to his office hours.. immediately in the first few weeks. Later they get inundated with helpless students. Basically the class is leaning towards hard and hes not a good teacher.

one of the better prof for econ, but overall, the class is extremely hard. it is nothing compared to macro econ. lectures notes are sloppy and hard to understand, but listening to what he has to say during lecture, rather than only copying his notes is the way to go. midterm was okay, but final was HARD!

EXTREMELY hard class. I would recommend going to EVERY ONE of his office hours. I think I would have done a lot better in this class if I went to his OH all quarter rather than just the last 2 weeks. Take Professor Das if you can! I heard he is SO easy. Sorensen only curves a TINY bit at the end. He lectures way too fast and his notes are so sloppy

Not exactly the best of Econ professors but not the worst either. While he doesn't make attendance mandatory, it's best that you don't miss class; missing even one lecture could make you lost as the material is cumulative  His tests are tricky but passable if you study hard enough.

he is the hardest professor that i've ever taken @UCR...lecture attendence is mandatory,he does not post any lecture materials on ilearn, push u to go his lecture other than that...exams are hard, especially the final, it's cumulative,which makes u read all book...anyway,DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS if i have other choice...

Todd was a wonderful professor. he's funny, great person, and best of all, he can teach! he relates to the student really well, he understands his economics. i can honestly say i am not an economics person but i came out of this class feeling great. you must attend class, though not madatory, but his lectures are crucial to the exams. great prof!!!

I took him for Writing 10 and he is really good at giving you feedback on your essays. He does talk about a lot of politics in class which can be off topic a lot. He does lots of pop quizzes so make sure do the readings. He also makes you watch 1.5 hour films for homework on the weekend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Hes the kind of professor who is giddy when leftists commit violence and then tries to gaslight you into thinking conservatives & "the rich" are a certain kind of "German political party". He forces politics in class, & you can get a good grade by tickling his "I'm so punx I want to eat the rich even though corporate media agrees with me!" button.
Very engaging and funny guy!

Has u buy 2 books,3 day work weeks,leaves discussion HW on weekends,Long pop quizzes,&doesnt respond to emails.He gets off track by talking about his political views& brings up his japanese wife a little too much wich makes sum students uncomfortable(take da class ull see wut I mean)Take another teacher, I recommend Richard Hunt.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Snyder was the best instructor I met during my undergraduate years. His professionalism, rigorous attitude, and sincere care for students made me fall in love with English and, even, the U.S.. For students who need to take ENGL courses to meet the writing skill requirement, I highly recommend you choose Professor Snyder as an instructor!
I love this king
Easy class
A lot of commitment required toward the course. However, Professor is always there to help.
Excellent professor. If you want a realistic professor with a lots of intellect, go for him. I enjoyed his lectures, and has a lot of office hours.

prof snyder is very dedicated to teaching English and he often derails off of the lecture (but its okay that's not a problem). 3 essays including the final essay and one group essay. he sends out an essay outline that we can follow and is very available with his office hours. definitely one of the better options for 1b
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Great teacher! I enjoyed his class and felt everything was pretty straightforward. Just go to office hours and he will basically tell you what he wants. Only thing is do read the books, or at least skim it / look up a summary. Lot of the questions he asks are pretty precise. That and sometimes he rambles but just try and get back on topic (essay)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He talks way too much and goes on many side tangents that are usually hard to follow. He is very passionate about the subject, however, and is knowledgeable on everything he teaches.

If you are obsessed with talking politics then this is the professor for you. I am the complete opposite and couldn't switch out at the time. He was really rude and I had 2 incidents were we had a disagreement and both times he assumed I was in the wrong  with no real reason but was later revealed he was in the wrong. Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is REALLY tough on essays for a beginner class. Make sure to follow his rubric EXACTLY and to try and include topics that he has talked about. He tends to go off-topic and talks A LOT about how he is a "Socialist Activist," and can make his readings about that
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He is a very hard grader because of the way he wants the essays to look. Take advantage of his office hours if you have the chance because it's really the only way you'll be able to get a decent grade on the essays. At times, he get off topic with his class, so make friends that you can study with and help each other.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor is very considerate and accommodating. There was no midterm or final. He stresses the importance of a strong thesis, so we do a lot of workshops for that. Go to office hours! He give really good feedback and helps brainstorm ideas. As long as you keep in contact with him, he is accommodating. Highly reccomend!

He is a tough grader, I don't think anyone in my class was able to receive an A on any essay. However, he does give good feedback and is willing to help you out or answer any questions you may have. He does incorporate humor into his lectures which makes the class a bit more intriguing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I'd say it's a little hard to get an A on an essay but I don't think he's a very tough grader. My writing is a little bit above average so I thought I was going to get a B in the class but I did better than I thought I would. Attend his office hours! He WILL help you! He gives a detailed outline for all of his essays, follow it and you'll be okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: all I'm going to say is that he's a total ahole and if you want to pass his class you'll have better chances sending a brain-damaged monkey to space than getting a reasonably good grade in his class. Focuses too much on politics and makes all of his assignments about politics. I don't think I've ever hated a professor this much.

This English class was focused on money in politics so if you are into politics this is definitely a class for you. Class is based on the 3 essays and discussions and has a lot of reading, but if you keep up, it isn't too bad. The professor is very passionate, but it simply wasn't the class for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The essays (which are the main part of the grade) are so heavily graded. Coming into this class straight out of high school was really challenging, even the professor pointed out the fact that our writing was heavily influenced by high school teachers, which he pointed out was the wrong way of doing his essays. Very amusing and sometimes fun class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor is very strict on how HE wants the paper to be and doesn't care how you want to write the essays because HE wants it a certain way. Lectures are short thankfully but sometimes would go off track because of him getting distracted by other things like politics or movies. Make sure to do the readings and attend class regularly.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Snyder is a VERY hard grader, keep in mind this is just ENGL004 which is one of the lowest levels of English offered on campus. You are graded on 5 papers only so if you mess up once, there goes your chance of getting a good grade. He also is not afraid to show that he is a "hardcore-anarchist" and will consistently show his political views.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Took during summer. 3 essays, mandatory zoom. Has habit of rambling and goes on tangents. Everything has to relate back to current politics. Try to write an essay that's not doesn't relate the assigned reading to social commentary and you won't get a good grade. Went to office hours to talk about essay and he just wanted to talk about politics.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had him for my ENGL4 class. Currently taking him for ENGL1C for the summer. For Engl4, he graded my paper really hard and I felt like I wasn't going to pass. I went to him during office hours and it helped me get Bs on my essay to bring my grade up. Since my first few essays were trash, his feedback helped me with other English classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Do not recommend taking this course. I genuinely learned nothing, we had 3 or 4 main essays and I received feedback way later on so I could not tell if I was getting better or not. and couldn't apply the feedback on future essays. Overall, the professor is unorganized, just rants every lecture instead of teaching and doesn't care to help you.

I felt as if this was another poli sci class. All he talked about was how capitalism was bad, and why we should vote for Bernie. We hardly ever dove into class material. He seems to have a pretty big ego as he talks about himself a lot. This also translates into his grading. He grades ridiculously hard for no reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Seriously do not take him! He is really annoying! Graded really hard on all the essays and did not give any extra credit idk why the rest of these say he gave ec.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: So heres the breakdown, He quizzes on the reading so just make sure to keep up and the quizzes are easy. He is a tough grader but he gives really REALLY helpful feedback and you can redo an essay. Quite the character, made me actually wanna go to class, and I dont even like English lol. Take him if you wanna have a class thats entertaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: A bit of a character. Didn't do too well in this class since English is not my forte, but he is a good professor. He does care about his students and writes helpful feedback when your essay is returned. Make sure to keep up with the reading, otherwise you'll fall behind in class when you're discussing things in groups.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I have never struggled in an english class but this one changed things for me. The quizzes were worth 20 % of our grade which is basically like another essay, these can be super easy points if you read or screw you over completely. It is kind of stupid how pop quizzes can be so detrimental to your grade. I hated english after this.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He is such an amazing person and Professor! English is a subject that always stresses me out, but he explains things in a manner that really simplifies concepts. His class is also so fun attend, and he is so hilarious. Time flies by. He is pretty strict in grading essays but if you ask questions, you'll be fine. Also, his emails are the best.

Really great Professor! I'm normally not one to enjoy anything involving an English subject, but this professor really allows you to look forward to class! When grading papers, he is strict but fair; just show that you care to improve and he will work with you. One of the funniest Professors I've had so far. 10/10 I do recommend.

My favorite professor of the quarter. He is so funny, class flies by. There are 4 essays and 2 books to read in the quarter. There are a lot of pop quizzes, but as long as you're reading you'll be fine. He gives great feedback during office hours. If you're putting in the effort you should be fine.

Professor Snyder loves politics, he would talk about politics with you for half an hour even though you only wanna walk-in for 5 minutes. Reading was really heavy. If you're not planning to spend too much time in this class, you won't pass.

Professor Snyder's class was probably the most enjoyable class I had my first year.  Class was graded on 4 essays, one of which was just a revision of a previous essay, and a bunch of "pop quizzes." It's a good idea to go to his office hours and get the help you need, he gives a lot of advice during this time and shows different ways of writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Snyder is the best English Professor that I have ever had. His office hours really help me perfect my essays before they were due, and I never received anything lower than an A as a result. He is hilarious, helpful, and very involved on and off of campus. Do the reading, go to office hours,  do the EC, and laugh yourself to a good grade!
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Snyder is HILARIOUS. His class was about politics tho, so it was boring if poli sci isn't your thing. YOU HAVE TO READ TO PASS THE QUIZZES, WHICH ARE 20%. I'm an idiot so I didn't read and that took a toll to my grade.. Go to office hours for help with papers! He's approachable and helpful. There is extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: His speaks his mind and has no filter, but aside from those traits, GO TO OFFICE HOURS. Seriously, it will save your life and if he tells you to change something do it, and if he hints something, do it. You'll like the results if U do. For me, there were 3 essays and yes, quizzes whenever he feels like it, so do the reading. (It's 20% of ur grade)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Professor Snyder was definitely the best I've had so far. He's tough on essay grading but he holds so many extra office hours and if you go to them it will really improve your grade. He makes up his quiz questions on the spot so as long as you read the material you'll be golden. He really cares about his students & his emails are the best lmao
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Gives you 2 books to read. Has pop quizzes through the week that are tough. You literally have to remember every line of the book to do well on his quizzes. He writes the quiz as you are taking it and makes up the questions as he reads the book in class, which is mainly why the questions are so tuff. Would not recommend him.

I remember walking into his class on the first day without knowing why I got placed into ENGL4. But as the weeks in the quarter went by, I realized I was learning a lot more than I expected. I went to his office hours and that definitely saved my grade- so go to his office hours (he's really friendly and he clarifies what he wants)!

He assigned about 3 books to read and we had pop quizzes about every other day. Extremely hard grader, but gives great feedback prior to turning in your essay during office hours. DON'T SKIP CLASS. Quizzes, attendance, and participation add up. Great professor just hard grader. DOES NOT CURVE GRADES. i passed with at 79.6 . C+ not curved to a B-

I loved this guy, but you GOT TO, show the effort. Go to office hours and he is willing to help you build up your essay, just make sure you know what your doing, go once or twice, but make sure you go. Getting to know him personally and educationally are something worth while, still friends now. Also read the book and you'll be fine for the quiz.
Like an earlier person said he''s all about his political position and not interested in talking about much else besides how capitalism is bad.
Great Professor, really learned a lot from him. Make sure you do the readings and you'll be good on the quizzes!

Professor Snyder is a great professor who really made me enthusiastic about taking English again(which was my least favorite subject) This particular class was a treat and as long as you are a responsible student(going to class, completeing readings) you will thoroughly enjoy the class, as well as take as much information from it!

Snyder was a really good teacher! He understands that high school English sucked and he takes that into consideration. You have to do the reading and there is A LOT. I only got an A on one essay but still ended with a 97% in the class because of the easy quizzes.(If you do the reading)

An interesting person overall, but his teaching style sucks. Only focuses on political stances and does move from there. Texts he has us read were boring and repetitive, I do enjoy reading dystopian stories-but it grew tired. Talked about himself a lot *yawn*, I didn't mind the language. But don't take the class if you don't want to be ripped off.

Professor is FUNNY ! he is really cool and makes class fun by showing videos, or just talk about himself. He grades hard grammar wise, but his class can be easily passed if taken. GO to his office hours! he helps out with your essays alot!

Snyder is definitely a great professor, I learned more in his class than I have in my entire college career. Very funny, and has a natural way of relating to his students. More of a political theory class than English but in a really good way. Course work and readings are actually interesting and you leave the class feeling enlightened:)
GREAT professor. Really gets the students a better understanding of writing in a way that makes it interesting. He's hilarious too. Overall extremely enjoyable class.
ok first of all this guy is definitely not easy, but does he provide everything you need to pass the class with an ok grade.

He is too funny! Even when class was so early in the morning he had the energy to get us pumped for class. He encourages office hours and its a must if you want an A on your papers. Attendance is required and your grade will drop a letter grade after three absences. Pop quizzes on the reading he gives our so make sure to read!

ok so snyder is an interesting character. I myself had trouble with him to begin with. we found time to talk it out and i really enjoyed his class. there is a s%$#load of reading and there are pop quizzes on them which are 20% of ur grade. hes a good guy but never seems to have enough time to finish. get help to ace essays and youll do good in clas

Professor Snyder has been my absolute favorite prof @ UCR. He's hilarious in class but we still learn a great deal. He's very open to helping students and I had great time in his class. He made me enjoy english again. Love love loved his class!!!!! =D

Overall, he was a pretty awesome teacher. He's  super nice goes out of his way to help. To pass his class all you need to do is read his stuff! No matter how much you hate it, READ! And then go to his office hours. If your confused or seriously lost on how to write an essay, he'll practically set it up for you with the ideas that you give him.

Mr. Snyder is one of the greatest teachers I've ever had.  Anyone who says it isn't an English class clearly doesn't understand that English means WRITING, and in this case it is about political stuff.  You don't work on sentence structure in English 1B-you can go to English 4 for that.  He is amazing and gives incredible feedback.

It's a fair class. Do your reading.. you will pass your his quizzes (well, actually, if you're like me and you don't retain info after you read it.. then you might not. -_-) Answer his prompt thoroughly in the assigned essay, and you will get a fair grade. Basically, you get back what you put in.

i have no idea why the last 2 comments say what they say. this class is very fun and the teacher makes it worthwhile. we only had 6 quizzes and they were SUPER easy if you did the reading. there are 3 essays and thats it. just do the reading and there is no reason why you should get anything below a B

Do not take this class! If you are here to learn english, this professor will not help you at all. Its not even an english class, all he teaches about is politics and civic stances. This was one of the useless classes i have ever taken. Interesting class but did not learn any english.

His lectures are pretty much all about political stuff that you can learn in PoliSci. I hated going to this class but I had no choice because he would give quizzes at least 1-2 times a week out of the 3 days that we had class. The only good thing is that there are only 3 essays. A lot more reading in this class than in other Eng 1B classes.

Grades hard on the essay because he looks for specific things. Discussion during lecture is interesting. Go to office hours because he'll tell you how to improve your essays. It's very difficult to do good otherwise.

He will be the best professor you'll ever have at UCR. The list can go on and on. I took his class for two years and I learned soooooooooo much. He can relate to you as a student but professional enough and claim his Ph.D. He def. deserves the best for future years to come.

Read two books, Pop quizzes the next day. Easy quizzes. 4 papers, 4th paper is a take home final essay so you don't need to wake up at 8am on the Monday of finals week. Great teacher, I recommend taking him. Isn't as hard as people say. If you do your work and listen to him you'll get a B or an A. Easy class and good teacher, no stress. Take him.

I loved his class because of his sense of humor and ability to joke around. He has truly helped me use abstract thoughts & made me a confident writer. only read 2 short books. Always available, even outside of  office hours. The only way to get a C is to not do anything right or miss class & nobody recieved any D's or F's. Teacher of the year.

Snyder will rip you a new one. He will make you feel heartrending pain as your soul shatters and your very world crumbles beneath your feet as you spend countless hours perfecting trivial lines. He will make your eyes burn into the endless void existing in your head as you read line after line after line. Overall, really awesome professor.

Mr. Snyder allows you the freedom to write in your own writing style, instead of conforming to the standards like most english teachers do. he talks with a high level of sophistication, yet always in a way that you can understand it. he's not as hard as everyone makes him out to be. READ! quizzes are 20% of grade and the quizzes are easy!

Great professor. He doesn't give out a lot of A's...but if you're willing to put in the effort he is willing to provide a lot of incite and help.  I learned a lot from this class.  Be sure to do the assigned readings because there will be pop quizzes.

He is hilarious and dedicated to his students' needs. You will learn alot from his class if you do all the work. However, he doesn't really give out A's, only high B's. But if you're in Basic Writing 3, it's a pass or fail class so grades don't really matter, just as long as you pass :)

Mr. Snyder is absolutely wonderful.  I've had him as a TA on two different occasions, and each time he lectured brilliantly.  He brings a clear and purposeful insight to the readings, and makes even the dullest assignments seem interesting.  I can honestly say that he should have been teaching the class instead of TA'ing for it.  Great guy!

Very cocky English PhD student. He describes himself as "perfect" He uses profanity constantly in class. You don't learn anything. He has an unrealistic expectation of students. Take this class with him if you want a B or a C in English.
I didn't understand how to write until I took his class.  He was hilarious and so intelligetn about writing.  Highly recommended.

Super cool hip-meister.  Loves indie music, films etc. Suprised his rating is not higher. Its my last year at Riverside but still remember him fondly as my first class at UCR.  Didn't realize until later how much work he gives.  If you like to write, this will be a breeze.  Extends language beyond papers.  Talks very casually and humorously.
This teacher is awesome!!! You would think that tangents are boring and off topic but his tangents are quite amuzing and at times hilarious. Highly recommend him.
He was very willing to help students even outside of the class.  His comments was very helpful, and I think I learnd a lot from him.  You will learn a lot more if you go to his office hour~ ^^

This teacher likes to nitpick when he grades your paper. Take his class and get a C. He has a huge ego. You can't do anything to defend yourself. If he thinks you're lame, you're lame. If you used to get an A, you'll get a B in this class. If you used to get a B, you'll get a C. Unrealistic stardard of grading. *Extremely explicit language in class

first off, he does NOT speak other languages, he FAKES it, if you couldn't notice.  He often marks students down greatly on papers and after you turn in the paper he explains what he wants.  He has what he calls "problem students" and has some every time he teaches.holds personal grudges like a kid.
