Dr. Svonkin is fantastic; highly personable, and always very willing to assist students in advising or just additional feedback on assignments. He  leads great discussions and asks very thought-provoking questions. He brings an interesting perspective with a background in American popular culture... He's hilarious, too. I love him!
Excellent, interesting class.  Great teacher.  Terrific choice of readings and a great classroom for discussion.  Highly recommended for those looking for an intellectually-stimulating class.
Dont waste your time with him, bad teacher!!
Great teacher, hard grader though. i enjoyed his class and his readings
Amazing teacher, little tough, expect a lot of learning after writing a paper.  But if you take his comments to heart you will learn a lot.
Great choice of reading books in this class.  Very clear and very helpful.
Terrific.  Great books.  Really enjoyed reading and discussing Wicked.
No Comments

Svonkin was very helpful and interesting.  I really enjoyed class discussions.  If some didn't like him, they were usually students who were unrealistic about their writing.  On peer review days, I read essays that were totally unclear, and those people complained when they got a C!  They were lucky to pass!  But most students got a B or better.

Svonkin's my favorite English professor.  I liked the readings chosen, the class discussions, and the mini-lectures.  He was extremely helpful, emailing me every time I asked for help and meeting me over and over to help me with my essays.  Most of the students liked him.  Those who didn't read didn't like him as they got burned on the quizzes.

Very hard professor. I showed him two revisions of my rough draft plus the abstract and still only got a C on the final draft. The quizzes are really hard, since they are basically mini essays. The readings are uninteresting and complicated. He marks you down for the littlest things on essays. Don't take him if you want to get an A or B.

he doesnt help you at all, he expects you to know everything on your own, he doesnt teach very well only expects students to learn on their own as well. dont take him he is hard so you will end up taking the class over if you dont like english he will make this class horrible for you
He was of no help, he waited my quarter

GREAT teacher! you learn a lot, but if you want a high grade, don't even think about it.  The highest I've ever got in this class was a C+, and I worked really hard on it too.  Revisions must be EXTREMELY good if you want an improved grade.  I HATED how hard it was, but I cannot say i hate the professor.  He is a great guy and i DID learn a lot.

The most interesting and educational class ever.  I learned so much.  My best English experience, as the discussions were thought-provoking, the reading material challenging, and the prof. great.  I went to talk to him every week about how to improve my writing.  Anyone who wants to learn and improve as a thinker and writer should take this guy.

Unlike the other students here, I found this professor to be very tough but very fair.  He was willing to help, but expected hard work and revisions in return.  Two students in my class didn't like him, as they thought they deserved A's, but the rest did.  So if you want easy, he is not for you, but if you want to improve your writing, take him.
Arrogant, condescending, and dull.  Someone you'd meet at a star trek convention.  His reading assingments are heinous--The Dispossessed should be banned.  I tossed my copy in the fireplace.

Wont give anything above a B-. Extreamly hard grader. Writes all over your paper with mostly useless comments. Wants you to write how he would write a paper which eliminates your style. Transfer out if you want to save your GPA

he didn't even show up to class half the time cause he was sick. i agree with the person below me, he doesn't give anything higher then a C+ and even that is pretty hard to get in his class. he lets you do revisions but they don't really help much. good luck.
dont take the class. he doesnt give anything higher then a C+. you're guaranteed to re-take the course.

Nice and easy english class. If you have him or gonna have him, be prepared to listen to how he's always in debt and finally paid it off then was laid off by UCR. I learn a very valuable lesson during my time in his class- don't ever pick a 7:10 am class!
No Comments
Good teacher, but the class is very time consuming.

Svonkin is a really nice guy and extremely personable to his students. The novel he chose for our class to read was very unpopular among us all as it was a science fiction novel that is difficult to follow along with because it is uninteresting to the average person and is very dull. Svonkin challenged me personally to become a better writer.
No Comments

A Stuart Smalley look-a-like with none of the entertainment value.  His class is boring, he does not give many high grades, and the textbook he uses (Signs of Life) is painful to read.  With the text and his lectures you will learn that American Culture is to blame for everyone's problems.

He's a great teacher.  Seemingly intimidating in the beginning, he is a very understanding and caring lecturer.  He takes his time on the essays he grades, so it takes awhile for them to come back, but likewise, he can give you extensions on your papers.

He is always late on grading papers so you never know what your grade is which is scary. If you participate in class then he likes that a lot and grades your papers better.  He writes a lot of comments on your papers which helps to revise.

Great teacher.  Makes class time fly by with humor and interesting reading assignments.  It takes him a while to grade essays, but that is only because he actually reads and makes comments on them.  Overall, he is wonderful and I highly recommend him.
liked his class...he allows you to rewrite essays and that's always coo...

He's a teacher that demands perfection in writing. He goes in expecting that we're all spectacular writers. I thought I would do well, because it would bring the best out of my writing. I discovered how wrong I was all too quickly. Do not take this class!
Very helpful and available when you need help. He is concerned and understanding. Writes a lot of helpful comments.
great teacher, always available for office hours. he is interested in the students learning to write and is always looking to boost class participation.

Had him Fall 2003. He is late at grading papers, but he is very lenient with everything. I turned in a paper late and I still got a B+ compared to other teachers who will mark you down. He is very interesting, good books, very nice and helpful.
He doesnt grade work on time. He is very interesting and cares more about you learning to write better, he writes a lot of comments. He lets you revise essays so DO IT.
He doesn't get any work graded

his class was interesting and he made the time go by pretty fast...he talks alot and has you read interesting essays from the textbook so the work actually pertains to your life.  he got a little behind and we had to play catch up, but overall a fair teac

Professor Desai's 139 class was alright. I mean sure learning about real estate is interesting, but the slides were a bit a mess and there would be 70+ slide lectures. There was a lot of uncertainty in her class where students were confused on what is going on in terms of content, exams, and what was expected out of us.

Prof. Swati Desai is very knowledgeable in the subject she is teaching. She shares real life examples in the class. Her lectures are great although there are too many slides. 
I did get to select my team mates. Tests are easy but you have to study for mid-terms and finals. She should teach all the 3 Quarters at UCR.

One of the top Profs at UCR. I am taking BUS 139 this Qtr.-Spring 24- I waited for 2 quarters to sign up. She is knowledgeable & is interested in teaching.Lectures are engaging, tests are easy-best part -Group Projects. I highly recommend Prof. Swati Desai's class- She has been teaching at UCR for more than 8 quarters .God bless Prof. Swati Desai.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment:
Every year, Prof. Desai has been popular professor at UCR. I am glad that I took her class. She knows her subject & she knows how to teach her subject. 
She assigns group projects- I wish students can choose group members. It's okay- I got good grade in her class.
Prof. Swati Desai should teach full time at UCR...We would benefit from her class.
if theres anyone on campus who can teach a real estate class. It is her! Thanks Ucr need more professors like this

This professor is interested in teaching. She knows her subject, up-to date slides. Caring and respectful. Lot of industry experience to share in the class. Interesting lectures .I would recommend this class to all my friends. Sign up early as the class gets full really fast. Thank you professor Swati Desai.

Professor shares lot of information that is not there in the textbook. I did not read much from the textbook but had to read papers for HW. Interesting take and not too much math. If you okay with group projects, this class is for you. My friend and I did work together.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I got an A+ in this class. Professor is really good. Talks about careers and opportunities. Text book and attendance not mandatory. Go for it.

I took this class in Spring 2021 and I am so happy that I did. The professor is very knowledgeable but needs to manage her time well in the lectures. She shares so much information on Real Estate and it's interesting. We had group projects and not all group members work hard. But, I really enjoyed the class.

I took this class in Spring Quarter and it was a good class. Professor is actually interested in teaching ! She gives good feedback, replied to my emails and is available to talk in her office hours. I think she can improve upon a few lectures but overall a great class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Is it Prof. Swati Desai or Prof. Swati S. Desai? I took this class with my friends in Spring 2021 Quarter at UCR. She is good at teaching and she has so many ideas. I want to pursue a career in Real Estate because I took her class. Easy Tests and Exams. We had group project but the instructions were clear and our group got an A in the project.

Prof. is always available in her office hours. Responds to emails within 24 hours. Good Power-Point slides. I will take her class again. I hope she continues to offer this class. My friends would take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Interesting class. I took this class in 2020. Very energetic and honest professor. She knows her subject. Easy class

Experienced in the field, but possesses a limited understanding of how thoughtful teaching should operate. Very arrogant and unwilling to accept that she is wrong. Blamed "IT" multiple times when it was her own obvious errors. No explanation for final grading. No clear criteria. You might learn but the class was a massive headache.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Although the topic was interesting and the professor is super knowledgeable, the execution is horrible. The class is not very structured and some topics seem as if they are being developed as we progress through the course. The professor is very unclear with assignments and requirements. The group project is graded harshly without instructions
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Sweeny gives the lectures a lot of energy - friendly & always willing to answer questions in class. Her slides were clear, & there's never trick material on the midterms, what you see is what you get & open-note. 1 easy 3-page paper at the end. She's passionate about the material & it spreads. Attend lecture for notes on studies she goes over!
super easy class but i swear she does not believe in covid

If I could grade Dr. Sweeny beyond a 5-point scale, I would definitely give her a 11/10 for this summer session. She is so caring, kindhearted, and really easy to understand. She makes her lectures a lot of fun and interesting and relates all of her concepts in real-life situations. I would definitely take her again! :)
Amazing professor that clearly cares about her students and their progress. Best professor I have had at UCR. Would take a million times if I could.

3 midterms and one final. You have to buy an online hw subscription with your textbook, but honestly just buy the hw thing, all answers are on quizlet. She's super laid back and her exams are all self-explanatory. Study her slides and make a class study guide and you'll be good. Class isn't mandatory but she makes it interesting so its worthwhile.

Professor Sweeny is the most caring professor I've taken at UCR. She makes me want to attend lecture because she is really great at explaining things and takes her students in consideration. The papers are a bit confusing and overwhelming so go to your TA for help! There are 5 midterms but they aren't bad because it isn't a lot of material for each

Dr. Sweeny was an amazing professor!  She is very clear with what to expect on exams, and they're pretty easy if you study her slides. She does not have all the information on her slides, but it's pretty easy to write down the key points of any experiments or studies. She provides extra credit and drops your lowest test score. Really nice, too.

Professor Sweeny is EASILY my favorite professor in UCR. She genuinely wants you to do well so approach her in office hours! Gives a lot of EC (3.4%), no book is necessary. Her tests are fair. Don't procrastinate the essays though, they're due after the exams. No A-, 90% is an A. 2 midterms, optional final. TAKE HER for psyc 12

Psych 12 overall has lots of vocabs and definitions, which make the materials a bit overwhelming, but Professor Sweeny tires her best to help her students understand the materials. She is a fast talker, so record her lectures! Talk to your TA for the essays cause they grade them. Study hard for this class cause it can be a bit difficult.
Although Professor Sweeny is very helpful and kind, her tests aren't easy and the papers are long. Get close to your TAs, because you will need their help for the papers. Also, do not procrastinate.

Funny, smart, sexy. Tests aren't too bad if you study. Only downside is that you HAVE to show up to lecture. Her slides have missing info so you have to fill in the blanks during lecture. 3 midterms and an optional final can't beat that. Would highly recommend!

Dr. Sweeney is one of the most helpful and caring professors at UCR. Psych 12 is a really difficult class but she somehow manages to make it easier! I got an A by simply going to lecture and remembering her examples. I never read the book once. Go to lecture and you'll be good. As far as essays, talk to your TA's A LOT, and dont procrastinate!

She's really nice, easy. Go to lecture though, she puts slides up BUT leaves portions out so u show to class. Section is req'd, she gives Participation points out. If u are confused at all, go to her office hours, she explains well. She's great for letters of rec too. Nice professor overall.

You have to work fairly hard to get an A otherwise getting a B is fairly easy. Take advantage of the extra credit!! She may seem approachable but through emails and Office hours with her she has a bit of suppressed anger and unprofessional attitude.

She didn't give me an A in that class just for 1 point. I ended up getting a B+ with a 89%. I worked hard on that class. She will help you if you go to her office hours. TAs are great. Midterm was easy but Final was very hard. I wont take her class again since now I am scared that I will end up getting a B for 1 point
Easily one of the nicest Professors on campus. Go to lectures and take notes and you'll do well. She clearly explains everything and makes it interesting and applicable.

Great professor! She's extremely helpful and and nice. I just paid attention in every lecture, studied for exams the night before, and got an A. The final isn't cumulative. Discussion did suck though, depends on your TA I guess, but for 10% you had to discuss a journal article, points were based on how much you talked. I'd definitely take her again
Great professor, goes out of her way to make herself available and is really helpful. I looked forward to lectures :)
One of my favorite professors at UCR. Just attend lecture and pay attention and you will ace the class. I got an A+ so she will definitely give you it if you earn it.

Her lectures were interesting and comprehensive. She knows what she's talking about and expresses enthusiasm about it, but her discussion sections were awful. She did not help at all for students struggling to meet her high expectations in discussion classes.
She's hot.

Great professor! Unlike many of the faculty absorbed in their own research, Dr. Sweeny makes it a priority to make herself available to help you with any questions you may have. Her lectures sometimes seem a little boring, but she gives examples for concepts that really help out with application problems on the tests. She's really nice too!

Professor Sweeny's lectures were clear, informative, and included plenty of real life examples to better understand and apply theories, etc. She also really cares about the success of her students. She gives guidance for the exams (what to read in the text), gives some extra credit opportunities, and is generally nice and approachable.

This was a pretty easy class for me, and I do not plan on going into any kind of research field. The midterm and final were not that difficult, we were babied through the 2 papers, and she gave us plenty of chances for extra credit. Another bonus, she doesn't give minuses.

The class was informative but the lectures were boring. She tried to make the class legit but had a hard time. Overall Prof Sweeney is approachable but your grade is determined by your TA since they are the ones grading your papers. Each student I spoke with had cool Ta's which meant good grades. Brynn was cool but overgraded your papers
She is very nice. Her test are a bit too much.  If you want to just pass psych 12 and not retain much take this class.  anyone can pass but wont really learn much.
true learned nothing

she is a very nice person but in all truth her exams are horible.her lectures are a waste of time and all over the place the only way to succeed in the class is to read the book.she also did not have communication with her ta's and i had the worse experience in this course.

I definately agree with the two comments below! She is extremely nice and very approachable! I was extremely nervous for this class but it turned out to be pretty easy, as long as you put in some effort. Midterms were very reasonable and she provided a nice study guide. DEFINATELY take her if you have the chance! She's great!!!
BEST teacher. I didnt want to take psych 12 but she made it easier then what i heard. I got an A on the first paper. During lecture she makes sure everyone understands the material. Great professor!

Overall a good teacher. Probably the best teacher you will find for Psych 12. You write less than most other classes and she genuinely wants her students to do well. Offers extra credit. Her midterm is challenging but reasonable. Take her if you get the chance. Easiest psych 12 class, but keep in mind it is still psych 12.

Personally, I didn't go to many lectures because it was honestly hard to focus. Professor Swanson does explain the material but he's very monotone. The class is an easy A but if you genuinely want a more engaging philosophy class I suggest you look elsewhere.

Great class, great professor, get Andrew as a TA he's the best. i wouldn't take it again, but it was still a great class. Write decent papers and you'll do fine. Take the quizzes and you'll be fine. Oh, the midterm was hella hard and timed, but like i didn't study or finish, and I still got a passing grade. You'll be fine. Take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Grade was made up by 3 papers, attendance to discussion sections and some weekly quizzes. No midterm and final tests. Gave multiple essay prompts to choose the one we thought was easiest. Really nice guy and our grade was basically determined by how hard your t.a graded the papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: 3 papers, no midterms and no final. Papers had interesting prompts that are understandable if you do the readings, go to lecture, OR your TA explains the readings to you. I dint do any of the readings or attend lecture, because my TA explained EVERYTHING. Quizzes every week. I recommend taking this class. Put in the effort, and you'll do well.

He has a lot of readings, but he goes over them all in his lectures, and I've been managing well with that. I only need to access the readings when I'm writing an essay about the content (there are a few essays). The only problem is that his quizzes can only be taken Friday night, and the prac quiz will only cover a quiz score b4 you take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Honestly not that hard. 3 papers no midterm or final. Just make sure you have a good TA because they will be the ones grading it. He posts readings online for you so you don't have to buy anything. Hes honestly a nice guy I think this was his first year teaching here though because it doesn't seem like hes used to big classes. Easy class though
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He only had 3 (4 but 10% of discussion doesn't count much) assignments counting towards our grade. Paper 1 was 25%, paper 2 30%, and paper 3 35%. Lecture was in the morning for me and at UV so I didnt go much, but he posts everything online so it's easy to self-teach yourself in the end. Easy discussion, just read the text he uploads for that week
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great Professor, real nice guy and honestly just check up with him at office hours and you'll do fine. Very straight up about lectures, there's no info you will not need
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Graded by 3 Labs (20%, 30% , 50% of grade). It's a shame not too many people go to lecture because he's super helpful there and really nice! Just make sure the labs you turn in are spot on and you'll be fine. TA's were helpful, Justen in particular.
Such a great and helpful professor. You do three group assignments in excel. No final Goes over what you need to do on the assignment in lecture. TA's are very helpful as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Class is super easy. Based on a  project that you turn in twice throughout the quarter for your grade. First is a rough draft, the second is the final draft. Tells you to buy a book it's about $40, you don't need it. Only time you need to attend class is the day he passes back your grade for the rough draft of the project, other than that no.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: No final.  Project only.  No attendance required, but I attended regularly.  He is extremely knowledgeable on the subject and has lots of examples.  I used the book, but not much.  His lectures covered everything you need to know.  Also, the book is free online.

Class is pretty easy got an A+ and I met my bf in this class. There are only 3 assignments. You should come to class so you are not lost. He makes you buy the book because he wrote it, but it is pointless to buy it.

Easiest Soc 5 professor you can take. You do not need the book for this, but you do need to go to office hours so you won't be so lost on the assignments. Lectures and discussions are not mandatory, but discussions can be very helpful. There are 3 easy assignments. Easy A class.

course consisted of just a group term paper. no final, midterm, or anything else, but an essay and a rough draft of it. lectures were very boring and unrelated to anything since all he wanted was the paper

He is very passionate and interested in teaching statistics. His class was really easy because it consisted of 3 group projects which he allows you to submit twice. Even though attendance isnt mandatory I suggest you go to the lecture & discussion, especially towards the end to help with assignment 3.

The nicest, most dedicated professor! Only 2 assignments (1st draft & final draft of a paper), book is not needed if you attend lecture. The paper is very abstract as you have complete freedom on the topic. If you seek his help he will go the extra mile to make sure you understand the material. He cares for his students and loves what he does!

Very easy class if you attend lectures & pay attention. He is extremely helpful & approachable if you go to his office hours! He even offered me coffee the first time I went in to his office. Book is very useful, but if you go2 lecture & download the slides you won't need it. NOTE: slides are on ilearn rightB4 lect & removed after lecture!

Swanson's class is simple. 3 assignments, attendance isn't mandatory and you can work in groups. But don't be too confident. I suggest going to class and keeping up with the readings even though their not mandatory so you're not all lost in the end like me.

Pretty much do what he says EXACTLY how he says it. That is... pretty much reiterate the text without plagiarizing on the project. NOT helpful. Harsh grader. Do not need to go to class or discussions but you should for help only

Easy class! must take with swanson if you need soc. 5. No work at all, except a few assignemnts. Pay some attendtion though because the final with a group, but no one knows whats going on since its so easy no one pays attention. Don't really need to go to lecture, discussion for sure. Didn't put forth the effort and got a B.
if your going to take Soc5 i recommend you take it with Swanson!! his very helpful, i understood the material... other professors are harder for Soc5!!
Take him I'd you need soc 5. Most laid back professor on campus. Does not require a book and all his slides are online
Easiest soc class at UCR. Never went to class. The midterm and final are both take home essays. Easy A!
Professor Swanson is really cool. You will do well in this class if you attend lecture and go to discussion. Not a hard class overall as long as you attend class.

Super boring class. Lectures are all online so no one even shows up. Pretty easy class with only 1 midterm and a group final, plus 1 research paper. Overall, didn't learn much in his class since all he did was show a bunch of pictures from his vacations.

He is a really good professor. Easy class. There were only two test. A midterm and a final. The final can be done in groups and you can even walk out to the library and work on it there. Recommend taking this professor. He is one of the most chill professors I have ever had.

Lectures were great and often included guest lecturers with special activities. Made learning about an arguably boring topic interesting somehow. Class was overall easy, but required twice weekly homework and some reading. The no tests or finals was amazing, and I feel like I still learned and absorbed a lot of information even without tests.

I am not sure why her reviews are so low. She is such a kind professor!! She had interesting lectures, and they were optional. All her assignments were easy, and she offered extra credit sometimes. She is very chill and understanding, so communicate with her for any extensions. There are NO tests or a final!! Overall, I would take her class again.
The professor is amazing. There were no exams which was amazing however there is a ton of reading and some of the assignments required a lot of writing. But overall a very easy class.

Knows her area very well and is passionate about her work. No tests or final but we do have writing assignments that are worth a lot of points. Pretty easy class if you put the work in. The lecture can be a bit boring, but it has interesting topics.

she's really chill and the class is super duper ez as long as you literally just turn in the assignments on time, there's also no real final (it's an essay) and a two-day grace period for late submissions on every assignment
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: I don't know why Professor Syvertsen has bad reviews, shes an amazing professor and an even better person. She is very passionate about her work and teachings, and cares a lot of her students and others. Definitely would take again, she always makes her lectures very interesting and interactive. 10/10

I don't really get the bad reviews tbh. I had her for 001 and liked her then; like her even more for 162. She's really passionate about anthropology, especially when it comes to medical anthropology since that's her field. For 162, it was three papers and discussion posts every week. I loved the class and the discussions it entailed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Syvertsen is an AMAZING professor. She truly cares about her students and is very lenient in regards to turning in coursework and grading. She also makes sure that her classroom is a safe environment for all students. Her lectures and readings are very interesting and they keep you engaged. Truly a phenomenal professor!

Did not enjoy this class. Textbook was awful, with grammar mistakes, faulty information, and a few ridiculously biased interpretations of anth. history. Instructor is flustered and anxious all the time and the lectures - boring and dry. HOWEVER when she saw the class didn't like it, she asked what she could do to change and she made a change

The class overall is very easy. If you study the guide she sends out a few days before the tests you'll be completely fine. Make sure to go to class for the poll everywhere questions. There are few things you need to do, but you do need to buy the Smartworks material which is approximately $75. If she decides to do the essay again it's another $15.

This class consisted of the grades from the inquizzitive assignments that are due every week, a midterm, a final, poll everywhere and a project. Yes, attendance does matter to answer the questions on the app but I missed a couple lectures and still managed to pass the class with an A. Lectures were interesting and everything was straight forward.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is honestly not a bad professor. Her lectures aren't the funnest, but she gets her job done. You will have to rely on the textbook in order to pass her exams cause she only goes over keywords in her lectures. She likes projects and you will be doing a lot of those, but honestly, they aren't that hard. Overall, she's an okay instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her grading scale is weird. had to pay for two extra things on top of the textbook. Takes attendance through polleverywhere and the points actually matter. The class is an Easy Pass, but she doesn't really inspire any eagerness to learn. Lecture is very bare.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I think it is hilarious that she is still a professor at UCR. She failed to make her classroom an inclusive and safe learning environment. In my opinion, she should stick to research. Additionally, I felt that none of my questions were ever answered and she would simply read off of the slides. I would never take her again PERIODTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTT

Uses poll everywhere for attendance. 1 midterm, 1 final(both similar to study guide & multiple choice), 1 public action letter(had to pay $15), Weekly Inquizitive homework(another fee), discussion sections are 10 points each(get Alejandro if you want a chill TA).She gets mad when people aren't paying attention. Study & do your work & it's easy A
it was an easy A if you did the work, which wasn't a lot. Had three assignments/projects but they were super easy/fast. Average lecturer

This class isn't too hard but not an easy A, and Professor Syvertsen isn't the most enjoyable lecturer but gets the job done. She is kind of boring and assigns a lot of online homework but it isn't too problematic. She randomly takes attendance and gives "pop quizzes" and doesn't post lecture slides. Not the best class but for a breadth its not bad

This was such an easy class. I did all the homework, showed up to every lecture and discussion section, but somehow still ended up with a B. Her lectures are super boring and straight off of the powerpoint slides, which she does not post online. Overall, easy, but boring and her grading was unfair.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Lectures were very boring and felt very pointless, the homework felt more helpful. Encourages attendance by making random top hat attendance. Overall very easy class up until the final which felt very easy but was graded harshly.
The class is fine but the homework she gives is ridiculous and takes forever. She is not very accommodating
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Basically all you need to do is read the book because lecture is the book, copy and pasted to a slide. But, the professor encourages attendance through the use of TopHat (you put in attendance codes in the website, that you get in class to show you were there). Don't leave early she gets butt hurt. Honestly EASY A but, I would not take it again.

Lectures are sorta important to go to because of random TopHat questions and attendance and the films she shows because it WILL appear on the midterm and final. Even though she says that lecture is important because she says some things are not in the textbook and slides are not posted, everything you essentially need to know is in the textbook.

Her lectures were interesting and the material was easy to understand. She was considerate of the class by asking if we understood the material or needed more time to write down notes or ask questions. She knew this was a breadth course for a lot of people so she made the assignments easy and gives about 2 weeks for each one to be due.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The required material (Tophat and InQuizzitive)+ textbook are not too expensive if you buy the book and inquizzitive in an online bundle. Class is a little boring and she doesn't post her slides online at all so make sure you take notes in class. The study guides are straightfoward, mostly terms, and the tests are not that hard.

Yes Professor Syvertsen makes attendance mandatory and you do have to buy and online membership for tophat, but besides that she is a great professor. She's an easy A. I took this class only for the credit but I came out with a lot more knowledge. I actually found her lectures interesting and she shows that she is very knowledgable on the subject.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Required textbook purchase with inquizzitive membership that expires and required tophat membership purchase which also expires at the end of the quarter. Lectures are very superficial and she only reiterates random textbook terms and gets offended when people leave 2 minutes early. Very unprepared and not helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lecture attendance makes up huge chunk of grade. Lectures are very half-assed and wasteful of time. All she does is go over basic terms found in textbook (mandatory purchase) and watch videos or movies. Prof sometimes stalls, too. No feedback on tests, nor assignments which take forever to be graded and are incredibly tedious and unnecessary.

Bad professor. To list only a few reasons: expensive course, hard time addressing students' questions and concerns (TAs weren't helpful either), sobby and doesn't care if students learn, cares only about getting people into her field, which is bad if you plan on taking this only as a GE, harsh grading criteria, and uninspiring mandatory lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took the summer class and it was actually hell, I didn't have a life for 9 weeks. This guy was actually out to get us and it was like he purposely wanted us to fail. He never answered e-mails, was rude when we asked questions, and his exams were out of the depths of hell.

Worst professor I've had. Reads off of premade illegible slides, pay attention to lecture for cryptic hints on what will be on the exam. Will need to teach yourself everything. Impossible exams, no practice final. Avgs: 40%, 45%, 37.5%. WILL test A & B content. Teaches as if you already know the content, rude when asking clarifying questions.

avoid if possible. lectures are almost completely useless, except when he sometimes gives out freebies on the exams. all material had to be self-taught through outside sources. only saving grace about this class is his big curve at the end due to a result of low exam scores.

OMG THIS CLASS WAS UNBELIEVABLE. I didn't even try to teach and just read off those old slides. The only good thing was the curve due to class averages being very very low. Made ochem 10x harder than its supposed to be.

Genuinely one of the worst lecturers I have come across in my time at UCR. I would probably receive more information by just not going to lecture because half of his lectures just create more questions instead of answering them. He uses slides from years ago and does not draw mechanisms live, making the class super confusing. Horrible experience.
The only saving factor of Switzer class is the curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Switzer CAN'T teach. MT1 and MT2 were not bad, as you could learn everything from his notes, but the final was a different story. He purposely includes material that was not taught, which was the main reason why no one got above an 85. You HAVE to take biochem to succeed, because looking back it was based on that material, which was unfair.

Switzer uses slides thathe made 20+ years ago, I am more confused when he speaks. He does not know how to effectivley teach. He prides himself on people failing. He will test on 8A/B material, so make sure you have a good understanding of that material to. He has a huge curve, but that is only because everyone fails the tests.

Did AB&C in 9 weeks over summer. He is awful but insane curve (basically 40% for B-). Most skip lecture, but I wouldnt, especially days he goes over the practice exams which are very similar to the real ones. Best bet is understand MCQ and either FULLY memorize FRQ or don't bother, small mistakes mean no credit, so time is better spent on MCQ imo.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Switzer could care less if students succeed in this class. He is rude to students and to TA's, constantly saying things like "most of you will get F's anyway so I don't care" and "I can count on my hand the amount of TA's that were actually doing what I asked" He goes above and beyond to ensure students are scoring under average. Do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I don't recommend. He's the worst lecturer I have had at UCR because he is extremely monotone, teaches as if students have taken the class already, and does not do his job of explaining concepts, why reactions happen and how they occur. I got a 71 ad 57 on MT1 and MT2 and a 62% on the final, and ended w an A-. Avg is low bc he is an awful lecturer
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A terrible teacher. The only reason to take him is because his curve is very good. You could get a 40% on an exam and it could be a B- if that was the average. But there is no other reason to take this teacher. If it is between him or Neary, choose Switzer because at least you get a curve. He is the lesser of two bad professors.

Enjoyed the class overall. Material was interesting, learned an lot. Exams were fun and puzzle-like, and required 8A and 8B knowledge. Never attended lecture but heard he's bad at teaching so prepare to self-study. Slides are okay but can be hard to decipher. READ THE TEXTBOOK and do all book problems and you'll have a good time.
he uses homework for people to study but ts is so unclear and it is completely different on how he solves it in his notes

I AM MORE CONFUSED WHEN HE TEACHES. HIS GRADING SCHEME IS SO NOT CLEAR AND ONLY BASED ON EXAMS. HE WILL TEST MATERIAL FROM 8A OR 8B!! HIS CURVE ISNT EVEN THAT GENEROUS WITH 72 BEING AN A-, AND I THOUGHT IT WAS A 65. HIS VOICE IS SO BORING AND HE IS SUCH A BAD LECTURER!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: im not good at ochem so this could be biased. switzer's lectures are a little messy. he just points to his already written out slides and does some practice. his tests are not too bad but ochem is hard in general so his averages are quite low. theres an insane curve which saved me. his exams are almost identical to his practice so use them!!

Lecture never helped since he would just go on a tangent. I would go to lecture but end up leaving early because they never helped. I used YouTube throughout all 3 weeks to understand the material. Has a great curve I would take him again even if I have to teach myself. Had free response those were easier than the multiple choice.
Switched exams from multiple choice to all free response during summer sessions. Was unwilling to help students and taught as if we already knew the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Absolutely terrible. Switches from MCQ to FRQ. Which while fine, he then locks the curve at 40/100 as the average. So true average with FRQs are below 40 (somewhere like 25-35) and he locks the curve so hes just failing half the class. 

Terrible lectures that do not properly go over the material. Goes on tangents. Does not listen to any feedback.

His notes are vague and he seems to whisper when he solves practice problems. I took him over the fast paced summer session and he all of a sudden decided to change the format of the class without explaining. Instead of all mcq exams, he added FRQ and decided to make the final all FRQ. Not open to questions or answering emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He changed the grading the day before we had two exams. Final exam was free response after stating in syllabus all exams will be mostly multiple choice. HW problems do not match exams. Would not allow TA's to answer questions during exams and he also refused to answer questions outside of class because of "how short" the course is (3 weeks).

Only about 20% of students show up to lecture due to his poor teaching style. Final exam is completely free response with no study guide given. Midterm practice tests do not accurately reflect the content on exams. Decided to completely change his whole grading system this summer making sure it is more difficult for students to pass. Would not rec.

This professor is terrible. He teaches like he doesn't care about his students, has horrible handwriting, and explains the material like everyone should already know what is going on. He goes off on unnecessary tangents and whenever you ask him a question he does everything but give you an actual answer.

This was the actual worst professor I have ever had. Never seen a professor care less about his students. Practice exams did not match up with midterms, and he did not even offer a practice final. Can't even read his hand writing and lectures do not make sense. Refused to answer questions about exams. Avoid this guy at all costs.
Not sure what he has going on this summer but he completely changed the format of the class he made the midterm and final on the same day and refuses to take questions about it

I took his class over the summer. He changed the way that the exams are formatted and they have free response. The second midterm and the final are on the same day, so you practically learn the whole course for one day of exams. He is vague about what to study and he is not open to answering any sort of questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor decided to change up his whole formatting last minute. He is not very focused on lecturing and goes very fast and off on tangents. Does not like listening to student input and is rude. Took him over summer and no one feels confident in his test. We were expecting fast paced but he's not doing it well. Overall horrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr.Switzer has a really big curve at the end of the course. His lectures aren't really the best as he tends to go off tangent or gets distracted, but his midterm 1 and midterm 2 reflect the notes and practice exams! The final was very hard but allowed for a good curve.

Lectures are not good at all and his notes are illegible. The midterms are fairly easy but the final was extremely difficult. The only good thing about this class is that the curve is really fat. You only need ~68% raw to get an A- or above.

Horrible professor. Easy to pass; however, there was no practice material except questions from the textbook which had no answer key. Personally would not take him again but apparently, he was easier over the summer.

Took him over the summer. curves insane. 56.6% overall got me an A
litework

Previously failed ochem or already know you won't do well bc you struggle with a lot of the concepts? TAKE SWITZER OVER SUMMER. Graded on 3 exams. 20 questions each. Really only need 4-5 questions right per exam to get a C.  Multiple choice over summer. No cumulative final. Doing you a favor making it so "easy." Sense of humor. Rides a skateboard.
Cool dude with a longboard.

Great professor. Curve is thick af. Multiple choice exams. Will NOT get mad at people randomly, sometimes roast the whole class but it's kind of funny. If you take in summer three midterms no final no cumulative. And as far as I know he is the only "scandal-less" organic professor in UCR. Downsides are very messy notes and terrible writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: For the summer series, Switzer uploaded his lectures to watch on your own time (the class voted for this). Then, he would do examples in lecture to reinforce the recordings. You didn't have to go if you didn't find it helpful. I thought it was very efficient, and the curve is huge. For 8B and 8C, he capped the curve to be avg. 40 tho.

DO NOT TAKE HIM. Final exam is nothing what we learned in lecture. Even though nothing was taught during lecture. Learned bare minimum from SI, nearly impossible to get through this class. Doesnt even walk you through mechanism. He just talks at you and goes on and on.
He only went over practice problems during lecture and the class was graded on 3 exams. The curve was really big, but the exams were super hard and still impossible to even get a 40%
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Switzer was good at teaching some topics, but the others not so much. He's not the worst, but definitely not the best. Exams were similar to the practice problems he assigned from the textbook, but the averages were still low at 40%. The majority of the final was post-midterm 2 material.

If you can take another professor, do so. I was able to get an A- in 8B and found it impossible to even get above average in his class even after putting countless hours in for studying. Another thing to mention is that his exams don't reflect the assigned homework or what he talks about in class at all. The only advantage is that his curve is big

I did not understand a single lecture. He expected us to know a lot of material from prior courses. Exams were completely unrelated to lectures. Didn't even know how to do the assigned practice problems. No SI provided either. Test averages were about 40%.

Nice man but not a good professor. Notes are handwritten, making them nonsensical and illegible. He teaches you "a general framework to solve specific problems", but a lot of his test questions come out of nowhere with random topics and crazy reagents. Lectures are dry and they get harder to watch. Homework doesn't match the test at all. Good curve
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Good curve. Gave prerecorded lectures and notes. Handwriting hard to read but slide content is manageable to understand and is on the minimal side. Went over practice problems during class time but often went on tangents or worked slowly. Not great at answering questions, would tell students to watch videos and wouldnt really elaborate on slides.

Had him for CHEM008C. While he tends to go off on tangents, he records his lectures so you can just watch in 2x speed. Do the book problems and you're set. Good curve. Kinda bad at lectures and tends to just gloss over things but nothing the book can't solve ( or youtube)

i hated this prof! he didnt teach anything he tested on!!! his exams looked nothing like the notes or practice problems he assigned. he didnt seem to care for his students at all. only reason i passed his class was bc he had a generous curve, but that too his curves were around 40%! he needs to teach better and expect more than 40% on exams!

I took him for 8B & 8C. He was understanding when UCR was transitioning into online. He made the final optional, which boosted my final grade a whole letter. However, this quarter, he said optional finals are a waste of his time and gave us 3 midterms. I'd say his MC exams are harder than Casselman's in person free response exams. Messy writer too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Out of all the ochem professors, I think he's the best. As long as you spend the time to understand what he says during lecture (I recommend rewriting his notes) you'll do fine! He was patient and understanding. You can tell he tries his best and puts in the time.
Great professor, teaches well, very good lectures, tests are representative of homework problems and they are open note; huge curve, overall great professor just study well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: One if the worst professor I have every had! His lecture are very quick, and explains in detail material that we will not be tested on. His test are extremely difficult and different rom any practice problems he assigns. The only reason I passed was S.I tutoring! Be careful of taking his class over the summer, or online.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a terrible lecturer. He keeps his lectures so fast-paced and simple but his exams were really difficult. Your grades totally depend on 3 midterms (summer only). There was no old exam provided for the last one. His curve was big and thats the only plus. I had to watch youtube to gain understanding.

This class is two midterms and a final. His tests are all multiple choice. His lectures are easy to understand and he puts suggested homework problems on the tests so do them!!! BEST ochem professor that i have had while at UCR. His curve is the best. I never went to lectures and was able to pass with a B.

This is a review for the Organic chem 08 series Lecture is pointless half of the students stop attending after week 2 Goes over concepts in their most simplistic form Tests are extremely difficult and hardly reflect the practice Is condescending grade is made up entire of 2 midterms and a final Must watch youtube videos to gain an understanding
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took the entire year of Organic Chemistry in 9 weeks over summer. Do a lot of practice problems (doesn't have to be the ones he assigns) and watch some Youtube videos to supplement his lecture notes (which are pretty well written). Overall, it was tough but rewarding. Thanks Professor Switzer!

His lectures are a bit hard to follow; however, I don't blame him. He has to teach 4 chapters a week, and it is going to be fast paced. Also 2 and a half hour lectures can be extremely tiring for both the student and the professor. I really think he tried his best to make sure a majority of the students passed. This is for summer btw.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took Ochem A&B over the summer. It is very fastpaced, and Switzer is not a good lecturer. I spent the majority of the lectures in a state of complete confusion, and he does not give good explanations when you ask questions. The material learned over the summer is surface level, but it is easy to pass the class because of his curve (avg.B-)

Grade based on 2 MTs and Final (200pts + 200pts) w/ f curve. However, lectures r terrible. You won't know wtf he's saying most of the time. U should still attend because he tells U which questions will be on the test. It's really hard to study for this class. I allocated 50% of studying to lec slides, 30% to past exams (provided,) 20% to textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: As a lecturer, he is one of the worst. He spent more time talking about his technology (ipads and such) than actual ochem. I stopped going to his classes after the first midterm and just went to the si sessions. SI leaders were more helpful and easier to understand.

Dr. Swizter is extremely monotonic in lectures he puts me to bed. I used to attend his lectures but legit got nothing from him. I ended up with an A but suffered my way through it. He switched his exams to multiple choice, but his curve is extremely generous. You only have to be one and a half standard deviations above the average to get an A.

He was an okay professor. His tests were pretty difficult if you don't prepare for them, but the final was extremely hard. His midterms us homework questions, so make sure to do them! His lectures were pointless since he didn't really go past explaining what's on the powerpoint.

Honestly this class wasn't as bad as I thought it was going to be. Ochem can be a drag but Switzer made it manageable. DO THE BOOK PROBLEMS!!! IT WILL LITERALLY SAVE YOUR GRADE!! I legit saw 5 problems on the midterm that were word for word from the book. Midterms were straightforward and easy but the final was a little difficult. Overall not bad!

Switzer is a passable class. Attending lectures is important because he says key things during class. you DO NOT need to read the book, but you DO need to do the book problems because he does pick a couple straight from the book. He goes off topic. He has 2 midterms and a cumulative final. I got a 69/100, 63/100, and 114/200 and ended with a B-.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I honestly had a decent time in this class. His lecturing style will take time getting used to, because of his tangents. But if you go to office hours and do all of the recommended homework problems, you will probably get an A. He takes a lot of his test Q from the homework. His final was pretty hard but just nail the midterms and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Took him in this last spring quarter. Straightforward professor, not the best lecturer, midterms are okay, final is hard. He has a very generous curve though.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Switzer is a good guy and very generous in regards to the curve (which saves most people). But he's not the best at teaching. You honestly don't need to go to lecture to get a high grade in the class. Piece of advice: DO THE BOOK PROBLEMS. There's a lot but it WILL save you. Half of the midterm problems are straight out of the book, word for word.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Switzer is an awesome professor who cares about his students. Curve was amazing and saved all of us. Work hard to get average/above average on midterms and final (by understanding his notes and practicing problems from his notes and SI). Never really went to his office hours or did the homework, and still did well in the class. Take him!

Midterms straight from the Lecture notes and HW. Final is reasonable. Attendance isn't necessary but beneficial because he gives lots of hints of what will be on the exams. He cares that you perform well, but NEVER asks if the class has any questions; he just lectures nonstop. Memorize the notes and you should be able to do Very well.
Best curve ever.  Midterms are okay but final is difficult.  Possible to earn an A with a lot of effort.  Hw crucial to success.  Notes are easy to follow so going to class isn't needed.

Lectures are very clear and organized. His tests are reflective of his notes. Overall average was curved to a B-. One of the easiest O-chem classes I had out of the series. Compared to the other classes in the series, I didn't go to office hours or SI sessions and did just fine. All you have to do is study and practice and take good notes.

midterms are based on the notes and problems. midterm averages consistently at 50 percent .  average set at B minus. the final was hard because of the overwhelming amount of material to study to prepare, for me anyway. some Final questions were  biochemistry concept questions not in lectures or problems,  so reading the book will help.

Switzer is a very good lecturer that is really upfront about what he is going to test on. He posts ALL lectures online and they are written so well that you could come to class and just sit and listen or just skip class and download later. I actually only went to 4-5 lectures and still got an A. Midterms were way easier than final, but curved huge
Boring lectures, very simple notes, and not too much investigations into the "whys" of mechanisms and reactions. Lectures felt very mechanical. Fair midterms, but final was ridiculously hard.

Best curve ever!! He's nice and approachable, don't be shy and go to his office hours for an A. Memorize all of the reactions and understand mechanisms. Got an A- by reviewing all of his notes straight after class and before the exam.

Average is set to a B-. He's pretty fair in grading but regrades on tests aren't that easy to get. Midterms are based on the homework & lecture notes. He posts the slides up so it's not necessary to go to class. His final is extremely difficult and almost irrelevant to material covered in class :(
This class is mainly geared for bio and pre-med students, it's really not fun if that's not what you're going to do.  (I probably won't even use half of this material)

go to class and understand his notes, all the test questions come from it. memorize the reactions at the back of each chapter it will help you a lot! got an A-, worked for it but its easy to get as long as you keep up with the chapters and take the time to understand/memorize his notes

The test were not diffiicult but he is very poor at explaining things, one time in class he told us that he knew something just because he knew it. He writes very poor notes, they are oversimplified versions of what you will be tested on. And he's notes are writen very fast so it is hard to keep up with him in class although he does post the notes

Lectures are pretty decent.He is willing to answer any question and always post up lecture slides after class.Has multiple review sessions.The homework is the key to doing well on his exams.However, the final consisted of a lot of Biology questions and was fairly difficult.His midterms are fair.Overall, good class until the final.I got an A-.
He might not be the best lecturer, but he gets to the point and his tests are fair. He has a generous curve.
He knows how to explain what is on his slides. Tests are from homework and slides. If you can teach yourself the hw and his millions of slides  you will be fine. very generous curve. Take him.

probably the worst chemistry teacher i've ever had. he's only interested in his apple toys and his handwriting for his lectures (which he post on ilearn) are almost not legible! does not like it when students whisper while he's lecturing. so soft spoken. doesn't go over all the reactions in the book, but expect you to know it anyways.

he's a pretty lenient grader and his midterm questions typically have info from the slides(which he always posts on ilearn) his final is pretty intense  though. average is a b-. i completely failed the 1st midterm,  passed the 2nd midterm & final and got a B. i would pick him over larsen.

Professor Switzer has an easier grading scale. He sets the ave as B-. One deviation above is an A- and below is C-. He is a good professor, especially review sessions that he will be able to answer all the questions you ask. But final is like a disaster. Anyway, his curve is the best.

33% Lab, 33% Midterms (2), and 33% Final.  1st average was 52, 2nd average 43.  He doesn't give you questions that you have never seen.  His lecture notes are gold and spot-on, but you will need to "skim" over the textbook just in case you don't understand his lectures.  He might throw in a reaction from only the textbook, but that was only once.

He is a kick this quarter. shows up with his skateboard and is "like-totally" into his students. He shows up like he's high, but I learned alot from him. Larsen has a better lecture, but Switzer is a much easier grader.

Pretty boring. He's spent up to 30 minutes trying to fix his tablet for lecturing, and it happens a lot. Some final exam questions were based on his research, and that made it almost impossible to prepare for. Take Larsen... she will prepare you for the future.

He's way boring. You learn more from the book than his lectures. He looks like Squidward from Spongebob...and talks like him too. Come to think of it, he might just be Squidward. Tests are ok as long as you do the homework.
Great Professor I think.

I personally will not recommend those students  planning to take the MCAT to take this  Professor because he avoid questions and gets quickly irritated. He doesn't use his time wisely in class instead he always speak about his apple product. :/

His tests always have at least one question from the assigned HW verbatim. Averages on the tests are usually 40% and that's a B-. If you complain about that then you deserve to fail. His tone of voice sounds like he's fed up with college students and he tends to be sarcastic and avoiding towards his students.

This professor is seriously not helpful in any way possible. He is rude, sarcastic and he does not help students with questions. He always goes around the questions and waste time in class with his infatuation with apple products. His hand writing is not legible. I would not suggest him to any student. honestly. His test are average.
Hmm...Failed both midterms (way below average), got a 50 on the final exam, did average in lab, I passed! some odd reason I think EVERYONE passes his class.

If the book could talk, you would hear Switzer's voice. He teaches straight from the book. He's a super smart guy, but he is really boring because he talks to the chalk board when he is lecturing. If you read the book before lecture, the class is a little easier. His tests are pretty hard. He likes putting mechanisms on tests. Avoid if possible.

Even with 3 8x11 sheets of paper, filled front to back with every reaction/mechanism you could get from the book or notes, his exams are RIDICULOUSLY HARD. The class average for my class was MT1: 26, MT2: 38, and we just took our final (majority didn't finish in 3hrs.). Your only chance of passing is via the curve & lab scores (lab's worth final).
He always stops to drink his diet soda.  Very weird, but funny and nerdy.  He basically taught from the book.

Dr. Switzer literally talks to himself during lecture, doesn't even make eye contact with the class. He stops lecture frequently whenever he hears something, or has to drink diet pepsi, he breathes so hard you can hear it. Curve is great, avg= B-, his test weren't hard. Easy A if you study the book, don't bother with lec. he'll put you to sleep.

He lectures approx. ten minutes overtime for each class.  He tends to ramble on about one topic until he doesn't have anything else to say.  He goes in depth about certain topics-which is useless- and does not explain as well on other concepts.
do not take his class if you want a A extremely low averages, he is really hard
Extremely hard

best ochem professor. he explains the material really well and clearly and also makes the material more interesting. his tests are pretty hard but atleast u get to bring cheat sheets.plus he hands out tables as well. curve is pretty good- average is a B-. awesome guy! so nice too. he's happy to look over ur test if u dont think u were graded fairly

Switzer has tried to go more in depth and illustrate applications to materials obtained in class. He looks timid but he really cares for his students. His tests are not that easy, but you're expected to do well since you're allowed a 8 by 11 sheet  front and back on midterms and 3x 8 by 11 on the final.

best ochem teacher i had. related material back to real life which made it more interesting. if you get lost in lecture his office hours are really helpful. always ended class 10 mins early for questions. shy, but very smart. i never read the book, just memorized the reactions and went to lecture and got an A
Swizter explains the material pretty well and he's really hot

Very nice. He doesnt care about the grade but only care how much his students can absorb. His average is a B-, so if u keep 1 standard deviation above, u r guaranteed an A. His tests are very hard though, but u get cheat sheets (3 8X11" frnt&bck). Take him if u want to learn and not get screwed over.
He is a very soft spoken person. His grading scale kicks @$$. Hands out past exams as a study guide and those are quite helpful. Overall he is a nice guy.
No Comments
he is a very shy teacher; he never really looked at the class.  but he really cares about his student!
Great instructor, but his test questions actually require that you know the material.  I failed, but I can't blame him.
Real quirky. A good guy with a great sense of humor, but really sometimes does not relay info so well.
The class I took started at 8AM, so I rarely went, still managed a C+ with minimal studying.  Decent teacher from the times I went to class.

I didn't learn much from this course. Way too much time was spent on microecon principles instead of environmental econ ones. The final exam did not reflect what was taught in class. Caring prof and passionate but not good lecturer. The class needs better structure.

This Professor is like a high school teacher, he is not understanding, he doesn't respect circumstances that you'd be dealing with if you don't come to class for those reasons, and doesn't post anything online for you to follow if you missed a class. He also puts material in the tests and finals that you haven't seen in lectures or in worksheets.

Great professor, tries to keep the lectures interesting. Heavy on the Econ side & does touch enough on the ensc portion, unfortunately. Hard exams if not prepared, make sure to go over lecture slides and study guides !!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's a great professor! Easy A if u choose the grading method that includes attendance and homework scores with the exams. He honestly cares for his students and recommends ucr resources to us. Make sure to attend lectures, he grades attendance via kahoot only. Also don't leave after the kahoots becuz he'll call u out and it's really rude:/
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: The class is so hard most people I know struggled in the class.
Super interesting class and not hard to pass. Make sure you keep up with the readings in the text book and show up because he takes attendance through kahoot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: UCR needs to hire this man ASAP. Quizzes and tests were simple and based off the book. Lectures were pretty standard. You do have to do a group project so just be cautious of the timeline when trying to complete it. Considered me like his own child, which was very wholesome to hear. The BEST BUS 103 Professor ever!

He was mainly reading the slides and the extra comments from the Pearsons. He had personal and understandable background knowledge about the topics. Hes open to questions and does encourage participation. Homework is weekly relating to reading. To do well on the exam, understand the homework and study the past quizzes. Overall, he is good.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: A sweetheart that loves every student and treats you like a loving father. He will not let you fail that's for sure. He comes from the field and shares his experience in his lectures. There ARE weekly writings but there is no page or word requirement long as you answer the question. Book is useful for this class

Professor Tehrani is the best business professor I have ever had. His lectures align with the textbook, however attending his lectures he provides a lot of examples and room for open discussion. I'd love to have more courses with him at UCR!
Awesome
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He is such a great professor! Essay prompts require lots of analysis and thinking but if you go into office hours, he is always willing to help and point you in the right direction. He also assigned reading homework often and did quizzes almost every lecture on the reading. The quizzes were extremely fair and if you read, they should be easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Terill was great. He was super nice and helpful. His essays IMO were pretty difficult, especially the last one. But overall, he's great!

Professor Terrill is a Great eng1A professor. He is a considerate grader on essays & his pop quizzes are super easy as long as you somewhat read the assigned reading book. He is so funny and nice. Most of the time it's just him laughing about his jokes. I definitely recommend his Eng 1A class.

Professor Terrill is really cool and makes Eng1A enjoyable. The essays aren't too bad and the stories we read were interesting. He is very funny and helpful. He really seems to love what he is doing. Also he gives pop quizzes so keep up with the reading. The quizzes are super easy if you read though. Definitely recommend taking his Eng1A class.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He is nice, but he's an tough grader

I have taken 2 classes with him : ENGL 1B and ENGL 1C  If you are taking 1B, I recommend you taking it! It is less work than other professors. You will enjoy it!  BUT if you are taking 1C, try to get another professor! In Engl 1C, he grades MUCH harder and assigns a LOT MORE work than other professors. Plus you won't get a good grade.

I took Professor Terrill's course (at RCC) awhile ago, and I still marvel at what an incredible instructor he is.  He is very knowledgeable, takes twists and turns in his lectures to make the course more interesting, doesn't have an ounce of arrogance, is entirely open to a wide range of opinions, and does everything to help his students succeed!

A hilarious professor with a funny bone leaning towards dry humor. He is sarcastic in the nicest way during his lectures. He asks general questions and there are never really any wrong answers with him. Will always point out you have a fair point. Gives excellent feedback on assignments and during class. His excitement for literature is contagious.

Really nice guy, and makes the class fun. He provides PDFs for every single assignment/quiz that you need and more, so that you don't have to spend a single cent on the class. No homework assigned, only essays. If you go up to him during office hours, he will give very valuable and honest feedback.

Definitely recommend this professor! Super, super chill. There are pop quizzes, but they are SUPER easy-- I only sparknoted the books and I aced every quiz. No HW, just 4 essays. No midterms or final. Only downside was the class was always dead quiet because he never enforced participation. Can be a good/bad thing depending on you.

Professor Terrill is an amazing professor he is hilarious and very easy going. He will have pop quizzes which can be answered in one sentence or even one word if you did the reading. The reading is not bad at all. Feel free to ask questions or even throw in your opinion during class. He will never put you down or embarrass you. Would take again.

I would definitely recommend prof Terrill!This professor is really chill yet expects what he asks for.I read a good amount of books, but totally worth it because he goes over the readings the next day in class.If you ask for help and go into office hours he will definitely HELP you and give you GREAT feedback! By far the BEST English prof i've had!

He's really cool! Go to office hours if you need help with your paper. He will help you! Also keep up with readings because there will be quizzes in class. Overall, he's really nice and down to earth and willing to help.

Professor Terrill, overall, was not that great. His class was very boring, the whole time would be spend mindlessly talking about the readings we had to do for the class that day. None of the readings were even interesting at all. His essays feel really pointless a lot of the time, and he grades pretty hard. I wouldn't recommend his class.

Mr. Terrill is a fantastic instructor.  He uses a lot of analogies in class which help us understand the complex concepts that he presents.  I like that he treats us like thoughtful, intelligent people rather than "kids" - take his class!

Terrill is a pretty cool young professor. Not many in-class assignments. Outside readings are required though. Pop quizzes happen very often. I like his final. We don't have to wake up and get to school at 8. He has an alternative final. Besides that, assignments aren't explained clearly in class. Go to office Hours!

(Note: Class taken 2007 SSI) Terrill is probably the most down to earth, "chill" instructor I've ever seen.  There is little/no classwork, and the HW readings are really light and interesting.  The essays are easy/fun (just finished a satire).  Don't bother purchasing the textbook(s)... borrow them and photocopy.  It'll be $15 to copy vs. $150.

Did minimal effort in this class and received a 98%. Class consist of 2-3 readings /week with you giving 5 annotations, lifestyle change project, one 700 word essay, two exams, and Pollev in class. (w/ study guide for exams). They have clear criteria of what they want. They also provide e.c opportunities. Discussion was just talking about readings

Easy class. Make sure to read and actively participate in discussions. Do the hw.

reviews.comment: Not accommodating students and the disrespect towards students was actually insane. Please don't take this class, we aren't "exaggerating."

This is a fairly simple class. I've seen the ratings so far now and I think they are over exaggerated first years. While there is some work it's just busy work. Ik some had problems with their accommodations being met so that's an issue but after that this is an easy class to do well in. Two lockdown exams and the rest was project assignments.

And on top of that there's no curve when you take the midterm and final. I had to put more work into this class than my other classes combined and I'm saying this as someone who is taking an upper division course as well and that class didn't require all this work. When students tried to help when the midterm wasn't working we were called rude

reviews.comment:
This is a workload for an intro class. Feels like you need to know EVERYTHING for exams.

They don't seem bothered with academic accommodations unless pressed about it.

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! I'm sorry but I assumed teacher assistants were there to assist and not run the class. The professor seems to forget that she's the one in charge of the class. I wouldn't say they're tough graders but everyone expects something different from what is asked. You don't know your grade so you're completely in the dark.
