She was a great professor that graded hard. If you put in the work you will be able to succeed. Be sure to score really high on the first essay, she will give you the rest of the scores based on that. For me, I got a B+ my first essay and never got lower.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: - tries to make the class fun - tough grader: I got my roommate (she's in English 1B) and ARC to edit my essay -> I got a B-. -gives easy assignments - gives three late passes: If you turn in late assignment, she will give you full credit
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Tucker is alright at teaching but will lose track of what he is supposed to be instructing and will lose many students' attention. He goes on a lot of tangents that can distract from the unit he is teaching. The homework is online and there is a lot but not hard. There are 2 tests, a midterm and a final that are pretty easy.
Do the hw and make sure to not fall behind. Tests are super easy and he gives a review session before and shows the kind of problems on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Kind of a confusing lecturer but if you keep up with the homework, its an easy class to get an A in. Midterm and final we were allowed a "cheat sheet" for that we could put anything on that we wanted. Not very accessible out of class, office hours canceled/doesn't respond to emails.

Tucker is a nice guy, but I'm not a fan his teaching style. He wasn't engaging and kind of just talked rather than taught. He was a bit unorganized and would confuse himself. The notes didn't reflect the homework well. Homework is unlimited attempts online and exams are close to the practice ones.

I had Tucker in 2021, and attending lecture was more detrimental than helpful to my learning. He doesn't communicate well with students either. Overall, if you're okay with studying and learning by yourself, you're fine, and will pass, but lecture is kind of useless. Go to discussion though, easy points there. Kind of harsh grading for midterms.

Just to echo what a lot of people complained about, this professor is unorganized and he has sloppy handwriting which makes it hard to copy notes or understand. He often has to repeat himself in class because of this. During the summer, he would often say "ok" every couple of minutes so that would be annoying for most. He's a nice professor overall
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor wasn't bad actually, I just don't like his teaching style personally. He shows you how to solve it rather then teaching it. It wasn't really engaging. I wished he asked us questions like "so, what do we do to solve this?" He would ask them then answer them himself which was odd for me. This professor is good, take him.

Took Prof Tucker MATH 120 Spring 2020 when COVID first hit. Very understanding professor and teaches the topics extremely well. Homework heavy, but very similar to examples in class, and if you grind through the homework, the class will be guarantee A. Final/midterm just like practice exams. Has a pretty funny camera stand too lol

He is a really nice professor, but to be honest the homework is heavy. His midterm and final are very close to the practice version. And usually, if your final is higher than your midterm, your midterm grade will get covered by the final's percentage.

As a person Professor Tucker is great but as a professor, he is very disorganized and jumps from topic to topic making it hard to understand what he is actually lecturing. The examples he utilizes rarely if ever match the homework and I did not quite understand why we could not email him nor TA's for help. Is that not part of their job?
Very nice, if you do all the work required, you will get good grades. he gave much time on midterms and finals.
Overall good professor. As long as you do all the assignments and attend class. You'll get an A in the class. Be sure to ask questions.

If you do the assigned homework, discussion worksheets, and do the practice exams, this class won't be too difficult. He's very understanding and gave us lots of time for the midterm and final. He can be a bit disorganized at times but, overall, a great professor.

Professor is enthusiastic & patient. Her lectures have a lot of content & you'll wont be able to understand as much just reading off the slides. but there are recordings posted. But the way she explains it will connect each concept to the next (logical-based content) It's sometimes hard so you'll need to study. hw is easy & everything is open notes

She is a great professor who shows a great passion for this subject. She is willing to help you understand the material and prepare for the exam, but you have to be willing to read the book and study. She tend to speak fast, but asked to slow down she does. She will make you work for your grade, but it's not difficult just a lot of information.

Not the best lecturer. Hard to understand sometimes and pretty boring. Her lectures take up the whole class and speeds up a considerable amount at the end to "wrap it up". Uses tophat, a website for quizzes instead of a clicker that costs money that no one else uses. Easy A (with a hella big curve) if you study straight off the powerpoints provided

4 papers and drops the lowest, 2 mini presentations, 1 case study, no final and no midterm (instead papers and case study). Teaches with passion, loves what he does, respects your opinion, allows participation, gives extra credit, very humble person. No need of book, he provides readings. Took class although did not need it.

Tuthills lectures are engaging! He gives pop quizzes, and sometimes all you need to do is write your name for credit so make sure you go to class! He also offers extra credit! Be expected to participate! He loves to talk to his students and sometimes he will randomly pick on students so do the readings. You will definitely learn so much with him
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Tuthill was an awesome professor, and always gave good feedback. Lecture were pretty straight-forward, and he put them online as well. There were 5 quizes overall, a midterm and a final (both essays), and a presentation during discussion. He also gives extra credit, and is a pretty funny and cool guy overall. Get to know him if you can!

Fantastic instructor. Syllabus is clear. Must attend class. 5 quizzes, midterm paper (approx. 4-6 pages) as is final paper. Must make comments on five readings to submit, credit only. Enthusiastic, thoughtful, excellent lecturer. Funny and smart. Attend class, participate, read and do papers and everyone should do well. Some struggle with reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Passionate of what he speaks. Knows his topic very well. Patient with students, promotes participation, values student's comments. 5 quizzes (5 question each), gives opportunity for extra credit, midterm and final are essays, a group presentation. No book needed, he provides readings. Highly recommend him.

Charlie is one of my favorite professors here at UCR. I respect him bc he's kind & genuine to all of his students. In fact, he doesn't even want you to call him Professor Tuthill. No sir. He prefers just a simple "Charlie." His 5 pop quizzes throughout the quarter are easy & he offers extra credit. He embodies what every prof should be. Take him!

This is my first quarter at UCR as a transfer and I'm SO happy I took a class with Professor Tuthill. He's very good at elaborating and explaining his points. His class is very interesting and he does a good job of mixing it up so it's not always lecture-heavy (videos, current events, discussions). Overall amazing professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: There's five pop quizzes he gives during lecture. Two of them are free 100%'s. This class isn't hard, but INCREDIBLY boring.  There's a ton of reading, but you could possibly get away with not reading any of them. I read like 2 of the assigned readings, yet passed with a B+. One midterm and 1 final (both essays), and 1 presentation
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Yates deserves an updated review, as the course has changed. Midterms were replaced by a short paper and a case analysis paper. There was a final, but it was open-notes and we had a week to complete it. No textbook, since weekly article readings were assigned. However, this course was online, so some aspects might change in the future.
If you care about your GPA, avoid taking the class with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Class is alright. Exams are wordy which makes it tricky. I was excited to take this class at first but the professor has a bit of an ego which led me to heavily dislike her and the class, bit of a bummer.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: exams are difficult
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class was kind of hard, its a lot of content and reading. Her test can be a bit tricky, but most of it is straight forward. She knows her stuff and is pretty funny so it makes class a lot more enjoyable.

She lets it be known from the beginning that it's a TOUGH course! There's too much material to be covered in 10 weeks. She has extensive knowledge and compassion about this subject. Her lectures were very clear. However, due to the amount of material the tests were somewhat difficult. I struggled on short answers while others struggled on M.C
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Yates is a really really good professor. The class is deemed "hard" because you got people who think social psych is "hard." Abnormal was a really fun and interesting class. She is an amazing lecturer and the exams were easy if you put in the time to study.

tests were HARD but obviously doable, people were getting 100% on her tests. Very funny in class but I found her to be harsh during office hours which caused me to stop going, she made me feel less than and a bit dumb to be honest. Her class is hard, just do the work, go over lectures and you should be fine

HARD CLASS!! Exciting course, but she really doesn't try and make the class easy. If you value your gpa don't take her. Her tests tend to be really tricky. Fun course but really hard! 2 midterms 1 final 2 papers.

She is AMAZING! You'll miss out on your undergrad experience if you miss out on Yates. You DO have to put work into it...attend lecture, etc. She doesn't test you on anything she hasn't taught you, so as long as you follow her study guides (And study them) you'll be good to go. Again, she gives you these study guides before each lecture.

Yates is a wonderful and competent professor! You can definitely learn a lot from her if you just listen. She provides all the slides and key terms for the tests. Her lectures are interesting and informative and her experience in the field is noteworthy. Do the work, listen, study, and appreciate having an amazing professor.

Not feeling this class. All the people who said to avoid it are right. This class is hard for no reason. It just is. The lectures are ridiculous, because literally speaks at a million miles a minute. Tests are crazy, too. My biggest gripe with them is that they are just terribly worded sometimes. which is annoying! Just ask the question clearly.

LOVE LOVE LOVE HER! she is super nice, funny, responds to emails quickly. I don't have anything bad to say about her. I appreciate having her there as someone i look up to. She presents very clearly, connects with students if you make an effort, and has a wonderful personality

I dont know what everyone is complaining about. Tuppet is one of the best psyc professors here. She is approachable, helpful, and hilarious! Her tests are hard, but they are fair. You get out what you put in, keep that in mind when you read the negative reviews. Pay attention in class, stay current on the readings and you will do just fine.
This teacher is amazing. Her tests are hard but the material and the way she teaches it makes it all worth it. I would definitely recommend her for abnormal Psych

She is one of the best professors at UCR. Her class is very hard, requires a lot of effort and you cannot miss lecture. The tests are Hard but she drops the lowest one. The group paper was a mess, but she's stated she'll never do it again. It's an upper division class, so expect a lot of work, but you'll also learn a lot.
i cant stand her! worst professor ever, i would NOT recommend! she pics a few "favorites" but stay away from her! your GPA will thank you!
OMG why didnt i listen to those comments below. she is terrible. if you hate professors that try and trick you in exams and try and confuse you then you should take her.

Great Professor. She is hard but fair. I don't know what all of the negative comments are about, its an upper division elective class, they won't hold your hand. You have to do a lot of work but it's worth it. Great class and great teacher.

I know how everyone keeps saying how hard this class is, but it is honestly THE most interesting class you will EVER take! I LOVED Dr.Yates, and i found her to be such an intense individual, with alot to offer as a professor. She is also extremely helpful outside class. Even though her exams are hard, they even out at the end...so don't worry!
screw this class!!! worst class i have ever taken at ucr. ridiculous group paper and 4 HARD HARD HARD tests! she is rude and thinks she is better than everybody else
She is insanely hard!! Her tests are impossible no matter how much you study! If you want your GPA to go down the drain take this class! If not, AVOID AVOID AVOID!!!!!

i would not recommend! very hard!! many people in this class were in there for their 2nd time. i would NOT take if you have a better way to get elective credits.... i was shocked with all the positive feedback - she might be nice, but screw nice give me a passing grade!

the class wasnt too hard. i took it for elective credits and i really enjoyed the class. she keeps everyone entertained and i actually looked forward to going to lectures!! i would recommed all psyc majors taking this class, you WILL learn some crazy interesting things!!
Prof. Yates is the best psyc professor at UCR. Her tests arn't hard if you put in the effort, pay attention in class. You will actually learn things in her classes!
best teacher ever. she knows her stuff, no bs. her tests are kind of hard, but they're well-written. take her if you ever have the chance!

awesome, awesome teacher. her tests can be wicked hard, but she's honest about the class: she really knows her stuff, and you're going to have to know it too if you want to pass. the lectures are great, you can tell she puts some work into making the class fun. i love her teaching style, and i actually miss the class.
Dr. Yates is an incredible charismatic professor that teaches with passion and has a great sense of humor. Her lectures are always interesting and I strongly recommend her classes.

Tuppett is one of the best Professors at UCR. She is engaging and extremely knowledgeable in her field. She makes lectures interesting and truly inspires academic curiosity. If you have the opportunity to take her class, I would recommend it, it is an excellent learning experience.
loved her lectures. one of the few classes i attended all the lectures to!

She's funny and makes the class very dynamic which keeps everybody interested. She knows her subject no doubt about that. She talks really really fast however shes understandable. I think her tests are hard.

She definitly knows about the material she is teaching.  The class was interesting and she gets the students involved.  This is one of the first classes at UCR where I actually attended every lecture.  I would take her again!
The lectures are interesting. She sometimes goes off on a topic.  The test questions are tricky, so its important to read  them carefully and know the material.

She's great! She's considerate and incorporates films etc. into lectures so that we stay awake. She's funny and she tells stories about her practice experiences. It's nice to have someone that actually does what they're teaching.

he was not as bad as everyone claims. If u attend class and participate u get points, if u get them right u get extra credit. Claims of him being unapproachable are false. I went to both office hours and review sessions, the prof was very helpfully. His test are very hard but he curves hugely!!!!!

This professor is disorganized and clearly has no clue what he's doing. He should not be teaching. I only got an 'A' in the class because I took AP Physics in high school and still had my notes. (The only reason I was even in this class is because I never took the AP test.) If you actually want to learn, stay away from this professor.

HE IS A TERRIBLE PROFESSOR! he did not even have is phd before he started teaching. He refuses to do examples, takes everything out on the class. Very rude and unapproachable. His final was a graduate level FInal. I got an A bc everyone failed. Refuses to curve or speak to u if u need help. Never take this professor if you want to pass and learn.

She is actually a pretty laid back teacher. If you try & participate, you wont have any problems. Essays are easy as long as you follow the guidelines. DETAIL is key to passing her class. Not enough detail can mark you down a lot. Reading is important too. She loves giving quiz's.

She is an approachable teacher however, she is very unclear about what she wants on the essays and she is a hard grader.  I got an A in English 1a and 1B but Igot a B+ after working my butt off in her class, i do not reccomend her to anybody who is taking science classes because she demands a lot of hours of work, with all the HW she assigns.

Uvalle reminds me of high school! She is very strict and there r a lot of readings with frequent quizzes. She's very picky about how she wants you to answer questions for quizzes/essays. Very narrow minded and always wants more explanation. Too much group work for me. If you just stay on top of the reading and participate you will be fine.

Uvalle is very narrowminded. She's not open to accepting or listening to ideas that are not her own. She is unapproachable. Her teaching style is appropriate for high school, not college. However, it is not too difficult to get a decent grade if you do the work.

she is a good teacher for non science majors, but for science majors who just wanna fulfill the english requirement, she is horrible. very serious, impractical and strict. needs hw on time, quizzes in every lecture, and things have to go her way, otherwise u are screwed. i wouldnt recommend her to any science majors unless you like english very muc

She's a little unclear when it comes to HW assignments but her grading on essays are fairly easy. I always did my essays right before class and received a B for my overall grade. Plus, there isn't an actual final.

feels like grade school. u don't do the hw, and she drops a whole letter grade on the essay because hw is answering every possible question pertaining to ur essay in detail. gives u the hw outlined in the syllabus, then throws on more at the end of class.

TERRIBLE CLASS. Lectures are long rants that contain no real material related to learning about the basics of politics. Lots of reading; weekly quizzes are EXTREMELY difficult to study for—no study guide and unclear what to study and can be pulled from anywhere in the reading. NO study guide for exams AT ALL just have to wing it and guess.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing lecturer. One of the best in our department, for sure. Always ready to help, but you have to show that you care and stay on top of your readings, or else it is so easy to fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Loved this professor! Always willing to help, if you show that you care about the class and yourself. Takes his syllabus very seriously and is very clear with his expectations. Some students don't like him because he teaches a lot of information and they want an easy A. Definitely not easy A, but worthwhile A :)

I had no interest at all in Politics before taking this course. I thought this course would be hard in the beginning  but was pretty hard for all the work you do including a paper. I actually thought this course was very interesting as the professor has a lot of knowledge in Politics around the world. Do the readings and show up for class!
Great class and great prof! Always willing to talk outside of class.

Overall I felt that this was an interesting class.  He does talk really fast, so be ready to write fast.  The exams themselves were not difficult if you read the book and attended lectures.  I'm a Biology major and found the class pretty easy (if you put the effort in.  Do not need to be polisci major to do well.
Lectures are full of information. Very clear in his expectations. He is very willing to talk to you after class if you have any questions!

Worst lecture r at ucr. Hes really cocky doesnt share ppt too many parts on the exam and doesnt help students unless they are enrolled in ucr students wwth disabilities. He talks too fast and too much info are given at once
Great Prof! Always willing to talk during office hours, not just about class material either. Very helpful guy.
Interesting class. Exams were not bad at all, but you must do the readings. Covers a lot of material in short amount of time.
Very intelligent professor. Easy to follow lectures, especially when you do the reading.

Professor tends to talk fast so be prepared to write/type quickly through slides. He does not post slides. Read the book carefully because details will be on the exams. The amount of information can be overwhelming. If you aren't a POSC major or aren't interest in politics I wouldn't recommend.

genuinely might be the best professor at UCR. choose her if you can. She is very well organized and clear during lectures and thoroughly explains each assignment. Attendance is mandatory but come on we literally pay for these classes don't skip.

Super nice professor, go to some office hours for each essay to talk about what you are gonna write, super personable and wants to help, get on her good side. Lots of tiny mini assignments though for each essay.

I love this professor, I have been able to take her for english 1A and 1B and would 100% take her again. She cares a lot about her students, has very very good feedback, super positive, and overall just a great professor and truly cares about her job and helping us succeed. My favorite professor I have ever had.

I had Dr. Van Zandt during fall 2023 and she was absolutely phenomenal! She is so passionate about her job and genuinely wants the best for all of her students. On so many occasions she showed us flexibility in order to best accommodate for us. Her feedback on our essays was also incredibly detailed and helped me a lot in improving my writing!

This professor wont disappoint. From all the nice things she did for our class was honestly remarkable. I loved taking her class, even though I hate English. She understands her students, and wants the best for all us. Not only is she a caring teacher, but also teaches you to write a lot better, and be prepared for future writing classes.
The best engl1A professor. Super caring and understanding and let us write papers on stuff that didn't require a lot of research and more about thought and emotions.
One of the best teachers i've ever had! Her lectures were always very engaging and you could tell she loves her job!!

She's understanding about the covid situation and is really real and open as a person. She talks about important topics and really wants to be there for her students because she cares about mental health a lot. Even when she was going through a hard time, she still managed to show up to class. PLEASE DON'T TAKE ADVANTAGE OF HER KINDNESS!

She is very caring and understanding of everyone. She is aware that people go through a lot of hardships and as a result she can give an extension if you ask. The class is only graded on 3 papers and a final, you can even redo a paper if you ask her! Communication is crucial with this professor! Be kind to her and do NOT take advantage of her!!!

I took CVZ's English 001A class during fall quarter of 2020. Safe to say she is an all around great person and exceptional professor. She does require attendance to regular class times, but is very understanding if you have something else going on- just talk to her first. It is a good idea to go to office hours to get your essays looked at.

Best English professor there is. She is very considerate of you and understanding during these times. Only did 3 essays and she makes sure to give you the best feedback and room for improvement. She is very educated and talks about important topics. Overall recommend taking her any chance you get
Professor Van Zandt is a very caring teacher and she really cares about her students. Go to her office hours. It will really help you become a better writer and helps your grade in the class.

Wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that she is the best English professor in Riverside. I took her twice, for 1A and 1B and she really was amazing. If you are having trouble with English and especially don't feel comfortable writing essays, I would definitely recommend taking her class!

Dr. Van Zandt was such an amazing professor! I hope I can take her class again someday. Office hours were so helpful, and she shows that she really cares about you. She loves teaching, and you can see it in the way she interacts with students. We had 4 essays plus an essay for the final, overall easy if you're good at writing and you get the help!

She is not the easiest grader but she goes above and beyond in order for her students to succeed. She provides a Google doc to sign up for her office hours. 5 essays but one is a revision and another is a reflection of the class. No final during finals week, just the reflection essay. The final project presentations was eye opening. Would recommend

Dr. Van Zandt is an amazing professor. Her bubbly personality makes the class worthwhile to attend. Despite being graded by only a few things, she does take the time to give you constructive criticism and how you can improve on your papers. Her office hours were very beneficial and she is able to help you shape your ideas for your papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Van Zandt was an amazing teacher all around. She somehow managed to make English enjoyable for me. She is great.

She is one of the best English professors I have had. She was super caring and understanding to my two week absence at the beginning of the quarter. She encourages us to go to office hours and always offers her help. Her feedback was always helpful and clear. I would definitely take her again.
Very good
He makes you pay for an 80 dollar online course that is the most useless thing when it comes to English ever. I think an 8th grader already knows the things that they "teach" you in the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lowkey, $80 for the most useless information regarding writing tips that a junior school schooler knows, might the most horrible financial decision I've made in a long time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He does not teach anything and makes you pay 100 dollars for an online course that is completely and utterly useless. The online course is nothing but frustrating and a waste of time.
His class is straight to the point. Most students that ended up with bad grades did not bother doing the homework/essays or ask for help.

I Got an A- ... despite the fact that i thought i was going to fail. he is an understanding teacher. but really hard class. assigns useless assignments. and grades papers strictly. he said in class he has never given so many b's in his life. and he gave like 4 lol
He failed me and my other friends with a C- grade. all u need is a C to pass, but he does not give you any chances to make it back up. lots of readings, not an easy class.
Assigns so much useless english homework.

I agree. He probably failed more than half of the class. He can careless about you and your grade. For him, it's all about attendance, homework, and grammar. If you like a selfish prof., he's the one!
A very hard teacher, he fail over half the class! DO not take him unless you plan to invest huge amount of time in this class just to pass it.

Terrible professor. Doesn't show any interest in teaching. Throws so much information at you and doesn't specify on what to actually focus on for the midterms. Gets mad when averages are low yet fails to properly teach
Gives low effort lectures, mainly just pictures and expects us to know minute details for the exams based off something he skimmed over, mumbles a lot

Overall a very enjoyable class. Told us to focus on general concepts for exams and stayed true to his word, study guides are very helpful. We asked to move one of the lectures from midterm 2 to the final and he obliged. Grade breakdown as follows: 3 Exams at 25% each, Presentation at 15%, Participation and Term paper at 5% each. Highly recommend.

reviews.comment: 2 midterm 15% each (ave. 63/100), 1 final 30%, 3 worksheet 6% each (giveaway), 1 video review 7% +1 presentation 10% and other. read off slides dozed off after 15 mins, questions from the slides, multi. choices / free response/ true/false/matching--95%straightforward + 5% tricky questions. understand+memorize the slides. Stilldont know he he graded

Never attended lecture because I found myself fading out a lot due to his teaching style and the material. Just do a great presentation and proposal, the rest will sort itself out-if you study everything. Either way, the class looks more intimidating than it really is, and you walk out having learnt something relevant.

DON"T EVER TAKE THIS GUY!! I REPEAT DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS! WORST PROFESSOR EVER! Does not know how to teach (just read off his slides). STRAIGHT UP LIE TO HIS STUDENTS! He told us to focus on BIG CONCEPTUAL TOPICS and ignore in-depth details but on his exams it was the exact opposite. Also he put out zero effort for the class (No review & outline)

Honestly, one of the worst professors I have had. His slides are saturated with genes and proteins which he promises will not be tested on, instead asking us to focus on "general concepts," and then testing exclusively on obscure specifics. The final was the exact opposite of what he told us it would be. Very poor.
EASY. take him. quiz was a sign in sheet
MEMORIZE the slides. don't need the book. Tests are pretty straight forward. the "pop quiz" is usually during the last 2/3 weeks of school. easy A if you put the effort in
gud

The professor struggles with technology, delaying lessons and assignments. She ignores feedback and rarely engages with students. Grading is unclear, assignments come late, and the class falls behind because the schedule and syllabus are often ignored, creating stress and confusion.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Have you ever been shot by a machine gun? Because taking this class is the academic equivalent. I've survived some things, but nothing could've prepared me for Carole-Anne Tylers course. Walking into lecture felt like stepping into a battlefield where the professor just unloaded information at us like a malfunctioning machine gun BRARARARRARAR
Genuinely the most horrible professor I've ever had. Do yourself a favor and never take this course

I strongly recommend staying away from this professor. Lectures are unhelpful, poorly managed, and boring. Professor ought to reorganize entire Canvas template because it is dated. If quizzes aren't canceled, the questions found within are ambiguous at best. Students are forced to buy online books which are never discussed in class.

reviews.comment: Week 7, no assignments have been graded. Midterm questions are difficult to understand and she refuses to admit fault, saying it was our issue for not knowing what she meant. Refuses to tell us when the actual midterm is. Lectures are tangents that do not discuss assigned readings. Makes us read an entire novel, only to test us on random articles.

the absolute worst professor ever SAVE YOURSELF! we never talked about half of the readings and goes on extremely long tangents and then talks about the actual readings for the last 5 minutes of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not organized at all. Instructions for assignments were not clear. Hardly any lecture is worthwhile to prep you for the pop quizzes/ in-person exams. I don't think she's a bad instructor, but she's hard to follow when it comes to learning new concepts. She expects you to understand new ideas/concepts after reading 15 pages of reading material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Avoid at all costs, most confusing and rude professor I've taken at UCR. Consistently showed up late to lectures, and would get mad at/punish students who came in late. Did not prepare actual syllabus or grading scale until Week 8, and had to curve every assignment in the last week of the course because no one understood the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: this woman was all over the place. as a classmate of mine described it, the class was based purely on "vibes". Lectures are just rambles and tangents, there's like a billion parts of the final that are unnecessary, and she is always behind on grading. If you want a class that you don't want to pay attention in, then her class is perfect.

Behind on classwork/readings because she doesn't use +1hr class time effectively (personal stories). Does not update grades. No TA. Final has 4 parts (presentation, quiz, exam, and take home essay) all which is supposed to be done in 1 day??? Makes you pay for books on Perusal because you HAVE to annotate readings there for a grade. Do not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I'm not even finished with the class yet and I have so much to say. It is week 7 and I don't know my grade... she has not made it clear what she is expecting. She grades very harshly yet does not give beneficial feedback. Her class. makes no sense at all. I have no idea what I am supposed to be learning... Seriously, do NOT take a course with her.

reviews.comment:
No syllabus until Week 2, outlined that
participation isn't mandatory (it was).
Freaked over Chat GPT and assigned insane short answer response assessments to replace essays, which she graded harshly and unfairly. Never stuck to the syllabus or the reading schedule. Off-topic and crude at times. She scrapped the initial grade scale last minute.

reviews.comment: Do not take it if you love yourself. She needs to be more organized and grades everything at the last minute late. She Does not reply to her emails when you have a question. She would go off-topic about her life stories in-class lectures and make randomly inappropriate remarks. This classroom was so small that few people were only in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: shes my thirteenth reason <3
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If I could rate 0 I would. Took her for Feminist Novels and didn't know my grade until Week 10-11 aka Finals Week. She played favorites with those who attended office hours and did not question her ever. She was really rude and nasty in her grading, humiliated us on the daily. Worst professor literally ever. Honestly hope UCR takes action.

Professor Tyler should not be a professor. I have never struggled so much in one class nor have I hated a professor more. She grades so harshly and confusingly that by the end of it I don't even know my final grade nor how to amend my mistakes. She does not care about her students and it shows in how unaccessible she is. Do not take her!!!!

I would suggest staying away from any courses with this professor. She is very unorganized, patronizing, and very unprofessional in meeting deadlines. Each time I participated in this class, she has always nitpicked at my responses and made me feel horrible. Navigating this class and her off-topic stories during lectures are overall frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is the absolute worst professor I have ever taken. She did not grade one single assignment until the last week before finals week. When we finally did receive this ONE assignment back, it was PARTLY graded. She is not accessible at all and is painfully unorganized. I have no idea how she is a professor at a university. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS.

Would not take again or recommend to anyone. Professor Tyler was the most disorganized professor I have ever had. She would go off on tangents and never discuss the actual readings she was assigning. She always made excuses for not grading our assignments and didn't grade our midterm until week 10 when nobody could do anything about it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: WORST PROFESSOR IVE EVER HAD IN MY WHOLE COLLEGE CAREER. The main issue is the grading and assignment aspects. She does not finish grading anything and when she does its half done. She just clocked out teaching this class and when she was emailed, she said "she had a lot going on". OKAY?! SO DO WE? if you can't grade assignments, don't assign them.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took CAT's class 6 yrs ago. She's the most difficult professor I've had. At the time, I thought she was unreasonably cruel in her grading principles. I quote "This is not a college-level paper. The writing is very weak" but I realize it was me not putting in the effort. She's made a lasting impression on me as I enter mid-career well into 6 figs.
Don't ever take her class! She gave us the syllabus in week 4. Very disorganized!

Honestly worst professor I have taken. I went into my final barely knowing my grade for the class as she lagged with grading. Very unclear on her expectations and critiqued students work with by unnecessarily saying youre trying too hard to sound smart. Took her nearly 1 month to grade the midterms and again several weeks for the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Takes forever to grade. I went into the final not knowing my grade (every day, she would show up to class making excuses as to why she hadn't graded it in weeks), and she made the final harder to "help" her grade it faster... Is extremely condescending in feedback, and is outright rude to students. Don't take this class if you don't need it.

Worst experience I've ever had. I've never rated a professor, but I had to rate this one. We only had two assignments: the midterm and the final. The midterm was graded at the same time as the final, meaning I didn't know my grade until I couldn't do anything about it. Lecture heavy, attendance mattered, worked hard and failed. AVOID THIS TEACHER.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Please do not take this class. Even if it is the only class open by the time you register. You will regret it.

I would never willingly take this professor again. Disorganized. Tangent-laden. Verbose. These are the words I would use to describe my experience in this class. Class would start late, and it would always go over by 3 or 4 minutes. I did not receive my midterm grade until the last day of finals week! Do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Awful professor! She was unprepared and unorganized and made up stupid excuses. I dont recommend you take her in any class. She assigns reading and talks about irrelevant stuff. She gave a pop quiz cuz people weren't coming and was laughing and smiling at the classes b/c of her pleasure in our struggle. Goes off tangents and is very condescending.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Tyler is a pretty dry person in general. But all of her exams are take home, she is a hard grader on essays and exams because she wants specific things in her paper/tests. Tests consist of short answer and essay questions. She takes a long time to grade and we don't know our grade until the last few weeks of the quarter.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very unorganized and late to almost every lecture. She found something to yell at us about every lecture and her grading is very vague and unclear. Her website is also really complicated and unnecessarily overwhelming. She gets mad when she gets asked questions bc we should know the answer. Expects too much for a undergraduate breadth course.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She has a reputation for being hard, but she's not GPA breaking at all. Here's the thing: just go to her office hours, read through her essay guides, and read all the assigned material and answer the questions. Also, don't be mad if she doesn't grade right away. If you do the work, you should know what you'll be getting!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: grades arbitrarily and has an illogical system for determining final grades. I asked her a few days before the quarter ended what my grade so far was and she had absolutely no idea. she also goes off on tangents and barely teaches, and when students ask her how they can improve papers she offers little and vague feedback while being visibly annoyed

Warning. Don't take her class. Constantly talked down to her students. Expected doctorate level work in a lower division English class. Tough grader and had a complicated grading system for no reason. Hardly followed the syllabus. Spent 2-3 class periods on author's bio/maybe a hot second on the actually story content. don't recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She talks down to the entire class at least once a week, fails to grade 500 word essays in < 6 weeks, has instructions that are 4x longer than the maximum length of your essays, reads paragraphs off of powerpoints she doesn't make, claims shes too busy to grade, and has a random 300 word assignment count more than the final. Got the syllabus week 4
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Nice person, terrible professor. No consideration for students whatsoever. She overlaps on class time and we get out late every time! Oh, but when it comes to her time, she wants all consideration. You leave early, she takes you off the attendance for the day. If you miss lecture twice, your grade goes down. She does not understand life happens.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is by far the worst professor I have take at UCR. She grades her papers based on her opinion and does not take yours into consideration. Pretty much her way or the highway. The class itself is not difficult, but she is a hard grader. She lags on and on, making the class dreadful. I like english, but boy did she make me detest it.

She's managed to turn a Literature class into one about Art History. 3 weeks into the quarter and we have yet to speak about or look at a single text. Everything is overly detailed, confusing, and boring. This is an upper division class of English majors, and she's turned it into an Art class for grad students. Truly disappointing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: One of the biggest things that irked me about professor Tyler was that everything from her guidelines for papers to how to use iLearn was over-detailed and that made it really overwhelming for me. It made it difficult for me to focus on the assignments since I'm spending so much time reading through directions for a paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Tyler is easily one of the most challenging and yet stimulating professors in the English department at UCR. Take her course if you actually enjoy learning and are open to criticism. Her courses taught me how to write and think critically. She takes a long time to grade, but the copious feedback you receive is well worth the wait.

I regret taking her class. She is the toughest professor I have ever had. She is very smart and knows a lot about many subjects, but her lectures are hard to follow as she's very disorganized. She takes forever to grade assignments and she's super tough on grading especially on papers. I didn't feel like I actually learned  from her class.

She is a tough professor. She has a tendency to go off on tangents and she is such a nice lady people feel awkward telling her. However, she is very knowledgeable in a lot of subjects - you will definitely learn a lot but it is up to you to fight against the negatives! You will be working mostly independently. She does, however, give good feedback.

She is brilliant but tough. You must read/watch everything, attend lecture and hope you drew the correct conclusions. I didn't get any graded work back until week 9 (of 10) and we took quizzes on readings assigned as many as 4 weeks prior to the quiz. My advice: take good notes and try to keep up with the mountains of reading.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS OR ANY CLASS WITH THIS PROFESSOR. She is the worst professor I have had at UCR. She assigns work that she cannot even grade on time, and if she does her grading is strange. So, don't expect to know how your grades are going until the class is over. Her instructions for assignments are way too long and unclear.

Professor Tyler is definitely not easy, and I would not recommend her if you are not good at English. She is a very tough and picky grader; she does not grade things quickly. She is ,however, very helpful in office hours. She will look at all drafts beforehand. You get what you put into it.

I can't believe she is a teacher. I have never experienced a teacher so unorganized and rude. Her critiques on your papers will not make any sense, and will not follow what has been said in lecture at all. I was excited to take this class so badly, and now I hope I fail so I can take it again with a teacher who is ACTUALLY competent.
worst professor I've had my entire educational career. DO NOT TAKE ANY OF HER CLASSES. YOU WILL REGRET IT.

Tyler seems a bit unorganized as we didn't get our grades back until about the 9th week of the quarter, and we were always behind on lectures; this was mostly because of her propensity to humor the students when they asked off topic questions. Overall, go to all the lectures and make sure to ask her questions if you don't understand, she will help!

This is THE worst professor I have ever had. Super unorganized, very late on assignments and on grading(it's week 9 and we still haven't had our first papers graded). Spends the entire class time on one subject and fall weeks behind because she goes into tangent. I feel like I wasted my money. I don't know how she's still teaching.

EXTREMELY UNORGANIZED. Required readings that you never use for class. Assignments are never graded in a timely manner. Essay prompts and syllabus are long winded and confusing. (Syllabus was 14 pgs). The entire class was very unclear. She's a very nice person though. If you're confused, I suggest office hours on a regular basis.

This woman made my quarter a living hell!  Nothing was EVER exceptional for her, and her lectures were more confusing than the readings!  Didn't post a syllabus until the 4th week, and did not follow it - she fell behind and made it difficult to keep up with her.  AVOID HER,

Post final syllabus end of week 4. We all now have GD on our grades because she can't grade on time because she's "busy". Didn't get our 1st papers back (500 wrds) until then end of week 9. She had them for 6 weeks. AVOID if you value sanity.

I emjoyed her class&took it fall 2012. She is a good professor but is soft spoken. She gives alot of feedback on papers.Lectures=clear. You have 2 papers&a final with a 1 page draft for the papers. final is cumulative and hard and 20 MC questons plus 2 short essays.always a day or 2 behind. posted final syllabus week 5. posted final s.g day before.

Avoid her at all costs. She is very unorganized and takes a VERY long time to update students' grades. She goes off on too many tangents in class and we started our final 40 minutes late. She's a real nice lady but her organization  and choice of content for this course needs improvement.
Unclear, long directions for every assignment (5-8 pages)

Professor Tyler knows her material, but she is not a very good teacher. She is unorganized when it comes to updating her students' grades. Avoid taking any of her classes. I regret not dropping this class when I had the chance.

She is unorganized and uninteresting. She assigns SO MANY readings that she NEVER goes through in class. She does not post any grades whatsoever throughout the quarter. Even other professors said she is not a good professor. Honestly, sign up for this class with her, it's an automatic FAIL. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!! DO NOT!!

such a waste of time!!  do not take this class!!!  she is a terrible teacher and you won't get ANY grades back the entire quarter so you won't have a clue as to how you are doing in the class.  huge regret taking this class and not dropping when I had the chance.
Spends too much time talking, directions for a 2 page essay were 8 pages long and very difficult to understand. Do not take her if you can avoid it.

She can be hard, especially if you're not serious about class. Keep up with the readings, pay attention in class, go to office hours if necessary and you'll be fine. She definitely knows what she's talking about and can easily clear up anything that is confusing, so just talk to her. She is very detailed when helping out. You can't be lazy with her
Avoid her if you can! She knows the material very well but but she's a terrible teacher.

By far, the worst teacher I have ever had. The work is hard (mainly because her instructions are ambiguous and contradictory at time) and on top of that, I haven't received grades from any of the assignments so far this quarter, and Week 9 ends tomorrow.  I urge you to avoid this teacher, if you value your sanity.

Good luck staying awake in lecture. She loves the sound of her voice and will talk on and on about the most irrelevant parts of english and has lost the ability to communicate with her students. I would suggest not showing up at all for class, but she uses clickers, so you are just out of luck. The amount of reading/homework is not bad though.
horrible.

She is the worst professor EVER!!! She is condescending and not helpful.  She wastes most of the class telling you about what will be covered in class, but then she never leaves enough time to actually TEACH.  Then she gives extrememly hard quizzes and tests on stuff she never actually covered!  DONT TAKE HER!!!!
She is by far the worse professor on campus!!!! DO NOT TAKE HER PLEASE! Safe your sanity, time, and life!!
DON'T EVER PUNISH YOURSELF BY TAKING A CLASS WITH HER!!  IT IS THAT BAD!!

No syllabus. Gave an online take home midterm over a weekend worth 15% of final grade, then changed it to 25% because we "took too long taking it". Classes unstructured and boring. She is an associate dean which means you cannot argue with her on grading problems and expect to win. Not recommended for FILM students.

This film class was cross-listed with English, but most of the time I felt like I was in a foreign language class!  She was at least 5 minutes late everyday so by the time she got all of her stuff set up we were already out 10-15 minutes of a 50 minute class.  She got very far behind because she rambled on and on everyday.  Would not recommend.

This is by far one of THE WORST English professors here on campus. She is boring during lecture, she gets pissed of if you can not understand something and asks a question about it and she is not enthusiastic nor organized when it comes to teaching. I would AVOID her classes AT ALL COSTS now.
Avoid this class, lecture is extremely long and unorganized. Lecture seems to differentiate from readings. Speaks way too much for students to even keep up with notes.

I think most of us were grateful to have our tests postponed but all of the tests?  The syllabus went through ungodly morphs up until the 7th week (out of 10) and although it's clear she's very intelligent, her expectations for herself should be better.  If you are patient, you're good.  If you aren't forgiving, don't take her.

The professor has been teaching for a while, but evidently not long enough to know that perhaps she should change her lesson plan. She assigns way too many readings and fails to cover a lot of them;and when she is going over the readings, she does so in a fast and incomprehensible manner. If you have a brain, then do not take this class.

Professor Tyler is certainly not the easiest professor you will have. She expects her students to engage with the material and actually think (hard) about what is being presented. If you like your information spoonfed to you like don't take her classes. But if you are willing to put in the effort, you will be rewarded.

She assigns more reading than she actually covers and then expects you to know it all for quizes. we only got through discussing maybe a third of the reading but were quizzed on all of them. her explinations of readings are scattered and difficult to follow.  Readings had little to do with the two papers we had to do. Over all she was totally dull.

This instructor is very unorganized and makes unreasonable demands on students that she herself does not live up to. She reviews weekly readings, weakly...and never engages the class. On review of terms and readings assigned, she adds material that has nothing to do with any assignments. DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY IN ONE OF HER CLASSES!

She is eccentric but not a bad person at heart. She is shy and not the best at communicating but she will help you if you're a respectful human being. Teaching is difficult, so we should all cut people a little bit of slack.

Bad: She asks vague incomprehensible questions and wonders why no one responds. She doesn't show up for office hours. She will try to micromanage and appropriate your paper. Her social skills are abominable. Good: She really is very intelligent. If you rub her the right way, like a genie, she will help you find information. (Hey it's a crap shoot!)

demanding, intelligent, and eccentric, but if you leave at the end of the quarter without learning something, then you just didn't try. if you attend class, read the material and actually listen, it'll be the most rewarding class you'll have taken.
Unprepared
Disorganized!  Oblivious to the fact that students were completely lost.

Dr. Tyler assigned the most difficult material I have ever encountered.  However, if you're up for a challenge she is an amazing teacher and exceptionally helpful on an individual level. She is brilliant, and very open to varying opinions.
unprepared - never covered half of the syllabus, and spent most of her time forcing her own readings and theories down students' throats
She's unprepared and will lecture on films that we've seen months ago. I think people are just too intimidated to say anything because she's the chair for the english dept.
she's a great professor.  one of the most interesting film classes i've taken.
unprepared.  does not facilitate class discussions
Proficient in the area of film and gender studies as well.

Did not have a clear rubric and refused to clarify. Did not accommodate to students' schedules despite claiming to. Refused to talk about grading with students. Unorganized and long lecture. Goes over the 3-hour lecture time to ramble, using large words to explain basic ideas. Pretentious.

What is expected of the assignments is not communicated clearly. The grading standards are very difficult to meet on major assignments that vary between only 10-15 points each. The lectures consist primarily of discussion of required readings. There is not a focus on teaching students about certain topics and how to do the assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Grading is never clear and does not prepare her students for assignments. Would clarify assignments details the day of or the day before the assignment was due. Goes pasted class time every time, and is inconsiderate of others schedules. She requires a one on one meeting with her which is not during class time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Engl33** this was an online class and super lecture heavy. There's about five assignments worth 10 points and a final. A hard, picky grader but isn't clear with instructions and what she expects. Two mandatory books. Attendance is mandatory and a discussion is due every week and if you turn it in even a day late, you get no credit for the week.

She's not a bad professor. But lectures are unbelievablely long and rather unorganized. She assigns a lot of work for almost no reason.  Has even said she would assign us more if she could. Very picky grader but gives no exact clear direction. Very ambiguous and hard to follow.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really liked this professor, the syllabus and grading criteria was very clear. Every individual has to do a presentation, and mini papers throughout the course but if your okay without an A she gives you options of assignments you can do/dont have to do in order to maintain your wanted grade. I really enjoyed her way of teaching
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: Explained everything easily. One of the best MCS classes Ive taken at UCR.

Rarely had a sign in sheet was mostly graded on the 4 papers we had. Could have gotten by without going to class. She assigns a reading along with every movie and you dont really need to do the reading.

I took Professor Vint's Intro to Lit.: Science Fiction course, and it was really enjoyable. We basically read two short stories a week, and the professor gives detailed, informative explanations on the reading material. We had five quizzes, a midterm, one paper, and a final. Do the reading, pay attention, participate in lecture, and you'll be fine.

She is an extremely picky, hard grader unless one regurgitates exactly what she says in class. Her comments on essays are non-specific and unhelpful. Students can't be creative at all in this class. A LOT of reading; over 7 novels. Quizzes not hard but randomly assigned. I did not enjoy this class and I did not enjoy this professor.

So I took Sherryl's Scifi lit class because I was interested that there was even a class on the topic. You basically read the selected short stories and Sherryl will explain the themes and concepts of the story itself and what scifi is. There's random quizzes so attendance is crucial. She is also very approachable and great at explaining concepts.

Prof Villa is amazing. His lectures are fun and interesting. The assignments are very easy and the workload is manageable. He is not a tough grader at all. I wish I could take him for more classes. There's a group project that really could have been a 1 person assignment. Sometimes you get time in class to do assignments.

He is nice however he is a tough grader. Attendance mandatory, you will be marked down if you're absent even once. I wish he wasnt so political. Its highly obvious that he is very liberal minded. He has no consideration for 2 sides of the argument & pushes his beliefs in his own lectures & onto students. Wish we could study content not liberalism.

He cares about his students and communicates with them. His lectures are pretty heavy and attendance is mandatory. He uses "name tags" as a way to know if you entered the class or not. I thought I was doing my best but he can be a harsh grader. He also tends to walk around the classroom to see what students are doing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had! deeply cares about the education system and his students.

Professor Villa is a gem. Go to every class and participate to get the most out of his amazing lectures. Grades are based off of 4 critical reflections and a final paper. Do the readings to contribute to discussions during class. Extremely respectable and friendly.

Totally recommend taking this class easy pass! The professor is caring and funny during lectures. There's not to much work the midterm consist of a 5 min powerpoint presentation and final is a 4-5 page essay.

Although the class may be an "Easy A", Professor Villa is able to grab and hold your attention and is able to make lectures fly by. He absolutely cares about all his students and his self motivations made me want to take his class seriously. Obviously is very knowledgeable of the material I absolutely hope I get to take more classes taught by him.

Professor Villa is a real gem! He is always willing to help and while the class is a very easy A you do actually learn a lot and are given great readings and resources as future educators. Grading was based off of 4 short critical analysis essays and 1 longer final essay. Super doable and well worth it.

Even though I say this class is easy, it is only because professor Villa really takes into account who you are as a person and student and doesnt just give you a number grade. Grade is based off of participation in section and four critical reflection papers and one final 5-6 of paper. He is the best.

He's a little bit boring as a lecturer, but he is easy to talk to one-on-one after class. I always felt prepared for the quizzes because during the lecture he says which slides are going to be on the quiz. Solid overall and would take other classes with him.
Great teacher
would take again
Nada, great class

He speaks in a monotone voice and reads directly from the slides, so don't bother attending lectures. He graded the written assignments and the final project harshly and gave no feedback, which made getting a good grade more difficult than it should be. It's clear that he has no passion or interest in teaching, try to avoid him if you can.

Terrible at teaching, realized the topics weren't even that difficult, he's just very bad at teaching. He talks so much but does not actually give any real information that is important to know. His slides are horrible too, so confusing and indirect. To reiterate, he has no idea how to teach. Very unclear. Exams nothing like what he taught in class
Great professor but the class is heavy content. Use YouTube videos if you can. He's great at explaining concepts but his tests are weird and leave out information he says he would include.

This class is difficult however it is very doable. If you can self study to understand how to strategically solve the fluid mechanics problems you will do well. Just study off slides and practice exams. The homework and textbook are absolutely useless. Class averages for the 3 exams were 69%, 39%, and 23%. Very large curve and almost nobody fails.

I heard horror stories about this class and a lot of them made it seem like he's unreasonable. However he was organized and the assignments are doable if you put in the amount of hours he recommends (15). If you do well on one midterm and do relatively well on the project you'll probably get a B. His curve was generous, but still a tough class.

i thought i was going to get an F, most of class got a C, I got a D. I straight up bombed all the exams, but stuck it out. did okay on project, curve helped, you only need D- to pass this class. either way you're going to have to take this course, make sure it's only once. do your best, if you can. i liked prof as a person, but his exams were hard

get ready to have a 0% on most exams, full credit on hw and pray you get good teammates for the project. screw alan and his complete lack of respect for students, grant tried his best but honestly they were both useless, dr. rodgers is chill guy, big personality, terrible prof, gives out "confidence destroyers", best advice, survive, you'll pass

The avg score on our final was 12%. Hw is absurdly difficult and will take 6+ pages of handwritten calculations per assignment. There's 1 group project worth half your grade, w/ 3 presentations and a final report (and you can't choose your group lol). Dr. Rodgers is cool but his policies made this one of the worst classes i've ever taken.

Dr. Rodgers was very invested in the success of his students. He is willing to set up office hours around your schedule and is very flexible regarding homework deadlines if more time is needed. His exams were difficult, but doable if you understood the material extremely well.

There are many almost impossible homework assignments. There is one huge final project. COMSOL will become your best friend. 2 midterms . Don't be alarmed if your grade is a 0-10% on the midterms. He and his TAs take pretty much the whole quarter to grade anything.

Extremely challenging class. Unless you score high above the average on both midterms than you'll get an A, otherwise prepare yourself for an A- or lower. Concentrate on explaining your project presentation and REPORT. He is a super chill, straight forward professor. He'll practically go over test material the previous lecture.

He is a good professor.. Knows what he is doing but his test are difficult.. usually really low average. but he curves or that's what I hear.. I havent finished the class but i guess for a fluid mechanic class i'm doing ok

His tests do include really intrinsic details from lecture and book. He doesn't take attendance but going to class is kind of necessary.

The class is interesting & ProfWang provides his own insight, which is cool.. Until you find out the exam is on the most intrinsic details from the book. His slides provide what you have to read but the material is heavy and can be hard to grasp for some. He also will not help you with the group project. Leaves it to you to figure out.

Good professor, although his lectures are very long, he speaks with no filler words. I didn't get a 100 BRO the professor stingy, shout out to my TA, Rebecca Teagan,awesome, gave me the point. Take class its light work.

reviews.comment: Weems is great. His lectures can be really long and boring, but the class is pretty easy as long as you attend discussion because the TAs help with visual analysis and are very helpful.

The class consists of a midterm, 4-5 page visual analysis paper & a final that's similar to the midterm but on different topics in art. Discussion usually tackles what lectures are and are helpful for the midterm/final
His lectures are very interesting, but extremely tiring. He explains the subject matter in a easy way.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Boring course esp. the first two week about CA oranges. He is very nice though! And likes when you visit office hours and the project to visit and art thing was fun. He grades fairly and exams are easy just pay attention during lectures and take notes. The text book is NOT required and I wasted my money :( but it's a nice (big) coffee table book

His lectures can be intimidating since he speaks academically and most aren't used to that (like myself.) But after a while I got used to it and just made to sure to write A LOT of notes.  You're allowed to use some for the midterm/final. He's a nice guy and occasionally tells funny jokes. Visit him during office hours, he'll appreciate it.

An intelligent and articulate educator. This class is in the main vein of his work, so he is particularly excited to teach it. Lectures are important and his exams require source material from the readings (with notes, of course). Not easy, but if you have the time to put in and are interested in this time-period, I recommend this course.

Easy class just BOOOOOOORING. But hes super nice and likes hwen students visit office hours but he talks a lot then too. Dont be scared to ask for help or clarification because he will. Got an A+ Just dont buy the textbooks!!! Purchased for nothing but I was lucky it was only $30

Overall his class was really easy.The midterm and final were basically the same.I bought the book for nothing because he gives you the important readings on Ilearn. His lectures will put you to sleep and space off but its an easy class..OH and he might make you go 2 a museam.

Professor seems intimidating at first, but the guys sometimes squeeks. It is pretty funny actually. He knows his stuff so he uses very high vocabulary, but it is clear. He likes to ramble about paintings but trust me, it all makes sense after the midterms! This class will change how you look at the world. He's cool dont worry and not that strict.
he is a very nice and helpful and likes his material and love his subject i recomand him he gives study guide to study before the exam and wont let u mamorize most of it plus extra credit

Monotone, rambles, and a dark room is a recipe for sleepiness. Bring a pillow. Attendance is mandatory, you sign in every class. But overall its a easy class. No need to buy the book, just listen to his lectures and take some notes. 4 tests in essay format.

Good prof. The way he speaks can be confusing (you'll understand what I mean if you were to write word-for-word what he says..it's a mess). Wait until he gives study guide to read text; narrows down to 30 works on study guide, 8 on test. Connect each piece of art to it's place in history and try to explain the bigger picture and you'll do great!

Part of your grade is on attendance. There's only three tests and also offered some extra credit. You don't need to use the book as long as you listen and take notes during lecture. He tends to ramble and is pretty repetitive, but I thought he was pretty amusing and definitely knows what he's talking about.

Boring as hell... and must think your made of money because he insisted on using a brand new book that was 90 dollars and then you had to buy a course reader which was an extra 65 dollars and when i got it.. it was just a stack of paper.. it wasnt even bound together!!! so now i have to go and buy a binder to fricken put it in!!

FIRST OF ALL HE THINKS HE OWNS THE WORLD! HE LIKES TO TEACH WITH THE LIGHTS OFF SO NOT ONLY IS IT BORING BUT SLEEPY AS WELL. TAKE A CUP OF COFEE WITH YOU AND ENJOY A LECTURE OF NONSTOP MONOOOOOOOOO. BOY ONLY IF I HAD ANOTHER CHOICE! AND WHOEVER SAID HES HOT, UMMMM NO NOT REALLY ACTUALY NOT AT ALL

You find yourself writing the way HE talks...! You have to weed through all the adjectives to understand the point of his lectures.  The essays are long. Use as many adjectives as you can think of for the essays.

Professor Weeks could benefit from using more adjectives in describing paintings. Not everything is "fantasitc;" however, he is an intelligent man and one that we can learn a lot from. As a citizen of the world, it's a must that people know at least SOME things about art history. Take his classes.
Really cute, but EXTREMELY boring.  You don't have to read the book either.  You just need it to memorize paintings.

This is by far the most boring class ever.  He takes up the entire hour and usually a couple of minutes after as well.  There are over 100 paintings to memorize & the tests are long- all essay except 10 identifications.  Lost of reading but you dont have to do it.  He grades on attendence too.
The lecture are boring but hes sortof cute in a nerdy way. The tests are sortof hard but if you show up to class and get the daily handout then its not to bad.

BORING!  However I learned ALOT.  Tests are long and you've got to study well before hand.  Dont leave it to the night before.  TRUST ME!  You dont have to do the assigned reading.  I didnt and got an A-
I swear this man is a robot.  But he's still a nice guy.  Part of the challenge of the class is staying awake during the slides.  But it's easy to pick up on things he's looking for on the tests.
I dropped his class because he is the most boring person in the entire world! His tests are essay and you have no idea what it will be on. 50+ pages of reading a night.
No Comments
Prof. Weems was very willing to set up an appointment to discuss any problems or concerns I was having in class. He was very professional, yet easy to talk to. Way to go JW! Keep up the good work!

assuming kate watt = catherine watt, her lectures go off tangent a lot but sometimes they're pretty interesting ngl.

She was alright. Not the BEST. She gave alot of good feedback if you went to office hours, but it was difficult to get above a B-/B even though I continuously went to her office hours.

Professor Watt is really AMAZING! She's so kind, funny, and awkward! The essays can be long at times. She is an interesting lecturer with an clean assignments, but seriously do not expect an A.

Terrible.... Her attitude is terrible.. She allowed one student to talk about anything she wanted. Did not like her. Don't know how she is able to become a lecturer. DON"T TAKE HER!!!!!

Hard grader and rarely gives A. Gives us the prompt about a week before it's due. Never gave us a syllabus. We watched 3 movies and read 1 book and she only took attendance on the first day.

First 7 weeks are instruction, final three are essays, but she will take time  in office hrs to help you get an easy B.

Challenge her, she will challenge you. Apathy and disinterest lead to no more than a passing grade. I will always use the most important things that I learned in Professor Wattâ??s courses.
Ms. Watt was an exciting teacher who discussed zombies. She's always helpful during office hours and will brighten your day!

You never really do anything but sit there and listen to her talk during class. She never gives any work during class or homework really besides a few pages of reading. Though, she is kind of unorganized, lost about 10 of the students papers at the end of the quarter.

Ms. Watt is pretty cool. Her class was super easy. People mostly get B's because she's wayyyyy too nice to give C's (Even if a person's essay really sucks). I had no problem getting A's on my essays and honestly my writing was okay, not phenomenal. Literally all you need to do is answer the prompt and do MLA format. Everyone in my class liked her.

one of the worst english teachers ever. she never gives out work throughout the quarter, but wants to wait til the last week to pile up work. she judge your whole grade based off like two assignments. pretty dumb if you ask me.
She thinks she's funny, but her jokes are lame. She seems a bit **** as well. Rarely does any one in her class receive an A. Most of the time, people receive B's.

I took Ms. Watt over the summer and her class was fairly easy. She goes over what she wants written on the essays before hand. On top of that, all we did in class was watch sci-fi movies and wrote essays about then after. Highly recommended teacher! Although she might be a little awkward in class (with her jokes)

Despite of what others say, she is a good professor to take for English01B. Overall, it was pretty easy but she does require some reading, but not that often. She does talk for most of the class, but we hardly had any homework. I would highly recommend anyone to take her.

professor watt sucks, a lot. She carries a sense of humor,  and her class was a joke.
