DROP HER CLASS IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR GPA!

Ms. Watt is a little awkward, but really nice. Class was boring, but attendance is mandatory! The only thing that I didn't like was that she didn't believe in A's. Her class is an easy B, but impossible for an A.
Interesting class, fun to attend.

Kate Watt was an excellent English teacher, we only wrote four essays and the final was fun. She is always willing to help and truly cares about making her students better writers. I would love to take 1B with her!

WORST TEACHER ON CAMPUS!!! avoid her at all costs!! she is lazy, irreponsible, and cannot teach. she thinks her jokes are funny but they are plain weird. she is **** and thinks she is right about EVERYTHING...

kate watt is fat and short but shes really easy. our final was on the stepford wives movie. the paper were only 3-4pgs. her handwriting sucked but thats ok because she talked the whole class and we never did work. you dont even have to go. she takes attendance the first 2-3 days and then forgets. she likes to talk about tin foil hats. shes great

DO NOT TAKE KATE WATT!!! doesn't had out syllabus until 5 week or later and doesn't stick to syllabus either. VERY awkward and weird sense of humor. HARD biased grader because she believes a good grade is a "C" class is useless you learn nothing.
She is very unorganized. No class-plan whatsoever. All she does is tell stories about her dad or whatnot. She lacks of focus, though her easiness makes up for it.
she was a cool prof. Funny, lots of class discussions, and basically, learning with her was awesome.
She is funny, sarcastic,and nice...good teacher,patient,and willing to help at any time.  She wants u to learn...sometimes gives u extensions
so unapproachable, biased grader, not a very good teacher.

Grades hard, because she considers a "B" to be a "good grade". Weird, and sometimes awkward sense of humor. A touch unorganized, didn't even give us a syllabus until week 5. We watched like 4 moves/documentaries though, so it wasn't all boring. Handwriting is illedgeable, so if you get a bad grade, you can't tell why, unless you talk to her.

She is lazy and boring at times. She has a weird sense of humor. All she does is talks in class and isn't very good at getting students to participate. She isn't very helpful either. She gives Bs to Cs to all papers even after you let her proof read.

**** teacher - she gives B's to girls and C's to boys - she doesn't "teach" at all, unless you consider watching movies every other day teaching. She is unfair in how she grades and gets offended if you disagree with her. Avoid this person at all costs as a professor and as an individual. She seems like a cool prof at first but is totally lazy.

a little scary on the entertaiment side ("i will punch you in the neck") but is overall a good prof, easy to get ahold of. wants students to do well, and walks you through a lot. only complaint is her syllabus, it's not very detailed. read 2 books, 4 papers total. eng 1B is an easy class though too bad we are forced to take it. never used the book.

she's kind of crazy yet entertaining. always digresses in lectures so you dont really have to pay attention to her. you don't have to participate but attendance is required. doesn't grade too easily on essays. the class is an easy B.

She doesn't seem to understand basic logical concepts, digresses frequently, and clearly has issues. She has indecipherable handwriting, so don't hope to get much from her paper comments. Talk to her about her dog, and you will get at least a B-.
Her grading was not that easy.  However, the class discussions were interesting and funny.
Not a hard grader, very nice, doesn't follow the syllabus, but it's ok because she tells you what she has changed. Overall, I have enjoyed her class.

very kind and understanding person as long as you stay on her good side. essays are pretty easy - she gives you a basic outline in the prompt itself. she just isn't very good at sticking to the syllabus, but it works out for your benefit so not a big deal
She's helpful if you go up to her. Her assignments are kinda unclear. Not too strict and doesn't grade too hard.
She digresses often and is unclear in her syllabus. Does not give due dates for papers until like a week before.

Dr. Mannies was so considerate and kind! Her lectures are hilarious and entertaining, and the workload (3 essays) was not bad at all if you attended lectures and did the readings. She makes the material very comprehensible and is a very understanding and caring professor! Definitely one of my favorite professors at UCR!

Professor Mannies is great, her lecture are entertaining and the workload is perfect if you do the reading and show up to class you will receive a good grade. she is amazing. one of the best teachers I've ever had. would highly recommend taking her class since she is extremely entertaining to listen to. i went to class just to attend her great lectures lol

Reading is not as heavy but make sure you read and pay attention in lecture because on midterms she may choose quotes from the reading about the authors.

Whitney Mannies is my favorite professor yet. Her exams are super easy and her lectures are not boring at all. She explains all the course content really well and is very understanding. 2 midterms and a final, both easy. Plus heavy extra credit for perfect attendance and all homework completed. You get to bring a cheat sheet on her exams.

He doesn't require you to buy a textbook and posts lecture notes  power points from the lecture day instead. This is a great way of organizing. Don't need to go to class to get an A. Just do the extra credit

Interesting material: he really makes it fun. Great guy and always incorporates real-world application. Understands students don't love insects but it's a blast.

The lectures tend to get boring sometimes, but other than that this class was pretty good. The class material is not that hard to understand and his teaching methods were pretty good.  No textbook required for this class too, which was nice.
Easy if you study, 2 midterms and final. lectures aren't mandatory, but section is.! definitely the best professor to take entomology with! NO TEXTBOOK REQUIRED!

The only thing the other person was right about was that he's nice to look at. He gave us advance notice for every quiz & even sent out email reminders the night before. Really enjoyed his class!

Professor White may be hot like fire, but his teaching methods will burn you. His teaching is fast-paced and he's not very good at explaining concepts to students. He always has worksheets ready for every class. Don't take this class if you value your GPA.

Professor White though a bit monotone is actually a smart guy when it comes to Entomology and bugs. I enjoyed taking his class. He did polleverwhere so although class was mandatory no one started to go after week 4.
Hw is so easy but they don't expect late work. Grades are not clarified. Exam are hard due to the mass majority cheating causing other grades to go down.

Honestly SUPER easy as a professor, his discussions was just the TAs going over really friggen easy problems. Lectures in his words “you don't need to take notes all the info is on the slides” and his homework takes forever to do but very indicative of his actual midterm and final. He does relative grading centered around the class median.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: got an A- even though I did well on the final and homework. Final was straight from homework problems and was not too bad. The class average was a B-. He does not curve:(

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF. Several peoples in the class cheated, which brought up the average! Because of that, my grade suffered. I wish those peoples could be found so I could get a grade change. Also, this class is a lot of work since no questions are MCQ.

He knows the content but is a strong believer that students should struggle in order to learn, thus overcomplicating the midterms. You never knew what to focus on for study sessions and nothing would've prepared me for them. Very nice guy and good to interact with but the material is very discouraging and too much work!
Very tough class and a lot of work.  Very nice guy though. Helpful in office hours. I wish class was easier since all other classes were MCQs.  I don't like doing homework on paper.  Exams were hard.

Probably the worst professor of ALL TIME. clearly does not care about lectures in the way that it seems like he does not prepare (only cares about research) very strict (negative mindset) and diff grading scale compared to other classes (doesnt tell you). Hw is easy and tests arent bad at all but horrible lecturer (stutter cough, repeats in bad way

No grading scale in the syllabus. HW worth 30%, midterm/final 35% each, with the final replacing the midterm if higher. I had a 67% (D+) that dropped to a D-, how is 67% a D-? Everyone's grade dropped a +/- due to higher test scores. HW was fine, and test questions came from HW/lecture problems—just put it all on your cheat sheet and you're good.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hard class but very nice guy. Was helpful during office hours. Class average was high because people either cheated or did well, not sure. I wish the class was much less work though!

Exams were extremely hard and there was nothing to prepare you for them. Homework makes up a big part of the grading, and it is graded really hard, and ended up being the thing that dropped my grade. Professor did not curve class at all, and made the grading cut offs even harder.

Gosh. I heard there was cheating in this class, which raised the mean. I could have gotten a better grade if those dudes didn't cheat.  Professor was nice and all, but those who cheated ruined it for me.  ALso, this class was a lot of work. I wish everything was multiple choice.

I asked the professor to re-grade one of my earlier homeworks from 3 months ago after class was over. I want more points so that I can get gooder grade. He sided with TA. If I had got more points, I could have raised my score to C-. Super hard class! I wish exams were all multiple choice! Find another chem 001 prof. if you want someone easier.

Super hard class. Just got my grade for the final, and I did terrible because it was so hard. Kinda my fault though since I didn't go to class or re-read my notes/homework; final questions were similar to those. Very nice guy though. Previous reviews are right; if you want an easier class with less work and MCQs, find a different prof.

Reasonable guy but class was really hard. I didn't expect as much work as this. The other CHEM 001 classes were multiple choice exams and homeworks. I preferred those since it's less work and I could at least guess and possibly get it right.  Knowledgeable guy but way too much work than I'm used to.

Pretty difficult class! I got a 40 on the midterm; I never went to class, but I heard he mentioned what was going to be on the exam when I wasn't there. I went to his office hours for help, and he was helpful with questions as long as they weren't already on the syllabus. Nice guy, but doesn't take nonsense questions.

Super hard class and lots of work! I had to read all the notes and review all the homework to really understand this class.  I would have preferred to do much less work to get an A, but I'm getting like a C because I slacked off too much. I really don't want to work so much to do well

Yeah man. Lots of work for this class. I wish there wasn't so much work!!! I much rather prefer multiple choice since I don't like to study too much for exams. Nice guy though, but if you want someone easier, find another prof.

I liked this prof but there was a lot of work in this class. All homework was free response instead of multiple choice.  I personally don't like a lot of work in my classes, so if you want multiple choice, choose a different prof. Otherwise, a nice guy but a lot of work!

I thought Wong was pretty cool dude. Gave lots of examples as well as real-life examples that was relevant to his research and real life. Went to office hours a lot; was pretty helpful. Don't ask questions already covered on syllabus though since those won't be answered

I got a C but that's because I didn't do the homeworks, and some of those questions were on the exam. My bad. Anyway, I thought Wong did a good job. When I told him my situation, he was kind and gave me hints on exam.

Wong is an amazing lecturer and he gives examples on real applications. He does example problems in class and is very helpful during office hours. He explains things in an easy way to understand, and his tests are fair and things you have seen in class.
Got an A in this course. Exams were easy and could do it all in less than than time given. Exactly what he said: similar to homework and notes. Gives good feedback during office hours. Very nice!
Good prof. Very straightforward. Test questions were from notes and homework. Pretty easy. Gave good feedback during office hours and was nice (as long as I didn't ask questions already on syllabus).

do NOT listen to other reviews. He isn't accessible, he's condescending when answering ANY types of questions, he's not a good lecturer. He reads off slides and gives contradicting instructions abt lecture/ex. His slides aren't his.1 cheat sheet during exams. tip:his exams q's are straight from the hw/lecture slides even if he tells u they aren't

Overall Wong was a decent professor. Lectures are consistent, concise, and covers information relevant to the exams. His homework and notes mirrored his midterms very similarly, he rarely throws curveballs.

Just finished the final yesterday. Pretty much what he said during class: just like homework and slides. I went to office hours often and he was helpful. I didn't ask questions that were already on slides, so he was helpful

He was an ok professor, but you definitely have to put in the work and self-study. He didn't seem that passionate about teaching. Anytime I went into his office hours, his tone was kinda condescending & his explanations were not very helpful (he would repeat the slides or definitions). I did prefer his testing style with only FRQ w/ partial credit

Also just finished the final. Was pretty fair. I like the free response questions compared to the multiple choice questions in the other CHEM 001 classes. I learned a lot in this class and I think I got an A too
Just finished the final just now. Not too long. Could do it all in less than 2 hours. Exactlly what he said: similar to homework and notes. Great prof.

The midterm was quite easy since it was all from previous homework and notes. You are allowed a cheat sheet even! Prof was very accessible in office hours. He even stayed behind during class to answer questions. Great class.  I'm doing really well and got one of the perfect scores on the midterm.

I received a good score on the midterm.  I dunno what the previous review was talking about. All questions from the midterm were from homeworks and the notes.  If that person found it difficult, they didn't study at all.
The midterm was quite difficult, and no information was given about the exams before hand. You are allowed a cheat sheet.

Professor, thank you for your lectures full of insights. At first this course was very challenging and I was not able to catch up, but later through the quarter I studied very hard and became more and more engaging. Overall I am grateful to your instruction and all your help outside class. I believe those who worked really hard should feel the same
The professor's lectures were very understandable and the exams made you really have to apply the knowledge. Would suggest self studying his lectures on the topic or doing homeworks posted online.

I had to withdraw from this class due to personal reasons. Anyways, Wong is very sweet. Although their grading style may not be the best for everyone, even though I really did struggle in this class due to the content. They are a very kind and caring professor, and if you ask them a question, they will help you!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Clear lectures and answers every question clearly. Easy to approach outside class; gotta understand his lecture material and study the homework carefully.

He prioritized his research over teaching the material and when asked him a question about the midterm or final he would say he hasn't made it and get very agressive and say he's busy. He doesn't respond to emails if he doesn't like what u say and he makes u feel dumb. His criteria is clear and his exams are clear, just wish i knew what to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pretty cool dude. Studying for a final now, and Wong made it clear what he expected of us on the exam. Midterm was what I expected too. Better than most chemistry profs here

I got a perfect score on the midterm. Midterm was exactly like Wong said it would be like, so I just studied the notes and homework. No surprises. I think there were like 7 perfect scores or something. Totally predictable.
Great prof! Exams were as he said: very similar to homework and notes. Probably the easiest class I took this quarter. Professor very caring. Great guy!
Somewhat difficult class. I never had AP chem before. Professor was approachable during office hours. Midterm was all from homework

Lectures are not very helpful as he skims through material very fast. 
Terrible attitude when answering students questions saying how people should know things instead of properly answering the question. Rambles on during lecture as well.

Did not give info for exam as "I didn't write the exam yet so I don't know."

pt. 1
Thermodynamic is a really important course & Wong able to answer all your questions. Does lot of examples; fast paced

He has been extremely understanding during the pandemic. Lectures are short and focused on thermo problems that are like the exam and homework. We took a midterm styled as a homework. Many students did well with many full 100% scores. Genuinely wants students to learn.
Very clear in lecture and answers every question. Easy to approach outside class. You just have to understand his lecture material and study the homework carefully.

Good teacher. Lots of homework. Exams were actually pretty easy even though I didn't do well, but mostly my fault since I hardly went to class. I would have done better if I put more time in it though.
Very knowledgeable guy. Wish we could go even more depth in the textbook since a lot of material seemed to be covered especialy after the 1st midterm.

I thought Prof. Wong was a great teacher.  I received above average on the midterm and this class was easy. I felt it was basically an extension of 1st year chemistry that I took at community college.

Great class and awesome teacher! I didn't have experience with MATLAB before, but his lectures are so clear that things are easy to understand. Gave good help and had tutorial sessions. Always answered questions during lecture live!

Great teacher! I wished this class was longer so that I could learn more about MATLAB and all the examples he showed us in class. Very enthusiastic about the subject! Great lectures even though this was with masks and social distancing.

Prof. Wong was a great prof during the pandemic. He was so caring and made it clear that he was not out to get us. His lectures were very clear, and he even gave several examples "live" with MATLAB to show how it works in real time. A great guy overall. Very understanding during the online class!
Great class. Professor clearly knows his stuff. Class was easy.
Prof. Wong was one of the best professors for this graduate class. His lectures clearly show how much he cares for his students. No textbook was required for the class, which is nice and saves money.
Great and interesting class. Thermodynamics is not easy, but the professor makes the class interesting.
Awesome class! Prof. Wong has a very clear voice, and he really knows his stuff.

Thermodynamic is a really important course for engineers, and Dr. Wang is a good professor and able to answer all of your questions but make sure don't ask stupid questions, which he already explained. Exams are easy if you attend his lectures, of course, you don't have to but you will need spending more time for review.

Really smart professor. He definitely knows his things and is very precise with details. He remembers everything he said, so if you ask him a question, make sure its something that he hasn't said. He may expect students to be as smart as him, so come to class after reading. And hes really deserving of that chilli pepper if you know what i mean ;)
Great class! Easy professor! Exams are what he writes on the board!
Great teaching style! good policies, hes not out to get us. great personality and smart as hell. tests were simple if you understand his lectures, which you do.
Awesome professor.  Class was clear, examples were great, and wish this was a longer class
This class is pretty much perfect as is. I can't really think of anything I would change. The instructor is an effective communicator and clearly knows how to conduct this course.
Great teacher! Professor was always accessible and lectures were clear.

He isn't an awful professor but I wouldn't say he's good. He doesn't really explain everything when he is writing out the solution to a problem. He allows a cheat sheet on exams but there isn't a study guide or sample. The TA was really helpful because his discussion examples(and lecture examples) were very similar to the exam.

Professor Wrathall is inspirational. Get ready to read a lot of difficult passages in Heidegger's Being and Time. The beginning is rough but Wrathall does extremely well making everything comprehensible. Go to his office hours! Ask questions! He is very friendly and approachable.  Also, he is conspicuously a red hot chili pepper.

Great professor, obviously knows what he's talking about and loves the material. Absolutely need the book, and it helps to have the exact same translation. No slides, only talking during lecture. Write fast or have a laptop!

bit of advice, as much as i hate to say it you need the books for this class. pdfs, downloaded copies, or printouts will not be enough. There are many many parts that he recommends be highlighted and it is only possible to do so accurately and completely if you have the books.

Wrathall is a fantastic professor for existentialism. Apparently it's one of his favorite classes and this is apparent in how well he teaches the class. The books don't cost much, and aren't very long. He grades fairly, and everything on the tests (take home) are graded fairly.
Ooooh baby oooh baby!
Good teacher! explains very well and is a very fair grader. The class is also fun makes it interesting

Awesome lecturer.  One thing is that you really have to listen to the subtlties (spell check) of his lecturing--otherwise you'll realize that you wrote nothing down during his lecture; you have to write or type everything  quickly because everything he says is important.  If you take excellent notes and read, you will do well in his classes.
Great professor. If you read and do the study guides you are for sure going to get a good grade. I learned alot.

Okay. This professor doesn't use slides or the whiteboard at all. All he does is talk, so that means you should definitely write or type fast if you can. I recommend you read before the class too or else you won't understand what he's talking about.

PHIL 165: Wrathall is an accomplished prof w/ an impressive pedigree (Harvard JD, Berkeley PhD).  He lectures with great clarity and is great for ofc hr visits. He gives study guides for his exams; if you complete them, you are guaranteed to ace the course. My study partner & I did just that. We both got A+s. Take him if you can.

Very smart and accomplished professor who is experienced in the field of law.  Teaches this course with great clarity using layman's terms and real-life examples.  Challenging course, strict grading, but not impossible to do well.  He makes you interested in the material.  Tests are essay format which are difficult to complete in the alotted time.

Hard grader compared to the rest of the TAs. However, he really forces you to learn the material which the other TAs just kind of dismiss. He responds extremely quickly with legitimate answers and he takes it personally if he can't answer your question to the fullest extent and makes it a goal to find out in the end.
Awesome lab instructor.  Knew what was going on, and was kinda funny in a dorky way.
ungh sooo good will definitely do.. er, take again
AMAZING!!!
No Comments

He is very helpful both in discussion and during office hour. A hard grader, but what do you expect it is upper division. He responds to emails with a lightning speed and encourages students to do better. Clearifies lectures quite well too
very helpful and very nice. was always there in his office hours to help. Couldn't have passed chem without his help.

Did not care about students who were affected by the fires earlier this year (myself included). Got a B+ on the final and still ended up with a D in the class. He spent a lot of time arguing with students during lecture - time we could've been covering material. Unnecessarily tough grader.

He grades with a HEAVY curve so I went from a C to an A. Other than that make sure to memorize, memorize, memorize the concepts that he gives out to study before the exams. He will not give a study guide, but if you ask him to give concepts he will. Anyways do not recommend but if you need to take it just make sure to study hard.

This professor was extremely rude to numerous of my classmates, completely disregarding their concerns, which is unprofessional considering many students pay heavy tuition fees. The overall concept of this course was easy, but this professor made the exams unnecessarily hard and biased towards him by having multiple correct answers. Don't recommend
Really Bad Professor. Avoid at all costs unless you want to fail.
The amount of receipts people have on this man is crazy.

Constant typos and negligence with inputting INCORRECT grades, treating people's time and money like a joke refusing to communicate with more than a sentence answer with absolutely 0 respect. He literally told us to stop messaging him about our grades that HE's literally getting paid to correct. Multiple correct answers on each exam was ridiculous.

THE ABSOLUTE WORST. I'm telling you wait to take this class with someone else. So many ppl had grading issues and mistakes which he refused to communicate clearly with us about. Practically had to beg him to fix our grades after he went back on his word the FINAL week of the course. Him and his ta's LOST my exam and barely took any accountability.

His syllabus is poorly structured and confusing, making it difficult to understand expectations or how grading works. He wastes lecture time going off irrelevant tangents and telling random, unfunny stories instead of actually teaching the material. His class is frustrating and disorganized, and his approach to grading is biased and unprofessional.
take this prof if you want to fail this class

Professor is sometimes funny, but it still doesn't ignore the fact that hes a horrible professor. One of the worst professors here at UCR. He was previously a professor at CSUSB, and his ratings there say it all. Was rude when it comes to being worried about your grade, exams with questions stating "which answer is most correct". DONT TAKE!!!!!!!!!

This might have been the worst professor I've had here at UCR.  Wu does not know how to structure a class or stick to a syllabus if his life depended on it. Tests did not align with most of the material and required niche understandings of very specific comments made in lecture. Participate multiple times because he just lies about that too. 0/10

work load is light. weekly homework quizzes, 3 exams (worth 80% of your grade), and you have to participate in LECTURE twice. he was alright, his lectures barely correlated with the exams so you kind of went into it blind every time. curve saved me tho
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Unfair exams, avoid at all costs, worst professor ever!

I gave this professor so many chances. His exams are blatantly unfair and require niche memorization of facts covered in class for less than a minute. He had to curve the class by so much. I was supposed to get an A-. However, when I asked where my participation points went, he never gave me a straight answer and only claimed that I received a B+.

take this professor if you want to FAIL. his exams are based on the most accurate/correct answer there is not 1 correct answer but there is like 2-3 possible answers. he defends himself by saying that he isn't always right. might be a funny professor but taking his class won't do you any good, believe me this class will mentally drain you sm.

Test is worth 75% of your grade. Class average for the first test was an F and second was a D. Apparently he's going to curve depending how well we do on our third exam but I doubt the class will receive a passing grade. Please avoid at all cost unless you want to lose your sanity or will to live.
Lecture-wise he is alright. But his tests make me want to harm myself

Attendance isn't mandatory or really needed, the class relies on test scores and all the questions on the tests are "critical thinking". The curve for this class is steep, mostly due to the low test averages. The tests are mostly based on applications of the vocab taught in class, I used the vocab from the slides and textbooks to make quizlets.

Take this class if you want your social life gone and mental health out the window. She gave out so many readings and she expects you to read EVERYTHING on ALL OF THE READINGS in a short amount of time and have EVERYTHING MEMORIZED on exams and the responses have to be exact.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Very pleasant professor, happy to talk to you. Lots of readings, however it just takes a bit of studying to get good grades on her tests. TA is a harsh grader but just be sure to be very specific in your test answers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: If you wanted to find an easy gen ed class don't take any of her classes. Lots of readings are required and you're going to spend more time on the readings than your other classes. If you already feel bad about your grade, don't worry she makes you feel worse by pointing it out! The TA grades harshly and are both hard to approach.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Good luck if you ever take any of her classes. My social life was gone with the amount of reading assigned
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you were thinking of taking any of her classes for gen ed credit be ready to read, participate, and fail.

She doesn't post the notes and doesn't let students to take pictures of her notes to copy on their own. You're screwed if a test/quiz is based on her lectures. Unless you stay up till 4 AM to pass the class.

"There isn't much reading" and she gives us pdfs with 36 or more pgs.. She begs students to participate and picks on the class for not raising their hands. At one point she asked us to come up to the front of the class to answer a question, like we are not in hs bro. And she wants SPECIFIC answers to her questions. Js don't take any of her classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: So mean…

The teacher is very demanding, giving me the feeling that in high school, to answer questions to stand up, and must answer questions, will point your name to let you stand up to answer questions. You are not allowed to be late for the test, even if you are one minute late, you are not allowed to take the test again!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great and knowledgeable teacher.  mFun class

Her course has reasonable amounts of reading and testing. The course difficulty is not very high, but definitely participation is very important. Her grading criteria is fair and she doesn't grade the exams that strictly. No papers, but in class writing
Hard class, great teacher. Cares a lot about understanding the lectures.

Professor Wu is a very genuine and nice person. I really recommend you know what class you are signing up for. I personally find the class interesting and I got an A CHN46. She is a very fair and qualified teacher who takes teaching seriously.

My GPA was 3.85 before taking her class. She definitely never prepare for lectures. Her English was tough to understand with numerous "er..." among her words and always reading slide by slide without useful information for us to prepare tests. Her tests were really hard, even I studied a lot, nothing works. Also, the grading was mean, I got 59.

Overall, a good prof. If you simply read the assigned books & watch the movies, you will easily get an A/B. Lectures optional, but very helpful to clarify reading material & take better notes. There is NO final. Weekly quizzes, consisting of only four MC or T/F questions & 3 Cumulative Tests w/ short answer questions (pretty easy IMO).
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Clear grading criteria--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Yenna Wu is the worst teacher I have ever met in UCR. There is a quiz almost every week. And she just gives us 4mins to answer 4questions. For example, she sets quiz on 12:00. you must submit it before 12:04 unless you will be late. The content of her exam was very boring because I don't think her focus was on whether we actually read the book.

Took this in Spring 2020 and Yenna Wu is a nice teacher but the class is ridiculously hard. You have tons of reading and film watching to do, and weekly quizzes amount to high stress. The 3 exams are also difficult. If you do the readings you will be good but due to the length you'll be rereading them multiple times. Overall, this class is mediocre
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: really bad teacher. you will feel unrespected. She would hurt you in different ways. oneline class is horrible.

Online class is a bust. She deflects all responsibility and relies on everything for our TA to fix. Does not help answer students questions and simply states theyre wrong. Not a hard class, just unclear at times. When students complain to her she simply thinks its because of THEIR lack of effort which is not true. Truly disappointed
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She never understood the questions that students asked, let alone answering them effectively. The quizzes and tests are mostly about some irrelevant details of the assigned readings which means she only wants to see if we have read and remember but not understanding the essence of the story. Her lectures never help. Worst course Ive ever had
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Yenna Wu is a very nice person but she doesn't know how to teach online. The quiz time is super short like 2-3 mins The reading volume is heavy. She doesn't care if you have other courses. I submitted the answer within the stipulated time, the system judged as "LATE", and she also regarded my score as invalid. Never take her online class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Disclaimer: I only took her class to maximize my class time, so I do not have a high standard the course I enrolled. She is a good professor in general. She shows up around the time as supposed to, she is not strict on tardiness, and she only does what she is supposed to do-- conducting knowledge. She's just had too much expectations on me.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: One of the easiest and most interesting classes I have taken. Professor Wu was great, all she wants you to do is talk about the readings and shes happy. Theres a lot of discussion, only one presentation, then the mid term and final. Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Wu's class was a great experience for me. She provided much context and historical background for the traditional Chinese short stories we were assigned to read. She's available to provide students with feedback on tests, and give in-depth details on how to further your understanding for the class. She provides valuable insight to Chinese life.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Read like you've never read before. If you read all of the assigned readings, its an EASY A. Also, if you like exciting instructors whose dedicated to inspire you and fuel your education learning experience.. i suggest you look elsewhere.

Very passionate professor who really wants the students to learn and do well. I enjoyed her class and really got a lot out of it. didn't have to buy a textbook which was a huge plus. Show up to class, pay attention, and participate. What you put into the course, you get out of it.

She is such a good teacher. I had no interest in the class before taking it and I felt awkward going in because I was one of like 5 students that were not of Asian descent. I ended up loving the class because it turned out to be an interesting topic and she made it so great to learn. I recommend her as a wonderful teacher, you learn alot.

She's very knowledgable. Has a Chinese accent, but speaks English very well. Assigns a lot of reading that you HAVE to do (for the tests). Two easy double-spaced 1-pagee response papers. Watch a few Chinese movies. She's very nice. Knowing how to pronounce Pinyin makes the class easier to understand. If you like China, you'll like this class.

Hard because she seems to conduct a lot of her class in CHN and shows films without subtitles.  She gives out too much work but she is a fair grader and will usually curve the class.  Be prepared for a LOT of reading.  I like her classes but I always seem to not do well because I don't have enough time to finish everything.
Umm... not very clear and very ****.  Assigns too much reading especially for us non-native speakers.

I took her for a year of chinese. She's an educated lady who is very concerned with the student's learning. She will bend over backwards to make sure students learn, unlike other professors who don't care to see students fail. She is very strict, and teaches more in a chinese style manner, but it's not a bad thing. She is a really good professor.

have taken many of her classes and I'd say she's a very helpful and caring professor.  she tries hard to get students involve in discussions, sadly a lot of students don't do their readings and slowed down the discussions quite a bit.  cheating is a big problem in her class tho, especially certain group of girls who should remain nameless....sigh
She's really nice although sometimes it feels like she doesn't understand the questions you are asking.  Very easy grader on papers and as long as you do the reading, it should be an easy A.
I was interested in the class but now I think it's a boring class. You gotta do the readings. She doesn't lecture that much at all. You have to learn on your own. But I guess it's an ok class.

Professor Wu is a very kind teacher. She is patient, and makes sure the student understands the material. On top of that, if you ever need help for anything, she is willing and happy to help you. *two thumbs up! =)

her class is very boring. she wastes a lot of time calling out names to answer questions (went down the roll sheet till someone knows the answer to her questions, TOTALLY UNECESSARY) She tests on stupid little details instead of the main point.
No Comments
High expectations and with alot of arrogance. Class curriculum discussions has no relevancy to the real world. Class points are based on memorization skills, instead of understand of Chinese.

If you like to learn on your own, take him! He does not do examples in class, they are all conceptual definitions and theorems. Going to lecture is pointless because of this. You wont be able to do the homework by just going to lecture. Office hours were helpful for homework. But youtube and google will be your best option to pass his class!

Easy, chill teacher. recommend taking, got an A- in his class! he gives the TA's what he is gonna put on the midterm/final so if you have a chill TA then you have nothing to worry about. I didnt do much of the homework, just go to class and ask office hours and you'll do just fine! :)
His class really is boring. Hes a nice person but he sounds like a talking book. Very easy though. He give practice problems that are harder then the actual exams.

He's really nice....go to office hours ull learn more. U have to study on ur own which isn't that bad...a lot of people did poorly in my class and got D's on the final however this helps for the curve.I got a B...easy midterm and quizzes, alright final. Just study!!!

He is a REALLY BAD professor. His lectures are soo boring I fall asleep in class everytime! Only one fourth of the class shows up during lectures! Really hard to understand and requires you to study on your own and learn from the book! The average was 85 in the class! Super Easy Tests but don't learn anything in this class!

I dread coming to this class just because it's so early in the morning and his lectures are pretty boring. I don't understand his way of teaching very well when I'm in class because he's pretty unclear but going to his office hours help. I like his grading though!

Yo!!! This teacher is a great teacher!!! He does have an accent but it's VERY understandable...He is an EASY teacher and I went to his office hours 4 times and he is REALLY helpful if you ask for help. He explains everything STEP by STEP, you just gotta be focused in lecture & do the homework, sample midterms and finals are harder than the actuals!
Very easy class, but with little thanks to his accent. Go to his lectures early and secure a front seat.
not so great of a teacher but he's very easy. he usually uses some examples from the book when he explains most of his concepts. just study on your own and you'll do fine on his tests.
He explains everything step by step
Easy teacher. Take him if you want to have an easy class. even though he has an acent, his notes is pretty clear. Homework problems are identical to the quizes
Nice enough professor, but the concepts he wants you to understand are pretty complex and the exams present them intentionally as more confusing than the way he explained them.

Let me start by saying he is sometimes hard to understand because of his accent. But he is a very very good teacher who uses many demonstrations. My fault I got a C-. I did 2/10 homework and failed them, as well as failing the final and midterm. Dont ask me how, but dont think it happens to everyone. read HIS book and you'll do well.
Funny guy. cool experiments. buy the book for extra studying.

This class was not the easiest since his slides have tons of info. It's all memorization basically. The HW is tricky but you have TA's to for help. I got 100% on the hw by e-mailing my TA. I got A's on the two midterms, and got a C for the final. Overall grade thanks to curve: A.

The first teacher to give me a B+ ... I've had a perfect record until this teacher. Alot of memorization, especially Einstein's wrong theories.  You HAVE to go to class & make sure to bring your laptop, because he has alot of notes & slides ~3-4 pg typed  20% curve though. But still, the first midterm was super easy, 2nd & 3rd(final) super hard

Only half way through the quarter but I love the professor! He has a funky sense of humor but his lecture slides are definitely difficult to comprehend and take notes. He uses a ton of visuals that help make sense of things. Seems very helpful. Midterm was killer, you have to know more than what things are, but also how to apply them to modern day.

The lectures are very boring, but he tries to make them entertaining with several demonstrations. No need to buy the book. All you have to know is his lecture notes. The questions on the homework and tests are a bit tricky. Just do the homework and you will be good. I ended up getting an A

grade is based on 2 midterms and hw, disc not mandatory. Ta's dont care if u dont go, very unpersonal. Tests are somewhat difficult especially if u dont study. But he is super awesome to watch cuz of his examples. its obvious he loves his job. He does get a little carried away, but overall He's awesome!!!! cute in a wacky scientist kinda way

Informative and fun, PHYS 7 with Wudka is a perfect science class for Humanities majors. Wudka makes up for his poor lectures abilities with excellent power points and physical presentations. Also, the fact that the class was curved about 20 percent did not hurt.

Perhaps I was wrong about the guy. He had a generous  curve. He tries to make the material interesting but there's more reading than necessary and the tests can get annoying. Just understand the online lecture notes and you'll get an A.

I had him for Phys 2C first. His lecture were boring.. so I never went to class. Pass with a C. I also had him for Phys 7 the  next quarter. Had to admit that in Phys 7, he was more interesting... and much easier. Maybe because Phys 7 is a Humanities course... but Wudka is a nice prof. and helps you if you go to office hours. But if you're gonna ta
Nice guy. but test questions are ridiculous. Advice if u dont want a bad grade take with another professor

Jose Wudka contradicts his own teachings. He tends to overcomplicate things for extravagance and the result is: poorly written notes, rambling in lecture and the MOST awkward homework questions you will ever come across in your life. And this guy got his Ph.D from MIT.
No Comments

You have to be quite DENSE to not at least pass this class. His midterms contain ten questions and his study guide is DIRECTLY related to the midterms I had just mentioned. I admit the final gets kind of tricky but if you do well on both midterms and BOMB the final, you will at least get a C.

He'll lecture on about something on a pretty animated powerpoint, but during the whole 90 minutes, you'll basically learn one significant thing that you'll need for the midterm. Luckily he curves the final grade so that you'll need a 50% to get you a C-. His english is hard to understand and his homework is frustrating, but it's not a hard class.

who gives multiple choice exams for physics? I hate him. He stutters and rambles to himself which makes it difficult to concentrate on what he has to say. His teaching methods are terrible and unhelpful. I tried speaking to him but he made me feel as if he didn't care and want to be bothered. sucky

WACK Teacher.ALL exams were multiple choice.Physics is based on partial credit, you don't always get the right answer.Horrible Curve..hardest physics curve out of all the physics professors. Teacher does not explain anything just reads off powerpoint= confused students= students not passing AVOID!

he relies WAY too much on powerpoint, since he just changes the slides and reads right off them, then rambles about SOMETHING you can't even put together. 2 midterms, 10 pts each multi choice, final 36 pts multi choice. bad curve!

Very easy professor - I went to lecture maybe only 20% of the time, got an A+. He reuses questions from previous years that he will tell you the answers to at his office hours. However, there is a reason I didn't go to lecture much - it's pretty boring.

this guy really gets into the material, but despite his jokes, still manages to make the class seem LONG.  his severe accent makes it easy to not pay attention. class wasn't required, lecture notes were online, i stopped going and got a good grade.
Boring, yet funny when he gets into it.  Very generous in extra credit but the material really sucks!

This guy is just...weird. I can't even describe him because I don't yet think that word has been invented. He's nice, but I don't know what the hell he's saying/doing in lecture. He seems to ramble on and go off on weird quirks.
I can explain it.  He is like a boring hippie.  Stay at home.
Go to class and pay attention, reader is unnecessary if you do. TA for this class sucked. Tests weren't too bad if you knew the information. More math than I was expecting.
Wu is awesome there is no denying it!!!  His accent does suck at times since he has a quiet voice, but if you go to class and pay attention you'll do fine.

Dr. Wu was very fair. His homework assignments were not that bad, also his exams were based off the homework and review questions. Very approachable. Lectures are boring though, although the guy tries to be coo in class.
I think Dr. Wu is an extremely fair teacher. The tests are based off the homework and review questions. Study that and you should do fine. He is a very nice and approachable teacher.

He is so cute! I agree! He is sometimes hard to understand but he loves what he does and everything is explanatory. Make sure you go to discussion, and do the homework and review questions. thats basically the test. really easy studying if you are up for reviewing all the work you already did for the homework.
he's so cute I just want to hug him.
he's a nice teacher. has an accent of course. just do the homework and understand it as well and you will do fine.
Great teaching style! good policies, hes not out to get us. great personality and smart as hell. tests were simple if you understand his lectures, which you do. =D great prof.
Dr Wyman is a great professor. He really cares about his students, but he lectures by using powerpoint instead of working out examples.

Very useful class. Lectures right out of the book, notes are photocopied pages of the actual text. Exams are really simple compared to the lecture and if you can follow the homework which is a majority of your grade anyways, you'll do well on the exams.

He was a very easy professor. His accent was a bit hard to understand, but he taught multivariable in the simplest way possible. He gives helpful feedback and advice during lecture and office hours. He also gives a practice midterm and final and grades very leniently (grades off either ranking or actual percentage in class - chooses highest grade).

Attended lecture only once a week. I think he's very fair and is eager to help, however, there can be miscommunication between him and the students. It's the TA's that grade everything. That being said, go to TA office hours more for clarification and a lower chance of being confused by the prof.

At first it was hard getting to the swing of things because of his accent and the lectures were a bit confusing at first. But after a week or two the course content becomes a lot clearer and easier. Practice a lot of problems outside of the homework and you'll see that the class is easy and can actually be fun. Grading scale is very rewarding
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Xinli is an amazing professor that understands multivariable calculus fully and explains it very well. He teaches at a good pace, gives reasonable amounts of homework, and it always available if you need extra help.

This class was crazy easy. He hands out a Midterm review, and it is exactly what the midterm is. I felt guilty. If you are looking for an easy A in math, take this dude. But if you want want to expand ways of thinking in math and go above and beyond, dont take this professor. He is super nice and caring, but his lectures dont help. Read the book.

He wasn't a bad professor, but I just didn't find his lectures useful. The way he explained things made the material a lot harder for me to understand. My TA really helped me understand the material. The material isn't hard, you can teach yourself from youtube videos or the book. 1 midterm, Final, quizzes in discussion section and online homework.
Why isn't his rating a 5.0?
reviews.rating_tags: Inspirational--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The course had rough points but overall it went well and Xin Dong definitely cares about his students and ensures they succeed. Definitely one of the easier Math courses on Campus.

Nice personality, good lectures and easily available outside of class. I enjoyed taking his class. Most of his exam and quiz problems were closely based off of the examples he discussed in class, so attending his lectures is a good idea.
Love his class. Highly recommend him!
He is intelligent and cares about students. The lecture improved quite a lot during the quarter.

He tailors office hours to the students' availability, but does not directly answer students' questions. He only focuses on the most basic examples in lecture (the book is more helpful). His tests are very straightforward.
Best professor 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: The professor would make lots of mistakes and fail to correct or explain himself. He even messed up a problem on our midterm but failed to drop the question or curve the test. Honestly the worst class I've been it. The subject is simple but it's very difficult to pass when there is no help and errors in tests.
Dr. Lin was one of the great topologists and one of UCR's great professors.  His loss will be deeply felt.  May you be in a better place, Professor.
He makes numerous mistakes on the board and does not complete most of the proofs. He often enters the class with no preparation at all. Shame.

Very interesting class.  The professor is funny in his own way.  His tests are tricky/interesting depending on how you look at it.  Study the sample problems and you'll do fine.  There are suppose to be 8 HW assignments but he only gives 4 :)

What the heck is the point of drawing pictures all lecture and not being mathematically rigorous??!!  At the graduate level, you MUST see proofs.  He expects every student to learn the proofs BUT he NEVER proves any of them.  He's a very unfair grader when it comes to exams.  I'm shocked he's getting high marks here.  Write like a mathematician!!!!
Very interesting class.  Lots of reading, discussing and presentation.  As long as you go to lectures, join every discussion, you will get an A+ for sure!!!
He is very patient and very helpful with homework questions during office hours!!  His sample tests are very similar to the actual tests, too!  I recommend this teacher!!

one of the best teachers at UCR. friendly, smiles alot (you'll see.) his exams are extremely similar to his practice so if you do the practice you will ace the exam.  got a B+ but only because i didn't do the HW :)
Not a good teacher but his test are quite similar to review problems. Hardly ever went to class and got a B+

BUS146 was great. While he didn't really lecture much, he played lectures by others that were just as informative. Rather, he was more of a resource for our projects that we worked on. This is probably the only class that I did any hands on, practical work in. Learned a lot and had a lot of fun. Work hard and it's an A. Expect lots of group work.
One of the best professor's at UCR, very engaging with his students.  Come to class, learn how to do the problems, do the homework and study.  His exams are difficult, but he curves very nicely.

Professor Pan is amazing. He actually finds fun, interesting ways to get students to understand the material. Students were participating and discussing the material in relevant ways, and he knew the answers to everything that was asked. Also motivates students by telling them not to stress and just do their best and they will succeed. Best prof!

Awesome teaching style! Dr. Pan puts an emphasis on learning and understanding the material, rather than just regurgitating a bunch of vocab.  In addition he has the class do pricing simulations which, although sometimes nerve-racking, are really quite fun and a great way to learn.
Helpful, knowledgable, attactive personality. Best ever Professor I had so far.

Very interesting & useful course. Extremely knowledgable, motivating, & caring professor. Great amount of learning and enjoyable experience. The best professor I had at UCR. I felt like a priviledge taking his course. Register early -- the seats got filled up overnight and many students stood in the class on day 1 with the hope to get registered.

Very knowledgable and humble!Always nice, fair to everyone Encourage students to their best. Very well prepared and organized. Attractive personality, always dressed up in a pleasant manner. Best professor ever at UCR.
At least for statics the tests werent bad and the grading scale was nice. He was a bit hard to understand but I think lectures were OK. Also he is very nice and chill
Very chill and nice teacher. The grading scale was good, and the tests were pretty fair IMO, just stuff from the homework. Lectures could be better tho.

He is a very caring professor, I can tell that he wanted students to understand the material. The exams are identical to the hw, and hw is 50% of total grade. Make sure you understand how to do them, else you will fail the class. Downside: if you mess up one small step, you get marked off by a lot.
He's a very nice guy, but he is bad at teaching the material for dynamics. Best to read the textbook/ watch online videos/ letting TA teach discussion.

Professor Xu was a pleasure to have. His exams were challenging but fair. He cared a lot about the progress of the class as a whole and more about actually teaching the ME students than making them do unnecessary things. Beware of his final. He will throw two very challenging questions that few will get right. But there is somewhat of a curve!
Isn't very helpful going to lecture, and the exam questions are from the book. Reading the book as a primary source and doing the problems and going to class after is a good way to pass with an A.

Professor Xue was fantastic, he is able to explain complex material easily and clearly. He answered my copious amount of questions with many details and was straightforward. All in all, 10/10. He is very easily accessible outside of class and he gives out EC during lectures, if you email questions relating to the unit, he will also give EC.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The class is basically a mash of ochem, genetics, and biochem material, which sounds scary but its very surface level stuff and he tells you what to expect on midterms. Super chill prof with easy to read slides. We also had to write a research article summary 1 pager and a 3 paged research proposal, which were pretty interesting assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I thoroughly enjoyed taking this course with Professor Min Xue. Although he is not the best lecturer if you do the homework assignments and keep up with them, the material is quite easy to get. He is quite helpful and made lecture entertaining with his memes. The two midterms are a bit difficult but the final is way easier so do well on the final.

Min Xue is great, he really does want you to pass. Lectures are the usual but he adds memes to them which make going to lecture not that bad. Definitely recommend him. He writes his own exams so you gotta pay attention to lectures. Some problems on the midterms come from examples from the lectures. quizzes in disc. but not graded, only for practice

Amazing professor, makes Chemistry enjoyable. Curves generously, adds memes to lecture to make it worthwhile, no quizzes in discussion and leaves it all on his students as to how to utilize resources (wont force you). He doesn't have a heavy accent at all and is really kind in office hours. Allows a cheat sheet for midterms and two for final!

I love Professor Min Xue! I scored a 47 on the first midterm (5 points below average), 57 on the second midterm (average), and then a 200/200 on the final because his extra credit boosted my final score of 180/200 to 200/200!!! Plus, the homework is pretty much the exam so study it. I ended up with an A in the class!!!

This man is a legend. This class was one of the easiest classes I have taken at UCR. To prepare for his tests, DO THE SMARTWORK and do extra practice problems with variations. He allows a cheat sheet on the test and try to read the chapter before entering the lecture in order to understand what he is talking about (gives you a better understanding)

Great professor!!! Prepares you for exams. Best teacher I have had at UCR. He handed extra credit out like it was candy. The test were really fair and exactly like what he said they would be. Attendance isn't required. I only went to a few lectures, however he is a great professor who was engaging and made chemistry fun. Power points were helpful.

She's a really great professor as long as you put in the effort. You won't get lost if you email her for clarification or see her during office hours. She can go through material fairly quickly, but as long as you let her know you don't understand, she will try to explain it to you as best as possible. Great prof, seems like she actually cares
Do not go at the ease of the course, she can torture you up at will. very bad at basics, UH must consider on sticking back to her.

I am doing my hornor thesis with her so the easiness doesn't apply for this case but she definitely is very helpfuls and her instructions are very clear. She is one of the awesome and nice professors that I have met.

She is relatively boring, but at least she tries to teach even though she knows are accent is a barrier. And watch out for her test, they were just straight up memorization, nothing conceptual, but make sure you memorize every slide even the minor details because they show up.

Class requires memorizing, but it is clear what is important and what is not. lectures are simplified versions of the book so if you don't understand her in lecture it's easy to refer to the book. not a hard class if you up in the time

her notes are really simple and repetitive, and she boxes everything that you need to know for the exam. but she's not really that helpful if you ask her questions, and her exam questions are ridiculous since they're all worth the same amount of points per question - the MC and the free response.
Her materials were straight forward so make sure you know her lectures well!
Easy stuff. She indicates on her lecture notes exactly what you need to memorize for the test. Her questions are pretty straight forward too. Sometimes she's hard to understand because of the accent.
Worst person of the year

Xu is a very easy teacher. He sucks at teaching and wastes a lot of time in class. If you want an easy class and self learn, then take his class. Prepare to spend a lot of self studying time. Quizes are worth 40% of grade, no midterm.

All of his tests and assignments are easy.  They are almost all modified examples from his lecture notes.  If you take his classes, count on getting an easy A or B, but don't count on learning the material unless you want to spend the time reading the book on your own.

Fairly easy teacher but he still expects you to know the material.  Be prepared for hard/never before seen stuff on the midterms and final.  Class taught at a slow pace...  Go to lecture and you should be good.
Yadong is such a innovative teacher! He has helped me countless times and through the ups and downs of life. What a great guy he is!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Professor Yarding Yin is an amazing professor! He made learning CHEM 1C material so easy! His lectures and his slides are very helpful and he always tries to help students learn the content on a deeper level. He encourages people to question during class and his exams were fair and he also gave extra credit! One of the best general chemistry prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Class is a breeze, I haven't studied for the tests and I have gotten above 90%. Love this dude too he is hilarious in lectures. Tests are easy labs are a little tedious but easy. Take this for an easy A.

This class is an easy A. The lecture slides are amazing and they help you a lot when doing the homework and preparing for exams. You don't need to do that much work in that class and I know you will do great :)
This class is very lenient in terms of grading. Pretty easy 'A' as long as you attend discussions, do the homework, and complete the practice tests he puts up before every exam.

Overall Yin was a decent professor. Lectures are consistent, concise, and covers information relevant to the exams. His practice tests mirrored his midterms very similarly, he rarely throws curveballs. However, be careful of the final, as the final was extremely difficult. Study hard, consistently and you should end up with a decent grade.

Good chemistry professor and cares about his students. Gives practice midterms that are similar to the actual exams. However be warned: his final exam was not easy and a lot of people were not ready for it.

Out of all my gen chem professors, yin has to be my favorite one. He's very passionate about teaching chemistry and his lectures are pretty straightforward and easy to understand. Before every midterm provides us with practice tests that are very similar to the actual exam and made videos explaining how to do every single problem. Highly recommend!

Professor Yin is amazing despite the 5-week Summer course. His lectures are very informative and explains a lot with details on the concepts. He's also very helpful during his office hours where he gives better explanations on problems you need help with. Exams are entirely similar to practice exams, study them and you'll do fine on the real exams
He's so nice, and truly cares about his students. Class isn't too bad. His curve and tests are fair and he is always eager to help.

Professor Yin's lectures can be a bit on the dry side, but he truly cares for his students. Easy midterms. Final includes bonus questions for extra points. Generous curve. Yin hosts office hours everyday from the last week of class leading up to the final so all his students should be more than prepared to take the test.

his lectures are sooooo boring. but the tests were pretty easy. exactly like the practice exams with numbers changed. not too bad of a professor but felt like the class a dumbed down a bit compared to my friend's professors
Yin is a nice guy and wants to help students, but hated his teaching method, he uses slides straight off the text book!! if the averages are low he tries to make test easier

Let's get one thing straight: the guy is boring. He is however really smart and cares for his students. If you attend class, you will be rewarded. He did a great job making the last two exams very easy. An A is very obtainable. Take him if you want an easy chem class.

One of the nicest professors at UCR. He is very helpful and does his best to help students not to fail his class. Attend lecture, even though it might be on the dry side, sometimes he goes over problems that are straight off the midterm.

Midterms are just a breeze given midterm reviews.  The final was a blizzard storm.  Study hard my friends!  Dr. Yin is extremely helpful!  His lectures are interesting.  Sign up for his class if you get a chance!
Don't take this class, get any other professors if you can

Avoid this prof at all costs, literally anything else is better! doesn't grade until week 9, unclear grading scale, won't curve, final is 40%, lectures are extremely dense, and exams are on the smallest details. offers extra credit but it's so little it doesn't make a difference.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
Need to know scientific names of literally everything, common name, methods, years, numbers, any detail you can think of. Final is 40% of grade.
Extremely slow grader, no grades submitted until week 9 or 10.
She's so nice and approachable, I'm terrible at dancing but as long as you put the effort in and attend class it will be easy.
Best dance professor ever. I'm quite literally the worse dancer in the world, and she was very accepting and understanding of my troubles.
She was so amazing. This professor was very easy and it was fun. This was my first dance class and it was SUPER EASY.

She is one of the sweetest, most approachable, and passionate people I've learned from while attending UCR. English isn't her first language, but she still effectively communicates all the necessary things. Not only is she a good teacher overall, but she is just SO COOL!!! You will not regret taking her class

Took DNCE005 in Fall 2022 and was the best class I had. She's super chill and teaches K-Pop. So if you're into K-Pop, then it's perfect. You really just have to show up to get participation points, she never grades on your skills but rather on your efforts. The final is just a one-page paper on K-Pop. She's super sweet and I absolutely love her.

Professor Li was a great professor. He makes learning R Studio very simple and his lectures were very helpful to use on the homework. There are lots of assignments but there are also a lot of extra credit to earn in the class. His class is very straight forward and there is only a take home midterm and final group project.

The content was difficult but Dr. Li did a good job of making sure the class understood what was going on. Now that I look back on it, his tests were fairly straightforward and his quiz questions came directly from his notes. Be prepared to dedicate a lot of time into this class or you won't pass
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Had Dr .Li for 160A and 160B which are some of the hardest classes that a Stats major will have to take. The class is by no means an easy A, but very doable! He allows cheat sheets on the test which can be useful; however, his tests definitely test whether you truly understand the material. Overall a great communicator at and a very likable guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The class and material itself is difficult but he himself is a great teacher. I was excited to go to every lecture and be taught by him. Homework only once a week, easy points! He curves your end of quarter grade and is just very generous and understanding. He also teaches 160B and Im excited to see him the following quarter.
Do the homework, review the slides for the midterms and final. You will do fine
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He explains concepts and theorems clearly. Exams are comparable to homework problems, though the time constraint can add difficulty.

AVOID FOR 114. Very hard two midterms with a low average. His practice midterm or final does not help at all, and including the homework. Most questions require double integration to solve. Other 114 professors did not require integration at all. Class is full of theorems. One of the worst professors I ever had at the EE department.

The lecture is BORING, but it is not his fault. This class topic is all about dry theorems throughout the quarter. 2 midterms and 1 final and there are only few questions on them. Cheat sheets allowed. I suggest you understand and write all of theorems on your sheets to get these questions right.
Great, caring professor
One of the best professors I've had! Great teacher overall who makes material digestible and fun! She is also so inspiring :)
Sam is a very fun professor and is very understanding

Sam is one of the best ENSC professors. Class had no tests but open note and online quizzes. She was funny, caring, sweet and super knowledgable. She makes super boring material really interesting. The lab is lots of outdoor hikes/field work and was also relatively easy. She's the best
Projects are always the same through the years except for small differences. You'll be fine if you read everything, and grasp the major concepts. It might not be easy to get A and A++ though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: The class is hard to begin with but he makes it worse. His anger management issues don't make things any better either. Tests aren't too bad but the lab instructions are very confusing and you will be asking classmates for help. No curve from what I can see

Yelled at office assistants in front of nearly 100 students because he was locked out of his computer (not their fault). Average midterm grade was ~60%. No curve. Lab assignments are 35% of your grade but instruction is unhelpful and criteria are unclear. Condescending and dismissive towards students. Take with another professor if possible.
He is a good professor but a tough grader, but as long as you get comfortable with his standard and lines, you will be fine in this course

Disturbingly petty towards students. Offered Zoom and then got upset when students used it. Constantly paranoid about students cheating on the quizzes and very patronizing.

Homework was unhelpful and did more to stress students out than actually help them learn. Labs felt like a chore and had a lot of gaps that students were forced to fill in.

He is a fair professor, the syllabus outlines everything. He gave us extensions on labs when we needed it. The HW is difficult and time consuming but its small in number and doable. Labs and Final are fair. Only issue was the midterm, average grade was like close to 50% but he was understanding and gave us an opportunity to rectify the mistakes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very inconsistent professor as he would randomly extend deadlines an hour before things were due. His lectures are extremely dull and boring just like the Mojave Desert.

Professor Yin is a decent person, very accessible outside of lecture, and while his lecture aren't the best, he does take time both in and out of class to help clarify. However his assignments and labs instructions are very vague, and you have to piece together information from different discussion to find out what he wants you to do for assignment
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Held my core grade by 0.425 marks. Expects a 10 on 10 for a B- and his teaching is 1/10. At the end of the quarter, added a assignment for 15% which was a project for 40% in other professor's advanced operating systems.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lectures are a mix of proofs and examples which he does by hand. He does a good job explaining the steps and is always open to questions. Go to his office hours for any additional help. He is very helpful and open to questions. Tests were straight forward, they were similar to HW and he allows a cheat sheet with any info.

Dr Hua may not be very engaging and seem distant during lecture, but he is very kind and helpful when you ask questions in class/office hours. He's extremely passionate about the subjects he teaches, and is very thorough in explanations but you need to reach out to him first. Assignments are very straightforward, but course is somewhat disorganized
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Hua's lectures are very helpful if you actually ask questions and do the homework. If you go to office hours he will help with the homework very thoroughly and he is very available for OH. However, if you just chegg it you can get a C.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Hua seems really awkward at first, but he warms up to you. He is actually really nice and very helpful when you ask questions. But make sure you do or else he will just do proofs the whole class!
Tests are pretty difficult. Very helpful teacher if you go to his office hours.

Soooo Boring. People started dropping out of class and he decided to start taking attendance. During Lecture he only does proofs and there are no examples done. Homework rarely has anything to do with lecture. Book is not helful either.
This guy doesn't know how to teach! Worst of all, he doesn't care about his students and he ditches his own lectures!
He sucks!
Worst teacher in UCR!
Got bored reviewing 110B for 4 weeks. He tends to begin proving things in lecture without any context, and is generally unclear sometimes.

Her lectures tend to be a bit boring, but she really wants you to learn. Feel free to ask any questions, and she is very accessible via email. Homeworks are long, but you get only 5 or 6 per semester, and lowest one gets dropped. Labs every week, and if you're not in class it can be hard to solve on your own. Easy grader.

Yang Ye is an amazing professor. Last quarter almost half of the class got an A. This class is based on a curve, so as long as you get above the curve, you can get an A. This class isn't an easy A. Study your butt off. Ordered 2 books and lectures were heavy. Read a ton and quizzes every 2 weeks. Our final was also on a Friday.

I took a total of 3 classes with Professor Ye. There's a lot of reading but it's manageable. Lectures go over reading and background but you must read it yourself to pass the tests. 4 tests, 1 midterm, 1 final but if you go to class/do reading you should have no trouble at all. Discs. help a lot, must participate in those. Assign great readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He explains and reads the poems with you. A good tip that I suggest is to use flashcards. It helped me A LOT since he quizzes you on what the character means in that sentence. There are many cases where one character means one thing in a specific sentence but could mean something else in another sentence.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Ye had a simple and clear course structure and reading is the only homework you have to do. His lectures are structured to pinpoint exactly what he wants you to take out of each reading (he knows you can't memorize the whole book). If you read, come to lecture, participate in discussion, and ask questions, then the class should be easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Not only is Professor Ye passionate, but his quizzes and tests are so that those who attend lecture will do well on them. The reading is 40-60 pages.
