You have to participate twice in each discussion, and there is a point for attendance. No take home essays,4 quizzes,2 tests. Just attend the lectures and read and this FIVE unit course is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Uploads lecture outlines but expands on it in lectures. Everything on quizzes and exams are based on lectures. Discussions and participation (in Disc.) are also part of the grade. Prof. Ye is wonderful, enthusiastic and passionate about literature. Quite a bit of reading but it's all manageable.

I'm still taking his course at the moment, but honestly Professor Ye is one of the nicest and most fair professors at UC. He cares about what he does and it shows through his lectures (which, by the way, you should try very hard not to miss because everything on the exams and quizzes are covered not to subtly during lecture). Make sure to keep up!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Ye is a decent professor.. Not gonna lie, it's very boring. You have to really read the material and pay close attention because you have to be aware what passages he reads during class for the midterms and final. Going to lecture is VERY IMPORTANT. If you choose not to read, you will fall behind and not do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Ye is a great professor who shares his passion for literature with his students. You have to keep up the readings in order to do well on the quizzes, but as long as you attend lecture, they're straightforward. Overall, his clear-cut grading criteria and passion for lit. makes this an interesting class and Professor Ye a great professor.

Ye is very specific with what he wants you to know. However, he wants you to know quite a lot. Very large amount of weekly readings, and discussion participation is 20% of your grade, so get ready to read a lot and talk a lot.

Toughest class ever taken as a GE or lower division requirement! Don't take this class unless you are willing to read and memorize all the crap from the books. There are 4 quizzes (40%), midterm (15%) and a final (25%). Discussion also counts toward your grade and is worth 20%. Better show up for discussion and get ready to participate!

Loved this class.  He is very worldly and gives great lectures.  I'd say you don't have to go to lecture, but either way you really have to do the reading. The syllabus outlines everything and the quizzes and tests are easy as long as you read, since questions are usually trivia about the story like "what animal did the old man turn into" etc.

Prof. Ye is a powerful and engaging professor. You must keep up with the readings to pass the class. Four quizzes are given, and are easy as long as you read and study the notes given during lecture. The plus is that they are MC questions. The midterm and final both consist of identification, MC, and an essay, but you know the prompt beforehand.

Prof. Ye's passionate lectures remind you that literature is the weapon, the power, and the identity of humanity. Read read read, before the week starts. Take notes on texts he specifically refers to during LEC (will be on tests). Tests are extremely easy, just read.  Fantastic, educated, and wise, best describe Prof. Ye.

His quizzes are multiple choice and tests are multiple choice, mix match, and short answers.  It's a really easy class, just read,you have to read since some questions are really specific like where was Beowulf stabbed?  The readings are interesting tho, and he's extremely passionate which makes it easier to learn. He curves the grade. Got an A-

Although it was a very challenging course, I learned A LOT. There are readings every single week and be sure not to fall behind because it'll catch up with you later. Pay attention to lectures no matter how boring it can get. If you put in a lot of effort into this class, you'll do great.
Learned alot eventhough I am a native chinese speaker! I found out sometimes the stuffs that he taught can be challenging but as long as you try, you will get an A for sure!
his chinese class is very easy for chinese native speaker. basically free A

I was one of the 12 people (70 people total in the class) to get an A. So if you want an A you need to be committed to this class/have no life haha. There are 4 quizzes (M.C., fill in blank, identify quotes), midterm, and final. Midterm and final are like the quizzes except more material with an in-class essay. READ EVERY SINGLE TEXT/PIC IN BOOKS!

Learn a lot from him, who is always super-passionated about what he is teaching. A broad knowledge base. His quizzes and assignments reinforce what you learn. Give out assistance every week to students, either via email or in class. Truly, my favorite professor of all time. I don't think I'll ever meet such a great professor again.

He seems to love what he teaches. Questions on quizzes are really specific. Didn't do well on the quizzes and midterm. Did okay on the final and managed to pass the class with a B. He curves the grades.

Professor Ye is a great professor. He is well-read and incorporates many aspects of a cultured world into his teachings. I enjoyed listening to his lectures in World Literature 17A. He teaches with passion, and I can see that he believes in what he is teaching. His exams are not too difficult if you study. Attend lecture and read the book.

Professor Ye is really passionate. You must read to do well on the quizzes and midterms. So don't take this class if you're looking for an easy A, take if if you want to actually learn because you have to earn your grade. He's a great professor, and I learned a lot from him.
Must read the books, actually attend lecture, there is no reason why anyone should get anything below a B-. Since he curves the class average to B-.

Awesome professor. Took his class twice. Wish I always had him. You learn so much from him. It's not an easy class, but if you're willing to work your butt off, take him. You'll gain a lot. I wish this school would hire more people like him.

Great professor. If you're in Chinese culture, take his class. He's a very funny professor and not boring at all. He makes the subject very interesting. Make sure you write down key terms that he mentions though. Do your reading and you'll be fine.

He is probably the best prof I've ever had at UCR. he's class is very interesting, there are a bit of reading and work in his class but the work is not hard if you go to class. He is very passionate, i had him for a few classes, he is so damn awesome.
Go to class, do the reading, and go to discussion, easily passed. A bit of reading but most passages are enjoyable.

Had him for Chinese Cinema. Really nice guy and very fair. He's really passionate about his work and it keeps his class really interesting. Need to go to class, he doesn't lecture from the book but has quizzes based on the book. Also have short papers based on films. He is particular but do as he says and you'll be fine. Probably my favorite prof.

Had him for Chinese Cinema.  Lectures are essential to pass the final, but they are kinda interesting to go to. He is 100% fair on grading quizzes and essays. He is a very kind and passionate professor. One of the bests at UCR. I definitely recommend. His class was pretty easy. Though if you do NOT put effort in this class, don't expect an A.
He is fantastic.  As long as you do the reading it is impossible to do poorly.  He does have an accent, however it was not difficult to understand.  I recommend his class.

He may expect a lot of reading and attention to detail, but he is truly an awesome professor.  He is very passionate about what he does, which is easy to tell.  I would recommend him as long as you have an interest in literature.

Professor Ye is clearly one of the best professors on campus! He knows what he is talking about. Thought lectures can get boring at times, it is a very interesting class. Go to the discussions and read the readers. If you put your effort into this class, you'll do well!!
very strict read text pay attention in class and take notes
avoid

Very passionate about what he teaches which is infectious.  However there is a lot of reading.  He says that if you just do the reading and keep up on it you will do well on the quizes which is very untrue.  The quizes are very hard and pick out random details that could have been easily passed over or forgotten on accident.  Otherwise good teacher

Stupid punks told me he's cool and now its the 4th week and I'm dying.  I read everything and he makes his freaking exams so difficult, I now have to do pass, no pass grade option because getting a good grade is near impossible due to his Harvard standards.  Nice guy, but too arrogant.

His English is VERY hard to understand. I know on my essays I would have done much better if he worded the prompts in better English. His lectures ARE HARD to understand, following his handouts and when you hear a keyword jotting down what he says is imparative. TONS OF READING FOR SUCH A SHORT CLASS!!! Quizzes are a little difficult.
I don't understand why others seem to like this professor so much. I couldn't get over the fact that he didn't speak to half the class.

His passion for film definitely comes through, which is always a plus.  Weekly writings are a little difficult to get an A on - picky on grammer.  Just show up to class and do all the assignments and it'll be a breeze.  Oh yeah, no FINALS!

Truly the best professor I've ever had at UCR... He's passionate about what's he teaching, which makes the class very interesting. He's also fair in grading, just make sure you don't miss his class a lot :) I love his class!
he made chinese poetry came alive.  one of the best professor I've had.  highly recommended.

This is not an easy class if you don't pay attention and take notes..but he is very very knowledged in chinese..as a chinese speaker he is HARD. so if you are not even native don't even think about it.

Easy class if you attend lectures. Prof Ye is really laid back. Get easy kiss up points by visiting his office hours and writing him emails. Possibly good candidate to have to write my reccomendation letters in the future.

She is rude so be prepared for sassy or smart remarks. A lot of reading and she will call on you in class to see if you read. Despite this, the material is not hard. Everything is easy to undertsand and comprehend, you just have to put in the work. I enjoyed the readings and topics being discussed so I was able to ignore the prof for the most part.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took her class ETST003 for the summer, and I do not recommend it. So much reading, and a very, VERY tough grader. The amount of reading and writing is abysmal, and so is the grading criteria. Avoid yourself the heartbreak and do NOT take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Assigns a lot of readings, is a tough grader, accepts no late work, calls on people randomly, gives sarcastic/annoyed answers to basic questions when she feels like the question is stupid, and just seemed not to enjoy her job by the end of the quarter. She's a kind, smart woman who cares about her students, but many teaching methods feel outdated.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Structure was terrible. No slides or lecture, just read and talk about it for the next hour and 20. Calls on random people & sarcastically jabs at people who don't have much to offer. If you don't do the readings or contribute be prepared to be called out. It felt like being in a high school class. Save yourself the headache and avoid at all cost.

I feel like we have to read 100+ pages a week. She is intimidating. Feels very much like high school- like constantly calling on random ppl or making ppl feel belittled for not having as much to give during discussion. It just seems weird. Lotssss of reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lots of group projects and assignments. She can be passive aggressive but she was honestly funny and gave lots of opportunities for extra credit. People that have problems with her just want and easy A.
She will mark down sooo many points for no reason and is not approachable for help
All she does is yell at the class and talks about her son.. She never actually goes over material in details and then yells "if you make blah blah mistake 0 points"

I never thought I would use Rate My Professor, but I really don't like this professor. Very disorganized, unclear lectures, lots of homework, and overall bad vibes. She was also mean to me one time in class for simply volunteering to participate. Also, like other reviews, she is very passive-aggressive. Do yourself a favor and AVOID her!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She started the class by yelling at us today and continued to yell the entire hour.

She treats her classes terribly and then blames it on her own family issues to cover up. She is uneducated and I feel so difficult to speak up because she will blame for not knowing. I feel like I am not learning the materials that should be preparing me for future spanish classes. Imconfused on why she behaves that way.
Super super passive agressive, picky, confusing, unclear about instructions, rude. I could go on. She deserves to be fired I wont lie

All of my emails inbox are from her. She sends out too many emails and all of her assignments she is super picky about what she expects and is not clear. Then she yells and complains at us that we do not listen. How do you expect every nit picky things on our assignments then not be clear then yell at us?? What kind of prof is this
Exam every other week, project every week, extreme amount of homework almost every day.

Professor is disorganized. She is a very harsh grader and is not clear about what she wants on assignments. She deducts points because she feels like it and expects us to remember all her rules. No rubrics.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She honestly wastes class time and expects you to understand everything. If you want to teach yourself Spanish, have way too much homework and projects this class is for you.

I took her for spn001 and now 002, ONLY BECAUSE i need the credits. I should'ev done this class at a CC, she is disorganized with her work and during spn001 and she told our class that she is not going to be giving us a final. Spn002 she is still the same. Way too much hw and projects that are tedious

I agree with the review below me. she gave me a really poor score on the first exam and marked me off for many tedious things. Considering how much work/project/exam/hw she gives us each week, she needs to really chill. So far none of her teachings make sense because it is so messy. I hope she reads this review and take into consideration.
I've never met a prof as passive agressive as her. Her instructions and teachings are all over the place and I will not be taking her again. She needs to fix her attitude before she teaches

The material was easy to learn and straightforward. I appreciated the helpful slideshows she made and the workload is heavy but manageable. However, I found the professor to be hostile, passive aggressive, and overall unprofessional. I would recommend avoiding this particular professor and choosing someone more mature and less ill-tempered.

I took this class as an elective course, and heard bad things about it, but I genuinely enjoyed taking this class with la professora. She genuinely cares about her students' understanding of the material and uses fun activities to keep us engaged with the concepts we were learning. If you need to take a Spanish class, take it with her !!

I LOVED Yolanda! Her class was really easy; she gave out HW daily and tests every 2 weeks on Thursdays. She gives out hella EC; I'd recommend doing them just to keep your grades up. She will grade sort of harshly but she's very chill!

I really enjoyed Yolanda's class, she was funny and you can tell that she genuinely cares about her students. Even though she gives out a lot of homework, it is for a good reason and she is understanding if you need an extension.

The teacher was unhelpful and was passive aggressive. She told us that she wanted to cancel our final, but some students she didnt like would pass, and she didnt want that. Then she acted like it was their fault, as if shes not the one in control. Also, there are mandatory daily assignments that are out of 0, if you miss its -2/0(a negative score).

This was a fun and easy class. Honestly, just try to pay attention in class and participate, and you will do just fine. She is hella funny and definitely makes class entertaining. If you're a weenie who isn't trying to pay attention, you might not do too well. I did aight in school and found this class to be pretty easy.

Lots of homework, but for good reason. She will mainly lecture in Spanish, so if you're like me and have no prior experience, you'll need to review power points a little more. As long as you do your work and ask for help, this class should be an easy A. She is strict in the important places, otherwise she's very understanding.

Wanna do nearly 10 assignments per week with no consistency in the due dates? Wanna be taught entirely in the foreign language you don't even know yet? Wanna get zeroes on major assignments with next to no feedback whatsoever? If you answered yes then boy howdy sign right up! You'll be stressed to the brim in no time! Seriously, avoid at all costs.

You will only have an advantage if you have some sort of prior experience in spanish. She gravitates towards teaching them more than the new students with 0 experience. Very strict on timing very strict on grading very strict on participation no second chance points her powerpoints are all in spanish and she teaches all in spanish lol. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Never thought I would feel bad about not knowing a language that I was trying to LEARN. She had no patience for students who struggled more with learning Spanish. I came here to learn not to be verbally put down by a professor. Definitely not worth anyone's time, money or mental health.
This class was pretty easy and she's a good teacher. There's a lot of work, but it really isn't that hard just a little tedious. Not hard to balance with other classes.

Highly recommend Professor Cardenas. Was accommodating if you happened to get covid, you could attend via zoom. Always responded to emails very quickly. During class, she calls on each person but isn't mean if you get it wrong. The exams are not bad just ask questions/ follow the study guide she gives. You'll do great. Truly cares about students!

Lots of assignments, lots of tests, and a few presentations. The UCR curriculum for Spanish is difficult as the workload is pretty heavy for an intro class. Highly recommend going to a Community College for Level 4 language requirement.

She is the worse professor I have ever had. She is rude to students who do not understand. She does not leave any corrections on wrong work & is consistently unclear with directions. She will also not meet with students that need help if she overschedules herself & the placement exam takes priority over her students. Is not working well with COVID
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She may give a lot of homework at the very beginning. She is very educated. If I have more time, I would like to take with her again. She is not a tough grader. Spanish 3 is very hard, but she always helps students by using her office hours and offering extra office hours. She always takes care of students who have a hard time to take the class.

She is a very professional professor. Although the attendance is mandatory, she is not very hard on it. If you are late for one or two minutes, she will not mark you down, although other professors might. She usually offers extra help for the students who have hard time to learn Spanish classes. She answers students' questions. She is respected.

She is one of the worst professors at UCR. Beware.. during the pandemic, she is very inconsiderate of her student's feelings. Every little mistake you do she WILL take-off points. A student voiced his concern about having a hard time during the pandemic and she basically told him to shut up which is highly inappropriate.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lol, just choose another professor honestly. The majority of the time she's on the whole classes ass about their work. She's very rude and is inconsiderate about other peoples lives and then complains about her own. Just choose one of the other professors, it will save you a migraine.

Hands down the worst professor I've ever had in my life. I was so desperate to leave her class I emailed my advisor to see if there was ANY spanish class I could take that wasn't hers. Rude, unprofessional, and uneducated. She will get mad if you ask her a question and accuse you of not paying attention in class for asking
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Worst Spanish professor I've ever had! She spends most of the time talking about her personal life rather than teaching, she speaks way too fast for Spanish 3 level students, and she would be on her phone during our test and watch videos with the sound on! DO NOT TAKE HER IF YOU CAN! Honestly the ppl who take her class and like her are brainwashed!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I LOVE THIS WOMAN WITH EVERY INCH OF MY TINY AND FRAGILE HUMAN EXISTENCE!! Had her for Spanish 1, 2, and 3. So bummed she's not teaching Spanish 4. La amor de mi vida. At first it's hard to warm up to her, but she is hilarious and super genuine. She really cares about her students and will make sure you understand the material. Her class is great!!

Love this woman! So incredible and kind and funny and generous. Even if you are not great at Spanish she will work with you and notice your attempts to improve. A good teacher that makes you work for the A instead of just handing them out is the one that everyone wants and needs. :-)))))))
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Can be confusing at times. Did not spend time with us practicing for the pronunciation test ( and there were some words I did not know how to pronounce). Did not really help on the final interview ( did not feel fully prepared). Extra credit is when you go to tutoring outside of class. Have a test/composition every Friday.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Would go to office hours, tutoring, email her, talk with her right after lecture, BUT she will put me down and tell me you are going to fail. I did all the online homework, booklet work, and more, but she is just difficult. All we do in class is talk to each other, she doesn't teach AT ALL. If you're stuck taking her, then good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Let's just say she's so amazing that I am willing to move around my schedule to make sure I can have her for all of my Spanish requirements. One of the most helpful personable hilarious professors out there. She is so real and will help you but only if you put in the work too. Don't expect a candy tray but she will help you!

Yolanda was a great professor. She really puts in the effort to make sure you understand the material. She's tough, but I learned a lot from her. She's very accessible outside class and tries to make lecture fun. She's understanding if you have an issue and very helpful. I would definitely recommend her.

Yolanda was a really awesome lecturer! She really cares about the students and I would recommend her to anyone who is planning on taking spanish. The class itself is heavy with work and tests, but that's a department thing. She gives a lot of hints and help in regard to tests and even brings food for the class at least once a quarter!

Office hours were always there and always helpful when needed. Yolanda is a very understanding and open teacher, always friendly and willing to go the extra mile to make sure her students are learning and understanding the material. As long as you give effort she will reciprocate, she will gladly help you. She's always fun in class.

Whe requires way too much work and teaches the class like the students are spanish speakers. She would mark off points if we even came even a second late to class and only gave us 5 minutes to complete a 10 or 15 minute quiz. She didn't even give us the whole class time for midterms either.

I took her summer class at RCC and loved her.  She wants you to learn the language.  Don't be afraid to go see her, she is amazingly helpful.  She wants everyone to do well.  She seems to love being a teacher.
Spanish 2 was great!!! She graded fairly easy, she cares for all students, she is just all around great.

Yolanda is awesome. She made spanish two really interesting and fun during summer school. She covers material very clearly and always asks questions afterwards. I really enjoyed her class, she is very funny and entertaining.

VERY VERY GOOD TEACHER. she loved me ! and the rest of the class too.  she's so nice and caring and laughs at jokes only we find funny.  she's dope and is just like a student herself. :D  the best! take her class!
Hola mi cielo, yo te amo, ella es muy bien. She is cool. Take her and learn and have fun. Memo.
She's very understanding; go to her office hours to get help; u will get a good grade if she knows u're trying.

**MONEY IN POLITICS** Extremely tough grader, does not ask clear questions on his tests, gives hundreds of pages of readings, and wants you to cite it directly for the midterm and the final or you get a 0, 2 weekly quizzes every week, and if you don't cite down to the page or second of his lecture then you get a 0. save yourself the trouble.

Provides lecture slides with barely any useful info on it. Makes you read the textbook, pretty much teach yourself the material. Emails you 4 in the morning about course materials, ends up waking me up.

Practically reads the powerpoint word for word, then post them online thus making it pointless to go to class. The powerpoint is structured around the textbook chapters so if you read the slides and read the textbook, you don't have to go to class. Tests have very specific/unfair questions from the textbook and powerpoints.

No electronics with some exceptions. Slides posted after class. You can read the whole textbook thoroughly and pass/ get good grades. Well-versed as a PhD in PSC but teaching and PowerPoints don't help much (or not at all) for students. Teaching style not suitable for lecturing for 80+ people. Frankly, powerpoint

reviews.comment: his tests are so annoying. SOOOOOOOO annoying
Asks students to read way too much, lecture notes are too general and are not really on the exams. No extra credit, no study guides, no review sessions
Reads off lecture notes.  Doesn't give study guides or any help towards tests.  Avoid if you don't like learning about US Congress and campaign finance stuff.

If you're good at reading & memorizing, then this class is an EASY A.  Lectures are boring but if you KEEP UP with the readings, you'll be in REALLY good shape b/c the tests are basically key terms and concepts straight out of the book.  Two essays based on readings a tad difficult. GO TO SECTION b/c that's where all the important info comes from!
Grades Hard, Most BORING lectures usually with 50% of people nodding off and 10% sleeping. Tests are easy if you read the book cover to cover and memorize all the specific details.
too self-righteous, thinks he's all that because he's a young professor.  Tries to act cool by grading hard.

Professor was pretty cool.midterm wasn't so bad but papers are graded pretty roughly...i pulled an A- on the midterm but got a C+ on the paper...don't u see something wrong here...DO NOT I REPEAT DO NOT TAKE 'CURTIS' as ur TA...he is HORRIBLE!he started giving us weekly assignments in discussion to recieve full credit also grades too hard on paper
easy, hot, but boring
This class was really challenging, but Yoshinaka is a great professor.  He explains things really well, plus he's really good looking.

Lack of effort in providing practice material and is harsh on minor mistakes. 
Focuses on memorization instead of deep comprehension. 
Changes syllabus the day before grades due.
You should stay consistent with the course material. The professor is very helpful, and the midterm and final exam questions will be based on the assignments and practice sets.

The professor is so knowledgeable and helpful. He was reachable too and responds to emails so fast. You need to study hard and not to procrastinate because the topics are cumulative. For the homework assignments, you receive your grade based on completeness, not correctness. The lab has 40% of the grade though.
Not clear with any instructions, constantly changing syllabus, exams based on pure memorization

Do not take this professor for CS180, the syllabus might well have not existed with how vague it was, his tests are testing your memorization and not your understanding of concepts and he grades group projects by amount of lines you contributed. No other professor has ever graded projects like this because everyone knows its dumb ah.
Syllabus is not clear, practice exam is rather vague, exams is based on rote memorization.

I had Professor Zhao for CS 152 and he was one of my favorite professors. However, don't take CS 180 with him. His exams heavily rely on memorization. When he saw over half the class failed the exams, instead of curving the grades, he made the exams worth more which is completely backwards. CS 180 with him is simply a much worse version of CS 100.

Professor Zhao was very accommodating to the strikes happening and gave many extensions for the final project, he also graded very fairly for how little help we got from our TA. Exams are very fair with no trick questions and homework is not long, with 2-3 questions for each assignment weekly. Study up and learn, his lectures are good!

The exams and assignments are not hard if you follow his lectures.
Like the pace of lecture giving.

reviews.comment: Perfect lectures. Intermediate level project. Focuses on exams and assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Zhao is a super caring professor. His speaking skills aren't bad. He is very clear and has a wide range of knowledge. He is also really approachable, so don't be afraid to go up to him for office hours and such. Really great guy!

Open notes tests. You NEED the notes. 2nd half of class is harder to understand without going to class because the slides suck. You don't have to go to the first half.  2 presentations. Graded by the class.  This is a project based class so most of the difficulty is based on how well you work with your team and the difficulty of the project.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Great professor, encourages class participation and made lectures enjoyable. She provides you with the project prompts with the syllabus, all of the projects were fun to work on.

Professor Zieger is very professional and respectful of her students' ideas. She encourages participation in lectures and I enjoyed the conversations we had as a class. This was definitely the most fun I've had in an English class, and both of her TAs were excellent. The projects were very creative and encouraged thinking outside the box!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Loved her! Very sweet person and great professor. A lot of powerpoints but she explains very well. Final and midterm were pretty easy too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I didn't get to connect with her much because this was a really big class, but I would love to take a smaller class with her. A lot of reading but she made books that I would normally find boring really interesting. You don't have to stress about keeping up with readings to pass, but she makes you want to do them anyway

Amazing teacher!!! I only read one of the texts out of like 5 and passed with an A+. Her lectures are super helpful and she goes into good detail about the reading in class. Not a hard grader at all, but the themes discussed in class are extremely interesting. I was never bored in her class, and her questions really made me think.
This class was extremely enjoyable! An easy course with a lot of reading. Professor always brought a positive attitude!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr.Zieger is a very good professor. She had 2 projects that are really easy. Final is easy. Attendance matters, the class is mostly graded on attendance and she does attendance quizzes. The class is A LOT of reading like sometimes it took 2 hours to finish the readings which made it hard to complete other assignments. Attendance is worth 30 points!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It was clear that Zieger was passionate about british lit. Her lectures were great & very informative. She had a strict rule on attendance & leaving class early, however. Lots of reading for a ten week course but expected for english majors. so thought about changing majors & decided not to after this course due to the reading & papers. Easy final.

Dr. Zieger is very passionate about what she does, and I found her class to be very unique and fun. Her class is however VERY reading heavy, it's only expected of an English class. Participation is also a must as well, I had to learn this the hard way when my grade dropped to a B-. Overall Dr. Zieger is a wonderful teacher. (She's also a BABE too)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Zieger was very passionate about British Literature and was very knowledgeable. However, she has a strict attendance policy and is not very fond of students who have to leave lecture early. She changed the attendance policy mid-quarter due to her experiences. Would not recommend if one is balancing other commitments.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Brilliant professor. Lovely to look at too!

Great Professor with interesting ideas! Took her twice and I'm glad I did. She really pushes good reading and writing habits and is more than willing to help during office hours. Sometimes her grading surprises me (I'll get an A when i feel like its a B and I'll get a B when i feel like it should be an A). But overall i do recommend!
Zieger is a sweet person, but she seems jaded at times, and her lectures left something to be desired. If you know your stuff, expect to not be called on.
She is a good teacher and explains material well, but she is a bad person, doesn't respect her students, is rude in class, and she is an unfair grader.

She was a great professor and always came to class prepared. Everything she said was clear and concise and she gives you everything you need to pass. The tests were fairly straight forward as long as you read and attended lecture. All in all I recommend taking her. Her lectures are brilliant!

Zieger is by far one of my favorite professors at UCR! I have taken three classes with her and will love to continue taking her. She is a very caring professor that will make sure you engage with the material and walk out of her class a learned person!

extremely amazing helpful brilliant professor, she carefully explains what she wants you to get out of the course so as long as you do the work you will get an A. I woul take any class she taught!! Amazing.

Professor Zieger is awesome. She's intelligent and passionate about what she studies and teaches. She throws some advanced ideas at her students but they're understandable if you come to class regularly and do the reading. She's approachable and one of my favorite teachers I've ever had. Signing up for her next class ASAP!

dr zieger is one of the best professors at UCR. She isn't easy but if you study and take good notes it's Easy to get an A on her midterm and final. she also asks you to write one paper and I recommend yougo to her office hours. she is extremely approchable and helpful in making your papers better.

Dr. Zieger is tough, but fair. This was the 1st time she taught 102 and she was fantastic. The paper is a bit tough, but she is always there to help her students. It's a lot of reading and discussion, but thats what an English class is and you learn a lot. I highly recommend her and cant wait to take another class with her.

Have taken her several times, and she is fantastic. Reading some of the complaints about her, all I have to say is if you are going to take a class, ANY class, you have to do the work for that class. Common sense. You don't take Chemistry and assume you're the exception to going to lab. If you do the work, her classes are very rewarding.

This teacher is just okay. I took her class as a first year Engish major and was very excited about it, but as someone else said, she acts like you are a lit. major, which is really frustrating. A lot of reading and lecture can be a little inconsistent and confusing.Go to lecture if you want a good grade. (Tough essays also!)

She is very nice and helpful. Anyone who says that she's aweful apparently did not prepare appropriatly for her classes! Do the reading and put some analytical though into it, and you'll do great! If you do poorly in her class, you shouldn't be in upper div. Eng. because she really is a great professor. Ive had her twice now.
Great class, material was interesting and the professor is kind, caring and helpful. The lectures were fun and she was willing to change anything that didn't fit. Overall a great professor!

Very nice woman, a little serious though.  She really wants you to learn and will help you if you have problems.  She encourages classroom discussion which is good.  She seems to water down the material a little; I would have liked to learn more about her own research in the subject.  Overall, highly recommended.  She grades high too!  Take her!

Her lectures are very helpful to understanding the reading material.  She gives a lot of sociohistorical background information. Her grading is fair, but not easy-it helps to go in for help during office hours. She is always willing to help students. She obviously enjoys teaching and wants students to enjoy her class.

Always prepared and exposes other ties to the works of literature, bringing them to life by taking us back in time. Great professor and always willing to help and find the answer to every question wholly.

She's one of the hardest prof. i have had but you can tell she loves teaching and she great at it.  I'v taken her twice and both times i learned a whole lot that was useful in other classes.  If you take one of her classes the best advice is to go to her office hours.  She's always willing to help out.

Wow, it was rather interesting because she actually refused to grade my paper for a while due to the fact that she thought i was cheating. She based this on the fact that I recieved a C on the first paper and the new paper was "such an improvment" from the last. Yet, when I went into her office to talk to her about my paper to prove that the paper was based upon my own ideas she ended up giving me a B on the paper..... That seemed extremely fishy to me
She wasn't very helpful at all. I dislike her class immensly.
I think she's a great professor, and very fair.  She's also really nice, and wants her students to succeed.
A little redundant and boring, but I overall enjoyed the class and I got an A, so I can't complain!

She is incompetent! All she can do is read off notes, and questions from student are shrugged off. She really makes UCR professor look terrible and low. She is the bad apple in the group of suburb professors.

This class was filled with boring reading but she made it bearable at the least. She was pretty easy because I barely did all the reading and all I had do was bring up a paragraph and write well in the essays. I turned them all in pretty late too and she still accepted them.
I love 19 century lit. but she was terrible. Don't take her if you can help it. She grades unfairly, and complains.
The worst English professor I have ever had. The class would have been better had she not taught it. She makes students feel stupid, and refuses to help. I wish I never took her.

very good professor. his exams are straight forward. curved the class by a lot. wish i had him again for this quarter but unfortunately not. very organized class and you will be given all of the material you need to study for the exams. all of the homework is online and everything is very organized and structured. I would highly take him again!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I think it may have been zoom learning but the professors lectures over a screen recording of OneNote on a tablet. He did not reply to any of my emails this quarter. He assigns little homework but with extra problems we as students should attempt. However, 1/3 of his final did not match his lecture notes, the book or any problems in his textbook.

Prior to this professor I had a tough time with Calculus in highschool, however Professor Song really helped me understand by showing his work and explaining any unclear concepts. His lectures are just him teaching the new concept then working through many different practice problems. Then at the end of the lecture he uploads everything he wrote.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This guy is kind of whatever. No one attends his lectures because majority of his class is being able to learn how to do the homework and practice midterm. His class was curved by a bit, but not much. If you're good with calc the class shouldn't be too hard, but if it's your first time study trig functions and just keeping doing the homework.

Generally disrespectful guy. Blows past student questions, sometimes holding eye contact before ignoring a student and saying "moving on." Makes students feel dumb. Completely static lecture style, sits behind the desk mumbling into the microphone and scribbling on a writing pad the whole lecture. Crams in many examples without explaining well.

She's pretty nice, but her class is painfully boring. Just show up with some caffeine in your system and you won't fall asleep I guess. Complete a weekly quiz, post 5 two-page discussions over the course of the semester, write a couple "take-home exam" essays, and you'll pass.

I took her ancient history class online at MSJC, I see she was also a literarture professor and now I see why she grades so harshly on her discussion boards and essays! She gave awesome feedback on my midterm which set me up for success in my final essay, because I knew what she wanted. Due well on your papers and you'll be be golden.
Easy teacher. Will give you constructive criticism.

She's really nice and always helps you when you need it. The homework was all book work but really helped with writing the essays. We wrote three essays and the final was a correction of our worst essay or a metacognative reflection. In class we just, well, I'm not really sure what we did. It was an easy class, just do well on the essays.

If you end up with her, don't drop her class, stay with her. She is a really cool and friendly person. Writing essays is what you'll do most of the time. If you do bad, she'll help you along the way to get better. Trust me, if you work in her class, you'll pass. Try to go to office hours when you need the help.

One midterm and final. Exams asked to draw diagrams and you must include all diagrams and all details to receive all the points. So t bother watching the recordings, just study his slides. This class is based off of pure memorization.

In his recorded lectures, his mic is so bad and he talks so low that any background noise (i.e a car passing by) will cut out what he's saying making it unbearable to watch, let alone learn from. Best part is watching the captions trying to auto-generate. I'm sure he wouldn't be able to transcribe his own recordings. prepare to learn from youtube

i was dreading it honestly this class wasnt that bad. your grade is based on two exams that asks you to draw out diagrams and its descriptions, so just study that. i rarely watch his prerecorded lectures as the audio is terrible, but studying his slides was sufficient enough.

1 midterm (61/75), 1 final (93.6/100)  154.6/175  A+. His exams asked for a lot of diagrams drawn from his slides and text with it to explain. His pre-recorded lecture audio is really bad. He tells you to read the book and I did (eventhough you dont need to) because some of the slides and his videos are so vague. Hardly does office hours,annoying
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Horrifyingly bad. Perhaps they were better in person. Set up lecture zoom, prof never came. Claimed to answer discussion during the lecture time, but would often either not show up or ignore Qs. Would not give feedback on exams. Rarely communicated. Had to be reported to the school to hold him to his public announcements. Still went back on some.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Rarely went to class but the times I did go his mic was always messed up and only first 2 rows could understand him. Funny guy but went off on too many side tangents. The midterm and final is literally memorizing diagrams on his slides. Gave us 15 points extra points on midterm and final since average was in 50's. No curve except that. MEMORIZE!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I like Dr. Z as a person but not as a professor. Your final grade is determined by only ten questions that are very specific to a topic so you can have a pretty good understanding of the course material and still not pass because you missed 3 questions. Class is not curved. Hes really hard to hear so sit in the front because lecture is important.

Tries to make lectures fun. Grade based on 10 free response Qs. not available besides set office hours. doesn't respond to emails with detail to answer Qs. can't hear even after he adjusts equipment & even if record is hard to hear still. hires grader & got marked off for something he specified didn't need to write on exam but he wouldnt review/fix

His exams are all FRQ, make sure you memorize all of the slides and the sample questions he gives you. On the midterm, 2-3 questions are usually word-for-word as the ones in the sample. On the final, 3-4 are word-for-word as the ones in the sample. He has an accent, so it might be difficult to understand him, but DO PAY ATTENTION.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: His lectures slides are very unorganized and not very clear. He tends to go off tangent A LOT and talks about random things. Sometimes you can't even hear or understand him. His exams are extremely difficult. You basically have to memorize all the slides in his powerpoint.

This class consists of 4 free response questions for the midterm, and 6 free response for the final. Some of the questions were exactly the same as his study guide, but 2 of them were always different, leaving you to possible fail the class because there is no curve. NOT AN EASY CLASS AT ALL.... I would highly suggest you don't take it

Class is not curved, so missing one whole question is a letter grade dropped. There are only 6 question for the final and 4 question for the midterm. All essay questions. This means you can know most of the material, and still not pass the class. A few practice question were verbatim on the test, but most weren't. Answers on the test require DETAIL
Horrible. i can't understand what he is saying. Memorize all 11 practice problems. No curve so if you mess up, you will get an F or D for sure.

This guy is just awesome. He is by far the easiest professor I ever had. He is very straight forward when it comes to exams and notes. He plays the random-est videos at the start of the class and most of his examples, that are relevant to the topic, are about alcohol. Take him as a professor for this class and you will pass.

Immunology was a lot like his bio5a lectures. Lots of tangent stories and silliness. But in this class it was more straight forward and he tells you what will/won't be on the midterm. 100% memorization for immunology. I suggest getting a cheap/free version of the book. Lectures are unclear.
Wasted a lot time talking about alcohol. Other than that, lectures were not clear. Some exam questions were of material not covered in lecture. Makes jokes and makes class laugh, but at what costs?

Dr. Z is a very funny professor but he gets off topic ALOT! wastes a lot of class time but his midterm is very easy. He makes the class more interesting but expect to do a lot of self studying if you want to do well in this class!

Eh, he was ok. Kind of hard to understand his accent. Talked about alcohol a lot. And went through his slides WAY too fast. I'd have to go home every night after lecture and catch up with the slides posted online. But since it's a science, the material is straight forward. Just study...
Zidovetski was pretty cool, he is very straightforward, and his midterm was easy. He's pretty funny too.

His accent is a little hard to understand so pay attention during lecture. His midterm is ok as long as you study but its hard to ace it. He puts the material on powerpoint slides so you can use those as study material. I recommend this professor.

The sickest bio prof. at UCR! His lecture is pretty decent but its hard to understand him becuase of his accent. Really good prof. He doesnt bored you to death with this lecture because of his jokes and Random music video before class.

I thouroughly enjoyed Dr. Z's portion lectures on Cell Biology.His "alcohol" jokes made the lecture much more interesting.Reading the lecture notes helped me for the first midterm(which Dr. Z wrote).I'll always remember how he played Youtube videos before class started.  I'll have Maduro for Genetics next, lets see how that works out. Take Dr. Z!!!
Lecture was fun but all that I can remember everytime walking out of that class was his jokes and nothing else related to biology.  Reading the textbook secured your chance of getting a good grade.

He jokes around a lot. A little too much which makes you rethink if you should go to class. He is one of the easier bio prof, but you still need to read the book. Definitely a nice curve. You can pass with at least a C by just going to lecture and cracking the book open a couple times. Not hardcore studying, but at least some studying.

hes such a funny teacher. he puts on random videos at the begining of each class. he's a good teacher makes you want to go to class just to hear his jokes but you learn alot if you go to class. he puts everything in his slides and if you study his midterm practices and understand them youll do good on his exams!

Just goes through the slides so it's helpful to read the chapter before lecture. Sometimes he can explain things pretty well. Very helpful and friendly during office hours. Gives sample midterms and finals that are helpful.

He doesn't teach. He just goes through slides and when he does teach, it is helpful but hard to understand. He is definitely one of the easier bio 5a professors at riverside. However, you probably won't learn much so just read the book A LOT.

he should be teaching high school bio for kids. spends too much time showing youtube videos during class time. he's probably a fun person to hang out with outside of class, but not a good lecturer. exams were ok, just make sure you really understand the concepts.

dude... i dunno about this guy.. i mean.. his lecures are so disorganized to me, i had to go to wikipedia to understand the material. Although he gives the actual exam and final question to you before  hand, its still freaking hard. one question entails the whole freaking course!

EXTREMELY entertaining lectures, he is simply hilarious. Lectures are powerpoint and are posted online, but go to class and pay attention because he will tell you what will be on the exam. The book is unnecessary because exams are lecture based. Generous curve, but it is based on class performance.
He is the best lecturer I had all year. His tests aren't hard as long as you take notes in lecture
Greatest teacher I had all year.
koolest guy ever
No Comments

Dr Z is the best teacher i have ever had, he actually teaches, he uses simple analogies for complex material, IF students could use logical reasoning and attended class then maybe they would't give this professor a low rating because of their stupidity
He's an awesome teacher, if the students would listen his tests are also very easy. the test are based on logic gained from the material in class
this guy makes alot of vodka jokes...i know he's russian....i think hes a habitually **** one!

Ok Dr. Z loves to make jokes and tell stories during classes, but you will only appreciate them if you have a sarcastic sense of humor.  For this course, you must memorize small details, and all exams are free response.  Grading is fair, but you must put time in to study.  Funniest teacher I've ever had.

the prof wasnt all that great, his stories were cool and funny, but immunology is by far the most interesting upper division i have taken. The class is a little tough, but if you study his notes you can ace the exam, becuz the curve is sweet. Definitely a class worth taking, not that bad at all!!!
No Comments
Man this guy just plain sucks....his lack of understanding of the material clearly shows his inablity to be a teacher...dont know why he is still here?
No Comments

Zidovetski is an ignorant and arrogant teacher, whose teaching methods are not only ineffectual but comical. His sarcastic remarks do nothing but show his disdain for subject and for the students he claims to teach. Poor technique, poor effort, just poor
rude and put-down

She assigns readings after every class and it is recommended that you do them. She does like to have class discussions. It is important to be very involved and she is great at explaining things! You will definitely learn something new in this class! The time goes by so fast. She is there for you when you need her! An awesome teacher.
she was great help. I loved her class. She gave great instructions.
No Comments
Zina is a great teacher. She gives you an assignment, is available to work with you, and will make sure you get it do. Anyone should be able to do well as long as they try and come to class.
I thought she was great. She's very enthusiastic, and she makes everything really fun.
shes kool, and helps a lot but sometimes shes a lttle confusing
Take it if you are up for the challenge. It is worth your time.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: A good professor with abundant knowledge. And he is also an interesting and nice person who is willing to help students. I adore him very much.
Awesome! All around great guy!

He lays down what he wants and he tests you exactly on what the lectures are about.  He's quite a knowledgeable prof, so you can ask him questions anytime if you're stuck.  You have to regurgitate information on the tests, so I suggest you go lecture!
great teacher

Projects are easy, but tests are hard.  It evens out and grades are fair.  Yes, it is difficult to take notes in his class.  You basically have to just go off and read the book after class since that is what is actually teaching you.
Easy class just go over his slides before a quiz and you'll do fine. His projects are a bit tought and can not be done the night before, but it's still possable.
Did one of three assignments (the first one).  Did all the labs.  Did poorly on the tests.  I still passed.  Easy grader.
Zordan is an okay professor but very very though when it comes to giving final grades. He does not curve and his voice is rather weak. Everything else is okay.

He's very organized during lectures. The slides make it difficult to take notes however. His programming assignments are tough too but grading is lenient. Take his class and you'll actually learn something fun.

Dr. Z is a true professor.  She is very organized and very good at what she does. The amount of work (especially for 110b) can become overwhelming but it is a BCH class what do you expect? Exams are a complete mix of multiple choice, short answer, and calculation (for 110a). Make sure you don't get lazy at the end of the quarter or it will bite you

Really focus on her slides. Don't need the book whatsoever. Got an A-, was REALLY close to an A - she told me 12% of the class got between A-, A and A+. The curve isn't that great for those of you who want an A. It's a lot to memorize, but it's biochem. What were you expecting?

There's SO MUCH TO MEMORIZE from the powerpoints, but if you attend the lectures, study the ppts and go to office hours with questions, you'll do alright. she's really, really good in office hours. she goes out of her way to help students and answer questions. She's also just a really nice lady.

Great lecturer, very clear. The subject a bit dry at times but it's a class I needed to take. She's really helpful in office hours, and by far the most caring professor I've ever had in a science class.  her ppts are really dense but the learning objectives make it easier to study for exams.
Got a B in the class- worked hard, memorize all the important concepts. Stay on top of it and you will get a good grade.
HELLA HARD!!! very organize, lots of slides to study (45 on avg.)
Dn't really need the book...her exams are very fair (A lot to memorize.)Looks like this quarter her curve will suck.Grade- two mids/1 final, hw and quizzes.
It's aight

She is a horrible professor,each of her lectures are on average about 45 slides, which includes wordy explanations and diagrams. She expects you to know all of this, and her coverage of the course is the hardest by far. Avoid taking this woman at all costs, I passed by the scrape of my neck..it is not worth ruining your GPA.

Such a sweet lady, but I hated this class. She tends to mumble to herself, but she thinks everyone can hear her. She goes over a LOT of material extremely FAST. Every lecture has so MANY learning objectives. It's literally impossible to know everything for the final. No assigned HW or req'd clickers. GOOD LUCK.

She is a very nice lady, but not a nice professor.Her exams are extremely specific and there is no efficient way to prep for them.You just have to answer all learning objectives and memorize  everything.The element of luck truely determines how you're gonna do on the exams.Most of the time, the material emphasized doesn't show up on exams.
Dr. Ziegler was a blast to have for Biochem 10. This was her first time teaching the class, but she made it interesting and fun. Highly recommend for students of any major!

She's extremely clear in what she expects of you. If you do learning objectives and understand them, that basically guarantees at least a B. This is course is hard in general, but I think she does her best in easing that for her students with learning objectives. She's also really approachable. Go to office hours! she helps!
Good teacher has a lot of info on her slides but if you know it you'll do good, her test are kind of hard but again if you dedicate time you'll do well.

Study the lecture slides before, during and after lectures.  Repeat this everyday throughout the quarter and you will do extremely in class!  Don't forget to ask question for Dr. Ziegler is very approachable in her office hour.
Very good teacher. Very sweet lady. She's like the Betty White of Biochem.

It's true, her powerpoints are packed with info. A bit confusing at times because you get too overwhelmed. One box would have 2 paragraphs, or so it seems. I'm exaggerating, but you get the point. Don't really need to attend lecture because everything is on the powerpoints. Hmwrk is directly off powerpoint, so they are simple

She is probably one of the most well prepared and caring professors I have had in the sciences.  Her lectures are packed with info, but she expects you to know maybe a fourth of it.  Don't be shy to go to office hours or email her, she sometimes will go above and beyond just to answer a question from a student.  I only wish she taught 110C too!
DO I HEAR VOICES?!

Excellent prof. Exams based on learning obj. and discussion problems. Do your work and study well and you should succeed! Lectures are a bit dry, but the subject is interesting and an actual challenge.

Prof. Ziegler is hard. If you have a job like I do, prepare to quit it. She posts notes online and is eager to help students. A few questions on her exams are quite specific. If you have trouble memorizing facts, you're in trouble. I should note that my T.A said that Prof. Ziegler believes that if you do well, she isn't being challenging enough.

Awesome lecturer.  The learning objectives make studying soooo much easier, and she's really good about posting powerpoints online so if you miss class or miss something in your notes you can get it later.

I had to work really hard in this class.  ACtually going to lecture helps, although the professors usually post the powerpoitns online in case you miss or skip.  Dr. Ziegler is really helpful in discussion sections and her lectures are way clearer than the other prof.

I'm not going to lie, this was a really hard class. I struggled taking organic chemistry (a prerequisite) at another school, and I didn't get the best grade here, either (kind of flaked otu during the end of the quarter).  But the lectures were really clear and well-organized, and Dr. Ziegler goes out of her way helping students.

her lectures are like mini-books and extremely detailed. there is more info than you would ever want, but she's not too bad. exams were quite difficult and engaging, but curve is very generous! she's also nice during office hours and great to talk to.

This is the worst teacher ever. She was totally useless during lecture and the power point slides were not to the point. You are better off reading the book. This teacher does not have the knowledge to teach this class.
Her slides are really long and detailed, and you need to memorize everything about them for her exams. The final pretty much determines your entire grade.

That first student who rated Dr. Ziegler sounds like he/she didn't even try.  Everyone I've talked to had a great experience in her class, and she was always helpful in office hours.  Lectures were clear, the ppts made studying for tests straightforward.  This was one of the hardest classes I've taken in terms of subject, but Dr. Z. made it fun.

Dr. Ziegler is a great addition to the department!  Her lectures are clear, and she's super helpful in office hours.  She's very organized.  She's always willing to make extra time for students, and sincerely wants to help.

Really great professor! Test are based solely on ppt and learning objectives, so you really don't even need the book. Very enthusiastic about the subject and extremely helpful. I never went to class really and got an A.

Really great professor! Test are based sning solely on ppt and learning objectives, so you really don't even need the book. Very enthusiastic about the subject and extremely helpful. I never went to class really and got an A.
She taught very well and clear. Tests were pretty much straight forward. Helpful during office hours. She is very energetic and enthusiastic about teaching
Nah, this prof is great she has learning objectives, she has extremely nice ppts. use learning objects for test everything she teaches in ppts are in test.
lectures way too fast...and does not seem like a very nice person, ostracizes students when you email her a question. expects a lot out of students.

Definitely one of the best math professors I have taken so far. Her exams are JUST like the sample exams she hands out. All you have to do is take some time to study them and you'll pass! Exams are curved so you have a pretty high chance at getting an A on both the midterm and final. I got an A+ on both. Lots of homework, but it's all VERY easy.

Do not see what the fuss is about. She went at exactly the level I would expect a college professor to go at (come on, I had high school teachers who went at the same speed), and her exams are exactly like her practice ones. I was frightened of math, but this was an easy class.
Very hard to understand! Run away from this teacher. The TA's are also terrible. For the mid-term the TA told me the wrong way to solve a problem -.-

The class is not too difficult, but it is extremely hard to understand the concepts. In the end it comes down to formulas though. The professor does teach very fast and is hard to understand during office hours. The TA was also not helpful at all.

HORRIBLE! i hated this class and it felt like torture. i could hardly understand her, she was always making mistakes, and was not a good teacher. so many people did bad in my class that the curve was huge, on my last midterm i only got 14 out of 48 correct and i got a C+.

This professor is mediocre at best. Her accent is unlike any I have heard at UCR. She also speaks and teaches at 100,00 miles per hour, so it's pretty tough to follow along. I would avoid her in the future if possible. I am getting an A+ only because I'm a math god, and I pwn. So, if you get her, make sure you pay attention and go to office hours.
Easy homework, hard exams unless you REALLY studied.

Probably one of the hardest math teachers I've experienced in my entire life. She does not explain the material well and even if you're just whispering, she will get on your case and give you the evil look for the rest of the quarter. DON'T TAKE HER!

exams from this professor is rather hard but the she curves them, which makes the the grades pretty fair. Although she explains the material pretty well in her lecture, it's not necessary to attend her lectures

I honestly wish I could have had another professor. She was comprehensible and her tests were weird. I put in effort in this class and was holding a c. the grade i got on the final was the grade I got in this class. She lacks any knowledge in math and I regret being in the class

Really an excellent instructor. I wish that they were all like her. She would work with you on ANYTHING. Helpful feedback on essays, extensions on essays for no good reason if you asked, always gave benefit of the doubt. Final was painful only due to length. Read, do homework, make an effort on essays and she'll love you - and you'll love her.

She uses textbook a lot and read one novel in the class. The final was based on the novel and it was a take home essay. She is a lenient grader, but writes encouraging comments on your essay. She's one the best English professor in UCR!
She was a great teacher. Very helpful. Prompt responses to emails. You need to participate in this class. Hated english before taking her class, it's not so bad now. I would recommend her to anyone.

She's a great professor! She's very understanding, going to office hours is very helpful. She really wants her students to do great in class and pass so she's very considerate. We used the textbook a lot and it's very useful to write essays. The class consisted of 4 essays and 2-part final, very easy. The essays are worth more than the final.

She was very helpful during office hours. There are four essays+final that is 2 parts. Make sure to keep up with the readings, there's not a lot, since she is big on class participation. She does make you write in class. There's free writes and you do metacognitives the day you turn in your essay. Overall, great class! good luck!
Great teacher and very helpful.

I'm indifferent about the professor—he's fine, but the course design was outdated and disappointing. No real supplemental material and little effort overall. UCR has many professors who excel in course design, but this wasn't one of them. The class needs a major redesign or for him to step aside. I wish I had dropped it and taken something else.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class, you don't show up in the class. The whole grade is assigned by the weekly cases. The case majority negotiates the price, but you and the opposite have the fixed limitation price. Therefore, someone may use unclear way to negotiate, and can lie the limitation getting high scores. Overall, I don't like this style of case homework.

Tries to keep class interesting but negotiation is a dry subject. Almost never finishes class early and can go off on tangents. The grading scale is weird because you are randomly pitted against your classmates, but the class is easy to get B+ and A/A- is pretty doable with a little effort. Good for an elective if you don't know what else to take.

I took CBNS165 (Stem Cell Bio) in person this past winter. The tests are not easy, but she uploads all of her lectures as videos, and they are great resources to refresh knowledge before each midterm. The TA's pre-midterm review is always clutch! The material is interesting and the curve at the end is great! Loved the class!
not a great professor would not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took CBNS 165 stem cell bio w/ zur Nieden summer 22. Was completely online - lectures + notes were posted at your own pace but discussion mandatory. Put in time reviewing lecture for the hw/problem sets - she grades tough. final exam was presentation of ur choice which bumps ur grade A LOT. Keep up with daily review and you'll get an A.

Not a good lecturer. Quizzes are super specific and a lot of times the answer is unclear. The grading criteria for the midterm is vague, and the professor/TAs definitely are looking for specific things that they don't mention in the instructions. Her half of the class was unnecessarily hard in my opinion.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Fairly unprofessional towards the latter half of class, and some of the TA's were incredibly rude. The last week of lectures wasn't even on CBNS101. Inconsistent grading with miscommunication between the professor and TA's. The midterm was supposed to be subjective and based on how we study, but we were graded based on (literal) textbook images.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I had her for CBNS101 & CBNS165 & I've hated both. You need to read in between the lines to understand what she's talking about during lecture and I've also noticed that she spaces out and gives you contradicting info. The only positive is she has no actual "tests" but these are 50/50 (MT/FINAL) classes. Easy to bs but not worth your time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her quizzes were VERY specific. I had to take notes on what she said word for word in recorded videos. Too many recorded videos to watch per week. She had a creative assignment (curved) rather than standard midterm exam. Unclear on grading scale in syllabus. Final grade, she actually increased the cut off. Many got lower grade than expected/deserve
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. zur Nieden is an amazing professor. Stem cell biology is not easy, but she made it pretty amazing. The online format is straight forward, broken down into modules, with each module including an assignment, a quiz, and a podcast. The textbook reinforces the material but all the info is provided on lecture slides and in lecture. Take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: literally attended 2 lectures besides test days. Lecture was pointless. just studied the slides (which there were WAY too many) and read the textbook for clarification.

Her lectures are extremely dense, and way too long, with a lot of filler information that has no value (i.e. history). Going into the first midterm you have no idea what to expect, then you get an exam the size of a final to complete in half the time. The exams itself wasn't hard material, but purely by how many questions there were was draining.
There was essentially no way to study for this class, it was brutal. I got a raw score 83% and the final curve ended up giving me a B. Avoid this class with this professor at all cost.
Very jumbled lecture slides. Hard to follow and not well organized. Would be helpful if practice problems or textbook problems were posted.

This professor was hilarious and I'll admit she's beautiful too. Her funny accent and sense of humor make you love her, but this quarter she only taught half the class. Lectures were extremely long & honestly you could just study lecture slides yourself and be fine.

She's very knowledgeable and has a passion for teaching. She tries her best to keep the class engaged. Also very approachable and understanding. Put in the time and effort then you will get the grade you deserve

I have taken more than one course with professor Zur Nieden and I can say she was great in both. She puts forth a great deal of effort in helping her students and her exams are meant to make you think. You can get an A in her course if you work hard.
She is by far one of the best professors I have had at ucr. She is always willing to make time for you to help you.

worst class ever. her notes are very vague and the last half of the quarter the ta taught and she is horrible too. hw problems cover stuff she hasn't gone over yet and ta favors those that work in her lab or next to her lab. ta grades really hard and expect an essay out of a question that literally say define a term. Avoid at all cost

Best professor I have had at UCR, Even thought the bar is set low, she is by far the best I have had. Clear, helpful, and kind. Pop quizzes and homework are hard though, but if you understand those your good for the tests. The Final is long and difficult because of the amount of info. This class is do able by all means put effort and you good.

The quizzes are lot more difficult then the midterms. I advise you attend lecture and record her lectures or jot down what she says because her notes are a bit vague. Other than that you should be fine and she's also fine.

This professor is very nice to her students! As long as you ask the right questions and approach her for clarifiation on the materials being studied, she makes the learning experience an enjoyable one!

Dr. zur Nieden's lecture notes might be a bit hard to obtain at times, but if the student actively asks questions and visits her during office hours, she seems more than willing to help with understanding the material. She is quite knowledgeable and very accomadating! Her easy-going personality and nice persona makes her very approachable!

Professor's lectures are pretty unstructured so it's hard to tell what the tests are supposed to be like.  It's just a bunch of details, and while the professors says to come to class since she'll mention important things to focus on, that never happened.  Also lecture notes are not posted or are sent out VERY late (a week after the lecture).
